text:
One hot day, Robert and his dad decided to go to the park. They brought their ball with them and once they arrived at the park, Robert wanted to play catch. 

Robert's dad said, "Let's play next to the fence. Be careful and don't throw the ball too far."

Robert played catch for a few minutes and threw the ball very high! But he missed it and the ball went over the fence. 

Robert's dad said, "Oh no, the ball went over the fence. I'll try to catch it." 

Robert's dad ran to the fence and grabbed the ball. He was so happy to get it back. 

Robert said, "Thanks, Dad, for catching the ball!" 

Robert's dad said, "No problem, let's go and find some shade. It's too hot in the sun." 

Robert and his dad went and found some shade and finished their game. They had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a rude boy named Jack. He was always shouting and making a lot of noise. One day, his mom decided to punish him for being so rude. She said, "No more shouting, Jack!" To make sure he followed the rules, she decided to take his mattress away.

Jack was very sad. He went over to his mum and said, "Please can I have my mattress back?" 

But his mum said, "No. You must learn that being rude is wrong."

So Jack started to cry. His mum said, "I won't give it to you until you learn to be nice. Then you will get your mattress back."

Jack was very quiet after that. He stopped shouting and started speaking nicely to everyone.

A few days later, his mum said, "Well done, Jack! You are being so kind now. Here is your mattress back!"

Jack was very happy and hugged his mum. He promised never to be rude again.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty little girl. She had long and curly hair and twinkling eyes. One Tuesday, the little girl and her Mommy went for a walk in the garden. Suddenly, the little girl saw something sparkly and shiny in the air.

"Mommy!" she shouted, pointing to the colourful things up in the sky. "What is it?"

"Oh, that's the birds," her Mommy said, smileing. "They are spraying, like a fountain in the sky".

The little girl watched the birds' dance. They moved around, up and down and around in circles. She said that it was charming and wanted to join the dance. So, she began to wave her hands, jump and twirl around. 

"Oh, look at you, charming little girl," her Mommy said, proudly watching her daughter. 

The little girl smiled, feeling so happy that she could twirl and dance in the garden. She wanted to do it every Tuesday!

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was a little bunny and the other was a little turtle. They were both very slow, and they liked to take their time when they explored.

One day, they decided to go for a walk. As they walked, the bunny found an old bottle of ink that was lying in the grass. She thought it might be fun to paint. So she showed it to the turtle.

The turtle said, "that looks fun! Let's settle down here and see if we can make a picture." So they sat down in the grass and opened the old ink. The bunny dipped her finger in the ink and made small dots on the ground. The turtle used his shell to make large circles. They worked together until they created a beautiful picture.

When they finished, they both felt happy. They looked at their artwork and smiled. They had worked slow and steady, but together they had created something special.

Tom and Mia liked to play in the park. They liked to slide, swing, and run. One day, they saw a big tunnel near the hill. They wanted to see what was inside.

"Let's go in the tunnel!" Tom said.

"OK, but be careful," Mia said.

They held hands and walked into the tunnel. It was dark and cold. They could not see anything. They heard strange noises. They felt fearful.

"Tom, I don't like this. Let's go back," Mia said.

"OK, OK, let's go back," Tom said.

But when they turned around, they saw a big dog blocking the way. The dog was angry and barked loudly. It showed its teeth and ran towards them.

"Help! Help!" Tom and Mia screamed.

They tried to run away, but the tunnel was too narrow. The dog was too fast. They had nowhere to go.

The dog jumped on them and bit them. They felt pain and blood. They dropped to the ground and cried. They wished they never went into the tunnel. They wished someone would save them. But no one came. The dog ate them. The end.

Once there was a little girl called Riya. She was very enthusiastic and always wanted to explore the world. One day, Riya decided to follow her head and see what she could find.

Riya found a tree with beautiful leaves. She touched the leaves and smiled. She then saw a bright butterfly nearby and followed it with her eyes. The butterfly flew away and Riya went after it. She followed the butterfly through the grass and up a hill.

At the top of the hill, Riya saw the most stunning views. After spending some time looking around, she noticed the butterfly had started flying away again. She started to follow it and continued doing so until it was out of sight.

Riya had such an amazing day, following her head and all the creatures she had seen! She was so glad she was so enthusiastic to explore her surroundings.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah was three-years-old and very curious. She loved to explore the world around her.

One day, she went out for a walk with her mommy. They went through a field of tall grass and saw a beautiful landscape. Sarah fell in love with it and looked at it with an adorable expression.

Sarah turned to her mommy and said, "Mommy, why do we not have a landscape like this at home?"

Her mommy smiled and said, "We can get one, Sarah, but we need to study a little bit first. We need to know how to take care of it before we can have one of our own." 

Sarah was excited and started to study the landscape some more. Every day she went out with her mommy and learned something new. After some time, they were ready to have a landscape of their own at home. 

When they got home, Sarah was thrilled to see the beautiful and adorable landscape they had created. She ran around it, playing and laughing. 

And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very curious. One day, she saw a mysterious note on the ground. She picked it up and looked for who had left it. No one was around. 

The little girl opened the note carefully. Inside there was a message that said: "If you refuse to follow the instructions inside this note, bad things will happen."

The little girl felt scared, but was also very curious. She just couldn't refuse! With a trembling hand, she opened up the paper. Inside were two simple instructions: "Just have Fun!"

The little girl smiled with relief and decided to follow the note's instructions. She went outside, ran around the park, and played with her friends.

After awhile, the little girl realized something strange. She hadn't been worried or scared the whole time. She knew that if she had refused to follow the note's instructions, something mysterious would have happened. Instead, she had lots of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to paint pictures with her fingers. She would dip her fingers in the paint and make beautiful pictures on paper. 

One day, Lily's mom gave her a very useful brush to paint with. Lily didn't want to use the brush because she liked using her fingers. But her mom told her to give it a try. 

Lily tried using the brush, but she didn't like it. She wanted to quit and go back to using her fingers. But then she realized that the brush was actually very useful. It helped her make more detailed pictures. So Lily decided to keep using the brush and she became a great painter. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He wanted to go on an adventure, so he packed his reliable luggage with everything he needed. But as he walked to the train station, he was very sad. His train was delayed!

Jack sat down on the bench and looked out of the window. Suddenly he saw his friend Pete walking down the street. When Pete noticed Jack, he ran over to him.

"Why are you here?" Pete asked.

Jack sighed. "My train got delayed."

"Oh no!" Pete said. "Don't worry, I'm sure it will be here soon."

Jack nodded and looked at his watch. Sure enough, just a few minutes later, the train arrived! Jack smiled and waved goodbye to Pete.

"Bye Pete! See you when I get back!"

With that, Jack loaded his reliable luggage onto the train and set off on his big adventure.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack. Jack was very excited because he had a special whistle. He wanted to show it to everyone so he went outside and started to shake it. As he shook it he heard the most beautiful sound. Everyone around him was in awe. 

Jack would shake his whistle anywhere he went and all of his friends followed him. Everywhere they went, people could hear the whistle shaking so loudly. 

One day Jack and his friends decided to take a break and find somewhere quiet. They all found a cozy spot by the river and Jack started to play his whistle again. Everyone around them stopped what they were doing and listened with delight. They all enjoyed the peaceful music Jack created with his shaking whistle.

When Jack was done playing, the group was surprised at how quiet it had become. They all thanked Jack for his wonderful music and went home happy.

Lily and Ben were excited to go to the lake with their dad. They liked to swim, splash and play with the fish. They also liked to find logs and sticks to make boats and rafts.

"Look, dad, I found a big log!" Ben shouted, dragging a long piece of wood to the shore. "Can we make a boat with it?"

"Sure, Ben, that's a great log for a boat. Let's see if we can find some rope and a sail," dad said, smiling.

Lily ran to help Ben with the log. She saw a blue towel and a stick nearby. "I have an idea, Ben. We can use this towel as a sail and this stick as a mast. Then we can tie them to the log with this rope," she said, holding up the items.

"Wow, Lily, you are very smart. That's a good idea. Let's do it," Ben said, nodding.

They worked together to make the boat. They tied the rope around the log and the stick. They attached the towel to the stick with some knots. They made sure the boat was strong and stable.

"Are you ready, Ben?" Lily asked, holding the boat.

"Yes, I'm ready, Lily. Let's send our boat to the water," Ben said, grabbing the other end of the boat.

They lifted the boat and carried it to the edge of the lake. They counted to three and pushed the boat into the water. The boat floated and the wind blew the sail.

"Look, dad, look! Our boat is sailing!" Lily and Ben shouted, jumping and clapping.

"Wow, you two, you made a wonderful boat. I'm very proud of you. Let's watch it go," dad said, hugging them.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion who lived in the jungle. He had a very loud voice and liked to roar. One day, he was walking on a track when he saw a little kitten. The kitten was so adorable that the lion wanted to play with her. But the kitten was scared of the lion because he was so big and loud. So the lion decided to be gentle and not roar. He approached the kitten slowly and they became friends. They played together on the track and had a lot of fun. From that day on, the lion learned that being gentle was just as important as being strong.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she was playing on her lawn when she heard a noise. It was her friend, Timmy.

"Hi Lily! What are you doing?" Timmy asked.

"I'm playing on the boring lawn," Lily replied.

"Why is it boring?" Timmy asked.

"Because there's nothing fun to do on it," Lily said.

Timmy thought for a moment and then said, "Let's play tag! That's always fun."

Lily smiled and they played tag on the lawn until the sun went down. From that day on, the lawn wasn't boring anymore.

Mommy and Daddy were planning a special trip. They told little Sarah that they were going to provide a surprise! Sarah was so excited. She couldn't wait to see what they were providing.

Mommy and Daddy took Sarah to the airport. "We're going to take a trip!" Daddy said. Sarah was so excited.

At the airport, the family got onto an airplane. As they flew, Sarah was amazed with things down below. She saw buildings, farms, trees and rivers!

Finally, they arrived at their destination. Daddy said "Sarah, we are here! We are going to the beach!" Sarah smiled and ran out of the airplane.

At the beach, Sarah splashed in the water, made sandcastles and collected seashells. Everyone was having a wonderful time.

After a few days, it was time to go home. Sarah was sad but also excited to tell her friends about her trip. However, when she got home, there was a bitter surprise. There was a terrible storm and the power had gone out. Mommy and Daddy provided candles to light the darkness. Sarah smiled and hugged her parents. She was happy to be home.

Once a little boy was walking next to the beach when he suddenly heard a noise. He was scared, but he wanted to see what it was. So he slowly walked towards the sound and saw a huge wave. He was so excited, and he knew what he wanted to do! He quickly took off his shoes and ran towards the wave. He held his breath and jumped, and he dived right into the water! It was so cold and refreshing.

After a few minutes, the little boy made it out of the water, and he was so happy. He was still wet but that didn't matter. He ran over to the ice-cream stand to get a treat. The ice-cream was so delicious and it made him very happy.

The little boy was so excited to dive in the wave again and he went back to the beach every day for days and weeks. He had so much fun and he was never scared anymore. Diving in the waves was his favorite thing to do. He was so brave that even his parents were amazed.

Once upon a time there was a naughty sausage. He was naughty because he liked to stay up late and run around. His mom told him to go to bed every night but he wouldnâ€™t listen.

Every night he increased his naughtiness. One night he even jumped on his momâ€™s sofa and made a big mess. His mom was so angry!

But then one day his mom had a great idea. She gave him a big box of sausages. He wanted to eat them but his mom said no way.

She said if he went to bed on time, then he could have one sausage every night. That way, his naughtiness would decrease.

He was so excited and he couldnâ€™t wait to have some sausages. So, he quickly went to bed.

Since then, he has become a good boy and his naughtiness has decreased. And every night he gets to enjoy a yummy sausage before bed.

Bella was a dog who lived with her owner, Tom. Tom was a kind man who gave Bella food, water, toys and hugs. Bella loved Tom very much and enjoyed playing with him in the park. They were happy together.

One day, Tom had to go away for a long time. He said he had to work in another place and he could not take Bella with him. He left Bella with his friend, Jane. Jane was not a kind woman. She did not give Bella enough food, water, toys or hugs. She kept Bella in a small cage and shouted at her when she barked. Bella was miserable and missed Tom a lot.

Bella waited and waited for Tom to come back. She hoped he would not forget her. She dreamed of running in the park with him and feeling his warm hand on her fur. She did not enjoy anything with Jane.

One day, Bella heard a familiar sound. It was Tom's car! She barked and wagged her tail. She saw Tom get out of the car and run towards her. He opened the cage and lifted Bella in his arms. He kissed her and said he was sorry he had to leave her. He said he would never do it again. He said he loved her very much and she was his best friend. Bella licked his face and snuggled with him. She was happy again. She enjoyed being with her owner, Tom.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends named Timmy and Sarah. 
Timmy and Sarah liked to march around the house and have a lot of fun. 
But one day, Timmy was feeling naughty, so he took Sarah's favorite toy and put it up on the shelf. 
Sarah didn't like this one bit and she felt very angry. 
Timmy could tell that Sarah was mad and he apologised for his rude behaviour. 
Then, Sarah smiled and they both decided to march around the house again. 
The end!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jill. She was three years old and liked to explore her garden. One day, Jill was skipping around when she saw something strange on the ground. She found a rare salad and was so excited that she wanted to show her mom.

Jill ran inside the house and shouted, "Mom! Look at this!"

Her mother rushed over and said, "Oh my! Where did you find this?"

Jill pointed towards the garden and said, "Over there!"

Her mother smiled and said, "Let's take this salad to the kitchen and make a delicious dinner tonight. It's very rare to find such a special salad."

Jill nodded enthusiastically and they went inside to prepare the salad.

The end.

The little girl was very excited. She had been walking around the field with her parents. It was a beautiful day and the sun was shining. The little girl's father asked her if she wanted to take a walk and she said yes.

The little girl skipped around the field and played. She saw all kinds of animals and plants. She was so excited that she wanted to pick some of the flowers. Her father let her pick one flower, but not too many.

Soon the little girl's father said it was time to go home. The little girl felt a little sad, but she was happy that she had been permitted to go for a walk in the field. She promised to come back the next day.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was clean. He wanted to do something fun. So he went outside and decided to play in the mud. He splashed and squelched for hours. When he finished, he was covered in mud. He was not clean anymore! Then, he realized it was time to go home. His mom didn't like messes and she was not happy when she saw the boy covered in mud. She made him do extra chores for the rest of the day. The boy was very sad. The bad ending was that he had to do extra work. He learned to be more careful the next time.

Mum put a dessert on the kitchen table. It was a yummy-looking cake!

Dad came into the kitchen. He smiled and said, "Are you ready to wrap the dessert?"

Mum said, "Yes, let's be careful!".

The duo carefully started to wrap the dessert. They used a lot of nice coloured paper. 

When they were finished, the dessert was all wrapped up and looked beautiful.

Mum said, "I can't wait to eat it!"

Dad laughed and said, "Me too!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very shy and didn't like to talk to people she didn't know. One day, Lily was playing with her toys when her mom suggested they go to the park.

Lily was a bit scared, but she really wanted to go to the park. She nodded her head and said, "Okay, Mommy." They got ready and walked to the park.

When they arrived, Lily saw some other kids playing. She wanted to play with them, but she didn't know how to say hello. Her mom suggested she wave her finger and say hi. Lily was nervous, but she tried it and the other kids waved back.

Lily was so happy she made new friends. She played with them all day and had a lot of fun. When it was time to go home, Lily said, "Thank you, Mommy, for suggesting we go to the park." And her mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, sweetie."

Once upon a time there was an orange leak. The leak was always getting bigger and bigger. Until one day it split. The orange leak split into two. Each part of the orange leak was still leaking and getting bigger. Soon the two orange leaks had spread across the floor. But then something surprising happened. A big sunny ray of light came down from the sky and filled the two orange leaks with sunshine. The orange leaks smiled and started to jump and dance in the sunshine. From that day on, the orange leaks never split again and always stayed together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to paint pictures of his favorite things, like trees and flowers. One day, Timmy wanted to paint a picture of a blueberry. So, he went to the store and bought some blueberries.

Timmy started to paint the blueberry, but something strange happened. The blueberry started to grow bigger and bigger until it was as big as Timmy! Timmy was scared and didn't know what to do. He tried to run away, but the blueberry chased him.

In the end, the blueberry squished Timmy and he became a blueberry pancake. It was not a normal day for Timmy, but the blueberry was very happy. The end.

Once upon a time there lived a princess. She was very helpful and kind.
One sunny day, the princess wanted to take a nap. She curled up on a comfy chair and quickly fell asleep.

Meanwhile, a helpful dragon spotted the sleeping princess. It quietly flew down to her and spread out its wings. The princess felt the dragon's warm feathers as she slept.

The kind dragon protected the princess from the sun and birds as she napped. It was so peaceful and comfortable under the dragon's wings. 

Finally, the princess finished her nap. She opened her eyes and thanked the helpful dragon for keeping her safe. The dragon flew off happily into the sky.

The princess went on her way, refreshed and thankful for her nap.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jane and Joe, who lived in the same town.

One day they decided to take a walk together. When they reached the park, they were amazed by the beautiful displays of flowers. Joe picked a charming yellow flower and gave it to Jane. Jane was so delighted that she smiled.

Joe said, "It is for you, Jane. The flower is very pretty."

Jane smiled again and thanked Joe. She said, "It is so sweet of you. I will put it in my room."

The friends then continued with their walk. Everywhere they looked, they saw lovely sights. Joe picked up more adorable flowers and gave them to Jane. Jane's face lit up with joy.

As they walked back home, Jane's room was filled with the charming flowers that Joe had given her. She was very thankful for the pretty items that he had displayed for her.

Once upon a time there was an old turkey named Tom. Tom lived on a farm with many other animals. One day Tom was walking through the farm when he heard a loud noise.

Tom looked around, trying to find the source of the noise. He saw an old tractor rolling down the hill. The tractor was going too fast and heading straight for a pond on the farm. 

Tom quickly ran over to the tractor and shouted, "Stop!" But the tractor kept going. So Tom did the only thing he could think of: he grabbed onto the front of the tractor and held on tight. 

The tractor came to a stop just before it hit the pond. Everyone on the farm was amazed that Tom had saved the day. 

Tom smiled and said, "I'm a hero!" and all the other animals cheered. From then on Tom was known as the brave turkey who saved the farm.

Once there was a band. They played music every day and everyone liked them.

One day, they decided to improve. They wanted to be even better, so they practiced and practiced. They made sure they played every note perfectly.

The band became very competitive. They wanted to be the best ones around. So they decided to go on a big stage and give a performance.

When they arrived at the stage, everyone cheered. Everyone loved the band's performance and they became even more popular.

Now, the band is very successful. They have lots of fans and get to play lots of shows. They are always looking for ways to improve and be the best band around.

Jack and Sara were best friends. They skipped around the playground together. One day, Jack spotted a plastic toy in the sandbox. He was so excited and decided to pick it up. But when he did, Jack started to worry. He was sure a little bird had been nesting there.

Sara noticed that Jack was worried and she said, â€œDonâ€™t be afraid, Jack. Letâ€™s put the plastic toy back.â€ So they placed it back in the sandbox, making sure it was safe and sound.

The two little friends skipped away, feeling glad that they could help out the little bird. They loved playing together, and they knew they could rely on each other. Jack and Sara were best friends forever.

The cat was very happy. It had new red toy. The toy had buttons that lit up, and made funny noises. The cat loved to scatter the toy all around the room.

Then one day, something else landed in the room. It was big and square and made beeping noises. The cat had never seen it before. It was a computer.

The cat was afraid at first, but before long it realised that it was ok. It started to explore the computer. It scatter the keys and studied the buttons. The cat had great fun playing with the red computer.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends went on an adventure in the forest. They walked and walked until they found a dark cave. 

Lily's friend said, "Let's go inside!" But Lily was scared. She said, "It's too dark in there, I can't see anything." Her friend said, "Don't worry, I'll point my flashlight in the cave." 

So, they went inside the cave. It was very dark but the flashlight helped them see. They found a treasure chest! But when they opened it, they found a scary monster inside. The monster was not modest and attacked them. Lily and her friends ran away as fast as they could. 

When they got out of the cave, they were safe but scared. Lily said, "I don't want to go on adventures anymore." Her friend said, "Me neither." And they all went home.

One day, a 3-year-old boy was playing in the barn. He was eager to learn and explore new things. As he was walking around, he saw a basket of apples. Although he wanted to take some, he resisted the temptation. 

Suddenly, a voice called out from the barn door. "Do you want to play a game?" the voice asked. The boy was very eager, he could not resist the offer. He shouted, "Yes!"

The voice revealed itself to be Farmer Bob. Farmer Bob said, "Let's play 'catch the apple' - you catch an apple and I'll catch one. Ready?" 

The boy was excited, he nodded eagerly. Farmer Bob threw an apple to the boy, and he caught it. Then it was the boy's turn. He threw the apple with all his strength and made a perfect throw. 

Farmer Bob could not catch the apple in time. He said, "Wow! You threw the apple so fast. You must have been resisting the temptation of eating the apples in the basket. You are so strong!" The boy smiled proudly. 

The boy realized that by resisting the temptation of taking the apples, he had trusted Farmer Bob and learned a valuable lesson.

Once upon a time there was a boy who loved to explore. One day he looked up at the sky and saw a rainbow. He felt happy because rainbows are so pretty. 

He wanted to touch it, so he ran quickly outside. But when he looked up he realized it was too high in the sky. So instead he clapped his hands and laughed.

As he ran though the grass, he noticed a spicy smell. He stopped and looked around and realized that the smell was coming from a bush full of bright red peppers. He picked one and mindfully tasted it, and then laughed because it was so spicy! 

The next time it rained he ran outside and looked up again and saw the rainbow. He smiled and waved at it and felt happy and excited to explore some more.

Tim and Kim are twins. They like to play in the kitchen. One day, they see a big bowl of lemons on the table. They want to try them.

"Look, lemons!" Tim says. "They are yellow and round. Let's eat them!"

"OK!" Kim says. "They look yummy!"

They reach for the lemons and take one each. They peel them and bite them. But they do not like them. They make a funny face and spit them out.

"Yuck!" Tim says. "They are sour! They hurt my mouth!"

"Me too!" Kim says. "They are not yummy! They are bad!"

They rub their tongues with their hands. They want to get rid of the sour taste. They look for something sweet to eat. They see a jar of honey on the shelf. They want to get it.

"Look, honey!" Kim says. "It is golden and sticky. Let's eat it!"

"OK!" Tim says. "It looks yummy!"

They reach for the honey and open the jar. They dip their fingers in it and lick them. They like it. It is sweet and smooth. It makes them happy.

"Mmm!" Tim says. "It is sweet! It makes my mouth feel good!"

"Me too!" Kim says. "It is yummy! It is good!"

They rub their bellies with their hands. They are full and satisfied. They smile and hug each other. They are glad they found the honey. They do not want any more lemons.

Sara likes to skip. She skips in the park, she skips in the school, she skips at home. She skips with her friends, she skips with her dog, she skips with her mom. Skipping makes her happy and strong.

One day, Sara finds a big weight in the garage. It is round and shiny and heavy. She wants to skip with it, but it is too hard to lift. She tries to roll it, but it is too slow. She tries to push it, but it is too big. She feels sad and tired.

Then, she sees a harmless bug on the weight. It is green and fuzzy and has six legs. It crawls on the weight and tickles it. Sara laughs and watches the bug. She forgets about the weight and skips with the bug. She names it Skipper and makes it her friend. Skipping with Skipper makes her happy and strong.

Once upon a time there lived a fierce lion. He lived deep inside a cave. He liked snoozing in the sun. One day, a brave mouse stepped into the cave. He saw the lion and he was scared. But, he was brave and he knew that the lion would not hurt him. He slowly walked up to the lion and bowed his head. He said to the lion, can I please live here with you? The lion was not sure what to do. He thought and thought and then he softly said yes. From that day on, the lion and mouse were friends. The lion shared his food and his cave. The mouse would always help the lion by cleaning the cave. They lived together and were happy. One day, the mouse made a brave decision. He said to the lion, I want to yield the cave to you. You have been so kind to me, this is my way of saying thank you. The lion was so happy and he thanked the mouse for his kind gesture. The cave belonged to the lion and he was very grateful. The mouse also found a new and safer home. They lived together in friendship, until the end of their days.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily who loved to play dress-up. She would fashion her own outfits from her mom's old clothes and pretend she was a princess. One day, Lily's mom bought her a special present - a dollhouse! Lily was so happy and couldn't wait to play with it. 

But the dollhouse was in a big box and Lily's mom said they had to wrap it first before she could open it. So they got some paper and tape and wrapped the box up nice and tight. Lily was so excited to see her new toy that she couldn't wait for her mom to finish wrapping. 

Finally, the box was all wrapped up and Lily tore off the paper to reveal her new dollhouse. It was so pretty and regular sized, just perfect for her dolls to live in. Lily spent the whole day playing with her new toy, imagining all sorts of adventures for her dolls to go on.

Once there was a little girl named Hannah. She was three years old. One day she was playing with her toys when something special happened. She found a box in her room. Hannah was so excited! She decided to open the box. Inside she found a beautiful doll. 

Hannah was so happy and started to show her doll to her family. But then she realized that the doll didn't have any clothes on. So she began to complain. She said "Why doesn't my doll have any clothes?" 

Her family was very patient with her. They said to her "Let's look for some clothes for your doll." So they went to the toy store and found a nice outfit for her doll. Hannah was so glad and gave her doll a big hug. She thanked her family for being so patient with her and showing her how to find the doll's clothes. 

Hannah was very happy and went back to playing with her doll. She never complained again about the doll's clothes.

Once upon a time, there was a little figure. Everyone liked the figure very much, because it was very thoughtful. But there were two friends who were always teasing it. 

One day, the figure had enough. So it decided to do something. It thought really hard, until it had an idea. The figure asked the two friends to come over. They both came, not knowing what was going to happen. 

The figure said, "I have something for you both. I made it special, just for you." 

The friends were so excited. They asked the figure what it was, but the figure just smiled. Finally, one of the friends said, "Please give it to us already!" 

The figure gently said, "I made this for you because I care. I hope you like it." It was a thoughtful gift that the two friends loved. 

From then on, the two friends stopped teasing the figure. They were happy to be friends and enjoy the thoughtful gift.

She went to her mom and said, "Here is the envelope, mom. What do you want me to do?"

Sara felt guilty. She did not want to lie to her mom and grandma. She took the coin out of her pocket and said, "Mom, I am sorry. I was naughty. I took the envelope and opened it. I also took the coin. I am sorry. Please don't be mad at me."

Her mom looked surprised and sad. She said, "Sara, why did you do that? That was not nice. You should not take things that are not yours. You should not open other people's mail. Sara felt sorry. She said, "I don't know, mom. I was curious. I wanted to see what was inside. I liked the coin. I was wrong. I am sorry. Can I give the coin back? Can I say sorry to grandma?"

Her mom sighed and said, "Yes, Sara. You can give the coin back. You can say sorry to grandma. But you also need to learn from your mistake. You need to be honest and respectful. You need to ask before you take something. You need to be careful with other people's things. You need to be a good girl. Do you understand?"

Sara nodded and said, "Yes, mom. I understand. I will try to be a good girl. I love you, mom. I love grandma too."

Her mom hugged her and said, "I love you too, Sara. I am glad you told me the truth. I forgive you. But you still need to say sorry to grandma. Let's go and mail the card. Maybe we can buy a new coin for her too."

Sara smiled and said, "OK, mom. Let's go. Thank you, mom."

"Let's go and see it!" said Tom.

"OK, but be quiet," said Lily. "We don't want to scare the birds."

They tiptoed to the scarecrow and looked at it. It had buttons for eyes and a straw for a mouth. It looked funny and friendly.

"Hello, Mr. Scarecrow," whispered Tom. "Do you like the wheat?"

The scarecrow did not answer. It just stood still.

"Maybe he is shy," whispered Lily. "Or maybe he is sleeping."

They decided to leave him alone and play somewhere else. But as they turned to go, they heard a voice.

"Hello, children," said the voice. "Thank you for being kind and honest."

They looked back and saw the scarecrow smiling at them. They were surprised and scared.

"Who are you?" asked Tom.

"I am the farmer," said the scarecrow. "I was pretending to be a scarecrow to see who would come and bother my wheat. Some children are naughty and pull the wheat or throw stones at the birds. But you were nice and respectful. You did not hurt the wheat or the birds. You were honest and did not lie."

Lily and Tom felt happy and proud. They apologized for coming too close to the scarecrow and said they liked the farm and the wheat.

The farmer smiled and said, "You are welcome to come and play here anytime. You are good friends and good children. And good children always whisper when they see a scarecrow."

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a strong man. He loved to clap his hands. He clapped all day long. He loved it so much that he wanted to make a special thing. So he went to the store and bought a little tap. He took it home and put it on the wall. Every day he would clap his hands and tap the little tap. He was so strong that he made it bigger and bigger. Soon, people from all around the town could hear the man clapping his hands and the tap. Everyone loved it and the man was so happy.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jane. Jane was very excited because today was a special day. She hopped out of bed and put on her favourite dress. She couldn't wait to find out the news.

Jane hurried outside, skipping lightly. She ran as fast as she could to the big park. When she got there, she saw all her friends. They were standing around in a big, happy circle. 

Jane's friends shouted with joy. They had heard some good news! Jane asked them what it was and they said that everyone was going to get free ice cream! Jane was so happy. 

But then they heard some more news. This time it was not so good. Apparently the ice cream was very bitter! Jane was sad. She had been looking forward to it all day. 

But her friends cheered her up. They said the best thing was to hurry down the street and get to the ice cream shop as soon as possible! So with big smiles on their faces, the friends ran down the street and got their ice cream. Although it was a bit bitter, it still tasted sweet!

Once upon a time there was a jolly girl named Pinky. She lived in a town by a big road.

Every day, Pinky liked to peek out the window and watch the cars go by on the road. She liked to guess what the people inside the cars were doing and where they were going.

One day, Pinky was peeking out the window when she saw a car with a funny looking animal in it. It was a friendly looking pup. Pinky smiled and waved as the car drove past.

The pup saw her and waved too and Pinky was so excited. She ran out the door and chased after the car, following the pup until she could no longer see the car on the road.

Pinky was sad that the pup was gone but she still felt jolly inside. She smiled and went back to peeking out the window and watching the cars go by.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Vera was walking in the woods. She saw an oak tree and said to it, "I wish I could climb you!" Suddenly, a young bird appeared on a nearby branch. He said, "I will encourage you and help you reach my nest on the top of the oak."

Vera was so excited and started climbing with the help and encouragement of the young bird. Soon enough, she had climbed all the way to the birds nest. She thanked the young bird and waved goodbye, as she went back home with a big smile on her face.

Vera learned that with a little bit of courage and a lot of encouragement, anything is possible. She now remembers the oak tree in the woods and the courageous young bird.

Anna liked to play with her cute doll. She named her doll Lily and gave her a pink dress and a hat. Anna and Lily did everything together. They had tea parties, read books, and sang songs.

One day, Anna and Lily went to the park with Mommy. Anna saw a big slide and wanted to try it. She put Lily on the grass and ran to the slide. She climbed up the ladder and slid down with a big smile. She felt happy and proud.

But when she went back to the grass, Lily was gone. Anna looked everywhere, but she could not find her doll. She felt sad and scared. She started to cry and called for Mommy.

Mommy came and hugged Anna. She asked her what was wrong. Anna told her that Lily disappeared. Mommy helped Anna look for Lily. They searched the park, but they could not see her.

Then, Mommy noticed a small crack in the fence. She peeked through the crack and saw Lily on the other side. She was lying on the dirt, next to a trash can. Mommy reached through the crack and grabbed Lily. She gave her back to Anna.

Anna was so happy to see Lily. She hugged her and kissed her. She thanked Mommy for finding her. She said she was sorry for leaving her alone. She promised to never lose her again.

Mommy smiled and said it was okay. She said she was glad they found Lily. She said they should go home and wash her. She said Lily was a very cute doll. Anna agreed and nodded. She held Lily tight and walked with Mommy. She felt happy and safe.

Once upon a time there was a sleepy lion who lived in a jungle with many animals. Everyday he would lay in the sun and take a nap, but he was feeling very grumpy.

One day he decided to let out a big roar. He roared so loudly that all of his friends stopped and looked at him in surprise. The lion was feeling better already!

He told all of the animals in the jungle that he was hungry. Without delay a little orange tiger came running up to him. He gave the lion an orangeâ€”it was so sweet and juicy.

The lion was pleased and thanked the tiger. He took a bite and roared loud enough for all the animals in the jungle to hear. Everyone was happy and went back to playing again. 

The lion was no longer grumpy or sleepy. He continued to roar with joy until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a kind prince who lived in a big castle. One day, he went for a walk in the forest and met a little girl. "Hello, little girl," said the prince. "What's your name?" "My name is Lily," said the little girl. "Nice to meet you, Lily," said the prince with a smile.

As they walked together, the prince realized he had lost his way. "Oh no! I think I'm lost," said the prince. "Don't worry, I can help you," said Lily. "I know this forest very well." 

Together, they found their way back to the castle. "Thank you so much for your help, Lily," said the prince. "You are very kind." "You're welcome," said Lily. "It was fun helping you." And with that, they said goodbye and the prince went back to his castle, happy to have made a new friend.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a fearful little boy named Tim. He was scared of many things, but he was very curious too. One day, Tim had a question. He wanted to know where corn came from.

Tim asked his mom about the corn. His mom told him that corn grew in the fields. Tim was scared to go to the fields, but he wanted to see the corn. So, he took a deep breath and started walking to the fields.

When Tim reached the fields, he saw a big scarecrow. He was scared at first, but then he saw the beautiful corn around it. Tim was happy that he faced his fear and found the answer to his question. From that day on, Tim was not scared of the fields anymore.

Tom and Lily were playing in the snow. They liked to make snowballs and throw them at each other. They laughed and ran and had fun.

But then they saw a big bear. The bear was hungry and angry. It growled and showed its teeth. It wanted to eat Tom and Lily.

Tom and Lily were scared. They did not know what to do. They tried to run away, but the bear was faster. They tried to hide, but the bear could smell them.

"Help, help!" they cried. "Is there anyone who can help us?"

A wise owl heard them. The owl had a special power. It could freeze things with its eyes. It wanted to help Tom and Lily. It flew over the bear and looked at it.

"Freeze, bear, freeze!" the owl said. "Leave the children alone!"

But the bear did not listen. It did not care about the owl. It jumped and tried to catch the owl. The owl was not fast enough. The bear caught the owl and bit it.

The owl's power did not work. The bear did not freeze. It was still hungry and angry. It threw the owl away and went after Tom and Lily.

Tom and Lily screamed. They had no one to help them. The bear reached them and ate them.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He had lots of energy and wanted to use his muscles to work. He decided to help his mom, who was doing the dishes. He thought it was fun to work with his mom. Each time he dried a plate, he showed it off to her and made her laugh. He was so proud of himself. His mom was very happy to have him help. 

The little boy kept at it and next he helped his dad to mow the lawn. He loved pushing the lawn mower and helping his dad. Every time he pushed the lawnmower his muscles worked hard. He was even funnier than usual, yelping and jumping out of the way each time the lawnmower moved. His dad was happy too. 

The little boy was so happy he got to work with his muscles. He felt like he was helping his family and it was funny too. He would see what he could do with his muscles the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a green frog who loved waffles. Every day, he hopped around looking for new waffles to eat. One day, he saw the most delicious looking waffle he had ever seen. But it was too far away for him to get to. So the frog said, "What can I do now?". 

Just then, he noticed a tiny puddle of water nearby. He hopped into the water, and he started to soak up the water with his big, green feet. Slowly, the puddle started to get bigger and bigger, until it was big enough for the frog to reach the waffle.

The frog was so happy when he was able to finally get the waffle. Then he hopped away and ate the delicious waffle. From then on, he made sure to always look for puddles to help him reach any waffles that he might find.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to study and so she often had a candle burning near her bed. The candle was pink. She would use it to study during the night when it was dark.

One day, the little girl's mom gave her a brand new pink candle. She was so excited! She snuggled up in her bed with the candle and started to study.

The little girl was so focused. She read pages and pages until the candle started to run out of wax. The flame was getting weaker and weaker. Finally, it went out.

The little girl was so proud that she had studied for so long. She grabbed the candle and hugged it close. Then, she crawled into her warm bed and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a toy bear named Teddy. One day, Lily was playing with Teddy when she accidentally dropped him on the floor. Teddy's leg broke and Lily was very sad. She didn't know what to do.

Lily's mommy saw that she was anxious and asked what was wrong. Lily showed her Teddy and her mommy said they could fix him. They went to the kitchen and put Teddy's leg under the faucet to wash him. Lily watched as the water went down the drain. Then, they put a band-aid on Teddy's leg and he was all better. Lily was happy again and hugged her mommy.

One day, Wren and Mommy went to the park. All around them were birds singing and little bunnies hopping. Then, Wren saw a tall tree. She shouted, "Mommy, look!" 

Mommy smiled and said, "Let's go see it." They both ran to the tree, and Wren held on tight to it. 

Suddenly, a voice shouted, "What are you doing here?!" Wren and Mommy were confused. Then they saw the voice belonged to a lady.

The lady said, "This is a quiz! What is the name of this tree?" 

Wren smiled and said, "Oak tree!"

The lady clapped and said, "You're right! Good job!" 

Wren and Mommy were so happy, Mommy said, "Let's go home and celebrate!" So, Wren and Mommy held hands and skipped home.

One day, a girl wanted to find something blue. She looked around and saw a navy dress. She thought it looked very good so she picked it up. She wanted to make sure it was the right size, so she sorted through the other clothes. She picked up the navy dress and put it on. 

It was perfect! She smiled and spun around. She was so happy. Everywhere she went, she felt good when wearing the navy dress. 

The girl wore the dress for a long time and when she was done, she put it back where she found it. She knew that someone else could enjoy it too. 

The girl was glad she had done a good job sorting through all the clothes to find the navy dress. She had made the right decision.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very brave. One day she wanted to go and play in a pool. She wanted to feel the cool, blue water. But when she got to the pool, she started to shiver. She was cold and scared.

She had never been in the pool before. She didn't know what to do. She started to cry.

Suddenly, her mum came over. Her mum said, "Don't be scared, Lucy. You can do it. Just be brave and you'll be OK."

Lucy listened to her mum and took a deep breath. She put one toe in the pool, then two, and finally she jumped in! She splashed and swam and soon she forgot to be scared. 

She finished her swim and got out. She felt happy and brave. She knew that if she was ever scared again, she could remember what her mum said.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was only three years old and loved helping her mummy with the cleaning. One day her mummy said to her: "Sarah, would you like to use the mop to help clean the floor?" Sarah was very excited and said yes. 

Mummy allowed Sarah to use the mop. She showed her how to use it, and said: "Don't worry Sarah, it is harmless".

Sarah was very excited to clean the floor. As she moved the mop, she got water everywhere! But mummy wasn't angry; she just laughed and said: "It's alright Sarah - you're doing a really good job!"

Sarah felt very proud of herself and she continued to mop the floor. Her mummy was very proud too.

The end.

Tim and Lily were playing in the park with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it. They were very playful and happy.

But then a big dog came and took their ball. The dog ran away with the ball in its mouth. Tim and Lily were sad and scared. They did not know what to do.

They saw a guard near the gate. He was wearing a hat and a badge. He looked strong and kind. They ran to him and told him what happened.

The guard listened to them and nodded. He said, "Don't worry, I will help you. Come with me and we will find the dog and get your ball back."

The guard took them to the other side of the park, where the dog was. The dog was still holding the ball, but it was not mean. It was just playful and wanted to have fun.

The guard called the dog and threw a stick. The dog dropped the ball and chased the stick. The guard picked up the ball and gave it to Tim and Lily.

Tim and Lily were very happy and grateful. They hugged the guard and said, "Thank you, thank you, thank you! You are the best guard ever!"

The guard smiled and said, "You're welcome, you're welcome, you're welcome! You are very brave and polite. Now go and enjoy your ball, but be careful of the dog. He might want to play with you again."

Once upon a time there was a three year old girl named Lily. She was a very creative and imaginative little girl. One day, when she was walking in the park, she spotted something very interesting. She saw a beautiful symbol made out of twigs and leaves.

Lily was very excited, and she carefully picked up the symbol. When she looked closer, she saw that it was an original symbol. She had never seen something so beautiful before.

Suddenly, Lily heard a voice behind her. It was an old man. He said, "That is a special symbol, young one. I want you to have it."

Lily smiled. She was so pleased the old man was offering her the symbol. She quickly accepted, thanked the old man and ran off with the symbol to show her friends what she had found.

From that day on, whenever Lily wanted to remember the symbol, she only had to look at her hand and feel the original symbol that she had accepted from the old man.

Eli was a young boy who loved to roll around in his bed. One night, he was rolling and kicking his bed so much that he kicked his sheet off of the bed! He was so excited that he continued to roll on the cold ground and soon it became very uncomfortable. He went to pick up the sheet only to find it ripped in two! He was very sad, but he knew he hadn't done the right thing by playing with his bed like that. 

Then his mom came in to tuck him in for the night. She explained to him that he had been bad and that was why his sheet was ripped. She said that he should always take good care of his things and that it was not okay for him to roll on the ground with his bedding.

Eli nodded and said he understood the lesson. He learned that night that when he gets an urge to roll around, he should stay in his bed, or risk something bad happening to his sheet!

Once upon a time, Jack was playing in the park. Suddenly â€“ something mysterious caught Jack's eye. It was a mask! Jack thought it looked cool and picked it up. He put it on and it fit perfectly. 

Jack really liked it and he decided to take it home. When he got home, he showed his mom the mysterious mask. His mom said he could keep it, as long as he took good care of it.

Jack put the mask on every single day. He loved playing with it. One day, while playing outside, he left the mask in the grass. He started to look for it, but it had disappeared! He was so worried and started crying.

But then, Jack remembered something his mom had said. She said that when he loses something, he should always look for it later in the same place - and just like that, the mask reappeared! Jack was so happy that he hugged it tight.

The end.

Anna and Ben went to the park with their mom. They saw a big lake with many birds. They saw ducks, geese, and swans. Anna liked the swans the most. They were white and graceful. She wanted to touch one.

"Mom, can I touch a swan?" Anna asked.

"No, dear, you can't. Swans are not friendly. They can bite you or hurt you with their wings. You have to stay away from them," mom said.

But Anna did not listen. She saw a swan that was close to the shore. She ran to it and tried to grab its neck. The swan was angry. It hissed and flapped its wings. It bit Anna's hand and made her cry.

"Ow, ow, ow! Mom, help!" Anna screamed.

Mom ran to Anna and pulled her away from the swan. She checked her hand and saw a small cut. She took a pink band-aid from her bag and put it on Anna's hand.

"There, there. It's okay. The swan did not mean to hurt you. It was just scared. You should not try to touch wild animals. They need their space and respect," mom said.

"I'm sorry, mom. I was curious. I wanted to see the swan. It was so pretty," Anna said.

"I know, dear. Swans are pretty, but they are not toys. You can look at them from a distance, but you can't destroy them. Destroy means to break or damage something. You don't want to destroy the swans, do you?" mom said.

"No, mom. I don't want to destroy the swans. I want to be nice to them. Can I say sorry to the swan?" Anna said.

"Sure, you can. But you have to be quiet and gentle. And you have to stay with me. Come on, let's go back to the lake and see if the swan is still there," mom said.

Anna and Ben followed mom to the lake. They saw the same swan swimming with its friends. Anna waved to it and said, "Sorry, swan. I won't bother you again. You are very beautiful. Bye, swan."

The swan looked at Anna and nodded its head. It seemed to forgive her. Anna smiled and felt better. She learned a new word and a new lesson. She decided to be more careful with animals and not to destroy them. She hugged mom and Ben and said, "I love you, mom. I love you, Ben. And I love swans, too."

Anna liked to play doctor with her toys. She had a white coat, a stethoscope, and a big book of pictures. She also had a pink x-ray machine that made funny noises. She pretended to check her toys for broken bones and give them bandages.

One day, she asked her brother Ben to join her game. Ben was older and liked to play with cars and robots. He said no, he was too busy. Anna felt sad. She wanted to show him her x-ray machine and how it worked. She thought maybe he would like it if he saw it.

She had an idea. She waited until Ben left his room to get a snack. She sneaked in and took his favorite robot. She ran back to her room and put it in her x-ray machine. She turned it on and waited for the picture to come out.

But something went wrong. The x-ray machine made a loud beep and a flash. Smoke came out of it. Anna was scared. She took out the robot and saw that it was melted and black. She had broken it. She knew Ben would be very angry.

She heard Ben coming back. She hid the robot under her bed and pretended to read her book. Ben came in and looked for his robot. He asked Anna if she had seen it. Anna said no, she did not. She hoped he would not find it. She felt very bad. She wished she had not taken his robot. She wished she had asked him nicely to join her game. She wished she had a different x-ray machine. A pink one.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the park with his friends. One day, Timmy saw a big, scary dog. The dog barked loudly and scared Timmy. Timmy ran away and hid behind a tree until the dog went away.

After playing for a while, Timmy noticed that he had an itch on his arm. He scratched it and it felt better. But then, he noticed that his hands were messy from playing in the dirt. His mom always told him to wash his hands after playing outside, so he went to the bathroom to clean up.

Later that day, Timmy went home and told his mom about the scary dog and how it scared him. His mom hugged him and said that it was okay to be scared sometimes. She also noticed that Timmy had a messy shirt from playing outside. She helped him change into a clean one and gave him a big hug.

Molly was a small girl who loved to dance and play. But one day, she saw something that made her worry.

Across the street, Molly saw a razor. It was shiny and had a sharp edge. She didn't know what it was, but it scared her.

Molly's mom saw her worrying and went over to her. She kneeled down, looked Molly in the eye and said,

"Don't worry, Molly. That's a razor. It's too small for you to play with. We'll put it away so no one gets hurt."

Molly was happy to hear that. She smiled, gave her mom a big hug, and went back to playing. Now, she wasn't worried anymore.

Once upon a time, in a land of many seasons, there lived a clever little bird named Timmy. Timmy loved to fly and play with his friends all day long. He liked the warm season best, when the sun was bright and the flowers were pretty.

One day, Timmy saw a butterfly trapped in a small box. The butterfly was sad and wanted to fly free. Timmy knew he had to help. He used his clever little beak to open the box and release the butterfly.

The butterfly was so happy to be free. It thanked Timmy and they became good friends. They played together in the warm season and had lots of fun. Timmy was happy that he could help his new friend, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a great big flood. All of the animals were scared, and they did not know what to do. Then, they saw a big boat coming closer. In the boat, there was a friendly man. He said, â€œDo not be scared. I will help you. Hold on tight!â€

The animals held on tight and the boat sailed in the big flood. Then, the man said, â€œLook! Over there!â€ All of the animals looked, and they saw a big island. All of the animals shouted and cheered.

The man steered the boat to the island. As soon as they arrived, the animals all bowed to say â€œthank youâ€ to the friendly man. He smiled and waved goodbye as the animals ran away to explore the great island. They were very happy and never forgot the friendly man who saved them from the flood.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jim. Jim loved to explore outside, but one day he found something very special.

Jim saw a box on the ground, he couldn't tell what was inside. He approached closer and noticed the box had a nice texture. He decided to open it and see what was inside. It was empty!

"Where did it come from?" asked Jim out loud. He was very curious.

Just then, an old man appeared. "It's mine," the old man said. He told Jim that he couldn't accept his box back, and he knew Jim would be able to take care of it.

Jim looked at the box and scratched its smooth texture before accepting the gift. He was so happy. He thanked the old man and ran home.

At home, Jim spent days filling the box with all sorts of things. He was so proud of his new box and he would show it off to all his friends. Jim often wondered what might have been in the box before, but he was glad it was now filled with his stuff.

The End.

Lily likes to draw with crayons. She has many colors and papers. She draws flowers, animals, and people. She is very happy when she draws.

One day, she wants to show her drawings to her mom. She goes to her room and looks for her file. A file is a big book with pockets. She puts her drawings in the file to keep them safe and neat.

But she cannot find her file. She looks under her bed, in her closet, and on her shelf. She does not see her file anywhere. She feels sad and worried. Where is her file?

She hears a noise in the living room. She runs to see what it is. She sees her little brother, Max. Max is playing with her file. He takes out her drawings and throws them on the floor. He laughs and claps his hands.

"Max, no!" Lily shouts. "That is my file! Give it back to me!"

Max looks at Lily. He sees that she is angry and scared. He does not like to make her feel that way. He is sorry. He picks up her file and her drawings. He gives them to her.

"I'm sorry, Lily," he says. "I just wanted to see your drawings. They are very cute. You are good at drawing."

Lily hugs Max. She is glad that he is sorry and that he likes her drawings. She is not angry anymore. She is happy.

"Thank you, Max," she says. "Do you want to draw with me? I can share my crayons and papers with you."

Max nods. He likes to draw with Lily. They go to her room and draw together. They have fun. They are good friends.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play with dolls and cars. One day, they find a big leather bag in the attic. The bag is brown and soft. It has many pockets and zippers.

"Wow, look at this bag!" Sara says. "It is so big and nice. I want to play with it."

"Me too," Tom says. "Let's see what is inside."

They open the bag and find many things. They find a hat, a scarf, a book, a pen, and a toy phone.

"Look, I can wear the hat and the scarf," Sara says. She puts them on and pretends to be cold.

"Look, I can read the book and write with the pen," Tom says. He opens the book and draws on it.

"Hello, hello, can you hear me?" Sara says. She holds the toy phone to her ear and makes noises.

"Who are you talking to?" Tom asks.

"I am talking to my mom," Sara says. "She is at work. She is very busy."

"What does she do?" Tom asks.

"She is a doctor," Sara says. "She helps people who are sick. She is very smart."

"That is cool," Tom says. "My mom is a teacher. She teaches kids how to read and write. She is very kind."

They discuss their moms and what they do. They ask each other questions and share stories. They have fun playing with the bag and the things inside. They think the bag is easy to use and has many surprises. They are happy to be friends.

Once there was a boy. His name was Tim. He was three years old and was very adventurous. One day he decided to go for a walk with his parents.

As they walked, they noticed something wonderful. There was a lake, with bright blue waters, and beautiful green trees surrounding it. 

The family couldn't help but add it to their list of favorite places. 

Tim was so excited, he said, "Can we go explore? I would love to see what's there!"

His parents replied, "Yes Tim! What an adventurous idea!"

They all went to explore. Tim discovered so many amazing things. He found colorful rocks, and new plants he'd never seen before. He even saw some animals stepping out of the water.

Tim added these sights to his memory, and felt a sense of wonder as he explored. He had a great day with his family and enjoyed their adventurous outing.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to swing and slide and run. Lily had a big red balloon. She tied it to her wrist with a string. She did not want to lose it.

"Look, Ben, my balloon is so high!" Lily said. She pointed to the sky. "It can touch the moon!"

Ben laughed. He did not think Lily was right. "No, Lily, your balloon is not that high. The moon is very far away. You are silly!"

Lily felt sad. She did not like Ben's words. She thought he was mean. She wanted to show him that her balloon was high. She let go of the string. She hoped her balloon would fly to the moon.

But the balloon did not fly to the moon. It flew away with the wind. Lily watched it go. She felt sorry. She wished she had not let go of the string. She wanted her balloon back.

"Ha ha, Lily, you are stupid!" Ben said. He pointed to the balloon. "You lost your balloon! Now you have nothing!"

Lily cried. She did not like Ben. She did not want to play with him. She ran to her mom. She hugged her mom. She told her what happened.

Her mom was kind. She wiped Lily's tears. She gave her a kiss. She said, "Don't worry, Lily. You are not silly or stupid. You are smart and brave. You tried something new. Sometimes we make mistakes. That's how we learn. And you still have me. I love you."

Lily smiled. She felt better. She loved her mom. She said, "Thank you, mom. I love you too. Can we get another balloon?"

Her mom nodded. She said, "Yes, we can. But this time, let's keep it tied to your wrist. OK?"

Lily agreed. She said, "OK, mom. Let's go get another balloon. A blue one. Like the sky. And the moon."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside on the grass. One day, her mom asked her to bring a glass of lemonade to her dad who was mowing the lawn. 

Lily skipped outside to find her dad. When she saw him, she said, "Daddy, Mommy wants you to have this lemonade. It's sweet and yummy!" 

Her dad took a sip and said, "Wow, this lemonade is spicy! Did Mommy put something special in it?" 

Lily giggled and said, "No, Daddy. It's just lemonade. Maybe you need a break from mowing the lawn. Let's play catch instead!" 

And so, they played catch together until the sun went down. Lily felt happy knowing she could bring her dad a refreshing drink and make him smile.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was feeling very weak and needed something to drink. She asked her mom, "Can I have some water, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, of course!" and gave her a big glass of water. 

Lucy quickly drank the water, but she still felt weak. So momma said, "Let's order something else to make you feel better." They decided to order some soup, and soon the delivery person brought it to their door. 

Lucy slowly ate the soup and her strength slowly came back. She felt much better, and momma was happy that the soup had made Lucy strong again. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny boy called Sam. One night, Sam had a huge dream. In his dream, he saw a sparkly bow. The bow was bigger than anything he had ever seen before. 

He called out to someone in the dream, "What is it?"

An voice replied, "It's a magic bow".

Sam was excited, he wanted to try it out. He reached out and grabbed the bow. He pulled back the bowstring, it felt so strong! 

Suddenly, he woke up from his dream. "What a huge dream!" he thought. Even though Sam knew it was just a dream, he still felt excited about the bow. He couldn't wait until he had a dream with the bow again.

One day, a little girl named Sue was playing in her room. She had many toys and clothes all over the floor. Sue liked to dress up her dolls in the clothes. She was having a lot of fun.

Suddenly, a big wind came through the window. It made a loud noise and the clothes began to fly around the room. Sue was frightened. She did not like the loud noise and the wind.

Sue decided to rush to her mom for help. She ran as fast as she could to her mom. Her mom saw that Sue was frightened and gave her a big hug. Together, they closed the window and picked up the clothes. Sue felt safe and happy again.

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl. She liked to swim. Every day she would go for a swim in the pond near her house. One day, when she was swimming, something caught her eye. She swam closer and saw it was a sheet. She swam over to it and carefully grabbed hold of it. She was so patient as she carefully swam back with it.

After she got out of the pond she carefully spread out the sheet. There were lots of beautiful colors painted on it. They were so pretty and the little girl was so happy. She used the sheet to make a big tent and inside she made a bed. She could now have her own special place to take naps and read books. She was so excited to have found the sheet!

The little girl went back to the pond to swim every day. She was so brave and patient. She was so happy she found the sheet that day. She would never forget her special find on her special swim.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Sarah who was very excited. She was looking forward to playing a game with her mum in the garden.

They got out a big ball and Mum said, â€œLetâ€™s play bowling!â€. Sarah was so excited that she ran to the end of the garden. She put the ball on the ground and ran back. 

Mum said, â€œNow strike the ball!â€ Sarah took a deep breath and used her whole body to strike the ball. It rolled down the garden and hit every single one of the pins.

Sarah was so excited that she jumped in the air and shouted â€œYay!â€. Her mum was so proud of her and gave her a big hug. 

They played for the whole afternoon and it was lots of fun.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park with their mom. They liked to slide, swing, and run around. They also liked to drink juice from the cooler that mom brought. The cooler was big and blue and had ice inside.

One day, a big dog came to the park. He was brown and furry and had a long tail. He saw the cooler and ran towards it. He wanted to drink the juice too. He knocked over the cooler and spilled the juice on the grass. Lily and Ben were scared and ran to their mom.

"Mom, mom, the dog is bad! He took our juice!" Lily cried.

"Shoo, shoo, go away!" mom said to the dog. She tried to pick up the cooler and the juice, but the dog barked and growled. He did not want to leave.

Mom felt helpless. She did not know what to do. She looked around and saw a man with a leash. He was the dog's owner. She called to him.

"Sir, sir, can you please get your dog? He is making a mess and scaring my children!" mom said.

The man heard mom's question and came over. He saw the dog and the cooler and the juice. He was sorry and embarrassed.

"I'm so sorry, ma'am. He escaped from his leash. He is usually friendly, but he loves juice. Let me help you clean up," the man said.

He put the leash on the dog and pulled him away. He also helped mom put the ice and the juice back in the cooler. He apologized again and left.

Mom hugged Lily and Ben and gave them a new juice. They were happy and thanked the man. They learned that some dogs can be naughty, but some people can be nice. They finished their juice and went back to play.

Jake and Sam had a big job. They wanted to build a modern house.

They got a big pile of wood and put it on the ground. Then they took a big pot of melted wax and poured it all over the wood. The wax helped to hold it all together. 

When the wax was completely melted and had covered the wood, Jake and Sam took some stones and started to put them on top of each other. They did this to make the walls of the modern house. 

When they finished, the house looked amazing. They had done a really good job. 

Jake and Sam were really proud of their modern house and they happily played in it all day.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old and loved adventures. One day she saw a big cabinet in the corner of her room. 

She was so curious and she wanted to find out what was inside. She got close and stared inside the cabinet. What she saw surprised her, it was full of toys!

She quickly opened the cabinet and saw all the toys, they were so much fun. She quickly took out a toy car and started playing with it. As Sarah was playing she heard a voice, it was her mum. She said to Sarah, â€œItâ€™s foolish of you to stare inside the cabinet, you never know what you will findâ€.

Sarah thought about what her mum said but decided that her curiosity was too much for her. She continued to open cabinets and explore rooms, searching for more fun and adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved animals and wanted to visit the barn to see the cows and horses. Her mom said it was easy to get there, just follow the road.

Lily walked and walked until she saw the big red barn. She went inside and saw a friendly farmer. "Can I pet the cows?" she asked. The farmer smiled and said, "Sure, I'll give you some hay to feed them too."

Lily was so happy to give the cows the hay. They were very hungry and ate it all up. She thanked the farmer and went back home, excited to tell her mom about her adventure at the barn.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch the parade with her family. One day, Lily saw a perfect float in the parade. It was covered in shiny stars and bright colors. She pointed at it and said, "Look, Mommy! That float is perfect!" 

As the parade went on, Lily saw many different things. She pointed at the clowns with their big red noses and the horses with their long tails. She even pointed at the band playing music. 

After the parade was over, Lily was so happy. She told her family that it was the best parade ever. They all agreed and went home with smiles on their faces. From that day on, Lily loved pointing at things and saying how perfect they were.

It was a hot day and Sandy and her mommy were at the park. Sandy blinked in the bright sunlight and looked around. Everything was so much fun.

Suddenly, Sandy saw a butterfly fluttering in the sky. She was mesmerized. She started to walk towards it when her mommy yelled "wait, Sandy!"

Sandy stopped and looked back at her mommy. Her mommy blinked and smiled. "Let's go and have a picnic," she said.

So they spread a blanket on the grass and unpacked the food. While they ate, the butterfly flew down and landed on Sandy's shoulder. Sandy gasped in surprise and smiled. She closed her eyes and blinked slowly. She felt so happy.

Afterwards, Sandy and her mommy packed everything away and headed home. Sandy couldn't stop smiling. She promised herself that she would always remember that special day at the park.

Ben is a big boy. He likes to help his mom and dad with their jobs. Sometimes he helps mom cook and clean. Sometimes he helps dad fix and build things. He is good at many jobs.

One day, dad asks Ben to help him with a new job. He says they have to open a big box. Ben is curious. He wonders what is inside the box. He follows dad to the garage. He sees the box. It is very big and heavy. It has many stickers and words on it.

Dad says, "Ben, this box has a new bike for you. It is a surprise. Do you want to open it with me?" Ben is happy. He loves bikes. He nods and smiles. He says, "Yes, dad, I want to open it!"

Dad gives Ben a tool. He says, "This is a cutter. It can cut the tape and the cardboard. But be careful, Ben. It is sharp. It can hurt you. You have to hold it like this and cut like this. Do you understand?" Ben is fearful. He has never used a cutter before. He is afraid he might cut himself or dad. He says, "Dad, I am scared. I don't want to use the cutter."

Dad hugs Ben. He says, "It's okay, Ben. You don't have to use the cutter if you don't want to. I can do it for you. You can watch and learn. And then you can help me take out the bike and put it together. How does that sound?" Ben feels better. He says, "Okay, dad. I will watch and learn. And then I will help you with the bike. Thank you, dad."

Dad and Ben open the box. They see the bike. It is shiny and red. It has two wheels and a bell. Ben is excited. He says, "Wow, dad, it is a beautiful bike. I love it. Can I ride it?" Dad says, "Yes, Ben, you can ride it. But first, we have to put it together. It is not ready yet. We have to attach the pedals and the seat and the handlebars. Do you want to help me?" Ben says, "Yes, dad, I want to help you. I want to learn how to do this job. It looks fun." Dad says, "Good, Ben. You are a big boy. You are brave and smart. I am proud of you. Let's do this job together." Ben and dad work on the bike. They have fun. They finish the job. They high-five. They say, "We did it!" They go outside. They ride the bike. Ben is happy. He says, "Thank you, dad, for the bike and for the job. I love you, dad." Dad says, "You're welcome, Ben. I love you, too." They hug. They smile. They have a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a nice dream about a big castle. In her dream, she saw a big stack of pancakes as tall as a tree. She thought it was so funny and giggled in her sleep. 

The next day, Lily woke up and told her mommy about her dream. Her mommy smiled and said, "That sounds like a fun dream, Lily." Then, they went to the kitchen and made a nice stack of pancakes for breakfast. 

Lily was so happy to have her dream come true. She ate the pancakes with syrup and smiled the whole time. From that day on, she knew that sometimes dreams can come true in real life too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw with her favorite ink pen. One day, Lily's friend came over to play. They both wanted to draw, but Lily's friend didn't have her own ink pen. 

Lily shared her ink pen with her friend, but soon realized that her friend was using it in a way that made her uncomfortable. She was drawing all over Lily's favorite book! 

Lily didn't want to hurt her friend's feelings, but she also didn't want her book to be ruined. So, she kindly asked her friend to stop using the ink pen on the book. Her friend was sad at first, but then Lily showed her how to draw on paper instead. They both had fun and made beautiful pictures together. From that day on, Lily made sure to name the rules before sharing her ink pen with anyone else.

Once there was a little bunny. He was a very happy bunny, but he was also very messy! His fur was filthy and his home was filled with junk. 

One day, spring came and the sun was shining brightly. The bunny was inspired to tidy up his home. He emptied out all the junk and swept the floors.

When he was finished, he was very proud of himself. To reward himself, the bunny decided to go on an adventure.

He hopped through the forest until he found a tree with lots of treats. He stepped up onto a branch and picked the best one he could find. Then he ran back home to enjoy his yummy treat.

The bunny was so happy to have found the treats and enjoyed his day of cleaning and adventure. From then on, he always made sure his home was neat and tidy, so he would always be ready for new spring adventures!

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to go on wild adventures. Every day she would grab her special diary and pass through the forest. She would explore the tall trees and feel the cool breeze. Her diary was filled with stories and drawings of her exciting adventures.

One day, when she was passing through a part of the forest she had never seen before, she found something very interesting! It was a bright and shiny star that seemed to move in the sky. She watched the star twinkle and thought it was very beautiful.

Then, she heard a voice that said, â€œTake this star and pass it on to your diary! It will bring you lots of luck!â€ 

Excited, the girl followed the instructions of the voice and wrote down the experience in her diary. From then on, she went on even more wild and wonderful adventures with her trusty diary.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He went to a new restaurant with his mom and dad. They sat down at a table and looked at the menu. Timmy saw some yummy food he wanted to try.
