Once upon a time, there was a queen. She was a very nice queen. She had a big, pretty castle. The queen had a lot of work to do every day. But today, she wanted to relax.

The queen went to the park to relax. She sat on a soft, green grass. The queen saw a bug. The bug was disgusting. The queen did not like the disgusting bug.

The queen went back to her castle. She was happy to be away from the disgusting bug. Now, the queen could relax in her big, pretty castle. The queen smiled and had a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a lucky mushroom. He was happy and bouncy, and he lived in a big green field. He wanted to play, so he hopped around looking for some friends. 

He found an ant, but it was too busy running around to play with him. Then he saw a ladybug, but she was too busy eating leaves to play with him. 

Finally, he saw a butterfly flying by. It was friendly and he asked if the butterfly wanted to play. The butterfly said yes, so they started to play tag. They laughed and had so much fun together. 

After a while, the sun started to set and the butterfly said it was time to go home. The lucky mushroom was sad, until the butterfly said he could come over to play again tomorrow. 

So, the lucky mushroom hopped back home feeling very happy. He had a new friend, and he was looking forward to playing together again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden. One day, she found a shiny jewel on the ground. It was so pretty that she wanted to keep it forever.

Lily showed the jewel to her mommy and said, "Look, mommy! I found a pretty jewel!" Her mommy said, "That's very nice, Lily. We should bury it in the ground so it stays safe."

Lily and her mommy dug a hole in the ground and buried the jewel. After they finished, Lily started to spin around in circles. She felt so dizzy that she fell down on the grass. Her mommy said, "Are you okay, Lily?" Lily replied, "Yes, mommy. I'm just dizzy from spinning around." 

From that day on, Lily would visit the spot where they buried the jewel and smile. She knew it was safe and sound in the ground.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, Lily's mom reminded her to clean up her toys before dinner. Lily said "Okay, Mommy!" and got to work.

As she was cleaning, Lily heard a voice from outside her window. It sounded like a bird. She looked outside and saw a beautiful blue bird perched on a tree branch. Lily said hello to the bird and it chirped back.

After Lily finished cleaning up, she went outside to play with the bird. She climbed up the tree and reached out to pet the bird. But then, she lost her balance and fell down. She hurt herself very badly and couldn't get up.

Lily's mom heard her crying and came outside to help. She called an ambulance, but it was too late. Lily had hurt herself too badly and didn't make it. Her mom was very sad and cried for a long time. The end.

Lila was a little girl who liked to learn new things. She liked to read books, draw pictures, and ask questions. She wanted to have wisdom, like her big sister Maya, who knew many things and helped her with her homework.

One day, Lila found a big book on the shelf. It had many words and pictures that she did not understand. She wanted to read it, but it was too heavy for her to carry. She tried to pull it down, but it fell on her head. She screamed in pain and fear.

Maya heard her scream and ran to her. She saw Lila on the floor, crying, with the big book next to her. She picked up Lila and hugged her. She asked her what happened and checked her head for bumps.

"I wanted to read the big book, but it hurt me," Lila sobbed. "I wanted to have wisdom, like you."

Maya smiled and kissed her head. She said, "You are very brave and curious, Lila. That is how you get wisdom. But you don't need to read big books that are not for you. You can read smaller books that are fun and easy. And you can always ask me or Mommy or Daddy if you want to know something. We are here to help you learn and grow."

Lila nodded and wiped her tears. She said, "Thank you, Maya. You are the best sister ever. Can you read me a small book?"

Maya said, "Of course, Lila. Let's go to your room and find a nice book. Maybe we can find one about animals or colors or shapes. What do you think?"

Lila smiled and said, "I think that sounds great. I love animals and colors and shapes. And I love you, Maya."

They walked to Lila's room, holding hands. They found a small book and sat on the bed. Maya read the book to Lila, who listened and learned. They laughed and hugged and had a good time. They both had wisdom, in their own way.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside, but it was winter and the weather was gloomy. One day, Timmy went outside to play but he felt sad because he couldn't find his favorite toy. 

He asked his mom, "Mommy, can you help me find my toy?" 

His mom replied, "Sure, let's look for it together." 

They searched and searched, but they couldn't find the toy. Suddenly, Timmy saw something standing in the snow. It was his toy! He was so happy and said, "Mommy, look! My toy was standing in the snow all along!" 

From that day on, Timmy learned that sometimes things can be hiding in plain sight, even in the gloomy winter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Olive. She was three years old, and she loved to go on adventures. One day, she decided to go on a special adventure. She went to the beach to gather some smelly olives!

Olive was very happy and ran to the trees. She found lots of olives lying on the ground and started picking them up. She picked the smelly olives carefully, but some of them were a bit squishy! She was having fun gathering them all up, and soon she had a big olives in her hands. 

Olive went back home with her olives. She showed her mama the smelly olives and told her all about her special adventure. Mama was very happy and they made a yummy olives-and-tomatoes dinner. Olive loved it, and since then she has gone on many more adventures!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy liked to play with her friends. But there was one special game she loved most. It was a game where she chased her friends with a veil. 

Her friends laughed when Daisy would tease them with the veil. But she knew it was all in good fun. 

One day, Daisy saw a fake veil in a store window. She was so excited to have one of her own. She asked her mom if she could get it and, after asking around to make sure the veil wasnâ€™t too expensive, her mom said yes.

Daisy took her new veil home and couldnâ€™t wait to show it off to her friends. They all laughed when she chased them around. 

Daisy loved her new veil and having fun with her friends! She was never afraid to tease and play!

Once upon a time there was a boy named Tom. Tom was very restless and always wanted to explore. One day Tom went outside to play and he found an old box. Tom was so excited, he wanted to know what was inside. But before he could open it, his mum called him in for lunch.

Lunch was delicious. Tom had warm bread with butter and he yummed it up. After he finished, he quickly ran outside to look at the box again. This time, he decided to open it.

There were lots of treasures inside the box. Tom found a shiny toy car, a wooden drum and lots of cool rocks. He was so happy he wanted to take them home. But then he noticed that there was something that looked like a toy buried in the ground.

Tom knew he had to find out what it was. So he quickly grabbed a stick and started digging. Soon, he found a beautiful teddy bear. Tom was so excited, he couldn't believe his luck. He quickly buried the box again and ran home with his new special toy. He was very happy and thankful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her toys and draw pictures with her crayons. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to mail a letter to her friend. Lily was excited to help and put the letter in the mailbox.

But then, Lily realized that she forgot to write her name on the letter. She felt very angry with herself for making such a mistake. She tried to take the letter out of the mailbox, but it was too late. The mailman had already come and taken the letter away.

Days passed and Lily's mommy never heard back from her friend. She explained to Lily that it's important to always write your name on things you mail, so people know who it's from. Lily felt sad that her mistake caused her mommy to lose her friend's letter. The moral of the story is to always double-check and make sure you do things right, so you don't have to feel angry or sad later.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Terry. He wanted to play with a net. He asked his family to teach him how to use it. His mum and dad said yes and took him outside to the garden. 

Mum taught Terry how to swing the net and catch things. He soon got the hang of it and was having lots of fun. Every day after school he would use the net to catch butterflies.

One day, he looked up from his net and saw something very distant in the sky. It was a brightly coloured balloon. Terry was so excited and asked his mum if they could go and get it.

Mum told him that the balloon was too distant and that it was impossible to get it. But she said that if he used the net he might be able to catch it. 

Terry was so determined and eventually managed to catch the balloon with his net and bring it back home.

Terry was a very happy boy. He now knew that with hard work and a bit of help, anything is possible!

Lily was a little girl who liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite one was a king doll. He had a crown, a cape and a big smile. Lily liked to pretend that he was the king of a faraway land and she was his friend.

One day, Lily decided to invite her king doll to a tea party. She set up a table with cups, plates and cookies. She put on a pretty dress and a hat. She said to her king doll, "Hello, King. Do you want to come to my tea party? It will be fun."

The king doll nodded and said, "Yes, Lily. I would love to come to your tea party. You are very kind to invite me."

Lily smiled and took his hand. She led him to the table and sat him on a chair. She poured some tea and gave him a cookie. She said, "Here you go, King. This is your tea and your cookie. They are very yummy."

The king doll took a sip and a bite. He said, "Thank you, Lily. This is very yummy indeed. You are a good hostess."

Lily and her king doll had a nice time at the tea party. They talked about the faraway land, the flowers, the animals and the stars. They laughed and sang and played.

But then, Lily heard a loud noise. It was her brother, Tom. He came into her room and saw the tea party. He said, "What are you doing, Lily? Are you playing with dolls? That is silly. Dolls are for babies. And who is this? A king doll? He looks foolish. He has a silly crown and a silly cape and a silly smile. He is not a real king. He is a fake king."

Tom grabbed the king doll and threw him on the floor. He said, "Ha ha ha. Look at the foolish king. He can't do anything. He can't talk. He can't move. He can't rule. He is just a toy. A stupid toy."

Lily was very angry and sad. She ran to her king doll and picked him up. She hugged him and said, "Don't listen to him, King. He is mean and rude. He doesn't know anything. You are not foolish. You are not fake. You are my friend. You are my king. And I love you."

The king doll smiled and said, "I love you too, Lily. You are my friend. You are my queen. And you are very brave and smart. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise."

Lily and her king doll went back to the tea party. They ignored Tom and his words. They had more tea and cookies. They had more fun. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily and her mom went for a walk in the park. They saw a bird struggling to fly. "Look, Mommy! The birdie can't fly high!" said Lily. Her mom replied, "Yes, sweetie. It seems like the birdie is having a hard time." 

As they continued their walk, Lily saw a butterfly. "Mommy, look! A butterfly! It's so pretty!" exclaimed Lily. Her mom said, "Yes, it's a beautiful sight." 

Suddenly, Lily's mom sneezed. "Achoo!" Lily said, "Bless you, Mommy. Do you have a cold?" Her mom replied, "No, it's just a mild allergy." They continued their walk and enjoyed the rest of the day together.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She loved jam. Every day she went to the market to buy more jam. 

One day, as Lucy was walking home from market, she slipped and hurt her knee. She cried and cried. 

Her mommy saw her and quickly ran over to pick her up. She hugged Lucy tightly and said, "Let's go buy some more jam. That will make you feel better!" 

So they both went back to the market and bought the yummiest jam there. 

Once Lucy got home, she felt much better. She ate some of the jam and it tasted sooo good. 

And that was how Lucy's mommy helped her feel better. The end.

Once upon a time there was a furry blueberry. It was soft and round and had thick, fuzzy fur. It sat atop a big hill all alone and sighed with sadness. 

Suddenly a friendly creature appeared. It was a small creature with two eyes, two legs, and two arms. The furry blueberry smiled.

The creature and furry blueberry played together all day long. They rolled around and giggled. They danced and sang silly songs. 

Before the sun went down, the furry blueberry hugged the creature goodbye. It had been so much fun, that both of them sighed with happiness. The furry blueberry waved with its tiny paw, and the creature disappeared into the night. 

The furry blueberry sat back atop the hill and gazed up in the starry sky, happy and content.

Once upon a time, there was a nice woman who had an onion. The onion was very clean and smelled nice. She wanted to make a delicious soup so she began to cut it into her cooking pot. As she was cutting the onion, she started to cry and the onion started to slip from her hands! 

The woman was very upset and tried to catch the onion. But, it was too slippery and quickly rolled away. She chased the onion around her kitchen until it rolled under the fridge. 

The woman couldn't reach it and started to cry again. Then, her cat came over. The cat reached under the fridge, grabbed the onion and brought it to the woman. 

The woman was so thankful that she fed the cat a very special treat. The cat purred and the woman was able to finish making her soup with a clean onion. They both lived happily ever after. The end!

Once there was a baby elephant who lived in the jungle. He was brown and very strong. But he was feeling sad, because the other animals were much bigger than him and he felt very small. He wanted to feel bigger, so he went to see his friend the monkey.

The monkey was very wise and he knew how to help. He made the elephant stand on a big scale. The monkey put more and more stones on the scale to make the elephant weigh more. Then they put some smoke on the scale and the elephant weighed even more!

The elephant was very happy because the scale said he was bigger now. He was the biggest animal in the jungle and everyone was surprised! The elephant was so happy that he ran around the jungle celebrating with his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily was walking down the hall when she saw her big sister Emma. Emma was being bossy and telling Lily what to do.

Lily didn't like it when Emma was bossy. She wanted to play by herself. So, Lily decided to go to her room and play with her toys. She looked at her stuffed animals and picked out her favorite bear. She hugged the bear and felt happy.

Later, Lily went back to the hall and saw Emma again. This time, Emma wasn't being bossy. She asked Lily if she wanted to play together. Lily smiled and said yes. They played together and had lots of fun. The end.

Once there was a big cow. She was very tired from a long day. She walked slowly to a nearby stand. The stand was full of grass and clover. The cow was happy to find some food. She started to nibble on the grass and clover. Suddenly, she felt something wet on her back. She was scared and ran away. It was an old farmer spraying water on her. The farmer wanted to keep her cool and healthy. The cow sighed. She was happy that the farmer was looking out for her. She nibbled her grass and clover until she was no longer tired. The sun then set and the cow went back to her home.

Ben and his dad went to the office. Dad had to work on his computer. Ben wanted to play with dad's toys. Dad had a lot of toys on his desk. He had a car, a plane, a ball and a phone.

"Can I play with your toys, dad?" Ben asked.

"Sure, you can play with some of them. But be careful, okay? Don't break them or lose them," dad said.

Ben picked up the car and made vroom-vroom noises. He drove the car on the desk and on the floor. He had fun with the car. Then he saw the plane. He wanted to fly the plane. He put the car down and grabbed the plane.

He threw the plane in the air and watched it soar. He clapped his hands and laughed. He ran after the plane and caught it. He threw it again and again. He did not see where the plane was going.

The plane flew out of the window and landed on the street. Ben gasped and ran to the window. He saw the plane on the ground. He saw a big truck coming. He saw the truck run over the plane and smash it. He saw the plane break into many parts. He felt sad and scared.

He started to cry. He ran to dad and hugged him. He told him what happened.

"I'm sorry, dad. I broke your plane. It flew out of the window and the truck smashed it. It has many parts now. I'm sorry, I'm sorry," Ben sobbed.

Dad looked at the window and saw the broken plane. He felt angry and sad. He loved his plane. It was a gift from his friend. He wanted to yell at Ben. But he saw Ben's tears and heard his sorry. He felt sorry for Ben too.

He hugged Ben and stroked his hair. He said, "It's okay, Ben. I know you didn't mean to break it. It was an accident. Accidents happen sometimes. I'm not mad at you. I still love you. But you have to be more careful next time, okay? You have to watch where you throw things. You have to respect other people's things. Do you understand?"

Ben nodded and said, "Yes, dad. I understand. I'm sorry. I love you too."

Dad smiled and kissed Ben's cheek. He said, "Let's go home and have some ice cream. How does that sound?"

Ben smiled and said, "That sounds good, dad. Can we get chocolate?"

"Sure, we can get chocolate. Come on, let's go," dad said.

He picked up Ben and his bag. He said goodbye to his bald boss, who was watching them from his office. He said, "Sorry, boss. I have to go. My son had a little trouble with my plane."

His boss nodded and said, "No problem, dad. I understand. Kids will be kids. Have a good day."

Dad and Ben left the office and went to the car. They drove to the ice cream shop and got chocolate ice cream. They ate their ice cream and talked about their day. They forgot about the broken plane and the parts. They were happy.

One day, a small boy named Bobby wanted to be active. So, he put on his sneakers, and went for a jog. As he jogged, he noticed the sky was getting dark. Soon it was night time, so Bobby stopped running and decided to go back home. 

On the way however, he heard something that made him alert. He looked around and saw a big, scary looking dog. Bobby was very scared and he didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Bobby heard a kind voice. "It's ok Bobby, don't worry. I will take you home." It was his uncle who had come looking for him. 

Relieved, Bobby thanked his uncle and they jogged back home together. Bobby had fun and remembered how important it was to stay alert when running outside in the dark.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was very excited, because it was her birthday. She put on her party dress and went outside to play.

Suddenly, Lucy saw a distant candle. Lucy wanted to get the candle, so she hurried to get it. But when she got close, she saw that it was too high up for her to reach.

Suddenly, Lucy's mom came outside. She saw what Lucy was trying to do. She picked Lucy up and held her high. Lucy quickly grabbed the candle.

Lucy was so happy to have the candle. She hugged it tight and went back inside for her birthday party.

Once upon a time, there was a tall man. He was walking down a long hallway. He came to an exit and he wanted to keep going. He looked for a way out, but he couldn't find one.

He looked up and saw a very tall door. He wanted to keep walking so he opened the door. He walked through the door, and then he saw a huge staircase. Again, he wanted to keep walking, so he walked up the stairs.

At the top of the stairs was another tall door. He opened it and he saw a big moon in the sky. He was so happy to find the exit. He was glad he was able to keep going and find the way out. He thanked the moon and went back down the stairs. He never forgot the tall exit that he found.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to ride his bike with his friends. One day, Timmy's tire popped and he fell off his bike. He was sad because he couldn't ride his bike anymore.

But Timmy's friends were there to support him. They helped him fix his tire so he could ride his bike again. Timmy was so happy and grateful for his friends.

From then on, Timmy always made sure to be alert and check his bike tire before riding. He didn't want to have another accident and miss out on all the fun with his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy found a toy gun in his backyard. He didn't know what to do with it, so he showed it to his friends. They thought it was cool, but Timmy knew it was not polite to play with guns.

Later that day, Timmy accidentally broke his friend's toy. His friend was very upset and started to cry. Timmy felt bad and knew he needed to say sorry and ask for forgiveness. His friend forgave him and they continued to play together.

Timmy learned that it's important to be polite and kind to others, and that forgiveness can make things better. He also knew that guns are not toys and should not be played with. From that day on, Timmy made sure to always be polite and to never play with guns again.

Once upon a time there was a girl who went on a wild adventure. She had a weird rag with her and it was her best friend. One day, she went deep into the forest and came across a strange creature. The creature was so weird that the girl was scared. The creature said, "Will you feed me?"

The girl was unsure what to do. She thought about the rag she had with her. She slowly took the rag out of her pocket and offered it to the creature. To her surprise, the creature was so happy! It said, "Thank you for feeding me", before it disappeared back into the forest.

The girl was glad she had her rag with her. From then on, she always kept it with her on all of her adventures. She learned that it's better to be kind to creatures, no matter how weird they may look!

Once upon a time, there was a powerful man. He had a special newspaper that only he could read. Each day he would read and smile.

One day, he invited a little boy over to his house and said, "let me show you my newspaper!"

The little boy looked at the powerful man, with awe and wonder. "Wow!" the little boy said.

"Oh, you must be new here! Welcome!" said the powerful man with a big smile.

The powerful man sat down and began to read his newspaper. The little boy sat next to him, eager to learn more. And as they read, they laughed and talked.

The little boy felt so happy and welcomed to be there.

The powerful man said, "you can read this newspaper if you like!"

The little boy was so excited, he replied, "Really? Thank you for welcoming me!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Millie. She was always very cheerful and liked to climb up high and watch the world go by.

One summer evening when Millie was playing outside her house, she saw a tree with a big branch jutting out. She thought it looked like a wonderful place to climb and so she started to climb.

Millie climbed and climbed until she was almost at the top and then she heard a voice calling out to her. It was her mom. She asked Millie what she was doing. Millie said that she wanted to make a memory. 

Millie's mom was mad and said it wasn't safe for Millie to be so high up. She warned Millie to come down right away. 

Millie was sad but she listened to her mom. She slowly started to climb back down the tree. When she got to the bottom, her mom smiled and gave her a big hug. She was glad that Millie was safe and told her that they could make special memories together - without having to climb so high. 

Millie agreed and they hugged each other tighter. Millie was still cheerful and they both enjoyed the rest of their evening together, creating wonderful memories without even having to climb!

Once upon a time there was a girl, Sarah, who loved warm socks. She always wore them and never wanted to take them off. One day, however, Sarah went to her room and found that her warm sock was missing. She looked everywhere, but could not find it.Sarah was very sad. She felt sad and lonely without her warm sock.

The next day Sarah decided to go looking for her missing sock. She looked everywhere - in her room, under the bed, in the yard, and even in the garden. But no matter how hard she tried, she could not find it.

At last, Sarah gave up. She was very sad and she really missed her warm sock. Suddenly, Sarah heard her mom calling her. She went to see what her mom wanted, and there it was - her missing warm sock! Her mom had been looking all over for it, and had finally found it!

Sarah was so happy! She ran to her mom, hugged her and thanked her for finding her warm sock. From that day forward, Sarah didn't miss her sock ever again.

Once there was a little girl named Ella. She loved to look at the sunrise every morning. It was always so beautiful!

One morning, Ella saw something even more wonderful than the sunrise. She saw a creative painting in the sky! It was made of soft pink, yellow and blue colors. Ella was so amazed. 

Ella ran home to tell her family about the painting in the sky. They all agreed it was very special.

"This painting is so incredible," Ella said. "I wish I could make something like this too." 

Ella's mom smiled. "You can do anything you put your mind to," she said. "It may take some practice, but you can improve and learn how to make something just as wonderful."

Ella smiled. She was determined to create her own painting in the sky.

The moral of this story is that with hard work and practice, you can do anything you set your mind to. Never give up on your dreams and you can always improve!

Once upon a time there was a boy called Bob. Bob was three years old and liked to explore. One day, Bob went into his mum's bedroom and saw a needle. He was a bit fearful and said to himself, "I need that needle". So, he picked it up and put it in his pocket. 

After a while, Bob got so excited about the needle that he forgot to be cautious. Suddenly, he tripped and the needle dropped. It landed on the carpet and made a tiny hole. Bob started to cry and said, "I will get in trouble". 

Bob's mum came in and said, "What happened here?". Bob was very scared and said, "I just wanted the needle". His mum saw that he was fearful and said, "It's OK, Bob. I can fix this. You don't need the needle". 

Bob's mum fixed the tiny hole with her special needle and some thread. She said, "It's all better now. You don't have to be scared". Bob smiled and thanked his mum for fixing the hole. 

The moral of the story is that it is important to always be careful when exploring and new things.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to wear her purple dress every day. One day, she went to the park to play with her friend Jake. Jake had a new toy, a red ball. Lily wanted to play with it but Jake said no.

Lily got upset and said, "Why won't you let me play with your ball? That's not nice." Jake replied, "Because you're foolish and you might pop it." Lily felt sad and went home.

When she got home, her mom saw that she was sad and asked her what happened. Lily told her about the ball and how Jake called her foolish. Her mom said, "Don't worry, we can tie a ribbon around your old ball and make it pretty. Then you can play with it and show Jake that it's just as fun." Lily smiled and felt happy again.

A little boy named Devin entered into his mom's room. He saw a motor sitting in the corner. He had never seen a motor up close. He walked up to it, and he thought to himself, "Why does Mommy have a motor?" 
Suddenly, his mom came in. She said, "Devin, this is an honest motor. It helps us make lots of things." Devin looked up at her with a confused look on his face. 
Mommy laughed. She said, "It works like a muscle. It helps us turn things into different things." 
Devin smiled and said, "So, it's like a strong helper?". Mommy nodded and said, "Yes, exactly. It's a very honest helper." Devin was happy that he got to learn all about the motor.

Once upon a time, in an ordinary little house, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim had a special cloth that he liked to play with every day. The cloth was soft and blue, and Tim would take it with him wherever he went.

One sunny day, Tim and his cloth went to play outside. They had so much fun running and jumping in the grass. Suddenly, Tim saw a cat stuck in a tree. The cat was scared and meowed loudly for help. Tim wanted to help the cat, but he didn't know how.

Then, Tim had an idea! He would use his cloth to help the cat. Tim rushed to the tree and tied one end of the cloth to a strong branch. He threw the other end of the cloth down to the ground. The cat climbed down the cloth and was safe. Tim was so happy that he could help the cat with his special cloth, and they all played together in the sun.

Once there was a boy who was very upset because he had no fuel for his car. He asked his mom for fuel but she said no.
The boy got more and more upset. He started to throw things around the house. His mom asked him to stop, but he threw more and more things.
Finally, the boy ran outside and threw a rock into the sky. It flew high up in the sky and disappeared. The boy smiled and felt a bit better. He knew he still needed fuel, but he was happy to have thrown something.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Timmy. He was only three years old and had not seen very much of the world. One day Timmy's mommy said they were going on an adventure! 

They drove to a big building and Timmy was so excited. When they got there, Timmy's mommy said they were going to examine a tube. Timmy didn't know what that meant, but he was very curious. 

They went inside and the doctor asked Timmy to sit still. He was very confused and scared at the same time. The doctor then showed him an enormous tube. Timmy thought it looked terrible. He was scared of it so he started to cry. 

His mommy hugged him and said it would be okay. She reassured him that the doctor was going to examine the tube, not him. The doctor then used a special light to look inside the tube and eventually everything was okay. 

Timmy was so relieved the tube was not connected to him in any way. He was happy the adventure was over! 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim lived in a small house with his mom and dad. Next to his house was a neighbor. The neighbor had a big, smelly dog.

One day, Tim saw the smelly dog in his yard. He wanted to play with the dog, but his mom said, "No, Tim. You must promise not to play with the smelly dog. It is not safe." Tim said, "Ok, mom. I promise."

But when his mom went inside, Tim forgot his promise. He went to play with the smelly dog. The dog was not nice. It bit Tim's hand. Tim cried and cried. His mom came out and saw what happened. She was very sad. Tim learned that he should always keep his promises.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Helen. She was very excited to go to the mall with her mom. 

When they got to the mall, Helen's mom got a massage. It felt really nice! Helen watched and thought it looked funny. During the massage, Helen's mom's purse fell off her lap and all her money spilled out onto the floor. 

Helen quickly came to the rescue. She grabbed all the money and put it back in her mom's purse. She saved the day! Helen's mom was so happy and thanked her for being so brave and helpful. 

After the massage, Helen and her mother went to the arcade to play games. They had lots of fun and Helen was very proud that she had saved the day.

Lily was sick. She had a bad cough and a hot head. Mommy said she had to drink medicine to feel better. But Lily did not like medicine. It was sour and yucky. She made a face and said no.

Mommy was sad. She wanted Lily to be well. She said, "Please, Lily, drink the medicine. It will help you. I know it is sour, but you can have some juice after. And a hug." She smiled and held the spoon.

Lily looked at the spoon. She saw the red liquid. She smelled the sour smell. She felt scared. She shook her head and hid under the blanket. She said, "No, no, no!"

Mommy sighed. She did not know what to do. She said, "Lily, I love you. I don't want you to be sick. The medicine is good for you. It will make the cough go away. And the hot head. And the sore throat. You will be happy and strong. Please, Lily, drink the medicine."

Lily heard Mommy's words. She heard the love in Mommy's voice. She peeked out from the blanket. She saw Mommy's eyes. She saw the worry and the hope. She felt sorry. She said, "Okay, Mommy. I will drink the medicine. But only a little bit."

Mommy smiled. She said, "Thank you, Lily. You are a brave girl. I am proud of you." She gave Lily the spoon. Lily opened her mouth. She drank the medicine. It was sour and yucky. She made a face and said, "Blech!"

Mommy laughed. She said, "I know, I know. It is not tasty. But it is over now. You did it. Here, have some juice. And a hug." She gave Lily a cup of juice and a big hug. Lily drank the juice. It was sweet and yummy. She hugged Mommy back. She said, "I love you, Mommy."

Mommy said, "I love you too, Lily. You are my sweet girl. Now, let's go to bed. You need some rest. Tomorrow, you will feel better." She tucked Lily in and kissed her forehead. Lily closed her eyes and smiled. She felt warm and cozy. She said, "Good night, Mommy."

Mommy said, "Good night, Lily." She turned off the light and left the room. She hoped the medicine would work. She hoped Lily would be well. She loved Lily very much.

Once upon a time there was a young clock. It was very excited because it had never been used before.
One day a young girl found it and decided to take it home. She was only three years old but she thought the clock was so beautiful!
She wound up the clock and it started ticking away. The girl was so excited to hear it.
Every day she would run to her room to show the clock new things. She loved it so much!
One morning the girl heard the clock ringing and it made her so happy. She knew that the clock was telling her it was time for breakfast.
The girl was so thankful for the clock because it helped her to know when it was time to get up. She thanked the clock every single day.
The clock and the young girl became and remained great friends, and they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful pale princess who lived in a magnificent castle. Every year she would design a new dress, and this year she designed a gorgeous dress that sparkled in the light. Everyone was so amazed when they saw it. 

The princess loved her beautiful dress so much she decided to have a grand celebration in the castle. Everyone was invited and they enjoyed music, dancing and delicious treats. 

The princess was very happy and smiled all night long. She showed off her pretty dress and twirled around with her friends. It was the best year ever! 

The next morning was just as special as the night before. The princess had a wonderful time, and the memories of the celebration will stay with her always.

Once upon a time, there was a little baby named Tim. He lived in a small house with his mom and dad. Tim had a clean crib that he slept in every night. He loved his crib very much.

One day, Tim found a small toy in his crib. It was a toy bug. Tim thought the toy bug was fun to play with. But then, the toy bug started to bite Tim's hand. Tim was very sad and cried.

Tim's mom heard him cry and ran to his crib. She saw the toy bug biting Tim's hand. Tim's mom took the toy bug away and gave Tim a big hug. Tim's hand felt better, and he was happy again. From that day on, Tim's crib was always clean and free from toy bugs.

Once upon a time, there was a little sock. The sock was clear and easy to see through. The sock liked to play with its friends, the other socks.

One day, the clear sock wanted to play with a new friend. It saw a big, red ball. The sock wanted to attach to the ball and go on a fun ride. So, the sock jumped and attached to the ball. The ball started rolling, and the sock had a great time.

After a while, the ball stopped rolling, and the clear sock said goodbye to its new friend. The sock went back to its friends, the other socks. It told them all about the fun ride with the ball. They all wanted to attach to the ball and have fun too. From that day on, the clear sock and its friends had many fun adventures with the big, red ball.

Once there was a little boy named Joe. He loved to play outside, but he was too small to do the things that his brothers did. His brothers played tag and soccer, but Joe couldn't do that.

One day, Joe's mom asked him if he wanted to go outside and slide. Joe was so excited! He had never tried sliding before.

When Joe got to the park, he found an ugly yellow slide. Joe was a little scared, because it was so high. But his mom said it was ok, so Joe climbed up the slide. 

Joe went to the top and sat down. He felt a cool, slippery cream on the slide. Joe giggled and he pushed off the slide and started to slide.

Joe loved it! He said he wanted to do it again and again. So Joe's mom put more cream on the slide and Joe kept sliding down. Flip and whirl, zip and swirl - Joe loved it!

Once upon a time, there was a family. Tom, the dad, wanted to get a pet for his three year old son, Joe. But Joe had a very special request - he wanted an attractive pet. 

Tom said, "What kind of pet do you want?"
Joe replied, "I want a puppy, Daddy. I want it to be attractive!"
Tom smiled, "I'll see what I can do."

The next day, the family went to the pet store. As soon as Tom opened the door, Joe was excited. He saw so many furry, cute puppies! 

He ran up to one and hugged it, saying "Daddy! I want this one! It's so attractive!" Tom thought the puppy was perfect for Joe and brought it home. 

Since then, Joe and his puppy have been the best of friends. Joe and his puppy go everywhere together. Everywhere Joe goes, his attractive puppy is right by his side!

Once upon a time there was a girl called Daisy. Daisy was very intelligent and loved to jump.

One day Daisy wanted to jump up to the sky and touch the clouds. She could see the clouds in the sky above her, but they were too high. She asked her mom if she could jump to the sky.

Her mom said "No, you can't reach the sky, but you can jump to the stars".

Daisy thought that this was a good idea, so she jumped and jumped as high as she could. But she did not reach the stars. She kept jumping and jumping, until suddenly she realised that she was running out of oxygen. She quickly came back down to the ground, where she could breathe lots of fresh air.

Daisy looked up to the sky, she knew that she could not reach the stars, but she still felt very happy that she had jumped high in the sky. She decided that she would keep jumping and never give up.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Will. He wanted to meet a cat. He asked his mom if he could go outside and find one. His mom said ok, but finding a cat would be difficult.

Will was excited to start looking. He looked all around, but didn't see any cats. He asked his mom where he could find one.

His mom said cats like to hang out in places like gardens and backyards. Will went to the backyard and looked around. He couldn't find a cat anywhere.

Will was about to give up when he finally saw a cat! He was so excited to meet the cat. He got closer and realized the cat was very scared. He knew it would be difficult, but he was determined to make friends with the cat.

He slowly approached the cat and spoke to it softly. He offered the cat a treat and after a few tries, the cat finally accepted. Will was so happy. He got to meet a cat!

Once there was a big dog. He had a warm vest on, and he was so happy. He ran and jumped and played all day.

But one day something terrible happened. Big dog stayed outside too long, and he became dead.

The people were sad. They put a blanket over the dog, and they carried him away.

Big dog's vest stayed outside for a long time. It was so sad to see how still the vest was without Big dog in it.

But then one day something wonderful happened. A new dog came to the house. He had a very big smile, and he was ready to play.

The people put the vest on the new dog, and everyone smiled. They took the dog outside, and he ran and jumped and kept everyone happy.

Big dog was gone, but his vest stayed to keep another dog warm and happy. The vest stayed with the new dog all day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, especially his trucks. One day, Timmy went to the park to play with his truck. He saw another boy playing with a truck too. Timmy wanted to play with that truck, but the other boy said no.

Timmy didn't like that answer, so he started to fight with the other boy. They pushed each other and yelled. Timmy's mom saw what was happening and came over to stop the fight. She told Timmy that it's not nice to fight and that he should wait his turn to play with the truck.

The other boy saw that Timmy was upset and decided to share the truck with him. They played together and had fun. Timmy learned that being competitive is good, but fighting isn't the way to win. He also learned that waiting can be hard, but it's important to be patient.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who lived far away. She was so far that no one knew where she was.

One day, a brave boy wanted to find the princess. He looked and looked, up high and down low. Finally, he saw something far away. Could it be the princess?

The boy ran as fast as he could until he caught up to her. He was so happy!

They ran around, playing and laughing together. They even sang a song. Eventually, it was time for the boy to go home. But before he left, the princess gave him a big hug and said goodbye.

The boy had caught the princess! He was so excited. He held on to the hug from the princess, and walked back home with a smile on his face.

Mary was playing in her classroom when she had an idea. She was going to spoil all her classmates! She took three candy bars and started sharing them out, one bar to everyone else in her class. 

But then a teacher came in and saw what was happening. "Mary," she said, "what are you doing? You can't share out candy in the classroom."

Mary was shocked. She said, "But everyone else was going to be so happy I was sharing it."

But the teacher said, "It's not nice to be so ignorant. You could spoil everyone's appetite before lunch if you give them snacks now. Now, why don't you put the candy away?"

Mary felt really bad, but she knew the teacher was right. She put the candy away and decided that in future, she would act more kindly and not be so ignorant.

Andy wanted to see what was inside the big box, so he grabbed its hard knob and opened it. Inside, he found two funny-looking robots.

"Hi there!" one of the robots said, its voice sparkling and loud.

Andy gasped. He had never seen talking robots before!

"How do you do?" he asked, so excited he could hardly get the words out.

The robots talked to each other in a language Andy didn't understand. He wondered what they were saying.

The robots saw his puzzled look and began laughing. Then they started talking in a language Andy could understand. 

"We are here to show you something cool," one of the robots said.

Andy's eyes widened. Together, he and the robots explored the box, full of fun and surprises. From that day on, the robots and Andy were best friends.

Once upon a time there was a beetle. He had to pack for a big adventure. He scurried around the house gathering some food, a hat and a map. He was so excited, but also a little bit scared. 
 
He looked out into the unknown, wondering what lay ahead. He set off, ready for the journey. Little did he know what excitement, danger and surprises were in store. 
 
The beetle spent days travelling, meeting new friends along the way. Finally, he arrived at his destination: an amazing, unknown kingdom. He stretched, shook off the travel dust, and walked inside - ready to explore!

Once upon a time, there was a monkey called Pete who was very confused. He was sitting on top of a tree, wondering how he could help the other animals in the jungle.

Suddenly, Pete had an idea. He took fruits from the nearby trees and made a big pile of food at the base of the tree. All the animals in the jungle had a great feast!

The other animals were so happy that someone had helped them, that they wanted to return the favour. So, they decided to build a tall tower for Pete at the top of the tree.

Pete was so delighted at this gesture, that he felt his confusion disappear. From atop his tower, he could see the entire jungle and keep an eye out for the other animals.

The moral of the story is that it's always nice to help someone in need, because you never know what they might do to return the favour.

Lily and Tom were playing hide and seek in the park. Lily was very good at hiding. She found a big bush near the lake and hid behind it. Tom looked for her everywhere, but he could not find her. He called her name, but she did not answer. He felt sad and tired.

Lily saw Tom walking near the lake. She felt sorry for him. She wanted to end the game and have fun with him. She had an idea. She picked up a small stone and threw it into the lake. It made a big splash. Tom heard the splash and turned around. He saw Lily waving at him from behind the bush. He smiled and ran to her.

"Lily, you are so clever!" he said. "You hid very well. But how did you make the splash?"

Lily giggled and showed him the stone. "I threw it into the lake. It was easy."

Tom hugged her and said, "You are very clever, but you are also very kind. You surrendered to make me happy. Thank you, Lily. You are my best friend."

They held hands and walked to the swings. They played and laughed together until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear cool clothes and show off her pretty face. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. She wore her favorite dress and felt very happy.

But when she got to the park, she saw her friends wearing different clothes. They laughed at her dress and said it was not cool. Lily felt embarrassed and wanted to go home. She covered her face with her hands and cried.

Suddenly, her mom came to the park and saw Lily crying. She asked her what was wrong. Lily told her everything and her mom hugged her. She said, "Don't worry, Lily. You are always cool and beautiful, no matter what you wear. Don't let others make you feel embarrassed." Lily smiled and felt better. She hugged her mom and went back to play with her friends.

Once upon a time there lived a mighty warrior. He was very brave and strong and didn't know fear. One day he set off on a quest, for he wanted to capture a most magical prize. 

He searched far and wide and finally he found it - an old bathtub! He was so happy and ready to bring home his wonderful new prize. But he was soon stopped in his tracks by an old wizard. He warned the warrior that the bathtub contained a great power, and that soon it would have to be returned. 

The warrior was undaunted and he saw no reason to return the bathtub, as he had found it after all. But the wizard insisted and before the warrior knew it, the bathtub was returned to the wizard and the warrior was left with nothing. 

But the warrior realised that it was his own brave and mighty heart that had made the journey worthwhile and that he would treasure that forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys and his dog, Max. One day, Timmy and Max went for a walk in the park. 

As they walked, Timmy saw a big tree with lots of leaves. "Wow, Max! Look at that tree! I admire it," Timmy said. Max barked happily. 

Suddenly, Timmy heard a loud noise. It was a group of kids playing soccer. Timmy felt nervous because he didn't know them. "Don't worry, Timmy. They look friendly," Max said. 

Timmy took a deep breath and walked over to the kids. "Hi, my name is Timmy. Can I play with you?" he asked. The kids smiled and said yes. Timmy felt happy and left his nerves behind.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to pick blueberries with her mom. One sunny day, they went to find the sweet berries.

Mia saw a big bush with many blueberries. She kneeled down to pick them. The ground was rough, but she didn't mind. Mia and her mom filled their baskets with the yummy fruit.

After picking the blueberries, they went home. Mia's mom made a delicious pie. They ate the pie together and it was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse named Max. Max was feeling weak because he didn't have any cheese to eat. He asked his friend, a bird named Bella, if she had any food to share. Bella said, "I have some seeds but I can't open the file to get them out."

Max said, "I can help you with that!" He used his sharp teeth to open the file and Bella got her seeds. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise and saw a big cat coming towards them. Max quickly said, "We need to escape!" They ran as fast as they could and hid in a small hole. Max said, "That was close!" Bella thanked Max for his help and they both enjoyed their food together.

Once upon a time there was a young boy named Robby. He was very curious and liked learning new things. One day, his mommy took him to the library. He was so excited!

When he got there he was amazed! The library was so big and had an incredible amount of books! Robby couldn't believe there were so many! 

He asked his mommy, "How do I manage to read all of these books?". His mommy smiled and said, "Well, you just take a book off the shelf and then you start reading. Have fun!".

Robby nodded and started to explore the library. He read some books, made some new friends and before he knew it, it was time to go home. 

Robby was so happy with his library adventure. He had learned so much and had a really incredible time. He couldn't wait to come back soon!

Once there was a boy who wanted to have a fair fight. He asked his brother if he would play with him, and his brother gladly agreed. The boy had never played this game before and he forgot the rules.

His brother told him to take a slap and mark a line on the ground. The boy did what he was told and slapped the ground with his hand, leaving a mark on it.

The brother said it was his turn to slap the line, but he was too scared. His brother wanted him to be brave and to give it a try, so he took a deep breath and slapped the line.

He was so proud of himself! His brother smiled and said that was a very fair fight. The boy smiled back, glad they were able to have a fun and fair fight.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Kitty. Kitty was very sleepy one day. She wanted to take a nap. But before her nap, she wanted to drink some milk.

Kitty went to her friend, Cow. She said, "Cow, can you give me some milk, please?" Cow was very kind and said, "Of course, Kitty! Here is some milk for you." Kitty drank the milk and thanked Cow for being so nice.

After drinking the milk, Kitty felt even more sleepy. She found a soft and warm spot under a big tree and took a long nap. When she woke up, she felt happy and refreshed. From that day on, Kitty always remembered to be kind and share with her friends, just like Cow. And they all lived happily ever after.

The moral of the story is to be kind and share with others.

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play with their wagon. They put their toys in the wagon and pull it around the yard. Sometimes they take turns riding in the wagon.

One day, Sara is sick. She has to stay in bed. She cannot play with Ben. She misses him and the wagon. She feels sad and bored.

Ben comes to visit Sara. He brings the wagon with him. He knocks on the door. Sara's mom opens the door and lets him in. She says, "Sara, look who is here!"

Sara sees Ben and the wagon. She smiles and says, "Ben, you came! And you brought the wagon!"

Ben says, "Yes, I came. I missed you, Sara. Do you want to play with the wagon?"

Sara says, "Yes, I do. But I cannot go outside. I am sick."

Ben says, "That's okay. We can play with the wagon inside. We can make a pretend road with pillows and blankets. We can be drivers and passengers. We can have fun."

Sara says, "That sounds fun. Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend."

They play with the wagon inside. They have fun. They are not scared. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Claire. Claire loved to go for walks and today she decided to go for a walk through the park. She saw lots of great things like huge trees and beautiful flowers.

Claire was walking through the park and when she reached the playground she noticed something on the floor. Claire bent down to take a closer look. It was a shiny penny! Claire was so happy and she shouted, "Look! I found a penny!" 

A boy who was playing nearby heard her and ran over to her. His name was Joe. He said to Claire, "Let's gather all the pennies we can find!" 

Claire and Joe had a great time collecting all the pennies together. They collected three of them in all. 

When they were finished gathering pennies they ran back to the playground and challenged each other to see who could jump the highest. Joe and Claire had so much fun!

Once there was a mommy and a daddy who loved each other very much. Every night they kissed each other goodnight. One night, the daddy gave the mommy a very special gem. It was big and sparkly and the mommy loved it very much!

The gem was so important that the mommy kept it very safe in her pocket. Every night she kissed the gem before she kissed her husband goodnight.

One day, the mommy saw a little bird with a broken wing in the garden. The mommy wanted to help the bird so she gave it her gem to make it better. The bird was very happy and flew away.

The mommy was sad that she had to give away her gem, but she knew it was important to help the bird. She smiled and kissed the spot where the gem had been. Even without the gem, her love was still safe and strong.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy bake cookies. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to strip the leaves off the mint plant. Lily was very happy to help and did it very carefully.

But then, while the cookies were baking, Lily accidentally knocked over the flour and made a big mess. She felt very sorry and thought her mommy would be mad. But her mommy just smiled and said accidents happen and they can clean it up together.

Lily learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that saying sorry is important. She also learned that helping others, like stripping the mint leaves, can make them happy. From that day on, Lily always tried her best to help her mommy and be a good girl. The end.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Sarah. Sarah was 3 years old and she loved to play. One day, Sarah went to the park to play with her friends.

At the park, Sarah found a special jewel. It was bright and sparkly, she had never seen a jewel so pretty. She ran and showed it to her friends. They were so excited and all took turns playing with it.

The jewel was so much fun! They played with it for a long time and finally decided to keep it as a special secret between them. From then on, they played with the jewel every time they went to the park.

Sarah and her friends were very happy and played all day, taking turns with the special jewel.

One day, two kids, Sarah and Mark, were playing in the park. Sarah asked Mark what he wanted to do.

"Let's ride in a van!" said Mark.

So the two kids went to a nearby van. When they opened the door, they saw it was full of tasty food.

"Yum!" exclaimed Sarah.

The kids ate all the tasty food and stuffed their pockets with more. Then they drove around in the van. The sun began to set and it became dark.

"I'm scared," said Mark.

"Me too," said Sarah.

But then, the lights of the van turned on and the kids felt safe again. They drove until they got home and had the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved his enormous teddy bear and his bathrobe that was soft and cozy. One day, Timmy's little sister took his teddy bear without asking and hid it. Timmy was sad and didn't know what to do. 

Then, Timmy's mom told him that they were going to have a surprise bath time. Timmy got excited and ran to get his bathrobe. But when he got to his room, he saw that his bathrobe was missing too! Timmy started to cry because he didn't have his teddy bear or his bathrobe. 

But then, Timmy's mom found his teddy bear and his bathrobe hidden in his sister's room. Timmy was happy again and put on his bathrobe. He hugged his teddy bear and felt warm and cozy. The conflict was resolved and Timmy learned to share his things with his sister.

Lily and Ben were playing with a big red ball in the park. They liked to bounce the ball and catch it. They had a lot of fun.

But then, a big boy came and took their ball. He said, "This is my ball now. Go away, you are too small to play with it." He was very rude.

Lily and Ben were sad and angry. They said, "No, this is our ball. We brought it from home. You are not nice. Give it back to us."

The big boy laughed and said, "No, I won't. I make the law here. You have to do what I say." He bounced the ball very high and ran away.

Lily and Ben ran after him. They saw a policeman near the gate. They told him what happened. The policeman said, "That is not fair. That is not the law. The law says you have to share and be kind. I will help you get your ball back."

The policeman followed the big boy and stopped him. He said, "You have to give this ball back to Lily and Ben. They are the owners. You are not. You are breaking the law and hurting their feelings. That is wrong."

The big boy was scared and ashamed. He said, "I'm sorry. I was selfish and mean. Here is your ball. Please forgive me."

Lily and Ben took their ball and thanked the policeman. They said, "You are very good and brave. You helped us. Thank you."

The policeman said, "You are welcome. I'm glad you got your ball back. Remember, the law is there to protect and respect everyone. You have to follow the law and be nice to others. That is the right thing to do."

Lily and Ben nodded and smiled. They learned a lesson. They bounced their ball and played happily. They also invited the big boy to join them. He said yes and became their friend. They all had fun.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with boats. They have a big tub of water in the yard. They put their boats in the water and make them sail.

"Look, my boat is fast!" Tom says. He makes his boat go zoom.

"My boat is strong!" Sam says. He makes his boat push Tom's boat.

They laugh and have fun. They pretend the tub is a port. They put their boats in and out of the port.

But then they hear a loud noise. It is a dog. The dog is big and angry. It runs to the yard. It wants to bite their boats.

"Watch out!" Tom shouts. He is alert. He grabs his boat and runs.

"Me too!" Sam says. He is alert too. He grabs his boat and runs.

They run to the house. They are safe. The dog barks and goes away.

They hug their boats. They are happy. They still like to play with boats. But they do not like the dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little turtle named Timmy. Timmy loved to crawl around in nature and explore the world around him. One day, Timmy met a bald eagle named Eddie.

"Hello, Timmy," said Eddie. "What are you doing crawling around in nature?"

"I'm exploring," replied Timmy. "I like to see all the different things in nature."

Eddie smiled. "That's a great attitude, Timmy. Always be curious and never stop exploring."

Timmy learned that day that it's important to always be curious and explore the world around you, even if you're just crawling. He also learned to never judge someone by their appearance, as Eddie may have been bald, but he was still a wise and kind friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine with her friends. One day, Lily's friend Emma came over to play. Emma was a bit bossy and always wanted to be in charge.

Lily and Emma decided to play a game of tag. Emma was "it" and chased after Lily. As Lily ran away, she accidentally touched a prickly bush and got a scratch on her arm. She cried out in pain.

Emma saw that Lily was hurt and stopped the game. She apologized for being bossy and offered to help clean the scratch. Lily was grateful for her friend's kindness and forgave her for being bossy earlier.

From that day on, Lily and Emma played together happily, taking turns being the boss and making sure to be careful not to touch any prickly bushes.

Once upon a time there was a bear. He had a nice bookshelf in his house, full of books and things he liked. One day he wanted to carry it to his friend's house, so he decided to try. 

He picked it up and tried to carry it, but it was very heavy. He took a few steps, but it was too heavy. The bear was upset, so he put the bookshelf down. 

Suddenly, his friend the rabbit came along. The rabbit saw the bear was upset and said that he could help. He had a big cart, so they tried to put the bookshelf on it. 

With the rabbit's help, the bear managed to carry the heavy bookshelf to his friend's house. The bear was so happy! He thanked the rabbit for his help. 

From then on, the bear and the rabbit were good friends and helped each other whenever they needed it. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, while playing, Lily found a hidden treasure in the bushes. She was so excited and wanted to keep it for herself.

Lily's friend, Jack, saw her hiding the treasure and asked, "Can I see what you found, Lily?"

Lily hesitated for a moment, but then she let Jack see the treasure. Jack was very happy for Lily and said, "You will be rewarded for being so kind and sharing your treasure with me."

From that day on, Lily learned that sharing is caring and that when you let others see what you have, good things will come your way.

Once upon a time there were two friends called Dave and Tom. 

Dave and Tom lived in the same village and were the best of friends. They always played together and had lots of fun. 

One day they began to quarrel over a toy they both wanted. Dave became angry and they began shouting at each other. 

Tom's mom heard them and came to see what was going on. She saw how serious it was and tried to help them both. 

She told them that life was too short to spend it arguing and that the most important thing was to stay friends. 

Dave and Tom listened to their mum and understood that quarrelling was not a good thing. They made up and hugged each other before explaining what had happened. 

After this they agreed not to quarrel over anything and to always stay best friends. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a big family. Every day they gathered together to share meals and stories. One day, a big storm came and made it very dark and cold outside. 

The family went outside to find ash covering the ground. Everyone got tired from the cold, so they decided to go inside and warm up. 

While inside, they gathered around the fireplace. The family laughed and had fun together while watching the flames dance. Everyone was so warm and cozy that they soon fell asleep. 

When they awoke the next morning, they were happy to see the sun shining brightly. The family was refreshed and ready to start a new day together. 

The family gathered together, feeling joy and warmth once again. They were grateful for the time spent together and never forgot the importance of gathering together even when things get tough.

Once upon a time, there was a small statue that lived in a garden. The statue was only 3cm tall and made out of wood. Everyday the statue would try to manage all the things around him.

One day, the statue wanted to find something to do, so he started working on a garden bed. He managed to move a bunch of stones to make the bed. Then he arranged all the pretty flowers around it. 

The little statue was really proud of what he'd managed to do. After that, he believed he could do anything he wanted. 

So he asked the other garden statues for help in creating a magical garden. He managed to organize the team and together they built a beautiful place. Everyone was so happy with the results! 

The small statue managed to make all the garden statues work together and create something beautiful. He showed that although he was small, he could still manage to do big things. 

The end.

The sun was brightly shining and Mary had a good feeling inside. Today she was going to do something extra special.

She grabbed a bowl and filled it up with water. Then she took out three shapes and put them into the bowl. She was sure the shapes would soak for a while, so she said goodbye and went outside to play.

Hours later, Mary came back inside. She took out the shapes from the water and admired them. Each of them now had a shimmering and dependable coating.

Mary ran back outside with her shapes and saw that the sun was now setting. How perfect, she thought. Soon enough it would be time for bed. But not before she gave her shapes a good use.

Mary smiled and started creating a beautiful painting. The shimmering shapes sparkled in the sunlight, creating a stunning picture she knew she could depend on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bake cakes with her mommy. One day, they decided to make a chocolate cake. Lily's mommy got out the mixer and started to mix the ingredients together. 

Lily was watching her mommy mix the ingredients and she thought to herself, "I think this cake is going to taste so yummy!" 

Suddenly, the mixer made a loud noise and Lily's mommy became alert. She quickly turned off the mixer and checked to see what happened. 

"Lily, did you put too much flour in the mixer?" asked her mommy. 

Lily looked at her mommy and replied, "No mommy, I didn't put too much flour. I think it was just a loud noise." 

Lily's mommy smiled and said, "You're right, Lily. It was just a loud noise. Let's finish mixing the cake batter and put it in the oven." 

Lily was happy that she helped her mommy and couldn't wait to eat the chocolate cake.

Anna and Ben are playing with blocks in the living room. They like to build towers and houses and bridges with the blocks. They have many colors of blocks: red, blue, yellow, green, and more.

"Look, Anna, I made a big tower!" Ben says, showing his blocks to his sister. "It is very high and strong!"

Anna looks at Ben's tower and smiles. She likes his tower, but she also wants to make her own. She picks up some blocks and starts to build next to Ben.

"Can I have some of your blocks, Ben?" Anna asks. "I need more to make my tower."

Ben shakes his head. "No, Anna, these are my blocks. You have your own blocks. Go away!"

Anna feels sad and angry. She does not like Ben's answer. She wants to share the blocks with him. She thinks he is being mean and selfish.

She decides to do something bad. She pushes Ben's tower with her hand. The blocks fall down and break. They make a loud noise.

"Anna, why did you do that?" Ben cries. "You broke my tower! You are a bad sister!"

Anna feels sorry for what she did. She sees Ben's tears and hears his cry. She knows she made a mistake.

"I'm sorry, Ben, I'm sorry!" Anna says. "I did not mean to break your tower. I was mad at you, but I should not have pushed your blocks. Can you forgive me?"

Ben looks at Anna and sees her face. She looks sad and sorry too. He remembers that she is his sister and he loves her.

"It's okay, Anna, I forgive you," Ben says. "But don't do that again, okay? It is not nice to break other people's things."

Anna nods and hugs Ben. "Okay, Ben, I won't do that again. I love you, brother."

They hug and make up. They decide to share the blocks and build a new tower together. They have fun and play nicely.

The end.

One day, a small girl was walking through her garden. She saw a white oak tree standing tall and strong in the middle. She stopped and looked up at it in wonder.

The girl wanted to climb it so she carefully scaled the tree and soon found herself perched in a seat high up in the white oak. She was so happy with the view she had, she almost didn't want to come down!

But eventually, the girl tired and had to go. She climbed down carefully, never forgetting the wonderful white oak and the seat she sat in. From then on, she would visit the tree every day and be happy.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bee named Buzzy. Buzzy loved to fly around and explore the world. He flew above a river and saw something very interesting. It was an oxygen tank, split in two!

Buzzy flew around the tank, confused. He had never seen anything like it before. Buzzy wanted to get closer, so he carefully flew inside the oxygen tank. It was dark, but he could still see water everywhere around him.

He decided it was time to find out where the split had happened. He flew up to the top of the oxygen tank and saw that it was very broken. There was a big crack in the middle. That must have been what caused the tank to split.

Buzzy flew out of the tank and went back to his friends. He told them all about his amazing discovery. They were very impressed! From that day on, they all paid more attention to the world around them.
