Amy was so happy - she couldn't wait to start shooting. With Grandma's help, she aimed the gun and chose a target. Then she pulled the trigger and ...POW! She had shot her first target! 

Amy was so proud of herself and had lots of fun shooting the toy gun. From that day on, she spent hours playing in the fancy room with her toy gun.

Monkey was outside playing when it started to shiver. Clouds had filled the sky and the weather had changed. 

Monkey ran to his Mommy and said, "Mommy, I shiver. It's cold outside." 

Mommy put a wrap around Monkey's shoulders and said, "My sweet, fragile Monkey, it's starting to rain. You'd better stay inside where it's warm and cozy." 

Monkey nodded and went inside. He felt warm and safe. 

Mommy smiled and said, "Look outside and watch the rain. See the sparkles from the sun?" Monkey saw them and smiled. "Oh, I love the weather!"

One day there was a scary laser. No one knew what it was for. Everyone was scared because it was so big and loud.

The people wanted to sort the laser out, but they didn't know how. They asked the children to help them.

The children were brave and wanted to help. One of them named John said, "I know how to play with the laser." He showed them how to make the laser move around like a toy.

Everyone was happy that the laser was sorted out. They had fun playing with it. The people were very thankful for John's help. John became a hero that day!

Once upon a time, there was a hairy wolf. The wolf was very creative and liked to design things. One day, he designed a beautiful bridge that connected two sides of a river. 

Every day, the wolf would look out over the bridge and feel proud of what he had designed. But the wolf wanted to design something even better. So he had a special idea. 

He designed a giant ferry boat which could carry lots of animals across the river. It was a great success! Now the animals could get across easily and the wolf was very happy. 

The hairy wolf had designed something that everyone could use and enjoy. And from then on, he was known as the most creative wolf in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a big room with a blackboard. In this room, a little dog named Spot lived. Spot was an unusual dog because he could draw on the blackboard. Every day, he would use his paws to make fun pictures.

One day, Spot was very tired. He wanted to sleep, but he could not find a good place to rest. He looked around the room and saw a soft pillow next to the blackboard. Spot thought it would be a great place to sleep.

Spot walked over to the pillow and lay down. He closed his eyes and began to sleep. As he slept, he dreamed of drawing on the blackboard. When he woke up, he saw that he had drawn a beautiful picture in his sleep. Spot was very happy and continued to draw and sleep next to the blackboard every day.

Once there was a young girl called Kate. One day, Kate was playing in the garden when she suddenly tripped and hurt her leg. She started crying and felt really sad.

Her mum came outside and said, "Oh no, Kate! You need a bandage. Let's get you one".

Kate shook her head and said, "No! I don't need a bandage".

Mum said, "Yes, Kate. You were so silly running around and now you need a bandage. Off we go".

Kate said, "No! I don't want to go! I don't need a bandage".

Mum said, "Oh Kate, you might not want a bandage now, but you need one, so let's go!"

Finally, Kate realised her mum was right and said, "Ok, I need a bandage".

So they went to the store and got a bandage for Kate. She put it on and felt much better. 
Mum said, "See, it's not so bad to admit that you need help sometimes".

Kate smiled and said, "Yes, I'm glad I'm still young enough to get away with silly things".

Once upon a time, there was a big, mean dragon. He lived in a dark cave and would shout really loud whenever he was angry. One day, a brave knight came to fight the dragon. The dragon was so rude to the knight and tried to scare him away. But the knight was not afraid. He had a plan.

He poured oil all over the dragon's cave and lit a match. The oil caught fire and the dragon was trapped. He couldn't shout anymore. The knight saved the day and everyone was happy. The end.

Little Joe wanted to drive. He hopped into his dad's car and gave it a try. The car made a funny noise and Joe's dad laughed. Little Joe laughed too.

Joe's dad showed him how to drive. Joe put his hands on the wheel, and his feet on the pedals. He watched as his dad drove around the block. Joe wanted to be just like his dad.

He practiced and practiced until he was a good driver. Gradually, Joe's success grew and he felt proud.

To celebrate, Joe took his dad out for a colorful drive. They drove past the rainbow colors of the sunset. Little Joe was so happy. He had done it! He was a successful driver!

Once upon a time, there was a hero. He had a special job - he had to store all the smooth rocks, so no one could take them away. He was a very special hero!

Every day, the hero would climb up a big hill and store the smooth rocks. He knew it was very important work and he was proud of himself!

At the end of the day, the hero would head back down the hill with bags full of smooth rocks. He was exhausted but happy. He knew he'd done a great job, and he'd help to keep the rocks safe.

And that's what the hero did every single day. On and on, he'd gather and store smooth rocks - and he was the bravest hero ever.

Tom and Sue are on a team. They play soccer with other kids. They like to kick the ball and run fast. They wear red shirts and blue shorts.

One day, they have a big game. They want to win and get a trophy. They go to the field with their coach and their friends. They see the other team. They wear green shirts and yellow shorts.

The other team has an old ball. It is brown and dirty. It has holes and patches. It looks like it will rot soon. Tom and Sue think it is a bad ball.

"Look at their ball!" Tom says to Sue. "It is old and ugly. It will not bounce well. We have a better ball. It is new and shiny. It will bounce high. We will win for sure!"

Sue nods. She agrees with Tom. She thinks they have a better ball. She thinks they will win for sure.

But they are wrong. The game starts and the other team plays well. They are fast and smart. They pass the ball and score goals. They do not care about their old ball. They only care about playing hard and having fun.

Tom and Sue are sad and mad. They do not play well. They miss the ball and lose goals. They care too much about their new ball. They do not have fun.

The game ends and the other team wins. They get the trophy and cheer. They are happy and proud. They thank their coach and their friends. They say good game to Tom and Sue.

Tom and Sue are sorry. They realize they were wrong. They learn a lesson. They say sorry to their coach and their friends. They say good game to the other team. They say nice ball to the other team.

The other team smiles. They say thank you to Tom and Sue. They say nice ball to Tom and Sue. They say they had fun playing with them. They say they can share their ball next time.

Tom and Sue smile too. They say thank you to the other team. They say they had fun playing with them too. They say they can share their ball next time too.

They all shake hands and hug. They are all on a team. They all love soccer. They all have fun.

Once upon a time, in a regular town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to march all day long. He would march up and down the street with a big smile on his face.

One day, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue did not like to march. In fact, she said, "I hate to march." Tim was sad to hear this, but he wanted to be friends with Sue. So, Tim decided to teach Sue how to march and have fun.

As they marched together, Sue started to smile. She said, "I don't hate to march anymore. I like it now!" Tim and Sue marched happily together every day. They became the best of friends.

The moral of the story is: don't be afraid to try new things, because you might find something you like and make new friends along the way.

Once upon a time there was a nice world. It was a happy place, full of nice things.

One day, all the animals in the world decided to start something special, they wanted to make the world even nicer than before. 

The animals worked together to put up new decorations, paint buildings and make a big park full of colourful flowers and trees.

The world looked so beautiful afterwards! Everyone was so happy with the result and they decided to have a great big party to celebrate.

Everyone enjoyed the party, playing and eating yummy food. After lots of fun, everyone said goodbye and it was time to go home.

The nice world was even nicer than before and everyone had a happy ending.

Once there was a boy called Bob. Bob went for a walk in the forest, and he stumbled over some sticks on the ground. He felt something squishy under his feet, so he looked down. He was very surprised to see a white tomato! Bob had never seen a white tomato before, so he was very excited. He picked it up and started to eat it. It was delicious!

Bob kept walking, but then he stumbled again. This time, he saw something even more exciting - a beautiful white rabbit! The rabbit hopped away before Bob had a chance to catch it.

Bob was disappointed that he couldn't catch the rabbit, but he was still very happy. He went home with the white tomato, thinking about the wonderful things he had seen that day.

Once upon a time there was a very brave girl called Amy. Amy wanted to win a trophy for her bravery.

So she set off on a big journey to try and win a trophy. As she passed through the forest she became very fearful but she kept going.

Finally she came to a deep, dark hole. She was so scared, but she was brave and she slowly stepped towards the hole. Suddenly, something popped out of the hole - it was a trophy!

Amy was so happy and clapped her hands in delight. She could now show everyone how brave she was and she took the trophy with her back home.

When she arrived, everyone was so proud of her. They all clapped and cheered to show that they appreciated her bravery and hard work. From then on, Amy was known as the bravest girl around!

Once upon a time, there was a girl. Her name was Jane, and she wanted to be happy. But she was very sad because there was something terrible on her shelf. It was a monster, and it scared her a lot. 

Every day, Jane looked up at the monster on her shelf and was too scared to do anything. She cried a lot and couldn't sleep.

One night, Jane had an idea. She decided to hope that the monster would go away. So, she closed her eyes and said the magic word: "Hope!"

The next morning, Jane opened her eyes and looked up. The monster was gone! Jane smiled and was very happy. She had hoped with all her might, and it worked!

The End.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the farm with her mom. They saw a big field of corn, and Lily was so happy. She loved corn and wanted to eat it all. 

Suddenly, a chicken came and started eating the corn too. Lily told the chicken to stop eating her corn, but the chicken didn't listen. 

Then, Lily's mom gave her a bag of corn to give to the chicken. Lily felt guilty for being angry at the chicken before. She gave the corn to the chicken, and the chicken was so happy that it stopped eating the corn in the field. 

From that day on, Lily and the chicken were friends, and they shared the corn together.

Once upon a time, there was a nice little bird. He was so charming and had beautiful feathers. The bird was looking for a place to fly and play. One day, he spotted a big cage in the middle of the garden. He flew towards it and landed on the cage. Standing on the cage, the bird looked through the bars and noticed there were many colorful fruits and seeds inside. 

He was so excited and opened the door to go inside. Once he was in the cage, the bird began jumping around and eating the sweet fruits. It was so fun! He enjoyed the time in the cage very much. 

But soon the bird noticed the garden was getting dark and the cage door had been shut while he was inside. He was stuck in the cage and tried to get out. He hopped up and down, flapped his wings, and pecked the door but it didn't open. 

Suddenly, a friendly girl appeared, who was charming and kind. She opened the door and the bird flew out. He thanked the girl with a happy chirp and flew away, never to forget the cage.

Once there was a little girl named Sally. One day, while she was walking in the park, she saw a stand with a rope stretching tight. She couldn't see what was at the other end.

Sally was very curious, so she walked slowly towards the stand. As she got closer she saw a beautiful trampoline. On the trampoline, there was a bouncing little kitten. He was so happy that he kept jumping up and down.

When Sally got to the trampoline, she couldn't help but smile. She wanted to join the kitten, so she grabbed the rope and started to swing on it.

The little girl laughed as she swung back and forth. Every time she got close to the trampoline, she would spring off and jump onto it with the kitten. They laughed and bounced and played together for hours.

The tight rope held them and the trampoline gave them enough lift to jump higher than ever. When they were finished, the stand held them until they reached the ground.

Once upon a time, there was a kind cat who liked to gaze out of the window. One day, while she was looking out of the window, she saw a small boy appear in the garden. 
The cat said, "Hello little one, what brings you here?"

The boy smiled and said, "I just wanted to say hello to you and give you a big hug!"

The kind cat was very pleased to receive the hug and thanked the boy. She said, "I hope you can come back soon and give me more cuddles and we can gaze out of the window together!"

The boy said, "I would love to come back, goodbye for now!"

The kind cat waved goodbye to the little boy and watched him leave. She went back to gazing out of the window, knowing that the little boy would be back soon for more cuddles.

One day, a little sheep went out to play. The sheep liked to play in the big, empty field. The sun was shining, and the sky was blue. The sheep was very happy.

The little sheep saw a big tree in the empty field. It ran to the tree and played with the leaves. The sheep liked the sound the leaves made when it touched them. It played and played until it was tired.

When the little sheep was done playing, it laid down under the big tree. The sheep looked up at the sky and saw the clouds. It felt happy and sleepy. The little sheep closed its eyes and took a nap.

Once upon a time there was a brave warrior who lived far away in the forest. 

One day the warrior sailed away to explore the world on a small boat. They sailed around for hours and hours, eventually coming to a new land.

The warrior was curious so they jumped off the boat and started to explore. But it was uncomfortable, so the warrior decided to go back to the boat.

In their hurry to get back, the warrior called out, â€œQuick! Quick!â€. It was then that a friendly bird flew over. The warrior smiled and asked the bird, â€œDo you know a faster way to sail?â€ 

The bird replied, â€œOf course! Follow me, I'll show you!â€ The warrior quickly hopped on the boat and followed the bird. 

The bird showed the warrior how to make the boat sail faster and soon the warrior was on their way. The breeze was gentle and the warrior felt comfortable once again. 

The warrior thanked the bird for showing them the way and sailed away, never to forget the bird's kindness.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear who was very curious. He loved to explore the forest and find new things. One day, he found a big ball with spikes on it. He was scared at first, but then he got closer and saw that the spikes were not sharp. He touched them and felt that they were squishy.

The little bear wanted to take the ball home with him, so he tried to attach it to his backpack. But it was too heavy and it fell off. He tried again and again, but it just wouldn't stay on. Finally, he asked his friend the rabbit for help. The rabbit knew how to attach things, so he showed the little bear how to do it. They worked together and finally got the ball attached to the backpack.

The little bear was so happy to have the ball with him. He showed it to all his friends and they all thought it was very cool. From that day on, the little bear and the rabbit were always looking for new things to attach to their backpacks.

Once upon a time, there were two boys called Jimmy and Tony who were very curious. One day, they decided to dare each other to go to the zoo. 

Jimmy said "Let's go to the zoo. I dare you!" Tony was brave, so he said "Yes, I dare too!".

They packed their bags and went to the zoo. They saw so many animals, such as tigers, monkeys, and elephants. They were amazed!

They heard some noise and followed it. It was the lions! They were roaring so loud that the boys were scared, but very interested. Jimmy and Tony watched the lions from a safe distance.

After that, they went home. They had a great time and promised to go back to the zoo again.

One day, a happy fish named Fin wanted to raise a big rock. Under the rock was a pretty scale. The scale was shiny and blue. Fin wanted the scale to make his home look nice.

Fin asked his friend, a strong crab named Claw, to help him. Claw said, "Yes, I can help you raise the rock!" They worked together to lift the rock. It was heavy, but they did it.

When the rock was raised, Fin took the shiny scale and put it in his home. Fin and Claw were very happy. They swam and played together all day. Fin's home looked so nice with the pretty scale.

The little girl was very sad. Her siblings had stolen her shampoo! She had been looking forward to using it on her hair, but now it was gone.

The girlâ€™s mom asked, "What happened?"

The little girl told her mom, "My brothers stole my shampoo!" 

The mother said, "That can't be true. They wouldn't steal something from you."

The little girl was very upset and she said, "Yes, they did! I saw them take it!" 

The mother was stunned. She was sure they just wanted to play, and maybe they got a little dizzy. 

"Let's go find them," the mother said. 

The little girl and her mom went looking and eventually found the little girl's brothers. They had taken the shampoo and were playing with it. 

The mother said, "Why did you take your sister's shampoo?"

The brothers said they wanted to play with it and didn't mean to steal it. 

The mother said, "We don't steal things! Go put the shampoo back."

The brothers apologized to their sister and put the shampoo back where it belonged. 

The little girl was happy to have her shampoo back. She gave her brothers a big hug and thanked them for being honest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in a small town. One day, she went out to the park to play. As she skipped around, she spotted a red ball. With a squeal of delight, she ran towards the ball and began to bounce it.

"Look at me, Mommy! I'm bouncing the ball!" the little girl exclaimed. 

Her mom smiled. "Yes, you are! You look so happy!", she said.

The girl kept bouncing the ball until she got too tired. All of a sudden, she felt guilty. She had taken the ball without asking.

"Mommy, I'm sorry. I took the ball without asking," she said softly.

Her mom smiled. "It's okay, sweetheart. Let's take it back to the park tomorrow and let someone else have a turn," she said kindly.

The little girl smiled and hugged her mom. She felt much better now that she had taken responsibility for her actions. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to take responsibility and not to feel guilty when we make mistakes.

Once upon a time, there was a brave bee. He buzzed around looking for food and play. One day, he started to fly really fast. Suddenly, he saw a flower and decided to land on it.

Suddenly, the bee heard a voice from below. It was a little girl playing in the garden and she asked the bee: "What are you doing up there?"

The bee replied: "I'm looking for food, and I'm having fun flying around."

The little girl smiled and said: "That sounds like fun. I wish I could fly too!"

The bee smiled back and said: "Maybe one day you can! Just keep dreaming." They said goodbye and the bee started flying again, this time even faster.

The little girl watched the bee until it was out of sight and smiled to herself. She knew that if she kept dreaming and hoped hard enough, one day she too would be able to fly.

Ben and Lily liked to play pirates. They had a big box that was their ship. They had hats and swords and a map. The map showed them where to find treasure. They wanted to find the treasure and share it with their friends.

One day, they sailed their ship to a new island. They followed the map to a big cave. They saw a shiny chest inside the cave. They ran to the chest and opened it. They found gold and jewels and toys. They were very happy.

But then, they heard a loud roar. A big dragon came out of the cave. It was angry and hungry. It wanted to eat Ben and Lily and their treasure. Ben and Lily were very scared. They grabbed some treasure and ran back to their ship. But the dragon followed them. It breathed fire and smoke. It burned their ship and their map. Ben and Lily were trapped. Their ship and their map were broken.

They cried for help. They hoped someone would hear them. They hugged each other and prayed.

Then, they saw a bright light. It was their friend Sam. He had a flashlight and a water gun. He had seen their ship and their map on fire. He came to rescue them. He shone his flashlight at the dragon. The dragon was afraid of the light. It covered its eyes and roared. Sam sprayed his water gun at the dragon. The water made the fire go out. The dragon was wet and cold. It ran away and hid in the cave.

Sam helped Ben and Lily get out of their ship. He gave them a hug and a smile. He said he was glad they were okay. He said he was sorry their ship and their map were broken. He said he had a new map and a new ship. He said they could use them to find more treasure. He said they could share it with him and their other friends.

Ben and Lily thanked Sam. They said he was a brave and kind pirate. They said he was their hero. They said they were sorry they lost some treasure. They said they still had some treasure to share. They said they had the best treasure of all. They said they had each other and their friends.

They followed Sam to his new ship. They sailed away to a new adventure. They were happy and safe. They were pirates.

Joe was a boy who loved to play. One day, he wanted to play with a hoop. However, he only had an orange hoop. Joe and his mom went to the store together, but Joe started to complain when he didn't see the kind of hoop he wanted.

Mom said to Joe, "What kind of hoop do you want, sweetheart?". Joe replied, "A blue one, mommy, not an orange one". His mom laughed and said, "I think an orange hoop is lovely, and it will look really nice in your room, right?". 

Joe thought about it, and then nodded his head in agreement. The two went home with the orange hoop, and Joe smiled all the way. Joe's mom was so happy to see Joe so happy and content. So, Joe played with his hoop for hours, and he never complained anymore.

Once upon a time, there were two chambers. They were far away from each other. Each chamber had a smart creature living inside. The creatures were so intelligent. They decided to work together to help each other.

One day, they noticed that the chambers were starting to separate from each other. They knew they needed to keep their chambers together. So, they worked together and figured out a way to keep the chambers close.

They put together a long, strong string and tied one end to each chamber. Then, the smart creatures held on the other ends and kept the chambers together.

Then, each chamber stayed close and the two intelligent creatures never had to worry about separating again.
The end!

Mary and James were happily playing together in the summer sunshine. Mary thought to herself that summer was very attractive. She smiled, then said to James, "Let's add something to our game."

"What should we add?" asked James.

"What about if we pretend there is a cave under the tree, and we have to explore it. We can take a stick and a pretend map!" Mary replied.

James's eyes lit up with excitement. "That sounds great!"

Mary and James gathered some sticks and stones, and began their adventures. They pretended they were discovering all kinds of things in their pretend cave, and enjoyed their game so much they didn't want to stop.

The two friends made up amazing stories as they explored, adding new ideas to their game. Summer was the best time to adventure together and have lots of fun!

Once upon a time there was a grumpy old man called Jack. Every day, he would sit by the window and watch the world go by. Jack was very sad because he had lost something very important to him. But he didn't know how to fix it.

One day, a little girl called Jazz came by. She had heard about Jack's problem and wanted to help him. She had a plan to make Jack happy again. Jazz grabbed a bucket and some paint and started to fix up Jack's house. She painted it with lots of bright colours that made Jack smile.

Jazz also put on some music for him. It was jazzy music and it made Jack's heart feel light. He was no longer grumpy. He laughed and smiled and was happier than ever! Jazz had fixed Jack's problem and he was very grateful.

Amy and Tim were standing in the garden. Amy had a big box and Tim had a small one. Tim was very excited and said: "Let's race!" 

Amy opened the lid of her box and took out two labels. "You can have the blue one and I'll have the red one," she said and gave one to Tim. 

The two of them ran about in the garden. They raced around a tree, then up and down the path. It was so much fun!

But soon, the garden was very messy. Leaves and twigs and little stones were scattered all around. 

Amy and Tim stopped running. "We had better tidy up," said Amy. 

So they both began to collect the labels and put them back in the box. After a few minutes the garden was tidy again. 

Amy smiled and said: "That was a great race!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a small desk in his room where he liked to draw. One day, Tim saw a big bug on his desk. He was scared, but he wanted to be careful. So, he called his mom.

"Mom, there is a big bug on my desk! What should I do?" Tim asked. His mom said, "Be careful, Tim. Don't touch the bug. I will come and help you."

But Tim didn't listen. He wanted to be brave. He tried to catch the bug with his hands. The bug was fast and it bit Tim's finger. It hurt a lot.

Tim cried and his mom came running. She saw the bug and Tim's finger. She was sad because Tim didn't listen to her. Tim's finger was red and it hurt for many days. Tim learned to be careful and listen to his mom.

One day, Jimmy was bored. He had nothing to do, until he saw his mom's hanger. He had an idea to pretend the hanger was a telephone. He picked up the hanger and said into it, "Hello? Is anyone there?" Suddenly, his best friend Charlie was on the line! Charlie said, "Hey Jimmy! Are you doing anything fun?" Jimmy said, "No, I'm pretending this hanger is a telephone." Charlie laughed and said, "That sounds fun! What else are you going to pretend?" Jimmy said, "Let me think! I'm going to pretend I'm a pirate, searching for treasure." Charlie said, "That sounds fine! Have fun playing!"

Jimmy hung up the hanger and went to his room. He got out his toy treasure chest and a hat. He put on the hat and yelled, "Ahoy! I'm a pirate looking for treasure!" Suddenly, he heard a knock on his door. It was his mom. She said, "What are you pretending to be, Jimmy?" Jimmy said, "I'm a pirate looking for treasure!" His mom said with a smile, "That sounds like a lot of fun!"

One day, a noisy dog named Max set out to find his ball. He looked all around the yard but could not find it. Max was sad and wanted to play with his ball.

Max saw his friend, Tom the cat, near the exit of the yard. Max asked, "Tom, did you see my ball?" Tom said, "Yes, it went through the exit. But a big dog took it."

Max was scared but wanted his ball back. He went through the exit and saw the big dog. Max said, "Please give me my ball back." The big dog growled, but then saw Max's sad face. The big dog felt bad and gave the ball back to Max.

Max and the big dog became friends and played with the ball together. They were both happy and made a lot of noise as they played.

Once there was a chubby little girl named Jane. Jane wanted very badly to learn how to play the piano. Every day she heard the piano music coming from her neighbor's house, and it made her want to learn even more. However, her parents did not permit her to learn. They said she was too young and it was too expensive.

Jane was determined to change her parents' minds, so she hatched a plan. She practiced very hard on an old piano that was in her grandmother's attic. When her parents came to visit, she asked them if she could play them a song. To Jane's surprise, they said yes!

As Jane played, her parents were so amazed. They finally let her take piano lessons. Jane was so happy that she could finally learn how to play the piano she had been dreaming about.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play in the yard. One day, they see a big dog in the yard. The dog is smelly and angry. It barks at them and runs to them.

Tom and Sam are scared. They run to the house. But the door is locked. Mom is not home. They look for a place to hide. They see a big box. They jump in the box.

The dog comes to the box. It smells the box. It bites the box. Tom and Sam are quiet. They hope the dog will go away.

But the dog does not go away. It pushes the box. The box falls over. Tom and Sam fall out. The dog sees them. It barks louder.

Tom and Sam see a belt on the ground. It is Dad's belt. Tom picks up the belt. He swings the belt at the dog. The dog is surprised. It backs away.

Tom and Sam run to the fence. They climb over the fence. They escape from the dog. They are safe.

They go to the neighbor's house. They knock on the door. The neighbor opens the door. She sees Tom and Sam. She sees the belt. She sees the smelly dog.

She says, "What happened?" Tom and Sam tell her the story. She says, "You are brave boys. Come in. I will call your mom." Tom and Sam are happy. They hug the neighbor. They hug each other. They are glad they escaped from the smelly dog.

Once upon a time there was a boy who only wanted one thing - a big TV. Every day he asked his mom and dad for an enormous TV, but they would just tell him, "No!" 

One morning he woke up and ran to the living room. He couldn't believe his eyes, there in front of him was a huge TV! He jumped up and shouted, "Yay! I get a TV!" 

The boy ran over to the TV and tried to turn it on, but it didn't work. He shook it and shook it and then he heard a voice. He quickly stepped back in surprise. 

The voice said, "Hello, little boy! I'm the TV genie! You get a wish for my TV and I'll make it come true!"

The boy thought for a moment and then he said, "I want the TV to make me happy and play games all day!"

The TV genie said, "Your wish is granted! Enjoy your enormous TV!" 

The boy was so excited and he played games all day long with his enormous TV! The End.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside, but it was getting cold. His mom said, "Timmy, you need to wear your jacket to stay warm." Timmy didn't want to wear his jacket because it was rough and scratchy.

Timmy's mom said, "I know your jacket is rough, but you have to wear it to stay warm." Timmy said, "I don't want to wear it, it's not comfortable." His mom said, "You can add a scarf to make it more comfortable."

Timmy thought about it and said, "Okay, I will wear my jacket with a scarf." Later, Timmy went outside to play with his friends. His friends said, "Why are you wearing a jacket? It's not that cold." Timmy said, "My mom said I have to wear it to stay warm." His friends said, "We don't want to wear jackets, let's play inside."

Timmy didn't want to play inside, so he said, "I will take off my jacket and play with you." But when he took off his jacket, he got cold and started to shiver. His friends said, "Are you okay?" Timmy said, "No, I need my jacket to stay warm." His friends said, "We're sorry, we didn't know. Let's add another game to make it more fun!" And they all played together happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a whale. She was very smooth and shiny. She swam in the icy sea for many days, searching for food. 
But then one day, she accidently lost her way! No matter how hard she tried, she couldn't find her way home.

The whale was so sad - she missed swimming with her friends. She felt all alone. Then one day, something amazing happened. 
A little shell, which was very smooth, started to follow her. She slowly realized it was her old friend, the starfish! 
The little starfish helped the whale find her way home. As they swam back, they were very happy they had found each other again. 

The whale and the starfish stayed together, and never lost their way again.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit who lived in a tiny house. He was very happy and peaceful, but one day, a bad thing happened: smoke filled the sky. The little rabbit was scared. He had never seen smoke before and he didn't know what to do.

The poor little rabbit felt so scared and all alone. He wanted to escape from the smoke. He looked all around, but he couldn't find anywhere to hide. He was so helpless.

Suddenly, he saw a hole near some trees. He hopped over to it and looked inside. There, he saw his friend, a deaf hedgehog. 

The little rabbit asked, "Can I go in with you? There is so much smoke outside."

The deaf hedgehog thought for a minute and then nodded. The little rabbit went in and the two of them stayed in the safe, quiet hole until the smoke cleared away. 

The little rabbit was so happy that he had been able to escape the smoke, and he never wanted to experience anything like it ever again. He was also happy that he had his friend the deaf hedgehog to help him escape. They were friends forever and ever. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a brother and sister who were young and loved to play together. All day long, they would settle down in the garden to play together.

One day, out of the blue, something unusual happened. The brother got a strange noise and then a spark came out of his tummy! The sister was amazed and was worried about her brother.

The sister helped her brother get back on his feet and asked him how he felt. He said he was feeling better and the noise and spark hadn't happened again.

The brother and sister were so relieved and they hugged each other so tightly. From then on, they always looked out for each other and helped each other in times of need. And they lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time there was a boy called Jake. He was three years old and could not wait to play with his friends. On that day, Jake went to the park. He brought his ball and his scooter. 

When Jake got there, he saw three other kids playing jazz. Jake wanted to join in and asked if he could play too. The other kids were a little rude and said, "No, this is our game". 

Jake did not know what to do, so he decided to just sit down and watch. But as he was sitting, his ball slipped out of his hands. It rolled over to the kids playing jazz. 

The kids stopped and were surprised. They asked Jake if he wanted to join them. As the day went on, Jake got better and better at playing jazz with his new friends. He had a really fun day. In the end, Jake was really happy he did not stay home.

There was once a wild flower in a meadow. It had beautiful yellow petals and smelled so sweet. The flower was so happy, until a cold wind blew. All of a sudden, the flower shivered and felt so alone.

Then a little girl came by. She was wearing a green dress and had rosy cheeks. She saw the wild flower shivering and wanted to help. She carefully bent over and held the flower in her hands.

The flower felt so warm and safe in her hands. The girl smiled and carried the flower to her house. She put it in a small pot and put it by the window. Now the flower could look outside and feel happy and warm.

The girl watered the wild flower every day and watched it grow. The flower was so happy and thanked the little girl by giving off a strong, sweet smell. The girl smiled and blew the flower a kiss.

The wild flower will always have a special place in the girl's heart. She will always remember the times she held the wild flower in her hands.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy bear. He was so tired that he could barely keep his eyes open. He went out for a walk and stumbled upon a big hill. He was so sleepy that he wanted to take a nap. He started to push and push at the hill, trying to make it smaller.

Suddenly, he saw something between the rocks. It was a big block of cheese! The bear was so excited! He stopped pushing and started to eat the cheese. It was so tasty!

When the bear had finished the cheese, he was feeling much better. He wasn't so sleepy anymore. He went back down the hill and back to his home. From that day on, he was never so sleepy again!

Once there was a little girl named Maria. She liked to explore and one day she decided to take a look around her house. She looked out of the window into the garden and saw a little bird on the ground outside. Maria quickly opened the door and ran to take the bird in her hands.

She held it close to her and said, â€œI have a special home for you.â€

Her mummy saw this and asked, â€œWhat will you do with it?â€

Maria smiled and said, â€œI will take it to my bedroom and put it on the floor.â€

Mummy said, â€œThatâ€™s a good idea. Maybe you can make a little nest for it.â€ 

So Maria carefully took the bird inside and made a soft nest out of some cloths and put it on the floor. The bird looked very happy and soon it was chirping and enjoying its new home.

Maria was very pleased and she said to her mummy, â€œI made a nice home for my little bird!â€

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat spaghetti with sauce. One day, her mom made spaghetti for dinner. Lily was so excited to eat it.

But when she took a bite, the sauce was too hot and it hurt her tongue. She started to cry. Her mom asked, "What's wrong, Lily?"

Lily said, "It hurts, Mommy. I don't like the sauce."

Her mom promised her that she would make the sauce cooler next time. Lily felt better and finished her dinner. From that day on, her mom always made sure the sauce wasn't too hot for her.

Once upon a time, there was a man who was very fast. He wanted to go the fastest he could. So, he sped around and around the street, like a flash of light. Everyone was so surprised to see the man go so fast. He was like a super speeder!

The man kept speeding around and around the street, but then something happened. He drove a little too fast and slipped on the wet street. He flew off his bike and onto the ground.

The man was sad, but luckily he was fine. Someone saw him fall and helped him up. They told him that he was a really fast rider and that he should be a bit more careful!

The man smiled and thanked them. He was happy to know he was fast and that he was okay. He thanked the nice person and hopped back on his bike, this time going a bit slower. He was too fast for his own good. From then on, the man always rode at a safe speed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside. She had a swing in her yard. Every day, she would go on the swing and go very high. She liked to feel the wind on her face.

One day, Lily saw a small, dirty cat near the swing. The cat was sad and wanted to play too. Lily thought the cat needed a bath. So, she took a small tub and filled it with warm water. She gently put the cat in the tub and began to bathe it. The cat liked the warm water and started to purr.

After the bath, the cat was clean and happy. Lily dried the cat with a soft towel. She put the cat on the swing and pushed it gently. The cat went high and loved it too. Now, Lily and the cat were friends, and they played on the swing together every day.

Once upon a time there was a nice girl who liked to listen. She loved to hear the birds sing, the wind whisper and her friends laugh. One day she heard a strange sound. It was coming from a tiny inch which she found near a tree. She bent down to listen and was surprised to hear music coming from the inch! It was beautiful and made her smile. She realized the inch was singing her a song. She was so happy she danced and sang with the inch until the sun went down. Then she put the inch away in a safe place and went home. She had a feeling that the inch would sing to her again the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside and run around with her friends. One day, Lily's mom brought home a big box filled with toys. Lily was very enthusiastic and couldn't wait to play with all of them.

As she was playing with her new toys, Lily noticed that one of them was very heavy. She tried to pick it up, but it was too heavy for her. Lily didn't give up, she kept trying and trying until she finally lifted the toy. She felt very proud of herself for trying so hard.

Lily learned that sometimes things can be hard, but if she keeps trying, she can do anything. She also learned that the weight of something doesn't matter, as long as she tries her best. From that day on, Lily was always enthusiastic about trying new things and never gave up, no matter how heavy the weight may be.

Once upon a time, there was a kind bunny named Bun who lived in a big forest. One day, while hopping around, Bun saw a little bird who had fallen from its nest. "Oh no, little birdie! Are you okay?" asked Bun, feeling compassionate.

The little birdie said, "I'm okay, but I need to get back to my nest in the tree. Can you help me?"

Bun thought for a moment and said, "I can't fly, but I can help you spring up to your nest. Let's try it together!" So, Bun and the little birdie hopped and jumped until they reached the tree. 

The little birdie thanked Bun and said, "You are a great friend. If you ever need anything, just ask me. I can fly you to space if you want!"

Bun smiled and said, "Thank you, little birdie. I don't need to go to space, but I appreciate your offer. I'm happy to help you anytime." From that day on, Bun and the little birdie became the best of friends and had many more adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a chimney. It was important because it changed things. Every day something new happened. The chimney changed the day and the night. It changed the leaves on the trees and made them different colors. It changed the way the birds sang and the way the flowers smelled. It changed the way people felt when they saw it.

One day the chimney didn't change anymore. It was still important, but it just seemed different. Everyone was very sad because the chimney had made things special.

But soon afterward, something magical happened! A small spark of light flew from the chimney and soon the whole house was glowing with warmth. Life was back to normal and the chimney was important again! It had changed everything.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends, but one day a big storm came. Her mom said they had to stay inside to be safe. Lily wondered why they couldn't go outside and play. She looked out the window and saw the rain pouring down. It made her sad that she couldn't go outside.

But then her mom said they could play a game inside. They played hide and seek and had so much fun. Lily didn't even think about going outside anymore. She was happy to stay inside and be safe with her family. After the storm passed, Lily realized that sometimes it's better to stay inside and be safe than to go outside and get wet.

Jimmy was walking along the path, carrying a big box. The sun was starting to rise, so the grass was sparkly and golden. Jimmy was feeling a bit uncomfortable because the box was heavy. 

Then Jimmy saw a rabbit hopping along the path. He stopped to admire the little creature with its soft fur. The rabbit stopped hopping and looked up at Jimmy with its big eyes. 

Jimmy asked the rabbit: "Do you want to help me carry this box? It's very heavy."

The rabbit shook its head and said: "I'm sorry, it's too big for me!"

So Jimmy took a deep breath and kept on carrying the box. As the sun got brighter and brighter, Jimmy felt a bit stronger. Eventually, the box was heavy no more and Jimmy reached his destination. 

The sunrise was beautiful, and Jimmy was happy he'd made it.

Once upon a time, there was a big, big bear. He was so large that he could not fit in his cave. One day, he went for a walk in the forest. He saw a little rabbit and said, "Hello, little one. Do you want to be my friend?" The rabbit said, "Yes, I do! But I am scared of your shadow. It is very big." The bear said, "I am sorry. Let me part from you so my shadow won't scare you." The rabbit said, "Thank you, Mr. Bear. Now we can be friends!" And they went for a walk together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was always very polite. One day, she was excited to find a surprise at her doorstep. It was a shiny tooth! She had been hoping that the tooth fairy would come.

The little girl was so happy, she decided to put the tooth under her pillow and go to bed. She drifted off to sleep with a smile on her face.

The next morning, the little girl woke up to find a special surprise. The tooth fairy had arrived! She had left the little girl some special treats, which made the girl so happy.

The little girl was so grateful for the surprise from the tooth fairy. She thanked her for being so polite and then went off to tell her mom about her special surprise. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tom. Tom was a happy little boy and he loved to explore. He was always looking at the world around him with curious eyes.

One day, Tom was walking around his garden when he saw something very attractive - a shiny fork! He was excited and picked it up to take a closer look. He wondered where it had come from.

Suddenly, Tom heard a voice. It was an old man, who had appeared from behind a tree. He said he had seen Tom looking at the fork and offered it to him. Tom was so happy, he almost danced!

The old man asked Tom to look after the fork, so he put it carefully in his pocket. From then on, Tom took it with him every day and it soon became his most treasured possession. He called it his magic fork!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Maria. She had a favourite book that she loved to read. It was a simple book, with humble words and beautiful pictures. 

One day, Maria was very excited about reading her book. She asked her mum 'Can I read my book?'

Mum said 'Sure you can, but remember, books can change'. Maria didn't really know what mum meant, but she was too eager to start reading her book.

As Maria opened her book she saw that it had changed. Instead of words and pictures, the book was filled with wonderful colourful illustrations. She couldn't believe her eyes. Maria sat there and read the story until it was time to go to bed. 

When Maria showed the book to mum, she asked 'What happened to the book?' Mum smiled and said 'See, books can change'. Maria nodded and smiled too, happy that her book had changed.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tommy. Tommy loved to play outside. One day, Tommy saw a post in the ground, but it was broken. He wanted to know why it was broken, so he tried to guess.

Tommy thought it might have been because the wind was too strong. But then he thought that maybe it was because an animal had done something to it. He couldn't figure it out. 

Then, Tommy saw something move near the post. He looked closely and saw a chipmunk! The chipmunk was digging around the post, and then it hopped away.

Tommy smiled. He realized the chipmunk had broken the post! He was so excited to know the answer. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a brilliant little girl named Lily. Lily had a big, red ball that she loved to play with. One day, while playing outside, her ball rolled away and went to a place she did not know. She was very sad.

Lily walked and walked until she saw a big building. She asked a nice man, "Is this a hospital?" The man said, "Yes, it is. Do you need help?" Lily told him about her lost ball. The man wanted to help her find it.

Together, they looked everywhere. Finally, they found the ball behind a tree. Lily was so happy to have her ball return to her. She thanked the nice man and went back home. From that day on, Lily always played with her ball near her house, so it would never get lost again.

Once upon a time there was a dog named Sam who wanted to build something. One day he decided to use his hammer. The hammer was big, red and heavy.

He took it outside and started to part the wood. Suddenly a rude frog hopped by. â€œWhat are you doing?â€, the frog said.

Sam was so surprised that he almost dropped the hammer. He said, â€œI am making something special.â€

But the frog was still not happy. He said, â€œYou are making a mess! Put down that hammer!â€

Sam was very sad. He didn't know what to do. But then he remembered he was a brave dog, so he said â€œNo, I will not. I am making something special and I won't give up.â€

The frog was shocked and said, â€œOh. Well, I guess that's okay then. Keep goingâ€.

So Sam kept hammering and soon he finished making his special thing. And the rude frog was very impressed.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Rebecca. She was only three years old. One day she was walking in the woods and she felt very scared because it was so dark. Suddenly, Rebecca saw a big ugly snake! She screamed out loud and started to cry. 

The snake said, "Why are you crying little one?" 

Rebecca answered, "I'm scared of you!" 

The snake said, "I'm not here to hurt you. I'm here to help you find your way back home."

Rebecca was so happy that the snake wanted to help her. She asked, "How can you save me?"

The snake said, "I can show you the way back home. Follow me and I'll make sure you are safe."

Rebecca followed the snake. He led her back home and she was very grateful. She thanked the snake and said goodbye.

The snake said, "It was my pleasure to help! Have a safe journey little one".

Rebecca went back home to her mom and dad and she was so happy. She told them all about her adventure and her new friend, the ugly snake.

Once upon a time, there was a big empty bus. It had no people inside. On the bus, the driver stopped counting. He had been counting all day long.

The driver wanted someone to ride the bus. He wanted someone to listen to him count. All day long, he looked outside to see if anyone was passing by.

One day, he saw a little girl walking by. She was a small 3 year old. The driver asked her if she wanted to ride the bus. The girl was excited. She said â€œYes!â€

So, the driver and the girl got on the bus. The driver started counting and the girl started laughing. She listened to the driver count all the way down the road. It was the best ride ever! The girl never wanted it to end.

Danny wanted some juice, but he didn't have any. He asked his dad if he could borrow some. His dad said yes and gave Danny a cup of juice. Danny thanked his dad and the dad said that he could always count on him to be reliable.

After Danny drank the juice, he asked his mom if he could borrow some, too. His mom said yes and she gave him a cup, too. Danny thanked his mom, and she said she was happy to lend him some juice.

Danny went outside and saw his friend, Sarah. He told Sarah about the juice he got from his mom and dad and asked if she wanted some. Sarah said yes and Danny gave her a cup of juice. He told her that his mom and dad were very reliable and they always let him borrow juice.

Sarah thanked Danny and enjoyed the juice. Danny was glad to be able to lend some of his juice. He liked the feeling of being able to help out his friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a humble girl named Lily. She loved to give and help others. One day, she saw an old lady who looked sad.

Lily went to the lady and said, "Why are you sad?" The old lady said, "I am hungry, and I have no food." Lily wanted to help her, so she ran home to get some food.

Lily put some food on a plate and went back to the old lady. She gave the plate to the lady and said, "Here, eat this." The old lady smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are very kind."

The old lady was happy, and Lily felt good that she could help. From that day on, Lily always looked for ways to help others and share what she had. And everyone in the town loved the humble girl who loved to give.

Once upon a time, there was a pale girl who always wanted something special to happen. Every day she would go to the grocery store and dream of something amazing. 

One day she asked the grocery store lady: "Will something special ever happen to me?"

The grocery store lady smiled and said "Don't worry, something special will happen soon".

When the girl heard that, she was filled with hope! She came to the grocery store every day just to see if anything had happened. 

One day it did! She saw a big box of chocolates on the shelf. "I've never seen this before!" she said.

She was so excited she couldn't believe it! She had finally gotten something special - it had happened just like the grocery store lady had said. 

The girl was now so happy, she was sure that all her dreams would come true.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play with toys and draw pictures. One day, Lily draws a picture of a cat. She uses a black crayon and makes a big circle for the head, two small triangles for the ears, and a long tail. She shows her picture to Tom.

"Look, Tom, this is my cat. His name is Max. Do you like him?" Lily asks.

Tom looks at the picture and smiles. He thinks the cat is cute. He likes cats too. He has a cat at home. His cat is white and fluffy.

"Yes, Lily, I like your cat. He is very cute. Can I draw a picture of my cat too?" Tom asks.

Lily nods and gives Tom a white crayon. She helps him find a blank paper. Tom draws a picture of his cat. He makes a big circle for the head, two small triangles for the ears, and a long tail. He adds some dots for the eyes and nose, and some lines for the whiskers. He shows his picture to Lily.

"Look, Lily, this is my cat. Her name is Snowy. Do you like her?" Tom asks.

Lily looks at the picture and smiles. She thinks the cat is cute. She likes white and fluffy cats too. She has a teddy bear that is white and fluffy.

"Yes, Tom, I like your cat. She is very cute. Can I hug your cat?" Lily asks.

Tom nods and gives Lily his picture. Lily hugs the picture and pretends it is a real cat. She makes a purring sound. Tom hugs Lily's picture and pretends it is a real cat. He makes a meowing sound. They laugh and play with their pictures. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily wanted a puppy very much. She asked her mommy, "Can I have a puppy, please?" Her mommy said, "Yes, you can have a puppy, but we need to find a good one."

So, they went to the pet store to find a puppy. Lily saw a cute and adventurous puppy. She said, "Mommy, I want that puppy!" Her mommy said, "Okay, let's take him home."

Lily and her new puppy played together all day long. She said to her puppy, "You are so adventurous! I love you, puppy." And the puppy barked happily in response. From that day on, Lily and her puppy had many fun adventures together.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lizzie. She loved to dress up in her clothes and have fun. One day her mum brought her some clay and said "Lizzie, you can use this clay to make useful things." Lizzie was so excited and asked "What can I make"?

Mum replied "You can make whatever you want, like dolls, cups or animals". Lizzie smiled and wanted to start right away.

She got busy with her clay. First she tried to make a cup, but it kept breaking. Then she tried to make a doll but it didn't look like a doll. She was getting frustrated, but her mum said "Don't worry sweetheart, just keep trying".

Lizzie fiddled with her clay for a while, and finally made something that looked like a dog. She was so proud of her work and said "Look mum, I made a useful dog". Her mum smiled and said "Good job Lizzie. You did it!"

From that day on, Lizzie loved to dress up and play with her clay. She made lots of useful things, like dolls, cups and animals. And she had so much fun.

Once upon a time there was an old grumpy fish. He wanted to go on an adventure. So he decided to follow a stream that ran near by. He swam downstream for hours and hours. He passed through the lush green meadows and the tall trees. Eventually he reached a big lake. There he met some new friends, lots of other fish.

They played together in the lake and had lots of fun. They swam and jumped and laughed. The old grumpy fish was very happy and soon forgot his grumpy mood.

He stayed with the other fish for a while and he felt free and alive. But eventually he had to say goodbye and follow the stream home.

He waved goodbye to his new friends and followed the stream back the way he had come. On the way home he felt much less grumpy and content. He had had a wonderful day, but he was happy to be back home and safe.

Mum and Dad took me to the gym. It was big and noisy. I saw lots of people lifting heavy weights. I wanted to join in, but it was too hard for me. 

Later, we went to the cafe for a drink. I had some juice which was really sweet. I also had a biscuit with it, for a treat. 

When we left, Dad was very thirsty. He drank lots of water from the water fountain. It was cool and refreshing. 

Then we all went back home. I was very tired and went straight to bed. It had been an exciting day, even if I couldn't lift any heavy weights!

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man named Tom. He loved to rock in his chair on the porch every day while wearing his helmet. One day, a little girl named Lily came to visit him.

"Hi, Tom! Why are you wearing a helmet?" asked Lily.

"I wear it to protect my head when I rock in my chair," replied Tom.

Lily sat down next to Tom and they talked for a while. Suddenly, a gust of wind blew and Tom's chair started to wobble. But thanks to his helmet, he was safe and sound.

"Wow, your helmet is really important!" exclaimed Lily.

Tom smiled and said, "Yes, it is. It keeps me safe when I rock in my chair. And it's always better to be safe than sorry."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a big iron toy truck that he loved to play with every day. One day, Timmy's mom told him that they were going to paint the truck black. Timmy was excited to see his toy truck in a new color.

When Timmy's mom started painting the truck, she struggled to get the paint to stick to the iron. Timmy asked his mom why she was struggling, and she explained that iron is a tough material to paint. Timmy watched as his mom kept painting until the truck was completely black.

After the paint dried, Timmy looked at his truck and said, "Wow, it looks so cool in black!" His mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you like it, Timmy." From that day on, Timmy played with his black toy truck every day, and he was always proud to show it to his friends.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They saw a big green snake on the grass. They were not scared. They wanted to touch it.

"Look, a snake!" Lily said. "Can we do something with it?"

"Maybe we can make it a funny hat," Tom said. He picked up the snake and put it on his head. The snake did not like that. It hissed and bit Tom's ear.

"Ow!" Tom cried. He dropped the snake and ran to his mom. Lily followed him. She was sorry for Tom.

"Are you okay, Tom?" Lily asked.

"No, it hurts," Tom said. His mom looked at his ear. It was red and swollen.

"You should not play with snakes, Tom," his mom said. "They are not toys. They can hurt you. You need to go to the doctor."

"I'm sorry, mom," Tom said. He felt bad. He learned his lesson.

Lily and Tom learned that snakes are not funny. They are animals that need respect. They decided to play with something else. They found a ball and a hoop. They had fun with them. They were happy and safe.

Lily and Ben are playing in the garden. They see a big box with a lock and a label. The label says "Do not open". Lily and Ben are curious. They want to know what is inside the box.

"Let's unlock the box and see what is inside," says Lily.

"But the label says no," says Ben.

"Maybe it is a surprise for us," says Lily. "Maybe it is a toy or a book or a cake."

Lily finds a key under a flower pot. She puts the key in the lock and turns it. The lock clicks and the box opens. Lily and Ben look inside.

They see many colorful things. They see paper, crayons, scissors, glue, stickers, feathers, and more. They are happy. They like to make things with these things. They are creative.

"Wow, look at all these things," says Lily. "We can make anything we want."

"Maybe this is a gift for us," says Ben. "Maybe someone wants us to have fun and be creative."

Lily and Ben take out the things and start to make things. They make hats, masks, cards, animals, and more. They have fun and laugh. They do not see the other label on the other side of the box. The other label says "Happy birthday, Lily and Ben. Love, Grandma and Grandpa."

Once upon a time, there was a bunny called Dave. Dave liked to explore the world. One day, he hopped through a big, beautiful landscape. The colors were so bright and the air was so fresh. Dave wanted to take some time to relax and enjoy the view, so he hopped over to a big patch of grass and sat down.

Suddenly, Dave smelled something delicious. He hopped around until he found a patch of strawberries. He picked some up and bit into them. They were so juicy and sweet. He munched and munched until the strawberries were all gone.

Dave was having so much fun in the landscape that he decided to stay a little longer. He hopped around some more and soon spotted a tree filled with apples. "Yum!" Dave said as he hopped over to the tree. He picked an apple and munched on it. It was so delicious. 

Dave sat under the tree and enjoyed the warm sun, munching on apples. Suddenly, he heard a voice. "Want some more?" it said. Dave opened his eyes, and he saw a kind-looking squirrel standing near him. "For sure!" Dave said, hopping over to the squirrel. 

The squirrel showed Dave to a secret patch of apples. Together, Dave and the squirrel munched on the delicious apples, enjoying the beautiful landscape all around them.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy house. Inside it lived a family who were very happy and content. They liked to spend their days dreaming and playing.

However, one day the family was very sad. They had heard some sad news and it made them weep and cry. Tears streamed down their faces as they hugged each other.

Suddenly, they heard a knock at the door. When they opened it, they were greeted with a surprise. Standing outside was a man who had lots of presents. He said that he wanted to make them happy again and he asked them to stop weeping.

The family was overjoyed and accepted his gifts. They laughed and hugged each other for hours. From that day forward, the family never felt sad in the wealthy house. They continued to laugh and play together, and the house was filled with love and happiness.

Once upon a time, there was a bee. He was very weird. He liked to part with his friends and do his own thing. 

So one day the bee went for a nice walk in the park. Suddenly, he saw an ant! 

He thought to himself "that ant is weird!" He hopped over and he said "hello!" The ant was very confused. 

The bee said "let's part ways and go explore the park together!" The ant said "okay!" 

They had a lot of fun exploring and learning about the world around them. After a while, they said goodbye.

Rose cheered and said, "Yippee! I did it!" She watched as the kite flew up into the cloud and stayed there. She felt so proud that she had done something so tricky.

Charlie was playing outside on a sunny day. He had an incredible surprise waiting for him at the pond. As he walked towards it, he saw something wet slipping through the tall grass. He ran over, and it was an unexpected animal. It was a duck! Charlie was so excited. He couldn't believe it.

He tried to get closer, but the duck started to slip away. Charlie ran after it and the duck led him to the edge of the pond. The water was so wet, so he was careful. He stayed in the grass and watched the duck as it took a long, smooth slip into the pond.

Charlie was amazed. The duck's movements were incredible. He watched it as it dived and swam and dove in the water. Charlie was so surprised he couldn't stop smiling. He wished he could join the duck, but he decided it was too wet. He waved goodbye and ran off to find something else to explore.

Once upon a time, there was a man who was very bald. He had no hair on his head. One day, he went to do his laundry at the laundromat. He put his clothes in the big machines and waited for them to finish. While he waited, he saw a funny video on his phone and he started to laugh. 

The other people at the laundromat heard him laughing and they started to laugh too. They all laughed together and it made the man feel happy. When his laundry was finished, he packed his clothes and went home. He told his family about the funny video and they laughed together too. From that day on, the man always remembered to find something to laugh about, even when he was doing his laundry.

Once upon a time there was a dependable frog called Mary. Mary lived in a muddy pond, and every day she would hop around the pond looking for something to eat. 

One day, Mary saw something strange. It was a little pink kitten, stuck in the mud! She knew she had to rescue it, so she hopped over to the kitten and started to pull it out. 

Mary kept pulling, and eventually the kitten was free! The kitten gave Mary a big hug and thanked her for rescuing it. Mary was so happy to have helped the kitten! 

Mary said goodbye to the kitten and continued hopping around her muddy pond. She was glad that she was able to be so dependable and help her new friend. 
The End

John ran quickly to the mall. As he looked around, he saw so many things. He found a deep pond with lots of fish inside.

Once upon a time, there was a pale plane. It was a very simple plane, but it could fly really high.

The plane was getting old, so the people who owned it wanted to remove it. They wanted to get rid of it so they could get a new plane.
