John went back to the swings. This time, he was able to reach them and he happily went back and forth for a long time. He was very happy!

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play outside and look at the sky. They see many white clouds in the blue sky. They try to guess what the clouds look like.

"Look, Anna, that cloud looks like a bunny!" Ben says, pointing at a fluffy cloud.

"I see it, Ben, it has long ears and a tail. And that cloud looks like a flower!" Anna says, pointing at another cloud.

They giggle and clap their hands. They see more clouds that look like animals, fruits, and toys. They have fun making up stories about the clouds.

But then, the wind blows hard and the clouds start to move. Some of the clouds get smaller and some get bigger. Some of the clouds join together and some separate.

"Oh no, the bunny cloud is gone!" Ben says, looking sad.

"And the flower cloud too!" Anna says, frowning.

They watch as the clouds change shape and color. They do not look like anything they know anymore.

"Maybe the clouds are playing too," Anna says, trying to cheer up Ben.

"Maybe they are," Ben says, nodding.

They decide to keep watching the clouds and see what they do next. They hope the clouds will make new shapes that they can guess. They hold hands and smile. They still like the clouds, even if they are different.

Lily and Tom were playing in the sand. They had a bucket and a spade each. They wanted to make a big castle with towers and a moat.

"Look, my tower is taller than yours!" Lily said, putting more sand on top of her spade.

"No, it's not!" Tom said, doing the same with his spade. "Mine is taller and stronger!"

They kept adding more and more sand, until their spades were too heavy to lift. They tried to pull them out, but they were stuck.

"Help!" Lily cried. "My spade is trapped!"

"Me too!" Tom said. "I can't get my spade out!"

They pulled and pulled, but nothing happened. They started to cry.

A man was walking by with his dog. He saw the children crying and came over.

"What's wrong, little ones?" he asked.

"Our spades are stuck in the sand!" Lily and Tom said.

The man smiled and bent down. He took hold of their spades and pulled them out with ease.

"Here you go," he said, handing them their spades. "You were trying to make a castle, right?"

"Yes, but we made it too big and our spades got stuck," Lily said.

"Well, sometimes less is more," the man said. "Why don't you try to make a smaller castle, but with more details? Like windows and doors and flags?"

"That sounds fun!" Tom said.

"Thank you, mister!" Lily said.

"You're welcome," the man said. "Have fun, but be careful not to dig too deep. The sand can be bitter if you taste it."

He waved and walked away with his dog.

Lily and Tom looked at each other and smiled. They decided to make a smaller castle, but with more details. They used their spades to carve windows and doors and flags. They were happy and proud of their castle. They did not stop until it was done.

One day, mommy took Sarah to the park. It was a beautiful sunny day and Sarah was so excited!

She went running into the park and started playing. She ran around and around and even tried to jump over the big puddle. Suddenly, she slipped and got her dress all wet. She was so angry! 

Mommy came over to Sarah, scooped her up, and said, "Don't worry, I'll spoil you and get you all cleaned up".

They went home and Mommy dried Sarah and gave her a big hug. Mommy made her some hot chocolate and they watched a movie together. Sarah felt much better. 

Mommy had Pspoiled Sarah and she was no longer angry. They had a lot of fun for the rest of the day!

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball. He would roll it all around the yard and chase after it. One day, Max got very dirty and needed a bath. His owner got some warm water and shampoo and gave Max a bath. Max didn't like the shampoo at first, but he loved how warm the water was. After his bath, Max felt very clean and happy. He went back outside to play with his ball again, rolling it all around the yard.

Once upon a time there lived a little boy named Jack. He loved to explore outside and was always very lively. He often ran and played on his porch, hoping to find something fun to do.

One day, Jack found an old, forgotten toy box on the porch. He opened it and discovered a long-forgotten teddy bear inside. Immediately, Jack's eyes lit up with joy. With a huge smile, he hugged the bear tightly. "This bear is my new friend!" he shouted.

Jack quickly ran inside to show off his new toy. He found his mom, who was busy washing the dishes and told her what he had found.

"Oh, how sweet," she said. "You should take care of your bear. Make sure to always show it love, just like you do for all of your friends."

Jack nodded and hugged his bear again. He knew his mom was right - a friendship mattered to him, even if it was with a toy bear.

Jack kept his teddy bear with him wherever he went and treasured their friendship. From that day on, he never forgot the lesson of showing kindness and love to everything, even the littlest of things.

Once upon a time there was a prince who was very rude. He was always unkind to everyone he met.

One day he met a little girl who was only three years old. She was so sweet and kind. The prince thought it would be fun to pick on her.

The girl looked up at the prince and said, "Why are you being so mean to me?"
The prince snarled and said, "Because I can."

The little girl stood up tall and bravely said, "I will not let you be so rude! We must fight!"

The prince was surprised. He asked, "What do you mean fight?"

The little girl smiled and said, "I mean that we can fight with our words. We can both be kind and polite. We can have a nice conversation."

The prince thought about this for a moment and realized how silly he had been. He nodded and said, "Ok. Let's do that!"

Since then the prince and the little girl have become friends. They talk every day and never fight with words.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Daisy. Daisy lived in a big house and loved exploring the garden. One day, Daisy was feeling really excited so she decided to dress up in her favourite costume. She put on her dress, her shoes, and grabbed her spear. Daisy raced off down the garden path in search of adventure.

Suddenly she heard a noise in the bushes and she was filled with curiosity. She crept closer to the bush and saw a friendly rabbit! To her surprise, the rabbit was also dressed up, with a silly hat and a cape. Daisy was so excited that she started to giggle. Then, Daisy and the rabbit began to play together.

They had so much fun playing make-believe games and chasing each other around the garden. Daisy was even brave enough to use her spear to pretend to be a brave knight!

In the end Daisy and the rabbit said goodbye and Daisy went back home to get changed out of her costume. She was still feeling excited about her day of adventures.

Lily was playing with her doll in the garden. She liked to pretend that her doll was sick and she was a doctor. She had a toy stethoscope and a bandage. She put the stethoscope on her doll's chest and said, "Don't worry, you will be fine. I will take care of you."

But then she heard a loud noise. It was an ambulance. It had a red light and a siren. It stopped in front of her neighbor's house. Lily saw two men get out of the ambulance. They had white clothes and a big bag. They ran to the door and knocked.

Lily was curious. She left her doll on the grass and ran to the fence. She saw the men come out of the house with a stretcher. On the stretcher was an old lady. She was Lily's neighbor, Mrs. Jones. She looked very weak and pale. She had a mask on her face and a tube in her arm.

"Where are they taking her?" Lily asked one of the men.

"They are taking her to the hospital, sweetie. She is very sick and needs help," the man said.

"Will she be okay?" Lily asked.

"We hope so. We will do our best to make her better," the man said.

Lily felt sad. She liked Mrs. Jones. She often gave her cookies and read her stories. She wanted her to be well.

"Can I do something for her?" Lily asked.

The man smiled. He bent down and gave Lily a hug.

"You can do something very important for her. You can pray for her and send her your love. She will feel it and it will help her heal," he said.

Lily nodded. She hugged the man back and said, "Thank you. I will do that. I care for her very much."

The man kissed her cheek and said, "You are a very sweet and kind girl. I'm sure she cares for you too."

Then he got in the ambulance with the other man and Mrs. Jones. The ambulance drove away with the siren and the red light.

Lily watched it go. She felt a tear roll down her cheek. She whispered, "Get well soon, Mrs. Jones. I love you."

Then she went back to her doll and picked her up. She hugged her and said, "Don't worry, you will be fine. I will take care of you."

One day, a big aeroplane was flying in the sky. The aeroplane was very popular because it could dance in the sky. It had many friends who liked to watch it dance.

The aeroplane would twirl, spin, and jump high in the sky. All the birds would clap their wings and cheer for the aeroplane. The aeroplane was very happy to make its friends smile.

One day, the aeroplane danced its best dance ever. All the birds and other aeroplanes clapped and cheered. The aeroplane was very proud and happy. It knew that dancing in the sky made everyone happy, and that made the aeroplane happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and run around in the park. One day, she went to the park and saw a boy crying. 

"What's wrong?" asked Lily. 

"I lost my way home," replied the boy. 

Lily felt sad for the boy and wanted to help him. "Don't be ashamed to cry," said Lily. "Let's find your way home together." 

The boy smiled and together they walked around the park until they found his house. The boy was happy and thanked Lily for helping him. Lily felt proud of herself for being a good friend. From that day on, Lily and the boy became good friends and played together in the park every day.

Anna loved to sing and dance. She wanted to be a musician when she grew up. She liked to listen to songs on the radio and learn the words. She also liked to make up her own songs and sing them to her toys.

One day, Anna's mom took her to the park. There was a man playing a guitar and singing. He had a hat on the ground with some coins in it. Anna liked his music. She asked her mom if she could give him some money. Her mom said yes and gave her a coin. Anna ran to the man and put the coin in his hat. She smiled and said, "Thank you for your music."

The man smiled back and said, "You're welcome. Do you like to sing?" Anna nodded. The man said, "Would you like to sing with me?" Anna was surprised and happy. She said, "Yes, please." The man said, "What song do you want to sing?" Anna thought for a moment and said, "Twinkle, twinkle, little star."

The man said, "That's a good song. I know that song. Let's sing it together." He started to play the guitar and sing. Anna joined him and sang with her loud and clear voice. The people in the park stopped and listened. They clapped and cheered. Anna felt proud and happy. She hugged the man and said, "Thank you for singing with me. You are a good musician and a compassionate person." The man hugged her back and said, "Thank you for singing with me. You are a good singer and a compassionate person too." They smiled and sang another song.

A big hot sun was shining in the sky. Two friends saw it and decided to go outside. They wanted to have fun in the warm weather.

The two friends started to play chase and they got very hot. One of the friends found an old rag lying in the grass. He decided to throw it in the air and try to catch it.

His friend got mad and picked up the rag. He wanted to keep it for himself. He started shouting and tried to pull it away from his friend.

This made the other friend very angry. He also wanted the rag and a fight started! They pushed and pulled each other trying to take the rag away.

Eventually one of them got it. Both were so tired that they decided to stop fighting. They took a break and decided to find something else to do.

Once upon a time there was a beach. All around the beach was white sand and bright blue water. The waves made a sound, like a song. It was always playing.

A little girl, wearing a pink swimsuit, was playing in the sand. The water was just like a big puddle. She liked to make little sand castles. They were so fun!

The sun was high in the sky. The little girl got tired and so she yawned. It was time for a nap. She laid down in the sand and watched the waves come in and out. The tide was going up and down. 

The girl closed her eyes and dreamed. She imagined she was riding the waves in a white boat. Then it started to snow, with white flakes falling all around her. It was so beautiful. 

The girl opened her eyes and saw the bright blue sky again. She yawned, it was time to go home. 

The little girl said goodbye to the beach and promised to come back soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his ball, and he would roll it all around the yard. One day, Timmy's mom said to him, "Timmy, I have a surprise for you!" Timmy was so excited to hear this, he couldn't wait to find out what it was.

When Timmy's mom brought out a big box, Timmy's eyes got really big. "Wow, Mommy! What's in the box?" Timmy asked. "It's a present for you, Timmy," his mom said with a smile. "It's a toy car that rolls really fast!"

Timmy was so happy and grateful for his generous mom. He couldn't wait to play with his new toy car and roll it all around the house. Timmy hugged his mom and said, "Thank you so much, Mommy! You're the best!"

Molly was so excited. She had just gotten a card in the mail. She opened it and saw it had a dead bug inside! She was so happy to come home from school and find it. She had never seen a dead bug before. She asked her mom to show her how to put it in a container.

Next, Molly and her mom went to the store. Molly wanted to buy something special with her card. She picked out a brightly-colored toy.

When they got home, Molly was so excited to show her toy to her dad. She asked him to come outside and see it. He was just as excited as Molly. Together, they played with it for the rest of the day.

Molly always remembered the day she got her card with the dead bug inside. It was her first time ever seeing a dead bug and buying something with her very own card. She was so happy!

Once upon a time there was a little bunny who liked to sing. He sang all day in the sunshine, but he felt lonely.

One day, as he sung, a big white cloud came down from the sky and said, "Hello, little bunny!"

The bunny was very surprised to see the cloud talking to him. He asked, "What are you doing here?"

The cloud said, "I heard you singing and I wanted to join in! Together, we'll make the best music ever!"

The bunny was so happy and he sang louder than ever. But then the cloud started to sing in a deep voice. It was strange and a bit disgusting.

The bunny stopped singing and said, "That's not music, that's yucky noise!" The cloud's face drooped and it said, "I'm sorry, I just wanted us to make beautiful music together."

The bunny smiled and said, "It's ok. Let's start over. Would you like me to sing first?"

The cloud's face lit up and it said, "Yes! That sounds lovely!"

So, the bunny and the cloud sang together all day, making the most beautiful music. Everyone who heard them said it was the best thing they had ever heard!

Joey and his dad were playing in the park. Joeys dad had a long tank with him. He was teaching Joey how to kick it. Joey was so excited. He tried his best to kick it far away. He didn't do a very good job at first. But with his dad's help and encouragement, Joey managed to kick it far away. His dad was very proud of him. They played for a long time. They had lots of fun together. Joey was very happy.

Maggie wanted to buy something special. She went to the store to look around. The store was full of things that caught her eye. She saw a math book that she liked. It was bright, colourful and very exciting!

Maggie asked the shopkeeper if she could buy the book. Thankfully, the shopkeeper said yes. But when she opened it up, it was filthy and covered with dirt. She was so upset.

Maggie asked the shopkeeper why the book was so filthy. He told her that it had come from a dusty warehouse. He said he had cleaned it up a bit, but some of the dirt had stayed.

Maggie decided to buy it anyway. She was so excited to learn about math! She took the book home and carefully wiped away the dirt. She was happy to see the clean pages of the math book. Maggie and her math book have been inseparable ever since.

Once there was a wealthy duck who loved to swim. He would swim around the pond every day. One day, he decided to take an adventure and swim to the top of a nearby cliff. He was so excited to explore what the cliff was like.

The cliff was high and steep. The wealthy duck had to work extra hard in order to make it to the top. But, he was determined and kept swimming. Eventually, he made it to the top of the cliff and was so proud of himself!

At the top, the duck had the most amazing view. He could see the pond far below and he felt so happy and free. From then on, the wealthy duck visited the cliff every day. He would swim to the top and enjoy the wonderful view of the pond below.

Ben and Lily were playing with their toys in the living room. They had a lot of fun making noises and stories with their cars, dolls and blocks. They did not hear their mom calling them for lunch.

"Ben, Lily, come to the kitchen, it's time to eat!" their mom said again, louder this time.

Ben and Lily looked at each other and smiled. They liked lunch, but they liked playing more. They decided to hide behind the couch and pretend they did not hear their mom.

"Where are they?" their mom wondered, looking around the living room. She saw their toys on the floor, but not her children. She walked to the couch and lifted the cushion. She saw Ben and Lily giggling and holding their hands over their mouths.

"Boo!" she said, making them jump. "I found you, you silly kids! Why did you not come when I called you?"

Ben and Lily looked at their mom with big eyes. They did not know what to say. They forgot to listen to their mom. They forgot to obey her.

"We are sorry, mom," they said together. "We were playing and we forgot."

Their mom smiled and hugged them. She was not angry, but she wanted them to learn. She was a smart lady and she loved her children.

"It's okay, I forgive you," she said. "But next time, please come when I call you. Lunch is important for your health and growth. And I don't want you to miss it."

Ben and Lily nodded and said they understood. They followed their mom to the kitchen and ate their lunch. They thanked their mom for the food and for finding them. They did not forget to say "I love you".

Molly was a very curious three year old. She was off exploring one day when she stumbled across a very strange thing: a big mirror. It seemed to shine more brightly than any other thing around. Molly was amazed at how the mirror seemed to move and change with her every movement.

Molly was sure that the mirror was trying to tell her something, so she slowly moved closer until she could see her own reflection. She looked into the mirror and saw an unfamiliar face. It was so gloomy that she started to cry.

Just then, a voice behind her said, â€œYou donâ€™t need to cry.â€ Molly turned around and saw a kind old woman with a gentle smile on her face.

The woman said, â€œYou donâ€™t know it yet, but youâ€™re looking at your future self. Thatâ€™s why it looks a bit gloomy. Everything will be ok.â€

Molly was a little surprised, but the woman's words made her feel better. She thanked the old woman and said goodbye, thinking she would never forget the lesson the mirror had taught her.

One day, there was a man who wanted to build something. He chose an original piece of wood and he held it in his hands and looked at it closely. Then, the man took out a nail and he held it between two fingers and considered it carefully. 

Next, the man carefully placed the nail on the wood and he held a hammer in his hand. He tapped the hammer against the nail and the nail became stuck into the wood. 

Then, the man held the wood and the nail up and admired his work. He was happy that he was able to build something original with a nail.

Ben and Lily were playing with their toy rockets in the garden. They liked to pretend they were going to the moon and other planets. They had a big book with pictures of the planets and their names.

"Look, this is Mars," Ben said, showing Lily a red planet. "It is very hot and dry. It has rocks and dust."

"Wow, Mars is pretty," Lily said. "Can we go there?"

Ben shook his head. "No, we can't. It is too far and too hard. We need a special rocket and a suit to go there."

"Why?" Lily asked. "Why is it hard?"

Ben tried to explain. "Because Mars is different from Earth. Earth has air and water and plants and animals. Mars does not have these things. It is not good for us to live there."

Lily frowned. She did not understand. "But it looks nice. It has a color and a shape. Why can't we live there?"

Ben sighed. He did not know how to explain better. He looked at the book and pointed to another planet. "Look, this is Saturn. It has rings. Do you like it?"

Lily nodded. She liked the rings. They were shiny and round. She forgot about Mars. She wanted to go to Saturn.

"Can we go to Saturn?" she asked.

Ben smiled. He knew Saturn was also hard to go to, but he did not want to make Lily sad. He said, "Maybe one day, when we are older and smarter, we can go to Saturn. But for now, we can only play with our rockets and look at the pictures."

Lily smiled too. She liked to play with Ben and their rockets. She liked to look at the pictures. She hoped one day they could go to Saturn and see the rings. She thought Saturn was the best planet.

Once upon a time there was a pretty green bird. Its wings were like a beautiful rainbow in the sky. The bird liked to zip around the world and explore different places.

One day the bird found a big green tree. It was the most beautiful tree in the world! The leaves were so big and the branches were strong. The bird began to zip around the branches and sang a beautiful song. 

The bird looked so happy! Soon, other animals began to come. There were tiny squirrels, lots of butterflies and even some bright yellow birds! They all liked to zip around with the green bird.

Then, one day, the green bird found a shiny green tree above him. He flew up and perched on the highest branch. He looked down and saw the animals below having fun. He zipped around and flew down to the ground. 

The green bird said goodbye to his friends and flew away. He was so happy - it was the most pretty day ever!

Once upon a time there were two friends, Sammy and Lizzy. Sammy was strong and Lizzy was green. They both loved playing, but sometimes they couldn't agree on what to play.

One day, the two friends were arguing about what to play. Suddenly, a voice said, â€œUnite!â€ They both looked around, but no one was there. Sammy said, â€œIt must have been a magic voice.â€

Lizzy smiled, â€œWhat if we unite together and play something new?â€ Sammy was excited and they both raced to Sammy's toy chest. Sammy pulled out a box of coloured blocks and Lizzy smiled, â€œLetâ€™s build a tower!â€

The two friends worked together, one placing blocks and one stacking them. Together, they made a very strong tower. They looked around proudly, and Lizzy said, â€œWe did itâ€¦we united!â€ Sammy smiled and hugged his green friend. 

The two friends were now closer than ever. They knew that when they united, anything was possible!

Jill was very stubborn. Every morning she would move down the street. She was so stubborn that nothing could stop her.

Every day, Jill would carry heavy boxes. She would stop in front of the different stores and move them inside. She was so strong.

Soon it was time for lunch. Jill kept on moving, but this time to the park. She sat on a bench and ate her lunch. She was so stubborn that she always kept moving. 

Finally, it was time to go home. Jill kept moving until she reached her house. She had had a long day, but was so proud of all the things she had moved throughout the day.

Once upon a time there was a green frog who was helpless and alone. He looked everywhere but couldn't find anyone to play with. He hopped along, feeling sad, until he suddenly heard music coming from a nearby pond. When the frog got closer, he saw two fish happily swimming together and singing sweetly. He was so excited that he quickly joined them in the pond! 

The frog found that he had the most fun when he was swimming and dancing with his new fish friends. They partied together all day and night, playing games and laughing the whole time. The frog was so happy he never wanted to leave the pond. 

The next morning, the sun came up and the friends knew it was time to part. The fish waved goodbye and the frog said a sad goodbye too. But as he hopped away, the frog felt hopeful. He knew his new friends wanted to play with him again soon, and he was excited for their next playdate!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside and explore the world around him. One day, he went to the park with his mom and saw a beautiful statue. It was big and shiny and Tim wanted to touch it.

His mom said, "Don't touch the statue. It's very old and fragile. We don't want to break it."

Tim was stubborn and didn't listen to his mom. He wanted to grab the statue and see how it felt. So, when his mom wasn't looking, he ran up to the statue and grabbed it with both hands.

Suddenly, the statue started to wobble and shake. Tim was scared and tried to let go, but it was too late. The statue fell and broke into a million pieces. Tim felt very bad and knew he should have listened to his mom. From that day on, he promised to always listen to his mom and never be stubborn again.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack. He lived with his mom and dad in their cozy home. Jack loved to play outside and always made sure to store his toys when he was done.

One day, Jack was playing with his favorite toy car and ran out of the home to his backyard. Suddenly, he tripped and fell, hurting his knee.

Jack started to cry and screamed, "Ouch!" His dad quickly ran to the backyard to find Jack on the ground, rubbing his knee. He quickly picked Jack up and held him in his arms, comforting him.

Dad said to Jack, "It's ok, you are safe now. Let's go inside and store your toys so that this doesn't happen again." Jack nodded, still holding onto his father.

The next day Jack was back in the backyard, playing with his toys. He remembered his dad's advice, and made sure to store his toys carefully when he was done!

Once upon a time, there was a happy duck who loved to whistle. He was very proud of his beautiful whistling, but he wanted it to be even better. So, one day he decided to go look for a special drink which would help to make his whistling even more perfect.

He searched and searched, but he couldn't find anything! But then he came across a pond and he saw something sparkling in the water. He bent down and he scooped it up in his beak - it was the perfect drink! It was cold and sweet and it made him feel amazing.

He drank it in one big gulp and then he started to whistle. But this time his whistling was even better than before - it was perfect! The duck was so happy that he danced around the pond, flapping his wings. He was so proud that he had found the special drink. 

From then on, the duck spent every day looking for more of the special drink so that he could make his whistling perfect. He had lots of fun and he never stopped whistling!

Once upon a time, there was a troubled dog named Max. Max was always sad because he could not find his toy. One day, Max saw his toy on top of a big steel box. He wanted to get it back.

Max tried to jump on the box, but it was too high. He tried to climb the box, but it was too slippery. Max was very sad. Then, he had an idea. He found a long stick.

Max used the stick to get his toy. He pushed the toy, and it started to slip off the box. Max was very happy. The toy fell down, and Max caught it. Now, Max was not troubled anymore. He played with his toy all day.

One day, a little girl named Mia found a delicate umbrella. It was very pretty with many colors. She loved it so much and wanted to show it to her friend, Tom. She thought, "I can't wait to see what Tom will say when he sees my new umbrella!"

Mia walked to Tom's house with the umbrella. The sun was shining bright, but she thought, "Maybe it will rain later, and I can use my umbrella." When she got to Tom's house, she showed Tom the umbrella. Tom said, "Wow, Mia! That's a pretty umbrella. What do you do with it?" Mia said, "I can use it when it rains to stay dry."

Later, the sky turned gray, and it started to rain. Mia and Tom were happy because they could use the umbrella. They opened it up and stood under it together. They stayed dry and laughed as they watched the rain fall. Mia was glad she found the delicate umbrella and could share it with her friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy. They walked in the park and saw a big tree. Lily's mommy said, "Let's sit under the tree and have a snack." 

Lily sat down but she felt uncomfortable. Her mommy asked, "What's wrong?" Lily said, "My buckle is too tight." Her mommy helped her adjust her buckle so she felt better. They ate their snack and then Lily heard a sound. She whispered to her mommy, "What's that noise?" Her mommy whispered back, "It's just the wind in the leaves." 

Lily was happy to know what the sound was. She smiled and hugged her mommy. They finished their snack and went back home. Lily felt happy and safe with her mommy.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with toys, but they do not like to share. One day, they find a big box of old toys in the attic. They are very happy and start to take out the toys.

"Look, a train!" Ben says. He grabs the train and runs to his room.

"No, I want the train!" Lily says. She runs after him and tries to take the train.

They have a big fight. They pull and push and yell. They do not hear their mom calling them.

Mom comes to see what is wrong. She sees them fighting over the train. She is very angry and sad.

"Stop it, both of you!" she says. "Why are you fighting over an old toy? Don't you know that sharing is good and fighting is bad?"

She takes the train and puts it back in the box. She locks the box and says, "You cannot play with these toys until you learn to get along. Go to your rooms and think about what you did."

Lily and Ben feel sorry. They go to their rooms and cry. They wish they had not fought over the train. They wish they had shared the toys and played together.

They knock on each other's doors and say, "I'm sorry. I love you. Can we be friends again?"

They hug and smile. They go to mom and say, "We're sorry, mom. We love you. Can we have the toys again?"

Mom is happy and proud. She unlocks the box and says, "Yes, you can. But only if you promise to share and not fight. Do you promise?"

They nod and say, "We promise. Thank you, mom."

They take out the toys and play together. They have fun and laugh. They learn that sharing is good and fighting is bad. They are happy twins.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tom. Tom went walking with his dad. They went to the park and saw a huge gear. Tom was so excited and they stopped to have a closer look. 

Tom touched the gear and his dad said, "Let's take it home with us and have some fun." Tom and his dad picked up the huge gear and went home. 

When they got home, Tom put the gear down in the garden and he ran around it. His dad asked, "What can we do with this gear?" Tom said, "Let's put it on a big rock and play a game!" 

So that's what they did. Tom and his dad created a game â€“ they each took a turn to roll the gear. They laughed and played until it was dark. Then, Tom and his dad stopped playing and went to bed. 

The End.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to go explore the world. She was so excited and feeling so brave. She put on her purple shoes and ran outside. The sun was shining brightly and the birds were chirping. She looked around and noticed a big sign with her name, her eyes grew wide. She peeked around the corner and saw a group of people with a big cake!

The little girl walked up to everyone with a big smile, they were all clapping and cheering. She felt so proud, it was a special day! Everyone was smiling and giving her hugs. Then her mom asked her, "Honey what is this sign for?"

The little girl beamed with pride and said, "It's for me! Everyone is here to help me celebrate my first adventure." The adults were so proud of the little girl. She was brave and bold and ready to explore the world.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer named Jack. Jack had a big field where he grew lots of corn. He was very gentle with his plants and took good care of them. One day, Jack decided to go on a trip and he needed to lock his house before he left.

As he was locking the door, he remembered that he had forgotten to feed his chickens. He went to the barn and saw that they had eaten all the corn he had left for them. Jack felt sad, but he knew he had to go on his trip.

When he came back, he saw that his corn had grown so tall! He was so happy and proud of his gentle care for them. Jack knew that he had to lock his house again before going to bed, so he did and went to sleep dreaming of his delicious corn.

John was walking along the beach at the harbor when he saw a delicate boat bobbing in the distance. He was excited and ran to it. When he got to the boat, he found three men onboard. When he asked them what they were doing, one of the men nodded and John knew it was something bad. He tried to run away but one of the men caught him. The men put John in the boat and sailed away. 

John was scared but he didn't know what to do. He tried to call for help but the men wouldn't let him. After a while, they reached a dark and secret harbor. The men took John out of the boat and he was never seen again. 

John was never seen again, but his memory lives on in the delicate boat that still floats in the harbor today.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. He lived in a wild jungle. Every morning he would roar very loudly. The other animals were scared of him and had to be extra quiet.

One day, the lion found a fireplace in the middle of the jungle. He was so excited! He went over to it and noticed it was very old and original. He made a roaring sound and the fireplace lit up.

Now the lion had a nice warm home. He would spend the evenings by the fireplace, warming his body and keeping himself safe.

Every evening, he would roar and the fireplace would glow brightly. He was so happy in his own special den. He was the king of the jungle!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a very ordinary life. Every day, she went to school, played with friends, and helped her mom and dad. 

Then one day, the little girl decided to do something adventurous. She was going to visit the city and buy a veil! 

The little girl was so excited. She had never been to the city before. On the way, she saw tall buildings, colorful street cars, and smelled yummy food. 

When the little girl arrived at the store, she found the prettiest veil she had ever seen. She smiled and put it on her head. She knew she had made the right choice. 

The little girl felt so proud of herself. She had taken an ordinary day and made it extraordinary.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tom. He liked to play with his friends and make jokes. Tom was a happy boy, but sometimes, he did unusual things that made his friends laugh.

One day, Tom found a big box near his house. He thought it would be funny to hide inside and remain there until his friends found him. He thought it would be a great joke. So, Tom crawled inside the box and waited for his friends to come.

As Tom waited, he started to feel hot and tired. He wanted to get out of the box, but it was stuck. His friends looked for him, but they could not find him. Tom was sad and scared. In the end, Tom's joke did not make anyone laugh, and he was stuck in the box.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal sunflower who lived in a small garden. Every morning the sun would come up, and the sunflower would turn towards it, eagerly awaiting its rays.

One day, a kind little girl came along. She saw the sunflower and thought it was the most beautiful thing she'd ever seen. She wanted to take it home with her, so she gently plucked it from the ground.

The little girl spent the afternoon with the sunflower in her garden. She made sure to feed it plenty of water so it wouldn't be thirsty. She even talked to it like it was a real person. 

Finally, after a long day of playing, the little girl brought the sunflower back to its home in the garden. She said goodbye to her new friend and vowed to come back tomorrow.

The sunflower smiled in the sunshine, grateful to have such a loyal friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to create things. One day, she decided to make a seat for her teddy bear. She gathered some pillows and a blanket and put them together to make a cozy seat.

As she was working, her nosy little brother came over to see what she was doing. "What are you making, Lily?" he asked.

"I'm making a seat for Teddy," she replied.

"That's cool," her brother said. "Can I help?"

Lily smiled and said, "Sure, you can help me fluff the pillows." Together, they finished the seat and put Teddy on it. He looked very happy and comfortable. "Thank you for helping me, brother," Lily said.

"You're welcome," he replied. "It was fun creating something with you."

Lily was a lazy girl. She often didn't want to do anything. Everything felt like too much effort. But one day, something inside of her changed.

She found a paintbrush and some paints lying around. As she looked at them, she felt excited. She began painting on the wall next to her.

She painted all sorts of things. She painted the sky, trees, and flowers. She really brought the painting to life!

When she was finished, she stepped back and looked at what she had created. She was so proud of herself. She realized that if you put your mind to it, you can do anything. 

From then on, Lily never felt lazy anymore. Painting had made a huge difference in her life, and she was so happy!

Ben and Lily were friends who liked to play together. They had different skin colors: Ben's skin was brown and Lily's skin was white. They did not care about that. They cared about having fun.

One day, they went to the park with their moms. They saw a big slide and ran to it. Ben went first and slid down fast. He laughed and said, "That was fun! Come on, Lily!"

Lily climbed up the ladder and got ready to slide. But then she saw a boy with red hair and green eyes. He was waiting for his turn. He looked at Lily and said, "Hey, you have weird skin. What is your name?"

Lily felt sad and scared. She did not like the boy's words. She said, "My name is Lily. What is your name?"

The boy said, "My name is Max. And I have the best skin. It is red and green, like a firework. You have boring skin. It is white, like snow. I am envious of nothing."

Ben heard what Max said. He felt angry and brave. He climbed up the ladder and stood next to Lily. He said, "You are wrong, Max. Lily's skin is not boring. It is beautiful, like a flower. And my skin is not weird. It is cool, like chocolate. We have different skin, but we are both good. You are envious of everything."

Max did not know what to say. He felt ashamed and small. He ran away from the slide. Ben and Lily smiled at each other. They slid down together and hugged. They were happy and proud. Their moms saw them and clapped. They had the best skin. It was the skin of friends.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was three years old and it was her birthday. She was so excited because she was having a special birthday party. All of her friends were there at her house. 

When everyone had arrived, Jane wanted to show them her new seat. It was a fluffy pink seat with sparkles all over it. All of her friends were very happy for Jane and they all made sure to give her a special hug. 

Then, Jane's mom opened a big box and everyone gasped! Inside the box were delicious birthday treats. Everyone grabbed something and then they all sat down in Jane's new seat. 

Jane was so happy to be surrounded by all her friends at her birthday. She smiled and laughed and then she remembered something bad. She had forgotten to get her friends presents! She started to feel sad but her mom gave her a big hug and told her that it was ok. 

Everyone still had a wonderful time, eating treats, playing games and laughing together. Jane was so glad that her birthday was such a happy one. She thanked her friends for coming over and then they all said goodbye.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Jenny. Jenny was three years old and she loved exploring nature. Every day she used to go for a walk in the woods near her house. She used to think about all the wonderful things she saw in nature and how loyal nature was to her.

One day, as she was walking, she spotted a little rabbit in a bush. She was so excited and ran over to try and pet it. The rabbit was scared and hopped away. Jenny thought to herself, "I just have to be a bit more loyal to nature and this bunny will learn to trust me". 

So, Jenny started bringing treats with her on her walks in nature. She would wait very still until the bunny came back, and then she would place the treats nearby. It got to a point where the rabbit was comfortable with Jenny being around and it even came out of the bush to eat the treats from her hands.

Jenny was so proud of herself, she had been really loyal to nature and it had rewarded her with a special friendship. From that day forward, Jenny and the rabbit were the best of friends.

The sun was shining and the sky was blue. All the animals were playing in the meadow and the birds were singing.

Suddenly, it started to rain and the meadow began to soak. The animals were so sad; all of their fun had stopped.

But then the sun came out again. A rainbow appeared in the sky, so charming and bright. Everyone was happy again.

The meadow was still a bit wet, yet it was still perfect for playing and running. The animals and birds rejoiced, as the rain had made the meadow even more beautiful.

And so they all played together in the sunshine, so happy in their meadow again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to wear his red vest every day. It was his favorite vest. He wore it to school, to the park and even to bed sometimes. Timmy's mom told him he needed to wear other clothes too, but Timmy liked his vest the best.

One day, Timmy's mom told him he needed to study for his test. Timmy didn't like studying, but he knew it was important. So, he put on his vest and sat down at his desk. He studied his regular words and his regular numbers. He studied for a long time, but he didn't give up.

When the day of the test came, Timmy felt nervous. But he remembered all the things he studied and he did really well! Timmy was so happy that he wore his red vest to celebrate. From that day on, Timmy knew that studying was important and he wore his vest proudly every day.

Once upon a time, there was a trunk. The trunk was very important, but it was far away. Little John wanted to see what was inside the trunk.

One day, Little John took a long walk to the distant land. When he arrived, he knocked on the trunk's door. Suddenly, the trunk opened. Inside, Little John saw lots of fun things. He found toys, sweets and games.

Little John happily stored all of the treasures in his backpack. He decided to take the trunk with him too.

Little John was so excited to show everyone back home what he had found! He started the long walk back and was soon back home again.

Little John opened up the trunk in the front yard and all of his friends were amazed. Together, they played and ate all of the treats until the sun set. Little John had the best day ever!

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they find a big book with many pictures of animals. They want to look at the book together.

Anna opens the book and sees a lion. She says, "Look, Ben, a lion! It is big and yellow and has a long tail. It can roar and snap." She makes a loud noise and pretends to snap her teeth.

Ben laughs and turns the page. He sees a monkey. He says, "Look, Anna, a monkey! It is small and brown and has a long tail. It can swing and touch." He swings his arms and pretends to touch his nose.

Anna and Ben have fun and look at more animals. They see a zebra, a giraffe, a snake, and a bird. They learn their names and what they can do.

But then, they see a picture of a dog. The dog is black and white and has a sad face. It looks like it is crying. Anna and Ben feel sad too. They wonder why the dog is sad.

Anna says, "Maybe the dog is lonely. Maybe it wants a friend." Ben says, "Maybe we can be its friends. Maybe we can make it happy." They hug the book and smile at the dog.

The dog seems to smile back. It looks less sad. Anna and Ben are happy. They say, "We love you, dog. You are our friend." They close the book and put it away. They go to play with their own toys and books. They are still friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky was very lonely and always wanted to make new friends. One day, Ducky went to the pond to swim and saw a new duck. Ducky wanted to introduce himself, but was too shy.

The new duck said, "Hi, my name is Daisy. What's your name?" Ducky was so happy to have a new friend and said, "My name is Ducky!"

As they were swimming together, they saw a big flood coming towards them. They were scared and didn't know what to do. Ducky said, "We need to find a safe place!" Daisy agreed and they swam to a nearby tree.

They were safe from the flood, but they were stuck on the tree. Ducky said, "I'm glad we're safe, but I'm still lonely up here." Daisy replied, "Don't worry, we can be friends forever!" And from that day on, Ducky and Daisy were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Nadia. She was three years old and loved to explore the world. One day, when Nadia was playing in the garden, she spotted a silly shrimp. She couldn't take her eyes off it and so she ran to call her mom.

"Mommy, Mommy, come look! I found a silly shrimp!" Nadia said.

Her mom smiled. "It is a very special shrimp. Let's put it in a bowl so it won't disappear," she said.

So they put the shrimp in a bowl and watched it. They decided to feed it and soon they saw it was having a lot of fun.

Nadia was so happy that the shrimp didn't disappear. The next day, mum told Nadia that the shrimp had disappeared.

"Where did it go, Mommy?" Nadia asked.

"I am not sure. Maybe someone took it or it just decided to disappear," her mom replied.

Nadia was sad, but she knew the shrimp would always be a part of her memories.

Once upon a time there was a birdcage. It was round and made of metal. Inside was a little bird. It was yellow and looked very happy in its cage. 

The birdcage seemed easy to open. The bird jumped out of the cage and flew away. It flew high into the blue sky and chirped happily. 

Below the bird, the little girl looked up in awe. She wanted to be able to fly like the bird, so she grabbed hold of the birdcage and tried to open it. But it seemed like an impossible task. 

Suddenly the girl had an idea. She grabbed her father's scissors and started to cut the strings that were holding the birdcage together. It was easier than she thought and the birdcage opened with ease. The bird flew away and the girl was very happy.

Once upon a time there was a plane in the sky. It made a funny noise and was going on an adventure. But then something went wrong and the plane started to shake. The people in the plane got scared and started to panic.

The plane flew lower and lower until it almost touched the ground, then it flew back up to the sky. Everyone felt safer, but then it started to shake again. Some of the people shouted and held onto each other's hands.

But then there was a big, loud noise, like a giant sneeze, and the plane stopped shaking. Everyone was happy and started laughing. They thanked the pilot for flying them safely back home and everyone hugged each other. 

From then on, everyone loved to take the plane for adventures. Whenever the plane started to shake, everyone just laughed and said: "We're flying!"

Tom and Sam were brothers who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big cliff near their house. They wanted to climb it and see what was on the other side.

"Let's go, Tom!" Sam said. "It will be fun!"

"I don't know, Sam," Tom said. "It looks high and scary. What if we fall?"

"Don't be a baby, Tom," Sam said. "I will teach you how to climb. It's easy. Just follow me."

Sam ran to the cliff and started to climb. He did not look back at Tom, who was still afraid. Tom did not want to be a baby, so he followed Sam. But he was not comfortable. He felt his hands and feet slip on the rocks. He felt his heart beat fast. He wished he was back at home.

"Sam, wait for me!" Tom cried. "I don't like this!"

But Sam did not hear him. He was too busy climbing. He wanted to reach the top and see the view. He did not care about Tom. He was selfish.

Soon, Sam reached the top of the cliff. He looked around and smiled. He saw the trees, the birds, and the river. He felt proud of himself.

"Wow, this is amazing!" Sam said. "I'm the best climber ever!"

But then he heard a loud scream. He turned around and saw Tom hanging from a branch. He had slipped and almost fallen. He was holding on for his life.

"Sam, help me!" Tom shouted. "I'm scared!"

Sam felt sorry for Tom. He realized he had been a bad brother. He had not taught him how to climb. He had not stayed with him. He had not cared about him. He had been foolish.

"Tom, I'm sorry!" Sam said. "I'm coming to help you!"

Sam quickly climbed down the cliff. He reached Tom and grabbed his hand. He pulled him up to the branch. He hugged him and said:

"Tom, I'm sorry I was selfish. I should have listened to you. I should have stayed with you. I should have cared about you. You are my brother and I love you."

Tom hugged him back and said:

"Sam, I'm sorry I called you a baby. I should have respected your feelings. I should have been brave. I should have trusted you. You are my brother and I love you."

The brothers learned a lesson that day. They learned that climbing a cliff is not as important as being kind and helpful. They learned that being a brother is not about being the best, but about being there for each other. They learned that being comfortable is not about being safe, but about being loved.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Joe. He was only 3 years old and he loved to stay outside and play with his friends. One day, Joe wanted to climb up to the top of a big tree in the backyard. His mom said it was okay, so he started climbing. 

When he reached the top, he was so happy! But then he saw something wild! A large bird was sitting in the tree and it didn't look very friendly. Joe was scared, but he decided to stay and see what would happen. 

The bird said to Joe: "You should not stay here! It is too dangerous!" But Joe was scared, he didn't know what to do. Then the bird flew away very quickly, and Joe was left alone on the top of the tree. 

It got dark outside, and Joe started to cry. He wanted to get down, but he was too scared to move. He stayed up there, feeling cold and hungry, until the morning came. 

Joe's mom found him the next morning, still on the top of the tree. She was so worried, and thankfully Joe was safe, but he never went climbing again.

Jane was very tired. She wanted to take a nap. She asked her mom, "Will you take me to the cliff to sleep?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes of course!"

When they arrived at the cliff, Jane looked out at the beautiful view. It was so fair. Jane was so excited. She hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for taking me here!"

They lay down together on the grass. The sun was setting in the sky. Jane started to feel sleepy. Her mom said, "We should go to sleep now. The night is coming."

So, Jane and her mom closed their eyes and fell asleep at the cliff. Jane dreamed of the beautiful fair view from the cliff and of running through the grass. When Jane's mom woke up, she carried Jane back home feeling happy.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. They like to slide, swing and run. One day, they see a big bell in the park. It is shiny and loud.

"Let's ring the bell!" Lily says. "It will be fun!"

"OK!" Ben says. "But be careful. The ground is wet and slippery."

They run to the bell. Lily goes first. She pulls the rope hard. The bell makes a great sound. Ding dong! Ding dong!

Ben claps his hands. "That was great, Lily! Now it's my turn!"

He runs to the bell. He pulls the rope hard. But he slips on the wet ground. He falls down. Ouch!

Lily runs to him. "Are you OK, Ben?" she asks.

Ben rubs his knee. "I'm OK, Lily. It hurts a little. But I'm OK."

Lily hugs him. "I'm sorry, Ben. You were brave. Do you want to try again?"

Ben smiles. "No, thank you, Lily. I think I had enough of the bell. Let's go to the slide. It's safer and more fun."

Lily nods. "OK, Ben. Let's go to the slide. But be careful. The slide is slippery too."

They hold hands and walk to the slide. They slide down together. They laugh and have fun. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a twin boy and girl. They were very helpful and always wanted to help each other. One day, they wanted to help their parents in the garden.

The girl said, "Let's go! We can help our parents in the garden."

The boy smiled and said, "That sounds like fun! I'm ready."

So, they got to work. They watered the flowers, planted some vegetables, and pulled out some weeds. When they were done, their parents were so happy.

Their father said, "Thank you, my helpful twins! You did a great job in the garden."

The twins smiled and hugged each other. They had a lot of fun helping their parents.

Mommy and Amy were very eager to decorate the house. Mommy took out the wire and asked Amy to thread it all around. Amy smiled and clapped as she ran around the house, threading the wire all around. Mommy hung colorful paper stars and tissue paper circles on the wire. Amy was so excited to see it sparkle, she laughed and smiled again. Together they decorated the house, so it looked like a special and happy place. Mommy and Amy hugged and went around to see their special house again. Everything was so sparkly and nice, it felt so magical!

Lisa liked to pick feathers from the ground. She found them in the park, in the yard, and sometimes on the street. She had a big box where she kept all her feathers. She was very organized. She sorted her feathers by color, size, and shape. She had red feathers, blue feathers, yellow feathers, and more. She had big feathers, small feathers, and fluffy feathers. She had round feathers, long feathers, and pointy feathers.

One day, Lisa went to the park with her mom. She saw a lot of feathers on the grass. She ran to pick them up. She was very happy. She thought they were from a bird. She wanted to add them to her box. She picked up a white feather, a black feather, and a gray feather. She held them in her hand. She looked at them closely. She noticed something strange. They were not real feathers. They were fake feathers. They were made of plastic. They were from a toy.

Lisa felt sad. She did not like fake feathers. She wanted real feathers. She threw the fake feathers away. She looked around. She saw a real bird on a tree. It had beautiful feathers. It was a blue jay. It sang a song. Lisa smiled. She liked the blue jay. She wanted to pick a feather from it. But she knew she could not. She knew the blue jay needed its feathers. She decided to leave it alone. She said hello to the blue jay. The blue jay said hello back. Lisa felt happy again. She went back to her mom. She told her about the fake feathers and the blue jay. Her mom hugged her. She said she was proud of her. She said she was a good girl. Lisa felt proud too. She said she loved her mom. She said she loved feathers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Cindy. Every day, Cindy would go to the store to get milk for her family. She loved the store and was always greeted by the friendly shopkeeper.

One day when Cindy was at the store, she noticed something strange: the shelves were all empty! She asked the shopkeeper why the shelves were empty. "It's too hard for you to understand," the shopkeeper said.

Cindy wasn't happy about this. But she had to trust the shopkeeper. So, she said goodbye and went home.

When Cindy told her family the news they didn't recognize the problem. But then they noticed something even more strange: the milk was gone too!

The family soon realized what had happened: the shopkeeper had been preparing for a snowstorm and had run out of milk. They were relieved that the shopkeeper had already taken care of the problem.

Cindy was happy that she had recognized the problem. Next time, she would know that she shouldn't leave getting milk too late.

Once upon a time, there was a band. The band was very loud and made a lot of noise.

The band was shaking and playing music. Everyone in town could hear it. Even babies in their beds could hear it. 

The shaking band was so loud that even the birds in the trees had to cover their ears. The shaking got so strong that it even shook the ground.

Everyone in the town loved the shaking band. They smiled and danced to the music the band was playing. Even little children were happy and danced with the band.

The band shook and played for a long time until it was getting dark. Then the band stopped. Everyone was sad, but happy at the same time.

Once upon a time, there was a white room. It was very boring. Nothing was in it; no toys, no people, nothing. 

One day, a little girl came in. Her name was Jane. Jane looked around and said, "It's so boring in here". 

Suddenly she had an idea. Jane asked, "Can we fill this room with fun things?". 

Her mom said, "Yes, of course we can! What do you want to fill it with?". 

Jane thought for a while and then said, "Let's fill it with balloons, games and toys!" 

So they filled the room with balloons, games and toys. Suddenly, the white boring room was full of fun and color! Jane was so happy. 

The end.

Mum and Dad were sad. They left the street and did not want to stay. Moon was confused. He felt like he was being ignorant. 

Mum and Dad said they needed to go. They asked Moon to leave with them. Moon didn't want to go as he was having so much fun. Mum said they needed to leave now and that they would come back another day.

So, Moon grabbed his little bag and followed Mum and Dad down the street. He looked back at the street one last time and then left.

He didn't understand why he had to leave so quickly, but he wanted to stay with Mum and Dad. They held his hands and kept him safe as they walked away from the street. 

When they reached the end of the street, Moon felt happy again. He smiled at Mum and Dad and they hugged him and said they were sorry they had to leave so quickly. 

Moon was no longer feeling ignorant. He learned that sometimes you just have to go, but that it didn't mean goodbye forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was only three years old. She liked to explore and find new things, so one day she decided to go on an adventure.

Sarah went outside and saw a little pathway. It looked so attractive that she decided to follow it. Along the way, she came across a big iron gate. She could not open it, so she started to cry.

Suddenly, a friendly voice said, "Don't worry, little one. I can help you. If you want, I can lead you past the gate so you can find out what's beyond it." Sarah looked up and saw a tall man with a big smiling face. She was very happy, so she said yes.

The man opened the gate and led Sarah beyond it. He showed her a beautiful garden with lots of flowers and birds. Sarah was so happy and made lots of new friends. She also learnt an important lesson that day: it is very important to ask for help when you need it.

The boy was ready to dive into the pool. It was so much fun splashing around and feeling like he was flying. He liked it so much he dove in again and again.

The lawyer watched from outside the pool. He was so impressed with the boy's diving skills he decided he wanted to join in. So the lawyer dove into the pool too, splashing around and feeling like flying just like the boy. They both had so much fun diving together.

Finally, when they were both all done, they climbed out of the pool. The boy and the lawyer were ready to do it all again!

Once there was a little girl. Her name was Lucy. She wanted something new to play with so she asked her Mom. Her Mom said, "I have an offer for you!" Lucy was very excited. Her Mom said, "If you help me clean the house, I'll give you a white hut to play with." So Lucy cleaned the house and sure enough, her Mom had a white hut waiting for her when she was done. 

Lucy was very happy. She dragged the hut into the backyard and played in it all day. She used it as a magical castle and pretended she was a princess. She called it her secret hideaway. Every day, she would go outside and play in her white hut. 

She thanked her Mom for the hut, and Mom said, "You're welcome. It's nice to offer you something special to play with." Lucy smiled and hugged her Mom. They were both very happy.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, John and Jane. Every day they would play together in the warm sun.

One day, they were so excited because they were planning a big celebration. They gathered up their things and went to the woods to find an axe.

John and Jane searched for hours for an axe, but they could not find one. They were sad and did not know what to do.

Then one of the friends had an idea! They decided to build a fort out of sticks they found in the woods. Soon they had built a really big and strong fort!

The two friends were so happy! They celebrated by sitting inside their fort and eating treats. They were warm and happy, and they made a promise to play together forever.

There was a family who lived in a nice house. They wanted to do something fun, so they decided to bake! Dad grabbed the flour and sugar and Mom brought out the eggs. The little girl was so excited. 

They put everything together in a bowl, then put it in the oven. They all waited for what seemed like forever until finally, something smelled delicious! 

Dad took out the cake, and it was so yummy! The family then put the cake on a big wheel. They got on the wheel and started to roll. It was so much fun! 

They rolled and rolled, through the park and all around the neighborhood until they got back home. They all felt safe and happy. 

The family sat down and enjoyed the delicious cake that they made together. It was a wonderful day!

Tim and Mia were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they found a big box in the yard. They wondered what was inside.

"Let's open it and see!" Tim said.

"Maybe it's a toy or a surprise!" Mia said.

They lifted the lid and peeked inside. They saw something shiny and round. It looked like a ball.

"Wow, a ball!" Tim said. He reached in and grabbed it.

But it was not a ball. It was a bomb. It had a timer and a wire. Tim did not know what it was. He pulled the wire by mistake.

The bomb made a loud noise and a bright flash. It hurt Tim and Mia very much. They screamed and cried. The box was on fire. The yard was full of smoke.

Mom and Dad heard the noise and ran outside. They saw Tim and Mia lying on the ground. They were very scared and sad. They called for help.

The help came and took Tim and Mia to the hospital. They had many burns and cuts. They had to stay in the hospital for a long time. They could not play outside anymore.

Tim and Mia were very sorry. They wished they had not opened the box. They wished they had listened to Mom and Dad. They said they would never touch things they did not know.

The moral of the story is: Do not be curious about things that are not yours. They might be dangerous or harmful. Be grateful for what you have and listen to your parents. They know what is best for you.

Once upon a time, a colorful bird named Bob lived in a big tree. Bob loved to fly in the sunshine and fill the sky with his beautiful songs. One day, he saw a little girl named Sue playing in the park.

"Hi Sue!" said Bob, "Do you want to play with me in the sunshine?" Sue looked up and smiled. "Yes, Bob! Let's play together!" So, they played and had fun under the warm sunshine.

But then, dark clouds came and covered the sky. The sunshine was gone. Bob and Sue were sad. They could not play anymore. They said goodbye and went back to their homes. The day ended with no more sunshine and fun.

One day, a mom and her son were looking for things to do. Mom suggested that they go for a walk in the park. The son shouted "yes!" excitedly as he liked going for walks.

So the two of them headed off to the park. At the park, there were lots of lovely trees and colorful flowers. They soon came across a pond. It had some ducks swimming in it and they were so much fun to watch!

Mom pointed to a distant hill. She said that if they went to the top, there would be an amazing view. The son agreed and so they headed up the hill. It was difficult to climb at first, but eventually they made it.

From the top, they could see for miles! They saw the pond with the ducks, the trees, and so much more. They stayed there for some time and enjoyed the distant view. It was a wonderful day and they had fun together.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She wanted to succeed in everything she did so she worked very hard.

One day, Jane was playing in her room when her mom heard an alarm go off. She looked to see what was going on and saw Jane playing with a brown toy truck.

"Jane, what are you doing?" asked mom.

"I'm trying to make my truck move," said Jane.

"Well, do you think you can do it?" asked mom.

"Yes, I can do it! I'm going to succeed!" Jane replied.

Mom smiled and watched as Jane worked hard to make her truck move. After a few tries and some practice, Jane finally made it move. She cheered in delight, "I did it! I succeeded!"

From then on, Jane kept trying her best to succeed in all the things she did. And every time she did, she would feel very proud.

Once upon a time, there were two friendly friends named Joe and Joanne. They liked to plan fun adventures together. One day, they had a great plan. They wanted to make a special stitch!

Joe and Joanne gathered up their things and went to Joanne's house. Joanne had all sorts of colorful material and pieces of thread. They picked different pieces and made a plan for the special stitch.

They worked very hard and soon had a plan all worked out. Joanne showed Joe how to use the needle and thread. Joe stitched and stitched until he had made a beautiful stitch! Joanne and Joe were so proud.

Joe and Joanne looked at the pretty stitch and hugged each other. They were so happy with their finished stitchâ€”it was perfect!

The two friendly friends had made the best plan ever and they cherished the special stitch they had made. They knew they would look back on this day, and always smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy lived on a small island with his mommy and daddy. The island was very pretty, with lots of trees and flowers. Timmy loved to play on the beach and look for shells.

One day, Timmy found a special shell that glowed in the dark. He was so happy and showed it to everyone on the island. They all thought it was very cool.

But then, a big storm came and the island was flooded. Timmy's house was destroyed and he had to leave his home. He felt very sad and humble. He couldn't find his special shell and he missed it very much.

Timmy and his family had to leave the island and go to a new place. They were safe, but Timmy was still sad about his lost shell. He wished he could go back to the island and find it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very curious and loved to explore the world around her. One Sunday, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy.

As she was playing, she found some colorful stones on the ground. She picked them up and showed them to her mommy. "Look, mommy! I found these pretty stones. Can we sort them by color?" she asked.

"Sure, Lily! Let's sort them together," her mommy replied. They sorted the stones into piles of red, blue, green and yellow.

Lily was very happy with their work. She hugged her mommy and said, "Thank you for sorting the stones with me, mommy. I love spending Sundays with you and daddy."

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Moni. She liked to sing very much. She sang all day long to the birds, bugs and flowers.

One day, Moni was singing in the garden and stepped on a bee. It gave her a little shock, but she was fine.

Moni was sad because she scared the bee. She sat down and didnâ€™t sing any more.

The birds, bugs and flowers all stopped and looked at what had happened. They flew over to Moni and sang a sweet song.

The little girl smiled and joined in. And soon Moni was singing with the birds, bugs and flowers again. It was so nice! She sang and laughed for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to play in the park with his owner, Lily. One day, they went to the beach and Max found a shiny rock. He thought it was his, but then another dog came and said it was his rock. Max didn't want to fight, so he just wagged his tail and walked away.

Later, Lily and Max went for a walk and they saw a big flag waving in the wind. Max barked at it, but Lily told him it was okay. They walked some more and saw a boy playing with a ball. Max wanted to play too, but the boy said it was his ball. Max didn't fit in with the boy's game, so he just watched from afar.

At the end of the day, Lily and Max went home. Max was tired from all the fun they had. He went to his bed and fell asleep, dreaming of the shiny rock and the waving flag.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. Her name was Jane. Jane was three years old. She didn't like taking baths. Whenever her mom asked her, she said, "No! I hate baths!"

One day, Jane was playing outside in the garden, when she found something. It was a gray spade. Jane said, "What's this?!"

Then, Jane's mom said, "That's a spade, Jane. It's a special tool to help you dig in the garden."

Jane smiled and said, "I love spades! I don't hate them like I hate baths!" 

Then she grabbed the spade and started to dig around in the dirt. She had a lot of fun until it was time to go back inside. She still didn't like taking baths, but now she didn't hate spades.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Max and Jane. Max was strong, while Jane was not. Max decided to show her how strong he was, and so he said he would lift a heavy bucket. Jane thought Max was silly, and so she laughed.

Max picked up the heavy bucket and carried it over to Jane. He said, "See! I'm strong enough to lift this bucket!" Jane clapped for him. She looked admiringly and said, "I wish I was as strong as you Max".

Max smiled and said, "You don't have to be strong like me. You just need to work together with your friends â€“ it's easy then!" Jane was surprised by this. She said, "That's true, Max! Working together is much easier!" 

They both laughed, gave each other a big hug, and went off be happily ever after. The moral of the story is that if you work together with others, you can do big and heavy things much more easily.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a man and his wife. The man was very thin, and the wife was a bit fat. They loved each other very much. One day, the man saw his wife was sad. She looked at her fat body and said, "I wish I was thin like you."

The man wanted to help his wife feel happy. He thought and thought. Then, he had an idea. They would go for a walk every day. Walking would help restore her happiness and maybe make her feel better about her body.

So, the man and his wife walked together every day. They talked and laughed while walking. The wife started to feel happy again. She was still a bit fat, but she did not feel sad about it anymore. They learned that being happy together was more important than how they looked. And they lived happily ever after.

The moral of the story is that it's more important to be happy and love each other than to worry about how we look.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy's mommy told him they were going to a party. Timmy was so excited! 

When they got to the party, Timmy saw a big cake with zero candles on it. He wondered why there were no candles. Then, he saw a man bow to the birthday girl. Timmy thought it was funny and decided to bow too. 

But when Timmy sat down on a chair, he felt uncomfortable. It was too big for him! So, he stood up and started to dance with the other kids. They played games and had lots of fun. When it was time to go home, Timmy was tired but happy. He couldn't wait to go to another party!

Once upon a time there was a small boy named Jack. He was a very thoughtful boy who thought about everything carefully.

One day, Jack went to his grandpa's house and was very excited to see him. When Jack saw grandpa, he bowed to show him respect. 

Grandpa smiled and said "I have a special surprise for you!" He handed Jack a tool kit. Jack was so happy. He had always wanted his very own tools.

Jack smiled and bowed again. Then he carefully opened the tool box. Inside he saw a special tool. It was shaped like a heart. Grandpa said "I made this special tool for you, Jack. I thought it would be a thoughtful present."

Jack was so happy and thanked grandpa with a big hug. He treasured the thoughtful gift everyday.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a new toy in their room. It was a screen that showed pictures and sounds. They were very happy and curious.

"Look, Lily, a screen!" Ben said. "Let's play with it!"

"OK, Ben, but we have to be careful," Lily said. "Mommy said screens are not for babies. They can hurt our eyes and ears."

They turned on the screen and saw a funny show with animals and colors. They laughed and clapped their hands. They forgot to be careful.

Soon, they heard Mommy's voice from downstairs. "Lily, Ben, time for lunch!"

They did not want to stop playing with the screen. They ignored Mommy's voice.

"Five more minutes, Mommy!" Ben shouted.

"No, Ben, we have to go now," Lily said. "Mommy will be angry if we don't listen."

But Ben did not listen to Lily. He wanted to play more. He grabbed the screen and pulled it away from Lily.

"Mine, mine, mine!" Ben said.

"Hey, give it back, Ben!" Lily said. "It's ours, not yours!"

They started to fight over the screen. They pulled and pushed and yelled. They were not careful.

Suddenly, the screen slipped from their hands and fell on the floor. It broke into pieces. The pictures and sounds were gone. They were very sad and scared.

They heard Mommy's footsteps coming up the stairs. They knew they were in trouble.

They looked at each other and said, "Uh-oh."

Once upon a time there was a big boat. It was shiny, very big and had lots of parts. There was a big window on the boat and a funny flag on the top. One day, the boat was ready to sail. Everyone was happy, but they were also a bit worried.

The boat went sailing away in the ocean. The waves were very big. The boat went up and down with all the waves. It made everyone a bit scared, but they all had brave smiles too.

While everyone was sailing, the captain looked out of the window. He was looking for something. Suddenly, he shouted with joy and said, "I found it! Look!"

Everyone was excited as they all looked in the same direction. There, in the far distance, they could see a small island.

Everyone on the boat cheered, and they sailed faster to get to the island. Finally, they arrived, and they all had a wonderful time together. They were not worried anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to look at tiny things with her microscope. Her microscope was incredible! It made things look very big.

One day, Lucy saw a tiny bug. She wanted to look at it with her microscope. She put the bug on a slide and leaned in close. The bug looked so big and had many colors.

Lucy showed the big bug to her friend, Tom. Tom thought it was amazing too. They leaned in close to look at the bug together. They both loved the incredible microscope and the big, colorful bug.

Tom and Lily liked to play in the park. They liked to slide, swing and run. One day, they saw a big maze made of hay. They wanted to go inside and find the way out.

They asked their mom if they could go. Mom said yes, but be careful and stay together. Tom and Lily ran to the maze and entered. They saw many paths and turns. They tried to remember where they came from and where they were going.

But soon, they got lost. They could not see the exit or their mom. They started to feel scared and sad. They called for mom, but no one answered. They walked and walked, but only found more hay.

Then, they heard a loud roar. They turned around and saw a big, filthy lion. The lion had escaped from the zoo and found the maze. The lion was hungry and angry. It saw Tom and Lily and wanted to eat them.

Tom and Lily screamed and ran. They tried to find a way out, but the lion was faster. It chased them and caught them. It bit them and hurt them. Tom and Lily cried and wished they never went to the maze.

The lion ate them and left. Mom came to the maze and looked for them. She saw the lion and the blood. She realized what happened and felt very sad. She wished she never let them go to the maze.

Once there was a dog. The dog had a bone. The bone was very big. The dog loved the bone. One day, the dog lost the bone. The dog was very lonely without the bone. The dog looked for the bone everywhere. Finally, the dog found the bone. The dog was so happy to have the bone again. The dog named the bone "Boney". Now, the dog was never lonely again because Boney was always with the dog.

Mum and Dad were packing a big box. 
"What are you doing?" asked Jack.
Mum looked up from the box. 
"We're packing a frame," she said, "for a very special picture."
Jack was curious. He wanted to help, so he took some of the soft things and put them around the frame. 
Mum smiled at him.
