"That's great," she said, "just be careful not to get too dizzy."

When the box was packed it was heavy. Dad carried it carefully out to the car. Jack could not wait to see the special picture!

Once upon a time there was a hose. It was extra special because it was used to protect the garden. Every day the garden was happy and safe.

But one day, something bad happened. A slimy and disgusting thing crawled out of a hole and started to wreak havoc. The hose didn't know how to help, but it had to be brave and protect the garden.

The hose spray water all over the slimy thing and it squirmed away. The hose had saved the garden!

From then on, the hose was always ready to protect the garden from anything bad. The garden got even happier and never had to worry again.

Once upon a time, there was a big gorilla. He lived in a jungle with many trees and animals. One day, a little girl saw the gorilla and wanted to ask him a question. She was scared because he was so big, but he looked kind. 

The little girl asked the gorilla, "Can you play with me?" The gorilla smiled and said yes. They played together all day long. The gorilla was very kind and gentle with the little girl. 

When it was time to go home, the little girl said goodbye to the gorilla and gave him a big hug. She was happy to have made a new friend. From that day on, whenever the little girl visited the jungle, she would always ask the gorilla to play with her. And the gorilla was always kind and happy to play.

Ben and Sam were brothers who liked to play in the garden. They had a big box that they used as a castle. Ben was the king and Sam was the knight. They had fun pretending to fight dragons and enemies.

One day, a new boy moved in next door. His name was Max and he had a lot of toys. He had a bike, a ball, a robot and a real sword. He saw Ben and Sam playing in their box and laughed. He said their castle was silly and their sword was fake. He said he was the real king and they were his servants.

Ben and Sam did not like Max. They said he was mean and rude. They said they did not want to play with him. They said their castle was impressive and their sword was sharp. They said they were the real king and knight and they would not listen to him.

Max got angry and decided to show them who was the boss. He got on his bike and rode towards their box. He shouted that he would knock down their castle and take their sword. He said he would call them names and make them cry.

Ben and Sam were scared and tried to stop him. They got out of their box and held their sword. They said they would defend their castle and fight him. They said they would call him a bully and make him leave.

But Max was too fast and too strong. He crashed into their box and broke it. He grabbed their sword and threw it away. He pushed Ben and Sam to the ground and laughed. He called them babies and losers and cowards. He said he was the king and they were nothing.

Ben and Sam were hurt and sad. They cried and ran to their house. They told their mom what happened and she hugged them. She said Max was wrong and mean and she would talk to his mom. She said Ben and Sam were brave and kind and she was proud of them. She said they were her kings and she loved them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to sit in her warm chair by the fireplace and read books. One day, her mom came in and said, "Lily, we are going to a show tonight. It's going to be so much fun!" Lily was excited and asked, "What kind of show?" Her mom replied, "It's a magic show. The magician will do tricks and we can applaud him." 

Lily and her family went to the show and sat in their chairs. The magician came out and did some amazing tricks. Everyone in the audience clapped and cheered. Lily loved it so much that she stood up and started to applaud too. After the show, Lily said to her mom, "I want to be a magician when I grow up!" Her mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Lily. You can practice your tricks in your warm chair by the fireplace."

Once upon a time, there was a small child named Jack who lived near a tall, big mountain. He asked his parents what was inside of it, and they told him it was a volcano. He was so excited, and wanted to learn more about it.

One day, Jack decided to take a closer look. He slowly walked up the big mountain and was soon at the top. He asked the volcano if he could come inside.

The volcano said no, but told Jack that it was very sleepy. Jack felt sorry, and decided to make a bed of soft moss and leaves to make the volcano more comfortable. The volcano thanked him and fell right to sleep. Jack enjoyed watching the volcano sleep and smiled as he walked back down the mountain.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Tanya. She liked nothing better than playing in the park with her friends. One day, she decided to try something new. She climbed on the seesaw and held tight. As Tanya went up and down, she saw something incredible. It was a treat. Tanya wanted to taste the treat, but it was too high.

Tanya called out to her friends, "Can you help me restore the treat?" Her friends agreed and formed a plan. They stacked their jackets to make a big pile. Then, they lay down on their stomachs to form a bridge. Together, they worked to bring the treat closer to Tanya.

At last, Tanya was able to reach the treat. She savoured every bite and thanked her friends for their incredible help. She had never tasted anything so delicious. Tanya and her friends had a wonderful time that day.

Once upon a time there was a chubby girl. She loved to play games and be with her friends. 

One day, the girl wanted to go upstairs to find her toy. She asked her mom if she could go upstairs. Her mom said â€œYes! But don't forget to come down after you find it!â€ 

The girl went upstairs. There were so many toys in her room. She looked everywhere but could not find her toy. Her friend saw her looking and asked â€œWhat are you looking for?â€. 

The girl said â€œI'm looking for my toy. I can't find it!â€ Her friend said â€œLet's look together! We'll find it soon.â€ So the two friends searched everywhere. 

Finally, the girl saw the toy in the corner. She ordered her friend, â€œI found it! Phew! Let's go downstairs.â€ So the two friends went downstairs and continued playing together.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big slide and a swing. They want to try them.

Tom goes first. He climbs up the slide and slides down. He laughs and says, "That was easy and fun!" Mia wants to try too. She climbs up the slide, but she is scared. She does not slide down. She cries and says, "I can't do it! It is too high!"

Tom hears Mia cry. He runs to her and says, "Don't cry, Mia. I will help you. You can do it. It is easy and fun!" He holds her hand and slides down with her. Mia stops crying and smiles. She says, "Thank you, Tom. You are a good friend. That was easy and fun!"

Their moms see them and clap. They say, "Well done, Tom and Mia! You are brave and kind. We are proud of you. Do you want a treat?" They give them each a piece of chocolate. Tom and Mia say, "Yes, please! We love chocolate!" They eat the chocolate and share it with each other. They are happy and hug their moms. They say, "We love you, mom!" They play some more and have a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to feed the ducks at the pond. She would bring bread in her folder and throw it to the ducks. She was always so proud when the ducks ate the bread she gave them.

One day, the little girl went to the pond to feed the ducks, but she forgot her folder. She saw a man who had a lot of bread, so she asked him if she could have some to feed the ducks. The man said no and told her to go away.

The little girl was sad and didn't know what to do. She went home and cried. The next day, she went back to the pond with her folder, but the ducks were gone. They had flown away because they didn't have any food to eat. The little girl was very sad and wished she had been able to feed them.

Once upon a time there was a small mouse called Sam. Sam was looking for a way to gain something valuable. One day, he saw a scale on the floor. He picked it up and started using it to measure things. 

The scale was normal sized and weighed things quickly. Very soon, Sam started gaining different items - some food, some money and even some toys! Everyone in the mouse family was very proud of him.

Sam's brother asked him what he was doing, and Sam said, "I'm using this scale to measure things and gain some stuff". His brother was amazed and wanted to do the same thing.

Soon all the mice in the whole family were using the scale to gain things. Sam was the first one to start, and very soon he became the most successful. Everyone was proud of him and the scale. 

And the mice lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time there was a fat cat. He was always so happy and loved to go for long naps in the sun.

One day the cat heard some news. He heard that if he did something special he could gain what he liked. He was so happy and ran right away to do it.

The cat worked hard and soon it was done. Then he knew what he had to do. He ran back to where he heard the news.

When he got there, his friends were so excited. They were jumping and cheering, because the cat had gained the thing he wished for!

Once upon a time there were two pigs called Peter and Pinky. They were good friends. Peter was always looking for ways to improve. He saw each day as a chance to be better than the day before.

One day, a teacher called Mrs Carrot paid a visit. She asked Peter and Pinky if they wanted to be her pupils. In return, she promised them yummy treats. 

Peter saw this as the perfect opportunity to improve and said yes right away. Pinky hesitated, although intrigued by the prospect of food. In the end, he agreed too. 

Then Mrs Carrot told them they had to practice their lessons every day. And, with lots of hard work, they could become more and more clever. Peter and Pinky followed the teacher's instructions and spent every day learning and practicing.

Sure enough, each day they became better and better. Soon, the lessons got easier and easier. By the end of the month, Peter and Pinky were proud to show off their knowledge. Mrs Carrot rewarded them with yummy treats - just as she had promised. 

Peter and Pinky were really happy their hard work had paid off. Now they could always improve and become smarter and smarter.

Once upon a time, there was a crab named Pinchy. Pinchy was very thin and he lived in a big ocean. One day, Pinchy met a fish named Bubbles. Bubbles asked Pinchy, "Why are you so thin?"

Pinchy replied, "I don't know. I eat a lot of food, but I never get bigger."

Bubbles had an idea. "Let's spin around together. Maybe that will help you get bigger."

So, Pinchy and Bubbles started to spin around and around. Suddenly, Pinchy felt something strange happening. He started to grow bigger and bigger! When they stopped spinning, Pinchy looked in the water and saw that he was no longer thin.

"Wow, thank you, Bubbles!" said Pinchy. "You helped me get bigger!"

Bubbles smiled and said, "You're welcome, Pinchy. Let's spin again sometime!"

Once upon a time, there was a sailor. He had a big boat. He loved to sail on the water. The sailor was stubborn. He did not like to ask for help.

One day, the sailor went out to sail. The sky was blue, and the sun was bright. The water was calm. The sailor was happy. He sailed far away from the land.

Soon, dark clouds came. The wind blew hard. The sailor was scared. He did not want to be stubborn anymore. He called for help. A big boat came and saved the sailor. The sailor learned that it is okay to ask for help.

Once there was a blue pencil. The pencil was special because it could provide lots of things. Every day the pencil went on a new adventure. One time it went to the beach and provided all the beach-goers with a great time. Another time, it provided a child with all the colours of the rainbow. 

The pencil loved all its adventures, but especially liked when it could provide happiness to others. Its best adventure happened when it provided a little girl with a sparkly drawing. The girl was so pleased with her drawing that she hugged the pencil tightly. 

The pencil knew that it had provided the little girl lots of happiness. From then on it was sure to provide joy whenever it could.

Once upon a time there was a lucky little girl. She went for a walk in the forest to explore. As she walked further into the forest she noticed a big, wooden barrel perched on the ground. She ran over to the barrel to get a closer look. With a curious shrug she pried open the lid of the barrel.

Inside was a secret treasure! It was a beautiful necklace with lots of glittering gems. The lucky girl gasped in delight and carefully put the necklace around her neck.

The little girl felt so lucky. She turned around to leave and ran back home, filled with joy. She had found something wonderful in that barrel, and she would never forget it.

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play at the park. The park has a big slide. Lila and Ben want to go on the slide.

"Let's go on the slide!" Lila says.

"OK!" Ben says.

They run to the slide. Lila goes first. She sits on the slide. She slides down fast. She laughs.

"Wow, that was fun!" Lila says.

Ben goes next. He sits on the slide. He slides down fast. He laughs.

"Wow, that was fun!" Ben says.

They go on the slide again and again. They have a lot of fun.

After a while, they feel hungry. They go to the bench. Lila has a sandwich. Ben has a pepper.

"Can I have some of your sandwich?" Ben asks.

"Sure, you can have half of it," Lila says.

"Can I have some of your pepper?" Lila asks.

"Sure, you can have a bite of it," Ben says.

They share their food. Lila takes a bite of the pepper. She makes a face.

"Yuck, this is hot!" Lila says.

Ben laughs.

"I like hot peppers. They are good for you," Ben says.

Lila drinks some water. She feels better.

"Next time, I will bring a long carrot. Carrots are good for you too," Lila says.

Ben nods.

"OK, next time we can share a carrot and a pepper," Ben says.

They finish their food. They smile at each other. They are happy. They go back to the slide. They play some more. They have a good day.

Once there was a loyal bear named Bobo who liked to explore the woods near his house. Bobo was always trying to find new things. One day, he stumbled upon a shiny razor. He looked at the razor and couldn't believe his eyes. He had never seen something so sparkly before!

Bobo cautiously picked up the razor and examined it. He couldn't figure out what it was. He shrugged and said, â€œI don't know what it is, but I'm sure it must be important." 

Just then, he heard a voice from behind. It was his rabbit friend, Jumpy. Jumpy said, "Oh, that's a razor, Bobo! It helps people cut their hair and beards." Bobo was very surprised. He thanked Jumpy for teaching him something new and put the razor away. From that day forward, Bobo and Jumpy were even more loyal to each other, because they trusted each other to always teach them something new!

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Lucy. She wanted to borrow a video so she could have lots of fun. She asked her friend Lily, if she could borrow a video. 

Lily said, â€œyes, I have a dependable video you can borrow! Go ahead and take it.â€ 

Lucy was so excited and said, â€œThank you, Lily!â€ She grabbed the video and hugged her friend.

The next day, Lucy returned the video. She thanked Lily again and hugged her goodbye. Lily smiled and said; â€œYouâ€™re very welcome, I knew I could trust you to be dependable.â€

And so, Lucy was happy that she was able to borrow a video and that Lily trusted her to be dependable. The two girls stayed great friends forever.

Lily liked to do yoga with her mom. Yoga was when they made funny shapes with their bodies on a mat. Sometimes they were trees, sometimes they were cats, sometimes they were stars. Lily liked to stretch and breathe and feel calm.

One day, Lily saw a big sack in the corner of the living room. She wondered what was inside. She asked her mom, but her mom said it was a surprise. Lily was curious. She wanted to see the surprise. She waited until her mom was busy in the kitchen, and then she tiptoed to the sack.

She opened the sack and peeked inside. She saw lots of toys and books and clothes. They were all new and shiny and colorful. Lily was happy. She thought the sack was a gift for her. She pulled out a doll, a puzzle, a hat, and a ball. She played with them on the floor. She made a mess.

Her mom came back and saw the mess. She was not happy. She said, "Lily, what have you done? This sack is not for you. It is for the children who don't have many things. We are going to give it to them tomorrow. You have to put everything back and make it tidy."

Lily felt sad. She did not mean to be naughty. She said, "I'm sorry, mom. I thought it was for me. I like the toys and books and clothes. Can I keep one?" Her mom said, "No, Lily. You have enough things. You have to share with others. That is what yoga teaches us. To be kind and generous and grateful. Now, help me put everything back and make it tidy."

Lily helped her mom put everything back in the sack. She said goodbye to the doll, the puzzle, the hat, and the ball. She said, "I hope you make the children happy. Maybe they will do yoga with you." She hugged her mom and said, "I love you, mom. I'm sorry I made a mess. Can we do yoga now?" Her mom said, "I love you too, Lily. Yes, we can do yoga now. Let's be trees." They smiled and made funny shapes with their bodies on the mat. They stretched and breathed and felt calm.

Once upon a time, there was a little boat named Daisy. Daisy loved to sail in the big blue sea. One day, Daisy noticed a big anchor in the water. She wanted to play with it, but she knew it was too heavy. 

Daisy asked her friend, a seagull named Lucky, to help her. Lucky flew down and picked up the anchor with his strong wings. Daisy was so happy and grateful to have a friend like Lucky. 

As they continued to sail, Daisy and Lucky saw many other boats struggling with their anchors. They decided to help them too. Daisy and Lucky learned that helping others is important and makes them feel good inside. They felt lucky to have each other and to be able to help others.

Tom and Lily liked to play with their mom's crystal vase. It was shiny and sparkly and made pretty sounds when they tapped it. But mom said they should not touch it, because it was very old and very breakable. She said it was a gift from her grandma, and she loved it very much.

One day, when mom was out, Tom and Lily decided to play with the crystal vase again. They took it from the shelf and put it on the floor. They pretended it was a castle, and they were the king and the queen. They had a lot of fun, until Tom tripped over a toy and fell on the vase. The vase broke into many pieces, and Tom and Lily were very scared.

They tried to fix the vase, but they could not. They tried to hide the pieces, but they could not. They knew mom would be very sad and very angry when she saw what they had done. They thought of running away, but they could not. They loved mom, and they did not want to hurt her.

They decided to tell mom the truth, and say they were sorry. They waited for mom to come home, and they showed her the broken vase. Mom was very sad and very angry, but she also saw that Tom and Lily were very sorry. She hugged them and said she forgave them, but they had to learn a lesson. She said they had to replace the crystal vase with something else.

Tom and Lily did not have any money, so they could not buy a new vase. They thought of what they could do, and they had an idea. They went to the garden, and picked some flowers. They arranged them in a nice bouquet, and tied a ribbon around them. They wrote a card that said, "We love you, mom. We are sorry for breaking your vase. We hope you like these flowers. They are not as shiny and sparkly as the vase, but they are very pretty and smell very good."

They gave the flowers and the card to mom, and mom smiled. She said the flowers were amazing, and she loved them very much. She said they were a very thoughtful and sweet gift, and she was proud of them. She said they could not replace the crystal vase, but they could replace her sadness with happiness. She said they were the best gift she ever had. She put the flowers in a glass jar, and placed it on the shelf, where the vase used to be. She said the flowers reminded her of her grandma, who also loved flowers, and of Tom and Lily, who also loved her. She hugged them again, and said they were very good children. Tom and Lily were very happy, and they learned their lesson. They never played with the crystal vase again, or with anything else that was not theirs. They always respected mom's things, and mom's feelings. They always told the truth, and said they were sorry when they made a mistake. They always tried to make mom happy, and mom always loved them.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to draw pictures for her family and friends. One day, Lily made a special card for her mom. It had hearts and flowers on it, and said "I love you" in big letters.

When Lily gave the card to her mom, she was very polite and said "thank you, sweetie". Lily felt happy because her mom liked the card. She loved making her mom happy.

From that day on, Lily made cards for everyone she loved. She would draw pictures and write nice words on them. And everyone was always polite and said thank you. Lily was happy because she loved making people feel happy with her cards.

Anna and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with dolls and cars and books. They went to the same school every day, except on Saturday and Sunday. On Wednesday, they had a special day. It was their birthday!

Anna and Ben were born on the same day, in the same hospital. Their moms were friends, too. They always had a big party together, with cake and balloons and presents. They were very happy and excited.

"Anna, what do you think is in your present?" Ben asked, as they waited for the party to start.

"I don't know, Ben. Maybe a new dress, or a hat, or a puzzle. What do you think is in yours?" Anna said.

"Maybe a new car, or a ball, or a book. I can't wait to see!" Ben said.

Soon, their moms called them to the table. They sang a song and blew out the candles. Then, they opened their presents. Anna and Ben smiled and gasped as they saw what they got.

"Wow, Anna, you got a blue bike! It's so pretty and shiny!" Ben said.

"Wow, Ben, you got a blue helmet! It's so cool and safe!" Anna said.

They hugged each other and thanked their moms. They were very happy with their presents. They decided to share them and play together.

"Anna, do you want to ride my bike?" Ben asked.

"Yes, Ben, and you can wear my helmet!" Anna said.

They put on their helmets and got on the bike. They rode around the yard, laughing and having fun. They revealed their new skills and their friendship. They had the best birthday ever.

Ben and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and blocks. But today they disagree. Ben wants to build a tall tower with the blocks. Sam wants to make a road for the cars.

"No, no, no!" Ben says. "Blocks are for towers, not roads!"

"Yes, yes, yes!" Sam says. "Cars need roads, not towers!"

They push and pull the blocks. They shout and cry. They have a fight.

Mom hears the noise. She comes to the room. She sees the mess and the tears.

"What is going on here?" Mom asks. "Why are you fighting?"

"Ben is bad!" Sam says. "He won't let me play with the blocks!"

"Sam is bad!" Ben says. "He won't let me build a tower!"

Mom shakes her head. She picks up the blocks and the cars. She puts them in a box.

"Enough!" Mom says. "No more blocks and cars for today. You need to learn to share and play nicely. Now say sorry to each other and hug."

Ben and Sam look at each other. They feel sad and sorry. They say sorry and hug.

Mom smiles. She gives them a kiss and a cookie.

"Good boys," Mom says. "Now let's go and read a book together. Maybe you can find a story about blocks and cars and towers and roads."

Once upon a time, there were two best friends: Jack and Jill. Every day Jack and Jill played together in their garden.

One day, Jack had a special surprise for his best friend. He had made her a wonderful costume! It was a bright pink tutu with matching frilly sleeves. Jill was delighted and gave him a big thank you hug.

Jack and Jill decided to take the costume to their neighbour Suzie's house and show her. Suzie was just as excited when she saw the costume. She said they should have a fancy dress parade.

Jack and Jill began to stir. They collected anything they could find like hats, buckets and ribbons. They asked around the neighbourhood until they had enough things to make a costume for everyone.

When the parade was ready, Jack and Jill led the way. People cheered and clapped as the children went around the neighbourhood. Jack was so reliable and everyone knew he had organised the whole parade with Jill.

At the end, everyone had a great time and Jack and Jill promised to do it again next week.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends called Tom and Sarah. Every day they loved to play together. Tom was always very bossy and liked to be in charge when they played.

One day they were playing when Tom received a surprise. His grandma had bought him a new puppy. Tom was really happy.

But Sarah was not happy at all. She was cross and bossy and told Tom that he was not allowed to play with her anymore. She said that the puppy was naughty and she didn't want it to spoil their games.

Tom was sad and asked Sarah to keep playing but she wouldn't listen. Tom and his puppy went off to play by themselves and Sarah went home.

The bad ending was that Tom and Sarah were no longer best friends. No matter how much they both wanted to play together, Sarah was too bossy.

Sara likes to play with her dolls. She has many dolls with different hair. Some have long hair, some have short hair, some have curly hair, some have straight hair. Sara likes to comb their hair and make them look pretty.

One day, Sara wants to take her dolls outside. She puts them in a big bag and carries them to the garden. She finds a nice spot under a tree and lays them on a blanket. She starts to comb their hair and talk to them.

But then, she hears a loud noise. It is a big dog. The dog sees Sara and her dolls and runs towards them. He wants to play too. He jumps on the blanket and grabs a doll in his mouth. He shakes the doll and makes it wet with his spit.

Sara is scared and angry. She shouts at the dog and tries to get her doll back. But the dog is too strong and fast. He runs away with the doll and leaves Sara and the other dolls behind.

Sara cries and hugs her dolls. She is sad that the dog took her doll. She hopes that her doll is okay and that her hair is not ruined. She wishes that the dog would bring her doll back and say sorry. She wishes that her doll would be dry and happy again.

Once there was a girl named Clara. She was very adventurous. One day, Clara's mommy said, "Let's put a swing in the backyard!"

Clara was excited. She helped her mommy put the swing up. When they were done, Clara said, "Let's swing!" They both sat on the swing and started going higher and higher.

While they were swinging, Clara asked her mommy, "Are we high enough?" Her mommy said, "Almost!"

Clara began to feel very adventurous. She said, "Let's swing even higher!" Her mommy said, "OK, let's try!"

So they both held on tight and started swinging as high as they could. Clara was laughing and giggling with joy. When they finally stopped, Clara said, "That was so much fun!" 

Her mommy said, "Yes, it was! I'm glad you had such a good time!" 

Clara smiled and said, "Me too!"

One sunny day, a driver was on the road. He was going very fast and his car was sped through the countryside.

Suddenly, the driver felt something heavy on the car and he had to slow down. He stopped the car and opened the door. Along the side of the car was a large rock.

The driver was angered. He shouted: "Who put this rock here?".

But no one answered. No one was around.

The driver moved the rock off the road and moved on. But then he heard a loud noise from behind. It was the same rock! 

The driver quickly stepped on the gas to speed away. Sure enough, the rock followed him, bouncing and rattling along the road.

The driver was confused. But then he noticed something in the sky above. It was an eagle! It was the eagle who had been carrying the rock, dropping it onto the road in an attempt to stop the driver.

The driver never again drove too fast. He knew to be aware of birds and rocks that could get in his way.

Once there was a farmer who lived on a farm in the countryside. Every day he took care of his animals, but one day he had a problem. The hay he used to feed his animals was all gone! He looked all around the farm, but couldn't find any more.

The farmer became very impatient and he started to cry. He felt helpless and sat outside his barn with his head in his hands.

Suddenly, he heard a noise. Looking up, he saw a young girl standing in front of him with a huge bundle of fresh hay in her arms. "I found this hay..." she said timidly, "...while I was playing in the forest". 

The farmer was so happy that he wanted to hug the little girl, but he just smiled and said, "Thank you very much".

The farmer fed his animals with the hay that the little girl had found. Every time he thinks of her, the farmer is reminded of the importance of being kind and thankful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play sports with her friends. One day, while playing, they heard a strange noise coming from a bush. Lily said, "What's that noise? Let's go peek and find out!" 

As they approached the bush, they saw a little bird with a broken wing. Lily said, "Oh no! We need to help this bird. But how?" Her friend said, "I don't know. It's an unknown problem." 

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I know! Let's build a little nest for the bird and take care of it until it feels better." Her friend agreed and they quickly gathered some leaves and twigs to make a cozy nest for the bird. 

After a few days of taking care of the little bird, it finally felt better and was able to fly away. Lily and her friend were happy that they were able to help the bird. They continued playing their sports, but now they knew that they could always help others in need.

There was a girl named Lily who loved her pink purse. One day, Lily was walking down the street when she dropped her purse. All her coins and toys fell out of the purse and scattered on the ground. 

Lily felt sad and started to cry. A kind lady saw what happened and helped Lily pick up her things. But when Lily tried to eat her candy, she found out it was sour. She didn't like the taste and started to cry again. 

The kind lady saw that Lily was upset and gave her a new candy that was sweet. Lily smiled and felt happy again. She hugged her purse tightly and thanked the lady. From that day on, Lily made sure to hold her purse tightly so she wouldn't drop it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He had a big pocket on his shirt. One day, Timmy found a rock on the ground. It was so ugly! Timmy didn't like it, but he didn't want to throw it away. Instead, he put the ugly rock in his pocket. Timmy walked around with the rock in his pocket all day. When he got home, he took the rock out of his pocket and put it on his dresser. Timmy was happy to have a new friend, even if it was an ugly rock.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very adventurous, always looking for exciting things to do. One day, she saw an old key on the ground. It was shiny and sparkly and it looked so exciting! When she picked it up, the key seemed to appear from out of nowhere.

The little girl couldn't wait to explore where the key might lead her, so she started running down the street. She didn't know what was on the other side, but it was so exciting! She ran and ran and eventually she came to a big castle. She couldn't believe her eyes.

She found a door with a huge lock on it. She put the key in and her heart was racing. She turned the key and the door opened! She walked in and the inside was grand and amazing. It was full of treasures, like the little girl had only ever seen in story books! She was so excited and so happy.

She looked around and she heard a voice. 
"Welcome! I'm so glad you found the key and followed it here," said the voice.
The little girl was amazed, but happy to know she had been so adventurous today. She had found something truly magical.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl. She had an offer to go play with a pitch. She was so excited!

The girl walked to the pitch, which was big and green. She saw a few people there, but they seemed a bit uncomfortable.

The girl smiled, and shouted "Hi, Everyone! Do you want to play with me?"

Everyone was quiet at first, but then one of them spoke up.

"Yes, we'd love to play with you!" the person said.

The girl was so happy, and the people all smiled back. They started to play together and it was fun. Everyone felt more comfortable when they were all playing together. In the end, they all kept playing until the sun went down. 

The girl was glad she chose to make the offer, and she never forgot how much fun she had on that pitch.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her dollhouse and her toy animals. One day, she went outside to play with her friends. They played hide-and-seek and had a great time.

After a while, it was time for Lily to go back inside. She was so tired that she forgot to bring her favorite doll with her. She only realized this when she wanted to play with her again later that day.

Lily searched everywhere, but she couldn't find her doll. She was very sad and didn't know what to do. Her mom saw her crying and asked her what was wrong. Lily told her that she had forgotten her doll outside and couldn't find her.

Her mom went outside and looked around. After a while, she found the doll lying under a bush. Lily was so happy and hugged her mom. She said, "Thank you, Mommy! You are great at finding things!"

Once upon a time there was a boy called Jack. He wanted to explore the jungle because he had never been there before.

He set off in the morning and lay down into the thick grass. The sky was so blue and the trees so tall. Jack felt so excited that he couldn't sit still.

He walked and walked until he found a funny looking animal. "Who are you?" said Jack.

"I'm a tiger," said the tiger. "Do you want to come into my jungle home?"

Jack nodded and went with the tiger. As they walked, Jack saw lots of animals running around - monkeys, birds and snakes.

Finally the tiger stopped at a big tree and said, "This is where I lay".

Jack looked around and he could feel how peaceful the jungle was. The sun was setting and it was getting dark.

Jack said goodbye to the tiger and lay down under a tree. He felt sleepy and soon he was resting peacefully in the restless jungle.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old and had lots of ideas. One day, Sarah had an expensive idea. She wanted to buy a brand new toy. She asked her mom for some money, but mom said no. 

Sarah thought and thought, but nothing came to her. Then she had an idea. She asked her mom if it would be OK if she sat outside and sold lemonade. Her mom agreed and Sarah quickly went to work. 

She set up a table in the driveway, put up a sign and waited. People came and went and Sarah sold lots of lemonade. In the end, she made enough money to buy her toy. She was so happy and thanked her mom for the great idea.

Once there was a boy who wanted to win. He wanted to win at a game more than anything. He practiced and practiced, but still couldn't win.

One day, he decided to ask for help. He went to his mom and asked her how to get better at winning. His mom said she had a useful way to help him.

The next day, his mom took him to a game area. He played new games and had a lot of fun. Every time he won, he got a special dinner. He kept winning until he was the best at the game.

By the end of the day, the boy had won a lot and his mom had a big smile on her face. He had used the useful advice given by his mom and had managed to win. He was so excited and happy that he had won so many dinners.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play in their room. They had many toys and books and a big bed with soft cushions. One day, they found a new game. They took the cushions and piled them up on the floor. Then they climbed on the bed and jumped on the cushions. They laughed and shouted as they bounced up and down.

"Look at me, I'm a mighty lion!" Ben roared, pretending to have claws and teeth.

"I'm a mighty princess!" Lily said, wearing a crown and a necklace.

They had so much fun that they did not hear their mom calling them for lunch. She came to their room and saw the mess. She was angry and told them to stop jumping and clean up.

"But mom, we're having fun!" Ben said, not wanting to stop.

"Yeah, mom, please let us play a little more!" Lily said, urging her mom to change her mind.

"No, you have to eat and then take a nap. You're making too much noise and you're ruining the cushions. They're not for jumping, they're for sleeping. Now come on, or you'll be in trouble." Mom said, grabbing their hands and pulling them away from the bed.

Ben and Lily were sad and mad. They did not want to eat or nap. They wanted to play. They thought their mom was mean and unfair. They did not say thank you or sorry. They pouted and whined all the way to the kitchen.

But when they came back to their room after their nap, they saw something terrible. The cushions were torn and ripped. The stuffing was everywhere. Their toys and books were broken and dirty. And on the wall, there was a big scratch and a note. It said: "I'm a mighty lion too. And I don't like noisy kids. Next time, be quiet and listen to your mom. Or I'll come back and eat you. Grrr!"

It was their cat, Fluffy, who had done it. He was hiding under the bed, looking smug and satisfied. He had heard them jumping and roaring and had decided to join the game. But he had played too rough and had destroyed everything.

Ben and Lily were shocked and scared. They cried and hugged each other. They wished they had listened to their mom and not jumped on the cushions. They learned their lesson the hard way. They realized that their mom was right and that they had been wrong. They said sorry to their mom and to each other. They helped her clean up the mess and promised to be good and quiet from then on. They hoped that Fluffy would not come back and eat them. They hoped that their mom would forgive them and love them still. They hoped that their cushions would be fixed and their toys and books would be replaced. They hoped that they would find a new game that was fun and safe and did not make anyone angry or sad.

The end.

Once there was a little fish who was very unhappy. He felt very miserable. He swam around searching for something to make him feel better, but nothing worked. 

Eventually he saw a big, scary shark. He was terrified. He tried to swim away, but the shark was too fast. Just as the shark was about to eat him, he saw a sparkly light in the water. 

The little fish blinked, and magically he was in a beautiful coral reef. He was safe! He swam around happily, feeling much better. 

The little fish never forgot his adventure. He reminded himself to keep blinking whenever he was feeling miserable.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had an old toy named Mr. Pill. Mr. Pill was round and soft. Tim loved to play with Mr. Pill every day.

One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He played on the swings and slide. But Tim forgot Mr. Pill at home. He started to miss his old toy. Tim felt sad and wanted to go home.

When they got home, Tim saw Mr. Pill on his bed. He was so happy to see his old toy again. Tim gave Mr. Pill a big hug. They played together and Tim did not miss Mr. Pill anymore.

Mia and Leo were adventurous twins who liked to explore new things. One day, they found a big box in the garage. It had many tools inside, like hammers, nails, and screwdrivers.

"Wow, look at all these tools!" Mia said. "I wonder what they do."

"Let's try them out!" Leo said. He picked up a screwdriver and a nail. He saw a wooden board on the floor. He tried to push the nail into the board, but it was too hard.

"Maybe you need to twist it," Mia suggested. She took the screwdriver from Leo and put it on the nail. She turned it around and around, but nothing happened.

"It's not working," Mia said. "Maybe we need a different tool."

She looked inside the box and saw a shiny metal thing. It had a round handle and two long arms. She grabbed it and showed it to Leo.

"What is this?" she asked.

"I don't know," Leo said. "But it looks cool. Let's see what it does."

They walked to the board and put the metal thing on the nail. Mia squeezed the handle and the arms closed around the nail. She pulled hard and the nail came out of the board.

"Wow, it worked!" Mia said. "This tool is amazing. It can take out nails."

"Let's find more nails and take them out," Leo said. "This is fun."

They spent the next hour using the metal thing to take out nails from different boards. They made a pile of nails and boards on the floor. They felt proud of their work.

They did not know that the metal thing was a pliers and that the boards were part of a shelf that their dad was building. They did not know that their dad would be very angry when he saw what they had done. They only knew that they had an adventurous day with a new tool.

Once upon a time there was an ash tree. It was mighty tall and stood in the middle of a sunny field. Every day it waved in the wind and twinkled in the sun.

One day, a little girl called Molly came to meet the ash tree. Molly had never seen anything so mighty and she couldn't believe her eyes. She ran to the tree, her arms outstretched.

When she reached the ash tree, Molly put her arms around it and hugged it tight. She could feel the tree's strength and she knew it was her friend.

The ash tree welcomed Molly with a gentle rustle of its leaves, as if to say 'hello'. Molly and the ash tree became good friends. They talked and smiled, and Molly looked up to the mighty ash tree every day.

Once upon a time, there was a calm little girl. She loved to explore the world and have fun. One day, while she was playing outside her house, she noticed a blue flower on the ground. She wanted to pick it, but then hesitated.

â€œMaybe I shouldnâ€™t do that,â€ the girl thought to herself.

â€œWhatâ€™s the matter?â€ asked her mom, coming out of the house.

One day, a little cat named Kitty was feeling anxious. She did not know where her meat was. She looked and looked, but she could not find it anywhere. Kitty was very hungry and sad.

Kitty saw her friend, Doggy, and asked, "Did you see my meat?" Doggy thought for a moment and said, "No, but let's look together." They looked under the tree, behind the rock, and by the pond, but they still could not find the meat.

Finally, they went to the big bush and found Kitty's meat. Kitty was so happy! She said, "Thank you, Doggy!" They both went home with big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy who was very busy. She wanted to design something special for her baby. So she went to get some materials to make something special. 

"Ah, now I just need some fabric!" she said. 

On her way to the shop, her baby started to itch really badly. She turned to him and asked: "What's wrong, baby?" 

The baby just pointed at his neck and said "Itchy!".

Momma smiled and said "I think I know just what to design for you! Let's go home and see what I can do!"

At home, Mommy got to work. She used the fabric to design a cozy scarf. Finally, it was finished. Mommy showed it to the baby and he was so happy! He hugged it tight and said: "No more itchy now!"

Mommy smiled and said: "See? Designing can be fun!"

Anna liked to wander around the house and look for things to play with. She liked to open drawers and cupboards and see what was inside. One day, she found a big envelope on the table in the living room. It had a stamp and a sticker on it. She wondered what was inside.

She picked up the envelope and tried to open it. She tore a little bit of the paper, but it was too hard. She decided to ask her mom for help. She ran to the kitchen, where her mom was making lunch.

"Mom, mom, look what I found!" she said, holding up the envelope.

Her mom looked at the envelope and frowned. She recognized the sticker. It was from the doctor. She had been waiting for some serious news about her health.

"Anna, where did you get this?" she asked, taking the envelope from her.

"I found it on the table. Can you open it for me? I want to see what's inside," Anna said, curious.

"Anna, this is not for you. This is for me. It's very important. I need to open it by myself," her mom said, gently.

"But why? What is it?" Anna asked, disappointed.

Her mom sighed. She didn't know how to explain to her little girl what was in the envelope. She didn't even know herself. She hoped it was good news, but she was scared.

"Anna, this is a letter from the doctor. He checked me and he wrote me what he found. I need to read it and see if I'm okay or not," her mom said, trying to sound calm.

"Are you sick, mom?" Anna asked, worried.

Her mom hugged her and kissed her cheek. She smiled, but her eyes were sad.

"I don't know, Anna. I hope not. But whatever happens, I love you very much. And you are very brave and smart and sweet. You are my best girl," her mom said, softly.

"I love you too, mom. You are my best mom. Can I help you open the envelope?" Anna asked, hopefully.

Her mom nodded. She took Anna's hand and walked to the couch. She sat down and put Anna on her lap. She opened the envelope and took out the letter. She held her breath and read it. She felt a tear roll down her cheek. She looked at Anna and smiled.

"Anna, guess what? The doctor says I'm okay. I'm not sick. I'm healthy. He says I can play with you and hug you and kiss you for a long time," her mom said, happily.

Anna clapped her hands and cheered. She hugged her mom and kissed her cheek. She was happy too.

"Yay, mom! You are okay! You are not sick! You are healthy! I'm so glad! Can we play now?" Anna asked, excitedly.

Her mom laughed and nodded. She put the letter and the envelope on the table. She didn't need them anymore. She had the best news and the best girl in the world. She got up and took Anna's hand. They wandered to the backyard and played in the sun. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Bob and Jane. Every day they would play in the park together, having lots of fun. One day, they decided to build something special, so they collected some logs and started to build a chair.

Bob found a nice and small log, just perfect for the back of the chair. When they finished building, they both decided to take a break. Jane looked around the park and suggested that they should have a picnic.

Bob nodded and started to go home to get what they needed for the picnic, but before leaving he said "Let's decide something. Whoever can do five somersaults in a row gets the small chair."

When Bob returned with the food and drinks. Jane had already got in position and she was getting ready to do the somersault. With determination, she did five somersaults in a row, and Bob had to admit defeated.

The two of them enjoyed their picnic in the chair, happy that Jane had won the small chair.

Once upon a time, there was a baby bunny who loved to play. He hopped around the meadow and enjoyed the sunshine. One day, he saw something shiny, it was a fork! He hopped up to it, and it was the perfect size, it fit just right in his paws. Immediately, he started to zip around with it! He was so happy to have found a new toy, he hopped faster and faster. Soon he was zipping around the entire meadow and it was so much fun! He kept playing until the sun went down, but he was so worn out that he fell asleep right away, cuddling with his new fork.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went for a walk with her dog, Max. They walked and walked until they came to a big door. 

Lily tried to open the door, but it was locked. She said, "Max, how can we get in?" 

Max barked and ran to the east side of the door. There was a small keyhole. Lily found a key and unlocked the door. 

Inside, there was a fair with lots of rides and games. Lily and Max had so much fun! They went on the merry-go-round and played a game where they won a big stuffed bear. 

When it was time to go home, Lily said, "Thank you, Max, for helping me unlock the door. That was a fairytale adventure!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom asked her to get a cup from the cupboard. Lily climbed up on a chair and opened the cupboard door. She saw a big black spider inside and screamed.

Her mom came running and saw the spider too. She said, "Don't worry, Lily. We'll get rid of it." Later that day, Lily saw a tiny plant growing in the garden. She asked her mom what it was. Her mom said, "It's a tomato plant. If we take care of it, we'll have yummy red tomatoes to eat."

Lily remembered the spider in the cupboard and said, "I hope the tomatoes don't grow any spiders!" Her mom laughed and said, "Don't worry, Lily. The tomatoes will be safe and delicious." And they were.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She liked to gaze at the stars at night. One day, her mommy and daddy went to a marriage. They left Lucy with a harmless cat named Whiskers.

While they were gone, Lucy and Whiskers played in the house. Lucy said, "Whiskers, let's play hide and seek!" Whiskers meowed and they started to play. Lucy hid under the bed and Whiskers looked for her.

But then, Lucy saw a big spider on the floor. She screamed and ran out of the room. Whiskers tried to catch the spider, but it was too fast. The spider bit Lucy on the leg. Lucy cried and cried. When her mommy and daddy came home, they saw Lucy crying and took her to the doctor. The doctor said that the spider was not harmless and Lucy had to stay in the hospital for a few days.

Molly and Mommy were in a car. Mommy said, "Where are we going, Molly?" Molly answered, "We're going to a hotel!" 

Mommy said, "That's right! We're going to a very tall hotel with lots of fun things to do!" 

They arrived at the hotel. Mommy said, "Let's go inside and find the hotel desk. We will bring our bags there". Molly and Mommy went inside the hotel and found the hotel desk. 

Molly said, "Can I help bring the bags to the desk, Mommy?" 

Mommy smiled and said, "Yes, you can carry one bag and I will bring the other one." They put their bags at the desk and Mommy said, "Now we're ready to have a fun stay at the hotel!"

Once upon a time, there was a happy little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved pirates and would always pretend to be one. He would wear a big hat and carry a toy sword. One day, Timmy went to the park and saw a pirate statue. He was so enthusiastic and ran to touch it. 

As he touched the statue, he felt like a real pirate. Suddenly, he heard a voice behind him say "Ahoy matey!" It was an old man dressed like a pirate. Timmy was scared at first, but the pirate was very kind and asked if he wanted to go on an adventure. 

Timmy was so excited and they went on a treasure hunt together. They found a chest full of gold coins and Timmy felt like a real pirate. He thanked the pirate for the adventure and went home with a big smile on his face. From that day on, Timmy knew that pirates were real and he couldn't wait for his next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a silly little pigeon. He flew around the park, looking for something to do. Then he spotted a bright red ball. The pigeon flew softly towards the ball and tapped it with his beak. The ball rolled away and he flew after it. The pigeon was so excited!

Suddenly, a voice said, "Stop!" The pigeon stopped and looked around. It was a little boy who was three years old. He said to the pigeon, "Can I play with you?" The pigeon was surprised, but agreed.

The boy and the pigeon spent hours playing together. They rolled the ball, chased each other around the park, and even sang silly songs. Then it was time for the boy to go home. He said goodbye to the pigeon and left.

The pigeon watched as the little boy walked away. He waved his wings and said, "Bye bye, silly pigeon!"

Once upon a time there was a doggy. He was small, brown and very happy. One day he wanted to go for a walk. 

He was walking by a stand when he saw something unusual. It was a kitty! The kitty had a big smile and the doggy was so excited. He wanted to go and say hello. 

But the kitty was scared. She wanted to hide. So the doggy sighed and stayed still. He wanted the kitty to come closer and be his friend. 

Suddenly, the kitty took a step forward. She meowed and the doggy wagged his tail. He was so happy. Now they were friends and could go for walks together. That was the most unusual, but best thing that ever happened.

Sara and Ben like to play with their toys. They have many toys: cars, dolls, blocks, animals, and more. Sometimes they share their toys, and sometimes they say "mine!" and do not want to share.

One day, they decide to sort their toys by color. Sara puts all the red toys in one pile, and Ben puts all the blue toys in another pile. They are happy with their sorting.

But then they see a weird toy. It is a green car with pink wheels and yellow spots. They do not know whose toy it is. They both want it, because it is weird and different.

"Mine!" Sara says, and grabs the toy.

"No, mine!" Ben says, and pulls the toy.

They start to fight over the weird toy. They tug and shout and cry.

Mom hears the noise and comes to see what is wrong. She sees Sara and Ben fighting over the weird toy.

"Stop, stop!" Mom says. "Why are you fighting over this toy?"

"Mine!" Sara and Ben say at the same time.

Mom shakes her head. She picks up the weird toy and looks at it.

"This is not your toy," Mom says. "This is a toy I bought for your cousin Lily. She is coming to visit tomorrow, and I wanted to give her a special gift. This toy is not yours, it is hers."

Sara and Ben feel ashamed. They did not know the toy was for Lily. They say sorry to Mom and to each other.

Mom smiles and hugs them. She says, "It is okay to like weird toys, but it is not okay to fight over them. You have many toys of your own, and you can share them with Lily when she comes. Maybe she will share her weird toy with you, too. But you have to ask nicely, and say please and thank you."

Sara and Ben nod and agree. They say they will be nice to Lily and share their toys. They put the weird toy back in the box and finish sorting their toys by color. They are happy with their sorting, and with each other.

Once there was a friendly sun. Every day he would shine and give off light. He was happy to do this and it made people smile.

One day, a big cloud was in the sky. He didn't like it, so he asked the cloud to move away. But the cloud said no.

Then Sun had an idea. He asked the cloud to fold up and join him in the sky. The cloud was happy and agreed to do this.

Now when sun and cloud are in the sky together they give off a friendly shade. Everyone is happy and they can play in the shade from the sun and the cloud. 

Sun and Cloud are the best of friends now. They love to fold up together in the sky, giving off a friendly shade for everyone to enjoy.

Once there was a cute little puppy. His name was Jeff. He loved to play, and every day he would throw his toy in the air. One day he decided he wanted to throw it higher. He threw it up as high as he could, and it started to fall. Jeff was worried, but then the toy bounced off a tree and slowly fell down right into Jeff's little paws. He was so happy! Jeff kept playing, and playing, and playing, and eventually it was time to go to bed. He was so tired his body felt like it wanted to fall into bed. Jeff was so happy and so tired that he forgot about his toy. He had thrown it so high, but he knew it would still be there waiting for him the next day. With a satisfied yawn, Jeff drifted off to sleep.

Once there was a little boy who wanted to grow. He was only three years old, but he dreamed of being big. One day he got an idea and decided to plant a note in his garden. He worked hard and watered it everyday.

Soon, a cute little flower grew from the note. He was so happy to see it. He smiled and hugged it. He looked after it very carefully every day.

The flower grew and grew, until finally it was as big as the little boy. He was so excited to see it grow so much and he hugged it tightly. He was very proud of his flower.

He gathered all his friends and family to come see his special flower. They all thought it was so cute and beautiful. The little boy felt so happy and proud of his flower, knowing that he made it grow.

Once upon a time, there was an ordinary turkey who lived in the forest. One day, she was walking around searching for food when she spotted a nice, juicy apple tree. She quickly gobbled up the apples and soon was full. 

A moment later, a little rabbit hopped in front of her. Small and curious, the rabbit asked, "Why are you here, turkey?"

The turkey replied, "I'm here to find food because I'm very hungry!" 

The rabbit said, "Oh wow! That's wonderful. I'm so happy you are full now."

The turkey nodded her head and said, "Yup. Eating the apples was delicious!"

The rabbit hopped off, and the turkey continued on her way. She was no longer hungry, and felt satisfied. She was happy with her ordinary day in the forest.

Once there was a huge bird. It lived high up in the sky and loved the wind. Every day, it would soar among the clouds and look down on the people in the world below. One day, the bird noticed a taxi below. It was a big yellow taxi with park lights on top. The bird was curious and wanted to know what it was. So, it decided to soar down closer to get a better look. As the bird flew close to the taxi, the driver saw it and was amazed by its huge wings. They waved to each other and both smiled. Later, the bird was happy that he had such an interesting experience and soared back up into the sky.

Once, there was a little girl who loved to splash in the river. She just had so much fun playing around with the water. One day, she saw a wealthy man. He had a big pot in his hands that was full of rich sauce. The little girl asked the man if she could have some of the sauce, but he just shook his head and walked away.

The little girl was sad, but she didn't give up. She made up her mind that she would get a taste of the rich sauce, so she went to the river and started to splash around. She splashed and splashed, until she managed to make a wave big enough to knock the pot out of the man's hands. The pot fell and broke, and the rich sauce spilled all over the river.

The little girl was overjoyed! She could finally get a taste of the rich sauce. She put her hands in the river and scooped up as much of the sauce as she could. She ate it up and it tasted delicious. From that day on, the little girl would always go to the river and splash around, hoping that she would be lucky enough to find some more rich sauce.

Once upon a time, there was a thick gate blocking the path of a little dog. Everywhere the dog looked, there was the gate. He was very sad as he couldn't get to the other side.

Just then, he saw a kind lady who smiled at him. She said that the only way to get past the gate was to rise up. The little dog didn't understand what the kind lady meant, but he trusted her.

The little dog took a big breath, pushed himself off the ground, and jumped over the gate. He had made it!

The little dog learned a very important lesson - when faced with challenges, don't give up! Believe in yourself and you can rise to the challenge.

Once there was a beautiful room, full of laughter and love. One day a little girl entered and began to weep. She was so sad and could not stop. Her tears filled the room and everyone in it felt the sadness.

The little girlâ€™s parents tried to comfort her, but nothing seemed to work. Finally, they decided to take her to a doctor. The doctor told them there was no cure for the girlâ€™s tears. She would never stop weeping.

The girl's parents were lonely without her happy laughter. So they decided to move away, to a place where they could start to heal. The little girl never smiled again. Every night, in the beautiful room with no laughter, she would always weep.

Once upon a time, two friendly birds were looking for a place to build their nest. They noticed a tall tree with lots of branches, so they flew over and asked the tree if they could make their home there.

The tree said, "I permit you to stay, but you must not make too much noise or hurt anyone." The birds happily agreed and settled into their new home.

Pretty soon, other birds found out about the new nest and wanted to join the friendly birds. The birds decided to invite the newcomers and start a network of friends. 

As more and more birds joined, their new network soon became too noisy and upset some of the trees nearby. The trees were so upset, they decided to forbid the birds from staying any longer.

The birds had no choice but to find a new home. They had forgotten the importance of following the rules to ensure peace and harmony.

Moral: It is important to follow the rules in order to live peacefully.

Once there was a graceful bird called Billy. He was always looking for something to do. One day he decided to try something new. He wanted to weigh himself with a spoon. 

Billy gathered his spoon and measured himself. He found that he was very light! He was happy with his weight and wanted to celebrate. 

So he started to dance in the sky. His graceful moves caused even the clouds to watch. He spread his wings and flew higher, higher and higher until he was just a dot in the sky. 

Billy went flying around the world. Then, one by one he started to pick up all the things he had weighed with the spoon. In the end, Billy was still the lightest and most graceful of them all!

Once upon a time there were two silly little birds. They were always quarrelling. One day, they decided to play with a net. They each held onto a corner and ran around in circles with it. It was so much fun!

But then they started quarrelling again. They fought so hard that the net got tangled. They couldn't undo it, no matter how hard they tried.

They decided to go find help. They flew around the garden looking for someone who could help them. Finally, they found a little girl and asked her for help.

The little girl was happy to help the silly little birds. She untangled the net in no time. The birds thanked her and flew away, never to quarrel again.

Once there was a stubborn girl. She was determined to do things by herself. One day, she was walking outside and she saw a little slope. She wanted to try and go down it. 

So, she started walking down the slope, but she started to slip. She couldn't keep her balance and fell over. She started to cry because she was in trouble. 

Her mum came out to find out what happened. She saw that her girl was crying and was very worried. She quickly helped her up and cuddled her close to her. 

The little girl tried not to be stubborn anymore. She held onto her mum's hand tightly and they both went back home together.

Edward and his mum were out for a walk. Edward wanted to explore, and his mum said it was ok, so she permitted him to wander around.

Edward found some jam on the ground! He wasn't sure where it had come from, but he was excited to pick it up. His mum said it wasn't safe to eat, so she asked him to put it back. Edward didn't want to, but his mum let him keep the jam if he promised to sit in the grass and enjoy the peaceful afternoon.

Edward smiled and sat in the grass. He examined the jam in his hand and stroked it softly. Then, he held it up and said 'Mum, can I make a wish on it?'.

His mum smiled and nodded. 'Yes,' she said, 'you can make a wish if you'd like. I'm sure it will come true!'

Edward nodded and closed his eyes. He wished for something wonderful and held the jam up in front of him. Then, he put it back where he found it and continued his peaceful walk.

Maddie wanted to bake a cake, so she went to the kitchen. She saw flour, sugar, eggs and all the other ingredients she would need. She started to mix the ingredients together but then the wind outside became wild. She thought it was strange so she went to the window and saw a huge hurricane in the distance.

She ran back to the kitchen and started to mix the ingredients even faster. But the wind outside kept getting wilder and wilder. The hurricane was coming closer and she knew she had to hurry if she wanted to bake the cake before it arrived. 

Maddie finished the cake but then the hurricane was already outside. The wind blew the kitchen door open and the hurricane's wind blew all the ingredients away. Maddie started to cry and said, "I wanted to bake a cake!"

But it was too late - the cake was gone and the hurricane was still raging outside. Maddie's cake was no more.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play outside. They have bikes. They ride their bikes on the path. They see a big bush. The bush is red. It has many flowers.

"Wow, look at the bush!" Lily says. "It is so pretty!"

"Yes, it is!" Ben says. "Do you want to smell the flowers?"

Lily nods. She stops her bike. She gets off. She walks to the bush. She smells a flower. It smells sweet.

Ben stops his bike too. He gets off. He walks to the bush. He smells a flower. It smells sweet too.

They smile at each other. They hear a buzz. They see a bee. The bee is yellow and black. It flies out of the bush. It comes near them.

They ride to the park. They are happy. They forget about the bee. They play on the swings and the slide. They have a good time. They are friends.

Jimmy was an energetic three-year-old. He loved to talk to everyone he met. One day, Jimmy's mommy took him to a tutor. He was embarrassed because he thought he was too young to go to tutoring.

The tutor smiled at Jimmy and said, "Hello, Jimmy! Do you want to talk about today's lesson?" Jimmy nodded his head and the tutor began to teach him.

At the end of the lesson, Jimmy said goodbye to his tutor and thanked him for spending time with him. His mommy was so proud!

Jimmy was no longer embarrassed. He was happy to have a tutor to talk to and learn from. He even told all his friends about his tutor!

Once upon a time, a young blueberry was growing in a forest. The blueberry was very happy, so it began to glow! All of the other blueberries in the forest wanted to be friends with the glowing blueberry.

So, the other blueberries asked the glowing blueberry to join them for a playdate! The blueberry was very excited and prepared for its playdate with the young blueberries. It shined its brightest and made the forest sparkle with its light.

They all had a very fun time together and enjoyed running around, picking wildflowers, and playing hide and seek. When it was time to say goodbye, the glowing blueberry thanked the other blueberries for such a lovely playdate.

One day, Jenny was feeling very happy and she couldn't help but smile. She had a new mask that she was so excited to wear. It was pretty and had a smiley face on it.

Jenny, Ellen, and Jenny's mom and dad all laughed and smiled. Jenny put on her mask and they all went outside to play. Jenny felt so proud and happy to be wearing her mask. It was a good day!

Once upon a time there was a little adorable girl. She loved exploring the world around her. One summer day, she went on a special trip. She arrived in a magical land. She could feel the happiness in the air.

As she walked around, she saw a big drum. She ran towards it and examined it with excitement. The drum looked like it was made with love. She placed her tiny hands on it and started to play. A beautiful, soft sound came out of it.

The moral of the story is that we should always be respectful of other peoples' property.

One day, Jack wanted to go to the cinema and watch a film. He was so excited! So he went to the cinema with his parents. But when they arrived, they saw something upsetting. The cinema had closed down! Jack was very upset. He wanted to see the film so much.

So Jack and his family went to the shops to buy the DVD. Jack was still feeling a bit upset, but he was also excited to watch the film at home. 

They got home, put the DVD in and watched the film. Jack smiled the whole time and was so happy!

Diana was bouncing on her trampoline. She was so happy to be outside playing. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise from the sky. She looked up and she saw something that confused her. It was a bird, tightly squeezing something in its beak. Diana was curious but she was also scared.

The bird flew right over her and gently dropped the item it was holding onto the trampoline. Diana was a bit scared but she was also adventurous. She slowly approached the item to see what it was. To her surprise, it was a bottle with a tightly sealed lid.

Diana happily yielded to the joy of playing with her trampoline. She smiled and enjoyed every moment of it.

One day, a boy named Tom wanted to play with his friend Ben. But his mom said, "No, Tom. You have to do your homework first. That is the law in our house."

Tom did not like the law. He thought it was boring and unfair. He wanted to have fun with Ben. So he decided to be naughty. He sneaked out of his room and ran to Ben's house.

"Hi, Tom!" Ben said. "Do you want to play with my new car?"

"Yes, please!" Tom said. He forgot about his homework and his mom.

They played with the car for a long time. They made loud noises and crashed the car into things. They did not care about anything else.

But then, Tom's mom came to Ben's house. She was very angry. She saw Tom and Ben playing with the car. She saw the mess they made. She saw Tom's homework on the table.

"Tom, what are you doing here?" she asked. "You broke the law! You were naughty!"

Tom felt scared. He knew he did something wrong. He wished he had listened to his mom.

"I'm sorry, mom," he said. "I won't do it again."

Tom's mom took him home. She made him do his homework. She also made him say sorry to Ben and his mom. She also took away his toys for a week.

Tom learned his lesson. He learned that the law is important. He learned that being naughty has consequences. He learned that he should obey his mom. He learned that he should become a good boy.

One day, a huge neighbor came to visit. He was a really nice guy, who brought lots of presents with him. Everyone was so happy to see him. 
When the neighbor arrived, he opened his bag and pulled out something magical. He said that it would change everything. Everyone was so excited, but no one knew what was going to happen. 
Suddenly, the neighbor waved his wand and poof! Everything around them changed. The trees were bigger, the sky was bluer, the house was sparkly and everyone was happier than ever before. 
It was a magical moment, and everyone was thankful for the huge neighbor and his ability to change the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to eat celery. He would munch on it all day long. One day, Benny's friends asked him to perform a magic trick. Benny was frightened because he had never performed before. But, he wanted to make his friends happy, so he agreed to try. 

Benny practiced his magic trick with the celery. He would make it disappear and then reappear. When it was time to perform, Benny was still a little scared, but he took a deep breath and started his trick. To his surprise, it worked perfectly! His friends were amazed and cheered for him. 

From that day on, Benny wasn't so frightened about performing. He even started to perform more magic tricks with his favorite food, celery. And his friends loved every one of them.

The two friends, Lucy and Max, were very curious. They wanted to find out what was in the big jar. 

Lucy peeked in and said, "It looks like sauce!" Max was excited and he wanted to try it. He rushed over to the jar, but Lucy stopped him and explained that it was Mom's special sauce.

They decided to do the next best thing. They went to the kitchen, got out some spoons and plates. They opened the jar and each got a spoonful of sauce.

They rushed to the table and tasted the sauce. It was delicious! Max and Lucy smiled and laughed. They had had a fun curiosity adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a plane. It was very big, and had many colourful windows.

One day, the pilot said, "Let's fly to the icy mountain and share some chocolate cake!".

So, the plane flew high into the sky. As it flew closer to the icy mountain, the pilot saw a little white rabbit eating a piece of cake.

The pilot said, "Hello! Would you like to share some cake with us?".

The rabbit looked up and said, "Sure! I love cakes!".

So, the pilot gave the rabbit a piece of the cake. The rabbit smiled and the pilot smiled back.

Then the plane flew over the icy mountain and the sun started to shine.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a pigeon. She was helpless and alone. She was not sure what to do until she saw a small lily in the garden. She decided to try to rise up and grab it. She worked hard and stretched her wings as far as they would go. Eventually, she was able to grab the flower and rise higher and higher into the sky. She was so happy! She flew around the sky, flapping her wings and letting the wind take her higher and higher until she was free. The little pigeon felt so strong and happy with her new freedom. She rose higher and higher, thankful for her strength and courage. And she lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big ranch. A family lived on the ranch and spent their days playing and taking care of the animals. 

One day, the family wanted to go for a ride. They got in their big pickup truck and drove around the ranch.

â€œWhat do you think of this ranch?â€ the mom asked.
