So the family drove around and stopped to visit the animals. They had a wonderful day, spending time together on the big ranch.

One day, little Joe was playing outside with his toy truck in the warm sunshine. His friend, Susie, came to join him and they had so much fun together, being friendly and laughing. 

Just then, Joe stepped on a rock and split his toe! He began to cry and all of his fun was gone. 

"Oh Joe, we need to get you a bandaid," said Susie. 

But Joe did not want to leave the sunshine. He shook his head, wiping his tears. 

"Don't worry," said Susie. "I know how to fix it. I'll sing a special song and it will make it feel better!"

Susie began to sing her special song and, sure enough, Joe's foot began to feel better. He smiled at Susie and thanked her for being so friendly. 

Together, they went inside to find a band-aid so Joe's toe would soon be all better.

Once upon a time there was a sunflower. She was very independent and did not need help from anyone. One day as she was playing, she heard a noise. It scared her so much she ran away. 

The sunflower ran and ran until she came to a big tree. She stopped, panting. She looked and saw a bird. The bird was looking at her with big eyes.

"Why are you scared?" asked the bird.

The sunflower trembled and said, "I heard a noise and it scared me."

The bird nodded and said, "It's alright. Don't worry, I am here to help you."

The sunflower smiled and together they went to explore the big tree. From then on, she was not scared anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys. She had a teddy bear that she owned and loved very much. One day, Lily and her family went to the harbor. She saw lots of boats and colorful fish in the water. She felt very happy and excited. She wished she could own a boat too. But for now, she was happy playing with her teddy bear at the harbor.

Once upon a time, there were two silly twins named Jack and Jill. All day long, Jack and Jill would do naughty things. One day, their mum got very mad. "No more naughtiness!" she cried.

So Jack and Jill promised to be good. However, they were very hungry. So their mum decided to feed them. She made them a yummy sandwich and some hot chocolate. Jack and Jill were so happy!

They ate the sandwich and drank the hot chocolate very quickly. Then they asked Mummy if they could eat more. But Mummy said no. She said they were being naughty if they wanted to eat too much. 

So Jack and Jill tried to be good. From then on, they only ate the food that Mummy gave them - and they stopped being naughty. That made Mummy very happy. 

And they all lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time there was a wild black cat. She lived under a tree in the meadow. One day, she saw a puppy running after a butterfly. The puppy was so strange and the butterfly was so fast! The wild black cat wanted to join the fun, so she chased after the puppy.

The puppy was so surprised when she saw the wild black cat running along. He barked and ran away. The wild black cat was very fast and she was determined to catch the puppy. Suddenly, she leapt towards him and kicked him with her claws. The puppy yelped in surprise and ran even faster! 

The wild black cat was determined to catch the puppy and continue the chase. She kept on going, kicking, and chasing the puppy. The chase went all the way to the river. In the end, the wild black cat couldn't catch him and the puppy ran away to safety. But the wild black cat still had a lot of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy seal named Sam. Sam loved to nap on the warm sand by the sea. One day, as Sam was napping, a little bird named Betty came by.

"Hi, Sam!" said Betty. "Why are you so sleepy?"

"I was up all night playing with my friends," Sam yawned. "Now, I'm very tired."

Betty nodded and smiled. "Well, I have an idea. Let's find a cozy spot for you to settle and rest."

Sam and Betty looked around the beach. They found a soft, shady spot under a big tree. Sam settled down, and Betty snuggled next to him. They both closed their eyes and took a long, peaceful nap. And when they woke up, they felt happy and ready to play together again.

Anna likes to ride her bike. She rides fast and slow, up and down, around and around. She has a bell on her bike that goes ding-ding. She likes to ring it when she sees her friends.

One day, she rides to the park with her mom. She sees a tall man with a big basket. He has many red things in his basket. Anna is curious. She stops her bike and asks, "What are those?"

The tall man smiles and says, "These are tomatoes. They are fruits that you can eat. They are juicy and sweet. Do you want to try one?"

Anna nods. She likes to try new things. The tall man gives her a tomato. Anna bites it. It is soft and wet. She likes it. She says, "Thank you. It is yummy."

The tall man says, "You're welcome. I'm glad you like it. I grow tomatoes in my garden. I sell them at the market. Do you like to grow things?"

Anna says, "Yes, I do. I have a flower pot at home. I grow sunflowers. They are yellow and bright. They make me happy."

The tall man says, "That's wonderful. Sunflowers are beautiful. They need sun and water to grow. Just like tomatoes. Maybe you can grow tomatoes too someday."

Anna says, "Maybe. That would be fun. Thank you for the tomato. I have to go now. Bye-bye."

The tall man says, "Bye-bye. Have a nice ride."

Anna waves and rides away. She rings her bell and smiles. She likes tomatoes. She likes the tall man. She likes to ride her bike.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to play and have fun. One day, Sarah went to the park with her friends. They played tag and bounced on the trampoline for hours. Sarah laughed and had a great time!

After the playtime, Sarah and her friends went for a snack. Sarah felt so happy, she knew she had been a success. She was so proud of herself!

When afternoon came, Sarah was very tired. She had bounced, ran and laughed all day. Her mom came to pick her up and gave Sarah a big hug. She said that Sarah had worked very hard, and it was time to go home and rest. 

As they drove away, Sarah smiled - she had had a wonderful day. And she knew she would have the energy to bounce again tomorrow!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was always very tidy. She liked to make sure her toys were in their proper places and everything was neat.

One day, Sally was playing with her toys when her cousin came over. Sally was excited to see her. The cousin had a big question. She wanted to know why Sally kept her room so tidy.

Sally just smiled and said, "Well, when I make sure my toys are neat and in the right spot, I'm always happy!"

The cousin and Sally started to play together. Everything was fun with the cousin there. Soon, Sally noticed something strange. Every time they went to play, there seemed to be one toy missing.

Sally began to tear apart her room, looking for the missing toy. After a few minutes of searching, Sally finally found it. It was hidden in the corner of her room, beneath a pile of books. 

Sally was happy to find her toy again. She smiled at her cousin and put the toy back where it belonged. The little girl said, "You see, keeping a tidy room can help you find things!"

Mia was a thin girl who liked to go to the gym. One day, at the gym, she saw someone teasing her. The teasing made her very sad. She didn't know what to do.

Thanks to one of her friends, Mia found the courage to stand up and speak to the person who had teased her. She looked them in the eyes and said firmly, "Teasing is not nice".

Her words made the teasier feel ashamed. From that day on, the person stopped teasing Mia and instead hugged her and said sorry. Mia was glad that she now felt safe at the gym.

Mia's experience taught her that it's important to stand up for yourself when someone teases you.

Once upon a time, there was a bear who was very ashamed. It was because he was very small, and he wasnâ€™t as big as the other bears. He was very sad, but he had an idea. His finger was very tiny, but he wanted to weigh himself.

The bear went to a pond and picked up a stone with his finger. He weighed himself with the stone, and he was surprised. He weighed the same as the other bears! He was so happy and he celebrated.

Suddenly, another bear appeared. He looked amazed and asked, â€œHow did you do that?â€ The bear smiled and said, â€œI used my finger and a stone to weigh myself.â€ The other bear was so impressed that he taught him new ways to weigh himself, using different things like leaves and twigs.

The bear was no longer ashamed â€“ he was so proud of himself! From then on, he weighed himself every day, and he was always the same size as the other bears.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily was playing in her room when she noticed a shiny knob on her dresser. She thought it looked lovely and decided to turn it.

When she turned the knob, a secret compartment opened up! Inside, she found a magical wand. She waved it around and suddenly, all of her toys came to life! Her teddy bear started dancing and her dolls started singing.

Lily was so happy and grateful for her lovely surprise. She knew that she would always remember the special knob on her dresser that brought her so much joy. From that day on, she made sure to always notice the little things that could bring her happiness. The end.

Once there was a little girl. She got a new book for her birthday. She was so excited that she wanted to read it right away. She opened the book and began to read.

She read about bubbles. Big bubbles and small bubbles. She liked bubbles.

The little girl decided to go out and play with her bubbles. She blew lots of bubbles and they filled the sky. Some were big and others were small. The sun was up and it was very hot. The little girl liked popping the bubbles with her hands.

The little girl had fun playing with her bubbles until it was time to go home. She had a great time outside in the hot sunshine reading and playing with her bubbles.

Once upon a time there was a furry little dog called Richard. He loved to explore the world around him and go on long hikes with his owner.

One day, Richard went for a walk and found an exciting trail to explore. He was so excited and set off following the trail with his owner.

As Richard walked, his owner saw a furry spider ahead. "Look, Richard! It's a hairy spider!" she said. Richard was scared and started to bark, his little tail wagging quickly.

Richard's owner smiled at him and said, "It's okay, Richard. I'm here to support you." She held his paw and said, "Let's keep going, the trail is full of surprises!"

So Richard and his owner carried on, exploring the trail and having adventures. Whenever Richard got scared, his owner was there to support him and help him see that his fears did not need to be so scary.

And they lived happily ever after.

One day two little boys were playing in the park. One was called Jack and the other was called Jake. Jack had a ball and he was trying to throw it. But, it kept rolling away from him. 

So, Jake shouted and said: "Let me help you!" He ran and picked up the ball. Jack was very happy and thanked him.

But, then something bad happened. It started to rain, and the rain was cold! Jack started to shiver and he was very scared. Then he shouted: "We must find shelter!"

They soon found a big tree. But, the rain was coming down harder and they were getting wet. Then they noticed there was a lake close by. So they shouted again: â€œWe can jump into the water!â€ 

The water was useful because it kept them nice and warm. They stayed in the lake until the rain stopped. Then they jumped out and laughed with joy! They had a great time playing together and had learnt that water can be very useful.

Once upon a time, there was a little pig. He lived on a farm with his family. The pig had a hidden spot he liked to play in. It was behind the big red barn. He loved to hide there and play with his toys.

One day, the little pig found a small seed in his hidden spot. He thought it would be fun to grow something. So, he dug a hole with his little pig feet and put the seed in the ground. He covered it up and gave it some water.

Every day, the pig went to his hidden spot to check on the seed. He gave it water and talked to it. Soon, a tiny green plant began to grow. The pig was so happy! He watched as the plant grew bigger and bigger. The little pig had grown a beautiful flower in his hidden spot. He was so proud of his flower and loved to sit by it every day.

Lily liked to write with her crayons. She wrote her name, her mom's name, and her dog's name on many papers. She also liked to draw flowers and stars and hearts. She was very proud of her writing and drawing.

One day, she saw a big white wall in the living room. She thought it was a good place to write and draw. She took her crayons and started to write and draw on the wall. She wrote "Lily loves Mom" and drew a big heart. She smiled and felt happy.

But then, her mom came into the living room and saw the wall. She was very angry. She shouted at Lily and said, "Lily, what did you do? You made a big mess on the wall! You are a bad girl! You have to clean it up right now!"

Lily felt scared and sad. She did not mean to make her mom angry. She wanted to make her mom happy. She said, "Mom, I'm sorry. I wanted to write and draw for you. I love you, Mom."

Her mom did not listen. She took Lily's crayons and threw them in the trash. She gave Lily a sponge and a bucket of water and said, "You have to scrub the wall until it is clean. And no more writing and drawing on the wall, ever!"

Lily started to cry. She did not want to scrub the wall. She wanted her crayons back. She wanted her mom to hug her and say, "It's okay, Lily. I love you, too." She wanted her mom to give her a gentle massage on her back and make her feel better. But her mom did not do that. She just walked away and left Lily alone with the wall. Lily felt very unhappy. She wished she never wrote and drew on the wall. She wished she had a different mom.

Once there was an old man. He was very kind. He wanted to show kindness to everyone. So he knelt down one evening and made a pretty wish. He wished that everyone in the world will always be happy.

He stayed there for a long time, with his eyes closed and his hands together. Then he stood up and went on his way.

Everyone around him could tell he was a kind old man. They could see the kindness in his eyes and the way he smiled at them.

The next day, when the sun was setting, he knelt down again and made another wish. This time he wished for all the children in the world to be happy and safe.

He stayed there for a few moments before standing up again. He was sure his wishes were coming true. He knew that the power of kindness was strong enough to make his wishes come true.

Jim was an eager boy. He had always wanted to explore the jungle.

One day, he finally got his chance and he was so excited. He peeked around the big green trees in the jungle and looked for animals. He saw some monkeys and birds, but he was a bit scared of them. He began to run away and hide behind a bush.

Then he spotted a little brown rabbit. It was so cute! He slowly approached it and the rabbit peeped at him. Jim was so happy to see the animal that he couldn't help but smile.

He stayed in the jungle until it was dark. He had seen so many animals and been so brave. He was happy that he had finally gone on his adventure. Jim could not wait to tell his mom what he had seen. He was eager to come back and explore again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved chocolate. Every day, she would find a big, chunky bar and eat it with glee.

One day, however, the little girl stumbled across something strange. It was a box, and inside was a mound of chocolate.

The little girl was curious, so she started to dig. Eventually, she found something even stranger - it was a box full of coins!

The little girl was surprised, but she had a plan. She took the box of coins, and buried them in her garden. She made sure that the coins were safe and secure, so no one would ever find them.

Unfortunately, the harsh sun melted the chocolate and made it uneatable. The little girl was sad, but she had plenty of other chocolate to eat. She kept the box of coins in her garden, and they stayed there forever.

Lily was a little girl who liked to go to school. She had many friends in her classroom. They liked to play, sing, and learn new things. Lily also liked her teacher, Miss Rose, who was very kind and funny.

One day, Lily and her friends had a special guest in their classroom. It was a puppy! The puppy was black and white, with a fluffy tail and big ears. He was very adorable. Miss Rose said his name was Spot, and he was her friend's dog. She asked the children to be gentle and quiet with Spot, and let him get to know them.

Lily wanted to pet Spot, but he was shy. He hid under Miss Rose's desk, and only peeked out with his nose. Lily waited patiently, and did not make any loud noises. She sat on the floor, near the desk, and smiled at Spot. She said, "Hello, Spot. I am Lily. You are very cute. Do you want to be my friend?"

Spot looked at Lily with his brown eyes. He saw that she was nice and friendly. He wagged his tail, and slowly came out of his hiding place. He sniffed Lily's hand, and licked it. Lily giggled, and stroked his fur. Spot liked that, and cuddled up to her. He gave her a soft bark, and licked her face.

Lily was very happy. She hugged Spot, and said, "I love you, Spot. You are my new friend." Spot barked again, and wagged his tail. He loved Lily, too. They played together, and shared a toy. Lily and Spot were adorable. Miss Rose and the other children smiled, and watched them. They were glad that Spot had found a friend in Lily.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bill and Joe. They were out in the park playing together when the sun began to set. Joe wanted to keep playing, but Bill was tired. He had been yawning and rubbing his eyes.

"Let's go home, Joe," Bill said, frowning.

"But I don't want to," Joe said sadly.

"We can play more tomorrow," Bill said.

Joe still didn't want to, so Bill picked up his phone and showed him something. It was a video of two kids having fun at the park.

"See? That could be us having fun tomorrow," Bill said with a smile.

Joe nodded and smiled too. Suddenly he wasn't so tired anymore. They said goodbye and walked home with happy hearts.

The moral of this story is that it's okay to be tired and take a break, but also important to try and find ways to have fun within your limits.

John was playing hockey in the park. He was whacking the puck around and having a lot of fun. But then he noticed it was getting gloomy outside, and he got a bit sad. He sighed and put away his hockey stick and skates, and went home.

On the way home John saw some kids playing a game of tag. He wanted to play too, but he didn't feel like it. He continued home, sighing.

When he got home, his mom asked him why he was so sad. John didn't know how to explain, so he said he was just tired. His mom hugged him and said that would be alright. He smiled and kept on walking.

John eventually forgot his sadness and he remembered the fun he had playing hockey. He smiled as he remembered what happened in the park and he was glad he was home.

Sara and Ben like to play with loops. Loops are round things that you can put on your fingers or make shapes with. Sara has a big box of loops in many colors. Ben has a small bag of loops that are all blue.

One day, Sara and Ben are playing with loops on the floor. Sara makes a flower with red and yellow loops. Ben makes a snake with blue loops. They are having fun.

But then, Ben sees a loop that he likes. It is green and shiny. He wants to have it. He thinks Sara will not notice. He takes the loop from Sara's box and puts it in his bag.

"Hey, that's my loop!" Sara says. She sees Ben take the loop. She is angry. "Give it back to me!"

"No, it's mine now!" Ben says. He holds the loop tight. He does not want to give it back.

Sara tries to get the loop from Ben. She pulls and pulls. But Ben is stronger. He pulls harder. The loop is weak. It breaks in two.

"Oh no!" Sara and Ben say. They look at the broken loop. They are sad. They liked the loop. Now it is gone.

"I'm sorry, Sara," Ben says. He feels bad. He should not have taken the loop. "I was wrong. Can you forgive me?"

"I'm sorry, too, Ben," Sara says. She feels bad. She should not have pulled the loop. "I forgive you. Can we still be friends?"

"Yes, we can," Ben says. He smiles. He gives Sara a hug. "And we can share the loops. There are enough for both of us."

Sara smiles, too. She hugs Ben back. "Yes, we can. And we can make new things with the loops. Maybe we can fix the broken one."

They pick up the loops and start to play again. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was three years old and his name was Sam. One day Sam went out for a walk with his mom. 

As they walked, they came across a field with lots of pumpkins. Sam said, "Mom, can I find a pumpkin?".

His mom smiled and said "Yes, of course, you can find a pumpkin."

So Sam started searching through the field and soon found the perfect pumpkin that he wanted. It was big and round, and had a funny face on it. 

When Sam picked up the pumpkin to show his mom, he noticed that it was sour! He wrinkled up his nose and asked his mother, "Is this the type of pumpkin I can keep?"

Once upon a time, there was a bear. The bear was walking through the woods when he heard a loud snap. He looked around and saw a curtain hanging down from a branch. There was a fisherman who wanted a boat for fishing. He went to the store and saw the boats. He wanted the most expensive one so he bought it. The boat blinked on the water and it was so cool. Emilda and her mum went to visit the beach. When they arrived, Emilda saw something sparkly in the sand. She ran over to have a closer look. It was a treasure! Emilda was so excited!

The color bin was a magical place. Inside the bin were yummy colors--reds, oranges, yellows, greens and blues. Everyone wanted to taste the colorful treats, but how? Once upon a time, there was a quiet wagon. The wagon was old and grey. One day, a little girl saw the wagon. She wanted to play with it.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to explore. One day, they went to the park with their mom and dad. They saw a big hill with many trees and flowers. They wanted to climb the hill and see what was on the other side.

"Can we go up there, mom?" Tom asked.

She pointed to the other side of the hill, where there was a different landscape. There was a lake with ducks and fish, and a bridge with cars and bikes. There were houses and shops and people. It was very different from the park.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very excited for her trip. She was about to explore the universe! She put on her special shoes and quickly ran outside. But as she was about to start her journey, she slipped on a rock and fell on the ground.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and explore. One day, he saw a garage that he had never seen before. He wanted to go inside and see what was there. His mom said, "Be careful, Timmy. Don't slip on anything."

Once upon a time, there was a pig and a sheep who were good friends. One day they decided to go on an adventure and went to a fountain in the middle of a forest. They go back and find the folder. They see that it is Mom's folder. Mom is a teacher. She has homework for her students.

"Mom, we have something to tell you," Lily says.

They tell Mom what they did. They show her the paper. They say sorry and give a hug.

Mom is not happy. She is sad and angry. She says they should not have opened the folder. They should not have taken the paper. They should have asked first. They should have respected her work.

But Mom is also kind. She sees that they are sorry. She sees that they want to help. She says they can make a new paper. They can draw and write something nice. They can say sorry to the student.

They make a new paper. They put it in the folder. They close the folder and put it back. They promise to never do it again.

Mom smiles. She says she loves them. She says they have learned a lesson. She says they have done a good thing.

Lily and Ben are happy. They have learned to be honest and respectful. They have learned to say sorry and to make things better. They have learned that taking things that are not yours is not a gift. It is a mistake.

"It disappeared. It's gone. Do you understand?" he said.

Lily nodded. She felt sad for his hat. She did not want her hat to disappear. She liked her hat. She hugged it and held it tight.

"Please don't disappear, star hat. I love you," she said.

The bus driver smiled. He felt sorry for his hat, too. But he was glad he made her understand. He drove her back to her home and helped her get off the bus.

"Here we are, little girl. This is your home. Go find your mommy and tell her about your adventure. And remember, be careful with your hat. It might have some magic in it," he said.

"Thank you, bus driver. You are very nice. I'm sorry about your hat. I hope you find another one. Goodbye," she said, and waved her hat.

"Goodbye, little girl. Have fun with your hat. But not too much fun," he said, and waved back.

Lily ran to her door and knocked. Her mother opened it and hugged her.

"Lily, where have you been? I was so worried. What have you been doing?" she asked.

"I went on an adventure, Mommy. I saw birds and buses and new things. I have a star hat. Do you like it?" she said, showing her hat.

Her mother looked at her hat and gasped. She recognized it. It was her hat. The hat she had when she was a little girl. The hat that had some magic in it. The hat that made her disappear.

Mum and Dad had a famous sandwich. It looked delicious and made their mouths water. 
Dad decided to close the sandwich and put it on the table. He wanted to save it for later.

After a while, Mum and Dad got up and went outside. They closed the door behind them, locking the sandwich away.

When they came back, they were surprised to find the sandwich was gone! They looked around and saw their neighbour's little girl, Pat, munching it happily.

Mum asked Pat what she was doing and the little girl said she got hungry. Mum smiled and said she could have the sandwich. Pat thanked her and finished eating the delicious sandwich.

Mum and Dad laughed as they watched Pat enjoy the famous sandwich. They were happy to share!

John was sad. He had lost his friends when he went for a walk. The sky was very gloomy, but he kept on walking. Suddenly, something caught his eye - it was a deer in the woods! The deer seemed to be looking right at him. John was so excited. He slowly moved closer and closer to the deer. The deer revealed its beautiful antlers. John was so amazed at the beautiful sight. He wanted to stay and admire it, but he remembered that he had to find his friends, so he waved goodbye to the deer and it ran away. John continued on his way, happy to have seen such a beautiful creature.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big building with her mommy and daddy. They always took the elevator to go up and down the floors.

One day, Lily and her family went to the mall. They got into the elevator and pressed the button to go to the toy store. But when they got out, they saw a big sign that said "Toy Store Closed". Lily was sad because she really wanted a new toy.

As they walked around, they saw a white puppy in a pet store. Lily loved the puppy and wanted to take it home. But her mommy and daddy said they couldn't because they already had a cat. Lily was sad again.

But then, as they were leaving the mall, they saw a man with a white puppy. The man said he couldn't take care of the puppy anymore and asked if they wanted to adopt it. Lily was so happy and hugged the puppy tight. She knew it was meant to be hers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside and making new friends. One day, she met a boy named Jack. Jack was very helpful and always said nice things to Lily. They became good friends and played together every day.

One day, they saw a big pile of dust in the park. Lily wanted to play in it, but Jack said it was not safe. He said that dust can make us sick and we should stay away from it. Lily was sad, but she knew Jack was right.

Lily learned that it is important to listen to our helpful friends and stay away from things that can harm us. She was grateful to have a friend like Jack who always looked out for her. From that day on, Lily always remembered what Jack had said and made sure to stay safe.

Mommy took Penny to the park. She pushed Penny in the swing and Penny felt like she was flying! As Mommy watched, Penny played on the slide, the seesaw and the monkey bars.

Suddenly, a weird man with a big key came by. He closed the gate and locked it. Penny couldn't get out!

Mommy started to worry. Then, she had an idea. She smiled and took out a penny from her pocket. She put it in the lock and it opened! Penny and Mommy ran home and had ice cream to celebrate. 

The next day, they went to the park and Mommy made sure to keep her pocket full of pennies so they would never get locked in again!

Once upon a time there was a great big whale who lived near a beach, near a group of rocks. One day while he was swimming he noticed something strange in the tide. It was a baby seal!

The whale swam over to the little seal, who looked scared and confused. He asked, "What are you doing here by yourself?"

The little seal told the whale, "I was swimming and the tide was too strong, so I couldn't make it back to shore!"

The whale was kind and said, "Don't worry, I will protect you!"

The whale gently carried the little seal back to the shore and found it a nice spot to rest. The little seal was so thankful to the whale for its great protection. 

From that day onward, the little seal remembered the whale's kind act and would often come back to visit him when the tide was low.

Once upon a time, there were two kids. One was called Harry, and the other was called Jimmy. They were best friends.

One day, Harry said to Jimmy, "Let's go explore the jungle!" Jimmy was so excited.

They went to the jungle, and it was very beautiful. They saw monkeys, parrots and all kinds of animals. They had so much fun! 

But then, they heard a rumour. The rumour was that if someone goes too far into the jungle, they will never come back. Even though the rumour was popular, Harry and Jimmy decided to go anyway. 

They walked through the jungle, looking at all the animals, but they kept on walking. Soon, they realised they had gone too far. 

Jimmy said to Harry, "We need to go back now." But it was too late. 

The bad ending has taught us a lesson. People should always listen to warnings and not take any risks. It is important to always tell an adult what you are planning.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sarah. She always liked to keep her room tidy. One day, Sarah and her mommy decided to go to the shops. 

They got in an elevator and pressed the button to go up. Inside the elevator, it was very small and neat. They spent some time looking around and pointing at things. 

When they got to their floor, the doors opened. Sarah and her mommy stepped out and went to the shops. They spent lots of time there, buying new things for Sarah's room. 

When Sarah and her mommy got back home, Sarah was thrilled to bring her new things into her room and make it even tidier than before.

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad. Dad told Mom he was going to the store. So Dad grabbed his coat and went away.

But when Dad got to the store, he couldn't find the salt. He looked high and he looked low, but it was not there. He was getting upset.

Just then, Mom saw something. It was a little mouse! Mom knew the mouse had taken Dad's salt.

So Mom ran outside and yelled at the mouse. She said, "Give me back my salt!"

The mouse was so scared that he quickly grabbed the salt and ran away. 

Dad was happy, and Mom gave the salt back to Dad. They both smiled and Dad went back to the store. This time, he was able to buy all the salt he needed.

Jack was walking down the street when he saw a naughty cat. The cat was sitting on a stand, making lots of noise. It made Jack giggle. 

"Hello, kitty cat!" Jack shouted.

The cat stared at him and then meowed loudly.

"Will you play with me?" Jack asked.

The cat raised its paws and tried to swat at something. Jack laughed. Then he stood real still like the cat and shouted, "Meeeeow!"

The cat got scared and ran away. But Jack was still smiling. He was glad he had made a new friend, even if it was very naughty.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She always felt a bit lonely. One day, she was walking down the street and saw a pastry shop. It was the most beautiful place she had ever seen. She wanted to go inside, so she slowly leaned forward and opened the door.

Inside, the pastry shop was full of delicious goodies. She could smell the sweet smell of pastry. She smiled, feeling much less lonely.

She decided to get herself a treat. She leaned forward and stared at all the pastries in the display case. She saw a pink macaron and could not resist. She handed her money to the storekeeper and received the delicious macaron.

Sarah sat down outside the store and ate her macaron. She felt so happy and content that she didn't want to leave. But soon enough, the sun began to set. She picked up her bag, leaned forward, and waved goodbye to the storekeeper.

The next day, Sarah returned to the pastry shop. Her macaron had made her feel less lonely, after all. She leaned forward, opened the door, and stepped inside.

Once there was a lady who had a special leg. It was deaf and she never wanted to talk about it.

One day, a little boy asked the lady why her leg was so special. She was surprised he noticed!

The lady smiled and told the boy she was deaf in the leg because she was born that way.

The boy was surprisedâ€” he thought it was unusual but very cool! He asked the lady to teach him sign language and she gladly agreed!

The lady taught the boy many things, including how to communicate with people who canâ€™t hear.

From then on, the little boy and the lady shared a special bondâ€” they both knew that being different could be a wonderful thing.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. One day, they find a big box in the yard. They want to make a boat with the box.

"Let's tie the box to the tree," Tom says. "Then we can pretend we are sailing on the water."

"OK," Sam says. He gets a rope and helps Tom tie the box to the branch. They climb inside the box and sit down.

"Look, there is land over there," Tom says, pointing to the fence. "Maybe there are pirates or animals there."

"Let's go and see," Sam says. He grabs a stick and pretends it is a sword. "But be careful, it might be dangerous."

They jump out of the box and run to the fence. They see a pale girl sitting on the grass. She has a doll and a book. She looks sad and lonely.

"Hi," Tom says. "Who are you?"

"I'm Lily," the girl says. "I just moved here. I don't have any friends."

"Do you want to play with us?" Sam asks. "We have a boat and a sword. We can have fun."

Lily smiles and nods. She puts down her doll and book and follows Tom and Sam. They go back to the box and untie it from the tree. They push it on the ground and pretend it is a boat. They sail to different lands and have adventures. They laugh and talk and become friends.

Once upon a time, a little girl with long brown hair was playing in her backyard. She loved playing outside and discovering new places.

Suddenly, a funny smell filled the air. The girl looked around and noticed a smelly license near the bush. She picked it up and tried to figure out what it was. 

The girl called out, "Who's here? I found a smelly license!"

From the bush, a man yelled out, "That's my license! Please give it back!"

The girl smiled and said, "You must stay hidden or else I won't give it back!"

The man said, "Okay, okay, I'll hide and you can keep my license as long as you promise to give it back!"

The girl nodded in agreement and put the license in her pocket. Then, she kept on playing and exploring her backyard.

Amy was playing in the playground. She loved to be creative and build things. Suddenly, she heard a loud SCREAM!

Amy was scared and ran to her mom. "Mommy, what was that noise?" she asked.

Mommy explained, â€œThat was someoneâ€™s yacht. They must have been shouting with excitement!â€

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle. In the jungle, there lived a large tiger. The tiger was very strong and could run very fast. One day, the tiger saw a ball lying on the ground. He picked it up with his mouth and started to play with it. He threw the ball up in the air and caught it with his paws. 

Then, a group of children came into the jungle. They were playing and laughing. They saw the tiger playing with the ball and they wanted to play too. The tiger was happy to share his ball with the children. They threw the ball back and forth, having lots of fun. 

Suddenly, the ball went too far and landed in a river. The children were sad because they couldn't get the ball back. But the tiger had an idea. He ran very fast and jumped into the river. He swam to the ball and brought it back to the children. They were so grateful and thanked the tiger. From that day on, the tiger and the children played together every day.

Once there was a small girl called Suzie who lived in a house with her mom. One day, Suzie was playing in the living room when she saw something on the floor.

'Mom, what is this?' asked Suzie.

'It's a letter,' replied her mom.

'What does it say?' said Suzie.

Her mom smiled and opened the letter. She read the letter very quietly.

'Mom, can I keep it?' said Suzie.

'Yes my darling, but you must keep it very quiet,' she replied.

So Suzie put the letter in an old box and made sure nobody else saw it. She wanted to keep it safe.

The next day, Suzie wanted to show her mom the letter again. When she opened the box, it was gone.

'Mom, where is the letter?' said Suzie.

'Oh, I had to remove it,' replied her mom.

Suzie was a little sad, but she knew it was the best thing to do. She promised herself that she would always keep her letters safe and quiet.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. Lily wants to go on the slide, but Tom is scared.

"Come on, Tom, it is fun!" Lily says.

"I don't know, Lily, it is high and fast," Tom says.

Lily holds Tom's hand. "We can go together. I will help you. Don't be scared," she says.

Tom thinks for a moment. He wants to be brave, but he is still scared. He looks at Lily. She is his friend. She is honest. She will not hurt him.

"Okay, Lily, I will try," he says.

They climb up the stairs. They sit on the slide. Lily counts to three. They slide down. Tom feels the wind in his hair. He feels the sun on his face. He feels happy.

He realizes he likes the slide. He realizes he is not scared anymore. He realizes he has a new goal. He wants to go on the slide again.

"Wow, that was fun!" he says.

"See, I told you!" Lily says.

They hug each other. They are happy. They are friends. They go on the slide again.

Once upon a time, a little boy and his dad were walking in the park. Dad started talking to the little boy about promises and how important they are to keep. He said, "Son, when you promise something, it's like you are joining a network. People rely on your word and believe in it. And if you don't keep your promise, it's weird." 

The little boy thought about it carefully and said, "I promise I will try my best to always keep my word." His dad hugged him and said, "That's great to hear, son!"

From then on, the little boy tried to always keep his promises even if it was hard for him to do. Whenever he was tempted to break a promise, he would remind himself of what his dad said to him and it would help him stay true to his word.

The moral of this story is that keeping your promises is very important. No matter how hard it might seem, a promise made is a promise kept, so always try to keep your word!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to decorate. She loved to put patterns on things â€“ trees, walls, and even the ground. Today, she had decided to decorate her bedroom.

First, she decided to paint the walls. She chose a cool pattern, which she did all by herself. When she finished, it looked beautiful and she was so proud.

Then, she picked out some cool fabric for her bedspread. The fabric had different coloured and patterned shapes on it. The little girl spread it over her bed and it looked so cool.

Finally, she looked for decorations for her dresser. She found a cool mirror and added some pretty coloured flowers to the top. Now her room was complete, and it looked so nice. The little girl was very happy with how it looked.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play outside with his dog, Max. One day, Timmy and Max were playing in the yard when Timmy's mom called him inside for lunch. 

Timmy rushed inside, excited to eat his favorite sandwich. But when he got inside, he saw that his little sister had made a messy strip of peanut butter and jelly on the counter. 

Timmy's mom was busy on the phone, so Timmy decided to clean up the messy strip himself. He grabbed a towel and wiped up the sticky mess. His mom was so proud of him for being such a helpful little boy.

The red cube sat on the table. The girl saw the cube and said she liked it. But the boy saw it and said he hated it. He didn't like the red color. The girl grabbed the red cube and starting playing with it. She made it bounce and spin. But the boy didn't like it. He started to cry. He said he hated the cube.

The girl felt bad. She tried to make him happy by showing him how to play with it. But the boy didn't join her. He just said he hated it. Finally the girl put the red cube back on the table and said she would get him something else. The boy smiled and hugged her. He was happy she listened to him and stopped playing with the cube.

Once upon a time, there was a cow called Daisy. She was very brave and loved to do things on her own. One day, she decided to stand next to the oven. Daisy was so curious about the oven and wanted to find out what it does. She knew it was hot, but she was brave enough to stand next to it. 

All of a sudden, the oven started making loud noises. Daisy was so scared! She did not know what to do. She wanted to move away, but the oven was so loud and so hot! Daisy stood tall and bravely, while the oven kept making noises and heating up.

After a while, a man came out and switched off the oven. Daisy was so relieved! The man smiled at Daisy and said, "That was a very brave thing you did there. Well done!" Daisy smiled back, feeling proud of herself. 

From that day on, Daisy always remembered how brave she was when standing next to the oven. And she never forgot how wonderful it felt to be brave.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the mud. He would make mud pies and jump in muddy puddles. One day, Timmy found a cool toy car buried in the mud. He was so happy and played with it all day.

But as the sun started to set, Timmy's mom called him in for dinner. Timmy was so excited about his new toy that he forgot to put it away. That night, it rained a lot and the mud swallowed up the toy car. Timmy was so sad when he woke up and saw that his toy was gone forever.

Timmy learned a lesson that day. He realized that he should always take care of his toys and put them away before going inside. From then on, he made sure to keep his toys safe and sound.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to watch videos on his mommy's phone. One day, Timmy saw a gray cat outside his window. The cat started to move around and Timmy got very excited. He wanted to show his mommy the gray cat, so he took a video of it with her phone. When Timmy's mommy came home from work, he showed her the video of the gray cat moving. They both smiled and Timmy felt very happy that he got to share something cool with his mommy.

Once upon a time, there was a rich man. He had a loop, which he had to stir every day. He stirred it every morning in a big pot. Every time he stirred, something special happened. He felt happy and excited all day.

One day, the man stirred the loop and something magical happened. Out of the loop came a little bird. The man was so surprised and he watched the bird fly away.

The man was so happy that he went to all his friends and told them the story of the magical bird. Everyone was so amazed and they all said that they wanted to stir some loops too. So they all gathered around the big pot and stirred their loops.

Just like the rich man, something magical happened! All of their loops made different kinds of birds, animals, and even amazing creatures. Everyone was so happy that they shared their magical loops with each other.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to cook with her mom. One day, Lily and her mom were in the kitchen. They were making a big cake for a party. Lily was excited and happy.

While they were cooking, Lily's mom looked at the clock. She was worried. "Oh no!" she said. "We don't have much time left!" Lily looked at her mom and asked, "What can I do to help, Mom?" Her mom said, "Please mix the cake mix faster, Lily."

Lily mixed the cake mix as fast as she could. She and her mom put the cake in the oven. They waited for the cake to cook. After some time, the cake was done. Lily and her mom were so happy. They took the cake to the party, and everyone loved it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to play outside. He would run and jump and climb trees all day long. But one day, he forgot to put on his bug spray and got lots of itchy bites. 

His mom reminded him to put on bug spray next time, but the little boy didn't listen. He thought he knew better. 

The next day, he went outside again without bug spray. This time, he got even more bites and they were very itchy. The little boy was very naughty and didn't listen to his mom's reminder. 

The bites got worse and worse until the little boy had to go to the hospital. The doctors tried to help him, but it was too late. The little boy had gotten very sick from the bug bites and he passed away. 

Remember, it's important to listen to your parents and take care of your body. Don't be naughty like the little boy in this story.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby cat. He was trying to find somewhere to live. One day he wandered into the garage. There was nothing inside, so he decided to make it his home. He was so happy to have made a home for himself. 

One day, a family moved into the house. They were very nice and let the cat stay in the garage. He was very happy and always greeted them when they arrived home.

Unfortunately for the cat, one day the family had to move away. They asked their neighbour if he could take care of the cat, and the neighbour said yes. The cat was sad about leaving the garage, but soon found his new home to be warm and comfortable.

The cat and the family kept in touch and from time to time, the cat would go back to the garage to visit. It was like his second home. He was always so happy when he visited the garage. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a bright sun in the sky. It shone on a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to read books. One day, she found a book with many pages. She sat under a big tree and started to read.

As she read the pages, she saw a sad bird with a hurt wing. The bird could not fly. Lily wanted to help the bird. She said, "Little bird, I will heal your wing so you can fly again." The bird looked at Lily with hope.

Lily took the bird home and cared for it. She put a soft bandage on the hurt wing. Every day, the sun shone bright and the bird got better. One day, the bird said, "Thank you, Lily, for healing my wing." Lily smiled and watched the bird fly away, happy to have a new friend.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big box in the attic. They were eager to see what was inside. They opened the box and saw many shiny things. They saw buttons, beads, ribbons, and needles.

"Wow, look at all these!" Tom said. "Let's make something with them!"

"Okay!" Lily said. "But we have to hurry. Mom will call us for lunch soon."

They took out some needles and thread and started to sew. They made a necklace, a bracelet, and a hat. They were having fun.

But then, Tom felt a sharp pain in his finger. He had poked himself with a needle. He cried out loud.

"Ow, ow, ow! It hurts! It hurts!"

Lily looked at him and saw blood. She was scared.

"Tom, what happened? Let me see!"

She tried to pull out the needle, but it was stuck. She pulled harder, but it only made Tom cry more.

"Stop, stop, stop! You're hurting me!"

Tom and Lily were both crying and screaming. They did not hear Mom coming up the stairs. She heard them and ran to the attic. She saw the box, the toys, and the blood. She was angry and worried.

"What are you doing here? How did you get this box? And what did you do to your finger?"

She took Tom and Lily to the bathroom. She cleaned Tom's finger and put a bandage on it. She threw away the needles and the thread. She scolded them for playing with dangerous things. She told them they were naughty and careless. She said they could not play with their toys for a week.

Tom and Lily felt sorry and sad. They wished they had not opened the box. They wished they had not played with the needles. They wished they had listened to Mom. They learned a hard lesson.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit called Fuzzy. Fuzzy had a big appetite and loved to eat. One day, Fuzzy went on a great adventure to find food. Fuzzy hopped and hopped around the forest until he came across a dry case. Fuzzy was so excited he forgot to be careful and quickly opened the case. Inside the case he found a big plate of vegetables and some yummy carrots.

Fuzzy hopped around in circles before settling down and starting to eat the delicious food. "Mmmm this is so good!" he said. As he was eating, Fuzzy heard a voice. It was a squirrel.

"Why are you eating the food from in my case?" the squirrel asked.

Fuzzy smiled and said, "I'm very sorry. I was so hungry and I thought the case was empty. May I please keep eating?"

The Squirrel thought for a moment, then said, "Yes, but next time please be more careful!"

So Fuzzy said thank you and continued to eat until he was full. Then he hopped away to find more food on his great adventure!

Once there was a little boy named Ben. Ben liked to go exploring in the forest. One day, he left his house to go explore the forest and he got very lost. He tried to find his way back home, but he couldn't. It was getting dark, and he was scared.

Suddenly, Ben heard a voice. It said, "Don't worry Ben, stay here. I will help you find your way back home." It was a kind deer. The deer said, "Follow me and I will show you the way home."

So, Ben followed the deer through the forest. They walked for a long time until they came to a clearing. There, the deer pointed to a path. Ben knew that path led to his home. He thanked the deer and said, "Thank you for helping me. I'm very sorry for getting lost."

The deer smiled and said, "That's ok. Just stay safe and don't get lost again!"

Ben smiled and nodded. Then, he hurried down the path towards home. He was never lost in the forest again.

Once upon a time, there was a big race. All the animals wanted to win. One little ant was very impatient. He wanted to start the race right away.

"Let's go, let's go!" said the impatient ant. The other animals agreed, and the race began. They all ran as fast as they could.

But in their hurry, they did not see a big tower of blocks. They ran into it and destroyed it. The animals stopped and looked at the mess they made. They felt sad.

One wise old tortoise said, "We should not have been so impatient. We should have looked where we were going." The animals learned that it is better to be patient and careful, so they didn't destroy anything again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a pet bird named Blue. Blue was a very patient bird. He liked to sit on Sue's shoulder and sing songs.

One day, Sue found a message in a bottle. She opened the bottle and read the message. It said, "Help me escape!" Sue wanted to help, so she asked Blue to fly and find who needed help.

Blue flew high and low, searching for the person who needed help. He finally found a little boy named Tim stuck in a tree. Blue helped Tim escape the tree, and they became friends. Sue, Blue, and Tim played together every day, and they all lived happily ever after.

Anna and Ben were twins. They liked to do many things together. They liked to play with their toys, read books, and sing songs. But their favorite thing was to celebrate their birthday. They always had a big party with cake, balloons, and presents.

This year, their mom and dad had a surprise for them. They said they would take them to the city for their birthday. The city was far away from their home. They had never been there before. They were very excited. They packed their bags and got in the car.

"Are we there yet?" Anna asked.

"Soon, sweetie. The city is very big and nice. You will see many new things," mom said.

"What kind of things?" Ben asked.

"You will see tall buildings, bright lights, and lots of people. And we have a special place to go for your party," dad said.

Anna and Ben wondered what the special place was. They looked out the window and saw the city getting closer. They saw the tall buildings, the bright lights, and the lots of people. They were amazed.

They arrived at the hotel and checked in. Mom and dad told them to get ready for their party. They put on their nice clothes and followed them to the elevator. The elevator went up and up and up. They felt their ears pop.

"Where are we going?" Anna asked.

"You'll see. It's a surprise," mom said.

The elevator stopped and the doors opened. They walked out and saw a big sign that said "Happy Birthday Anna and Ben!" They also saw a big room with a huge window. The window showed the whole city. It was beautiful. They saw cake, balloons, and presents on a table. They also saw their grandma and grandpa, their aunt and uncle, and their cousins. They were all smiling and clapping.

"Surprise!" they all shouted.

Anna and Ben were so happy. They ran to hug their family. They thanked their mom and dad for the best birthday ever. They celebrated with cake, balloons, and presents. They looked at the city and felt very lucky. They had a big and nice party in the big and nice city. They had a wonderful birthday.

One day, Jack was playing in the park. He was running around and exploring the neat things he could find. Then, he saw something he really liked. There were two dogs in the park, and they were rolling on the ground together. Jack was so happy to see them.

He walked closer and wanted to pet them, but they started to tease him. The bigger one barked loudly, and the smaller one growled. Jack held back his tears and ran away.

As he was running, he saw a big, fat shadow in the corner of the park. He thought it was a friendly dog, so he walked up to it. It was a big, fat bear. It scared Jack and he froze in fear.

The bear got angry and started growling at Jack. He tried to run away, but it was too late. The bear grabbed Jack and pulled him into its arms. It was very big and fat, and the bear hugged Jack tightly until he couldn't breathe anymore. Jack cried out in fear and sadness, but no one could help him.

In the end, Jack died in the bear's arms. It was a terrible ending, and everyone in the park was sad. They had seen the whole thing and no one knew what to do. Jack had been so young and hadn't meant any harm. He had just wanted to pet the doggies, but they had teased him.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful and delicate princess. Every day she would go outside and sit on a bench in the garden, with a knob in her tiny hand. She would whisper softly to the knob and they would have the most wonderful adventures together.

Inside the knob there was a tiny, magical world; a world full of fairies and pixies, of delicate butterflies and colourful birds. The princess and the knob talked of wonderful things and laughed together.

One day, the princess and the knob spotted a rainbow in the sky. They both whispered "Let's go explore it!", and set off on a new journey together.

The princess and the knob clambered over the hills and hills, eventually reaching the end of the rainbow. Lo and behold, at the end of the rainbow there were a giant pot of gold coins! The princess and the knob both whispered, in excitement and joy, "We found it!" 

The princess and the knob hugged each other and twirled and danced around the pot of coins, celebrating the most perfect day. From then on, the princess and the knob were the best of friends. They would whisper to each other about the adventures they would go on and explore the world together.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play games. Today they play a game with cards. They have to match the cards with the same picture. Lily is good at the game. She finds many matches. Ben is not so good. He forgets where the cards are.

"Look, I have four matches!" Lily says. She shows Ben her cards. They have a cat, a dog, a ball and a flower.

"I have only two matches," Ben says. He shows Lily his cards. They have a car and a star.

"Lily, you win the game!" Ben says. He is sad. He wanted to win.

"Don't be sad, Ben. You can have a prize," Lily says. She is kind. She has a pastry in her bag. It is a smooth pastry with chocolate on top. She breaks it in half and gives one half to Ben.

"Thank you, Lily. This pastry is yummy!" Ben says. He smiles. He likes the pastry.

"You're welcome, Ben. You are my friend," Lily says. She smiles too. She likes to share.

Lily and Ben eat the pastry. They are happy. They play another game. They have fun.

Molly was so excited to go to her friend Kiki's house for a sleep over. When she walked in the door, Kiki's mom welcomed her with a big hug and showed her the room she would be sleeping in. Molly gasped with delight. Kiki had such a nice and comfy mattress, with blankets and pillows waiting for her.

Molly and Kiki jumped around on the bed, laughing and playing. Soon Kiki laughed, "Hey Molly, let's have a pillow fight!" As they teased each other with their pillows, they both rolled onto the floor, still laughing and having a good time.

Eventually, it was time for bed. Molly hugged Kiki's mom and said thank you for making her feel so comfortable. She hopped onto the mattress, snuggled in with a blanket, and was so happy for such a wonderful sleepover.

Once upon a time there was a kitty. She was very soft and always happy. She loved to stretch her body and play.

One day, the kitty was in the yard playing and stretching her body when she saw a dog. The dog looked sad and the kitty wanted to help. She walked over to the dog and asked what was wrong.

The dog said he needed to go to the veterinarian. It was time for his checkup. The kitty was so happy to help. She said she would bring the dog to the veterinarian. 

The kitty and the dog began their long journey to the vet. They walked and talked on the way. When they got to the veterinarian, the kitty waited outside while the dog went in. 

After a while the dog came out smiling. The vet said the dog was all better. The kitty and the dog thanked the vet, then walked home together. The kitty and the dog were so happy to be friends. They both stretched and played again in the yard.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Lily's mom told her to put on her clothes and stay inside because it was going to rain. 

Lily didn't want to stay inside, but she knew her mom was being helpful. So she put on her clothes and stayed inside. 

As she was playing with her toys, Lily heard a loud noise outside. She looked out the window and saw that it was raining very hard. She was happy that she listened to her mom and stayed inside. 

Later that day, Lily's mom gave her a big hug and said, "You were very helpful today by staying inside. You kept yourself safe from the rain." Lily smiled and felt proud of herself for being a good listener.

Once there was a little boy who wanted a bookshelf. He asked his mom and dad for one, but they said no. Then he asked his grandpa and grandma, but they said no too. The little boy was very sad.

He went for a walk to think about what he should do. Suddenly, he saw a weird bookshelf in an old store. He went inside and asked the shopkeeper how much it was.

The shopkeeper said it was very old, so it was free. The little boy was very happy and took it home.

At home, the little boy was so excited to put his books on his new bookshelf. He organised them by colour and size.

His mom and dad were very surprised when they saw it. They asked him where he got it. He smiled and said â€œGrandpa and Grandma said it was weird, but I wanted itâ€.

Once there was a bear who liked to rock. He was embarrassed because none of the other animals wanted to rock with him. He decided to go for a swim.

When the bear was in the water, he noticed the fish. He said to them, "Hey fish! Let's rock together!" The fish were confused, so the bear said, "We can rock while swimming!"

The fish liked the idea, so they began to rock while they were swimming. The bear laughed and smiled because he was no longer embarrassed. He was glad he found some new friends to rock with!

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat bear who loved to eat honey. One day, the bear was walking in the forest when he saw a little rabbit who was crying. "Why are you crying?" asked the bear. "I hurt my leg," replied the rabbit. "Can you carry me to my home?" 

The bear picked up the rabbit and carried him to his home. "Thank you for helping me," said the rabbit. "No problem," replied the bear. "I am strong and can carry you easily." 

From that day on, the bear and the rabbit became good friends. The bear would often carry the rabbit when his leg hurt, and the rabbit would bring honey for the bear to eat. They were very happy together in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and twirl around in her pretty dress. One day, she went to a party with her friends. They were all having fun until one of the boys stepped on Lily's foot. It hurt a lot and she started to cry.

Her friend, Emma, noticed and asked what was wrong. Lily mentioned that her foot hurt. Emma took a smooth ice pack and put it on Lily's foot. It felt much better and Lily stopped crying. But the boy who stepped on her foot didn't say sorry. Lily felt upset and didn't want to dance anymore.

Emma saw that Lily was sad and decided to talk to the boy. She mentioned that he had hurt Lily and should say sorry. The boy realized he was wrong and said sorry to Lily. She forgave him and they all danced together happily ever after.

Once there was a nosy little plant. She wanted to explore the world. So, one day, she was in a rush to get out of her pot. She pushed and pushed until she suddenly fell out the door.

The plant was so excited. The world was so big. She saw a big tree, and an even bigger sun. She wanted to explore more. 

So, the little nosy plant ran and ran. She wanted to know everything. She ran into a river and splashed around. She ran up a hill and jumped on its bumpy top.

Then suddenly, she heard a voice. "Hey, where are you going!" it said. It was a friendly butterfly. The plant was so happy to meet him.

The butterfly flew with the plant through the sky and showed her all the secret places it had explored. Together they flew high, and together they raced through the air.

The little nosy plant had so much fun with the butterfly. She had explored far and wide. She was so glad that she had rushed out of the pot.

Once upon a time, there was a fun factory full of happy workers. They all worked very hard every day to make lots of things for other people.

One day, one of the factory workers wanted to be more independent. She wanted to do her own work and have her own ideas. So, she smiled and shrugged. With determination, she walked right out of the factory and started her own business.

Even though it was difficult to be independent, she kept at it. Slowly, the other workers began to realize what she had done. They clapped and cheered her on.

Soon, the worker had a very successful business. She was so happy. She had managed to create something special, all on her own.

Freddy went outside to visit his neighbor. He was excited to say hello. As he walked up to her house, he was surprised to see her being very rude to the mailman. She was shouting and waving her arms. Freddy was confused. He didn't understand why she was being so mean.

As Freddy tried to go over to her, she noticed him and said. "Go away, I don't have time for you!" Freddy was sad. He couldn't believe his neighbor was being so rude. He slowly walked away and back to his house. 

Freddy felt a little better when he got back. He put on his favorite shoes and ran out to play with his friends instead of visiting his neighbor. He had a good time playing tag and laughing.

At the end of the day, Freddy went back home and gave his mom a big hug. He told her all about his day, but he chose not to say anything about his rude neighbor. Mom said that sometimes adults don't act very nice, but she was glad he had a good time with his friends.

Once there was a panda who was very hairy. He was called Andy. Every day, Andy would go and search for food.

One day, he was walking deep in the forest when he saw a small cave. He thought it would be a great place to look for food. As he got closer, he could feel the cave was strange.

When he stepped inside, he saw there were many white things on the ground. He didn't know what they were, but he knew he needed them.

Andy walked around the cave carefully and eventually found a big pile of bamboo. He was so happy and wasted no time picking up as much as he could.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It said to him, "I need help. You need to help me". Andy looked around but he couldn't see anyone in the cave. With a puzzled look on his face, he said, "Who said that?".

The voice said, "I'm here. I am a big, hairy panda like you. I need your help to get out of the cave". Andy was so excited. He took the white things and placed them in a line in front of the cave. He said, "These will help us get out of here!".

Slowly, he and his new friend made their way out of the cave. Once they were safely outside, they hugged each other. They were so happy and thanked each other for

Once upon a time, there was a fireman who worked very hard. He was a very compassionate man and he helped many people who were in trouble. One day, he got a call about a fire at an old house. He raced to the scene and quickly got to work fighting the flames. He was brave and he worked very hard to get the fire under control. After a long time, the fire was out and the house was safe. Everyone was very thankful to the fireman for his help and his compassion. The fireman was happy that he could help and all the people around were very grateful for his hard work.

Once upon a time there was a kind little girl. She loved to wear her colorful skirt. One day, the girl wanted to part with her skirt and find another one. She looked in her closet and saw a purple skirt that had sparkles on it. She grabbed the skirt and put it on. She ran out of her house with the skirt flowing in the wind. 

The girl was so happy with her new skirt! She ran to the park nearby, twirling and turning while she was wearing it. She looked so beautiful, like a princess! Soon she became friends with the other kids there who were wearing colorful skirts too. 

The girl laughed and played with the other children in the park. She loved her new skirt and was so kind to her new friends. They had so much fun! She knew that this was going to be her favourite skirt. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl called Daisy. Daisy was only three years old and she lived in a warm and cosy home.

One day, Daisy heard a loud noise. She trembled in fear and ran to see what it was. She saw a big man holding a weapon. Her little heart raced in fear.

Daisy tried to stay brave and step forward. She took a deep breath and asked him politely: "Excuse me, sir. What are you doing?"

The big man was startled and quickly put his weapon away. He looked at Daisy with a humble expression.

The man said, "My young friend, I'm ashamed of what I was doing. I was trying to scare someone but I was wrong. I've learned a valuable lesson: we should never scare others, even if we don't mean it.

Daisy smiled and nodded in agreement. She then happily ran back to her house. From then on, Daisy remembered her lesson and always acted with kindness and respect towards everyone.

Tom is a kid who likes to play with his phone. He has many games and videos on his phone. He plays with his phone all day and all night. He does not listen to his mom and dad when they tell him to stop and go to bed.

One night, Tom is playing with his phone under his blanket. He is very sleepy, but he does not want to stop. He thinks he will miss something fun on his phone. He hears his phone ring. He thinks it is a message from his friend. He picks up his phone and says hello.

But it is not his friend. It is a scary voice. The voice says, "I know you are playing with your phone. You are a bad kid. You do not sleep when you should. You do not listen to your mom and dad. I am coming to get you. I will take your phone and make you cry."

Tom is very scared. He drops his phone and screams. He runs to his mom and dad's room. He tells them what happened. His mom and dad hug him and calm him down. They tell him it was a prank call. Someone was trying to scare him. They tell him he should not play with his phone so much. He should sleep when it is dark and play when it is light. He should listen to his mom and dad. They love him and want him to be healthy and happy.

Tom says he is sorry. He says he will not play with his phone so much. He says he will sleep when it is dark and play when it is light. He says he will listen to his mom and dad. He says he loves them and thanks them for helping him. He gives them a big hug and a kiss. He goes back to his bed and puts his phone away. He closes his eyes and falls asleep. He has a good dream.

The moral of the story is: Playing with your phone too much can be bad for you. You should sleep when it is dark and play when it is light. You should listen to your mom and dad. They love you and want you to be healthy and happy.

Tina was a light girl with a big smile who loved to play outside. One day, she found a thin plastic bag in the grass. She took it home to show her mom, but it had a hole in it. When her mom saw it, she said, "Oh no, sweetheart! The bag is not useful anymore." 

Tina began to tear up. She was so sad to see the bag torn apart. But then, her mom showed her something special. It was a big kite made out of light plastic â€“ perfect for flying in the breeze. 

Tina was delighted. She jumped for joy and shouted, "Let's go fly it!" She and her mom laughed together as they raced outside. Soon, the kite was high in the sky and Tina's tears had been forgotten. She was so happy!

Once upon a time, a big bad cat was looking for somewhere to hide. He sneaked into a shelter, but he couldn't escape.

The owner was being fake, and the cat didn't know what to do. He hid behind a box and was very quiet.

Suddenly, he heard the owner's voice. He was calling and looking for the cat. The cat looked around and saw an open window, so he quickly escaped through it.

The cat was so glad that he had got away! He never wanted to go back to the shelter. He was safe and free now. The end.

Once there was a small girl who liked to swing. Every day she would go outside to the fence in her back yard and swing. Swinging made her feel so happy. She would swing back and forth, giggling as she flew through the air.

But one day she was too careless. She was swinging so high and going faster and faster until she kept going and flew right over the fence. She landed on the other side and it scared her. She started to cry, but then she saw something surprising. On the other side of the fence was a big tree, with a swing just for her.

She stopped crying and smiled. She ran over to the swing and started to swing right away. She laughed as she went back and forth. She swung and swung until it started to get dark. Then it was time to go back home, but the little girl would come back soon and swing on the other side of the fence.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Abby. Abby was three years old and she was playing in the garden one day.
Suddenly, dark clouds started to gather in the sky, and soon a huge flood started. Abby was scared that she would be washed away so she started to run for the house.
Suddenly she heard a noise. It was her mom calling from the house.
"Abby, hurry inside! We need to manage this flood together".
Abby ran inside and together she and her mom managed to put sand bags around the house.
The scary flood started to subside, and Abby and her mom were so relieved.
The next day after the flood, Abby was playing in the garden again, thankful that she and her mom managed to stay safe.

Once upon a time, there were two musical friends, Greta and George. Greta loved to play her trumpet very loudly while George enjoyed playing the piano in a delicate manner.

Every day, they would play music together in the park. However, one day, they had an argument over who played better. Greta was very selfish and wanted to separate the two of them so she could be the star of the show.

But George had an idea. He suggested that Greta should play the trumpet for one part of the song and he would play the piano for the other.

Greta agreed and the two of them created a beautiful piece of music. Greta had such a blast playing with George and soon stopped being so selfish.

The moral of the story is that friends should work together and not separate from each other. Together, we can create amazing things!

"What are you doing grandma?" asked Charles.

"I'm adding yarn" said grandma.

"Wow! What a lot of yarn!" said Charles.

He watched as grandma wound the high yarn around her fingers and added more.

"Why are you making yarn?" asked Charles.

"I'm making a special scarf for your mom's birthday," said grandma.

Charles smiled.

"Can I help you add the yarn?" he asked.

Grandma smiled and gave Charles some yarn to add. 

They spent the rest of the afternoon adding the yarn together. They laughed and sang as they worked.

At the end of the day, the scarf was finished. It was a long, high scarf, full of many colors.

Charles was so proud of the finished scarf. "That looks wonderful" said Charles.

Grandma smiled. "It sure does," she said. "It was so nice to have your help in adding the yarn. You did a great job."

Mummy was playing with clay and making things. Tom was watching her with big eyes.

Tom: "Mummy! What can I do?"

Mummy smiled at him. "How about you help me make something with the clay?"

Tom clapped his hands together. "Yes!"

Mummy gave Tom the clay. "Let's start by stretching the clay."

Tom watched closely as Mummy showed him how to make the clay longer. He tried to do it himself, and was so happy when he saw that he could!

Then Mummy showed him how to make a yummy cake with the clay. Tom loved to make the little details - like adding chocolate chips to the top of the cake.

They finished their yummy clay cake together. Tom was so proud of his work and he couldn't wait to show Daddy when he came home.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sarah. She was a nice girl and very polite. One day, Sarah went to the park with her mom. She saw a very big apple tree. Sarah wondered what it would be like to eat one of the apples from the tree.

"Mom, can I have one of the apples?" Sarah asked.

"No, Sarah," her mom said, "you can't have one of those apples."

Sarah asked why not. 

"Those apples aren't for you," her mom said. "They belong to the birds and animals in the park."

Sarah nodded, understanding. She saw a small apple on the ground and asked if she could have that one.

"Yes!" her mom said, "you can have that one!"

Sarah was very happy, and thanked her mom for the apple. They went home and Sarah enjoyed her apple!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to help his mom in the kitchen. He liked to put the dishes in the dishwasher and make sure they were tidy.

One day, Timmy's mom asked him to sort the dishes before putting them in the dishwasher. Timmy was happy to help and started sorting the dishes. He put the plates in one pile, the cups in another, and the forks and spoons in a third pile.

But then, Timmy accidentally dropped a plate and it broke into many pieces. His mom was very upset and told him he had to be more careful. Timmy felt sad and wished he had been more careful. His mom had to clean up the broken plate and Timmy wasn't allowed to help in the kitchen for a while.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Sam. Sam loved chocolate. He always looked for it in the cupboard, but his mum kept it hidden. Every day, he thought of new ways to find it. One day, he heard his mum talking on the phone. She said something about buying lots of chocolate for a party. Sam was very excited!

So, Sam decided to go and help search for the chocolate. He included his best teddy bear and off they went. He looked in the cupboard, behind the curtains, even under the couch. He searched everywhere!

At last, he found some chocolate hidden in a jar on the shelf. He picked it up and tasted the delicious chocolate. Then, he heard a harsh voice. It was his mum! She was angry because Sam had found the chocolate. He felt sad and put it back in the jar.

Sam bowed his head and thought of a new plan. He knew he had to include his mum too if he wanted to get more chocolate. So, on the next special occasion, he asked her if he could help buy the chocolate together. This time, his mum said yes!

Lily was a deaf girl who liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was Anna, who had long hair and a blue dress. Lily liked to brush Anna's hair and talk to her with her hands.

One day, Lily's mom said she had a surprise for her. She gave Lily a big box with a bow on it. Lily was very happy and opened the box. Inside, she saw a new doll. The doll had short hair and a pink dress. She also had a hole in her ear.

Lily's mom said, "This is Emma. She is a deaf doll, just like you. She can wear a hearing aid in her hole, or you can take it off and talk to her with your hands. She is your new friend."
