"I don't know," Ben says. "Maybe we have to ask the teacher first. She owns the stickers. They are not ours."

"But I want a star sticker," Lily says. "It is my favorite symbol. It makes me happy."

"Me too," Ben says. "But we have to be good and wait. The teacher will tell us when we can use the stickers."

They sit on the floor and look at the stickers. They are nervous. They hope the teacher will let them have some stickers soon.

The teacher sees them and smiles. She walks over to them and opens the box.

"Hello, Lily and Ben," she says. "Do you like the stickers?"

"Yes, we do," they say together.

"They are very nice, aren't they?" the teacher says. "They are for you. You can have some stickers and make your own pictures. You can use any symbol you want. Just be careful and don't stick them on the walls or the furniture."

"Thank you, teacher!" Lily and Ben say. They are very happy. They pick some stickers and start to make their own pictures. Lily chooses a star sticker and Ben chooses a heart sticker. They stick them on a piece of paper and show them to each other.

"Look, this is my star picture," Lily says. "It is bright and shiny."

"Look, this is my heart picture," Ben says. "It is warm and sweet."

They smile and hug each other. They are proud of their pictures. They are not nervous anymore. They have fun with the stickers.

Once upon a time, there was a happy boy named Timmy. He loved to draw with his crayons and make pictures. One day, Timmy drew a bright and colorful image of a smiling sun. He was very proud of his work and showed it to his mommy.

"Look mommy, I made a cheerful sun!" Timmy said, holding up his picture.

"Oh, that's so beautiful, Timmy! You really know how to mark your paper with such pretty colors," his mommy replied.

Timmy smiled and continued to draw more pictures, feeling happy and proud of his artwork. He loved making images that made people smile.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She was very curious and loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Lucy found a strange object. It was an original microscope. She was so excited to explore it and see how it worked. She asked her mom, "What is this, mommy?"

Her mom said, "That is a microscope. It lets you look at things very close and see details that you can't see with the naked eye." Lucy felt really proud of finding such a cool item. 

She decided to look at something with her microscope. She chose a leaf from the garden and it looked so different and amazing when she looked at it through the microscope.

Lucy was so pleased with her new discovery. She said to her mom, "I feel so lucky for finding this original microscope. I can finally explore the world around me." 

Her mom smiled and said, "That's wonderful. Now you can use that microscope to explore lots of new things!" 

Lucy was so happy and she thanked her mom for helping her understand how the microscope worked. She was excited to explore even more with her new original microscope!

Once upon a time, there were two farm friends, Jojo the cow and Bailey the horse. Jojo loved to eat hay but today there was none for him. When Bailey heard about this he decided to help. She went out to the pasture and with her trusty old friend, Max the goat, they started to stir the hay with their noses. They worked until the hay was ready for Jojo to eat. Jojo was delighted with the dependable help of his friends. From that day forward they all lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, she went to the park and saw a boy sitting on a bench. The boy looked sad, so Lily went over to him and said, "Hi! Do you want to play with me?"

The boy looked up and smiled. "Yes, please!" he said.

Lily offered the boy her favorite toy and they played together for hours. They had so much fun that they didn't even notice the year passing by.

As the sun began to set, the boy said, "Thank you for playing with me. You're a good friend."

Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome. Let's play again tomorrow!" And they walked home together, slowly enjoying the beautiful sunset.

Once upon a time, there was a group of animals who lived in a forest. They were all friends and liked to play together. One day, it started to rain very hard. The animals got scared and ran to find shelter. But one little rabbit was left behind. 

The other animals noticed the rabbit was missing and went back to find him. They saw him shivering in the rain and knew they had to help him. They huddled together and made a roof with their bodies to keep the rabbit dry. 

It was an important moment for the group of animals because they learned that helping each other was the right thing to do. From that day on, they always stuck together and never left anyone behind in the rain again.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Lily. They loved playing together. One day they decided to play cricket in the park. 

They started to set up and Lily noticed that Jack had forgotten his bat. She very nicely offered to lend him hers. Jack was so happy and thanked her.

Jack said, "Let's play then!" But when he threw the ball, it went straight into a bush. They both heard a rustling noise and an alert cricket jumped out. This made them laugh and Jack felt quite embarrassed.

Luckily, Lily was very kind. She comforted Jack and said, "Don't worry, mistakes happen!"

They soon forgot about the incident and went along with their game. They had so much fun together!

Once upon a time, there was a clever pig named Wilbur. Wilbur was walking in a field when he heard a noise coming from a basket. He went over to investigate and found a bird picking berries from the baskets. "Hey, that is my basket! What are you doing in it?" Wilbur said.

The bird replied, "I'm just eating some berries. Please don't be mad at me. I'm very hungry." Wilbur thought for a minute and decided he could be helpful and kind.

"Well, if you are hungry then I can help. I know the field really well. I can take the basket and show you where to find more berries," Wilbur said. The bird was so happy to hear this and thanked Wilbur.

The two set off and soon Wilbur had the bird back in the field collecting fruits. It was a happy ending for both of them. Wilbur was clever to think of a way to help the bird, rather than be mad. And the bird was grateful for his help.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play in the park with their dog, Spot. One day, they see a big slide. Anna wants to try it, but Ben is scared.

"Come on, Ben, it will be fun!" Anna says. "You are brave, you can do it!"

Ben shakes his head. "No, it is too high. I will fall and hurt myself."

Anna thinks for a moment. She has an idea. She runs to their mom, who is sitting on a bench. She asks for some sauce. Mom gives her a small bottle of ketchup.

"Thank you, Mom!" Anna says. She runs back to Ben and Spot. She shows them the sauce.

"Look, Ben, I have sauce. If you go on the slide with me, I will give you some sauce. You like sauce, right?"

Ben nods. He likes sauce very much. He looks at the slide again. It is still high, but he wants the sauce.

"Okay, I will try it," he says. "But you have to go first."

Anna agrees. She climbs up the stairs and sits on the slide. She holds the sauce in her hand. She smiles at Ben and Spot.

"Ready, set, go!" she shouts. She slides down fast. She laughs and feels the wind in her hair.

Ben watches her. He sees that she is happy and safe. He feels a little less scared. He follows her up the stairs and sits on the slide. He holds Spot in his arms.

"Ready, set, go!" he repeats. He slides down with Spot. He feels a little nervous, but also excited. He lands next to Anna.

They both giggle and hug each other. Spot barks and licks their faces.

"Wow, that was fun!" Ben says. "Can we do it again?"

"Sure, let's do it again!" Anna says. She gives him some sauce. He squeezes some on his finger and licks it. It is yummy.

They run back to the slide, holding hands. They are brave and happy. Mom watches them and smiles. She is proud of them.

Once there was a boy named Sam. Everyday he liked to play outside. One day he saw a rope. He thought it might be fun to attach it to the tree. 

So he grabbed the rope and found a spot to attach it. But it was too long. He wanted it to be tight. He kept trying but he couldn't make it fit.

Suddenly, Sam had an idea. He knew how he could make it fit. He grabbed the rope and attached it around his waist. Then he started running away. 

Suddenly, he felt the rope become really tight! He noticed that it was attached to the tree. He started to try to escape, but it was too tight. 

Then Sam's mom came outside and saw Sam attached to the tree! She laughed and used scissors to help Sam escape. Sam was so happy he had a fit of giggles.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Amy. She was very excited because she had a mysterious invitation. After quickly getting dressed she walked outside to keep the invitation safe.

Amy walked past a big tree and saw some chirping birds. She followed the birds and soon she saw a big castle. She thought the castle looked so magical. She knocked on the door and a friendly voice asked her to come in. 

Inside the castle, Amy saw a table full of presents. She was amazed! The voice asked her to choose one, so she chose a big box. She carefully opened the box and inside was a beautiful shiny crown. The voice asked her to put the crown on her head to become the queen of the castle. Amy was delighted!

Amy kept her invitation safe in her pocket and promised to come back to the castle soon. With a wave goodbye and a huge smile, she left the mysterious castle.

Lily and Tom were playing in the garden. They liked to pretend they were explorers in a new land. They set up a tent with a blanket and some sticks. They looked at the landscape around them. They saw green grass, yellow flowers, blue sky and white clouds.

"Wow, this is a pretty place!" Lily said.

"Yes, it is. I wonder what animals live here," Tom said.

They heard a noise behind a bush. They peeked and saw a bunny. The bunny had brown fur and long ears. It was nibbling on a carrot.

"Look, a bunny!" Lily whispered.

"Shh, don't scare it," Tom whispered back.

They watched the bunny for a while. It looked happy and cute.

"Can we pet it?" Lily asked.

"Maybe, but be gentle," Tom said.

They crawled slowly towards the bunny. The bunny saw them and twitched its nose. It did not run away. It seemed curious.

"Hello, bunny. We are Lily and Tom. We are explorers. Do you want to be our friend?" Lily said softly.

The bunny tilted its head and sniffed. It hopped closer to them. It let them touch its fur. It felt soft and warm.

"Hi, bunny. You are very nice. Do you like carrots?" Tom said kindly.

The bunny nodded and offered them a bite of its carrot. It tasted sweet and crunchy.

"Thank you, bunny. This is a tasty carrot. Do you want to share our tent?" Lily said gratefully.

The bunny agreed and followed them to their tent. They made a cozy spot for it with some leaves and grass. They cuddled with the bunny and told it stories. They felt happy and sleepy.

They fell asleep in their tent with the bunny. They dreamed of more adventures in the new land. They had a new friend. They were happy.

Lilly and her dad went to the beach for a day out. Lilly was so excited; she had never been to the beach before. 

Dad grabbed a big, light kayak and set it down on the sand. 

"Come on, Lilly, let's go kayaking!" said Dad. 

Lilly was so happy. She got in and Dad pushed the kayak into the sea. 

"Look how fast we are going!" said Dad. 

Lilly laughed and screamed with joy. They glided across the ocean, feeling the spray of the waves against their faces. 

Eventually, they returned back to the beach and got out of the kayak. Dad picked it up and put it down on the sand. 

"Lilly, I need to dry the kayak before we go home," said Dad. 

Lilly nodded, and the two of them began to wave the kayak back and forth, letting the warm sunshine dry it. 

When it was finished, the kayak was light and dry. Dad looked happy.

"Let's go home, Lilly," he said.

Lilly smiled and took Dad's hand. Together, they walked away from the beach, back home.

Once there was a brave bug. His name was Alfie. He loved to cook yummy treats. One day he decided to make a squishy apple pie. He mixed the ingredients and put the pie in the oven.

When the pie was ready, Alfie took it out and put it on the table. Then he called out, "I'm done cooking!"

Just then, a little bee flew by and said, "That smells so yummy! Can I have some?"

Alfie smiled and said, "Sure! I made it for everyone to enjoy." He cut a big slice of the apple pie and handed it to the bee.

The bee said, "Thank you, Alfie! You're very brave and kind."

Alfie smiled and said, "It's the least I can do. Enjoy your pie, my friend!"

Tom and Ann are husband and wife. They live in a small house with a big garden. They like to grow flowers and vegetables. Every morning, they rise early and work in the garden. They are happy and love each other.

One day, a big storm comes. The wind is very strong and the rain is very heavy. Tom and Ann are scared. They run inside the house and close the door. They hope the storm will go away soon.

But the storm does not go away. It gets worse and worse. The wind breaks the windows and the rain floods the floor. Tom and Ann hear a loud noise. They look outside and see a big tree falling on their house. They scream and try to escape, but it is too late. The tree crushes their house and them.

The next day, the sun comes out and the storm is over. The garden is ruined and the house is gone. Only the tree is still there, lying on the ground. No one is available to help Tom and Ann. They are gone too. The end.

Jimmy was a small boy, who loved to whistle. Whenever he felt happy, a little whistle would come out of his mouth. His parents were so proud of him, they knew he was special. Every year Jimmy and his parents would go on a long, incredible journey.

One year, they decided to go to the beach. When they got there, Jimmy couldn't wait to get out of the car. He tossed off his sandals and began to whistle as he ran down to the beach. Suddenly, a gust of wind whipped past him and his whistle flew away! He was so upset.

Jimmy began to cry, but his parents were there to help. Together, the three of them searched for the lost whistle. After a while, Jimmy spotted it lying in the sand, and scooped it up with a smile.

The moral of the story is to never give up when something you love is lost. If Jimmy had stopped trying, he wouldn't have found his whistle.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a lovely doll that she played with every day. One day, Lily's doll stopped working. It was a machine that made noises and moved around.

Lily tried to fix the machine, but she didn't know how. She decided to ask her mom for help. "Mommy, can you please help me fix my doll machine?" Lily spoke to her mom.

Her mom looked at the doll machine and saw that it needed new batteries. She put in new batteries and the machine started working again. Lily was so happy that her lovely doll machine was fixed! She hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for fixing my doll machine!"

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweet. Tweet was very frightened of the big crane that lived near his tree. One day, Tweet decided to try to be brave and fly close to the crane. As he got closer, he saw that the crane was just standing still and not moving. Tweet felt a little bit better and decided to try to get even closer. 

As he flew closer, the crane suddenly moved and Tweet got scared and flew away. But then he realized that the crane was just stretching its wings and not trying to hurt him. Tweet felt proud of himself for trying to be brave and decided to fly back to his tree. From that day on, Tweet was not as frightened of the crane and would often try to fly close by to say hello.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy. Lily loved to play on the swings and slide. She saw a boy who had a big figure and he was playing with a ball. She wanted to play with him but felt shy.

Suddenly, it started to rain and Lily and her family had to go home. But, they got caught in the rain and got soaked. Lily felt ashamed because her dress got wet and she thought she looked silly. When they got home, Lily's mommy gave her a warm bath and put on her cozy pajamas. Lily felt much better after the bath and snuggled up with her favorite stuffed animal.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to sleep in her cozy bed every night. One morning, she woke up early because she heard a loud noise. It was her cat, Fluffy, who knocked over a vase. Lily was very upset because the vase was very special to her.

Later that day, Lily and her mom went for a walk in the park. They saw a big dog passing by. Lily was scared of dogs, but her mom held her hand tightly and they walked away safely.

At dinner time, Lily's dad came home from work. He was very proud of himself because he got a promotion at his job. But Lily was sad because she didn't have a good day. She told her dad about the broken vase and the scary dog. Her dad listened carefully and gave her a big hug. He said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can fix the vase and I'm proud of you for being brave around the dog." 

Lily felt much better after talking to her dad. She learned that even when things go wrong, her family will always be there to make her feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved space and he dreamed of going to a planet one day. One night, Timmy looked up at the sky and saw a bright star. He wondered if the star was a planet.

The next day, Timmy asked his mom if he could fill up his rocket ship with gas so he could go to the planet. His mom told him he couldn't go to space because he was too little. Timmy was sad but he still loved looking at the stars.

As Timmy grew up, he learned more about space and planets. He read books and watched videos about the universe. One day, he built a rocket ship that could go really fast. He filled it up with gas and blasted off into space. Timmy finally got to visit the planet he had always dreamed of.

Ben and Mia love to play with their toys. They have cars, dolls, trains, and a big helicopter. The helicopter is red and yellow, and it makes a loud noise when they push a button.

One day, they hear a real helicopter outside. They run to the window and see it flying in the sky. It is bigger and faster than their toy helicopter. They are very excited.

"Look, look!" Ben says. "A helicopter!"

"Wow!" Mia says. "Can we go see it?"

They ask their mom if they can go outside. Their mom says yes, but they have to hold her hand and be careful. They put on their shoes and coats and follow their mom to the door.

They enter the yard and see the helicopter landing on the street. It has a big cross on it. Some people come out of the helicopter. They are wearing white clothes and carrying a stretcher.

"What are they doing?" Ben asks.

"They are helping someone who is sick or hurt," their mom says. "They are doctors and nurses. They have a special helicopter that can take them to the hospital."

"Can we say hello to them?" Mia asks.

"Maybe, but we have to stay here and not get in their way," their mom says.

They watch as the people take the stretcher to the helicopter. They see a man on the stretcher. He has a bandage on his head and an oxygen mask on his face. He looks sad and scared.

"Is he going to be okay?" Ben asks.

"I hope so," their mom says. "The doctors and nurses will take good care of him."

The people close the door of the helicopter. The helicopter starts to make a loud noise again. It lifts off the ground and flies away.

"Bye, bye, helicopter!" Ben and Mia wave.

"Bye, bye, helicopter!" their mom waves.

They go back inside and play with their toy helicopter. They pretend to be doctors and nurses and help their dolls and animals. They are happy and proud.

One day there was a modern car. It was bright green and had lots of buttons. The car belonged to a little boy. He loved to play with the buttons on the car. 

One day the boy pushed the red button. Suddenly the car started to move. The boy was so excited. 

The car drove down the road until it stopped at an ice cream shop. The boy got out of the car and ran inside. He bought a delicious strawberry ice cream cone. 

When he finished eating, the boy got back into the car. He pushed the blue button and the car started to drive. The car drove the boy back home. 

When the car stopped, the boy got out and said goodbye. The modern car made a noise and the boy's day ended.

Once upon a time there was a successful station. It spread out all around the place. Everywhere people would come to visit. People would come to the station to ride on the trains, buy things and have fun.

The station spread cheer in the neighborhood. Everyone was happy to see it! They would throw special parties and have lots of fun.

Every day, more people came to the station to check it out. Some people even stayed and became a part of the station. It became a place of friendship, creativity and joy!

Soon the station spread across the whole city and it became even more successful. Everyone was excited to see the station grow and spread love and friendship.

And that's how the successful station spread and became part of the community.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mary. Mary was very naughty. One day, Mary was walking in a wild wood. She felt very curious and she wanted to explore. 

Suddenly, she saw a big tree with lots of leaves. She wanted to climb the tree, so she leaned in. But the tree was too tall and she could not reach the top.

Just then, she saw a friendly squirrel. The squirrel said to her, "Why don't you try leaning on me? Together we can reach the top of the tree.

Mary smiled and said, "Thank you, Squirrel! I can lean on you." So Mary leaned on the friendly squirrel and they both reached the top of the tree. Then, Mary said goodbye to the squirrel and she went home.

One day there was a green vegetable. It was big and clear. Daddy wanted to measure it. He got a ruler out of the drawer and measured the vegetable. He measured it three times and each time it was the same number, three. 

Daddy was very happy. He put the ruler back in the drawer and said to the vegetable, "You are a very big vegetable! You measure three. You are amazing!" 

Mommy smiled and said, "Yes, it's an impressive vegetable!" Then she took out a big pot and started to cook the vegetable. 

Daddy and Mommy enjoyed a delicious meal. Everyone was happy that Daddy had measured the vegetable and that it was so clear. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Tommy and Lucy. Tommy had an idea. He said, "Let's play a game!" Lucy smiled.

The two of them ran in the garden to find something to play with. Tommy saw some sticks and said, "I know! Let's use these to shoot!"

Lucy was so excited. She said, "What a great idea, Tommy!" The two of them picked up the sticks and had so much fun shooting things.

After a while, they got a bit tired. They sat on the grass and it felt so comfortable. They lay down and looked up at the sky, happy that they had a fun time.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a bald man who lived all alone in a cave. He was very lonely and wanted a friend. One day, he found a mouse that was all alone too, so he decided to make it his friend.

The bald man would feed the mouse and talk to it every day. They would play together and the mouse would stay very close and keep the bald man company. The mouse would also climb up and sit on the bald man's shoulder.

One day, the mouse was very hungry and the bald man gave it a piece of cheese to chew. The mouse loved the cheese and chewed it until it was gone. After that, the two friends were even closer and would always play together in the cave.

The end.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big slide and Tim wanted to go down it. He pointed at the slide and said, "Mom, can I go down the slide?" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, Tim, you can go down the slide."

As Tim climbed up the slide, he saw a little girl named Sue holding a toy with a handle. Tim wanted to play with the toy, so he asked Sue, "Can I play with your toy?" Sue looked at Tim and said, "I'm sorry, but this is my favorite toy. I don't want to share it right now."

Tim felt sad, but he understood. He went down the slide and had lots of fun. After a while, Sue came over to Tim and said, "I'm sorry I didn't share my toy earlier. Do you want to play with it now?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, thank you!" They played together and had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time there was a black record. It was very helpful and it could do great things.

One day, a 3 year old wanted to use the record. The record said, "I can't help you out. You have to be older". The 3 year old was very sad.

Then, an old man showed up. He was very helpful and offered to help find a way to make the record work. He tried to figure out how to make the record work, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't make the record work. 

The 3 year old was very sad. He asked the old man, "Can you make it work?" 

The old man shook his head and said, "I'm sorry, but I can't make it work. I tried everything I could. I'm afraid the record will never work again." 

The 3 year old was very sad and never forgot the black record. The 3 year old never saw the old man again.

Once upon a time there was a peanut. It was happy and round, like a ball. But something was wrong. The peanut was smelly. It could smell really bad, like something was wrong.

The peanut was sad, so it decided to go on a journey. It wanted to find out what was making it smell so bad.

The peanut rolled and rolled until it found a smelly river. Something was in the river and it was making it smell. The peanut rolled closer and closer and it saw a fish!

The fish was eating the peanut. It was eating the peanut up bit by bit until it finished. Then the fish swam away and the smelly river became clean again. The peanut was happy the smelly fish had gone.

And that was the end of the peanut's adventure!

Once upon a time there were two friends, Ginger and Gwen. Ginger was a brave girl who never gave up and Gwen was very inventive. 

One day, they decided to explore the forest. They saw lots of trees and animals, but suddenly Gwen noticed something. She saw a cable lying on the ground. She shouted to Ginger, "Hey Ginger, let's mark where the cable is so we can find it again!" 

But Ginger disagreed and said, "No, let's not. We might get lost!" But Gwen was so determined that she had to mark it.

Suddenly, they both became dizzy. They had marked the wrong cable which was leading them to a giant hole! Ginger was scared but still tried her best to get out of it. She got out but Gwen was stuck and started crying out for help.

Eventually, Gwen made it out with call for help. Ginger and Gwen learned an important lesson that day never get too dizzy with excitement, itâ€™s better to think twice before doing something.

Once there was a little girl who loved pink. She always wanted to wear something pink and play with something pink. One day, she asked her mom for a pink sail. Her mom was not sure but she decided to mail the sail to her daughter.

When the package arrived, the little girl was very excited. She ripped open the package and saw the most beautiful pink sail. She held the sail up high and immediately started to twirl around with it. She ran around and around with a big smile on her face.

The little girl's mom watched her twirling around with the sail and said, "It looks like you had a lot of fun!" The little girl smiled and said, "Oh yes, thank you so much for my pink sail mommy!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to play in her garden. One day, she felt so excited that she decided to stay outside until she fell asleep. As night came, the girl fell asleep and started to dream of playing with her toys.

Suddenly, something woke her up. When she opened her eyes, she saw a big cone in front of her. She thought it was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen! She was so excited that she kept staring at it for a few minutes until she got up and reached for it.

The girl was about to grab the cone when something else stopped her. It was a bird that was hopping around, making silly noises and flapping its wings. The girl felt silly for being so foolish and she stopped reaching for the cone.

The girl realized that the cone was just a part of her dream and she went back to playing with her toys in the garden. From that day on, she never made the same foolish mistake again.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy who wanted to go out for dinner. They took their little girl to a restaurant. The little girl was very excited to see the menu. She saw lots of yummy foods like pizza and spaghetti. 

The mommy and daddy ordered their food and the waitress took it to the kitchen to store it. The little girl was happy to see the waitress was successful in carrying all the food without dropping anything. 

After a little while, the waitress brought the food to the table. The mommy and daddy ate their food and the little girl had some too. They all had a great time at the restaurant and the little girl was happy to see the menu and watch the waitress store and bring the food successfully.

Lily liked to record sounds with her toy phone. She would press the red button and say something, then press the green button and hear it back. She liked to record her mom, her dad, her cat and her toys.

One day, Lily went to the farm with her mom. She saw many animals there: cows, pigs, chickens, horses and more. She wanted to record them all. She ran around with her toy phone, pressing the red button and saying hello to each animal.

She saw a huge bull in a big pen. He had horns, fur and a ring in his nose. He looked scary, but Lily was not afraid. She wanted to record him too. She went close to the pen and said, "Hello, bull. You are huge. Can I record you?"

The bull did not like Lily. He did not like her toy phone. He did not like her voice. He thought she was annoying. He snorted, stomped and shook his head. He wanted her to go away.

Lily did not notice. She pressed the green button and heard her voice. She giggled and said, "You sound funny, bull. Do you want to hear it again?" She pressed the green button again and again.

The bull got angry. He charged at the pen, trying to break it. He made a loud noise, like a roar. Lily got scared. She dropped her toy phone and ran to her mom. She hugged her and said, "Mom, the bull is mad. He does not like to be recorded."

Her mom picked her up and said, "It's okay, Lily. The bull is just grumpy. He does not like strangers. You should not go near him. He could hurt you."

Lily nodded and said, "I'm sorry, mom. I just wanted to record him. He was huge."

Her mom smiled and said, "I know, Lily. You are very curious. But you have to be careful. Some animals are not friendly. Come on, let's go see the other animals. Maybe they will like to be recorded."

Lily agreed and said, "Okay, mom. Let's go. But can I have my toy phone back?"

Her mom looked at the pen and saw the toy phone lying on the ground. The bull was still angry, but he could not reach it. She said, "Maybe later, Lily. Maybe later."

Once upon a time, there was a deer in the forest. The deer was very peaceful and liked to eat grass. One day, a little girl came to the forest to play. She saw the deer and said, "Hello, deer! What is your name?" The deer didn't answer because it didn't understand what the girl said. 

The little girl went closer to the deer and said, "You are very pretty and peaceful. I will name you Daisy." The deer looked at the little girl and started to walk away. The little girl followed the deer and said, "Don't go, Daisy. I want to be your friend." 

The deer stopped and looked at the little girl. It realized that the girl was kind and wanted to be friends. From that day on, the little girl visited Daisy in the forest every day. They played together and the little girl brought Daisy some grass to eat. Daisy was no longer lonely and was happy to have a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big furry dog named Max. Max loved to play on the carpet in the living room. One day, Max's owner said, "Max, I will allow you to come with me in the car to the park!" Max was very excited and wagged his tail. 

Max jumped into the car and sat on the carpet in the backseat. He looked out the window and saw many trees and flowers. When they arrived at the park, Max ran around and played with other dogs. He even found a new furry friend named Bella. 

After playing for a while, Max's owner said it was time to go home. Max was tired but happy. He was grateful that his owner allowed him to come along in the car. When they got home, Max fell asleep on the furry carpet, dreaming of his fun day at the park.

Henry loved to learn about the world. He loved to watch people and see what they did. One day, Henry went for a walk and saw a smooth lake. He wanted to learn how to swim but he had some trouble. He kept trying, but he couldn't get the hang of it. 

After many attempts, he got frustrated. He felt like giving up. But he kept trying until he finally learned how to swim. He was so proud when he could swim smoothly. He learned that if he worked hard and kept trying, he could achieve anything. He learned a valuable lesson that day.

Once upon a time there was an old man. He was a happy man, but he had a problem - he needed a tour. He thought and thought about what to do, but couldn't find an answer.

One day an idea came to him. He decided to take a foolish tour. It was a long journey, but he was determined.

He started his tour in the morning, walking through fields and valleys. He enjoyed the scenery, he frolicked in the sunshine and flew kites in the wind.

At night, he stopped and camped. He ate his dinner and lay down to sleep. But as he was about to go to sleep, he needed something else. He needed a blanket! So, he walked and he found a blanket in a tree. He wrapped it around him and slept soundly.

The old man ended his foolish tour feeling very happy and content. He had seen a lot of wonderful things on his journey, and he was glad he had taken it.

Once upon a time, there was a naughty little mouse. His name was Peter. Peter liked to play all day and never listen to his mom.

One day, Peter took a walk in the forest. Suddenly, he saw something that made him blink - a secret door! He ran quickly to the door and peeked inside.

"Oh wow!" Peter said.

"Who goes there?" a voice said from inside.

Peter was so scared that he couldn't say a word. After a few moments, the voice spoke again.

"If you want to enter this secret door, you must answer a riddle. If you can't answer it, you must go away."

Peter thought for a minute and then asked, "What is the answer?"

The voice replied, "Beware the naughty ones!"

Peter smiled and said, "I know the answer! I'm naughty, but I'm also very curious! May I enter please?"

The voice laughed and said, "Yes, you may come in and explore the secret door!"

And so, Peter did. He explored the secret door with great curiosity and had many adventures!

Once upon a time, there was a pale gem which nobody knew the power of. One day a teacher appeared in the village and told the people, "I know the power of the pale gem! I will teach you how to use it." Everyone was excited and gathered around the teacher. 

The teacher said, "Now, I will teach you how to make the pale gem magical. First you must find a special vessel and fill it with water. Then place the pale gem in the vessel and watch as it glows." Everyone was amazed! 

The teacher continued, "While holding the vessel with the pale gem in it, you must say a very special spell. Say the words 'Pale Gem, I call on you to bring us luck and fortune!' and the gem will become magical and bring us luck and fortune." 

Everyone was thrilled and thanked the teacher. The village was now filled with more luck and fortune than ever before, all thanks to the teacher who taught them all how to use the pale gem.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who lived in a big meadow. She was playing with her friends when suddenly the sun disappeared from the sky! The bunny was scared and asked her friends: "Where did the sun go?"

Her friends all said they didn't know, so the bunny had to go look for it. She hopped around the meadow, but couldn't find the sun anywhere. Suddenly she saw a rare rainbow in the sky!

"I know!" she shouted. "The sun must have gone past the rainbow!"

So she hopped towards the rainbow, but as she got closer, the sun disappeared behind a cloud. The bunny was sad and thought she had lost the sun forever.

Just then, a warm breeze touched her face and the cloud slowly moved away. There it was! The sun was there, shining brighter than before! The bunny was so happy and the meadow lit up with its warmth. From that day on, the bunny never lost the sun again.

Sam was excited. He had never seen a lake before! So early in the morning he set off with his friend, Davin, to go find it.

"Where the lake, Davin?" asked Sam.

"It's not far," replied Davin.

They walked for a bit until suddenly they saw it - a big black lake. Sam and Davin were amazed.

"Wow," said Sam.

"Let's go for a swim!" said Davin. And he ran to the edge of the lake.

But Sam stopped Davin from going in.

"What?" asked Davin.

"Wait," said Sam. "Let's ask Mom if it's okay first."

Davin nodded and agreed, and so they continued on until they eventually got home.

After asking Mom, they learned that the black lake had dangerous things in it, and that they weren't allowed to go in unhindered.

Sam and Davin were both relieved to find out before they made a mistake, but they were also disappointed that they wouldn't be able to go swimming in the beautiful black lake. They vowed to find another way to explore the lake, safely.

Once upon a time there was a mysterious box. No one knew what was inside, not even the mightiest of kings! Everyone wanted to peek inside and see the lovely reward. 

One day, a little boy named Bob came along. He looked at the mysterious box, and wanted to peek inside. He asked his mom if he could open it. His mom said yes, so he opened the box carefully.

When he opened the box, Bob was so surprised at the reward! Inside was a beautiful doll with a lovely dress. He was so thrilled that he ran around telling all of his friends about his awesome reward. 

Everyone was so happy for Bob! He was so proud that he kept his reward very close. He never stopped talking about it and every day, he would take it out to peek inside the box and show it to his friends.

The end.

Anna was very good at school. She liked to learn new things and play with her friends. But there was one thing she did not like: tests. Tests were scary. They had many questions and she had to write the answers. Sometimes she did not know the answers and felt sad.

One day, her teacher said they would have a big test the next day. It was about animals and their sounds. Anna loved animals, but she was not sure if she could remember all their sounds. She went home and tried to study, but she was too nervous. She wished she could skip the test.

The next day, she went to school with a heavy heart. She saw her friend Ben in the playground. He smiled and said, "Hi, Anna. Are you ready for the test?" Anna shook her head and said, "No, Ben. I am scared. I don't want to do the test." Ben hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Anna. You can do it. You know a lot about animals. And I have a surprise for you. If you do the test, I will give you something special."

Anna was curious. She asked, "What is it, Ben?" Ben winked and said, "You will see. But you have to do the test first. Come on, let's go to the classroom." He took her hand and led her to the door. Anna felt a little better. She liked surprises. Maybe the test would not be so bad.

She followed Ben to her seat and took the test paper. She looked at the questions and tried to think of the answers. She knew some of them, like what sound a cow makes or what a lion has on its head. But some of them were hard, like what sound a giraffe makes or what a penguin eats. She guessed and hoped she was right. She finished the test and gave it to the teacher. She felt relieved and proud. She did the test!

She looked at Ben and he smiled. He whispered, "Good job, Anna. Now, are you ready for your surprise?" He reached into his backpack and pulled out a small box. He gave it to Anna and said, "Open it." Anna opened the box and gasped. Inside was a beautiful necklace with a charm of a cat. She loved cats. She said, "Wow, Ben. This is amazing. Thank you so much. How did you know I like cats?" Ben said, "I know you, Anna. You always draw cats and talk about them. I wanted to give you something to celebrate your test. You are my best friend." Anna hugged him and said, "You are my best friend too, Ben. Thank you for helping me with the test. You made it less scary." They put on their necklaces and smiled. They were happy. They celebrated their test.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little bunny named Betsy. Betsy loved to play outside and hop around in the grass. One day, she found a shiny stone and picked it up with her paws. She thought it was very pretty and decided to keep it.

As Betsy hopped around, she saw her friends playing in a nearby field. She wanted to play with them too, so she hopped over to join in the fun. Betsy showed her friends the shiny stone she found and they all thought it was very cool.

Together, they played games and laughed until the sun began to set. Betsy was happy she found the stone and even happier to have such great friends to play with. She knew it was going to be a great day when she woke up tomorrow. The end.

Anna loves to dance. She dances every day with her friends. They learn new moves and have fun. Anna wants to be a famous dancer when she grows up.

One day, Anna's teacher tells her that she has a special surprise for her. She says that a famous dancer is coming to visit their class. Anna is very excited. She wonders who it is and what they will do.

The next day, the famous dancer arrives. She is very pretty and graceful. She smiles and says hello to the class. She tells them her name is Maya and that she is here to teach them some new moves and give them a massage.

A massage? Anna does not know what that is. She asks Maya what a massage is. Maya explains that a massage is when someone rubs your muscles gently to make them feel good and relaxed. She says that dancers need massages to keep their bodies healthy and happy.

Anna thinks that sounds nice. She agrees to try a massage. Maya shows her how to lie down on a mat and covers her with a soft blanket. Then she starts to rub Anna's back, arms, legs and feet. Anna feels a warm and soothing sensation. She closes her eyes and sighs. She likes the massage. She feels very calm and cozy.

Maya tells Anna that she is doing great and that she is a very talented dancer. She says that she hopes to see her again someday. Anna thanks Maya for the massage and the lesson. She says that she hopes to be a famous dancer like her someday. Maya hugs Anna and tells her to keep dancing and dreaming. Anna smiles and hugs her back. She is very happy. She thinks that today is the best day ever.

Once upon a time there was a bunny named Binky. Binky wanted to build something special. He hopped to the store and saw a nice microphone. He wanted it for his house.

Binky asked the shopkeeper, "Can I build this with my hands?"

The shopkeeper smiled, "Of course you can. You need blocks and tools."

Binky hopped home and started to build. He put the blocks together and was really proud. He was finished! 

The microphone was shiny and perfect. Binky was so excited, he wanted to get something tasty to celebrate. He hopped to the bakery and bought some cookies. They were so yummy and sweet!

Binky decided to take a break and try out the microphone. He talked into it and heard his own voice, loud and clear! He was so happy.

Binky was so proud of his microphone. He had a tasty snack and was pleased with his work. Binky hopped home, ready for his next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a big stadium. It was where people went to watch sports games. One day, a little girl went to the stadium with her family. She saw the grass on the field and it was very green. She also saw a man with a hairy beard selling popcorn. 

The little girl really liked watching the game. She saw the players running and kicking the ball. She admired how fast they could move. When the game was over, the little girl and her family went home. She was very tired but happy because she had a fun day at the stadium.

Tim and Lily were playing in the yard. They liked to dig in the dirt and make mud pies. They were very dirty and happy.

"Tim, Lily, come inside!" Mom called from the door. "It's time for lunch!"

Tim and Lily ran to the door. They wanted to eat. They were very hungry.

"Stop!" Mom said. "You can't enter the house like that. You are filthy! Look at your clothes and your hands and your faces. You need to wash first."

"But Mom, we're hungry!" Tim said.

"And we're tired!" Lily said.

"I know, I know. But you can't sit on the couch or touch anything until you are clean. The couch is white and soft. You will make it dirty and brown. Go to the hose and rinse off. Then I will give you a towel and some soap. Then you can enter the house and eat."

Tim and Lily did what Mom said. They went to the hose and rinsed off. They rubbed their hands and faces with the towel and the soap. They threw their dirty clothes in a basket. They put on some clean clothes. Then they entered the house and ate.

Mom smiled and hugged them. "That's better. Now you are clean and hungry. Enjoy your lunch. And after lunch, you can play with your toys. But no more mud pies, okay?"

"Okay, Mom," Tim and Lily said. They ate their lunch and played with their toys. They did not make any more mud pies. They did not want to be filthy again. They liked the couch. It was white and soft.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She wanted to explore her world. So, she stepped onto a path. The path was organized and she felt excited. 

At first, she ran along the path. But then she started to pause. She noticed all the small things in her surroundings - the bugs crawling across the ground, the leaves on the trees, and the dewdrops from the morning glistening on the grass. 

She paused to pick a flower and put it in her pocket. Then she paused to look at the birds and hear their sweet songs. She paused to feel the sunlight on her skin. 

When she arrived at the end of the path, she felt like she had been on an adventure. She had experienced so many new things and discovered that exploring can be so much fun!

Once upon a time there was a kids named Tom. Tom was very brave and was always looking for a new adventure. One sunny day Tom decided to go outside. He wanted to feel the warm sunshine on his face.

Suddenly, there was a big rumble in the sky. It was loud and noisy. Tom looked up and saw bright lightning in the sky. He was so excited! He had never seen lightning before.

After watching for a few minutes, Tom decided it was time for an adventure. He wanted to find out more about the lightning. So he ran down the street and went to the park.

At the park he saw more lightening and heard thunder. He also saw a big tree. He remembered he had read about lightning and trees in a book. He thought that if he could touch the tree, he could complete his mission.

Tom made it to the tree, and with one hand, he touched the tree. As soon as he did, there was a big explosion of lightening and a huge roar of thunder. Tom was so happy! He had completed his mission. 

Tom knew not everything was as noisy and scary as lightning. He had completed his mission and felt brave and proud. He thanked the lightning, and ran back home with a big smile on his face.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big, rough tree with a peach on it. Tim wanted the peach, but it was too high for him to reach.

"Mom, can you help me get the peach?" Tim asked. His mom tried to reach it, but it was still too high. They needed something to change how high they could reach.

A kind man saw Tim and his mom, and he had a long stick. "Do you need help?" the kind man asked. Tim's mom said, "Yes, please! We want the peach but it is too high." The kind man used the stick to get the peach, and it fell down.

Tim was so happy to have the peach. He thanked the kind man, and shared the peach with his mom. They enjoyed the sweet peach together under the rough tree at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat popcorn. One day, he went to the store with his mom to buy some popcorn.

At the store, Tim saw a big bag of popcorn. He asked his mom if they could get it. His mom said yes. They went home, and Tim's mom made the popcorn. Tim was very happy.

But when Tim ate the popcorn, it was bitter. Tim did not like the bitter popcorn. His mom saw that he was sad. She said, "Don't worry, Tim. We will make new popcorn that is not bitter." They made new popcorn, and it was yummy. Tim became very happy and ate all the popcorn.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the garden with his spade. His spade was big and shiny, and he used it to dig holes in the ground.

One day, Timmy's friend Billy came to play. Billy wanted to borrow Timmy's spade, but Timmy didn't want to let him. Timmy said, "I don't trust you with my spade, Billy. You might break it."

But Billy promised he would take good care of the spade and return it when he was done. Timmy finally agreed and gave Billy the spade.

After a while, Billy came back with the spade, but it was all wet and dirty. Timmy was angry and said, "You didn't take care of my spade like you promised. Now it's all wet and dirty!"

Billy said sorry, but Timmy didn't forgive him. Timmy was so angry that he never spoke to Billy again. And that's the sad ending of Timmy and Billy's friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very independent, which meant she liked to do things all by herself.

One day Lucy was playing outside in her garden and her new friend Mary was there too. Mary had an iron and Lucy thought it was fun to watch it go up and down.

But then Mary started to tease Lucy and jiggle the iron around. Lucy didnâ€™t like it, so she took her iron away.

Mary felt sad that Lucy didnâ€™t want to play with her. But Lucy showed her that even though she was independent, she still wanted to be friends.

The two girls then laughed and played together with the iron. Lucy showed Mary how to make it go up and down without teasing her. They had lots of fun together and never let the iron tease them again.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat named Tim. Tim was a very comfortable cat. He liked to sleep on soft mats and play with his toys. One day, Tim saw a small box with ink inside. He was very curious about the box.

Tim called his friend, a small bird named Sue. "Sue, come see this box of ink!" Tim said. Sue flew to Tim and looked at the box. "Let's use the ink to make a sign," Sue said. They both thought it was a good idea.

Tim and Sue worked together to make a sign. They used the ink to draw pictures of their toys. When they finished, they hung the sign on a tree. All their friends came to see the sign and thought it was very pretty. Tim and Sue were very happy and proud of their work.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She liked to swim in the big lake near her house. Every day when the sun got up she would put on her swimming costume and run out to the lake. 

The lake was so big and there were lots of animals living in it. Sometimes she would take a bucket and fill it with water from the lake. She would pick up little sticks and stones and put them in the bucket.

One day when she was swimming, the little girl heard a noise. It was a bell ringing. She looked around and saw a little boat on the lake. On the boat there was a friendly man. He waved at the girl and said hello. He asked the girl if she wanted to take a ride in his boat. 

So the little girl jumped into the boat with the friendly man. They went all around the lake, past the animals, and even under bridges. The little girl had so much fun! 

When they got back to the shore the girl thanked the friendly man and got out of the boat. She waved goodbye to him and then ran home to tell her mommy all about her wonderful trip.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run and play with her friends. One day, she asked her mommy if they could race to the park. 

"Sure, Lily!" her mommy said. "But first, we need to get dressed. Let me help you put on your shirt and pants."

Lily giggled as her mommy pulled her shirt over her head. "My waist feels funny!" she said.

"That's because your shirt is a little too tight," her mommy explained. "I'll fix it for you."

After they got dressed, they raced to the park. The ground was rough and bumpy under their feet, but they didn't mind. When they got to the park, Lily's friends were already there. 

"Let's race to the swings!" Lily said to her friends.

"Okay!" they all shouted. And off they went, running as fast as they could. Lily's heart was pounding in her chest as she ran. It was so much fun!

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their cars and trucks. They have a big box of toys in their room. One day, their mom says they have to go to the store with her. She says they will buy some beef for dinner. Tom and Sam do not want to go. They want to stay and play.

"Can we stay, mom?" Tom asks.

"No, you have to come with me. It will not take long. You can play when we come back," mom says.

Tom and Sam are sad. They put on their coats and shoes. They follow mom to the car. They leave their toys in the box.

At the store, mom puts some beef and other things in the cart. Tom and Sam are bored. They look at the toys on the shelves. They see a big red fire truck. It has lights and sounds. They want to play with it.

"Can we have it, mom?" Sam asks.

"No, you have enough toys at home. Come on, we have to go," mom says.

Tom and Sam are mad. They do not want to leave the fire truck. They follow mom to the car. They get in the car.

On the way home, mom says she is sorry. She says she will make them a yummy beef stew for dinner. She says they can play with their toys after they eat. Tom and Sam are still mad. They do not say anything.

When they get home, they run to their room. They want to play with their cars and trucks. But when they open the box, they see nothing. The box is empty. Their toys are gone.

"Where are our toys?" Tom cries.

"Who took our toys?" Sam yells.

They hear a bark. They look out the window. They see their dog, Rex. Rex has their toys in his mouth. He is running around the yard. He is having fun.

"Rex!" Tom and Sam shout.

They run outside. They chase Rex. They try to get their toys back. But Rex is fast. He runs away. He hides under the porch. It is dark under the porch. Tom and Sam are scared. They do not want to go under the porch.

"Rex, come out!" Tom says.

"Give us our toys!" Sam says.

But Rex does not come out. He does not give them their toys. He barks. He likes his new toys.

Tom and Sam are sad. They miss their toys. They do not want to play with Rex. They go back inside. They do not want to eat beef stew. They do not want to do anything. They sit on the couch. They cry.

Mom sees them. She is sorry. She hugs them. She says she will buy them a new fire truck. She says she will teach Rex not to take their toys. She says she loves them.

Tom and Sam are happy. They hug mom. They say they love her. They say they will eat beef stew. They say they will play with Rex. They say they will share their toys.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a small girl named Mia. Every day, she asked her mom to go to the park.

Mom was always busy, so she said no. But one day, she said yes! Mom packed a sack full of snacks and toys.

Mia jumped with joy and they headed to the park. The park was very distant and they had to walk.

On the way there, they stopped to pick some flowers. Mia noticed a huge tree and asked her mom to climb it. 

But Mom said, "No! We have to hurry to the park."

So they kept walking. Soon, they arrived at the park. They ran around and played. Mia had the best day ever. 

When it was time to go home, they packed up their sack and headed back home. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her marbles. One day, she found a big, shiny marble that was very flexible. She could squish it and it would bounce back to its original shape. 

Lily decided to show her marble to her pet cat, Mittens. She fed Mittens some cat food and then showed her the marble. Mittens was very interested and Lily let her play with it for a little while. 

After a while, Lily took the marble back and put it in her pocket. She went outside to play with her friends and they all played with marbles together. Lily's friends were amazed by her flexible marble and they all wanted one too. 

Lily was happy to share her marble with her friends and they all had fun playing with it. When it was time to go home, Lily put the marble back in her pocket and said goodbye to her friends. She couldn't wait to play with her marble again tomorrow. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved holidays because they were fun and easy. One day, she went to the park with her family to gather some pretty flowers. She saw lots of colors like red, yellow, and blue. She picked them carefully and put them in a basket. When she got home, she showed her mom the flowers and they made a pretty bouquet together. Lily loved how easy it was to make something so beautiful!

Once upon a time there was a playful puppy, called Puppy. Puppy loved running and playing in the garden with his friend Ted. One day Ted had a special surprise for Puppy - a special blue case. When Ted opened the case, Puppy saw a beautiful toy inside. He nodded, so happy to get such a wonderful present!

Puppy liked playing with his toy. He would chase it around the garden and nuzzle it until it rolled away. One day, Puppy got so carried away playing with the toy that the case rolled away too. Puppy raced after it - it was just too precious to lose. He chased it, panting and yapping, until they both fell down in a heap.

Puppy looked up at Ted with a twinkle in his eye. Ted smiled back and nodded, knowing that both Puppy and his special blue case were safe. They were so happy that they played until the sun went down. With their favourite toy and special case both safe, their playful fun could continue another day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom gave her a weird-looking milk bottle. Lily didn't want to drink it because it looked strange. Her mom told her to try it anyway. Lily opened the bottle and took a sip. It tasted different than what she was used to, but it was actually quite good.

The moral of the story is to not judge things by their appearance. Just because something looks weird, doesn't mean it's bad. It's important to try new things and keep an open mind.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the jungle with his mom. They saw many big trees and colorful birds. Tim was very happy to be in the jungle. He liked to look at all the animals.

In the jungle, they found a huge, friendly elephant. The elephant said, "Hello! I am hungry. Can you help me find food?" Tim and his mom wanted to help the elephant, so they looked for food to feed him.

They found some big, green leaves for the elephant to eat. Tim said, "Here you go, Mr. Elephant! We found these leaves for you." The elephant ate the leaves and was very happy. He thanked Tim and his mom for their help. Tim and his mom smiled and waved goodbye as they left the jungle.

Once upon a time, two friends were walking through the woods. It was getting dark and it was getting scary. Suddenly the two friends heard a noise. It sounded like something was rising.

The two friends looked around and saw a card lying on the ground. It was glowing in the dark. One of the friends was brave and decided to pick it up. But when they touched it, the card began to rise.

The two friends were scared. They backed away slowly. The card kept rising until it stopped moving.

The brave friend stepped forward and said, "What are you?"

The card opened up and out floated a magical butterfly.

The two friends were so happy. The butterfly fluttered around them and then flew away. The friends learn that there was nothing to be scared of.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Lily. She loved to play hide-and-seek with her friends. One day, Lily was playing and she found a small wardrobe. She opened it and saw a beautiful dress inside. She tried it on and it was perfect for her!

Lily's friend, Tommy, saw her wearing the dress and said, "Wow, that's a pretty dress! Can I try it on too?" But Lily didn't want to share the dress because she loved it so much.

Later that night, Lily went to bed and dreamt about the dress. She dreamed that she was wearing it and everyone was complimenting her. But then she heard a voice saying, "Sharing is caring, Lily." She woke up and realized that she should have let Tommy try on the dress too.

The next day, Lily went to Tommy and apologized. She said, "I'm sorry for not sharing the dress with you. You can try it on now." Tommy was happy and they played together wearing the dress. Lily learned that sharing is important and it made her feel happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl. She was very foolish and always got into trouble. She often did things that she wasn't supposed to.

One day, she went to the zoo. She was looking at the animals and having a lot of fun. Then, she saw a big door. She wanted to open the door, but it was locked.

The young girl was determined, she didn't want to give up yet. She tried to find something to help her open the door. She searched everywhere, but couldn't find anything that could help.

After a while, she saw a long stick. She picked it up and used it to try to open the door. Suddenly, the door opened!

The young girl was so excited. She had opened the door! But she had been too foolish and now, she was in trouble. She quickly shut the door and ran away!

Once upon a time, there was a mother and her son. They were walking in the park together when the son suddenly spotted a bee flying around. He was excited and wanted to catch it. He reached for it and then decided to shoot it with his finger.

The mother got angry and scolded him for being careless. She said sternly, "No! You must never shoot a bee. It is not nice and you could hurt it. We should be careful and kind always."

The son felt sad but promised to never shoot a bee again. He hugged his mother tightly and said, "I'm sorry, mommy. I love you."

The mother smiled and kissed the top of his head. She said kindly, "It's okay sweetie. I love you too."

And they hugged and walked happily through the park together.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play together. One day, they want to travel to the sea. They ask their moms if they can go.

"Yes, you can go, but be careful and stay close to us," their moms say.

Anna and Ben are happy. They get in the car with their moms and drive to the sea. They see many things on the way. They see trees, flowers, cows, and birds.

"Look, Ben, the sea is blue and shiny!" Anna says when they arrive.

"Yes, and the sand is yellow and soft!" Ben says.

They run to the beach and play with the sand. They make a big castle with a yellow flag. They also find some shells and stones. They put them on the castle to make it pretty.

"Wow, your castle is so nice!" a girl says. She comes to Anna and Ben. She has a yellow hat and a yellow dress.

"Thank you! What is your name?" Anna asks.

"My name is Lily. I like your flag. Can I play with you?" the girl says.

"Sure, you can play with us. We are Anna and Ben. We are friends," Ben says.

They all play together and have fun. They travel to the sea and make a new friend. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bird named Blue. Blue was very friendly and loved to fly high in the sky. One day, Blue decided to soar to the top of a mountain. It was a big mountain, but Blue was determined to reach the top. 

As Blue flew higher and higher, the air got colder and the wind got stronger. But Blue didn't give up. Finally, Blue reached the top of the mountain and looked out at the beautiful view. 

Blue felt very proud of themselves for reaching the top of the mountain. From up there, everything looked so small. Blue realized that they could do anything they set their mind to. And so, Blue continued to soar through the sky, exploring new places and having many more adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass and look up at the sky. One day, she saw a mysterious object in the space above her. She wanted to reach it, but it was too high up.

Lily asked her mommy for help. Her mommy picked her up and they reached for the object together. It turned out to be a shiny balloon! Lily was so happy to have found it. She played with it all day long and even took it to bed with her at night.

From that day on, Lily always looked up at the sky, wondering what other mysterious things were up there. She knew that if she reached high enough, she might be able to find something else amazing.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a shy boy named Tim. Tim loved to help his mom in the kitchen. One day, while washing the dishes, Tim accidentally dropped a dish. The dish broke into pieces. Tim felt very sad.

Tim's mom heard the noise and came into the kitchen. "What happened, Tim?" she asked. Tim looked down and said, "I broke the dish, Mom. I'm sorry." His mom smiled and said, "It's okay, Tim. We can try to repair it together."

Tim and his mom picked up the pieces of the broken dish. They found some glue and started to repair the dish. Tim was very careful as he put the pieces back together. His mom helped him when he needed it. Soon, the dish was fixed and looked almost like new.

Tim felt happy that he could help repair the broken dish. His mom was proud of him for trying to fix his mistake. From that day on, Tim was not as shy in the kitchen and continued to help his mom with the dishes. And they both took extra care not to break any more dishes.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was only three years old. He was feeling very angry. He wanted to go to the bathroom. 

The little boy got up from his seat and walked out of the room. He went down the stairs and headed for the bathroom. 

When he got there, he opened the door and stepped inside. He was so excited to be there. But suddenly he heard a loud noise. It was coming from the toilet!

The little boy was very scared. He saw a big frog come out of the toilet. The frog looked angry.

"Ribbit!" said the frog. The little boy was shaking. He knew that frogs could not talk. 

The little boy said "Please go away. I just want to use the bathroom."

The frog said "Ribbit!" and then hopped away. 

The little boy was very relieved. He used the bathroom and went back upstairs. He was happy that he had faced his fears and been brave. He was no longer angry.

Jimmy was feeling fearful as he looked at the water. His mom took his hand and said, "Don't be scared, Jimmy. Let's go park by the water."

So, Jimmy and his mom began walking to the park. They saw other children playing and happy in the sunshine. There was a big slide and a swing.

Suddenly, the water didn't seem so scary anymore. Jimmy giggled and ran to the slide. He climbed up the stairs and waved to his mom as he went down the slide.

They stayed at the park for a long time, playing together and exploring the area. When it was time to go, Jimmy wasn't scared anymore. He waved goodbye and thanked his mom for taking him to the park.

Once upon a time there was a jungle that seemed very dry. All the leaves were brown, and there were no animals. But then one day a strange thing happened. 
A huge elephant appeared from the sky and landed in the middle of the jungle. He was big and friendly and had bright big ears and a big trunk. 
He used his trunk to grab leaves from the trees and sprinkle water all over the jungle. Soon the whole jungle seemed much greener and happier. 
The elephant stayed there, and all the animals came back to the jungle. The elephant looked around with a smile on his face. Suddenly, the jungle seemed full of life.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was happy and had many paint boxes in her bedroom. Every day, she enjoyed raising her paintbrushes and delighting in all the colors that the paint could make.

One day, the little girl felt nervous. She was scared of heights and wanted to get down from the wall, where she had been painting. But before she could climb down, there was a loud boom. The wall suddenly collapsed and the girl was trapped.

The little girl was sad and scared. But then, something amazing happened. Helpers quickly arrived to rescue her. They were able to set her free from the rubble.

After it was all over, the little girl was safe and sound. She never forgot the lesson she learned that day. No matter how much fun it is to raise paints and colors, one must always be careful and not take risks around heights.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and pick berries from her garden. One day, her mom asked her to go outside and pick some berries for dessert. Lily was so excited because she loved berries.

When she went outside, she saw that the berries were very dirty. She didn't want to bring them inside like that. So, she decided to wash them in the stream nearby. While she was washing the berries, she saw a little bird flying around. 

"Hi there little birdie, do you want to help me pick berries?" Lily asked.

"Tweet tweet, yes please!" the birdie replied.

Together, they picked the berries and washed them. Lily was so happy that she had a new friend to play with and that they could enjoy the delicious berries together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. Jane had a very mild nose, and she loved to nod her head. Jane lived on a farm with lots of animals, so every morning she would go outside and nod at them. She had lots of fun with her animal friends.

One day, Jane had a surprise waiting for her outside. It was a little kitten! Jane was so excited and she couldn't wait to nod at the kitten. She bent down and looked closely at the kitten and it nose was so mild and warm. Jane pet the kitten, and soon the little kitten was purring with happiness.

Every morning from then on, Jane would go outside and nod at the kitten. She would pet the little kitten and look into it's mild eyes. Jane and the kitten became best friends, and they had lots of fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a family who went on vacation to the beach. The sun was shining and the sand was warm. The little boy, named Timmy, was excited to play in the water. 

But Timmy's dad was grumpy. He didn't want to go to the beach. Timmy's mom tried to make him happy by making a sandcastle with Timmy, but he was still grumpy. 

Later that day, Timmy saw a man signing with his hands. Timmy didn't know what he was saying, but he thought it was cool. He tried to sign back, but he didn't know how. 

The next day, Timmy's dad surprised him by taking him to a sign language class. Timmy was so happy and he learned how to sign "vacation". From that day on, Timmy's dad wasn't grumpy anymore and they had a great vacation together.

Once upon a time, there was a King and a Queen who lived in a big castle. The King was a very thoughtful man who liked to give gifts to his Queen. One day, he gave her a beautiful, shiny jewel.

"It is so lovely," the Queen said when she saw the jewel. "I love it!"

The King smiled, happy that his gift had been so well-received. He then told the Queen a secret.

"This jewel has special magic. Whenever you feel sad and want to cry, all you have to do is look at it and it will make you feel better," he said.

The Queen was so happy. She thanked the King and put the jewel in her pocket.

The next day, the Queen was feeling sad and wanted to cry. She remembered the King's words and took out the jewel, but it did not work. She began to weep sadly and the King came to her side.

"What is wrong, my Queen?" he asked.

"The jewel does not work. I still feel sad," she replied.

The King looked at the jewel and he noticed that it was fake. He had been tricked by a thief!

The King and the Queen were very disappointed and they wept together. They had been so naive and careless, but it was too late. They had lost the real jewel and they could never get it back.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat yogurt because it was yummy and healthy. One day, Lily's mommy said to her, "Lily, it's time to take a bath. You will feel clean and jolly after!"

Lily didn't want to take a bath because she was having too much fun playing with her toys. But, her mommy said, "Come on, Lily. It's important to be clean so we can stay healthy. Plus, we can have more fun after you're all clean!"

So, Lily took a bath and her mommy helped her wash her hair and body. After her bath, Lily felt so fresh and clean. Her mommy gave her a big hug and said, "Now let's go have some more yogurt and play together!" Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love yogurt and playing with you, mommy!"

Mama was walking in the park with her daughter, Emma, who was three. Mama wanted to show her something special. Soon, they saw a big, bright billboard with beautiful plants on it.

Mama pointed to the billboard and said, â€œLook, Emma, that is so delicate!â€

Emma was amazed by how pretty and delicate the plants were. She jumped on the spot, full of joy. She asked, â€œMama, can we speed to it?"

Mama was happy to see how excited Emma was and said, â€œLetâ€™s go! We can speed down this path and reach it in no time.â€

They walked quickly and soon they reached the billboard. They looked at it carefully and Emma said, â€œMama, this is just so delicate!â€

And they both smiled, happy to have seen the beautiful billboard.

Once upon a time, there was a big truck. The truck was very loud and had many wheels. It was a vehicle that helped move things from one place to another. 

One day, a little bird was flying above the truck. The bird was very graceful and flew with ease. The bird wanted to measure how big the truck was, so it flew down and landed on the hood. 

The bird looked at the truck and saw that it was very long and tall. It was too big for the little bird to measure, but it was still very impressive. The bird flew away, feeling happy to have seen such a big and powerful vehicle.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Lily. She had a nice smile and loved to play with her toys. One day, she went to the park with her mom and dad. While playing, she lost her favorite toy bear. Lily looked all around the park but couldn't find it. She felt sad and wanted her bear back. Her parents tried to help her find it but they couldn't either. 

Lily went home feeling very upset. But the next day, her parents surprised her with a new teddy bear. It wasn't exactly the same as her old one, but it was still nice and soft. Lily was happy again and hugged her new bear tightly. She learned that even though she lost something she loved, she can still find happiness in other things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mandy who was very eager to learn how to tie her own shoes. Her mom had a ball of thread and she showed it to Mandy and said, "Look, this is thread. We can use it to tie your shoes."

Mandy was very excited and she said, "Yes! Let's do it!"

Mom grabbed the thread and started tying it around Mandy's shoelace. "Okay, see you have to pull the thread like this," she said, demonstrating for her.

Mandy watched intently and tried to follow what her mom was doing. After a few minutes, she got the hang of it and soon she was able to tie her own shoes! She was so proud and eager to show her mom what she had learned.

Mom was so proud of her and said, "That's wonderful, Mandy! Now you can tie your own shoes!" Mandy happily thanked her mom and showed her how she could tie her shoe.

After that, Mandy practiced tying her shoes every day until it became second-nature. Soon enough, she was able to tie her shoes with ease.

The end.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They saw a big machine near the fence. It had wheels and a long arm with a claw. Lily wanted to see it closer. She said to Tom, "Let's go to the machine. It looks fun."

Tom was scared. He said, "No, Lily. The machine is not for us. It is for the workers. It can move and hurt us. We should stay away."

But Lily did not listen. She ran to the machine and climbed on it. She pushed some buttons and pulled some levers. The machine started to move. The wheels turned and the arm swung. Lily laughed and shouted, "Look, Tom, I can make the machine move!"

Tom was very worried. He ran after Lily and tried to stop her. He said, "Lily, stop! You don't know what you are doing! The machine is dangerous! Come down now!"

But Lily did not hear him. She was too busy playing with the machine. She moved the claw and grabbed a big rock. She lifted it up and threw it. The rock flew in the air and landed on Tom. Tom fell down and cried. He was hurt. He had blood on his head and his leg.

Lily saw what she had done. She was shocked and scared. She jumped off the machine and ran to Tom. She said, "Tom, Tom, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to hurt you! Are you okay?"

But Tom did not answer. He was not okay. He was very hurt. He did not move. He did not breathe. He was dead.

Lily started to cry. She hugged Tom and said, "Tom, Tom, please wake up! Please don't be dead! I love you!"

But Tom did not wake up. He did not love her back. He was gone.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to go outside and play with his toys. One day, Timmy's mommy told him to come inside because it was getting dark outside. 

Timmy went inside and his mommy locked the door. Timmy asked his mommy why she locked the door and she said it was to keep them safe. 

The next morning, Timmy woke up early and saw the sunrise. He thought it was very pretty. But then he saw something weird in the sky. It was a bird with a funny hat on! Timmy laughed and told his mommy about the weird bird he saw. 

From that day on, Timmy always looked for the weird bird during the sunrise. And his mommy always locked the door to keep them safe. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a magic turtle named Toby. He lived in a big forest and loved it there.

One day, Toby was out walking and suddenly heard a loud noise. He knew it was an emergency!

Toby began to crawl away as quickly as he could to get to safety. Frightened, he got underneath a large rock and hid.
