From that day on, the butterfly would not resist the wind. Even when it became very strong, he was never afraid. He always remembered the kindness of the small ant and kept on flying.

Lily and Ben were hungry. They went to a big place with many tables and chairs. They saw a man with a white hat and a big smile. He gave them a menu.

"What do you want to eat?" he asked.

Lily looked at the menu. She saw pictures of food. She pointed at a picture of a pizza. "I want this," she said.

Ben looked at the menu. He saw words. He could not read them. He felt sad. He stretched his neck to see what Lily chose. He saw the pizza. He liked pizza. "I want this too," he said.

The man with the white hat nodded. He took the menu and went away. He said he would come back soon with the food.

Lily and Ben waited. They were very hungry. They looked around. They saw other people eating and talking. They saw a big window. They saw cars and trees and birds outside.

They also saw a big sign. The sign had words and a picture. The picture was of a red animal with sharp teeth and claws. The animal looked angry. It was a lion.

Lily and Ben did not know what the sign said. They did not know what a lion was. They thought it was a funny cat. They laughed.

The man with the white hat came back. He had a big tray. He put the tray on the table. He had two pizzas. He gave one to Lily and one to Ben. He also had a big cage. He put the cage on the floor. He had a surprise.

"Here is your food. Enjoy!" he said. "And here is your dessert. A special treat for you. A lion!"

He opened the cage. The lion came out. It roared. It was hungry too. It saw Lily and Ben. It saw the pizzas. It wanted to eat them all.

Lily and Ben were frightened. They screamed. They tried to run. But it was too late. The lion was faster. It jumped on the table. It knocked over the tray. It grabbed Lily and Ben. It bit them. It ate them.

The man with the white hat was not smiling anymore. He was shocked. He did not mean to hurt Lily and Ben. He wanted to make them happy. He thought they would like to see a lion. He did not know that lions were dangerous. He did not know that lions ate people.

He was sorry. He was very sorry. But it was too late. Lily and Ben were gone. The lion was full. The end.

Once upon a time in a big garden, there were two friends, Peter and Sarah. Peter had a special coat which he loved very much. But one day, he put the coat in the ground and started to bury it. 

"What are you doing?" said Sarah, surprised. 

"I'm burying my coat" said Peter.

"But why?" said Sarah, still confused.

Peter answered, "Because my coat is getting old and I'm feeling restless. I want to bury it so that I can get a new one." 

Sarah thought for a moment and said, "You should show respect for things that are old, even if they become useless. Some people don't even have old things to replace. You should have done something differently." 

Peter thought about this for a moment and agreed with Sarah. That day, he decided to forgive his coat, take it home and get it repaired.

The moral of the story is that we should learn to show respect and care for the things we have, even if they have become old and useless. The things we have can always be used for something.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily. She was very scared at night because she heard noises in her room.

One night, Lily heard louder noises coming from her closet. She was so scared that she started to cry. Then she heard a small voice coming from her closet.

"Help me, Lily," it said. "I need to escape from here."

Lily was even more scared but she was brave. She opened the closet and saw a little mouse. The mouse was scared too.

"Please help me," it said. "I'm trying to escape but I'm stuck here."

Lily was very brave and she reached her hand inside the closet to help the mouse. She grabbed the mouse gently and put it outside the window. 

The mouse was very happy and thanked Lily. Then it ran away into the night. 

Lily was happy that she had helped the mouse and she was no longer scared at night. She went to bed feeling brave and safe.

Once there was a large dog named Spot. Spot was very, very tired. He had been walking for hours. All he wanted to do was take a nap. 

Spot found a patch of soft, green grass to sleep on. He laid down, closed his eyes and soon he was fast asleep. 

While Spot was napping, some junk collectors came by. They had a large cardboard box. Inside the box were lots of shiny, interesting things. 

The junk collectors noticed Spot napping and decided to take a break too. They sat down near Spot and began chatting loudly. 

All of the sudden, Spot woke up! He was so startled. But Spot was a nice dog and he wagged his tail in a friendly manner. 

The junk collectors felt welcomed and they all began to laugh. They gave Spot a pat on the head and then went on their way, carrying the large box.

Spot was very happy. He was so glad that he had taken a nap in that special spot.

John was a very lucky boy. He had a teddy bear that he loved to hold. He called it his history bear because his parents told him it had come from his grandpa many years ago.

John's grandpa had been a brave soldier, so John's parents told him it was important to take care of his special bear. Whenever he held it, he was very grateful.

One day, John's parents took him to the beach. It was a lot of fun, but when he looked down, John heard a small squeak. There was a tiny white bunny! He gently picked it up and held it in his hands. 

John was so happy to have a new friend, he couldn't contain his excitement! He looked up at his parents with a beaming smile, delighted to have found his bunny. He knew it had its own special history and he was grateful to have it as a companion. 

From that moment on, the bunny and John were inseparable. He held it close to his heart, knowing it was a special part of his history.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia liked to play dress up with her clothes. She would put on pretty dresses and skirts. She liked to reveal her fashion to her friends. Her friends liked her fashion too. They would clap and say, "Wow, Mia! You look so nice!"

One day, Mia found a dirty, old dress in her closet. It was disgusting! It had mud and yucky stuff on it. Mia did not want to wear the disgusting dress. But she had an idea. She would clean the dress and make it pretty again.

Mia washed the dress in soapy water. She scrubbed and scrubbed until all the yucky stuff was gone. When the dress was clean, she put it on. It was not disgusting anymore. Mia revealed her new fashion to her friends. They clapped and said, "Wow, Mia! You look so nice!" And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play at the park. One day, he went to the park with his friend, Lily. They went to the slide and Timmy got on first. He slid down the slide and it was so much fun!

Lily wanted to slide too, but when she got to the top, she smelled something smelly. "Ew, what's that smell?" she asked. Timmy looked and saw that there was some smelly trash at the bottom of the slide. "Don't worry, I'll get it," said Timmy. He climbed down and picked up the trash, then threw it away. Now the slide was clean and Lily could slide down too. They both had so much fun sliding and playing together. The end.

Tiny was walking in the park when she noticed a big spring. It was so big and shiny, it made her jump! She ran over to it and touched it with her finger. The spring moved, so she touched it again. She laughed and started to bounce up and down on it.

When she looked up, she saw a boy. He was a little older than her, around five or six.

"Hi!" said Tiny.

"Hello," said the boy.

"What are you doing?" asked Tiny.

"I'm looking for something important," said the boy.

"What is it?" asked Tiny.

"It's a special spring," said the boy. "It's magic and it can make wishes come true."

Tiny was excited. "Do you think this is it?" she said, pointing to the big spring.

The boy smiled and nodded. "Yes, I think this is the one. Thank you so much for finding it," he said.

Tiny beamed. She was so happy to have helped the boy find something important. Then, she watched as the boy started to make his wish on the spring. When he was done, the spring glowed and a puff of magic sparkled in the air.

Tiny smiled. She was so glad she had helped the boy find such an important spring.

Once upon a time, there was a big red brick house. The house had many rooms and a big garden. One day, a sleepy cat came to the house and asked to come inside. The kind owner let the cat in and gave her some milk. The cat was very happy and went to sleep on a soft pillow. 

The owner of the house liked to build things with bricks. He had many bricks in his garden. He decided to add more bricks to his collection. He went outside and picked up many bricks. He stacked them up high and made a big tower. The tower was so tall that the cat woke up from her sleep and looked at it with big eyes. 

The owner saw the cat looking at the tower and smiled. He said, "Look at my tower of bricks! I added many bricks to it today." The cat purred and rubbed her head against the owner's leg. From that day on, the cat came to the big red brick house every day to play with the owner and look at the tower of bricks.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had long hair that always got tangled. One day, her mommy said, "Lily, let's comb your hair so it's not messy anymore."

Lily didn't like getting her hair combed because it hurt a little bit. But her mommy was very gentle and did it fast so it didn't hurt too much. "I love you mommy," said Lily.

"I love you too, sweetie," said mommy. "Now your hair looks so pretty and neat!"

Lily smiled and ran off to play with her toys. She felt happy and loved because her mommy took care of her and made her feel special.

Anna was very excited. Today was her birthday and she saw a big package on the table. She wanted to open it and see what was inside. She ran to the table and reached for the package.

But she was too fast and did not see the toy car on the floor. She stepped on it and stumbled. She fell down and hit her head on the table. She cried out loud. It hurt a lot.

Mom and Dad heard her cry and came to see what happened. They saw Anna on the floor and the package on the table. They picked her up and hugged her. They said, "It's okay, Anna. You are brave. We have a surprise for you."

They gave her the package and helped her open it. Inside was a beautiful doll with a pink dress and a hat. Anna smiled and forgot her pain. She loved the doll and thanked Mom and Dad. They said, "Happy birthday, Anna. We love you."

They all sat on the couch and played with the doll. They were very happy and quiet. They did not want to make more noise and wake up the baby. They had a nice birthday party.

Once upon a time, there was a great cave deep in the forest. The entrance was surrounded by huge trees, and if you looked carefully, you could see a light in the darkness. Inside the cave, lived an old woman. 

Every morning, the old woman would walk out of the cave and into the forest. She would remind the animals that no matter the future, it was important to live together in peace and harmony. 

One day, the old woman's peacefulness was challenged. A strange creature, covered in dark fur and cold eyes, appeared in the forest. The creature threatened the old woman, saying that if the animals would not become its slaves, it would wipe out the entire forest. 

The old woman, however, refused to be afraid. She told the creature that in dark times like these, it was more important than ever to live in peace and unity. Reminding the creature of the importance of living together peacefully, the old woman bravely walked back to her cave. 

The creature vanished, and nobody ever saw it again. The old woman's bravery and the reminder to live in peace and unity remained in the forest, and the animals remained great friends. From this story, we can remind ourselves always to stay united, even when the future is uncertain.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to draw and color. He was very creative. One day, Timmy decided to draw a cactus. He used lots of green and brown colors to make it look real. 

After he finished, Timmy's mom asked him if he wanted to go to the park. Timmy was very excited and rushed to put on his shoes. At the park, Timmy saw lots of other kids playing. He wanted to play too, so he ran to the swings and started swinging back and forth. 

After a while, Timmy got tired and decided to rest under a big tree. He looked up and saw some birds flying in the sky. Timmy thought they looked very free and happy. He decided to draw them too. Timmy was very proud of his drawings and couldn't wait to show them to his family when he got home.

One day, Rosa's parents invited her to a breakfast party. She was so excited. Rosa jumped out of bed and ran to the kitchen. It was a bright morning and the sun was shining in through the windows.

Rosa's dad had made pancakes and there were lots of other fun things to eat. She had some of her favorite cereal with milk and a piece of toast with peanut butter.

Then, Rosa's mom handed her a big surprise! It was an alarm clock! Rosa was so happy. She loved the bright colors on the clock and that it made a ringing noise when it was time to wake up. 

Rosa hugged her parents and thanked them for the wonderful surprise. She knew it would help her wake up in the morning so she could have breakfast with them. It was definitely the best way to start the day!

Once upon a time, there was a patient little boy who had a very rough day. He was walking down the street, feeling very worried.

Suddenly, he saw a big, mean dog running towards him. He started to worry even more and he quickly closed his eyes. 

The dog came up to him and said, "What are you so worried about?"

The patient little boy replied, "I'm worried that the day is only going to get worse."

The dog said, "Ahh, don't worry so much. It'll be alright." But it wasn't alright; the little boy kept worrying until finally he burst into tears. 

The dog looked at the little boy sadly and said, "Well, I hope things get better for you soon." 

But unfortunately, things didn't get better. The little boy was never able to go outside again and didn't ever stop worrying. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer who had a unique chicken. This chicken was different from all the other chickens because it had rainbow feathers. One day, the farmer needed to lift a big bag of corn but he couldn't do it alone. The unique chicken saw the farmer struggling and decided to help. It flapped its wings and lifted the bag of corn with ease. The farmer was amazed and grateful for the chicken's help. From that day on, the unique chicken became the farmer's favorite and was treated with extra love and care.

Once upon a time there was a very special store. The store was very delicate and everything was carefully placed inside it.

One day a little girl went inside the store and saw all the toys and treats. She was so excited and could not wait to see what was inside. She ran around taking all the different things off the shelves and filling up her sack.

Suddenly one of the store owners came and said: "Why are you taking those things? Those are not for you!!"

The little girl was surprised and told the store owner: "I was just looking. I'm sorry, I didn't know." 

The store owner smiled and said: "That's ok. But remember, we all should be careful when we go shopping, so we don't break anything." 

The little girl nodded and thanked the store owner before she left with her sack full of things. She was careful to not touch anything delicate and left the store with a skip in her step!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to watch videos. One day, her mom showed her a funny video of a cat playing with a ball of yarn. Lily laughed and laughed at the silly cat.

Later that day, Lily went to the park with her mom. They saw a group of kids playing on the swings. One of the kids had a mild cold and was sneezing a lot. Lily's mom reminded her to cover her mouth when she sneezed, so she wouldn't get sick too.

As they were leaving the park, Lily saw the same kid from the swings walking with his mom. She remembered how he sneezed a lot and she felt bad for him. So, she ran up to him and showed him the funny cat video on her mom's phone. The kid laughed and laughed, and Lily felt happy that she could make him feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy was playing with his favorite toy car when he accidentally broke it. He felt sad and didn't know what to do.

Timmy's mom saw that he was upset and asked him what happened. Timmy told her that he broke his toy car. His mom hugged him and said, "It's okay, accidents happen. Let's try to fix it together." They tried to fix the car, but it was still broken.

Timmy's mom decided to take him to the university to see if they could fix the car. At the university, they met a kind and honest professor who was happy to help. He fixed the car and Timmy was overjoyed. From that day on, Timmy learned that it's always good to be honest and that there are always people who are willing to help when things break.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear pretty jewelry, especially her shiny necklace with a heart-shaped pendant. One day, Lily and her mommy went to the park to play. It was a cold day, so Lily wore her warm coat.

While playing, Lily saw a big dog with a red collar. The dog was friendly and Lily petted him. The dog's owner, an old man, said to Lily, "Be careful, that dog likes to mark his territory." Lily didn't understand what "mark" meant, but she smiled and continued to play.

Suddenly, the dog jumped on Lily and bit her necklace. The necklace broke and fell on the ground. Lily started crying and her mommy came to help her. The old man apologized and said he didn't know his dog would do that. Lily's mommy took her home and tried to fix the necklace, but it was broken beyond repair. Lily was sad and never wore jewelry again.

Once upon a time there was a humble girl who liked to paint. She wanted to go on an adventure, so she picked up her paintbrush and went to the forest. There, she found a small weapon with a bright handle. She thought it looked just like something an explorer would have. So she picked it up and painted a big â€˜Xâ€™ on it.

The girl was so happy to have her own weapon that she couldn't stop smiling. She ran around the forest coloring everything in sight with her paintbrush. She painted trees, rocks, and even a big log. She made the forest so pretty.

When she finished, the humble girl was so proud of her work. Before she left, she stood in the middle of the forest and twirled her weapon around as she smiled. She was so happy that she wanted to stay in the forest forever. But night was coming and she had to go home.

So with her weapon in one hand and her paintbrush in the other, she set off for home, looking forward to the next dayâ€™s adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. Jack loved to play baseball with his friends. They would throw the ball and hit it with a bat. Jack was very good at it and he always had fun.

One day, Jack was feeling upset. He didn't know why, but he just felt sad. His mom noticed and asked him what was wrong. Jack told her that he was feeling upset and didn't know why.

His mom gave him a big hug and said, "It's okay to feel upset sometimes. Let's go outside and play some baseball. That always makes you feel calm and happy." Jack smiled and went outside to play with his friends. Playing baseball made him forget about feeling upset and he had a lot of fun. Jack realized that he loved playing baseball and it always made him feel better.

Lily and Tom were best friends. They liked to play in the park with their toys. One day, they saw a big pile of waste near the swings. It was dirty and smelly and had many things that they did not want.

"Who made this waste?" Lily asked. "It is not good for the park."

"I don't know," Tom said. "But we can help to clean it up. We can support the park and make it nice again."

They got some bags and gloves from their moms and started to pick up the waste. They put it in the bags and tied them up. They worked hard and had fun. They felt mighty and proud.

Soon, the pile of waste was gone. The park looked clean and green. Lily and Tom smiled and hugged each other. They had supported the park and made a difference.

The end.

Once there was a brave little fox. The fox loved luxury things and wanted one very badly. One day, the fox saw a beautiful and luxurious fur on the ground. It was very soft. The fox wanted it desperately, so it decided to pinch it and take it home with him.

The fox was very happy when he got home. He put the fur in his den and sat atop it. Suddenly, there was a loud noise outside. The fox ran to the window and saw a big, hungry wolf. It started growling and ran towards the fox.

The fox was very brave and defended his fur from the wolf. Unfortunately, the wolf managed to grab the fur and took it away. The fox was very sad. He had lost his luxurious fur. He had been very brave, but he still couldn't keep it.

Once upon a time, there was a famous plane. It belonged to a very special family. One day, the dad wanted to take the plane on an adventure, so he called his two little children.

"Come on, everyone! We are going to fly in the plane!"
The two children were very excited, so they quickly ran to their Dad.

Once they were all in the plane, the dad asked his two children a question.
"Where would you like to go?" he asked.

The two children quickly answered: "The beach!"

The dad smiled. "Let's go!" 

So the dad and his children went to the beach for a special adventure. They had so much fun, and the famous plane took them back home at the end of the day. 

The children loved it and they always remembered the adventure with the famous plane.

Once there was a girl who was very troubled. Every time it rained she was so sad. She had a special friend who wanted to make her feel better. So her friend gave her a spade and said, "Let's go and play together!"

The girl and her friend ran outside to the garden. The rain had made it very wet, but the girl was still smiling. She started using the spade to scoop out big holes in the ground and filled them with water. She and her friend watched as the water turned into muddy puddles.

When the puddles were full, the girl and her friend had a wonderful time jumping in them and making a big splash! The girl thought it was the best fun she ever had.

Once all the puddles had been soaked up, the sun came out and warmed the garden. The girl was now feeling even happier because she wasn't so troubled anymore. She and her friend began to relax in the sun and enjoy the day.

Once upon a time, in a big pond, there lived an alligator. His name was Al. Al was an incredible alligator who had many friends.

One day, Al and his friends played in the pond. They splashed and laughed. The sun was warm and everyone was happy. Al's friends were glad that he was so incredible and fun.

As the sun went down, Al and his friends went home. They said "bye" and hugged. Al was happy to have such good friends. The end.

A little girl named Lucy was taking a walk with her mom. As they walked, they noticed an interesting sign. It was a big, colorful sign with pictures. Lucy asked her mom what the sign said, and her mom told her that it was a 'fast food' sign. Lucy was excited, she had never been to a 'fast food' place before. 

Lucy and her mom continued walking, but soon they stopped in front of a bright red building. It had a big yellow sign that said 'Fast Food'. Lucy was so happy, and she asked her mom if they could go in. Her mom said yes, and they walked inside. 

Inside, there were lots of people. Some were sitting down, eating food. Other people we're standing in line waiting for their food. There were lots of delicious smells in the air. 

Lucy and her mom waited in line until it was their turn. Lucy was so excited. She said she wanted to get a cheeseburger and french fries. Mom said that sounded delicious, so Lucy took out some money and paid for the food.

After Lucy and her mom finished their meal, Lucy took one last look at the 'fast food' sign and said goodbye. She couldn't wait to come back and take a visit again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the garden and watch the vegetables grow. One day, he saw a big, red tomato that looked so yummy. He picked it and it was very dirty, so he washed it and ate it.

The next day, Timmy went back to the garden and saw a big, round pumpkin. He wanted to spin it around and around, but it was too heavy. So, he decided to spin around himself instead. He spun and spun until he got dizzy and fell down.

Later that day, Timmy started to feel sick. His tummy hurt and he felt very filthy. His mom took him to the doctor, but it was too late. The tomato he ate was not clean and made him very sick. Timmy learned a lesson to always wash his vegetables before eating them.

Once upon a time, there was a dirty person named Tom. Tom liked to scare people for fun. He would hide behind trees and jump out to say, "Boo!"

One day, Tom saw a little girl named Sue. He thought, "I will scare her too!" So, he hid behind a tree and waited for Sue. When Sue walked by, Tom jumped out and said, "Boo!" Sue cried and ran away.

Tom laughed and went home. But that night, a big storm came. The wind blew and the rain fell. Tom's house fell down because it was old and dirty. Tom was scared and sad. He wished he had been nice to Sue and others.

Once upon a time, there was an intelligent dog named Buddy. Buddy loved to watch videos on the big box with his family. He would sit and wag his tail, happy to see the fun pictures on the screen.

One day, Buddy heard a whistle outside. He jumped up and ran to the door. He wanted to find out who was making the fun sound. Buddy's family opened the door, and he ran outside to play.

Buddy found a little girl with a whistle. She blew the whistle, and Buddy ran to her. They played together all day, running and laughing. Buddy was happy to have a new friend. At the end of the day, they went inside to watch a video together.

Once there was a big, attractive garden with lots of different plants and vegetables growing. One patch of the garden was filled with broccoli. Every day, the broccoli would get bigger and bigger. 

One day, a little boy was walking by the garden when he saw the broccoli patch. He thought it looked very tasty and started to yell out loud, "I want to eat the broccoli!" 

The gardeners heard him and came running over to see what the ruckus was. The little boy was so excited that he pointed at the broccoli and shouted again, "That's what I want to eat!"

The gardeners started to laugh and said, "Well, this broccoli is still too small to eat. Wait a few more weeks and it will get bigger. Then you can come back and try it!"

The little boy thanked the gardeners and ran off to tell his family about the delicious broccoli he had seen in the garden. From then on, he visited the garden every day and watched the broccoli get bigger and bigger. Finally, it was big enough to eat, and he couldn't wait to try it!

Molly was a very modest girl. She loved to do fun things that would excite her.

One day, when Molly was playing outside, she felt something weird on her skin. It was a butterfly!

Molly could hardly believe it! She was so excited that a beautiful butterfly was able to sit on her arm.

The butterfly was so light and delicate. Molly was careful not to move too much, so the butterfly could stay on her arm.

When the butterfly flew away, Molly was sad but also happy. She couldn't believe that the butterfly had been on her skin!

Tommy loved ice cream. He liked to feel the cold and sweet in his mouth. He liked to lick the cone and make it last. He liked to choose different flavors every time.

One day, he went to the park with his mom. He saw a big ice cream truck. He ran to it and asked for a cone. The man gave him a cone with three scoops: chocolate, vanilla and strawberry. Tommy was very happy. He thanked the man and paid with his mom's money.

He walked back to his mom, holding his cone carefully. He saw a little girl on a bench. She had no ice cream. She looked sad. Tommy felt sorry for her. He wanted to share his ice cream with her. He walked to her and said, "Hi, I'm Tommy. Do you want some of my ice cream? It's delicious."

The little girl smiled. She said, "Hi, I'm Lily. Thank you, that's very nice of you. I would love some of your ice cream." She took a lick of the strawberry scoop. She said, "Mmm, this is my favorite flavor. You are very kind, Tommy."

Tommy and Lily became friends. They shared the cone and talked. They had fun. Tommy's mom saw them and smiled. She was proud of Tommy. She knew he had a big heart. She thought, "Sharing is caring. Tommy learned a good lesson today."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play baseball with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend threw the ball too hard and it hit him in the hand. Timmy's hand hurt a lot and he couldn't play anymore. 

Timmy's mom took him to the doctor. The doctor said Timmy's hand was okay, but he needed to wear a special glove to make it feel normal again. Timmy didn't like the glove because it was big and bulky. 

One day, while playing with his friends, Timmy accidentally dropped his glove. The ball rolled far away and his friends couldn't find it. Timmy was sad because he thought he wouldn't be able to play anymore. But then, one of his friends found the glove and released it to Timmy. Timmy was so happy and put the glove back on. He felt normal again and was able to play with his friends.

Sara and Ben were playing in the garden. They saw a big red strawberry on a green plant. Sara wanted to pick it and eat it.

"Can I have the strawberry?" Sara asked Ben.

Ben shook his head. "No, it is mine. I saw it first."

Sara felt sad. She liked strawberries very much. She looked at the strawberry. It was shiny and juicy. She wanted to taste it.

"Please, Ben, can we share it?" Sara begged.

Ben thought for a moment. He liked Sara. She was his friend. He did not want to make her sad. But he also liked strawberries. He wanted to eat it all.

"Okay, we can share it. But be careful. The strawberry is delicate. It can break easily." Ben said.

Sara smiled. She was happy. She thanked Ben. They carefully picked the strawberry. They broke it in half. They each took a bite. The strawberry was sweet and yummy. They enjoyed it.

They looked at each other. They were both happy. They hugged. They did not mind sharing. Sharing was good. They decided to look for more strawberries together. They had fun in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny was very hungry and wanted to find some food to eat. He went outside and found a big field with lots of celery growing.

Benny hopped over to the celery and started munching on it. Suddenly, he heard a voice behind him. "Hey there, little bunny! Can you lead me to the nearest carrot patch?" It was a little mouse named Mickey.

Benny replied, "Sure thing! Follow me!" and he led Mickey to the carrot patch. They both ate until they were full and happy. Benny was no longer hungry and Mickey was grateful for his help. They became good friends and went on many adventures together.

Once upon a time there was a group of people. They wanted to eat something tasty and easy. So they decided to eat some yummy bananas. Each person picked up a ripe banana and started to eat. They all enjoyed this delicious snack.

The bananas had a sweet taste and were crunchy. They were so easy to eat, that the group finished in no time. Everybody was so happy, they jumped and cheered.

The group was so full, they could not eat anymore. Everyone had a fun time eating their bananas. They went away happy, hoping to eat more bananas soon. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to dance to jazz music. He would jump up and down and twirl around whenever he heard it. One day, Timmy's mom told him to clean up his toys, but Timmy didn't want to. He thought it was more fun to dance to jazz music. 

But then, his mom said if he didn't clean up, she would have to punish him. Timmy didn't like the sound of that. He knew that punishment meant he would get in trouble and maybe not be able to dance to jazz music anymore. So, he quickly cleaned up his toys. 

After he was done, his mom was happy and told him he could dance to jazz music as much as he wanted because he was such a good boy. Timmy felt happy and harmless, knowing that he did the right thing and didn't get punished. From that day on, he made sure to clean up his toys before dancing to jazz music.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Joy. She was three years old and full of energy! Every morning she would wake up, put on her favourite dress and go to the park.

As soon as she arrived, she saw all her friends. They played together and shared lots of laughs. All the children were very competitive playing tag and racing each other.

In the afternoon they decided to stir something special. Joy and her friends took out a big bowl, flour, sugar and eggs. They worked very hard stirring together.

When the baking was finished, they all took a big bite and the tasted delicious! Everyone cheered and there were big smiles. Joy knew her friends were always welcome.

Chloe was walking down the street. It was a sunny day, and Chloe felt open and happy. Suddenly, she heard a noise from her left.

"What was that?" Chloe muttered. She looked around, but she couldn't see the source of the noise.

Chloe decided to take a closer look. She followed the sound until she saw a cute little puppy. The puppy was sitting by itself in a patch of grass, looking very sad.

Chloe decided to speak to the puppy: "Why are you so sad?" she asked.

The puppy looked at Chloe with its big, brown eyes. "I'm lost," it said.

Chloe smiled. She knew just what to do. "Let's relax together," she said. Chloe and the puppy both lay down in the grass, and the puppy's sadness slowly disappeared.

Chloe sat up and the puppy followed her lead. "Come with me, and I'll help you get home," Chloe said.

The two of them walked down the street, hand in hand. Chloe opened the door to her house, and the puppy ran inside.

Chloe knew the puppy would be safe there until she could help it get back home.

Once there was a little girl named Rachel who liked to wear her favorite skirt. It was white, with tiny flowers stitched on it. Rachel would twirl and spin around in her skirt, feeling very happy.

One day, Rachel wore her favorite skirt to the park. She was feeling very careless, running and laughing without paying attention to where she was going. When she got to the swings, Rachel accidentally stepped on a big mud puddle. Her skirt was now covered in mud!

Rachel was very upset and started to cry. She didn't want to get in trouble for ruining her skirt. So she decided to lie to her mom and tell her the mud was already on the skirt when she found it.

Rachel was filled with guilt, but she still kept lying. Every time her mom asked about the mud, she just said: "It was already there when I found it."

Rachel was relieved when her mom believed her story. She knew she was wrong to tell such a careless lie. From then on, Rachel was more careful and tried not to tell any lies.

John and Mary were very excited. They had been looking forward to dinner all day. They hoped for something yummy. 

Tonight, their parents made something special for dinner. It was spaghetti! It smelled great and it looked delicious. 

John and Mary both smiled as they started eating their dinner. They loved spaghetti and their parents had made it very well.

John and Mary enjoyed their dinner. They finished all the spaghetti and then asked for more. They hoped they would get more. 

Their parents smiled. They said they would make more spaghetti the next night. That made John and Mary very happy, and they thought it was great.

Anna was sleeping in her bed. She had a big test today at school. She wanted to do well and make her teacher happy. But she was also a little scared. What if the test was too hard? What if she forgot what she learned?

She heard her mom call her name. "Anna, wake up! It's time to get ready for school!"

Anna opened her eyes and rubbed them. She saw her mom smiling at her. She also saw her favorite dress on the chair. It was pink and had flowers on it. Anna liked pink and flowers. They made her feel nice.

"Good morning, sweetie," her mom said. "Are you ready for your test?"

Anna nodded. She got out of bed and hugged her mom. "Yes, mom. I studied a lot. I know my ABCs and my numbers and my colors."

"That's great, Anna. I'm very proud of you. You are a smart and brave girl. You can do anything you set your mind to."

"Thank you, mom. You are the best mom ever. You always help me and love me."

Anna and her mom kissed and smiled. They went to the bathroom and brushed their teeth. Then they had breakfast and packed Anna's backpack. Anna put on her nice dress and her shoes. She was ready to go to school and take her test. She was not scared anymore. She was excited and confident. She knew she would do well and have fun. She hugged her mom again and said goodbye. She got on the bus and waved to her mom. She was happy and looking forward to her day.

Once there was a nice girl. She wanted to ride on a whip. Every day she would seem out her window and wish that she had a whip to ride on. One day it seemed like her wish was answered. She woke up to see a nice whip parked outside her house! She was so happy. She quickly ran outside and jumped on the whip. She held on tight and started to ride around the city. Everyone seemed to be so happy to see her on the whip. She was having the best time of her life. She had so much fun that the sun started to set before she even noticed the time had passed. She smiled and waved goodbye to the nice people she had met on her journey and made her way home. The whip seemed to take her back faster than before. She parked it and went inside with a joyful heart. From that day on she never stopped riding her whip. It was the best gift ever!

Once upon a time, there was a kind little boy named Jack. Every day, he loved to number the clouds in the sky. One day, Jack noticed something strange. He was counting the clouds from the sink!

Jack was confused - why was he counting clouds from the sink? He decided to investigate. As he looked in the sink he realized that the entire sink was full of clouds! 

Jack was very sad. He wanted to play with the clouds, but he didn't know how to get them out of the sink. So he called out for help and luckily, his mom came running.

Mom was very kind and she helped Jack by getting all the clouds out of the sink. She made sure that Jack could play with the clouds. Jack was thankful and counted the clouds one more time before they went back to the sky. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a deaf bird. He wanted to fly, but he couldn't. One day, he looked out of his nest to see a big pond. He flew over to it and saw that the water was very still. He went for a dip in the pond and found that he could hear! He was so excited to hear the sound of the birds chirping and the wind rustling the trees. After he swam around for a while, he flew back to his nest, feeling so happy and free. From that day on, the deaf bird could fly and hear all the beautiful sounds of nature.

Once there was a fair otter. She loved to swim in the river. Every day she would float and glide in the cool water. She enjoyed feeling the peaceful current.

One day she swam upstream until she reached a big waterfall. It was so large! She was scared, but she wanted to see what was on the other side.

So the brave otter took a deep breath and jumped into the waterfall. She swam and swam. Finally, she made it over the waterfall.

On the other side, the otter discovered a beautiful lake. She swam and swam around the lake. It was so calm and peaceful. She was so happy she had taken the brave jump! From then on, she visited the lake every day and swam around.

The fair otter would always remember that day. She swam and had so much fun in the lake. It was her very own special place!

Alex had a great garden. He liked to play there all the time. One day, Alex wanted to record everything in his garden so he could remember it. He wanted to remember how much fun he had playing there.

Alex found some paper and a pencil. He looked around his garden and began to draw. He drew the big tree and the flowers. He drew the swings and the slide. He also drew the birds and the bugs he saw there.

Finally, Alex was done recording his garden. He put down his pencil and looked at his drawing. He was so proud of what he had done. It was a great record of his garden. He knew he could remember all of his fun times in the garden with this picture.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color with her crayons. One day, she decided to make a picture of a wild animal. She drew a big square for the animal to live in.

Her mom came in and said, "What a nice picture, Lily! What animal is that?"

"It's a lion," said Lily proudly.

Her mom smiled and said, "Let's cut it out and put it on the fridge!"

Lily was so happy and they cut out the lion together. It looked so nice on the fridge that Lily's dad came in and said, "Wow, that's amazing! Did you draw that, Lily?"

Lily nodded and said, "I drew a wild lion in a square!"

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max was a guard dog who lived in a small house. He was a restless dog who liked to run and play all day.

One sunny day, Max was playing outside with his friend, a little girl named Lily. Lily said, "Max, let's sit under the tree and rest." Max wagged his tail and they both sat under the tree.

As they sat, Max heard a noise. He stood up, looked around, and saw a little lost kitten. Max and Lily decided to help the kitten find its way home. They all walked together and soon, the kitten was back with its family. Max, the guard dog, felt happy and proud that he could help his new friend.

Tommy was at the park with his mommy. He wanted to explore but he was scared to go too far away. So he stayed close by and played on the swings. 

He watched as a regular yellow chair arrived on a truck. His mommy said it was for the park. Tommy thought it looked fun and wondered what he could do with it. 

He called over to his mommy and she said it was ok for him to sit on the chair. Tommy ran over and hopped on it. It was so comfortable and he loved how the sun felt on his face. 

He spent the whole day in the regular yellow chair, watching the birds and playing with some of the other kids. When it was time to go, Tommy was sad to leave but he was excited to come back and get to play on the chair again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she wanted to go to the park. Lily was very enthusiastic and said "yes, please!" So, Lily's mom helped her dress in her favorite pink dress.

When they arrived at the park, Lily saw a man selling grapes. She asked her mom if she could have some grapes. Her mom said yes and they went to buy some grapes. They were very sweet and juicy!

After eating the grapes, Lily saw a little boy playing with a ball. She went up to him and said "Hi, my name is Lily. Do you want to play with me?" The little boy said "Yes, I would love to play with you!" So, they played together for a while and had a lot of fun.

When it was time to go home, Lily's mom asked her if she had a good time. Lily said "Yes, I had so much fun! I made a new friend and ate yummy grapes." Her mom smiled and said "I'm glad you had a good time." And they went home, happy and tired from a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to collect shiny rocks and pretty flowers. One day, she went for a walk with her mom and found a big, sparkly rock. It was difficult to pick up because it was heavy, but Lily was determined to add it to her collection.

As they continued their walk, Lily's mom noticed that she was having trouble breathing. She asked Lily if she was okay, but Lily just shrugged her shoulders. When they got home, Lily's mom took her to the doctor. The doctor said that Lily had a problem with her lung, and she needed to take some medicine to help her breathe better.

Lily was scared, but her mom reassured her that everything would be okay. She held Lily's hand as they walked to the pharmacy to collect the medicine. When they got home, Lily took her medicine and felt much better. She added her new sparkly rock to her collection and showed it to her mom. "Look, mommy! It's so pretty!" she exclaimed. Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, it is. And so are you, my sweet Lily."

Once upon a time, there was a little ant named Andy. He loved to crawl around and explore the world. One day, he met a friendly ladybug named Lily. 

"Hi there, Andy!" said Lily. "What are you up to today?" 

"Just crawling around, looking for something special," replied Andy. 

As they continued on their way, they saw a big, juicy strawberry in the distance. 

"That looks like an ordinary strawberry," said Lily. 

But Andy had a feeling that it was anything but ordinary. He crawled closer and closer until he was right next to the strawberry. Suddenly, he saw something shiny and sparkly inside the strawberry! 

"Look, Lily!" he exclaimed. "It's a treasure!" 

Together, they carefully dug out the treasure and found a beautiful diamond. From that day on, Andy and Lily crawled around together, looking for more treasures to discover.

Ben and Mia are playing in the garden. They see a big fat frog near the pond. Ben wants to touch it, but Mia says no.

"Don't touch the frog, Ben. It is poison. It can make you sick," Mia says.

Ben does not listen. He runs to the frog and tries to catch it. The frog jumps away and leaves a white spot on Ben's hand.

"Ow, ow, ow! It hurts!" Ben cries. He shows his hand to Mia.

Mia is scared. She remembers what mom said. "If you touch a poison frog, you have to wash your hand with water and soap. Or you have to go to the doctor."

Mia takes Ben to the house. She turns on the tap and washes Ben's hand. She puts some soap on it and rubs it. She rinses it with more water.

"Is it better now, Ben?" Mia asks.

Ben nods. His hand does not hurt anymore. He is sorry he did not listen to Mia.

"Thank you, Mia. You are a good sister. I will not touch a poison frog again," Ben says.

Mia smiles. She hugs Ben. She is glad he is okay.

They go back to the garden. They play with their toys. They do not go near the pond. They do not want to see the fat frog again.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful boat. It was called the Sailboat. One day, the Sailboat wanted to go somewhere special. He sailed away to a very big school. Everything at the school was huge! He huffed and he puffed as he sailed up to the school. He met lots of children who were learning and playing in the school. He even said hello to the teacher. The teacher was so happy to see the Sailboat. The teacher and the children gave the Sailboat lots of hugs and cuddles. Then, he sailed away waving goodbye to his new friends. The Sailboat was so excited for his next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. One day, Lucy went to play with her friends in the park. The sky was very blue, but the wind was a little harsh. Lucy felt cold, but she still wanted to play.

While playing, Lucy saw a big tree. She thought it would be fun to call it a "network tree" because all her friends could play and talk under it. So, she told her friends, "Let's go to the network tree!" They all ran to the tree and started to play.

But then, another kid named Tom came and said, "This is my tree. You can't play here." Lucy and her friends became sad. They didn't want to fight, so they left the tree. As they walked away, they saw a bigger and nicer tree. They called it the "new network tree" and played happily under it. Tom saw them having fun and realized he was wrong. He joined them, and they all became friends. The harsh wind didn't bother them anymore because they were together.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty foot. It was so powerful that it could spread far and wide. Everywhere it went, it made the ground shake.

One day, the mighty foot wanted to go on an adventure. So, it spread all around the world. The foot hopped over mountains, ran across fields, and even swimmed in the ocean. Everywhere it went, the mighty foot made new friends.

After a long day, the foot stopped for a rest. It was so tired. But soon, it was back on its way again. It continued to spread all around the world, spreading joy and friendship.

The mighty foot was tired, but it kept going. After a long journey, it finally came back home. And the foot spread a big smile all around. Everyone who had seen it was so happy.

The mighty foot spread happiness and friendship all the way home. And the friends that it had made along the way, kept it company forevermore.

John wanted to study. He went to his cupboard and opened it. Inside, he saw a brilliant book - full of bright colors. John grinned and grabbed it. 

He took the book from the cupboard and opened it. But when he opened the book, he found nothing inside - just a blank paper. He was sad. 

John put the book back in the cupboard and then he had an idea. He put his hand in his pocket, and pulled out a pencil. He smiled.

John took the book back out of the cupboard and opened it again. This time, he was ready. He filled the blank pages with brilliant drawings and stories. John was so happy to study his new book.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sandy. She wanted to learn how to roller skate, but it was hard for her. She tried and tried, but she kept tumbling onto the floor.

Sandy's mom saw her trying and said, "Be persistent and you will learn how to roller skate!" Sandy kept trying, but she still couldn't do it.

That night, Sandy lay in bed, minding all the things her mom had said. She closed her eyes, and when she woke up in the morning, she was ready to try a new way.

She put on her roller skates and tried to stand. This time, Sandy stayed up on her feet because she used her mind and concentrated hard. She kept going, taking one step at a time, until she was skimming across the floor.

Sandy learned that if you are persistent and try your best, you can do anything you set your mind to. She was so happy and went on to become a roller skating champion!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a big thumb. He loved to count his toys. He had a lot of toys, but they were all cheap. One day, Timmy lost his favorite toy car. He looked everywhere, but he could not find it. He started to cry. His mom came to him and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. Let's count all your toys together and see if we can find your car." Timmy wiped his tears and started to count. They counted all the toys and found his toy car under the bed. Timmy was so happy!

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little rabbit named Remy. Remy was a very fast runner. One day, Remy saw a big race with many animals. Remy wanted to join the race and try to win. He asked his mom if he could go, and she nodded yes. Remy was very happy.

The day of the race came, and Remy was ready. He put on his best shoes and stood at the start line. The race began and Remy ran as fast as he could. He passed the other animals, one by one. But then, Remy saw a little bird on the side of the race path. The bird looked miserable and sad.

Remy stopped running and went to the bird. He asked, "Why are you sad?" The bird said, "I hurt my wing and can't race." Remy felt bad for the bird. He knew he could win the race, but he decided to help the bird instead. Remy took the bird to his mom, and she helped fix the bird's wing. The bird was happy and thanked Remy. Even though Remy didn't win the race, he felt good for helping a friend.

One hot day, a little boy named Tom went to the beach with his mom and dad. They played in the sand and built a big sandcastle. Tom was very happy and excited.

Then, Tom saw a big wave coming. His dad warned him, "Tom, be careful of the big wave!" Tom listened to his dad and moved away from the water. The big wave splashed onto the beach and the sandcastle was gone. Tom felt sad, but his mom said, "Don't worry, we can build another one."

So, Tom, his mom, and his dad built an even bigger sandcastle together. They played and laughed all day at the beach. They were very careful of the waves and had lots of fun in the hot sun.

Mommy took me to a special hill. There were lots of rocks all around us. I could see the sun shining bright above us.

"Let's have a picnic!" she said.

We spread out a blanket and put out some food. It was yummy!

The sun was mild, so I asked Mommy if I could explore the hill. She said yes and I set off.

I found a huge rock that was the perfect size. I wanted to move it, but it was too heavy.

Then I remembered that my mommy had brought a blanket to cover the rock. So I ran to get it, and with Mommy's help, together we covered the rock so that it looked like a big furry animal.

I was so happy. We had created something special. 
Mommy said, "Let's sit here and look at our work."

I smiled and said, "Yes! Let's cover more rocks!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was very obedient, which means she always listened to her mommy and daddy. One day, her mommy asked her to help dry the dishes after dinner. Lily happily agreed and dried all the dishes with a big smile on her face.

The next day, Lily's mommy told her they were going to a party with all of their friends. Lily was so excited! She put on her favorite dress and waited patiently for her mommy to finish getting ready. When they arrived at the party, there were lots of other children there too. They played games and ate yummy snacks.

But then, it started to rain outside. Everyone had to go inside, but they were all wet from the rain. Lily's mommy asked her to help dry off all the other children. Lily remembered how happy she felt when she helped dry the dishes, so she happily helped dry off all of her friends.

The moral of the story is that it feels good to help others, even if it means getting a little wet.

Once upon a time there was a witch who lived in a deep, dark forest. She was very naughty and didn't like to share. One day, she stumbled into a wet meadow and discovered a secret cave. Inside, she found a magical cave filled with riches. But the witch didn't want to share - so she hid the cave and put a magical spell on it.

To unlock the cave and yield the riches, she decided that a special ritual must be done during a full moon. So she spent the whole night preparing and soon a full moon lit up the night sky. She did the ritual and the cave opened.

The witch was so happy that she could finally have all the riches for herself. She quickly gathered what she could and hurried out of the cave. But when she tried to close the cave door, it wouldn't yield. She tried again and again but the door still wouldn't yield.

The witch was mad. She huffed and she stomped and then finally gave up. She realized there was nothing she could do and so the cave remains open to this day.

Tommy liked to draw with his crayons. He had many colors and he made pictures of his family, his dog, and his toys. He liked to show his drawings to his mom and dad, who always said they were very good and gave him hugs.

One day, Tommy wanted to draw a big picture of a dinosaur. He looked for a big paper, but he could not find any. He saw a paper on the table, but it had many words on it. It was his dad's work paper. Tommy thought it was boring and he wanted to make it more fun. He took his crayons and started to draw a dinosaur over the words.

His dad came into the room and saw what Tommy was doing. He was very angry and shouted, "Tommy, what are you doing? That is my important paper! You ruined it!" He took the paper and the crayons from Tommy and threw them in the trash.

Tommy felt very sad and scared. He did not mean to make his dad angry. He wanted to make him happy. He said, "I'm sorry, dad. I just wanted to draw a dinosaur for you. I love you."

His dad looked at Tommy and saw his tears. He felt sorry for yelling at him. He realized that Tommy did not know that the paper was important. He hugged Tommy and said, "I'm sorry, too, son. I love you, too. I know you like to draw, but you have to resist drawing on papers that are not yours. They might belong to someone else who needs them. Here, let me give you a new paper and some stickers. You can draw a dinosaur and decorate it with stickers. How does that sound?"

Tommy smiled and nodded. He was happy that his dad was not angry anymore. He took the new paper and the stickers and started to draw a new dinosaur. He hoped his dad would like it. He felt a little embarrassed for drawing on his dad's paper, but he learned his lesson. He decided to always ask before he used someone else's paper. He thought that was a good way to be a good boy.

Once upon a time, there was a big animal farm. There were cows, pigs, chickens, and ducks. They all lived together and played together. One day, the cows and the pigs started to quarrel. They were arguing about who was the best animal on the farm.

The chickens and the ducks tried to calm them down, but it didn't work. Then, the farmer came and saw what was happening. He told them that they were all special in their own way and that they should be happy with who they were.

After the farmer left, the animals felt better. They decided to have a picnic together and share their delicious food. They all agreed that the food was so yummy and they were happy that they didn't quarrel anymore. From that day on, they all played together and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a man. He was very nice and always gave things to people. One day, he had a white cross. He wanted to give it away. So he found a little girl and brought the cross to her.

The little girl was so happy and she said, "Thank you!" But, when the man left, the cross started to feel heavy. The little girl tried to take it off, but it wouldn't move. It was stuck.

The little girl began to cry and she tried to ask for help, but no one came. Finally, she had to carry the cross everywhere she went. No matter where she went, the white cross was always with her.

The little girl never found a way to get rid of the cross. She was stuck with it forever. And that's the bad ending to the story.

Once upon a time, there was a famous, long haired princess. Her hair was so beautiful that it even made grown-up kings and queens jealous!

One day, the princess decided to go to the market. She told her mom, "I am going to the market". When she was finished shopping, the princess visited a magical castle. Inside, she met a fairy and they became fast friends.

The fairy asked the princess, "What can I do to serve you today?" The princess answered, "I would love to have a new hairstyle".

The fairy smiled and said, "I will be more than happy to serve you". She waved her wand and the princess' hair changed into an even more beautiful style. 

The princess was so excited about her new hair! "Thank you so much for serving me," she said to the fairy. 

The fairy replied, "You are so welcome! I am glad to make you even more famous!" The fairy and the princess laughed and hugged. Together, they went for a walk in the beautiful, magical forest.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl called Lily. She loved to explore her home and one day she found a big, attractive rug in the living room. It was so soft and warm to the touch. She proudly asked her mom, "Mommy, can I keep this rug?"

Her mum smiled and gently said, "Sweetheart, if you promise to really, really take good care of it, then you can have it."

Lily was very excited and immediately nodded her head, saying, "Yes, I will take care of it, I promise!"

So her mum hugged her and said, "But you have to keep this promise, Lily. It's a very important thing."

Lily smiled and said, "Mommy, I will keep my promise. I promise!"

Every day, Lily made sure to keep her promise and she took very good care of her attractive rug.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy old man. He lived far away, in the mountains. The grumpy old man had three laws that he always remembered.

First, he remembered to be kind. Second, he remembered to be brave. And third, he remembered to be honest.

The grumpy old man always obeyed his laws and tried to make the world a better place. He was proud of his laws and reminded himself to keep them in his heart.

One day, a young boy came to visit the grumpy old man. He asked the old man if he could help him with his laws. 

The old man smiled, and said, "my biggest law is to remember what is important. If you follow that law, you can always make the world a better place".

And the young boy smiled back, for he knew that the grumpy old man had been right. He remembered the old man's laws and kept them in his heart.

Once upon a time, there was a happy bunny. The bunny lived in a burrow on a hill. One day, the bunny saw a big carrot on the hill. The bunny wanted the carrot, but he didn't know how to get it. He asked his friends, but they didn't know either.

Then, a selfish fox came along and saw the bunny looking at the carrot. The fox said, "I can get the carrot for you, but you have to give me something in return." The bunny didn't like the fox's idea, but he didn't know what to do. He guessed that he had no other choice.

The fox climbed up the hill and got the carrot. When he came back down, he asked the bunny for his payment. But the bunny said, "I don't want to be selfish like you. You can keep the carrot." The fox was surprised and felt bad for being selfish. From that day on, the bunny and his friends knew that it was better to be kind than to be selfish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play dress-up and try on different clothes. One day, she was playing in her room and couldn't find her favorite dress. She looked in her closet, but it wasn't there. 

Lily started to panic and ran to her mom. "Mommy, my dress is gone!" she cried. Her mom tried to calm her down and asked where she last saw it. Lily told her she hung it on a hanger in her closet. 

Her mom went to look in the closet and found that all the hangers were different. They weren't the same ones that they had before. She realized that someone had snuck into their house and taken Lily's dress. 

Lily was sad and didn't understand why someone would take her dress. Her mom hugged her and promised to buy her a new one. But Lily couldn't stop crying and went to bed feeling scared. The bad person was still out there and she didn't feel safe anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lola. She was very brave and liked to try new things.

One day, Lola's mom gave her an onion. Lola was uncomfortable because she had never tried an onion before.

Mom smiled and said "Lola, why don't you try it! You'll feel better when you taste how good it is."

Lola took a deep breath and bit the onion. At first she felt uncomfortable and wanted to stop, but she kept trying. With each bite she felt better and better.

Finally, after eating the entire onion, she felt much better. She was surprised and made a huge smile.

"Mom, I like onions now!" she said. "It was hard at first, but it was worth it so I could improve!"

Mom nodded and said "I'm very proud of you, Lola. You tried something new, and you got better at it!"

Katy and her dad were in the garden. Katy's dad took out a microscope. He looked at Katy with a thoughtful face and said, "Let's look at the plants in the garden with this microscope".
Katy was so excited. She put her eye to the microscope and couldn't believe what she saw! Everywhere she looked were tiny, colorful plants! They were so small she almost couldn't see them, but with the help of the microscope, she could.

Katy's dad said, "Can you see all of the beautiful plants now?"
Katy nodded excitedly, "Yes!"

Her dad smiled with pride. She had learned something new today. They continued to look at the plants and Katy had so much fun. She thought of all the new things she could learn with the help of the microscope.

Once upon a time there was a pirate. He lived on a big ship in the sea. The pirate had a fine parrot who loved to fly around and go on adventures.

One day they sailed to a small island. When they got there the Pirate said "Let's look around this island, it looks fun!" 

The parrot flew ahead of the Pirate and soon spotted something glittering in the sand. "Please look!" The parrot said.

The Pirate was very excited. He had found a big treasure chest full of gold! They both cheered and began to take the treasure back to their ship.

They sailed home, happy and proud. Now, the Pirate always has a fine treasure. He and the parrot can play with it every day. The end.

One day, a boy was walking in the forest when he came across an enormous tree. He stared at the tree for a minute in awe and wondered how he could get to the top. Suddenly, he spotted a kitchen at the top of the tree! He was so excited that he quickly started climbing up the trunk, but it was very slippery and he couldn't get very far.

He decided to ask the tree for help. "Excuse me, Mr. Tree. Can you help me get to your kitchen?" he said.

The tree thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, I can help you. Just watch and see."

It then spread its branches into the sky, creating a bridge to the top of the tree. The boy was amazed! He hopped onto the bridge, and the tree gently swayed back and forth, helping the boy make his way across. 

When he finally reached the kitchen, the tree smiled and said, "Good job! I'm glad I can yield you some help and that you are safe." 

The boy thanked the tree and continued to explore the kitchen. He found an ice cream sundae nearly as big as he was. He happily enjoyed his treat and thanked the tree one last time before heading home.
