Lizzie and her Chubby bear were so excited, they danced around and hugged each other. From then on, they both enjoyed the gold, thankful for the magical dragon and the truth it shared!

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy. She had big eyes and a big heart. She loved to play and explore.

One day, the puppy was taken out for a walk. She was happy and excited to go, as she was wearing her new leash. It was thick and had bright colors.

The puppy walked and ran through a big field. She saw yellow flowers blooming in the meadow. They were beautiful and smelled sweet. She liked to play and nibble at the petals.

Suddenly, the puppy heard a noise. She wanted to go see what it was, but the leash was stopping her. She knew that it was for her safety, so she stayed where she was.

The sun moved up in the sky and soon it was time to return home. The puppy was sad to go, but she knew that she would come back to the meadow soon. She looked out over the field as it was blooming with color. She was happy knowing that she would return soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a big box of socks. She loved her socks very much. Every day, Sue would put on a new pair of socks. She liked to wear socks that were bright and fun.

One day, Sue could not find her favorite socks. She looked all around her room. "Oh no," she said, "I need to find my socks!" Sue's mom heard her and came to help. "Sue, you must be alert and look carefully," her mom said. Sue nodded and started to search again.

Sue looked under her bed, in her closet, and even in her toy box. Finally, she found her favorite socks behind her big teddy bear. "I found them!" she shouted. Sue's mom smiled and said, "Good job being alert, Sue!" Sue put on her favorite socks and went outside to play, happy that she had found them.

Once upon a time there was a little turtle called Tim. Tim liked to swim in the big ocean and chase tiny fishies. But one day, Tim began to worry. He heard about a big and enormous whale who scared all the fish in the sea. Tim was so worried â€“ what if this whale took all the fish away?

But then, Tim had an idea. He would talk to the whale and ask him to leave the fish alone. So Tim took a deep breath, and with a mighty plop! he jumped into the ocean and began to paddle towards the whale. Tim was very scared, and his heart was beating fast.

When Tim reached the giant whale, he asked the whale not to eat all the fish, telling it that they all needed to live happily in the sea. Tim asked very nicely and the whale listened. It seemed to understand, and agreed to keep all the fish safe. Tim was so happy he clapped his hands and jumped into the air with joy.

From then on, Tim never had to worry about the whale again, and all the fishies in the ocean continued to live their life in peace.

There were two friends, Rory and Jack. Rory had a strong brush. Jack asked Rory why he had the brush. Rory said, "I need it to learn how to brush my hair." Jack said," That's smart! Can I learn too?" Rory said, "Sure! Just watch me."

Rory showed Jack how to brush his own hair. First, he put the brush on top of his head. Then, he ran the brush through his hair in long strokes. Finally, he brushed his hair all the way down.

Jack tried it too. He grabbed the brush and started brushing his hair. Jack said, "Wow! I'm learning something new!" Rory smiled and said, "Yep, brushing is fun!"

Jack and Rory kept brushing their hair until it was perfect. They were both proud of themselves. They both had learned something new!

Tom and Sue are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they find a big cave. They want to go inside and see what is there.

But Tom and Sue have a quarrel. Tom says he should go first, because he is bigger and stronger. Sue says she should go first, because she is smarter and faster. They yell and push each other. They are not nice.

A big bear lives in the cave. He hears the noise. He is angry. He comes out of the cave and roars. He is very loud.

Tom and Sue are scared. They run away from the bear. But they do not hear each other. They are deaf from the roar. They do not know where to go.

They get lost in the park. They are sad and sorry. They wish they did not quarrel. They wish they were friends again.

Once there was a furry creature. It lived deep in the forest. It had two big eyes, two small ears and two soft paws. Its name was Fuzzy.

One day, Fuzzy found a crystal in the forest. It was sparkly and shiny. The crystal glittered in the sun and Fuzzy wanted to keep it.

Fuzzy asked the crystal, "Can I pick you up?"

The crystal didn't answer.

Then Fuzzy said, "I'll weigh you. If you're light enough I'll take you with me."

So Fuzzy weighed the crystal, and it was light enough. Fuzzy put it in his pocket and took it with him.

Fuzzy was so happy, he jumped into the air and started to cry. His crystal had made him so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't want to clean up, so she ignored her mommy and kept playing. 

Later that day, Lily spilled her juice all over the floor. Her mommy asked her to grab the mop and clean it up. Lily didn't want to do it, but she remembered how she ignored her mommy earlier. So, she grabbed the mop and cleaned up the juice. 

After she finished, Lily felt proud of herself for being a good listener. Her mommy hugged her and said, "You did a great job, Lily. It's important to listen and help out when you can." From that day on, Lily always listened to her mommy and helped clean up.

John loved exploring the world. Every day, he took his bike and went for a ride around the neighbourhood. One day, he was riding his bike when it got dark. He got scared and wanted to go home. But his parents encouraged him to keep going. 

John told them, â€œBut it's dark outside.â€

His parents smiled and said, â€œYes, it is. But don't worry, the world is filled with wonderful things. Let's see what you can find.â€

John nodded and kept riding. He kept pedalling, even when it got darker. Soon, he spotted a shooting star! He was filled with awe and happiness. He couldn't believe what he saw. 

John rode his bike all around the neighbourhood, looking at the sky and exploring. His parents were so proud of him for facing his fears and exploring the world.

Tom and Lisa are husband and wife. They love each other very much. They live in a big house with a garden. They have a dog named Spot and a cat named Fluffy.

One day, Tom comes home from work. He is very tired and hungry. He sees Lisa in the kitchen. She is making dinner. He smells something good. He says, "Hello, my beautiful wife. What are you cooking?"

Lisa smiles and says, "Hello, my dear husband. I am cooking your favorite soup. It is almost ready. Why don't you sit down and relax?"

Tom says, "Thank you, my sweet wife. You are so kind and thoughtful. I will sit down and pet Spot and Fluffy."

Tom goes to the living room. He sees Spot and Fluffy on the sofa. They are sleeping. He tries to pet them, but they do not like it. They wake up and start to bark and hiss. They jump off the sofa and run away.

Tom is surprised and sad. He says, "Why are you so mean to me, Spot and Fluffy? I just wanted to pet you. I love you. Don't you love me?"

Lisa hears the noise and comes to the living room. She sees Tom and the animals. She says, "Oh, Tom, I'm sorry. Spot and Fluffy are not used to you. They are new. I got them for you as a surprise. I wanted to make you happy. Do you like them?"

Tom looks at Lisa and the animals. He feels confused and angry. He says, "You got them for me? Without asking me? I don't like surprises. I don't like dogs and cats. They are noisy and messy. They make me sneeze. How could you do this to me, Lisa?"

Lisa feels hurt and sorry. She says, "Tom, please don't be mad at me. I didn't know you don't like dogs and cats. I thought you would like them. They are cute and friendly. They need a home and a family. I wanted to share our love with them. Can you forgive me, Tom?"

Tom looks at Lisa and the animals. He sees that Lisa is crying. He sees that Spot and Fluffy are scared. He remembers that Lisa loves him very much. He remembers that he loves Lisa very much. He feels sorry and ashamed. He says, "Lisa, I'm sorry. I was rude and ungrateful. You are the best wife in the world. You always try to make me happy. I should have thanked you for your gift. I should have given you a hug and a kiss. I should have been more open and understanding. Can you forgive me, Lisa?"

Lisa looks at Tom and the animals. She sees that Tom is smiling. She sees that Spot and Fluffy are wagging their tails and purring. She feels happy and relieved. She says, "Tom, I forgive you. I love you. You are the best husband in the world. You always work hard and care for me. You always make me laugh and feel safe. You always say sorry and mean it. I should have asked you before I got the animals. I should have respected your feelings and preferences. I should have been more careful and considerate. Can you forgive me, Tom?"

Tom and Lisa hug and kiss. They say, "I forgive you. I love you. You are my beautiful wife. You are my dear husband. We are a happy family."

Spot and Fluffy come closer. They lick and nuzzle Tom and Lisa. They say, "Woof, woof. Meow, meow. We forgive you. We love you. You are our kind owners. You are our new family. We are happy too."

Once upon a time, there was a little green hanger. He was always very careful when he hung clothes on the line.

One day, he decided to swing as high as he could and let go. He felt like he could trust the wind. But, as he swung, the wind became stronger and stronger. Soon, the hanger lost his grip on the clothesline and flew away. 

The hanger was so scared. He tried to find something to hold on to, but he couldn't see anything. He yelled out, "Help me! I'm falling!" 

But, no one came to save the small green hanger. He kept falling until he landed on the ground. He was never seen again.

The little green hanger had learned the hard way that he couldn't always trust the wind. Sometimes, trusting can lead to bad things.

Once, there was a little girl named Amy who loved to play outside. One day, the sky was a mild blue and the sun was shining. Amy was very excited, so she ran outside to have some fun. 

She saw a shoot, so she decided to play with it. She ran to it and kicked it back and forth with her friends. They had so much fun, they were not paying attention to the sky. 

Suddenly, it started to rain. The rain was mild and soft. Amy stopped playing and ran to her house. Her friends followed right behind her. 

When they got inside, they laughed and giggled. Amy had such a great time playing with her friends, even though it was raining. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very hungry. One day she went to a porch and saw a box. Inside the box were paper and colorful ink. She was curious. She opened the box and took a piece of paper.

The little girl ran to her room and grabbed a crayon. She drew a very happy picture on the paper. Then she put the paper back into the box. She was excited! She took the paper out and looked around. Then she put it back in.

The little girl wanted to keep her picture forever. Then she saw a shiny machine on the porch. It said 'Print'. She figured out how to make the machine print her picture. She was so happy! She got a copy of her happy picture. She was very proud.

The little girl hung her picture up on the wall. Now she can look at it every day and feel happy.

Once there was a girl who wanted to play. She asked her uncle for help. He said yes and took her to a special place. 

At the special place, the girl got to use a special toy. It was a regular toy, but was used in a special way. She played and had so much fun. 

Uncle was also having fun. He laughed at the girl and showed her different ways to use the toy. She learned many new things. 

When the girl was done, she thanked uncle for taking her to the special place. He said it was his pleasure. 

The girl went back home happy and excited to play with her regular toy again. She was so proud of what she had learned.

Once upon a time, there was a kind pig named Pinky. Pinky lived on a farm with his friends, the cows and the chickens. One day, Pinky saw a big truck coming towards the farm. The truck was filled with hay for the animals.

Pinky was very happy and started to wave his tail. "Look, look!" he said to the cows and chickens. "We will have lots of hay to eat."

But the cows were not happy. "That hay is for us," they said. "You pigs always get more food than us."

Pinky felt sad. He didn't want to fight with his friends. "I'm sorry," he said. "I didn't mean to make you angry. Let's share the hay together."

The cows and chickens were happy with Pinky's kind words. They all ate the hay together and became good friends again. And Pinky felt happy too, knowing that he had helped solve the conflict.

One day, a squirrel and a bird sat on a tree. They started to discuss who had the better life. The squirrel said, "I can run fast and climb trees. I can find lots of nuts to eat." The bird said, "I can fly high in the sky and see the whole world. I can sing pretty songs."

The squirrel felt jealous of the bird. He wanted to fly too. He thought of a plan. The squirrel asked the bird, "Can you teach me how to fly?" The bird said, "I can try, but you don't have wings like me."

The bird tried to teach the squirrel how to fly. The squirrel jumped from the tree and tried to flap his arms like wings. But he could not fly. The squirrel was sad.

The bird saw the sad squirrel and said, "Don't be sad. You can do things I can't do. You can climb trees and find nuts. We are different, but we can still be friends." The squirrel smiled and agreed. They played together and had fun. From that day, the squirrel was not jealous of the bird anymore. They became the best of friends.

Once there was a modest pilot who flew a plane each and every day. One day, a loud siren rang from his plane. He had no choice but to put on the parachute and save himself.

The pilot looked down from the sky and saw a river below. He threw away his fear of water and jumped into the river. He was relieved to see a small rowboat at the side.

The pilot started rowing with all his might and for hours and hours, he continued to row. Suddenly, he heard a voice from the river bank. It was a three year old child.

"Where are you going?" the child asked.

The pilot answered, "I'm trying to save myself."

The child smiled and said, "I can help you! I have a bigger boat at home." 

The pilot thanked the child and soon they were on the bigger boat. After several hours, the pilot reached the shore safely. 

He thanked the child and said, â€œIâ€™m very lucky to have found you. You saved my life.â€ 

The modest pilot was very grateful for the child's help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved candy very much. One day, her mom gave her a big bag of candy. Lily was so happy and ate a lot of candy. But her mom said, "Be gentle with your teeth, Lily. Too much candy is not good for them."

The next day, Lily woke up with a toothache. She cried and cried because it hurt so much. Her mom said, "Let's go wash your face and brush your teeth. Maybe that will make you feel better." 

Lily washed her face and brushed her teeth very gently. She felt a little better. Later, her mom took her to the dentist. The dentist said, "You have a cavity from eating too much candy. Next time, be gentle with your teeth and don't eat too much candy." From that day on, Lily learned to be gentle with her teeth and eat less candy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old, and liked to play pretend.

One day, Sarah found a pile of photos on the floor. She smiled and picked them up. Sarah began to sort the photos into piles.

Suddenly, she heard a very loud noise. Startled, Sarah looked around. She spotted her friend, Jack, standing in the doorway. "What's the noise, Jack?"

"I'm speaking in sign language," explained Jack. "I'm deaf."

Sarah was surprised. She had never seen anyone sign before. Jack began to teach Sarah some sign language. It was fun!

Sarah wanted to remember this moment, so she found the best photo from the pile and put it in her pocket.

From then on, Sarah and Jack were the best of friends - and Sarah always remembered the day she learned sign language.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Molly. She lived in a nice red house with her family. One day she decided to go for a swim in the lake behind her house.

When she reached the lake, Molly saw something red in the water. It was a ghost! Molly was scared and started to cry.

Suddenly, the ghost said: "Don't be scared, Molly. I'm friendly. I'm just here to make the lake more fun by splashing around."

Molly was still scared, but she was also curious. She stepped a little closer and the ghost said: "Come in and splash with me!"

Molly thought for a moment and made a brave decision. She jumped in the lake and began to splash with the red ghost. They had so much fun!

When it was time to go home, Molly thanked the ghost. The ghost smiled and said: "You're welcome. Come back anytime and we can play together again!" Molly smiled and went home, feeling much braver than before.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a long fireplace. Inside the house lived a family with a dog named Max. One day, Max was playing with his ball when it accidentally went into the fireplace. The family tried to get the ball out, but it was stuck. 

They decided to call a man who knew how to fix things. The man came and looked at the fireplace. He saw that a part of the fireplace was broken and that's why the ball got stuck. He fixed the broken part and got the ball out for Max. Max was very happy and wagged his tail. The family thanked the man and Max never played with his ball near the fireplace again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, it's time to clean up your toys." Lily said, "But I don't want to work!" Her mom said, "Cleaning up is not work, it's just helping." 

As Lily was cleaning up her toys, she heard a loud noise. She looked under her bed and saw a big, green monster! The monster said, "I'm jealous of your toys. I wish I had toys to play with." Lily said, "You can play with my toys!" The monster was so happy and they played together for hours.

But then, Lily's little brother came in and saw the monster playing with Lily's toys. He became jealous and said, "I want to play with those toys too!" The monster said, "Don't be jealous. You can play with us too!" So, they all played together happily ever after.

Once, there was a girl named Lucy. She was three years old. Lucy liked to play with her toys. One day she saw something pink beside the rail. She was curious and wanted to know what it was.

So, she walked to the rail and tried to guess what the pink thing was. She guessed that it was a toy. When she looked closer, she saw that it was a pink balloon. She was so happy! 

Lucy picked up the balloon and brought it home. She showed her mom the pink balloon. Her mom said the balloon was very pretty. Lucy hugged the balloon and thanked her mom. 

From then on, every day Lucy and her pink balloon would play together. They always had lots of fun. Lucy was so glad that she had found the pink balloon.

Once, there was a little girl named Jane. She was 3 years old and very friendly. One day, a magical angel came to visit her. The angel was wearing a shiny white gown, with silver wings on her back. Jane was so excited. She wanted to remember the angel forever, so she took a picture.

The angel gave Jane a special bag with lots of fun things inside. There was a toy car, a teddy bear, and a storybook. Jane was so happy, she said thank you to the angel and waved as she flew away.

Jane loves to look at the picture of the angel sometimes. She remembers what the angel looked like and what was in the bag. Jane smiles when she remembers her friendly angel.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful kitten named Mittens. Mittens loved to play in the garden with his friends. One day, Mittens saw a big dog coming towards him. Mittens didn't know that the dog was dangerous. 

Mittens' friend, a wise old cat, warned him about the dog. "Mittens, that dog is not friendly. You should stay away from him," said the wise old cat. But Mittens didn't listen. He thought he could play with the dog and make friends with him.

Mittens went to play with the dog and the dog attacked him. Mittens was hurt and scared. He realized that he should have listened to the wise old cat's warning. The moral of the story is that it's important to listen to the advice of others, especially when it comes to our safety.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who was very hungry. She wanted to eat something. The girl saw a box of cereal on the kitchen table. It looked yummy, and it smelled spicy.

The girl opened the box, and she tried some of the cereal. It was delicious! She ate a big bowl.

When she was done, the girl wanted more, but the box was empty. She sighed, wished she had more cereal, and went to do something else.

Later that day, the girl went back to the kitchen. To her surprise, the cereal box was full again! She took a bowl and tried some of the cereal. It was even better than before! It tasted so spicy!

The girl thanked her mom and dad for leaving more cereal. She was so happy to have a full bowl to enjoy. The girl smiled, ate the cereal, and went happily on her way.

Once upon a time there was a sailor who wanted to take a trip. He had a boat that was very light. He wanted to rock in the boat.

He said, "I think I'll go on a trip and rock in my boat."

He put on a funny hat and hopped in the boat. He said, "I'm ready to rock in my boat!"

He rocked and rocked until his boat was far away from the shore. He had a wonderful time rocking in the boat.

"I feel so light and free when I rock in my boat," said the sailor. He rocked and rocked until the sun set.

The sailor was so happy he had gone for a ride in his boat. He smiled and waved goodbye as he sailed away into the night.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to skip and play outside with her friends. One day, Lily's mom bought her a big bag of candy. Lily was so happy and ate all the candy in one day. But, the next day, Lily got a shock when she woke up with a tummy ache. 

Lily's friend, Jack, came to play with her and noticed that Lily wasn't feeling well. "What happened?" Jack asked. "I ate too much candy and now my tummy hurts," Lily replied. Jack said, "Oh no, you spoiled your tummy by eating too much candy. Next time, you should only eat a little bit at a time." 

Lily realized that Jack was right and promised to be more careful next time. From that day on, Lily learned to enjoy her treats in moderation and never spoiled her tummy again. The moral of the story is to always be mindful of how much you eat and to take care of your body.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy was walking in the park when he stumbled over a rock. He fell down and scraped his knee. 

As he got up, he saw a big statue of a lion. The lion was very hairy and looked very scary. Timmy was a little afraid, but he decided to go closer and touch the statue. 

When he touched the statue, he realized that it was just a statue and not a real lion. He felt better and continued to play with his friends in the park. From that day on, Timmy always remembered to watch where he was walking so he wouldn't stumble again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Bobbie. She was only three years old and loved to explore the world around her. She liked to go to the park, but one day she felt a bit embarrassed. She was looking at a tall tree and wished she could climb up it as quickly as a monkey.

Bobbie asked her mum, "Mum, can I climb that tree?" Mum smiled and said, "Not today Bobbie, it's too high. But don't worry â€“ you'll be able to do it someday!"

Bobbie felt a bit ashamed and walked away. She kept thinking about the tree but then spotted a swing nearby. Bobbie grabbed onto the swing and pushed off with her feet. She felt so excited as she soared higher and higher! 

Bobbie forgot all about the tree and instead looked up at the sky, feeling peaceful and happy. She waved goodbye to the tree, happy that she'd got to explore it.

Once upon a time, there was a little alligator. He lived in a very wet place and loved to play in the water. 
One day, while he was playing, he found a small, dark and mysterious cave. As he slowly crept inside, he could feel how cold and damp it was. 
Suddenly, he heard a loud roar. He looked in front of him and there was a bigger alligator! He was so scared and quickly tried to run away, but the big alligator chased him deep into the cave. 
Suddenly, the little alligator found himself in a big pool. He quickly jumped in it and started to swim. Then, he realised that the big alligator had disappeared!

He was so relieved. He swam for a few minutes and then climbed up on a little rock, where he could take a rest. The little alligator was happy to be safe and sound. He enjoyed his time in the pool, seeing the different kinds of plants and animals around him. 
Soon, the little alligator returned home, excited to tell everyone what had happened. From then on, he was careful around dark caves, just in case the big alligator decided to reappear!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to eat carrots, but he always made a mess. His mom would tell him to use a napkin, but Benny didn't like the rough napkins. He wanted a soft napkin.

One day, Benny went to his friend's house for lunch. His friend's mom gave him a soft napkin. Benny was so happy! He ate his carrots and used the soft napkin to wipe his mouth. His friend's mom said, "Benny, you are such a good bunny. You always remember to use a napkin."

Benny smiled and said, "Thank you. My mom always tells me to use a napkin, but I didn't like the rough ones. This soft napkin is much better."

His friend's mom said, "It's always important to remember to use a napkin. It keeps us clean and tidy." Benny nodded his head and said, "I will always use a napkin from now on." And he did. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a group of delicate butterflies. They loved to wander around the garden and smell the pretty flowers. One day, they met a little girl named Lily.

"Hello, butterflies!" said Lily. "Can I play with you?"

"Of course!" said the butterflies.

Lily laughed and chased after the butterflies as they wandered around the garden. They flew up high and then landed on a delicate flower. 

"This is so much fun!" said Lily. 

The butterflies were happy to have a new friend to play with. They continued to wander around the garden together, enjoying the sunshine and the beautiful flowers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and make up stories. One day, she found a magic wand in her toy box. She waved it around and said "Abracadabra!" but nothing happened. She tried again and again, but the wand refused to work.

Lily was sad and frustrated. She wanted to do magic like the fairy tales she read. She asked her mom for help, but she didn't know how to use the wand either. Lily refused to give up and kept trying.

After many tries, Lily finally figured out the magic word. She waved the wand and said "Bippity Boppity Boo!" Suddenly, her toys came to life and danced around her room. It was perfect! Lily was so happy that she giggled and danced with her toys all night long. From that day on, Lily knew that if she refused to give up, she could make her own magic.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play games with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend brought a game called chess. Timmy had never played it before, but he thought it looked cool.

Timmy's friend taught him how to play chess. Timmy had to choose which chess piece to move each turn. He liked the knight piece the best because it looked like a horse. Timmy and his friend played chess for a long time and had a lot of fun. Timmy even won a few games!

From that day on, Timmy loved playing chess. He thought it was a cool game and would choose to play it whenever he had the chance.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toy cars. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy had a cool uniform on because his dad was a firefighter. Timmy thought it was interesting and asked if he could wear it too.

But when Timmy put on the uniform, he accidentally spilled juice on it and it made a big stain. Billy was upset and Timmy felt bad. He said sorry and asked Billy to forgive him. Billy forgave Timmy and they continued to play with their toy cars happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Julie. She was a very brave and adventurous girl who loved doing new things. One day, Julie was walking through a dark and scary forest. She was scared, but she kept walking. As she walked, she heard a strange noise. It sounded like some one was talking.

Julie slowly moved closer and closer to the noise until she spotted a man sitting in the shadows. She couldn't see his face, but he was speaking.

"I'm so thirsty," the man said, "I wish I had some of that nice smelling perfume." He laughed.

Julie felt scared, but she was also curious. She thought to herself, "Maybe I should give him some perfume." 
Julie slowly moved closer and closer, but before she could reach the man, he suddenly jumped out of the shadows and grabbed her by the arm.

"Give me your perfume!" he shouted. Julie was so scared, but she still tried to speak.

"Please, let me go," she managed to say. But the man was too angry and wouldn't listen.

He grabbed the perfume from her and ran away, leaving her alone in the dark forest. Julie never saw him again, and that was the last time she ever felt brave enough to do something new.

A small squirrel named Susie loved to explore. One day, when searching for a snack, she found a large square hole in the ground. Susie couldn't wait to find out what might be inside. She bravely stuck her head inside the hole and was surprised to see a giant playground. She squeaked with delight and ran inside! 

Susie scurried around the playground, jumping on the slides and galloping around the merry go round. Eventually, Susie noticed that something wasn't quite right. A large, creepy rat had trapped her inside the playground and surrounded her. He taunted her in a low voice and said, "You can't escape from here - you're trapped!"

Susie squeaked and tried to escape, but the rat blocked her way. She felt helpless, like she was stuck in the playground forever. But then, she noticed something - there was a second square hole in the ground, leading outside the playground. That must be the way out!

Susie quickly ran through the square hole and escaped from the playground. She ran away as fast as she could and never returned. Even though she had been scared, Susie was brave and found a way to get out of her dangerous situation!

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Lily. She loved to play outside when the sun was shining. One day, while she was playing, she saw lightning in the sky. She was scared and ran inside to tell her mom.

Her mom said, "Don't worry, the lightning won't hurt you as long as you stay inside." But Lily was still scared.

Later that day, Lily's family went for a picnic in the park. Lily was having fun playing with her toys, but then the sky turned dark and lightning struck a tree nearby. Everyone ran to the car, but Lily's dad was struck by the lightning. He didn't have a chance.

Lily was very sad and missed her dad. She learned that lightning can be dangerous and that it's important to stay safe during storms.

Once there was a boy named Jack who wanted to catch a heart. He went all around the world everyday to try and catch one. He had no luck, but he did not give up.

One day, Jack was walking and he saw a regular heart in a tree. He jumped up quickly to catch it. He grabbed the heart and hugged it closely.

He was so excited to have caught the heart. He could feel it beating in his hands. He held it tight and never let it go.

Jack was so happy, he held the heart everyday. When he was sad, he remembered the heart and smiled. He was the happiest boy in the world. 

He loved the regular heart and he kept it forever. It made him feel so happy and he was so proud of himself for catching it.

John and his dog, Ted, were walking in the park. Ted loved to explore and smell all the different plants and animals. Suddenly, John saw a worm in the grass. It was big and impressive! John picked up the worm and put it in his bag. He thought he would take it home and give it a nice rest. 

But Ted had other ideas. He barked and jumped around the bag, trying to get it away from John. Finally, Ted managed to grab the worm in his mouth and start to run. 

John was frustrated. He ran after Ted, but Ted was much faster. John was worried about the worm and wanted to get it back! After a long time, John managed to catch the worm and put it back in the bag. He petted Ted and thanked him for his help. 

John then took the worm back home and gave it a nice rest in his garden. He was happy that the worm was safe and he was also impressed by Ted's impressive actions!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy cook in the kitchen. One day, her mommy was making a cake and asked Lily to mix the batter. Lily loved to mix and stir things, so she happily did it.

After the cake was in the oven, Lily went outside to play. She found some wood and started building a little house for her dolls. She loved the smell of the wood and how it felt in her hands.

When the cake was done, Lily's mommy took it out of the oven and put some spicy frosting on top. Lily couldn't wait to try it. She took a big bite, but it was too spicy for her. She didn't like it at all.

Lily started to feel sick and her mommy had to take her to the hospital. The doctor said that the spicy frosting made her very sick and she had to stay in the hospital for a long time. Lily learned that sometimes things that look and smell good can be bad for you.

Once upon a time, there lived a careless little bear. All day long he played in the forest, and he never once thought about danger or getting hurt.

One day, though, the little bear stumbled into an active volcano! The volcano was smoking and making loud noises.

The bear was scared, so he quickly grabbed a sack he found near the volcano and raced away. He ran back home as fast as he could.

"What's in the sack?" asked the little bear's mom.

The little bear looked inside and realized it was just a pile of soft rocks. "They're from the volcano, mom," he said.

His mother shook her head, knowing she couldn't keep her little boy safe if he kept being so careless. "Be more careful next time, okay?" she said in a worried voice. 

The little bear promised that he would, and since then he's been extra careful while playing in the forest.

Tim was walking around the park. He saw a vendor who had a new cart. The cart was filled with colorful things. Tim liked the cart. He wanted to kick it, so he did!

The vendor was angry. He told Tim not to kick his new cart. Tim started to cry. He said he was sorry.

The vendor smiled. He said it was okay and gave Tim a balloon. Tim was happy. He thanked the vendor and enjoyed playing with the balloon. He forgot all about the cart!

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie. The birdie was flying around and saw a hunter. The hunter was very busy looking for animals to catch. 

The birdie said, "Hello, Mr. Hunter. What are you doing?"

The hunter replied, "I am looking for animals to catch and poke with my stick."

The birdie was scared and flew away. But the hunter saw the birdie and threw his stick at it. The stick hit the birdie and it fell to the ground. The hunter caught the birdie and took it away. 

The little birdie never saw its family again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot. Spot loved to run and play all day long. One day, Spot saw a wide hole in the ground. He didn't know it was dangerous, so he jumped right in. 

Spot got stuck and couldn't get out. He barked and cried for help, but no one could hear him. He didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Spot saw his owner walking by. He was so happy to see him! Spot knew his owner would save him. But his owner didn't see him and kept walking. 

Poor Spot was stuck in the hole forever. He didn't have a perfect ending, but at least he knew he was loved.

Once there was a very intelligent girl. Her name was Mary. Mary had a new shirt that she was planning to wear to her playdate. But then, something terrible happened - her brother spoiled it!

Mary was so upset. She didn't understand why her brother had ruined her favourite shirt. She went to her mum and dad and told them what happened.

Her parents knew that Mary was very intelligent and so they said that they would help. They took Mary out for the day, so she could forget about the spoiled shirt.

At the end of the day, Mary's parents had a new surprise for her. It was a brand new shirt - the same one her brother had ruined! Mary was so happy. She hugged her parents and thanked them for their kindness. 

Mary never forgot what a kind and intelligent girl she was. And she never forgot to be kind and understanding to her brother too!

Once upon a time, there was an attractive mill. It had tall walls, a big wheel and lots of birds who sang along as it spun. The mill was very important because it prevented the town from running out of food. 

One day, when the mill was spinning, some naughty cows wandered past. They stumbled into the mill and caused a lot of trouble, making a huge mess inside. 

The mill worker was very angry and called for the mayor. However, the mayor knew that the cows were just being curious and needed help to get out of the mill. 

So he asked the mill worker to get the cows safely out, and then asked a few children to help clean up the mess. 

After all was finished, the mill worker and mayor were very happy because they had prevented any more damage to the mill. 

From then on, the mill worked hard and everyone in town knew to stay away from it, to prevent any more accidents.

Once upon a time, there was a wise king who lived in a big castle. The king loved all of his people, and always wanted to make sure they were happy and safe.

One day, the king asked one of his helpers to fetch a pipe. So the helper went to the store and ordered the pipe.

Once the helper brought the pipe back to the palace, the king was so pleased. He said "thank you for getting me this pipe, you are so wise and helpful!" Then the king played a song on the pipe for all the people in the castle. Everyone clapped and cheered.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and draw pictures. One day, she went to her grandma's house. Her grandma had a big vase in the living room. Lily thought it looked weird because it was very tall and had flowers on it.

Lily asked her grandma, "What is that weird vase?" Her grandma smiled and said, "It's a vase. I put flowers in it to make the room pretty." Lily nodded her head and said, "Oh, I see."

Later that day, Lily and her grandma were sitting on the couch. Lily said, "Grandma, can we draw pictures together?" Her grandma smiled and said, "Of course, Lily!" They spent the rest of the afternoon drawing and coloring. Lily was very happy to spend time with her grandma and see the weird vase in her living room.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a big tree with lots of leaves. She climbed up the tree and sat on a branch. She looked up at the sky and saw some clouds. She wondered what they were.

Suddenly, she heard a loud noise. It was a branch breaking! She fell down from the tree and landed on the ground. It was a messy fall. She had some dirt on her clothes and a small cut on her knee. She cried and her mom came running to help her.

After her mom cleaned her up and put a band-aid on her knee, Lily started to question herself. She wondered if she should have climbed so high. She learned her lesson and promised to be more careful next time. From that day on, she played in the park but never climbed that tree again.

Sam and Mia are friends. They like to play together. Sometimes they play with toys, sometimes they play with balls, sometimes they run and jump.

One day, they decide to play exercise. They want to be strong and healthy. They find a big rope in the yard. They think it is fun to pull the rope.

Sam says, "I will pull this end, and you pull that end. We will see who is stronger."

Mia says, "OK, let's do it. But be careful, don't pull too hard."

They start to pull the rope. They pull and pull and pull. They feel their arms and legs working. They laugh and smile.

But then, something happens. The rope breaks. It snaps in the middle. Sam and Mia fall down. They are surprised and scared.

They look at the rope. It is old and thin. It is not reliable. It is not good for exercise.

Sam says, "Oh no, the rope is broken. It is not a good rope. It is a bad rope."

Mia says, "Yes, it is a bad rope. But we are OK. We are not hurt. We are still friends."

They hug each other. They are happy. They decide to find another game to play. They look for a reliable toy. They find a ball. They think it is fun to kick the ball. They play exercise with the ball. They are strong and healthy.

Sam and Tom are brothers. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a man with a stick in his mouth. The stick makes smoke. The smoke smells bad.

"Look, Tom, the man is making smoke!" Sam says.

"Why is he doing that?" Tom asks.

"I don't know. Maybe he likes it. Do you want to try?" Sam says.

He picks up a twig from the ground and puts it in his mouth. He blows hard, but no smoke comes out.

"Let me try!" Tom says.

He takes the twig from Sam and puts it in his mouth. He blows harder, but still no smoke comes out.

They hear a voice behind them.

"Hey, what are you two doing?" It is their mom. She looks angry.

She sees the twig in Tom's mouth and takes it away.

"That is not a toy. That is a filthy thing. The man is smoking. Smoking is bad for you. It makes you sick and hurts your lungs. You should never try it. Do you understand?" She says.

Sam and Tom nod. They feel sorry and scared.

"I'm sorry, mom. We didn't know. We were just curious." Sam says.

"Me too, mom. We won't do it again." Tom says.

Mom hugs them and kisses them.

"I love you, boys. I'm glad you are safe. Come on, let's go home and have some juice and cookies." She says.

Sam and Tom smile. They hold mom's hand and walk away from the park. They don't look at the man with the smoke stick anymore. They learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a soft rhinoceros called Flo. She lived in the jungle and loved to explore. One day, Flo decided to go for a walk in the forest. As she walked, she saw a shiny object on the ground. She quickly grabbed it, and it was a beautiful bracelet! Flo was so happy, she put it on her wrist and kept walking.

Not long after, Flo saw a bird in a tree. She wanted to grab it, but the bird flew away. She was a bit disappointed, but then she heard a noise. She looked up and saw something big and grey. It was a rhinoceros! Flo was very excited and she ran over to him. He was very friendly and they started playing together. Flo was so happy she had found a friend.

Soon the big rhinoceros had to go home, and Flo waved goodbye. But before he left, he gave her a big hug. Flo was so happy she had a new friend and was sure she would see him again soon.

Later that night, Flo hugged her soft pillow and thought about her day. She had found a shiny bracelet and met a new rhinoceros friend, it had been the best day ever!

Peter was excited. It was the first day of school and he was ready to make new friends. He said goodbye to his mom and dad as he hopped out of the car. He was so eager to get inside and get started. 

On the way, Peter's dad reminded him to be serious at school. He said to always listen to his teachers, respect others and do his best. Peter nodded to show he understood.

When he got to school, Peter found out that there were a few special things he had to do every day. He had to stand up every morning when the flag was raised, he had to bring his own lunch and he also had to shake his teacher's hand when he said hello.

Peter's dad reminded him of these things every day. He said to always remember because these things made him look serious and respectful. Peter was careful to follow all the rules, so that everyone would know how responsible he was. 

After a few days of school, Peter got the hang of it. He felt so proud that he was able to show how serious he was about his school day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, beautiful red apple. Little Susie really wanted to touch it, but she was too scared.

"Please don't be scared, my sweet Susie," said her mom. "Let me help you. If we both try, we can touch the apple together."

Susie looked up at her mom with a hopeful smile and slowly put out her hand. She was very scared, but she wanted to touch the apple so badly.

Mom slowly put her hand on top of Susie's and they both gently touched the red apple. "See, Susie," her mom said, "it's not so scary after all!"

Susie was so relieved and so happy that she hugged her mom. She felt so proud that she'd been brave enough to touch the apple.

One day, a boy named Tom went to the park. He saw a girl named Sue. Sue was on a jog. Tom thought Sue was amazing.

Tom wanted to be friends with Sue. He said, "Hi, I am Tom. I like your jog. Can we be friends?" Sue said, "Hi Tom, I am Sue. I like your smile. Yes, we can be friends."

Tom and Sue played together. They had a lot of fun. Then, Tom noticed the sky was getting dark. "Oh no, it is going to rain," said Tom. Sue was sad. They both went home.

At home, Tom looked out the window. He missed Sue. Sue was amazing. But now, they could not play together. It was a bad ending.

Lilly had a sweet day playing outside. She climbed trees and played in the park. All that playing made Lilly very, very dirty. When it was time to go home, her mother said it was time for a bath.

In the bathroom, Lilly got very excited when she saw all the fun bubbles. Her mother turned on the bath and soon the water was just the right temperature. Lilly's mother gave her a special soap to wash with. It smelled like flowers and was very sweet. 

When it was time to get out, Lilly's mama put a bulb in the ceiling. As the bulb lit up, it lit up the bathroom like sunshine. Lilly hopped out of the tub and ran to her bedroom to put on her warm pajamas and a cozy robe. 

Tonight Lilly was so happy and clean after her sweet bath. She felt so special, just like a princess.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to play with his stick. One day, Max found a very heavy stick in the park. He was so happy and wanted to show his friend, the small cat named Mimi.

Max picked up the heavy stick in his mouth and started to deliver it to Mimi's house. He walked and walked, but the stick was very heavy. Max was very tired, but he wanted to show the stick to Mimi.

Finally, Max reached Mimi's house with the heavy stick. But when he got there, Mimi was not happy. The heavy stick was too big for her to play with. Max was sad and tired. He had to go back home with the heavy stick. The day was not a good day for Max and Mimi.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pocket in her dress where she kept her favorite toys. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. While playing, she found a shiny rock on the ground. She picked it up and put it in her pocket, thinking it was special.

When she got home, she showed her mom the rock. Her mom told her that it was just a regular rock, but Lily still thought it was valuable. She kept the rock in her pocket and took it with her everywhere she went, even though it was very light.

One day, Lily's little brother wanted to play with the rock. Lily told him how much she valued it and that she didn't want him to lose it. Her brother promised to take good care of it, and Lily let him play with it. From that day on, Lily and her brother shared the rock and both thought it was very special.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside in the sun with her friends. One day, they decided to play a game of tag. Lily was running so fast that she didn't see a rock in her way. She tripped and fell, ripping her favorite dress.

Lily was sad because her dress was torn. Her friend Sarah saw that Lily was upset and offered her a cloth to wipe away her tears. Lily was grateful for her friend's kindness and felt better.

Later, Lily's mom asked her what happened to her dress. Lily told her the truth and said, "I tripped and fell." Her mom was proud of her for being honest and said, "It's okay to make mistakes. The important thing is to learn from them and step forward." 

Lily learned that it's important to be honest and grateful for the kindness of others. She also learned that it's okay to make mistakes and to keep moving forward.

Once upon a time there was a boy who loved to eat. He ate all kinds of food - from apples to zucchinis. One day he found a clean point in the garden. He was so excited! He picked it up and took it home.

At home, he asked his mom, "Can I eat it?" His mom said, "Yes, but make sure it's washed first." So the boy went to the kitchen and washed the point.

When the point was clean, the boy put it in a big pot of boiling water and cooked it. After a few minutes, the point was ready to eat. The boy took it out of the pot, carefully put it on a plate, and ate it with a big smile on his face. Mmmmm - it was so yummy! The boy was so happy that he had found a clean point to eat.

Once there was a boy. He was 3 years old and his name was John. He was always curious and wanted to explore the world. One day his mom and dad promised him a special surprise. 

He was so excited that he could not wait to know what the surprise was. He was taken to an airport and he was so happy he couldn't believe it. His parents had promised him a flight in a plane. 

John was feeling adventurous and determined to make the most of his journey. He packed his bag with some of his favorite toys. The journey was tough but also thrilling, and he saw so many beautiful places. 

When John got back home he was full of stories and he couldn't stop talking about his amazing journey to his little sister. John was so pleased with his surprise that he promised to take her to the airport one day and show her the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink coffee with her mom every morning. Coffee was her favorite drink because it made her feel grown-up. 

One day, Lily and her mom went to their favorite coffee shop. It was very popular, and lots of people were there. Lily saw a big chocolate cake and wanted to have it. She asked her mom to buy it for her, but her mom said no because it was too big for her. 

Lily got upset and started to move around in her chair. Suddenly, she accidentally knocked over her mom's hot coffee. It spilled all over her mom's dress, and her mom got burned. Lily felt very bad and cried. Her mom had to go to the hospital, and they never went back to that coffee shop again.

Once upon a time, in a small house, Mom and Dad were sitting at the table. They wanted to drink coffee. Dad wanted strong coffee, but Mom insisted on weak coffee. They talked about it for a bit.

Mom made the weak coffee and put it on the table. Dad was not happy, but he drank it anyway. They talked a little more and smiled at each other.

Then, a big wind came and blew the door open. The wind was so strong that it knocked the weak coffee off the table. The coffee spilled all over the floor. Mom and Dad were sad because they had no more coffee to drink. The day did not end well for them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved the color pink. She had a pink dress, pink shoes, and a pink hat. One day, Sue got a card in the mail. It was an invite to a party!

Sue was so happy. She put on her pink dress, pink shoes, and pink hat. She was ready to go to the party. At the party, there were many kids. They played games, ate cake, and had fun.

Sue saw a big slide at the party. She was scared to go on it. But Sue was brave. She dared to go on the slide. Sue climbed up the slide and slid down with a big smile. All the kids clapped for Sue. She had a great time at the party.

John was sad. No one wanted to play with him. He had an idea that could make him happy. He decided to put on a show.

John started to practice. He brought out his instruments and sang big notes. He then put on a big hat and began to juggle. He wanted the show to be perfect.

On the night of the show, John was filled with excitement. He was about to perform for a lot of people.

John stepped on the stage. He started playing his instruments and the people clapped. Everyone could feel the music in their hearts.

John then juggled the balls, one after another. They flew in the air with ease. Everyone cheered and clapped for John.

Just as John was about to finish, he heard a crack. One of the balls had fallen to the ground and broken. Suddenly, a heavy silence spread over the room.

John took a deep breath. He picked up the broken ball, put it at his feet and continued to juggle the other balls. The audience clapped louder than before. Everybody was impressed by John's show.

John smiled and bowed. From that day onwards, he was no longer alone. He had lots of friends to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and explore the world around him. One day, Timmy and his friends were playing in the park when they heard a loud noise. It was an emergency! Timmy's friends ran home, but Timmy wanted to see what was happening.

As Timmy got closer, he saw that there was a big fire in the building. The firefighters were trying to put it out, but it was hard work. Timmy wanted to help, but he knew he had to resist the urge to run into the building. It was too dangerous.

After the firefighters put out the fire, Timmy realized that he had learned an important lesson. Sometimes it's important to resist doing something that might be dangerous, even if it seems exciting. Timmy was glad that he stayed safe, and he knew that he would never forget this emergency. Even though it was a boring day, it turned out to be a very important one.

Once upon a time there was a small boy named Bob. Bob loved to play in the garden. One day, he heard his mom and dad mention something about a mosquito. Bob didn't know what a mosquito was, so he asked his dad what it was. 

"A mosquito is a small insect," said Dad. 

Bob was intrigued. He wanted to see a mosquito. However, Dad warned him to stay away from mosquitoes. "It can bite you and make you get very sick," Dad said. 

Bob was disappointed. He wanted to find a mosquito so he could see what it looked like, but the warning scared him. He kept looking around for a mosquito and finally, he saw a small one flying around near a plant. 

Bob cautiously approached the mosquito. Then he felt a sudden sting on his arm. He realized the mosquito had just stung him! He screamed and started crying. His dad quickly ran to him and took him inside.

Bob never saw the mosquito again, but Dad taught him an important lesson. Always remember what your parents tell you!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to walk in the park with his mommy. One day, they went to the park and Timmy saw a big red ball. He wanted to play with it, but it was too heavy for him to push. 

Timmy's mommy went to get some water, leaving Timmy alone with the ball. Timmy decided to try and push the ball again. He pushed and pushed, but the ball wouldn't move. Suddenly, the ball rolled over Timmy's foot and hurt him very badly. 

Timmy's mommy came back and saw Timmy crying. She took him to the hospital, but the doctor said that Timmy's foot was broken. Timmy had to wear a cast on his foot for many weeks, and he couldn't walk or play with his friends. The park was empty without Timmy's laughter and joy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was very gifted, which meant he was really good at building things. He loved to use his hammer to build houses and towers with blocks.

One day, Timmy's mom noticed that he was getting very tired. She told him it was important to relax and take a break. Timmy didn't want to stop building, but he knew his mom was right.

So, Timmy put down his hammer and sat down on the floor. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He felt his body start to relax and his mind become calm.

After a few minutes, Timmy felt much better. He picked up his hammer and started building again, but this time he felt more energized and focused. From then on, Timmy remembered to take breaks and relax when he needed to.

Lila and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big truck. The truck has a picture of a rhinoceros on it. Lila and Ben want to see the rhinoceros.

They run to the truck and look inside. They see a big cage. The cage has a door with a zip. Lila and Ben are curious. They pull the zip and open the door. They see a big, gray rhinoceros. The rhinoceros has a horn on its nose. It looks at Lila and Ben.

Lila and Ben are scared. They run away from the cage. The rhinoceros is angry. It follows them. It makes a loud noise. Lila and Ben scream. They look for a place to hide. They see a pond. The pond is deep. Lila and Ben jump into the pond. They swim to the other side. They climb out of the pond. They are wet and cold.

The rhinoceros does not like water. It stops at the edge of the pond. It snorts and shakes its head. It turns around and goes back to the cage. It closes the door with the zip. It lies down and sleeps.

Lila and Ben are safe. They are also sorry. They know they did a bad thing. They say sorry to the rhinoceros. They say sorry to the truck driver. They say sorry to their moms. They promise to never open a cage with a zip again. They hug and go home. They are still friends.
