"Of course, you can," says mom. "You can rest on the couch or in your bed. But first, eat your lunch and follow the order."

Anna and Ben nod. They finish their ice cream and wash their hands. They sit at the table and eat their soup and bread. They feel warm and full. They thank mom and go to rest. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a wild animal that was very lonely. He wandered around in the forest all day, but he never found any other animals. One day he saw a big shadow in the forest and he panicked. He ran as fast as he could away from the scary shadow.

But as he ran, he suddenly found himself in a clearing where he saw lots of animals playing in the sunshine. After that he wasnâ€™t scared anymore, and he realised that he should never panic without knowing what something is.

The animals welcomed him, and he was no longer lonely. From that day on, he was very happy to be part of the group.

The moral of the story is that you should never be afraid of something until you know what it is. Donâ€™t panic!

Once upon a time, there was a big, black dog named Max. Max was very restless because he needed to go for a walk. His owner, a little girl named Lily, saw that Max was feeling sad and decided to take him for a walk. 

As they were walking, Max saw a ball in the park and needed to play with it. Lily threw the ball for Max and he chased it. Max was so happy that he wagged his tail and barked with joy. 

After playing with the ball, Max was tired and needed to rest. Lily took Max home and he fell asleep on his cozy bed. Max dreamed about playing with the ball and felt happy knowing that he had a good day with his best friend, Lily.

Ben and Lily were playing with their wagon in the backyard. They liked to fill it with toys and pretend they were going on a trip. Ben was very organized. He put all the cars in one corner, all the dolls in another, and all the books in the middle. Lily was not so organized. She liked to mix everything up and make funny noises.

"Ben, can I question you something?" Lily asked.

"Sure, what is it?" Ben said.

"Why do you make everything so neat? It is more fun to make a mess!" Lily said.

Ben thought for a moment. He liked to have everything in order. It made him feel calm and happy.

"I like to make everything neat because it helps me find what I want. And it looks nice too. Don't you like to make things nice?" Ben said.

Lily shrugged. She liked to make things fun. She did not care if they were nice or not.

"I like to make things fun because it makes me laugh and have a good time. And it looks funny too. Don't you like to make things funny?" Lily said.

Ben smiled. He liked to make things fun too. He did not mind if they were funny or not.

"I like to make things fun too, sometimes. But not always. Sometimes I like to make things nice. Can we do both?" Ben said.

Lily nodded. She liked to do both too. She did not mind if they were nice or not.

"Okay, we can do both. How about we take turns? You can make things nice, and then I can make things funny. And then we can switch. Does that sound good?" Lily said.

Ben agreed. He liked to take turns. He thought it was fair and kind.

"Okay, that sounds good. Let's do that. You can go first. What do you want to make nice?" Ben said.

Lily looked at the wagon. She saw a red car, a blue doll, and a green book. She had an idea.

"I want to make a rainbow. Watch this!" Lily said.

She took the car, the doll, and the book, and arranged them in a row on the wagon. She added a yellow ball, an orange crayon, and a purple hat. She made a rainbow with the toys.

"Look, Ben, I made a rainbow! Isn't it nice?" Lily said.

Ben looked at the rainbow. He thought it was very nice. He also thought it was very funny.

"Yes, Lily, you made a rainbow. It is very nice. And very funny. Good job!" Ben said.

He clapped his hands and laughed. Lily clapped her hands and laughed too. They were happy. They liked to play with their wagon. They liked to make things nice and funny. They liked to question each other. They liked to be friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved his toy car with a motor. He would play with it every day and make it go vroom vroom. 

One day, Timmy's friend came over to play. Timmy was so proud to show his friend his toy car. His friend liked it too and asked if he could own one too. 

Timmy said yes and they played together with their toy cars. They had so much fun that they didn't even notice it was time for lunch. Timmy's mom called them in and they happily ran inside, still talking about their toy cars.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside, but today it was gloomy and rainy. Timmy was sad because he couldn't play outside. He sat inside and watched the raindrops fall on the window.

Suddenly, Timmy had an idea. He went to get his bucket and filled it with water from the sink. He pretended he was outside in the rain, splashing around with his bucket. Timmy had so much fun, he started to dream about being outside in the sunshine.

The rain stopped and the sun came out. Timmy was so happy! He ran outside with his bucket and played in the puddles. Timmy knew that even when things seem gloomy, there is always a way to have fun and dream about better days.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because she was going on a holiday with her family. They were going to the beach!

When they arrived, Lily saw the big blue ocean and heard the waves crashing. She said, "I hear the ocean! It sounds like music!" 

But after a few days, Lily got bored. She said to her mom, "This is boring. Can we do something fun?" 

Her mom said, "Let's build a sandcastle!" So they built a big sandcastle together. Lily was happy again and said, "This is the best holiday ever!"

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to run and play in the park. One day, Max saw a little flea on his fur. The flea was very small and Max couldn't catch it.

Max didn't like the flea on him. He wanted to be safe from the flea. Max decided to go to the vet to get rid of the flea. At the vet, Max saw other dogs and cats. They were all waiting to see the vet.

Max was scared because he didn't like the vet. But the vet was kind and gentle. She gave Max a medicine that made him safe from the flea. Max was happy and went back to the park to play.

Once there was a little girl named Lina. She was three years old and loved to play by the sea.

Lina went down to the beach and saw a big chest. She was very impressed and wanted to open it.

She ran towards the chest and said, "Oh wow! Can I open it?"

The sea answered, "Yes, Lina, you can open the chest!"

Lina was so happy that she opened it right away. Inside the chest she discovered a lot of shells and when she touched them, they splashed around the beach. She was filled with joy and was amazed by the color and shapes of the shells.

Lina was so proud of her discovery that she ran to her mom and said, "Mom, look what I found! Aren't these shells impressive?"

Her mom replied, "They sure are! You found a real treasure today. Don't forget to pick up some of these shells to keep as souvenirs."

Lina gathered some of the most impressive shells she could find and was so proud to show them to her family.

Johnny was a humble 3 year old boy who went to the park every day to play. One day when he arrived he noticed a guard staring at him. He was a bit scared at first but the guard had a friendly smile. Johnny walked closer to the guard and asked why he was staring. The guard said he was just admiring his courage and that he was welcome to stay and play. Johnny felt much better and he thanked the guard for making him feel so welcome. He waved goodbye to the guard as he left the park that day and continued to think about his politeness and humbleness.

Once upon a time, there was a navy. The navy was very reliable. It was really good at making things happen.

One day, the navy asked the children to help them out. They wanted the children to make them a boat so they could go sailing.

At first, the children weren't sure how to make a boat. But they worked hard and thought of an idea. They decided to use sticks and some bits of fabric from the navy.

Finally, the boat was complete! The navy was very proud. They thanked the children for all their help.

The boat was reliable - it got them to their destination safely. The navy and the children celebrated with some cookies.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the yard. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a rake to help clean up the leaves. Timmy thought it was fun to use the rake, but it was hard work too. 

After Timmy finished raking the leaves, he went inside to get a snack. His mom gave him a big apple to eat. Timmy held the apple in his hand and said, "This apple is cold!" His mom told him to put the apple on the scale to weigh it. Timmy put the apple on the scale and saw that it weighed one pound. 

Timmy was happy to have helped his mom and to have learned something new about weighing things. He ate his apple and felt proud of himself for being such a good helper. The end.

Tom and Lily like to play in the farm. They see many animals there. They see cows, pigs, sheep and chickens. They also see a big horse. The horse is brown and has a long mane. The horse is deaf. He cannot hear anything.

One day, Tom and Lily want to ride the horse. They ask the farmer if they can. The farmer says yes, but they have to be careful. He says the horse is very old and gentle, but he cannot hear them. He says they have to touch him softly and talk to him with their eyes.

Tom and Lily enter the barn where the horse is. They see him eating hay. They walk slowly to him. They touch his nose and his ears. They smile at him. The horse looks at them. He snorts and shakes his head. He likes them.

Tom and Lily climb on his back. They hold his mane. They say "giddy up" and "whoa" but the horse does not hear them. He just walks around the barn. He stops when he sees a carrot. He bends his neck and eats it. Tom and Lily laugh. They pat his neck and say "good boy".

The horse takes them for a ride around the farm. They see the other animals. They wave at them. The animals wave back. They have fun. The horse is happy. He is not lonely. He has two new friends.

Tom was a bad boy. He did not listen to his parent. He did not eat his food. He did not play nice with his toys. He did not say sorry when he was wrong.

One day, his parent said, "Tom, you need to take a nap. You are too tired and grumpy. Go to your bed and lay down."

But Tom did not want to nap. He said, "No, no, no! I do not want to nap. I want to play. I want to have fun. Naps are boring."

His parent said, "Tom, you have to nap. It is good for you. It will make you feel better. You will have more energy and more fun later. Please, do as I say."

But Tom did not do as his parent said. He ran away from his bed. He hid under the table. He made a lot of noise. He threw his toys around. He was very naughty.

His parent was very angry. He found Tom under the table. He said, "Tom, you are a very bad boy. You did not listen to me. You did not obey me. You made a mess. You need a time out. Come with me."

He took Tom to his bed. He said, "Tom, you will stay in your bed until you are sorry. You will not play. You will not talk. You will think about what you did. Maybe then you will be a good boy."

He left Tom in his bed. Tom was very sad. He did not like his bed. He did not like his time out. He wished he had listened to his parent. He wished he had taken a nap. He said, "I am sorry, parent. I am sorry I was bad. I will be good. I will nap. I will listen. I will obey. Please, come back."

But his parent did not come back. He was busy cleaning the mess. He was busy making dinner. He was busy doing other things. He did not hear Tom.

Tom lay in his bed. He cried. He felt lonely. He felt sorry. He fell asleep. He dreamed of being a good boy.

Once upon a time, there was a princess. She was very frightened, because she was alone. She wanted to find her crown.

The princess looked and looked, but it was no where in sight. Then she remembered, she had to pray.

So, she closed her eyes, folded her hands and said her prayers. When she opened her eyes, there was her crown on the ground. It was sparkling and beautiful.

She was so happy and thanked God for helping her find her crown. The princess smiled and wore her crown with pride. 

From that day forward, she always prayed and never forgot to thank God for all the good things in her life.

Lily and Ben are playing with their toy cars and trucks. They like to make noises and pretend they are driving fast. Lily has a red car and Ben has a blue truck.

"Let me see your car, Lily," Ben says. He wants to play with it.

"No, it is mine. You can play with your truck," Lily says. She does not want to share.

Ben is angry. He grabs Lily's car and runs away. "Give it back, Ben! That is not nice!" Lily shouts. She chases him.

Ben runs to the living room, where Mom is watching TV. He hides behind the couch. Lily follows him. She sees Mom and says, "Mom, Ben took my car. He is not sharing. He is mean."

Mom looks at them and says, "Ben, why did you take Lily's car? You have your own truck. You should share with your sister."

Ben does not answer. He holds the car tightly. He likes the red car. It is cool.

Mom says, "Ben, you have to give the car back to Lily. It is hers. If you want to play with it, you have to ask nicely. You cannot demand it."

Ben does not want to give the car back. He says, "No, I want it. It is mine now."

Mom says, "Ben, that is not how we behave. You have to be kind and respectful. If you do not give the car back, you will have a time-out. Do you understand?"

Ben does not like time-outs. He knows Mom is serious. He thinks for a moment. He does not want to be in trouble. He says, "Okay, fine. Here, Lily. You can have your car back. But can I play with it later?"

Lily is happy. She takes her car and says, "Thank you, Ben. Yes, you can play with it later. But you have to ask me first. And you have to let me play with your truck too."

Ben nods. He says, "Okay, deal. I am sorry, Lily. I was not nice."

Lily smiles. She says, "It is okay, Ben. I forgive you. You are my brother. I love you."

Mom smiles too. She says, "That is very good, kids. I am proud of you. You are learning to share and to say sorry. That is a cool operation. Now, do you want to watch some TV with me?"

Lily and Ben say, "Yes, please." They sit on the couch with Mom and watch TV. They are happy. They hug each other and their car and truck. They are friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she was playing with her toys when she saw a big dog running towards her. She started to panic and didn't know what to do.

Just then, her kind neighbor came over and saw what was happening. He quickly ran to Lily and picked her up. "Don't worry, I'll keep you safe," he said. The dog ran away and Lily felt much better.

After that, Lily thanked her neighbor and they had a nice chat. They talked about how much they both loved the sunshine and how important it is to be kind to others. From that day on, Lily knew she could always count on her neighbor to help her if she ever panicked again.

Tim and Lily were friends who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big sign that said "Magic Show Next Week". They were very excited and wanted to see the magic show.

They asked their moms if they could go, and their moms said yes, but they had to be good and do their chores. Tim and Lily agreed and waited for the week to pass.

The day of the magic show came, and Tim and Lily went to the park with their moms. They saw a man with a hat and a wand, who said he was the magician. He did some tricks, like pulling a rabbit out of his hat, and making a coin disappear and reappear.

Tim and Lily clapped and cheered. They believed that the man was really doing magic. They thought he was amazing and clever.

But there was a boy named Max, who was older and mean. He did not believe in magic. He thought the man was lying and cheating. He wanted to spoil the fun for Tim and Lily.

He shouted at the man, "You are not a magician, you are a faker! You are using strings and pockets and mirrors! You are tricking us!"

The man heard Max and was angry. He said, "You are a rude and ignorant boy. You do not know how to enjoy magic. You do not have any imagination or wonder. You are spoiling the show for everyone."

He pointed his wand at Max and said, "Abracadabra!" Then, he snapped his fingers.

Suddenly, Max felt a tickle in his nose. He sneezed, and a bunch of flowers came out of his mouth. He sneezed again, and a stream of water sprayed out of his ears. He sneezed a third time, and a cloud of smoke came out of his eyes.

The man laughed and said, "Now, do you believe in magic?"

Tim and Lily laughed too. They thought Max got what he deserved. They enjoyed the rest of the show, and thanked the man for his magic.

Max was embarrassed and scared. He ran away, crying and sneezing. He learned his lesson, and never bothered Tim and Lily again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to explore and play outside. One day, she went on a walk and found a pretty cave. She was so excited to go inside and see what was there. 

As she walked deeper into the cave, she heard a loud noise. It scared her, so she wanted to stop and go back home. But she remembered her mommy told her to be brave and not give up. So, she kept going until she found a cute little bunny stuck in a hole. 

Lily stopped and helped the bunny out of the hole. The bunny was so happy and grateful, it hopped away. Lily felt proud of herself for being brave and helping the bunny. She went back home and told her mommy all about her adventure in the pretty cave.

Once upon a time, there was a family who loved to race. They would race each other every single day! They became really good at it, but soon one of them wanted to be the best. He started to race really hard and work extra hard to be the best.

The other members of the family saw this and felt sad. They wanted to race for fun, not for a competition. The hard racing upset them. They wanted to have fun like before, but the hard racing kept happening. 

The family knew they had to do something. One day, they all decided to race together, with the same rules, and the same goal. To have fun! They all raced together, enjoying the time they spent together. 

And eventually, they became the best family at racing. But most importantly, they had fun while doing it.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat was in the ocean and it had a big anchor. The anchor helped the boat stay in one place. The boat was far away from the land, it was very distant.

One day, some people came to the boat. They wanted to decorate the boat with pretty things. They put up colorful flags and balloons. The boat looked very pretty with all the decorations.

The people had a party on the boat and they had lots of fun. They danced and sang songs. The boat stayed in one place because of the anchor. The people were happy to be on the boat, even though it was very distant from the land.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his rubber ball. He would bounce it up and down, up and down. One day, Timmy imagined that he was a superhero with a fast car. He pretended to drive his car around the living room, making vroom vroom sounds.

But then, something bad happened. Timmy accidentally threw his rubber ball too hard, and it bounced out the window. Timmy tried to catch it, but it was too fast. The ball bounced down the street and into the road, where a big truck ran over it. Timmy was so sad that he cried.

Timmy's mom hugged him and said, "It's okay, Timmy. We can buy you a new ball." But Timmy knew that it wouldn't be the same. He learned that sometimes, imagining things can be fun, but it's important to be careful with the things we love.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she wanted to cook some cookies with her mom. They mixed flour, sugar, and eggs together in a big bowl. Then, they put the cookies in the oven to bake.

After they finished cooking, Lily and her mom sat down to enjoy the cookies. Suddenly, Lily's foot started to hurt. She was sad because she couldn't run and play like she wanted to. Her mom gave her a hug and said, "Don't worry, we'll put some ice on your foot to make it feel better." 

Lily felt better after a while and was happy again. She thanked her mom for helping her and they continued to enjoy their cookies together.

Once upon a time there was a fisherman. He went fishing every day, in the same spot under the bridge. He had a regular routine - he would use his pole, cast his line and patiently wait for a bite.

One day while fishing, he noticed a little blinking light in the water. He stared at it for a while, wondering what it could be.

"Hello? Is someone there?" he asked.

"Yes!" said a small, squeaky voice.

The fisherman was surprised - he leaned closer to the water, and down in the deep he saw a fish with a shining, blinking light on its head.

"Hey there little fish!" said the fisherman. "What's your name?"

The little fish looked up and said: "My name is Glowy!"

Glowy said he was lonely and asked the fisherman if he could come along with him. The fisherman said yes, so Glowy leapt out of the water onto the shore. The fisherman packed up his fishng supplies and, with Glowy safely tucked in his pocket, went home for a regular dinner.

From then on, the fisherman and Glowy were great friends and went fishing together every day. Blink, blink!

Once upon a time, there was a big forest. In the forest, there lived a wise old owl. The owl was very clever and always knew what to do. 

One day, a little girl named Lily went into the forest to look for some berries. She wandered too far and got lost. She was very scared and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, the owl appeared and hooted loudly. Lily was surprised but happy to see the owl. The owl asked her where she lived and Lily told her. The owl said she would help her find her way home. 

The owl flew ahead and Lily followed. They walked and walked until they reached Lily's house. Lily was so happy to be home and she thanked the owl for helping her return safely. As a thank you, Lily's mom made some tasty cookies for the owl to eat.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a gloomy day. The sky was gray, and the trees were sad. The people in the village did not feel happy.

In the village, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily felt sad too. She started to cry. She cried because she wanted the sun to come out and play.

Then, a big, fluffy cloud heard Lily cry. The cloud felt bad for her. So, the cloud moved away, and the sun came out. The village was happy again, and Lily stopped crying. They all played and had fun in the sunshine.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to scatter in the morning. Every morning, she would skip around the garden and scatter all the tiny pieces of light she found there. One morning though, she came across something new; coffee. She had never seen coffee before and she was so excited that she just had to pick it up and scatter it around. She ran around the garden, sprinkling coffee everywhere and the garden filled with a delicious scent. She ran and jumped, scattering coffee around with a huge grin on her face. After she had scattered the coffee all over, she stood back and admired her work. The garden had been filled with light, and now it was even brighter. She smiled and skipped away, feeling happy and satisfied.

Once there was a lady. She had a special promise. Every day she would follow it. It made her feel normal.

The promise was that she would be kind to others. She had a special smile for everyone she met. She said hello when she walked past. Everyone around her felt happy.

Then one day, a little girl was walking by. She looked sad. The lady stopped and asked why she was feeling down. The little girl said she had no friends.

The lady smiled and promised her that she would be her friend. She told the girl that if she followed her, she would always have someone to talk to.

The little girl smiled and thanked the lady. They walked away together, with the lady always keeping her promise in mind. 

From that day on, they were best friends and they felt normal thanks to the special promise they shared.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to read books. One day a special book caught her eye. It looked incredible - bigger than the others and more colourful. She did not know what it was but wanted to see it closer. She asked her mum what it was and she said it was a novel. The little girl was very excited to hold this novel in her hand.

As she opened the book she could not believe what she saw. There were amazing pictures and so many words that she had never seen before. She knew it was a special book and she read it every day. As she read she began to see things that she did not understand. She asked her mum what some of the things meant and when she heard the answers, the little girl eyes lit up with wonder and delight.

The little girl kept reading this incredible novel and each time she picked it up she was filled with excitement. As she read, she discovered a new world full of surprises, adventure and wonder. She couldn't believe how things from earlier in the book made sense later on. The novel was amazing and the little girl loves it so much.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old. One day her mommy gave her a special gift. It was a pretty phone! Jane was so happy to have the phone. She ran around the house with it, showing all her toys. Jane had so much fun!

The next day, Jane's mommy gave her another surprise. This time it was a box of pink balloons. Jane was so excited! She ran around the house with her balloons and her phone, looking so happy.

On the third day, Jane's mommy gave her a special hug. Jane felt so loved. She hugged her mommy back and smiled.

Jane was so happy because of all the surprises her mommy had given her. She was very thankful and she loved her mommy very much.

Once upon a time in a small forest there lived a little rabbit. Each day the rabbit went for a walk, hopping around the forest and looking at all the animals and plants. One day, the rabbit noticed a strange mushroom growing on a tree. It was a tall mushroom with a long stem and a rounded top. 

The rabbit was a bit troubled. He had never seen such a mushroom before. He wondered what kind of mushroom it was, why it was growing on a tree instead of the ground, and why it was so tall. 

The rabbit decided to look around the mushroom and see if he could find some clues. He noticed some small beetles crawling around the base of the mushroom, and he realized that the mushroom must be providing food for the beetles. He saw some of the beetles climb up the stem of the mushroom and disappear inside the top. 

The rabbit was a bit more troubled now. He had never seen anything like this before! Then suddenly, the top of the mushroom opened and out came a beautiful white butterfly. The rabbit smiled as he watched the butterfly fly from the tree and flutter away into the sky. 

The rabbit noticed that the mushroom had been providing a home for the little beetles and a place for the beautiful white butterfly to hatch from its cocoon. He was so happy that he had taken the time to notice the mushroom and learn more about it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a black cat named Mittens who liked to play with yarn. One day, Lily wanted to have a picnic with her friends. She planned to bring sandwiches and cookies.

But then, her mommy got a call from a lawyer. The lawyer said they had to go to court because of a parking ticket. Lily didn't understand what a parking ticket was, but she knew it made her mommy sad.

So, Lily decided to make her mommy happy by drawing a picture of Mittens and giving it to her mommy. Her mommy smiled and hugged her. Lily felt happy too because her plan worked!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom told her that it was going to rain outside, so they decided to stay inside and play together. They played with dolls and blocks and had so much fun.

But then, Lily remembered that she had an exam the next day for her preschool class. She felt guilty because she hadn't studied yet. "Mommy, I feel guilty. I didn't study for my exam," said Lily. 

"Don't worry, Lily. We can study together and you will do great on your exam," said her mom. So, they spent the rest of the day studying and practicing for Lily's exam. 

The next day, Lily went to school and took her exam. She felt proud of herself because she had studied so hard. After school, it started to rain again, but Lily didn't mind because she knew she had done her best on her exam.

Once upon a time, there was a wild ear. It had a mind of its own, and it liked to wander off to explore the woods.

One day, the ear decided to go on a big adventure. He hopped off and started running. He raced up hill, across rivers, and through the tall trees. He did not stop until he reached a beautiful meadow.

As the ear was walking around one bush, he heard a noise. It was a loud noise and it scared him. He turned and saw that it was a big pair of scissors. The scissors were cutting nearby, so the ear started to panic. He ran and ran until he was out of sight. 

But even though he was safe, the ear wasnâ€™t quite the same. He had been scared so badly that he was now missing a bit of his left ear. The ear was not wild anymore â€“ he was just a bit different. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a world of snow. Everything in the world was white, the trees, the sky, everything! 

In this world there lived a little girl. She wanted to explore the world and see all of it's beauty. So she stepped outside and began to walk. 

The little girl walked for a very long time, until she saw something in the distance. It was a big castle, the biggest one she had ever seen! She couldn't wait to visit it. 

When she arrived at the castle, a big man stood in front of her. He smiled and asked her what she wanted. The little girl smiled back and said, "I want to explore". The man nodded his head and opened the door. 

The little girl was so excited to explore the world around her. She was amazed at all of the spectacular things she saw. Before the little girl knew it, the day was over and it was time to go home. 

The little girl thanked the man for giving her a chance to explore the castle. He smiled and nodded his head and said goodbye. 

The little girl left the castle and walked back home with a smile on her face. 

She had experienced a whole new white world that she never knew existed!

Once upon a time there was a fly. This fly was orange, so it was very special.

The fly was so special that it began to demand things from all the other insects it knew. It wanted them to do whatever it wanted them to do.

One day, the fly wanted to go on an adventure. It demanded that the other bugs help it fly away.

The other bugs were hesitant at first, but decided to help the fly. They flew with the fly for hours and hours.

Finally, the orange fly made it to its destination. It had been a long journey, but the fly was happy to have arrived. It thanked the other bugs for helping it make it to its destination.

Once upon a time, there were two naughty kids. They loved to run and play near a big, tall structure in their backyard. One day, they decided to do something very naughty and climb the structure.

The kids reached the top of it and looked around. They could see far away, but at the same time, they felt scared. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. They looked down and saw their mom coming! They quickly climbed down, one step at a time.

Their mom was angry. She said they should never go near the structure again. She warned them of the danger. But the kids didn't understand.

Time passed and the kids grew up. They started to regret not listening to their mom. They wished they had listened so they wouldn't have gotten in trouble. From then on, they stayed away from the tall structure and never climbed it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved dolphins, they were her favorite animal. One day, she went to the beach with her mommy and daddy. She saw a dolphin swimming in the water and it made her very happy. 

Lily wanted to decorate her room with dolphin pictures. She asked her mommy, "Can we get some good dolphin pictures for my room?" Her mommy said, "Yes, we can go to the store and find some good ones." 

After they went to the store, they found some good dolphin pictures. Lily was so happy and said, "Thank you mommy and daddy, my room will be so pretty now!"

Once upon a time, there was a queen who lived in a beautiful palace. Every day, the queen would take her royal carriage and go out for a ride. On a beautiful summer day, the queen was out in her carriage when it suddenly rolled in a ditch. She got out and tried pushing the carriage, but it was too heavy.

Suddenly, a little girl came running up to the queen. "Hello," she said, with a smile. "Can I help you?". The queen was so happy to see her that she said "Yes, please!". 

The little girl grabbed one end of the carriage and began to push. With her help, the queen and the carriage were soon back on the road.

"Thank you very much," said the queen, smiling. "You have been a great help."

"You're welcome," said the little girl, still smiling. "I'm serious about helping people!"

The queen was very pleased and thanked the little girl again. 

The queen continued on her journey, happy with the help the little girl had offered.

Once upon a time, there was a poor boy named Timmy. Timmy lived in a small house with his mommy and daddy. They did not have a lot of money, so they could not buy many toys for Timmy to play with.

One day, Timmy needed to go to the toilet. He went to his mommy and daddy and demanded that they take him to the toilet. They quickly took him to the toilet and Timmy was very happy.

After Timmy finished in the toilet, he went back to his mommy and daddy and gave them a big hug. Even though they were poor, Timmy loved his mommy and daddy very much.

Once upon a time, there was a man who loved to load his journal with stories. Every day he wrote in his journal, but one day it was gloomy outside and the man didn't want to write. He felt sad and walked around feeling sadder and sadder.

The man thought maybe he should take a walk to feel happier. So he loaded his journal in a bag and started walking. He walked through the gloomy trees and looked at the gray sky. He felt a bit better. 

Then he noticed a colorful bird flying above him. The bird was singing a happy song and the man smiled for the first time since he began walking. He watched the bird fly around and chirp its happy song. The man suddenly felt much happier and started to laugh.

The man was so happy that he started to skip. He skipped all the way back home, loaded his journal and wrote down all his happy thoughts. He was so glad that he had gone for a walk, even though it was a gloomy day. The man smiled and knew that tomorrow would be a better day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had long hair that always got in his eyes, so his mom took him to the barber. The barber was a man who cut hair for a living. Timmy thought the barber was weird because he had a big mustache.

When Timmy sat in the barber's chair, he got scared. He didn't want the barber to cut his hair. But his mom said it was time for a haircut, so Timmy had to be brave. The barber started cutting Timmy's hair, and Timmy didn't like it. He wanted to run away, but he couldn't.

After a while, the barber was finished. Timmy looked in the mirror and saw that he looked different. He felt sad because he liked his long hair. But then his mom told him that it was just hair, and it would grow back. Timmy learned that sometimes we have to part with things we like, but it's okay because they can come back in a different way.

Once upon a time, there was a vehicle. It was a tough vehicle and it needed help. It had to make it up a big hill. The vehicle could not make it up the hill on its own. So, a friend came to help.

The friend was very encouraging. He said, â€œCome on, vehicle. You can do it! You are tough!â€

And with the encouraging words of his friend, the vehicle was able to make it up the hill! Everyone cheered for the vehicle and the friend was so proud of the vehicle for being so tough.

After the vehicle made it up the hill, the two friends high-fived each other. They were so happy and the vehicle was so proud. It had made it up the hill!

Once there was a lazy butterfly. He spent all his days fluttering around in the meadow. One day he spotted a big, quiet tree. So he decided to take a rest there and when he did, his eyes closed and he began to blink.

Soon enough, the little butterfly was fast asleep. He slept so quietly that no one bothered him.

When dusk began to come, the butterfly woke up. He lazily fluttered out of the tree and started playing in the meadow again. Everywhere he fluttered he had a big, friendly smile on his face.

The next day, the butterfly blinked and flew away, no one ever knew where he went. But his friends in the meadow couldn't help but imagine what adventures he could have had in his far away destination.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted a cookie, but her mommy said no. Lily was sad. 

One day, she went to the park and saw a lady sitting on a bench. The lady had a bag of cookies. Lily wanted a cookie, so she asked the lady. The lady said yes and gave her a cookie. 

But when Lily took a bite, she made a sour face. The cookie was bitter! She didn't like it. The lady said sorry and gave her a sweet cookie instead. Lily was happy and said thank you.

One day, a group of friends were playing outside when they started to feel hot. They noticed that there was an amazing spray nearby. 

So the friends decided to run and play in the spray! It felt so cool and refreshing. They laughed and squealed with joy as they were sprayed. 

The friends screamed and clapped whenever the spray stopped; then they'd go back for more again and again! It was so much fun.

The friends had an amazing time playing in the spray. It was the best day ever, and they will always remember it.

Once upon a time, there lived a naughty infant. The infant loved nothing more than getting into mischief. One day, the infant was pranking the animals when suddenly the sky became very dark. Thunder and lightning filled the air and the infant became frightened.

Luckily, a kind-hearted fairy was nearby and saw the frightened infant. She waved her wand and the storm was restored. The infant was so relieved to see the sun again that she hugged the fairy tight and thanked her.

From then on, the naughty infant learned to always be kind and not get into trouble. Each time she thought of doing something naughty, she remembered the kind fairy and her magical wand, and she decided to be good instead. The infant was restored and the world was a better place.

Once upon a time, there was a goose named Gigi. Gigi was very fat because she loved to eat all day long. One day, Gigi met a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to cook and he asked Gigi, "Would you like me to cook you something yummy to eat?"

Gigi said, "Yes, please!" and Timmy went to his kitchen to cook. He made a delicious meal for Gigi and she ate it all up. After eating, Gigi felt sleepy and decided to take a nap.

While Gigi was sleeping, Timmy saw a big fox coming towards Gigi. He knew that foxes like to eat geese, so he quickly woke up Gigi and they both ran away.

From that day on, Gigi and Timmy became good friends and Timmy promised to always protect Gigi from any danger. And Gigi promised to never eat too much and become too fat again.

Anna and Ben are playing in the park. They see a big dog with brown fur. The dog is furry and soft. Anna and Ben want to pet the dog.

"Hello, doggy!" Anna says. "Can we touch your fur?"

The dog wags its tail and licks Anna's face. Anna giggles and strokes the dog's fur. Ben admires the dog. He thinks the dog is brave and strong.

"Can I pet you too, doggy?" Ben asks.

The dog barks and runs to Ben. Ben hugs the dog and feels its fur. The dog is warm and friendly.

The dog's owner comes to the park. He sees Anna and Ben with his dog.

"Hi, kids!" he says. "Do you like my dog? His name is Rex."

Anna and Ben nod and smile. They like Rex very much.

"Rex likes you too," the owner says. "He is a good dog. He likes to play and cuddle."

"Can we play with Rex again?" Anna asks.

"Sure, you can," the owner says. "We come to the park every day. Maybe we can see you again."

Anna and Ben are happy. They say goodbye to Rex and his owner. They go back to their mom and dad. They tell them about the furry dog they admire.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Joe and Mary. Joe had an amazing motor toy. Mary wanted to try it out too.

"Can I try it?" asked Mary to Joe.

"Yes, of course. Just imagine how fast it will go," said Joe excitedly.

Joe showed her how to drive the motor. He had put some spicy in its tank so that it would go even faster.

Mary was thrilled. She imagined herself flying on the motor while it made its loud noises. They roared around the countryside together, having lots of fun.

Finally, the motor came to a stop and the two tired friends hugged each other.

"That was the best day ever!" said Mary. 

Joe just smiled. He was happy to share his motor with his best friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Benny. Benny lived in a big cave with his mama bear. One day, Benny wanted to go on an adventure but he was hungry. Mama bear told him she would supply him with some honey for his journey.

Benny was so happy and ran out of the cave, feeling alert and ready for his adventure. As he was walking through the forest, he saw a little rabbit who looked scared. Benny asked the rabbit what was wrong and the rabbit said he was lost and didn't know how to get back home.

Benny knew he had to help the little rabbit, so he led him back to his home in the forest. The rabbit was so grateful and thanked Benny for being so kind and alert. Benny felt proud of himself for helping someone in need and went back home to his mama bear with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a long day at school and he was very tired. When he got home, he went straight to his room to rest. He lay down on his bed and looked at his screen. The screen was big and bright, and Timmy loved to watch his favorite shows on it.

Suddenly, Timmy's mom called him for dinner. Timmy got up and went to the kitchen. He ate his dinner and went back to his room. He watched a few more shows on his screen before going to bed. As he was falling asleep, he heard a strange noise coming from the screen. It sounded like a monster!

Timmy got scared and called his mom. She came into his room and saw the monster on the screen. She knew what to do. She pressed a button on the remote control and the monster disappeared. Timmy was relieved and went back to sleep. From that day on, he made sure to turn off his screen before going to bed.

Once upon a time, there was a great reindeer. He had a special job. He was a snow-stopper. His job was to prevent snow from coming. Every day, he stood and looked at the sky. He waited to see if snow was coming.

One day, he saw something very special in the sky. He spotted a big group of reindeer. It was a whole family of reindeer! The great reindeer was so happy. He couldn't believe it.

The great reindeer was excited to meet the reindeer family. He waved to them in the sky. He knew that the reindeer family would help him to prevent snow from coming. They could fly all around and keep the snow away.

From that day on, the great reindeer and the reindeer family worked together. They flew around the sky and stopped snow from coming.

Thanks to the great reindeer and the reindeer family, everyone stayed warm and cozy. They were very happy with their new friends!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was three years old and he really liked watching boats. One day, he decided to take a look at what was in the sea. He ran to the beach, and when he got close he saw something amazing - a navy! He was so excited. 

Jack started walking along the beach and soon he discovered a beautiful boat. It was a navy boat with big white sails. He decided to jump inside. As he explored the boat he noticed it was very peaceful inside. 

Jack enjoyed his time in the navy boat and he pretended he was the captain of the boat for the day. He discovered many interesting things and had great adventures. 

When the sun started to set, Jack had to go home. He said goodbye to his navy boat and promised to come back soon. He was really happy to have discovered such a peaceful place.

Once upon a time there lived two friends, both called Jane. Jane the first was a kind and happy girl who always looked on the bright side of life. She was always cheerful and always looking for ways to make her life better.

Jane the second was a gloomy girl however, who was always worrying and complaining about life. She thought everything was too hard and too sad.

One day, Jane the first found a treasure in the woods. Both girls were excited and decided to spend the day hunting for treasure. Jane the second was worried and asked Jane the first what would happen to the treasure when it was spent.

Jane the first smiled and answered, â€œno matter how much treasure is spent, the best treasure is always friends!â€ Her friend agreed and they had a great day searching for treasure and sharing their friendship.

From then on, Jane the second always remembered that her friendship with Jane the first was the most precious treasure. Despite the gloomy days she prayed for, she knew that she had a spark in her life that brought joy to her life - her friendship with Jane the first.

Ben was bored. His parents had left him at home while they went shopping. To make things more boring, it was raining outside and he couldn't even play in the garden.

Suddenly he heard a loud thumping sound. He looked out the window and saw a big pile of lumber that someone had dropped in the garden. 

He quickly ran outside. Even though it was raining he didn't care. It was time to play!

He moved each piece of lumber and built a great hideaway. It was the best game ever and he decided he wouldn't leave until it was dark.

When the sun started to go down, Ben reluctantly left his hideaway and went back inside. He was very tired, but he had so much fun. Even though it was a boring day, it had a fun ending!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sophie. Sophie was three years old. She wanted a tutor all of her own.

One day, Sophie heard a knock at her door. When she opened it, she saw an old lady. She was a tutor. 'Welcome,' said the old woman.

Sophie was so excited, she quickly invited the lady into her house. The tutor said she could teach Sophie all kinds of new things.

The old lady was so very thoughtful. Every day she would bring Sophie new books and toys to help her learn. Sophie was so delighted! 

The old lady was a very patient tutor. She taught Sophie how to draw and how to count. Every student needs a patient tutor, thought Sophie. It was the best day ever. 

Sophie was happy to have a kind and thoughtful tutor who could help her learn. She was always excited to welcome her tutor every day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Anne. She was so cute and everyone wanted to play with her.

One day Anne heard clapping. She looked around and she saw some people around a car. They were all happy and clapping. Anne walked closer and saw that the car was running on gas. She was so amazed, she couldn't believe that the car was running on gas.

Then Anne asked her dad, "What is going on?"

Her dad said, "These people are applauding because the car is running on gas. Isn't it amazing?"

Anne thought it was amazing and started applauding too. She was so excited and clapped as hard as she could. Everyone around started laughing at how cute she was.

Anne felt so proud that she could help make the car run on gas. She knew that it was something special and meaningful to all of them. From that day on, Anne remembered what she had learned and always knew that gas can help make things run.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his toy cars and trucks. One day, he found an ancient gear on the ground. It was rusty and old, but Timmy thought it was cool.

He took the gear home and showed it to his dad. His dad told him it was very old and special. Timmy wanted to keep it safe, so he put it in a box and locked it with a key.

But one day, Timmy's little sister found the key and opened the box. She played with the gear and accidentally broke it. Timmy was very sad that his special gear was broken and couldn't be fixed.

Timmy learned that sometimes things can't be fixed when they're broken, but he still had his toy cars and trucks to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Maisy. She was playing in her bedroom when she saw a big chest in the corner. Maisy was very curious, so she walked over to the chest and opened it. Inside she found lots of toys! Maisy was so excited that she grabbed the toys and started to play.

Suddenly, her older brother Oliver burst into the room. "Put those back!" he said in a loud bossy voice. Maisy was so scared, she quickly put the toys back in the chest and shut the lid. She started to cry.

Oliver saw her crying and said, "Don't worry, I won't be mad. You can play with the toys if you want. I just don't want you to make a mess in here!" Maisy smiled and said, "Thank you, Oliver!" She was so happy that she opened the chest and started playing with her toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a sweet sister named Daisy. They loved to play together and have fun. One day, they decided to go to the park to play on the swings and slide.

When they got to the park, Lily saw a big truck. She asked her sister, "What is that big truck doing?" Daisy replied, "It's here to load some things." They watched as the truck filled up with big boxes.

Suddenly, one of the boxes fell off the truck and landed on Daisy. She was hurt very badly and had to go to the hospital. Lily felt very sad and wished she could take back what happened. She learned that sometimes accidents happen and it's important to be careful.

Once upon a time, there was a big, black cat named Mittens. Mittens was very graceful and could jump very high. One day, Mittens wanted to go outside to play. So, she asked her owner if she could go outside. Her owner said yes, and Mittens ran outside.

Suddenly, there was thunder in the sky. Mittens was scared of thunder, so she tried to run back inside. But, she tripped and fell down. Mittens hurt her leg and couldn't walk anymore. She cried and cried, but nobody came to help her.

Finally, Mittens' owner found her and took her to the vet. But, it was too late. Mittens had hurt herself badly and couldn't walk anymore. Mittens was very sad that she couldn't jump and play anymore. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a nice lady named Jane. Jane worked in a big place called a hospital. Every day, she would go there to help people feel better. She liked to make them happy and see them smile.

One day, Jane had to prepare a big room for a little boy named Tim. Tim was not feeling well, so he had to come to the hospital. Jane put clean sheets on the bed, and she put some toys in the room for Tim to play with. She wanted Tim to feel at home.

When Tim came to the hospital, he saw the nice room that Jane had prepared for him. He saw the toys and smiled. Jane was happy to see Tim smile. She knew that he would feel better soon. And Tim did feel better, all thanks to the nice lady Jane and the hospital.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing sport with his friends. They would play soccer, basketball and baseball together. One day, Timmy's friend Billy stole his soccer ball. Timmy was very sad because he loved that ball. He told Billy it was bad to steal and asked him to give it back. Billy said sorry and gave the ball back. From then on, they played sport together happily. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily and her friend Timmy were playing in the park when they saw a big, fierce dog. They were scared and didn't know what to do.

Lily said, "Let's discuss what we should do."

Timmy replied, "We should file away from the dog."

So, they ran away as fast as they could. When they were safe, they talked about the scary dog and how they felt. They both agreed that they never wanted to see that dog again. 

From that day on, Lily and Timmy always made sure to be careful and stay away from any fierce dogs they saw.

Buddy was a loyal dog. He loved his owner, Sam, very much. Every day, Sam would take Buddy for a walk, play with him, and give him treats. Buddy would wag his tail, lick Sam's face, and smile.

One day, Sam had to go to school. He put on his backpack and said, "Bye, Buddy. I'll be back soon. Be a good boy." Buddy barked and watched Sam leave. He felt sad and lonely. He wanted to go with Sam.

Buddy decided to look for Sam. He jumped over the fence and ran down the street. He sniffed the air and followed Sam's scent. He crossed the park, the bridge, and the busy road. He saw a big building with many children. He thought Sam was there.

Buddy ran to the door and pushed it open. He ran inside and looked for Sam. He saw many people, but not Sam. He heard someone say, "Hey, there's a dog in here!" He heard someone else say, "Get him out!" He heard someone else say, "He's cute!"

Buddy was scared and confused. He ran around, looking for a way out. He bumped into tables, chairs, and books. He knocked over a vase, a lamp, and a clock. He made a big mess. He heard people yell and scream.

Suddenly, he saw Sam. Sam was in a classroom, sitting at a desk. He looked up and saw Buddy. He said, "Buddy, what are you doing here?" He got up and ran to Buddy. He hugged him and said, "I'm sorry, Buddy. I didn't mean to leave you alone. You're my best friend."

Buddy was happy and relieved. He licked Sam's face and smiled. He wagged his tail and said, "Woof, woof!" He was glad to see Sam. He didn't care about the mess. He only cared about Sam.

Sam's teacher was not happy. She said, "Sam, you can't bring your dog to school. He caused a lot of trouble. You have to take him home and clean up the mess."

Sam said, "I'm sorry, teacher. I didn't know he would follow me. He's a loyal dog. He loves me very much."

The teacher said, "I can see that. He's a lucky dog to have you as his owner. But you have to be more careful next time. Now, go home and come back tomorrow."

Sam said, "Okay, teacher. Thank you." He took Buddy by the leash and walked out of the school. He said, "Come on, Buddy. Let's go home. I'll give you a treat and a hug. You're a good boy."

Buddy barked and smiled. He followed Sam home. He was happy to be with Sam. He was a loyal dog.

John was hungry, but he didn't want to eat just anything. He wanted something healthy and delicious. 

"I want a sandwich," he said. 

Mum smiled and replied, "Okay, let's make a healthy sandwich."

John was excited and followed Mum to the kitchen. They gathered the ingredients and Mum handed him a knife.

John cut the vegetables and got to work spreading the cheese on the slices of bread. The sandwich was finally ready. 

"Wow! That looks so delicious!" said John. 

Mum told him, "Let's put it in the toaster to give it a crunchy twist."

John was surprised, but he agreed. He pressed the button and they watched as the sandwich went in and reversed out of the toaster. 

Mum looked at John, who was drooling with anticipation. She smiled and said, "There you go. Enjoy your healthy sandwich!"

Once there was a happy girl named Meg. She loved exploring the world around her. One day, Meg was outside in her garden. She spotted an unusual thing in the sky. It was a giant balloon! Suddenly, Meg screamed with joy.

Meg wanted to reach the balloon and touched it. As soon as she did, it started to rise up in the sky! Meg clapped her hands with excitement as the balloon drifted away.

For hours, Meg watched the balloon rise higher and higher. But then, something strange happened. The balloon started to change its style. Instead of being round, it was now in a very different shape. Meg was amazed!

The balloon started to move in a very fast and normal way. Suddenly, Meg realised it was heading back down to the ground! She screamed with delight as the balloon floated back down to her. It was a magical moment!

Yesterday, the girl was restless. She dreamed of having a magical adventure. Everywhere her dream led her was new and exciting. She zoomed around in a rocket ship and went deep under the sea. She played games on distant planets and flew around skies filled with rainbow-colored birds.

The girl held tight to her dream and used it to explore places she had never been before. As night fell, the girl returned to her room and wished that the magic of her dream could stay with her forever.

The next morning, she smiled as she remembered how wonderful yesterday's dream had been. No matter how restless she felt, her dream was the perfect escape.

Tim and Jen like to play in the park. They run, jump, slide and swing. They have fun with their friends. But there is one thing they do not like. It is the big fence. The big fence is tough and tall. It does not let them see what is behind it.

One day, Tim and Jen are curious. They want to know what is behind the big fence. They look for a hole or a gap, but they do not find any. They try to climb, but they are too small. They ask their friends, but they do not know. They ask their mom and dad, but they do not tell. They say it is a mystery.

Tim and Jen do not give up. They have a plan. They wait until the park is empty. They bring a big box and a rope. They put the box near the fence. They tie the rope to the box. They pull the rope hard. The box moves. It hits the fence. The fence makes a loud noise. It shakes. It bends. It yields.

Tim and Jen are happy. They see a hole in the fence. They peek through the hole. They see what is behind the fence. They see a lot of trees and flowers. They see a pond and a bridge. They see a house and a car. They see a dog and a cat. They see a man and a woman. They see their mom and dad.

Tim and Jen are surprised. They do not understand. They ask their mom and dad. They say they are sorry. They say they have a secret. They say they own the land behind the fence. They say they built the house and the car. They say they love the dog and the cat. They say they wanted to make a surprise for Tim and Jen. They say they wanted to share their mystery with them.

Tim and Jen are happy. They hug their mom and dad. They thank them for the surprise. They say they love them. They say they love the land behind the fence. They say they want to play there. They say they want to share their mystery with their friends. They say they do not need the big fence anymore. They say they want to take it down. They say they want to make the park bigger and better.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Ollie. He was very excited today because he had a very big exam. He was so eager to start it!

When he got to school, all the other children in his class were already there and busy with their exams. Everyone was trying very hard not to make any mistakes.

Suddenly, a plate of delicious, tasty cherries appeared on Ollie's desk. He was so happy and started eating his cherries as he worked on his exam. 

Ollie was having so much fun that he didn't notice that, one by one, the cherries were quickly vanishing. When he looked down at his plate again, there were no more left. He was so shocked and asked, "Where did all the cherries go?"

His teacher smiled and said, "Those cherries have vanished! You must have eaten them all!"

Ollie laughed and finished his exam, feeling more relaxed and confident. He was glad the tasty cherries had given him such a boost.

One day there was a little girl called Sarah. She was 3 years old and had a big appetite for jelly! She was so excited to hear that the supermarket had plenty of jelly in stock.

So Sarah asked her parents if she could go to the store and get some jelly. After thinking for a moment, her parents said yes!

When Sarah arrived at the supermarket, she was even more excited. She picked the biggest and brightest jelly she could find.

Then she went to the register and the lady at the store told her that the jelly she had chosen was too expensive. Sarah was so sorry. But then the lady said that she would give Sarah the jelly for free!

Sarah was so excited! She took the jelly home and shared it with her family and it tasted delicious! Everybody was so happy and Sarah was excited to have found such a yummy jelly.

Ernie was playing in his room when he heard a terrible noise coming from outside. He stepped outside to investigate and he saw that his dad was out in the garden involved in a big project. Ernie was very curious, so he asked his dad what he was doing. His dad said he was making something with a hammer. Ernie was so excited and asked if he could help.

His dad let him try hammering for a few minutes, but it was too difficult for him. After a few attempts Ernie dropped the hammer and it made a terrible noise. His dad was mad because the hammer was broken. He said Ernie was too young to help and sent him back inside. 

Ernie was sad and confused. He had been so careful, why was his dad so mad? Suddenly Ernie realized what had happened; he had made a terrible mess! Ernie was embarrassed and he knew he had to fix it, but he didn't know how. He was really scared and he began to cry. 

Ernie's dad quickly came to his side and hugged him tight. He said that it was okay and he understood why the hammer broke. He said a real hammer was much too heavy for Ernie. Then his dad went back outside and got a special toy hammer for Ernie. They spent the rest of the afternoon making things together, and it was a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty mouse. It was always so clever and brave. One day, it was playing in the garden when it saw a big bucket of paint. It wanted to have fun and paint the garden, but it knew it mustn't. The mouse ran away to prevent the paint from spilling.

Soon, the mouse ran into a big, strong and mighty lion. The lion asked the mouse why it was running away. The mouse told the lion all about the bucket of paint. The lion felt sorry for the mouse and decided to help. He agreed to help the mouse prevent the paint from spilling.

The lion asked the mouse to climb onto his back. Then, the lion raced over to the bucket of paint. He arrived just in time - the bucket was about to fall over! The lion placed his big, strong and mighty paw over the bucket and held it steady.

The mouse was so relieved. It thanked the lion for helping to prevent the paint from spilling. The lion smiled warmly and said it was no problem. Together, they had saved the bucket of paint and made the garden a happy place.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She went on a big trip with her mommy and daddy. They had lots of luggage with them. Lily had a pink backpack with her favorite toy inside.

On the way to the airplane, they saw a big bird flying in the sky. Lily wanted to skip like a bird, but her backpack was too heavy. So, she held her mommy's hand and walked quietly to the airplane.

When they arrived at their destination, they went to a quiet hotel. Lily was so tired from the trip that she fell asleep right away. The next day, they went to the beach and Lily skipped in the sand. She loved the feeling of the sand between her toes. It was a fun trip for Lily and her family.

Alex liked to study. He went to school every day. He liked to learn. Today he was studying science.

Alex found it fun. He learned about plants, animals and more. He also learned about how to be creative. 

Alex liked to be creative. He liked to invent things. He liked to draw pictures and make things with his hands.

At the end of the day, Alex was tired. His mom had made some tea. Alex drank his tea and went to bed. 

Alex dreamed about being creative and learning new things. He couldn't wait for the next day of school to come!

Once upon a time there was a girl. Her name was Sarah. One day Sarah was sick, so she had to go to the hospital. Her mommy and daddy brought her there in the car.

At the hospital, the doctors looked at Sarah. They said she needed an o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n. They said it would make her feel fit again. So Sarah was brought into the o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n room.

The doctors did the o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n and it was over in no time. When they were done, Sarah felt much better.

The doctors were so happy. They said Sarah was now fit and well. They gave her a big hug and said she could go home.

Sarah and her mommy and daddy drove home in the car. Sarah was happy to be home and fit again!

Tim and Sam like to play sport. They like to run and kick a ball. They are good friends and share the ball. But one day, a new boy comes to the park. His name is Max. He is rude.

Max sees Tim and Sam playing sport. He runs to them and takes the ball. He says, "This is my ball now. You can't play with it. Go away!" Tim and Sam are sad and angry. They say, "That is not nice. That is our ball. Give it back!"

Max does not listen. He laughs and runs away with the ball. He says, "You are silly. You can't catch me. I am the best at sport." Tim and Sam chase him. They want their ball back. They are not happy.

They run and run, but Max is fast. He goes to the other side of the park. He sees a big slide. He thinks, "I will go on the slide with the ball. That will be fun." He climbs up the slide. He holds the ball.
