Their mom nods and kisses them. "I'm glad you had fun. Now, it's time for a nap," she says.

Lily and Ben nod and yawn. They go to their room. They lie on their beds. They close their eyes. They have a good nap.

One day, a dog named Spot wanted to play golf. Spot put on his fancy hat and went to the park. He saw a big tree and thought it would be fun to use it in his game.

Spot met a cat named Fluffy at the park. Fluffy said, "I want to play golf too!" So, Spot and Fluffy started to play. They took turns hitting the ball and running after it. The big tree was in the way, but they didn't mind.

As they played, Spot hit the ball very hard. It flew up high and got stuck in the big tree! Spot and Fluffy looked at each other and laughed. They knew the big tree would be a part of their game. Together, they climbed the tree, got the ball, and kept playing their fun game of golf.

Once upon a time there was a lively little girl called Lucy. She loved playing tag and running around in the park with her friends. One day Lucy wanted to have something special to eat so she asked her mum for some butter. Her mum opened the fridge and handed Lucy the butter. She was so excited!

Lucy took the butter and went to find her friends in the park. They had a great time playing lots of fun games but it was getting chilly so they decided to make a fire to keep warm. Lucy told her friends that she had some butter. Everyone was very excited and they gathered some wood and started to burn it in the fire.

As the butter started to melt in the fire the delicious scent filled the air. Lucy and her friends enjoyed their snack and soon the night became warm and lively. They all agreed that having the butter around made the night much more fun. Lucy went home happy with a special memory.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. His name was Tommy. He loved to touch things.

One day, Tommy was playing in his room when he found a mysterious bottle. He picked it up and examined it closely. It was beautiful and he wanted to take it with him. 

Suddenly, he heard his mum call from the kitchen: "Tommy, come here quickly!"

Tommy ran to the kitchen and tried to hide the bottle behind his back, but his mum noticed it.

"Tommy, what have you got there?" she asked.

Tommy was silent. His mum smiled and said: "Let me see that bottle. You can keep it, but you have to be careful - it's very fragile." 

Tommy was so happy. He gave his mum a big hug and said: "Thank you!"

He was careful and gentle as he touched the bottle and thanked his mum again. From then on, he never stopped being careful and always touched things gently. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to hop around and play with his friends in the forest. One day, Benny found a shiny gem on the ground. He picked it up and showed it to his friend, a little bird named Pip.

"Look, Pip! I found a pretty gem!" Benny said.

Pip flew closer to take a look. "Wow, that's so cool! But what are we going to do with it?"

Benny thought for a moment and said, "I know! Let's solve a puzzle with it! We can hide it somewhere and give our friends clues to find it. It will be so much fun!"

Pip nodded excitedly and they spent the rest of the day coming up with clues and hiding the gem. All their friends had a great time trying to solve the puzzle and find the gem. Benny and Pip were very happy that they could share their treasure with everyone.

Once there was an old man and he had an old bucket. Every day he would go down to the river and fill up his bucket with water. But one day, the old man was struggling. The bucket was heavy and he wasn't able to lift it out of the river. He tried and tried, but he just couldn't resist it no matter how hard he tried.

Then, suddenly, a little girl appeared. She was only three years old but she was filled with strength. She said that she would help the old man lift the heavy bucket out of the water.

The little girl easily lifted the bucket out the water. The old man was so thankful and he kept saying, "Thank you! Thank you!" The little girl smiled and said it was no problem.

The old man and the little girl smiled at each other knowing they had worked together to resist the heavy old bucket.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wander around her backyard and explore. One day, she saw a big, angry dog coming towards her. Lily was scared and her knee started to hurt.

Lily's mommy came outside and saw the dog. She quickly picked up Lily and took her inside. Lily's mommy called the dog's owner and they came to get the dog. From that day on, Lily was careful when she wandered around outside.

A few days later, Lily was playing with her toys when she heard a knock at the door. It was the dog's owner! They brought over a big bag of treats for Lily and apologized for their dog scaring her. Lily was happy and her knee felt better, and she learned that sometimes even angry things can have a happy ending.

Once upon a time, there was a fierce mermaid who lived in a beautiful ocean. Everywhere she swam, she always had fun. 
One day, she saw a little girl playing on the beach. She was so excited and wanted to play with her. 
So the mermaid swam closer to the shore and asked the girl, "Can I play with you?" 
The little girl was very scared. She had never seen a mermaid before and thought that she was fierce.

The mermaid wanted to prove to her that she wasn't fierce. So she gave her a card that she had found in the ocean. 
The little girl was so excited and smiled at the mermaid. She said, "Thank you! I'll never forget this gift."

The mermaid was delighted that the little girl was no longer scared of her. The moral of this story is that it's best to show kindness to others and not judge them by their looks.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Kate. She loved to go to the lake near her house. Today, she wanted to bring something with her, so she grabbed a sack.

When she got to the lake, it felt very warm. She wanted to try something new, so she used the sack to jump into the lake.

The water was cool and refreshing as she jumped. She could feel the sack floating around her. She stayed in for a long time, swimming in the lake.

When Kate finally got out of the lake, she was so happy. She felt warm from the sun and the lake had been so much fun.

Kate took the sack and went back home, thrilled with her adventure at the lake.

Once upon a time, there was a brave prince. He loved to learn swordfighting. Every day he would go practice with his teacher.

One day his teacher said he was ready to learn the secret of the sword. The prince watched carefully as the teacher taught him. He learned quickly and the teacher was impressed.

As the prince was leaving, the teacher said, "Remember to share the secret with no one!" The prince promised he would not.

The prince practiced with his sword every day. Everyone was amazed how fast he was learning and how good he was getting.

The prince's friends became envious of him and wanted to learn the secret too. But the prince kept his promise and did not teach them.

The prince kept improving and his friends kept coming back asking him to teach them. But the prince just smiled and kept practicing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, but it started to rain. Lily didn't want to go inside, but her mom said she had to. 

Lily was stubborn and didn't want to listen to her mom. "I want to play in the rain!" she said. But her mom said it was too dangerous.

Lily was sad and didn't know what to do. Then her mom had an idea. "Let's play a game inside," she said. Lily was happy again and they played together until the rain stopped.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane took a big walk and she found a loop. She was so happy to find it, she ran up to it and said, "I can sell this loop and make lots of money!"

Jane started to walk with the loop to the market. On the way, she had to cross a deep river. Suddenly, a bad man jumped out with a knife. He said, "Give me the loop, or else!" Jane was so scared, she started to cry.

But then she thought of a plan and said, "If I give you the loop, will you let me go?" The man thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, but only if you give me all of your money as well." Jane tried to cross the river without the bad man noticing, but he saw her and he chased her for a long way.

In the end, Jane couldn't get away. The bad man took both her loop and her money. Jane was so sad, she cried until she couldn't cry anymore.

Once there was a little anchor who was feeling very restless. It wanted to go on an adventure but it didn't know how. So it stayed around the same spot, day after day.

Then one day, the anchor decided to take the plunge and grow some legs so it could travel! The anchor took its first steps, feeling so brave and excited.

The anchor walked around, exploring all of the new places it had never seen before. Everywhere it went, the anchor felt more and more excited about its adventure.

Soon, the anchor felt like it had grown so much since it began its journey. It had grown in courage and confidence, which soon turned into boldness.

The anchor had a newfound sense of adventure and joy that it had never felt before. No longer was it restless, because it was excited to see what else was out there to explore!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Max. Max loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, while she was playing, a big bad monster appeared. The monster had three heads and wiggly arms.

Max was scared and wanted to run away. But the monster offered her some sweets. "If you come a bit closer, I can give you some nice sweets," said the monster.

Max was still scared and didn't want to get too close. But then the monster said, "I won't hurt you. I just want to give you a gentle touch to show I'm a nice monster." Max could see the monster looked different than usual monsters and decided to take a closer look.

She reached out to take the sweets and noticed the monster was giving her a gentle touch instead of a bad one. Max started to feel much better. After that, they became friends and they would often play together in the sunshine.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy went outside to play. It was a warm day, and the sun was shining bright. Timmy saw a taxi drive by and he waved to the driver. The driver stopped the taxi and asked Timmy where he wanted to go. Timmy didn't want to go anywhere, he just wanted to see the taxi up close. The driver was nice and showed Timmy the inside of the taxi. Timmy was so happy and thanked the driver for showing him the taxi. From that day on, Timmy loved taxis and always waved to them whenever he saw one.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a very unusual mop. Everyone who saw it was amazed. One day, Daisy's mom was cleaning with her mop, and it went out the window! Daisy was so sad and missed her mop. 

Then, all of a sudden, a beautiful fairy appeared in the room. She told Daisy she could make the mop come back. Daisy was so excited. The fairy waved her wand, and the mop magically flew right back into Daisy's arms. Daisy hugged the mop and thanked the fairy.

As a thank you, Daisy wanted to give the fairy a kiss. The fairy was so happy and blushed. Then, the fairy waved her wand and Daisy and her mom were filled with joy and surprise. The mop had grown larger than before and could now clean even better!

The fairy waved goodbye and flew away. That was one of the most unusual and magical moments of Daisy's life. And she has kept her special mop ever since.

Once upon a time, there was an adventurous cat named Tom. Tom loved to play and explore. One day, he went outside to find something new.

Tom saw a big red ball. It was very hot. He said, "Wow! What is this?" A bird heard Tom and said, "Be careful, Tom. That is heat. It can destroy things." But Tom was adventurous and didn't listen.

Tom touched the heat with his paw. It hurt a lot. He cried, "Ouch!" The heat destroyed Tom's paw. Tom learned that he should listen to his friends. The end.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They saw a big hole in the ground. It looked like a pit.

"Let's go and see what's in there," Tom said. He was brave and curious.

"No, Tom, it's too dark and scary," Lily said. She was afraid and careful.

"Come on, Lily, don't be a baby," Tom said. He ran to the pit and looked inside.

Lily followed him slowly. She did not want to lose her friend. She saw Tom bend over the edge of the pit. He gasped and trembled.

"What is it, Tom? What do you see?" Lily asked.

Tom did not answer. He was too scared. He saw a big snake in the pit. It had red eyes and sharp teeth. It hissed and coiled.

The snake jumped out of the pit and bit Tom on the leg. Tom screamed and fell to the ground. He was hurt and bleeding.

Lily cried and ran to help him. She called for help. She hoped someone would come and save them.

But no one came. The snake was hungry and angry. It wrapped itself around Tom and Lily. It squeezed them hard. They could not breathe. They could not move. They could not talk.

The snake ate them both. It was not nice. It was mean and cruel.

The end.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play outside. One day, they go to the big hill near their house. They run up and down the hill. They have fun.

They see a big tree on the hill. The tree has red and green things on it. Tom and Mia are hungry. They pick some of the things from the tree. They are apples. They are yummy.

Tom and Mia sit under the tree. They eat the apples. They share with each other. They are happy. They say thank you to the tree. They say thank you to each other. They are good friends.

Once upon a time there was a cool pup called Joey. Joey loved to jog and play. One day he was jogging in a park when he saw a big cat called Cinders. Joey wanted to unite with Cinders and asked her if they could play together.

Cinders said yes with a meow and the two animals started to have lots of fun. They zoomed around the park chasing each other and playing tag. Joey even showed Cinders how to do a cool trick!

Soon the two new friends were joined together on a united adventure. They raced each other around the park, laughing and playing until it was time to go home. But before they left, Cinders thanked Joey for a wonderful day of fun and friendship.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very brave and always wanted to protect her family.One day, she heard a noise coming from outside her house. She bravely opened the door and saw a giant monster! 

The monster was thrashing around and making a lot of mess. The girl thought of a plan and quickly grabbed her mop. She bravely approached the monster and tried to sweep away the mess.

The monster roared but the little girl showed no fear. She kept sweeping until the monster calmed down. When it was all over, the monster even thanked the girl for protecting her family and cleaning up all the mess! 

The girl smiled and hugged the monster. From that day on, she was bravely protect her family whenever she needed.

Ben and Lily were playing with their toy cars in the garden. They liked to make them zoom on the grass and the dirt. They had many cars of different colors and sizes.

"Look at my orange car!" Ben said. "It is very fast and loud. Zoom, zoom, zoom!"

Lily looked at Ben's car and wanted to play with it. She reached out her hand and grabbed it. "I want to play with the orange car!" she said.

Ben was angry. He did not like to share his car. He pulled it back and shouted. "No, it is my car! You have your own car. Give it back!"

Lily was angry too. She did not want to give back the car. She held it tight and cried. "No, it is mine now! You have many cars. I only have one!"

They both started to tug and yell. They did not hear their mom calling them from the house.

"Ben, Lily, what is going on?" mom said. She came to the garden and saw them fighting over the car. She was not happy. She took the car from them and put it on the table. "You two need to learn to share and be nice. No one can play with the car until you say sorry to each other."

Ben and Lily looked at each other. They felt bad for making mom angry and for hurting each other. They said sorry and hugged. Mom smiled and gave them a hug too. She gave them each a cookie and a glass of milk. She said they could play with the car together if they promised to take turns and be kind.

Ben and Lily agreed. They thanked mom and went back to the garden. They played with the car and their other toys. They made them zoom and laugh. They were happy and had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her ball. One day, Lily's mommy said they were going to the park to play. Lily got ready by putting on her shoes and grabbing her ball.

When they got to the park, Lily saw a big slide. She was a little scared to go down it, but her mommy encouraged her to try. Lily climbed up the ladder and sat at the top of the slide. She took a deep breath and slid down. It was so much fun!

After playing for a while, Lily's mommy surprised her by pulling out a tube. She blew it up and they took turns crawling through it. It was like a secret tunnel! Lily giggled and had so much fun. She couldn't wait to go to the park again and play with the tube.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who was very happy. Every day, she went out to the garden and pulled flowers. One day, she saw something strange. It was a storybook! She pulled the storybook out of the ground and opened it. The girl was so excited, she couldn't believe it! Inside the storybook, there were beautiful stories that made her very, very happy. She read them over and over again and even shared them with her friends. From that day on, the girl was very, very happy. She always pulled new flowers to give to the people she loved. Everyone was so happy and they all enjoyed reading the beautiful stories.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved the sea. She loved to swim and explore its depths. Every day she would visit the shore looking for new discoveries. One day, she spotted something strange in the water. It was a jellyfish! She had never seen a jellyfish before and was very excited. She wanted to get closer to see it better but she knew she had to be careful. She slowly moved closer but the jellyfish began to drift away. Suddenly she noticed it was crying. She was so sad to see the jellyfish weep. She wished she could help it but she did not know how. She gently touched the jellyfish and whispered that she was sorry. The jellyfish stopped crying and slowly smiled at her. It was then, that she knew she had made a new friend. They spent the day playing together and the jellyfish taught her all about the sea. It was a wonderful day.

Once upon a time in a far away place there lived a queen. The queen loved to sell her things. She had a big box and in it she sold all kinds of fun things. Every day lots of people came and bought something from the queen.

One day, the queen decided to sell a magical object. It was called a peace stone. She sold it to a beautiful princess. The princess lived in a peaceful castle and loved the stone very much.

The stone brought peace and happiness to the castle and all the people who lived there. Everyone was very happy and the queen was pleased with what she had done.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a cool person named Tim. Tim was very happy because he had a new toy. The toy was a big red ball. Tim loved to play with the ball and bounce it around. 

One day, Tim's mom told him it was time to settle down and take a nap. Tim didn't want to stop playing with his ball, but he knew he had to listen to his mom. So, he put his ball down and laid in his bed. 

As he closed his eyes, he thought about how much fun he had with his ball. But he also felt happy that he listened to his mom and settled down for a nap. When he woke up, he was ready to play with his ball again!

Once upon a time there was a giant tree in a hidden forest. Every night an owl would come and rest in its branches. One night the owl heard a strange noise. 

The owl looked down and noticed a body in the clearing. Curious, the owl flew down and investigate. 

The owl asked, â€œWho are you?â€

The body replied, â€œI am the guardian of the hidden forest. I am here to protect it from any harm.â€

The owl said, â€œCan I help you?â€

The body replied, â€œYes, remove the rocks that are blocking the path.â€ 

The owl obliged and flew around the forest. After a few hours the owl had removed all the rocks.

The body said, â€œThank you for your help, now the hidden forest is safe.â€ 

The owl said farewell and flew away, happy that it had helped the guardian of the hidden forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they saw a parade coming from a faraway place. The parade had lots of people in colorful clothes playing music and singing. They marched through the park and made Lily and her friends very happy.

After the parade, Lily and her friends went home. But Lily realized she left her favorite toy in the park. She was sad because the park was very distant from her house. Her mom saw her sad face and asked what was wrong. Lily told her about her lost toy. Her mom said they could return to the park and look for it. 

So, they returned to the park and looked everywhere. Finally, they found the toy under a tree. Lily was very happy and thanked her mom. They walked back home while talking about the parade and how much fun they had.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy fish named Fin. He lived in a big tank with many other fish. One day, Fin saw a new fish in the tank. Her name was Bubbles. Fin wanted to be friends with Bubbles.

Fin swam up to Bubbles and said, "Hi, I am Fin. Do you want to sit on the rock with me?" Bubbles smiled and said, "Yes, I would like that." So, Fin and Bubbles went to sit on a big rock at the bottom of the tank.

As they sat on the rock, they talked and laughed. They watched the other fish swim around the tank. Fin was happy to have a new friend. Even though he was clumsy, Bubbles liked him just the way he was.

One day, the clever bunny was in the kitchen. He saw a spoon on the counter. He wanted the spoon, so he decided to steal it. The bunny looked around, but no one was watching. He grabbed the spoon and ran away.

But then, the bunny heard a noise. He looked over and saw a cat. The cat had seen the bunny steal the spoon! The bunny was scared and started to run as fast as he could. But the cat was fast too, so it followed him.

The bunny ran and ran, until at last he was near his home. He hopped inside and put the spoon away where it would be safe. Then, he breathed a sigh of relief that the cat couldn't reach him. The bunny had been very clever, and now the spoon was safe.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jodie who was three years old. Jodie loved to do wild and crazy things. One day Jodie saw people doing yoga and she thought it looked really fun.

Jodie went up to the people doing yoga and asked if she could join too. They said, "sure, why not!" So Jodie began to do yoga with them.

At first Jodie didn't understand how to do the poses, but she kept trying. After a while she started to figure it out and started doing the poses like the other people. 

The people doing yoga thought Jodie was really brave and determined and told her how good she was doing. Jodie was so happy that she could do yoga and understand it. 

From then on, every day Jodie did a little bit of yoga and gradually got better and better. In the end, Jodie couldn't believe how crazy and fun yoga was!

Once upon a time, there was a charming mechanic. He worked all day long fixing things that were broken. One day, he was walking through the park to get to his job when he stumbled over a big rock. He fell to the ground and scraped his knee. He was so sad!

But then a little girl came to help him up. She held out her tiny hand and smiled. He took it and got up. She asked him what was wrong and he told her he was a mechanic.

The little girl was so happy to meet a mechanic. She asked him to come and fix her red bike. He smiled, and said he would be happy to. He followed the little girl to her house and fixed her bike. She was so excited, she thanked him with a hug and a kiss on the cheek.

The mechanic was so happy that he had made the little girl happy. He realized it was the most charming thing anyone had ever done. He smiled, said goodbye and stumbled away.

Mummy and Papa were going on a trip. They had been planning it for a while and were so excited. They packed their bags and said goodbye to their naughty 3 year old daughter, Ellie.

"Bye bye, Mummy," Ellie said waving her hand.

"Don't forget to be a good girl while we are gone," Mummy reminded.

Their car drove away and soon they were gone. Ellie started playing with her toys.

Suddenly, she noticed that on the table was a large, shiny folder. It said "My Exam".

Ellie was curious and opened the folder. Inside was a secret map. Ellie didn't know it, but it was Mummy and Papa's very special travel map that they used for their holiday. 

"Oh no," said Ellie. She had been naughty and taken the map without asking!

The next morning, Mummy and Papa returned home. When Mummy saw the mess on the table, she was angry.

"Why did you take our map without asking, Ellie?" Mummy asked.

Ellie was embarrassed, but she said sorry and promised to always ask next time.

Mummy and Papa hugged her, and soon they were all laughing again. They could go on their trip another day.

Ben and Lily liked to play with their paints. They had many colors and brushes and paper. They liked to make pictures of animals and flowers and cars. One day, they decided to paint a big rainbow on the wall. They thought it would be fun and pretty.

They got their paints and brushes and a big ladder. They climbed up the ladder and started to paint. Ben painted red and orange and yellow. Lily painted green and blue and purple. They were very happy and proud of their rainbow. They did not see that the paint was dripping from their brushes and spreading on the floor.

Mom came home and saw the rainbow on the wall. She was very surprised and angry. She saw the paint on the floor and the ladder. She saw Ben and Lily on the tip of the ladder. She shouted at them to come down. She was afraid they would fall and hurt themselves.

Ben and Lily heard Mom and got scared. They tried to come down, but they slipped on the paint. They fell off the ladder and landed on the floor. They were not hurt, but they were very messy and sad. They cried and said they were sorry.

Mom was glad they were not hurt, but she was still angry. She told them to go to their room and wait. She cleaned the wall and the floor and the ladder. She was very tired and unhappy. She wished they had not painted the rainbow.

Later, Mom came to their room and hugged them. She said she loved them, but they had done a bad thing. She said they had to help her paint the wall again. She said they could only paint on paper from now on. She said they had to be calm and careful when they played with paints.

Ben and Lily said they understood and they were sorry. They hugged Mom and said they loved her. They said they would help her paint the wall. They said they would be calm and careful. They learned their lesson. They still liked to paint, but they never painted on the wall again.

Once there lived a bird who had troubles. He was very sad and wanted to be happy. He remembered a story he had heard about how to create a magic that would make him happy. So he began searching for the things he needed. He tried hard, but could not find them. He was very troubled.

Then one day, he saw something he had never seen before. It was shiny and beautiful. He thought it was the magical item he was looking for. He quickly grabbed it and put it in his pocket. 

But when he looked closer, he saw it was a cage. He had put a bird in the cage. He felt terrible and wanted to let it go. But he was too scared to open the cage. So he kept the bird locked inside.

He thought the magic would work and make him happy. But it didn't, and he remained troubled. He had learned a hard lesson, and was never was happy again.

Tommy watched as his dad took the brown chalk out of his bag. His dad drew a big circle in the dirt with it. Then he took a black piece of chalk and made a line that went up and down. He smiled at Tommy and said, "Watch this!"

Tommy's dad took out a toy car. He rolled it around in the circle and it made a funny noise. Tommy laughed and clapped his hands. Then his dad rolled the car up and down the line.

Tommy watched until his dad had put the car away. Then his dad put all the chalk back into his bag and gave Tommy the brown chalk. He said, "It's all yours, now you can go and play!" 

Tommy was so excited. He ran off, drawing circles and lines in the dirt with his special brown chalk. It was so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was only three years old. He liked to watch the world go by from his bedroom window. One day his Mommy brought him a cane! The boy was excited and wanted to try it out. He wobbled around the house and watched the cane help him balance.

His Daddy was frustrated. He wanted the boy to stay in the house. But the boy was too curious and wanted to explore the world. So, the boy and his cane set out. Everywhere the boy went people watched him. His cane was so bright and colourful that it made him very happy.

He marched around the garden, the park and down the street. He laughed with joy as he watched the clouds drift by and the wonderful birds in the sky. Then, suddenly, his cane broke. The little boy was so sad and frustrated. He quickly ran back home, cane in hand.

When he arrived, his Mommy and Daddy were so relieved to see him safe and sound! The boy was given a new cane and he never tried to go too far from home again. He was very happy with his new cane and the ability to watch the world outside. The end.

Tom and Anna liked to play with blocks. They could build many things with blocks, like houses, towers, cars and animals. One day, they decided to build something new.

They played in the freezer for a long time. They had a lot of fun. They did not feel cold at all. They felt happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was so excited, because today was the day she was joining a new band. She had been looking forward to it for weeks.

The boy was so proud of himself for easily finding the way to the end of the path. He knew he had done something special, even if it was just walking down a path. The people in the group kept clapping and it made the boy feel very proud.

Once there was a little girl who was always hungry. She wanted a treat but she didn't know how to get one. One day she decided to use her imagination and create her own treat. When she finished the mix, she put it in the oven and soon it was ready. She took it out and it smelled delicious! She used a spoon to eat her treat and it was so yummy. Now she was no longer hungry and she was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. One day, Jane's mummy said they had to go and visit Grandma's house. Jane was so excited!

Grandma gave them both a hug and said "Come and visit me again soon!" Jane and her mummy waved goodbye and said "Bye Grandma!"

As they drove away, Jane smiled. She was so happy that she had visited Grandma and had some yummy red biscuits!

One day, a pirate named Tom was sailing on his big boat. He liked to find gold and jewels and fill his chest with them. He had a map that showed him where to dig for treasure on an island.

He saw the island and said, "Ahoy, mateys! Let's go and get the treasure!" He and his friends got off the boat and took their shovels and their chest. They followed the map and found a big X on the ground.

They started to dig and dig, but they did not find anything. They dug deeper and deeper, but they only found dirt and rocks. They looked at the map again and saw that it was a fake. Someone had tricked them!

Tom was very sad and angry. He said, "Who did this to us? Who gave us this bad map? We wasted our time and our energy for nothing!" He threw the map on the ground and stomped on it.

He and his friends went back to their boat, feeling sad and tired. They had no treasure to fill their chest. They had no gold or jewels to make them happy. They only had a bad map and a big hole. They wished they had a real map and a real treasure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, I will teach you how to ride a bike today." Lily was very excited and said, "Thank you, Mommy! You are so helpful."

Lily's mom showed her how to ride the bike and held onto the back of it. Lily pedaled and pedaled until she was riding on her own. She laughed and shouted, "Look Mommy, I'm doing it!"

Later that day, Lily went to play with her friends. She saw her friend, Timmy, who was feeling sad. Lily asked him, "What's wrong, Timmy?" Timmy said, "I lost my toy." Lily said, "Don't worry, I will help you find it." They searched and searched until they found the toy. Timmy was so happy and he laughed and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are a good friend."

Rex was a spoiled dog. He had many toys, treats and a big bed. His owner, Sam, loved him very much and took him for walks every day. Rex liked to run and chase birds and squirrels. He felt very happy and lucky.

One day, Sam bought a new toy for Rex. It was a red car that could zoom. Sam showed Rex how to push a button and make the car zoom across the floor. Rex was curious and excited. He wanted to play with the car. He barked and wagged his tail.

"OK, Rex, let's play with the car. But you have to be gentle and careful. Don't bite it or break it. It's not a chew toy. It's a zoom toy." Sam said.

Sam pushed the button and the car zoomed away. Rex ran after it and tried to catch it. He barked and jumped. He had fun. Sam laughed and watched him.

But Rex was not gentle or careful. He bit the car and shook it. He heard a crack and a beep. The car stopped zooming. Rex dropped it and looked at it. It was broken. He felt sad and guilty.

"Rex, what did you do? You broke the car. You were not gentle or careful. You were naughty. You spoiled the zoom toy." Sam said.

Sam was not happy. He picked up the car and threw it in the trash. He scolded Rex and told him to go to his bed. Rex hung his head and walked to his bed. He felt sorry and ashamed.

He wished he had been gentle and careful. He wished he had not spoiled the zoom toy. He wished he could make Sam happy again. He loved Sam very much and did not want to upset him. He hoped Sam would forgive him and play with him again. He learned his lesson. He decided to be a good dog.

Sam and Mia are friends. They like to play hide and seek in the park. Sam is the seeker and Mia is the hider. Mia runs to find a good spot to hide. She sees a big tree with a lot of shade. She thinks it is a good place to hide. She goes behind the tree and waits for Sam.

Sam counts to ten and then says, "Ready or not, here I come!" He looks around the park and tries to find Mia. He sees a swing, a slide, a bench, and a fountain, but he does not see Mia. He wonders where she is. He walks towards the tree and thinks he hears a giggle. He decides to peek behind the tree and see if Mia is there.

He sneaks up to the tree and peeks behind it. He sees Mia sitting on the ground and smiling. He says, "I found you, Mia!" Mia says, "You are a good seeker, Sam!" Sam says, "You are a good hider, Mia!" Mia says, "Thank you, Sam. You are very honest. You did not cheat and look before you counted." Sam says, "You are welcome, Mia. You are very nice. You did not move from your spot and make noise." They hug and laugh. They are happy. They decide to play again and switch roles. Sam is the hider and Mia is the seeker. They have fun playing hide and seek in the park.

Once upon a time there was a box. It was a big red box. Inside the box, there was a very special machine. The machine was called a printer. It could do something very magical - it could print words and pictures.

One day, something special happened. The printer started to print lots of red words and red pictures. The words and pictures spun and twisted and twirled around the inside of the box. It was so exciting!

The little box and the printer were both very happy. They danced around together, laughing and singing. The red words and pictures were everywhere!

Then the printing stopped and everything was still. The little box and the printer were worn out from all the fun. But they both still had happy memories of their special day filled with red print.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly cat named Mittens. Mittens loved to drink coffee in the morning. One day, Mittens accidentally knocked over the coffee pot and spilled hot coffee everywhere. The coffee was very hot and it started to melt the table. Mittens tried to clean it up but it was too late. 

The table melted and Mittens felt very sad. Mittens didn't know what to do. Mittens' owner was very upset too. Mittens felt bad for making a mess and wished it never happened. From that day on, Mittens never drank coffee again.

Tim and Mia are twins. They like to play with their toys and pretend they are in space. They have a big box that they call their rocket. They put stickers on it and draw stars and planets.

One day, they decide to go on a mission to explore the universe. They put on their helmets and suits and get inside the box. They count down from ten and then make loud noises like a rocket.

"Zoom! Zoom! We are flying to the moon!" Tim says.

"Look! There is a big cheese ball!" Mia says. She points to a yellow ball on the floor.

"Can we eat it?" Tim asks.

Mia nods. They get out of the box and run to the ball. They pick it up and take a bite.

"Mmm, this is yummy!" Mia says.

She chews the cheese and smiles.

"Wait, this is not cheese!" Tim says.

He spits out the cheese and makes a face.

"This is rubber! It is hard and yucky!"

He throws the ball away and rubs his tongue.

Mia laughs. She thinks it is funny.

"Sorry, Tim. I was joking. That is not the moon. That is our dog's toy. He likes to chew it."

She hugs Tim and says sorry.

Tim is not mad. He hugs Mia back and says it is okay.

They go back to their box and pretend they are in space again.

They have fun and forget about the rubber ball.

They are happy twins. They love to play and explore the universe.

Once there was a girl. Her name was Jane. She had a dark style and everyone recognized her because of it. Each day she would wake up and get dressed in her dark style outfit. She loved it and she felt like she stood out.

One day Jane went to the park with her mom. She saw other kids playing and she wanted to join in. She saw that all the other kids were wearing bright colors with funny patterns. Jane did not recognize the style of the other kids.

She hesitated to play because she didn't know if the other kids would recognize her dark style. But her mom encouraged her to go and play with them. Jane went and joined the other kids.

They had so much fun playing together. The other kids soon recognized Jane's style and they began to copy it. All the kids were soon wearing dark colors like Jane. They all felt like they belonged. Jane was so happy and felt so proud.

Once upon a time, there was a brave bear called Bob. Every day, Bob would take his friend, a little rabbit, with him on all his adventures.

One day, Bob saw an interesting zigzag path in the forest. He urgently wanted to explore it, so he urged his friend to join him.

"Let's go, Rabbit! It's gonna be an exciting journey!" he exclaimed.

But Rabbit was feeling a bit afraid. "It's very dry and there are so many zigzags," he said nervously.

"Don't worry," said Bob reassuringly, "I'm here with you. Nothing bad will happen."

Rabbit felt a bit better. With a happy heart, he followed Bob onto the zigzag path. Together, they explored the mysterious path and had a great adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a special lamp that he loved very much. The lamp was very bright and helped Timmy see in the dark. One night, Timmy fell asleep with the lamp on. 

In the middle of the night, Timmy woke up and saw that the lamp was still on. He knew he had to turn it off because it was not wise to waste electricity. Timmy turned off the lamp and went back to sleep. 

The next morning, Timmy's mom was very proud of him for being so wise and turning off the lamp. She gave him a big hug and told him how much she loved him. From that day on, Timmy always remembered to turn off the lamp before he went to sleep.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lily. She was very hungry and she wanted something to eat.

One day, Lily went for a walk in the woods. As she was walking, she saw a small cabin. She was very surprised! She had never seen it before. 

Lily went to the cabin and knocked on the door. A kind old man opened the door.

â€œHello, my name is Lily,â€ she said. â€œI am very hungry. Can you help me?â€
