Joe's mom smiled. "See, that wasn't so hard. Now the smell is gone!"

Once upon a time, there was an ancient grandma. Every day, she liked to bake something special. One day, she decided to bake a cake with lots of soap in it. She mixed the soap with eggs, flour and sugar. Then, she put the mixture into the oven.

Grandma was so happy that everyone liked her special cake. Now, she bakes a soap cake often and it's always a big hit.

George was playing in the park when a tall man in a black coat grabbed his arm. George started to cry and the man said, "It's okay, I'm here to help you". George was scared and said, "Where are you taking me?"

The man said, "I'm taking you to jail". George became more scared. He asked, "What is jail?" The man said, "It's a hot place where bad people go".

George was very scared but he didn't stop crying. He was sure he was a good boy and he didn't want to go to jail. 

Just then, George's mom showed up and asked the man, "What do you think you are doing?"

The man said, "I'm just trying to help him". 

George's mom said, "Thank you, but it's time for George to come home." She grabbed his hand and they both went home. George was so relieved to be home and away from that hot jail.

Sam liked to collect things. He had a big box of things he found in the park, like rocks, sticks, leaves and feathers. He liked to look at them and show them to his mom and dad. One day, he went to the park with his dad and saw something new. It was a shiny metal thing on the ground, near the rail where the train went by.

"Dad, what is that?" Sam asked, pointing at the metal thing.

"That is a coin, Sam. It is money. People use it to buy things," his dad said.

"Can I have it?" Sam asked.

"Sure, you can have it. But be careful, don't go near the rail. The train is very fast and loud and can hurt you," his dad warned.

Sam nodded and ran to pick up the coin. He was very happy. He put it in his pocket and smiled. He wanted to find more coins. He looked around and saw another one, a little farther away, also near the rail. He ran to get it, but did not see the train coming.

"Sam, stop! Come back!" his dad shouted.

But Sam did not hear him. He reached for the coin and touched the rail. He felt a big shock and fell down. He was very scared and hurt. He cried out loud.

The train passed by and made a loud noise. His dad ran to him and picked him up. He hugged him and checked him. He was glad that Sam was not badly hurt, but he was very angry and sad.

"Sam, why did you do that? I told you not to go near the rail. You could have died. You were very foolish and naughty," his dad scolded.

"I'm sorry, dad. I wanted to collect more coins. I did not see the train. I'm sorry, I'm sorry," Sam sobbed.

His dad sighed and kissed him. He took him to the car and drove him home. He threw away the coins and gave him a band-aid and some ice cream. He told him to rest and be more careful next time.

Sam was very tired and sorry. He learned his lesson. He did not want to collect coins anymore. He only wanted to collect things that were safe and fun. He hugged his dad and said he loved him. His dad hugged him back and said he loved him too. They were happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little barber who had a very busy shop. People from all over used to come to get their hair cut. But no matter how hard he struggled, the little barber still had trouble keeping up.

One day, the barber had a brilliant idea. He decided to ask his neighbor for help with the shop. At first, the little barber was afraid because his neighbor was bigger and stronger than he was. But soon enough, the little barber's neighbor said yes.

The barber was so relieved. Now he could spend less time trying to keep up with all the customers and more time giving them the perfect haircut! The barber was so grateful for his neighbor's help and knew he had learnt a valuable lesson.

He realised it was much easier to get things done with help. So he reminded himself: don't struggle alone, always ask for help when you need it!

Tom and Lily were playing on the beach. They liked to make sand castles and dig holes. They also liked to roll on the sand and feel the sun on their skin.

"Look, Lily, I can roll very fast!" Tom said. He rolled down a small hill and landed near the water. He laughed and got up.

"Wow, Tom, you are very strong!" Lily said. She tried to roll too, but she was slower and smaller. She rolled halfway and stopped. She saw something in the water. It was big and gray and had a fin. "Tom, Tom, look!" she shouted.

Tom looked where Lily was pointing. He saw the thing too. He felt scared. He remembered what his dad had told him. "That is a shark, Lily. Sharks are not nice. They can bite. We have to go away."

Tom ran to Lily and took her hand. They ran back to their sand castle. They did not want to play near the water anymore. They wanted to be safe.

"Are you okay, Lily?" Tom asked.

"Yes, Tom, I am okay. Thank you for helping me. You are very brave." Lily said.

They hugged each other and smiled. They were happy to have each other. They did not like sharks, but they liked to roll on the sand.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the grocery store with her mom. They would walk down the aisles and pick out yummy snacks like apples and crackers.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who liked to play golf. He brought his golf club and ball to the golf course and wanted to play. He was very excited to have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She was only 3 years old and liked to explore the world.

One day, Amy was walking in the park. Suddenly, she saw a big, clumsy bird. She was a little scared at first, but then she thought the bird was funny so she laughed. The bird noticed Amy and they started talking.

Lily and Ben are friends. They live in a big city with many cars and people. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big black dog in the park. The dog is friendly and wants to play.

"Hi, dog!" Lily says. She pets the dog's head. The dog wags its tail.

"Wait, dog! Come back!" Lily and Ben shout. They run after the dog. But the dog is faster. The dog runs out of the park and into the city.

"Stop, dog! Stop!" Lily and Ben cry. They are scared. The city is loud and busy. There are many cars and people. They can't see the dog.

They see their moms. Their moms are worried. They run to Lily and Ben and hug them.

Lily and Ben nod. They say goodbye to the dog in their hearts. They hope the dog finds his home. They hope the dog is happy. They walk with their moms to the bus. They go home. They are tired. They sleep. They dream of the dog.

Anna and Ben are playing with their toy cars in the garden. They like to make them zoom and crash and honk. But then, Anna's car breaks. The wheel falls off and the car cannot move.

"Oh no!" Anna cries. "My car is broken! I need to repair it!"

Ben looks at Anna's car. He has an idea. He runs to the kitchen and comes back with a piece of beef. He puts the beef on the wheel and tries to stick it to the car.

"Here you go, Anna. I fixed your car with beef. Now it can move again!"

Anna looks at Ben's repair. She is not happy. She shakes her head.

"No, Ben. That is not a good repair. Beef is not for cars. Beef is for eating. And it smells bad. And it will attract flies. And it will make my car dirty. And it will fall off again. I do not want beef on my car. I want a new wheel!"

Ben is persistent. He does not want to give up. He thinks beef is a good repair. He tries to convince Anna.

"But beef is soft and juicy. And it is red like your car. And it is yummy. And it is fun. And it is different. And it is clever. And it is beef! You should try it, Anna. You will like it!"

Anna is persistent too. She does not want to try it. She wants a new wheel. She argues with Ben.

"No, Ben. Beef is not soft and juicy. It is wet and sticky. And it is not red like my car. It is brown and bloody. And it is not yummy. It is gross. And it is not fun. It is silly. And it is not different. It is weird. And it is not clever. It is stupid. And it is not beef! It is garbage! You should take it off, Ben. You will hate it!"

They keep arguing and arguing. They do not listen to each other. They do not agree. They are both persistent.

Mom hears them and comes to the garden. She sees Anna's car with beef on the wheel. She sees Ben and Anna fighting. She is not happy. She scolds them.

"Stop it, you two! What are you doing? Why are you putting beef on the car? Why are you yelling at each other? That is not how you play. That is not how you repair. That is not how you share. That is not nice!"

She takes the beef off the car and throws it in the bin. She gives Anna a new wheel and helps her fix her car. She gives Ben a hug and tells him to be sorry. She tells them to play nicely and to use their words. She tells them to be kind and to respect each other. She tells them to be less persistent and more flexible.

Ben and Anna listen to Mom. They say sorry to each other. They hug and make up. They play with their cars again. They zoom and crash and honk. They have fun. They are happy. They are friends.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their toys. But sometimes they fight over their toys. They have a big fish toy that they both want.

Suddenly, the little girl heard a loud splash. She looked up, and there was her boat, back in the stream near the beach. In its place was a beautiful, clean navy boat!

The little girl looked up at the sky with a smile and a nod, and thanked the stars for protecting her special boat.

The little girl was dirty and needed a bath. The fairy wanted to help her. She used her magic to make a bathtub appear. The little girl was surprised and happy. She got into the bathtub and the fairy gave her a bath. The little girl felt clean and refreshed.

After the bath, the fairy flew away. The little girl waved goodbye and said, "Thank you, fairy!" From then on, the little girl always remembered to take a bath and stay clean.

Jenny was very happy today, because she had a little chocolate all to herself. She could not wait to eat it. She picked it up and looked at it carefully. She liked the shiny, brown wrapping.

She untied the ribbon and carefully opened the wrapping. Inside was a tiny, little bar of chocolate. She licked her lips in excitement.

She quickly broke off a piece, popped it into her mouth and started to chew. It was sweet and delicious. She smiled and took another bite.

She had enjoyed it so much that soon, she had eaten all of the chocolate. She was happy that she now owned the empty wrapping. She held it close to her and went to show her parents her special treat!

Once upon a time there was a good giant who was taking a journey. The journey was very long and full of danger.

He was walking through a dark forest when he came across a small mouse. The giant said to the mouse, "Where are you going?" 

"I'm on a journey," replied the mouse.

"Would you like to come with me?" asked the giant. The mouse thought for a moment and then shook its head.

"No, I must go alone. I have to be brave and serious so I can complete my journey," the mouse said.

The giant nodded and said, "You need a lot of bravery and courage to complete this journey. I hope you make it."

The mouse said, "Thank you. I will try my best!" With that, the mouse quit the forest and continued on its journey.

The giant smiled and said, "Good luck on your journey little mouse!" 

And with those words, the giant watched the mouse walk away until it was out of sight.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little girl named Lily. She loved to explore and discover new things. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy. There, she saw a big slide and her eyes got really big with excitement. She begged her parents to let her slide down it.

Her mommy and daddy warned her to be careful and to keep her body safe. Lily listened and climbed up the ladder to the top of the slide. She was so happy and couldn't wait to slide down. But when she got to the top, she saw that the slide was very tall and steep. She got scared and almost changed her mind.

But then she remembered what her parents said about being careful and keeping her body safe. She took a deep breath and slid down the slide, feeling proud of herself for being brave. From that day on, Lily always remembered to be careful and keep her body safe when trying new things.

Ben and Lily were twins. They liked to spend time with their mom and dad. One day, their mom and dad said, "We are going to the park today. Do you want to come?"

Ben and Lily were very happy. They said, "Yes, yes, yes! We love the park!"

They put on their hats and shoes and got in the car. They drove to the park. The park was big and green. There were swings and slides and a sandbox. There were also many animals. Ben and Lily saw ducks and squirrels and birds.

They ran to the swings and took turns pushing each other. They laughed and shouted, "Whee!" They slid down the slides and made funny faces. They dug in the sandbox and made castles and cakes.

Then they saw a dog. The dog was brown and fluffy. It had a collar and a leash. It was with a boy. The boy was older than Ben and Lily. He said, "Hi, I'm Sam. This is my dog, Max. He is very intelligent. He can do tricks. Do you want to see?"

Ben and Lily nodded. They liked dogs. They went to Sam and Max. Sam said, "Max, sit." Max sat. Sam said, "Max, shake." Max lifted his paw and shook Sam's hand. Sam said, "Max, roll over." Max rolled over. Ben and Lily clapped. They said, "Wow, Max is very intelligent. He is a good dog."

Sam smiled. He said, "Thank you. Do you want to play with Max? He likes to fetch and run and cuddle."

Ben and Lily said, "Yes, please. We want to play with Max." They threw a ball and Max fetched it. They ran with Max and he chased them. They cuddled with Max and he licked their faces.

They had a lot of fun with Sam and Max. They made new friends. They thanked Sam and Max for playing with them. They said, "Bye, Sam. Bye, Max. See you again."

They went back to their mom and dad. They told them about Sam and Max and the tricks. Their mom and dad said, "That sounds wonderful. We are glad you had a good time at the park."

They got in the car and drove home. They were tired but happy. They said, "We love the park. We love Sam and Max. We love mom and dad." They hugged and kissed and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Pete. He was only three years old and always wanted to help his dad. One day, Pete's dad said, "Time to load the truck, Pete!" So Pete went out to the truck and started loading it with boxes.

Pete was having trouble lifting the heavy boxes, so his dad came out and said, "Here, let me help." He picked up the biggest box, and Pete was so happy to help.

Pete ran to the shed to get the hammer so they could seal the box shut. His dad patiently waited while Pete looked for the hammer. When Pete finally found it, he said excitedly, "Here it is!"

His dad said, "Thank you Pete, now let's get to work and load the truck."

Pete was eager to help, so he impatiently began hammering the box shut. His dad stopped him and said, "Pete, let me help. You need to be careful, you could break the hammer."

Pete smiled and let his dad take over. Together, they loaded the truck and were able to finish just in time for the big trip.

Mama and Baba laughed when they saw Jack. He was wearing an ordinary outfit, but he had put his shoe on the left foot. Mama said it didn't matter, but Baba said it was wrong. Jack was sad and went to sit in the corner.

Mama told Baba that it wasn't wrong, that it was just a little mix-up. Baba shook his head and said no. He said it was wrong and he didn't want Jack to do it again. Jack was very sad, he had very mixed-up feelings inside him.

Mama saw that Jack was sad. She knelt down beside him and said that it was ok, that babies make mistakes sometimes. Baba heard this and felt bad for what he said. He laughed and came over to hug Jack, saying that it was ok and that his shoe looked funny.

Jack laughed too and hugged his parents. He smiled and was happy again. Baba said that they could make a game of it, to help Jack remember to always put his shoe on the right foot. The family spent the afternoon playing the game and in the end, Jack always remembered to put his shoe on the right foot - no matter what.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play dress up with her friends. One day, she found a big rubber ball at the park. It was so bouncy and fun to play with! 

Lily's friend, Timmy, saw the ball and said, "Wow, that ball is so high! Can I play with it too?" 

Lily replied, "Sure, but first we have to dress up like princesses!" 

So they put on their princess dresses and played with the rubber ball all afternoon. They bounced it so high that it almost reached the clouds! 

When it was time to go home, Lily said, "I had so much fun playing with you, Timmy. Let's do it again tomorrow!" 

And Timmy replied, "Yes, let's play with the high rubber ball and dress up like princesses every day!"

Once upon a time, there was a lovely otter who lived in a river. Every day he swam around, exploring and looking for food. One day, he saw a big fish and he was so excited! He tried to swim faster, but the fish was just too fast for him.

He got so frustrated that he began to yell. He yelled with all of his might and it echoed around the river. Suddenly, he heard a noise coming from the other side of the river. It was a voice, but it wasn't like his voice! It was different, but it was still lovely.

The otter was scared and he stopped yelling. He swam over to the other side of the river to see what it was. There he saw the most beautiful thing he had ever seen. It was another otter! The two otters said hello and became friends. From then on, the otters would often yell together and it sounded like a song. They were so happy and the lovely sound filled the river with love.

Once there was a cat. He liked to sleep in a very tight spot. He found a piece of cloth and decided to fold it. He made it very tight so that he could stay inside.

The cat felt very comfortable in the tight cloth. He curled up in it and took a little nap. He felt safe and warm inside the tight cloth.

The cat stayed in the cloth for a very long time. Eventually, he crawled out and wandered off. He was very tired from sleeping in the tight fold. 

The cat was happy that he had a very comfortable place to rest. He knew he would come back to the tight fold whenever he needed a nap!

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was very gifted, he could do tricks like roll over and fetch. One day, Max was outside playing when he saw a big, scary thunderstorm coming. Max started to tremble with fear. 

His owner, a little girl named Lily, saw Max trembling and asked, "What's wrong, Max?" 

Max replied, "I'm scared of the thunderstorm, Lily." 

Lily hugged Max and said, "Don't be scared, Max. I have a gift for you that will make you feel better." 

Lily went inside and came back with a cozy blanket for Max to snuggle in. Max felt much better and stopped trembling. From then on, Max knew that whenever he was scared, Lily would always have a gift to make him feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a big balloon. It was the biggest balloon ever and it was very pretty, just like the colors of the rainbow. The balloon was tied outside and it was waiting for something special. Then, a little boy came running outside. He saw the balloon and said, "Wow!" Then he ran for the balloon and started to play with it. He was so happy and he ran around with it in the bright and mild sunlight. The little boy laughed as the balloon flew higher and higher in the warm air. He kept running, feeling the freedom of the balloon and the warmth of the sun. Finally, the little boy ran inside and the balloon floated away and was gone.

Once there was a little bouncing bunny. He was a friendly bunny but he was so bouncy that he made a lot of noise when he hopped. One day he hopped into town, and he saw a rude fox.

The fox saw the bunny and he said, â€œBe quiet!â€ The bunny was so surprised because he was not being rude. He was just being bouncy.

He hopped closer to the fox and said, â€œWhy are you being so rude? I am just trying to be happy and have fun.â€

The fox replied, â€œI donâ€™t like your noise. It is too much for this town.â€

The bunny thought for a moment, and then he had an idea. He said, â€œWhy donâ€™t you join me? Then we can both have fun, and make less noise.â€ The fox thought about it, and then he started to hop and bounce with the bunny. They had a lot of fun, and the town was happy because there was much less noise.

Lily and Ben like to play with dolls. They have many dolls with different clothes and hair. One day, Lily sees a hole in her doll's dress. She is sad and shows Ben.

"Oh no, your doll has a hole!" Ben says. "We need to fix it."

"How?" Lily asks.

Ben has an idea. He runs to his room and comes back with a needle and thread. He learned how to sew from his mom. He tells Lily to hold the doll and he sets the needle in the hole. He makes a stitch and pulls the thread. He does this many times until the hole is gone.

"Look, Lily, your doll's dress is fixed!" Ben says. "Now she has a nice stitch."

Lily smiles and hugs her doll. She hugs Ben too and says, "Thank you, Ben, you are a nice friend. You are good at sewing."

Ben smiles and says, "You're welcome, Lily. I like to help you. Do you want to play with the dolls some more?"

Lily nods and they play with the dolls happily. They make up stories and have fun. They are nice friends.

Once upon a time, there was a very interesting boy called Jack. He loved to press buttons, and try new things. On this particular day, Jack found a trumpet.

He had no idea how to play it so he went to find his dad. His dad was very happy to discuss it with Jack and show him how it worked.

At first, Jack struggled to make a sound but then his dad showed him how to make a loud trumpet noise. Jack was so excited and soon practised making the noise every day. 

He loved it, and it always made him smile - even if the sound was a bit squeaky! Soon, his dad was so proud of his progress that he asked him to perform in front of some of the neighbours. 

Jack was so proud of himself and was even praised by the adults. From that day on, Jack enjoyed practising the trumpet and making interesting noises!

Once upon a time, there was a new rocket. It was shiny and big. The rocket wanted to serve and help people. It lived in a town with many friends.

One day, the rocket saw a cat stuck in a tree. It wanted to help the cat. The rocket used its fire to push it up to the tree. It got the cat and brought it down. The cat was happy and thanked the rocket. All the friends in the town clapped and cheered.

The rocket learned that it is good to serve and help others. It felt happy and proud. The rocket's friends loved it more. The end.

One day, Jack was playing with his toys in his room. Suddenly, he heard a loud scream coming from outside. He crawled to the window to investigate the noise. To his surprise, he saw a skeleton walking around his yard. Jack was scared and started to cry.

He ran out of his bedroom and told his parents about the skeleton. His parents were also shocked and started to look for the skeleton. But it was gone! They looked all around the house, in the garden and even in the garage. Jack was very relieved when they could not find the skeleton.

After that, Jack was extra careful when he was outside. Every night, he made sure to check his backyard for the skeleton. But he never saw it again. Instead, he saw a lot of regular birds and animals. The skeleton never came back again.

Peggy was a cheerful three year old. She loved to play in her garage. But one day, when she was playing in the garage, something strange happened. She asked her mom for help, but her mom ignored her. 

Peggy felt sad and alone. She wondered why her mom was ignoring her. She tried again, but still no response. After a few more tries, Peggy decided to go outside and try to find someone to help her.

She looked and looked until she spotted her friend, Timmy. He was playing in the nearby park. She ran up to him and asked for help. Timmy happily agreed and the two friends went back to the garage. 

When they arrived, Timmy fixed the problem in no time. Peggy was happy and grateful. She thanked him and gave him a big hug.

From then on, Peggy was determined never to be ignored again! She made sure to ask for help whenever she needed it. She was always cheerful, even when things didn't go her way.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to go outside to play. She opened the door and started to carry her teddy bear. But when she tried to close the door it wouldn't shut. She was so sad. She didn't know how to fix it.

Just then her Big Brother walked in. He said, "Let me help you." He knelt down and looked at the door. He moved and pushed it until it finally closed. The girl was so happy. She said, "Thank you Big Brother!"

Big Brother smiled. He said, "You're welcome. That door is so fine now!"

The little girl giggled and said, "Yes, it is!" Then she hugged her teddy bear and ran outside to play.

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a small kitten in her yard. The kitten was very cute and soft. Lucy wanted to play with the kitten. She was very careful when she picked it up. She did not want to hurt the kitten.

Lucy's mom saw her playing with the kitten. She said, "Lucy, you need to be careful with the kitten. It is very small and needs our help. You must remind your friends to be careful too when they play with it."

Lucy and the kitten played all day. They played with a ball and a soft toy. Lucy was very happy to have a new friend. She told her friends to be careful when they played with the kitten too. They all had a fun day together.

Lily and Max were playing in the living room. They had a big blanket that they liked to spread on the floor and pretend it was a tent. They crawled under the blanket and whispered to each other.

"Let's go on an adventure," Max said. "We can be explorers and find new things."

"OK," Lily said. "But we have to be quiet. Mommy is working in the other room and she doesn't like noise."

They nodded and crawled out of the blanket. They looked around the room and saw a basket of toys, a bookshelf, a couch and a lamp. They decided to explore the bookshelf first.

They climbed up the bookshelf and looked at the books. They saw pictures of animals, cars, princesses and pirates. They picked up some books and flipped through the pages.

"Look, a lion!" Max said, pointing at a book. "It's big and yellow and has a mane."

"Roar!" Lily said, making a lion sound. "It's scary and noisy."

They laughed and put the book back. They moved on to the next book. It had a picture of a spaceship on the cover.

"Wow, a spaceship!" Max said. "It's shiny and fast and goes to the stars."

"Zoom!" Lily said, making a spaceship sound. "It's cool and noisy."

They laughed and put the book back. They moved on to the next book. It had a picture of a flower on the cover.

"Look, a flower!" Max said. "It's pretty and colorful and smells nice."

"Sniff!" Lily said, making a sniffing sound. "It's sweet and quiet."

They smiled and put the book back. They were about to move on to the next book when they heard a voice.

"Kids, what are you doing up there?" Mommy said, coming into the living room. "You're making too much noise. You're supposed to be playing with the blanket, not the books."

"Sorry, Mommy," Lily and Max said, climbing down the bookshelf. "We were just exploring."

Mommy sighed and smiled. She picked up the blanket and spread it on the floor again.

"OK, you can explore, but under the blanket, OK?" Mommy said. "And be quiet, please. I have to finish some work."

"OK, Mommy," Lily and Max said. They crawled under the blanket and whispered to each other.

"Let's go on another adventure," Max said. "We can be pirates and find treasure."

"OK," Lily said. "But we have to be quiet. Mommy is working in the other room and she doesn't like noise."

They nodded and pretended to sail on a ship under the blanket. They were quiet, but happy.

Sara and Tom were best friends. They liked to play with their furry toys and ride their bicycles in the park. One day, Sara had a big idea.

"Tom, do you want to marry me?" she asked.

Tom was surprised. He did not know what marry meant. He liked Sara, but he also liked his bicycle.

"What is marry?" he asked.

Sara smiled. She had seen her big sister marry last week. She wore a white dress and a pretty flower in her hair. She kissed a man and everyone clapped.

"Marry is when you love someone and you want to be with them forever. You wear nice clothes and you get a ring and a cake. Do you want to marry me?" she repeated.

Tom thought for a moment. He loved Sara, but he also loved his bicycle. He did not want to give it up.

"Can I still ride my bicycle if I marry you?" he asked.

Sara nodded. She liked Tom's bicycle too. It was red and shiny and had a bell.

"Of course you can. We can ride our bicycles together. And we can share our furry toys and our cake. It will be fun. Do you want to marry me?" she asked again.

Tom smiled. He decided to say yes. He liked the idea of being with Sara forever. He liked the idea of wearing nice clothes and getting a ring and a cake. He liked the idea of riding his bicycle with Sara.

"Yes, I want to marry you," he said.

Sara and Tom hugged. They were happy. They ran to Sara's house to tell her mom and dad. They did not know that they had to wait until they were older to really marry. They did not care. They had each other and their bicycles and their furry toys. They had everything they needed.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little bird. The bird loved to sing and would sing all day long. One day, the bird was feeling very hungry and decided to order some food. The bird went to a restaurant and asked the waiter to bring some seeds. The waiter was very nice and quickly brought some seeds for the bird to eat. The bird was so happy and sang a song to thank the waiter. After eating, the bird felt very full and decided to fly away. Before leaving, the bird looked back and saw that the waiter had left the door open. The bird sang another song to say goodbye and flew out into the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a charming oyster. It lived in the sea and everyone in the village said how beautiful it was.

One day, a boy came to the village. He had a question, and he wanted the oyster to answer it. The boy asked the oyster, â€˜Why are you so charming?â€™

The oyster thought and thought, and then it answered. It said, â€˜Because I love to laugh and dance in the sea!â€™ The boy smiled and thanked the oyster for its answer.

Then he said goodbye and the oyster waved back. From then on, the oyster was known as the most charming oyster in the sea.

The day was perfect. The sun was shining and the birds were chirping. Jenny was so happy and excited.

Jenny was dreaming about playing on the swings and swimming in the pool. She was imagining there were no limits to what she could do.

Alarm was ringing. That was Jennyâ€™s signal that it was time to get up. She was feeling a bit tired but she was determined to start her day.

At the park, Jenny was running around and having fun, but she was growing tired quickly. Before long, her legs started to feel heavy, her eyes drooped, and she began to yawn.

Once again, the alarm went off, but this time to signal that it was time to go home. Jenny was pleased - she'd been playing all day, and had a great time. Now, she could rest and dream of the next day's adventures.

Anna and Ben are playing in the park. They see a big dog with a ball in his mouth. The dog is running and jumping. Anna and Ben want to play with the dog.

"Hello, dog!" Anna says. "Can we play with you?"

The dog barks and wags his tail. He drops the ball and runs to Anna and Ben. They throw the ball and the dog fetches it. They have fun.

But then, the dog sees a cat. The cat is on a tree. The dog wants to chase the cat. He runs to the tree and barks. The cat hisses and scratches. The dog cries.

"Bad cat!" Ben says. "Leave the dog alone!"

Ben picks up a stick and tries to scare the cat. But the cat is not afraid. The cat jumps on Ben and scratches his face. Ben cries.

"Help!" Ben says. "The cat hurts me!"

Anna hears Ben. She runs to him. She sees the cat on his face. She grabs the cat and pulls it off. She throws the cat away. The cat runs and hides.

"Are you okay, Ben?" Anna says. "I rescue you from the cat."

Ben hugs Anna. He says, "Thank you, Anna. You are my hero. You are perfect."

The dog comes to them. He licks their faces. He says, "Woof, woof. Thank you, too. You are my friends. You are perfect."

Anna and Ben smile. They pet the dog. They say, "You are welcome, dog. You are our friend. You are perfect."

They play with the dog again. They forget about the cat. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a mule named Molly. She lived on a farm with her friends, the cows and the chickens. Molly was big and strong, but sometimes she got tired from working hard all day.

One day, Molly saw the cows laying down in the field. They looked so relaxed and happy. Molly felt envious of the cows, she wanted to relax too. So, she decided to lay down in the field with them.

As she lay there, she felt her body start to relax. Her muscles weren't tight anymore and she felt happy. From that day on, whenever Molly felt tired, she would lay down and relax like the cows. And she never felt envious of them again.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat named Max. Max liked to keep his fur clean by licking it all day long. He also liked to keep his belly full by eating fish from the nearby river. 

One day, Max went for a walk in the forest. He saw a wide tree with lots of branches. Max climbed up the tree to see the view from the top. It was so high up that he felt a little scared, but he was also excited to see everything from so high up. 

Max knew that climbing trees was a healthy thing to do. It made him strong and gave him lots of exercise. He decided to climb more trees in the future so that he could keep his body healthy and strong.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red car. The car was very fast and could go vroom vroom! The car's driver was a happy man who loved to drive his car around. One day, the man needed to park his car, but it was very difficult to find a good spot. He drove around and around, but all the spots were taken. Finally, he found a small space and carefully parked his car.

As he got out of the car, he smelled something funny. It was smoke! He looked around and saw a big, black cloud of smoke coming from a nearby building. He quickly called the fire department to help put out the fire. The firefighters arrived and worked hard to put out the flames. Finally, the fire was out and everyone was safe.

The man got back into his car and drove away, feeling happy that he found a parking spot and that the firefighters were able to put out the fire. He knew that he would always be careful when parking his car and that he would always call for help if he saw smoke. The end.

Once upon a time there was a happy little girl. Her name was Sarah. She loved to play with her toys and do her puzzles. One day she saw something extra special. It was a screen! Sarah was very curious. She wanted to know what it was.

So, Sarah pressed a button and the screen twisted. It showed different shapes and animals. Sarah was delighted! She smiled and laughed with joy. 

But then something happened. The screen seemed to get stuck and it just kept twisting. Sarah was a little bit scared. But then she remembered something her mommy told her. She needed to be patient.

So, Sarah took a deep breath and waited. Sure enough, after a few minutes, the screen stopped twisting. She was so relieved! She clapped her hands and danced around the room.

Sarah was amazed by the screen. She knew she learned something special that day and she would always be patient when her toys got stuck. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little bird. The bird loved to soar high in the sky and look down at the world below. One special day, the bird decided to build a tent. The bird found a nice spot in the grass and started to get ready.

The bird gathered his sticks and feathers and carefully put it all together. When the bird was done, he had made a strong and sturdy tent! The bird felt so proud and happy, he couldn't wait to try it out.

So the bird jumped in and spread his wings wide and soared high in the sky. The wind felt so nice and the bird felt so free! He enjoyed the view, he could see everything from way up high.

The bird had made such a wonderful and cozy tent, he decided to stay for a little while and explore the sky. The bird soared through the clouds and over the trees, feeling so happy and free.

When the bird finally tired, he flew back and landed in his tent. The bird was so happy and ready for his next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside in the snow. One day, she saw a big gray cloud in the sky. It looked like it was going to snow a lot. Lily was very excited.

She went outside to play in the snow. She made a snowman and had a snowball fight with her friends. But then, the snow started to fall harder and harder. Lily's mom called her inside, but she didn't want to leave the snow.

Suddenly, the snow turned into a big storm. Lily tried to go back inside, but the wind was too strong. She got lost in the storm and couldn't find her way back home. The snow was too high and too cold. Lily was scared and alone. She wished she had listened to her mom and attached herself to her when she had the chance.

Once upon a time, there was a bell. It was round and made of shiny metal. It was so thick that it was hard to move.

One day, a boy was playing in the snow. It was so cold that everything was freezing. Suddenly, he heard a sound. It was coming from the bell!

The boy decided to take the bell to his house. When he did, he saw a tiny bird inside! The bird had been cold, so it had frozen.

The boy was happy when the bird thawed and flew away. He was even happier that the bell was now free to make its happy sound!

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat named Fluffy. Fluffy had a computer that he liked to play with. He played games and watched fun videos on it.

One day, Fluffy's friend, a brown dog named Spot, came to visit. Spot saw the computer and wanted to play too. Fluffy did not want to share his computer with Spot. He wanted to keep it all for himself.

Spot was sad and went home. Fluffy kept playing on his computer, but he felt lonely. He realized that not sharing his computer made him lose his friend. Now, Fluffy was all alone with his computer and no one to play with.

Once there was a little girl who loved to play. One day, she was playing hide-and-seek and she found a funny desk in the corner of the room. She had never seen it before. She called out to her friend, "Come look at this desk! I think it's so funny!" 

Her friend ran over and they started searching the desk drawers and shelves. They found some funny and interesting things. All of a sudden, a loud scream came out of the desk. The girls were so scared they both screamed and ran out of the room.

When they got back into the room, they saw that it was only a little mouse! The mouse had been sleeping in the desk and was just as scared as the girls! The girls both laughed and it wasn't so scary anymore. They decided to leave the mouse alone and never told anyone about it!

Once there was a girl named Julie. She was a brave and strong girl. Her mummy made her favourite dinner - pasta. Julie was so excited to eat the pasta that she ran to the kitchen. But when she got there, she was a bit worried. It looked very difficult. She wanted to help her mummy to complete the dinner.

So she climbed onto a chair and reached up to the counter. She got the pasta and put it in the pot. She stirred it and added the sauce. Then she waited patiently, watching it cook.

When the pasta was finally complete, Mummy said it was delicious. Julie was so proud of herself. She had been brave and strong and completed the pasta all by herself.

Once there was a boy named Joe. He was very excited because he was going to get to eat some spaghetti. He went to the kitchen and saw a big pot of warm spaghetti on the table. Joe was so happy to see the spaghetti that he smiled.

He slowly took the lid off the pot and revealed the most delicious smelling spaghetti. He couldn't believe his luck. He started to eat the spaghetti with a spoon, enjoying every bite as he ate.

When he finished, he felt very peaceful. He liked the way spaghetti made him feel so he decided to make some more. He went to the kitchen, grabbed the ingredients and made the most delicious spaghetti he had ever tasted.

Every day after that Joe would make and eat some spaghetti. Every day he would feel peaceful, just like he did that first day. It revealed to Joe that having spaghetti was a great way to make himself feel calm and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a young peach. She was small and round and very juicy.

She wanted to explore the world and make some new friends. So she decided to introduce herself to everyone she met.

She first met a little rabbit. The rabbit was quite shy, but the peach was kind and soon the rabbit was smiling and sharing stories with the peach.

Once upon a time, there was a small boat. The boat lived in a harbor. The harbor was a nice and fair place. All the boats liked the harbor. They knew it was a safe place to be.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. One day, Lucy went outside to explore her garden. As she looked around, she saw a mysterious rake in the corner. She walked over and gently picked it up with both hands.

When Lucy looked closer, she saw that the rake wasn't like a normal rake. It had symbols and special markings all over it. Lucy stood still and wondered what it was for.

Suddenly, the rake began to move. It wobbled in Lucy's hands and then flew up into the air. Lucy smiled as the rake spun around again and again. The more it spun, the bigger Lucy's smile became.

Lucy watched in amazement as the rake flew higher and higher, spinning around the sky. Then, all of a sudden, the rake disappeared into a mysterious cloud.

Lucy looked up and sighed. She waved goodbye to the mysterious rake, and something inside her heart even smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the rain and jump in the puddles. One day, she went outside and it started to rain. She ran around and got very wet. Her clothes were soaked and her hair was dripping.

As she was walking back to her house, she saw a big rainbow in the sky. She wondered how it got there and why it was so pretty. She felt happy and excited to see something so wonderful.

When she got inside, her mom made her a cup of hot chocolate. Lily took a sip and made a funny face because it tasted bitter. Her mom added some sugar and stirred it until it tasted sweet. Lily smiled and felt warm inside.

Once upon a time, there was a famous rabbit. He liked to hop everywhere he went. Every day he would hop to the nearby store to get his favourite foods and supplies. 

One day when he hopped to the nearby store he noticed something special - a giant calendar! He had never seen anything so big before. He hopped around the store and noticed the calendar was filled with pictures. 

He hopped back to his burrow to tell all of his friends about the calendar. His friends were so excited when they heard about the calendar. They asked him to take them to the store so they could see it. 

The next day all of his friends hopped to the store with him. When they saw the calendar, they were all amazed. Together the bunny and his friends explored the calendar and learnt the days of the week. It was the most amazing day ever!

One day, Sally went on an adventure. She wore a bright, red shirt and filled a basket with a few items. She left the house and started to explore the forest.

As she walked along, Sally saw a small cottage surrounded by neat and tidy gardens. She wondered who lived there and got closer to take a peek.

Suddenly, someone came out of the house. It was an old lady. She saw Sally and walked up to her.

"Hello little one," said the old lady, smiling.

Sally was shy, but politely answered, "Hello."

The old lady noticed Sally's bright red shirt. "Where did you get such a shirt?" she asked.

Sally explained that she had left her house to go on an adventure and was wearing the shirt for the journey.

The old lady smiled and said, "Well, be sure to stay safe, and keep your clothes tidy just like these gardens!" 

Sally thanked the old lady and went on her way. She never forgot the old lady's kindness and the lesson on keeping her clothes tidy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside with her daddy. They would run around and laugh together. One day, they decided to climb a big tree. Daddy climbed up first and then Lily followed. 

As they were sitting on a thick branch, Lily leaned over to grab a leaf. Suddenly, the branch started to crack! Daddy quickly grabbed onto Lily and pulled her back to safety. 

Lily was scared and started to cry. "Don't worry, sweetie," Daddy said. "I've got you. We'll climb down together." And they did. From then on, they decided to only climb trees that were strong enough to hold them both.

Once upon a time there was an old hook. It just hung there on the wall all by itself. One day it seemed to grow wings and it flew away into the air. The hook vanished. Everyone in the house was so surprised to see a hook fly! They had never seen such a thing before. Nobody knew what happened to the old hook, but it never came back. It had simply vanished. The end.

Once there was a small fireman who worked very hard. He wanted to make sure that everyone was safe and happy. One day, he was very thirsty. He decided to take a break and go get some juice to drink. So he hurried to the kitchen and opened the fridge. There was orange, apple and strawberry juice. The small fireman chose the strawberry juice and he drank it all up! He was so happy and thanked the juice for quenching his thirst. Then, he went back to work and continued to make sure everybody was safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing outside and getting dirty. One day, Timmy's mom told him it was time to take a bath and wash all the dirt off. Timmy did not want to take a bath, but his mom said he had to.

As Timmy was taking a bath, he saw his toy spaceship. The spaceship had a laser that could shoot out pretend beams. Timmy pretended to shoot the laser and make noises. His mom asked him what he was doing, and Timmy told her he was fighting aliens.

After his bath, Timmy felt calm and clean. He put on his pajamas and asked his mom to read him a story. Timmy fell asleep dreaming about flying his spaceship and washing away all the aliens.

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to look for bugs and flowers. They saw a lizard on a rock. It was green and brown and had a long tail.

"Wow, look at the lizard!" Lily said. "It is so cool. Can we touch it?"

Ben was scared of the lizard. He thought it might bite or scratch them. He shook his head.

"No, Lily, we can't touch it. It is not a toy. It is a wild animal. It might run away or hurt us."

But Lily did not listen to Ben. She wanted to see the lizard up close. She had an urge to touch it. She moved slowly towards the rock.

"Come on, Ben, don't be a baby. It is just a lizard. It is not a lion or a snake. It is cute and small. I want to pet it."

Ben tried to stop Lily. He grabbed her arm.

"Lily, stop! You are being silly. The lizard does not want to be petted. It wants to be left alone. You are scaring it. Come back here!"

But Lily pulled her arm away from Ben. She reached out her hand to the lizard. The lizard did not like Lily's hand. It felt threatened. It opened its mouth and showed its teeth. It hissed and jumped at Lily.

"Aaaah!" Lily screamed. She was surprised and scared. She fell back and dropped her hand. The lizard ran away and hid under a bush.

Ben ran to Lily. He hugged her and checked her hand. She had a small scratch on her finger. It was bleeding a little bit.

"Are you okay, Lily?" Ben asked. "Did the lizard hurt you?"

Lily nodded. She was crying. She felt sorry and stupid.

"Yes, Ben, I am okay. But the lizard hurt me. It was angry at me. I should have listened to you. You were right. I was wrong. I was silly. I am sorry, Ben."

Ben smiled and kissed her cheek. He took her hand and wrapped it with a leaf.

"It's okay, Lily. I forgive you. You are not silly. You are curious. But you have to be careful. Some animals don't like to be touched. They need their space. Next time, we can look at the lizard from far away. Okay?"

Lily smiled and nodded. She hugged Ben and said thank you.

"Okay, Ben. Thank you for being my friend. You are very smart and brave. And tall. I like you."

They walked back to the house. They saw their mom and dad. They told them what happened. Their mom and dad were glad they were okay. They gave them a hug and a cookie. They said they were proud of them for being honest and kind. They said they loved them very much.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sunny went to visit her granny. Sunny was so excited to go! When she arrived, she gave her granny a big hug.

Granny smiled and said, "I have something I'd like to borrow from you, Sunny. Can you give me a hug too?" 

Sunny happily hugged granny tightly. After the hug, Sunny was feeling a bit tired from her visit. 

"Why don't you take a nap, sweetie?" Granny suggested.

"Ok," said Sunny, smiling. "You can borrow my sleepy head for a bit!" 

Granny laughed and put Sunny down for a nap. After a nice rest, Sunny felt refreshed and ready for a new adventure. She hugged granny goodbye and said, "Thanks for lending me your hugs, granny!"

Once upon a time there was a thin magic print. It was so special that it could make anything appear! Everyone was amazed.

One day, a 3-year-old boy named Jack was playing in the park. He saw the print and ran over to look at it. He was so excited. He asked his mom, "What's that?"

"That's a magic print," his mom said.

Jack was so happy. He wanted to try the print, so he reached out and put his hand on it. Suddenly, a beautiful castle appeared! Jack was so excited. He ran around and around the castle, laughing and having fun.

Then, he looked at his mom and said, "Thank you, Mommy! This is the best thing ever!"

Once upon a time there were two friends. The first friend was named Owen, and the other one was called Bob. Owen and Bob were always together! 

One day, Owen and Bob were walking together near a big building. The building smelled really bad and Owen did not like it. Bob, however, decided to go inside despite the smell. 

When Bob came out, he had lots of things. Owen asked why he got those things and Bob said that he wanted to gain something out of the smelly building. 

The moral of this story is that bad things can lead to unwanted results. Owen learned that it is best to stay away from smelly buildings!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved to play. He ran around and giggled all day long. Then one day he saw something high up in the sky. It was big and green and it flew in circles above him. The little boy forgot all about his toys and ran to see the green thing in the sky.

He looked up and saw it was a scale. But the scale was too tall for him to climb. He was getting so frustrated that he screamed and shouted. He was so desperate to get up the scale but he didn't know how to do it. He felt so foolish and ignorant.

Then, just as he was about to give up, he heard a voice call out from above him. Looking up, he saw an old man smiling down at him. The old man asked the little boy if he wanted to get up the scale. The little boy shouted yes and the old man said he could help.

The old man explained that he had a rope that could be tied around the little boy. The rope could pull the little boy up the scale. So the little boy put on the rope and closed his eyes. The old man started to pull and before he knew it, the boy was at the top of the scale!

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie named Tweet. Tweet loved to play with twigs and make nests in trees. One day, Tweet found a big twig and started to twist it around. Suddenly, the twig snapped in half! 

"Oh no!" cried Tweet. "What do I do now?"

Just then, a wise old owl flew by. "Don't worry, little Tweet," said the owl. "You can use the two pieces of twig to make a new nest. I am proud of you for being so resourceful!"

Tweet was happy and thanked the owl. Together, they worked on building a new nest with the twigs. And from that day on, Tweet was proud of the cozy home they had built.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play football with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend asked him if he wanted to join a football team. Timmy felt excited but also a little scared because he knew football could be difficult.

Timmy decided to give it a try and joined the team. At first, he found it very difficult to keep up with the other players. He felt sad and wanted to quit. However, his coach encouraged him and told him that with practice, he could become a great football player.

Timmy kept practicing and soon he started to feel more confident. He was able to keep up with the other players and even scored a goal in a game! Timmy learned that even when things feel difficult, if he keeps trying and practicing, he can achieve anything he wants.

Tom and Mia like to help their mom cook dinner. Today, they are making pizza with cheese and sauce. Mom gives them each a ball of dough and shows them how to roll it flat.

"Can I have more sauce, please?" Mia asks. She likes sauce a lot. She thinks it makes the pizza yummy.

"Sure, here you go," Mom says. She gives Mia a spoon and a bowl of sauce. "But don't put too much, or it will be messy."

Mia nods and starts to spread the sauce on her dough. She wants to cover every bit of it. She dips her spoon in the bowl again and again.

"Look, Mom, I have a lot of sauce!" Mia says proudly.

Tom looks at Mia's pizza. He thinks it has too much sauce. He only puts a little bit on his dough. He likes cheese more than sauce. He sprinkles cheese on his pizza and makes a smiley face with it.

"Look, Mom, I have a cheese face!" Tom says happily.

Mom smiles at both of them. She thinks they are very creative. She puts their pizzas in the oven and sets the timer.

"Good job, kids. Now we have to wait for the pizzas to bake. Do you know what happens when they bake?" Mom asks.

"The cheese melts and the sauce bubbles," Tom says.

"And the dough rises and gets bigger," Mia says.

"That's right. The dough increases in size when it is hot. That's why we have to roll it flat first. Otherwise, it would be too large to fit in the oven," Mom explains.

The kids nod and watch the oven. They can smell the pizza and hear it sizzle. They can't wait to eat it. They think it will be the best pizza ever.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Harry and Molly. They both loved carrots and often ate them together. 

One day, Harry and Molly were playing together. Harry wanted to eat all the carrots, but Molly didn't want to share. This made Harry sad.

The two friends started to quarrel. Molly shouted and said that she wanted all the carrots. Harry was angry and shouted back.

Then, something very special happened. A big, white rabbit appeared with a basket full of carrots. He said that since they could not agree, they should both take some of the carrots. 

Harry and Molly were very happy and thanked the rabbit. They both grabbed a few carrots, and then hugged and made up. That day, they both ate their fine carrots and they never had to quarrel again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the forest near her home. One day, she met a cute rabbit. The rabbit was harmless and didn't want to hurt anyone.

"Hello, little rabbit," said Lily. "What's your name?"

"My name is Fluffy," replied the rabbit.

Lily and Fluffy became friends and played together. Suddenly, Lily's mom called out to her. "Lily, it's time to go home! Hurry up!"

"I have to go now, Fluffy," said Lily. "But I'll come back tomorrow to play with you again!"

Lily ran back home, feeling happy that she had made a new friend in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a big hurricane. The wind was blowing very hard and the rain was pouring down. A little girl named Lily was scared and asked her mom, "What's happening?"

Her mom replied, "There's a big storm outside. But don't worry, we're safe inside our house."

Suddenly, the power went out and it was very dark. But then, the lightning revealed a surprise. Lily's mom had lit candles all around the room, making it feel cozy and warm. Lily smiled and said, "I like the candles. They make me feel safe."

Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm glad. Sometimes, even in the midst of a scary storm, we can find something beautiful and comforting."

Once upon a time, there was a zipping sound in the quiet room. It sounded like someone was playing with something. Two friends, Mel and June, were curious and excited to find out what was making the noise. 

"What's that noise?" asked June.
"I don't know," said Mel, "Let's go find out!"

The two went searching around the room until they found the source of the noise: a pin, zipping up and down the wall!

"How unusual," said June, "How does it zip up and down the wall like that?

Mel put her finger to her lips and said, "Shhh, maybe it's magic?"

June's wide eyes lit up as she said, "That's it! I think we should try to figure out how it works!"

The two friends worked together to try and make the pin zip again. After a few minutes of hard work, the pin began to zip again!

"Woo-hoo!" cried Mel, "We did it! How exciting! I think this pin has a magical zipping power!"

June and Mel enjoyed their newfound discovery and magic pin. From that day forward, the two friends would take turns zipping the pin up and down the wall. It was the quietest, most exciting adventure they ever had.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play with their bikes in the park. One day, Sara sees a big hill and wants to go down fast. Ben urges her to be careful, but Sara does not listen. She pedals hard and zooms down the hill.

But there is a rock on the path. Sara does not see it and hits it with her bike. She falls off and hurts her leg. She cries out loud. Ben runs to her and sees blood on her knee. He is scared and calls for help.

A lady who is walking her dog hears them and comes over. She sees Sara's wound and says they need to go to the hospital. She has a phone and calls a taxi. She helps Ben and Sara get in the taxi and goes with them.

At the hospital, a doctor and a nurse look at Sara's leg. They clean it and put a bandage on it. They give her some medicine to make the pain go away. They tell her she is brave and will be fine soon. Sara feels better and smiles.

Ben hugs her and says he is sorry. He says he loves her and will always watch out for her. Sara says she loves him too and thanks him. She says she was silly and will listen to him next time. The lady who helped them says they are great twins and gives them some stickers. They say thank you and wait for their mom and dad to come. They are happy they have each other.

Once there was a little girl named Lily who was three years old. She was a very fair girl with lots of curiosity. She wanted to understand everything around her.

Lily asked her mom what kinds of exercises she could do to keep her body strong. Her mom said that if she wanted to keep her body strong, she should do exercises like running, jumping, and skipping.

Lily was so excited to do exercises. She loved running and jumping. She tried her best to jump as high as she could and she also ran faster than ever!

Every day, Lily kept doing these exercises and she started to understand how it felt to be strong and healthy. She also saw that being fair with her exercises was very important. She knew that if she tried her best, she would always be strong and healthy.

Once upon a time, there was a group of eager toddlers. They were always on the lookout for any fun activity that they could do together. One day, they gathered around their teacher and asked, "Teacher, can we do something fun?". Their teacher smiled and said, "Yes, why don't you rub your tummies with both hands?"

The toddlers were excited and started to rub their tummies. None of them wanted to stop, so they kept going and going. They rubbed and rubbed until they started to get tired.

Suddenly, one of the toddlers got too eager and he rubbed so hard that he started to cry. The others in the group immediately stopped and they gathered around their crying friend.

The teacher came to the rescue. She knelt down and comforted the toddler while gently taking his hands away from his tummy. She said, "It's ok. You can be eager, but you must be gentle." 

The group of toddlers looked relieved and they all promised to be more gentle when rubbing their tummies. The group went back to having fun together.

Tim and Kim were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they found a big box in the garage. They decided to make a tent with the box and some blankets. They put the box on the grass and covered it with blankets. Then they crawled inside and pretended it was a boat.

"Let's sail to an island!" Tim said.

"Okay, but we need a map and a flag," Kim said.

They drew a map with crayons and cut out a flag from paper. They stuck the flag on a stick and put it on top of the box. Then they grabbed some snacks and toys and got ready to sail.

They rocked the box back and forth and made boat noises. They looked at the map and followed the lines. They saw birds and clouds and trees. They had fun sailing to the island.

But then, the wind blew very hard. It made the blankets fly away. It made the flag fall down. It made the box tip over. Tim and Kim fell out of the box and onto the grass. They were scared and sad. Their tent was gone.

"Help! Help!" they cried.

Mom heard them and came outside. She saw the mess and hugged them.

"Don't worry, my loves. It was just a terrible wind. You are safe and sound. Let's go inside and have some cookies," she said.

Tim and Kim nodded and followed Mom. They were still sad, but they felt better. They knew they could make another tent another day. They knew they could sail to the island again. They knew Mom loved them.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. Lily loved to play at the park with her friends. She would run, jump, and swing on the swings. One day, Lily's friend Timmy started coughing and couldn't breathe well. Lily's mom, who was a nurse, knew that Timmy's lungs were not regular and he needed help. She called an ambulance and Timmy went to the hospital. After a few days, Timmy felt better and could swing again with Lily. They were happy to play together once more.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play together. Today, Tom goes to visit Mia at her house. He brings his toy car and his hat.

"Hi, Tom!" Mia says. "Do you want to play with me?"

"Yes, please!" Tom says. He puts his hat on the table and his car on the floor. "What do you want to play?"

Mia thinks for a moment. She has an idea. "Let's play tea party!" she says. She takes two cups and a pitcher from her toy box. She fills the pitcher with juice. "This is our tea," she says.

Tom nods. He likes juice. He takes a cup and holds it out. Mia pours some juice into his cup. "Thank you," Tom says. He takes a sip. The juice is sweet and cold.

Mia pours some juice into her cup, too. She raises it to her lips. But then, she sneezes. Achoo! The juice spills out of her cup and onto her dress. She gasps. Her dress is wet and sticky.

"Oh, no!" Tom says. He puts his cup down and gets a napkin. He tries to help Mia wipe the juice off her dress. But the napkin is too small. The juice makes a big stain.

Mia starts to cry. She does not like her wet dress. She feels sad and messy.

"Don't cry, Mia," Tom says. He hugs her. "It's okay. It was an accident. You can change your dress."

Mia sniffles. She looks at Tom. He is a good friend. He makes her feel better. She hugs him back. "Thank you, Tom," she says. "You are very nice."

Tom smiles. He is happy to help Mia. He likes to play with her. He does not mind the juice. He thinks it is funny. He laughs. "You're welcome, Mia," he says. "You are very nice, too."

Once there was a little girl called Max. Everyday, Max went for a walk on the beach with her parents. She was so excited when she saw the big oysters! They were all so big and original. Max wasn't sure what to do, so she shrugged. Her dad noticed this, so he showed her how to open the oyster with a special tool. Max found a beautiful pearl inside! She was so happy, she started to jump and dance! Her dad and mum were very proud of her and they all shared a big hug. They kept the pearl in a special box as a beautiful reminder of their fun day at the beach.

Once there was a very modern train. It was so modern that it had steam coming out of it. The train was so excited because it had never seen anything like it before.

One day, another train came along. It was old and slow. The modern train teased the old train saying it was too slow. The old train just smiled and kept going. 

The modern train was so proud of itself. It kept teasing the old train until finally, the old train stopped and said, "Hey, wait up!" The modern train was surprised but it stopped and waited.

The old train had a really great idea. He suggested that the two of them work together. They put their steam together, and they zoomed off down the tracks! They had so much fun and they went so fast! 

The modern train had a great time and learned something new. Teasing doesn't always have to be mean, it can be fun too!

Once upon a time, a long, long time ago, there was a big castle. The castle was very old, so we call it ancient. Inside the castle, there was a princess. She loved to play with her toys, but one day, she accidentally dropped her iron toy. It was very heavy, so it made a loud noise. The princess was very sad because she thought her toy was broken forever. 

But then, a kind knight came to the castle. He saw the princess crying and asked her what was wrong. She told him about her toy and the knight promised to help her. He went to the toy and picked it up. Then, he released the toy from his hand and it fell back into the princess's lap. She was so happy that her toy was not broken! The princess thanked the knight and they became friends. From that day on, they played together in the ancient castle every day.

Once upon a time, there was a man. He was a bad man. He liked to squeeze things too hard. One day, he went to the park. He saw a ball. The ball was big and red.

A little boy was playing with the ball. The bad man wanted the ball. He went to the little boy and took the ball away. The little boy was sad. The bad man began to squeeze the ball.

The little boy's big sister saw what happened. She was not happy. She went to the bad man and said, "Give the ball back!" The bad man did not want to give the ball back. The big sister was brave. She took the ball from the bad man.

The bad man was mad, but he left the park. The little boy and his big sister were happy. They played with the ball together. They had fun, and the bad man did not squeeze things too hard anymore.

One night, Jack the fireman was going to work. He drove to the fire station and shut off the engine. He and his four friends, Tom, Joey, Liz and Jodi, quickly jumped out of the truck and hurried to get their gear.

Suddenly they heard a loud noise coming from a nearby house. They ran over to the house and saw that a huge chimney was on fire! Smoke was coming out of the top.

"Look!" shouted Tom, pointing at the fire. "Someone must have been careless when they used the chimney!"

The five brave fireman, with Jack in the lead, quickly put on their respirators and rushed in. They were ready for the challenge. After a few moments of hard work, the fire was put out. Everyone cheered, relieved that the house was safe.

The next day, the fireman went back to the fire station and gathered their gear. Jack said a quick prayer of thanks and shut the door. They had saved the day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy who wanted to go outside. She asked her mom if she could go, but her mom refused. Lucy was very sad because she wanted to go out and play. 

Then, out of nowhere, there was a huge lightning storm. Lightning lit up the sky and it was so loud Lucy had to cover her ears. Lucy ran to the window and watched the flashing, bright lights in amazement. 

Mom said "You better stay inside until the big storm is over. Lightning can be very dangerous!". Lucy wanted to go out and play, but she knew it would be unsafe. So she agreed to stay inside and be safe. 

Afterwards, the storm was over and the sky was back to normal. Lucy was relieved and excited to go outside and play with her friends. Her mom saw her excitement, so she let her go. 

Lucy was very thankful and happy that she got to go play!

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day she was on an adventure in the park. She noticed an old camera lying on the ground next to a tree. She picked it up and decided to take it home.

When Daisy arrived home with the camera, her mummy was very surprised. She asked Daisy where she got it from. Daisy told her mummy about the park and the old camera.

Mummy thought the camera was broken but then she found a battery and put it into the camera. To her delight, the camera worked!

Mummy was very grateful to Daisy. She said "the camera fits in perfectly with Daisy's adventure kit. Now you can take photos of all your adventures."

Daisy was very happy and thanked her mummy. She was very excited to go back to the park and go on many more adventures with her camera.

Once there was a little girl named Emmy. She was three years old and loved to explore. 

One day, Emmy wanted to buy something special. She asked her mom for some money, and her mom gave her some to buy a toy.

Emmy went to the store and looked around. She saw a big toy that made a lot of noise! Emmy thought it was so cool and wanted to buy it. 

So Emmy put the toy in her basket. But her Mom said, "No Emmy, that one is too noisy!"

Emmy asked, "What can I buy, Mommy?"
 
Her mom answered, "Why don't you buy a quieter toy, like this one? This one is safe and it won't make too much noise." Emmy liked that idea. 

So she put the quieter toy in her basket and bought it. Then she took it home and played with it all day.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play games and learn new things. One day, they have a quiz at school. The quiz is about animals and colors.

Lily is good at the quiz. She knows that a cow is black and white, and a frog is green. She also knows that a lion is big and loud, and a mouse is small and quiet. She answers all the questions right.

Tom is not so good at the quiz. He gets confused by some animals and colors. He thinks that a pig is pink and purple, and a fish is blue and yellow. He also thinks that a bear is small and soft, and a bird is big and hard. He answers some questions wrong.

When the quiz is over, the teacher gives Lily a star sticker. She says, "Lily, you did a lovely job on the quiz. You are very smart and careful."

The teacher gives Tom a smiley sticker. She says, "Tom, you tried hard on the quiz. You are very brave and curious."

Lily and Tom look at each other. They are happy for each other. They say, "Thank you, teacher. We like the quiz. We like to learn new things."

They hug and go to play. They are good friends. They share their stickers and their toys. They yield to each other and take turns. They have fun and laugh. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, while playing hide and seek, Lily's friend Tommy vanished. Lily was scared and didn't know what to do.

Lily ran to her mommy and daddy and told them what happened. Her daddy said, "Let's go find Tommy. We will ask the lawyer who lives next door if he saw anything."

The lawyer was very honest and told them that he saw Tommy playing near the lake. They rushed to the lake and found Tommy safe and sound. Lily was so happy that her friend was okay. From that day on, Lily and her friends never played near the lake again.

Once upon a time, there was a fit trap. It had lots of numbers on it. The trap was shiny and it sparkled in the sun.

Every day, a bunny hopped around looking for food. He was so hungry and could not find anything to eat. But one day, he saw the fit trap. He went over to it, and saw the numbers. What were they for?

The bunny was excited! He poked the numbers, and then the trap sprang open! Out sprang a plate of delicious food! The bunny nearly hopped away with joy. He knew what the numbers were for. They were for him to open the trap. He filled his tummy with the food, and was so happy.

He learned that the numbers were a very useful tool. From then on, he always looked for fit traps with numbers and soon he was never hungry again!

Once upon a time, there was a bird. This bird was very enthusiastic and loved to sing. Everyday, the bird would flutter its wings and sing a beautiful song.

One day, the bird noticed a handle near its nest. It had never seen a handle before! The bird was very curious, so it pecked at the handle with its beak. Suddenly, the handle opened and made a lovely sound!

The bird was delighted. It started to sing an even happier song while flapping its wings. Soon, other birds gathered around the handle and joined the bird in its singing.

The birds were so enthusiastic that even the sun started to shine brighter. It was a happy day! All the birds sang together until evening, and they were very pleased with their singing.

Lisa loves to skip. She skips in the park, she skips in the school, she skips in the mall. She likes to skip because it makes her happy and fast. She can skip faster than her brother Tom, who likes to run.

One day, Lisa and Tom go to the mall with their mom. Mom says they can watch a movie. Lisa is excited. She likes movies. She skips to the movie place. Tom runs after her. Mom walks behind them.

At the movie place, they see a big sign. It says "Modern Popcorn". Lisa and Tom wonder what that means. They ask mom. Mom says it is a new kind of popcorn. It has different colors and flavors. It sounds fun. Mom buys some modern popcorn for them to share.

They go inside the movie room. It is dark and big. They find their seats. Mom gives them the popcorn. Lisa and Tom look at it. It is very pretty. It has red, blue, green, yellow, and pink pieces. They smell good too. They taste them. They are sweet and salty and sour and spicy and fruity. They are yummy. Lisa and Tom like modern popcorn.

They watch the movie. It is funny and scary and sad and happy. They laugh and scream and cry and smile. They eat their popcorn. They skip some pieces to each other. They have fun. They love movies and modern popcorn. They are happy.

Tom and Lily are friends. They like to play outside. One day, they see a big rainbow in the sky. It is very pretty. It has many colors.

"Wow, look at the rainbow!" Tom says. "It is so bright and nice."

"I like the rainbow too," Lily says. "I wish I could own it. Then I could make it shine whenever I want."

Tom thinks for a moment. He has an idea. He says, "Maybe we can own the rainbow. We just need to find the end of it. There must be a pot of gold there. Then we can buy the rainbow with the gold."

Lily likes Tom's idea. She says, "Yes, let's go find the end of the rainbow. Maybe it is behind that hill. Come on, let's run."

Tom and Lily run towards the hill. They are very excited. They hope to find the gold and the rainbow. But as they run, they feel something wet on their heads. It is raining. The rain makes the rainbow fade away. It is gone.

Tom and Lily stop running. They are sad. They look at the sky. It is gray and wet. They say, "Oh no, the rainbow is gone. We can't own it anymore. We can't find the gold."

They are about to cry. But then they see something else. They see a big puddle on the ground. It is shiny and clear. It reflects the sky and the clouds. It looks like a mirror.

Tom smiles. He says, "Look, Lily, there is another sky. It is on the ground. It is like a big water mirror. We can play with it. We can splash and jump and make waves."

Lily smiles too. She says, "You are right, Tom. There is another sky. It is wet and fun. We can own it. We can make it our own water mirror."

Tom and Lily forget about the rainbow and the gold. They run to the puddle. They play with the water mirror. They laugh and have fun. They are happy. They own the wet sky.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She liked to climb trees and loved to play with her friends. One day, she decided to have a party. She asked her friends to come over and play.

At the party, everyone had fun climbing the trees. But then something bad happened. One of the kids fell from a tree and got hurt! All the kids were very scared.

The girl was very sad and worried. She wanted to help her friend but didn't know what to do. She asked her mom for help. Her mom called the doctor and soon the friend was feeling better.

But the bad thing was that none of the kids wanted to come back to the party ever again. The girl was very sad that her party was ruined. She learned a hard lesson that day and was careful when climbing trees with her friends.

Once upon a time there were two friends who loved to be adventurous. One day they decided to go explore in the forest. As they were walking through the trees, they saw a delicious ice-cream stand. It was serving different flavours of ice-cream, with many sprinkles and toppings. They were so excited.

The first friend picked a scoop of strawberry ice-cream and the second friend picked a scoop of chocolate. They both took a big lick and it was like a dream come true! It was so yummy.

They had such a great time exploring the forest and eating delicious ice-cream. From then on they knew they could make any day an adventurous one.

Once upon a time, there was a deaf shark. She liked to swim and bounce around in the ocean. One day, she saw a little fish with big red eyes. The little fish said to the shark, "Will you play with me?" The shark happily said yes and together they started to bounce in the sea. 

First, the fish and the shark bounced around big rocks. Then, the shark leapt over the fish and made a big splash. The little fish laughed and clapped his fins. Next, the shark raced the fish to the coral reef. She was so fast she beat the fish and reached the reef first!
