Finally, the shark and the fish swam together for hours. They were having so much fun! After a while, the sun started to set and the sky turned blue and pink. The fish and shark said goodbye and the shark swam back home. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color with her crayons. One day, she drew a picture of a seal. It was very creative, with lots of colors and patterns.

But then, Lily's little brother came along and accidentally spilled juice on her drawing. Lily was very upset and started to cry. She didn't know what to do.

Her mom came to see what was wrong and saw the ruined drawing. She told Lily that accidents happen and that she could always make another picture. Lily felt a little better, but she still wanted her seal picture back.

So, her mom helped her make a new seal picture. Lily was very happy and proud of her new creative drawing. She learned that even when things don't go as planned, there's always a way to make things better.

Once upon a time, there were two little birds. They were very excited to explore the world. So one day, they decided to take off and fly. They zipped through the sky, so fast that the trees and buildings were nothing more than a blur.

The birds did not know where they were going, so they decided to see what their brains could do. Suddenly, they heard a tiny noise coming from below. It was a little mouse! It was zipping around in search of food. The birds said hello and followed the mouse.

Soon the birds found themselves in a beautiful meadow with lots of tall grass and brightly colored wildflowers. As they zipped around, they explored every corner of the meadow until they felt tired and lay down in the tall grass.

The sun was setting and the birds began to feel sleepy. They closed their eyes and soon both of them were dreaming. They dreamt about flying around the world and exploring many more exciting places.

At last, when the sun started to rise, the birds opened their eyes and realized that their adventure was only just beginning. So with one â€œzipâ€, the little birds were off again, happily exploring the world.

Once upon a time, there was a big wreck in the town. It was a mess. The cars were broken, and the people were sad. The sun was harsh, and it was hot. The people did not know what to do.

Then, a nice helper came to the town. The helper wanted to make things better. The helper said, "I will keep the town safe and clean." The people were happy to hear this.

The helper worked hard. They fixed the wreck and made the town clean again. The people were not sad anymore. They were happy and safe. The helper stayed to keep the town nice. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat bear who lived in the forest. One day, the bear went for a walk and got lost. He was scared and didn't know what to do. 

A little girl named Lily was walking in the forest too. She saw the bear and said, "Hello, Mr. Bear. Are you lost?" 

The bear said, "Yes, I am lost. Can you help me?" 

Lily said, "Yes, I can help you. Let's go find your home." 

Lily took off her jacket and gave it to the bear. They walked and walked until they found the bear's home. The bear was so happy and said, "Thank you for rescuing me, Lily. You are my hero." 

Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome, Mr. Bear. I'm glad I could help."

Once upon a time, there was a vegetable in a garden that nobody could see. It was hidden. But the vegetable was very happy, no matter what. Until one day, when a giant monster came along and tried to destroy it. 

The monster was big and strong, and the vegetable was scared and weak. The vegetable tried to run, but it was too late! The monster caught up and started to pull and smash the vegetable. 

But then something magical happened. A brave fairy appeared, and with a wave of her wand, she made the monster disappear!

The vegetable was saved! The fairy smiled and flew away, and the vegetable smiled too as it went back to its secret hiding place.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, Timmy was walking in the park when he stumbled and fell. He hurt his knee and started to cry.

A kind lady saw Timmy crying and came over to help him. She gave him a band-aid and a hug. Timmy felt better and thanked the lady. She told him that it's okay to stumble sometimes, but we should always get back up and keep going.

Timmy learned an important lesson that day. He realized that just like stumbling, we all make mistakes sometimes. But if we keep trying and don't give up, we can find gold at the end of the rainbow. The lady was very popular in the park because she was always helping others. Timmy wanted to be just like her when he grew up.

Once upon a time there were two friends, a fox and a rabbit. The fox always was naughty and wanted to do whatever he wanted. The rabbit was always kindly and helped whenever he could. On day, they went to the forest to explore it together. The fox saw a twig and wanted to pick it up, but the rabbit warned him not to because twigs have thorns that could hurts them. 

But the fox was naughty and didn't listen. He picked it up and got a thorn stuck in his paw. He started crying and the rabbit hurried over to help him. The rabbit carefully removed the thorn and then cursed himself for not protecting his friend. 

The fox learned a valuable lesson that day about why it's important to listen to others. The rabbit also learned a lesson about protecting his friend. They grew closer and remained friends. They also vowed to always look out for each other and to trust each other. The moral of the story is that it's important to protect your friends and to always listen to their advice.

One day, there were two friends, John and Mary. They were playing in Mary's house. Mary had a stamp collection. She was very proud of it.

John was fascinated by the stamps. He asked Mary if he could look at them. Mary said, "Yes, but you need to be careful and tidy. You need to trust me to take care of them."

John carefully looked at each stamp. He was so excited. Then he found a really special one. He wanted to take it home with him.

John said to Mary, "Can I take this one home with me?" Mary said, "No, that one is my favorite. You can trust me to take care of it. You can come to my house whenever you like and look at it."

John smiled. He felt very happy that Mary trusted him and that she was being so tidy and careful with her stamp collection.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dolphin. He lived in the ocean, and he loved to play with his friends. Every day, he swam and listened to the waves crash against the shore. 

But when it was time to sleep, the dolphin went to a special spot. It was a quiet place, where he could be alone and go to sleep. He would close his eyes, and drift away on the waves. 

Soon, the other ocean creatures knew about the dolphin's special spot. Every night, they would come and join him. They would curl up around him, and sleep together until the sun came up. 

The dolphin and his friends were very happy. They loved sleeping together, and dreamed of swimming together when the sun rose. Cuddling up with his friends made the dolphin feel safe and warm. Soon, everyone was sleeping peacefully, and the dolphin had the best dreams ever!

Jim was a strong soldier. He had a clear tank that followed him everywhere to support him in battle. One day, Jim was walking through the forest when he heard a noise.

"Who's there?" asked Jim.

No one answered him.

Suddenly, a big tank came out of the bushes and blocked Jim's way. Jim couldn't get away.

"Please let me go" said Jim.

But the tank didn't listen and kept blocking Jim's way.

Jim had no choice but to fight the tank. He got into his clear tank and tried to push the big tank away. But the big tank was too strong and it pushed Jim's tank over, trapping Jim underneath.

Jim was never seen again. The big tank had won.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to church with her family every Sunday. One day, Lily's mom asked her to count how many people were in the church. Lily counted and found out there were 50 people in the church.

After church, Lily's family went to a restaurant for lunch. Lily's food was not perfect, it was cold and not tasty. She was sad and didn't want to eat it. But her mom told her that it's important to be grateful for what we have, even if it's not perfect.

Lily learned that counting people in church is fun, but being grateful for what we have is more important. She promised to always be thankful for everything in her life, even if it's not perfect.

Once upon a time, there was a man called Joe. Joe had a shed outside his house. In the shed, Joe made pies every day. One day, Joe decided to sell his pies. He went from door to door with a basket full of pies. He shouted, "Pies for sale! Pies for sale!"

One neighbour came out and bought lots of pies. He asked Joe what kind of pies he had. Joe told him he had sweet, juicy pies, but then he remembered he had a sour pie too.

The neighbour asked Joe, "How much is the sour pie?" Joe thought carefully, then he replied, "$2 please." So, the neighbour bought the pie and went back inside his house.

Joe went to the next house to sell his pies but nobody wanted to buy a sour pie. So, he sold all of his sweet, juicy pies and went back home. 

At the end of the day, Joe had lots of money and his basket was empty. "That was a good day of selling pies," Joe thought to himself.

Once upon a time there was a brother and sister who loved to play together. One day they went to the park and saw the most interesting mug. It was big, colourful and looked like it belonged to a magical creature. The brother was very tempted to steal it but the sister was obedient and wouldn't let him.

The brother said "Come on, just take it! It'll be fun!"

The sister replied firmly "No! That would be wrong, stealing is not allowed!"

Eventually, the brother listened to his sister and put the mug back. Both of them were glad that they had been obedient and followed the rules. After that, they ran off and played their favourite game. 

The End.

Once upon a time there was an adorable little girl. She loved playing games, especially chess. She had a special set of chess pieces and she liked to move them around in different patterns.

One day, she heard someone calling her name. She hurried down the stairs to see what was happening.

When she got there she saw her mommy. "It's time for school sweetie," her mommy said. The little girl was so excited, she quickly grabbed her chess pieces, so she could show them to her friends.

On the way, she got scared when she heard a loud noise. Her mommy said, "Don't worry! Hurry, we need to get to school."

The little girl started to run. She was so eager to show her chess pieces and tell her friends all about them. When they arrived, all the children were very impressed.

The little girl smiled proudly and said, "My mommy made them for me!" Everyone agreed that the chess pieces were absolutely adorable.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue. She was three years old and had a friend called Jack. One day, they decided to go and play near the lake.

The lake was really big and it had very high waves. Jack wanted to go into the lake, but Sue was scared of the water. She tried to resist, but Jack kept persuading her.

"Come on, Sue! Don't be scared. I'll look after you!" said Jack.

Sue was very scared, but eventually she gave in and went into the lake with Jack. She was so scared of the high waves, but she resisted. She closed her eyes and held Jack's hand.

When they reached the middle of the lake, they both started to feel better. Sue smiled and laughed as they splashed around in the water. They had so much fun, and before they knew it, it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a painter who was very good at her job. She could make a perfect painting every time. She loved to paint and made pictures of lots of things, like flowers, animals and buildings.

One day, the painter was having trouble with her paintbrush. She tried to fix it and when she finally did, the painbrush shot out of her hand! The painter was very surprised and a little scared.

The painter quickly grabbed the brush and checked to see if it was okay. She was relieved to find that it was all right and nothing was broken.

The painter was so proud of herself for fixing the brush. She went back to painting and finished a perfect painting. She smiled, happy that she had not been hurt.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety. Tweety lived in a cute birdcage in a little girl's room. The little girl loved Tweety very much and would often sing to her.

One day, the little girl noticed that Tweety was getting tired. So, she decided to pause her singing and give Tweety some rest. Tweety was very happy and started to chirp happily.

The little girl smiled and said, "You are the cutest bird in the world, Tweety." Tweety chirped even louder and hopped around in her birdcage. From that day on, the little girl made sure to pause her singing and give Tweety rest whenever she needed it. And Tweety lived happily ever after in her cute little birdcage.

Lila and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big orange cat. The cat is graceful. It walks on the fence and jumps on the tree.

"Wow, look at the cat!" Lila says. "It is so pretty and fast!"

"I want to pet the cat," Tom says. "Maybe it is friendly."

They run to the fence and call the cat. "Here, kitty, kitty! Come to us!"

But the cat does not come. It looks at them and meows. Then it runs away.

"Bye, cat!" Lila and Tom say. "Maybe we will see you again."

They are not sad. They are happy. They have seen a big orange cat. They have had fun. They go to the slide and slide down. They laugh and smile. They are friends.

Gus saw a junk car outside. It was pale and rusted. He wanted to take a closer look.

"Mommy, can I watch the junk car?" Gus asked.

"No, honey, it's too dangerous," Mommy replied.

Gus didn't understand. He wanted to watch the junk car.

So, he snuck away from Mommy and toddled over to the car. He looked in the windows and touched the rusted metal.

Suddenly, a man came and grabbed Gus.

"What are you doing here?" he yelled.

Gus started to cry. He wanted Mommy. The man tossed Gus away and ran off.

Gus was so scared he didn't know what to do. He ran back to Mommy.

Mommy was very angry. She never wanted Gus to watch the junk car again.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky lived by a river with her family. One day, it rained so much that the river got very big and started to flood. Ducky and her family had to swim to a safer place. Ducky was anxious but her mom told her to relax and stay close. Finally, the rain stopped and the flood went away. Ducky was happy to go back to her home by the river.

Once upon a time, there was a humble plate. Every day, it would rise up and down in the air. It was a magical plate and could even float away if it wanted to!

One day, the plate decided it wanted to visit the world. So it started to slowly rise up into the sky. It floated around, admiring all the sights that it saw. 

Soon, the plate was very high up in the sky. It was so close to the sun! The plate felt warm and content as it flew around. 

Then, it descended back to Earth, ready to settle in its home once again. The plate was happy that it had gone on an adventure, even though it was only a plate and not a human.

Sara and Ben like to swim in the pool. They move their arms and legs fast and make big splashes. They play with a ball and a duck. They are happy and laugh a lot.

But then, Mom comes and says, "Time to get out, kids. We have to go soon." Sara and Ben do not want to go. They want to swim more. They say, "No, Mom, please. Just a little more."

Mom says, "Sorry, kids, but we have to go. And you have to be tidy. Look at your toys. They are all over the pool. You have to put them away in the basket."

Sara and Ben sigh. They do not like to be tidy. They like to swim and play. But they know Mom is right. They get out of the pool and dry themselves with towels. They move their toys to the basket. They say, "Bye, pool. Bye, ball. Bye, duck. We will come back soon."

Mom smiles and says, "Good job, kids. You are very tidy. Now let's go. We have a surprise for you." Sara and Ben wonder what the surprise is. They follow Mom to the car. They are curious and excited. They hope the surprise is something fun.

One day, a little red hen found some wheat. She was so happy. She wanted to make bread with the wheat. But first, she needed help to plant the wheat. So, she went to her friends, the cat, the dog, and the duck.

"Will you help me plant the wheat?" asked the little red hen. The cat, the dog, and the duck all said, "No, we are too busy to help." The little red hen was upset, but she did not give up. She planted the wheat all by herself. The wheat grew big and tall.

One day, the little red hen saw that the wheat was ready. She went to her friends again. "Will you help me pick the wheat?" she asked. The cat, the dog, and the duck all said, "No, we are still too busy to help." The little red hen was sad, but she did not give up. She picked the wheat all by herself.

Next, the little red hen needed to drop the wheat at the mill to make flour. She asked her friends, "Will you help me take the wheat to the mill?" The cat, the dog, and the duck all said, "No, we are still too busy to help." The little red hen was upset, but she did not give up. She took the wheat to the mill all by herself.

When the little red hen came back with the flour, she made the bread. The smell of the bread made the cat, the dog, and the duck come running. They wanted to eat the bread. But the little red hen said, "No, you did not help me. I will eat the bread all by myself." The cat, the dog, and the duck were sad. They learned that they should help their friend next time.

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle with lots of wild animals. One day, a little monkey got lost in the jungle and didn't know how to get back to his family. He looked around and saw a kind veterinarian who was walking nearby. The monkey ran towards the veterinarian and asked for help. The veterinarian saw that the monkey was lost and decided to lead him back to his family. They walked through the jungle together and finally found the monkey's family. The monkey was very happy to be reunited with his family and thanked the veterinarian for helping him.

The sky was grey and big raindrops started to fall from it. They made a big noise when they landed on the ground. Sally heard them and she looked up at the sky. She saw the rain turning the world around her into a big pool of water.

Sally jumped out into the rain and twirled around and around. She laughed and laughed as the raindrops tickled her face. She saw a big puddle, and without thinking she jumped right in.

Sally splashed and the water went everywhere. She moved her clumsy arms through the puddle and felt the rain on her skin. She forgot how cold it was and just enjoyed the moment.

Suddenly, Sally's mother grabbed her arm and pulled her away. She smiled as she carried Sally back inside, out of the rain. Even though Sally was a bit wet, they both still laughed and smiled.

One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk with her mom. They walked into a mist. The mist was wet and made Lily feel uncomfortable. She told her mom, "I don't like this mist, Mommy."

Her mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, Lily. The mist will go away soon." They kept walking, and Lily saw a big tree. She wanted to climb it, but her mom mentioned that it might be too slippery because of the mist.

Lily listened to her mom and didn't climb the tree. Instead, they found a dry spot under the tree to sit and have a snack. As they ate, the mist went away, and the sun came out. Lily felt happy and warm again.

Once upon a time, there was a robot on an adventure. He thought he was alone, but suddenly he heard a loud scream! The robot was very scared. He quickly looked around and saw a dangerous creature near him. He wanted to run away, but the creature was too close and he was scared to move.

The robot screamed and tried to run, but the creature was too big and it was blocking his way. Then the creature came closer and closer. The robot had no choice but to scream even louder. He was so scared and desperate.

But then, suddenly, the creature flew away! As soon as it left, the robot was so happy. He waved goodbye and thanked his lucky stars for being brave enough to scream for help! That was the day the robot learned that sometimes, the best way to get rid of danger is to just scream.

Once upon a time, there was a big ship on the ocean. The ship had a big anchor to keep it from moving. One day, a storm came and the ship started to move a lot. The anchor was not strong enough and disappeared into the water. 

The captain of the ship was very worried. He asked his crew to help find the anchor. They searched and searched but could not find it. Just when they were about to give up, a kind fisherman came along. He saw the captain's worry and offered to help. 

The fisherman was very generous and had a big heart. He dove into the water and searched for the anchor. After some time, he found it and brought it back to the ship. The captain was very happy and grateful. He thanked the fisherman and they became friends. From that day on, the captain made sure to have a stronger anchor so it would never disappear again.

One morning, a boy woke up early. He looked around the room and saw a magazine on the floor. He picked it up and looked at all of the pictures. They were so colourful and interesting. He liked flipping through the pages.

The magazine was so useful. It had all different kinds of stories, pictures, and games. He loved looking through it. The boy decided to take the magazine with him finding it hard to part with it 

He took the magazine to his bedroom and looked through it some more. He read and looked at the pictures and played some of the games. He really enjoyed it. The magazine was so much fun to use.

The boy spent all morning looking at the magazine. He was having so much fun learning and playing with it. He thought it was the most useful and fun thing ever!

Mummy and Timmy were in the kitchen. On the table was a plate with a fork in the middle. Mummy said to Timmy, "It is time to settle down and eat your dinner."

Timmy looked up at Mummy and said, "I no like that. I don't want to eat that food." Mummy said, "It's fine. It's your favourite food. Come and try it."

Timmy slowly walked up to the table and looked at the plate. He saw the fork on the plate and he said, "What's that?" Mummy replied, "That is a fork. It is what you eat your dinner with."

Timmy smiled and reached out his hand towards the fork. He grabbed it and smiled. He said, "I like the fork mummy." Mummy smiled and said, "Now settle down and eat your dinner."

So Timmy ate his dinner with the fork and was very happy. Mummy was pleased too because Timmy had eaten all his dinner. It was a fine end to the evening.

Jim was sad. Something bad had happened and he had suffered a lot. He wanted to be cheered up, so his mom took him outside. The sun was blazing, but the air was icy. Jim was still afraid, so his mom took him over to the park.

There, they sat on the swings. As they were swinging back and forth, Jim's fear slowly faded away. He even smiled when he saw a television in the distance. His mom said they could watch it.

Jim was excited and ran to the television. He pressed his nose up to the screen, looking at all the colourful shapes. He forgot all about his suffering, and laughed as he watched the show.

Jim may have suffered, but today he was happy.

One day, a little girl was playing near a pond. She noticed a seal in the water and wanted to get a closer look. She tugged on the seal's tail and it gave her a slap on the head with its flipper. The girl was embarrassed and she ran away.

When she got back home, she told her mom what had happened. Her mother gave her a hug and said, "When you get close to a seal, they can get scared, so they might slap you or bite you. You need to be careful around wild animals."

The girl was embarrassed, but she nodded and promised to be more careful. She said, "I won't get so close to animals anymore," and her mom smiled and held her close.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Sam. He loved to explore. Today, he wanted to go for a walk in the woods to find a creek. So he said goodbye to his parents and started walking.

On his way, Sam heard a noise coming from the trees. When he looked between the branches he saw an amazing sight. A group of frogs were jumping from stone to stone in the creek.

Sam wanted to stay and watch but he didn't want to delay his adventure, so he said goodbye to the frogs and continued his walk. 

Later, he came across a tall mountain and said, "Wow, that's amazing!" He was quite happy and excited. 

He followed the creek until he reached his parents house. When he walked inside he said, "Mummy, look I found a creek! It was amazing!"

His Mummy smiled and said, "I'm glad you had a great adventure, Sam."

Once upon a time, there was a small dog named Ben. Ben was scared of big cars. One day, Ben's family went on a trip. They took a big car and put a lot of things in it. They had to unpack the car when they got to the new place.

On the way, the big car made a loud noise. Ben was scared. The family stopped the car and looked at it. They saw that the car had a bad tire. Ben's dad took out a new tire. He put the new tire on the car. Now the car was good to go.

When they got to the new place, Ben helped his family unpack the car. He was not scared anymore. Ben liked the new place. He had fun playing in the grass and running around. Ben was happy to be with his family on the trip.

Ben and Sam are brothers. They like to play outside. One day, they see a bird in a tree. The bird is wet because it rained. The bird has a blue and yellow feather.

"Look, a bird!" Ben says. "I want the feather!"

"No, I want it!" Sam says. "It is pretty!"

They both run to the tree. They try to climb it. But the tree is wet and slippery. They fall down and hurt themselves. They cry and cry.

The bird sees them. It is scared. It flies away. It takes the feather with it.

Ben and Sam are sad and angry. They have no feather. They have no bird. They have no fun. They have a bad day.

Once upon a time there was a mommy and her little boy. The little boy loved to bake with his mommy. One day, his mommy took him to the store to buy things to bake with. They bought butter, flour, and sugar. 

When they returned home, the little boy and his mommy put on their aprons and started cooking. The little boy helped measure the flour and sugar while mommy melted the butter in a pot. 

"Can I mix it with a spoon?" the little boy asked his mommy.

"Yes, you can mix it!" his mommy said. 

The little boy stirred the batter carefully until it was nice and smooth. His mommy then scooped it into pans and put it in the oven. After about 15 minutes, she took the pans out and let them cool down. 

The little boy's eyes lit up when his mommy cut into the buttery, sweet cake. 

"Yum! Can I try a piece now?" the little boy asked eagerly. 

"Yes, of course" his mommy replied. She put a piece of cake on a plate for him and the little boy smiled with delight. 

The little boy and his mommy ate the cake together and it was delicious. From that day forward, they would go to the store and bake together every week.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to eat fruit. She especially loved apples and bananas because they were yummy. One day, she went to the market with her mom to buy some fruit.

Lily saw a big basket of apples and asked her mom if she could have one. Her mom said yes, but only one. Lily picked out the biggest apple she could find and took a big bite. "Mmm, this is so yummy!" she said.

As they continued to walk around the market, Lily saw a man selling bananas. She asked her mom if she could have one, but her mom said they already had enough fruit. Lily was sad, but her mom reminded her that they still had the yummy apple. "That's true," Lily said, "I'll just remain happy with my apple."

Once upon a time, there was a good boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys and eat cookies. One day, Timmy saw a big building with many people going in and out. He wondered what was inside.

Timmy asked his mommy, "What is that big building?"

His mommy said, "That is where the lawyer works. He helps people with problems."

Timmy thought that was very interesting. He wondered if he could be a good lawyer when he grew up. He decided to study hard in school so he could help people too.

Once upon a time, there was a thin story. It was about a little girl who loved to explore. One day, she went on an adventure to a secret land. As she wandered around, she stumbled upon a special tree. She studied it closely, and noticed it had a door made of leaves. She opened the door and stepped inside.

What she found amazed her! There was a room with a big, comfy chair and wonderful things to explore. She stayed for a long time until finally it was time to go home. She said goodbye to the tree and slowly made her way back.

The little girl never forgot her remarkable discovery. Even as she grew older, she continued to remain curious about the secret room. She told her own kids the same story, so they could have the same wonder in their hearts. 

The thin story became part of their family, and it still lives on today.

One day, a little girl wanted to see a clown. She asked her mom and she said yes. So they drove to the circus. 

When they arrived, the little girl saw the clown. He was wearing colorful clothes and had a funny hat. She was excited to talk to the clown. 

The clown came over and asked her what her name was. She answered and then he started making funny jokes. She laughed and laughed until she was tired. The clown was very harmless and made her feel happy.

The little girl asked her mom if she could talk to the clown again. Her mom said yes and she did. They talked about the circus and enjoyed each other's company until it was time to go home. 

The little girl had a great time with the clown from the circus. She will never forget that day when she talked to the harmless clown.

Once upon a time, there was a big wardrobe in a little boy's room. The boy thought the wardrobe was very boring. It just stood there, not doing anything fun. The boy wished the wardrobe would do something exciting.

One day, the boy decided to go inside the wardrobe. He opened the door and went in. Inside, he found a secret world! There were trees, flowers, and animals. The boy was so happy that the boring wardrobe was not boring anymore.

The boy played with his new animal friends every day. They would go on adventures and have so much fun. The boring wardrobe had become the most exciting thing in the boy's room. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a 3 year old girl named Mia. She was standing in the garden with her father, who began to explain something important to her.

He said: "Mia, there is something called land. It is a big and beautiful place. Everyone in the world lives on a piece of land."

Mia was curious and asked: "Daddy, what is it like? Is it fair?"

Her father smiled and nodded: "Yes, Mia. Land is a very fair place. Everyone is free to explore, have fun and live happily." 

Mia thought about her father's explanation for a moment, and then said: "That sounds really nice! I want to go see the land!"

Her father replied: "Well, one day you can. Always remember, land is a beautiful, fair and special place".

Mummy was pouring a sweet drink into cups. She needed to hurry, because soon her friends would arrive. She was wearing a beautiful skirt with flowers all over it. She hummed a sweet song as she worked. 
Finally the drink was ready and Mummy put it on the table. She looked around and smiled. Everything was ready for her special tea party. 
She clapped her hands, excited to show her friends her new skirt. They all talked, laughed and enjoyed the sweet drink. 
Mummy's friends were so happy to see her. They all thanked her and said goodbye as they left. 
Mummy waved as they left, happy and content.

Lily and Tom like to play with their toy trucks in the garden. They have a big pile of sand that they can load and unload with their shovels and buckets. They pretend they are builders and make roads and houses with the sand.

One day, they see a big truck parked outside their house. It has a sign that says "Grass". Lily and Tom are curious and run to the truck. They see a man wearing a hat and gloves. He is loading the truck with rolls of green grass.

"Hello, what are you doing?" Lily asks the man.

"Hello, I'm delivering grass to your neighbor. He wants to make a new pitch for his soccer team," the man says.

"What is a pitch?" Tom asks.

"A pitch is a place where you can play soccer. It has to be clear and flat and have lines and goals," the man explains.

"Can we help you?" Lily and Tom ask.

"Sure, you can help me. But be careful, the grass is heavy and the truck is big," the man says.

He gives them each a small roll of grass and shows them how to load it on the truck. Lily and Tom are happy and work hard. They load the truck with the man until it is full.

"Thank you, you are very good helpers," the man says.

"You're welcome, you are very nice," Lily and Tom say.

The man drives away with the truck, waving to them. Lily and Tom wave back and run to their garden. They decide to make their own pitch with their sand and their toy trucks. They have a lot of fun playing soccer on their pitch. They score many goals and cheer for each other. They are very proud of their pitch.

Mandy was going on a trip with her family. She was so excited! She was packing her bag with lots of things like her toy bear and her colors. She asked her mom if she could also pack some shrimp. "Yes," her mom said, "but be fast. We need to hurry up!"

Mandy ran over to the kitchen and grabbed the shrimp from the refrigerator. She put them in her bag and made sure that it was safely closed.

Mandy's dad said, "Let's go!" Mandy was ready! She grabbed her bag, and the family hopped in the car.

Mandy had a wonderful trip. She played different games and ate all the shrimp that she had packed. She was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very troubled. She was always sad and couldn't seem to find joy in anything. One day she walked out into the garden and saw an old man. He was sitting on a bench and stroking a player in his hand. The old man saw the little girl and smiled. 

"Why do you look so troubled, little one?" He asked sweetly. 

The little girl tried to tell him how she was feeling but she didn't know the right words. She just kept shaking her head and crying. 

The old man understood and he took her hand. He said,
"I know how you feel when it's hard to find your smile. That's why I always carry my player around. It helps me remember that the world is still a happy place, even when we get tired or sad." 

The little girl looked up at the old man and wiped away her tears. For the first time in a long time, she felt like she could find her smile again.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to look at the stars at night. They had a big book with pictures of stars, planets and comets. They learned that comets were balls of ice and dust that flew very fast in the sky. Sometimes they could see a comet with a long tail of light.

One night, their dad said, "There is a special comet in the sky tonight. It is very bright and beautiful. Do you want to see it?"

Tom and Lily nodded and ran to get their coats and hats. They followed their dad to the backyard, where he had set up a telescope. He helped them take turns to look through the lens.

"Wow!" Tom said. "The comet is so big and shiny! It looks like a star with a long hair!"

"It's amazing!" Lily said. "The comet is so pretty! It looks like a fairy with a magic wand!"

Their dad smiled and said, "You both have good imaginations. The comet is called Halley's Comet. It only comes once every 76 years. That means you won't see it again until you are very old."

Tom and Lily gasped. They felt lucky to see the comet. They wanted to remember it forever.

"Can we draw the comet, dad?" Tom asked.

"Can we write a story about the comet, dad?" Lily asked.

Their dad nodded and said, "Sure, you can. But first, you have to choose. Do you want to draw or write?"

Tom and Lily looked at each other. They both liked to draw and write. They both wanted to do both. But they knew they had to choose.

Tom thought for a moment and said, "I want to draw the comet. I like to use colors and shapes."

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I want to write the story about the comet. I like to use words and sentences."

Their dad said, "That's a good choice. You can both express yourselves in different ways. Let's go inside and get some paper and pencils."

Tom and Lily followed their dad to the house. They were excited to create their comet art. They did not mind that their room was messy. They only cared about the comet.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends decided to go on an adventure in the woods.

As they walked deeper into the woods, the sky started to get gloomy and dark. Lily's friend, Timmy, said, "I think we should leave now before it starts raining."

Lily looked at her gear and saw that she had brought a raincoat. She said, "I'm not scared of a little rain. Let's keep going!"

But soon enough, it started pouring down rain and Lily regretted not listening to Timmy. They quickly left the woods and ran back home. From then on, Lily always made sure to check the weather before going on any adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to walk with his cane. He would take it with him everywhere he went. One day, Tim went for a walk in the park. He walked and walked, but he couldn't find his cane. He looked everywhere, but it was nowhere to be found.

Tim was very sad. He sat down on a bench and started to cry. Suddenly, he heard a noise behind him. He turned around and saw his persistent little dog, Max, carrying his cane in his mouth. Tim was so surprised and happy to see his cane again. He hugged Max and gave him a big kiss. From that day on, Tim and Max went on many walks together with Tim's trusty cane.

John was so excited to go to the zoo with his mom. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. John and his mom walked quickly to the zoo since he couldn't wait to see all of the animals there.

When they arrived, John said, "Mom, look! I see lions!" John was so cheerful as he saw all of the different animals there. He saw tigers, monkeys, and even elephants.

John's mom asked him, "What's your favorite animal, John?"

John answered, "I like the lions! They look so happy and cheerful in their big place."

John and his mom laughed. John loved the zoo and he wouldn't forget today's fun visit.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was very troubled. One day, she was playing in the garden when she started to imagine a tornado. It was the most amazing thing she had ever seen! The tornado spun round and round, faster and faster. Bigger and bigger it went, until it filled the whole sky.

Suddenly, Lucy heard a loud noise in the sky. She was very scared. She held onto the fence and closed her eyes tight. When she opened them, the tornado had gone. She was so happy that it had gone away.

She quickly ran back inside her house, and hugged her mom tight. Then, she told her mom all about the amazing tornado she had imagined. Lucy never felt troubled again.

Once upon a time, there was a purple cat named Fluffy. Fluffy lived in a small house with his best friend, a little girl named Lily. They loved to play together every day.

One day, Fluffy and Lily were playing with a ball, when they heard a loud cry. They saw a little boy named Timmy who had fallen and hurt his knee. "Ouch! I have pain!" Timmy cried. Fluffy and Lily ran to help him.

Lily said, "I will give you a band-aid for your pain." Fluffy found a soft purple cloth to put on Timmy's knee, and Lily put the band-aid on top. Timmy stopped crying and said, "Thank you, Lily and Fluffy." They all became friends and played together happily.

Once upon a time there lived a girl named Lucy. One day, she went outside to play in her garden. She found a broken pot with herb growing inside it.

Lucy was delighted. She decided to pick the herb and store it in her pocket. As soon as the herb left the pot, it vanished!

Startled, Lucy stumbled to her feet. A voice called out behind her. "What did you do with the herb?"

"Nothing!" Lucy replied, turning around. Her neighbor, Rachel, was standing there. "It just vanished!"

Rachel smiled. "That's amazing! I like your garden Lucy. Let's look for more herbs tomorrow!"

And so, with an agreement, Lucy and Rachel went back inside. They were never able to find the herb again, but they never stopped looking!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Daisy. Daisy loved to do something called yoga. Every morning, Daisy got very wet by washing her hands and body with warm water.

After Daisy washed up, she rolled out her yoga mat and started to stretch. Daisy loved stretching her arms, legs and face. It felt very nice!

Yoga was useful for Daisy. It made her strong and healthy. It also helped Daisy relax and gave her lots of energy. Daisy felt amazing after she did yoga each day.

So every morning, Daisy remembered to wash and then do yoga. It was a fun and useful way to start her day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, noisy dragon. He lived in a big cave in the mountains. Every day, he would fly around the village and scare all the people. They were very scared of him.

One day, a hero came to the village. He was very brave and strong. He decided to feed the dragon so that he would not be so angry. The hero brought lots of food for the dragon. He gave him apples, carrots, and even some cake. The dragon was very happy and stopped being so noisy.

From that day on, the dragon and the hero became friends. The villagers were no longer scared of the dragon and they all lived happily ever after.

Little Peter and his mother were out in the park on a sunny day, looking at all sorts of things. His mama pointed to a tree and said, 
"Look there, Peter! See that big tree with the zipper in it?"

Peter was very excited. He had never seen anything like it before. 
"What is it, Mama?" he asked.

"It's an ant's nest," said his mother. "And when you part the zipper, lots of ants will come out. Would you like to try?"

Peter was thrilled. He eagerly parted the zipper, expecting to find lots of ants. Instead, there was only a small, boring leaf. Peter was disappointed. "No ants?" he asked.

His mama smiled. "Let's wait for a little bit longer and see what happens." They waited and waited, and soon, the boring leaf moved! It was an ant! Peter was delighted, and soon enough, more and more ants appeared.

Peter had learned that sometimes, good things take time.

Once upon a time, there was a funny clown named Bob. Bob loved to juggle and balance things on his nose. He would often perform in the park for kids and their parents. One day, a little girl named Lily came up to Bob and asked if he was available to perform at her birthday party. 

Bob smiled and said, "Of course I am available! I would love to perform at your party." Lily was so happy that she started to jump up and down. Bob asked her what she wanted him to do at her party. 

Lily replied, "Can you balance a ball on your nose and juggle at the same time?" Bob laughed and said, "I can certainly try!" At the party, Bob did just what Lily asked him to do. All the kids were amazed and cheered loudly. 

After the party, Lily hugged Bob and said, "Thank you for making my birthday so special!" Bob smiled and said, "It was my pleasure. I love making people happy with my clown tricks."

One day, a little girl called Amy was walking in the park. She noticed a dancer and stopped to take a closer look. 

"Wow, what a pretty dancer!" said Amy.

The dancer smiled at Amy and said, "Hello Amy, I am dancing alone today. Are you lonely too?"

Amy nodded and said, "Yes, I am lonely. Would you like to play with me?"

The dancer smiled and said, "Yes, I'd love to!"

So the dancer and Amy ran around the park, playing tag and having lots of fun. When the sun began to set, they waved goodbye and the dancer left. 

Amy felt a little less lonely after spending the afternoon with the dancer and smiled as she watched the dancer leave.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run and play outside. One day, Timmy saw a huge comet in the sky. He pointed at it and said, "Wow, that comet is so big!"

His friend Johnny came over and asked, "What are you looking at?"

Timmy said, "Look up! There's a huge comet in the sky!"

Johnny looked up and said, "Wow, that's amazing! Let's jog to the park and see if we can see it better from there."

So, Timmy and Johnny jogged to the park and looked up at the huge comet. They were so happy to see it and they talked about it for a long time. When it got dark, they went home and told their parents all about the huge comet they saw.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to help his mom in the kitchen. One day, they were making a great big cake. Tim was very happy to help.

As they mixed the cake, Tim's mom turned on the oven. But the oven did not get hot. Tim's mom looked at the oven and frowned. She did not know what to do.

Tim wanted to help his mom, so he thought very hard. He had an idea! He ran to get his dad. Dad came and fixed the oven. The cake was baked and everyone was happy. Tim felt great because he helped save the day.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tom. Tom was three years old and enjoyed playing outside all day. One day, Tom was excited to balance on the seesaw outside. He wanted to see how high he could get. 

Tom got on one side of the seesaw and balanced the other side with a snack he had packed for himself. He pushed down hard and flew up high in the air. He was having so much fun! 

Suddenly, his snack flew off the seesaw, and Tom was left with nothing to balance it with. He got off the seesaw, feeling angry and frustrated. He tried to search for a new, unique snack to balance it, but nothing he found was quite right. 

Finally, Tom gave up and sadly went back home. He never got to balance on the seesaw again!

Once upon a time, there was a helpful fish named Fin. Fin liked to dive deep into the water. One day, he found a folder on the sea floor. The folder was red and pretty.

Fin showed the folder to his friend, Sam the starfish. Sam said, "I saw a crab looking for a folder like that yesterday." Fin thought it would be nice to give the folder back to the crab.

So Fin and Sam went to find the crab. They found him near a big rock. Fin said, "We found your folder!" The crab was so happy. He thanked Fin and Sam for being helpful friends.

Once upon a time, there was a team of five friends. Every day, they would all meet up and play together. One day, the team decided to build a campfire. They all worked together to collect wood, found a spot and lit the fire.

"This fire looks nice," said the leader of the team.

The friends all cheered and began toasting marshmallows. All of a sudden, the fire began to burn too big, and the leader looked very worried.

"Uh-oh, this fire is getting really big," said the leader. "Someone help me put it out!"

The team all worked together to get a bucket of water, and poured it on the fire. The fire sizzled and began to shrink. Phew, the team were all very relieved.

But when they turned around, they saw that their friend Tommy was missing! He was so sleepy, and had fallen asleep in the bushes. The team all ran over to Tommy, picked him up and carried him back home.

They all agreed to never leave Tommy behind again. They toasted marshmallows, laughed, and talked until late at night.

Once upon a time a young girl called Amy was sitting in her garden and she was very sad. She was weeping because she didn't have enough muscle to play with her friends. 

"Why are you crying, Amy?" her dad asked, seeing her sobbing in the grass.

Amy looked up at her dad with tears in her eyes and replied sadly, "I want to play, but I don't have the muscle to keep up with my friends". 

Her dad hugged her tightly and said, "Don't worry, I have something special for you". He brought out a bright green kite and held it up for her to see.

Amy gasped as she saw the beautiful green kite fluttering in the breeze. She wiped away her tears and her face lit up with excitement.

"Now you don't need muscle to fly your own kite," her dad said with a smile.

Amy smiled back and grabbed the kite, running up and down the garden with it. Later that afternoon, the sky was filled with the bright green kite flying through the air. 

Amy never wept again because she had a wonderful new way to play.

One day, a little girl named Lily found a picture on the floor. She looked at the picture and saw a big, angry dog in it. Lily wondered who the picture belonged to.

Lily walked outside and showed the picture to her friend, Tim. Tim said, "I wonder who drew this angry dog. It looks scary!" Lily and Tim decided to find who made the picture.

They walked around and asked their friends, "Did you make this picture?" Everyone said no. Finally, they found their friend Sam. Sam said, "Yes, I made that picture. I was angry when I drew it, but I am not angry now." Lily and Tim were happy they found the owner of the picture, and they all played together.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy. He was so clumsy! He would stumble and bump into things all the time. But he was also very brave.

One day, he decided to go explore. He started walking down a path until he came to a big hill. It was so tall he couldn't see the other side.

The young boy wanted to climb the hill. He started walking up, but he was too clumsy. He kept slipping and falling back down!

He kept trying and soon, he made it to the top. From the top, he could see far away. All the trees and buildings looked like tiny toys.

The young boy settled down on the hill. He watched the sun go down and the stars come up. It was so peaceful up there.

He found a new home on the hill. Every day he'd go back and just sit and look out over the view. He was very happy.

John and his dad were driving down the street. They saw a motorcycle parked on the side of the road. John's dad said, "Let's try and save it". 

John said, "Yes, Dad. Let's do it." So they stopped the car and went to check out the motorcycle. 

The motorcycle was very old. John was alert and looked around to make sure it was safe. They started to fix the motorcycle and it made some noises. 

Suddenly, a loud noise scared John. He saw a big truck coming down the street. His dad yelled, "Run!" 

John and his dad ran back to their car. But it was too late. The big truck hit the motorcycle and it was destroyed. John and his dad had failed to save it.

Bob and his mom were eager to play. They walked into the room and Mom said, "Let's split up and look for something to do." 
Bob quickly ran to the toys, grabbed a teddy bear, and shouted, "Found it!" 

Mom smiled and said, "That's great! Now let's play a game of hide and seek." 
Bob grinned and decided to be the hider first. He ran and hid behind the couch. 

Mom was ready and said, "1, 2, 3!" She started to look around. Bob waited, eager to be found. 
Mom walked to the couch and said, "Aha, there's my Bob!" She had found him.

Bob smiled and called out, "Yay!" He was excited to be found. 
Mom laughed and said, "It's your turn now, let's see if you can find me!" 
Bob eagerly ran around the room looking under the table and in his mom's bedroom. But no matter where he looked, he could not find her. 

Finally, Bob turned around and Mom was standing right behind him. She had split up with Bob and followed him until he found her. 
Bob laughed and said, "Good game Mom!"

Once there was a little boy who loved to dream. He would sit on his favourite park bench and imagine all kinds of wonderful things. He would daydream about flying to outer space, becoming a superhero and sailing on a big boat.

One day, as he was busily dreaming, something embarrassing happened. A bee flew up and buzzed around his head. It was so funny that the little boy started to giggle. All the other people around him started to laugh too, and he became embarrassed.

He quickly ran away from the bench and hid behind some bushes. But he didn't stay embarrassed for long. After a few moments he put on a brave face, ran back to the bench and started dreaming again.

Once upon a time, there was a rich man named Tom. Tom liked to ride the subway. One day, he met a girl named Sue on the subway.

"Hi, I'm Sue," she said. "Do you mind if I sit here?" Tom said, "No, sit here."

They talked and laughed as the subway went fast. Tom and Sue became good friends. They played and had fun every day on the subway.

In the end, Tom and Sue were very happy. They loved to ride the subway together. And they always minded each other's feelings.

Jill liked to act. She would pretend to be all sorts of different people, from a teacher to a doctor. One day, she pretended to be a chef. She collected all the ingredients she could find in the kitchen: eggs, butter and some clear grapes.

"What can I make with this?" thought Jill. And then it came to her: a grape salad! She got to work crushing the grapes, adding some sugar and other ingredients she had found. Then, she mixed it all together.

When she was done, it looked really yummy. She wanted to try it but she decided to show it to her mom first. So, she put the grape salad on a plate and went to find her.

"Mom!" Jill said. "Look what I've made! It's a grape salad!"

Her mom was very impressed. "That looks delicious! Are you sure you made it all by yourself?"

Jill nodded proudly. "Yes! It's my very own grape salad."

They both sat down and enjoyed the grape salad. From that day on, Jill continued to act and make delicious creations.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly little puppy. His name was Spot and he lived near the river. One day, it started to rain and the river flooded. Spot was worried, so he looked for help.

Spot saw a man walking down the street. He barked and asked for help. The man was very friendly, with a big smile on his face.

"What is the matter, little pup? Is the river too wet?" asked the man.

Spot barked and nodded his head. "Yes, the river is wet and it's getting too high. Can you help me clean it up?" he asked.

The man smiled and nodded. "Yes, I can help. I'm very strong, and I'll get the river all clean for you, no problem!"

So, the man started to work. He moved rocks and sticks, and soon the river was much cleaner. Spot was so happy to see a clean river, and the man smiled and said goodbye.

Spot thanked the man again and again, and soon the man was gone. Spot had a new friend, and a clean river too!

John and his mom went on a walk one day. As they walked, they saw a dull, old mailbox. John wanted to collect something so he asked his mom what was inside.

His mom laughed and said there was no way to tell without opening it. But then she had a bright idea. She said they should write a letter, put it in the mailbox and see if someone wrote back.

So John wrote a letter and put it in the mailbox. He waited patiently for a day, but nothing happened. He was getting bored so his mom suggested that they write more letters.

John and his mom wrote several letters and each time put them in the mailbox. After a few days, something wonderful happened - they started getting letters back!

John was so happy and he enjoyed collecting all of the letters in the mailbox. His mom said that was his special collection and he was proud of it.

Once there was a comfortable seat in the park. It was brown and furry and looked like a lion. One day a little boy saw the seat and wanted to sit on it. So he walked over to it and hopped on. He was very surprised to see that the seat has a tail! He giggled. Then, without warning, the seat started to move and roar! The boy was so scared that he jumped off and ran away. After the boy left, the seat changed back into a lion. It looked around the park, yawned and then walked away.

Rosie was a very tidy girl. She was always putting things in their proper place, which made her mom very happy. She was especially careful with the clock, which hung on the wall in the hall.

One day, Rosie was bored and she wanted to do something fun. She saw the clock and smiled. She decided that it would be really fun to cut it, but her mom had told her not to touch it.

Rosie knew she wasn't allowed, but she wanted to do it anyway. She just had to know what would happen. So, she took the scissors, carefully climbed up the chair and finally, she cut the clock.

At first, nothing happened. Then all of a sudden, the clock rang out loudly. Rosie was very surprised. She quickly put everything back and made sure the room was tidy.

Thankfully, her mom didn't find out what had happened. She did, however, tell Rosie once again not to touch the clock - because you never know what might happen!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a toy cell. It was her favorite toy. She played with it all the time. One day, her friend, Tim, came to play with her. Tim saw the cell and wanted to play with it too.

"Can you lend me your cell?" Tim asked Amy. Amy thought for a moment and said, "Yes, but you have to be nice to it." Tim promised to be nice, and Amy lent him her toy cell.

Tim played with the cell, but he was rude. He threw it and hit it. Amy saw this and felt sad. She knew she should not have lent her toy cell to Tim.

Amy went to Tim and said, "You are not nice to my cell. Give it back, please." Tim felt bad and gave the cell back to Amy. He said sorry for being rude. Amy forgave him, and they played with other toys.

From that day on, Tim learned to be nice to his friends' toys. Amy and Tim played happily ever after, and Amy knew that she should only lend her toys to friends who would be nice to them.

Once there was a boy named Bob. He loved to look at the big bright blue sky. One day, he decided to go for a walk in the park.

He looked around and noticed a pond. As he walked closer, he could see a big fish swimming around. He was so excited, he had never seen anything like it before!

The fish was very gentle and the boy could tell that it was a tuna. Bob looked into the water and watched the tuna swim around. It was so beautiful!

Bob suddenly noticed a bird flying above the pond. He looked up and watched as the bird circled around. Then it swooped down and landed right next to the tuna!

Bob was so surprised that he didn't even move. The bird looked around and then flew away with the tuna still in its beak.

Bob was amazed. He could hardly believe that he had just seen a bird with a tuna in its beak! He couldn't wait to tell everyone about his adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was always sleepy because he never went to bed on time. One day, Timmy's mom told him to go to bed early so he wouldn't be sleepy in the morning. 

Timmy didn't listen to his mom and stayed up late playing with his toys. The next day, Timmy woke up very sleepy and didn't want to go to school. His mom told him that he had to go to school, but Timmy didn't want to listen. 

Timmy decided to sell his toys so he could stay home and sleep. He went to the store to sell his toys, but he didn't get much money. Timmy was very sad because he didn't have any toys left to play with. 

In the end, Timmy didn't get to stay home and sleep. He had to go to school without any toys to play with. Timmy learned that it's important to listen to his mom and go to bed on time so he won't be sleepy.

Once upon a time, there was an amazing bear called Henry. He lived in a big forest and he was always curious about the world. One day, Henry saw a puddle in front of him and he decided to add something to it.

Henry thought for a while and eventually decided to add some leaves to the puddle. When he finished, he stepped back and admired his work.

But then he heard a voice.

"That's amazing Henry!" It said.

Henry jumped and looked around. He saw a rabbit standing next to the puddle.

"What did I do?" Henry asked the rabbit.

"You've made the puddle look amazing!" The rabbit said.

Henry smiled at the rabbit and thanked him. He was so glad he had decided to add something to the puddle. From that day on, Henry always looked at the puddle whenever he went past it and he always felt proud of what he had done.

Tommy the rabbit was playing in the garden with his friend, Sammy the squirrel. They were making little clay pots with the orange clay they found. Tommy said to Sammy, "Look, my pot is bigger than yours!" and Sammy said, "But mine is prettier!" They laughed and continued to play.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. It was the farmer's tractor coming towards them. They quickly ran to hide behind a bush, but Tommy's big pot was left on the ground. The tractor ran over the pot and crushed it into tiny pieces. Tommy was very sad and said, "My pot is gone. It's all rotten now." Sammy tried to comfort him and said, "Don't worry, we can make a new one together."

Tommy and Sammy started to make a new pot, but Tommy was still feeling sad. He said, "I wish my old pot was still here." Sammy replied, "It's okay Tommy, we can make an even better pot this time." But Tommy couldn't stop thinking about his old pot and how it was now just a pile of rotten clay.

Billy was a restless boy. He loved to explore and gaze out of his window at the sky. One day, he looked up into the sky and saw something white. Billy knew it was snow! He had never seen snow before. 

Billy was so excited that he wanted to go outside right away and feel the snow. He asked his parents if he could go outside and they said yes. He ran out and watched in amazement as the snowflakes grew bigger and bigger. He clapped his hands and watched them twirl around and around. 

Billy picked up a handful of snow and watched it disintegrate in his hands. He gasped in delight! He ran around with his hands stretched out, to try and catch more snow. 

After a few hours, Billy was tired from all the snow. He trudged back inside, still full of joy from his first snow experience. Billy lay in bed in his warm, cozy bed, dreaming of snowy days.

Once upon a time, there was a big farm with lots of animals. There was a bull named Billy who loved to eat grass all day long. One day, the farmer noticed that Billy was looking a little sad. He realized that Billy needed some new hay to eat.

So, the farmer went to the barn to supply Billy with some fresh hay. Billy was so happy and started eating it right away. The hay was so fancy and smelled so good that Billy felt like a king.

From that day on, Billy was the happiest bull on the farm. He loved the farmer for always supplying him with the best hay. And the farmer loved Billy for being such a happy and healthy bull. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big mountain. It was very tall and had snow on top. The mountain was happy and peaceful, until a bossy cloud came along. The cloud told the mountain what to do and how to behave. The mountain didn't like being told what to do, so it said "no" to the bossy cloud. The cloud got angry and started to rain on the mountain. But the mountain stood strong and didn't let the rain bother it. Eventually, the cloud went away and the mountain was happy again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run around and play with her friends. One day, she saw an attractive store with lots of toys inside. 

Lily ran to her mom and said, "Mommy, can we go to that store? It looks so pretty!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "Sure, Lily. Let's go see what they have inside." 

Lily was so excited that she ran ahead of her mom to the store. When they got inside, Lily saw a toy she really wanted. She said to her mom, "Look at that toy! It's so cool. Can we get it?" 

Her mom looked at the toy and said, "Yes, that toy is very attractive. Let's get it for you." 

Lily was so happy that she ran around the store with her new toy. She said to her mom, "Thank you for taking me to the store. I love my new toy!"

John and his mom were walking through the store, looking at the things.

"Mom, can I please have that?" he asked, pointing to a bright yellow hammer on the shelf.

"We'll see," his mom said, smiling.

John smiled back as he watched the lady at the cash register sell the hammer to the man in front.

John thought it was amazing that the man got to buy the hammer. He put it in his pocket and walked away.

John asked his mom again, "Can I please have the hammer now?"

His mom said, "Yes, sure," as she took it off the shelf.

John was so excited. He had an amazing new hammer!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to visit her uncle who lived in a big house. But today, something was difficult for her. She had a big bag of toys, but it was too heavy for her to carry. She tried and tried, but she couldn't do it. 

Suddenly, Lily heard a scream coming from inside the house. She got scared and didn't know what to do. But then her uncle came out and saw her struggling with the bag. He smiled and said, "Don't worry, I'll help you." 

Lily was happy that her uncle was there to help her. She gave him the bag and they went inside. They played with the toys and had lots of fun. Lily was happy that she got to spend time with her uncle and that he was there to help her when things were difficult.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Kelly who loved to explore. On one of her adventures she came across a weird pebble in the park. She picked it up and tried to lift it but it was too heavy for her. So she asked her mom for help. 

â€œThis pebble is too heavy for me to lift, Mommy! Can you help me?â€ 

Her mom smiled and said, â€œIf something is too difficult for you, you can always ask for help. You shouldnâ€™t try to do everything on your own.â€ 

So Kelly and her mom worked together and were able to lift the pebble and set it down safely. 

Kelly learnt that itâ€™s always good to ask for help when something is too hard. The moral of the story is that two heads are better than one!

The day was wild. There was a shark in the ocean. It was big and scary!

The little fish wanted to swim away. He tried to move, but the shark was too strong. He could not resist.

Then the dolphins came. They were loud and brave! They created a big wave, and the shark ran away.

The little fish was so happy. He could swim free again! He thanked the dolphins and they smiled. He had resisted the shark, and now everything was back to normal.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy girl who loved to play with her toys. She had a big dollhouse with many rooms and a garden with flowers. One day, she met a magical fairy who gave her a magic wand.

The fairy said, "With this wand, you can shrink yourself small like a bug."

The girl was excited and said, "Wow, that sounds like fun! Can I try it now?"

The fairy warned her, "Be careful, once you shrink, you might not be able to come back to your normal size."

The girl didn't listen and waved the wand. Suddenly, she shrunk and found herself in her dollhouse. She had fun playing with her toys, but she couldn't find a way to get back to her normal size. She realized she should have listened to the fairy's warning. Finally, after a long time, the fairy came back and helped her return to her normal size. From that day on, the girl learned to listen to wise advice.

Once upon a time there was a pot that was very flexible. Every day the pot would do something different. One day the pot jumped up and down. Then it rolled from one side of the room to the other. The pot was so happy that it started to dance and sing.

The next day, the pot wanted to do something even more exciting. So it grabbed a pen and some paper and started to draw a picture. After it was finished, the pot could see that the picture was so beautiful!

When the pot was done, it looked around the house and found two chairs that were close together. So the pot decided to do something really fun - it started to balance on top of them! The pot felt so flexible that it could stay on top of the chairs. Everyone watching thought it was incredible.

The pot had so much fun doing all these things. It couldn't wait to get up the next day and do something even more exciting!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with bubbles. One day, she found a big bottle of bubble soap. She blew lots of bubbles and they were so pretty! 

But then, her friend came over and wanted to play too. Lily didn't want to share her bubble soap. She tried to resist her friend, but her friend got very sad. 

Lily felt bad, so she decided to share her bubble soap. But it was too late. Her friend had already left. Lily felt very lonely and sad. 

From that day on, Lily realized that being rich in bubble soap wasn't as important as having friends to share it with.

Once upon a time, a big, fat onion was growing in a garden. The onion was happy because it had lots of sun and water. One day, a little girl named Lily came to the garden. She saw the onion and said, "Wow, you are a big onion!"

The onion replied, "Yes, I am big, but I will remain here in the garden until I am ready to be picked."

Lily asked, "Why do you want to stay here?"

The onion said, "I want to grow bigger and stronger so that I can be a good onion for someone to eat."

Lily smiled and said, "I love onions! When will you be ready?"

The onion replied, "In a few more weeks, I will be ready to be picked and eaten. But until then, I will remain here in the garden, growing bigger and stronger."

Once there was a little boy named Sam who loved to whistle. Every day, he would go outside with his friends and whistle as loud as he could. One day, Sam's mommy suggested that he should get a tutor to help him learn some new whistles.

At first Sam was scared of the tutor, but the tutor was very gentle and slowly he began to warm up to him. The tutor taught Sam lots of new and exciting whistles. Over time, Sam got really good at whistling and soon he was the best whistler in the neighbourhood.

One day, Sam's mommy asked him, "Sam, can you whistle a special song for us?" Sam smiled and whistled a gentle tune. Everyone clapped and cheered for him. Sam had come a long way since the tutor first started teaching him!

Once upon a time, there was a nice little fish. He liked to dream about swimming in the ocean. He swam with the dolphins and had lots of fun.

But one day he saw something far away. It was a big shark! The little fish was scared. He started to swim away as fast as he could.

Thankfully he was able to find a safe place. It was a peaceful bay, with no sharks. Here the little fish could dream peacefully. He dreamt of happy times with his friends, the dolphins. He was happy and content in the peaceful bay.

Once there was a swan who was very different than the other swans. He had big bright feathers, but he never talked like the other swans. He was very sad and stayed alone.

One day, a little girl saw the swan. It looked so lonely, so the little girl decided to comfort it. She brought it some food and sang it a special song.

The swan was so happy to have a friend! He waggled his feathers and started to eat. The little girl smiled and stroked the swan's feathers.

The little girl went back to see the swan every day, bringing it food and singing her special song. The swan was so happy to have a friend that it stopped feeling so alone and different. 

The little girl and the swan were the best of friends and the little girl comforted the swan every day.

It was a cold day outside. Mama and Jonny stepped out for a walk. Mama said "Let's go! Time to walk!" Jonny beamed with excitement.

As they took steps, Mama noticed a big puddle on the way. "Oh, look Jonny! There's a puddle!". Jonny smiled and jumped with joy.

Mama asked him "Do you want to pour water on the puddle?" Jonny was thrilled to do it. He filled his little pail with water from a nearby pond and started to pour it on the puddle.

When the puddle was full, he was surprised to see frogs jumping out of it. The little frogs hopped around, enjoying the cold water. Jonny was so thrilled with the sight that he kept playing with the frogs until it was time to go home.

Timmy was walking in the park with his mom. He saw a funny looking man with a big tray of snacks. Timmy asked for one and the man gave him a big smile and nodded. The man was very polite.

Timmy's mom thanked the man and they kept walking. As they walked, the man called out after them, "What do you say?"

Timmy turned around and knew the answer. He said, "Thank you," in a polite voice.

The man nodded and smiled and said, "You're welcome!"

Timmy and his mom waved goodbye and kept walking. As they walked, Timmy couldn't help thinking if the man was still watching. The man was very polite and Timmy felt glad he had remembered to reply.

Once upon a time, there was a brave rocket. It wanted to protect everyone and make the world a better place. One day, the rocket came across some competitive monsters. The monsters were trying to cause trouble and make the world a mess.

"I'll protect you!" shouted the brave rocket. The monsters were scared and ran away.

The rocket flew up high in the sky and saw a beautiful rainbow. It wanted to protect the rainbow and make sure it stayed safe and beautiful. So, the rocket created a shield around the rainbow so the monsters could not touch it.

The rocket was very proud and said, "I am so glad I could protect the rainbow. Now everyone can enjoy it."

Once there was a little lion who lived in a large jungle. He had thick and fluffy fur, but he was always feeling very alone. He looked around the jungle, and couldn't find any other lions, so he decided to roar to make some friends.

The jungle filled with his fierce, scary roar. He looked around, but no friends came to play with him. All of a sudden, he heard something else roar back. He ran and followed the sound to discover a big fountain in the middle of the jungle.

Beside the fountain he saw two other lions. They were very friendly and made him feel less alone. The little lion was so excited he jumped, and sprayed a fountain of water around them all. The three lions laughed and laughed, playing together all day.

At the end of the day, the little lion felt so happy that he had made some new friends. He said goodbye to the two lion friends, and they all roared together one last time. The little lion then happily ran off home, feeling less alone in the thick jungle.

Once there was a little girl named Anna. She was three years old and very brave. One day, she wanted to do something surprised. So she went out to explore.

She walked over a hill and found a lucky lollipop. She was so excited. She picked up the lollipop and held it tightly.

Then she decided to cover it. So she brought it home and put it in a big box. She closed the box. Now, the lollipop was safe.

Anna couldnâ€™t wait to enjoy her lucky lollipop. She opened the box and smiled. She had a lot of fun eating it.

Anna was so happy. She had a magical and lucky day!

Once upon a time, there was a helpful little bug named Herb. Herb liked to crawl all day long. He crawled up and down, left and right, all around the big green leaf where he lived.

One sunny day, Herb saw a tiny friend stuck in a hole. The friend was a small ant named Ally. Ally was trying to crawl out, but the hole was too deep. Herb wanted to help his new friend.

Herb crawled down into the hole to help Ally. They both tried to crawl out together. With Herb's help, Ally crawled out of the hole. They were both very happy. From that day on, Herb and Ally were best friends, and they crawled and played together all the time.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Max and Mark. Max was 3 years old and Mark was 4 years old. They were always laughing, running and playing together.

One day Max opened his mailbox and found a very special message. It said: "If you want to fit in, take a friend today and go for a run. Then you will both be fit and laugh together. So what do you say?"

Max smiled. He knew just who to take. He hopped down the street to Markâ€™s house to share the message. When he got there he found Mark already out in the front yard waiting.

Max showed Mark the message and they started running. After a while they stopped to catch their breath and both started to laugh. They ran around the neighbourhood and laughed the whole time.

When the sun was setting Max and Mark said goodbye and made a promise to go running again. For now, they were both much more fit and full of laughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance to jazz music with her parents. One day, Lily's mom gave her a useful tip. "Lily, when you dance, try to kneel down and spin around. It will make your dancing even more fun!" Lily was excited to try this new move.

At the next jazz dance party, Lily showed off her new move. Her friend, Timmy, saw her and said, "Wow, Lily! That move was so cool! Can you teach me how to do it?" Lily was happy to teach him and they both danced together, kneeling and spinning around.

After the party, Lily's dad said, "Lily, you were amazing! You are such a great dancer!" Lily smiled and felt proud of herself. She replied, "Thanks, Dad! I learned a new move today, and it was very useful!"

Lily loves to help her mom bake. Today, they are making pastries for a picnic. Lily gets to roll the dough, cut out shapes, and fill them with jam. She is very careful not to drop anything.

When the pastries are done, they smell yummy. Lily can't wait to taste them. She helps her mom put them in a basket, along with some fruit and cheese. They get ready to go to the park.

On the way, they see a big dog. The dog is friendly, but he is also hungry. He jumps up and tries to get the basket. Lily holds on tight, but the basket is too heavy. She drops it on the ground. The pastries spill out, and the dog grabs one.

Lily is sad. She worked hard to make the pastries, and now they are gone. She starts to cry. Her mom hugs her and says, "It's okay, sweetie. We still have some pastries left. And we can share them with our friends at the picnic. Maybe they will have some treats for us, too."

Lily feels better. She wipes her tears and smiles. She picks up the basket and walks with her mom. She hopes the dog liked the pastry. She thinks it was yummy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to sit on her clean chair and read her favorite books. One day, her mommy told her it was time for bed. Lily didn't want to go to bed, but she was feeling very tired.
