As she got ready for bed, Lily's daddy came in to say goodnight. "Why are you yawning, Lily?" he asked. "I'm tired," she replied. "Well, you need to get some sleep so you can have energy to play tomorrow," he said. 

Lily climbed into her bed and snuggled under her cozy blankets. "Goodnight, Daddy," she said. "Goodnight, Lily," he replied. As he turned off the light, Lily yawned one more time and drifted off to sleep, dreaming of all the fun she would have the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a big giant who lived in a tall castle. He was very kind and loved to help others. One day, he went to the forest to collect some wood for his fireplace. While he was walking, he saw a little rabbit who was lost and scared. The giant felt sorry for the rabbit and decided to help him. He picked up the rabbit and put him in his pocket.

As he was walking, the giant accidentally split a log in half with his axe. He was very strong! When he arrived back at his castle, he took the rabbit out of his pocket and gave him some carrots to eat. The rabbit was very happy and thanked the giant for his kindness. From that day on, the giant and the rabbit became the best of friends and had many fun adventures together. The end.

Lila and Ben were playing in the backyard at night. They liked to look at the stars and make wishes. Lila saw a bright light in the sky. She pointed and said, "Look, Ben, a comet!"

Ben looked up and saw the light too. He said, "Wow, it's so pretty! Maybe we can make a wish on it."

Lila nodded and closed her eyes. She wished for a new doll. Ben closed his eyes and wished for a new bike. They opened their eyes and smiled at each other.

But then they heard a loud noise. It was their neighbor, Mr. Grump. He was angry and rude. He shouted, "What are you kids doing out here? You're making too much noise! Go to bed, now!"

Lila and Ben were scared and sad. They ran inside their house. They felt like their wishes were ruined by Mr. Grump.

The next day, Lila and Ben went to the park. They saw a girl and a boy with a new doll and a new bike. They looked happy and friendly. They waved at Lila and Ben and said, "Hi, do you want to play with us?"

Lila and Ben smiled and said, "Yes, please!" They ran to the girl and the boy and shared their toys. They had a lot of fun.

Lila and Ben learned that sometimes wishes don't come true the way you expect. But they also learned that being kind and sharing can make you happy and find new friends. They decided to ignore Mr. Grump and enjoy their lives. They hoped that one day he would learn to be nice too.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Mark. He loved to observe the world around him. One day, he saw a big, red apple in a tree. It looked delicious.

Mark asked his friend, Tom, "Can you help me get the apple?" Tom said, "Yes, let's work together." They climbed the tree and got the apple. They shared it and it tasted very good.

The moral of the story is that when we help each other, we can achieve great things and enjoy delicious treats together.

Once upon a time there was a brown otter. The otter's name was Pat. Pat loved to swim in the river near his home. Every day he would record what he saw and did as he swam. 

One day, as Pat swam along, he saw something unusual. It was a bright yellow fish sitting amongst all the brown and green rocks in the riverbed. Pat was so surprised that he quickly stopped to take a closer look.

"What are you doing in this river, little fish?" asked Pat.

"I'm recording," the fish replied.

Pat was intrigued and asked, "What are you recording?"

The fish smiled and explained, "I'm making a record of all the wonderful things around me - like you, the otter!"

Pat was so pleased that he thanked the fish for recording him. From then on, Pat and the fish were good friends, and they explored the river together, recording everything they saw.

Once upon a time there were two little monkeys that lived in the jungle. They were very good friends, but sometimes they misbehaved.

One day, one of the monkeys got a very clever idea. She wanted to use her long monkey tail to swing from tree to tree. She grabbed it around the waist and started to swing. It was so much fun, she wanted to do it all the time.

The other monkey thought this was a bad idea and tried to stop her. But the first monkey was too strong, and she kept swinging.

The other monkey was very upset that his friend was not behaving. He tried to find a way to make her stop, but she was just too clever. 

Suddenly, an idea popped into his head. He reached up and grabbed the first monkey's long tail and held on tight. She squealed with surprise and dropped to the ground.

Both monkeys were very surprised by what had happened, but the second monkey was very happy that his friend had stopped misbehaving. They hugged each other and laughed. From then on, the two monkeys behaved very well!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run fast and play with his toys. One day, Timmy's mom took him to the lab to measure how tall he was. Timmy was so excited to see all the cool machines in the lab.

While Timmy was waiting for his turn to be measured, he saw another little boy playing with a toy car. Timmy asked the boy if he could play too, but the boy said no. Timmy felt sad and didn't understand why the boy didn't want to play with him.

When it was finally Timmy's turn to be measured, he was so happy to see that he had grown taller. But when he went to find his mom, she was nowhere to be found. Timmy started to cry and didn't know what to do.

Suddenly, a kind lady came up to Timmy and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her that he couldn't find his mom. The lady tried to help Timmy find his mom, but they couldn't find her anywhere. Timmy was lost and scared, and he wished he had someone to play with.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and swing on his swing set. One day, Timmy's dad took him to the park to play golf. Timmy loved hitting the ball with the golf club.

After they finished playing golf, Timmy and his dad went back home. Timmy's mom asked if they had fun and Timmy said, "Yes, we played golf and I swung on the swing set." His mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a tidy day."

Later that night, Timmy went to bed and had a bad dream. In his dream, he was playing golf and accidentally hit the ball into the neighbor's yard. When he went to retrieve it, he saw a big, scary dog. The dog chased Timmy and bit him. Timmy woke up crying and his parents comforted him.

From that day on, Timmy was scared of dogs and didn't want to play golf anymore. But he still loved swinging on his swing set.

One sunny day, Millie and her father, Daddy, went to the park. They saw lots of birds playing in the trees and bugs crawling across the grass. Daddy noticed a big club and said: "Let's join the club!". But Millie disagreed. She liked playing in the park and didn't want to join the club. 

Daddy said: "The club looks attractive and fun. Besides, all the other kids are already playing in it, why don't we join them?" Millie thought about it for a moment, but still disagreed. She decided to stay in the park and play by herself. 

But then Daddy had a brilliant idea. He said: "I know, let's make our own club! We will be the only two members and it will still be fun!" Millie was very excited and agreed. They started playing games and having fun together. 

Millie discovered that she and Daddy could have just as much fun in their own club as the other kids did in the big one. She was so happy that she had disagreed in the first place and that Daddy had suggested they make their own.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Susie. She was very scared of the dark. One night when Susie's parents were out, Susie heard a noise coming from the kitchen. She was too scared to check what it was so she just stayed in her bedroom. 

Suddenly there was a bright light coming from the kitchen. Susie was scared but she also wanted to know what it was. She tiptoed towards the kitchen door and whispered: "Hello?"

The light was coming from the fridge and it had started to shine! Susie felt relieved but then she noticed something strange. The fridge was covered with a big, dark and spooky shadow! Susie was so scared she started screaming and ran away back to her bedroom. She never went back to the kitchen again.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat on the water. The boat was moving slow, and the people on it were getting bored. Suddenly, they saw a dolphin jumping in the water! The people were so happy and they started to rush to the side of the boat to see the dolphin. 

The dolphin was swimming fast and jumping high! The people on the boat were amazed and they started to cheer. The boat started to go faster, chasing the dolphin. The people felt like they were flying! 

After a while, the dolphin swam away and the boat slowed down again. But the people on the boat were still happy because they had seen something amazing. They talked about the dolphin and how it made them feel. And they knew that even though the boat was slow, they could still have fun and see amazing things. The end.

Jack loved to play with his blocks. He had a big pile of them and he was so excited to build things. Every day, he would gather the blocks and create something new.

One day, Jack's mom noticed something. Jack's blocks were getting dirty. She knew what to do - she gave Jack a rag and some water, and told him to wipe them.

At first, Jack didn't understand what she meant, but then he realized she wanted him to clean the blocks. He was very excited to do it. 

So Jack dipped the rag into the water and started wiping the blocks. He worked very carefully and soon his blocks were all clean and shiny. His mom was so happy and proud, and gave him a hug. 

Jack was so thankful to have such a reliable mom that helped him take care of his toys. From then on, he was determined to always keep them clean and take care of them himself.

Once upon a time there was a gray mixer. It was always alone and only had itself to talk to. Then one day it met a green mixer and the two mixers began speaking together. They talked and laughed, and the gray mixer had never been so happy.

But then the green mixer stopped talking and just walked away. The gray mixer was so sad that it cried and cried.

The next day, the gray mixer saw the green mixer again. This time the green mixer asked the gray mixer how it was and asked to be friends. The gray mixer was so happy, it jumped up and down.

The moral of this story is that it's important to be kind and make friends! Friends will always be there for you, no matter what. Treat them well and you will always be happy.

One day, an old man went for a walk in the sunshine. He saw a light shining in the sky and thought, "What is that?" He kept walking until he saw a little bird. As he got closer, the bird flew away. The old man was scared, but something deep inside him told him it was ok. He trusted the light in the sky.

The old man kept walking and soon he saw a little red car. He had never seen a car like this before. He slowly approached the car and reached his hand out to touch it. But then the car suddenly moved, and the old man jumped back in surprise. Once again, deep inside him, he trusted the light in the sky.

As he kept walking, he heard music coming from a tree. He peered closer and saw that there were lots of little birds sitting in the branches. Suddenly one of the birds flew out of the tree towards the old man. He froze, but then remembered the light in the sky and trusted the bird.

The little bird flew around the old man, singing a beautiful song. The old man smiled. He suddenly felt so safe and happy. The light in the sky had told him to trust. And he did.

Anna and Ben love to play outside. They like to run, jump, and swing in the park. They see many things in nature. They see birds, flowers, and bugs. They think nature is lovely.

One day, they go to the park with their mom. But the sky is dark and gray. Mom says, "It looks like it will rain soon. We should go home." Anna and Ben do not want to go home. They want to play more.

"Please, mom, can we stay a little longer?" Anna asks.

"Me too, me too!" Ben says.

Mom says, "Okay, but only for a few minutes. Then we have to go."

Anna and Ben are happy. They run to the slide and slide down. They laugh and have fun. But then, they hear a loud boom. It is thunder. They see a bright flash. It is lightning. They are scared.

"Mom, mom, help!" Anna and Ben cry.

Mom runs to them and hugs them. She says, "Don't worry, we will be okay. Let's go home now."

But it is too late. The rain starts to fall. It falls hard and fast. It is a storm. The rain gets them wet and cold. The wind blows and makes them shiver. The thunder and lightning make them cry.

They try to go home, but the water is everywhere. It covers the road, the grass, and the park. It is a flood. They cannot walk or drive. They are stuck.

They see the birds, the flowers, and the bugs. They are wet and sad too. They think nature is not lovely anymore. They think nature is mean and scary. They wish they had listened to mom. They wish they had gone home sooner. They are in trouble.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to skip around her farm, playing with all the animals. One day, she found a big pile of corn. It was yellow and smelled so good. She decided to pick some and take it to her mom to make popcorn.

But Lily was too small to carry all the corn by herself. Luckily, her helpful dog, Max, came along and saw her struggling. Max barked and wagged his tail, telling Lily he would help her. Together, they carried the corn to the house and gave it to Lily's mom.

Mom made delicious popcorn and Lily and Max shared it while skipping around the farm. They were so happy and grateful to have each other's helpful company. The end.

Ben and Jen are twins. They live in a hut with their mom and dad. They have a dog, a cat and a hen. The dog is big and brown. The cat is small and black. The hen is white and lays eggs.

Every morning, Ben and Jen help their mom and dad. They feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They give them water and food. The dog likes bones. The cat likes milk. The hen likes corn. They are happy animals.

But one day, Ben and Jen are lazy. They do not want to feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They want to play with their toys. They say to their mom and dad, "We are tired. We do not want to feed the animals. You do it."

Their mom and dad are not happy. They say to Ben and Jen, "You are not tired. You are lazy. You have to feed the animals. They are hungry and thirsty. They need you. If you do not feed them, they will be sad and sick."

Ben and Jen feel bad. They do not want to make the animals sad and sick. They say to their mom and dad, "We are sorry. We will feed the animals. We love them." They go to the hut and get the water and food. They feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They pet them and talk to them. The animals are happy and healthy. Ben and Jen are happy and proud. They are not lazy. They are good twins.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park with her mommy. They went to the playground and Lily saw a big swing. She asked her mommy if she could swing. Her mommy said yes and pushed her on the swing.

Lily was having so much fun swinging back and forth. She felt the warm sun on her face and the wind in her hair. After a while, Lily's tummy started to feel empty. She asked her mommy for a snack. Her mommy gave her a banana and a bottle of water.

Lily ate her snack and drank her water. She felt so full and happy. She looked around and saw that the park was filling up with more kids and families. Lily was excited to play with new friends on the swings and slides.

Tim and Sam are friends. They like to play with their kayaks in the lake. They have a race to see who is faster.

"Ready, set, go!" Tim says. He paddles hard with his stick. Sam paddles hard too. They splash water and laugh.

Tim is in front. He sees a big rock. He thinks he can go around it. He is smart. He does not want to hit the rock.

But Sam does not see the rock. He paddles straight to it. He hits the rock with his kayak. His kayak stops. He is sad.

Tim looks back. He sees Sam and the rock. He stops too. He is kind. He does not want to win alone.

"Are you okay, Sam?" Tim asks. He paddles back to Sam.

"I'm okay, Tim. But my kayak is stuck. I can't move it." Sam says.

Tim helps Sam. He pushes the rock with his stick. The rock moves a little. Sam pulls his kayak. The kayak comes out. Sam is happy.

"Thank you, Tim. You are a good friend. You are smart and kind." Sam says.

"You're welcome, Sam. You are a good friend too. You are fast and fun." Tim says.

They hug. They paddle together to the shore. They share a snack. They are both winners.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little bunny. He had big floppy ears and a furry tail. Every day, he would hop around looking for a home. He wanted to make a home that was his very own.

One day, he hopped into a meadow filled with daisies. He looked around and saw a hollow log. He thought, "This is the perfect place to make my home."

He hopped inside and made some extra fluffy leaves for a bed. He made some sticks into a cozy nest and he had a little home of his own.

The shy little bunny was so happy. He was no longer alone and he had a place to keep him warm. From then on, he was never shy and he always had a place to call home.

Once upon a time there was a greedy fox who loved to wander. He wondered all over the forest, looking for something just for him.

One day he came upon a special well. He loved the way it sparkled in the sunlight and wanted it all to himself.

The fox was very selfish and did not want to share the well with anyone, so he tried to cover it up so no one else could find it.

But the fox had not seen a rabbit in the area. The rabbit saw the fox and noticed he was trying to cover the well. The rabbit was angry and stopped the fox from ruining the well. He told the fox that the well belonged to everyone and he should share it with everyone.

The fox was very angry and tried to take the well for himself again. But the rabbit was too strong and scared the fox away.

The rabbit was very happy that he was able to save the well from the selfish fox and that everyone could share the special well.

Once there was a little boy who was very gifted. He loved to travel and explore. One day, he decided to go on a special trip to a hotel. When he arrived, he was so excited. The hotel greeted him with a big smile and said, "Welcome!"

The little boy felt so special. He looked around the hotel and saw that it was very beautiful. Everywhere he looked there were bright decorations. He loved it!

The boy went to the desk to check in and the desk clerk was so friendly. She gave him a big warm welcome. She gave him special treats and told him all about the special things in the hotel.

The boy enjoyed exploring all of the hotel and all the treats that he received. He was so happy to receive such a warm welcome. He knew that this hotel was one of the best places he had ever been.

One day, Alex went to the kitchen. His eyes lit up with enthusiasm when he saw a big cup of juice. Alex stared at it in delight and smiled. Then he drank some. He liked it so much he wanted some more. He asked his mom if he could have some more, and she agreed. So Alex had an even bigger cup of juice.

He was really enjoying it. His excitement increased as he drank the second cup. He finished the second cup and wanted more. Alex's mom said no, but he was so enthusiastic she could not resist his pleading. So she gave Alex a third cup of juice.

Alex was so happy he was jumping up and down with joy. He felt full after drinking three big cups of juice. He thanked his mom and went off to play.

Once upon a time, there were two friends - Tim and Jill. They liked to wander around in the same forest every day. One day, when the two of them were walking, they noticed a big chest in the middle of the forest. 

"Let's open it," suggested Tim excitedly.

Jill shook her head and told him, "Let's not, Tim. It might be someone else's chest, and it wouldn't be nice to open it without permission."

But Tim insisted and started to open it.

In the chest, the two friends found a lot of money. 

Tim said excitedly, "Let's take the money. It's going to help us a lot!" 

But Jill said sadly, "No, let's not. We have no right to take their money. It's not ours."

In the end, Tim realised Jill was right and the two friends put back the money.
 
The moral of this story is that it is never right to be selfish. We must always act with kindness and respect towards others.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy lion who lived in the zoo. All the other animals were scared of him because he was so grumpy. He had a card that he cherished very much. It was special to him because it meant he could own the zoo.

One day, the lion wanted to take a walk outside the zoo. He asked the zookeeper if he could have his card to go out. The zookeeper gave him the card and the lion smiled.

The lion was now the owner of the zoo! He was so excited that he decided to invite all the animals to his house for a party. The animals were scared at first, but when they saw the grumpy lion's card, they knew the lion really owned the zoo.

The party was a big success! Everyone had a great time, and the lion was no longer grumpy. He was now the happy owner of the zoo. Everyone had so much fun, they decided to do it again soon. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jill. She was very cute and liked to play outside. One day, she decided to go explore the woods. As she walked, she saw a shiny red object. She wanted to see what it was, so she reached out for it. It was an emergency button! Jill was so excited. She quickly pushed the button and suddenly, a big red truck came. It was the fire truck! A firefighter came out and thanked Jill for her help. She was so proud of herself. From then on, when Jill was out playing, she made sure to never forget to reach for the emergency button if she ever needed help.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, but he always wished he had more. One day, his mom took him to the toy store. Timmy was so happy! He saw many toys, but he wanted a plastic truck. 

Timmy's mom bought him the truck and they went home. Timmy played with his new toy all day. He drove it around the house and made it jump over pillows. But then, the truck got stuck under the couch. Timmy tried to reach it, but he couldn't. 

He asked his mom for help. She said, "I have an idea! Let's use an ordinary ruler!" Timmy didn't know what that meant, but he watched as his mom used the ruler to reach the truck. She got it out and gave it back to Timmy. He was so happy and thanked his mom. From that day on, Timmy loved his plastic truck even more.

Once upon a time, there was a small office. Inside, there was a man. He was working very hard. All of a sudden, the man felt dizzy. His head started to spin and before he knew it, he started to shrink!

"Oh no!" he yelled as he got smaller and smaller. He looked around the office and noticed a cat watching him from the corner.

"Help!" he cried to the cat. "Can you help me stop shrinking?"

The cat just meowed and sat there.

The man was very scared. He didn't know what to do. Suddenly, he had an idea. He threw open a box of pens and pens and started to climb inside. As he crammed in the box, he felt himself start to get bigger again.

The cat watched as the man slowly grew back to his original size. When he was back to normal, the man thanked the cat and went back to work. He never felt dizzy again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was three years old, and she was always very tidy.

One day, Sarah was playing hide and seek with her mom. Sarah ran in the house and hid under the bed. Her mom soon found her, because Sarah was in a tidy spot!

Next, Sarah ran outside. She remembered mommy telling her not to go too far away. So Sarah hid behind a big crack in the wall. She could not be seen - it felt like the best hiding spot ever!

Her mom was not far away - she soon noticed that Sarah was missing and looked around the garden. Suddenly, she found Sarah hiding behind the crack! She was so happy to find her little girl safe and sound.

Sarah and her mom hugged. Sarah had fun hiding, and her mom was happy that Sarah was being so tidy.

Once there was a fat pipe. It was resting on the ground, but it wanted to be tested. It wanted to see how strong it was.

So one day, a 3 year old child came by to test the pipe. He picked it up and squished it with his hands. The pipe was tough, so the child threw it on the ground. It bounced and rolled down the hill!

The child was happy and so was the pipe. It was pleased to know it was strong, and the child was happy to see that the pipe could withstand the test.

The next day, the child and the pipe went for a walk together. They were the best of friends.

Lily liked to ride her bike. She rode it every day around the park. She was very good at riding. She could go fast and turn and stop. She had a pink bike with a bell and a basket.

One day, she saw a new boy in the park. He had a blue bike with a horn and a flag. He rode his bike near the fence. He did not look at Lily. He looked at his bike. Lily wanted to talk to him. She rode her bike to the fence.

"Hi, I am Lily. What is your name?" she asked.

The boy looked at her. He smiled. "I am Max. I like your bike. It is very pretty," he said.

"Thank you. I like your bike too. It is very cool," she said.

"Do you want to ride with me?" he asked.

"Yes, please. That would be fun," she said.

They rode their bikes together around the park. They rang their bell and horn. They waved their flag and basket. They laughed and talked. They became friends.

Lily and Max were very happy. They liked to ride their bikes. They liked each other. They were popular. All the other kids in the park wanted to ride with them. They shared their bikes and toys. They had a lot of fun.

Lily and Sam were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They saw a squirrel on a tree. The squirrel had a big tail and brown fur.

"Look, a squirrel!" Lily said. "Can we pet it?"

Sam shook his head. "No, squirrels are shy. They run away if you get too close."

He picked up a stick. "But we can play with it. Watch this!" He threw the stick at the squirrel. The stick hit the tree and made a loud noise.

The squirrel was scared. It jumped from the tree and ran across the grass. Sam ran after it. He wanted to catch it.

"Sam, stop!" Lily shouted. "That's not nice. You are hurting the squirrel."

She followed Sam and the squirrel. She saw a man with a big camera. The man was gentle. He liked animals. He was taking pictures of the squirrel.

"Hey, kids, what are you doing?" the man asked. "Don't chase the squirrel. It's not a toy. It's a living creature. It has feelings, too."

Sam stopped. He felt bad. He dropped the stick. "I'm sorry, mister. I was just playing. I didn't mean to shoot the squirrel."

The man smiled. "It's okay, kid. I know you didn't mean any harm. But you have to be careful. Squirrels are wild animals. They need space and respect. If you want to play with them, you have to be gentle and quiet. Maybe then they will come closer and let you see them better."

Lily nodded. She liked the man. She liked the squirrel, too. She wanted to be its friend. She sat on the grass and waited. She did not move or make any noise.

The squirrel was curious. It saw Lily and the man. It saw that they were not angry or scary. It came closer and closer. It sniffed Lily's hand. It nibbled on a nut. It let Lily touch its fur.

Lily was happy. She felt the squirrel's soft tail and warm body. She whispered, "Hello, squirrel. You are so cute. I'm sorry my brother shoot you. He won't do it again. Will you be my friend?"

The squirrel looked at Lily with its bright eyes. It made a small sound. It seemed to say, "Yes, I will be your friend. Thank you for being gentle."

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved his bike. He would ride it around the park every day. One day, a mean man came and stole Timmy's bike. Timmy was very sad and didn't know what to do.

But Timmy had a loyal friend named Sarah. She saw the mean man steal Timmy's bike and she knew she had to help. Sarah chased after the mean man and got Timmy's bike back. Timmy was so happy and grateful to have such a loyal friend.

From that day on, Timmy made sure to always lock up his bike with a pedal lock so no one could steal it again. And he was even more grateful for his loyal friend Sarah. The end.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful girl who loved to dance. She was graceful and light on her feet and twirled and spun with wonderful grace. Every night, she would move and sway to the music in her room. But one night, she was upset. Her bookcase had fallen over and all of her books were scattered across the room. But then a miracle happened. The books began to float off the floor and quickly gathered themselves into the bookcase. They moved in perfect harmony and with grace, just like the girl danced. Soon the room was back to normal, and the girlâ€™s dancing could continue.

Since then, the girl and the bookcase have been dancing every night, celebrating life and the wonderful world around them. Grace and harmony forever.

One day there was a girl named Ruby. She looked for something special to wear. She thought and thought, and then she found a pretty, peach dress. 

Ruby put on the dress, twirled around and smiled. Everyone said the dress looked so nice, and Ruby felt so happy.

Ruby decided to give the dress to her mom. She was so thoughtful. Her mom was so excited and put the dress on right away. She looked so beautiful!

Ruby and her mom twirled and danced together in the peach dress. They laughed and smiled, and Ruby felt so proud. They both had so much fun.

At the end of the evening, Ruby was so happy she had found the peach dress. It had made everyone so happy!

One day, there was a little boy named Bill. He loved to ride his tricycle. He would pedal it around the park and shout with joy.

One day, Bill wanted to try something new. He wanted to go faster on his tricycle and so he pushed the pedal hard. As he pedaled, he heard a familiar sound - he was shouting with excitement!

The harder he pushed, the faster he went. He shouted louder and louder and soon he was flying around the park. He felt so happy and free and was so excited that he was able to go so fast on his tiny tricycle.

After a while, Bill slowed down and stopped. He smiled and waved at his friends as they passed by. He couldn't believe he had gone so fast and had had so much fun. He knew he'd never forget the wonderful day he had pedaled so hard.

Jacob was a three year old and he loved going on adventures. He wanted to go to the park and play, but his mom said no. She said that Jacob's body was too fragile and he needed to rest. So Jacob stayed at home, feeling disappointed and sad.

But Jacob found a way to have an adventure right at home! He filled a sack with all the pillows and blankets he could find. Then he laid down in the middle of the pile and pretended he was camping. His stomach was full of excitement and he imagined his camping adventure.

Suddenly, he noticed that the blanket underneath him was too thin and he could feel the ground below. Jacob knew that he needed to be extra careful because his body was fragile and he couldn't get hurt.

He carefully tucked himself into the pillow pile again and finally went to sleep, happy with his adventure.

Tom and his mom were walking down the street. They were on their way to the store. Tom had never been there before. All around him were tall buildings and lots of people. Tom stared at them curiously.

Suddenly, the two of them stopped in front of a building. Tom wondered why. His mom was staring at someone coming out of the building. It was an unknown person. Tom didn't know who the person was.

Suddenly, his mom whispered, "That's the judge." Tom felt scared and kept staring. The judge seemed very serious as he walked away. Tom wanted to ask his mom questions, but he was too scared.

The two of them kept walking, and Tom kept staring at everything around him. He knew his mom was watching, but he couldn't help it! He was so curious about the unknown things around him.

Once upon a time, there was a sailor named Alex. He was a big strong sailor who sailed on the ocean. He had lots of friends and he was always happy. 

One day, Alex was very upset. No one was sure why he was so sad. His sailing friends asked what was wrong, but Alex wouldn't tell them.

"Why are you upset, Alex?" said one of his friends, Pearl.

"Something special was taken away," said Alex, still looking upset.

Pearl was very sad to see Alex so unhappy. She wanted to help him. So she gave Alex a big hug. He smiled a little and thanked her.

The friends then found some bouncy blue balls to give to Alex. He laughed and smiled. He was so happy to get the balls from his friends. Alex was glad to have such kind friends. He wasn't so upset anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a lady called Maisie. She was very eager to have her house look like a palace. One day she decided to polish her furniture up with a teaspoon. She was surprised at how shiny the furniture became! Maisie was so pleased with the results, she showed it off to everyone in the town.

Everyone said how amazing it looked and offered to help her polish the rest. Maisie was so happy that she started jumping about around her house. "Thank you so much for the help," she said. 

Then, suddenly a little girl called Alice spoke up. She was three years old but was very clever. She excitedly said, "I can help, too!" 

Maisie was so pleased and said, "That would be wonderful Alice. Please get the teaspoon and you can help me polish my furniture." 

Alice was so eager and excited that she ran off to find the teaspoon and started polishing. Maisie and Alice both polished and polished until the furniture shined like the sun. Everyone was so amazed at the outcome and couldn't believe what they'd achieved that day. 

Maisie was so proud and at the end of the day said, "We all did such a great job. Alice, you did a wonderful job of polishing. You're a very special helper, thank you!"

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. But today, the park was full of fog. They could not see very far. They could not see their mom and dad.

"Where are they?" Lily asked. She felt scared.

"I don't know," Tom said. He held Lily's hand. "Maybe they are hiding."

They walked around the park. They looked for their mom and dad. They looked for other people. But they only saw fog. Fog was everywhere. It was cold and wet.

"Let's go back to the slide," Lily said. "Maybe they are there."

They went back to the slide. But they did not see their mom and dad. They only saw a man. He was sitting on a bench. He was wearing a big coat and a hat. He had a beard. He was unknown.

"Hello, children," the man said. He smiled. "Are you lost?"

Lily and Tom did not answer. They did not know the man. They did not like his smile.

"Come here," the man said. He reached out his hand. "I can help you find your mom and dad."

Lily and Tom did not move. They felt more scared. They did not want to go near the man.

"Leave us alone!" Tom shouted. He pulled Lily away. "We don't need your help!"

They ran away from the man. They ran away from the slide. They ran away from the fog. They ran until they saw a light. It was a car. It was their mom and dad's car.

They ran to the car. They opened the door. They saw their mom and dad. They were sitting in the front. They were dry and warm.

"Lily! Tom!" their mom and dad said. They hugged them. "We were looking for you! Where were you?"

"We were in the fog," Lily said. She cried. "We were lost. We saw a man. He was unknown. He was scary."

"We're sorry, sweetie," their mom said. She kissed her. "We didn't mean to leave you. The fog came so fast. We couldn't see you."

"It's okay, mommy," Tom said. He smiled. "We're safe now. We're with you."

They got in the car. They drove away from the park. They drove away from the fog. They drove home. They were happy.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Nathan. Nathan was three years old. He was always very helpful. 

One day, Nathan went for a walk in the park. He saw a beautiful blue bird! Nathan was so excited that he shouted "Hello bird!". 

The bird flew away but came back with a surprise. It had found a blue feather for Nathan! 

Nathan shouted "Thank you" to the bird. He was very thankful for the helpful bird. He held the blue feather close to his heart and went home to show his friends. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys on the smooth floor of her room. One day, she found a zipper on her favorite dress. She tried to zip it up and down, up and down but it got stuck.

Lily's mom was busy cooking in the kitchen and couldn't help her. So, Lily decided to try to fix the zipper herself. She pulled and tugged until suddenly the zipper broke and flew off the dress.

Lily was sad and didn't know what to do. She sat on the floor and cried. Her mom came in and saw the broken zipper. She tried to fix it but it was too late. Lily's favorite dress was ruined.

Once upon a time, a little squirrel named Nutty loved to collect acorns. One day, she found a big, shiny acorn and was very happy. But then, she saw another squirrel named Sammy who also wanted the acorn. They both wanted it so much that they started to fight over it.

Nutty was very fast and managed to get the acorn first, but then she realized she had hurt Sammy. She felt guilty and sad. She knew she shouldn't have fought over the acorn.

Later that day, Nutty saw Sammy again. She felt bad and wanted to make things right. So she went over to Sammy and gave her the acorn. Sammy was surprised and happy. She clapped her hands and thanked Nutty.

Nutty learned that it's better to share than to fight over things. She felt happy that she had made Sammy happy and knew that she had done the right thing. From that day on, Nutty always shared her acorns with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved playing with his toys, especially his toy car. One day, Timmy's toy car broke and he was very sad.

When they got home, Timmy's mom took an x-ray of the broken toy car to see if they could fix it. But Timmy was already happy with his new toy car and didn't mind if the old one couldn't be fixed.

Once upon a time there was a nation. The nation was very obedient and followed the rules. All the people in the nation were happy and content.

One day, the leader of the nation asked all the people to tie a special knot together. The knot was to stand for the nation's unity and strength. Everyone was excited about the idea and began to tie the knot.

They all worked together to tie the knot and soon it was done. The knot was very strong and held the nation together. Everyone cheered with joy and thanked each other for helping out.

From then on, the obedient nation always remembered the special knot that tied them together. They kept it safe and held on to it for always.

Once upon a time there was a man who was very honest. He always did the right thing no matter what. One morning he woke up, feeling quite tired. He looked around and he knew it was time to get up. He couldn't help it though, he yawned big and long. 

After breakfast he went to find his battery. He needed to get it so he could start on his errands. He found it under the chair and looked at it closely. It was still in good shape and was ready to use. 

He went out to do his errands, feeling more awake. He smiled, knowing he was being honest, and he knew the battery would get him where he needed to go. 

The end!

Molly was a three-year-old girl who loved playing dress up and looking at herself in the mirror. One day she found a mop in mommy's closet. It didn't belong there, but she thought it was fun to try. She put the mop on her head like a hat and laughed. Molly liked pretending that it was her beautiful princess crown.

Mommy came into the room and saw Molly wearing the mop. "Molly, put that back! It doesn't belong on your head. It's too disgusting!" 

Molly was disappointed and sad. She put the mop back in the closet and went to find something else to do. She found her princess dress and put it on, finding happiness in the beauty of her dress. 

Mommy smiled seeing Molly twirl in her dress. She hugged her and said, "That's much better! Let's go play." Molly giggled and they played together all afternoon.

There were two best friends. One day, one of them suggested going on a ship. The other one was jealous and said no. The friend suggested again, but the jealous one still said no. The friend was sad and said goodbye.

The jealous one felt bad and thought of a plan to get back at the other one. He quickly decided to make a ship by himself. The jealous one was so excited and started building right away.

He worked very hard and eventually finished the ship. But before he could show it to the other one, a big storm hit and destroyed the ship. The jealous one was very sad and could not believe it.

When the friend found out he felt sorry for the other one. Even though the jealous one had been mean, the friend wanted to help him. But it was too late. The jealous one had caused a bad ending by being too jealous.

Once upon a time, there was a dinosaur. He was very big and he was very kind. He was a compassionate dinosaur.

One day, he saw a little girl. She looked sad and he wanted to help her. He asked her why she was so sad.

The little girl started to cry. She told him that she had lost her favourite bird. The dinosaur said he was sorry and asked her if there was anything he could do to help.

The little girl thought for a moment, then she had an idea. She mentioned that maybe they could look together. The dinosaur said that sounded like a good idea and they set off on their search.

After a while, they found the little girl's bird! The little girl was so happy and thanked the kind dinosaur. Then they both went on their way.

The dinosaur was very happy that he had been able to help. He felt proud and was reminded that it is important to be compassionate.

Once upon a time there was a furry bear named Bear. He was very happy and loved to play every day. One day, he got a bright idea! He decided to try and make his own movie. He went to find a film and loaded it into his camera.

He was so excited to show his movie off to all his friends. But sadly, something went wrong. The film wasn't loading properly and Bear started to get upset. He tried again and again but the film still wouldn't load. He started to cry but nothing could fix it.

Bear's friends tried to cheer him up, but it was no use. He had wasted all his time and the film was ruined. Bear was very sad but he knew that he had to be strong. He put away the film and decided to have fun with his friends instead.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a pink balloon. It loved to fly around in the sky, but it was lonely. One day, it went to a park to meet some new friends.

The first thing it saw was a boy playing with a ball. He noticed the balloon and asked if it wanted to play. The balloon was excited and said yes!

They started to play and the balloon was having lots of fun. But then the balloon bumped the ball too hard and the boy started to complain. He said the balloon was too rough and not being careful.

The balloon felt sad and started to cry. But the boy said he was sorry and gave it a hug. He said it was okay and told the balloon to try again.

So the balloon flew around the park, slowly and carefully. And the balloon stayed friends with the boy for many years afterwards. The end.

Bob is a nice man. He loves to throw things. One day, Bob found a big box. The box was closed, but Bob wanted to open it. He threw the box and it opened with a big bang. When the box was open, Bob saw a nice, shiny ball inside. Bob smiled and threw the ball up in the air, and then caught it. He played with the ball, throwing it up and catching it, until it was dark and he had to go home.

Once upon a time there was a very happy girl. She loved to play with her pony in the sunshine. Every morning she would wake up and pray to the sky.

One day the girl said, â€œDear sky, please give me sunshine and happiness today.â€

The sky answered, â€œYes my little friend, I will give you sunshine and happiness.â€

The girl hugged her pony and said â€œThank you sky!â€

The sun shone brightly and the little girl was very happy. She sang a song and laughed with her pony.

The girl smiled and said â€œLetâ€™s go and play outside!â€

Every day the little girl prayed to the sky and every day the sky answered. Her heart was always very full of joy and happiness.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and her little girl. The little girl was so pretty with her delicate blond curls and bright blue eyes. The mommy and her daughter loved to do things together. One day, mommy said, "I'm going away for a bit, just for work."

The little girl was sad, so mommy gave her a delicate kiss on the forehead and said, "I'll be back soon." The little girl wasn't sure what jail was, but she knew mommy was talking about going away and she didn't like it.

A few days later, mommy came back. The little girl ran up to her and gave her a big hug. Mommy said, "Did you miss me?" and the little girl said yes and kissed her mommy on the cheek.

Mommy said, "I love you so much, even when I'm away." The little girl smiled and said, "I love you, too." They hugged each other and the little girl knew that no matter what happened, her mommy would always come back to her.

One day, Jack and Jill went for a walk. They were strolling down the street, but then they began to quarrel. Jack said that he wanted to go to the park, but Jill said she wanted an ice cream.

They argued for a while and got angry. Then, Jack got an idea. He said they should go to the park - but he would buy her an ice cream first. Jill was very nervous but she agreed.

They gradually walked towards the park. It was only an inch away, but it took a long time to get there. Finally they arrived and they both got their ice creams. They were no longer quarrelling - they were happy and smiling.

Once upon a time, there was a family who had a special theatre. Every week, the family would perform plays for their friends and family. One day, the mother decided to gather special costumes for the theatre. She found a velvet dress that sparkled in the light. As she looked closer, she realised it was fake. She laughed, and put the dress back down. 

The next week, it was time for the family to perform in the theatre. They dressed up in their costumes and put on the play. The mother wore the velvet dress and everyone's faces lit up when they saw it. It looked so beautiful and sparkled like no other dress. 

At the end of the show, everyone was clapping and cheering. Even the baby clapped and laughed in delight. Everyone was so proud of the family for performing a great show. 

The mother wore the velvet dress for many of the shows. The audience was never able to tell it was fake.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy orange. He just wanted to turn and be happy, but he could not figure out how. One day he saw a little boy who offered to help. The little boy was only three years old but was very wise. He said to the orange, "You have to turn yourself. Believe in yourself and you can do it!" The orange was happy and he tried to turn himself. He tried and tried, but he just couldn't find the strength. Then the little boy put the orange on the ground. He said, "Now, turn!" The orange was surprised when he suddenly spun and rolled away. He was so happy that he had turned himself. The orange thanked the little boy for showing him the way. He was no longer grumpy and was now free to spin and turn wherever he wanted.

Sammy was having an exciting day. He was outside in the sunshine and playing with his toys. After running around, he got very tired and yawned. He was so tired he could barely keep his eyes open.

Suddenly, Sammy heard something. It was a crazy noise, like someone shouting and laughing at the same time. He knew it was something he had never heard before.

He crept closer to see what was making the noise. To his surprise, he saw a little squirrel jumping around in the sunshine and laughing. It looked so funny, Sammy started laughing too.

He watched the squirrel for a few minutes until eventually it stopped and yawned. Sammy had never seen a squirrel yawning before and thought it was very cute. Then the squirrel scurried away and Sammy went back to his toys knowing that he had just seen the craziest thing ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to take naps in her cozy bed every day. One afternoon, while she was taking her nap, she dreamed about her favorite toy, a teddy bear named Brownie. She was so eager to play with him when she woke up.

When Lily woke up from her nap, she saw Brownie on her bed. She was so happy and eager to play with him, but she noticed that he was dirty and dusty. So, she decided to rub him with her soft blanket to make him clean and cuddly again.

Lily played with Brownie all day long, and they had so much fun together. When it was time for bed, she hugged Brownie tightly and fell asleep with a big smile on her face. From that day on, Lily made sure to keep Brownie clean and never forgot to rub him with her blanket before taking a nap.

One day, a little girl named Patty was playing in the garden when a big bee came buzzing by. Patty screamed out of surprise and her dad ran over to protect her. He waved his arms in the air and shouted, â€œGo away bee!â€. The bee flew away and Patty felt safe again. 

That night, Pattyâ€™s dad put an alarm in her room to protect her from any scary noises in the night. Patty was a bit sleepy, but she felt safe and hugged the alarm tightly. 

In the morning, Pattyâ€™s mom came in to wake her up. â€œGood morning, sleepyhead!â€, her mom said. Patty hugged the alarm and smiled. She was thankful that her dad had put the alarm in her room to protect her.

Once upon a time, there was a cop. He was an ordinary cop, but he was a very brave one.

One day, he was walking down the street. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise! Quickly, he jumped over a fence and ran towards it.

He saw a little boy jumping on a trampoline in his backyard.

The cop walked over to him and said, â€œWhat are you doing here? You should not be jumping on this trampoline!â€

The little boy smiled and said, â€œI just wanted to have some fun! Please don't take me away.â€

The cop smiled too and said, â€œAlright, you can keep on jumping. But you must be careful and stop when it gets dark. Okay?â€

The little boy nodded and said, â€œYes, sir! I promise I'll be careful!â€

The cop smiled again and walked away. The little boy was so happy he kept on jumping and having a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily who loved playing outside. She always went to the park to pull her wagon and fill it with packages and bundles. One day, Lily went to the park to pull her wagon around, like she always did.

Suddenly, Lily saw a large package. It was wrapped in a bright and shiny paper. She wanted to take it home so she pulled the package until it was close to her wagon.

Lily asked her mom, "What is inside it? Can I open it?"

Her mom replied calmly: "Let's wait until we get home, then we will open it together, ok?"

Lily was very excited and she pulled the package in her wagon faster. Soon they got home and opened the package. Inside it was a big teddy bear! Lily was so happy that she hugged it and named it Bear.

From then on, Lily and Bear were best friends. They always went to the park to pull the wagon together, with lots of packages and bundles.

Once there was a frog. He was hopping around looking for something to eat. All he could see was some leaves and some bugs, but he was still hungry. Suddenly he smelled something delicious.

"What is that smell? I'm so hungry!" croaked the frog. 

He hopped over to the smell and found a man cooking something on the fire.

"What are you cooking?" asked the frog.

"I'm cooking some yummy food. Would you like some?" said the man, who was very friendly.

The frog was so excited. He said, "Yes please! Food would be available to me."

The man gave the frog some of the food and the frog ate it hungrily. It was the best thing he had ever tasted!

"Thank you so much," said the frog happily. "You were so kind to share your food with me. I'm so lucky!" 

The man smiled and said, "You're welcome. It's always nice to share what we have with others." 

From then on, the frog always remembered how kind the man had been and that there was always food available if you needed it.

Once there was a happy, hairy monkey named Jake. Jake liked to eat peaches.

One day, Jake saw a big peach tree in the forest. He was so excited he jumped up and started swinging from branch to branch. When he got to the tree he started adding peaches one by one to his basket.

A frog hopped up to him and said, "What are you doing?"

Jake looked up at the frog, smiled and said, "I'm adding all these peaches to my basket."

The frog smiled and said, "My, they look delicious."

Jake smiled, thanked the frog and said, "Would you like to help me add peaches to my basket too?"

The frog jumped up and said, "Yes! That sounds like fun!"

So Jake and the frog added peaches to the basket until it was full. And they had so much fun doing it.

In the end, Jake thanked the frog and said, "My basket is full of delicious peaches now. Let's go eat them!"

The frog smiled and nodded. They both ran off happily, snacking on peaches as they went.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Amy. She was three years old and loved learning. Every morning she would put her school uniform on and go to class.

One day, Amy was late for school. She was so excited to get there, but when she arrived, the classroom was empty. 

"Where is everyone?" asked Amy. 

Her teacher was standing in the doorway. She smiled and said, "We are learning outside today. Hurry up, let's go!"

Amy and her classmates went outside. It was a beautiful day, so they could learn in the sunshine. They made mud pies, caught caterpillars and looked for bugs in the grass. 

Amy had so much fun that day! She loved learning and was so happy she had a uniform to wear to school.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They found a big bow on the ground. It was red and shiny. Lily wanted to play with it. She said, "This is my bow. I can shoot arrows with it."

Tom wanted to play with it too. He said, "No, this is my bow. I can shoot arrows better than you."

They both pulled the bow. They started to fight. They shouted and pushed each other. They were very angry.

A man saw them fighting. He was pale and had a beard. He said, "Stop fighting, children. That is not your bow. That is my bow. I lost it here yesterday. I need it for my work. I am an archer."

Lily and Tom stopped fighting. They felt sorry. They said, "We are sorry, sir. We did not know it was your bow. We just wanted to play with it. It is very pretty."

The man smiled. He said, "It is okay, children. I forgive you. Do you want to see how I shoot arrows with it?"

Lily and Tom nodded. They said, "Yes, please. That would be fun."

The man took them to a target. He showed them how to hold the bow and aim. He shot an arrow. It hit the bullseye. Lily and Tom clapped. They said, "Wow, you are very good, sir. Can we try too?"

The man said, "Sure, but be careful. The bow is strong and the arrows are sharp. You need to listen to me and follow the rules."

Lily and Tom listened to the man. They took turns to shoot arrows. They had fun. They learned a new skill. They thanked the man. They said, "Thank you, sir. You are very kind. We are sorry for fighting. We will share and play nicely from now on."

The man said, "You are welcome, children. I am glad you learned your lesson. You are very brave and smart. Now, go and enjoy the park. And remember, do not fight over things that are not yours."

Lily and Tom said, "We will, sir. Goodbye."

They waved to the man. They ran to the swings. They played happily. They did not fight anymore. They were friends.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the beach with her mom and dad. They had a fun day playing in the sand and splashing in the water. Lily found a pretty shell that she wanted to show her friends.

When they got back home, Lily had an idea. She wanted to perform a play for her friends with the shell. She put on a comfortable dress and called her friends to come over. She was so happy and excited.

Lily and her friends sat on the floor and she told them a story about the shell. She said that the shell was a magical shell that could sing and dance. Her friends clapped and laughed as Lily performed her play. They all had a great time and loved the story about the magical shell.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tim. He was only three years old, but he really loved to read. One day, Tim wanted to read his books outside the house.

His mom asked, "Tim, what do you need to take outside with you?"
Tim said, "My leash!"

So his mom put on Tim's leash and he went outside. It was sunny, and Tim sat down to read.

He opened his book, but it was difficult. The words were too small, and Tim couldn't understand them.

Suddenly, Tim's mom came out of the house. She said, "Tim, why don't you find a bigger book? That one looks too difficult."

Tim put his book away and started looking for a bigger one. Soon enough, he found one with bigger print. He started to read it and he understood every word.

Tim read for a long time. Then he took off his leash and ran inside for lunch.

Molly the monkey was very clever. She had a plan to drive the skeleton away. She went to a magical store and bought a shiny red car. She got in and put on her seatbelt.

She drove around and around the skeleton, making loud noises and honking her horn. The skeleton was scared and ran away in a hurry. Molly felt so proud of herself.

Molly continued to drive around town, honking her horn and having lots of fun. Everywhere she went, she showed that she was a very clever monkey.

Soon it was time for Molly to go home, but she wanted to drive around just a little bit more. So, she drove to the beach, where she had lots of fun. She drove around in the sand and splashed in the sea. 

At last, Molly drove back home, tired and happy. She had had a wonderful day and she was proud of her clever driving skills.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy loved to organize things and make them tidy. One day, Daisy found a furry leaf on the floor. She decided to organize it and make it look neat.

She grabbed a small box and carefully placed the leaf inside. She took a marker and drew a picture of the furry leaf on the lid. Daisy smiled and was very proud of her work.

She took the box with the leaf inside and placed it on the very top shelf. Every time Daisy would pass by, she'd smile at the box, remembering her good work. 

The furry leaf was now safe, organized and happy!

Once upon a time, there was a wise little rabbit who lived deep in the woods. Every day he made sure to explore new parts of the woods and he was so brave!

One day while exploring he noticed a bright light way off in the distance. He ran over to see what it was and saw a giant fire in the middle of the woods. "Oh no!" the rabbit thought. He knew he had to do something, but he didn't know what. He couldn't put out the fire.

Just then, he remembered something his grandpa told him. He had said,"If you ever get in a tough spot, dive in and see what happens". So the brave bunny dove into the fire.

When he emerged from the flames, he noticed that the fire had gone out. The rabbit had used his wisdom to figure out the best way to handle the dangerous situation. He had realized that by diving into the fire he could create a steam that would put out the fire.

The rabbit was so proud of himself! He had saved the woods from the fire and even learned something new. From now on he would always remember to "dive in" if he ever needed help.

Anna likes to help her mom in the kitchen. She wants to be a good cook like her mom. She puts on a pink apron and stands on a stool. She helps mom stir the soup and cut the bread.

But then, Anna sees a big knife on the counter. She wants to use the knife too. She reaches for it with her hand. Mom sees her and says, "No, Anna, no! The knife is sharp and dangerous. You can hurt yourself. Put it down now!"

Anna is scared and drops the knife. It makes a loud noise on the floor. Mom hugs her and says, "It's okay, Anna. I'm sorry I yelled at you. I just want you to be safe. The knife is not for you. You can use the spoon and the fork. They are safe and fun."

Anna says, "I'm sorry, mom. I didn't know the knife was bad. I just wanted to help you. I love you, mom." Mom says, "I love you too, Anna. You are a good helper. And you look very pretty in your pink apron. Come on, let's finish the soup and the bread. They smell yummy." Anna smiles and nods. She helps mom in the kitchen again. She feels happy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. One day, Jane wanted to go on an adventure with her horse. She went outside and hopped on the horse. The horse began to pass over the grass and Jane was so happy.

Suddenly, they came to a muddy pond. Jane said to her horse, "Let's pass through here, my horse!" But the horse was scared and shaking. Then it said, "No, I'm scared! It is too dirty for me!"

Jane thought about it for a moment. Then she said, "Don't worry! I'll take care of you and make sure you don't get dirty." So Jane and the horse passed through the pond, and Jane made sure the horse was careful and didn't get too dirty.

When they were done, Jane was so proud that she and her horse made it through the muddy pond. She said to her horse, "We did it, my horse! We passed through the muddy pond and we were so brave!" 

And Jane and her horse continued to pass through the grass happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit, who lived in a wood. He hopped along until he came across a white flea. He looked at it very carefully, with his big brown eyes. 

The rabbit was very curious and couldn't help but wonder why the flea was so white. The flea said, "I've been eating a lot of snow!" 

The rabbit was so shocked that he was speechless. He couldn't believe what he had heard. 

The flea thought the rabbit was so cute. He asked, "Would you like to join me for breakfast? I've got some yummy snow over here!" 

The rabbit was very excited, so he nodded and hopped over. They enjoyed their tasty meal together, talking and laughing all morning long. 

At the end of the day, they said goodbye to each other and the white flea hopped away.

The rabbit thought of his white friend fondly whenever he saw the snow.

Jill was so excited to have cereal for breakfast. She jumped up from her chair and began to dance around. "I love cereal! I love cereal!"

Her Mom smiled at her and said, "Oh Jill, I'm so glad you enjoy cereal. What kind do you want this morning?"

Jill quickly replied, "The red one!"

Jill's Dad laughed. "That's your favorite, isn't it? Do you want me to pour it for you?"

Jill nodded and said, "Yes, please!"

Mom and Dad both smiled, as they watched Jill enjoy her cereal. She giggled and scooped up the delicious red cereal with her spoon. 

After she finished, she grinned and said, "Yum, I love red cereal!"

Jack was eager to go to the park. He put on his shoes, hopped out the door, and skipped down the street. But when he arrived at the park he saw something very disappointing. All the swings were full.

Jack frowned. He had really wanted to go on a swing. He looked around, but there was nowhere to sit.

Suddenly, a little girl with long, curly hair appeared. She smiled at Jack and said, "There is room for one more swing if you want to join us!"

Jack smiled. He was so eager to be able to play. The two of them hopped on the swing, Jack on one side and the little girl on the other. As they swung, they sang and laughed together.

The sun was starting to go down, and the two friends reluctantly got off the swing. Jack smiled and thanked the little girl, then waved goodbye.

He couldn't stop smiling as he started his journey back home. Jack was so happy to have made a new friend and to have had the chance to have so much fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a boring day. He played with his toys, but he was not happy. He wanted to do something fun.

One day, Tim noticed a small, round pill on the floor. He did not know what it was. He picked it up and showed it to his mom. She told him it was a pill to help people feel better when they were sick. Tim thought it was interesting.

Tim's mom said, "Let's play a game to make the day fun!" They played a game of hide and seek. Tim hid behind the big chair, and his mom found him. They laughed and had a great time. The boring day turned into a fun day, and Tim was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big castle with a lot of rooms. One day, a little boy named Timmy went inside to explore. He found a big chamber that was very empty. Timmy felt a little scared because it was so quiet. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise that surprised him. It was coming from a door at the end of the chamber. 

Timmy walked towards the door and opened it. Inside, he saw a big monster! The monster was very angry and started to chase Timmy. Timmy ran as fast as he could, trying to find a place to hide. He ran back into the empty chamber and closed the door behind him. 

The monster banged on the door, trying to get in, but Timmy was safe inside. He felt very proud of himself for finding a place to hide. Timmy waited for a long time until he was sure the monster was gone. Then he opened the door and ran out of the castle, feeling very brave.

Once upon a time there was a young boy. His name was John and he loved to play. One day, he was playing in his backyard when he bumped his knee. It really hurt!

John started to cry and his mum came to help him. She was very kind, and gave John a big hug. That made John feel better, because hugs can heal a broken heart.

The next day, John went to the park with his mum. As they walked, they saw a wall that was very high. John was so excited that he wanted to jump and touch it. His mum said, "you can try, but if you hurt yourself again I will have to give you another hug!"

John bravely jumped until he could touch the wall. He did it! His mum gave him a tasty treat to celebrate his success.

John's knee soon healed, but he will never forget the day he jumped to touch the wall.

Once there was a large dog named Jog. He lived in a big house in the country. Every morning, Jog would go for a long jog and enjoy the warm sun.

One day, Jog's owners decided it was time to remove him from their home. They thought he was getting to be too large for them to take care of. Jog was sad to say goodbye to his home and family.

The next day, Jog found himself in a new house on a big farm. He was so excited to explore his new home. Every day, Jog went for long jogs around the farm. He soon made lots of new friends who joined him on his jogs.

Jog still misses his old home and family, but he is happy to have found a loving new home on the farm. He never goes without his daily jog!

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a clean, shiny treasure. The treasure was hidden under a tall tree. Many animals lived in the forest, but no one knew where the treasure was.

One day, a little rabbit was hopping around the forest. He saw the tall tree and wanted to stand near it. As he stood there, he saw something shiny under the tree. He dug and dug, and found the clean treasure.

The little rabbit was so happy to find the treasure. He shared it with all his animal friends in the forest. They all played with the treasure and had a lot of fun. From that day on, the animals always stood near the tall tree and played with their clean, shiny treasure.

Teddy woke up in the morning and felt happy. He wanted to go outside and play. He hopped out of his bed and went to find his mom.

He found her in the kitchen and said, "Mom, can I play outside?" She smiled and said, "Yes, Teddy, you can go outside and play."

He ran to the door and opened it. The sun was shining on the other side. He looked up at the big, blue sky and saw a few white fluffy clouds floating around. He smiled and went off to play.

He saw a group of kids playing ball on the other side of the park. He wanted to join in, so he crossed over and said hi. The kids were happy to have him. They started to play the game.

Teddy was popular with the kids because he was really good at the game. He could kick the ball really far and everyone cheered when he did it.

He was so happy and felt really proud! He knew he was a star! He smiled and felt that everything was right in the world. He knew he'd always love this game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved drinking milk. Every morning, her mommy would pour her a glass of milk and she would drink it all up. One day, while Lily was drinking her milk, her mommy said, "Lily, do you know how to count?" 

Lily shook her head no. "Let's count the milk cartons in the fridge," her mommy said. They walked to the kitchen and opened the fridge. There were five cartons of milk inside. "One, two, three, four, five," they counted together. 

Later that day, Lily was playing in the backyard when she saw a big dog. She wanted to pet the dog, but her mommy said, "No, Lily. That dog is not safe. We don't know him." Lily remembered what her mommy said and stayed away from the dog. 

The next day, Lily's mommy poured her a glass of milk and said, "Let's count the cartons again." They walked to the kitchen and opened the fridge, but there were only four cartons left. "Uh oh, we need to buy more milk," her mommy said.

Once upon a time there was a fly. She was small and quiet and wanted to explore the world. One day, she had an idea and wanted to share it with everyone. She flew off to the very distant tree to tell everyone her big idea.

When she arrived, she saw all the animals gathered around the tree, listening to a big bird. They were all excited about the bird's idea. The fly couldn't believe it and was so angry. She spoke out, "No, my idea is much better!â€

The animals laughed at her. They all thought her idea was silly and they didn't believe she had anything important to say. The fly was so upset. She became very angry and decided to prove them all wrong by releasing her idea into the air.

But her idea was never heard. As soon as it was released, a strong wind blew it away and it was never seen again. The animals all laughed and were happy to have the big bird's idea back in the centre of attention.

The moral of the story is that it's important to be kind and not put others down. Everyone has the right to express their ideas, even if they don't seem important to others. Showing respect, even if other's ideas seem silly or distant, can result in a much better outcome.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to go on adventures with her teddy bear named Teddy. One day, Lily and Teddy went on a walk in the park. 

Lily saw a butterfly and said, "Look Teddy, that butterfly is so interesting!" Teddy replied, "Wow, it's so pretty!" 

As they continued to walk, Lily saw a big zip on her jacket. She said, "Teddy, can you help me zip my jacket?" Teddy replied, "Of course, I can carry your jacket too!" 

Lily and Teddy continued their adventure in the park, happy and content with each other's company.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom took her to the train station to go on a trip. Lily was very excited to ride on the train. 

When they got to the station, Lily saw a silly clown. The clown was juggling and making funny faces. Lily laughed and said, "Mom, look at that silly clown! He's so funny!" 

Suddenly, Lily's mom realized she forgot her ticket at home. She was worried they wouldn't be able to go on the train. But then, the silly clown came over and said, "I can help you! I have a friend who works at the station. Maybe she can help us." 

The clown went to talk to his friend and came back with a ticket for Lily's mom. Lily was so happy they could ride on the train. She said to the clown, "Thank you for helping us! You're the best!" And they all got on the train and went on a fun adventure.

Joey saw a big top and wanted to go inside to have some fun. He skipped through the entrance and saw a big wheel spinning round and round. It was so shiny and sparkly that it made him smile. He ran up to it and grabbed hold of one of the spokes. Together with the other children, they all held on tight, shouting with excitement and spinning faster and faster. 

The wheel kept spinning and spinning and after a few turns it suddenly stopped. Joey had reached his goal! He was thrilled and cheered loudly, marking his victory with a gentle fist pump. 

After a mild pause, Joey and the others got up and ran back to the entrance. Joey said goodbye to his new friends and thanked them for playing, with a warm hug for everyone. Soon enough, the children were all back inside the big top, just in time to watch the next show.

One day, a small boy named James was outside playing in his garden. He saw something very special. It was a black kangaroo! James was so excited to be able to watch this kangaroo.

He watched as the kangaroo hopped around in the grass looking for something to eat. As it hopped, it hopped towards James. James was so happy! He was so close to the kangaroo and he couldn't believe it.

James wanted to get closer to the kangaroo, so he reached out his hand. The kangaroo sniffed it and let James pet him. The kangaroo was very soft, and James enjoyed petting him.

James watched and enjoyed the kangaroo for a while. Then, he watched as the kangaroo hopped away and disappeared into the trees. James smiled and ran back inside his house to tell his family about his special black kangaroo.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Shelly. She always went to the park to play. One day, Shelly saw a big shadow on the ground, and it made her very scared. 

She slowly tiptoed to the shadow and slowly said, "Who are you?"

The shadow spoke in a friendly voice and said, "I am Solomon, the magical lion. I have come to test your bravery. If you do not surrender, I will take you away with me." 

Shelly was very scared, but she was also brave, so she stood up tall and said, "I will not surrender, I am not foolish!" 

Solomon the magical lion then laughed and said, "Well done Shelly, you have passed my test. You are brave and you will be rewarded. As your prize, I shall give you magical wings!"

Shelly was so happy with her reward, she ran off with her new wings to tell all of her friends about her adventure. And from that day on, no shadow scared her ever again.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a cat and a dog. They liked to play all day. One day, they saw a shiny chain on the floor. They both wanted it.

The cat had an idea. She rubbed her head on the dog's leg. The dog felt happy and closed his eyes. The cat took the chain and ran away. The dog felt sad and guilty.

Later, the cat felt bad. She went back to the dog and gave him the chain. They both played with the chain and were happy friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a big, mean dragon. He liked to destroy things for fun. One day, he saw a post and he wanted to destroy it. So, he breathed fire on the post and it broke into little pieces. 

But then, a kind, deaf bunny came along. He didn't hear the dragon coming, but he saw the post was broken. He felt sad because the post was important to him. The bunny asked the dragon why he destroyed the post. 

The dragon felt bad for making the bunny sad. He apologized and promised to never destroy anything again. The bunny forgave the dragon and they became friends. They even found a new post and fixed it together. The end.

The girl had come up with a new way to tie things. She was glad she had thought of this mild and fun idea.

Once upon a time, there was a dependable, little boy. He loved to wander around looking for treats. One day, he decided to wander a bit further than usual. 

"Be careful, Little Boy," his mom warned.

He looked around the corner and noticed a tall, wooden tub filled with bubbling dough. He watched in amazement as the baker scooped up the dough with his hands and carefully placed it in the oven to bake. When the delicious smells drifted through the air, he knew that it was time to return home with his newfound treat. 

Little Boy was very excited to tell his mom about his day. As soon as he arrived back home, she smiled and said, "I told you the bakery would have something special in store for you." 

Little Boy remembered his mom's words and realized that he had been dependable. He had found an amazing bakery that he could rely on for special treats. From that day on, he would visit the bakery whenever he wished to wander around and get his delicious treat.

Once upon a time there was a nice lady who loved to cook. She cooked everything, and she was very good at it.

One day, the lady was cooking dinner and she needed something to drink. She went to her cupboard and found a big, clear glass. It was very pretty.

The lady filled the glass with water from the sink and took it to the table. She was very polite and thank the glass for helping her.

The lady enjoyed her dinner, and felt so happy that she could cook for herself. She thanked the glass once again and put it away.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who liked to spend her time reading books. One day, she asked her mom for a novel. Her mom shook her head and said that it was very expensive. The little girl was sad, but her mom had an idea. She asked the little girl to search the library for books instead. The little girl was so excited! She ran to the library and soon found a novel that she really liked. It was full of wonderful stories, and she felt so happy. The novel was not expensive, so she asked her mom if she could take it home. With a smile, her mom said yes. The little girl was so happy that she could take home her favorite novel. She thanked her mom and ran off to enjoy her new book.

Tiny was very scared, but she was brave. She was playing in the park and when she found a cocoa bean she was so excited! She held it in her hand and touched it, it felt strange and she wasn't sure what to do.
