The little girl didn't understand why anyone would hate such a beautiful temple. So she walked around and looked at everything with her gentle eyes. Soon, she began to understand why people didn't like the temple. She realized it was dark and there was a feeling of sadness in the air.

The little girl decided to make a change. She lit some candles to make the temple brighter. She found some happy music and played it. She made the temple feel lighter and more welcoming.

The people in the village soon noticed the change. They stopped hating the temple. It was now a place that they could visit and admire. The little girl had made a big difference with her gentle heart.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby beehive. It flew around looking for food. One day, it decided to sail away. It flew high in the sky, looking down on the world below.

The beehive sailed over land and sea. Eventually, it saw a big, beautiful lake. The beehive decided to land there. As it floated down, it heard the sound of music coming from the lake.

The beehive circled around until it found the source of the music. Inside the lake was a chubby boat with people singing and dancing. The beehive joined in their fun and the people welcomed it with open arms.

The beehive stayed with the people and they all sailed away together. The lake was full of adventure and the beehive felt at home. As they floated away, they looked back at the lake with fond memories.

Once upon a time, there was a frog named Freddy. Freddy lived in a pond with his friends. One day, Freddy saw a beautiful frog named Lily. He asked her, "Will you marry me?" Lily said, "Yes!"

Freddy was so happy, but his friends were miserable. They didn't like Lily because she was different from them. They said, "We don't want you to marry her, Freddy." But Freddy loved Lily and didn't listen to his friends.

Finally, Freddy and Lily got married by the pond. All of their friends came to the wedding and saw how happy Freddy was with Lily. They realized that being different was okay and they all became friends again. Freddy and Lily lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max liked to carry his favorite toy, a red ball, everywhere he went. One day, Max saw some different dogs playing with a different ball. He wanted to play with them too, but he didn't want to leave his red ball behind. 

Suddenly, Max heard some loud noises and saw some police cars driving by. The different dogs got scared and ran away, but Max was brave. He picked up his red ball and followed the police cars to see what was happening. 

When Max got there, he saw that the police were helping some people who were hurt. Max felt proud that he had helped too by carrying his red ball to the scene. From that day on, Max learned that even though things may be different, he could always help in his own way.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play together in the park. One day, they find a big jacket on a bench. It is red and soft and warm.

"Look, Tom, a jacket!" Sara says. "Let's try it on!"

They take turns wearing the jacket. They pretend they are superheroes and pirates and astronauts. They have a lot of fun.

"Tom, do you want to marry me?" Sara asks. She remembers her mom and dad are married and they love each other.

"Okay, Sara, I will marry you," Tom says. He thinks Sara is kind and pretty and smart.

They hold hands and walk to the big tree. They say, "I do, I do, I do." They hug and kiss. They are happy.

Then they hear a voice.

"Hey, that's my jacket!" The voice says. It is a big boy. He looks angry.

Sara and Tom are scared. They drop the jacket and run away. They hide behind the slide.

"Sorry, sorry, sorry," they whisper. They hope the big boy will not find them.

They wait until the big boy leaves. Then they come out of their hiding place.

"Tom, are we still married?" Sara asks.

"Yes, Sara, we are still married," Tom says. "But we don't need a jacket. We have each other."

They smile and hug. They are happy.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tommy who was three years old. Tommy had a big adventure one day. He saw a car stuck in a ditch and knew he had to save it. 

Tommy pushed and pulled with all his might. He tried so hard he almost fell in the ditch! 

Tommy looked for help and saw a group of impressive men walking by. He yelled out, "Help me save the car!" 

The impressive men stopped and said, "We will help you save it, Tommy. You have been so brave!" 

Tommy and the men worked together to push the car out of the ditch. At last they were successful. 

The impressive men cheered, "Hurray! Tommy saved the car!" With a smile, Tommy replied, "That was fun! Let's do it again!"

Once there was a generous bear. He liked to help others and was always very kind. But he had one habit that no one really knew about: he loved to eat clay!

Every day he would go outside and search for clay in the woods. Then he would find a quiet spot, sit down and take a bite of the delicious clay. 

One day, he stumbled across two little kittens. They were feeling scared and alone, so the bear was very generous. He shared some of his clay with them and the kittens were so happy.

The bear and the kittens became fast friends, and they would go out into the woods every day searching for clay. Sure enough, they always seemed to find enough clay for everyone, and soon enough it became a daily ritual.

It was a wonderful friendship that would last for years - and all because of the generous bear, who was always willing to share his clay with others.

Once upon a time there was a young boy who loved going on adventures. Every Wednesday he would take his little bike out to explore the woods near his house. 

One Wednesday he was riding along a path when he heard a loud groaning coming from a nearby bush. He cautiously went over to see what was wrong and noticed a little badger had gotten its paw stuck in a thorny bush. 

The young boy knew he had to help the badger, even though it looked tough. He gently reached in and carefully started untangling the thorns from around the badger's paw. When he was done, he used his other hand to support the badger and help it back out of the bush. 

"Thanks!" said the badger. "I was so scared I wouldn't be able to get out!"

The young boy smiled, glad he had been able to help. From that day on, he was even more eager for Wednesdays to come around and go on his next adventure.

One day, Jane and her mom went on a trip to the beach. Jane was excited to be by the water. She could see the sparkling blue ocean, and the white sand. Jane and her mom decided to go for a kayak ride.

Jane was having so much fun paddling around in the kayak. But then something disturbed her, a big splash! She looked over and saw a dolphin jumping out of the water. Jane was charmed.

"Mom, look at the dolphin!" Jane said. 

"Oh it's so charming," her mom replied.

Jane was mesmerized by the dolphin, and she never wanted the kayak ride to end. Soon they were back on land and watching the Dolphin swim away. Jane waved goodbye, and was so happy she was able to experience this special adventure.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sarah. She loved to explore and was always curious about the world.

One day, Sarah was playing in her backyard when she heard a strange noise. She stopped to listen, then looked around. She couldn't see anything, so Sarah asked her mom: "Mom, what was that noise?"

Her mom replied, "That's the police, sweetheart. They are looking for something."

Sarah was intrigued, and asked, "What are they looking for?"

Her mom said, "I don't know. We can go take a look. Come on!"

So, Sarah and her mom walked down the street to watch the police search. The police were being very persistent and searching everywhere - but they couldn't find what they were looking for.

Sarah stayed and watched until the police gave up, then headed home with her mom. 

That night, Sarah dreamed of being a detective, searching the world and finding things that nobody else could. One day, she thought, she would be brave and persistent enough to be the one who could help the police find what they were looking for.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Tom. He was a generous boy, who always shared his things with others. One day, Tom found a chest in the garden. It was filled with lots of lovely things that he wanted to own. But the chest belonged to a mean man. He was not generous like Tom.

Tom was sad and tried to explain to the mean man that he was only being generous. But the mean man did not care and shouted at Tom. He said that Tom had to give the chest back or he would be in trouble. 

So Tom sadly returned the chest and said goodbye. He never saw the chest again and was not able to own it. Tom was very sad. He had learnt his lesson - some things you just can't share. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Molly. She was three years old and loved to play.

One day, Molly was looking through her mummy's messy drawer when she stumbled across a strange book. She picked it up and saw the word 'dictionary' written on the front. She was so curious, she just had to take a closer look.

Molly opened the dictionary and saw lots of strange words that she didn't understand. She started to worry and wondered what all the words meant.

Just then, Molly's mum walked in and noticed that Molly was holding the dictionary. She said to Molly, "Don't worry my darling, a dictionary is a book filled with lots of words and their meanings".

Molly replied, "Oh, so it's like a fun puzzle?"

Molly's mum smiled and said, "Yes, it sure is! Why don't we look through it together and see what we can learn?"

Molly was so excited and the two of them sat down and began reading the dictionary. It was so much fun and Molly learned something new that day.

There were two friends named Tom and Joe. Tom asked Joe, "What is for lunch today?" Joe replied, "I made a very creative salad." Tom was excited. He asked, "Can I come eat it with you?" Joe laughed and said, "Of course!"

So the boys went to Joe's house for lunch. When they arrived, the salad was ready. Tom looked at the table and said, "What a beautiful salad!" The boys began to eat the delicious meal.

Suddenly, Joe lost his fork. Tom saw this and said, "Don't worry, Joe. We can be creative and find another way to eat the salad." Joe smiled and said, "Good idea!" In the end, they used two spoons instead of a fork.

Anna and Ben like to play with their toys. They have many toys of different shapes and colors. Sometimes they make a mess and their mom tells them to sort their toys. Sorting means putting the same toys together in a box or a basket.

One day, Anna and Ben found a new toy in their room. It was a big truck with lights and sounds. It looked very modern and cool. They wanted to play with it, but they did not know how to make it work.

"Maybe it needs power," Anna said. "Power means something that makes things go or light up."

"Where can we get power?" Ben asked.

"Maybe from the wall," Anna said. She pointed to a socket where their lamp was plugged in. "The lamp gets power from the wall. Maybe the truck can too."

Anna and Ben took the truck and the cord that came with it. They unplugged the lamp and plugged the truck into the socket. They waited for something to happen, but nothing did.

"Maybe it is broken," Ben said. He was sad.

"Maybe we need to press a button," Anna said. She looked at the truck and saw a red button on the side. She pressed it and the truck came to life. It made a loud noise and started to move. It bumped into the wall and the bed and the toys.

"Wow, it works!" Anna said. She was happy.

"Look out, it is going to hit us!" Ben said. He was scared.

Anna and Ben ran away from the truck. They did not know how to stop it. They wished they had sorted their toys before. Maybe then they would have found the instructions for the truck. They hoped their mom would come soon and help them.

One day, a little girl named Julia went exploring in the woods. She found a unique crystal! It was sparkly and shiny and very pretty. She wanted to keep it, so she put it in her pocket and kept walking.

Suddenly, Julia heard a mysterious voice. It said "Tell me! Tell me!" She looked all around, but she couldn't see anyone. Julia was scared, so she just stayed where she was.

Then the voice said again, "Tell me about the crystal!" Julia went closer and saw that it was a fairy who was talking to her! She told the fairy all about the unique crystal she had found.

The fairy smiled, and said "I'm so glad you found the special crystal. You can keep it if you like." Julia smiled too, and thanked the fairy. Then she said goodbye and went running back home, happy with her special crystal.

Once upon a time there was a sack. It was made of a flexible material and was filled with bones. Inside the sack was a skeleton! The skeleton had flexible hands and it could move around inside the sack.

The skeleton had a plan. It wanted to get out of the sack, but it was hard. It tried to push the flexible material of the sack but it kept sliding back into place.

Then it had an idea. The skeleton used its flexible hands and pulled apart the flexible material. It was difficult work but the skeleton was determined. Slowly the skeleton pushed the pieces of material apart until the sack was open. 

The skeleton was free! It jumped out of the sack and went on a great adventure. It never forgot the sack that had kept it for so long and was thankful for its flexible material.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to help his mommy clean the house. One day, Timmy's mommy asked him to help her clean the windows. Timmy was so proud that he could help his mommy.

Timmy got a ladder so he could reach the high windows. He climbed up and down the ladder to clean the windows. His mommy was happy that Timmy was helping her.

After they finished cleaning, Timmy's mommy gave him a big hug and told him how proud she was of him. Timmy felt happy that he could help his mommy and make her proud.

Jim took his car to the park. He saw so many cars driving along the traffic. He was very smart and knew to drive carefully. He parked his car carefully between the other cars. He parked it in the right spot and looked around to make sure it was safe. 

Jim hopped out of the car. He waved to all the other cars as they drove by. He felt so smart, parking his car like a pro. Jim then went to explore and have fun at the park. He ran and laughed when he saw many other children playing too. 

Jim stayed at the park until it was late. He knew it was time to go home and he was sad to leave. He got back into the car and drove off. He drove safely along the traffic and parked his car back home. 

Jim knew he did a good job. He was very smart and he was glad about that. He smiled and gave himself a pat on the back for parking his car safely.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to draw with his pastel crayons. One day, Benny's friend, a little bird, asked him if he wanted to play outside. Benny said, "No, I want to draw." The little bird said, "Okay, I'll come back later."

Benny drew all day and gained a lot of confidence in his drawing skills. But when he looked outside, he saw that it was dark. He felt confused because he didn't realize how much time had passed. He went to bed feeling proud of his drawings.

The next morning, Benny woke up to find that all of his drawings were ruined because he had left them out in the rain. Benny was very sad and wished he had gone outside to play with his friend instead.

Once there was a panda, who lived in the forest. She was very pretty and loved to measure things. One day the panda saw a butterfly and said, "Let me measure you!" The butterfly fluttered away, saying, "No thank you!" 

The panda then saw a squirrel and asked, "Will you be measured?" But the squirrel just scurried away. The panda felt sad, until a bee buzzed past and said, "I'll be measured!" 

The panda was so happy that she jumped and clapped her hands. She carefully measured the bee and said, "You are very pretty and just the right size!" The bee thanked her and flew away. 

The panda continued to measure flowers, birds, and trees. She was so happy, and she knew that measuring all the things in the forest made them even prettier.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty king who loved to bake. He would bake cakes, cookies, and pies every day. One day, he wanted to bake a special cake for his daughter's birthday.

He asked the baker, "Can you help me bake a cake for my daughter's birthday?"

The baker replied, "Of course, Your Majesty. What kind of cake would you like?"

The king said, "I want a cake with lots of stringy frosting and sprinkles on top. It must be the best cake ever!"

The baker smiled and said, "I will bake the most delicious cake for your daughter's birthday. It will be the talk of the town!" And so, the baker and the king worked together to bake the most amazing cake ever.

Once upon a time there was a curious little girl named Macy. She had a bright smile and loved to explore her neighbourhood. Every day, Macy would go outside with her rod and clean the pond in her backyard.

One day, while Macy was washing the leaves in the pond, she heard a funny noise. She looked around and saw a frog hopping around. 

Macy asked the frog, 'What are you doing here?' 

The frog croaked, 'I'm just here to take a swim!'

Macy smiled and said, 'That's fun. Can I help you?' 

The frog hopped onto a leaf and said, 'Sure!'

Macy and the frog worked together to clean the pond. They picked out the leaves and the sticks, and popped the bubbles in the water. Macy was so curious about the frog's life, she asked him lots of questions while they worked.

At the end of the day, Macy said goodbye to the frog and thanked him for all of his help. The frog gave Macy a big hug and hopped away. 

Macy looked around her clean pond and smiled. It was the perfect day!

Once upon a time there was a pretty octopus. It had eight long tentacles and it made a lot of friends in the sea. It would swim around with its friends and have fun every day.

One day, it noticed a little box. It swam over and looked inside. To its surprise, there were lots of colourful toys in the box. It was so excited and wanted to play with them, so it reached in with two of its tentacles and grabbed a few.

Suddenly the box shut! The octopus was stuck. It tried to push open the box but it wouldn't open. It knew it had to find help.

The octopus swam over to the nearest coral reef and asked all the sea creatures for help but none of them could open the box. Just then, a big passing whale swam by. The octopus asked for its help and the whale said it could try. It came closer and used its big snout to push the box open.

The octopus was free! It thanked the whale and was so happy to be able to play with its toys. And, it was thankful to have such a kind and helpful whale as a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a princess. She had a pretty dress and a shiny crown. One day, she was eating a big slice of cake. But then, she accidentally got some frosting on her face. She felt embarrassed because all the other princesses were looking at her. But her friend came over and wiped the frosting off her face. Then, they both laughed and ate more cake. The end.

There was once a small diamond. It was so beautiful that every time it sparkled, the sun hid behind the clouds. The sun knew it was no match for the diamond's shine. Every day, the diamond stayed in a box that didn't close.

One day, the sun came out from the clouds and shined brightly on the diamond. A small child saw the sparkle of the diamond and wanted to share it with the world. She found a box with a lid and put the diamond inside. She was glad she had picked this box because it didn't have a lock, but it did have a lid. The child closed the lid carefully and smiled. Everyone in the world could now enjoy the diamond's sparkles!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy fell down and hurt his arm. His mom took him to the hospital and the doctor said he broke a bone in his arm. Timmy felt very helpless because he couldn't use his arm and it hurt a lot.

But the doctor said not to worry, because the bone would heal. Timmy had to wear a cast on his arm for a few weeks. His friends came to visit him and they drew pictures on his cast. Timmy felt happy because he knew his bone would heal and he would be able to play with his friends again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat that wanted to sail across the sea. The boat was very slow, but it had a hero who was very strong. The hero was a big man with a big heart. He knew how to sail the boat, and he loved to do it.

One day, the boat and the hero were sailing across the sea when they saw a big storm coming. The storm was very strong, and it made the boat go very slow. The hero said, "We need to go faster! We need to sail faster!" But the boat could not go any faster.

Then, the hero had an idea. He said, "I will be the sail! I will use my big arms to push the boat faster!" And so, the hero became the sail, and he pushed the boat faster and faster. They sailed through the storm, and they made it to the other side of the sea.

The boat was very happy, and it said to the hero, "You are my hero! You saved me from the storm!" And the hero smiled and said, "I am happy to be your hero. I love to sail with you."

Once upon a time, there were two friends. They were best friends, and they liked each other very much. On a cold and windy day, the friends went outside their house and sat in the garden. They were both wearing their warmest clothes and had their blankets to keep themselves cozy.

The friends wanted to have lots of fun and play together, so they opened their blankets wide and made a cozy shelter. Inside their shelter, they were very safe and they felt very happy.

The friendly friends laughed and talked and enjoyed each others company. They looked up at the stars and shared funny stories. They stayed inside the blanket until dinner time. 

When dinner time arrived, the friends opened the blanket, folded it up and went inside the house for dinner. 

The friends had enjoyed a lot of fun and laughter under the friendly blanket.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Bob. Bob loved to play with his toys and be with his friends.

One day Bob and his friends went to the park with his mom. It was a really nice day, but Bob's mom warned him to not go too far.

As the kids were playing, they came across a big, round cake. It looked so yummy that they all wanted a piece. But when they looked closer, they saw that it was filthy.

Bob's friend, Lisa said, "Let's still eat it!" But Bob's mom quickly shouted, "Stop!"

Everyone stopped and looked at Bob's mom. She said, "You can't eat a filthy cake. It's not safe!"

The kids all said, "Sorry". And they didn't touch the cake again. They had to take the yummy looking cake home with them. 

The end.

David was so excited for his new bed. He ran through the toy store and pointed with excitement at the bright yellow bed that he wanted to buy. His mom smiled and decided to buy it for him. 

When they got home they put the bed together in David's room. He was so proud of it and spent a few hours playing with his toys in it. 

But as the night grew darker, David started to be tired so his mom decided it was time for bed. She tucked him in, but when she closed the door, David thought he saw some things move around in his bed. He was scared so he decided to ignore it. 

In the morning, when David woke up, he saw his room was a big mess. His bed was the messiest of all, with toys everywhere. David was very sad because he knew his mom wouldn't be happy. He had decided to invite some of his toys into his bed and that is why it was such a mess. 

He knew he had made a bad decision and he didn't know how his mom would react. She was very angry when she saw the mess and knew it was all because of David's decision. He was so sorry that he couldn't undo what he had done.

Rena had a flag. It was a special flag that was very important to her. She held it tight and flew it high. One day, her best friend, Tim, saw the flag. He asked Rena to lend it to him. Rena said yes and Tim promised to take good care of it. He flew it high and waved it in the wind. It felt like it was waving hello to the whole world. Everyone around was so happy to see the flag. When Tim was finished, he gave the flag back to Rena. She thanked him for taking care of it. They waved the flag goodbye as they went their separate ways.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anne. She had a special blanket with her everywhere she went. It was her best friend. The blanket had a stitch on it that Anne loved to protect. Everywhere Anne went, her blanket followed. 

One day, Anne went to the park and met a nosy dog. She loved the curious pup and wanted to take it home. But Anne knew she couldn't protect the pup like she did her blanket. Anne told the pup, "I wish I could take you with me but my blanket needs protecting more." 

The pup understood and said, "It's okay. I want you to keep protecting your blanket. I will be here waiting for you." Anne hugged and thanked the pup and went on her way with her blanket. From then onward, Anne made sure to protect her blankie even more.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved festivals, so when she heard about a big festival, she was very excited. She begged her mom to take her. Her mom said "yes", so she got ready for the big day.

When the day came, Lily felt so happy. She was surrounded by all the decorations and lots of people. There was singing and dancing and lots of food. She was so excited to try all the treats.

But as she was eating, she saw a lot of people being very mean to each other. They were fighting and arguing and being spoiled. Lily was so sad and filled with worry.

When the festival was over, Lily's mom asked her how it was. But Lily didn't want to talk about it, she just wanted to go home and forget about the bad things she had seen. She was so disappointed and felt very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny. The bunny liked to eat carrots and lettuce. One day, the bunny found a sword in the forest. The bunny thought the sword was shiny and pretty. The bunny picked up the sword and brought it back to its burrow. The bunny tried to eat the sword, but it was too hard. The bunny decided to keep the sword as a treasure instead. The end.

Once there was a sweet little girl called Emily. She was three years old and she was very happy. One day, she was playing with her two best friends, Jack and Amy.

The three of them were laughing and having a great time together. Suddenly, Emily had an idea. She said to them, "Let's see who can climb the highest up the tree!"

Jack and Amy were very jealous. They both wanted to be the one who went higher. Emily laughed and said, "It's okay, we can all do it!"

So the three of them started climbing. Jack and Amy were a bit faster but Emily stayed at the top for the longest. When she came down, she was beaming and happy. She said, "My heart is so full that I can't stop laughing!"

Everyone was so happy that they hugged each other and laughed. They had a great day together, and Emily was extra happy because she had made her friends laugh.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her toys and have fun with her friends. One day, Lucy saw her mom's makeup on the table. She thought it was pretty and wanted to try it on her face.

Lucy put the makeup on her face and felt very happy. But then, she noticed that she made a big mess on the table and her mom's makeup was all over the place. Lucy felt guilty because she knew she should not have touched her mom's things without asking.

When her mom came home, she saw the mess and asked Lucy what happened. Lucy told her mom the truth and said sorry. Her mom forgave her and told her that it is important to ask before using someone else's things. From that day on, Lucy learned to always ask for permission and to be more careful with other people's things.

Once upon a time, there was a small ship that sailed across the sea. It was very cold, so the crew all wore big coats and hats as they sailed through the air.

One particular morning, the crew part from the shore. They thought that the voyage was going to be a happy one. Little did they know, a storm was brewing on the horizon.

The captain could see the storm darkness ahead, but he hoped that the ship could outrun it. As the waves grew higher and higher, the ship started to shake. The crew started to become scared.

The first mate looked at the storm and said with a shaky voice, "The storm is too strong, we won't make it."

The crew started to panic as the storm grew larger and larger. They knew that a bad end was coming. The ship eventually sank, and all of the crew perished in the cold sea.

Once there was a girl named Jane. She was playing with her toys in her bedroom. Suddenly, something out of the window caught her eye. Jane saw a bright dragonfly waving its wings outside her window.

"Wow!" said Jane in disbelief. She opened the window and the dragonfly flew in. Jane was thrilled and held out her hand for the dragonfly to land on.

The dragonfly flew away and made a little swirl in the air, leaving a spiraling trail of black ink. Jane held out her hand again, but the dragonfly was gone. 

But the trail of ink stayed. Jane clapped her hands as she saw the beautiful original design that had just been created. She smiled and waved goodbye to her magical friend.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a big red car. She loved to put things in the car boot. One day, she went to the park with her mom and dad. Before they left, Lily put her toys in the boot. But she was careless and did not shut the boot all the way.

At the park, Lily had so much fun. She played with her ball and her doll. She ran and laughed all day. The sun began to set and it was time to go home. Lily and her parents walked back to the car. 

When they got to the car, they saw that the boot was open. Lily's toys were gone! She was very sad. Her mom and dad told her it was important to shut the boot next time. From that day on, Lily was never careless with the boot again. She always made sure to shut it tight, so her toys would be safe.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Poppy. She loved to explore the world around her. 

One sunny day, Poppy went outside and saw a puddle. She opened the puddle and hopped right inside, feeling the cool water rush around her.

Suddenly, a troubled-looking bird flew down. Poppy looked up in surprise and asked, â€œWhatâ€™s wrong? Why are you so troubled?â€

The bird responded, â€œIâ€™m caught in a net and canâ€™t get out!â€

The bird smiled and thanked Poppy for helping him out. Poppy taught us a valuable lesson: itâ€™s important to help others in need.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Suzy. One day, Suzy wanted to comb her hair. She looked for her comb but it was no where to be found. She asked her Mom, â€œMom, whereâ€™s my comb?â€ Her Mom replied, â€œI donâ€™t know. Letâ€™s look for it.â€ So they looked around the house but it was still nowhere to be found. 

They finally found the comb in an empty drawer. Suzyâ€™s Mom said, â€œIt looks like we have to work to find things sometimes!â€ Suzy was happy and took her comb. She combed her hair and looked so pretty.

Tom and Sue are friends. They like to play together. One day, they visit a new country with their moms. The country has many animals and trees.

"Look, Tom, a big lion!" Sue says. She points to a cage. The lion has yellow fur and sharp teeth.

"Wow, Sue, he is scary!" Tom says. He holds his mom's hand. He does not want to go near the cage.

But Sue is careless. She runs to the cage. She wants to touch the lion. She does not listen to her mom.

"Sue, stop! It is dangerous!" her mom shouts. She runs after Sue.

But it is too late. Sue puts her hand through the bars. The lion bites her hand. Sue screams. She is hurt.

Tom and his mom hear Sue scream. They run to help her. They see blood on her hand.

"Oh, Sue, you are silly!" Tom says. He is sad and angry. He does not want Sue to be hurt.

"I'm sorry, Tom. I'm sorry, mom. I was careless. I wanted to see the lion. I did not think he would bite me." Sue says. She cries. She is sorry and scared.

Her mom hugs her. She calls a doctor. The doctor comes and helps Sue. He puts a bandage on her hand. He says she will be okay.

Tom and his mom hug Sue too. They say they are glad she is okay. They say they still love her. But they also say she has to be careful. She has to listen to her mom. She has to respect the animals.

Sue nods. She says she learned her lesson. She says she will be careful. She says she loves Tom and her mom too.

They all smile. They decide to leave the lion alone. They go to see other animals. They have fun. They enjoy their visit to the new country.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to play with his toys. One day, he was playing in his garden when he heard a loud noise. He was very scared and asked his mom what was happening.

His mom told him there was nothing to worry about, and asked him to go on playing. Jack was worried, but he agreed and went back to his garden.

Suddenly, Jack heard the noise again, and this time it was even louder. He was really scared and peeped around the corner to see what it was.

To Jack's surprise, he saw a giant pistol lying on the ground! He was so scared but slowly walked up to it and touched it with his finger.

Just then he heard his mom's voice. She ran up to him and quickly picked up the pistol and hugged him. She told Jack that he should not be playing with such dangerous things. She said that if anything, he should have gone back to his garden.
