Adam and his mom went to a restaurant one day. Adam was excited because he loves to try new things. The restaurant had a big menu on the wall. It had lots of strange-looking things on it, which made Adam feel a bit worried.

Adam's mom asked him what he wanted to eat. He didn't know, so he just pointed to one of the weird options. His mom said "That sounds interesting, let's try it!"

They ate their meal and it was really good. Adam was quite surprised, but he liked it a lot! After they finished, the waitress came over and said "Was everything ok?" and Adam smiled and said "Yes!"

The waitress said "Great, I'm glad you liked it." Adam's mom thanked the waitress, and then they both happily left the restaurant. 

Adam and his mom had a really good time. It was nice to work together to try something new and different. Eating at the restaurant was weird and wonderful!

Once upon a time, there was a lonely little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play outside in the park. One day, Tim saw a big tree with many sticks on the ground.

Tim thought it would be fun to collect the sticks. He picked up one stick, then two sticks, then three sticks. Soon, he had a big pile of sticks. Tim was very happy.

A little girl named Sue saw Tim and his sticks. She asked if she could play too. Tim said yes, and they both collected more sticks together. They were not lonely anymore, and they became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. Jack wanted to play with his ball, but it was stuck on the roof. Jack felt sad because he couldn't get his ball. 

Then, Jack saw his friend Lily walking by. Jack asked Lily to help him get his ball. Lily said yes and together they got a ladder. Lily climbed up the ladder and passed the ball down to Jack. Jack was happy and thanked Lily for her help. 

Lily smiled and said it was fair to help friends in need. Jack agreed and they played together with the ball. The end.

One morning, Jack woke up feeling excited. He sensed something was different. 

Jack asked his mum, "Mum, what is today?" 

His mum replied, "Today is a special day, Jack. We are going to measure the dead tree in the backyard!" 

Jack was so happy he jumped up and down. He asked, "How will we measure it?" 

His mum said, "We will measure it with a tape measure. We will measure the height and width of the tree!"

Jack enjoyed measuring the dead tree. He stretched out the long tape measure from the top of the tree trunk to the ground, and then around the trunk. In the end, Jack was proud of the measurements he made on that special morning!

One day a very old pigeon was walking on the ground. It was so old that it moved very slowly. A little boy saw it and wanted to help it, so he walked up to it and gently pushed it along. The little boy was very kind and patient and he kept pushing the pigeon until it reached a nice grassy area. 

When it got there, the pigeon stopped and started eating the grass. The little boy watched it and smiled as he watched it eat. He was so happy that he had been able to help the elderly pigeon. 

After a while the pigeon flapped its wings and flew away. The little boy waved goodbye and wished it a safe journey. He was very happy and proud of himself for helping the elderly pigeon. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a frightened leopard. He was always afraid of things in the jungle. One day, he decided to pay a visit to his friend, the elephant. As he was walking, he heard a loud noise. He got so scared that he ran away as fast as he could.

When he reached the elephant's house, he was relieved. He told the elephant about the noise and the elephant said that he was not in danger. The elephant suggested that they pay a visit to the lion, the king of the jungle. 
 
The leopard was very nervous about meeting the lion, but the elephant said that it would be okay. So, the leopard and the elephant went to meet the lion. When they arrived, the lion welcomed them warmly. He said that he appreciated the leopard coming to meet him and gave him a big hug. 

The leopard was no longer frightened. He had made a new friend and learned that paying a visit to those you are afraid of can be a good thing.

Once there was a little girl named Anna. She was three years old. Anna loved to play with her dolls. She got a new dress for her birthday, and it was just for her dolls.

One day, Anna decided to kneel down to pray. She thanked God for her birthday dress. She felt so blessed.

After she finished praying, Anna put on her special dress. It was pink, fluffy, and covered in tiny diamonds. She felt so lucky!

Anna was so spoiled, that all the other dolls were jealous. They wished they had such a beautiful dress too. But Anna was special, and she had the most beautiful dress in the house.

Once there was a family with a little boy named Jack. Jack was three-years-old and he lived at home with his mommy and daddy. Every day, Jack's daddy would come home from work and right away he would need something to eat. He needed a big spoonful of pepper every single day.

So, Jack's mommy went to the store and bought the pepper. She bought regular pepper, which meant it was a bit spicy. But then Jack's daddy tried the pepper and he said, "This pepper is too spicy, I need some milder pepper, something regular."

Jack's mommy thought for a bit and then she said, "Well, I think I know what to do." She got out of the kitchen and she went to the store again. This time, she bought regular pepper - just the right kind for Jack's daddy to eat.

Once Jack's mommy brought the regular pepper home, she gave it to Jack's daddy and he said, "This is just right! Thank you! Now I can have pepper every day." And that's when Jack learned, if you need something, it's best to get it right away.

One day, a pink car named Speedy liked to go fast. Speedy loved to race with his friends. He was very good at it. All the other cars wanted to be like him.

One day, a new car came to town. His name was Slowly. Slowly was not fast like Speedy. He had no money to make him go fast. The other cars did not want to play with Slowly. This made Slowly very sad.

Speedy saw Slowly and said, "Why are you so sad?" Slowly told Speedy that he had no money to be fast like him. Speedy wanted to help. He gave Slowly some of his money to make him go fast.

Now, Slowly was fast like Speedy. They raced together and had lots of fun. All the other cars wanted to play with them too. Speedy and Slowly became best friends. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very hungry and wanted to eat some cookies. She went to the kitchen and saw a plate on the table. She took the plate and laid it on the floor. Then she opened the cookie jar and took out a cookie. But, to her surprise, the cookie was bitter and she didn't like it. So, she put the cookie back on the plate and went to her mom to ask for a new one.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear. He lived in a forest with his friends, a rabbit and a bird. One day, they found a jar with honey inside. The bear wanted to eat all the honey, but the rabbit said it was not wise. The bird said they should share the honey. 

The bear got angry and wanted to fight with the rabbit and the bird. But then he thought about what they said and realized they were right. So, they all shared the honey and became good friends forever.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Daisy. Daisy went on a big adventure to find her precious toy.

She went out into the cold day, and stumbled upon some lightning in the sky. But Daisy was scared and refused to go closer to the scary lightning.

She kept walking and eventually found a small pond. There in the pond was her precious toy! Daisy was so excited and couldn't wait to grab it.

But when she got close to the pond, she heard a voice telling her to stay back. The voice said it was very dangerous and refused to let her take the toy from the pond.

Daisy was very scared and didn't know what to do. But then a bright light shone over the pond and Daisy decided it was safe enough to get her toy.

The light was warm and comforting and Daisy was so happy to finally have her toy! She thanked the mysterious voice and ran home with her prize.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved fashion. She liked to wear pretty dresses and shiny shoes. One day, Lily went to a party with her friends. She wore a beautiful dress that sparkled in the sun. 

At the party, Lily saw a boy who was very loud. He screamed and shouted and made everyone scared. Lily felt mild fear in her heart. She didn't like the boy's behavior. 

Later, Lily and her friends were playing a game when the boy came over and started to scream again. This time, Lily knew what to do. She stood up and said, "Stop screaming! You're scaring us!" The boy stopped and looked at Lily. He realized that he was being too loud and apologized. From then on, Lily and the boy became friends and had fun playing together.

Once upon a time there was a puppy. He was so very small and furry. Every day the puppy liked to go for a walk. 

Today it was time to get ready. His owner loaded him up with a special leash so he wouldn't run away. The puppy was very anxious. He didn't like when something new was put on his body. 

His owner pet him to reassure him everything was ok. Then slowly and carefully the leash was clipped. The puppy felt a little better. Now it was time for a walk! 

The puppy and his owner walked and walked. The puppy looked around and sniffed all of the wonderful smells. He felt better and less anxious as he trotted on the leash beside his owner.

Once upon a time, there was a panda named Pete. Every day, Pete was very enthusiastic about his day. He loved to explore the outdoors and see new things.

One day, while exploring the forest, Pete saw something amazing. It was a small house made from twigs and leaves. Pete was so excited he began to yell and hopped up and down.

Then, a man appeared from the small house. He asked Pete what he was so enthusiastic about. Pete explained that he had never seen a house like this before and was so thrilled to see it.

The man smiled and said, "Come on inside and you can look around some more!" Pete thanked the man and followed him into the house. Pete made sure to yell and be enthusiastic about everything he saw!

Pete and the man shared a wonderful adventure and by the end, Pete was happier than he had been in days! He said a fond goodbye to the man and ran off, yelling and excited about his new day of exploring.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One night, she went to bed and started to dream. In her dream, she was in a magical world where she could play with all the toys she ever wanted. She was so happy!

The next day, Lily told her friends about her dream. One of her friends, named Timmy, became envious. He wished he could have the same dream as Lily. So, that night, he went to bed and hoped to dream about playing with all the toys he ever wanted. And guess what? He did! Timmy was so happy when he woke up the next morning.

From that day on, Lily and Timmy would always talk about their dreams and the fun they had playing with all the toys. They were the happiest kids in the world!

Once upon a time, there was a very lonely cloud. Every day he would look down from the sky and see the happy people on the ground smiling and laughing. He felt so lonely and wished he had someone to talk to. 

One day, it started to rain. The lonely cloud wasn't so lonely anymore because now he could talk to the people below. He felt happy to make them laugh and smile. As he rained he said, "Hi everyone! I'm a lonely cloud and I'm here to visit you!"

Suddenly, a little girl below shouted, "Look Mama! A talking cloud!"

The little girl and her mama stared up at the cloud astonished. 

The cloud asked, "Do you want to be my friend?"

The little girl nodded and ran over to her mom.

"Mama, can I be friends with the cloud? Please!?"

The mom smiled and said, "Of course you can. Just reach up and touch your nose to his raindrops and make a wish."

The little girl closed her eyes and did what her mom said. When she opened them, the cloud was gone. But the little girl kept her friendship with the lonely cloud in her heart.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She had a pet dove named Dolly. One day, Mia and Dolly went to the park to play. The sun was shining and the sky was blue. Mia was very happy.

Mia and Dolly played near the big tree. Mia threw a ball and Dolly would fly and bring it back. They were having so much fun. But then, the ball got stuck in the tree. Mia tried to jump and get it, but she was too short. She felt frustrated.

Mia saw a big boy near the tree. She asked him, "Can you help me get my ball?" The big boy said, "Sure!" He kneeled down and let Mia climb on his shoulders. Together, they reached up high and got the ball.

Mia said, "Thank you!" and the big boy smiled. Mia and Dolly went back to playing with their ball. They had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Max who loved watching videos. He would watch videos of animals and cars all day long. One day, Max's mom told him to stop watching videos and go outside to play. Max didn't want to stop watching videos, so he started to cry.

Suddenly, Max heard a loud noise. He looked up and saw a bird zooming towards him. Max was scared and ran inside the house. He told his mom about the bird and she was alert. She went outside to see what was happening and found out that the bird was trying to protect its nest from Max.

Max's mom explained to him that he should respect nature and not disturb the animals. Max understood and decided to go outside to play instead. He had fun playing with his toys and even saw the bird zooming around in the sky. From that day on, Max learned to appreciate nature and not just watch videos all day long.

Once upon a time, there was an angel who liked to run. Everyday the angel flew to different places and ran around having fun. Then one day, an ignorant man saw the angel running and thought it was strange. He shouted, "What are you doing?" So the angel stopped running and was embarrassed.

The angel was too shy to tell the man what it was doing, so instead it flew away. But the man was curious, so he followed the angel. Everywhere the angel went, the man followed. The angel was scared and kept running and running until it was too tired to fly.

The man finally caught up and the angel flew away. But before the angel left, it left a special gift for the man. It was a surprise he had never seen before. When the man opened the gift, he discovered it was a magical toy that could fly and run.

After that day, the man never forgot his experience with the angel. He would play with the toy and remember the kind angel who gave it to him. He was forever thankful for the gift, and the lesson it taught him: Never be ignorant to what is around you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the big green yard with her fluffy dog named Max. One day, Lily saw a big flash in the sky and heard a loud noise. It was lightning! She felt scared and ran to her mommy. 

Mommy said, "Don't worry, Lily. Lightning is just like a big flash of light in the sky. It happens when the clouds are angry and make loud noises." Lily felt better and asked, "Can we play outside again when the lightning goes away?" 

Mommy said, "Yes, we can play outside again when the lightning goes away. But we have to wait a long time and guess when it's safe to go back outside." Lily smiled and hugged her mommy. She was happy to learn something new and couldn't wait to play with Max again.

Once there was a wide lake in the forest. Two children went to the lake to have some fun. They saw a fish and started to laugh.

The children were very excited, so they got a screw from the ground and played catch. They laughed as they threw the screw back and forth.

When it was time to go home, the children said goodbye to the lake and the fish. They held hands and walked away, still laughing.

Once there was a black bear that lived deep in the woods. One day, the bear was feeling really tired and he thought â€œI need a rest!â€ He looked around and spotted a nice flat rock close by. The bear wobbled over to it and took a seat.

The bear leaned back and closed his eyes, but he started to hear a very loud noise. He opened one eye and saw something moving in the nearby tree. Then the bear heard a harsh voice say: â€œHey, who are you?â€

The bear was surprised, so he looked up and saw a small bird with bright yellow feathers. The bird said: â€œWhat are you doing here? I live in this tree.â€

The bear replied: â€œIâ€™m just resting a bit. I am very tired.â€ Then he asked a question: â€œHey bird, can you help me? Can you lift me up to your tree? I want to take a nap there.â€

The bird thought for a moment, then he chuckled and said: â€œYes, I can offer you a lift. Come on, hop on my back.â€ And with that, the bear had a lift up to the tree. He said goodbye to the bird and fell asleep, feeling much better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ellie. She loved to explore the forest near her house. One day she went out to explore, and soon she found an acorn on the ground. She liked the way the acorn felt when she rubbed it, so she started to rub it harder and harder.

"Why do you keep rubbing that acorn?" an old man asked.

Ellie looked up. "I like how it feels," she said. 

"That's very persistent of you," the old man said. 

The old man smiled and nodded, then he took the acorn from her and put it in his pocket. "Maybe you'll see it again one day," he said mysteriously, before turning and walking away.

When Ellie got home, she asked her mom about the old man. Her mom smiled and said that one day, as she was about to give up, she had found a big oak tree in that very same spot where Ellie found the acorn. Ellie couldn't believe what she was hearing! The old man knew that if she kept rubbing the acorn, something special would happen.

From that day on, Ellie never gave up when she encountered something difficult; she knew that putting in a little bit of effort could have an amazing payoff.

One day there was a terrible noise outside. It was so loud that a little boy had to cover his ears. He ran outside to see what was happening and saw a big fireman with a yellow hat. He was yelling and telling everyone to stay inside their houses. 

The little boy was so scared and he wanted to cry. The fireman saw him and kneeled down to talk to the little boy. He said, â€œDonâ€™t worry little one, I am here to help!â€ The fireman said he had to help put out the terrible fire.

The little boy was so brave. He told the fireman that he could help too, and the two of them ran towards the fire together. Afterworking together for a long time, they finally managed to put out the fire.

The little boy was so proud of himself, and the fireman was very thankful. He gave the little boy a big hug and said, â€œYou were very brave. You saved us all!â€

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was walking in the street. All of a sudden, there was an emergency. She saw a fire! She was scared and didn't know what to do.

Then the firetruck came. It had a loud siren. The firefighters were very impatient. They wanted to put out the fire. They let the girl get out of the street.

The firefighters put out the fire. They were very happy. The girl was happy too. She was glad there wasn't an emergency anymore.

Once upon a time there was a bulb. It lived in a dark cave, so it was scared and fearful. One day, a rock came tumbling into the cave and smashed against the bulb. It broke the bulb into pieces, causing the cave to be dark and scary. The bulb was so scared that it started shaking. 

The rock knew that the bulb was very scared, so it started to rock the bulb back and forth in an effort to comfort the bulb. This made the bulb even more scared and it trembled even more. 

The rock continued to rock the frightened bulb until it finally shattered into thousands of pieces. The pieces were too small to put the bulb back together.

The end.

Lily had a very creative idea. She wanted to wrap every lawyer she saw. She thought it would be fun. So she ran outside and saw a lawyer. She ran up to him and said, "I want to wrap you!"
The lawyer smiled. He saif to her, "Why do you want to wrap me?"
"Because it looks like fun," said Lily.
The lawyer said, "That's very creative! Let's do it!"
Then the lawyer and Lily wrapped each other up in big blankets and skipped around the park. They had so much fun that even after all the lawyers were gone, they kept wrapping each other up!

Once upon a time, there was a big furry bear. The bear had lots of stuff in his cave. One day, the bear went outside and saw his friend, a little rabbit. The rabbit waved to the bear and said hello. The bear was happy to see his friend and they played together. They had fun running and jumping around. After playing, the bear went back to his cave and looked at all his stuff. He realized that playing with his friend was more fun than having lots of stuff. From that day on, the bear spent more time with his friends and less time collecting stuff in his cave.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Snowy. Snowy was very white and fluffy. He loved to play in the garden and eat carrots. 

One day, Snowy noticed that his carrot patch was getting smaller. He was worried that he wouldn't have enough carrots to eat. He decided to ask his friends if they had seen any carrots around. 

His friends told him that they had seen some carrots in the farmer's field. Snowy decided to go there and get some carrots. But when he got there, he saw that the farmer had put up a fence around the field. Snowy tried to jump over the fence, but he couldn't. 

Days passed, and Snowy became very hungry. He decided to try and jump over the fence again. This time, he made it over, but as he was eating the carrots, the farmer caught him. The farmer was very angry and Snowy was scared. The farmer took Snowy away and Snowy never saw his garden or his friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play basketball with his friends. One day, Timmy went to the park to play basketball with his friends. He brought his long basketball with him. 

While playing, Timmy slipped on a banana peel and fell down. His friends rushed to help him up. They saw that his basketball had rolled away. They all looked for it together and found it behind a tree. 

Timmy was happy to have his basketball back. He thanked his friends for helping him and they continued playing. From that day on, Timmy made sure to watch where he was walking so he wouldn't slip again.

Once upon a time, there was a scaly monster. It locked itself in a tight room and refused to let anyone inside. On the outside of the room, there was a sign that read "BEWARE - POISON INSIDE".

The people were scared to open the door. But then one brave child stepped forward. He was very brave and curious and he decided to open the door - even though it was scary.

When he opened the door, a plume of poison came out! It filled the air and made the people cough and choke. Everyone was scared, but the brave little child stayed inside the room.

Slowly, the little child ran his hands along the walls of the room, until he found a special switch. He pressed it and the switch released the poisonous cloud. Everyone outside was so happy!

The brave little child saved the day. He proved that even though the poison was scary, it could be released if you were brave enough.

Once, there was a white car ready to go. The family piled inside and drove to the park. They parked the car in the lot and got out. Everyone was so excited to explore the park! 

The children saw a big slide and ran to the top. They were ready to have so much fun! The dad watched them slide down the white slide and laughed. 

Soon, they found a swing set. It was white too. The dad tried it first, then the kids each took a turn. They went as high as he could! 

Finally, it was time for a picnic. The mom laid down a blanket and the family shared a snack. Then, the dad suggested a game of tag. The children ran around the park until they were ready to go home. 

They all hopped back into the white car and drove away. Everyone was so happy and tired from the day in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a large fairy. She was very happy and always wanted to make children smile. Every day, she flew around the world looking for ways to excite them. 

One day, she flew to a small children's playground. She saw lots of smiling children playing together. And so, the fairy decided to make the playground even more fun. She used her magical powers to make a giant slide appear. The children were so excited to see the huge slide! They scurried up the big stairs and slid down again, laughing and shouting in delight. 

The fairy was so happy to see the children having so much fun. She knew that she had made the right decision. From that day on, the playground was known as the happiest place ever!

Once upon a time there were two puppies, named Bob and Pat. Bob looked around and noticed a big structure by the park.

"What's that Pat?" asked Bob.

Pat hopped and jumped up and down. "It's the cheap slide," she said.

Bob and Pat rushed over to the slide. They ran up the stairs and saw that it was made of bright colors. 

Bob and Pat rushed down the slide and giggled. When they reached the bottom they rushed up and did it again. Then they darted to the swings and flew higher and higher. 

The puppies rushed around the structure, having lots of fun. At the end of the day they ran together, happy and exhausted.

Once upon a time, there was a happy girl who wore a pretty veil on her head. She loved to play outside and soak up the sun. She was always cheerful and loved to sing and dance.

One day, the girl went to the river to soak her feet in the cool water. She saw a frog and tried to catch it, but she slipped and fell into the river. Her veil got caught on a branch and she couldn't swim to the surface. The frog tried to help, but it was too late. The girl drowned and her family was very sad.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had ten toes on her feet. One day, she was eating a yummy candy and accidentally dropped it. The candy fell on her big toe and stuck there. She tried to wiggle her toe, but the candy wouldn't come off. Her mom came to help and used warm water to wash off the candy from her toe. From that day on, Lily made sure to hold her candy tight, so it wouldn't fall on her toes again.

One day, there was a big dark blackboard. It was so big that nobody could wrap their arms around it! Everyone was so curious and wanted to find out what was inside. But no matter how hard they tried, nobody could open it. 

Suddenly, a little girl stepped forward. Her name was Mary and she was only three years old. She said she knew how to open the blackboard.

The people were amazed, but they stepped back and let Mary take a turn. She walked up to the blackboard and carefully wrapped her arms around it. Suddenly, the blackboard opened and everyone could see what was inside.

It was filled with colourful toys, books and drawings. Everyone was so excited and happy! From that day on, the dark blackboard was never forgotten. Mary showed them how to wrap their arms around it and open a world of wonderful surprises.

One day, a little boy named Tim saw a hole in the ceiling. He wanted to repair it. He told his mom, "Mom, there is a hole in the ceiling. Can we fix it?"

His mom said, "Yes, Tim. We will fix it tomorrow. But for now, be alert and don't go near the hole."

The next day, Tim's dad came with a ladder. He climbed up and fixed the hole in the ceiling. Tim was very happy. He said, "Thank you, Dad! Now the ceiling is all better!"

Later that day, Tim and his mom heard a noise. They were alert and looked around. They saw a bird that had flown into the house. The bird had come through the hole in the ceiling before it was fixed.

Tim's mom said, "Good thing we fixed the hole, or more birds might come in!" Tim was happy that he helped repair the ceiling and keep the birds outside.

One day Timmy wanted to go explore the park. His mom said he could go as long as he brought his pig. Timmy was so excited because his pig was his favorite toy. 

When they arrived at the park, Timmy's pig was very heavy. He tried to push it but it was just too heavy for him. So, his mom had to help him. 

They were walking around the park when suddenly the pig flew out from Timmy's hands and flew away. Timmy screamed, â€œMy pig!â€ 

His mom said, â€œDon't worry. We'll find it.â€ She pointed to a tree nearby and said, â€œI think it flew over there.â€ So they ran over to the tree and both of them started to push the leaves and branches aside. 

Finally, Timmy found his pig! He picked it up and gave it a big hug. He said, â€œMommy, look, I found my pig!â€ 

His mom smiled and said, â€œI'm so glad we found my pig. Let's go home.â€ So they both walked back home, holding hands.

Molly was feeling scared. It was dark outside and the wind made the trees tremble. Suddenly a loud thunder clap made her tremble too. She started to cry.

Her mom came in with a glass of wine and she felt better. The sweet smell of the wine made her feel less scared.

Molly's mom told her a story about brave dragons who were conquering their fear. Molly felt better and soon she was not scared anymore. 

Eventually the dark night passed, and the sun came out to shine again. Molly was no longer trembling, and she felt brave and strong like the dragons. She smiled and gave her mom a giant hug.

Once upon a time, there was a little car named Max. Max was very fast and loved to race with his friends. One day, Max and his friends found a tunnel. The tunnel was dark and scary, but Max was brave and went inside. 

As Max drove through the tunnel, he saw something very ugly. It was a big, green monster! The monster was blocking the way out of the tunnel. Max knew he had to be quick and race past the monster. 

Max revved his engine and raced as fast as he could. The monster tried to catch him, but Max was too quick. Finally, Max made it out of the tunnel and back to his friends. They were all very proud of Max for being so brave and racing past the ugly monster.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl and a cute little bear. The little girl loved going on picnics with the bear.

One day, the little girl got up extra early and decided to surprise the bear with a special picnic. She went to gather a blanket, some cookies and a basket of fruit.

On the way to the picnic spot, she and the bear struggled to carry the heavy items. The bear was determined to get to the spot, so he kept pushing and pushing, but the little girl was getting tired.

The little girl kept reassuring the bear that they were almost there. They finally reached the picnic spot and the little girl was so excited to show the bear her surprise.

But when they arrived, the bear was not happy. He was angry that the little girl had struggled with the heavy items. He shouted at her and said, "I don't want any picnic! Let's go home!" 

The little girl was very sad, but she began to gather up the picnic items and they slowly trudged back home. The little girl never tried to surprise the bear with a picnic ever again, and they stopped going on picnics together.

Once upon a time, there was a clever girl named Sarah. She was three years old and loved to learn new things. One day, Sarah's parents introduced her to something special - a desk! At first, she was scared of the big table, but her parents showed her that her desk had lots of fun features. 

They showed her the drawers and taught her how to open and close them. Then, they showed her all the special places where she could keep her books and pencils, and she was so excited! Finally, her parents introduced her to the seat where she could sit and do her work. Sarah felt so grown up with her own desk. 

With her curious mind and clever eyes, Sarah was soon enjoying all the different things she could do with her desk. She would draw pictures, practice writing, and even pretend to be a teacher and give lessons to her teddy bear.

Sarah was so happy that her parents had introduced her to her new desk. She was learning so much, and having so much fun. Her clever mind was having a great time!

Once upon a time there was a helpful truck named Toby. Toby was always ready to help people in need. One day, he was driving around town when he heard a strange noise. He stopped to investigate and saw a box. Inside the box was a little kitten, meowing quietly. Toby kindly loaded the box onto his truck and drove towards the nearest animal shelter. 

When Toby arrived at the shelter, the workers were so happy to see him. "Thank you for bringing this little one to us," one said. Toby smiled and replied, "It was no problem at all, I'm always happy to help!" The workers carefully unloaded the box from Toby's truck. 

The kitten was so grateful for Toby's help that it followed him out of the shelter. Toby was quite surprised and said, "Where are you going, little one?" The kitten looked up at Toby with bright eyes and purred in a friendly way. Toby laughed and said, "I guess you are coming with me, then!"

From that day on, Toby and the little kitten became good friends, and Toby was always happy to have a helpful companion.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who was getting ready to start her exam. She was very nervous. She had been studying very hard, but she was still scared.

She took a deep breath, and the exam began. She was asked lots of questions, and the exam was very rough. Every time she got to a difficult question, she thought about all of her hard work and kept going.

At the end, she felt relieved. She was happy that she made it through the rough exam. She looked around the room and saw that everyone else felt relieved too.

The girl was so proud of herself for finishing the exam. She felt like she was ready to take on anything!

Once there was a young girl named Daisy. She was 3 years old, and loved to laugh. Every day, Daisy would sing silly songs and jokes into her microphone. She thought it was so much fun!

One day Daisy's mom took her to a special park. She saw a stage with a big microphone on it! She was so excited, she ran right over to it. 

Once she got there, she grabbed the microphone and started singing. Then some other children saw Daisy and started to laugh. Soon everyone in the park was laughing at Daisy's funny songs. Daisy just laughed and laughed too. 

She and the other kids had so much fun that day. They all sang songs, put on a show and laughed together. Daisy was so happy she kept singing and laughing into the microphone. 

By the end of the day, everyone was smiling and all had such a great time. Daisy loves to laugh and loves her microphone!

Anna felt strong. She was three years old and she liked to try new things.

Today, Anna was playing with some weights. She liked to try and lift them up and hold them in her hands. She felt proud when she could lift the most weight.

Anna and her parents went to the park and she enjoyed running and playing with the other kids. She liked to show off her strong muscles.

When it was time for lunch, Anna had a big, yummy sandwich. She enjoyed feeling full and powerful after a good meal.

After lunch, Anna and her parents went for a swim in the pool. She enjoyed feeling the water all around her and it made her stronger.

At the end of the day, Anna felt strong and proud. Playing with weights and running in the park had helped her feel more powerful, and she was glad that she was enjoying doing new things.

Ben and Mia like to ride their bikes in the park. They have red bikes with two wheels and pedals. They wear helmets and gloves to be safe.

One day, they see a big hill in the park. Ben says, "Let's go up the hill and down again. It will be fun!" Mia says, "OK, but be careful. The hill is hard and steep."

They pedal hard and fast to go up the hill. They feel the wind in their faces and the sun on their backs. They reach the top and see the park below. They smile and shout, "We did it!"

They get ready to go down the hill. They hold the brakes and lean forward. They go down very fast and feel the thrill. They laugh and scream, "Whee!"

But then, Ben hits a rock and falls off his bike. He scrapes his knee and elbow. He cries and says, "Ow, ow, ow! It hurts!" Mia stops her bike and runs to him. She says, "Oh no, Ben! Are you OK?"

She helps him get up and wipes his tears with her sleeve. She says, "Don't worry, Ben. I have a band-aid in my pocket. Let me put it on your knee and elbow. It will make you feel better."

She takes out a band-aid and sticks it on his wounds. She says, "There, all done. You are brave, Ben. You can ride your bike again."

Ben smiles and says, "Thank you, Mia. You are a good friend. You can ride your bike with me anytime."

They hug and get back on their bikes. They pedal away to find more fun in the park.

One day, Jack and Jill went out to play in the park. Jack saw an ashtray, and he wanted to take it home. But Jill said, "No! That's not yours. Leave it."

Then Jack started to cry. He said, "No! I want it!" 

Jill said, "It's not yours. You can't have it!" 

Jack didn't want to listen, and this made things difficult.

Suddenly, Jack and Jill started to fight over the ashtray. Jack wanted it, but Jill didn't want Jack to take it home. They fought and fought until they were both very tired.

Finally, they both agreed that the ashtray would stay in the park. They were both happy, and they decided to go home and have a snack.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little bird. He wanted to fly so high in the sky but there were no trees tall enough. He kept flying higher and higher, but soon he was so high that it was too bright and too hot. All the birds around him were hiding from the sun.

Suddenly, he saw something special. It was a huge tree, sprouting from the clouds. It had long branches reaching out, with big leaves that shaded the sun. He immediately flew to it and rested in its shade. The tree gave him a big hug and released him to fly higher.

The brave little bird kept soaring until the sun was gone and the night settled in. Every day he kept flying higher, with the tree's shade always behind him. The brave little bird never forgot the tree's releasing hug. And so he always flew high and remained brave.

Once upon a time there was a loyal fox. He was very curious and was always looking for adventure.

One day, he felt a strong wind coming and heard a loud noise like thunder. He looked up and saw lightning in the sky. It was a magical sight and he couldn't resist. So he decided to go dance with the lightning. 

He raced up the hill and danced with all his might. As he twirled around the lightning, he felt a special joy. He jumped and leaped and twirled in the sky.

Suddenly, he heard a voice calling out. It was his mom. "Come home now," she said, "It's time for dinner."

So the loyal fox stopped dancing and raced back home. He was so happy, he had made a new friend - the lightning. He felt a strong bond and knew he would never forget this magical day.

Once upon a time, there was a selfish soldier. He was mean and didn't care about anyone else. One day, he was walking through a wood and he began to panic. He was alone and scared. He didn't want to be there any more.

Suddenly, he heard a noise. Someone was coming. He was so scared he wanted to run away. But then he saw who it was. It was a kind old lady. She was smiling at him and wanted to help.

The soldier was relieved. He was no longer alone and scared. He told her what had happened and they talked and laughed together. The soldier felt happy again. He thanked the old lady and promised to be less selfish and look after himself better.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Peter. Peter was only three years old, and he liked to explore the world. 

One day, Peter decided to go on an adventure. He took his teddy bear with him and began to look around. 

Peter soon came across a large bone. It was quite a difficult bone, for it was buried deep in the ground. Peter wanted to get it out, so he knelt down and began to dig with his tiny hands. 

Just as he was about to reach the bone, he heard someone say: "Why don't you let me help you?"

Peter was surprised and looked up. He saw a friendly bird nearby. 

"Can you really help me get the bone out?" Peter asked. 

The bird replied: "Of course I can! Just kneel down and I'll do the rest!" 

So Peter knelt down and the bird quickly dug out the bone with its beak. 

Peter thanked the bird. He took the bone and went on his way. Peter had a wonderful adventure that day!

Once upon a time there was a monkey named Pete. Pete loved to bathe. Every morning he headed over to the river and splashed around in the cool water. He had all sorts of interesting things to do while he bathed. He would blow bubbles and play in the mud.

One day when Pete was in the river plays, he saw something that looked very fun. There was a funny looking boat bobbing up and down in the water. It intrigued Pete, so he decided to hop in. Pete had so much fun sailing around in the boat, he never wanted to leave.

After a few hours, Pete became a bit tired. He knew it was time for his to head back home and get ready for bed. When he arrived back home, his mommy encourage him to take a warm bath.

So Pete got in the tub and played in the bubbles. He felt so relaxed and happy. After his bath, he was ready to go to bed.

Pete went to bed with smiles on his face, dreaming of all the interesting things he did that day.

Once there were two children playing in the park. The one child wanted to touch the helicopter but the other child said no. The first child was angry and sad because he was not allowed to touch it.

Suddenly, something terrible happened. It started to rain and lightning flashed in the sky. The helicopter started to shake in the wind. The children had to go home quickly and run inside.

Once they were safe inside, they looked out the window. The helicopter was still shaking, it looked so scary. Suddenly, all the lights went out and the terrible storm raged even more. 

The children knew they were lucky to have the safety of the house. The one child thought back to the helicopter, wishing that he had been able to touch it before the storm.

Max had a lot of purple shampoo in his room. He was ready to try it out! He walked over to the mirror and picked up the bottle. It felt a bit heavy in his hands.

Max's mum saw him and smiled. She knew he liked playing with colourful things. She encouraged him to try the shampoo on his own.

Max smiled back. He was a bit scared of getting it in his eyes, but he was brave. He squirted a bit of the purple shampoo in his hand, rubbed it together and put it on his hair. It tickled! 

Max's mum watched him in admiration. She thought he did a great job and told him so. He smiled proudly. 

Max was so proud of what he'd done. He had tried something new by himself and it worked out great! His mum's encouragement had made him feel even more confident.

Once there was a baby bird. It was very weak and small, and it couldn't find the food it needed. Suddenly, it saw something shiny! It was a camera! The baby bird hopped up to the camera, and it opened its beak. Suddenly, the camera started to feed the baby bird! The baby bird was so excited that it chirped and sang. It was so happy to finally have something to eat.

After eating, the baby bird felt much stronger. Its feathers looked shinier, and it was full of energy. From that day on, the baby bird got food from the same camera every day. It would come back and open its beak, and the camera would always feed it.

The baby bird and the camera became best friends. Whenever the baby bird felt weak, it knew it could always turn to the camera. The camera would always be there, ready to feed it.

Mum was amazing. She had a special way of making everything better. One day, Mum took Lilly for a walk in the park. They looked around at all the trees and birds, and Lilly felt really happy. 

Suddenly, Lilly heard a loud noise. She got scared, and started to panic! But Mum was there to help and said, "It's okay honey, don't worry. That's just an aeroplane flying overhead." 

Lilly was so relieved and smiled at her Mum. She thought that Mums were the best, and felt so lucky to have such an amazing Mum.

Lily was hungry. She wanted soup for lunch. She asked her mom, "Can I have soup, please?"

Mom said, "Yes, you can. But first, you have to help me find the soup can. I put it somewhere in the kitchen, but I forgot where."

Lily and mom started to search for the soup can. They looked in the cabinets, in the drawers, in the fridge, and in the oven. But they could not find the soup can anywhere.

Lily said, "This is crazy. Where is the soup can?"

Mom said, "I don't know. Maybe we have to look somewhere else."

Then, Lily had an idea. She remembered that she saw something shiny in the living room this morning. She ran to the living room and looked under the couch. There, she found the soup can.

Lily shouted, "I found it! I found the soup can!"

Mom came to the living room and saw the soup can. She said, "Oh, Lily, you are so smart. How did you find the soup can here?"

Lily said, "I saw it when I was playing with my toys. I thought it was a toy, too. But it was not. It was the soup can."

Mom said, "Well, you are right. It is not a toy. It is our lunch. Come on, let's go make some soup."

Lily and mom went back to the kitchen. They opened the soup can and poured it into a pot. They heated it up and stirred it. Then, they poured it into two bowls and added some crackers.

Lily and mom sat down at the table and enjoyed their soup. They were happy and full. They thanked each other for their help.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boat named Benny. Benny loved to sail on the big blue sea. One day, Benny saw a big anchor stuck in the sand. Benny asked his friend, a seagull, "What is that big thing in the sand?" The seagull replied, "That's an anchor. It's used to keep big boats in one place."

Benny felt bad for the anchor because it looked helpless. "I want to help the anchor," Benny said. Benny tried to pull the anchor out of the sand but he couldn't do it alone. He asked his seagull friend to help. Together, they pulled and pulled until the anchor was free.

As they sailed away, Benny felt proud that he could help the anchor. "I guessed the anchor needed help," Benny said. The seagull replied, "That's right. It's always good to help others when they need it." And from that day on, Benny always looked for ways to help others in need.

Once upon a time, there was a big, big elephant named Ellie. Ellie was so huge that she couldn't fit in a normal house. She lived in a big field with her friends, the monkeys and the birds. One day, Ellie woke up and felt very tired. She walked over to her friend, the monkey, and said, "I'm so tired. I can't stop yawning!" 

The monkey said, "Maybe you need to go to sleep earlier. That's what I do when I'm tired."

Ellie replied, "I can't sleep. My iron is broken and it makes a loud noise that keeps me awake."

The monkey had an idea. "Let's go find a new iron for you," he said. 

So, Ellie and the monkey went on an adventure to find a new iron. They searched high and low until they found a shiny new iron. But, when they tried to bring it back to Ellie's field, they realized it was too heavy for them to carry. 

Ellie was upset and said, "What are we going to do now?"

The monkey replied, "Don't worry, we'll think of something. Let's rest for a bit and then come up with a plan." 

And so, Ellie and the monkey took a nap and when they woke up, they had a great idea. They asked the birds to help them carry the iron back to the field. Together, they were able to bring the iron back and Ellie was finally able to get a good night's sleep. The end.

The sun was shining outside, but Ali stayed inside. He liked playing inside on rainy days the best, so he happily stayed there today. He was gifted with a special skill and enjoyed flexing his talent.

Once upon a time there were a mom and a three year old girl who were very hungry. The mom said it was time to cook something, so they went to the kitchen together.

The mom pointed to a squash and asked the girl, "Do you want to help me cook this?"

The girl said "Yes!" and the mom smiled. She got out all the ingredients for a squash soup and put them in the pot. She gave something to the girl and said, "Here, stir the squash and add some water, please."

The girl stirred the squash, feeling happy and excited to help cook. But then she got a bit uncomfortable and said, "This squash is too big." 

The mom smiled and said, "That's ok. Give the squash a hug and it will get smaller." So the girl gave it a big hug, and it did get smaller!

The mom put the pot on the stove and said, "Now we just wait a few minutes and our soup will be ready." The girl smiled, happy that she helped to cook.

Once upon a time there was a wise old man who wanted to organize his day. He had many things to do, but he was determined to get everything done. First, he started with a big smile on his face. He was excited to start his day. He made a plan and set out to do his tasks one by one with determination.

After he finished all his tasks he felt very satisfied. He looked at his face in the mirror and saw that the smile was still there. He was happy that he was able to organize his day so well. He was able to get a lot done and still have some time to relax and enjoy the day.

He knew that being wise, organized and having a smile on his face was the key to having a successful day. He was proud of himself for proving just how wise and organized he could be. He knew that he had made a wise decision by taking the time to organize his day. He smiled a big smile and went off to enjoy the rest of his day.

Mama was in the kitchen making a new meal. She had all the ingredients mixed together in a pot. They were spicy. She opened the pot and added some soap. Then she stirred it all together and closed the lid.

The soup smelled delicious! Mama put a big bowl on the table and the family gathered around to enjoy it. They all ate it with big spoons. The soup was nice and hot and a little spicy.

When everyone had finished eating, Mama filled the bowl with warm soapy water. She passed it around the table and everyone took turns washing their spoons.

When they had all rinsed their spoons off, Mama closed the bowl and put it away. Everyone praised her for her delicious spicy soup. The family all had a special moment and smiled.

Once upon a time, in a big jungle, there was a little monkey. The monkey had a broken toy. He was very sad about it. He wanted to fix his toy, but he did not know how.

One day, he met a wise old elephant. The monkey asked the elephant to help him fix his broken toy. The elephant was very kind and agreed to help the little monkey. They worked together to make the toy as good as new.

After they fixed the toy, the monkey was very happy. He thanked the elephant and said, "I demand we play together now!" So, the monkey and the elephant played with the toy in the jungle. They became best friends and had lots of fun together.

Teddy was very excited. He was going camping with his family. Dad carried the tent and Teddy helped too. 

When they arrived at the campsite, they got to work. Dad put the tent up with some help of Teddy. Then they kneeled on the grass and Teddy saw a magpie. 

After the tent was pitched, Teddy and his family had a picnic. They ate apples and sandwiches under the tent. 

It was getting dark, so Teddy and his family got ready for bed. They kneeled down and said their prayers before getting into the tent. 

In the morning, Teddy was excited to go on an adventure! He couldn't wait to explore the woods and find out what was waiting.

Once upon a time, there was a playful little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in nature. She would run, jump, and laugh with her friends.

One sunny day, Lily met a small bird. The bird said, "Tweet, tweet! I don't understand where my family is." Lily wanted to help the bird find its family. They looked under rocks, on top of trees, and near the river.

Max stared at the huge tree in front of him. He had never seen anything so tall and grand. He couldn't help but feel small and insignificant. Max began to explore the grounds in front of him. He spotted some eyes watching him. A squirrel had been staring at Max with inquisitive eyes, seemingly asking him why he had come to play in this unfamiliar place. Max smiled and waved, not wishing to be ignorant of the creatures around him.

The squirrel hopped away and Max continued to explore. He stumbled upon a group of children playing tag. Max's eyes lit up and he ran towards them. The children stopped running and stared at the new kid. Max looked back and forth between the children and the squirrel, not knowing what to do. After a moment of uncertainty, the kids invited Max to join the game and show them how to play.

Max enjoyed the game and soon forgot about the staring squirrel. He and the kids ran around the park, pretending to be super heroes and villains. They laughed and joked, having the time of their lives.

Max smiled as he wandered home later that evening and thought of the game he had played. He knew that, even when things seem strange and unfamiliar, it never hurts to give things a try.

One day, Robin went outside to see what the day had in store. She walked and walked until she came to a creek. She had never seen one before and it made her so curious! She wanted to explore. But Mom had a surprise! â€œI was thinking of playing in the creek too â€“ itâ€™s such a nice day! Why donâ€™t you come with me?â€ Robin looked up. She was so excited and relieved! She joined her Mom in the creek and had the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a kid called Tom. Tom was very excited because he had just gotten a box of stamps. He took the box out of its bag and opened it. It was so comfy he decided it would be the perfect spot to gather his stamps. He lay down and went back to collecting. Soon he had arranged all of them and sat down with a big smile on his face.

One day, Amy was feeling very sick. She had a big fever and felt very weak. Her Mommy gave her some medicine to make her feel better. After taking it, Amy felt much better. 

Her Mommy said, "Let's go outside to get some fresh air." Together, they went to the park. There was an enormous tree in the park, and Amy was so excited. She ran over to it and jumped.

Mommy said, "We can't jump today. Let's go for a jog around the park instead!" Amy was surprise, but liked the idea. Together, they jogged around the park. It was so much fun! 

Amy was so happy that she felt better and that they had jogged around the park. Soon it was time to go home, but Amy had a lot of energy still. 

Mommy said, "Let's stay here a while longer and jog some more!" So they jogged around the park one more time, and then they went home. 

That was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Jenny. She was a very shy girl who didn't like to talk to strangers.

One day while Jenny was in the park, she met a stranger. The strange was very friendly and asked Jenny if she wanted to play.

Jenny was very scared, but she was brave and decided to try and accept the stranger's offer. She smiled and said yes.

The two of them had lots of fun together. The stranger taught Jenny how to swing on the swings, and how to use the slide.

After that day, whenever Jenny went to the park, she would look for the stranger. They were great friends now, and Jenny was no longer scared of strangers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a charming room with pink walls and a big bed. Every night before bed, Lily would imagine she was a princess in a magical land. She would twirl around in her room and pretend she was dancing at a grand ball. 

One day, Lily's mom brought home a new toy. It was a big box filled with dress-up clothes and props. Lily was so excited and couldn't wait to play with it in her charming room. She imagined herself as a brave knight who saves the kingdom from a fire-breathing dragon. 

As Lily grew up, she never forgot her charming room and all the fun times she had imagining different adventures. Even now, as an adult, she still likes to imagine and dream about all the amazing things she can do.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little rabbit called Flo. Flo loved learning new things and was always asking questions.

One day, Flo asked her mum what a calendar was. Flo's mum smiled and said, "A calendar is a book with numbers and dates on it. We use it to keep track of time and things we need to remember." Flo was curious, so she asked her mum to show her.

Flo's mum took out an old calendar from the drawer and let Flo look at it. Flo asked her mum why the calendar had funny drawings, and Flo's mum explained that each month had a different name and little symbol. She also told Flo that she needed to be careful when holding the calendar, as it was very important.

Flo looked at the calendar, marvelling at all the different names. Finally, she came to the conclusion that a calendar was nosy. It was full of names and symbols and it was always asking questions. Flo smiled at how accurate her new-found understanding was.

Once there was a pig named Fred. He was very hungry and looked for something to eat. He saw a big red barn and wanted to go inside to find something to eat. But when he got to the door, he found it was locked. He asked the farmer for food. But the farmer refused. He said that he was not allowed to give food to animals from the barn.

So Fred decided to look for food somewhere else. He went to the farmer's garden and found some delicious fruits and vegetables. He was so excited that he made a big feast! He was so happy that he did not even care that the farmer had refused him.

But suddenly, he heard a noise. It was the farmer, and he was not happy. "What are you doing in my garden? You must get out!" the farmer shouted. But Fred refused. He said he was still very hungry. The farmer was surprised and finally agreed to let Fred stay and eat.

Fred was very happy. Now he could eat until he was full. He thanked the farmer and went back to his barn, his tummy full and happy.

Once upon a time there was a big family who lived in a big house. One day the little boy wanted to play outside so his mummy said 'OK'. She warned him to stay away from the naughty square, but the little boy wasn't listening. He was too busy running and playing.

The naughty square was a wild place. All sorts of animals lived there, but the little boy wanted to explore. He saw a rabbit and tried to catch it, but it hopped away just in time.

Suddenly, the little boy heard a loud noise from the naughty square. He ran to see what it was, and there he found his daddy had been punished. His mummy was very angry, and said 'you should have listened!'. But the little boy was too scared to say anything.

The little boy learned an important lesson that day: never go to the naughty square again. He promised himself he would never disobey his mummy's instructions again. He kept this promise, never again entering the naughty square and living happily ever after.

Danny saw a big bin and wanted to play. He tried to open the bin but it was locked. "Daddy, open the bin!" shouted Danny.

"No, Danny," said Daddy. "You mustn't play in the bin. It's too dangerous."

Danny thought for a moment. Then he had an idea. He picked up a stick and tried to open the bin with it.

"That's a foolish thing to do, Danny," said Daddy. He opened the bin and showed Danny inside.

Inside the bin were lots of toys that Danny could play with. Danny was so excited and began to play with all the toys. Daddy watched him, smiling.

"See, Danny," said Daddy. "Sometimes silly ideas can lead to something fun!"

Once upon a time, there was a big jug. The jug was blue and lived in the kitchen. One day, a small boy named Tim saw the jug. Tim wanted to use the jug to get some water. He tried to pick it up, but the jug was too heavy for him.

Tim asked his friend, a cat named Sam, "Can you help me with this jug?" Sam said, "Yes, I can help you!" So, Sam used his paws to help Tim lift the jug. Together, they carried the jug to the sink to fill it with water.

As they were filling the jug, a rude bird flew into the kitchen. The bird saw the jug and wanted to knock it over. The bird said, "I want to make a mess!" Tim and Sam said, "No, don't do that!" They were scared, but they worked together to protect the jug. The bird saw how strong they were and flew away. Tim and Sam were happy that they saved the jug. They knew that if they worked together, they could make anything happen.

Lily liked to help her mom in the kitchen. She wanted to be a good cook like her mom. Today, they were going to make soup for lunch. Mom said they needed to prepare some vegetables first.

Mom gave Lily a big knife and a cutting board. She showed Lily how to cut the celery into small pieces. Lily was careful with the knife. She liked the sound of the knife on the board. She liked the smell of the celery. She felt proud of her work.

Mom smiled at Lily and said she was doing a great job. She put the celery pieces in a big pot with water and salt. She added some carrots, potatoes, and chicken. She turned on the stove and said the soup would be ready soon.

Lily and Mom cleaned up the kitchen. They sang a cheerful song while they washed the dishes. They were happy to work together. They were hungry for the soup. They could not wait to taste it. They knew it would be delicious.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a penny on the ground. He was very happy and enthusiastic. He showed his mom the penny and asked her a question, "Mom, what can I buy with this penny?"

His mom smiled and said, "You can buy something nice at the store tomorrow." Tim was excited and went to bed early, dreaming about what he would buy with his penny.

The next day, Tim and his mom went to the store. Tim saw a big, red ball. He really wanted the ball, but it cost more than his penny. He was sad, but his mom had an idea.

She said, "Tim, remember the penny you found? If you save more pennies, you can buy the ball one day." Tim understood and started to save all the pennies he found.

After some time, Tim had saved enough pennies to buy the big, red ball. He was so happy and thankful for his mom's help. Now, he could play with his new ball all day.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Jack. He was three years old and his favourite thing to do was play outside. One day Jack went out to play and he heard a big sneeze. He rushed over to see what had happened and he saw a wide dragon. 

Jack was scared at first, but then he noticed the dragon was smiling at him.

"Hello there!" the dragon said. 

"Hi!" Jack said back. He was feeling brave now. 

"I'm so sorry to sneeze like that," the dragon said. "I just had the most amazing dream and it made me so happy that I couldn't help but sneeze!" 

Jack smiled. He was glad the dragon was so cheerful. 

"Thank you for being so nice," said the dragon. Then it flew away, leaving Jack feeling happy and wide awake.

Sara and Ben like to swim in the pool. They wear swim suits and goggles. They splash and kick in the water. They have fun.

Sara and Ben were playing with their toys in the living room. Sara had a round ball that she liked to bounce and catch. Ben had a truck that he liked to push and pull. They were having fun, but they also made a lot of noise.

One day, a little girl named Lola went shopping. She brought her cool pink purse. Lola was excited to buy something new because she loved to shop.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety. Tweety was very curious and loved to explore the world around him. One day, Tweety saw a powerful eagle flying in the sky. Tweety wanted to fly like the eagle, but he knew he was too small.

Kate and her mom were in the big theater. It was dark with the lights twinkling above them like stars. Kate's mom smiled at her and said, "Do you want to take a bath?"
