On the last day of the week, Tim and his dad went to the park again. Tim was playing on the swings when he saw a big, scary dog. The dog ran towards Tim and bit his leg. Tim cried and his dad took him to the doctor. Tim's mom came home, but he was sad because his leg hurt a lot. The week ended badly for Tim.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Charlie. Charlie was only three years old, but he was very brave. He decided he wanted to gain a new adventure, so one day he walked to the subway station.

When he got there, Charlie saw that it was very busy. People were running around, and the trains were coming and going. He was so excited!

He went up to a subway worker and said, â€œHi! Can I ride the subway?â€

The subway worker smiled and said, â€œSure thing! Just be careful and stay close to me.â€

So, together, they hopped on the subway. Along the way, it stopped at all sorts of places. There were parks and stores and lots of different kinds of people. Charlie was having the best time ever!

At the end of the ride, right before he had to get off, the subway worker said, â€œRemember, Charlie, you can always come back and ride the subway again!â€

Charlie smiled and said, â€œI will! Next time, I will be even braver!â€

Once upon a time, there were two friends - Ella and Toby. They were best friends.

One day, Ella said to Toby, "Let's celebrate!" Toby was so excited. He asked, "What are we celebrating?"

Ella said, "We are celebrating because we found an old cable!"

Toby said, "That's funny!" The two friends laughed and celebrated. They jumped up and down and cheered with joy.

They had so much fun celebrating the cable. Toby was so happy, he asked Ella if they could celebrate more. Ella smiled and said, "Sure, let's celebrate again!".

Once upon a time, in a pretty land, there was a big beach. The beach had soft sand. Many kids came to play in the sand. They made sand castles and drew pictures.

One day, a happy girl named Lily came to the beach. She saw the soft sand and wanted to dance. She danced and danced in the sand. Her feet felt good in the sand. The other kids saw Lily dance and they wanted to dance too.

So, all the kids danced in the sand. They laughed and had fun. They danced until the sun went down. Then, they said goodbye to the pretty beach and went home. The sand had a big dance party and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little mole who lived in a cozy hole in the ground. One day, the mole was feeling sad because he missed his family. He wanted to feel warm and loved.

Then, a kind rabbit came by and saw the sad mole. The rabbit wanted to help the mole feel better, so she gave him a big hug to comfort him. The mole felt a little better and his heart felt warm.

The rabbit stayed with the mole and they talked about happy things. They talked about the sun and the flowers and how nice it is to have friends. The mole felt so happy to have made a new friend and he knew that he was not alone anymore.

Once there was a bright kitten living in a big family home. Everyone loved the kitten and took care of it.

One day, the family was having lunch together. As they ate, the mother said "This food reminds me of the fun times we all had together.â€

The little boy asked, "What do you mean, Mommy?â€

The mother smiled and said, â€œIt reminds me of the way we all took turns cuddling and playing with the kitten!â€

The little boy smiled and said, â€œOh, thatâ€™s right! We have such a bright and playful kitten!â€

Everyone laughed and enjoyed the reminder of the fun times with their kitten.

Once upon a time, there lived a small girl named Rose who loved to study. One day, Rose was studying in the forest, when she heard a loud caw. She looked around and saw a big black raven, who looked like it was trying to get her attention.

Rose, curious, made friends with the raven and they spent the day flying and playing together. But then, the raven started to act strange. Instead of cawing, it was trying to talk in human words!

Rose soon found out that the raven was fake. It was run by a machine! The raven had been trying to trick her into telling it secret things about her studies. Rose was angry and so threw the fake raven away.

â€œRavens are meant to fly, not to spy!â€ she said crossly.

The tiny girl continued on with her studies, and never got tricked again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Kelly. She was playing bow and arrow with her best friend, Todd. Todd had a great big arrow that went very far and Kelly was very impressed. She asked if she could try it.

Todd handed the arrow to Kelly, but then he forgot to tell her how to use it. Kelly was embarrassed and put the arrow down on the ground.

Todd saw Kelly feeling silly and said, "I'm sorry! I forgot to tell you how it works. Here, let me show you how to do it. Put the arrow on your bow like this, then pull back and let go."

Kelly tried it and was amazed by how far the arrow flew. She smiled and said, "Thanks for teaching me how to use it Todd! Let's play again!"

Yesterday, Maria's Mommy gave her a special box. Inside the box was a messy surprise. Maria pulled it out and ripped the paper. She was very happy to find a puppy! Maria hugged the puppy and the puppy licked her face. Maria giggled with joy. 

Maria cuddled the puppy all day. They played tag and chased each other around the yard. When it was time for bed, Maria put the puppy in its bed. They said goodnight and Maria went to hers. 

This morning, Maria ran to the puppy and they played again. But the puppy got so excited that he tore all the paper off the box! It was very messy, but Maria still loved her puppy. She said, ''It's okay. We just have to play cleaner games.'' 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a king. He had an unusual bed. Each night the king would lie in it and close his eyes.

One night, he heard a noise and opened his eyes. He saw a funny creature sitting near his bed. It had long ears and big eyes. The king thought it was very unusual.

The creature smiled and said, "Good evening, King. I feel like your bed is not very comfy. Let me help you." Then it got up on the bed and lied down. 

The king was impressed. The bed was much softer and more comfy. He thanked the creature and went to sleep. 

The next morning, the king thanked the creature again and said goodbye. The creature smiled and waved then vanished in the morning light. 

The king never saw the unusual creature again. But every night he thanked it, because his bed was so comfy now. The End.

Lila and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys. They have many toys, but they do not share well. They always want the same toy.

One day, they find a new game. It is a game of matching. They have to match the pictures on the cards. Some pictures are of animals, some are of fruits, some are of shapes. Lila and Ben take turns to flip two cards and see if they match.

Lila is good at matching. She matches a cat and a cat, a banana and a banana, a star and a star. She is happy. She says, "I am good at matching. I have many matches."

Ben is not good at matching. He flips a dog and a fish, an apple and a pear, a circle and a square. He is sad. He says, "I am bad at matching. I have no matches."

Ben looks at Lila's matches. He is envious. He wants to have matches too. He says, "Lila, can I have some of your matches? Please?"

Lila looks at Ben's cards. She sees a sun and a sun. She likes the sun. It is bright and warm. She says, "No, Ben. You cannot have my matches. They are mine. But I will trade you. You give me your sun and I will give you one of my matches."

Ben thinks. He likes the sun too. But he wants to have a match. He says, "OK, Lila. I will trade you. Here is my sun. Give me a match."

Lila and Ben trade their cards. Lila has a sun and a match. Ben has a match. They are both happy. They say, "We are good at trading. We have matches and suns." They smile and hug. They play some more. They share their toys. They are twins. They love each other.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. Her name was Jenny. She had a new pedal bike, and she wanted to go for a ride on it.

So she asked her mom if she could take it outside. Her mom said yes, and Jenny was so excited.

She hopped up on her bike, and started to pedal. It was hard work at first, but Jenny kept going. After a few minutes, she was going really fast.

Then, she heard her mom's voice calling to her. She stopped and asked if it was time to come back home.

Her mom said that it was time for lunch. So, Jenny hopped off her bike and headed inside. She had a lot of fun riding her new pedal bike, and can't wait to ride it again.

It was a sunny day and Jimmy was out playing in the park. As he ran around, he came across a mouse. He was excited to see it and noticed how flexible the little mouse was.

Jimmy exclaimed, â€œWow, that mouse is so flexible! Maybe it wants to be my friend!â€

The mouse gave him a little surprise, by hopping right up on his shoulder! Jimmy was overjoyed and thought to himself, â€œNow I have a new best friend!â€

Jimmy and the mouse were having so much fun running around the park together, but then suddenly they heard someone coming towards them. It was Jimmyâ€™s mom. She had come to take him home.

Jimmy shouted, â€œMom, look, I made a new friend, a mouse!â€

But to Jimmyâ€™s surprise, his mom said, â€œOh no, we canâ€™t keep it. Poor thing, let it go.â€

Jimmy sadly said goodbye to his new friend, and watched as the mouse ran away. He realized he would never see it again.

The end.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Bob and Nora. They loved to play together and had so much fun!

One day they decided to play a nice game of jazz. They danced, hopped and split around the room. They were so cute and adorable.

Suddenly, Nora shouted "I want to split again!". Bob decided to join in too, and together they split about the room. 

Bob said "You are the best splitter ever Nora!" and Nora said "Thanks Bob, you too!" Then they laughed and hugged.

The two friends had such a fun day, splitting around and playing jazz. They had the best time ever!

Once there was a monkey named Max. Max was very strong and had large muscles all over his body. He was always looking for something fun and exciting to do.

One day, Max visited a new beach. He was amazed by the huge waves and bright, sunny sky. As he looked around, Max had an idea. He decided to design a sandcastle.

Max worked hard, making sure the sandcastle was big and beautiful. When he was done, Max stepped back to admire his work. He was so proud of his design!

Just then, Max heard a voice say, "That looks amazing!" He turned around to see a small crab standing near him. The crab was happy to see the castle and asked Max if it was his design.

Max smiled and said, "Yes, sir. I used my large muscles to make it!" The crab was impressed, and the two friends shared a laugh. From then on, Max and the crab were best friends. They would meet each time Max came to the beach, and they would design fun creations together.

Once upon a time, there was a little flower named Bloom. Bloom lived in a big garden with many other flowers. Bloom had a goal to be the most beautiful flower in the garden.

One sunny day, Bloom saw a dangerous bug coming near the flowers. Bloom was scared and said to the other flowers, "Watch out! Dangerous bug is coming!" The other flowers thanked Bloom for the warning, and they all hid from the bug.

After the bug left, the flowers were safe and happy. Because Bloom warned them, they all agreed that Bloom was the most beautiful flower in the garden. Bloom's goal came true, and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree in a peaceful forest. The tree was very wise and had lived for many years. One day, a little bird came to the tree and asked for help. The bird's nest had fallen and he didn't know what to do.

The tree leaned down and listened to the bird's problem. Then, the wise tree told the bird to use some sticks and leaves to build a new nest. The little bird was very happy and thanked the tree for its help.

From that day on, the bird visited the tree often and they became good friends. The tree was happy to have brought peace to the little bird's life. And the little bird was grateful to have met such a wise friend.

Rose and Timmy were playing at the park. Rose looked up and saw something spark in the sky. She looked and said, "Look Timmy! It's so spark! Let's leave the park to go and find it". Timmy agreed and they both ran off in search of the spark.

They soon found it in a big field. It was in a very tall tree that had lots of yummy fruit. Rose and Timmy climbed the tree and ate the fruit, it was quite yummy!

Once Rose was finished eating she noticed the spark had moved. She motioned to Timmy and said, "Come on! The spark has left the tree, let's find it!"

So, the two of them hopped down from the tree and began their search. Finally, they found the spark in a river. Rose and Timmy splashed around in the water trying to catch the spark. In the end, they never did. But, they still had a fun day at the park!

Cindy woke up early in the morning and jumped out of her bed with hope. She ran to her window to see what color the sky was that day. She smiled when she saw the beautiful pink sky. Outside and all around was so peaceful and calm. 

Cindy put on her favorite pink dress, ran outside, and played in the sweet-smelling morning air. She ran around the yard, laughing and feeling joy. She laughed out loud when she saw a bright pink butterfly fluttering around her. 

Cindy filled with hope that the day would be the best day ever. She smiled and laughed the rest of the morning until it was time for lunch. She ran inside with a tummy full of happiness and a heart full of hope.

Once upon a time, there was a selfish man, who always had to have his way. One day, he baked a delicious cake for a special occasion. As he was frosting and decorating the cake he thought of the joy that it would bring others and decided to fold his selfishness away. 

The man carefully arranged the cake and set it on the table for his guests to enjoy. When all of the guests had arrived, the man brought out the cake. Everyone excitedly gathered around to get a closer look. Suddenly, the man spoke up and said, "This cake is for me only. I'm sorry, nobody else can have it." 

The man's selfishness was quickly revealed, and everyone was saddened and angry. Gradually, the guests began to drift away, until the man was alone with the cake. As he looked at the cake, he felt a profound sadness. He realized that the joy of eating the cake paled in comparison to the pleasure of sharing it with others. 

The man had one final thought as he folded the cake away â€“ that no matter how delicious it was, it would never taste as sweet as the joy of being generous.

Once there was a little girl who was very creative. She was always thinking of new things to do. One of the things she liked to do was to steal mittens. Every day she would steal a mitten from someone or take one without asking.

One day, she stole the mitten from her neighbor. The neighbor saw her and asked her to give it back. The little girl felt bad and gave the mitten back. She learned that stealing was not nice and promised to never do it again.

Instead of stealing, she used her creativity to make her own mittens. She felt much better when she had her own mitten and her neighbor was happy too.

From then on, the little girl used her creativity for good. She was so happy that she no longer had to steal mittens.

Once upon a time, there was a star in the night sky. Everyone thought the star was very special and wished for something wonderful.

One day, the star decided he wanted to record his adventures. He invited some friends to come join him. He was so excited he was going crazy!

His friends brought their markers and paints and they all drew and painted what they saw. They saw big mountains, rainbow rivers and fields full of bright flowers. They recorded it all.

At the end of the day, they felt very proud of the record they made. The star thanked them for their help and wished them a good night. Everyone smiled and said goodbye with a hug. 

The star was so happy he sparkled and twinkled in the sky all night long. He was the happiest star in the sky and everyone could see it. 

The star became a famous star. He kept recording his adventures and soon everyone knew about him. The crazy star in the night sky was now a star of adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his blocks. He would stack them up high and make big towers. One day, Timmy made an enormous square tower. It was so big, it reached all the way up to the ceiling!

Timmy's mom came into the room and saw the tower. "Wow, Timmy! That's a really big tower!" she said. Timmy was so proud of his tower that he wanted to show it to his friend, Johnny. "Let's go talk to Johnny!" Timmy said.

So, Timmy and his mom went to Johnny's house. When they got there, Timmy showed Johnny his enormous square tower. "Wow, Timmy! That's amazing!" Johnny said. Timmy was so happy that he had made something so cool.

Once upon a time there was a hairy mule. He lived in a field and ate lots of yummy grass. One day something very exciting happened. The mule went to the beach with his friend the horse. They splashed in the water and had lots of fun! The mule ran and ran until he was very tired. Then he stopped to rest and looked out over the ocean. It was a beautiful day and the mule smiled happily. After that, he and the horse went home. They had a great time and were happy to be back in their green field. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog. His name was Bark and he loved to take long walks. He would take a walk every morning, but one day Bark noticed that his walk was too short.

Bark went to his friend Jake the Cat and asked him what he should do. Jake thought for a moment and then said â€œMaybe you should replace your walk with a longer one.â€

Bark thought that this was a great idea, so he did just that. He started taking longer and longer walks, until his walks were as long as he wanted them to be. He was so happy!

The moral of the story is that if you want something to be bigger, replace it with something larger.

One day, Dad was driving a car. He was going to Granny's house. The sky was gray, like a yucky old sock! The wind was cold too. Dad had to rub his hands together to keep warm.

After a while, they saw Granny's tall house. They drove up the driveway. Dad opened the car door and it was cold outside!

Mom and Dad found Granny in the kitchen, eating a yummy snack. She was very happy to see them. "I'm so happy you're here!" she said.

They all went outside to play together. Dad brought a big ball for them to play catch. Even though the air was cold, they had fun! After a while, Dad drove them home. It was getting dark and cold. But inside the car, it was nice and warm.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to explore the park near her house. One day, she went on a walk and discovered a pretty flower. She picked it up and smelled it. It smelled so good!

As she continued her walk, she saw a nice lady sitting on a bench. The lady smiled at Lily and waved hello. Lily felt safe and happy around the lady. They talked for a little while and the lady even gave Lily a piece of candy.

Lily was so happy to have discovered the flower and the nice lady. She ran back home to tell her mommy all about her adventure. From that day on, Lily made sure to visit the park every day to see her new friend, the safe and kind lady.

One day, a little boat went to a port. The port was big and had many boats. The little boat wanted to make friends.

The little boat saw a big boat. The big boat was stirring the water. The little boat went near the big boat. The big boat said, "Hi, I am Big Boat. You are little. Do you want to play?"

The little boat was happy. They played in the mild water. The sun was warm and nice. The little boat and the big boat were friends. They had fun at the port.

Once upon a time, there was a little mole who lived in a hole. He liked to dig and play in the dirt all day long. One day, he found a bouncy ball and started to bounce it around. He was having so much fun!

Suddenly, he heard a noise coming from above. It was a boy who was very creative. He had made a toy airplane out of paper and was flying it in the sky. The little mole was amazed and watched as the airplane flew higher and higher.

The boy noticed the little mole and decided to bounce the ball to him. The mole caught the ball and bounced it back to the boy. They played together for a while and had a lot of fun. From that day on, the little mole and the creative boy became great friends and spent many afternoons playing together. The end.

Once upon a time there was a dog named Fuzzy. Fuzzy was very loyal and always followed his family around. He had a bright and soft skin that was always comforting and warm.

One day Fuzzy decided to go for a walk. He ran and ran until he got very far away from his home. He laughed and barked with joy, but soon he started to get lost and didn't know how to find home.

Fuzzy began to panic and cried for help. But no one heard him. He forgot which way to go and nothing looked familiar. He felt sad and lonely, and he started to walk back the way he came. 

Suddenly, Fuzzy remembered his special family and he knew what he had to do. With his loyal heart he kept walking and walking until he found his way home. His family welcomed him back with hugs and love. Fuzzy was so happy to be back with his family and never wanted to forget how to find home again!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly bear named Bubba. Bubba lived in the forest with his friends, the birds and the squirrels. One day, Bubba found a tube in the river. The tube was big and yellow and Bubba thought it would be fun to play with.

Bubba tried to fill the tube with water from the river, but it had a hole in it. The water kept coming out. Bubba was sad because he wanted to play with the tube. But then, his friend the squirrel came up with an idea. They found some leaves and put them inside the tube. The leaves filled up the hole and now Bubba could play with the tube all day long.

Bubba and his friends had so much fun playing with the tube. They rolled it down the hill and even used it as a slide. Bubba was happy that he found the tube and even happier that his friend helped him fix it. From that day on, Bubba and his friends always looked for things to fill the tube with and play with together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a purple bottle that she loved very much. One day, Lily was playing with her bottle when she saw a butterfly. The butterfly had pretty purple wings that made Lily happy.

As she watched the butterfly, Lily started to blink her eyes. Blink, blink, blink. Suddenly, the butterfly flew away and Lily was sad. She looked at her purple bottle and realized that it made her happy too. So she hugged it tightly and smiled. 

From that day on, Lily always kept her purple bottle close by. And whenever she saw something beautiful, she would blink her eyes and remember how much she loved her bottle. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a noisy little boy. He loved making noises with anything and everything. One day, he found a bottle. He loved it and started banging it to make lots of noise. His mother came in and said, "No! You must not make so much noise with the bottle!" The little boy stopped and looked sad. His mother said, "Noisiness can be very annoying. You should be more quiet and respectful." 

The little boy thought about what his mother said. From then on, he tried to be quieter and more respectful. His mother and everyone around him was much happier. 

The moral of the story is: Respect others by being quiet and polite.

Once there was a little boy named Luke who liked to explore his garden. He was three years old and full of energy.

One day he noticed a strange plant at the edge of the garden. He peered at it curiously and reached out to touch it. Suddenly there was a loud noise. His mom rushed to his side and said, "Oh no! Don't touch that. It's poisonous." She quickly grabbed him and hugged him tight.

"Mom, why can't I touch it?" Luke asked in surprise.

His mom gave him a warning look. "That plant is very dangerous. It can make you very sick if you touch it. Let's go see the doctor tomorrow. He will tell us what to do."

The next day they went to the doctor. He was very thoughtful and listened carefully to the story. Then he explained to Luke why the plant was so dangerous.

He warned Luke never to touch the poisonous plant again. Luke remembered the warning and was careful in the garden from then on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat strawberries because they tasted so yummy. One day, her mom took her to the park to play. While they were playing, Lily saw a cool dog running towards her. She got scared and started to panic. But her mom told her not to worry because the dog was friendly. Lily felt much better and even petted the dog. After playing with the dog, her mom gave her a big juicy strawberry to eat. Lily was happy and forgot all about her panic. From that day on, Lily loved dogs and strawberries even more. The end.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play with books and toys. One day, they find a big book with many pictures. The book says "University" on the cover. Lily and Tom do not know what that means.

"Look, Tom, this book has many colors and shapes. What is university?" Lily asks.

"I don't know, Lily. Maybe it is a place where people learn things. Do you want to learn things?" Tom says.

"Yes, I do. Let's open the book and see what is inside," Lily says.

They open the book and see many pages with words and numbers and drawings. They try to read some words, but they are too hard. They look at the drawings and point at the things they know.

"Look, Lily, this is a car. And this is a tree. And this is a dog," Tom says.

"Look, Tom, this is a flower. And this is a house. And this is a cat," Lily says.

They turn the pages and see more and more things. They are happy and curious. They think the book is very attractive.

But then, they see a page with a big hole. Someone has torn the page and made it ugly. Lily and Tom are sad and angry.

"Who did this? Who tore the book?" Lily says.

"I don't know, Lily. Maybe it was a bad person. Or a naughty animal. Or a strong wind," Tom says.

They look around and see a squirrel on a branch. The squirrel has a piece of paper in its mouth. It is the piece of the book. Lily and Tom shout at the squirrel.

"Hey, squirrel, give us back the piece of the book. You are not nice. You are not smart. You are not attractive. You are a thief," Lily and Tom say.

The squirrel looks at them and makes a noise. It does not care about the book. It likes the paper. It thinks the paper is tasty. It chews the paper and swallows it. Then it runs away.

Lily and Tom are very sad. They close the book and hug each other. They wish they could fix the book. They wish they could go to university and learn more things. They wish they could find the squirrel and teach it a lesson. But they can't. They can only play with their books and toys and hope to find another attractive book someday.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play outside. He saw a big box near the tree. Tim was very curious. He wanted to know what was inside. So, he went closer to the box and took a peek.

Inside the box, Tim found a toy gun. He was so happy! He picked up the gun and started to play with it. He pretended to be a superhero, saving the world from bad guys. Tim ran around the yard, laughing and having fun.

After playing for a while, Tim started to feel hungry. He went back to his house and saw his mom in the kitchen. She had made some yummy cookies for him. Tim ate the cookies and told his mom about the toy gun and his adventures. His mom smiled and gave him a big hug.

One day, Luke wanted to play outside. But first he had to put on his bathrobe. He asked his mom, "Please put on my bathrobe?" His mom said yes, and she helped him put it on. 

Next, Luke went outside to play. But he noticed something strange. It was a harmless bug! He was scared at first. He didn't want to get too close because he thought it might hurt him. 

His mom saw him and said, "It's okay, Luke. It's harmless. Come a little closer and take a look!" So Luke took two steps closer and looked at the bug. He asked, "Please can I touch it?" 

His mom said, "Yes, but only if it's okay with the bug!" Luke smiled and said, "Hi, bug! Please can I touch you?" The bug stayed still, so Luke decided to pet it very gently. He said, "Thank you, bug!"

Lisa and Ben were twins who liked to play together. They had a modest house with a small garden and a big dog. They also liked to eat dessert after dinner, especially cake and ice cream.

One day, their mom baked a chocolate cake for them. She put it on the table and told them to wait until after dinner. Lisa and Ben nodded, but they could not stop looking at the cake. It smelled so good and had white frosting and sprinkles on top.

"Can we have a small piece now?" Lisa asked her mom.

"No, sweetie, you have to eat your vegetables first," her mom said.

Lisa and Ben sighed and went to play with their dog. They threw a ball and ran around the garden. They had fun, but they still thought about the cake.

"Maybe we can sneak a bite when mom is not looking," Ben whispered to Lisa.

Lisa nodded. She was curious and hungry. They waited until their mom went to the kitchen to get some water. Then they tiptoed to the table and reached for the cake.

But before they could touch it, they heard a loud bark. It was their dog, who had followed them. He jumped on the table and knocked over the cake. It fell on the floor and broke into pieces. The dog licked some of the frosting and wagged his tail.

Lisa and Ben gasped. They knew they were in trouble. They looked at each other and then at their mom, who came back to the living room.

"What happened here?" she asked, frowning.

Lisa and Ben did not know what to say. They felt sorry and scared. They did not want to lie, but they also did not want to get punished.

They looked at their dog, who looked happy and innocent. He did not mention anything. He just barked and licked his lips.

Once there was a little girl named Janie. One cold winter day she was playing by the fireplace. She was holding a spool of thread. She wanted to make something special. 

Janie's mom came into the room and said, "What are you doing?" 

Janie said, "I am making something special with the thread."

Janie's mom smiled and said, "Let me show you how to twist the thread so it looks nice." 

Janie watched as her mom took the end of the thread and twisted it around her fingers. Janie tried to do the same and it worked! She was so excited to see the twisted thread and started making a bracelet with it. 

Janie smiled at her mom and said, "I like making things with the twisty thread!"

Jane and Tom went to the park today. Jane observed the squirrels in the trees while Tom explored the playground. Jane saw that the squirrels were very independent as they jumped from branch to branch.

Tom shouted to Jane, "Look Jane! I'm going down the big slide!" Jane looked over and watched as Tom climbed the ladder. He then shouted, "Wheee!!!" as he went down the slide.

Tom ran up to Jane, smiled, and said, "That was really fun! Let's go again!" Jane replied, "OK, let's go!" They both began to climb the ladder again, but Jane looked back and observed the independent squirrels still jumping from tree to tree.

Once there was a little girl named Anna. She was three years old and lived in a big house with her parents. 

One day as she was playing outside it started to rain. She ran to her dad and said, "Daddy, it's raining! What should I do?"

He replied, "Don't worry Anna. You can go inside and play until the rain stops."

Anna went into the house and started to explore. She opened a door that she had never opened before and saw a ghost! It was a mean looking ghost and it made her scared. She ran away and started to cry.

Her mom came over and said, "What's wrong? You look hurt."

Anna explained what she saw. Her dad then said, "It's alright sweetheart, it was just a silly ghost." He took Anna in his arms and gave her a big hug.

Eventually the rain stopped and Anna had a fun day. She learned that even though there are strange things that can scare us, we don't have to be scared.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved going to the park to play. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom and dad. He was very happy.

At the park, Tim saw a big tree. He wanted to give the tree a hug. So, he hugged the tree and felt good. Tim liked the tree a lot. He played with his ball, ran around, and had a lot of fun.

Tim had a successful day at the park. He played and laughed a lot. When it was time to go home, Tim felt tired but happy. He couldn't wait to come back to the park again.

Once upon a time there was a bright lady. She liked to go for walks in the park. One day, as she was walking, she saw a jelly sandwich on the ground. It looked delicious so she picked it up and smiled. 

Just then, a naughty boy appeared. He was running around and being quite silly. He saw the lady looking at the sandwich and he laughed.

The naughty boy said "What you got there? Can I have it?" 
The lady smiled and said "No, I think I'll keep this one. It looks like it might be my lucky day" 

The naughty boy then said "What if I just steal it? I bet you won't catch me!" 
The lady said "That would be wrong. You shouldn't steal, it's not nice." 

The naughty boy thought for a moment and then said "Ok, I won't steal it. I'll just go get my own jelly sandwich from home." 

The lady smiled and said "That sounds like a much better idea! I think you will like it even more that way." 
The naughty boy smiled and thanked the lady for helping him, before running off. 

The lady walked away, enjoying her lucky jelly sandwich.

Nana loved cooking. Every day she would collect the best ingredients and make lots of tasty treats. But one day she had a goal. She wanted to quit cooking and become a truck driver.

She was very excited. She found an old truck and set off on her first journey. Along the way she found a young puppy that was very spoiled. She picked up the pup and adopted it. The pup and Nana had so much fun driving around together.

They monitored their fuel and looked for new places to explore. Nana was so proud of herself for achieving her goal of becoming a truck driver. She was happy she quit cooking and that she had her new pup with her. 

Nana and the pup travelled around for months, enjoying every adventure. And everyone that saw them was very happy to have them around.

Once upon a time, there was a little house near the woods. In the house lived a mommy, a daddy, and a little girl named Sara. They were a happy family. They liked to play games, sing songs, and have fun together.

One day, Sara went to bathe in a small pool near the house. She liked to splash and play in the water. But she did not know that there was a dangerous snake near the pool. The snake wanted to come close to Sara.

When mommy and daddy saw the dangerous snake, they ran to Sara. They picked her up and took her back to the house. They told her to be careful and always look for dangerous things. Sara learned to be safe when she played outside. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a prince. He was very nervous because he had something to do. He let the people around him help him. He let the birds tell him stories. He let the animals give him advice. He was so nervous, he could barely sleep.

Finally, the prince let the wind guide him to the place he needed to go. When he arrived, he was so happy he forgot to be nervous. The people cheered for him and clapped.

The prince let everyone give him a big hug. Then, he thanked them all.

Now the prince was brave and not nervous at all. He was ready to take on the world!

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play outside. But today the weather is bad. It is raining and windy. Sara and Tom are sad.

"Can we go outside?" Tom asks his mom.

"No, you have to stay inside. The weather is too bad. You can get wet and cold," mom says.

"But we want to play!" Sara says.

Mom thinks for a moment. She has an idea.

"Why don't you play pretend? You can be mighty heroes who save the world from the bad weather. You can use your toys and blankets and pillows to make a fort and a rocket," mom says.

Sara and Tom like mom's idea. They run to Tom's room and start to play pretend. They make a fort with blankets and pillows. They make a rocket with a big box and some crayons. They put on their capes and helmets.

"We are the mighty heroes! We can stop the rain and the wind!" Sara says.

"Yes, we can! Let's go to the rocket and blast off to the sky!" Tom says.

They get into the rocket and pretend to fly. They make noises and gestures. They have fun.

Sara and Tom forget about the bad weather. They are happy. They stay inside and play pretend. They are the mighty heroes.

Once upon a time, there was a man named Andy. He wanted to show his wife something special. He was eager to show her what he had made with his own hands.

One day, he took her to his house. When they arrived, they saw something Andy had made. It was a big surprise!

Andy asked his wife, "Do you like it?"

"Yes, it's beautiful!" she said.

Andy was very happy. He was eager to show her his creation. She smiled and thanked him for a wonderful surprise.

The couple enjoyed their time together, and Andy was glad he could show his wife something special.

Candy was playing in her garden with her toys when she saw a big bowl in the grass. She was scared because she had never seen it before. She backed away and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, a rabbit hopped out of the bowl. Candy was even more scared. She wanted to run away but she was too curious. She took a deep breath and slowly walked towards the rabbit. 

The rabbit smiled at her and said "Hi Candy!" Candy was surprised and didn't know what to say. She just shrugged. 

The rabbit jumped out of the bowl and slowly made its way up Candy's arm and onto her shoulder. She smiled and the two of them went back to the bowl. 

Candy leaned over it to see what was inside and was amazed to find dozens of small colourful stones. The rabbit told Candy that it was a special bowl and she could take a few of the stones home with her. 

Candy took three of the stones with her and said goodbye to the rabbit. She was no longer scared and went back to her garden, with her special stones safe in her pocket.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the puddles after it rained. She would jump up and down and make a big splash. One day, she saw a big cake on the kitchen counter. It looked so yummy that she couldn't resist it. She took a big bite and it tasted so good.

But then, her mom came into the kitchen and saw what she had done. Her mom was troubled and upset. Lily knew she had done something wrong. She tried to say sorry, but it was too late. Her mom told her she couldn't have any more cake and sent her to her room.

Lily felt sad and alone in her room. She wished she could take back what she had done. But she knew she couldn't. She learned that sometimes doing something that seems fun can lead to trouble and sadness.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a dog named Max. Max was a very dependable dog. Timmy loved Max very much. 

One day, Timmy decided to invite his friend Billy over to play. Billy was a troublemaker, but Timmy didn't know that. When Billy came over, he started to make a mess. Max tried to help clean up, but Billy just made more trouble. 

Timmy realized that he shouldn't have invited Billy over. He felt bad for Max and all the trouble Billy caused. From that day on, Timmy only invited his dependable friends over to play with Max.

Lily and Max are friends. They like to play together. One day, they go to Lily's house after school. Lily's mom says they can have a snack.

"Would you like some milk and cookies?" she asks.

"Yes, please!" Lily and Max say.

Lily's mom gives them each a glass of milk and a plate of cookies. They are chocolate chip cookies. They smell good. Lily and Max say thank you and sit at the table.

They drink their milk and eat their cookies. They are very good. They make them happy.

"Your mom makes the best cookies," Max says.

"Thank you. I like them too," Lily says.

They share their cookies and talk about their day. They have fun. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the dirt and make mud pies. One day, she found a special spot in the soil where she could dig and find shiny rocks.

Lily's mom warned her that the sun was very hot that day and that her ice cream would melt quickly. Lily didn't listen and ran outside to eat her ice cream. As she was eating, she heard a strange noise coming from the soil. 

Lily decided to investigate and started digging. After a few minutes, she found a beautiful necklace that was buried in the soil. She was so happy and ran back to show her mom. Her mom was amazed and proud of her brave little girl. From that day on, Lily always listened to her mom's warnings and never let her ice cream melt again.

Once, there were two friends who were playing in the yard. One was clumsy and the other wasn't. 

The clumsy one said, â€œLetâ€™s catch a bug!â€

But the other one disagreed.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in his bedroom all day long. His bedroom was warm and cozy, with lots of toys.

One day, Tim's mom came into the bedroom. "Tim," she said, "why don't we go outside and play in the sun?" She suggested this because it was a beautiful day outside. Tim thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, Mom, let's go play outside!"

So, Tim and his mom went outside and played in the warm sun. They laughed and had lots of fun. When they were tired, they went back inside to Tim's warm bedroom. They both agreed it was a great day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sam. She loved to wear her favorite dress, which was blue with a big pink bow.

One day, Sam went for a walk in the woods with her mom. Suddenly, they heard a noise. "What was that?" Sam asked.

"I'm not sure," her mom replied. "But stay close to me!"

The noise got louder, until they saw a man walking towards them. He was wearing a terrifying mask and carrying a big weapon.

"Oh no!" Sam's mom said. "Let's go!" She grabbed Sam and they ran away, but the man chased after them.

Finally, they reached a big house. Sam's mom opened the door and they quickly ran inside. The man stopped outside and shouted, "You can't escape! I'll get you!" 

Sam and her mom were so scared. They hid behind the couch and waited for a long time.

Finally, the noise stopped. Sam's mom peeked outside, but the man was gone.

"We are safe now," Sam's mom said. She hugged Sam tightly. "Let's never go for a walk in the woods again."

Sam nodded. She never wanted to experience something so terrible again.

Jim heard a big noise. He looked up and saw a rocket flying in the sky. He shouted with joy and waved, but the rocket was high in the air. Suddenly the rocket disappeared. Jim was sad. He went to look for it but he couldn't find it.

As he walked, he heard a loud thud. He went towards the sound, and he saw the rocket lying on the ground. Jim was so surprised. He went closer and saw that the rocket was dead.

He sighed and walked away, his head hung low. He missed the rocket but he knew nothing could bring it back to life again. He put the memory of the rocket deep in his heart.

Mia was a small girl who always wanted to help others. One morning, Mia saw a grumpy model walking down the street. She asked the model, "Are you ok?" The model just grumbled and kept on walking. Mia knew she wanted to help.

Mia ran after the model and said, "Please let me help you!" The model stopped and looked at Mia. She could see the concern in Mia's eyes. She sighed and said, "Ok then, what can you do to help me?" 

Mia thought for a moment and said, "I can make you smile!" She jumped up and down, clapped her hands and smiled a big smile. The model couldn't help but laugh a little.

The model thanked Mia and said, "You really did help me! That was very kind of you!" Mia smiled and said, "You're welcome!" Then she ran off to help someone else.

Tom and Sam liked to play hockey with their sticks and ball. They played in the park near their home. They had fun and were good friends.

One day, a big boy came to the park. He had a big stick and a big ball. He said, "This is my park. You can't play here. Go away."

Tom and Sam were scared. They did not want to fight. They wanted to play. They said, "Please, can we play with you? We can share our sticks and ball. We can be friends."

The big boy laughed. He said, "No, you can't play with me. You are too small and weak. I don't need friends. I only need my stick and ball. Now go away or I will hit you."

Tom and Sam ran away. They were sad and angry. They said, "He is mean and rude. He is not a good boy. He does not know how to share. He does not know how to be a friend."

They went to their home. They told their mom what happened. Their mom hugged them. She said, "I'm sorry, my boys. Some people are not nice. They do not care about others. They only care about themselves. You did the right thing. You did not fight. You did not hurt anyone. You are good boys. You are dependable boys. You are my boys. I love you."

Tom and Sam smiled. They felt better. They said, "We love you too, mom. You are the best mom. You are dependable too. You always help us. You always listen to us. You always love us."

They hugged their mom. They asked her a question. They said, "Mom, can we play hockey in the backyard? We still want to play. We still have fun. We still have each other."

Their mom nodded. She said, "Of course, you can. You can play hockey in the backyard. You can play anything you want. You can have fun. You can have each other. You are my boys. You are my hockey boys."

Tom and Sam cheered. They ran to the backyard. They took their sticks and ball. They played hockey. They had fun. They had each other.

But the big boy was still in the park. He was alone. He had his stick and ball. He played hockey. He did not have fun. He did not have anyone. He was mean and rude. He was not a good boy. He did not know how to share. He did not know how to be a friend. He was sad and lonely. He had a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was an orange box that needed to be sorted. A quick bunny wanted to help. He hopped up to the box and started looking for things to sort. He found a ball and a toy car. He put the ball in one side of the box and the car in the other.

The bunny was very quick and soon he had the box all sorted. With a big smile, he hopped away. But he had to stop. He could see something orange in the grass. He hopped up to have a look. It was a big orange leaf! He picked it up and put it in the box with the other things.

The bunny had now sorted the box with all the orange things. He was so proud of his work. He hopped away with a happy hop. The box was organised and the bunny was quick!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jenny. Jenny loved baking in the kitchen. She would visit her old baking station every day and get busy baking. 

Today, on a particularly wet day, Jenny was feeling extra excited to bake. She quickly gathered all the ingredients from around the kitchen and carried them over to her special baking station. 

Once everything was ready, Jenny put on her special apron and started mixing the ingredients together. She carefully measured, stirred and sprinkled until she had a nice big bowl of dough.

Next, Jenny set the oven and let the dough bake until it was a golden brown. After smelling the delicious aroma, she carefully took the dough out of the oven and let it cool. 

 Finally, Jenny cut the dough into pieces and enjoyed her wonderful wet delicious treats. Yum!

Once upon a time, there was a famous spoon. He was a special spoon, because he could make magical soup that could make anyone feel better.

One night, the spoon heard a noise outside. It was a little girl who was cold and lonely. The spoon wanted to help, so he shook and shivered until he made a warm, special soup. The girl was so happy, and to thank the spoon, she gave him a big, shiny smile.

From that day on, the spoon was very famous. Everyone wanted to enjoy the magical soup, because it made them feel happy, warm and cozy. The spoon was happy and he kept shivering to make more magical soup. And everyone lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a gifted dog named Spot. Spot could do many things that other dogs could not do. Spot liked to help people and teach them new things.

One day, Spot saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was trying to fill a big jug with water. She wanted to give the water to her mom, but the jug was too heavy. Spot wanted to help Sue.

Spot had an idea. He taught Sue to use a small cup to fill the jug little by little. Soon, the jug was full of water. Sue was very happy and thanked Spot. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy fan. He would turn it on and watch it spin around and around. One day, Timmy's sister came into the room and took his fan away. Timmy got very frustrated and yelled, "Give me back my fan!"

His sister said, "No, I want to play with it now."

Timmy didn't want to share his fan, but he didn't want to fight with his sister either. So, he decided to ask his mom for help. He said, "Mom, my sister took my fan and I'm frustrated. Can you help us share it?"

Mom came into the room and said, "Let's take turns playing with the fan. That way, everyone can have fun."

Timmy and his sister agreed and took turns playing with the fan. They both had a good time and learned that sharing can be fun too.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bunny named Benny. Benny loved to play in the forest with his friends. One day, Benny and his friends found a whistle. They blew it and it made a loud sound. It surprised them all! They had never heard such a noise before. From that day on, Benny carried the whistle with him everywhere he went. He loved to surprise his friends by blowing the whistle when they least expected it. They would all laugh and play together in the forest. Benny was happy to have such great friends and his whistle to make them all smile.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Joe. Joe was only 3 years old and he loved playing with his clay pot. He would spend hours making impressive things with it. Joe was so proud of his pot that he made sure he never left it behind.

One day, Joe decided to take his pot to the nearby park. But along the way, he was spotted by two bullies who were trying to steal the pot from him. Joe screamed for help, but nobody was around to help him.

The bullies snatched the pot away and laughed. Joe was so angry that he ran after the bullies, but it was too late. 

Joe was sad but he had to accept that the pot was lost forever. He had to suffer knowing that he will never get the pot back.

Jack was three years old. He was curious and loved to play. One day he saw a cord connected to the family TV. He had never seen this before and wanted to find out what it was. So he asked his mom if he could touch it. 

His mom said yes, but only if he was very careful. Jack promised he would be and then started to pull the cord. Suddenly, the TV lit up which made him jump and laugh. His mom was not happy with this as it was difficult to turn off again. 

So Jack's mom decided to only allow him to touch the cord when she was present. That way she could make sure he stayed safe. Jack promised he would be careful and they both smiled. From that day, Jack and his mom had lots of fun exploring the TV and its cord.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved her rubber. Every day she found special ways to play with it. She would make it into perfect shapes and pretend it was a little ballerina.

He looked so friendly and cute, so she asked "Can I pet you?" The doggie barked a little and started to lick her hand. She was so happy and gave him a big hug.

The doggie just cocked his head to one side and looked sad. The little girl felt bad and said, "It's ok, I forgive you!" Then they played together, just like old friends. Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved watching helicopters in the sky. He looked up at them every day with joy in his heart. One day, he asked his mom if he could have a helicopter of his own. His mom said to him, "That's an expensive toy, I'm sorry."

The moral of the story is that hard work pays off! With patience and perseverance, you can achieve your goals.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play basketball with his friends. One day, Timmy's basketball disappeared! He looked everywhere but he couldn't find it.

From that day on, Timmy made sure to keep his basketball close by so it wouldn't disappear again. He played with his friends every day and they all had lots of fun together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Peter. Peter loved to explore and play in nature. One day, he found a pipe in his garden. He wanted to know more about the pipe so he poked it. Suddenly, a light began to shine from the pipe! He was so excited and asked, "What is this?"

He heard a voice that said, "I am the pipe magician! I can show you something very special if you come inside." Peter was so excited, he nodded and followed the pipe inside. 

The pipe magician led him to a room filled with coloured lights. "These are magical lights," the pipe magician said. He then waved his hands and the lights began to flicker and move. Peter smiled and said, "That looks so beautiful!" 

The pipe magician laughed and said, "Yes, these lights can make any wish come true. All you have to do is make a wish and blow on the pipe! Then, your wish will come true." Peter was so happy and excited he made a wish and blew into the pipe. The light began to twinkle and shimmer brighter and brighter. Peter's wish had come true! 

The pipe magician smiled and said, "Now, the pipe will take you home. Have a safe journey!" And with that, Peter arrived back home. He never forgot the magical pipe and the light that he found!

Once upon a time, there was a green raft. It was in a big river. A boy saw it and wanted to grab it. He jumped in the water and swam to the raft. He climbed on it and started to float away.

But the river was very strong. The boy couldn't control the raft. It went faster and faster. The boy was scared. He tried to grab the sides of the raft, but it was too slippery. Suddenly, the raft hit a big rock and the boy fell into the water. He couldn't swim well and the river took him away. The end.

Once there was a girl who liked to take her dog for a walk. She was only three years old, so her mom got her an old leash so that she could hold her puppy safely. Every day, she would plan a special route for them to go on. First, they would go to the park and swing on the swings, then they would go for a long walk all around the block. The girl loved spending time outside with her pup, and her mom was always happy to watch them explore. They would always come back home for dinner, tired and happy. The girl was always proud that she got to be her pup's special walker, and her pup was proud to go out and explore with her.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Molly. She was 3 years old and so very eager to explore the world. One day she was walking down the street when she heard a pleasant chirping noise. Molly smiled back and said, "Hello! My name is Molly. What's your name?"

Kiwi told Molly about his adventures and about the wonderful world around him. He listened and was very compassionate to Molly whenever she talked. 

Kiwi decided to introduce Molly to the entire world and show her the magical beauty of nature. They spent hours playing and exploring the world together and each day brought more and more amazing discoveries.

Molly was very lucky to have such a compassionate and loyal friend like Kiwi. He brought her nothing but joy and adventure and taught her so much about the world.

Once upon a time, there was a rat who lived in a cave. He was very hungry, so he went out to find something to eat.

He walked around the forest, looking everywhere. He soon found some food that looked delicious, but it was too high up in a tree. He had to find a way to get it.

Then he had an idea. He came across a spray bottle. He thought to himself, "If I spray this bottle, maybe the food will come down." So he sprayed it up in the tree. 

It worked! The food came tumbling down and he was so happy. He ate the cheap food and thought it was the best thing he ever tasted. He thanked the spray bottle for helping him out and then he ran home.

The rat was very happy and he never went hungry again. He learned that no matter how tough life can be, there are always solutions, even if they are cheap. 

The End.

Once upon a time a little boy named Sam wanted to have lots of fun. He went to his mom and suggested they play a puzzle together. But Mom was too busy and said no.

Mom saw how upset Sam was and felt regret for not playing with him. She came over and hugged Sam and said "Puzzles are more fun when you share them with someone special". She also suggested they get all the pieces they needed and then they played the puzzle together.

Sam learned an important lesson. He learnt that it was silly to try and do things on his own, and that it was more fun to share things with family. He was pleased and happy to share his puzzlw with Mom. The end.

Once upon a time there was a big elephant. He wanted to know how much he weighed, so he asked the wise old animal doctor.

Once upon a time, there was a sad leather bag. It sat alone, feeling lonely and wishing for someone to stay with him. One day, a little boy came and saw the bag. Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Floppy. Floppy loved to create things with his toys. One day, he wanted to make a special picture for his mom. His sister was upset at first, but then she saw how happy Floppy was with his finished picture. She realized that it was important to let Floppy have his own time to create. Once upon a time, there was a special piece. It was perfect and it made everyone very happy. Each day, people would take turns relaxing with the piece. It made them feel so calm and relaxed.
