After a while, the family decided to give the piece away. They wanted to share the happy feeling it created with other people too. So, they put the piece in a special box and gave it away. 

The piece brought joy to many families and everyone was so happy they could relax together. It was perfect.

Once there was a long gorilla. Every day he loved to sing and make songs. One day he was walking through the forest and he heard two birds chirping by a tree. The gorilla stopped and listened to the birds. 

The birds said, "Why don't you sing with us? The forest will be more beautiful with your cheerful songs."

The gorilla smiled and said, "I would love to! Singing is my favorite thing to do." So the three of them sang together in the forest. After a while, the birds said, "Thank you for singing with us, Gorilla. Now we can all make the forest more beautiful together." 

The moral of this story is that everyone has something special to contribute, and that by working together we can make the world a brighter place.

Timmy was so excited - he was going to ride his bike up the hill. He hopped onto his bike and peddled up the hill with excitement. 

But halfway up the hill, he started to worry. "I'm so alone! What if I can't get to the top?", he thought. He stopped peddling and just sat there. 

Suddenly he heard a voice. "Hey, don't worry! I'm right here." It was his mom. She had run up the hill after him "I'm not going to let you go alone," she smiled. 

Timmy felt so relieved and happy. His mom had come to make sure he was safe! He hopped back on his bike and, with his mom walking next to him, finished going up the hill. 

At the top of the hill, Timmy and his mom both cheered. His mom threw her arms around him and said "Nobody has to feel lonely when I'm around". 

Then, with a smile, Timmy started to peddle back down the hill. Now he was not worried - he was with his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a little boy. Every day, the mommy took the little boy out for a walk in the dark woods. They always had lots of fun. One day, the mommy told the little boy that he should test himself by going alone to the furthest part of the woods. The little boy was nervous, but he went anyway.

When the little boy was in the woods he heard strange noises. It was so dark he couldn't see anything. He started to get scared. He called out for his mommy, but she didn't answer. The little boy was so scared he was trembling with fear. 

The little boy started walking back. As he was walking through the woods, he saw big, unknown shadows in the dark. He ran as fast as he could. Suddenly, a large, unknown creature jumped out out at the little boy and grabbed him. 

The little boy screamed for help, but no one heard him. He was never seen again. 

The mommy had set him up to test himself, but she never expected a bad ending like this!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to watch cartoons. He would watch them every day and laugh at the silly characters. One day, Timmy saw a scary cartoon that made him frightened. He didn't like it at all and wanted to turn it off.

But his big sister, Sarah, wanted to keep watching. She thought it was funny and didn't understand why Timmy was scared. They argued and Timmy started to cry. Their mom came in and saw what was happening. She turned off the cartoon and hugged Timmy, telling him that it's okay to be scared sometimes.

From then on, Timmy and Sarah made sure to watch cartoons that they both liked and that didn't scare Timmy. They learned that it's important to be kind to each other and to not watch things that make someone frightened.

Once upon a time, there were two frogs. One of them was very weak, but the other frog chose to ignore it. The weak frog croaked and hopped up to the other frog and asked, "Why won't you talk to me?" But the other frog just ignored it.

The weak frog tried and tried to get the other frog's attention, but he kept on ignoring it. So, the weak frog hopped away sadly.

The next day, the weak frog came back and said to the other frog, "Please talk to me, I'm lonely." But again, the other frog ignored the weak frog.

The weak frog felt so upset and angry. It hopped around the other frog and shouted, "Why won't you talk to me?!" But still, the other frog ignored it.

The weak frog was so heartbroken. It had to find someone else to talk to, someone who would listen and care.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was only three years old. Her name was Anna. One day, she was resting in her bedroom when she started to imagine something. She imagined that she was a superhero wearing a yellow helmet. She visualized herself flying around and saving people in distress. 

Suddenly, Anna heard a knock on her bedroom door. She opened it and saw her dad with a funny looking helmet. It was dull green and had two antennas sticking out. 

â€œWhat is this, daddy?â€ she asked.

Her dad smiled and said, â€œItâ€™s your superhero helmet! Whenever you want to save people, just put it on and you will gain special powers.â€

Anna was so excited. She thanked her dad and put the helmet on. She was ready to go! She imagined leading her own team of superheroes and saving the world from evil villains. 

Anna went on many exciting adventures with her superhero team and she wore her helmet proudly.

Once upon a time there was a dolphin who liked to wander. He swam around the ocean every day looking for something new and exciting. 

One day the dolphin found something special. The ocean was warm and the sun was shining. The dolphin smiled and knew he had found a special place. 

The dolphin decided to explore this special place. He swam around and looked at all the amazing things in the ocean. He could see colourful fish and coral in the warm water. 

The dolphin kept swimming and he soon came across a big beach. The sand was so warm on his fins, he just had to stop and take it all in. He stayed for a while and enjoyed the sunshine and the waves. 

When he felt it was time to move on, the dolphin returned to the ocean. He decided to wander around some more, so he could find more special things. 

He kept swimming and he found many amazing things. But nothing was as special as the warm beach he had found. And so the dolphin kept coming back to this place whenever he wanted to wander.

Once upon a time, there were two brothers who lived in the same house. The oldest brother was named Jack, and he was very proud of that. His younger brother, Jason, was a bit jealous. 

One day, Jack found a funny root in the garden. He thought it looked like a face and it made him laugh. He showed it to Jason and soon both of them were laughing and having fun together. 

After a while, Jason wanted the funny root for himself. He wanted it because Jack had found it first and he was jealous. Jack could see that Jason wanted the root and he decided to let him have it. 

The little brothers hugged each other when Jack gave Jason the funny root, and they both laughed and laughed.

Once upon a time, there was a little penguin. The penguin lived in a cold place with ice and snow. The penguin had a broken toy. The broken toy made the penguin very sad.

One day, the penguin saw a big bear. The penguin had a question for the bear. The penguin asked, "Can you fix my broken toy?" The bear looked at the toy and said, "I will try."

The bear tried to fix the toy, but it was too broken. The bear could not fix it. The penguin was sad. The bear said, "I am sorry, little penguin. Your toy is too broken to fix." The penguin cried and went back to its cold home. The penguin's toy was still broken, and the penguin was very sad. The end.

Once there was a tall player. He liked to stretch his body every day. He would stretch his arms up high. He would reach and stretch his legs out. He would also stretch his back and make it curve. He would laugh and have fun while he was stretching.

One day the player was feeling especially happy. He was feeling so happy that he decided to stretch his arms to the sky. He tried reaching them as high as he could and then held his arms in the air. The player felt so tall and so strong.

The player then decided to take a break. He sat down and happy thoughts filled his mind. His happy thought was about stretching every day for years and years. He smiled as he thought about it.

The tall player stretched once more before getting up and going off on a new adventure. He knew he would stretch everyday from that moment on!

Once upon a time, there was a big yard. In the yard, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play in the yard with her toys. One day, Lily's mom said they had to hurry and go to the store. Lily didn't want to leave her toys in the big yard, but her mom promised they would come back soon. 

Lily and her mom went to the store and bought some yummy snacks. But Lily kept thinking about her toys in the big yard. She asked her mom if they could hurry back home. When they got back to the big yard, Lily was so happy to see her toys again. She played and played until it was time for dinner. 

After dinner, Lily's mom said it was time for bed. Lily was sad to leave her toys in the big yard again, but her mom promised they would play again tomorrow. Lily went to sleep dreaming about all the fun she would have in the big yard the next day. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in his backyard. His backyard was not big, but it was fun. One day, Timmy's friend came to play. His friend brought a ball to throw. They threw the ball back and forth. Timmy's mom came outside and saw them playing. She smiled at them and said they were having fun. Timmy was happy to have a modest backyard to play in with his friend.

Jenny loved her green dress with the zipper. She wore it every day, even when it was cold or hot. She liked to zip and unzip the zipper, and make noises with her mouth. She felt like a big girl in her green dress.

One day, Jenny's mom said, "Jenny, you can't wear your green dress today. It's too small for you. You have grown a lot, and the zipper won't close. Look, it's stuck on your tummy. You need a new dress, my sweetie."

Jenny was sad. She didn't want a new dress. She wanted her green dress with the zipper. She cried and said, "No, no, no! I want my green dress! I don't want to grow! I want to stay small!"

Mom hugged Jenny and said, "I know, Jenny, I know. But growing is good. It means you are healthy and strong. And you can still play with your green dress, even if you can't wear it. You can use it as a blanket, or a cape, or a tent. Or you can be generous and share it with someone who needs it. Maybe there is a little girl who doesn't have a dress, and would be happy to have your green dress with the zipper. What do you think, Jenny?"

Jenny thought for a moment. She still loved her green dress, but she also wanted to be good and kind. She wiped her tears and said, "Okay, Mom. I will share my green dress with someone who needs it. Maybe they will like to zip and unzip the zipper, too. And maybe you can buy me a new dress, with a bigger zipper, and a different color. How about pink?"

Mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Jenny. You are a very generous girl, and I'm proud of you. Come on, let's go and find someone who will love your green dress as much as you did. And then we can go and buy you a new dress, with a bigger zipper, and a pink color. How does that sound?"

Jenny nodded and said, "That sounds good, Mom. I love you."

Mom said, "I love you too, Jenny." And they held hands and walked out of the door.

Once upon a time, there was a squirrel named Sam. Sam had a warm, cozy home in a big tree near the river. One day, Sam saw a boat sail on the river. He wanted to sail too, so he made a small boat from a leaf.

Sam put his boat in the water and started to sail. He was so happy! But soon, the wind blew very hard, and Sam's boat went far away from his warm home. Sam was scared and sad.

A kind bird saw Sam and helped him get back to his tree. Sam learned that it's fun to try new things, but it's also important to stay safe and close to home. And he also learned that friends can help you when you're in trouble.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little mushroom. The mushroom was very angry because no one wanted to sit with it. It felt sad and alone.

One day, a little girl named Lily came into the forest to play. She saw the angry mushroom and thought it looked funny. Lily walked over to the mushroom and said, "Hello, mushroom! Can I sit with you?" The angry mushroom was so happy that it smiled.

Lily and the mushroom became best friends. They would sit and play together every day. The mushroom was not angry anymore. It was very happy to have a friend like Lily. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a happy duck who loved to bounce. Everywhere the duck went, it would bounce its way there. One day, it bounced over to the pond where it saw a doctor.

"Hello!" said the duck cheerfully as it bounced around.

The doctor stared at the duck and said, "You're bouncing a lot. What's wrong?"

The duck looked at the doctor sadly and said, "I feel sour."

The doctor paused and then said, "That's okay, you need to take a break and drink some water to help you feel better. Here, try some of this sour lemonade and see how it makes you feel!"

The duck sniffed the lemonade and smiled. It took a sip of the sour drink and instantly felt better. The duck was so happy and thanked the doctor before bouncing away. 

From then on, the duck never forgot the doctor's advice, and whenever it felt sour it would take a sip of sour lemonade.

Once upon a time there was a wise old lady. She lived in a tall, green tree and liked to look out over the countryside. 

One day, a gentle breeze blew through the sky and scattered the lady's coins all over the ground. The old lady was very surprised and, using her wisdom, she quickly jumped out of her tree. 

The lady dashed around trying to collect all her coins, but she was too slow. With all the coins scattered, it was hard for the old lady to find them all.

But then something amazing happened - the lady heard a chirping noise and, turning around, she saw a group of happy birds. The birds had found all the scattered coins and were gathering them back together in a pile. 

The lady was very pleased and thanked the birds for their help. She quickly collected all her coins and started to head back to her tree. 

The wise lady was glad to have her coins back and thanked the birds for their kindness. She knew she had been very lucky, and from then on the old lady was always generous to the birds who had helped her.

Tom and Lily were playing in the garden. They liked to dig in the dirt and look for bugs. They found a big worm and a shiny beetle. They put them in a jar and showed them to their mom.

"Wow, you found some nice friends," mom said. "But you are very dirty. It's time to wash your hands and face."

Tom and Lily followed mom to the bathroom. Mom turned on the tap and gave them some soap. The soap was mild and smelled like flowers. It made bubbles on their hands.

"Rub the soap well and rinse with water," mom said. "Then you will be clean and fresh."

Tom and Lily did as mom said. They liked the feeling of the soap and the water. They splashed a little and laughed.

"Look, mom, we are clean!" Lily said.

"Yes, you are," mom said. "And just in time, because grandma and grandpa will arrive soon. They are coming to visit us and have dinner with us. Do you remember them?"

Tom and Lily nodded. They loved grandma and grandpa. They always brought them gifts and told them stories. They were excited to see them.

"Can we show them our bugs?" Tom asked.

"Sure, but only if they want to see them," mom said. "Some people don't like bugs very much. But I'm sure they will like you very much. Now, let's go and wait for them at the door."

Once upon a time, there was a big blue cloud in the sky. As the cloud floated by, it started to urge the wind to blow. The wind blew and the cloud drifted slowly through the sky. Suddenly the cloud stopped moving, much to the surprise of the animals below.

The animals were curious why the blue cloud had stopped moving and urged the wind to blow it again. As the clouds moved, the animals noticed that it was raining! They were so happy to finally have some water to drink, so they jumped and cheered!

The animals thanked the blue cloud for the rain and cheered as it slowly drifted away. They all waved goodbye until the cloud was out of sight. From that day on, the animals always looked up at the sky whenever they needed rain.

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He loved to play all day long. But one day he heard a loud screaming. He looked around but he couldn't see where the screaming was coming from. So he followed the sound. Eventually, he arrived at a big factory. The factory was very cheap and it looked old.

It was then that Jack noticed a man in the factory. He was screaming loudly. He was asking for help, but nobody was coming. Jack was scared but he decided to go inside. He saw that the man was stuck in a big machine. Jack tried to help him, but he was too small and couldn't move the machine.

So Jack shouted, "Help! Help!". Soon enough, a few workers came running and freed the man from the machine. The man thanked Jack and he gave Jack a big hug. He said, "Thank you! You saved me! You are so brave!". Jack smiled and was happy that he helped somebody.

One day, a dog named Max went out to play in the yard. It was icy and cold, but Max did not care. He liked to run and jump in the snow. Max found a big stick on the ground. He picked it up and started to chew on it. Max was very happy.

Max saw a big icy hill in the yard. He wanted to go up the hill. Max ran and ran, but the icy hill was very slippery. He tried to go up the hill many times, but he could not do it. Max was sad.

Max tried one more time to go up the icy hill. He ran as fast as he could, but he slipped and fell down. Max was hurt and cold. He could not play in the yard anymore. Max went back inside his house and cried. The day was not fun for Max.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Jim. Jim wanted to buy a new toy sail so he went to the shop to find one. He looked through all the sails but they were all too expensive.

Then he found one that was very cheap. It had a bright red colour and a big sail, so Jim bought it.

When Jim got home, he was so excited to play with his new sail. He opened the box and rolled the sail around his room hoping it would take him to far away lands.

But then the sail started to shake and the wind blew it really hard. Jim tried to hold on to it, but the sail was too strong, so it rolled out of the window and flew away.

Jim stood in his bedroom and looked sadly at the window. He had wanted to explore the world, but his cheap sail had broken. Jim had a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and very mischievous. One day, she was eating a sweet and sugary treat and her mother warned her to brush her teeth afterwards.

At first, Lucy resisted the idea of brushing her teeth, but her mother explained that she would get a big surprise if she did it. This made Lucy very excited and she quickly ran to the bathroom to brush her teeth.

When she finished brushing, Lucy found that there was a surprise waiting for her - a brand new toothbrush!

It was so adorable and it had her name written on it. She was so excited to try it out! 

Lucy ran back to her mother and said: "Mommy, I brushed my teeth. Look what I got!"

"That's great darling!" her mother replied. "Now you have your own special toothbrush - isn't it adorable?" 

Lucy smiled and nodded, now happy that she had resisted the temptation not to brush her teeth.

John loved to write. He wanted to write all day. So he made a special request to his daddy.

John said, "Daddy, can I write?" 
His daddy said, "Yes. Now, what would you like to write?"

John thought for a moment and then smiled. He grabbed a pencil and started scribbling on a piece of paper. After a few minutes, he was done.

John handed the paper to his daddy. His daddy said, "I am impressed. You wrote a story."

John smiled. He was so happy. Then he noticed it was raining outside and said to his daddy, "Daddy, look, it's wet outside." 

His daddy smiled and said, "Yes, it is wet outside. Now let's go inside and you can read the story you wrote."

John was very excited. He ran inside and started to read his story. He was so proud of himself that he had written a story, all by himself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her dolls. One day, Lily's mom told her that they were going to visit her grandma. Lily was so excited because she loved her grandma very much.

When they got to her grandma's house, Lily saw a beautiful vase on the table. Her mom told her that it was very fragile and she should be careful around it. Lily promised to be careful and not touch it.

Later that day, Lily's grandma recommended that they all go for a walk in the park. Lily loved going for walks so she turned to her mom and asked if they could go. Her mom agreed and they all went for a lovely walk in the park. When they got back to her grandma's house, Lily was very tired and went straight to bed. She dreamed of all the fun she had that day and couldn't wait to visit her grandma again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing outside, even when it was cold. One day, his mommy told him to put on his jacket before going outside. Timmy didn't want to wear his jacket because he thought it was too hot. His mommy said, "Timmy, it's important to wear your jacket so you don't get sick."

Timmy didn't want to listen to his mommy. He said, "I don't want to wear my jacket, it's too hot!" But his mommy insisted, "You need to resist the urge to take off your jacket. It's important to stay warm."

Timmy finally put on his jacket and went outside to play. After a while, he realized that his mommy was right. It was cold outside and he needed his jacket to stay warm. He felt proud of himself for listening to his mommy and wearing his jacket.

The moral of the story is that sometimes we need to listen to our parents even if we don't want to. They know what's best for us and want to keep us safe and healthy.

Once there was a boy called Jake. Jake loved to play in the park with his friends. One day, he was playing in the park when he fell. He was so scared and he didn't know what to do. He started to worry.

His mom saw him from the other side of the park and ran over to help. Jake was still scared but when he saw his mom everything felt normal. She picked him up and hugged him.

Jake's mom kissed him on the forehead. She smiled and said "it's ok, these things happen". Jake felt better now and wasn't worried anymore. He hugged his mom and they started to play together in the park.

Rory was a very curious 3-year-old boy. One morning, he started watching his parents get ready for work. He noticed his mom was wearing big, black boots. He had never liked boots and he was fearful!

"Mommy," he asked, "why do you wear those big, black boots?"

His mom said, "I wear boots to keep my feet warm and dry."

Rory wasn't sure he believed her. He asked, "Can I try them on?"

His mom smiled and said, "Yes, you can. Let me help you get them on."

Rory was amazed! The boots were so big and they fit him perfectly! He started stomping around the living room, feeling brave and strong.

"The boots make me feel like I can do anything!" he shouted.

His mom laughed. "I guess they do, don't they!" she said.

Rory was so proud. He had learned that even the things he was fearful of could be wonderful, if he just gave them a try.

Once upon a time a little boy named Sam was playing in the park with his friends. He noticed that some people were making a big tank in the middle of the park. Sam was fascinated and wanted to know what it was for.

The people explained that the tank was for preventing fires from happening. They said it was a popular way of protecting the park from danger.

Sam and his friends decided this was a great idea and that they wanted to help. So they filled the tank with water and washed the ground around it to help prevent fires. 

When they were done, Sam's friends clapped and cheered. Sam was so proud that he had helped to prevent fires, and it had become very popular with all his friends and the people who visit the park.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Jane. She had a purple toy which she absolutely loved. It was a pink rabbit.

One day Jane decided to play with her rabbit. She put it on the ground, said "bonjour" and moved away. But the rabbit stayed in its place and did not move at all.

Jane then sat in front of the rabbit and said, "Come on rabbit! Let's dance!" But the rabbit just stayed still and didn't dance.

That's when Jane's mom came over and said, "Jane, you need to separate yourself from the toy. You need to keep a distance from the rabbit. Let's try dancing to some music."

Jane and her mom started singing and dancing to a spicy song. Jane noticed the rabbit began to move to the beat! It hopped and swayed until the song ended.

Jane was so amazed and excited. She thanked her mom and hugged her bunny tightly. She knew that from that day forward, she and her bunny would always separate and reunite with a dance.

Once upon a time, there was a little sheep named Baa. Baa had a lot of wool on her body. She felt very warm and cozy with her wool. But one day, Baa saw that some of her friends didn't have much wool. They looked cold and sad.

Baa felt unusual. She wanted to help her friends. She thought about it and decided to share her wool with them. Baa's friends felt warm and happy with the wool. They thanked Baa for her kindness.

The moral of the story is that sharing is caring. When we share with others, we can make them feel happy and loved.

Once upon a time there was a yellow bird. He was a very successful bird. Every morning he would lay his eggs in the same spot in the forest.

One day, the yellow bird had laid six eggs. He was so proud! He knew the eggs were safe and he took the time to sing a happy song.

As time went on, the yellow bird was pleased to see the eggs hatch. Six yellow birds bowed out of the eggshells to join their father.

The yellow bird was so proud of his family. He was successful in raising his little birds. Every morning, he flew with them to a new and exciting place.

The yellow bird and his family explored the forest and they were always happy and successful. From that day on, they laid in the forest together and always had lots of fun.

Joshua was a mighty boy. He was playing in the park one day when he noticed a lemon in a tree branch. He smiled and shouted, â€œItâ€™s a lemon! I love lemons!â€

But then, a naughty squirrel came running out of the tree and grabbed the lemon. Joshua was very disappointed. He wanted the lemon for himself. He shouted and shouted at the squirrel, but it didn't listen.

The squirrel then ran off with the lemon. Joshua was so mad! He stomped his feet and shouted louder. At that moment, his mom came over to see what was wrong.

â€œJoshua, why are you shouting?â€ she asked.

Joshua explained that the naughty squirrel had taken his lemon. He shouted and shouted, but it wouldn't come back. Mom smiled and said, â€œDon't worry, letâ€™s go find some more lemons.â€

So, they went to the store where they bought a nice big bag of lemons.

Joshua was happy. He ran home with his new lemons - shouting in joy all the way!

Once, there was a pet called Mojo. Mojo was a small but very active puppy who loved to bark and chase his tail. Mojo was getting very dirty, so his tummy was in need of a polish.

Every day, Mojo would follow his paw around the house, always looking for something shiny to polish his tummy. He would often find shiny things like keys, coins, and pieces of jewelry. He would take the shiny things in his paw and try to polish his tummy, but it wouldn't work. He needed something special to make it sparkle like the others.

One day, Mojo's mommy had an idea. She brought out a soft cloth and began to gently rub Mojo's tummy. Mojo felt warm and happy. When she was done, Mojo's tummy sparkled brighter than it ever had before!

However, afterwards, Mojo was in pain. His mommy explained that polishing can hurt sometimes, just like after you brush your teeth. But Mojo knew that it was worth it in the end, because now his belly was super shiny and he felt proud of his sparkly tummy.

One day, a big cat saw a small human in the park. The cat was hungry and wanted to catch the human for food. The cat hid behind a tree and waited for the right time to spring.

The small human was playing with a ball. He kicked the ball and ran after it. He did not see the cat behind the tree. The cat saw the ball and thought it was a toy. The cat jumped out of the tree and tried to grab the ball with his claws.

"Meow!" the cat said. He wanted to play with the ball and the human.

"Ah!" the human said. He was scared of the cat. He thought the cat wanted to hurt him. He ran away from the cat and the ball.

"Wait!" the cat said. He followed the human and the ball. He wanted to be friends with them.

The human ran to his mother, who was sitting on a bench. He hugged her and pointed at the cat.

"Mommy, mommy, there is a big cat!" the human said. He was crying and shaking.

The mother looked at the cat and saw that he was not angry or mean. He was just curious and playful. She smiled and picked up the human.

"Don't worry, sweetie, the cat is not bad. He just wanted to play with you and your ball. He is not strong, he is weak. He cannot hurt you. Do you want to pet him?" the mother said.

The human looked at the cat and saw that he was not scary or fierce. He was just fluffy and cute. He stopped crying and nodded.

"Okay, mommy, I want to pet him. But can I have my ball back?" the human said.

The mother and the human walked to the cat and the ball. The cat saw them and wagged his tail. He licked the ball and gave it back to the human.

"Thank you, cat. You are nice. Do you want to play with me and my ball?" the human said.

The cat meowed and nodded. He liked the human and the ball. He wanted to play with them.

The mother, the human and the cat played together in the park. They had fun and became friends. The cat learned that humans are not food, but friends. The human learned that cats are not bad, but good. The mother learned that sometimes, the best things happen when you spring a surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with stones. One day, he found a big, round stone in the park. He thought it was a very special stone.

Tim wanted to see what was inside the stone, so he tried to squeeze it with his hands. The stone was too hard, and Tim felt foolish. He knew he couldn't open it that way. Tim saw a big dog in the park, and he had an idea. He threw the stone towards the dog, hoping the dog would help him open the stone.

The dog ran after the stone and brought it back to Tim. Tim tried to squeeze the stone again, but it was still too hard. He realized that he should not waste his time on things he couldn't do. Tim learned that it is better to play with things he knows and can do well, instead of trying to do something foolish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was very obedient and loved playing games and quizzes.

One day, Sarah was excited to hear that her mum and dad had a surprise for her. They said she was going to the zoo with them. This made Sarah so happy and very excited.

They drove to the zoo, and Sarah was amazed by all the animals. She saw monkeys, tigers and giraffes. She asked so many questions that her mum and dad couldn't keep up.

At the end of their time at the zoo, Sarah participated in a quiz. She got all the questions right and won a special prize. Everyone was so proud and Sarah was extremely excited. She hugged her mum and dad and thanked them for taking her to the zoo.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Abi. She was three years old and she loved to play outside. 

One day, Abi set off to look for her will. She searched everywhere but she couldn't find it. Then, she remembered that it was pink so she looked in the pink flowers and the pink sky. No luck. 

Finally, she heard a big, deep voice. "Hello there Abi," it called out. Abi looked up and saw a big purple dragon. "Have you seen my will?" she asked.

The dragon nodded. "It is over there," he said, pointing to a pink bush. Abi went over to the pink bush and sure enough, she found her will. 

"Thank you!" she said to the dragon. Abi was so happy to have found her will. 

The dragon smiled. "You are welcome," he said. 

Abi set off home with her will in hand, feeling very happy and thankful.

Mum and Dad bought a fancy gorilla. It was very big! They named it George. They brought George home and Mum dressed him in a fancy red hat and a bow tie. George was so excited and he smiled at Mum and Dad.

Mum and Dad gave George lots of treats. Every day they bought him some fresh fruit. George loved the bananas, apples and oranges. He gobbled them up!

George also loved playing in the backyard. He would swing from the trees and make funny noises. He was so funny! Every night, Mum and Dad played with him in the garden.

Mum and Dad were so happy that they had bought George. They said he was the best gorilla ever!

Molly was very excited, as she was ready to explore the maze. She was with her parents, holding their hands and wondering what secrets the maze held. Molly's parents had been talking about mazes for days and Molly was eager to see one in real life.

Molly went further and further into the maze, taking each turn and discovering more and more twists and turns. Each corner was an adventure. Eventually, after a few turns, Molly became tired and a bit scared - she had been in the maze for what seemed like forever.

Molly's dad saw the tired look on her face and said, "Don't worry Molly, we'll surrender and go home."

Molly was relieved. She grabbed her parent's hands and they left the maze. Molly felt sure that one day she'd be brave enough to explore a maze again. 

As they left, Molly took one last look back. She felt excited to explore the maze one day and find out where each turn would lead her.

One day, a girl named Jane went for a walk. She loved to skip and feel the smooth ground under her feet. As she skipped, she saw a big ball. Jane wanted to play with the ball, so she picked it up.

Jane started to skip with the ball. She held the ball on her head and tried to skip at the same time. It was fun, but it was also hard. The ball kept falling off her head.

After a while, Jane got tired. She sat down and put the ball on the ground. But then, a big dog came and took the ball away. Jane was sad and cried. She went home without her ball and couldn't play with it anymore.

Once there was a little girl named Jackie. She wanted to pick a peach from the big tree in her garden. Jackie was a bit foolish and climbed the tree without asking anyone for help. She was so excited she couldn't wait to pick and eat the delicious peach.

Suddenly, it started to rain and the wind blew cold, so Jackie began to shiver. All the leaves and branches froze, and Jackie was stuck! She didn't know what to do, so she started to cry.

But then, a kind fairy flew by and said, "Don't worry Jackie! I can help you!" The fairy waved her magic wand and the branches around Jackie unfroze. Jackie happily jumped down and grabbed the delicious peach. She said thank you to the fairy and ran inside to eat her treat!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Abigail. She was three years old, and she liked to explore. One day, she decided to wander down to the harbor near her house. It seemed so calm and peaceful that she wanted to see what it was like. 

As she arrived at the harbor, Abigail noticed lots of little boats that bobbed around in the water. She was so amazed that she didn't notice the big wave that was coming right at her! Suddenly, she was swept away by the wave and found herself surrounded by water. 

Abigail was helpless and alone. She wanted to find the shore again but she had no idea how to get back. It seemed like she was going to be stuck forever in the harbor! 

But then, two strong hands lifted her out of the water. It was her dad. He had seen her get swept away and had come to the harbor to rescue her. The look on Abigail's face went from feeling helpless to feeling relieved. 

Her dad hugged her tightly and carried her back home. Abigail was so relieved that her dad had saved her from the harbor. She never wanted to wander so far away from the shore again.

One day, Bobby and his mom were walking in the park. Bobby saw a bumper car and wanted to play in it. He asked his mom if he could have a ride, but she said no. Bobby began to feel sad but then his mom suggested something else.

"Let's make some jam!" she said.

So they went to a store to buy the ingredients. They bought different fruits: strawberries, blueberries, cherries and apples. Bobby was very excited.

When they got home, Bobby helped his mom. He cut the fruit and put the pieces into a pot. Then his mom brought the pot to the stove to heat it up.

When the jam was done, they ate it together with different kinds of bread. Bobby's mom said it was the best jam she ever had. Bobby was so happy. In the end, his mom brought him to the bumper cars after all.

"Look!" Mary said to her mommy. 
Her mommy smiled. "What is it?"

Once there was a boy named Tom. He liked to play in the park. One day, Tom found a big stick. He thought it was fun to play with the stick.

Tom saw a fearful dog in the park. The dog was scared of the stick. Tom said, "Don't be scared, dog. It's just a stick. I will not hurt you."

The dog and Tom became friends. They played with the stick together. They had a lot of fun. And the dog was not fearful anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Anna. She was three years old and liked to polish things. One day, there was a hurricane coming and Anna had to go inside. She looked out the window and saw everything outside was empty. She was scared of the hurricane.

But then Anna had an idea! She ran to the kitchen and grabbed a can of polish. Then she ran to her grandpa's room. She started to polish his big chair, so it was super shiny.

After she was done, Anna felt much better. She was no longer scared of the hurricane. She knew that polishing things helped make them look better, and she even made her grandpa's chair look extra special. The storm passed by quickly, and everyone was happy and safe. The end.

A girl and her mum were discussing what she should wear to school. The girl wanted to wear her favourite scarf, but her mum said it wouldn't be suitable. The girl was very obedient so she reluctantly agreed, but she was still disappointed.

When the girl got to school, she found out all her friends were wearing their favourite scarves. She wished she had followed her heart and listened to her mum. 

Feeling jealous, the girl decided to disobey her mum and put on her scarf. She felt happy for a few minutes, until she spotted her mum and teacher in the playground. 

The girl's teacher was not pleased. She said that the school had a strict rule against wearing scarves and the girl had broken it. The teacher said the girl would have to go home and discuss the matter with her mum. 

The girl was very scared when she returned home. Her mum was very angry and said that she had been very disobedient. The girl asked her mum for forgiveness, but she didn't listen. 

The girl was punished for the rest of the week, and felt very sad. She never forgot her lesson and was careful to always be obedient when her mum was around.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tom who loved to wander around the town. He saw so many incredible things, like tall buildings and colourful shops. 

One day, as Tom was wandering around, he spotted a big puddle on the sidewalk. He stood in front of it and was so surprised. He said, "What is this? It looks so incredible!" 

Tom decided to wander closer to the puddle, but he felt a little scared. Just then, something amazing came out of the puddle - it was a large frog! Tom was so happy and the frog hopped right onto his arm! 

Tom was so surprised and couldn't believe his eyes. It was an incredible day because of his new friend. From that day on, Tom and the frog wandered around the town and explored together as best friends.

Anna looked out the window. She wanted to see the clear sky and the shiny stars. She wished she could reach them. All of the sudden, a glowing envelope appeared. Anna was so excited. She opened it. Inside the envelope were stars that were glowing too. Anna reached her hand to take one of the stars. She could feel its magic. She put it in her pocket and went back to bed. The star kept on glowing in her pocket. This made Anna feel very happy and special.

Once upon a time, in a big, green forest, there was a chubby, little bunny. This bunny loved to play with his friends. They would run, jump, and make lots of noise while playing.

One day, while they were playing, a big, kind bear came to the forest. The bear could do a funny trick. He would bow to the trees and the trees would bow back. The chubby bunny and his friends were very happy to see this.

So, the chubby bunny asked the big bear to teach them how to bow. The bear said, "Yes, I will help you." They all tried to bow to the trees, and the trees bowed back. They made a lot of noise, laughing and clapping. From that day on, the chubby bunny and his friends would always bow to the trees, and the trees would bow back. Once upon a time there were two best friends, Gabby and Emma. Gabby was only three and Emma was a little older. One day, they were playing in the park when they heard a loud noise. 

Gabby jumped and said, "What was that?"

"Don't be scared," Emma said calmly. "It's just the rush of the cars driving by on the road."

Gabby nodded and looked around at the busy street. "It's so loud!"

Emma gently put her arm around Gabby and said, "Look, there's Daddy!"

Gabby smiled and quickly ran over to her dad, shouting, "Daddy!" her dad smiled and said, "Let's go home, Gabby. Hold onto my belt."

Gabby nodded and grabbed onto the belt as they quickly rushed back home. When they arrived, Gabby was tired and a little bit scared, so her dad held her close and said, "Don't worry, everything is calm now."

Gabby smiled and snuggled in closer, feeling safe and comforted by her dad's warm hug.

Ben and Mia are twins. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a trail of ants on the grass. They follow the trail to a big tree.

"Look, Ben, there is a hole in the tree. Maybe the ants live there," Mia says.

"Let's see what is inside," Ben says. He bends down and stares into the hole. He sees something shiny and round.

"What is that?" he asks. He reaches his hand into the hole and pulls out a coin.

"Wow, Ben, you found a coin! Maybe it is a magic coin," Mia says.

"Maybe it is. Maybe someone hid it here for us to find," Ben says. He puts the coin in his pocket.

They hear a voice behind them. It is their mom.

"Ben, Mia, it is time to go home. Did you have fun in the park?" she asks.

"Yes, mom, we had fun. We found a hidden coin in the tree," Ben says.

"A hidden coin? Let me see," mom says. She looks at the coin and smiles.

"That is a very old coin, Ben. It is from a long time ago. Someone must have lost it or forgotten it here. You are very lucky to find it," she says.

"Thank you, mom. We love you," Ben and Mia say.

They hug their mom and walk home with her. They are happy and curious about their hidden coin. They wonder what other secrets the park has.

One day, a little girl was walking in the park when she spotted something rare. She couldn't believe her eyes when she saw a present poking out from under a bush. She walked up to it and reached out to poke it.

Suddenly, a man in a green hat appeared. He said, "That's a very rare present. You must be special if you can find it!"

Once upon a time, there was a big garden. In the garden, there was a vine that grew and grew. The vine had big green leaves and it looked great. One day, a little girl came to the garden. She said, "Hello garden, I am here to see you." The garden said, "Welcome little girl, come and see the vine." The little girl looked at the vine and said, "Wow, it looks great!"

There was a little girl named Lily who lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. Lily loved to play with her toys, but she didn't like sharing them with her friends. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a herb plant to take care of. Lily was happy to have her own plant to look after.

One day, Lily's friend came over to play. Lily didn't want to share her toys, but she remembered how happy she felt when her mommy gave her the herb plant. So, she decided to share her plant with her friend. Her friend was happy to have a plant of her own to take care of.

Lily's mommy was proud of her for sharing. She told Lily that sharing is a good thing to do and it makes others happy. Lily felt happy too. She realized that even though she was poor in sharing her toys, she could be rich in sharing her herb plant. From that day on, Lily shared her toys and her herb plant with her friends.

Once upon a time, there were two birds - one was named Pat and the other one was called Paul. Pat and Paul were very good friends and they loved to eat together. Every day after school they would go to the forest to share food.

Lily liked to use her crayons to draw pictures. She had many colors, but her favorite was peach. She liked how it looked like the fruit she ate with her mom. Once upon a time, there was a lion. He was big and strong. He liked to roar. He'd roar very loudly.

All the other animals stopped and listened to the lion's roar. They cheered him on. 
The lion roared and roared until finally, he reached the star. The star looked like a bright and shiny ball. The lion was so happy that he'd reached the star. He hugged it and went home. 
From then on, the lion was known as the lion who roared, and he was forever honored by the other animals.

Once, there was a generous man named Bob. Bob wanted to open a restaurant. He worked very hard to make it happen. He painted the walls of the restaurant every day and he spent lots of time choosing what food to buy.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. She had a cup that was blue. Every morning she would get out of bed and drink from the cup. This made her very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. Lily was very independent and liked to do things on her own.

Once upon a time, there was a big and fair princess who lived in a castle. She had a big garden with lots of flowers and trees. One day, a thief came and stole her favorite flower. The princess was very sad and called for help.

Once upon a time, there was a apple tree. Every day, the tree would make delicious, original apples. One day, a little bunny hopped over to the tree. He saw all the apples and wanted to taste one. He jumped up and grabbed a big, juicy one with his leg.

Once upon a time, there was an amazing dish sitting on the kitchen table. It was a big, steaming dinner with colorful vegetables, rice and some yummy chicken. Two children were standing nearby, looking at the dinner with wide eyes.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very pretty and loved the color yellow. She went out for a walk through the park and noticed something very special - a big yellow popper!

Sam and Mia were playing with paper. They liked to fold it and make different shapes. Sam made a hat and Mia made a boat. They put their paper things on their heads and pretended to sail on the water.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise outside. It was thunder. They saw a bright flash in the sky. It was lightning. They were scared and ran to their mom.

"Mom, mom, what is that?" Sam asked.

"That is a storm, Sam. Sometimes, the clouds make noise and light when they are angry. But don't worry, it will go away soon," mom said.

Max wanted to bounce. He saw something big and put on his shoes. It was a truck. He ran to it and bounced up and down. He laughed as he bounced on the mild truck. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her stuff toys and reading books. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she dared to try a new food for dinner. Lily felt a little scared but she wanted to be brave, so she said yes.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch birds fly in the sky. One day, she saw a big brown bird with a long beak. She was very happy to see it.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess. She was walking through the woods when she saw something special in the distance. She ran to it and found a treasure!

Suddenly, a voice spoke from behind her. It said, "You must hurry. Someone may be coming for this treasure!"

The princess thanked the voice and ran home. She was so excited to show her treasure to her family.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful sun in the sky. It was so happy it wanted to share its love with the world. So the sun picked a flower and gave it a big, warm hug. The flower was so happy!

But then, one day something bad happened. The rain came and the flower started to rot. The sun was so sad, it wanted to save its love. So, it used its sunny rays to try and dry up the flower. But, it was too late - the flower had rotted away.

Once there was a small cat named Fred. Fred wanted to be comfortable, but he had a lot of trouble. Every day, he would try to find somewhere he could be safe and comfortable, but it seemed no matter where he went, trouble followed him.

Once upon a time there was a lion. He liked to roar very loud! One day, he wanted to make a special sound. He needed a firework for extra loudness.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. Her name was Sarah. She was three years old. She loved to explore and imagine. One day Sarah was walking in the woods. Once upon a time, there was a dull jungle. In this jungle there lived an elephant who loved to move around. Every day, the elephant would move around in her jungle looking for new things. One day as the elephant was moving around, she saw something strange. It was a deep hole in the ground.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sally. Sally was three years old and very curious. She wanted to learn all the time.

Ben and Sam were best friends. They liked to play outside and go on adventures. One day, they saw a kayak by the lake. It was red and shiny and looked like fun.

"Wow, look at that kayak!" Ben said. "Can we try it?"

"I don't know," Sam said. "It's not ours. Maybe someone left it here."

They ran to the kayak and touched it. It was smooth and hard. They looked inside and saw two paddles.

"But what if someone comes back and gets angry?" Sam said. "We should ask first."

"Who are we going to ask?" Ben said. "There's no one here. Come on, don't be scared."

Ben climbed into the kayak and grabbed a paddle. He waited for Sam to join him.

Sam looked around. He felt bad. He knew it was wrong to take something that was not theirs. He wanted to have fun, but he also wanted to be good.

He tried to paddle back, but it was hard. The wind was blowing and the water was choppy. He felt tired and sorry.

The man ran into the water and swam towards Ben. He reached the kayak and grabbed it. He pulled Ben out and dragged him to the shore.

He was very mad. He yelled at Ben and asked him why he had taken his kayak. He said he had been generous and let other people use his kayak, but only if they asked first. He said Ben had been rude and selfish.

Ben felt ashamed. He didn't know what to say. He wished he had listened to Sam. He wished he had been good.

He looked at Sam, who was still on the shore. Sam looked at him with pity and concern. He walked over to Ben and the man.

He said he was sorry for what Ben had done. He said they were friends and they had seen the kayak and wanted to try it. He said Ben had not listened to him and had gone without asking. He said he had tried to stop him and had stayed behind.

He said they had learned their lesson and they would never do it again. He said they were sorry and they hoped the man would forgive them.

The man looked at Sam and Ben. He saw they were young and scared. He saw they had made a mistake and they were sorry. He felt his anger fade.

He said he was glad Sam had been honest and brave. He said he was glad Ben had come back and had apologized. He said he would forgive them, but only if they promised to be good and to respect other people's things.

He said he would be generous and let them use his kayak, but only if they asked first and followed his rules. He said he would teach them how to paddle and how to be safe on the water.

He said he hoped they would enjoy the kayak and the lake, but also learn to be good and kind.

Sam and Ben nodded. They said they were sorry and they thanked the man. They said they would be good and they would respect his kayak. They said they would like to learn from him and have fun with him.

They hugged each other and smiled. They felt happy and relieved. They had made a new friend and they had learned a valuable lesson.

They had learned to be good and generous.

Once upon a time, there was a baby named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toys and eat yummy food. One day, his mom gave him a spicy snack to try. Tim had never tasted spicy food before.

Tim ran to his mom and asked for some water. His mom gave him a big cup of water. He drank it all up and felt better. Tim learned that water can help when things are too spicy. From that day on, he always used water to help when he ate spicy food. And Tim and his mom laughed and played together with his toys.

Eventually he made it to the top of the ladder and could see a really high tree filled with spicy red chillies. The chillies called out to him - "Come get me Ben! Dare yourself to pick me!"

Ben was scared but he decided to dare himself. He carefully climbed down the ladder and picked the spicy chillies. He was so proud of himself and showed his mum. Now Ben knows he can dare himself to do anything. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the wild woods. He would run around and measure how far he could go. One day, Timmy met a little girl named Lily. Lily had a big smile on her face and Timmy thought she was nice.

In the end, Timmy and Lily stopped being friends because of their argument. Timmy felt very sad and wished he had never argued with Lily. He realized that being friends was more important than being the best at measuring.

Once there was an old bookcase. The bookcase was in an old house. It had been there for a long time, but it had never been filled with books.

Once upon a time, there was a little white cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to play with her best friend, a small boy named Timmy. They played outside in the sun every day. Fluffy liked to chase Timmy, and Timmy liked to run.

One day, Timmy learned a new word at school. He wanted to teach Fluffy the word too. Timmy said, "Fluffy, the word is 'repeat'. Can you say 'repeat'?" Fluffy looked at Timmy and said, "Meow." Timmy laughed and said, "No, Fluffy, say 'repeat'."

Fluffy tried again and said, "Meow-peat." Timmy clapped his hands and said, "Good job, Fluffy! You said the word!" Fluffy was very happy. She liked learning new words with Timmy. From that day on, Fluffy and Timmy played a game where they would teach each other new words. They had lots of fun together, and they lived happily ever after.

Anna and Ben were twins who lived on a farm with their mom and dad. They liked to play with the animals, especially the sheep. The sheep were soft and fluffy and made funny noises.

One day, Anna and Ben saw a new sheep in the barn. It was smaller than the others and had a black spot on its head. Anna and Ben wanted to pet it and feed it some grass.

"Hello, little sheep," Anna said. "What is your name?"

The sheep looked at Anna and bleated. Anna smiled and stroked its wool.

"Can we be your friends?" Ben asked. "We are nice and we have more grass for you."

The sheep nodded and followed Ben to the fence. Anna and Ben gave it some grass and played with it. They hoped the sheep would like them and stay with them.

But the other sheep did not like the new sheep. They thought it was different and strange. They were ignorant and mean. They pushed the new sheep away and did not let it eat or drink with them. They made loud and angry noises at it.

The new sheep was sad and scared. It did not understand why the other sheep were so rude. It wanted to go back to the barn and hide.

Anna and Ben saw what was happening and ran to the new sheep. They hugged it and told it not to worry.

"Don't listen to them, little sheep," Anna said. "They are ignorant and bad. You are good and cute. We love you and we are your friends."

"Yes, we are," Ben said. "And we will protect you and take care of you. You can stay with us and be happy."

The new sheep smiled and licked Anna and Ben's faces. It felt safe and warm with them. It hoped they would always be together.

Once upon a time there was a bunny who lived in a green meadow. This bunny had big ears and a big nose. He loved to hop all around the meadow.

One day, he saw something shiny in the grass. When he went closer he saw that it was a comb made out of silver. The bunny was so excited that he wanted to take it with him so he hopped away with it in his mouth.

The bunny stopped to find a safe place to keep the comb. He hopped up the hill and he saw a big tree with a high branch. He figured this would be a perfect place for the comb.

When he tried to hop up the trunk to the high branch, he couldn't reach it. He thought and thought and decided to build a ladder out of logs. He stuck them in the ground and hopped up one by one. 

When he finally got to the top, he put the comb carefully on the branch. "There! This is a perfect place to keep the comb safe," said the bunny. 
And it was! Whenever he wanted to comb his furry ears he could hop up to the high branch and get it down. The End.

Once upon a time there was a playful girl and a playful boy. The girl invited the boy to her house. Her parents saw how happy they were together and so they invited the boy for dinner one night. 

At dinner, the girl's parents asked the boy to marry their daughter. The boy was so excited and said yes. They all celebrated and had a great time. 

From then on, the girl and the boy were married. They were always together, playing and having fun. Everyone in the town was happy for them. 

One day, the girl and the boy decided to invite all their friends to a party to celebrate the special love they share. It was a wonderful day filled with laughter, music and dancing. They were so happy and playful together.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was very hungry and wanted to eat dinner. But, his bowl was dirty and he didn't want to eat from it. So, he went outside to find a clean bowl. While he was searching, he saw a little bird in the tree. Fluffy tried to catch the bird, but he missed and instead, he struck the tree with his paw. The bird flew away and Fluffy felt sad. Finally, he found a new clean bowl and ate his dinner happily.

One day, a big red car went for a long drive. The car had four round tires. The car liked to drive fast and rush down the road. The car saw trees, flowers, and animals as it drove.

But one day, the car had a flat tire. The tire was not round anymore. The car could not rush down the road. The car was sad. It wanted to go fast again.

The car's friend, a big truck, came to help. The truck had a new tire for the car. They put the new tire on the car. It was easy. Now, the car could rush down the road again. The car was happy and said "thank you" to the truck. They drove together, and they had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to stand on stage and sing songs. One day, Timmy's friend Billy asked him to sing at his birthday party. Timmy was so excited and said, "Sure, I would love to sing at your party!"

On the day of the party, Timmy arrived at Billy's house and saw a big stage set up in the backyard. Timmy felt a little nervous but he stood on the stage anyway. He started to sing and everyone clapped and cheered.

After the party, Timmy's throat hurt a little bit from singing so much. His mom asked him if he was okay and Timmy said, "I'm okay, but my throat hurts a little bit." His mom gave him some water and Timmy felt better.

From that day on, Timmy knew that he loved to sing on stage and he couldn't wait for his next performance.

One hot summer day, Barb filled her bucket up with warm water from the well and brought it back to her house. As Barb neared her home, she spied something exciting in the yard. She saw a big pile of dirt and stones. When she got closer, Barb saw that her dad was at work. He was building a beautiful sandcastle.

"What are you building, daddy?" Barb asked excitedly.

"I'm building a castle for you, princess!" replied her dad with a big smile.

Barb tapped her fingers together and jumped up and down in excitement. She loved seeing her dad doing his work. Together, they dug and molded the big pile of dirt and stones until a beautiful sandcastle was made.

The sun had gone down but even then, Barb was still excited. She ran home and shouted, "Goodnight, daddy! See you tomorrow!"

Tim and Mia were friends who liked to play outside. One day, they went to the lake with their moms. They saw many things at the lake: fish, ducks, frogs, and flowers. They also saw something unusual: a big brown animal with long teeth and a flat tail.

"Look, Mia, what is that?" Tim asked, pointing at the animal.

"I don't know, Tim. It looks scary," Mia said, holding Tim's hand.

The animal was chewing on a tree near the water. It made loud noises with its teeth and tail. It did not see Tim and Mia.

"That is a beaver, kids," one of their moms said, coming closer. "It is not scary, it is just busy. Beavers chew on trees to make their homes in the lake. They are very clever animals."

"Wow, a beaver!" Tim said, feeling curious. "Can we go closer, mom?"

"Only a little bit, Tim. We don't want to bother the beaver. It might get angry if we get too close," his mom said.

Tim and Mia walked a little bit closer to the beaver, but not too much. They watched the beaver chew on the tree and splash in the water. They thought the beaver was unusual, but also amazing. They learned something new at the lake that day.

There was a dark forest.

The bunny had an important task to do.

Once upon a time, there was an orange passport. It was a special passport because it could test you! It wanted to find out if you were kind and helpful.

One day, a little boy stepped up to be tested. He had a big smile on his face and said he was ready! The passport asked him lots of questions and he answered them all. He said that he liked to feed ducks and play with his friends. He also said that he always shared his snacks with his brothers.

The orange passport was very happy and gave him a big hug. Then, it gave the boy a shiny sticker with a big thumbs up on it. He was so excited! He had passed the test.

The boy kept the orange passport and looked at the sticker every day. It reminded him to show kindness, be helpful and always share.

Once upon a time, there was a nice boy named Dan. He wanted to explore the world, so he set off on an adventure. Dan had to cross a wide sea to get to a far away land. 

At the land, Dan met a lot of strange and interesting creatures. He also found himself getting into a lot of trouble. 

One day, an angry giant appeared. He said that Dan was stupid and told him to leave right away. Dan was scared, so he quickly returned to the sea. He waited until it was safe then he paddled back across.

When he finally came back to his own land, Dan was happy. He let out a big sigh of relief and thanked his lucky stars for the safe journey. Dan had learned a very important lesson - to always listen to the giants!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lisa. She was very hungry. She wanted something to eat. 

One day she went for a walk in the forest. Suddenly she saw an apple tree. She saw there were lots of yummy apples hanging from the tree. 

She said, "I want to eat the apples, but I can't reach them. What should I do?" 

Then she noticed a ladder leaning against the tree. She smiled and said, "I can climb up the ladder and get the apples!" 

So she grabbed the brush next to the ladder and began to climb. She carefully brushed away all the leaves on the way up the ladder. Finally, she reached the top of the tree and grabbed as many apples as she could. 

She carefully climbed back down the ladder and enjoyed the yummy apples. 

The End

Once there was a thin gray rabbit. Every day it hopped through the meadow. One day it found the mud. It thought the mud felt nice so it hopped and hopped in it.

When the rabbit was done playing it looked at itself. It had mud all over it and it was a little scared. But then it had an idea! It remembered seeing a wipe one time. 

The rabbit hopped over to a nearby tree and it grabbed a thin gray wipe from the tree trunk. It looked at the wipe and then hopped back to the mud. With a few swipes the rabbit was clean and the mud was gone. 

The rabbit was so happy that he kept the thin gray wipe. From then on any time he got dirty he used the wipe to clean himself. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside in the dirt and mud. One day, his mom told him to come inside and wash his hands before eating his food. Timmy didn't want to stop playing, so he ignored his mom's reminder.

Later that day, Timmy's tummy started to hurt. He realized he had eaten his food with dirty hands. He went to his mom and said, "Mommy, my tummy hurts. I think I ate my food with dirty hands." His mom said, "I reminded you to wash your hands before eating. Now you know why it's important."

From that day on, Timmy always remembered to wash his hands before eating his food. He didn't want his tummy to hurt again.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly lion who loved to explore the earth. He decided one day to take a journey and set off on foot. As he travelled, he could smell the delicious smells of different dishes from nearby villages. 
 
Suddenly, he saw a village not far away. He was so excited as he had never seen a village before. He ran as fast as he could, up a hill and down the other side, until he arrived in the village. 

As soon as the villagers saw him, they were very kind and poured out a big bowl of tasty food for him. The lion was so happy to find such friendly people and thanked them for the delicious meal.

After his meal, the lion sat and watched all the people of the village as they went about their daily tasks. He noticed one woman with a bucket of water, another man pouring seed in the ground, and children playing happily. The lion smiled and realized that he had found a place to be at home. 

He thanked the villagers once again, said goodbye and then continued on his journey.

Once upon a time, there was a big, bossy cat named Tom. Tom liked to tell everyone what to do. He lived in a small house with his friend, a little mouse named Tim.

One day, Tom saw Tim near the stove. Tom was scared that Tim might get hurt. So, he yelled, "Tim, stay away from the stove!" Tim jumped and ran away from the stove quickly.

From that day on, Tim knew that Tom was only bossy because he cared. They played together and had lots of fun. And Tim never went near the stove again.

Once upon a time there was a little green frog. He was sitting in the pond and enjoying the sun. Suddenly he felt the earth shaking beneath him. It was an earthquake! He was scared and he began to hop around the pond.

"Help me!" he shouted. "I need someone to help me!"

Just then he saw a big green bird. "Can you help me?" he asked.

The bird looked around and shook his head. "I'm sorry, little frog," he said. "But I can't help you. I need to find a safe place before the earthquake gets worse."

The frog felt very sad and afraid. He jumped around the pond, looking for something or someone to help him. But the earthquake was very strong and he couldn't find anyone. Suddenly it stopped and the frog was safe. But he was sad. He'd needed help and he had been all alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and touch everything he saw. One day, Timmy's mommy had to go to work and she left him with his grandma. 

Timmy's grandma was very rich and had a big house with lots of toys. Timmy was very happy and played with all the toys. He even touched the shiny things and the soft things. 

After playing for a while, Timmy's grandma asked him to help her with some work. Timmy didn't like work, but he wanted to make his grandma happy, so he helped her. They worked together and finished all the work. Timmy was proud of himself for helping his grandma. 

At the end of the day, Timmy's mommy came back from work and was very happy to see that Timmy had a good day with his grandma. From that day on, Timmy loved to help his grandma with work and play with her toys.

Once upon a time there was a big, scary silver box. Inside the box was a treasure. One day, a man came to bury the silver box deep in the ground. He dug a big hole, put the box in the hole and covered it up with dirt. 

The man said no one must ever touch the box. But a little girl heard the man and she wanted to see the treasure. So she waited until the man left and she crept up to the box. She lifted the dirt up and opened the box. Inside was a beautiful silver necklace. 

The girl was so happy she put the necklace around her neck and ran away. She kept the necklace a secret and never told anyone about the box. The man never knew the little girl had found the silver treasure. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to run. She ran in the park, she ran in the garden, and she even ran in the house. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to help put some clothes in the wardrobe. Lily was very happy to help and ran to the wardrobe.

Once upon a time, there was a big tire. It was very popular with all the kids in the neighborhood. They loved to play with it and jump on it. One day, a little girl named Lily saw the tire and decided to try jumping on it too. She bounced up and down, feeling like she was springing into the sky. 

As Lily played with the tire, she noticed a bird hopping nearby. It looked like it was trying to spring up and catch a worm. Lily thought it was funny how the bird was using the same word as her game with the tire. She giggled and continued to jump on the tire. 

Soon, Lily's friends came over to join in the fun. They all took turns jumping on the tire and springing into the air. They played until the sun began to set and it was time to go home. Lily was tired but happy, and she knew she would always remember the fun day she spent with the popular tire.

Jim looked out his window and gazed across the street. He saw his neighbor Jim and his family playing in a lively game of tag. Jim couldn't help but smile while he watched them. 

He smiled wider when he saw his neighbor look up and wave excitedly. When Jim opened his window, he heard his neighbor say, "Come join us, Jim! Tag is a lot of fun!"

Jim thought it sounded like such a great idea. He ran downstairs, put on his shoes and ran off to join in the fun. Jim laughed and smiled while they ran around chasing each other. He felt so happy to be out with his neighbors. 

Soon the game was over and everyone said goodbye. Jim waved goodbye to his friends and watched as they ran home. He was so excited that he decided to play tag from his bedroom window every day from now on. It made Jim feel happy and lively.

Hannah was a little girl. She went out to the garden and saw a big, thick spider. She was scared. She wanted to catch it, but it was too quick. She chased it around the garden. Then she saw a stick, so she picked it up. She used it to try and catch the spider. The spider was still very quick, but eventually she managed to catch it. She was so happy that she put it in a jar and took it home to show her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucky. Lucky was always very brave and strong. She loved playing outdoors in the sunshine.

One day, Lucky's mom said to her, "Hey, Lucky! I have an adventure for us. Let's go explore a volcano!" Lucky was so excited that she started to rush towards the volcano.

On their way, Lucky's mom said, "If we reach the volcano before noon, we'll be very lucky. Over there, we will have a big surprise!"

When Lucky and her mom arrived at the volcano, the ground started shaking and the volcano started to rumble. Suddenly, Lucky heard a loud noise and saw a huge amount of lava running down the steep slopes of the volcano!

Lucky and her mom started to run quickly away from the volcano.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to dream. Every night she would go to bed and close her eyes and dream about all the amazing things she could do. One day, the girl decided to get a newspaper to look for ideas for new things to dream about.

As she read the newspaper, a story caught her eye. It was an ancient story about a magical journey across the sea. She read on and soon found herself dreaming about the story and imagining herself taking a magical journey to far away places.

The little girl thought it was the best dream ever. She couldn't wait to tell her mom about it! So she ran to her mom and said, "Mommy, I had the best dream! I went on a journey across the sea. It was so fun!" Her mom smiled and said, "Wow, that sounds like an amazing dream!" 

The little girl never forgot her dream and continued to look for ideas in the newspaper. Even when she grew up, she would still close her eyes and dream about ancient stories.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a favorite vest that he loved to wear. It was a pretty vest with many colors. He wore it all the time.

Tim took off his wet vest and started to weep. He was sad because his favorite vest was wet. His mom saw him weep and hugged him. She told him not to worry, she would dry the vest. Tim felt better and played with his toys while he waited for his vest to dry.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bake with her mom. One day, Lily's mom asked her to help her make some cookies. Lily was very excited and said, "Yes, I want to help!"

Lily's mom gave her a bowl of sugar and told her to pour it into the mixing bowl. Lily accidentally spilled some sugar on the floor and said, "Oh no, I made a mess!"

After they finished making the cookie dough, Lily's little brother Jack came into the kitchen. He saw the cookies and said, "Can I join and have some too?"

Lily's mom said, "Of course you can! But be careful, they're very hot."

Jack took a bite of the cookie and said, "This is terrible! It's too hot!"

Lily's mom laughed and said, "Don't worry, Jack. We can wait for them to cool down before we eat them."

Once upon a time, there was a helpless little puppy who lived in a big, empty house. He felt so alone and stirred sadly all day. Until one day, there was a knock at the door. Once there was a bright rabbit. She loved to bite things. She especially liked to bite leaves and blades of grass.

Lily was a little girl who liked to dream. She dreamed of many things, like flying in the sky, playing with animals, and finding a rainbow. She dreamed of rainbows because they were so pretty and had many colors. She wanted to see one for real, not just in books or pictures.

One day, Lily and her mom went for a walk in the park. It was a sunny day, but there were some clouds in the sky. Lily hoped that maybe there would be a rainbow after the clouds went away. She asked her mom, "Mom, can we see a rainbow today?"
