Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to help her mommy cook dinner. One day, Lily's mommy was making rice for dinner. She put the rice on the stove to cook. 

Lily was curious and wanted to see what was happening to the rice. She got too close to the stove and accidentally touched the hot pot. It burned her little finger! 

But don't worry, it was a harmless burn. Lily's mommy put some cold water on her finger and gave her a hug. From that day on, Lily knew to be careful around the stove when her mommy was cooking.

Lila had a dog named Max. Max was big and brown and very charming. He liked to play with Lila and lick her face. Lila loved Max very much.

One day, Lila and Max went to the park. They saw many other dogs and people there. Max ran and jumped and barked with joy. Lila laughed and clapped her hands. She threw a ball for Max to catch.

But then, Max started to scratch. He scratched his ears, his neck, his back. He whined and shook his head. Lila was worried. She looked at Max and saw something small and black on his fur. It was a flea. A flea is a bug that bites dogs and makes them itch.

Lila did not like the flea. She wanted to help Max. She took Max to a nice lady who had a shop. The lady had a spray that could make the fleas go away. She sprayed Max all over and combed his fur. Max felt much better. He wagged his tail and licked the lady's hand.

Lila was happy. She thanked the lady and gave her some money. She paid the lady for the spray and the comb. The lady smiled and said, "You are welcome. You and Max are very charming. Come back anytime."

Lila and Max went back to the park. They played some more and had fun. They did not see any more fleas. They were happy and itch-free.

Once upon a time, there was a fancy calendar. It had pretty pictures and bright colors. The calendar hung on the wall in a little girl's room. She loved to look at the pictures every day.

One day, the little girl heard a noise. It was a loud noise that made her jump. She was scared. She looked around the room to see what made the noise. She saw the fancy calendar on the floor. The wind had blown it down.

The little girl picked up the calendar and put it back on the wall. She was not scared anymore. She knew that the wind had made the noise. She smiled at the fancy calendar and felt happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a frog. He was very lonely, so he decided to go on an adventure. He hopped onto the sea, looking for an island. After a while, he finally found one. 

When the frog reached the island, he was very surprised. The island was filthy! Sticks, stones and leaves were everywhere. The trees were droopy and the water was very unclear.

The frog said to himself, "This island needs help!" He looked for someone who might need his help, but he didn't see anyone. 

Suddenly, a deep voice came from behind him. "Who are you and what are you doing here?" the voice demanded.

The frog turned around and saw a big dragon with wings. He shook nervously and said, "My name is Frog and I'm here to help make this island clean." 

The dragon smiled. "That's what I wanted to hear! Let's start cleaning this island and make it look beautiful. We can do it together!"

The frog and the dragon worked very hard and eventually, the island was clean and beautiful. The frog and the dragon were very happy. Now the island was no longer filthy and the frog had found a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly little boy named Mark. Mark loved to play outside, and he was always happy. One day, he noticed a mint in his backyard. He quickly ran to it and yelled with joy! It seemed the mint was the biggest one he had ever seen. He decided to pick it and take it home - he was sure his family would be as happy as he was.

He ran inside, holding the mint up proudly. But when his family saw the mint, they got very excited, and started to yell. Mark was even more excited, he had never heard anyone so happy before!

They all went outside with the mint and started to play a game in the backyard. They tossed it back and forth to each other, and it was extremely fun. Mark was so thrilled, he was yelling and laughing with his family.

At the end of the game, they had to decide what to do with the mint. Everyone agreed to share it, so they each got a piece. They chatted as they ate the mint, which had a delicious, sweet flavour.

Mark was very happy. He loved spending time with his family, especially when they were being friendly and having fun. He knew that wherever he found the mint, it would always be a special part of their happy memories.

Once upon a time, there was an ugly basket. Nobody wanted the basket and so it was very sad. 

One day it decided to settle in the forest. One by one, animals began to come by and take the basket in. A rabbit brought it a nice, soft blanket. A deer gave it a pillow. And a fox found some pretty flowers for the basket. 

Soon, the basket became very cozy. All the animals settled there at night, listening to the frog's songs and feeling the warmth of the fireflies. 

The animals loved the basket and so did the basket. It felt like home and it couldn't have been any happier.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was very cheerful and he loved to run. One day he went for a run in the woods and he found a sparkly gold coin! He was so happy and he ran home to show his mum. Mum was very excited too.

That night the boy went back to the woods with his mum and there were lots of sparkly gold coins! They gathered as many coins as they could and filled their buckets with the gold.

The boy was so cheerful as he ran home with his mum, buckets full of gold. They decided to use the gold to buy a new toy for the boy.

The boy was so excited and he hugged his mum. Then he ran outside to play with his new toy and have lots of fun.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy spider. The spider lived in a cobweb on a tree. The tree was in the yard of a small house. The spider loved its cobweb very much. It was its home.

One day, a little girl named Lily saw the spider. She was not scared. She said, "Hello, hairy spider. I like your cobweb." The spider was happy to hear that. It said, "Thank you, Lily. I value my cobweb too."

Lily and the spider became friends. They played together every day. The spider showed Lily how to make a cobweb. Lily showed the spider how to play with toys. They had a lot of fun. And they both learned to value each other's company.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit who was weak and always very hungry. He asked, "What food is there for me to eat?" He looked around and saw a turnip. He hopped over to the turnip and tried to pull it from the ground but he was too weak. 

Suddenly, a friendly goat appeared. The goat said, â€œLet me help you!â€ The goat began to reverse around the turnip, like a windmill, and eventually he was able to pull the turnip from the ground.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Jane. Jane was 3 years old and she had a puppy. Itâ€™s name was Spot. Spot was a very naughty puppy and he kept chasing the birds in the park.

â€œNow Spot, remember to sit when I tell you to!â€ Jane said.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit named Candy. Candy was so delicate and gentle, everyone in the forest adored her.

One day, Candy accidentally stepped on the tail of another rabbit. The poor rabbit was really mad! He growled at Candy and said, "Why did you step on my tail?!"

But Candy knew it was an accident, so she tried to apologize. "I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you," Candy said softly.

The other rabbit was still angry, but then he thought about how gentle and kind Candy always is. He felt his heart soften and he said, "It's okay. I forgive you."

Candy was so happy and relieved. She thanked him for his kindness and the two rabbits stayed friends. That's why it is important to be gentle and to forgive.

One day, a little girl went to visit her grandmother. She asked if they could bake a cake together. Her grandmother said yes, so they went to the kitchen. 

When they got there, the girl noticed a big, noisy mixer on the counter. Every time the little girl tried to talk to her grandmother, the mixer was so loud that she couldn't hear her. She got frustrated and started to yell at the mixer. 

The grandmother noticed and said softly, "My dear, yelling at the mixer won't help. We just have to be persistent and some way we'll find a way to talk to each other without it being so loud."

So, they both started to look around the kitchen and they found two pots that were the perfect size to cover their ears. The grandmother put one pot on her ears and the little girl put the other one on. Now, they could hear each other talk and the mixer was bearable now.

The little girl was so excited that Grandma had helped her. They quickly went back to work on the delicious cake.

Once upon a time there were two little children, Timmy and Sally. They were in school, and the classroom was big and shiny. There was a modern blackboard on the wall. 

Timmy and Sally sat down in the chairs, and the teacher began to talk. She said, "Today we will be learning about numbers. Can anyone tell me what number comes after three?"

Timmy was so excited. He stood up and said, "Four!" But the teacher said he was wrong. 

Sally said, "That's not fair! He was right!" But the teacher didn't believe them. She said, "You must both sit down and be quiet!" 

Timmy and Sally sadly sat back down. They felt bad, and the lesson was over. 

The teacher said, "Remember, there is no room for mistakes in this classroom. Now go home and study hard or you won't do well on the test!" 

Timmy and Sally left the classroom and walked home feeling very sad. They would have to work even harder next time.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Jack and Ben. Jack had a cool toy car and Ben was very envious. Jack wanted to show it to Ben, so he invited him over to his house. When they got there, Jack pointed to a big door and said, "Look! This is my garage!" He was so excited that he could hardly wait to show Ben his car. 

Jack opened the door, and then he and Ben stepped inside. They both gasped at what they saw. Jack's car was so shiny and fast! He urged Ben to take a seat and try it out. Ben was so happy, he couldn't believe it!

They had so much fun driving around the driveway. After they were finished, they said goodbye and then Ben went on his way. He was so envious of Jack's car, he really wished it was his. But they remained good friends, and every now and then they would visit each other in the garage.

Tom and Sam love to play baseball. They have a bat, a ball and a glove. They go to the park with their mom and dad. They find a big field with grass and dirt.

"Can we play baseball now?" Tom asks.

"Yes, you can. But be careful and have fun," mom says.

Tom and Sam run to the field. They take turns hitting and catching the ball. They laugh and shout. They do not see the sun go down. The sky gets dark and the stars come out.

"Boys, it is time to go home. It is too dark to play baseball," dad calls.

"Did you have fun playing baseball?" mom asks.

"Yes, we did. It was fun," Tom says.

They smile and hug mom and dad. They are happy. They love baseball. They love mom and dad. They go home and sleep. They dream of playing baseball again.

Once upon a time, there was a pink bunny named Rosie. Rosie loved to play with her whistle. She would blow it all day long. One day, Rosie's mom said, "Rosie, you have blown your whistle too much. It's time to stop." 

But Rosie didn't listen. She kept blowing her whistle. Then, her dad came in and said, "Rosie, you need to listen to your mom. If you don't stop blowing your whistle, we will have to punish you." 

Rosie didn't want to be punished, so she stopped blowing her whistle. She felt sad, but she knew it was the right thing to do. From that day on, Rosie only blew her whistle when it was okay to do so.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little rabbit called Fluffy. He lived in the woods on a bright, sunny day.

Fluffy loved to dance. He would hop around, spin and twirl and jump in the air. Everyone in the woods thought he was so funny, watching him dance and showing off his moves.

But one day, Fluffy was feeling a bit uncomfortable. He couldn't get his dance just right and he didn't feel happy like he usually did.

Fluffy hopped out of his resting spot and followed the music. As he got closer, he saw something amazing! There was a group of other rabbits dancing together!

Fluffy couldn't believe his eyes. He wanted to join in and dance with the others. So, he put on a brave face and joined the fun. He found he was able to do all the moves with the others and had a great time.

The other rabbits were so happy to have Fluffy join them and he never felt uncomfortable again. From then on, every time the sun shone, Fluffy and his new friends would dance in the woods together, having the best time ever!

Once upon a time, there was a fair peanut. It looked so tasty that a lion roared with happiness when he saw it. The lion decided to eat the peanut, so it quickly ran over to grab it. The lion roared again and again as it crunched the yummy peanut!

The lion was so happy that it decided to take the peanut and share it with its friends. So, it roared as it ran through the forest to find them. Soon, it arrived at the other lions' door and proudly presented the peanut to them.

The lion was so pleased that it decided to share the other fair peanuts it had found. The other lions were soon so full that they could barely roar anymore! They all enjoyed the tasty peanuts and were thankful to the lion for bringing them such a fair snack.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, a soft bear and a brave squirrel. They were united by their playful spirit and big hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a smart girl. She had a great big truck. And everyday it needed fuel.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play outside. She loved to watch the birds fly and the flowers grow. One day, Lily found a soft, fluffy bunny in the grass. She picked up the bunny and held it gently in her arms. 

Lily loved the bunny so much that she didn't want to let it go. She decided to keep the bunny as her own pet. But as time went by, Lily realized that the bunny was not happy living inside her house. The bunny missed the nature and the freedom of the outdoors.

Lily felt sad at first, but she knew that the bunny would be much happier living in the soft grass and fresh air. From that day on, Lily always remembered to think about others before herself.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with clay. She would make all sorts of things with it like animals and flowers. One day, Lily made a unique clay person that no one had ever seen before.

Then, Lily's mom came in and saw what happened. She hugged Lily and told her that it's okay to make mistakes. Together, they picked up the pieces and made a new clay person that was even more special than the first. And from that day on, Lily learned that hugs can make everything better.

Lily liked to bounce on her bed. She bounced up and down, up and down, with a big smile on her face. She felt happy and free.

But her mom did not like it. She said, "Lily, stop bouncing on your bed. You will break it. And you will make a lot of noise. You have to be obedient and quiet."

Lily did not want to stop. She said, "But mom, bouncing is fun. I love bouncing. Please, let me bounce a little more."

Her mom shook her head. She said, "No, Lily. You have to listen to me. Bouncing is not for beds. Bouncing is for balls. If you want to bounce, you can bounce a ball. But not on your bed."

Lily frowned. She did not have a ball. She looked around her room. She saw a drawer. She opened it. She found a sock. She rolled it into a ball. She said, "Look, mom, I have a ball. Can I bounce it?"

Her mom smiled. She said, "Yes, Lily, you can bounce your sock ball. But not on your bed. You can bounce it on the floor. Or outside. But be careful. And don't lose it."

Lily nodded. She said, "OK, mom, I will be careful. And I will not lose it. Thank you, mom. You are the best."

She took her sock ball and ran outside. She bounced it on the grass. She bounced it on the sidewalk. She bounced it on the wall. She had a lot of fun. She was obedient and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy gave her a package. "What's inside?" asked Lily. "It's a rare toy horse," said her mommy. "Can I ride it?" asked Lily. "Yes, you can," said her mommy.

Lily opened the package and saw the rare toy horse. She was so happy! She rode it around the room and pretended she was in a big race.

Her little brother, Max, came into the room. "I want to ride the horse too!" he said. "Okay, Max," said Lily. "You can ride it after me."

Max waited patiently while Lily rode the rare toy horse. When she was done, Max climbed on and rode it too. They both had so much fun riding the horse together.

One day, Timmy wanted to take a nap. He grabbed his port and headed to the park. He found a nice spot and laid down. He felt guilty because he was supposed to be helping his mom. But before he knew it, he was fast asleep.

As he slept, Timmy dreamed of being in a magical forest. He was running and playing games with his friends. He smiled as they laughed and had fun.

But soon enough the sun started peeking through the clouds. Timmy knew it was time to wake up. As he opened his eyes, he still felt a little guilty. He was supposed to help his mom.

He grabbed his port and made his way back home. He decided that the next time he took a nap, he would make sure to help his mom first.

Once upon a time, there was a very brave boy named Tim. He loved to zip around the park and have fun! 

One day, while running around the park, he noticed a big, shiny tooth lying on the ground! He was so excited and he picked it up. 

He showed it to his mom and she was so impressed by it. His mom said that it must have belonged to a very strong dinosaur. Tim was so proud of his tooth, he couldn't stop smiling. 

His mom told him that he should put the tooth somewhere safe, so he put it in a special box and zipped it shut. 

Tim kept the tooth for a long time, and every time he looked at it he was reminded of how brilliant he was for finding it.

Once upon a time, there was a cow called Curly. Curly had lots of milk to share. He loves banging his tail against the bucket as he sprayed it out.

One day, Curly saw a little girl. He wanted to give her some of his milk. He sprayed it out, but the little girl said, "No no! That's too much milk!"

Curly was sad. He wanted to give the little girl some milk, but he made a mess. Curly said, "Oh, I'm sorry." 

The little girl smiled and said, "It's okay Curly. Just spray a little bit at a time". Curly nodded and sprayed a small amount of milk into the bucket. The little girl thanked him and Curly was happy. 

The little girl gave Curly a pat on the head and said, "You're a good cow, Curly!" Curly mooed with delight and they both went their separate ways.

Once there was a playful bunny who liked to hop around in the forest. Sometimes he would go to a pond on the side of the forest and play there. 

One day, the bunny heard a loud warning from the woods. He became scared and started hopping away, but the warning was getting closer and closer. The bunny hopped until he reached a big stone. 

He saw that the warning was from a big furry bear. The bear was running towards the bunny, so the bunny hopped away towards the pond. The bear ran on the other side and caught up quickly. The bunny was so scared that he jumped into the pond. 

The bear did not want the bunny to escape, so he plopped himself right into the pond! The poor bunny couldn't swim and he couldn't get away. The bear swam and swam until he caught the bunny. 

The bear did not have a playful heart and he took the bunny away. That was the sad and bad ending of the playful bunny's story.

Once upon a time there was a big heavy tube. Every day it would ring, ring, ring! The little girl in the house wanted to know who was ringing it. She went outside and saw a big delivery truck. The delivery driver was holding a heavy tube in his hand.

The girl asked, "What is that?" The delivery driver said it was a special package for her. She thanked him and carried the big heavy tube inside the house. She opened the tube and out came lots of toys! She was so happy that she laughed and danced and rang a bell. 

The little girl played all day with her new toys. She was so glad that the big heavy tube had rung!

Once upon a time there was a little lily. She loved to fly high and feel the breeze. She used to soar through the sky with her wings. 
But one day, she found a hidden flower in the grass. She thought it was so pretty and wanted to pick it. But as she touched it, it burst into flames. 
The little lily was frightened and flew away as fast as she could. She was so scared that she forgot to make sure she was out of danger. Suddenly, she heard the crackle of a fire nearby. She looked down to see that the fire had spread quickly and was now engulfing her. 
The little lily sadly perished in the fire.

The moral of the story is to be careful. When you find something new and exciting, always check to make sure you're safe. You never know what hidden dangers may be lurking.

Once upon a time there was a happy little boy. He loved to play with his toys and have fun with his friends.

One day he went to the park and saw another little boy playing with a whistle. He wanted to play with it too so he asked the boy if he could borrow it. The boy said yes and the little boy happily ran away.

He blew the whistle and it made a loud noise. Everyone thought it was funny! He blew the whistle again and again and everyone laughed. But then the little boy got hot so he went home.

He couldn't keep the whistle forever so he went back to the park and gave it back to the other boy. He said thank you and the other boy said you're welcome.

The little boy was happy and went back home. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy bunny. He liked to play with his drum and it made a loud noise. One day, the bunny was banging his drum and he was having so much fun.

Suddenly the drum started shaking and loud crashing sounds were heard. The bunny was scared and ran away, but when he returned he saw that a giant had destroyed his drum.

The bunny was very sad and tears filled his eyes. He wanted to say sorry to the giant, but the giant had already gone. The bunny didn't know what to do, so he said goodbye to his beloved drum.

The bunny slowly walked away and his heart was heavy. He will never forget the fun he had with his drum.

Once upon a time, there was a small bug named Ben. Ben was only an inch long. He lived in an open field with his family. They were all very happy.

One day, Ben and his family saw a big, open hole in the ground. They did not know what it was. Ben's mom and dad sat down to discuss what they should do. They talked and talked. They wanted to make sure everyone was safe.

After they talked, Ben's mom and dad told him and his brothers and sisters to stay away from the hole. They said it was not safe. Ben and his family learned that talking and discussing things together can help keep everyone safe and happy. And that was the moral of the story - always discuss things with your family to make good choices.

Sammy was playing in the backyard when it started to rain. He ran inside to the laundry room and saw his mom. She was washing the dark laundry in the big sink. Sammy's mom smiled and said, "Come help me wash the laundry, Sammy!" So he ran to her, took off his shoes, and jumped into the sink. He grabbed a wet pair of pants and scrubbed and scrubbed until the pants were clean. Mom put the clean, dark laundry into the basket and said, "Good job, Sammy! You helped me wash the laundry." Sammy smiled and said, "Let's do it again!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three years old and very hot. She was so hot she had to take medicine. 

The medicine made her feel better. She did not mind taking it at all. She started to feel cool and happy. 

She went outside to play with her friends. They laughed and talked and had a good time. They played hide and seek and chased each other around.

Then it began to get hot again. She knew it was time to take more medicine. She did not mind at all, she was happy to take the medicine. 

The medicine made her feel cool and happy again. She went out to play with her friends and have fun. She was so glad she had the medicine to keep her cool. 

The End

One day, a little girl named Sue wanted to help her mom. Her mom had a lot of tasks to do. Sue asked her mom, "Can I help you with a task?" Her mom said, "Yes, you can organize your toys. That is an easy task for you."

Sue went to her room and saw her toys all over the floor. She started to organize them. She put her dolls in one corner and her cars in another. Sue felt happy helping her mom with the easy task.

When Sue was done, she called her mom to see. Her mom came into the room and said, "Wow, great job organizing your toys, Sue!" Sue smiled and felt proud. From that day on, Sue always helped her mom with easy tasks around the house.

There was a girl called Beth. She was a pupil in school. She was always very tidy and she often helped tidy her classroom.

One day, Beth's teacher was looking for something to praise the class for. Then, the teacher noticed the tidy classroom and said to the pupils, "That's very tidy! Beth, what's your name?"

Beth replied with a big smile on her face, "My name is Beth."

The teacher said, "Well, Beth. You have done a very good job keeping your classroom tidy. So, I'm giving you a reward. I'm going to give you a puppy!"

All of Beth's classmates were so excited to see the puppy that the teacher brought in and Beth was so excited that she hugged the puppy tightly. She named the puppy Tidy, after her efforts to keep her classroom clean. 

From then on, Beth and Tidy were inseperable. They would play together everyday after school and Beth would be the one to put away all of Tidy's toys, making sure that the room was tidy!

Joe was running around and around in circles. He loved to run, just like his big brother. Joe looked over and saw his brother sitting at the table drinking coffee. He wanted to try coffee too. 

Joe toddled over to the table. He watched as his brother added a little sugar and milk to his mug. Joe thought it looked yummy and asked his brother if he could try some.
 
His brother said it was too hot and that Joe should wait until it cooled down. Joe was very bored waiting for the coffee, so he started to run circles around the table. 

When the coffee was finally cool enough, Joe took a small sip. He thought it was a bit too sweet for his taste, so he decided he'd stick to iced tea. Joe was happy and ran outside to join his brother in a game of tag.

One night, Kelly was getting ready for bed. She put on her pyjamas and brushed her teeth. She asked her mum for a story.

Mum said: "Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had five fingers."

Kelly looked at her hands and wiggled her fingers. Mum continued the story.

"One day, her fingers began to disappear one by one. Until, pouf! All five of her fingers were gone. Where did they go?"

Kelly looked scared. She asked: "Mummy, where did they go?"

Mum smiled and said: "Don't worry, Kelly. They're safe and ready to come back when you need them."

And with that, Kelly felt calm and ready for bed. She snuggled into her pillow and fell asleep, safe in the knowledge that her fingers were not really gone forever.

Once upon a time there was a gifted little girl. She loved playing in the garden, and every day she stopped near the same flower. The flower was very special - it seemed to be alive. It was warm and special, tinkling like a bell whenever she touched it.

One day, when the little girl stopped to stroke the flower, it shivered and she felt a sharp pain in her hand. She screamed out and stopped touching it.

Mommy, who had been watching awhile, quickly ran over to check on her daughter. She asked her what had happened, but the little girl couldn't quite explain it. All she could do was point to the flower.

Mommy gently took her away from the flower and held her close. She said, "You have a special gift, my little one. A gift that will allow you to feel the pain of those around you."

The little girl was confused. She didn't know what Mommy meant, but she knew it was important. From then on, she was extra careful when she stopped and looked at the flower. She knew it was special, but if it brought her pain, she wanted to stay away.

Once upon a time there was a rich girl who liked to dress up in fancy clothes. One day, the girl was getting ready to go out and grabbed her favourite umbrella. She ran out and opened it up, ready to fly away.

Suddenly, a child nearby saw her and asked, "What is that?"

The girl smiled and said, "It's an umbrella! I use it to keep me dry if it's raining."

The child was very curious and asked, "Can I try it out?"

The rich girl was more than happy to share and said, "Sure! Here you go!"

The child started to run around with the umbrella, twirling it around and laughing. The girl laughed with her and enjoyed watching the child's joy. When it was time to go, the girl packed up her umbrella and thanked the child for a lovely dress-up day.

One day, a child called James went to the park with his mom. James was so happy to be there, because it was a lovely and charming day. 

"Mom," he said, "Let's go to the playground!"

His mom smiled. "Ok, James, let's go."

When they reached the playground, James saw a big mysterious box with shiny buttons and flashing lights. He was curious and he wanted to open it. 

So he asked his mom, "Can I open it?"

She shook her head and said, "No, James. You must mind your job and stay away from it."

James was sad and didn't understand why, but he obeyed his mom. Then he heard an angry voice coming from the box. It was a robot, asking for help. 

James rushed to the box and said, "I will help you."

The robot replied, "Open the box and I will come out."

James was so excited to see the robot and quickly ran home to get the key to the box. But when he returned, the playground was empty and the mysterious box was gone. James had no way of saving the robot, and he could only hang his head in sadness.

The lesson James learned was to always mind his job, even if something exciting comes along. If only he had mind his mom's advice, he would have had a

Once upon a time there was a shy animal in the forest. Her name was Molly and she was very scared and stayed away from the other animals.

One day, a curious bunny noticed Molly and hopped over to say hello. She was so excited that she said, â€œHi, Molly!â€ But Molly was too shy to answer and just kept looking away.
