When it was time to go home, Clare wanted to stay and play at the park. She wanted to slide down the big gray slide some more. Her mom said they had to go home. Clare was sad.

Mom said she could come back to the park to play the next day. She said they could stay and play at the park as long as they wanted. Clare was happy! She hugged her mom and they headed home.

The next day, Clare and her mom went back to the park. She raced to the big gray slide and again, she went down it again and again with a big smile on her face. She stayed and played at the park for a long time. Clare loved her big gray slide!

Once upon a time, there was a lazy zip. He was different from all the other zips, because he never wanted to do anything. He just liked to sit and do nothing.

One day, a special lady saw the lazy zip. She smiled and said, â€œCome on Zip, letâ€™s go for a walk!â€ Zip didn't want to go, but the lady held his hand and took him out for a walk.

On the way, they saw a big hill. The special lady said to Zip, â€œLetâ€™s go up the hill!â€ Zip wanted to go back home, but the lady held his hand and they started to climb the hill.

When they reached the top, Zip was so happy! Together they looked out into the distance, seeing all the beautiful things around them.

Zip was no longer lazy. He had seen so many beautiful things and he knew that he could be brave and do anything he wanted to. From that day onwards, Zip was never lazy again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and sing, and she had a big brother named Max. Max was always bossy and told Lily what to do.

One day, Lily heard a sound coming from her closet. She was scared, but she believed it was just her toys making noise. She asked Max to check, but he said he was too busy.

Lily decided to be brave and check the closet herself. She found her toy robot had fallen and was making the sound. She felt proud of herself for being brave and not letting her brother boss her around. From that day on, Lily knew she could do anything she believed in.

Once upon a time, there was a nice angel. She was very patient and kind. 
The angel flew around looking for happy children. She saw a little boy named Jack. 
Jack was so tired from playing all day. He yawned a big, wide yawn. 
The angel saw his tired yawn and smiled. She gave him a special hug. 
Jack felt so good after the hug and was so happy to see the kind angel.

The angel said, â€œGood night, Jack! Sleep well!â€ 
Jack smiled and said, â€œGood night, angel! Thank you for being so patient with me!â€ 

And so the angel continued to fly around looking for happy children to make sure they were all safe and content.

The tiny pig called out. He called and called. He wanted to find his friends and have some fun! He went to the meadow and looked around. He could hear the other pigs in the distance.

He walked through the field, but he was feeling a little scared. He kept calling out and eventually he heard a familiar voice! It was his friend! His friend's name was Olive and Olive let out a joyful squeal.

Together they ran and played in the meadow. They had so much fun! They snorted and laughed and ran around in circles. This was the best day ever!

The sun began to set, and the pig said goodbye to Olive. He started to jog back home. He felt a little bit fearful since it was getting dark, but he kept pushing until he was safely at home.

Once there was a boy named Sam. He was 3 years old and loved to play. Today he wanted to play with his fan. He watched as his mom plugged it in and switched it on.

The fan started spinning and Sam jumped in excitement. But soon, he looked frustrated. He wanted to move the fan too, but it seemed too hard for him. He frowned and said, "I can't do this!"

Mom smiled and said, "Let me help you, Sam. Here, take my hand so you can do it!" With her help, Sam was able to move the fan around. 

Sam smiled in satisfaction as he pointed the fan around. "Thank you Mommy!" he said.

Once upon a time there was a very adventurous little girl named Alice. One day she wanted to go on a big adventure. She put on her green sweater and jumped outside. 

Alice looked around and saw a big tree with lots of leaves. She said "Wow, this tree looks so fun to explore!" 

Alice started to climb the tree. It was really tall and she had to use her hands and feet. When she finally reached the top, she was so happy. 

Alice looked around and saw something interesting. It was a printer! She had never seen one before so she started to press all the buttons. 

The printer started to make a lot of noise. Then, it printed out a colorful picture of a dragon! 

Alice jumped with joy! She had never seen such an adventurous picture before. She thanked the printer and promised to come back again soon.

Mommy was very happy. She had found a special silver coin. It was very expensive, and it was very shiny in the sun. 

Mommy decided that she would put it in a special box and keep it safe forever. She said to her daughter, "This coin is very special so we must pray for it."

The daughter and Mommy kneeled down beside the bed. They held hands and closed their eyes, then prayed for the coin. Mommy said, "God, please protect this special silver coin. Keep it safe and make it strong." The daughter opened her eyes and smiled.

The silver coin stayed in the box forever. Every night, the daughter and Mommy would pray for it. They thanked God for the special silver coin and for keeping it safe.

Once upon a time there was a reliable car that liked to drive. Every spring it would drive up and down the road. It would take people to places like the park and the store. One day, the car drove to the park. It stopped in front of the playground. Out came two kids, one was three and one was five. They quickly ran to the slide, giggling and laughing. Then, the car drove to the store. The three year old got out and ran inside to buy candy. The five year old stayed in the car. The car drove the kid home and parked in the driveway. The kids said goodbye to the car and thanked it for taking them on such a fun drive. The reliable car drove off, happy it had made the kids so happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very creative. She had a chair in her room and everyday she would keep it in the same spot. 
One day, the little girl wanted to be creative with her chair. She decided to keep it outside in the garden. She wanted to sit on it and enjoy the sun.

So she put the chair in the garden. It was a perfect spot. She kept her chair there all day. The sun was shining and she was happy. She sang and danced in the chair. 

When the sun went down, the little girl kept her chair in the same spot in the garden and went back inside her house. She was so happy with her creative idea!

The end!

John was walking home from school, looking forward to snacking on something delicious from the fridge. He made it to the door, but it was already open. He stepped inside expecting to see something normal. But the fridge was gone! John was so shocked he couldn't believe his eyes! He raced around the house calling for his parents, but there was no response. Suddenly the front door slammed shut.

John ran to the window, but all he saw were two shadows vanish around the corner. He thought his parents had left, but they weren't around. John was alone and all that was left was the empty space where the fridge used to be. 

John tried to open the door but it was stuck shut. He couldn't get out and had no food. He tried asking for help, but no one could hear him. 

John eventually got so hungry he started to cry, when he heard someone say from outside, "You should've thought of that before you decided to steal my fridge!"

John never saw his parents again and he had to stay inside without food and vanished from the normal life he once had.

One sunny day, Lucy and her friends decided to have lots of fun. They grabbed their sliding mats and went outside in the garden. The sun was shining brightly and the grass was so green.

The friends put the mats down and jumped on them. They started to slide on the grass. It felt so good and the grass tickled their skin. The friends laughed and giggled as they slid around.

The sun made everything look so bright and harmless. The friends were enjoying their slide so much that they didn't want it to ever stop.

When the sun went down, the friends were sad that the slide had to end. But they promised to each other that they would slide again the next day.

Once upon a time there was a tire. It was round, and it glowed in the night. All the other toys in the bedroom were amazed - why was that tire so special?

The tire spoke to them, in the softest of voices. "I'm fragile," it said. "I need very special care." All the other toys stared in wonder.

"How can we keep you safe?" asked a doll. "Be gentle with me," said the tire. "When I'm happy, I glow brighter. That's how you'll know I'm okay."

"But how can we be gentle, if we don't know how?" asked a stuffed bear. The tire thought for a minute, then said, "Love me like you would a friend. That will keep me safe."

So the toys All hugged the tire, and it glowed brighter and brighter. All the toys were happy, and the tire was happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with glue and make things. One day, Timmy wanted to make a paper airplane, but it was very difficult. 

Timmy's friend, Sally, came over to play. "What are you doing, Timmy?" asked Sally. "I'm trying to make a paper airplane, but it's too difficult," replied Timmy. 

Sally smiled and said, "Let me help you!" Sally showed Timmy how to fold the paper and soon they had made a perfect airplane. Timmy laughed with joy as they flew the airplane around the room. 

From that day on, Timmy and Sally made many things together with glue. They always had fun and laughed a lot. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. One day he went outside to play. When he stepped outside, he saw something strange in the sky. It was yellow mist!

The little boy was curious and wanted to look closer. He grabbed onto the mist and started to pull it down. He pulled and pulled until the yellow mist surrounded him.

The little boy loved playing in the yellow mist and laughed and jumped around in it. He felt funny and free! As the sun went down, the little boy said goodbye to the yellow mist and went home.

The little boy never forgot that special day when he pulled down the yellow mist.

Once upon a time, there lived two little birds named George and Lucy. George was the oldest and he was brave and loud, while Lucy was younger and quieter.

One day, they both decided to fly high up in the sky. They zipped and zipped, higher and higher until they reached the clouds.

Suddenly, a loud thunder clap interrupted them. Lucy was spooked and started to cry. She was scared and wanted to go home. But George was brave and told her, "Lucy, don't be scared. It is just thunder, it won't hurt you."

Lucy looked to the sky and saw a clear sky with shining stars. She took a deep breath and stopped crying.

George smiled and hugged Lucy. Then, the two little birds began to zip back home, safe and sound.

Ben and Lily liked to play in the park. They liked to swing, slide and run. One day, they saw a big house near the park. It looked old and scary. They wanted to see what was inside.

They went to the door and pushed. It was not locked. They went in. It was dark and dusty. They heard a strange noise. It was a song. A rough song. It sounded angry and sad.

They followed the song. It came from a room. They opened the door. They saw a man. He was sitting on a chair. He had a guitar. He was singing the song. He looked at them. He was not happy. He was angry.

He shouted at them. He said they were bad. He said they should not be there. He said he would lock them in. He got up. He ran to the door. He slammed it. He locked it.

Ben and Lily were scared. They cried. They wanted to go out. They wanted to go home. They banged on the door. They shouted for help. But no one heard them. No one came. They were trapped.

The moral of the story is: Do not go into places you do not know. They might be dangerous. Listen to your parents. They know what is best for you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Laura. She wanted to be part of a team, so she asked her mom if she could join a team.

Mom said, "Yes, of course you can join a team! But remember, teamwork takes lots of hard work and practice." Laura nodded and smiled, excited to join a team.

A few days later, she received a letter from the team and she was so excited. She opened the letter and read it out loud, "'Welcome to the team, Laura! We look forward to bringing you into our team and helping you become a strong team player!'"

But when Laura went to her first practice, she was weak and couldn't keep up with the other players. She wanted to join the team and make them proud, but she just wasn't strong enough to keep up with everyone else.

She approached the coach and said, "Coach, I'm not sure if I can be part of the team. I'm weak and I don't think I can keep up."

The coach smiled and said, "That's ok, Laura. We all start off weak, but with hard work and practice, you'll become stronger. We believe in you, so don't give up!"

After that, Laura kept practicing and trying her best. Little by little, she became stronger and more confident. Eventually, Laura was able to keep up with the rest of her team

Once there was a big motor. It was very heavy and nobody could lift it. Suddenly, a tiny boy appeared with a big smile on his face. He was only three years old, but he was very brave.

He went up to the motor and tried to lift it. Everyone was surprised and amazed, but they were also a bit ignorant. They didn't believe the little boy could do it. But he was determined and kept trying. He kept trying and trying, until he could lift the motor up!

The crowd cheered and clapped when the little boy lifted the motor. They were so proud of him. The little boy was also proud of himself. He smiled and showed off his muscles, like a little tough guy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Laura. She had a hurt foot and her mommy was so worried about her. "We need to hurry," she said.

So, they got in the car and drove to the hospital. When they arrived, they saw that the hospital was very poor. There were no toys and not many nurses.

But Laura did not care. She was happy to go to the hospital to get help for her foot.

When they arrived at the hospital, the nurse said, "You can come inside now."

So, Laura and her mommy followed the nurse inside. The nurse looked closely at Laura's foot and smiled.

"We can make it better," said the nurse. Then she gave Laura some medicine and a bandage.

Laura was very happy when she got better. She thanked the nurse and said goodbye.

Then they all waved goodbye as Laura and her mommy went back home.

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play with sand. They had a big bucket and a small shovel. They wanted to make an island with sand. They filled the bucket with sand and turned it over on the ground. They made a round hill of sand.

"Look, we made an island!" Lily said. "But it needs something more."

"Maybe we can make a palm tree with leaves and a coconut," Tom said. He found a stick and some green paper. He cut the paper into leaf shapes and stuck them on the stick. He also found a brown ball and put it on the stick. He pushed the stick into the sand hill.

"Wow, that looks like a real palm tree!" Lily said. "But how can we get the coconut?"

Tom had an idea. He climbed on the sand hill and reached for the ball. He pulled it off the stick and held it in his hands. He squeezed the ball hard.

"Crack!" The ball broke into two pieces. Inside, there was white stuff and water.

"Look, it's a real coconut!" Tom said. He gave one piece to Lily and kept the other. They drank the water and ate the white stuff.

"Mmm, this is yummy!" Lily said. "We are successful island makers!"

They smiled and hugged each other. They were happy and proud of their island. They played with sand until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She woke up and asked her mom for some toast. Her mom made her some toast and put it on a plate. Lily ate her toast and it was yummy.

After breakfast, Lily wanted to pour some juice for herself. But the jug was too heavy for her. Her mom saw her struggling and came over to be helpful. She poured the juice for Lily and gave her a big hug.

Lily was happy and went to play with her toys. She remembered how her mom was so helpful and poured her some juice. She felt loved and grateful. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little girl who loved to go on adventures. Her favorite thing to do was go to the fun camp in her town. Whenever she went to camp, she loved to learn and improve her skills.

At camp, she would play games, practice sports, and make new friends. Every day she did something new, something to make her even cleverer and better at the things she enjoyed.

The camp was always so much fun, and she could not wait to go back again. Even though the little girl improved her skills each time she went, the camp was always a magical new experience.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a toy named Zipper. Zipper was a hard toy car. Tom loved to play with Zipper every day. They had lots of fun together.

One day, Tom met a girl named Sue. Sue had a toy named Daisy. Daisy was a soft toy doll. Tom and Sue liked to play together with Zipper and Daisy. They had so much fun that they wanted their toys to be friends too.

Tom and Sue decided that Zipper and Daisy should marry. They had a big party with cake and juice. Zipper and Daisy were now married and they played together all the time. Tom and Sue were happy that their toys were friends, just like them. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a playful dog named Spot. Spot loved to run and play with his friends. One day, Spot saw a new player in the park. The player was a little boy named Tim.

Spot wanted to invite Tim to play with him, so he ran up to Tim and said, "Hi, I am Spot. Do you want to play with me?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, I want to play with you, Spot!"

They played all day in the park. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. Spot and Tim became best friends. And from that day on, they played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl named Lily. She loved to explore the world around her. One day, she decided to go outside and melt some snow. She grabbed her measuring cup and went to the back yard. 

Lily looked at the snow and shouted, "What a lot of snow there is to melt!" She filled the cup with snow and placed it on the ground. 

Lily then noticed her mom coming to the back yard. "Mom!" she shouted in delight. 

"What are you doing, Lily?" Mom asked. 

"I'm melting snow! I'm being so brave," Lily replied. 

Mom smiled and said, "That's wonderful, Lily! I'm proud of you for being so brave." 

Lily smiled back, then she continued to measure and melt the snow until all of it was melted. She was so proud of her work and knew she was really brave.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her friends at the park. One day, they decided to have a race to see who was the fastest. They were very competitive and ran as fast as they could.

But then, Lily fell down and hurt her knee. She started to cry, but her friend Sarah came over to comfort her. Sarah gave her a hug and said everything would be okay. Then, Lily's mom came with a rod to help her walk. They all went home together, and Lily felt much better knowing she had such caring friends.

Once upon a time, there was a fisherman. He liked to catch fish with his fishing rod. One day, he caught a fish that looked bad. He wanted to examine it to see if it was sick. 

The fisherman took the bad fish to his home and put it in a bowl. He looked at it closely and saw that it had spots on its body. He thought it might be contagious, so he threw the fish back into the water. 

The fisherman learned that it was important to examine the fish he caught to make sure they were healthy. He didn't want to catch any more bad fish that could make him or other fish sick. From that day on, he always checked his fish before taking them home.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was very eager to play. She wanted to use her new balloon.

She ran outside and found a big green ballon. She was so excited and giggled as she picked it up. She bounced the balloon around and it made her laugh.

Sally held the balloon and stared at how it changed colour in the sunlight. Suddenly she heard a noise in the sky. Sally looked up, and up and up, until she saw a bunch of colourful balloons.

Sally was so eager that she wanted to join them. She closed her eyes and imagined flying away with the other balloons.

When Sally opened her eyes, she was still holding her own little green balloon. But she knew that if she wished hard enough, one day she could go on the same magical adventure.

Once there was a daddy and a daughter. The daddy loved coffee. Every morning he would make coffee. But one day, he spilled coffee all over the couch while he was making it. The daughter was very angry and she shouted at the daddy. She said, "Daddy, why did you do that?" The daddy got very hurt and he began to cry. 

 The daughter realised that she had been unkind and she felt sorry. She hugged her daddy and said, "I forgive you, Daddy". But instead of forgiving her, the daddy said, "You should not be so unkind. You should always be nice and be kind to others." 

The moral of the story is that we should always remember to be kind and gentle to all, even when we are hurt. Even when we make mistakes, we should forgive and always be kind.

One day, Grandma wanted to take her grandchild for a walk. She was so excited to spend time with them.

Grandma said to her grandchild, "Let's go for a walk! Put on your dress!"

But the grandchild didn't want to. She wanted to stay home and play.

Grandma said, "We can pick some vegetables from the garden and make a salad! That will be fun!"

The grandchild still wasn't ready to go, but after a few minutes of convincing, she reluctantly agreed. 

The grandchild went to put on her dress. She was ready to go, but then she realised she had forgotten to bring a bowl to put the vegetables in.

Grandma noticed her grandchild's worried expression and said, "Don't worry - I have a bowl. Let's go now and pick some vegetables, ok?"

The grandchild smiled and nodded. They both put on their dresses, grabbed the bowl and headed out to the garden. Grandma and her grandchild had a wonderful time picking vegetables for their salad. The grandchild was so proud that she had helped make a delicious vegetable salad, ready to eat!

One day, there was a spark in the sky. It was called a star. All of the stars were safe in the night sky. 

Every night, the stars would call each other. They would call softly, saying 'hello' to one another. The stars would twinkle and sparkle together, lighting up the sky. 

Then one day, something changed. There was a new star in the sky. It didn't look like any of the other stars. This new star was very big and very bright. 

At night, the stars called out to the new star. They asked it to join them and become part of the night sky. The new star was happy and said yes. 

The stars welcomed the new star and from that day forward, they all sparkled together in the night sky, safe and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Clara. Clara loved to collect things. One day, she decided to go to the stable to see if there was anything she could collect.

As soon as she entered the stable, she found a hidden box in the corner. It was filled with old coins. Clara was so excited that she started to collect them. She filled her pockets with the coins, and soon enough they were all gone.

Clara was so happy to have found such a hidden treasure. She ran home to show her family what she had found. 

The coins became a special memory for Clara and her family, and they all decided to keep them safe in a box in a very secret place.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey named Max. Max lived in a big jungle with lots of trees and animals. One day, Max saw a giraffe walking by and asked, "Can I ride on your back?"

The giraffe said, "No, that would be selfish. You always want to ride on everyone's back and never let anyone ride on yours."

Max felt sad and realized the giraffe was right. He had been selfish. So, he decided to apologize and said, "I'm sorry for being selfish. I promise to share and be kind."

The giraffe forgave Max and they became friends. From then on, Max learned to share and not be selfish. He also learned that it's not always about riding on someone's back, but about being a good friend.

Once upon a time, there was a kind owner named Tim. Tim had a dog named Spot. They lived in a big house with a huge yard.

One day, Tim and Spot went to play outside. Tim took a ball and said, "Ready, Spot?" Then he would shoot the ball far away. Spot would run fast, catch the ball, and bring it back to Tim. They played this game many times and laughed a lot.

After playing, Tim and Spot sat down under a tree. Tim looked at Spot and said, "You are a good dog, Spot." Spot wagged his tail and gave Tim a big, wet kiss on his face. They were the best of friends, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a dead tree in the woods. It was all alone, with no other trees around. But then one day, something special happened. A big grey and white coat wrapped around the tree! It was so soft, and it made the dead tree look alive again.

The coat then flew up in the sky, and it wrapped the dead tree with a big hug. The tree felt so happy and strong again. The coat flew away and the tree was left alone, but it was happy and felt alive. 

The other trees in the woods were so surprised. They had never seen anything like this before. They talked and talked about the amazing grey and white coat that had wrapped around the dead tree. 

The other trees wished that they too could have a coat like that, to make them strong and happy again. 

Then, from the sky, the coat came back. It brought the same grey and white wrap, but this time it hugged all the trees in the woods! Now all the trees were happy and felt alive, just like the dead tree.

Sam wrote a letter to his mom and dad. He wanted to tell them about his vacation. He told them it was very light outside and that he played all day. He wrote that he went to the beach and it was fun. He also wrote that he saw a lot of animals and they were really funny. Sam told them he wanted to stay there longer and have a longer vacation. He ended his letter with love and signed his name at the bottom. His mom and dad read his letter and smiled. They were so glad he was having a good time.

Lily and Ben are playing with blocks. They like to build towers and houses and cars. Lily has a lot of red blocks and Ben has a lot of blue blocks. They share some yellow and green blocks.

"Look at my tower!" Lily says. "It is very tall and strong. It can touch the sky!"

Ben looks at Lily's tower. He thinks it is too tall and not strong. He wants to make his tower taller and stronger. He takes some more blocks and puts them on top of his tower.

"Look at my tower!" Ben says. "It is taller and stronger than yours. It can touch the stars!"

Lily looks at Ben's tower. She thinks it is too silly and not stable. She sees that Ben's tower is leaning to one side. She has an idea. She takes a yellow block and throws it at Ben's tower.

"Oops!" Lily says. "I am sorry. I did not mean to do that."

Ben's tower falls down with a loud crash. The blocks scatter all over the floor. Ben is angry and sad. He cries.

"Why did you do that?" Ben says. "You are mean. You broke my tower!"

Lily feels bad. She did not want to make Ben cry. She wants to make him happy. She has another idea. She takes some blocks and makes a funny face with them. She puts them in front of Ben.

"Look at this!" Lily says. "It is a silly face. It has a big nose and a small mouth and two eyes that are not the same. It is funny. Do you like it?"

Ben looks at the silly face. He stops crying. He sees that Lily is trying to make him laugh. He thinks the silly face is funny. He smiles.

"I like it!" Ben says. "It is very silly. Can I make one too?"

Lily nods. She gives Ben some blocks. They make more silly faces with the blocks. They laugh and play. They are friends again. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore. One day, she saw a green island in the middle of a big lake. She wanted to go there and see what was on the island.

Lily asked her mom if they could go to the lake, but her mom said they couldn't go that day. Lily was sad, but her mom promised they would go soon. The next day, Lily's mom surprised her by taking her to the lake. They got in a boat and rowed to the island.

When they got to the island, Lily saw a big store. She was so excited to see what was inside. They went in and Lily saw lots of toys and candy. Her mom told her she could pick out one toy to take home. Lily was so happy and picked out a new doll.

From that day on, Lily always remembered the green island and the store where she got her doll. She knew she would go back again someday.

Ben and Lily went to the hospital with Mom. Mom had a hurt arm and needed an x-ray. An x-ray is a picture of the bones inside the body. Ben and Lily were curious and wanted to see the x-ray.

"Can we see the x-ray, Mom?" Ben asked.

"Sure, honey. The doctor will show us soon," Mom said.

They waited in a room with a big machine. The doctor came and asked Mom to put her arm on a table. He put a big apron on Mom and Ben and Lily. The apron was heavy and felt like a blanket.

"This apron will protect you from the x-ray rays," the doctor said. "They are very small and can go through the skin, but not the bones. That's how we can see the bones on the x-ray."

The doctor went behind a window and pressed a button. The machine made a beep sound and flashed a light. The doctor came back and took the apron off Mom and the kids.

"Let's see the x-ray," the doctor said. He took a big paper from the machine and put it on a wall. The paper had a picture of Mom's arm and the bones inside.

"Wow, that's cool!" Ben said.

"Look, Mom, your bone is broken!" Lily said.

"Yes, sweetie, that's why it hurts. The doctor will put a cast on it to help it heal," Mom said.

"A cast? What's that?" Ben asked.

"A cast is a hard wrap that goes around the arm. It keeps the bone in place and makes it strong again," the doctor said.

"Can we sign the cast, Mom?" Lily asked.

"Of course, you can. You can use different colors and draw pictures on it," Mom said.

"Yay, that sounds fun!" Ben said.

The doctor put the cast on Mom's arm and gave her some stickers. He also gave Ben and Lily some crayons and paper.

"Here, you can fold the paper and make cards for Mom. She will love them," the doctor said.

"Thank you, doctor. You are very nice," Mom said.

"You're welcome. I hope you feel better soon," the doctor said.

Ben and Lily folded the paper and made cards for Mom. They wrote "I love you" and "Get well soon" and drew hearts and flowers. They gave the cards to Mom and hugged her.

"Thank you, Ben and Lily. You are the best kids ever. I love you so much," Mom said.

They smiled and kissed Mom. They were happy to see the x-ray and make the cards. They hoped Mom's arm would heal fast. They were proud of Mom and of themselves.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a cat named Max. Max was very alert. He liked to watch the birds outside. Sue liked to watch Max.

One day, Sue saw Max looking out the window. She went to see what he was watching. Sue saw a big bird with a red mouth. She thought it was pretty. Sue wanted to touch the bird, but she had to mind her mom. Her mom said not to touch birds.

Sue called her mom to see the bird. Her mom saw the bird and smiled. She said, "That bird has a pretty red mouth!" Sue and her mom watched the bird together. They were happy. Sue knew that minding her mom was a good thing to do.

Molly was a cheerful three year old who loved to play. She especially loved to play dress up. She would wear Mommy's high heels, Daddy's hat, and Grandpa's glasses. One day, Molly was playing dress up with her yellow raincoat. She decided to wear it outside and find something fun to do. 

First, she walked to the playground. But the park was too quiet and she wanted to find something more exciting. So she continued walking and eventually, she came across a peanut street vendor. The peanuts looked so delicious and smelled so good! Molly was so excited and cheerful, she asked the vendor for some peanuts. 

The vendor gave her a big bag of peanuts and Molly couldn't wait to eat them. She started eating them, one at a time and enjoyed every single peanut. She was so happy and cheerful, she finished the whole bag in no time. 

Molly was so full, she didn't want to play dress up anymore. She thanked the peanut vendor and went back home. From then on, Molly tried to go outside and find new exciting things to do and eat.

Once upon a time, there was a happy boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside and run around. One day, Timmy found a big chest in his backyard. He opened it and inside he found a book. 

Timmy was so excited to read the book. He sat down on the grass and started to read. The book was about a cheerful puppy who loved to play catch. Timmy loved the story so much that he read it again and again.

After he finished reading, Timmy put the book back in the chest and closed it. He was happy to have found such a special treasure in his backyard. From that day on, Timmy would often go back to the chest to read more cheerful stories.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who went for a walk in the park. He was happy, but he didn't know that danger was nearby.

As he walked, he saw a shiny coin on the ground. He wanted to pick it up so he bent down to take it, but all of a sudden an old man shouted "Don't pick it up!"

The boy felt very uncomfortable. He looked up and the old man said, "That coin is dangerous. I want to warn you not to touch it."

The old man told the boy about all the bad things that could happen, so the boy was very scared. He ran away without taking the coin and never went back to that park again.

The old man had warned him and the boy had listened. He was thankful that he was safe.

Once upon a time, there was a big wardrobe in a little girl's room. The wardrobe was very dull and old, but the little girl loved it anyway. Every night, the little girl would shake the wardrobe a little bit, hoping that something magical would happen.

One day, the little girl's mom told her that they were going to clean out the wardrobe. The little girl was sad, but she knew it had to be done. As they were cleaning, the little girl found a small box hidden in the back of the wardrobe. She shook it a little bit and heard something rattle inside.

Excitedly, the little girl opened the box and found a beautiful necklace. She put it on and felt like a princess. From that day on, the little girl would shake the wardrobe every night, hoping to find more magical treasures hidden inside.

Once upon a time, there was a bright chicken. She lived on a farm with many other animals. Everyday, she would flutter around, looking for something yummy to eat. One day, she found some delicious corn in the field. She was so happy and quickly hopped onto it. Suddenly, the farmer came around and noticed her. He was angry that she was eating his crops. He shooed her away and she flew away, too scared to come back.

Later that night, the chicken realized she had missed the corn. She had been so happy for a moment, and now it was gone. She knew she should have stayed away from the farmer's crops.

The moral of this story is that we should be careful what we go after. We might miss out on something that we thought was wonderful.

Once upon a time, there was a big plane in the sky. It was flying very high and very fast. Suddenly, it had to lean to one side because of some strong wind. The people inside the plane got scared and some of them started to feel sick.

One of the passengers, a little boy, got very angry. He wanted the plane to stop leaning and go back to flying straight. But the wind was too strong and the plane kept shaking. The boy started to cry and his mom tried to calm him down.

Finally, the pilot was able to make the plane fly straight again. Everyone inside the plane was relieved and happy. The little boy stopped crying and even got to see some pretty clouds from his window. The end.

The sun was shining brightly on the park. The park was full of children playing, laughing and running about.

Amy was a little girl and she had come to the park with her dad. He was playing catch with her and they were both laughing.

After a while, Amy's dad said, "Do you want to play a game, Amy? It's called 'Gum and Mind'."

Amy was excited. She liked games. She nodded and said, "Yes, dad!"

Her dad explained the rules. They had to be competitive and try to get the most pieces of gum. If they could both get the most pieces they could share them.

Amy started chasing the pieces of gum and minding each one she wanted. She remembered to look at every piece and decide which one she wanted the most.

At the end of the game, Amy and her dad had found the same number of pieces of gum. They shared the gum out between them and smiled. Amy had had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl called Lily. She was always in such a rush and was always running around. One day, Lily's mom and dad told her about a holiday. It was a big, special adventure and she was so excited.

Lily and her parents got ready for their holiday and set off. They drove in their car at a very slow pace and eventually arrived at the beach. The waves were so gentle, the sun was shining and the sand felt baby-soft, like a cloud beneath their feet.

Lily loved running around in the sand. But then something funny happened; her dad started walking backwards! Lily was so surprised and clapped her hands. She watched her dad seeing everything in reverse, and it made her giggle.

Lily then tried walking backwards herself and it felt so strange but fun. The holiday was so special and she loved spending slow times with her parents. Eventually the holiday ended, but Lily will never forget the day.

Once upon a time, there was a big bird in the sky. The bird flapped its wings and flew all around. One day, it flew over a family. The family was very happy and they sang a song. The bird liked it so much that it flew past them again and again. 

The family thought that the bird liked their song and they allowed the bird to listen. Every day, the bird flew by and listened to the family's song. Each time, the bird became happier. 

One day, the family decided to no longer allow the big bird to listen. The bird was very sad and flew away. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to share our joy with others. Allowing people to enjoy the good things we do can bring us and them a lot of happiness.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing her flute every day. One day, she went to the park to play her flute. She saw a boy sitting on a bench and asked him if he wanted to hear her play. The boy said yes and Lily started to play her flute. The boy listened patiently and clapped when she finished.

Suddenly, a big dog came running towards them. The boy got scared and ran away. Lily tried to run too, but she tripped and fell. The dog bit her and she had to go to the hospital. The doctor tried to help her, but it was too late. Lily didn't make it.

The boy felt very sad when he heard the news. He wished he had been more patient and stayed with Lily. He never forgot about her and always remembered the beautiful music she played on her flute.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Dave. He loved to explore!

One day, he went to the park to play. He was so excited! He was running around exploring all the trees, grass and flowers.

Suddenly, he found a big nail on the ground. He picked it up and thought it was funny.

Dave said "Wow! What's this?"

His Mom said "It's a nail, Dave. Don't play with it! Nails can be very dangerous."

But Dave liked the nail because it was funny.

So, he kept it and took it home. He showed it to his friends and they all thought it was funny too.

The End.

Once there was a giant who lived in the sea. One day, the giant decided to go for a swim. He swam from the shore to a nearby island. He was so alert on his journey and was looking around at all of the sights. 

The giant was so excited to explore the island. He saw birds flying in the sky and huge stones in the water. 

The giant pushed a large stone and found a secret place. It was filled with so many colorful fish. The giant was so happy. He decided to stay and swim with the friendly fish. 

The giant stayed and swam in the secret place all day long. The fish were so much fun to play with. The giant never got bored and was alert in case any predators came by. 

Finally, the giant said goodbye to his new friends and swam back home. He had such a wonderful day that he couldn't wait to go back again soon!

Mandy and Mike were best friends. Every day, they liked to spend time in Mike's bedroom. They liked to enjoy all the furniture. One day, they were playing with Mike's toys when they noticed something strange. There was an ugly old chair in the corner of the room.

"What's that?" asked Mandy.

"It's my mom's old chair," explained Mike.

Mandy thought it looked very uncomfortable. "Why don't we get rid of it?" she said.

Mike shook his head. "My mom loves that chair. We need to keep it," he said firmly.

So, Mandy and Mike decided to do their best to make the ugly chair look better. They spent the day rearranging the furniture in the room. They moved the chair to a different corner. Then, they added some decorations to it. In the end, the chair looked a lot better.

"Let's spend some time sitting on it," suggested Mandy.

Mike smiled. He was glad he and Mandy had decided to keep the chair. He knew his mom would be happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny mouse called Robbie who lived in a cozy nest near a peanut tree. Robbie was so adorable and loved to eat peanuts all day. One day, he decided to try and reach for the peanuts himself.

Robbie got up on his hind legs and asked the peanut tree if he could grab a few peanuts. But the peanut tree was very strict and wouldn't let him have any peanuts. Robbie begged and pleaded with the tree but nothing worked. 

At this, Robbie got angry and started to shake the tree. He didn't realise how big and strong the tree was and it came crashing down. Robbie was sad and frightened as he started to run away from the tree.

When Robbie was safe, he realised that he had pushed too hard and learned his lesson. He now knew that it was not always best to get what he wanted and he should always be gentle and caring.

Once upon a time, there was a little daisy. The daisy was sad. It did not like the rain. The rain made the daisy wet.

One day, the sun came out. The daisy was happy. The sun made the daisy warm and dry. The sun and the daisy were friends.

But the rain did not like the sun. The rain and the sun disagree. They both wanted the daisy to be their friend. The daisy wanted to be friends with both the sun and the rain. The sun and the rain became friends too. Now they all play together and the daisy is not sad anymore.

Sam was a little dog with short white hair. He had a big nose and he was very curious. 

One day he decided to take a walk in the woods. As he was walking he noticed something shiny in the snow. It was an icy crystal. Sam was fascinated and he decided to pick it up.

When he touched the icy crystal he heard a sound. Someone was talking! It said â€œTouch me and I will be your friend.â€ 

Sam was scared, but he wanted to make a new friend. He put his nose closer and he said â€œHello?â€

Then, a very friendly voice answered â€œHello, Sam! I am the icy crystal. I can help you find the lost numbers in your skin. Would you like that?â€

Sam was so excited to find out that the icy crystal could help him find the lost numbers! He smiled and he said â€œYes, I would like that!â€ 

From that day, Sam and the icy crystal became very good friends and they went on many adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to go outside and play with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to clean his room. Timmy didn't want to clean his room, so he went outside to play instead.

As he was playing, Timmy's friend Billy came over and showed him a disgusting bug he found. Timmy thought it was cool, but his mom always told him to stay away from bugs. Billy then said they should go inside and play video games, but Timmy remembered his messy room and said he couldn't.

Billy asked why, and Timmy told him about his mom's request to clean his room. Billy then said, "Why don't we clean your room together? It will be fun!" Timmy thought about it and realized that cleaning his room was important. So, he went inside and cleaned his room with Billy's help.

In the end, Timmy learned that sometimes it's important to do things we don't want to do, like cleaning our room. And he also learned that having a friend to help can make a boring task fun.

Once upon a time, there was a wide sky with many stars. Each star twinkled and shone, but they were all alone up there. One star wanted to be friends with the others and unite with them. 

So, the star started to twinkle brighter and brighter, hoping to catch the attention of the other stars. Soon enough, all the stars noticed the shining star and they all twinkled back at it. 

The star was so happy to have friends and be united with the other stars. Together, they made the wide sky even more beautiful. And from that day on, the star was never alone again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Max. Max loved to play outside in the forest. One day, Max met a little rabbit named Ruby.

"Hi Ruby!" said Max. "Do you want to play with me?"

"Yes, please!" said Ruby, glad to have a friend to play with.

Max and Ruby played together for a while. Then Max said, "Let's lie down under this tree and look at the clouds."

Ruby agreed and they lay down under the tree. They saw a cloud that looked like a big, fluffy bunny.

"I see a bunny!" said Ruby.

"I see it too!" said Max.

They were both glad that they were friends and could play together.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to go on the slide. It was fun and fast. But today, they saw something new. Someone had put paint and stickers on the slide. It was all different colors and shapes.

"Wow, look at that!" Lily said. "Someone decorated the slide. It is so pretty!"

Tom frowned. He did not like the paint and stickers. He thought they were stupid. They made the slide slippery and sticky. He wanted to slide on the metal, not on the mess.

"That is not pretty, that is stupid!" Tom said. "Who did this? They ruined the slide. I don't want to play on it anymore."

Lily was sad. She liked the slide, even with the paint and stickers. She thought they made it more fun and interesting. She wanted to play with Tom, but he was angry.

"Please, Tom, don't be mad," Lily said. "Let's try the slide. Maybe it is still fun. Maybe we can pretend we are sliding on a rainbow, or a dragon, or a spaceship."

Tom shook his head. He did not want to pretend. He wanted the slide to be normal. He crossed his arms and turned away.

"Fine, then I will slide by myself," Lily said. She climbed up the ladder and sat on the slide. She smiled and slid down. She felt the paint and stickers on her hands and legs. She laughed and enjoyed the ride.

Tom watched her. He saw her having fun. He felt a little sorry. Maybe he was being too mean. Maybe the slide was not so bad. Maybe he could try it too.

"Hey, Lily, wait for me!" Tom said. He ran to the ladder and followed her. He sat on the slide and slid down. He felt the paint and stickers on his hands and legs. He was surprised and curious. He smiled and liked the ride.

Lily and Tom slid down again and again. They forgot about being mad. They had fun and played together. They liked the slide, even with the paint and stickers. They decided it was not stupid, it was special.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Joe and Jane. They loved to share things with each other. One day, Joe and Jane were in the park together. Suddenly, they heard a strange language coming from a nearby tree. The language was unknown to them, so they listened carefully. 

Joe and Jane tried to figure out what the language was, but they couldnâ€™t understand any of it. They decided to share the strange language with each other and see if they could figure out what it was. 

The two friends made up different noises and words for the language and shared them with each other. After trying out different sounds and words, Joe and Jane finally understood the language! It was a language they had never heard before. 

Joe and Jane both smiled and shared a high five. They were happy to know the unknown language and share it with each other. From then on, they always shared what they knew with one another.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Jane. She wanted some candy and asked her brother for some. But her brother was feeling very selfish and wouldn't give her any. Jane was so mad and started to talk in a loud voice. Her brother didn't like this, so he told her she could not have any candy. Jane was very sad and started to cry.

Jane's mum heard the noise and came running. She asked Jane why she was crying. Jane said her brother wouldn't give her any candy. Her mum was angry and told her brother he must give Jane some candy. But her brother was still being selfish and refused.

Jane was very upset and desperate for some candy, so she reached out and grabbed some from her brother's pocket. Her brother was so angry that he shouted at her. Jane was so scared and started to cry again.

Her mum was very disappointed and told her that she doesn't like her being so selfish and taking things that don't belong to her. She said she would not give Jane any candy. Jane had to go to bed without any candy and was very sad. The end.

Ben and Sam were best friends. They liked to play with cars and trucks in the yard. One day, they found a pipe in the grass. It was long and shiny and made a funny sound when they blew into it.

"Wow, this is a cool pipe!" Ben said. "Can I have it?"

"No, I saw it first!" Sam said. "It's mine!"

They both wanted the pipe. They started to pull and tug on it. They got angry and shouted at each other.

"Let go of my pipe!" Ben yelled.

"No, you let go of mine!" Sam yelled back.

They pulled so hard that the pipe broke in half. They both fell to the ground and started to cry.

They looked at the broken pipe and felt sad. They had ruined their fun and their friendship.

"I'm sorry, Sam," Ben said. "I was mean to you. Can you forgive me?"

"I'm sorry, too, Ben," Sam said. "I was mean to you, too. Yes, I forgive you."

They hugged and smiled. They decided to share the pipe. They each took a half and blew into it. It still made a funny sound.

They laughed and played with the pipe. They were happy and kind to each other. They were best friends again.

Little Jack was out in the backyard playing with his friends. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. They all stopped and looked around. Then they saw a strange man. He was holding something in his hands.

The man walked over to a patch of soft ground and started to dig with a small shovel. He was burying something! Little Jack and his friends ran over to see what it was. 

The man smiled at them. He had buried a box full of treasure. It was a special treasure that only children could see. The man said it was a gift from the stars. Little Jack and his friends were so excited. 

But then the man said that the treasure was very weak and needed to be taken care of. He said it had to be buried again in order to stay strong. 

Little Jack wanted to keep his new treasure safe. So he and his friends found another patch of soft ground and carefully buried the box. They smiled. They knew their treasure was safe and strong.

Once there was a little chick. She was only three years old. She wanted to fly so bad, but she was still too young.

One day, her mommy encouraged her. She said â€œyou can do it!â€ The little chick was so excited. She flew up in the air.

The sky was so clear and blue. She was flying so high. She was so proud of herself.

Her mommy was so happy for her. She said â€œwell done! You did it!â€

The little chick was so proud. She kept flying higher and higher. She never wanted to come down.

Once upon a time, there was a group of friends who liked to play hockey together. It was very popular to play in the city. Every day, they would add more people to their group, until they had lots of friends who wanted to play hockey. It was so much fun! 

The group of friends kept growing, until one day they had to move to a bigger place so they could all play. They added nets and more sticks, so they could all play together. They even added goals, so they could have a real hockey game. It was so exciting! 

Every day, the group of friends played hockey and enjoyed it more and more. People from all over the city started to hear about their game and wanted to join in. Hockey became more and more popular. All the friends kept adding new people to the game, and soon hockey was the most played game of all!

Lily and Tom were playing with their toy boats in the bathtub. They liked to sail them across the water and make waves with their hands. Lily had a red boat and Tom had a blue boat.

"Look, my boat is faster than yours!" Tom said, pushing his boat forward.

"No, mine is faster!" Lily said, pushing her boat harder.

They both laughed and splashed each other. But then, Lily's boat hit the edge of the tub and broke. The mast snapped and the sail fell off.

"Oh no, my boat!" Lily cried, picking up the pieces.

"Don't cry, Lily. I can fix it for you," Tom said, getting out of the tub. He ran to his room and came back with a bottle of glue.

"Here, let me help you," he said, taking the broken boat from Lily. He put some glue on the mast and stuck the sail back on. He held it for a few seconds until it dried.

"There, good as new!" he said, handing the boat back to Lily.

"Wow, thank you, Tom! You are so kind and powerful!" Lily said, hugging him.

"You're welcome, Lily. You are my best friend," Tom said, smiling.

They got back into the tub and sailed their boats together. They had a lot of fun and forgot about the time. They were happy.

Sally was a 3 year old running through the park. She raced to a river and saw the water was rough. She touched the icy water with her feet, making silly noises. 

"Ahhhhhh!" She squealed as she kicked the water. 

"Sally!" A voice shouted from behind her.

Sally turned and saw her mom standing there.

"Mommy!" Sally said, clapping her hands.

"What are you doing?" her mom asked.

"I'm kicking the rough water in the river," Sally said with a smile.

Her mom smiled back and said, "That's great! But be careful, it can be dangerous. Now, come on. It's time to go home."

Sally nodded and started to run back with her mom. But as she ran, she looked back one last time and smiled at the river.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the kitchen to get some milk from the refrigerator. But when she opened the door, she saw that her little brother had left the door open and all the food inside was getting warm.

"Liam, why did you leave the refrigerator door open? That's naughty!" Lily scolded her brother.

"I didn't mean to, I just forgot," Liam answered.

"Well, you need to be more careful next time," Lily said as she closed the refrigerator door. "Now, let's go play outside!"

Once upon a time, there were two friends - Jenny and Jacob. They liked to play together in the park. 

On this day, Jenny found a funny word. She squeaked and said "I found a word!"

Jacob heard her and said "Oh, what is it?" 

Jenny laughed and said "Haha - it's a secret!"

Jacob's smile got bigger and he said "Can I see it?"

Jenny shook her head and said, "No, I'm going to tease you with it!"

Jacob's mouth dropped open. He thought it was not very nice, but he smiled and said, "Ok, I promise I won't be too serious!" 

Jenny giggled and they began to play. They both had lots of fun and Jacob even got to guess what the silly word was.

Once upon a time there was a chubby duck. He wanted to collect lots of colourful feathers for his sack. Every morning he flew around the pond, looking for the prettiest feathers. He collected red and blue, yellow and green and all the colours in between! The more feathers he found, the bigger and fuller his sack became.

One day he found a big, sparkly green feather and he was so excited. He put it in his sack and flew away. He had almost filled it, and he was determined to get enough feathers to make it big and plump!

The chubby duck kept searching. He collected feathers all day, until finally the sack was bulging. He was so happy he had been able to fill it, that he indulged in one more feather. It ended up being the last feather he needed, but it was the prettiest one yet - a beautiful pink one!

The chubby duck proudly carried his full sack of colourful feathers home. He couldn't wait for everyone to see his amazing feat. He gathered all his friends and family around and revealed his full sack of feathers - it was a beautiful sight!

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was only three-years-old and she had long, curly hair. One day, when she was out playing in the garden, she saw a very strange thing. It was a white witch!

The little girl was scared at first, but then she noticed that the witch had a kind face. She smiled at the little girl and held out her hand. She had something in it. It was a small, white stone.

The little girl thought it was very pretty, and so she took it. She put it in her pocket, and then gave the witch a big hug. The witch smiled and hugged her back. The little girl squeezed as hard as she could.

The little girl and the witch talked for a while, until the witch had to go. The witch waved goodbye, and the little girl waved back. She knew she would always remember her new friend.

There once was a little girl called Jenna who lived in a very big, old house. One day, she decided to explore her garden. As she slowly wandered around, she saw something very interesting. She stopped and gazed at an herb. It was dull green in colour and very soft. She carefully touched it and looked at it closely. 

Jenna love the herb so much that she took it home with her. She kept it in a pot on her window sill, and looked at it all the time to admire its beauty. She even talked to the herb and named it 'Charlie'. 

One day, she even put some of her old clothes on it to pretend it was a little person. She laughed and smiled as she played with the herb.

The herb and Jenna became good friends, and she would always take good care of it. She would water it every day and make sure it had enough sunshine. 

Jenna still visits Charlie in her garden from time to time and is always so grateful to have such wonderful herb in her life.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the mud. One day, she found a powerful ring in the mud. She put it on her finger and it made her feel strong.

Lily's friend, Timmy, came over to play. "Wow, Lily! That ring is so cool!" he said. "It's powerful!" Lily replied. "Can I try it on?" Timmy asked. "Sure!" Lily said, taking off the ring and giving it to Timmy.

As soon as Timmy put on the ring, he felt like he had superpowers. "I feel so strong!" he said. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise coming from the sky. "What was that?" Lily asked. "I don't know, but let's go check it out!" Timmy said.

They ran to the park and saw a big tree had fallen down. "We have to move it!" Lily said. Together, they used their powerful strength to move the tree out of the way. "Wow, we make a great team!" Timmy said. "Yeah, we do!" Lily replied, smiling.

Once upon a time, in a big jungle, there lived a group of animals. They were all friends and liked to play together. One day, they decided to gather fruits to have a big party. They were very glad about the idea.

The animals, like the monkey, the elephant, and the bird, went to different parts of the jungle to gather fruits. The monkey climbed trees to get bananas, the elephant used his long nose to reach the high branches, and the bird flew to find berries. They all worked together and had fun.

When they all came back to their party spot, they shared the fruits they gathered. The monkey said, "Sharing makes us happy and strong friends." The other animals agreed and they enjoyed their party. The moral of the story is that sharing and working together makes everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to play with her friends. They were having so much fun, but then Lily saw a drain. She wanted to study it, so she went closer to look. Suddenly, her ball fell into the drain! 

Lily was very sad because she thought her ball was dead. She asked her friends what to do, but they didn't know. Just then, a kind man walked by and asked what happened. Lily told him about her ball, and he said he could help. He got a long stick and fished the ball out of the drain. 

Lily was so happy and thanked the man. She learned that she should be careful around drains and that there are always kind people who can help. She went home and told her mom all about her adventure. Her mom was proud of her for being brave and for learning something new.

The empty sun shone on the playground. A young girl named Mary was there, observing her surroundings. She spotted a lovely green tree, full of yellow birds. Mary smiled and watched the birds flutter around in the sunny sky.

Suddenly, she heard laughter coming from the empty playground across the street. Mary couldn't help but be curious. She pushed open the gate and stepped onto the playground.

Mary looked around and discovered many exciting things. There were swings, slides and a giant sandpit. She observed the empty playground and imagined how wonderful it would look when it was full of children on a holiday.

Mary smiled and ran around the playground, exploring all the nooks and crannies. Slowly the day grew darker, so Mary reluctantly trotted home. She felt happy, knowing the playground would soon be full with joyful laughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. She was hopping around in the forest, looking for some yummy carrots. Suddenly, she noticed a strange trap on the ground. She was so curious and wanted to explore it. She started to sniff it, but it suddenly made a loud sound! She was very scared and started to scatter away.

The rabbit realized the trap was very serious. She knew she had to be careful not to stumble into any more of them. She quickly hopped away looking for safer places to eat.

But while the rabbit was hopping away, she noticed something else. This time, it was also a trap! It didn't make a loud noise this time, but the rabbit was still scared. She quickly scattered away again to stay safe.

The rabbit was relieved that she was able to scatter away from the traps. She promised herself to always be very careful in the forest and to always look around for any traps. She was so lucky she was able to escape!

Once upon a time there was a generous man who loved to sing opera. He had a big voice and his singing was very beautiful.

One day, the man went to the park to sing. He asked the guard if he could permit him to sing. The guard smiled and said yes.

The man began to sing and soon many people came to listen. They all clapped and cheered when the man finished singing.

The generous man felt very happy that he had been able to share his love of opera with so many people. He thanked the guard for permitting him to sing and went back home.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who had a surprise in a case. She was so excited to open it to find out what was inside.

Inside the case, she found a helpful doll. It had a pretty dress, a shiny smile and friendly eyes. It was the most helpful doll she had ever seen.

The girl was so happy and she hugged the doll tight. She played with it until bedtime and knew that it would be her best friend.

From then on, the girl and her helpful doll were inseparable. They played together every day and had lots of fun!

Once there was a big party. The party was to celebrate a birthday. Everyone was so happy! As the party began, colors started to appear all around. There were streams of different colors from yellow to pink. The colors made the celebration even more exciting! All the guests got together and cheered. The colors were different, but everyone still had so much fun together. The birthday person felt so special and filled with joy. People cheered and celebrated until the end of the night. It was an unforgettable celebration!

Susie and Sam were best friends. They were always together and did everything together, even when it seemed impossible!

One day, Susie and Sam went out for a walk. As they passed the garden, Susie noticed an onion in the middle of the garden. She screamed in joy and ran towards the onion.

Sam ran after her. "Where are you going Susie!" he asked.

Susie laughed. "Look," she said, pointing to the onion. "Let's pick it!"

Sam was worried. "It's too big for us to pick Susie," he said.

But Susie was confident. She smiled and said, "I am sure we will find someone dependable to help us pick it."

And sure enough they did. They screamed and waved at their neighbor until he came to help. So with the help of their dependable neighbor, Susie and Sam picked the onion together.

Afterwards, they enjoyed a wonderful onion soup - the best they had ever tasted!

Once upon a time there was a princess who was very sad. One day a brave knight came to her rescue. He saw the princess was down, so he asked her what was wrong. The princess said she was very ignorant and did not have any friends because of it.

The knight felt sorry for the princess and he wanted to help her. He asked her if she would like to have fun with him. The princess happily agreed. The knight took the princess out for a grand adventure. They explored the countryside and went on many fun adventures.

Finally, the knight and princess stopped at a lake. The knight dared the princess to catch a fish with her bare hands. She was scared, but the knight said he would be there to help her. The princess closed her eyes and put her hands in the water. Suddenly, she felt the coldness of a slippery fish. She caught it and held it up! The knight cheered and they both laughed.

The prince and princess then became good friends. They learned a lot from each other and found out that knowledge is not only found in books. Also, they realized that being ignorant is not bad, as long as you are willing to learn and explore.

The knight saved the princess from being lonely and ignorant. He showed her that having fun and exploring is sometimes the best way to learn. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Ben. Ben loved to eat berries. One sunny day, Ben went to the woods to find some berries. He saw a big bush with red berries on it. Ben was very happy.

Ben started to eat the berries, but he saw a troubled bird named Tim. Tim was sad because he could not find any food for his family. Ben wanted to help Tim. He said, "Tim, do not be sad. I will help you find some food."

Ben and Tim rushed to another part of the woods. They found a big tree with lots of berries. Ben and Tim picked the berries together. They were very happy. They took the berries back to Tim's family. Tim's family was very happy too. From that day on, Ben and Tim became best friends.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Timmy found an old cube in his backyard. The cube was very ancient and had strange symbols on it. Timmy was very curious about the cube, so he picked it up and examined it closely. He sighed when he realized that he couldn't understand the symbols on the cube.

Timmy decided to ask his mom about the cube. He showed it to her and she was amazed by its ancient look. She explained to Timmy that the cube was very old and probably belonged to someone long ago. Timmy was fascinated by the cube and wanted to learn more about it.

Together, Timmy and his mom did some research and found out that the cube was used by ancient people for a game. They decided to try playing the game and had a lot of fun. Timmy was happy that he found the ancient cube and learned something new. He sighed contentedly and went to bed, dreaming about the adventures he would have with the cube.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play and have fun. They are very happy because they are going on holiday with Mum and Dad. They pack their bags and toys and get in the car.

The car goes very fast on the road. Lily and Tom look out the window and see many things. They see cows and sheep and trees and houses. They tell each other what they see and make up stories. They sing songs and laugh.

After a long time, the car stops at a big house. Mum and Dad say this is where they will stay for the holiday. They get out of the car and take their bags and toys. They go inside the house and look around. It is very nice and cosy.

But there is a problem. The house has a smelly smell. It smells like old socks and cheese and fish. Lily and Tom do not like the smell. They cover their noses and say yuck. Mum and Dad do not like the smell either. They say sorry and look for the source of the smell.

They find it in the kitchen. It is a big bin full of rubbish. Someone forgot to take it out before they left. Mum and Dad take the bin outside and throw it away. They open the windows and spray some perfume. The smell goes away and the house is fresh and clean.

Lily and Tom are happy again. They say thank you and give Mum and Dad a hug. They unpack their bags and toys and choose their rooms. They are ready to enjoy their holiday. They hope to see more cows and sheep and trees and houses. They hope to have more fun and make more stories. They hope the house does not get smelly again.

It was a bright morning when the sun came out to play. Little Marky was so excited for his very first day of tutoring. He had heard so many stories about his new tutor, and was dreading going. 

His Mum showed him the way to the room, where he saw his new tutor smiling. She was gentle and softly spoke to him. She told him that they were going to spray some flowers together.

They went outside and the tutor showed him how to hold the sprayer properly and together they sprayed the flowers. They were both so excited to see them come to life with all the beautiful colors. 

Marky started to feel more comfortable with his new tutor after they had finished. He was feeling more excited when they headed back inside to do the tutoring work. 

His Mum met him afterwards and they both smiled. Marky knew that he had made a new friend, and he was already looking forward to his next lesson!

Sarah stood gazing at the sky, her little face was full of wonder. The clouds were moving so quickly, and the sun was so bright.

In the corner of her eye, Sarah saw something sparkle. She walked over and saw it was a memory. It was golden in colour and it shone in the sun. Sarah thought it must be special and she wanted to take it home.

But then, when Sarah tried to pick it up, she heard something crack. The memory had broken into pieces. Sadness filled Sarah's face, but she remembered something her mama had said.

Mama had said that broken memories are just pieces of beautiful stories. So Sarah gathered all the broken pieces in her hands and looked back at the sky.

The clouds were still moving, the sun still shone and Sarah was sure that her broken memory would still be just as special. She took the pieces home and put them somewhere safe, so that she could always remember that special story.

Once there was a huge tree. Every season it changed in amazing ways. In the spring it was full of leaves and life. In the summer it had tasty fruits that the animals would eat. In the autumn the leaves turned golden. In the winter, the tree was huge and places to hide. 

One day, a little girl was walking by the tree and saw something strange. It was an old dusty book, tucked between the roots of the trunk. The little girl picked it up and opened it. Inside, the most beautiful pictures were on every page. 

The little girl couldn't read the words on the page, but she looked at the pictures carefully, seeing how one page was connected to the next. She liked the pictures so much that she took the book home.

Every morning she would come to the tree and read the book. Eventually, she found that she could remember the stories without looking at the book. And the more she read, the more she learned about the world around her.

The moral of the story is that we can learn something from everything, even if we can't read the words. A huge tree can teach us a lot if we take the time to look and explore.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful beetle. He loved to race across the garden, weaving in and out of the flower petals. He spun around and around and around, racing against the wind.

One day, he came across two other beetles who were racing against each other. He wanted to join in, so he did! He raced his hardest against them, scurrying across the blades of grass. He rolled and twirled, feeling the sun on his back. 

Just when the graceful beetle was about to win, he spotted a very special flower. He stopped, and watched as the sun danced across its petals. He was so captivated by its beauty that he forgot about the race.

The ending of the story was happy, for the beetle was content. He had discovered something that was far more precious that racing - an appreciation for the beauty of the world.

Once upon a time, there was a frog who lived in a pond. The frog loved to jump and swim in the water. One day, the sun was shining very hot and the water in the pond started to get warm. The frog felt hot and wanted to find a safe place to rest.

He hopped out of the pond and saw a big tree with a hole in it. The frog thought it would be a safe place to rest. As he hopped into the hole, he noticed a small stick with a flame on it. He didn't know what it was, but he knew it was hot.

The frog started to feel scared and wanted to leave, but he was too late. The stick fell and burned the tree. The frog was lucky to escape just in time. From that day on, the frog knew to always be careful and look for safe places to rest.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy little boy. He was always so tired, so he decided to take a nap. With a little spray from his pain, he drifted off to sleep.

Once upon a time, a long lion lived in a big forest. He loved to run around, climb trees and eat yummy snacks.

Once upon a time there was a happy little girl called Lilly. Lilly liked to play in the garden and loved to sing jolly songs. When Lilly got thirsty, she would run into the house and ask her mum for a drink.

Once upon a time, there was a big garden. In the garden, there was a rake. The rake was very useful to clean up the leaves. One day, a fierce wind blew and many leaves fell on the ground. Once upon a time there was a lazy reef. The reef was very unhappy. It wanted to be fixed so that the coral could be happy and healthy.
