Jack was scared and ran away, but Jane stayed and laughed.

Then they went to play in the sand and have lots of fun. The day was very happy, and they were glad to have seen what happened at the sea.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a friend named Billy who was very strong. One day, Timmy and Billy went to the park to play. Timmy brought his favorite toy truck and a bottle of juice. 

Timmy wanted to drink his juice, but the bottle was too heavy for him to pour. Billy saw Timmy struggling and offered to help. He poured the juice into Timmy's cup and they both drank it together. Timmy was happy to have a strong friend like Billy who could help him with things he couldn't do on his own. 

After they finished their juice, Timmy and Billy played with the toy truck. They took turns pushing it around and pretending it was driving on the roads. They had so much fun together and Timmy was grateful to have such a good friend like Billy.

Once upon a time there was a young girl who loved to play in the garden. One day she decided to use a tall ladder to climb up to pick some apples from the tree. When she was half way up the ladder, she slipped and began to fall. 

Just then her father saw her and called out, "Stop! Don't move!" The girl immediately stopped and stayed still.

Her father said, "Be careful and think before you do something. You could have been hurt badly if you had fallen all the way down, but now you are fine."

The girl smiled, thanked her father and decided that she should always use her common sense and be careful when using the ladder. She had learnt an important lesson. 

Moral: Being careful and using common sense can help us stay safe.

Once there was a boy named Sam. He was very shy and kept all his favourite treasures in his pocket. One day, he decided to go for a walk in the woods. He carried his pocket with him and started walking. 

As he walked, he noticed something shimmering in the distance. He was curious what it was and ran towards it. All of a sudden he heard a voice saying "stop right there Sam". It was an old man looking very angry. He said that the thing Sam was wanting was in danger and needed to be carried away by someone brave. 

Sam was scared and wanted to run away but the old man said if he was brave and carried it away, he could keep it forever in his pocket. Even though he was a bit shy, Sam knew he had to be brave. He slowly took the special thing and put it in his pocket and ran as fast as he could. 

The old man watched him go with a smile and said, "You did it, Sam". Sam smiled too and his pocket felt extra special, knowing he was brave enough to help.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to design things. One day, he wanted to make a belt. But not just any belt, a fancy belt!

Tim went to his mom and said, "I want to make a fancy belt. Can you help me?" His mom smiled and said, "Of course, Tim! Let's get some things to make it pretty."

Together, they found some nice colors and shiny things. Tim put them all on the belt. It looked very fancy! Tim was so happy with his fancy belt.

He showed his belt to his friends. They all loved it! Tim was very proud of his fancy belt. He wore it every day and felt very special. And everyone knew that Tim was the best at designing fancy belts.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who wanted to buy cauliflower. But he didn't have any money, so he couldn't buy it. He was very jealous of the other children who could.

Then one day he went to the market with his mom. He went up to the man selling the cauliflower and asked for some. His mom said she'd pay for it.

The little boy was so excited. He was happy that his mom could pay for the cauliflower. He ran to the other kids at the market and told them he had cauliflower. They were all jealous.

The little boy was really proud of himself. He was finally able to get cauliflower after he didn't have enough money. He thanked his mom for helping him and they went home with the cauliflower.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a lively little bird named Chirpy. Chirpy lived in a big tree with many friends. Chirpy liked to hop on their shoulders and sing happy songs.

One day, Chirpy saw a big cat near the tree. The cat wanted to catch Chirpy and his friends. Chirpy was scared, but he had an idea. He flew to his friend, the big dog, and asked for help. Chirpy hopped on the dog's shoulder and said, "Please help us, big dog!"

The big dog barked and chased the cat away. Chirpy and his friends were safe. Chirpy thanked the big dog for saving them. From that day on, Chirpy and the big dog became best friends. They played together and Chirpy always sang happy songs on the dog's shoulder.

Once upon a time, there was a hurricane. It was big and strong. The wind was so strong it made people feel dizzy. All the people had to stay inside so they would stay safe.

The hurricane went around and around for a long time. It knocked down some trees and blew away some roofs. But eventually, it started to get weaker. Finally, it ended. 

Everyone was so happy it was gone. They went outside and looked around. They hugged each other and said goodbye to the hurricane. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a smart hunter named Tim. Tim lived in a small house near the woods. He had a big dog named Rex. They were best friends. Every day, they went to the woods to find food.

One day, Tim and Rex were walking in the woods when they heard a loud noise. "What's that?" asked Tim. Rex barked and wagged his tail. They walked closer to the noise and saw a big, brown bear. The bear was sad and crying.

Tim said to the bear, "Why are you sad?" The bear replied, "I lost my baby bear. I can't find her anywhere." Tim and Rex wanted to help the bear, so they started to look for the baby bear. They walked and walked, listening for any sound of the baby bear.

Finally, they heard a soft cry. Rex barked and ran towards the sound. Tim followed Rex and saw the baby bear stuck in a hole. Tim helped the baby bear out of the hole, and the bear was happy.

The big bear thanked Tim and Rex for their help. "You are very smart and kind," said the big bear. Tim, Rex, and the bears became good friends, and they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted to buy a toy from the store, but she didn't have enough money. She asked her mom for some extra money, but her mom said no. 

Lily decided to design her own toy instead. She gathered some paper, crayons, and glue. She drew a picture of her dream toy and cut it out. She glued the pieces together and made a beautiful toy. 

When Lily went to the store, she saw a vendor selling toys. She wanted to show her toy to the vendor, but the vendor said no. The vendor only wanted to sell his own toys. 

Lily was sad, but she remembered that she had organized a toy sale at her house. She invited her friends and sold her handmade toys. She made enough money to buy the toy she wanted from the store. The moral of the story is that if you work hard and stay organized, you can achieve your goals.

Maddy and her family went to stay in the hotel. Her mum and dad were very excited. Maddy was young and she couldn't wait to explore.

When they got to the hotel, Maddy saw a big room. There were two beds and lots of toys. Maddy started to poke one of the pillows.

Just then, Maddy's dad came over to her. "Maddy. Please don't poke the bed." he said.

Maddy smiled and said "Ok, daddy!"

Maddy then went and explored the hotel. She looked in the lobby and saw a lot of people. She poked her fingers at them, but they just laughed and said "hello".

Maddy had lots of fun in the hotel. She can't wait to come back again soon.

Once there was a woman. She was walking in the park when she saw two dogs playing together. She was surprised to see them because they were different colours. She watched them, smiling, as they seemed to unite and play happily together.

The woman had an idea. She went to her village and told her neighbours what she had seen, telling them they should do the same. She told them they should all unite and work together, no matter what their differences were.

The neighbours were hesitant at first. They did not know if it was a good idea or not. But the woman was very persuasive and she persuaded them that it was a good thing to do.

They all agreed and decided to have a meeting the next week. However, the woman was very strict about what time people should arrive. Some people thought she was too harsh, but she believed it was the only way to make sure everyone would arrive on time.

At the meeting, all the neighbours united and decided to work together. The woman was proud of what she had accomplished and the whole village was very happy.

Once upon a time there was a small girl named Lucy. She was happy and wanted to explore the world.

One day, Lucy found a valley that she had never seen before. She decided to explore the valley and when she reached the bottom, she noticed it was hot.

Lucy asked a nearby butterfly, "Why is it so hot in this valley?" The butterfly explained that inside the valley it was getting too hot and she had to solve the problem.

Lucy thought and thought and came up with an idea. She made a fan out of some sticks and some leaves she had found and put it by the entrance of the valley. The fan blew the hot air away and cooled the valley down.

The butterfly was very pleased and thanked Lucy. From then on Lucy explored the valley with the butterfly and they had many great adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a big fat cat named Tom. Tom loved to play with his toys and eat lots of food. One day, something bad happen to Tom. He hurt his paw and couldn't walk anymore. His owner took him to the hospital, where the nice doctor helped him feel better. Tom was so happy to be able to walk again and play with his toys. From that day on, Tom made sure to be careful and not get hurt again.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy. His name was Jack. Jack had a very special gift, he could talk to animals. One day, Jack was in the kitchen getting some food. Suddenly, he heard a noise from outside. He went to investigate what was happening. 
 
He looked out the window, and he saw a big grey cat. It was meowing for help! Jack opened the door and the cat ran inside. Jack noticed that the cat was injured and scared. He wanted to help the cat, so he made it a bed in the kitchen and gave it some food. 

The cat was so thankful and started to purr. Jack talked to the cat and, after a while, the cat told Jack itâ€™s story. It had been on a long journey and it was very tired. The cat asked Jack if it could stay with him, and Jack said yes. 

The cat was so relieved, it surrendered itself to Jack. Jack took good care of the cat, and even named it 'Fluffy'. Fluffy and Jack became best friends and they lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Max. Max liked to play with his toys and run around in the park. One day, Max saw a cat walking by and decided to invite her to play. The cat was happy to join in and they had lots of fun together.

After a while, they got tired and sat down in the grass. It was very quiet and there was a silence all around them. Max and the cat enjoyed the peacefulness and just sat there for a while. Then, they said goodbye and went their separate ways.

Max was happy to have made a new friend and couldn't wait to invite the cat to play again. From that day on, Max and the cat became good friends and would often enjoy the silence of the park together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to go to school. She was never careless and always enjoyed learning. One day, the little girl put on her coat and was ready to go. As she stepped out the door, she noticed it was raining and her coat wouldn't cover her enough. She ran back inside and grabbed an umbrella to cover her from the rain. 

When she got to school, all of her friends were already there, but she felt not very dry! Her teacher kindly said that she should go dry off in the school's cloakroom. The little girl smiled, thanked her teacher, and walked to the cloakroom.

When the little girl returned to the classroom, she was dry and happy and all her friends exclaimed how clever and careful she was! She had used her umbrella to cover her from the rain. The little girl smiled and knew that being careful was important.

Once there was a bird who loved to play. Every day it flew to the same door and twittered happily. The door was always shut, but the bird was confident that it would soon unlock.

One day something remarkable happened. As the bird approached the door, it began to unlock. The bird was so excited it flapped its wings and sang.

It flew inside and saw a box in the middle of the room. The bird was curious and wanted to get closer. Suddenly, the box began to shake and a small key popped out. It was the key to unlock the box!

The bird was overjoyed and quickly grabbed the key. It unlocked the box and inside it found a wonderful surprise.

However, the bird was upset when it saw how the surprise was being used. Inside the box were cages filled with other birds, all trapped. The bird desperately wanted to free them, but it couldn't find the key to unlock the cages. 

The bird was determined to do whatever it could to save its friends. It flew off to find the key that would help unlock their cages.

Once upon a time, a group of mighty friends lived near the sea.
Each one of them was strong and brave, even though they looked different. They often played together, and were as close as could be.

But one day, a storm hit their town, and it was so powerful that it split them apart. The friends were blown away in different directions! They were so scared and sad, and felt very alone.

But then something beautiful happened - the power of their friendship came together and the group was reunited! It was mighty, and it was strong.

The friends hugged and cheered, and decided to never be apart again. They promised to be loyal and kind, and to never forget the power of their united friendship.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived on a farm with her mommy and daddy. The farm was very big and had many animals like cows, pigs, and chickens. Lily loved to play with the animals and help her parents on the farm.

One day, Lily's daddy told her they were going to climb a high mountain. Lily was scared because she had never climbed a mountain before. But her daddy encouraged her, saying, "You can do it, Lily! I'll be right here with you."

So, Lily and her daddy started to climb the mountain. It was hard, but they kept going higher and higher. When they reached the top, they could see the whole farm from up there. Lily was so happy and proud of herself for climbing so high.

As they were coming down the mountain, Lily said to her daddy, "Thank you for encouraging me to climb the mountain. I feel brave now!" Her daddy smiled and said, "You are brave, Lily. And you can do anything you set your mind to."

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with toys and read books. They also liked to pretend they were pirates on a big ship. They had a flag with a skull and a hat with a feather.

One day, they found a shiny ring in the sand. It was gold and had a red stone. Lily put it on her finger and said, "Look, Ben, I have a treasure!"

Ben smiled and said, "You are very pretty, Lily. Do you want to marry me?"

Lily was shy and blushed. She liked Ben, but she did not know what marry meant. She asked, "What is marry?"

Ben said, "Marry is when you love someone and you want to be with them always. You share your toys and your books and your ship. You also give them a kiss."

Lily thought for a moment. She loved Ben and she wanted to be with him always. She liked to share her toys and her books and her ship. She also wanted to give him a kiss. She said, "Yes, Ben, I want to marry you."

They hugged and kissed. They were very happy. They put the ring in a box and buried it in the sand. They said, "This is our secret treasure. We will come back when we are big and dig it up."

They held hands and ran to their ship. They sailed away, singing and laughing. They were the best pirates ever.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She was very independent. Every day she liked to play by herself. She would run, skip and make up games.

One day she was outside playing and she noticed something. Looking up, she saw a big bird in the sky. It was hopping in the air and its wings were spread wide.

The girl watched it for a long time. Then suddenly the bird started to rise. It went higher and higher. The girl was amazed. She watched until the bird was just a speck in the sky.

The girl was happy and excited. She felt like she could do anything. She raised her arms as if trying to rise like the bird. With a big smile she ran off to play. From that day on she was more independent than ever before.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to wear his cozy bathrobe after taking a bath. One day, he put on his bathrobe and went to the kitchen to get some milk. But when he got there, he saw his cat staring at him with its big eyes. 

Timmy thought it was crazy that the cat was staring at him like that. He tried to shoo the cat away, but it wouldn't budge. So, Timmy just stared back at the cat until it finally walked away. From that day on, Timmy made sure to always wear his bathrobe when he went to get milk, just in case the crazy cat was there again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a pet cat named Mittens. One day, Timmy and Mittens went for a walk in the park. They saw a big tree with a patch of flowers underneath it. Timmy picked a flower and gave it to Mittens to smell. Mittens liked the flower, but Timmy accidentally touched a sharp thorn on the stem and it hurt his finger. He said "ouch!" and Mittens licked his finger to make it feel better.

After a while, Timmy and Mittens got thirsty, so they went to a lemonade stand. The lemonade was too sour for Timmy, but Mittens liked it. They sat down on a bench and watched the people walking by. Suddenly, Timmy saw a little girl crying because she had lost her doll. Timmy and Mittens went to help her look for it. They searched and searched until they found the doll in a patch of grass. The little girl was very happy and thanked Timmy and Mittens. They all became friends and played together in the park. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a silly boy who loved to store things. Every time he found something, he kept it in his pockets. One day, he found a really interesting thing. It was big and round and felt like victory. He thought it was really fun and decided to store it in his pocket.

The silly boy took it everywhere he went. He showed it to all his friends and they had lots of fun. He was so proud of what he was storing.

One day, he went to the park and hid his special victory. He played hide and seek with his friends, but when it was time to find his treasure, he couldn't find it. Everyone searched and searched, but they still couldn't find it.

The boy was disappointed and couldn't believe he had lost his victory. His friends tried to make him feel better, but he was still sad. 

Then, from the bushes, the boy heard something. When he looked, there was his victory, just waiting for him! He was so happy, and he knew that he would always store it safely. The friends laughed and congratulated him on his victory.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Mike and Lola who both wanted to own a raft. They decided to build one together.

First, they went to the store to buy supplies. Then, Mike and Lola got to work building their raft. They were very careful and worked hard.

When the raft was finally finished, Mike and Lola were so excited! They pushed it down to the lake and hopped on. They laughed and waved to their friends as they floated away.

The friends had a lazy day on the lake. They made up stories, played games, and even ate lunch right on the raft! It was the perfect day.

At the end of the day, Mike and Lola were so proud of their raft and all the fun they had. Owning a raft was even better than they ever imagined!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved playing hockey. He would go to the park every day to play with his friends. One day, Timmy's friend Billy fell down and hurt his leg. Timmy said, "Billy, are you okay?" Billy said, "No, my leg hurts so much. I can't seat." Timmy said, "Don't worry, I'll help you." Timmy helped Billy to seat down on the bench. Billy said, "Thank you, Timmy. You're a good friend." Timmy said, "No problem, I don't want you to be dead."

One day, a little yellow duck walked into the kitchen of a house, looking for something to do. He saw a faucet and thought it looked like a lot of fun. The duck flapped his wings and flew up to the faucet. He grabbed the handle in his beak and started flapping them back and forth.

The little duck was having so much fun that he didn't notice the lady of the house coming in. She saw what the duck was doing and said, "Young duck, you must behave!" The duck just looked at her curiously and didn't listen.

The lady then tried to be a bit more strict. She said, "I said, behave! Or else I will have to find something else to do with you!" The duck finally understood and stopped flapping the faucets. He then ran away into the garden, looking for something a little less troublesome to do.

The little yellow duck was now a bit more mindful about how he behaved in the house. He remembered what the lady said and would always be extra careful whenever he was in the house.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She wanted to go on an adventure, but she was a bit frightened. She thought for a moment, and then she made a choice.

She chose to go for a walk in the rain. She put on her raincoat, and her rain boots, and ran outside. It was wet, but she was too excited to care. Splish, splash, she hopped through the puddles.

But soon it got too dark and she started to feel scared. She wanted to go home. But on her way she saw a bright, twinkling light. It was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen!

She reached out, and carefully chose to pick up the light. It turned out to be a beautiful sparkly star! The girl was so happy. She ran back home, holding her sparkly star safely in her hand.

Once upon a time there was a brave girl. She went for a walk in the woods and spotted a lion. The lion looked big and scary, but the brave girl was not afraid. She wanted to see if the lion was friendly, so she called out to him. The lion said hello and asked her to come closer. The brave girl was a bit scared, but she wanted to be brave. She stepped closer to the lion. The lion asked if she wanted to play. The brave girl was excited and smiled. She said yes. The lion and the brave girl played together. They had fun chasing each other and playing tag.

Suddenly, a hunter arrived. He shouted at the lion and the brave girl and told them to leave. The brave girl looked to the lion for help. The lion growled and stood his ground, refusing to go. He was trying to protect his new friend. The hunter shouted more and tried to scaring the lion away, but the lion resisted. The brave girl was so proud. Eventually, the hunter left and the lion and girl watched him go. The brave girl was so relieved. She thank the lion for being so brave and for protecting her. The lion smiled and the two went back to playing. The brave girl was reminded of how dangerous the world can be, but also how powerful friendship can be when you resist.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the store with her mommy. They were looking for some lemons to make lemonade. They found some lemons, but they were very expensive.

Lily said, "Mommy, why are the lemons so expensive?"

Her mommy said, "I don't know, Lily. Sometimes things happen and they become more expensive."

Lily was sad because she really wanted to make lemonade. But then, a nice lady overheard their conversation and said, "I have some lemons at home that I don't need. You can have them for free!"

Lily was so happy and said, "Thank you, nice lady! This is the best thing that ever happened!"

Mum and Dad took Flora to the park. Flora danced in the sun and splashed in the water. She was so excited to play.

Mum and Dad took out a picnic blanket and set up some popcorn. "Let's spray the popcorn with mild flavoring," said Dad. Flora watched as Mum and Dad sprayed the popcorn. She couldn't wait to try one!

"Yum!" said Flora, after trying one of the popcorn. They were the most delicious she had ever eaten. "Can I have some more?" she asked.

Mum and Dad laughed, and sprayed some more popcorn with mild flavoring. Flora kept eating until all the popcorn was gone.

It had been a lovely day at the park, with delicious mild popcorn to eat. Flora couldn't wait to come back and play again with Mum and Dad.

Once upon a time, there was a man who lived beside the sea. Every day, he went to the beach and watched the original waves roll in. 

One day, the man noticed a strange thing. He saw a turtle start to escape from the sea. The man went closer and saw that the turtle had a small wagon on its back. 

The man asked the turtle, "Where are you going?" 

The turtle replied, "I am escaping from the sea. I want to explore other places, but I can't do it without my wagon."

The man thought it was a nice idea. "If you leave, I will miss you," he said. But he also thought it was brave of the turtle to go on an adventure.

The next day, the man said goodbye to the turtle. Then, the turtle went on its way. The man waved goodbye and watched the turtle make its escape. 

From that day on, the man thought of the turtle fondly. He remembered the original explorer who taught him the rewards of taking risks.

One day, a little girl named Mia went for a walk in the park. Mia saw a big, wet puddle on the ground. She jumped in it and splashed water everywhere. Her shoes and clothes got very wet, but she was happy and laughed.

Then, Mia saw many shapes on the ground. There was a circle, a square, and a triangle. She wanted to show her mom the shapes, so she yelled, "Mom, look at the shapes!" Her mom came over and looked at the shapes with her.

Mia and her mom played with the shapes. They made a big circle with wet leaves, a square with sticks, and a triangle with rocks. They had so much fun playing with the shapes in the park. At the end of the day, they went home with big smiles on their faces.

One day, a little boy named Tim was very excited. He wanted to play with his ball. He went to the park with his mom. At the park, Tim saw his friend, Sam.

Tim and Sam played with the ball. They kicked it to each other. They laughed and had fun. Tim kicked the ball high in the sky. Sam tried to catch it but missed. They ran after the ball together.

As they played, Tim and Sam got tired. They took a break to rest their lungs. They sat on the grass and drank water. After resting, they were ready to play again. They kicked the ball until the sun went down. It was a fun day at the park.

Once there was a boy named Jim. He was only 3 years old and he loved to eat yogurt. He always asked his mom to give him some yogurt to eat. Today, however, his mom did not give him any. "Why won't you give me any yogurt?" he asked his mom.

His mom said, "I'm sorry, Jim. I don't have any yogurt right now. It's all gone." Jim was so sad. He did not understand why there was no yogurt anymore.

Suddenly, he smelled something terrible. He ran to the kitchen to look and he saw that the yogurt was all spilled on the floor. It had gone bad and was now stinky. Jim was very sad and angry. 

"Who spilled the yogurt?" he yelled. His mom shook her head and said, "I'm sorry, Jim. I guess it was just a terrible accident." 

Jim was still very sad, but at least he knew what happened. His mom gave him a big hug and said, "Don't worry, Jim. You can come with me to the store and we can buy some more yogurt." That made Jim happy again and he smiled.

One day, a little kangaroo named Roo was playing in the big green park. Roo loved to jump high and run fast. He was having so much fun that he did not see a small girl named Lily.

"Watch out!" Lily yelled. But it was too late. Roo bumped into Lily and they both fell down. Lily started to cry, and Roo felt very sorry.

"I am so sorry, Lily," said Roo. "I did not mean to bump into you. Can we be friends?"

Lily stopped crying and looked at Roo. She said, "Yes, we can be friends. But you have to be more careful when you play."

Roo promised to be more careful, and they both played together in the big green park. They had so much fun, and from that day on, they were the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. His name was Timmy and he was 3 years old. He had a great big smile on his face. He was very enthusiastic about life.

One day Timmy was in his house when he heard a sound from outside. He ran to the window to take a look. He saw a big yellow vehicle pulling up.

Timmy asked his mom what it was. She replied, "It's the ice cream truck. It serves ice cream to everyone."

Timmy was so excited he couldn't wait to get outside. He ran out the door and to the ice cream truck.

When he got there he saw that the truck was full of different kinds of ice creams. Timmy picked one and asked the driver for it.

The driver said, "Sure, that one is for you. Enjoy!"

Timmy was very happy. He ran back to his house with his ice cream to show his mom. From then on, every time the ice cream truck arrived to his town, Timmy was always the first one to get some.

Tommy was playing in the sand. He forgot his bucket. He wanted to make a sandcastle but he didn't have a bucket. He felt sad.

Then, he saw a pretty blue egg in the sand. He picked it up and smiled. He quickly ran home with the egg so he could show his mom.

When Tommy got inside, he found his mom. She was feeling jealous because his dad had bought a new toy for his sister.

Tommy showed his mom the egg and said "Look Mommy! I found a special egg!". His mom smiled and hugged him. She suddenly felt better. Tommy was happy that he could make his mom feel better.

They put the egg in a bowl on the kitchen table. Tommy and his mom looked at the egg and smiled together. Tommy was glad that he didn't forget his egg.

Jane was embarrassed. She had been waiting outside Mommy's bedroom door all morning. She wanted to go in and play but Mommy said, "No, not yet." So Jane waited and waited and waited.

Finally Mommy opened the bedroom door and said, "Ok Jane, you may enter." Jane smiled and stepped into Mommy's bedroom. She had never been in there before.

When Jane was in the kitchen, she turned to Mommy and asked, "Can I have a snack?" Mommy smiled and said, "Yes, I will permit you to have a snack."

Jane was excited and ran to the kitchen to get her snack. She poured herself a glass of juice and took out some cookies. She was about to have a yummy snack!

When Jane finished her snack, she thanked Mommy and said, "Thank you for permitting me to have a snack in the kitchen!" Mommy smiled and said, "You're welcome!"

Jane was so happy and relieved she wasn't embarrassed anymore. She had finally been allowed in the kitchen!

One day, Tom and his mum went to the park. Tom saw a tall tree. He wanted to climb it and his mum said he could.

Tom said, 'Yay! I'm climbing the tree!' He started to climb and he quickly reached the top.

While he was up there, he saw a whistle on the branch. He wanted to pick it up, so he did. It was a shiny green whistle and it made a loud noise when he blew it.

He blew it again and a man came over. He said, 'Hello Tom! That's a lovely open whistle! Would you like to keep it?'

Tom held the whistle in his hand and said, 'Yes please!' He was so excited to have his own whistle. 

Tom and his mum thanked the man and went home. From that day on, Tom would take his whistle with him everywhere he went and play it at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a bird named Joe. Joe liked to dance and sing, but he also liked to be quiet.

One day, Joe was sitting in his nest, when he heard a loud noise from inside the house. Joe looked over and he saw that a nice big oven was making the loud noise. He was so excited, he started to do a happy dance and sing. 

The people inside the house heard Joe singing and they came outside to see who it was. When they saw Joe, they all laughed and cheered.

Joe was so happy that he flew down to the people and started to sing and dance even louder. 

The people were so impressed they started to applaud Joe. Joe was so excited that he started to jump up and down and sing even louder! 

The people were so excited that they decided to give Joe a treat. They opened the oven and gave him some warm bread. Joe was so happy he chirped and sang even louder than before, while eating the bread.

The people were so happy at Joe's performance, they all applauded him once again. Joe was so happy he started to do a happy dance, and sang his loudest song yet! 

The people clapped and cheered for Joe, and after that Joe was always welcomed back to show off his amazing singing and dancing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. Her aunt always looked after her while her mom and dad were away. One day, Lucy was bored, so she decided that she wanted to go to the store. 

"Please, Auntie," Lucy begged. "Can I go to the store?"

But her aunt said no. She said that Lucy needed to stay at home and behave. Lucy was sad, but she knew that she had to do what her aunt said. 

Later that day, Lucy's parents came home and she was so excited. She ran into the living room and shouted a loud "hello!" She was so happy to see them again. Her aunt scowled at her and told her that she needed to be quieter. 

But Lucy ignored her aunt and jumped up and down with joy. She wanted to show her parents how much she had missed them. As her aunt continued to scold her, Lucy ran up to her parents and hugged them tight. 

Suddenly, her aunt's face turned bright red with anger. She said Lucy was being naughty and told her to go to her room. Lucy was embarrassed and upset. Her parents told her to listen to her aunt. So, with tears in her eyes, Lucy slowly walked to her room. 

The ending was very unhappy. Lucy had to stay in her room, feeling embarrassed and sad that she had not behaved like her

Once upon a time there was a furry bear who loved to sing. Every day the bear would walk around the forest looking for something to eat. One day he found a pear tree and the pears looked so yummy. So the bear reached up and grabbed a pear and started to sing.

The bear sang and sang, louder and louder. Some of the other animals in the forest heard him and came to him to sing along. Soon, the whole forest was filled with singing. Even the birds in the trees chirped along.

When they were done singing, the bear thanked the other animals. He said, "Thank you for singing with me. You make the forest a much happier place." The other animals agreed and gave the bear a big hug.

The bear was so happy that he decided to make the pear tree his special home. He knew that so long as he had pears to eat and friends to sing with, he would never be lonely or sad. From then on, the furry bear made sure to sing with his friends every day.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jane. Jane loved numbers. She counted the clouds in the sky and the stars in the night. One day, Jane's dad gave her a special present. It was a shiny steel box.

Jane opened the box and inside was a magical surprise! It was a crystal ball. Jane was so happy and wanted to explore the magical world inside. But one important rule would not let her do that. Her dad said, "Be very obedient and only look at the ball when I say."

So Jane put the ball back in the shiny steel box and obeyed. Every day, Jane would carefully take out the steel box and count the numbers inside the crystal ball. Jane became very obedient in counting numbers and soon was a master.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a dead dog. He was very wet and all alone. The dead dog wanted somebody to be with him.

So he started walking. He wanted to find someone that he could be with. He walked for a very long time but he couldn't find anyone.

The dead dog was getting very tired. He wanted to find someone to be with. He knew he couldn't keep walking forever.

Suddenly, he saw somebody. It was a little girl. The dog wanted to be friends with her. He was so excited! He ran to her and barked.

The little girl was so happy. She gave the dog a big hug and they became friends. They stayed together until the sun went down. The dead dog was no longer alone.

Lilly was feeling quite bored one day. She had no idea what to do and all of her toys seemed quite boring. But then, Lilly suddenly heard a noise outside her window. She walked closer and noticed a beautiful bird perched on the windowsill.

The bird said "Hi Lilly. I can show you something really fun". Lilly was very excited and asked the bird what it was.

The bird replied "It's the perfect snack that you have been looking for. I can lead you to it, if you follow me". 

So, Lilly followed the bird and they soon arrived in a big, open field. Suddenly, a tree appeared in the middle of the field. Lilly was so excited and ran to the tree. When she reached it, she noticed something on a branch. It was a big basket filled with apples, cherries and other tasty snacks.

Lilly was so excited and couldn't believe her luck. She thanked the bird and enjoyed the perfect snack. Now she knows where to go when she is bored again.

Lily and Ben were playing near the sea. They liked to look at the big waves and the birds. They saw a cliff that was very high and had many rocks. Lily wanted to climb the cliff and see what was on top. Ben was scared and said no.

"Please, Ben, come with me. It will be fun. Maybe we will find something original, like a treasure or a dinosaur," Lily said.

"No, Lily, it is too dangerous. The cliff is too high and too steep. We might fall and hurt ourselves. And what if the waves come and wash us away? We should stay here and play with the sand and the shells," Ben said.

Lily was not happy. She wanted to have an adventure. She did not listen to Ben. She ran to the cliff and started to climb. Ben shouted at her to stop, but she did not reply. She kept climbing higher and higher.

Ben was very worried. He did not want to lose his friend. He ran to the cliff and tried to follow her. He was not good at climbing. He slipped and scraped his knee. He cried out in pain. Lily heard him and looked down. She saw Ben bleeding and crying. She felt sorry for him. She realized she had been silly and selfish. She climbed down as fast as she could. She hugged Ben and said sorry.

"It's okay, Lily. I'm glad you are safe. But please don't do that again. It was too scary. Let's go back to our parents and get a band-aid for my knee. And maybe some ice cream," Ben said.

Lily agreed. She learned her lesson. She decided to play with Ben and not go near the cliff again. They walked back to their parents, holding hands. They were still friends.

Once upon a time, in a thick forest, there lived a squirrel named Sam. Sam loved to find acorns and play with his friends. One day, Sam found a big acorn under a tree. He was very happy and wanted to show it to his friend, Bunny.

Sam went to Bunny's home and said, "Bunny, look at my big acorn! Let's play with it." Bunny looked at the acorn and said, "Wow, that's a nice acorn! But first, let's pay the tree a 'thank you' for giving us the acorn." So, Sam and Bunny went to the tree and said, "Thank you, tree!"

Sam and Bunny played with the acorn all day. They rolled it, threw it, and even pretended it was a ball. They had so much fun and were very tired. At the end of the day, they put the acorn back under the tree and said, "Thank you, tree, for letting us play with your acorn."

The next day, Sam and Bunny went to find more acorns in the thick forest. They found many acorns and shared them with their friends. And every time they found an acorn, they remembered to pay the tree a 'thank you.'

From that day on, Sam, Bunny, and their friends always said 'thank you' to the trees for giving them acorns to play with. The trees were happy, and the forest was filled with laughter and fun.

Once there was a university. It had lots of buildings and a big playground. One day, a 3 year old girl went to play on the playground. She saw a rope and started to pull it. When she pulled it, a door opened. She was very surprised!

The little girl went inside and saw lots of books and computers. She looked around and wanted to explore, so she started to walk around the university. But then, a security guard saw her and said that she had to leave. He said it was not safe for children.

The girl felt guilty. She knew she wasn't supposed to be there. She ran away as quickly as she could. She never went back to the university again, but she never forgot the surprise of finding it when she pulled the rope!

Once upon a time, there was a baby. The baby had a toy. The toy was expensive. The baby loved the toy very much.

One day, the baby played with the toy. The baby slapped the toy. The toy made a funny noise. The baby laughed and said, "Toy, you are funny!"

The baby played with the toy all day. The baby was happy. The toy was happy too. They were best friends forever.

Once upon a time there was a radish called Fred. Fred was very curious and wanted to grow. So every day he asked everyone he could find, "How do I grow?"

One day he asked a bee, "Can you help me grow?"
"Sure!" replied the bee. "You need sunlight and water to grow. So go find some!"

Fred was so excited. He hopped through the garden looking for some sunlight and water. He climbed up a tree and got to the top. It was warm and sunny up there. Then he looked for some water and found a stream nearby.

The next morning, he was the happiest radish ever. His green leaves began to spread and he started to grow bigger and bigger.

Soon Fred was so big, it was crazy! He was so excited, he ran through the garden telling everyone he could find, "I grew! I grew!" 

And he lived happily ever after, growing bigger and bigger every day.

The little boy was so spoiled. Everywhere he went, he got special things. He had a napkin in his hand and he looked at it with a smile.

The boy went outside and saw a friendly dog. He smiled and waved at the dog with the napkin. The dog wagged its tail and barked. The little boy's face lit up with joy.

The little boy then saw a friendly cat. He shook the napkin at the cat, and it ran away. The little boy laughed and waved the napkin after the cat.

The little boy had a great time playing with the dog and wave the napkin. When it was time for a nap, he put the napkin in his pocket and wished his furry friends goodbye. "Bye! See you later!" He said.

One day, Peter was playing outside. He saw something very curious - a big yellow station. He wanted to examine it. He went up to the station and looked at it carefully. It had two doors, a sign, and lots of buttons. He pressed the buttons on the station and heard clicking noises. He listened carefully, and then he heard a train whistle in the distance. Curiously, he looked around and saw a yellow train entering the station. He watched the train until it stopped in the station, and then he ran up to the train to examine it. He looked at every part of the train and smiled at it. The train sounded its horn, and Peter had to go home.

Lily was very happy today. She was going to do a great class with her friends. The class was about animals. Lily loved animals. She had a dog at home. His name was Spot.

She put on her pink dress and her shoes. She took her backpack and her lunch box. She said bye to her mom and dad. They gave her a hug and a kiss. They said, "Have fun, Lily. Learn a lot. We are proud of you."

Lily got on the bus with her friends. They sang songs and played games. They were very excited. They saw the teacher waiting for them at the zoo. The teacher smiled and said, "Hello, children. Welcome to the animal class. Today we are going to see and learn about many different animals. Are you ready?"

The children said, "Yes, teacher. We are ready." They followed the teacher to the first cage. They saw a big lion. He had a mane and sharp teeth. He roared loudly. The children were scared. They hid behind the teacher. The teacher said, "Don't worry, children. The lion can't hurt you. He is behind the bars. He is just saying hello. Can you say hello to the lion?"

Lily was brave. She stepped forward and said, "Hello, lion. You are very big and strong. But I am not afraid of you. I have a dog at home. He is my friend. He barks and wags his tail. Do you have a friend, lion?" The lion looked at Lily and blinked. He stopped roaring. He licked his paw and rubbed his head. He seemed to like Lily. He nodded and said, "Yes, I have a friend. She is a lioness. She is in the next cage. She is very beautiful and smart. She hunts and plays with me. We are happy together." Lily smiled and said, "That's great, lion. I'm happy for you. Can I see your friend?" The lion said, "Of course. Come with me. I'll show you." He walked to the next cage and called his friend. The lioness came and greeted Lily and the other children. They were amazed and curious. They asked the lion and the lioness many questions. They learned a lot about them. They thanked them and said goodbye. They went to see the other animals. They had a great time. They did a great class. Lily was very happy. She made a new friend. She couldn't wait to tell her mom and dad. She thought, "This is the best day ever."

Jade and her mom were walking near the beach. The beach was filled with beautiful things, like little boats and pretty shells. Suddenly, Jade's mom started to get worried. She shouted, "Where is the dog? He disappeared!"

Jade was scared. She asked, "Mommy, did the dog go away?" Her mom said, "He is probably running around the beach. Let's go look for him."

They searched around the beach, but they couldn't find the dog. Then, Jade saw something moving near the sand. It was the dog! He had been hiding behind a tree the whole time. "Come here!" shouted Jade, and the dog ran to her and cuddled in her arms. Jade was happy.

Jade's mom said, "We were so scared, but now we found the dog. Let's go home now." As they started walking, Jade looked back towards the beach. She said goodbye to the beach and waved to it. Then, they started walking back home.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved exploring the world. Jack's mom gave him a gift one day â€“ it was a small magnet.

Jack stared excitedly at the magnet. He wanted to explore it and see what it could do. He showed the magnet to his mom, who smiled and said â€œgo ahead! See what you can find!â€

Jack excitedly began walking around with his magnet. Everywhere he went, he saw things stick to it. He was amazed! Even the leaves on the ground stuck to the side of the magnet.

Finally, Jack came across an old kitchen with a refrigerator. He looked around and smiled â€“ he knew the magnet could open it. Sure enough, the door opened when the magnet came close.

Jack looked inside and spied a cookie. He was about to take it when suddenly a loud voice shouted â€œNo Jack! Those are not yours!â€ 

Jack quickly put the cookie back and ran towards his mom, his heart beating. 

His mom looked at him, disappointed but proud of his obedience. â€œIt's okay dear,â€ she said, â€œbut you should never take things that aren't yours.â€ 

Jack nodded, gave his mom a hug, and said, â€œYes! I am an obedient boy!â€

Once upon a time, there was a long pig. Every day it would display its grand beauty. It would show off its curly long tail and trot around the meadow. The other animals were always amazed at its beauty.

One day, the pig found a muddy pond. It decided to take a dip in the mud and play. It rolled around and around, making silly noises and splashing the mud everywhere.

The pig was so excited that it started to display a funny dance. It jumped around, kicking its feet in the air and singing its own funny song. The other animals watched in amazement and laughed.

Finally, the pig had to leave the pond and go back to its home. But the animals had enjoyed watching it display its antics, and it was soon invited back for another performance. The long pig always enjoyed showing off for its friends!

Tommy and Mommy set off for a jog in the park. Tommy was excited to explore the park with Mommy. As they walked, Tommy saw a yellow guard sitting on the bench.

"Mommy, who is that?" asked Tommy, pointing to the yellow guard. 

Mommy smiled and said, "That's the park guard! He watches over the park to make sure everyone is safe while they jog." 

Tommy felt safe and he was excited to jog around the park. Together, Tommy and Mommy started jogging around the park. 

The yellow guard watched over them as they jogged. Every once in a while, he would wave and smile at Tommy. 

Tommy and Mommy kept jogging until it was time to go home. 

As they said goodbye to the yellow guard, Tommy waved and said, "Bye! See you soon!" 

The yellow guard waved back and said, "Goodbye. Have fun jogging!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun and pick flowers. One day, she saw her mommy and daddy drinking some red wine. 

"Can I have some?" asked Lily.

"No, it's only for grown-ups," said her mommy.

Lily felt sad and ashamed that she couldn't have any wine. She decided to go outside and play by herself. 

As she was playing, she saw a big blanket and decided to cover herself with it. Suddenly, she couldn't breathe and started to feel very sick. 

Her mommy and daddy found her too late. They were very sad and cried a lot. Lily had accidentally covered herself with the blanket and couldn't get any air. It was a very bad ending to a beautiful day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was walking in the park. He skipped and smiled as he passed the day. 

Suddenly, he saw something that made him stop. It was a sour apple, sitting on the ground by an old tree. He stared at it, wondering if it would taste good. 

So he picked up the apple and popped it into his mouth. But, it was so sour! He quickly spat it out and laughed. 

He continued on his walk and soon he came to a lake. He ran down to the shore and started jumping around and shouting. Suddenly, he saw a little fish jump out of the lake.

He watched it swim around until it passed out of sight. The little boy laughed as he waved goodbye and then continued on his way. 

He continued to pass the day with joy and laughter until the sun went down. 

The end!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. It was his birthday and he was very excited. His mommy baked him a cake and he blew out the candles. 

Suddenly, Timmy's friend Billy came over. Billy was worried because he forgot to bring Timmy a present. Timmy told Billy not to worry and that his presence was enough of a gift. 

After they ate some cake, Timmy's mommy washed the dishes. She told Timmy and Billy to dry them with a towel. Timmy and Billy had fun drying the dishes together and they laughed and giggled. 

Timmy had a great birthday with his friend Billy and he couldn't wait until next year to celebrate again.

One day, a boy named Jack went to the store. He wanted to buy some candy. But he had no money.

Jack's mom told him that he needed money to buy things at the store. She gave him some money and said that he could use it to buy candy.

Jack was very excited! He went to the store to buy the candy. He chose a lollipop. He asked the storekeeper how much money he needed.

The storekeeper told him how much money was available. It was exactly the right amount of money!

Jack was very happy. He paid for the lollipop and went home. He enjoyed his treat and told his mom all about his adventure at the store.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted a friend. She looked everywhere, but couldn't find one. One night, when she was sitting on the grass, something wild happened.

A tiny bird flew down from the sky and landed beside her. The little girl was so excited that she almost hopped up and down.

"Hello!" the little girl said. She smiled and asked the bird if it wanted to be her friend. The bird twittered and nodded its head.

The little girl and the bird had so much fun together. They laughed and sang and chased each other around. They were best friends.

The little girl was so happy that she had found a wild friend. Every day, she and the bird played together in the sunshine.

The little girl and the bird were the best of friends and they were never apart. They would always be friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily went outside to play and she saw a butterfly. She wanted to catch it, but it was too fast.

Lily began to struggle to catch the butterfly, but it kept flying away. She didn't want to give up, so she kept trying. Suddenly, she saw that the butterfly flew towards her home. She ran inside and saw that her mommy had left the door open.

Lily was scared because her mommy always told her to be careful and not leave the door open. She realized that her mommy was careless and didn't remember to close it. So, she closed the door and felt safe again.

Once upon a time, there was an orange bird named Pat. Pat was sad because he didn't have a friend to play with.

One day Pat saw a mirror in the park. He decided to talk with the mirror and ask for help.
Pat said, "Please, mirror! May I have a friend? Please permit me to have a friend!'

The mirror said, "I can't give you a friend, but I can show you a picture of a friend."

Pat was happy and said, "That would be nice, mirror! Please permit me to see the picture!"

The mirror said, "Look into my shiny surface and you will see a picture of your friend."

Pat looked into the mirror and saw the orange face of a new friend. Pat was so happy and said, "Thank you, mirror!"

The mirror said, "You're welcome, Pat! Now go have fun!"

And Pat did have fun with his new friend! They played in the park for hours and then Pat flew off to find even more friends. From that day forth, Pat always remembered to thank the mirror for showing him the picture of his orange friend.

One day, a curious little boy named Tim went to school. In his bag, he had a big, red pencil. He was very happy with his pencil and couldn't wait to use it. He knew it was a special pencil.

At school, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue did not have a pencil. She looked sad. Tim thought about his big, red pencil and had an idea. He said, "Sue, let's share my pencil. We can both use it, and we can both be happy!"

Sue smiled and said, "Thank you, Tim! You are very kind." They both used the big, red pencil to draw and write. They became very good friends. Tim was happy that he shared his pencil with Sue.

The other kids in school saw Tim and Sue sharing the pencil. They thought it was a good idea. They started to share their things too. The teacher was very proud of Tim and Sue.

The moral of the story is that sharing makes everyone happy. When we share, we make friends and show kindness to others.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy asked her if she wanted to help make dinner. Lily was excited and said yes! They made spaghetti for dinner. Lily's job was to bring the noodles to the pot. She felt proud to help her mommy. 

Later that night, Lily couldn't sleep because she heard a noise outside her window. She felt scared and helpless. She called for her mommy to come and help her. Her mommy came quickly and held her tight. She told Lily that everything was okay and she was safe. Lily felt better and fell asleep. 

The next day, Lily brought her mommy a pretty flower she found outside. Her mommy smiled and gave her a big hug. Lily felt happy to make her mommy smile.

Alice was having a great day. She went to the playground and played a game with her friends. She was so excited and happy. 

When Alice went home, she wanted a special dessert. Her mom said she could choose between ice cream and chocolate cake. Alice thought they both sounded delicious and she couldn't decide. 

Alice's dad was very helpful. He asked her if she wanted to play a game. He said if she guessed which one he was thinking about, she could have it for dessert. Alice guessed ice cream. Her dad smiled and said she was right! 

Alice was so excited to eat her ice cream. But then, before she could dive into it, she had to quit. It was time for bed. Alice was very disappointed but her dad said she could have her dessert tomorrow. 

Alice was happy that her dad was so helpful and she was looking forward to eating her ice cream the next day.

Jack was walking through the hallway. He saw an enormous mess! Everywhere he looked there was something spilled on the floor. Jack knew he couldn't leave the mess there, he needed to clean it.

He went to the closet and grabbed a mop. The mop was too big for Jack but he needed it to clean the mess. He tried to lift it but it was so heavy he couldn't carry it.

Then his big brother came by and saw the mess. He said he would help and grabbed the enormous mop. He started to mop the floor and it didn't take long before the hallway was clean! Both Jack and his brother were very happy.

John was a little boy who lived on a farm. Every morning he went outside and saw the pretty flowers. He loved picking the petals off and watching them flutter in the wind. 
One day, John saw something very special. In the field beyond the flowers was a huge tree with lots of colourful feathers next to it. He was so excited! He couldn't wait for the morning to come so he could go back. 
When the morning arrived, John ran to the tree as fast as he could. He was so excited when he saw the feathers lying on the grass. He bent down and carefully picked up a big red one. He held it tight and waited for the big surprise. 
Suddenly, the sky started to darken and the wind became strong. A big storm was coming! John looked at the sky and tears ran down his cheeks. He hadn't expected this and he felt so sad. 
Just as he was about to despair, John heard a sound coming from the tree. He looked up and noticed that a big beautiful parrot had made its nest in the branches. He watched in awe as the parrot flapped its wings and, with a loud squawk, flew off into the grey sky. 
John suddenly realised why the feathers were lying on the ground - the parrot had been so busy getting ready for the storm that it had forgotten to take them! John smiled and was soon picking them up one by one,

Once, there was a fat cat. His name was Sam. He had three big paws and a big, long tail.

Sam loved to play with his paint. All day long he would paint beautiful pictures on his own paper. He was very proud of his artwork and would often show it off to the other animals.

One day, a rabbit hopped over to Sam's house. He spoke to Sam, "Wow, your paint is so pretty! What do you do with it?"

Sam smiled and answered, "I make special pictures. I own the paint and I can do whatever I like with it."

The rabbit was amazed. He thanked Sam and hopped away. 

Sam was so happy that he could share his own beautiful artwork with the other animals. He knew that he would paint many more pictures in the future!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Tracy. She loved strawberries and wanted to eat lots of them. But when she went to get some strawberries, she realized all the strawberries were wet!

Tracy was mad, but then she had an idea. She went to the store and looked for something to replace the wet strawberries. She found some orange gummy bears, so she got them.

When Tracy went outside to eat her gummy bears, she ran into her neighbor, Jack.

Jack asked, "What do you have?"

Tracy answered, "I have gummy bears! I couldn't find any dry strawberries."

Jack said, "Well, why don't we go to the store together and get dry strawberries? That way you can eat the strawberries and I can have the gummy bears."

So, Jack and Tracy went together to get dry strawberries. When they got back to Tracy's house, they ate their treats! Tracy enjoyed her dry strawberries and Jack liked his gummy bears. They both had a great snack and a great time!

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She wanted something very special. She wanted a new couch. Her mom said the couch had to be good.

Lucy went to the store and looked at all the couches. She saw red ones and brown ones, big ones and small ones. Then she saw the perfect one.

It was a big, green couch. It looked so comfy and Lucy knew it was good. She wanted it so badly.

So she asked her mom to buy it. Her mom said yes and they took it home. Lucy was so excited!

Now she can curl up on her new couch and it's so good that she likes it a lot.

Jenna was riding her bike around the playground. She saw a big, tall structure in the middle of the field and wanted to try it. She rode her bike up to it and saw that it was an old football goal. She asked her dad if she could try it. Her dad looked around and said, "Yes, we can give it a go".

Jenna was excited and quickly got off her bike and started running towards the structure. She saw there were two posts and a net. Jenna quickly got to the back of the structure and started kicking the ball.

The ball was hard and bitter and she knew at once it must have been cold and wet in the night. She kept kicking and soon enough the ball was flying between the posts and into the net. Jenna grinned, the feeling was amazing! She continued for a few more minutes before she got tired. She was still smiling when she said goodbye to the structure and walked back towards her dad.

Once upon a time there was a poor alligator. He was always very shy and didn't have many friends. One day, he met a friendly little girl. She was so kind and asked him if he wanted to play. The alligator was so surprised and happy, he said yes right away. 

The girl said "Come on, I'll spoil you!" and they both laughed. Together they played many games and had lots of fun. The alligator felt right at home with the little girl. 

"Thank you so much for spoiling me!" said the alligator as they were saying goodbye. The little girl smiled and said "No problem, I had lots of fun!" 

The little girl and the alligator were great friends from then on. They would always play together and have so much fun. The alligator went from being poor and lonely to being spoiled and happy.
