Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl who loved to march. She wore her marching shoes and marched around the house. Everywhere she marched, she sang a song.

One day, she was marching in the kitchen and she saw something yummy. It was a jar of strawberry jam. She marched over to the jar and smiled.

The little girl asked her mom if she could have some of the jam. Her mom said yes, so the little girl found a spoon and started to march around the kitchen as she ate her jam. She felt happy and danced and sang her marching song.

When she was done, the little girl hugged the jam jar and thanked it for the yummy treat. Then she put the lid on and marched back to her room. She felt full and happy and enjoyed her march around the house.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dog named Max. Max had a silver ball that he loved to play with. One day, Max lost his silver ball in the tall grass.

Max looked and looked, but he could not find his silver ball. He felt sad and asked his friend, a big cat named Tom, for help. Tom said, "Don't worry, Max. We will manage to find your ball."

Max and Tom looked and looked together. They asked a bird to help them, too. The bird flew high and saw the silver ball in the grass. The bird called out, "I found it! I found it!"

Max and Tom were so happy. They thanked the bird and played with the silver ball together. Max learned that with the help of friends, he could manage anything.

Once upon a time there was a little girl, named Star. She was three years old and loved to explore. She went out to her backyard every day. 

One day, when she was playing in her backyard, a butterfly came flying to her. It was so beautiful and incredible that it made Star smile. She followed the butterfly around her garden and watched it land on a flower. 

Suddenly, Star heard a deep voice say, "Hello little girl! Do you own the garden?"

Startled, Star looked up, and saw it was a very big fairy. "Yes," Star said. "I own this garden."

The fairy nodded and said, "Well, I'm giving you something very special. I'm giving you the power to make a wish come true in a minute. It's incredible!"

Star was so excited. She thanked the fairy and tried it several times. She wished for a new bike, and it appeared in one tiny minute! Star was amazed and couldn't believe it. 

From then on, every day, Star went out to her garden, and made her own incredible wishes come true!

Once upon a time, there was a man who had to feed some paper. He got a big pile of paper and put it on the table. The man was so messy, the paper was all over the floor. He tried and tried to feed the paper but it wouldn't stay in one place.

The man was getting frustrated and angry. Then, he had a bright idea. He put the paper in a big bowl and put it on the table. With a spoon he started to feed it slowly, one spoonful at a time.

The man was so happy when he finished feeding the paper. He cleaned up the messy floor and all the paper was eaten up. He was so proud of himself and smiled. He knew he had done a very good job.

One day, a boy named Tim found a switch on the wall. He did not know what it did. He wanted to find out, so he called his friend, Sally. "Sally, I found a switch. What do you think it does?" asked Tim.

Sally thought for a moment and said, "I don't know, but we should polish it first. It looks dirty." So, they got a cloth and cleaned the switch. It looked great after they polished it.

Tim and Sally decided to be brave and flip the switch. When they did, the room filled with pretty lights. They laughed and played in the light, feeling great. From that day on, they always polished the switch to keep it clean and shiny, so they could play with the pretty lights whenever they wanted.

One day, Jack and Mandy were playing in the garden. Mandy wanted to play a game and asked Jack, "Do you want to play chain?" 
Jack thought this was a jolly game, so he agreed. They both grabbed hold of a chain, but suddenly, it got stuck in the garden. They tried to tug and pull it out, but it would not move.

Mandy was frustrated and said, "We need to find something to help us prevent the chain from being stuck!" They searched in the garden, but could not find anything.

Jack had an idea. He ran to the kitchen and found a wooden spoon. He thought this might help them to get the chain out. But when he got back to the garden, Mandy had vanished. He called out her name, but there was no answer.

The wooden spoon did not help to prevent the chain from being stuck. The chain stayed in the garden, and Jack never found out where Mandy had gone.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his best friend, a little girl named Sue. Sue and Spot would play all day long, and they were very happy.

One day, Sue wanted to play dress-up. She put on a pretty dress and a hat. She looked at Spot and said, "Spot, let's play dress-up together!" Spot wagged his tail and barked, "Yes, let's play!" Sue put a small hat on Spot's head, and they both laughed.

As they played, they heard a loud crash outside. They ran to the window and saw a big wreck. A car had hit a tree. Sue and Spot went outside to see if they could help. They saw a man who was hurt. Spot barked loudly to get help, and Sue stayed with the man. Soon, help came, and the man was okay. Sue and Spot were very brave and helpful. They went back inside to finish playing dress-up, knowing they had done a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play in her backyard. One day, she saw a hedge and wondered what was behind it. She asked her mom, "What's behind the hedge, mommy?" 

Her mom replied, "I don't know, Lily. Let's go find out." They walked over to the hedge and saw a little bunny hopping around. Lily was so happy to see the bunny and asked her mom if she could keep it. 

Her mom said, "We can't keep the bunny, Lily. It belongs in the wild." Lily felt anxious because she didn't want the bunny to leave, but her mom explained that it was best for the bunny to be free. Lily said goodbye to the bunny and they went back inside. 

Later that day, Lily's little brother came up to her and asked, "Lily, can I question you about the bunny?" Lily smiled and said, "Of course, ask me anything you want!"

Once upon a time there was a bald man. He was very sad because he wanted some chocolate. Every day he would walk by the store and see all the delicious chocolate in the window, but he had no money to buy any.

One day, the bald man had a great idea. He decided to wash some dishes in exchange for some chocolate. So he found a nice family at the park and asked if he could wash their dishes for some chocolate.

The family was so happy to have someone willing to do their dishes that they gave the bald man lots of chocolate! The bald man was so glad and excited that he ate all the chocolate in one sitting.

The bald man was so happy that from then on he decided to wash dishes for families whenever he wanted some chocolate. And he lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old. She liked wearing her favorite yellow dress every day. 

One day the sky was gloomy. Lucyâ€™s mom said, â€œLetâ€™s make a cake!â€ Lucy was happy and ran to the kitchen.

They mixed ingredients together and put it in the oven. Lucy wanted to help, so she helped her mom measure the flour. 

It wasn't long before the kitchen smelled yummy. Lucyâ€™s mom asked, â€œWould you like to help decorate the cake?â€

Lucy got out sprinkles and icing. She put the sprinkles on top of the cake and said, â€œI love wearing my sprinkles.â€

â€œYour cake looks beautiful!â€ said her mom. 

Lucy smiled and said, â€œMommy, I love you!â€

Her mom hugged her and said, â€œI love you too, Lucy.â€

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved to run and play outside in the sunshine. One day, she decided to climb a big hill. She climbed and climbed until she reached the top. 

But then, something bad happened. Lily's shoe broke! She didn't know what to do. She was stuck on the hill with a broken shoe. 

Luckily, Lily's friend came along. Her friend was reliable and helpful. She admired her friend for always being there when she needed her. Her friend helped her down the hill and fixed her shoe. Lily was so happy and grateful to have a friend like her.

Once upon a time, there was a little goat who lived on a farm. All the animals on the farm were very happy. One day, the little goat found something special. It was a shiny red chilli! It looked so tasty and spicy!

The little goat was so excited. He couldn't wait to try it. But deep down he was afraid. He nervously put the chilli close to his nose, and took a small sniff. Suddenly, he started to tremble, and quickly put it back down.

The goat's friend, a pig, noticed and waved his hoof. "Why don't you try it?" he said. The goat had an idea. He picked up the chilli again and put it in his mouth, then stuck his thumb out to stop it from going any further.

The pig smiled. "Go on, try it!" The goat hesitated, then mustered all his courage and took a brave little bite. Surprisingly, it wasn't as spicy as he'd thought it would be!

The little goat smiled and jumped around with joy. He'd put his fears aside and found out that there was nothing to be so scared of! He had discovered something incredible. He was now brave and happy, thanks to the tasty spicy chilli!

Once upon a time there was a grandmother who lived in a small house. Grandmother was very graceful. Every morning, Grandmother would give her granddaughter a file. The file contained pictures of all the most beautiful places in the world.

Granddaughter was very excited every time she received the file from Grandmother. One day she asked, â€œGrandmother, why do you always give me the file?â€

Grandmother smiled and said, â€œMy dear, I give you the file because I want you to be as graceful as I am. I want you to be able to appreciate all the beautiful places in the world.â€

Granddaughter was so happy to hear this from her beloved grandmother. She ran to her grandmother and hugged her tight. Grandaughter thanked her grandmother for her loving gift. From then on, she always kept the file close to her, so that she could look at it whenever she wanted to.

Once upon a time there was a Copper. Copper was an angry Copper. He had big angry eyes and he didn't like talking to anyone. One day he was walking by the lake and noticed a beautiful bird sitting on the edge. He wanted to talk to the bird, but was too scared. The bird told Copper it was very tired so it needed to Rest. Copper understood what the bird needed and he decided to help out. He brought the bird some leaves to build a nest and also some food to eat. 

At first the bird was scared, but Copper didn't show his anger. He smiled at the bird and the bird felt safe. Copper sat next to the bird and promised to stay until it was well rested. After a few hours, the bird thanked Copper for being such a good friend and flew away. From that day onward, Copper stopped being angry and was always friendly and kind.

Once upon a time, there was a chicken who was feeling a little worried. She was feeling very sad because no matter how hard she tried, nothing seemed to ever change. 

Then one day, she decided to make a decision. She wanted to be happy and healthy. 

The chicken took a deep breath and started to do some things differently. She began to exercise every day, eat healthier food and take some time to relax. 

By doing these things, the chicken started to feel a lot better. Soon, she was feeling more energized and healthier. 

Though she still had worries sometimes, she had made a big change and it felt really good. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was a pupil and she liked to study. But one day, she met her classmate Cat. Cat was very bossy and always told Lucy what to do.

Cat said to Lucy, â€œYou must study harder, then you can get better marks!â€

Lucy was a bit angry, but she said OK.

So every day, Lucy and Cat studied and got better marks. Cat was very bossy, but also very helpful.

Soon, everyone in their class was getting good marks. Lucy was so happy and proud of herself.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was very happy because he had a treasure map. He wanted to find the treasure so he could have lots of gold and toys. 

Timmy walked and walked until he found a big tree. He leaned against the tree and looked at the map. He was very thoughtful and tried to figure out where the treasure might be. 

Suddenly, he saw a big X on the map. It was near the river. Timmy ran to the river and started digging. After a few minutes, he found a big box. He opened it and inside was lots of gold and toys! Timmy was very happy and he knew he was a very lucky boy.

Once there was a tall octopus. He was very worried. He didn't know what to do. He had lost his best friend - a fish. 

He started to swim around looking for his friend but he couldn't find him anywhere. He was so sad.

He stopped and saw a small fish swimming close by. The octopus asked him, "Have you seen my friend?"

The small fish thought for a bit and said, "No sorry, I haven't. But don't worry - I'm sure he'll turn up soon!"

The octopus smiled. He thanked the small fish and started to swim around again, not so worried anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty dress with flowers on it. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to help clean the house. Lily said "Yes, mommy!" and started to clean.

Lily struggled to lift the heavy vacuum cleaner to clean the carpet. She called out to her mommy, "Mommy, this is too heavy for me!" 

Her mommy came to help and said, "Lily, it's okay to ask for help when you struggle. We all need help sometimes." 

From that day on, Lily learned that it's okay to ask for help when she needs it. And she also learned that sometimes, pretty dresses are not meant for cleaning the house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a new dress that she loved very much. One day, Lily went to a party and saw a big bowl of olives. She had never tried an olive before, but she dared herself to try one. She took a bite and didn't like it very much, but she was proud of herself for trying something new.

Once upon a time, there was a playful cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to play with her toy mouse and jump around the house. One day, Kitty found a big thing called a piano. The piano had many black and white keys that made fun sounds when Kitty pressed them with her paws.

Kitty's friend, Doggy, came over to see what the noise was. "What are you doing, Kitty?" Doggy asked. "I am playing the piano," Kitty said with a big smile. "It is so much fun! Do you want to try?" Doggy wagged his tail and said, "Yes, please!"

Kitty and Doggy played the piano together, making loud and soft sounds. They laughed and danced to the music they made. They played until they were tired and then lay down near the piano, happy with their new game. From that day on, Kitty and Doggy loved to play the piano and make music for everyone to hear.

Once there was a little girl named Julia. She was three years old and loved playing with her friends. One day, Julia found a beautiful jewel on the ground. It was very sparkly and she was so happy! She smiled at the jewel and decided to keep it.

Julia's friends came over for a visit and she wanted to show them the jewel. She held it up and proudly said, "Look at my jewel!" Her friends were impressed and smiled back at her. They wanted to have a competition. Julia was very competitive, so she agreed. 

They played a game of see-saw. Julia wanted to win so she tried her best. In the end, Julia was the winner and she smiled with joy. All her friends clapped and said, "You did it!" Julia felt like a champion and she was so proud of her jewel.

Once upon a time, there a girl named Lily. She loved to go for walks in the woods. On one sunny day in summer, she went for a walk with her dog, Max. 

As Lily and Max were walking, they suddenly heard a loud voice.

"Lily, do not go near the river!"

Lily was surprised and asked, "Who said that?"

It was a frog, who had seen her and Max coming. 

"I am a wise frog, I know many things. I saw you coming to the river and I wanted to warn you. The river is a dangerous place to swim," said the frog in a deep voice. 

Lily was amazed at how wise the frog was. She nodded and thanked the frog for the warning. She then turned around and went back home with Max. 

The frog watched them go and smiled. It was brilliant of him to warn the girl in time.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to run and jump and slide. They saw a big dog with gray fur. The dog was barking and wagging its tail.

"Can we pet the dog?" Lily asked Tom.

"OK, but be careful. He might bite," Tom said.

They walked to the dog and said hello. The dog licked their hands and let them touch his ears. He was very soft and warm.

"What is your name, dog?" Tom asked.

The dog barked again. He sounded happy.

"His name is Max. He is my dog," a voice said.

Tom and Lily turned around and saw a boy with a leash. He was wearing a hat and a coat.

"Hi, I am Ben. Do you like Max?" the boy said.

"Yes, he is very nice. We are Tom and Lily. We are playing in the park," Lily said.

"Can we play with you and Max?" Tom asked.

"Sure, but we have to be gentle. Max is old and weak. He can't run fast or jump high. He likes to cuddle and nap," Ben said.

Tom and Lily realized that Max was not a young and strong dog. He was an old and weak dog. But they still liked him. They decided to play with Ben and Max. They gave Max some water and a treat. They hugged him and told him stories. Max wagged his tail and closed his eyes. He was happy to have new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small bird called Fred. He was very brave, but he was also very tiny. 

One day, Fred escaped his nest and went on a big adventure. He flew very high in the sky and eventually came across a tall cliff. It was too high for Fred to climb and he was scared. 

Fred started to get worried, so he called for help. Luckily, a beautiful big eagle heard him and told Fred he could help him. The eagle said that if Fred could trust him, he would take him back to his nest. 

So Fred did and the eagle swooped down and grabbed Fred in his claws. As they flew back to the nest, the eagle said to Fred, â€œAlways trust those who are kind, because they know what is best for you.â€ 

Fred thanked the eagle and was so happy to be back home. From then on, he never flew too far away from his nest again.

Once upon a time there was a dependable dog named Spot. Spot had lots of fun each day, but his favorite time was when his owner gave him a loving touch. Spot could feel the softness and love of his owner's touch.

One day Spot saw something lovely he had never seen before. It was very colorful. Spot decided he wanted to touch it. He slowly reached out his paw and when it made contact, he felt something familiar. He felt the same loving touch that he felt when his owner would pet him. 

Spot was so happy! He knew his owner's touch was dependable. Spot had found a wonderful color that also gave him a loving touch. He knew that color would remind him of his owner's love every time he saw it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved dinosaurs more than anything else in the whole world. He had a toy dinosaur that he carried with him everywhere he went. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play.

"Hey Timmy, I brought my toy dinosaur too! Let's play together!" said Billy.

Timmy looked at Billy's dinosaur and didn't like it as much as his own. "No, I don't want to play with your dinosaur. Mine is better," said Timmy.

Billy felt sad and left to go home. Timmy's mom saw what happened and talked to Timmy. "Timmy, it's not nice to not accept other people's toys. It's important to be kind to others and share your things," said Timmy's mom.

Timmy realized he was wrong and felt bad. He went to find Billy and said, "I'm sorry for not accepting your dinosaur. Let's play together now." Billy forgave Timmy and they had fun playing with both of their dinosaurs. Timmy learned that it's important to be ready to accept others and their things.

Once there was a famous flower. He lived in a garden with lots of other flowers. Every day he watched them bloom in beautiful colors, but he couldn't bloom himself. 

One day, a boy named Danny came to the garden. He had a bag of coal with him. He put some coal around the flower and then said, â€œMaybe this will help you bloom!â€ 

The flower was so excited! He felt funny, and then he started to slowly bloom. Bright pink petals appeared around him and soon he was more beautiful than any other flower in the garden.

Danny smiled and said, â€œI knew you could do it!â€ 

The flower was so happy. From that day on, he bloomed every day in the garden and was known as the most famous flower!

One day, there was a cherry tree in the garden. It had lots of beautiful cherries. Each one was shiny and red.

The gardener wanted to make them even shinier, so she got a cloth and began to polish the cherries. She moved the cloth up and down and round and round, until the cherries were so shiny that she could see her face in them!

Then, a foolish bird came and tried to eat the cherries. But he was so silly that he didn't notice how shiny they were. So, he hurt his beak on them.

The gardener thought this was very funny. She laughed and laughed and told the bird to be more careful. The bird soon flew away, better off for the lesson!

Once there was an old woman who lived in a house with her three cats. Every day she played with them and they were very happy. One day she wanted to buy something new for them, so she went to the store to buy a cube. It was a cheap cube, made of bright colors and it looked very special. 

She brought the cube home and put it on the floor so her cats could see it. When they saw the cube, they couldn't believe their eyes and they were so happy! But then one of the cats disturbed the cube and it fell over, making a loud noise. The old woman was so surprised and for a second she didn't know what to do. But she was relieved to see that her cats were still happy and running about the house. 

From then on, the old woman always kept the cube on a shelf so that it wouldn't be disturbed by the cats. The cats still played together and the old woman was always happy to watch them and smile.

Once upon a time there was a reliable little girl. Her name was Maria and she was three years old. Maria liked to help her mommy clean around the house. 

One day, Maria and her mom were in the kitchen. Her mom was stirring a sauce in a pot. Maria asked, "Can I help you, mommy?" 

Her mom answered, "Yes, you sure can." She gave Maria a washcloth and said, "You can clean the counters with this." 

Maria happily smiled and started cleaning. She wiped the counters with the washcloth until they were shiny again. 

Afterwards, her mom rewarded her with a big hug. Maria felt happy to have helped. 

The End!

Once upon a time there lived a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and always wanted to move and play. So everyday she went outside to have an exercise. 

One day, after playing with her friends, she heard a loud strike of thunder. The sky began to darken and Lucy knew a storm was coming. Without thinking twice, she ran back home.

When she arrived to her house, her mum was waiting for her. She said, "Lucy you need to stay inside. But you can do something healthy like stretching or other exercises."

Lucy was sad, inside the house she couldn't play like before. So she began to do the exercises her mum had taught her. She then heard her mum repeating "the storm is coming" again and again until it was too strong. The sky went completely grey and the rain began to fall.

Lucy was safe, but she still couldn't go outside. But mom had reminded her of the importance of exercise, so she kept on doing stretches, push ups and other movements. 

When the rain stopped, Lucy excitedly ran outside and resumed playing with her friends. The day might have been full of rain, but it was now healthy and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a poor man who worked at a big store. He had many friends there who were also called staff. The poor man was always very kind to everyone and worked very hard every day.

One day, the poor man's friends noticed that he was wearing old and torn clothes. They felt sad for him and decided to dress him up in new clothes. They gave him a nice shirt and pants to wear, and he looked very happy and handsome.

From that day on, the poor man felt very grateful to his staff friends. He worked even harder and always made sure to be kind to everyone. The staff were happy to see him happy and they all became even better friends.

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to fish. They had a big pole that their dad gave them. They went to the lake with their pole and a bucket. They hoped to catch many fish and sell them at the market.

They saw a man with a loud voice and a sign that said "Fish for sale". He had many fish in his cart. He shouted, "Come and buy my fresh fish! They are tasty and cheap!" Tim and Sam wanted to sell their fish like him. They thought he was very smart and rich.

They threw their pole in the water and waited. They waited for a long time, but no fish came. They felt sad and bored. They wondered why the man had so many fish and they had none. They decided to ask him for a tip.

They walked to the man and said, "Hello, sir. We are trying to catch fish and sell them, but we have no luck. Can you tell us your secret?"

The man looked at them and smiled. He said, "Sure, boys. I'll tell you my secret. I don't catch fish. I buy them from the store and sell them here. It's easier and faster. Do you want to buy some?"

Tim and Sam were shocked and angry. They felt cheated and lied to. They said, "No, thank you. We don't want your fish. You are not smart and rich. You are sneaky and bad. We will catch our own fish with our pole. Goodbye!"

They ran back to their pole and bucket. They hoped to catch a big fish and show the man. They learned a lesson that day. They learned that not everyone is honest and that fishing is hard work. But they also learned that fishing is fun and rewarding. They enjoyed their time at the lake with their pole and their bucket.

Tim is a fat cat. He likes to sleep on his owner's bed. His owner is a girl named Amy. Amy loves Tim very much. She gives him food and water and toys.

One day, Amy has to go to school. She says goodbye to Tim and leaves. Tim is sad. He wants to play with Amy. He looks for something to do. He sees a big rock on the window. The rock is shiny and round. Tim thinks it is a toy.

Tim jumps on the window and tries to grab the rock. But the rock is heavy and hard. It falls from the window and lands on the ground. Tim falls with the rock and hurts his paw. He cries very loud.

Amy hears Tim's cry. She runs back to the house. She sees Tim and the rock on the ground. She is scared. She picks up Tim and hugs him. She says sorry to Tim and takes him to the vet. The vet gives Tim a bandage and a treat. Tim feels better.

Amy and Tim go back home. Amy puts the rock away. She says to Tim, "That is not a toy, Tim. That is a rock. Rocks are not for cats. Rocks are for gardens." Tim nods. He understands. He does not want to play with rocks anymore. He wants to play with Amy. Amy and Tim play with a ball and a mouse. They are happy. They love each other. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a happy family. They lived in a big house with a garden. Every day, the mom would prepare yummy food for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. She would use lots of colorful veggies and fruits to make the food healthy and tasty.

The dad would go to work with his folder full of papers. He was a busy man, but he always made time to play with his lively little girl. They would run and jump and laugh together in the garden.

One day, the family decided to have a picnic. The mom prepared sandwiches and fruit, while the dad packed the folder with some important papers. The little girl was so lively and excited to go on a picnic with her family. They had so much fun playing games and eating yummy food. It was a day they would always remember.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy girl called Sia. She loved to dream about strange and wonderful things. One day, she woke up and saw a big carpet in the corner of her room. She had never seen it before and was very curious.

Sia started to dream about all the things she could do with the carpet. She imagined flying high above the clouds and playing tag with her friends. She could even turn it into her own private castle!

The carpet was so big that Sia could lay out across it and take a nap. She felt like she had found a special secret that no one else knew about.

Every day, Sia would visit her carpet and make up new dreams for the future. She never got tired of dreaming about its possibilities and exploring the magic of the carpet.

Once there was a lively little girl named Trixie. She liked to play outside in the garden with her toys. One day Trixie was playing hopscotch and she slipped. She fell on her knee and felt a sharp pinch. She had made a cut!

Trixie started to cry as she looked at the cut. Her mommy ran out to help her. She quickly took Trixie inside and cleaned the cut. Then she put a special patch on it to make it feel better. 

Trixie was so happy that her mommy took care of her cut. She felt much better and was ready to go back to playing outside. She ran out the door to continue playing hopscotch, this time with more care!

Mommy and Daddy were discussing in the living room. Mommy was smiling and Daddy was laughing. They were talking about a big surprise.

Suddenly, the doorbell rang. Daddy opened the door and there was Grandma. Grandma was holding a very special gift. She said it was for Mommy and Daddy.

Mommy and Daddy said thank you and asked what it was. Grandma said it was a polite surprise.

Mommy and Daddy opened the gift and it was a big, fluffy kitten. They were so excited and started talking about names for the kitten.

Grandma smiled and said it was nice to see them discussing so politely. Mommy and Daddy laughed and said that the kitten was the best gift ever.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Tom. Tom was very excited because he was going to pretend to be a pirate. "I'm going to sail on the seas all the way to Noon Island", he said to himself.

One day, Tom was sailing his boat far out to sea when the clouds turned dark. The wind was blowing and the boat was rocking from side to side. Suddenly, it began to rain! "Help!", Tom cried. 

Tom's boat began to fill up with water, getting wetter and wetter. He tried to bail out the water with a bucket, but it was no use. Eventually, Tom's boat was so weighed down with water from the rain, it sank.

Tom had a bad ending and he never made it to Noon Island. But the lesson he learned was to always check the weather before venturing out to sea.

Once there was a little girl. She was always sad and one day she started to cry. The tears were running down her red cheeks. She had been crying for a long time and she did not know why.

Suddenly, she saw a small pebble. It was very smooth and sparkly. It looked like it was just waiting for her. She picked it up and held it in her hands. It felt warm, like it was a little friend.

The little girl stopped crying. She started to feel much better. Her sorrow melted away when she saw the pebble. Now she had something shiny and available to make her happy.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Mandy and Sammy. They liked to play together in the park every day.

One day, they were walking home from the park when Mandy noticed something strange. Sammy seemed to be carrying a grocery bag. She asked him what was inside the bag. 

Sammy smiled and said, "I found this bag in the park and it looks like it belongs to someone." 

Mandy said, "It must be a loyal friend to have dropped their grocery bag for so long without coming back for it!" 

Sammy smiled and said, "I think so too. Let's take it home and see if we can help find the owner." 

Mandy and Sammy took the grocery bag to Mandy's house and asked everyone they saw if they had lost a grocery bag. Sure enough, they found out that it had belonged to Mandy's neighbour Mr. Brown.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was nervous because he heard a noise from the ceiling. He went to his mom and said, "Mom, I hear a noise. It makes me nervous."

The puppy froze in his spot, looking around to find the source of the voice. Suddenly, he saw a little girl running and shouting. 

The puppy felt so guilty. He dropped the bone and wagged his tail, hoping the girl would be less mad at him. The girl was very mad but also amused by the puppy's guilty and clumsy behavior. She found it quite funny, so she said: "It's okay, little puppy. You can keep the bone."

Anna and Ben are playing with their blocks. They like to build towers and houses with their blocks. They have many colors of blocks: red, blue, yellow, green, and more.

"Look, Anna, I made a big house with a roof!" Ben says. He shows Anna his house. It has four walls and a roof made of blue blocks.

But then, a big wind comes. The wind is very strong. It blows and blows. It makes a loud noise. Anna and Ben are scared. They hug each other.

Molly was so excited to go for a walk. She had put on her shiny pink coat and was pulling on her mittens. She had asked her mom if she could bring along her favourite squeaky toy and her mom said yes.

Al now had an even more lively adventure waiting for him on the other side of the swamp!

Billy smiled. He knew that going to church wearing his mama's fine clothes would be an adventure. He couldn't wait!

Once there were two friends, Sarah and Beth. They were walking together in the park and Sarah noticed a pretty curtain on top of the empty stage. She asked Beth, "What is that?" Beth answered, "It's a graceful curtain!" Sarah climbed up on the stage and twirled around with the curtain. She spun around and around and felt so graceful.

Next, Sarah asked her friend, "What shape is the curtain?" Beth answered, "It's a triangle shape!" Sarah was amazed by the shape of the curtain, it was so special!

Finally, Sarah asked Beth, "What color is the curtain?". Beth answered, "It's blue and yellow, just like the sky!" Sarah and Beth both looked up and smiled. The curtain was beautiful, just like the clear sky. 

The two friends shared a laugh and decided to dance around the stage with the graceful curtain. Sarah and Beth had so much fun playing with the curtain and will never forget that beautiful day in the park.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy. He was very creative and would love to always make new things. One day, while playing outside, he had an idea. He wanted to create a rod.

The little boy gathered some sticks and twigs in his backyard. He used his imagination and made them into a rod. He was very pleased with his work.

He showed his mom his shop creation. She praised him and said, "Wow, what a wonderful rod! It looks so strong."

The little boy beamed with pride. He was so happy that he had been able to create something with his own little hands. From then on, every day he would create something new.

Once there was a little girl who went for a walk in the woods. She saw an owl perched on a branch and felt curious. She went closer to the owl and examined it. The owl looked back at her with its big eyes. The girl thought it was so interesting and smiled. 

Suddenly, the owl moved and the girl backed away. The owl left a present behind which was something gross and disgusting. The girl wrinkled her nose in disgust. 

The girl touched the present with her finger and it made a squishing sound. She quickly wiped her finger on her pants and backed away from the present. 

The girl wanted to see the owl again so she kept examining the area where it had been. But the owl was nowhere to be seen.

Once upon a time there was a red car, it drove very fast. One day it was driving through a park, going very quickly. Suddenly, it hit a big rock and the tire exploded.

The car stopped and the driver hopped out. He looked around and saw a big, round shape. It was a tire! He knew that it would be hard to get it on the car, but he tried.

"This is going to be difficult!" said the driver. He bent over and tried to lift the tire up, but it was too heavy for him. 

Just then, a small girl walked up. She had a smile on her face. 

"Can I help?" she asked.

The driver stared at her in surprise. He nodded and said, "Yes! That would be very nice. Can you speed up the process?"

The little girl smiled and grabbed the tire. She lifted it easily and put it on the car. 

"There you go!" she said.

The driver couldn't believe it. "Thank you so much," he said. 

The little girl smiled and waved goodbye. She took off running and the driver watched after her in amazement. She had saved the day!

Once upon a time, there was a family of four. They had a mom, a dad and two children. The mom loved to cut round shapes from different materials. She used paper, fabric, wood, and more.

One day, the two children were watching their mom cut circles from a piece of fabric.

"Mom," the older child said, "why do you like to cut circles so much?"

The mom looked up and smiled.

"I like to cut circles because I want us to remember to be compassionate," she said. "Circles are symbols of compassion and unity."

The children felt warm and happy knowing that their mom was so compassionate. They learned a valuable lesson that day, and they never forgot it.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very healthy and loved to eat beef. One day, she heard a noise coming from outside which disturbed her. 

She opened the door to find a cow in her garden! She was so excited and wanted to get a closer look, so she followed the cow. Suddenly the cow started eating a patch of grass near a bush.

The little girl realised that the cow had found some tasty beef! She was so happy and collected the beef for her dinner. She thanked the cow for showing her such a healthy food. 

And that's how the little girl got her tasty beef!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who was very lucky. He liked to go outside and play each day. 

One day, the little boy saw a bug on the ground. He wanted to catch the bug, so he slowly inched closer and closer. Suddenly, the bug froze! The boy was so excited. He slowly reached down and picked up the bug. 

He brought the bug inside his house and decided to make it his pet. He put the bug in a jar with some leaves and gave it a name. He called the bug Lucky. 

The little boy and Lucky were very happy together. Every day, the boy would let Lucky out of the jar and they would play together. 

The little boy and Lucky became very good friends. They would play together each day and freeze together when they were scared. The little boy loved his lucky bug and was so happy to have found it!

Once upon a time there was a handy man who had a fancy house. Whenever someone needed help, they would knock on the handy man's door.

One day, a young lady came to the door. She said, "Please, I need your help. I need to sack the old teach and find a new one for my son." The handy man said he could help her.

So the handy man went to the teach's old house and packed all of her belongings in a big sack. He said goodbye and put the sack in the back of his car.

Then the handy man drove to the young lady's house. He gave her the sack and said, "Now you can find a fancy new teach for your son."

The young lady was very happy because the handy man had helped her. She thanked him and soon they both went back to their homes. And they all lived happily ever after.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big box in the attic. Inside the box, there were many old things, like hats, glasses, and scarves. Tom and Lily decided to dress up and pretend to be different people.

Tom put on a hat and a pair of glasses. He also found a fake mustache and stuck it on his face. He looked at himself in the mirror and smiled. He thought he looked like a smart and important man.

Lily put on a scarf and a necklace. She also found a pretty hat with a flower on it. She looked at herself in the mirror and giggled. She thought she looked like a beautiful and fancy lady.

Tom and Lily gazed at each other and laughed. They had fun making up stories and acting them out. They pretended to be a king and a queen, a doctor and a nurse, a teacher and a student, and more.

But after a while, Tom became selfish. He wanted to try on all the things in the box and did not want to share with Lily. He grabbed the scarf from Lily's neck and the hat from her head. He said, "These are mine now. You can't have them."

Lily was sad and angry. She said, "That's not fair. You are being mean and selfish. You have to share with me. We are twins and we are supposed to play together."

Tom did not listen. He said, "No, I don't. I like these things more than you. Go away and leave me alone."

Lily felt hurt and lonely. She did not want to play with Tom anymore. She ran out of the attic and went to find their mom. She told her what Tom did and how he made her feel.

Their mom was not happy. She went to the attic and saw Tom wearing all the things from the box. She said, "Tom, what are you doing? Why are you being so selfish and rude to your sister? You know you have to share and be kind to each other. That's what twins do."

Tom felt ashamed. He realized he was wrong and he had hurt Lily's feelings. He took off the things from the box and said, "I'm sorry, mom. I'm sorry, Lily. I was being selfish and mean. I don't want to be like that. I want to be a good twin and a good brother. Can we play together again?"

Lily smiled and hugged Tom. She said, "I forgive you, Tom. I love you, twin. Yes, we can play together again. But this time, let's share and be nice to each other."

Tom and Lily nodded and agreed. They put the things back in the box and thanked their mom. Then they went to play with their toys and have fun. They gazed at each other and laughed. They were happy and they were twins.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Ted, who loved playing together. Every day, they would go out and explore the world together.

One day Bob and Ted went for a walk in the park and saw a lovely bird. They stopped and looked at it for a while, it was so colourful and beautiful. 

Suddenly, Bob started to worry. He said to Ted, â€œWhat if the bird doesnâ€™t have a home? Where will it go at night? Iâ€™m worried about it!â€

Ted looked around and said, â€œLook over there, I think I see a luxury nest in the tree. Maybe the bird lives there!â€ 

Bob and Ted both smiled when they saw the nest. They were very happy that the bird had a lovely place to call home.

Bob and Ted said goodbye to the bird and went back home. From then on, they never worried about the bird again!

Grace and her mum went to the zoo. Grace was so excited to see the animals! She saw monkeys, tigers, lions and zebras. She loved the zebras the best.

Grace pointed to the zebras and said, â€œMum, letâ€™s pray for them!â€ Her mum smiled and said, â€œYes, letâ€™s pray.â€

Grace and her mum held hands, closed their eyes and prayed silently. Grace felt so peaceful and happy. The air was quiet and the zebras were so beautiful.

When they opened their eyes, Grace said, â€œWe should always be kind to animals, right?â€ Her mum nodded. â€œYes, thatâ€™s right.â€

Once upon a time there was a jolly little girl. Every day, she loved to play with her clock. She loved to watch it tick and tock and to watch the hands go round and round.

One day, she noticed something different about the clock. It had started to spring from side to side! She tried to make it stop, but nothing she did worked. 

The jolly little girl continued to watch her clock and noticed that the more it sprang, the faster it ticked and tocked. Finally, she got an idea. She held the clock tightly and sang a little song, and after a few moments, the clock stopped springing and her song kept it ticking and tocking steadily.

The jolly little girl was so proud that she had solved the problem with her clock. She had done something special - something only she could do. From then on, she was no longer jolly - she was ecstatic!

Lily was a young girl who liked to play with her toys. She had many dolls and cars and blocks, but her favorite toy was a fork. She liked to pretend it was a sword or a wand or a comb. She did not like to share her fork with anyone, not even her brother Tom.

One day, Tom wanted to play with Lily's fork. He asked her nicely, but she said no. He tried to grab it from her, but she pulled it away. They started to fight over the fork, and Lily got angry. She shouted at Tom and hit him with the fork. Tom cried and ran to their mom.

Mom was very upset. She saw the fork and the mark on Tom's arm. She scolded Lily and took away her fork. She said Lily had to say sorry to Tom and be nice to him. She said Lily could not play with the fork anymore, because it was not a toy. She said Lily had to play with something else.

Lily felt sad and sorry. She did not mean to hurt Tom. She loved her brother and her fork. She wished she had shared her fork with him. She wished she had not fought with him. She wished she had not hit him. She regretted being mean and selfish. She wanted her fork back, but it was too late. She had lost her favorite toy and made her brother and mom unhappy. She had a bad day.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who was very brave. She wanted to explore the world, so she set off on an adventure. On her journey, she came across a big, messy castle. She was a bit scared, but then she saw a friendly face peeking out of the window - it was a dragon!

The dragon invited her in and she nodded her head. The inside of the castle was even more messy than outside, but the dragon looked kind. He told her, â€œI have been in pain for a very long time. Would you help me?â€

The princess was frightened, but she nodded her head. They worked together to clean up the mess, and bit by bit the castle became shiny and sparkly. The dragon felt better, and the princess was happy.

She thanked the dragon for helping her on her adventure and set off on the next leg of her journey. She remembered the lessons she had learnt from the dragon, and with a nod of her head, she was off!

Once upon a time there was a happy little three year old girl. Her name was Jane. Jane loved to play and explore. One day Jane stumbled upon a huge and mysterious maze. She was excited to explore it. She wandered the paths and around the corners for hours, looking for a way out. Along the way, she met a humble old man and room full of animals. 

The old man smiled and said: "Little one, the way out of the maze is the way you came. Look for it." Jane was confused and asked the old man: "How can I find my way out?"

The old man replied: "Be patient, follow your heart and trust in yourself. You will find the way out. Look carefully at the paths and be humble". Jane was determined and brave, she searched the maze and finally found the way out! She was so proud of her little humble self. Jane would never forget her adventure in the maze.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a very nice dress and she was happy. On this day though, Daisy wanted something different.

Daisy asked her mommy: "Can I have a new dress?"

Her mommy said: "No, Daisy. We don't have money for that right now."

Daisy didn't want to yield. She continued asking and pleading until finally, her mommy said "Okay, but you have to be good!"

So they went to the store to get Daisy a new dress. Daisy got to pick out the dress she wanted and she was so excited! Finally, she was allowed to go home with her new nice dress.

At the end of the day, Daisy was beaming with happiness. The new dress was just what she wanted, nice and pretty. She thanked her mommy and snuggled into the dress. Daisy was so proud of her valuable new dress.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved cookies more than anything in the world. One day, Lily's mom made some cookies for her, but she couldn't find them anywhere. She looked under the bed, in the closet, and even in the toy box, but the cookies were nowhere to be found.

Lily was sad and started to cry. Her mom saw her crying and asked what was wrong. Lily told her that she couldn't find her cookies. Her mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, I'll help you find them." They looked everywhere together, but the cookies were still distant.

Finally, they found the cookies in the kitchen on the counter. Lily was so happy that she hugged her mom and said, "Thank you for helping me find my cookies!" From that day on, Lily learned to always ask for help when she couldn't find something.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion named Leo. He lived in the jungle with his friends. One day, Leo saw a little mouse and wanted to eat him. But the mouse said, "Please don't eat me, I can help you one day." Leo laughed and said, "How can a tiny mouse help me?"

On Wednesday, Leo was sleeping when he heard a loud noise. It was a hunter with a gun. Leo tried to roar, but he couldn't. The hunter shot him and Leo fell to the ground. The little mouse saw everything and ran to Leo's friends. He told them what happened and they all ran to help Leo.

When they arrived, Leo was lying on the ground, dead. His friends were sad and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, they heard a small voice saying, "I can help." It was the little mouse. He climbed into Leo's ear and whispered a magic spell. Leo woke up and roared with joy. He was alive again! From that day on, Leo and the mouse were best friends and always helped each other.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty nurse who helped lots of people. One day she was very sad, because someone was very mean to her. She didn't understand why they were so mean. She asked her friends for help.

Her best friend said, "you should forgive them". But the nurse didn't want to. She couldn't see how she could forgive them.

Then, one day, something surprising happened. She met the person who had been so mean and they were very sorry. They told her they were sorry and that they understood how wrong they had been.

The nurse felt much better. She was so glad that she could forgive them. It made her feel special and mighty. She knew that she was a kind person who didn't like to stay angry. From then on, she knew that it was better to forgive than to stay angry.

Once, there was a girl called Amy. She was always very happy. One day, when she was playing with her toys, mummy called her. "Amy, it's time to go to the park," mummy said. Amy was very excited and ran to get her pants. But when she got to her bedroom, she couldn't find them.

"Mummy, I can't find my pants," Amy said.

Mummy laughed. "Oh, did you forget where you put them?"

Amy thought hard, but couldn't remember. Then, she suddenly remembered - she left her pants on the kitchen table! She ran to the kitchen and found them.

"Thank you for helping me remember, mummy," Amy said.

Mummy smiled. "That's alright. Now let's go to the park and have some fun!"

And so, Amy and mummy had a really happy time at the park.

Sara and Ben like to play in the garden. They have a small table and some cups and plates. They pretend to serve tea and cake to their toys. Sara is careful with the cups. She does not want to spill or break them. Ben is not careful. He likes to make noise and mess.

One day, Sara and Ben find some flowers in the garden. They are yellow and white and smell nice. Sara says they are spring flowers. She picks some and puts them in a vase. She wants to serve them with the tea and cake. Ben says he wants to pick some too. He runs to the flowers and pulls them hard. He does not see the bee on one of them.

The bee is angry. It does not like Ben. It stings him on the nose. Ben cries and drops the flowers. He runs to his mom. Sara is sad. She does not have enough flowers for the vase. She does not want to play with Ben anymore. She serves tea and cake to her toys by herself. She hopes Ben will be more careful next time.

Once there was a big fire. Smoke was all around. A fireman arrived and started to put out the fire. He was brave and strong.

The fireman saw a small bad dog. The dog was shaking and scared. The fireman wrapped the dog in a big blanket to keep it safe. Then he took it away from all the heat and smoke. 

The fireman said, "Thank you for being so brave. You're a very good dog!" 

The dog smiled, jumped and barked. The fireman said, "I'm going to take you home now, okay?" 

The dog was happy. It was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a house in the woods. In the house lived a little girl. She saw something far away that was shining light. She wanted to reach out and get it.

So she grabbed her coat and went outside. She walked across the meadow until she came to the light. It was a big castle! She was so excited.

She ran all the way to the castle. When she got there, she realized the castle was really a big tree! She touched the trunk of the tree and it was so soft and cuddly.

The little girl fell asleep with her head against the tree trunk. She had such a nice, comfy nap! The tree's softness made the nap so restful. When she woke up, she looked around and the light in the woods had gone. She realized it was already time to go home.

So she waved goodbye to the big tree and started to walk back home. The walk seemed much shorter this time! When she got home, she remembered the light in the woods and the wonderful nap she had. She smiled and went inside.

The end.

Once there was a bear named Beary. Beary wanted a new friend, but he didn't know how to find one. 
One day, Beary went outside and he saw a leaf. Beary was ready to introduce himself. He asked the leaf if it would like to be his friend. 
The leaf was so excited and said yes. 
From then on, Beary and the Leaf were best friends. They went on adventures and had lots of fun together. 
Every day they introduced each other to new things and explored the world together. 
They were always ready for whatever the day had to offer.

Once upon a time there was a skeleton. He was very polite and he liked to move around. He danced in the fields and skipped by the trees. He even moved inside some big, old houses! The skeleton moved all day. 

He was so polite that he said 'hello' and 'thank you' to everyone he came across. He heard them call him the 'polite skeleton' and he was so proud! 

One day he was walking down a big road and he came across a river. The skeleton moved to the other side and thought he would take a rest. He laid down by the river and closed his eyes for a nap. Suddenly, he felt something move around his feet! He opened his eyes and it was a little three year old child playing with him! 

The skeleton was so polite that he said 'hello' to the little boy and acted friendly. And from then on, the polite skeleton and the little three year old boy were the best of friends!

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl named Bella. Bella had a lot of laundry to take care of every day. She was so brave every morning as she took all the laundry to the washing machine and started washing it.

One day, Bella was washing her laundry and a giant appeared. He said to her, "Little Bella, can you come with me?" Bella was brave although she was frightened and said, "Where do you want me to come?"

The giant showed her the way and told her, "I can show you a brighter place if you come with me." Bella thought for a while and decided to come.

The giant took Bella to a distant land, far away. There, the flowers bloomed so brightly, the air smelled sweeter, and the sun sparkled in the sky. Bella had never seen such beauty and she was filled with joy.

The giant told her, "Come back anytime you want, Bella. I will be waiting." Bella was so brave and thanked the giant. Then, she went back home with the laundry.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and her little girl. Every morning, the mommy would help the little girl get dressed and ready for the day. But one day, the mommy was being very rude. She kept telling the little girl to "hurry up" and "stop wasting time".

The little girl felt sad and angry at the same time. She wanted to stay in bed and not go anywhere. So she stopped and told the mommy that she didn't want to get dressed.

The mommy got mad, but she knew that her little girl needed some time and understanding. So she explained that the morning was special and that they had lots to do. She hugged the little girl and asked if she was ready to get dressed now.

The little girl smiled and said yes! She was very happy that the mommy had been so patient and understanding. From then on, the mommy and her little girl had lots of nice mornings together.

Once there was a little boy named Jamie. He was curious and always wanted to learn new things. One day, Jamie asked his mom for help.

"Mom, what is that?" Jamie pointed to a beautiful metal box on the dresser.

His mom smiled. "That is a special box. I can send things in it to people far away. It's like magic!"

Jamie was excited. He wanted to send something too. He looked around his room and found a shiny marble. He put it in the box and closed the lid.

"Now what do I do?" he asked.

"Close your eyes and picture the person you want to send it to," his mom said.

Jamie closed his eyes and thought of his friend, Ryan. He imagined Ryan opening the box and being surprised by the beautiful marble.

Mom said that the box would make the marble travel to faraway places. Jamie wondered how the box could do such a thing. He opened his eyes and smiled. He was sure that Ryan would love his surprise.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. He lived next to a deep, dark well. He was always curious and one day he decided to come closer to the well to take a peek inside. His dad was very worried and told him: "Don't come close to the well! You can hurt yourself!â€ But the boy ignored him and came closer. Suddenly, he lost balance and fell inside the well. 

The boy leaned against the walls of the well and started to cry. Then he heard a voice from above: â€œDo not worry! I am here to help youâ€. He looked up and saw a beautiful angel right above the well. The angel asked: â€œDo you remember what your dad said? If you do as your dad tells you, you can prevent yourself from getting into dangerous situations." 

The angel flew away, while the boy felt really grateful. He decided that he would always listen to what his dad said. From that day on, he would never be clumsy around the well again! 

The moral of the story is that it is important to listen to your parents' advice. They know what is best for you, even if it may seem unimportant or uncomfortable at the time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a parrot named Polly who liked to talk a lot. One day, when Lily was playing with Polly, the parrot flew away and got stuck in a tree.

Lily felt helpless and didn't know what to do. She cried out, "Polly, come back! I miss you!" But Polly couldn't hear her.

Just then, a kind man walked by and saw Lily crying. He asked her what was wrong and she told him about Polly. The man climbed the tree and rescued the parrot. When he came back down, he gave Polly a kiss and handed her back to Lily.

Lily was so happy to have Polly back that she gave the man a big hug and said, "Thank you for helping me and my parrot!"

One evening, Jack was walking down the street when he stumbled and fell over. He was very upset but he was obedient and tried not to cry. Suddenly he heard a voice. 

"It's alright young man, here let me help you up."

Jack looked up and saw a kindly old man. He smiled at Jack and helped him stand up again. Jack thanked him for his help.

"You're a very obedient young lad," noted the old man.

Jack beamed with pride. He had been very obedient and not cried like he wanted to do.

The old man then said goodbye and Jack watched him walk away. He was very thankful for the old man's help and finished his walk back home, never stumbling again.

Lily and Max were best friends. They liked to play in the park with their toys. One day, they found a big box near the slide. They wondered what was inside.

"Let's open it!" Max said. He tried to pull the lid, but it was too heavy. "Help me, Lily!"

Lily ran to Max and grabbed the other side of the lid. They pulled and pulled, but the box did not open. They felt something move inside. They heard a loud roar.

"Wow, what is that?" Lily asked. She was scared, but also curious.

"I don't know, maybe a lion!" Max said. He was brave, but also nervous.

They decided to peek inside the box. They lifted the lid a little bit and saw a furry face with big eyes and horns. It was not a lion, it was something else. Something unique.

"Hello, I'm Zee," the creature said. "I'm a zebra-unicorn. I was on a trip to the zoo, but I got lost. Can you help me?"

Lily and Max were surprised, but also happy. They had never seen a zebra-unicorn before. They wanted to be friends with Zee.

"Hi, Zee, we're Lily and Max," they said. "We can help you find the zoo. Come with us!"

They opened the box and helped Zee out. He was very grateful. He followed them to the gate of the park, where they saw a zoo truck. They waved to the driver, who was looking for Zee.

"Thank you, Lily and Max, you are very kind," Zee said. "You are also very unique. I hope we can meet again someday."

He gave them a hug and a lick, then climbed into the truck. Lily and Max waved goodbye, then went back to the slide. They had a new story to tell. They had met a zebra-unicorn.

John woke up early one morning. He was very excited because it was a special day. He had a brand new novel that he was going to try and read. John was only three years old, but he was a very brave boy.

He went to his bedroom and pulled the novel out of his toy box. He opened the book and started to read. Unfortunately it was too complicated for him and he couldn't understand the words. He felt a bit foolish, but this only made him more determined to read it.

John put the book down and looked out of the window. He saw a large tree with big birds flying around. He decided to go outside and explore the tree.

John walked towards the tree and when he got there he noticed something strange. Sitting right on the tree's trunk was a bright green frog. John thought it was so funny! He wanted to take the frog home, even though it seemed a bit foolish. He reached out to pick it up but it hopped away before he could get it.

John smiled as he watched the frog hop away. He looked back at his novel and read the words carefully. By the end of the day, he had read the whole book - and he had learned something new!

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a smart rabbit named Tim. Tim loved to play with his friends. They would run, jump, and kick a ball all day long. Tim was the best at kicking the ball.

One day, while they were playing, they saw a long snake. The snake was not nice. It wanted to eat Tim and his friends. They were very scared. Tim thought of a plan to save his friends.

Tim told his friends to run away and hide. He then took the ball and kicked it very hard at the snake. The ball hit the snake and it went away. Tim and his friends were safe and happy. They knew that Tim was very smart and brave.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She was a very troubled girl, but she had a lot of power inside of her. She didn't know what it was or what to do with it.

One day, she met a man who promised to teach her. He said he could help her understand the power she had within her.

Lily was excited to learn, so she listened very carefully. The man taught her many things. He showed her how to use her power to help others.

Finally, after many lessons, Lily was able to use her power to do great things. She was no longer troubled, but instead happy and grateful. She will never forget the man who taught her how to use her inner power.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She loved to watch the dancers every day. She wanted to be a dancer too, so she asked her mom if she could learn how.

Her mom said yes and took her to a dance class. There she learned all sorts of dance steps. She practiced every day and soon she was the best dancer in town.

On the day of her first dance performance, she put on her clean and shiny shoes. But when she arrived, she noticed that the stage was really dirty. She asked her mom if she could still perform on such a dirty stage.

Her mom said, of course, and the little girl began her dance. She twirled and spun and skipped and hopped. Soon, the audience was clapping and cheering for her.

The little girl smiled, glad she had asked her mom if she could still perform. Now, she is a dancer and everybody knows it!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He loved to build with blocks and make tall towers. One day, he went to the museum with his mom. The museum was big and had lots of things to see. Tim saw dinosaur bones and pretty paintings. But when he went outside, his shoes got dirty in the mud. 

Tim wanted to build something at the museum, but he didn't have any blocks. He looked around and saw some sticks on the ground. He picked them up and started to build a little house for the bugs. It wasn't as tall as his block towers, but it was still fun to build. 

After he finished building, Tim went back inside the museum. He was happy to see all the things again, but he was also excited to show his mom the little house he built for the bugs outside. Even though his shoes were dirty, Tim had a fun day at the museum.
