Ben watched Lila and clapped his hands. He wanted to go next. He waited for Lila to come back. But when Lila came back, she looked sad. She had a scratch on her arm. She said, "Ow, ow, ow! The rope is rough. It hurt me."

Ben felt sorry for Lila. He hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Lila. Do you want a band-aid?" Lila nodded. She said, "Yes, please. And a hug."

Mom heard Lila and Ben. She came to them and saw the scratch. She said, "Oh, no, Lila. That looks painful. Let me help you." She took out a band-aid from her bag and put it on Lila's arm. She kissed it and said, "There, there. It will be better soon."

Lila smiled and said, "Thank you, Mom. Thank you, Ben. You are very kind. I love you both." Ben smiled and said, "I love you too, Lila. And I love you, Mom." Mom smiled and said, "I love you both, too. You are very sweet. Now, do you want to play something else?" Lila and Ben nodded. They said, "Yes, please. Let's play something else." They held hands and ran to the slide. They forgot about the rough rope and the zip line. They had fun in the park.

Once there was a nosy mouse who lived in a house. One day, he wanted to escape the house because it was very noisy. He looked for a way out, but he couldn't find one. Suddenly, he saw a hole in the wall and he quickly squeezed through it. Phew, he was finally free!

The mouse wanted to explore the outside world and have adventures. He was so excited! The mouse skipped through the woods and ran across meadows. He also danced in the sun and whistled in the moonlight.

Finally, the mouse returned home. He was tired and happy from his great escape. He went back through the same hole he went out of and snuggled up in his bed. But the mouse found himself yearning for more adventures outside of his house.

Once upon a time, there was a huge soldier. He had a big, shiny helmet on his head and a green uniform. His boots were strong and shiny.

The soldier stood in the field and he felt brave and strong. He looked around and saw lots of trees, flowers and birds.

Suddenly, there was a loud noise. The soldier remained still. He stood in the same spot for a long time until the noise stopped.

The soldier remained in the field all day. He was very brave and didn't move. As night fell, the soldier finally left and returned home. He was very tired, but happy he had been brave and remained in the huge field all day.

Sam liked to study golf. He watched his dad play golf on TV and learned the names of the clubs and the holes. He also had a toy golf set that he played with in the yard. He wanted to be a good golfer like his dad.

One day, his dad said, "Sam, do you want to come with me to the golf course? I have a lesson with the coach and you can watch and learn."

Sam was very happy and said, "Yes, dad, I want to go!"

They got in the car and drove to the golf course. Sam saw many people playing golf and hitting the ball with different clubs. He also saw the coach, who was a tall and friendly man. He said hello to Sam and his dad and gave them some tips.

"Sam, do you want to try hitting the ball?" the coach asked.

Sam nodded and took a small club from his toy set. He put the ball on the ground and swung the club. But he missed the ball and fell down. He felt embarrassed and sad.

The coach and his dad helped him up and said, "Don't worry, Sam, it's okay. Golf is hard and you need to practice a lot. You are doing great for your age. Just keep studying and trying and you will get better."

Sam felt better and said, "Thank you, coach, thank you, dad. I will keep studying and trying. I want to be a dependable golfer like you."

The coach and his dad smiled and said, "You are welcome, Sam. We are proud of you. You are a dependable son and a good learner. You have a bright future in golf."

Sam hugged them and said, "I love you, coach, I love you, dad. You are the best teachers."

The moral of the story is: study hard, try your best, and don't give up. You will learn from your mistakes and improve your skills. You will also earn the respect and love of your teachers and parents.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who loved to play with packages. He wanted to stay with them all the time and sometimes, he even slept with them!

One day, his parents took him to the park and gave him a soft package. It was special, but he didn't know why! He wanted to stay with it and play with it, but his parents told him that he had to share the package with other children. 

At first, the boy was upset that he couldn't keep the package all to himself, but then he realised that it was much more fun to play with others. When the boy shared the package, he smiled and the other children smiled too.

The little boy learnt an important lesson that day - it's important to share with others and it can even be more fun than keeping something all to yourself.

Once upon a time, there was a happy boy named Jack. He lived in a little blue house with his mom and dad.

One day, Jack was running in the big backyard. The sun was shining and he felt so good. As he ran, he saw something sparkly in the grass. It was a bottle of perfume!

Jack picked it up and he sniffed it. It smelled so nice and he smiled. Then he ran to find his mom.

Jack found his mom in the kitchen and said, "Mom, look at what I found!" She smiled and said, "That's a very nice smell."

Just then, his brother Tommy walked into the kitchen. He saw the perfume and he got jealous. He yelled, "That's not fair! I want some too!" Jack just laughed and ran away with the perfume in his hand.

One day, a chubby cat named Kitty went to the park. Kitty saw a swing and wanted to play on it. Kitty climbed on the swing and started to move back and forth. Kitty was very happy.

A little boy named Timmy saw Kitty on the swing. Timmy said, "Hi Kitty! Can I play on the swing too?" Kitty said, "Yes, Timmy! Let's play together!" So, Timmy and Kitty took turns on the swing. They had lots of fun.

After playing for a while, Kitty and Timmy were tired. They decided to settle down under a big tree. They sat and talked about their fun day at the park. Soon, they both fell asleep, dreaming of more fun days on the swing.

Once upon a time, there was a driver named Bob. He had a very old car and it was not very reliable.

Bob went to the store and he saw a modern car. It was shiny and it looked very nice. He went up to the man at the counter.

"Can I buy this car?", Bob asked. "Yes, of course," said the man.

So Bob bought the car and drove it home. It was much faster than his old car and it was more reliable. He was very excited and happy.

The next day, Bob took the car out for a drive. He was very impressed. He drove it faster and it handled really well. He was very pleased with his new car and he was sure it would improve his life.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was always in an awful hurry. Everywhere she went, she ran!

One day, Jane was running so fast, she didn't see the small hole in the grass and she tripped and fell. Jane scraped her shoulder and it hurt a lot!

Fortunately, Jane had a kind and caring friend called Tom. Tom saw what happened and he said, "Oh no Jane! Be careful next time!" He helped Jane to her feet and gave her a big hug!

Jane was sad she had hurt her shoulder but Tom promised to help. He took her hand and they walked the rest of the way together. He told Jane, "We must be careful around those holes!"

From that day forward, Jane and Tom always took it slow and steady. They laughed and held hands and walked together side-by-side. 

No more hurrying for Jane. She learned to be careful and it was much more fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the mall with her mommy to buy new toys and clothes. One day, they went to the mall and Lily saw a big toy she wanted. But her mommy said they couldn't buy it because it was too expensive.

Lily was sad and started to cry. Other people in the mall saw her crying and she felt embarrassed. Her mommy tried to calm her down but it didn't work. Suddenly, Lily had an idea. She asked her mommy if they could save money so they could buy the toy later. Her mommy agreed and they left the mall.

Over the next few weeks, Lily helped her mommy save money by not buying candy and toys. Finally, they had enough money to buy the toy Lily wanted. She was so happy and her smile increased as she played with her new toy. From then on, Lily learned that saving money was important and it made her feel proud.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a cat named Tom. Tom was a very polite cat. He always said "please" and "thank you" when he talked to others. Tom had a friend named Jerry, who was a mouse. They liked to play together.

One day, Tom found a big bowl of cream in the kitchen. He loved cream so much! He wanted to keep the cream all for himself. So, he thought of a plan to hide the cream from Jerry.

Tom put the cream in a big box and hid it under his bed. He didn't tell Jerry about the cream. But Jerry was very smart. He saw Tom hiding the cream and wanted to have some too.

Jerry quietly took the cream from the box when Tom was not looking. He ate all of the cream! When Tom came back to get his cream, it was all gone. Tom was very sad and upset. He learned that being selfish and not sharing with his friend was not a good thing to do. From that day on, Tom and Jerry didn't play together anymore, and Tom was left all alone.

Gus peeked out of the window, the sunshine was bright and strong. He liked peeking and seeing things beyond the wall. Then he heard a voice, it was his mom calling him. 

"Gus," she said, her voice was rough. "Come down, it's time to go outside". 

But Gus didn't want to go, he just wanted to peek and see what the sunshine brought. But his mom was so insistent, he had to obey her.

Outside the sun was so bright, it almost blinded Gus. He shielded his eyes with his hands, to keep the sunshine away. Then he heard a loud noise, it was coming from the ground. He looked down and saw a big burly man, with a mean looking face. 

The man was rough with Gus, and he dragged him away from the sunshine. Gus struggled and screamed, but the man wouldn't let him go. 

So Gus was taken away from the sunshine, in a bad ending indeed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to read the newspaper with her mommy every morning. One day, when they went outside to get the newspaper, it was very gray outside. Lily asked her mommy, "Why is the sky so gray?"

Her mommy replied, "It's because it's going to rain today, Lily."

Lily was sad because she wanted to play outside, but her mommy had an idea. "Let's print out some coloring pages from the internet and color them together inside!" her mommy suggested. 

Lily was excited about this idea and they printed out lots of fun pictures to color. They had so much fun coloring and talking about the pictures. Lily even made a picture of a gray cat from a coloring page she printed out. From that day on, whenever it was gray outside, Lily and her mommy would print out coloring pages and color them together.

Once upon a time, there was a big palace. It was tall and strong and very pretty. Inside lived a King and Queen. They were very kind and gentle.

One cold winter night, the Queen shivered. She was so cold and the palace was so big it made her shiver even more.

"My dear," the King said, "You must be very cold. Please, let me get you a coat to keep you warm."

The Queen nodded and smiled. "Thank you, my King," she said. 

The King brought her a nice, warm coat. She put it on and stopped shivering. 

The King put his arm around the Queen. He was gentle and they both smiled. It was good to be warm and safe in the palace.

Once upon a time there was a cute bunny. She was an adorable bunny with fluffy fur. She hopped around in the bright field, enjoying the sunshine. The bunny hopped and hopped all day long.

But one day, the bunny felt very, very heavy. So heavy she couldn't move! She tried hopping to see if it would help, but she was so heavy she just couldn't move. What was going on?

The bunny looked around, and saw a big scale nearby. She hopped over to the scale, and saw that it was made for creatures like her! She stepped onto the big scale - and found out she was heavy from eating too many carrots!

The bunny hopped away again, feeling much lighter. She knew to only eat a few carrots in the field, even though they were so yummy! From then on, the bunny was very careful about how much she weighed.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy jelly. It was stuck all the way at the bottom of a deep pool. The jelly was very sad. It wanted to get free! 

Then one day, an brave swan swam down to the bottom of the pool. The swan saw the grumpy jelly, and it knew it had to rescue it. 

The swan pumped its wings as hard as it could and as it flew up, it scooped up the jelly into its wings. Soon, the jelly was rescued from the bottom of the pool and was high up in the sky!

The jelly was so happy that it thanked the swan many times. They both then flew away into the sunset together, never to be parted again.

Once upon a time there were two boys, John and Steve. John loved his flute and played it every day. He found it fit him perfectly and made him feel happy. 

One day all the children in the villagewere celebrating. Everyone was having a great time, so John wanted to show off his flute.

When John wanted to take it out, Steve said "No! That flute is mine." He said it was his special flute for special days.

John felt unhappy. He wanted to show off his flute more than anything. So he decided he would take the flute anyway. Just as he was about to take it, Steve started to cry.

John felt bad. He didn't want to make his friend cry, so he said to Steve: "Let's both celebrate and play our own flutes together".

Steve agreed, and they celebrated with happiness, playing their flutes together, each in perfect harmony.

Timmy was excited. He had been invited to a birthday party. His friend Daisy was having a party and had invited him to come. 

When he got to Daisy's house, he found it filled with balloons and people. There were cakes and presents everywhere. He was so excited. He wanted to play with all the toys.

Daisy saw Timmy and hugged him. She was wearing a pretty dress and had a big daisy in her hair. Timmy was embarrassed because he was wearing his old jeans. But Daisy said they looked nice.

Timmy had a lot of fun at Daisy's party. He drank soda, ate cake and played with Daisy and her friends. When they played pass the parcel, Daisy gave him a special prize - a toy car. Timmy smiled. It was the best birthday party ever.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Ben and Sal. Ben wanted to organize a picnic. So, he asked Sal to join him. Sal said, "Yes!"

Ben started to get everything ready. He layed out a big blanket, picked some wild flowers, and made a waffle for each of them.

When it was all ready, Sal asked Ben, "Did you remember to bring the juice?" Ben looked down, feeling a bit guilty. He replied, "No. I forgot all about it."

But, Sal was not angry with Ben. She said, "That's all right. We can still have a picnic. We can just eat the waffle while we go on a walk."

And that's just what they did. The two friends had a wonderful picnic, even without the juice. And they both agreed that it was one of the best picnics they had ever had!

Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Amy. She was very obedient and did whatever her mummy and daddy told her to.

One day Amy's mummy and daddy decided to take her to a special place. As they walked Amy saw a big dark opening in a hill. They went into it and after walking a while, the tunnel opened out into a huge cave.

Amy was so excited! There were little sparkles of light coming from holes in the cave walls. She wanted to explore so she started walking. She walked and walked until she saw something.

It was a big cave full of animals! They were all happy to see Amy, and she was very excited. She ran around and petted them all.

Amy's mummy and daddy watched and smiled as Amy played. When it was time to leave, Amy said goodbye to all the animals and followed her mummy and daddy. They were so proud of her for being so obedient.

Toby was a careless young boy. He loved to explore the world around him. Today he decided to wear his old red jacket and explore the countryside. He skipped over the hills and ran through the fields.

He soon came across a tall oat field. He watched as the oat swayed softly in the wind. With a smile on his face he decided to explore further. He followed the oat field until he came across a small stream.

Toby found a patch of grass by the stream and sat down. He heard the sound of water running and the oat softly swaying in the wind. He felt so peaceful and content. It felt like he could stay there forever.

Suddenly he could feel something tickling his head. He looked up and saw that hundreds of oat straws had fallen on him. He had been so careless that he hadn't noticed the oat straws falling from the trees.

Toby laughed and brushed the oat straws off his head. Then he jumped up and ran back home, his red jacket billowing in the wind. He had a wonderful day and he now knew the feeling of being surrounded by nature.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to climb high up in the trees in his backyard. One day, he climbed up so high that he got scared and couldn't climb back down. He yelled, "Help! I'm stuck and can't get down!" His mom heard him and came running outside. She saw that Timmy was trapped up in the tree and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. I'll fix this." She got a ladder and climbed up to get him down. Timmy was so happy and hugged his mom. From that day on, he never climbed so high up in the trees again.

Tom and Sue are friends. They like to play in the farm. One day, they see a new animal in the farm. It is a mule. A mule is like a horse, but with long ears and a different tail.

"Hello, mule!" Tom says. "What is your name?"

The mule does not answer. He looks at Tom and Sue with big eyes. He is shy.

"Can we pet you, mule?" Sue asks. She walks closer to the mule. She wants to touch his soft fur.

The mule does not like that. He kicks his legs and makes a loud noise. He runs away from Sue. He is scared.

"Ouch!" Sue says. She falls on the ground. She hurts her knee. She cries.

Tom runs to Sue. He helps her get up. He hugs her. He is sorry.

"Don't cry, Sue," Tom says. "The mule did not mean to hurt you. He is new here. He does not know us. He needs time to be our friend."

Sue stops crying. She nods. She understands.

"Maybe we can give him some food," Tom says. "Maybe he likes apples or carrots. Then he will see we are nice."

Sue smiles. She agrees.

They go to the barn. They find some apples and carrots. They take them to the mule. They put them on the ground near the mule. They wait.

The mule sees the food. He smells it. He is hungry. He walks to the food. He eats it. He likes it.

Tom and Sue watch the mule. They are happy. They see the mule's ears move. They see his tail wag. They see his eyes glow. He is happy too.

"Look, Sue," Tom says. "The mule is glowing. He likes us. He is not shy anymore."

"Look, Tom," Sue says. "The mule is coming to us. He wants to be petted. He is not scared anymore."

The mule comes to Tom and Sue. He lets them pet him. He makes a soft noise. He is friendly.

Tom and Sue pet the mule. They talk to him. They give him a name. They call him Moe.

Moe is a good mule. He likes Tom and Sue. He likes the farm. He is easy to love.

John was very bored. He wanted to do something fun. So he told a lie. He said he had found a diamond. His mom smiled at him and said,"That's wonderful, John. Where did you find it?" 

John lied again. He said he found the diamond in the garden. His mom took him outside to look for it. 

They searched and searched, but the diamond was nowhere to be found. John's mom looked mad. She said,"John, why did you lie? That was wrong." 

John felt guilty. He knew he shouldn't have lied. But it was too late. He had no diamond, and he was in big trouble.

Once upon a time there was a dog called Todd. Todd was very impatient. He wanted something very badly! One day Todd heard someone talking about a battery. He knew that batteries were good for lots of things and he really wanted one.

So Todd went to the shop to try and borrow one. The shopkeeper said no, because Todd could not give him back the same battery. Todd was so disappointed but he didn't give up.

He asked everyone he saw but no one could help him. Todd was about to give up when he noticed a cat with a battery in its mouth. Todd asked the cat politely if he could borrow the battery, but the cat just hissed at him.

Todd was so disappointed but he knew he had to keep trying. Suddenly he noticed a hole in the wall. Todd had an idea. He reached into the hole and pulled out the battery he had been looking for.

He was so happy he that he was able to borrow the battery and use it for whatever he liked. Todd was very proud of himself!

Once upon a time, there were two little bunnies who lived in a big meadow. They loved to play together every day.

One day, the little bunnies wanted to make a special blanket for their mommy. So they went off to collect some soft wool from the nearby sheep. The wool was warm and fluffy and the bunnies were very happy.

They took the wool back to their meadow, and started to make a blanket. They did their best to make a beautiful blanket, but then it started to rain. The rain made the wool wet!

The little bunnies were so sad to see their blanket ruined. But then, the mommy bunny came to the rescue! She hugged them both and dried the wool with a big warm towel. 

Then she finished the blanket and put it on her bed. The little bunnies were so happy and thanked their mommy for serving them in their time of need. The little bunnies cuddled up with the blanket and had a nice warm sleep.

Lily and Max were twins who loved to watch movies. One day, they went to the cinema with their mom and dad. They bought a big bag of popcorn to share.

"Can I have some popcorn, please?" Lily asked Max.

"No, it's mine!" Max said. He was selfish and did not want to share. He held the bag tight and ate the popcorn fast.

Lily was sad and angry. She tried to grab the bag from Max, but he pushed her away. They started to fight over the popcorn.

"Stop it, you two!" their mom said. "You are making a lot of noise and bothering the other people. If you don't share, I will take the popcorn away."

But Max and Lily did not listen. They kept fighting and pulling the bag. Suddenly, the bag ripped and the popcorn flew everywhere. It landed on the floor, on the seats, and on the people.

"Oops!" Max and Lily said. They looked around and saw everyone staring at them. They felt ashamed and sorry.

They rushed to pick up the popcorn and apologize to the people. They realized they had been very rude and selfish. They wished they had shared the popcorn and enjoyed the movie.

They learned their lesson. From then on, they always shared their snacks and toys with each other and with their friends. They became happier and kinder.

Once upon a time there was a big, big tree. Under this tree, there was a soft bed of leaves. One day, a little girl named Lucy decided to take a nap there.

Lucy was very tired, so she closed her eyes and began to lie down. Just then she heard a noise! It was a deaf little bird.

The bird said in a soft voice, "Do you want to be my friend?" Lucy smiled, and said, "Yes, I do!"

The bird flew away and came back with an acorn. He gave it to Lucy and said, "This is a special acorn. It can make any wish come true." Lucy thanked the bird, and said, "I wish for a new swing!"

The bird nodded and flew away. The next day, Lucy woke up and saw a brand new swing under the tree. She hugged the bird and said, "Thank you."

The bird smiled and said, "You are welcome, my friend." From then on, Lucy and the bird were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big orange cat named Kitty. Kitty lived in a small house with a nice family. Kitty loved to play with her toys and her family.

One day, Kitty's favorite toy went missing. She looked all around the house, but she could not find it. Kitty's family saw her looking for her toy and they wanted to help. So, they all decided to join in the search for Kitty's toy.

They looked under the beds, behind the couch, and even in the kitchen. After a long time of searching, Kitty's little brother found the toy under a chair. Kitty was so happy to have her toy back, and she was even happier that her family joined her in the search. They all played together with the toy and had lots of fun.

Once there was a boy. He was very happy and he wanted to learn something new. He went to a special place and he saw something big. It was a guitar! The guitar was heavy.

The boy wanted to learn to play the guitar. So he kneeled down and he looked at it. He wanted to pick it up and try to play it. He put his fingers on the strings and he learned how to make music.

He was so happy! He kept playing and he kept learning. With each song he learnt, he got better and better. He kept playing the guitar until it was time to go home.

The boy said goodbye to his guitar and he went home. He never forgot how he kneeled down, looked at his guitar, and made music. He remembered this day for a very long time.

Once upon a time there was a girl who was very wealthy. One day she was walking in the city when it started to rain. She didn't want to get wet so she tried to find an umbrella.

The girl looked all around but couldn't find an umbrella, until she saw one in the window of a shop. She had enough money to get it so she went inside the shop and asked the shopkeeper.

The shopkeeper said 'Yes, you can have the umbrella'. So the girl took the red umbrella and left the shop.

The girl was very happy with her red umbrella, now she was safe and dry. She thanked the shopkeeper and smiled to herself. Now she could go out and explore the city in the rain with her new umbrella.

Sam was a small rabbit on an adventure. He wandered around in the green fields, looking for fun. Suddenly, he saw something big in the ground. It was a large trap!

"Oh no!" Sam exclaimed. He ran away to safety. 

Sam felt scared. He looked around for help, but there was none. He started to wander again, but he felt worried. 

Suddenly, he heard a friendly voice from above. A big bird was watching him.

The bird said, "Don't worry, Sam. You can fly with me and get away from the trap." 

Sam was so happy! He hopped on the bird's back and they flew away to safety. 

From then on, Sam never wandered too close to a large trap again.

Lily liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was Anna. Anna had a pink sweater that Lily's grandma made for her. Lily always put the sweater on Anna when it was cold.

One day, Lily wanted to go outside and play in the snow. She put on her coat and boots and hat. She also put the sweater on Anna, so she would not be cold. She took Anna with her and ran to the yard.

Lily made a snowman with a carrot nose and a scarf. She put Anna next to the snowman and said, "Look, Anna, we made a friend for you!" She smiled and hugged Anna.

But then, a big dog came running to the yard. The dog saw Anna and thought she was a toy. He barked and jumped and grabbed Anna with his teeth. He ran away with Anna in his mouth.

Lily screamed and cried. She ran after the dog, but he was too fast. She could not catch him. She saw Anna's pink sweater become dirty and torn and heavy with snow. She saw Anna's face become sad and scared and hurt.

Lily fell on the ground and sobbed. She lost her favorite doll. She lost her grandma's sweater. She lost her friend. She was very sad. She wished the dog never came. She wished she never went outside. She wished she could have Anna back.

Once upon a time, there was a family who had a farm. The farm was very special because it was full of wheat. The wheat was golden and it grew every summer. 

One day, the family's tractor broke down. The tractor was not moving and it was very sad. The family didn't know what to do. 

Then the family had an idea. They decided to ask their neighbor to help them repair the tractor. 

The neighbor worked hard. He fixed the broken pieces and the family's tractor was repaired. It was a cold day, but the family was happy. 

Now the family could use their tractor again. They could drive to the wheat fields and reap the wheat. It was a very happy day!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom told him they were going to a special place called a church. Timmy didn't know what a church was, but he was excited to go.

As they walked to the church, Timmy saw lots of people dressed in their Sunday best. They all looked happy and smiled at him. When they got inside, Timmy saw lots of chairs and a big stage. He didn't know what was going to happen, but he was excited to find out.

Suddenly, a man came up to the stage and started talking. Timmy didn't understand everything he said, but he saw lots of people nodding their heads and clapping their hands. The man was talking about being successful and helping others. Timmy didn't know what that meant, but he knew it must be important.

After the man was finished talking, Timmy and his mom left the church. As they walked back home, Timmy thought about what he had seen and heard. He didn't know exactly what it all meant, but he knew that going to church was a special thing and he wanted to do it again.

Once upon a time, there were two worms who wanted to go on an adventure. They decided to come to the woods to see what they could see. 

They looked and looked, but nothing seemed very exciting. Then they found a big hill they wanted to climb.

The two worms started to climb the hill, but it was hard work! They kept trying and trying until they reached the very top. The worms cheered, they were so happy to have been successful!

At the top of the hill, they saw something they had never seen before â€“ a big lake! They swam around and around, until they were so tired that they needed a rest. The two worms curled up in a sunny spot under a tree and soon fell asleep.

The worms had the best time and were so happy that they had come on their adventure. From then on, they often came back to the woods for more adventures!

Once upon a time, there was a sack. Inside the sack was a story. The sack was very angry.

The story was about a boy who liked to play. He often played outside and had lots of fun. But when the sack saw him, it got very angry.

The angry sack started to chase the boy. It ran after him, growling and baring its teeth. The poor boy was scared!

Thankfully, a friendly dog came to the boy's rescue. It barked and scared away the sack. The boy was saved!

The boy ran home and told his mom all about his story. His mom was very glad that the friendly dog had saved him. The boy and his mom lived happily ever after.

Lila and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to run, jump and slide. They had a lot of fun.

But then, they saw a poor thing on the grass. It was a bird. It had a broken wing. It could not fly. It looked sad and scared.

"Oh no!" said Lila. "The poor thing! We have to help it!"

"Maybe we can take it home and rest it," said Ben. "Then it will get better."

They picked up the bird gently and put it in a box. They ran to their house. They showed the bird to their mom.

"Mom, look!" said Lila. "We found a poor thing in the park. It has a broken wing. Can we keep it and rest it?"

Mom looked at the bird. She smiled. "You are very kind, Lila and Ben. But we can't keep the bird. It belongs to the wild. We have to take it to the vet. The vet will fix its wing and let it go."

"OK, mom," said Lila and Ben. "But can we go with you to the vet? We want to see the bird fly again."

"Of course, my loves," said mom. "Let's go now. The bird needs our help."

Once upon a time, there was a big refrigerator in a kitchen. The refrigerator was very comfortable inside. It had cold air and many good foods to eat. One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to make some toast for breakfast. He put the bread in the toaster and turned it on.

Suddenly, Tim smelled something. "Oh no!" he cried. He had forgotten about his toast. It was burning in the toaster. Tim's mom came into the kitchen and quickly turned off the toaster. She took out the burnt toast and threw it away.

"Be careful, Tim," his mom said. "You don't want to burn your food." Tim nodded and promised to be more careful next time. From then on, Tim always remembered to watch his toast, and he enjoyed many more good foods from the comfortable refrigerator.

Joshy was a 3 year old boy who loved to explore and play outside. But one day, it was raining heavily so he could not go outside. It was very gloomy in the house with no one around to cheer him up. Joshy began to feel a strong urge inside him to do something exciting. Suddenly, he shouted out and demanded that his mom put on some music to make him feel cheerful again.

The music filled the room with joy and Joshy started to dance around the house. His mom laughed and clapped, encouraging him to keep going. Joshy's own excitement and urge helped him to forget the gloomy atmosphere. He leapt and twirled, doing all sorts of silly moves, and ended up falling onto the floor with a loud thump. But he was not hurt, he was only filled with joy.

He smiled and ran to his mom, demanding to play outside again. But his mom said it was still raining and he had to stay inside. Joshy was not encouraged by the news, but his urge kept him from being too sad. He kept dancing around and slowly the gloomy feeling faded away.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tom. He was three years old. He was feeling troubled because he had to sit through a long lecture.

Lily likes to use her crayons to make pictures. She draws her family, her dog, and her toys. She also likes to write messages for her friends. She knows some letters and sounds, but not all of them.

Molly and her mom were walking in the park. Molly saw a fat tree. She ran over to it and saw a big, green leaf. Molly reached out her hands and squeezed the leaf. She chuckled when it made a funny sound.

John and Dina were playing in the park. The park had lots of beautiful buildings for them to explore. John and Dina had been best friends for a long time and usually got along well.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to read books, especially her favorite book about a princess. One day, Lily went to the library to borrow a new book. She went home crying and learned that it's important to be careful and responsible with borrowed things.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to learn new things. One day, he saw a big storm outside his window. There was loud thunder and bright lightning. Tim felt a little scared.

Tim's mom saw him and said, "Don't be scared, Tim. The lightning is just light in the sky. It can be loud, but it won't hurt you." Tim listened to his mom and felt better. He wanted to learn more about lightning.

So, Tim and his mom went to the library. They found a book about storms. They read the book together. Tim learned that lightning comes from the sky when it is very cloudy. He also learned that it can make a loud noise, but it is far away.

After they read the book, Tim felt tired. He said, "Mom, I'm tired. Can we go home now?" His mom smiled and said, "Of course, Tim. Let's go home and rest."

They went home, and Tim took a nap. He was happy that he learned about lightning. Now, when he saw lightning, he wasn't scared anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree with lots of yummy fruits. One day, a little girl came to the tree to pick some fruits. She saw some big, juicy prunes at the top of the tree, but they were too high for her to reach. She tried to climb the tree, but it was too tall and scary.

Once upon a time, there was a fast rabbit. He liked to run and play all day. One day, he hurt his paw and needed some tape to make it better. He found some tape and tried to snap it with his teeth, but it was too hard.

From that day on, the rabbit learned to be careful when he played so he wouldn't get hurt again. And he always remembered to use his paws to snap the tape. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a funny clown. He loved to play on the stage and make people laugh. One day, he was juggling some balls and trying to balance them on his nose. But then he slipped and fell down. His nose became smelly because of the balls!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He loved to explore the world. One day, he decided to explore outside in nature. He was happy to see all the fun things around him.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Spot. Spot was very eager to do something special for his family. One day, he had an idea. He wanted to deliver a big surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very tired because he had been playing all day. He wanted to take a nap, but he had a secret. He had a toy that he loved very much, but it was broken.

Once upon a time, there was a small creature. It had eyes that could blink and was very curious. One day, the creature saw a shape far away. It blinked, as it was new and strange and it wanted to learn more.

Ben and Lily liked to play with their toy farm. They had many animals, like cows, sheep, ducks and pigs. They made noises for each animal and moved them around the farm.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy decided to go for a walk to feed the ducks in the pond. She walked calmly and soon came to the pond. Sam woke up feeling glad. He had been especially excited for today. As he got up, he heard his Mom in the kitchen making breakfast.

Once there was a delicate bird. He was a very shy bird and didn't like to meet many people. One day, he met a three-year-old child. The child wanted to introduce the bird to her mom. The bird was scared, but he liked the little girl and trusted her.

"Stop, stop, stop!" she said. She picked up a towel and dried them off. "You need to calm down and settle this. Fighting is not nice. You are brother and sister. You should love each other and play nicely."

She took them to their room and sat them on their beds. She gave them each a hug and a kiss.

"Now, I want you to think about what you did and say sorry to each other," she said. "Then you can go back to the bathtub and play with your boats. But you have to be careful and gentle with them. They are not real boats. They are toys. And toys can break."

She left them alone and closed the door. Tom and Mia looked at each other. They felt bad for what they did. They remembered how much they liked their boats and how much fun they had playing with them. They realized they were silly to fight over a race.

They got off their beds and walked towards each other. They hugged and said sorry.

"I'm sorry, Tom. I didn't mean to break your navy boat. It is a very interesting boat. I like it too," Mia said.

"I'm sorry, Mia. I didn't mean to cheat. Your red boat is a very pretty boat. I like it too," Tom said.

They smiled and held hands. They went back to the bathtub and looked for their boats. They found them both floating on the water. They were not broken after all. They were happy and relieved.

They put their boats back on the water and played with them again. But this time, they did not race. They made up stories and adventures for their boats. They shared and helped each other. They laughed and had fun.

They learned their lesson. They learned to settle their problems and to be kind to each other. They learned to love their boats and their bathtub. And they learned to love each other.

John and Jill were playing in the park. They were having a good time until they accidentally separated from each other. 

"John, where are you?" asked Jill.

John replied, "I'm here," but he was too far for Jill to see him. Jill started to worry. "How will I find you?" she wondered. 

Just then, Jill saw a white sock on the ground. "That must be John's sock," she thought. She picked it up and followed the path it was pointing towards.

She finally found John looking for his sock. "John, I found this white sock. Is it yours?" she asked. 

John smiled. "Yes, it's mine. Thank you for finding it!" 

The two hugged and were happy to be reunited.

Once upon a time, there was a happy mine. Inside the mine were lots of treasure. Every day, the mine held something special.

Once upon a time, there was a modest violin. It was always left all by itself in a corner of a house, and no one ever gave it much attention.

The violin and the child left happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a huge grape. It was so big, it filled up the room! One day, a small boy and a small girl came to meet the grape. They were so excited to meet the grape because it was so big.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw pictures. One day, she drew a perfect house with a mailbox. She wanted to show it to her friend, Tim.

The next day, Tim and Lily played together. They learned that even when things don't go as planned, it's important to be patient and try new ideas. And that's how Lily and Tim became best friends.

Once upon a time there was an ostrich. He was big and strong and he liked to lean against things. He could lean against trees and rocks and even houses.

One day, he was leaning against a tree when he heard a noise. He looked up and saw a lion walking across the desert. The lion was very impressive. He was big, fast and fierce.

The ostrich was scared, so he ran away, but the lion saw him. The lion roared and roared, but the ostrich was too fast. Then the lion stopped roaring, sat down and said:

"Oh ostrich, why do you run away? You are so fast, why don't you stick around and play with me?"

The ostrich thought about it for a moment and said: "Maybe I will play with you. Just give me a chance and I will show you how fast I can run!"

The lion was so impressed with the ostrich's speed that he agreed and they had a wonderful time running and playing together in the desert. They were fast friends and learned that even the biggest and most impressive things can be friends.

Once upon a time there was a child. She was small, but compassionate. She tried her best to be helpful and kind.

The child talked and laughed with the old man. She smiled and asked him questions. It made him feel better and more hopeful. By the time they were done walking, he was much happier.

The child's compassion made the old man feel seen and loved. She had brightened his day and helped him to feel better.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Candy and Bob. Candy had a funny idea. She wanted to put a blob of sauce on Bob's head. It sounded foolish, but Candy kept asking Bob to let her do it. 

Finally, Bob agreed. Candy took out a jar of sauce and held it above Bob's head. She opened the jar and poured the sauce out slowly. It made a gooey mess on Bob's head, and he started to giggle. 

But soon, Candy and Bob noticed something strange. The sauce had started to rot! It was getting all smelly and moldy. When Candy and Bob saw this, they both started to laugh! They laughed until their sides hurt. 

Candy and Bob decided that from now on, they would never put sauce on anyone's head again. They learned that it was foolish to put sauce on someone's head and that it would only rot.

Mia was walking through the park one day when something small and shiny caught her eye. She decided to pull it out of the grass and it was a toy train. She held it up to her face and smiled.

Bob was feeling very thoughtful. He knew he wanted to do something special to make his mom happy. She had been working so hard lately and he wanted to show her how much he loved her. So he set off with a smile and went to work.

Mummy shared the treat with her three year old daughter. They both thought it was very yummy! She was so excited and thanked Mummy for the treat.

But Melissa was brave and had a plan. She picked up some spicy spices from her kitchen and threw them onto the step. Instantly, the step moved with a soft spring sound, and Melissa was able to walk across it.

Just then, a little voice called out to her. It was her mummy, calling from the kitchen. "Melissa," she said. "It's dinner time. Come back in for dinner."

Lily and mom went outside. They saw the rocket and teddy, safe and sound. They saw the star, bright and beautiful. It was attached to the balloon. The aliens gave them the star and the balloon. They said: "Goodbye, Lily. Goodbye, mom. We have to go now. Maybe we will see you again. You are very kind and friendly. We are glad we met you."

"Look, Mom! I found a mint!" Amy said, holding the mint up high. Her mom smiled and said, "That's great, Amy! But remember, we don't eat things we find on the ground."

Amy nodded and kept the mint in her pocket. She continued to spin and play in the park. Soon, she met a little boy named Tim. Tim was sad because he had lost his mint.

"Hi, Tim! I found a mint. Is it yours?" Amy asked. Tim looked at the mint and smiled. "Yes, that's my mint! Thank you, Amy!" he said.

From that day on, Amy and Tim became best friends. They would spin and play together in the fine, sunny park every day, and they always shared their mints with each other.

Once there was a baby boy who was three years old. He was standing in a field and looking around. He saw a piece of paper blowing in the wind. He wanted to get it. He ran over and shook the piece of paper until it was all the way up in the air. After that, he was so excited!

The baby boy was very thoughtful. He wanted to do something special with the piece of paper. So he decided to draw a picture with it. He used a green and blue crayon to draw on the piece of paper. He had lots of fun making the picture.

When he was done, the baby boy shook the piece of paper to make sure all the colors were dry. Then, he was very happy and ran to show his mom his special drawing. She was so proud and gave him a hug. It was a very fun day!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Daisy. She loved going to the store with her mom and dad. 

One day she asked her dad, "Can I buy something at the store by myself?" 

Her dad said "Yes, but only if you tie the knot in the bag properly. Can you do it?" 

Daisy was so excited and said "Yes, I can do it!" 

So off she went, proudly carrying her shopping bag. 

At the store she picked out some cookies and tried to tie the knot in the bag, but it was too hard. She tried again and again, but she just couldn't get it right. 

Soon she became frustrated and started to cry. Then her dad came and showed her how to tie the knot carefully. Daisy finally succeeded and was so relieved. 

The moral of the story is: never give up, even if things seem too hard!

Once upon a time, there was a nosy mouse. His name was Sneeky. Sneeky wanted more than anything to join the animal club in the forest, but they said he was too small.

One day, Sneeky was very curious and he saw a big bone near the lake. He knew it would help him join the animal club!

Sneeky grabbed the bone and took it to the meeting spot. When he got there, all the animals were so surprised to see him. 

Then the leader of the club said, "Sneeky, why are you here with a bone?"

Sneeky replied, "I wanted to join you, so thought the bone would help me!"

The animals laughed and said, "Well, why didn't you say so? Of course you can join us!"

And ever since that day, Sneeky has been a part of the animal club.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the snow. One day, he went outside and it was very cold. He forgot his coat and he started to freeze. His mom said, "Timmy, always wear your coat when it's cold outside. It will keep you warm." 

The next day, Timmy went to a store with his mom. They saw a toy that Timmy really wanted, but it was very expensive. His mom said, "Timmy, we can't buy that toy today. It's too expensive." Timmy was sad, but he understood. 

When they got home, Timmy's mom said, "Timmy, it's important to welcome people into our home. We should always be kind and friendly." Timmy remembered what his mom said and he greeted his dad with a big hug when he came home from work. 

The moral of the story is to always remember to wear your coat when it's cold outside, to understand that some things are too expensive, and to welcome people into your home with kindness.

Mary was playing in the garden. She had her favourite toy car and she was driving it around, around and around.

Suddenly, she heard a sigh. She looked up and saw an old man. He was sitting near the garden, and he looked frustrated.

Mary walked up to him. "What's wrong?" she asked.

Once upon a time, there was a pink mosquito called Tori. She liked to fly outside and explore the world.

Emily was an eager three-year-old girl. She liked to help out at home. One day, she decided to surprise her mommy. She found a big blue bowl. Carefully, she filled it with water and carried it into the kitchen.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy. He wanted to cook something special. So he went to the market to buy yummy ingredients. He bought a small bag of flour, an egg and some butter.

When he got home, he set up his own cooking corner on the kitchen table. He grabbed a napkin to mop up any messes. He was so excited to be cooking.

One day, little Timmy went for a walk with his mommy. The sky was looking very gloomy. Down the street, Timmy saw a beautiful park with a big tree in the middle. At the top of the tree, he noticed a bulb that was shining brightly. 

Timmy asked his mommy why the bulb was in the tree. She explained to him that the bulb lay there to light up the park every night. She showed Timmy how much more cheerful the park looked with the bulb in the tree. 

Timmy was so fascinated that he asked his mommy if he could lay in the tree and admire the bulb. His mommy agreed and lifted Timmy up, so that he could lay in the tree and look at the bulb. 

The bulb kept lighting up the gloomy sky, and before long, Timmy had fallen asleep in the tree. In the morning, when the sun had risen, Timmy's mommy carefully lifted him down from the tree.

They both smiled as the bulb brightly lit up the park for one last time before the sun rose.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted a luxury toy very badly. But her mommy said no. The little girl started to scream. It was very loud. Once upon a time, there was a boy. His name was Jimmy. He liked to dream about flying high up in the sky.

King Bob was a kind ruler who loved his people very much. Everyday he would prepare for something special in his hive. On this particular day he had something special to do.

Ben and Lily liked to play outside. They liked to run and jump and climb. But today, it was raining. The sky was gray and the water was falling. Ben and Lily were sad. They could not play outside.

They looked for something to do inside. They found some old boxes and some crayons. They had an idea. They made a jail with the boxes. They drew bars and locks and keys. They pretended to be cops and robbers.

Ben was the cop and Lily was the robber. Ben caught Lily and put her in the jail. He said, "You are bad. You stole the cookies. You have to stay in the jail." Lily said, "No, I am not bad. I am hungry. Please let me out." Ben said, "No, you have to stay. You have to learn your lesson."

But Lily did not want to stay. She pushed the boxes and made a hole. She crawled out of the jail. She ran to the kitchen. She saw the cookies on the table. She grabbed one and ate it. It was yummy. She smiled.

Ben saw Lily eating the cookie. He was angry. He ran to the kitchen. He said, "Hey, you escaped! You are still bad. You ate another cookie. You are chubby. You have to go back to the jail." Lily said, "No, I am not chubby. I am just a little bit. And I am not bad. I am sorry. I will share the cookie with you." She broke the cookie in half and gave one piece to Ben.

Ben looked at the cookie. He looked at Lily. He was not angry anymore. He was happy. He said, "Thank you, Lily. You are not bad. You are nice. You are my sister. I love you." He took the cookie and ate it. It was yummy. He smiled.

They hugged and said sorry. They decided to play something else. They did not need the jail anymore. They put the boxes away. They looked outside. The rain had stopped. The sky was blue and the sun was shining. Ben and Lily were happy. They could play outside again.

Lily and Tom were best friends. They liked to play with trains. Lily had a big train that made steam. Tom had a small train that did not make steam.

One day, they went to the park with their trains. They saw a boy with a shiny new train. His train made steam and noises. It was very fast and fun.

"Wow, look at his train!" Tom said. "I want a train like that!"

Lily felt jealous. She liked her train, but she thought the boy's train was better. She wanted to play with it.

"Can we play with your train?" she asked the boy.

The boy shook his head. "No, this is my train. You can't touch it."

Lily and Tom felt sad. They went back to their trains.

"Your train is nice, Lily," Tom said. "It makes steam. My train does not make steam."

Lily smiled. She had an idea.

"Tom, I have something to tell you. I recommend you to do this. You can make your train make steam too. You just need some water and a straw."

She showed Tom how to put some water in his train and blow through a straw. The water came out as steam.

They played with their trains happily. They did not care about the boy's train anymore. They were happy with their own trains. They were best friends.

Mother was getting ready to paint. She had a cup full of colorful paint and a big brush. She was going to paint the elderly lady's house.

Once upon a time, there was a doggy named Bob. Bob was very fast and love to race. One day, Bob was out running in the garden, when he saw something shiny in the corner.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a present for her friend, but she couldn't find it. She looked everywhere, but it was nowhere to be found. 

Lily's friend came over to play and asked about the present. Lily told her that she lost it and felt sad. Her friend urged her to keep looking, but Lily didn't think she would find it.

They continued to play and have fun, but then Lily's friend accidentally broke her favorite toy. Lily was upset and didn't know what to do. Her friend apologized and said she didn't mean to break it. 

Lily thought for a moment and then said, "It's okay, accidents happen. You're still my friend and that's what's important." Her friend smiled and they continued to play together, happy and content.

Mum was walking into the living room when she noticed a vase that was very dirty.

"Why is this vase so dirty?", she asked no-one in particular.

Then she saw her three year old daughter sitting on the floor playing.

"Why is the vase dirty?", Mum asked her daughter.

The little girl looked up and said, "I tried to give it a bath and I made a bit of a mess."

Mum smiled and said, "Don't worry, we can fix it. First, can you help me by getting me some paper towels and some warm water?"

The girl nodded eagerly, and soon she was back with a few towels and a bowl of warm water.

Mum took the towels and started wiping the vase. She was almost finished when the little girl said, "Mum, can we freeze it too?"

Mum looked up, surprised. "Yes," she said. "That's a great idea. Let's freeze it."

So Mum and her daughter filled the vase with water, and then placed it in the freezer. They made sure it was good and frozen before taking it out and leaving it to dry.

The vase was now sparkling clean!

Once upon a time there was a little girl who liked to design things. She especially liked to design things out of her old toys. One day, she found a bar of soap and decided to design something out of it. She thought and thought, but couldn't decide what to make.

Just then, her mom walked in and saw the old soap in her daughter's hands. "What are you going to make with that old soap?" asked her mom.

Lucy decided to see if she could make him smile. She waved her hands in the air and snapped her fingers to show him how much fun she was having. After a bit, the judge slowly smiled and he clapped for her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She was excited to play on the swings and slide. When they arrived, Lily saw a lot of leaves on the ground. She picked up a red leaf and showed it to her mom. "Look mommy, pretty leaf!" she said.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny. Jenny liked to explore and find new things. One day she decided to visit a special place. When she got there, smoke was everywhere. Jenny didn't like the smoke, so she quickly ran away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys in the park. One day, she found a small bottle of oil on the ground. It was smooth and shiny.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite toy sword that she liked to play with. One day, Lily's friend, Timmy, came over to play. Timmy saw the toy sword and wanted to play with it too. But Lily didn't want to share her toy.

Timmy asked, "Can I please play with your toy sword?"

The moral of the story is that sharing is important and it's not nice to use a weapon, even if it's just a toy.

Once upon a time, there was a family who went on a holiday. They went to a big beach with lots of sand and waves. The little girl was so excited to build sandcastles and swim in the sea. Her parents were proud of her for being so brave in the water.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who wanted to ride around and explore her neighborhood. She saw that the big kids were riding bikes and wished she could too.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Oliver. He had long hair that he liked to wash with shampoo. Every night his mum would say, "Oliver, stretch your arms to the sky before going to bed!"

Once there was a mommy and a daddy. They were very happy together. But one day they decided to marry. So, they looked for a very special place. When they found it, they put on their best clothes and said "I do!" Now they were married.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. Lily wants to go on the slide, but Ben is scared.

"Come on, Ben, it is fun!" Lily says. "I will go first and show you."

Lily runs to the slide and climbs up the ladder. She sits on the top and smiles at Ben. She slides down fast and laughs.

"See? It is not scary. It is fun!" Lily says. "Now you try."

Ben walks to the slide and looks up. It is very high. He feels his legs shake. He does not want to go on the slide.

"No, Lily, I do not want to. It is too high. I will fall and hurt myself." Ben says.

Lily rolls her eyes. She thinks Ben is stupid. She does not want to play with him anymore.

"You are stupid, Ben. You are a baby. You do not trust me. I am your friend. I will not let you fall. You are missing out on the fun." Lily says. She runs away to play with other kids.

Ben feels sad and angry. He does not like Lily calling him stupid and a baby. He does not like Lily leaving him alone. He wants to show Lily that he is not stupid and a baby. He wants to show Lily that he trusts her. He decides to go on the slide.

He climbs up the ladder slowly. He sits on the top and looks down. He feels his heart beat fast. He closes his eyes and slides down.

He opens his eyes and sees Lily waiting for him at the bottom. She looks surprised and happy.

"Wow, Ben, you did it! You are brave! You are not stupid and a baby. You trust me. I am sorry I was mean to you. Can we be friends again?" Lily says.

Ben smiles and nods. He feels proud and happy. He hugs Lily and says, "Yes, we can be friends again. I am sorry I was scared. You are a good friend. Can we go on the slide again?"

Lily nods and says, "Yes, we can go on the slide again. It is fun!"

They run to the slide and go on it again and again. They laugh and have fun. They are friends. They trust each other. They are not stupid. They are smart.

Once upon a time, there was a happy family living in the jungle. At the end of each week, they would celebrate. They would sing, dance and play all together.

Once there was a young girl called Jane. Jane was playing in the garden with a new tool. She picked it up and was about to use it, when suddenly the tool began to tremble. Jane was a bit scared, so she quickly put the tool down. 

Then, Jane heard a voice coming from the tool. It told Jane that it was frightened and needed help. Jane thought long and hard and finally came up with an idea. She hurried inside and came out with a big bucket of soapy water and a clean cloth. 

Jane gently wiped the tool down with the cloth, and then cleaned it with the soapy water. As Jane cleaned the tool, the trembling stopped. The tool thanked her and told her it was feeling much better now. 

Jane was very pleased and together they went back outside to play. Jane smiled as she looked at the clean shiny tool. It was now her best friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she saw a big house with a tall chimney. She wondered what was inside the chimney, so she went closer to examine it. 

Lily looked up and saw a little bit of light coming from the top of the chimney. She thought it was magical and wondered where the light came from. She decided to climb up the chimney to find out. 

It was a long and tiring climb, but Lily finally made it to the top. She looked around and saw that the light was coming from a small bird's nest. Once there was a girl named Henry. She lived in a child's room and enjoyed painting a lot. One day, Henry wanted to paint a number. She was very anxious to see what it would look like.

The next day Henry came back with what she thought was a better painting. But her parents weren't impressed, and they said it still wasn't good enough. Henry was so frustrated, she started to cry.

Her mom comforted her and said "Henry, painting is like a journey. It's important to take your time and keep trying. It's not about the final painting, it's about the effort you put in along the way."

 Henry was sad, but she tried to take her mom's advice. She kept painting and finally made a picture her parents liked.

The moral of the story is to not be anxious when trying something new and to keep trying, even if something doesn't turn out the way you want.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was three years old. Every day she asked her Mama to add sugar to her food.

The little girl held the plate carefully in her hands. She sprinkled a bit of sugar on top of all her food. It was delicious.

The little girl was very careful with her plate of sugar. She knew it was fragile and she didn't want to break it.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to help their mom and dad with chores. One day, mom asked them to put their plates and cups in the dishwasher after lunch. Tom and Lily said yes and ran to the kitchen.

But when they got there, they saw a big pile of toys on the floor. They forgot about the dishwasher and started to play with the toys. They had fun with the cars, the dolls, the blocks and the puzzles. They did not hear mom calling them.

Mom came to the kitchen and saw the mess. She was not happy. She asked Tom and Lily, "Did you put your plates and cups in the dishwasher like I asked you?"

Tom and Lily looked at each other. They knew they did not do what mom said. They felt bad. They wanted to be honest.

Tom said, "Mom, we are sorry. We forgot. We saw the toys and we wanted to play. We did not mean to make you angry."

Lily said, "Yes, mom, we are sorry. We will put our plates and cups in the dishwasher now. And we will clean up the toys too. Please forgive us."

Mom smiled and hugged them. She said, "Thank you for being honest, Tom and Lily. I forgive you. But next time, please remember to do your chores first, and then you can play. OK?"

Tom and Lily were playing in the yard. They had a big box and some old clothes. They wanted to make a fort.

"No, Tom, that's not how you do it," Lily said. She took the jacket and the skirt from him. She showed him how to zip them along the edges. "See, like this. Now we have a wall."

Tom nodded. He looked for more clothes to zip. He found a pair of pants with a zipper. He zipped them to the jacket and the skirt. "Look, Lily, another wall!"

Lily smiled. She found a hat with a zipper. She zipped it to the top of the pants. "Now we have a roof!"

They crawled inside their fort. They felt cozy and happy. They pretended they were in a castle.

But then they heard a loud noise. It was Dad. He was fixing the fence. He had a hammer and some nails. He was banging and banging.

Tom and Lily looked at each other. They felt embarrassed. They realized their fort was made of old clothes. They didn't want to wear them anymore.

They unzipped their fort. They took off the clothes. They ran to their room. They put on clean clothes.

They decided to play something else. They didn't want to zip clothes anymore. They learned their lesson.
