What was it? It was a little mouse! The mouse ran all around Amy's room and Amy wanted to catch it. She closed the door so the mouse couldn't get away. She wanted the mouse to be her friend. She said, "That mouse is mine!" She opened the door slowly and chased the mouse. She was so fast. She caught it in her hands and said, "I caught you!" But then she shut the door and opened it again quickly. The mouse was gone! That was why she had to shut the door so quickly. Now, Amy and the mouse were friends forever.

Ben and Lily were playing in the sand. They had a big bucket and a small bucket. They filled the big bucket with sand and made a castle. They filled the small bucket with shells and made a fence.

A man came to the beach. He had a cart with many things. He saw Ben and Lily's castle and fence. He liked them very much. He said to Ben and Lily, "Hello, little ones. Do you want to sell me your bucket and shells? I will give you money for them."

Ben and Lily looked at the man. They liked their bucket and shells. They did not want to sell them. They said, "No, thank you. We want to keep our bucket and shells. They are ours."

The man was not happy. He said, "But I need them for my cart. They are very pretty and shiny. I will give you more money for them. Please, sell me your bucket and shells."

Ben and Lily shook their heads. They said, "No, thank you. We want to play with our bucket and shells. They are not for sale."

The man was angry. He said, "Fine, then. I will take them anyway." He grabbed the bucket and shells from Ben and Lily. He put them in his cart. He ran away.

Ben and Lily were sad. They cried. They said, "He took our bucket and shells. He was mean. We want our bucket and shells back."

A lady saw what happened. She was kind. She said to Ben and Lily, "Don't cry, little ones. I saw what he did. He was wrong. He should not take your bucket and shells. I will help you get them back."

She ran after the man. She caught him. She said, "Stop, you thief. Give back the bucket and shells to the children. They are theirs. You cannot take them."

The man was scared. He said, "I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I was greedy. I wanted to sell them. Here, take them back. I will not bother them again."

The lady took the bucket and shells from the man. She gave them back to Ben and Lily. She said, "Here you go, little ones. Here are your bucket and shells. They are yours. You can play with them. I'm sorry he took them from you."

Ben and Lily were happy. They smiled. They said, "Thank you, thank you. You are nice. You helped us. We are glad you are here."

They hugged the lady. They hugged their bucket and shells. They played in the sand. They made a new castle and fence. They had fun.

One day, a little girl named Ava decided to start her own garden. She was so excited to improve her garden. She dug the soil and planted lots of different flowers.

She watered the plants every day and waited for them to grow. Finally, two weeks later, the flowers started to blossom. 

Ava was so proud of her work. She asked her mother to come outside and take a look. Ava said, "I improved this garden by myself!"

Her mother was very impressed. She said, "I'm so proud of you Ava. You worked really hard ".

But as the months passed, something strange started happening. The flowers had a very bitter taste.

Ava was sad. She thought to herself, "perhaps I need to improve the soil to make the flowers taste better".

So she started to research better ways to improve her garden. After a few months she found the right solution and added some soil amendments to make the flowers taste sweet. 

After a few short weeks, the flowers started to taste much better. Ava was happy again and she sang with joy. Her garden continued to improve and she was so proud of her hard work!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on journeys with her family. One day, they decided to go on a journey to the park. The park was very popular, so there were lots of people there. 

Lily's mom told her to mind her manners and be polite to everyone. Lily played on the swings and had lots of fun with the other kids. She even made a new friend! 

After a while, it was time to go home. Lily was sad to leave the park, but she was happy she had such a fun journey with her family. She fell asleep in the car, dreaming of the next journey she would go on.

Once upon a time, in a dark forest, there lived a wise old owl. The owl had a lot of wisdom. All the animals would come to the owl for help when they had a problem. They would bow to the wise owl and ask for advice.

One day, a little rabbit came to the wise owl. The rabbit was very sad. He had lost his toy in the dark forest. He bowed to the wise owl and asked for help. The wise owl thought for a moment and told the little rabbit to follow the path in the dark forest.

The little rabbit followed the path and soon found his toy. He was very happy. He went back to the wise owl and bowed to thank him. The wise owl smiled and said, "Remember, even in the dark, there is always a way to find what you are looking for."

From that day on, the little rabbit never felt scared of the dark forest again. He knew that with the wisdom of the wise owl, he could find his way through any problem.

Billy and his family were walking in the woods one day. The sun was shining and the sky was blue. Everything was going great until suddenly, a huge thunder filled the sky. Billy was scared. He grabbed his mom and hugged her tight.

His mother said, "Don't worry, Billy. It's just thunder. It can't hurt you."

Billy was still scared, but he started to feel better.

Mom and dad started to get worried. They wanted to get back home. Then suddenly, it started to rain. Huge drops of rain came down from the sky. It got really dark and soon it was pouring.

Mom and dad grabbed Billy's hand and they all ran back home together. When they got home, they were all safe. Billy was feeling better again. Everything was back to normal.

Mary was a little girl, who was 3 years old. She loved playing outside and looking at the beautiful flowers. One day, Mary wanted to go into the bathroom, so she asked her mom if she could go.

"Yes Mary," her mom said, "but remember to pray first before you enter the bathroom."

So Mary stopped and said a short prayer. Then she opened the door and walked in. 

Once inside, Mary suddenly felt frustrated. She couldn't understand why the bathroom wasn't as fun as the flowers outside. That's when Mary remembered her mom's words - that she had to pray before entering the bathroom.

She began to think about all the things she was thankful for - like the bright sun and the buzzing bees. She smiled and actually started to feel better.

By the time Mary had finished her prayer, the bathroom felt much more cheerful and inviting. She had learned that sometimes all it takes is a little bit of prayer to help calm and centre yourself.

Lily wanted to wear her pink dress to the park. She liked how it had flowers and ribbons on it. She thought it was the prettiest dress ever. But her mom said no. She said it was too cold and windy for a dress. She said Lily had to wear her jeans and sweater instead.

Lily was very sad and angry. She did not want to wear her jeans and sweater. She wanted to wear her pink dress. She said to her mom, "No, no, no! I want my dress! My dress is nice! I hate jeans and sweater!"

Her mom said, "Lily, stop. You are being silly. You will be cold and sick if you wear your dress. You will suffer. You have to wear warm clothes. Now, hurry up. We have to go soon."

Lily did not listen. She ran to her room and put on her dress. She hid under her bed and waited for her mom to leave. She thought she was very smart and fast. She thought she could sneak out and go to the park by herself.

But she was wrong. Her mom found her under the bed. She was not happy. She said, "Lily, what are you doing? You are being naughty. You cannot go to the park by yourself. You have to listen to me. You have to wear your jeans and sweater. Come on, let's go."

Lily cried and cried. She did not want to go. She wanted to wear her dress. She did not care if she was cold or sick. She did not care if she suffered. She only cared about her dress. She said, "No, no, no! I want my dress! My dress is nice! I hate jeans and sweater!"

Her mom sighed and said, "Lily, I love you. But you have to learn. You cannot always have what you want. You have to think about what is good for you. You have to be brave and strong. You have to wear your jeans and sweater. They are nice too. They will keep you warm and cozy. Trust me, you will have fun at the park. Now, please, let's go."

Lily did not want to go. But she saw her mom's face. She saw her mom was sad and tired. She saw her mom loved her. She felt sorry for her mom. She said, "Okay, mom. I will wear my jeans and sweater. But can I bring my dress with me? Maybe I can wear it later."

Her mom smiled and said, "Sure, Lily. You can bring your dress with you. Maybe you can wear it later. But only if it is sunny and warm. Deal?"

Lily nodded and said, "Deal, mom. I love you."

Her mom hugged her and said, "I love you too, Lily. Now, let's go to the park."

Once upon a time there were two friends who loved to play. Every day, they would get together in the garden and have lots of fun.

One day, they decided to do something special. They wanted to fly! They gathered some leaves, tied them together and made a cool little airplane.

The two friends hopped in and flew away into the sky. They waved to all the birds and waved to people on the ground.

Suddenly they heard a loud noise. It was a horn! A big hot air balloon was flying right next to them. The friends waved and shouted hello to the people in the hot air balloon. Everyone was having so much fun.

The friends flew higher and higher until they could not see the ground anymore. But they never forgot their cool flying adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit. He had a long, fluffy tail. One day, the rabbit heard a noise outside his hole in the ground. He looked out and saw a fox. The fox was very selfish, and he wanted to take the rabbit's tail for himself.

So the fox said, "I'll give you three coins if you give me your tail." The rabbit was so sad. How could he give away his precious tail? But he was very poor and he needed the coins, so he said yes.

The fox was so happy. He took the three coins and the rabbit's tail. He ran away with it, wagging his own tail behind him. The rabbit was very sad and he wished he had been less selfish with his tail.

Lenard was an adventurous boy. He loved to explore and have new experiences. Every day he imagined new places he could go and things he could see.

One morning, Lenard decided to go on a journey. He packed his luggage and was ready to go. His mom wished him luck and told him to be careful.

Lenard set off on his journey. He wandered around the town and eventually arrived at a far away land. There he tried new food and explored different places. He was having a great time.

But one day, Lenard saw something he shouldn't. He decided to ignore it and kept going on his adventure. However, he soon realized what a mistake he had made.

He turned to go back home, but it was too late. He felt a mixture of surprise and regret. He had made a mistake and he knew he couldn't go back to make it right. 

Lenard wanted to go back home but he never made it. He was never able to make up for his mistake and eventually, he had to say goodbye to all his dreams of adventure.

One day, Sally and her dad went to the cliff. It was very high and very white. Sally looked down and was a little scared.

Her dad said, "Let's peek over the edge." He held Sally's hand and they both peeked over the edge.

Sally gasped. She saw the birds flying below and the clouds floating above. It was so beautiful.

Then Sally's dad said, "Let's go explore the white cliff. It looks like an adventure!" So they explored the white cliff and it was a lot of fun.

At the end of the day, Sally and her dad looked back at the white cliff. Sally said, "Thank you for taking me to the cliff, Daddy. It was a great adventure!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Susie. She was only 3 and on a sunny day she decided to go outside and explore.

Susie saw a huge bubble and she went to investigate. She thought it was weird and so she got closer to have a better look. Suddenly, the bubble started to shake! She was scared and said â€œhelp!â€

Then, a cheerful voice spoke, â€œdonâ€™t worry Susie, itâ€™s me!â€ An old lady appeared from inside the bubble. She explained that she was a magical bubble lady who lived in the bubble and could make it shake with her magic wand.

Susie thought this was really weird, but she was happy to meet the bubble lady and even happier when the old lady gave her a magic wand of her own. She waved it around and a huge bubble appeared in the garden, which Susie could go inside and play with. 

Susie and the bubble lady explored the garden together and she made lots of interesting bubbles that they could play with. From then on, Susie and the bubble lady were great friends!

Once upon a time there were two friends, a fox and a wolf. The fox was very small and charming. One day, the wolf saw a gun he wanted to have, so he told the fox to give it to him. The fox shook his head and said, "No, it is wrong to take things that do not belong to you." The wolf was very unhappy, and was about to leave in a huff when the fox spoke again. He said, "But if you are kind, you will receive kindness in return. If you leave this gun here, I will find something special to give you!" The wolf thought about this and decided that he would leave the gun and accept the fox's kind gesture. The fox was very happy and gave the wolf a gift of a necklace. When the wolf saw how kind and charming the fox was, he was glad he had left the gun and allowed his friend to give him a very special present.

The moral of the story is that when we leave something that does not belong to us and are kind, we will receive kindness in return.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the rain. One day, her mom asked her to come inside because it was wet outside. 

Lily said, "But mommy, I love the rain! Can't I stay outside and play?"

Her mom replied, "I know you love the rain, but you need to behave and come inside. You don't want to get sick."

Lily sighed but knew her mom was right. As she walked inside, she looked up at the sky and saw the earth getting wetter and wetter. She couldn't wait for the rain to stop so she could go back outside and play again.

Once upon a time, there were two playful rabbits named Floppy and Mopsy. They loved to hop around and play together in the green grass. One day, they found a big hole in the ground.

Floppy said, "Look Mopsy, a hole! Let's go explore it!"

Mopsy replied, "I don't know, it looks scary."

But Floppy was brave and said, "Don't be scared, I'll protect you."

As they went down into the hole, they saw a mean rat. The rat wanted to fight them, but Floppy and Mopsy worked together and scared the rat away. They were happy they had each other to help. From then on, they always played together and never went into any scary holes alone.

Tommy was walking in the park. He really liked the park because there were so many fun things to do. He saw a fence and he thought it looked very interesting. He jumped up to see what was on the other side. When he looked, he saw a regular garden. He thought this was the most beautiful garden he had ever seen. He wanted to explore it more, so he tried to find a way through the fence. He walked around it and tried to find an opening. But no matter how hard he looked, he couldn't find one. So, he just stood and looked at the beautiful garden he couldn't get to. He was so sad, but at least he got to see it. He promised himself he would come back and find a way to get through the fence.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was very sad because she spilled her favorite sauce on the floor. She started to weep and cry.

Her mom came over and saw how sad Sarah was. She hugged her and told her a charming story about a magical unicorn. Sarah smiled and felt better.

The mom then asked Sarah if she wanted to make some more sauce. They went to the kitchen, and Sarah helped her mom make some yummy sauce.

When the sauce was ready, they shared it together with a big hug. Sarah was no longer sad and was happy again. 
The end!

Mum and Dad took their little girl out for a walk. The sky had gone grey and the wind was getting stronger. Suddenly, lightning struck and little girl became scared.

"Mum, what was that?" asked the little girl.

"It's lightning," said Mum. "But don't worry, we're safe."

The wind blew and the sky grew darker. The little girl started to cry, but Mum and Dad tried to cheer her up.

Suddenly, lightning struck again, brighter this time and closer. The little girl screamed and Mum and Dad picked her up and ran. They ran and ran until they found shelter.

But the lightning followed them and it became too much for the little girl. She closed her eyes and the lightning struck one last time, taking her away. Mum and Dad cried and held each other close, mourning the loss of their little girl.

Wendy and Mommy wanted to make something special. So they went to the store to buy supplies. They got paint, markers and sparkling paper.

When they got home, Wendy and Mommy started to decorate. They decorated the walls with the paper and the markers. Then they painted the table with a bright rainbow. It looked so beautiful!

They made a wishing jar too! Wendy and Mommy put coins in it to make it look rich. Wendy decided to use the money inside to help a patient.

When they finished decorating, Wendy felt so proud of her work. She could not wait to show it to Daddy. He was very proud too and told Wendy that she did a wonderful job decorating.

Jenny was getting ready for her big trip. She was so excited and enthusiastic to go. She had been counting down the days until she could leave.

Jenny's mom came into her room and asked her what she was doing. Jenny told her she was trying to pack. Her mom smiled and gave her a hug.

Then, Jenny's dad said, "Let me give you a rub before you go." Jenny smiled and said yes. Her dad gave her a nice long rub on her back. She felt so relaxed.

Finally, Jenny finished packing and was ready to go. She was so full of joy and enthusiasm that she almost forgot her suitcase. She was finally off on her big adventure.

One day, two boys were out searching for something special. They ran through the garden, over the bridge and around the trees, but nothing seemed special enough. Suddenly one of the boys noticed something shiny in the grass. He bent down and picked up a shining strip that sparkled in the sunshine.

The two boys grinned at each other. They had found something very popular! Taking the strip, they ran back and showed it proudly to all their friends. Everyone oohed and ahhed at the beautiful strip and it became the boys' most prized possession.

The boys searched everywhere they went and took the strip whenever they went on an adventure. Everywhere they went, their strip was the most popular!

Once upon a time, there lived a family with two children. They lived in a big, happy house.

The oldest was Bob and he was 6 years old. His little sister was 3 and her name was Sue. Every night, Bob and Sue would go to bed. 

One night, Bob had a plan. He closed his eyes and thought long and hard until he had the perfect plan. He then opened his eyes and whispered it in Sue's ear:

"Let's make a surprise for Mummy!" 

Sue was so excited, she jumped up and down in her bed. Together, they made a plan to make a very special bracelet for their Mummy.

The next day, the two children worked hard, gathering buttons, ribbons and beads from the house. Bob showed Sue how to tie the buttons together with a piece of string until she learnt how to do it very well. They made a beautiful, cute bracelet with all sorts of colours and textures and it was perfect for their Mummy. 

When Mummy finally saw the bracelet that night, she was very happy. She hugged and kissed both of them and thanked them for their thoughtfulness.

Bob and Sue both smiled, happy to see their plan worked out so well. Mummy loved her bracelet and Bob and Sue loved giving it to her. 

The End!

Once there was a strong rabbit who loved to bounce. He bounced so high he could see the whole world. Every day he would bounce and be so happy.

One day the rabbit saw a pair of scissors laying on the ground. He hadn't ever seen scissors before. He looked so close and could see how sharp they were. Suddenly, he had a great idea. He decided he was going to use the scissors to help him bounce even higher!

The rabbit took the scissors and hopped back to his favorite spot. He held the scissors in his paws and got ready to jump. And jump he did! He felt like he was going higher and higher than ever before. He was so excited he could hardly contain himself.

Eventually the rabbit landed safely on the ground. He put the scissors down and gave himself a big hug for being so brave and strong. From that day on, the rabbit would always use the scissors to help him bounce higher!

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and her little girl. Mommy wanted to cook dinner so she told the little girl to come with her to the kitchen.

The little girl was so excited because she had never been to the kitchen before. Everything looked so amazing!

Finally, Mommy and the little girl arrived at the stove. Mommy said to her little girl, â€œI need you to lead me to the stove so I can cook dinner. Can you show me the way?â€

The little girl smiled and said, â€œYes, Mommy!â€ She led the way to the stove and Mommy was so proud.

â€œYou are so amazing!â€ she said to her little girl. 

The little girl smiled and was so happy that she was able to help her mommy. She was glad that she could make dinner together with her.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted a cookie. He asked his mom, "Can you bring me a cookie, please?" His mom was very reliable, so she said, "Yes, I will bring you a cookie."

Tim was very happy. He waited for his mom to bring the cookie. When his mom came back, she had a big cookie in her hand. "Here is your cookie, Tim," she said with a smile.

Tim took the cookie and said, "Thank you, Mom!" He ate the cookie and it was very yummy. Tim was glad that his mom was always reliable and could bring him a cookie when he asked.

Once upon a time, there were two bears, Bob and Jenny. Bob was a young bear, and Jenny was an old bear. They were discussing the summer day.

"The sun is shining brightly and it's making the blossoms in the trees sparkle," said Jenny.

Bob looked at the ground and noticed the dust near his paws. "What's this dust?" he asked Jenny, pointing towards the dirt.

Jenny smiled. "That dust is from the old path," she said. "It's been here for many, many years."

Bob smiled back. He thought about the years that had gone by and how young he still was.

"Let's go find some new adventures!" he said with excitement.

And so they did. They explored the woods and enjoyed their summer day together.

Every morning, the nosy little mouse came out of his hole. He wanted to explore the world and see what was happening. So he ran around the garden, looking high and low.

But one day, the mouse heard a noise. It was different from anything he had heard before. In the middle of the garden, a cage had been opened and a beautiful blue bird had been released!

The mouse stopped and watched in amazement as the bird flew up into the sky and away. He couldn't believe his eyes!

The mouse was so happy for the bird and wished he could feel that same kind of freedom. But he knew he had to stay in his hole.

But, every morning, the nosy little mouse still remembers the blue bird he saw that day. He knows that the sky is full of possibilities and the world is waiting to be explored!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jake. Jake was three years old and very curious about things. One day, Jake found a shiny penny on the ground. He asked his mum what it was.

His mum said, "that is a penny. It's a very small coin that people use to buy things."

Jake said, "That's cool! Can I buy something with it?"

Mum explained, "Yes, you can buy something yummy with it, like an ice cream. But it might not be enough for a big ice cream. Maybe you can buy some chocolates instead."

Jake was thrilled. He said, "Yay! Can we go to the supermarket now?"

His mum smiled and said, "Sure! Let's go get you some yummy chocolates!"

So Jake and his mum went to the supermarket and Jake bought some chocolates with his penny. He was so excited to enjoy his yummy treat!

One day, Joe was in his bedroom looking for something. He was searching everywhere. Under his bed, he found a twisty screw. 

Joe was so excited! He thought it was a special thing, so he took it to show his dad. His dad was doing some work on the roof, so his mom told Joe to take it to him.

Joe ran outside, but as he got closer, he heard loud noises coming from the roof. He peeked up and saw dad struggling. He kept dropping the screw he was trying to use and things were becoming very chaotic.

Joe figured he could help! He ran up the ladder and held up the twisty screw he'd found. His dad was so relieved! He quickly took the screw and started to work. But as he added the twisty screw, the roof came crashing down â€“ it was disgusting. 

Joe's dad was very sad. He wished Joe had kept the twisty screw in his room, then none of this would have happened. Joe felt terrible and luckily no one was hurt. But he had learned an important lesson: sometimes itâ€™s best to leave things alone.

Once upon a time, there was a playful kitten named Lily. She loved to chase after butterflies and climb on chairs. One day, Lily's owner brought home a big box. Lily was curious and went to investigate. 

Inside the box, there was a present wrapped in shiny paper. Lily wanted to know what was inside, so she started to paw at the paper. She was having so much fun playing with the wrapping that she didn't notice her owner watching her. 

Finally, Lily managed to unwrap the present and found a new toy to play with. She was so happy and grateful to her owner for the gift. From that day on, Lily loved to play with her new toy and would always remember the fun she had with the wrapping paper.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Ann. She was full of energy and loved to explore the world with her mom.

One day, Ann and her mom went for a walk in the jungle. Ann saw all kinds of funny animals, and she laughed when she saw the monkeys swinging from the trees. Then, she heard a loud noise, and she thought it was the funniest thing ever!

Ann asked her mom, "What was that noise?" Her mom replied, "That was a crazy bird!" Ann laughed and laughed. "That was so funny!" 

Then, she spotted a bright butterfly. She chased after it and laughed as it flew through the jungle. 

Ann and her mom had a wonderful time in the jungle. They laughed and explored until the sun went down. That day was so full of fun and adventure. Ann couldn't wait to come back to the jungle again.

One day, there were two children, Bud and Ben. They wanted to find something special to do.

Bud said, "Let's bury the turkey!"

Ben asked, "What's a turkey?"

Bud explained, "It's a big bird! We can bury it in the ground and dig it up again!"

So they went outside. It was a gloomy day. They found a spot to bury the turkey. Ben held the turkey while Bud dug a big hole. When the hole was ready, Bud placed the turkey into it and then filled the hole back up with dirt. They both said goodbye to the turkey and covered it up with some leaves.

Then they ran off to play, feeling very happy.

Once there was a little girl named Daisy who was very lonely. One day, Daisy was playing in her garden when suddenly she started to tremble.

She looked around, but she couldn't see anything that would make her afraid. But then she noticed something sparkling on the ground. It was a beautiful bracelet! She was so excited; she picked it up and put it on her wrist.

But then, to Daisy's surprise, the bracelet started to tremble. At first, Daisy was scared. But then she realised that the bracelet was shaking because it was lonely and wanted a friend too.

So Daisy held the bracelet and both of them stopped trembling. Daisy was so happy, she had a friend! From then on, Daisy and her bracelet were the best of friends, and neither of them ever felt lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted to play. She found a marble in her toy box and it was so shiny! She held it in her hand and it felt comfortable.

After that, she got some friends together and went to the garden. She had the marble in her pocket and wanted to play a game. Suddenly, the marble began to slip out of her pocket!

She quickly bent down and caught it before it reached the ground. She was so glad that she had managed to catch it! She put the marble back in her pocket and played all day with her friends.

At the end of the day, the little girl was tired and happy. She put the marble back in her toy box and went home.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Mia and Joe. Mia was 3 years old and Joe was 4. One Tuesday, they stepped out of their house to explore the town. It was mild and the sun was shining.

Mia and Joe decided to go the park to play. It was the best day they ever had. they laughed, they ran and they played with their toys. 

But then they started to fight. They both wanted the same toy, and they argued and shouted. They stopped having fun.

That's when Joe realized something. He said "Let's share the toy and have twice as much fun together". So Mia and Joe agreed to share their toy and that made them both very happy.

Mia and Joe learned a valuable lesson that day. They realized that it was better to share and work together than to fight. The moral of the story is that sharing is caring!

Once upon a time there was an old man with a big problem. His pants were very hairy! Whenever he tried to put them on, the hairs would make him itchy and uncomfortable.

One day, a little girl saw the old man scratching and asked, "Can I help you?" The old man smiled and said, "Yes please! Could you help me get my pants on?"

The little girl agreed, so they both worked together. She carefully brushed away the hairs until the pants were nice and smooth. Then, the old man easily put them on.

The old man thanked the little girl, "Thank you so much! I would never have been able to get my pants on without your help!" The little girl smiled and said, "You're welcome!"

A driver was on a rough road. She had to be careful as the road was uneven and bumpy. Along the way, she noticed her car was making strange noises. She stopped to investigate and realized something was wrong. 

The driver tried to explain the problem to the mechanic, but he didn't understand. In frustration, she decided to go and find help at the garage up the street.

The driver made it to the garage and the mechanic explained that her car needed some repairs. He said it was going to be a hard job, but he vowed to fix it.

She thanked him and waited patiently until he finished the job. After a few hours, the car was fixed. She paid the mechanic and drove away, relieved that her car was now running smoothly.

Once upon a time, Simon and Sam were two best friends. They liked to play together every day. One evening, as the original sunset slowly painted the sky, Simon said, "I know! Let's raise our arms and watch the sun go down!"

So Simon and Sam smiled and held their arms up towards the sky and watched the sun go down. When the sun finally disappeared, Simon screamed, "That was fun!"

Sam then replied, "Yes, let's do that again tomorrow when the sunset comes!" 

And that's what they did. Every evening, they would look forward to the sunset and raise their arms together to watch the sun go down.

Once there was a very old house. It was so old that its paint was starting to fade and peel away. The windows were open and the wind blew inside.

One day, a gust of wind blew over a paint can in the garden. The paint can rolled right into the house. It was so excited to find some colour! 

The paint ran all around the house and over the windows, walls and floor. It was everywhere! The house was so happy to be colourful again.

But the next day, it started to rain. The house began to suffer as the paint started to drip, run and mix together. The house was hurt and all its colours disappeared again.

The old house was no longer colourful, but at least it was open to the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to explore the world around her. One day, she found a tiny bug on the ground. She wanted to see it up close, so she asked her mom for her microscope.

Her mom helped her set it up and Lily carefully put the bug under the microscope. She examined it closely and saw all the little details she couldn't see before. It was so cool!

Later that day, Lily's mom gave her a cookie. But when she took a bite, she realized it was spoiled. She didn't like it at all and told her mom. Her mom said sorry and gave her a fresh cookie instead. Lily was happy again and went back to examining the world around her.

Once upon a time, there was a big, easy chair. It was a pastel color. The chair was very nice and soft. 

One day, a little cat found the chair. The cat jumped on the chair and started to sleep. The cat did not want to surrender the chair to anyone else. 

A little dog came to the chair. The dog wanted to sit, but the cat said no. The dog was sad. Then, the cat decided to share the chair. They both sat on the chair and were happy. They did not want to surrender the chair ever again.

One day, there was a brilliant bush. It was the most special ever! 

Jack was walking by and he loved it. He wanted to make it even more special, so he had an idea. He grabbed a stick and began to reverse around it, going backwards in circles.

He was spinning faster and faster, and was having so much fun! He was certainly not getting tired! 

The bush started to sparkle and glitter, it was so beautiful! Everyone stopped to admire it. Even the birds were impressed.
 
The bush was now even more brilliant than ever! Jack was very proud. He had been clever and done something amazing. Now, everyone could admire his masterpiece!

Lily and Ben are twins. They are three years old. They have a baby brother, Max. Max is very small and cute. He likes to sleep and drink milk.

One day, Lily and Ben are playing with their toys. Lily has a doll and Ben has a car. They are having fun. But then, Max wakes up. He starts to cry. He wants to play too.

Mom comes in. She picks up Max and hugs him. She says, "Lily and Ben, can you share your toys with Max? He is your baby brother. He wants to join you."

Lily and Ben look at each other. They don't want to share. They like their toys. They are stubborn. They shake their heads. They say, "No, Mom. These are our toys. Max can't have them."

Mom sighs. She says, "Lily and Ben, sharing is nice. Sharing makes others happy. Sharing shows love. Don't you love Max?"

Lily and Ben think. They love Max. He is their baby brother. They don't want to make him sad. They want to make him happy. They want to show him love.

They nod. They say, "Yes, Mom. We love Max. We will share our toys with him."

They go to Max. They give him their toys. They smile. They say, "Here, Max. You can play with our doll and our car. We will share with you. We love you."

Max stops crying. He grabs the toys. He giggles. He says, "Thank you, Lily and Ben. You are nice. You are my big sister and brother. I love you too."

Mom smiles. She says, "Good job, Lily and Ben. You are good sharers. You are good siblings. I am proud of you."

They all hug. They play together. They are happy.

One day, a bunny hopped into a shop. The shop was big and wide.

The bunny saw a shelf filled with yummy carrots and he thought, "That looks yummy!" He hopped closer and closer to the shelf. 

Then, the shop keeper shouted loudly, "Hey! Don't steal those carrots!"

The bunny said, "I was just going to take one!"

The shop keeper said, "No stealing in my shop! I won't let anyone steal from my wide shelf. Now hop away!"

The bunny hopped away with his ears drooping down. He never wanted to steal from the wide shelf, but he didn't want the shop keeper to be mad at him. 

So the bunny never hopped back to the shop again.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved taking photos with his camera. One day, Timmy decided to take a photo of his cat. He wanted the photo to be successful, so he spent a lot of time setting up the perfect shot.

But just as he was about to take the photo, his cat jumped up and knocked over the camera. Timmy was very sad because his photo was ruined. He decided to try again the next day.

The next day, Timmy tried again to take a photo of his cat. He was very careful and set up the shot perfectly. He took the photo and was very happy because it looked successful. But then, he accidentally deleted the photo from his camera.

Timmy was very upset because he had worked so hard to take a successful photo. He decided to give up on taking photos and went to play with his cat instead.

Once upon a time, there was a human named Timmy. Timmy loved to wear colorful clothes. One day, Timmy went to the park to play. He saw a big slide and wanted to go down it. But when he climbed up, he slipped and fell down. Timmy was sad because he hurt his knee. 

Just then, he saw another human named Johnny. Johnny was wearing a colorful hat. Timmy asked Johnny if he could help him up. Johnny said yes and helped Timmy stand up. Timmy was happy again. 

But then, they heard a loud noise. It was a big dog that got loose from its leash. The dog was not friendly and started to chase them. Timmy and Johnny ran as fast as they could. They found a tree to climb and the dog couldn't reach them. Timmy was scared, but he was happy that Johnny was there to help him. They waited until the dog left and then climbed down. They became good friends and played together every day.

Anna and Ben like to play in the park. They run and jump and swing and slide. One day, they see a big rock near the pond. They want to climb on it and see the ducks.

Anna goes first. She is careful and slow. She gets on the rock and waves to Ben. Ben is happy and wants to join her. He runs to the rock and tries to climb. But he slips and falls. He hurts his knee and cries.

Anna hears Ben and gets down from the rock. She runs to him and hugs him. She says, "Don't cry, Ben. I will help you." She finds a leaf and puts it on his knee. She says, "This will heal your knee. It will make it better."

Ben stops crying and looks at his knee. He sees the leaf and smiles. He says, "Thank you, Anna. You are a good friend." He hugs her back. He says, "Can we still play on the rock?"

Anna nods and says, "Yes, we can. But we have to be more careful. We have to find a way to climb that is fit for us. Maybe we can use a stick or a rope or a ladder."

They look around and find a stick. They use it to help them climb on the rock. They sit on the rock and watch the ducks. They are happy and safe. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to visit her grandma in the forest. On the way, she saw a big bear. The bear looked frightened and ran away when he saw Lily. Lily felt scared too, but she knew she had to keep going.

When she arrived at her grandma's house, she told her about the bear. Grandma said that sometimes animals get scared too, and that Lily should always be careful when she visits the forest. They had tea and cookies together and talked about all the things they love.

After their visit, Lily felt happy and safe. She said goodbye to her grandma and walked back through the forest. She didn't see the bear again, but she knew that if she did, she would remember what her grandma said and be brave.

Once upon a time, there were two young friends, Jake and Zoe. Zoe liked to play in the haystack, counting the hay. 

One day she said to Jake "Let's go and number the hay. It will be fun!" 

Jake replied, "Yes! That sounds great!"

So the two young friends set off. They went up to the hay and started counting it together. They thought it was funny that how many pieces of hay there were. 

After a little while, Zoe said, "I think I can count to ten!" 

Jake smiled, and said "That's great, Zoe! Now let's count the hay together!"

They stood side by side, counting the hay. As they counted, they laughed and smiled. 

When they had finished counting, Zoe said "Let's come back and number the hay again tomorrow!" 

And so they did, each time having more and more fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who liked to watch her favorite show on the television. She asked her mommy one day if she could watch it during dinner. Her mommy said yes, but she had to sit at the dinner table to eat her dinner while watching the show.

So the little girl watched her show while eating dinner, but she was starting to get uncomfortable. She asked her mommy if she could get down from the dinner table and eat in front of the television.

Her mommy said no, so the little girl got off the dinner table anyway. She sat in front of the television and ate her dinner. It was much more comfortable for her there.

The little girl enjoyed dinner in front of the television and watched her favorite show. She smiled and was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog. His name was Spot. Spot was very brave and loved to play.

One day, Spot saw something sparkly on the ground. He picked it up and it was a belt. The belt was shiny and had fun colors. Spot was very happy, he could not believe it!

Spot put the belt on and he blinked. Spot blinked again and the belt started to work magic. Suddenly, Spot could fly. He was so happy he barked and flew around and around.

Spot flew around for hours and he couldn't believe how fun it was. When he was done flying, Spot took off his belt and put it away.

Spot was very tired after all the flying, so he went to bed and he dreamt of all the fun he had in the sky.

Once upon a time there was a bulb. It was so shiny and sparkly that everyone wanted to look at it. Everywhere it went, it made people smile.

One day the bulb decided to show its friends the funny things that it could do. It blinked and glowed, turning different colors and twinkling in the night sky. Everyone cheered with delight and cheered for the bulb.

The bulb was so proud and happy as all of its friends watched with wide eyes. The next day the bulb decided to show all its friends its magic. It lit up the room with a bright light and shone so brightly that everyone had to look away.

At the end of the day, everyone was thankful for the bulb. They thanked it for showing them such a fun display and for giving them so much joy.

Once there was a little girl called Mina. Mina loved to go on the board to play outside. One day, Mina wanted to go on the board but it was too tough. She pulled and pulled, but it would not budge.

Mina started to cry and screamed in frustration, "Mommy, please help me!"

Mina's mommy came running and said, "What's wrong my love?"

Mina showed her the board and said, "It's too tough and won't go."

Mommy said, "Let me help you, sweetheart." She tried to move the board, but it was truly tough. 

So, mommy took Mina in her arms, and said, "Let's go get a new board from the store." 

Mina smiled with delight, and off they went to get a new board. 

When they arrived, they saw the perfect board to go on. The board was not too tough and they could go on it together. 

Mina jumped up and down with excitement. Together, they enjoyed lots of rides on the new board. 

The end.

One day a little girl named Grace was hungry for candy. As she was walking to the store, she saw a man come out with a bundle of candy beneath his arm. She couldn't believe what she was seeing and turned towards him with happy eyes.

Grace ran over to the man and asked him kindly if he had any candy. The man smiled and said yes he did. He flipped over his arm, and there were two big bags of delicious candy. 

Grace was so happy, but then the man said he was only giving her one bag. Before she could say anything, the man bent down and put his gentle hand on her leg. He said to her, "If you want the other bag, you'll have to turn around three times and then wave to me."

Grace was confused but decided to give it a try. She turned around three times, and when she looked back the man was gone. But then, as she waved goodbye, the man popped his head from behind a tree. In his hands he had the other bag of candy, which he threw over to Grace with a big smile.

Grace thanked him and ran home with two big bags of candy in her hands. She never saw the man again, but every once in a while she remembers that magic day when she whispered a simple wish and it was granted.

Once upon a time, there was a little jellyfish. The jellyfish lived in the big sea. The jellyfish had many friends. They liked to play all day.

One day, the jellyfish felt a tickle in its nose. It tried to stop it, but it could not. The jellyfish sneezed a big sneeze! All its friends laughed and laughed. They thought it was funny.

The jellyfish and its friends were hungry. They found some delicious food to eat. They ate and ate until they were full. Then, they played some more. They had a fun day in the big sea.

Once upon a time there was a kid who loved to unpack. One day, the kid was so excited that they ran outside in their garden. When they stepped out, they felt surprised! It was cold and icy! The kid looked around, and noticed all the boxes that had been delivered. They were full of toys and treats.

The kid quickly ran towards the boxes, and started unpacking. One by one, they pulled out all the things from the boxes. Their eyes sparkled as they found each new toy. They found cars, and dolls, and a big stuffed bear.
 
The kid danced around in the cold icy air, laughed, and jumped around. They were so happy! After all the boxes had been unpacked, the kid slept soundly, dreaming of all their new toys. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a princess. She had a beautiful crystal and she loved it so much.

One day, an elf came to her door. He offered her a very special gift. It was a loud yellow bell. The princess liked it very much, but she said she had to keep her crystal.

So the elf offered her another gift. It was a big loud trumpet! The princess thought the trumpet was too loud, so she said she would keep her crystal, but thanked the elf all the same.

The elf went away, but not before offering her one last special gift - a small quiet crystal. The princess loved it and said yes, she would keep it! From that day on, the princess kept all three of her special gifts - the yellow bell, the loud trumpet and the quiet crystal.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to look up at the sky and watch the fluffy white clouds go by. One day, she saw a little bird flying towards a big, dark cloud. Lily was worried that the bird would get lost in the cloud, so she ran to get her dad.

"Daddy, daddy! We have to save the bird from the cloud!" she exclaimed. Her dad smiled and picked her up, and they ran towards the cloud. When they got there, they saw that the bird was safe and sound, perched on a branch.

Lily was happy that the bird was okay, but she felt a little jealous that it got to fly so high up in the sky. Her dad noticed and said, "Don't be jealous, Lily. You can be whatever you want to be when you grow up, even a bird if you want!" Lily smiled and hugged her dad, happy to have saved the bird and excited for her future.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo who lived in the deep blue sea. One day, Nemo saw a jellyfish and asked, "What are you?" The jellyfish replied, "I am a jellyfish, and I can sting you if you touch me."

Nemo was scared and swam away quickly. He told his friend, a happy crab named Crabby, what had happened. Crabby said, "Don't be afraid, Nemo. Just remember to always ask questions before you touch something new."

Nemo learned his lesson and from then on, he always asked questions before touching anything. He lived happily ever after with his friends in the deep blue sea. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to spend his days playing outside in the sun. One day, Tim went on a big adventure to find the light.

Tim walked and walked towards the east. He saw pretty flowers, tall trees, and soft grass. The sky was blue, and the sun was shining. Tim felt happy and excited on his adventure.

As Tim walked, he saw a light up ahead. It was a beautiful butterfly, shining like a light in the sun. Tim smiled and watched the butterfly fly away. He knew he had found the light on his adventure to the east.

Mia and her family had been planning their trip to the zoo for weeks. She was so excited! Finally, the day had arrived, and they quickly started to pack their car.

Mia's mom was packing the trunk when Mia asked, "Mom, what are you doing?" Her mom explained, "I am putting things in the trunk so we don't forget them at home."

Mia grinned and asked, "Are we going to the zoo now?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes! We are all set, let's go!"

Mia was even more excited now as they drove to the zoo. She couldn't wait to see all the animals and explore the different exhibits. 

Once they arrived, Mia was filled with so much joy and amazement. She was delighted to watch the monkeys swing from the trees, and she was amazed by the giant elephant whose trunk was twice as long as she was tall!

Mia's day at the zoo was an experience that she would never forget. She left the zoo even more excited than when she arrived.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the beach with her mommy and daddy. One day, while they were walking on the beach, they saw a cute seal playing in the water.

Lily said, "Mommy, can I go grab the seal?"

"No, Lily," her mommy said. "We can't grab the seal. It's not safe for us or the seal."

Lily was sad, but she understood. She watched the seal play in the water and said, "The seal is so cute. I wish we could play with it."

Her daddy said, "We can't play with the seal, but we can watch it and enjoy its cuteness from a safe distance." And so, they sat on the beach and watched the seal play in the water, happy to see it having fun.

Once there was a small bear named Winter. Winter loved to explore in the woods and one day, he discovered a small doorway hidden in a tree. 

Excitedly, Winter stepped through and found himself in a new and magical world. He gasped when he saw that flowers glowed in the dark and trees were shaped like animals! 

Winter was looking around when he noticed someone standing nearby. It was a small fairy. She said, "Hello, Winter! What is your name?" 
Winter smiled and said, "My name is Winter." 

The fairy laughed and said, "That's a wonderful name! I'm glad you're here. You can explore and make friends in this magical place!" 

Winter was so excited! He thanked the fairy and began exploring. He made many new friends and enjoyed discovering all the wonderful things in the magical world. 

Winter will never forget his magical time in the small doorway deep in the woods.

Once upon a time there was a jolly little puppy named Fuzzy. Fuzzy really enjoyed exploring the world around her. On this particular day, she decided to go for a nice long walk in the woods.

Fuzzy was having fun running and sniffing around when, all of a sudden, she heard a voice. It was an old man that lived in the forest. "Hello, little one," he said, "come closer so I can give you a big hug!" 

Fuzzy moved closer and as she did, she noticed something behind the old man in the distance. It was a big open area with a long bridge and a strange looking box. Fuzzy could not tell what it was exactly, so she asked the old man: 

"What is that?"

The old man explained to Fuzzy that it was a grill. Then he showed her how he could reach the grilled food by pressing a button. Fuzzy was so excited, she ran over the bridge and eagerly reached out to press the button.

Suddenly, the grill opened and Fuzzy saw that there were sausages inside! She knew that the old man liked sausages so she cheerfully grabbed two and ran back to give them to him. The old man was so happy that he hugged Fuzzy again!

Lily and Max were playing in the park with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it. Sometimes they would shout "goal!" or "catch!" when they scored or caught the ball.

One day, a big dog came to the park. It saw the ball and wanted to play too. It ran to the ball and grabbed it with its mouth. It shook the ball and made it wet and dirty. Lily and Max were scared of the big dog. They wanted their ball back.

"Hey, give us our ball!" Lily yelled at the dog. "That's our ball, not yours!"

The dog did not listen. It growled and ran away with the ball. Lily and Max chased the dog, but it was too fast. They lost sight of the dog and the ball.

They were very sad and angry. They had no ball to play with. They had no fun. They wished they had their original ball, the one that was clean and dry and round.

They walked back to the park gate, hoping to find their ball. They saw a man holding a leash. The leash was attached to the big dog. The big dog had the ball in its mouth.

"Is that your ball?" the man asked Lily and Max. "I'm sorry, my dog took it. He likes to play with balls. He didn't mean to be bad."

Lily and Max nodded. They were happy to see their ball, but they were still scared of the big dog.

"Can we have our ball back, please?" Max asked the man.

"Sure, sure," the man said. He took the ball from the dog's mouth and gave it to Max. "Here you go. Sorry again."

The dog looked at Lily and Max. It wagged its tail and licked its lips. It wanted to play with them and the ball.

"Can we play with your dog?" Lily asked the man. She was not scared anymore. She liked the dog's friendly eyes and soft fur.

"Of course, of course," the man said. He smiled and let go of the leash. "He's very gentle and playful. He won't hurt you. He just needs some exercise. He has a bad lung, you see. He can't run too much."

Lily and Max smiled too. They threw the ball to the dog and watched it chase and catch it. They petted the dog and praised it. They had fun with the dog and the ball.

They learned to share and be kind. They made a new friend. They forgot about their original ball. They liked their new ball, the one that was wet and dirty and chewed.

It was a gloomy day. The grass in the lawn was not blooming. everyone was so sad and disappointed.

Then something magical happened. A little brown bunny hopped over to the lawn. The bunny smiled and said a happy word. Suddenly, the lawn started to bloom! Pretty yellow and purple flowers filled the lawn.

Everyone was so happy. They cheered for the little bunny and smiled. The bunny hopped away and the grass kept blooming.

The sun broke through the clouds and the day became brighter. Everyone enjoyed spending time in the sunny, blooming lawn from that day forward.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on walks in the forest with her mommy. One day, while they were walking, Lily found a mushroom. It was big and red and looked interesting. 

"Mommy, look! I found a mushroom!" Lily said excitedly. 

Her mommy looked at the mushroom and said, "That's a very interesting mushroom, Lily. But we can't eat it because we don't know if it's safe." 

Lily understood and they continued their walk. But later that day, Lily forgot about the mushroom and started playing with her toys. It wasn't until bedtime that she remembered. 

"Mommy, I forgot to show you the mushroom again!" Lily said. 

"That's okay, sweetie. We can go back to the forest tomorrow and find it again," her mommy replied with a smile. 

Lily went to sleep happy, knowing that she would get to see the interesting mushroom again soon.

Once there was a big cow. She had lots of milk and it was very clear. Every day she would have her milk churned into a white and creamy kind.

One day, a little girl came to the farm. She looked at the cow. The cow mooed and smiled. The little girl said, "Can I have some of your milk?" The cow nodded and said, "Yes, of course!".

The little girl took a big bucket and filled it with the cow's milk. She was so happy and thanked the cow for sharing her milk.

The little girl took the bucket of milk home and shared it with her family and friends. Everyone was happy and thanked her for the clear and delicious milk.

Once upon a time, a bird named Tweety found a feather. Tweety was happy and grateful to have found the feather. Tweety wanted to show the feather to his friends.

Tweety flew to his friends' tree and saw them racing. Tweety wanted to join the race but he was worried about his feather. His friends saw him and asked him to join. Tweety was excited and joined the race.

Tweety had so much fun racing with his friends. He felt grateful for having such wonderful friends. After the race, Tweety showed his friends the feather he found. They were all amazed and happy for Tweety. From that day on, Tweety and his friends had many more races and adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Jenny who loved horses. She was so excited when her mom said she could go to the barn to pet them!

When Jenny arrived at the barn, she couldn't believe her eyes. Inside she saw a special surprise - real pony! She reached out to pet his shiny coat, but he stepped back and whinnied.

She realized she needed something to get his attention - she saw a fake whip in the corner. Jenny grabbed the whip and tried it out. To her surprise, the pony stepped forward and nickered. She patted him softly on the neck, and he let her get even closer.

They became friends, and Jenny came to visit the barn every week. She never forgot the surprise that made their friendship possible - the fake whip!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play in her backyard with her toys. One day, Lily saw a rat scurrying around her yard. She was scared and ran inside to tell her mom.

"Mommy, there's a rat in our yard!" Lily exclaimed.

"It's okay, Lily. We'll take care of it," her mom replied.

Lily watched as her mom set up a trap to catch the rat. The trap was flexible and could bend to fit in small spaces. After a while, they caught the rat and it was time to part ways.

"Goodbye, little rat. I hope you find a new home," Lily said as they released the rat into the woods.

Lily was happy that the rat was safe and she could play in her yard again. From that day on, Lily made sure to keep her backyard clean so that no more rats would come to visit.

Max was a persistent three-year-old. He really wanted to use a rubber. He asked his mum if he could have one but she said no. He was disappointed so he asked again and again and again. His mum kept saying no but Max just kept asking. 

Finally, his mum said he could have a rubber if he wrote down all of his numbers. Max was so happy and he said yes straight away. He got out his pen and a piece of paper and started to write. 

He had some trouble getting it right, so he asked his mum for help and she taught him how to write his numbers. He was so proud when he had finished and couldn't wait to get his rubber. 

His mum gave him the rubber and said he had done a great job. Max was so excited to have his own rubber and used it to draw for hours. He was so proud of himself for being persistent and managing to get his rubber.

Once there was a head. He loved to watch things. He would watch animals in the park, rainbows in the sky and clouds in the morning.

One day, the head wanted to watch something different. He saw a bossy woman. She was telling people what to do and where to go. 

The head was so interested in the woman that he started to watch her from a distance. He would stand far away and watch her every day.

One day, the head got closer and said to the woman, â€œHello, who are you?â€

The woman looked at the head with surprise. She said, â€œIâ€™m the boss around here. What are you doing here?â€

The head replied, â€œIâ€™m just watching you. You look so bossy!â€

The woman started to laugh. She said, â€œWell, thank you for the compliment. You can watch me if you want, but please respect my space.â€

The head nodded, and every day he came to watch the bossy woman. He found that watching her made him feel happy.

Molly was a little girl who loved to play. She always wanted to try her hardest and to win the game. She was very competitive.

One day, Molly was playing a game with her friends. As the game went on, Molly paused. She looked over at her friends on the other side. She wondered if she had done something wrong. 

Molly's friends paused too. They smiled at Molly and waved. Molly knew that they were on her side - they wanted her to do her best. 

Molly smiled back and continued playing. She worked hard, and together her and her friends had a lot of fun. In the end, Molly was the one who won the game - but she was proud of them all.

Tom and Sam were brothers who liked to play in the garden. One day, they saw a big onion growing in the dirt. They wanted to pick it and eat it, but their mom said no. She said the onion was for dinner and they had to wait.

Tom and Sam were not happy. They thought their mom was mean. They decided to sneak out and get the onion when she was not looking. They ran to the garden and pulled the onion out of the ground. It was very big and round and smelled strong.

"Let's eat it now!" Tom said.

"Okay!" Sam said.

They each took a bite of the onion. It was very spicy and made their eyes water. They coughed and cried and threw the onion away. They felt dizzy and sick.

Their mom heard them and came to the garden. She saw the onion and their faces. She was angry and sad.

"Why did you do that?" she asked. "I told you to wait for dinner. The onion was not ready to eat. It was not good for you. You did not listen to me. You did not respect me. You did not welcome me as your mom."

Tom and Sam felt sorry. They realized they had been naughty and hurt their mom. They hugged her and said they were sorry.

"We love you, mom. We are sorry we did not listen to you. We are sorry we did not welcome you as our mom. We will not do it again. Please forgive us."

Their mom smiled and hugged them back. She said she loved them too and forgave them. She said they could still have dinner, but they had to drink some water and rest first. She said they had learned a lesson.

"Next time, you have to listen to me and trust me. I know what is best for you. I want you to be happy and healthy. I welcome you as my children. That is what moms do."

Tom and Sam nodded and said they understood. They drank some water and rested in their beds. They felt better and thanked their mom. They learned to welcome their mom as their mom and to listen to her. They also learned to not eat onions raw.

Once upon a time, there was a mild magic. It would shrink things, which made it very special. 

One day, it saw a little girl and it decided to give her a special surprise. It made all of her toys shrink and she was so excited. She shouted for joy and said, "This is fun!"

The girl took her tiny toys and put them into her pocket. Then, she went outside and played a game. 

The magic made everything in the game shrink. She had a lot of fun running around with little blocks, dolls, and trees. 

At the end of the day, the magic returned all of the stuff back to normal. She clapped her hands and said, â€œThat was a great day!â€ 

The mild magic gave the girl a special surprise that she would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little boy called Ted. Ted loved going for walks and that day, he decided to wander off into the woods. 

Ted started to make his way through the dense trees and bushes, but he slowly got lost. He wasn't scared, but he was starting to feel a bit worried.

As he looked around, he saw a small rabbit. It was hopping quickly from one side to the other. Ted thought to himself, "That rabbit looks like it knows the way out of here."

He called out to the rabbit, but he didn't expect it to listen. He was very surprised when the rabbit stopped and looked at him.

"Can you help me find my way home?", asked Ted. The rabbit nodded and motioned for him to follow.

Ted followed the quick little rabbit and they soon found their way out of the woods. Ted was so excited and happy that he gave the rabbit a big hug.

The rabbit hopped away and Ted was back home in no time. From then on, Ted always made sure to never wander too far away!

Timmy and his friends were playing togther in the park. They were having lots of fun. Suddenly, they noticed an orange butterfly near them. Timmy's friend named Cody exclaimed, "Let's catch it!" They started to chase the butterfly and it flew away.

The butterfly flew very quickly around the park. Eventually it escaped into a bush. The friends were upset with the butterfly because it had escaped. Then Timmy had an idea. He said to his friends, "Let's make a plan. Since the butterfly likes orange, let's make a trail of orange flowers." His friends enthusiastically agreed.

They quickly gathered some orange flowers and laid them out in a path. They all shouted, "Come back little butterfly!" Soon, the butterfly flew out of the bush and followed the orange trail for a turn. The butterfly flew slowly and finally landed on Timmy's shoulder. Timmy's friends were amazed and cheered in delight. 

The butterfly returned all thanks to Timmy's clever plan. The friends laughed and hugged Timmy. Then they all went to the playground, cheering and singing happily.

Once upon a time there was a hero called Max. He was brave and strong and had an important mission. He was sailing in a small boat on a big lake. The lake was filled with fish and the sun shone brightly. 

Max wanted to catch some fish. He took out his rod and dropped it into the lake with a splash! He was waiting for a bite when he saw an ignorant fish swimming by. Max was brave and he decided to capture the fish. 

He put his net into the lake and with a big splash he caught the fish! Max was very pleased and he held up the fish with pride. He had become a hero. 

Max finished his mission and sailed off with a smile on his face. He had saved the day!

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was a parrot, and the other was a cat. They were always together.

One day, they were playing a game in the garden. The cat was being very rude, so the parrot flew away.

But then he saw that the cat had fallen over. The parrot felt sorry for the cat and flew back down to help.

The cat was scared and cold, so the parrot wrapped its wings around the cat and kept it warm.

After that, they were best friends forever. They had learnt that being rude never solves anything and that being kind was the best way to be.

Once upon a time there was a jolly old man called John. John owned the biggest row of houses in the village. Each house was painted in a different colour and the people living in the village were very pleased. 

However, one day John announced to the village that he was going to tear down the row of houses and build some new ones in its place. Everyone in the village disagreed with his plan. 

One small child, named Mia, asked John why he wanted to do this. John replied, "It will be something new and exciting." 

Mia thought for a moment, then said, "But I like our houses! I don't want to lose my own one." 

John smiled and said, "That's okay, I promise to save yours. You can keep your own house." 

Everyone thanked John and the village was once again jolly. Mia and her family continued to live in their own house and the other villagers stayed in their homes too!

Once upon a time, there was a big bookcase in a house. The bookcase was very tall and had many books on it. A little boy named Timmy loved to look at the books on the bookcase. One day, Timmy climbed up to reach a book on the highest shelf. He accidentally knocked over some books and the bookcase started to wobble. Timmy was scared that the bookcase would fall on him, so he stayed very still and tried not to move. 

Suddenly, a fierce wind blew through the window and knocked the bookcase over. But Timmy was safe because he stayed still and didn't move. His mom came running in to see what happened and was very proud of Timmy for being so brave. From then on, Timmy knew to be careful around the bookcase and to always stay still if it started to wobble.

Once upon a time, there was a furry bear. It had two arms and was very cuddly. One day, something happened that made the furry bear side very angry. It couldn't figure out why it was so mad. Then it realized it was because it hated the other arm. It had never felt that way before and it made it feel very weird.

The furry bear didn't want to feel this way, so it decided to talk to the other arm. He asked it why it did not like him. But the other arm would not answer. It just stayed there, not saying anything.

So the furry bear got brave and told the other arm that he still wanted to be friends, even though he felt angry. He explained that even though he did not know why he felt so mad, he did not want to hate the other arm.

At first, the other arm said nothing. But then it nodded and smiled. After that, the two arms became good friends. They would hug each other and play together all the time. The furry bear was so happy and the two arms stayed friends forever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She was three years old and loved playing with her toys.

One day, Sue was looking for something new to do. Suddenly, she saw an interesting box. She opened it up, and inside she found lots of brightly colored thread.

Sue was so excited. She chose one of the softest and brightest threads, and began to grow it. She wrapped the thread around a special toy bear, and the thread fit perfectly.

"Oh, how beautiful!" said Sue.

She continued wrapping the thread until the bear was completely covered. Sue was very proud of her work.

The next day, Sue showed her bear to all her friends. They were all so impressed. Sue had grown something truly special. 

From then on Sue decided, she would always take the time to grow something new with thread.

A little boy named Marky was travelling with his mom to visit his grandma. Marky asked his mom a lot of questions about where they were going.

Mom said: "We are going to grandma's house."

Marky asked: "What should I bring?"

Mom said: "Pack your bag with some toys and some clothes that fit."
