Once upon a time, there was a clumsy boy. His name was Andy. Every day, Andy would go to the office with his mother. His mom was always so happy to have him there with her. 

One day, his mom said to him, "Andy, do you believe in magic?". Andy was so excited he replied, "Yes I do!". 

His Mom then said, "Magic will happen if you believe in it. So focus on the office and use your imagination, and you will start to see the magic."

Andy thought about it and then he closed his eyes. Suddenly, he saw something unbelievable. He saw a big white bunny in the corner! 

Andy opened his eyes and said, "Mom, did you know there's a cute bunny in our office?". His mom said with a smile, "Honey, that's the magic I was talking about. Believe and you will see!" 
Andy was so happy and he just couldn't believe his eyes. He said, "I will never stop believing in magic, Mom!". 

The End.

Once upon a time there was a great port. Every day, ships would come and go, and everyone in the port liked to watch them.

One day, everyone was gathered around the port to watch a big ship. The ship was so big and grand, it was the best ship ever!

When the ship got close to the port, everyone cheered and clapped. But then- to everyone's surprise- the ship suddenly stopped! No one knew what was happening, as the ship just stayed there.

But then, the ship began to move again. It sailed away from the port and out of sight! Everyone was disappointed that the ship was gone, but they soon realised that the end was great. The ship was going to a better place and everyone was happy.

And so, the port watched the ship sail away until it could no longer be seen. And the end of the great ship was one of the happiest times ever in the port.

Anna and Ben are playing with paper and glue. They want to make a big house with windows and doors. Anna cuts the paper with scissors and Ben puts glue on it. They stick the paper together and make the walls and the roof.

"Look at our house!" Anna says. "It is so pretty and big!"

"Yes, it is!" Ben says. "But we need more glue. The glue is almost gone."

Anna looks at the glue bottle. It is almost empty. She sees another glue bottle on the table. It belongs to Lily, who is playing with dolls.

"Let's use Lily's glue," Anna says. "She has a lot of glue. She won't mind."

"No, Anna," Ben says. "That is not nice. Lily's glue is hers. We have to ask her first."

But Anna does not listen to Ben. She takes Lily's glue and pours it on their house. She wants to make it stronger and shinier.

"Anna, stop!" Ben says. "You are using too much glue! And you did not tell Lily!"

Lily hears Ben and looks at the table. She sees Anna and Ben with her glue and her paper house. She is very angry and sad.

"Hey, that is my glue!" Lily says. "And that is my paper house! You took them without telling me! You are mean!"

She runs to Anna and Ben and tries to take her glue and her paper house back. But the glue is sticky and wet. It makes a mess on the table and on their hands and clothes. The paper house falls apart and tears.

"Oh no!" Anna says. "Look what we did! We ruined Lily's glue and her paper house! We are sorry, Lily!"

Lily cries and says, "You are not sorry! You are bad! You broke my glue and my paper house! They were mine!"

Anna and Ben feel bad. They know they did something wrong. They want to make Lily happy again.

"We are sorry, Lily," Ben says. "We should have told you. We should have asked you. We should have shared with you. We were not nice. We were not good friends."

"Can you forgive us, Lily?" Anna says. "Can we help you make a new glue and a new paper house? Can we play with you and your dolls?"

Lily stops crying and looks at Anna and Ben. She sees that they are sorry and that they want to be nice and good friends. She thinks for a moment and then says, "Okay. I forgive you. You can help me make a new glue and a new paper house. You can play with me and my dolls. But you have to promise to tell me and ask me and share with me next time."

Anna and Ben nod and say, "We promise. We will tell you and ask you and share with you next time."

They hug Lily and say, "Thank you, Lily. You are a good friend."

They clean up the mess and make a new glue and a new paper house. They play with Lily and her dolls. They have fun and they are happy. They are good friends.

Once upon a time there was a strong girl. She loved to explore, and one day she decided to go on an adventure. She went to the garage and found a vehicle. It looked different than the other ones around, and she was curious. 

The girl asked her mom, "What is that vehicle, mommy?" Her mom smiled and said, "That's a special vehicle, sweetie. It's strong and it will take you anywhere you want to go." The girl was excited, and she said, "Let's try it out!" 

The girl and her mom got in the vehicle, and it drove off with a loud whirring noise. They stopped in the most beautiful place the little girl had ever seen. There were tall trees and flowers all around, and the sun was shining brightly. She said, "Mommy, I love it here. I want to stay here forever." 

Her mom smiled, and said, "I knew you would, sweetie. That's why I let you try the special vehicle. I'm glad you found a place you love." 
The little girl felt a strong sense of love and security, and she knew that no matter where she went in life, she could always come back here. From then on, this place was her special place, and the girl's and her mom's vehicle took her there often.

Once there was a cute bear called Bob. Bob was always looking for something fun to do. One day, he decided to explore a spooky cave. 
As Bob walked into the cave, he heard a noise. He saw a ghost! Bob got scared and he squeezed his eyes shut.

The ghost was friendly and asked Bob, "What are you doing here?". Bob replied, "I was looking for something fun to do." The ghost said, "I have a game to play. Let's give each other a big squeeze." 

Bob was still scared but he thought it sounded fun. So he slowly opened his eyes and gave the Ghost a big squeeze. 

The Ghost laughed and said "That was lots of fun. Let's do it again". Bob happily agreed and they squeezed each other again, over and over. 

Bob had so much fun playing with his new Ghost friend. He made sure to tell all his other friends about his big adventure and how he made a Ghost friend by squeezing him.

Mommy and Billy were in the grocery store buying food for dinner. Mommy didn't want to forget to buy anything, so she asked her three year old son, "Billy, do you remember what we need for dinner?"
Billy smiled and said, "Meat! We need meat for dinner tonight."
Mommy laughed and gave him a hug. "You're right, we need meat. It's okay if I forget things, but it helps if you remind me."
Billy nodded and looked around the store. He saw some ordinary looking packages of meat and asked, "Mommy, can we buy this?"
Mommy smiled and said, "Yes, let's buy some meat for dinner."

They happily headed home with the meat. Billy had reminded Mommy of what they needed, and dinner was bound to be wonderful!

Once upon a time there was a fancy space. It was so very big and full of things to explore. In one corner of the space, there was a big pile of blankets. A little girl loved to come and fold them. She enjoyed it so much, her mommy and daddy would give her a big hug afterwards. She enjoyed folding the blankets so much that she would do it every day. She even pretended that when she folded the blankets, she was creating new shapes and designs in the space. The little girl was so proud of herself for folding the blankets so well. Her mommy and daddy were so happy too. The little girl couldn't believe that one day she was able to transform the big space with the blankets she folded. She was so proud and happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she went to her mom and said, "Mommy, I want to grow big like you!" Her mom smiled and said, "You will grow big one day, my dear."

As Lily played outside, she saw a bird zoom by. "Wow!" she exclaimed. "That bird is so fast!" Her mom said, "Yes, birds can fly very fast."

Suddenly, it started to rain and Lily got wet. She ran inside and said, "Mommy, I'm all wet!" Her mom said, "Let's dry you off with a towel."

Later that day, Lily's dad came home and asked how her day was. Lily said, "I saw a bird zoom by and I want to grow big like mommy!" Her dad smiled and said, "You will grow big and strong, just like mommy."

One day, a little girl was out for a walk with her mommy. As the little girl looked around, she noticed a rag lying on the ground. The little girl asked her mom if she could pick it up, so her mom said yes.

The little girl noticed that the rag was very sad looking. She decided she wanted to give it a hug and she did. The rag felt very soft as she hugged it.

The little girl noticed something twinkling in the corner of the rag. When she looked closer, she noticed that it was a gold coin! She was very excited, but sad too. She was sad because she knew the rag didn't belong to her.

So, the little girl said goodbye to the rag and put the gold coin in her pocket. She thanked her mom for taking her for a walk and they went home. The little girl never saw the rag again, but she was happy knowing that it was found by someone else who could take care of it.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a big tree and wanted to climb it. Tim did not mind the sign that said, "Do not climb." He thought it would be fun to go up high.

As Tim climbed, he felt a hurt in his hand. He looked down and saw a small cut. But he did not want to stop, so he kept going up. The tree was very tall, and he could see his house from the top.

Suddenly, Tim lost his grip and fell down. He landed on the ground with a thud. Tim was very hurt and cried. His mom and dad came running and saw the sign. They were sad that Tim did not mind the sign, and now he was hurt.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Alex. He wanted so much to eat some chocolate but his mom said he had to wait. Alex was very impatient. 

He asked his mom, "Can I have it now?" 

His mom said, "No, sweetheart. You need to work for it." 

So Alex worked very hard and waited. He put away his toys, brushed his teeth and ate all his dinner. At last, his mom gave him the chocolate he wanted.

He was so happy. He said to his mom, "Thanks for the chocolate!" 

His mom smiled and said, "You worked very hard for it. I'm glad you like it!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Andy. He was only three years old, and he liked to explore. One day, Andy found himself in a big valley. He was amazed by the view and ran down the hill.

Suddenly, he spotted a silly rabbit. The rabbit was hopping around, playing in the grass. Andy smiled and went over to the rabbit. He wanted to say hello but he was a bit scared. Then the rabbit noticed him and said "Hi Andy!"

Andy was surprised. He said hello back and couldn't believe that animals could talk! The rabbit laughed and asked Andy to play with him. They had so much fun running around the valley, until the sun began to go down.

The rabbit said he had to go back home, so Andy gave him a big hug. As the rabbit left, Andy couldn't help but feel sad. He watched the rabbit until he was out of sight, then Andy started to tear. 

He was disappointed because he wanted the rabbit to stay and play together a bit longer. Andy wiped his tears and decided to explore the valley by himself. As he looked around the valley, he realized how silly the rabbit had been, making him smile again.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl called Lucy. One day, Lucy found a ball of thread in her garden. She was so excited to play with it.

She started to unravel the thread, and it quickly made a mess! She was very proud of what she had done, but her mummy was not happy.

Mummy said, "You must go and put the thread back in the ball, Lucy."

Lucy was a little ashamed, but she was determined to put it back. She spent the whole day threading the thread back into the ball.

When she had finished, she was so happy! She held the finished thread up to show her mummy. Her mummy smiled and said, "Well done, Lucy - you have done a great job."

Lucy was so proud of herself for finishing her thread. From then on, Lucy knew she could do anything if she tried.

Timmy wanted to go to the park but his mom said he had to stay at home. Timmy was very sad. Soon, he had an idea. He saw his dad's keys and he took them. Then he opened the door and went outside.

He walked to the park and he saw a police officer. The officer said, "Why do you have the keys?" Timmy was scared. The officer said, "You can't go to the park. You must come to jail with me."

Timmy did not want to go to jail so he ran away. He ran and ran until he felt tired. He couldn't run anymore. Soon, the officer caught him and he took Timmy to the jail. 

The officer put Timmy in a small room. He said, "You have to stay here until your mom is ready to get you." Timmy was very scared. He didn't like being in jail. 

Finally, the officer said he could leave. Timmy's mom came to get him and they went back home. Timmy was glad to be home and he promised himself he would never do anything bad again.

Oliver was getting ready for the big day. He had on his best clothes and was ready to march. Oliver's parents explained that in a few minutes a hurricane was coming and that it was important to march in a safe direction.

"Are you ready, Oliver?" asked his mom.

"Yes," Oliver responded eagerly.

They marched away from their home and began to walk along the roads. It was a windy day and the hurricane didn't seem to be getting any closer. Oliver was scared but his mom held his hand and told him that it was okay.

Soon they arrived at a hill with a meadow at the bottom. The sunset was beautiful, with a graceful orange light flooding the sky. Oliver felt safer here, as if the hurricane was far away and they were safe. 

They stopped to admire the beauty of the meadow and take in the sunset. As they stood there watching the orange light play across the meadow, they could feel the breeze getting cooler and the hurricane blowing further away. Oliver smiled and knew that he was safe.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man with a lot of money. He was so happy that he wanted to send some of his wealth to others. So he reached into his wallet and pulled out some gray coins. He looked up in the sky and sent the coins away with a wave of his hand. 

The coins flew around the world, visiting all the places they could. Everywhere they went, they spread joy and gave people happiness and laughter. People were so thankful for the man's generosity, they all smiled and said thank you. 

Eventually, the coins returned to the wealthy man and the money he sent out was gone. But the man still had a smile on his face, because he knew he had made many people happy. 

The End.

Lilly the kitten was so excited! She knew that if she followed the path outside she would find something special. It was a secret path, and nobody had ever used it before.

"I'm so excited! I can't believe I'm the first one to ever find this path!" Lilly exclaimed.

As she followed the path, Lilly saw a bright orange slide in the distance. She ran over to check it out. The slide was so smooth and shiny. Plus, it had a really cool bumpy texture.

Lilly didn't wait to see what else the path had in store. She ran up the steps of the slide and said, "Watch out world, here I come!"

She grabbed the sides of the slide and began to slowly slide down. It felt like she was flying. She laughed in delight as the cool breeze tickled her fur.

When she got to the bottom, Lilly was having so much fun, she decided to slide down again. This time she went a lot faster. She laughed as she flew through the air.

"That was so much fun!" Lilly squealed.

Lilly knew she would be back to slide down the orange slide many more times!

Once upon a time, there lived an ancient old man. One day, he explained to a young boy something very special and curious.

He pulled out a piece of string and said, "This string is very special because I made it a long time ago. It's very old."

The old man said, "If you hold the string firmly in your hands and make a wish, your wish will come true!"

The young boy was so surprised. He held the string in his hands and made a wish, then the old man said, "Now it's done, your wish will come true!"

The young boy was so excited and he thanked the old man for his magical string.

The old man smiled and said, "It's my pleasure, now be sure to use it wisely!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and run around. One day, she was playing with her friend, Timmy. They were running and laughing when suddenly Timmy fell and hurt his toe. 

Lily asked, "Are you okay, Timmy?" 

Timmy replied, "Ouch! My toe hurts!" 

Lily said, "Let me see. Oh no! Your toe is dirty. We need to clean it." 

So, Lily and Timmy went inside to get a wet cloth to clean Timmy's toe. While they were cleaning, Timmy tried to joke around to make Lily laugh. He said, "I guess I won't be able to run anymore. I only have nine toes now!" 

Lily giggled and said, "That's a funny joke, Timmy. But don't worry, your toe will be all better soon." 

After they finished cleaning Timmy's toe, they went back outside to play. They ran and laughed some more, but this time they were more careful not to hurt their toes. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a smart young boy called Jack. He was always trying to learn new things and his parents were so proud.

One day, Jack saw his mom and dad walking with a new puppy. He asked them, "What's that?". They replied, "It's a little pup! We've decided to spoil you with a puppy for your youth!" 

Jack was so excited! He laughed and hugged his parents, and couldn't wait to show the puppy all of his favourite games. He ran to the backyard and started to play with the puppy.

They spent the whole day running and playing together, and Jack learned many things. He was so happy to have a new best friend. No one could spoil him more than his parents!

Once upon a time, there was a wise old lady who lived in a forest. She was very compassionate and always helped her friends.

One day, she was walking in the forest when she stumbled across a very big stone. She decided to move the stone so that she would be able to bathe in the clear stream.

The old lady made several attempts to move the stone, but it wouldn't budge. She was growing tired and a little sad.

Suddenly, a little creature appeared in the forest and asked her what she was doing. She told him her story and together they tried to move the stone.

No matter how hard they tried, the stone would not move. The little creature told her that the stone was put there by magical forces and could not be moved by humans.

The old lady sadly thanked the creature for his help and decided that she would never be able to bathe in her beloved stream again.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree in a park. The tree had many leaves and birds lived in its branches. One day, a little girl came to the park with her mommy. The little girl saw the tree and wanted to climb it. But the tree was too big and she was too small. 

Instead, the little girl and her mommy sat under the tree and had a picnic. They ate sandwiches and fruit, and the little girl loved the taste of the sweet strawberries. After they finished eating, the little girl wanted to play hide and seek. Her mommy told her to be careful and yield to other people in the park.

The little girl ran around and found a small box under the tree. She opened it and found a toy inside. She was so happy and showed it to her mommy. They played with the toy together and had a lot of fun. The little girl was grateful to the tree for giving her a special toy and for letting them have a picnic under its branches.

Once upon a time, there were two children. One was little Joe, who was only three years old. The other was big John, who was five years old. 

Big John wanted to play a noisy game, but little Joe wanted it to be quiet. Big John wanted to play tag, but little Joe wanted something more serene. Big John insisted, but little Joe kept insisting that he wanted it to be quiet. 

Then, an idea came to big John's head. He said, "Let's eat something spicy!" Little Joe said that sounded good, so he agreed. So, off they went to find something spicy to eat. 

They looked around until they found a spicy dish. They ate it together and it sure was delicious! Little Joe and big John kept eating the spicy food until they were all done. 

When they were finished, they were both very satisfied. They had both insisted on something and it ended up being a great time.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Sally. Sally really loved pastel colors. One day, Sally's mommy brought her to a special store.

Sally stepped inside, and she was amazed at all of the beautiful colors. They were so bright and happy! There were blues, greens, pinks, and more. Sally's mommy bought her a thick pastel brush, so Sally could paint her own pictures.

At the end of the day, they went home. Sally was so excited to show everyone what she had bought. She was ready to start painting right away.

When she opened her brush, something magical happened. Little paint sprites came out of the brush and flew around the room! They had such a good time swirling and dancing around the room.

Sally had come all the way home with a special present, and she was so excited to keep painting and exploring the magical world of pastels.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to be rich. One day, he got a bright idea to make a jar of money. He quickly ran and began to pack his things into one big bag. He packed a jar, some coins and a spoon to dig in the ground.

The little boy started digging in the ground, and he found a lot of gold coins. He was so happy he wanted to share them with his friends, so he filled his jar full of coins and put a lid on top.

The little boy was now rich and very proud of his jar full of money. He showed it to his friends, who all thought he was very clever. The little boy decided to donate his newly-found wealth to help people in need. He packed the jar of coins into his bag and set off to make a positive difference in the world.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toy cars in the living room. They liked to make them zoom and crash and beep. But then, Lily's car stopped working. She pushed the button, but it did not move or make any sound.

"Oh no, my car is broken!" Lily cried. "Can you fix it, Ben?"

Ben looked at Lily's car. He saw that the battery was empty. He had a new battery in his pocket. He took it out and opened the car with a screwdriver.

"Here, Lily, I can fix it. You need a new battery. The old one has zero power. See?" He showed Lily the battery. It had a big zero on it.

"Wow, thank you, Ben!" Lily said. She watched as Ben put the new battery in the car and closed it. He pushed the button and the car came to life. It moved and made a loud beep.

"Yay, it works!" Lily cheered. She hugged Ben and gave him a kiss. "You are the best brother ever!"

They continued to play with their toy cars, happy and smiling. They made them zoom and crash and beep. They had a lot of fun.

Tom likes to draw with his crayons. He has many colors and shapes to make. He likes to draw big and small, happy and sad, and anything he can think of. Today, he wants to draw a triangle.

He picks a yellow crayon and starts to draw on his paper. He makes a line that goes up, then a line that goes down, then a line that goes across. He looks at his triangle and smiles. He likes his triangle.

But then he sees that his triangle is empty. There is nothing inside it. He thinks that his triangle is lonely. He wants to make his triangle happy. He thinks of what he can put inside his triangle.

He picks a blue crayon and starts to draw on his paper. He makes a circle inside his triangle. He thinks that his circle is a ball. He likes his ball. He thinks that his triangle likes his ball too.

He picks a red crayon and starts to draw on his paper. He makes a star inside his circle. He thinks that his star is a toy. He likes his toy. He thinks that his circle likes his toy too.

He looks at his triangle, his circle, and his star. He sees that they are not empty anymore. He sees that they are happy. He is happy too. He likes his drawing. He shows his drawing to his mom. She likes his drawing too. She gives him a hug and a kiss. He feels proud and loved. He thinks that today is a good day.

John was so frightened that he almost began to cry. He had just dropped his toy truck. All that was left was the eraser - and it was broken into tiny pieces.

John ran to his mum. She was folding laundry in the kitchen.

"Mum, my eraser broke," he said with a quiver in his voice.

His mum knelt down and put her arm around him.

"Don't be frightened, John. We can raise it," she said.

John looked up.

His mum got out some glue and a scissors. She helped John to glue the pieces of the eraser back together and then turn them into a new shape.

John smiled as he felt a sense of joy in his heart. He had never felt so proud that his mum had made something so special for him. He hugged her tightly, and she laughed as she hugged him back.

Now, every time John looks at his eraser he feels so brave and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a nice police officer. He wore a blue uniform and a shiny badge. He liked to help people and keep them safe.

One day, the police officer saw a little girl who was lost. He said, "Hello there! Are you lost?" The little girl nodded her head and the police officer said, "Don't worry, I will help you find your way home."

The police officer was very useful because he knew the town very well. He asked the little girl where she lived and he took her there. The little girl was very happy to be back home with her family. She said, "Thank you, Mr. Police Officer!" and gave him a big hug. The police officer smiled and said, "You're welcome. I'm glad I could help."

A little boy saw a watch at the store and he wanted it. His mummy was very thoughtful, so she bought it for him. He was so happy and he couldn't wait to attach it to his wrist.

He wanted to show his daddy, so he ran over to him. His daddy smiled when he saw the watch and gave it a careful look. The little boy then proudly showed his daddy how he could attach the watch to his wrist. He kept doing it over and over, until he finally got it to stay on. 

His daddy told him how proud he was. The little boy was very happy. Now he could look at the watch and count how many minutes until his next adventure. He smiled and felt very special with his new watch.

Jimmy was playing in the living room when his mom called out to him. "Jimmy! Behave and come in here please," she said.

Jimmy ran over to his mom. She was holding a pencil in her hand. It was a heavy pencil, and it felt like it was made out of metal.

His mom handed the pencil to Jimmy. "This is yours," she said.

Jimmy smiled. He knew he was supposed to be good and use the pencil for drawing and writing.

So Jimmy behaved, and he used the pencil for all the things his mom said. He carefully wrote letters and then drew pictures in his coloring books.

After his mom saw how he was using the pencil, she beamed with pride. Jimmy had learned to behave and use the pencil correctly.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little girl called Lucy. She loved to explore her garden and she often found special things. Today she found something even more special - a sparkling object. When she picked it up, she went to tell her mom.

"Mom, look what I found in the garden," Lucy said, excitedly holding up the shiny thing in her hand.

"Oh, that's mine," said her mom. "It's a special necklace. I must have dropped it when I was gardening earlier."

Lucy beamed. She was so happy to have found it for her mom.

"Thank you for finding this for me," said Mom. "You're so smart and I'm so proud of you."

Lucy smiled and gave her Mom a big hug. She would never forget this special moment and the mine she had found in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the snow. One day, as she was walking, she saw a big sign with pictures on it. It was called a billboard. Lily thought it was very pretty.

Suddenly, Lily felt very cold. She looked down and saw that her feet were covered in snow. She had frozen toes! She realized it was foolish to not wear her warm boots. So, she went back inside to warm up by the fire. 

After her toes thawed out, Lily put on her boots and went back outside to play. She passed by the billboard again and smiled. She knew that next time, she would be prepared and not freeze her toes again.

Once upon a time there was a regular beetle. All day he would sit in the garden, soaking up the sunshine and watching the world go by. He would see all sorts of creatures come and go, but he always stayed put.

One day, the beetle flew away from the garden, higher and higher. Eventually, he reached a bright yellow sun. He loved the warmth of the sun and enjoyed gazing around at all the pretty sights.

But before long, the beetle started to feel a bit homesick. He wanted to go back to the garden where he'd been before. Taking a deep breath, he stretched out his wings, and began the long journey back home.

Back in the garden, it was business as usual. The beetle was happy to be back in his regular spot. He was relieved that now he would never have to leave his beloved garden again!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Jane. She loved to play with round balls. One day, she decided to go to the park to play with them. 

When Jane got to the park, she saw an incredible round ball. She ran over to it and started to pick it up. Suddenly, a boy named Bob yelled at her. 

"That's my ball!" he shouted.

Jane was sad. She said, "But it's so incredible. Can't I just play with it for a bit?" 

Bob said, "No, this is mine. Go get your own ball!"

Jane looked around and saw lots of other round balls. She chose one and started to play with it. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a mom and dad and a yellow couch. Every day the mom and dad would sell things and make money.

One day, the dad looked at the yellow couch and said to the mom, "Let's sell the yellow couch". The mom said yes and they went to a shop.

At the shop, they talked to the shop keeper. They said, "We have a yellow couch to sell". The shop keeper said, "I'll buy it".

The mom and dad took the money and went home. They put the money in the box. Now they had more money to buy other things.

The end.

Mum and Dad were taking Ollie the elephant to the park. Ollie was very excited to go.

As they arrived, Ollie saw a giant slide. He wanted to go down it right away.

Mum said "Ollie, the slide looks very dangerous. We have to be very careful".

Ollie thought for a moment and said "Okay, I'll be careful".

Mum smiled and said "If you are careful, you will get a reward".

Ollie went down the slide very slowly and carefully. When he reached the bottom, Mum and Dad clapped and cheered.

Mum said "Well done Ollie! You did a great job! Here is your reward". She gave Ollie a big hug and he was very happy. 

They stayed at the park for a while longer and when it was time to go home, Mum said "It's time to close now. We need to go home". 

Ollie said "Okay, let's go!" and they all walked home together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He was so excited to go outside and play in the sun. He set out away from his house, happy and ready to have some fun.

He was almost to the park when, suddenly, he tripped and twisted his ankle. He looked around to find help, but no one was near. He felt so sad and scared.

He closed his eyes and saw a bright light and he opened them, to find an angel standing nearby.

She said, "Don't worry Tim, I will help you." She smiled and her eyes sparkled with kindness. She bent down and carefully put his foot in the right place. 

She whispered something and with a twist of her wrist, Tim's foot felt OK. He was so amazed and happy, he thanked the angel again and again.

The angel smiled and said, "It was not too difficult, all you need is a bit of hope."

Ellie went to the station with her father. She was excited because it was their first outing since the lockdown. 

"Why are we here, Daddy?" she asked. 

"We're here to get some coal for the fire," her father replied.

While her father spoke to the coal-man, Ellie looked around the station. Everywhere she looked was tidy and well-ordered. 

Suddenly, Ellie spotted a discarded wooden box in the corner. She quickly ran over to investigate. 

"Ellie, stop!" her father shouted. But it was too late. Suddenly, the station flooded with thick smoke. 

"I was trying to prevent it," her father sighed. "But I guess I was too late."

As it turns out, the wooden box contained fireworks. Ellie had been so excited by the discovery, she had lit one without realising the danger it posed. Fortunately, the fire was quickly extinguished and the station was safe â€“ albeit a little dusty. 

Ellie and her father smiled at each other. 

"That was dangerous!" her father said. 

"But I saved the station, Daddy!" Ellie beamed. 

And from that moment on, Ellie learned a valuable lesson: tidy places can often hide unexpected surprises.

Once there was a powerful lock. It was so strong that nothing could unlock it. Not even the strongest of animals or humans could open the lock. 

One day, a 3-year-old boy and his grandpa were walking in the forest. Suddenly, the boy saw the lock. He was very curious, and asked his grandpa, "What is that?". His grandpa replied, "That's a lock. It's very powerful and nothing can open it."

The boy didn't agree. "I think I can open it", he said. His grandpa laughed, and said, "No, son. That's impossible." 

The boy kept trying, and trying. He was determined to open the lock. Finally, after much effort, he was able to open it. He gave a big smile and said, "See grandpa, I knew I could do it!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her red ball. One day, she saw a big basket and decided to bounce her ball into it. She threw the ball up high and it bounced off the ground and into the basket. Lily was so happy! She ran to get her mommy to show her what she had done. Her mommy was very proud of her and they played together with the ball and basket for the rest of the day. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Michael and Sarah. They were always together, playing and laughing in the park.

One day, Michael and Sarah spotted a big copper coin lying in the sand near the swings.

Excited, Michael asked Sarah, "Can I have the copper?"

Sarah, not wanting to disappoint her best friend, made a promise. "Yes, you can have the copper," she said.

Sarah was feeling uncomfortable, because she wanted to keep the copper for herself. But she knew it was the right thing to do, so she picked it up and handed it to Michael.

Michael thanked Sarah and gave her a hug. "Thank you so much! That was incredibly kind of you," he said, smiling.

Sarah smiled back. Even though she felt uncomfortable, she was glad that she kept her promise.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who wanted to find something special. She went on a walk in a dark forest. As she walked, she saw something glimmering between the trees. She stopped and looked closer. It was a string. 

She pulled the string until it was all the way out and it led her to a big tree. She looked around, but saw nothing else. She took the string in her hands and walked around the tree. 

Suddenly, a door opened in the tree. The girl was very excited and stepped inside. Inside, she found a beautiful surprise - a box filled with golden stars! The girl smiled and put the stars in her pocket. 

The girl thanked the tree for the surprise and said goodbye. She closed the door and, holding the string in her hands, ran all the way home. She will never forget the dark forest and all the surprises it held for her.

Once upon a time, there was a lively little car named Toot. Toot loved to drive fast and play with his friends. One day, Toot's friends asked him to come to the park to play.

Toot was excited and said, "Yes, I will come!" But first, he needed to get some fuel. Toot went to the fuel place and filled up his tank. Now, he was ready to go to the park.

Toot drove to the park and saw all his friends waiting for him. They played all day, racing and laughing. Toot was happy he had come to the park. And when it was time to go home, Toot knew he had enough fuel to get back.

Once upon a time, there was a little orange fox named Foxy. Foxy lived in a dark cave near a big hill. One day, Foxy went outside to play with his friend, Bunny.

Foxy said, "Bunny, let's go to the top of the hill and roll down!" Bunny nodded and they both ran up the hill. Foxy saw a big rock and said, "Bunny, I bet I can push this rock down the hill!" Bunny looked at the rock and said, "Be careful, Foxy!"

Foxy pushed the rock with all his might. The rock rolled down the hill and went straight into Foxy's cave. Foxy and Bunny ran back to the cave to see what happened. When they got there, they found that the rock had made a new room in the cave! Foxy and Bunny were very happy and played in the new room all day.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty mushroom. It watched all of the animals in the forest have fun and wished it could join them. But the mushroom couldn't run or play like the animals did.

One day, a bird flew by and noticed the mushroom looking sad. The bird asked why it was so sad and the mushroom said it wanted to run and play like the other animals.

The bird had an idea and told the mushroom it could tie itself to a stick and the bird could pull it around the forest. The mushroom was so excited and did as the bird said.

The bird flew around the forest with the mushroom in tow and the mushroom had so much fun! All the other animals in the forest were so surprised to see the mighty mushroom running around with the bird. The mushroom was finally able to join the other animals in the forest and had so much fun!

The bird and the mushroom were happy ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Alice. She was three years old and very excited for the day. She wanted to find something fun to do. Suddenly, she saw a brilliant yellow butterfly flying in the garden. She wanted to catch it, so she ran after it.

Alice's mum saw her and called her back. She said, "Alice, don't run away! I promise you won't miss anything exciting if you stay here with me". Alice nodded and came back to her mum.

The mum said, "Alice, you must remember not to wander off like that. I must give you a little lecture about the importance of listening to adults." Alice sadly nodded.

Just then, Alice's dad came out of the house and said, "Alice, you did a brilliant job being a good girl and listening to your mum! I'm very proud of you."

Alice smiled and hugged her dad. She realised that listening to adults was really important and it made her dad happy. She decided to always remember to listen to her parents.

The moral of the story is that it is important to always listen to adults.

Sarah was packing her house. She had to move to a new place, but she was very excited. She gathered up all her things and made them easy to carry. She put her books, pencils, clothes, and dolls into bags. She packed up her bed and the chairs too. Finally, everything was ready to go. She grabbed the bags and said goodbye to her house. She was excited to see her new home!

Once there was a smart little bug who liked to change. He could change the way he moved, and he could change his color. Every day he saw something new and wanted to change some more. He saw a big tree and wanted to change his color so he could blend in with it. He flew away to the top of the tree and changed from yellow to green. Now he was the same color as the leaves, and no one could see him.

The little bug had so much fun on the tree that he wanted to stay there all day. But, he knew he had to change again and he flew away. He wanted to change his color so he could be part of the sky. He spread his wings and changed from green to blue. Now he was the same color as the blue sky, and everyone was impressed.

The little bug felt so smart because he could change to fit whatever he wanted. He felt like he could do anything, and that made him excited. He changed his color one more time and flew away, off to explore the rest of the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved cake so much that she asked her mom to bake one every day. But her mom said, "Lily, we have to be patient and wait until it's a special occasion to have cake."

Lily didn't want to be patient, so she decided to stretch time. She closed her eyes and imagined that time was like a rubber band that she could stretch and make longer. She counted to ten and when she opened her eyes, it felt like hours had passed.

But when she went to the kitchen, there was no cake. Her mom said, "Lily, you can't stretch time to make cake appear. But we can bake one together and enjoy it when it's ready." Lily smiled and helped her mom bake a delicious cake. They enjoyed it together and Lily learned that sometimes it's better to be patient and wait for good things to come.

Tim and Sam are brothers. They like to play with cars and trucks. They have a big box of cars and trucks in their room. One day, they find a new car in the box. It is red and shiny and has a button on the side.

"Wow, look at this car!" Tim says. "It is so cool! Can I play with it?"

"No, it is mine!" Sam says. "I saw it first! You can play with the other cars."

Tim is sad. He wants to play with the new car too. He waits until Sam is not looking. Then he grabs the new car and runs away.

"Hey, give it back!" Sam shouts. He chases Tim down the hall.

Tim pushes the button on the side of the car. The car makes a loud noise and zooms out of his hand. It flies across the hall and hits the window. The window breaks and the car falls outside.

"Oh no!" Tim says. "The car is gone!"

Sam catches up with Tim. He sees the broken window and the car on the ground. He is very angry.

"You broke the window and the car!" Sam says. "You are so bad! I will tell Mom!"

Tim is scared. He knows he did a bad thing. He starts to cry.

"I'm sorry, Sam!" Tim says. "I just wanted to play with the car!"

But Sam does not listen. He runs to Mom and tells her what Tim did. Mom is very alert. She hears the noise and sees the broken window. She is very mad.

"Tim, what did you do?" Mom says. "You broke the window and the car! You could have hurt yourself or someone else! You are in big trouble!"

Tim feels very bad. He wishes he did not take the car. He wishes he did not break the window. He wishes he did not make Sam and Mom mad. He knows he will not play with cars and trucks for a long time. He has a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved cars and trucks more than anything. One day, Timmy's dad took him to a gas station to get some fuel for their car. Timmy thought the gas station was impressive because there were so many cars there.

While they were getting gas, Timmy's dad warned him not to touch anything. Timmy listened carefully and promised not to touch anything. But as they were leaving, Timmy saw a toy truck on the shelf and he really wanted it. He asked his dad if he could have it, but his dad said no. Timmy was sad, but he knew he had to listen to his dad.

As they drove away from the gas station, Timmy looked out the window and saw all the cars on the road. He was happy to be in his car with his dad and he knew they had enough fuel to get where they were going. Timmy was grateful for his dad's warning and he felt safe knowing his dad was taking care of him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He was cheerful and loved to play. One day he saw a video. He was very excited! He watched it over and over until he knew all the words.

The video showed different ways of being happy. Jack smiled and clapped his hands. He was excited to learn new things.

Soon enough, Jack tried out all the things he learned in the video. He was so cheerful and happy. Everyday he tried something new, like singing and smiling to his friends. 

Jack was so happy that he decided to make his own video. He wanted to show everyone his own version of being happy. So, he made a cheerful video and shared it with his friends and family.

Everyone was so happy to see Jack's cheerful video. They also started making their own videos to show things they were happy about. Soon enough, everyone was cheerful and joyous. The end.

Once upon a time, a boy was walking in the woods. He saw a pine tree and suddenly heard someone joke. He looked around and saw a little squirrel on the tree. The squirrel was laughing and hopping around the tree. The boy thought the squirrel was really funny and started to laugh.

The squirrel stopped and looked at the boy. It then made an impressive jump from the pine tree onto the boy's shoulder. The boy thought it was amazing and smiled. The squirrel stayed on the boy's shoulder and they walked around the woods.

The boy and the squirrel became good friends. Every day they went for a walk in the woods, and the squirrel would always make some jokes. The squirrel was so funny and the boy always laughed.

Eventually, the boy and the squirrel said goodbye. The boy was sad but was happy they had shared special moments in the woods. The boy will never forget how impressive the little squirrel was.

Once upon a time, there were two sisters who were playing in the garden. They decided to pick up sticks and see who can make the coolest shapes with them. Little sister had an idea. She wanted to make an unusual shape with her stick.

With lots of enthusiasm, Little Sister started to do the task. She twisted and turned the stick until it made an unusual shape.

Big Sister saw the unusual shape and laughed at Little Sister. She said that nothing interesting could come out of silly sticks.

At this, Little Sister got upset and ran away. Big Sister felt a bit bad and followed Little Sister.

Big Sister told Little Sister that it is okay to make unusual shapes with her stick. She said that anything can be made special as long as we try hard and use our imagination.

The two sisters embraced and Little Sister smiled. They ran back to the garden and made lots of unusual shapes with sticks.

The moral of the story is that it is okay to be creative and try new things.

Once upon a time there was a mommy and a daddy and they had a special surprise for their three year old child. The mommy and daddy had been gone for a long time and now they were back home. When the child saw them, she smiled with joy. The mommy went to the car and unpacked some bags with something inside. The Daddy opened the bags and out came something very special for the child, a new doll.
The child was so excited and gave her mom and dad lots of hugs and kisses. Then the mommy and daddy unpacked some more. This time it was a big box filled with toys. Some were shiny and some were colorful, but most were dirty. The child had so much fun playing with all the toys, she did not have time to clean them. 
In the end, mommy and daddy had to help her. They all worked together to clean the toys, and when they were all done the child was very happy. She had lots of new things to play with and she was very excited. 
The three of them had so much fun and shared lots of laughter. That's the way things should be, when families come together.

Once there was a boy. He wanted to play in his green garden. He saw a tree and he wanted to climb it. He started to climb but then he fell. He felt sad. Then his mommy came over to him. She saw that he was sad and she asked him what happened. He told his mommy that he fell from the tree. So his mommy decided to go and fix it. She grabbed some heavy tools and went over to the tree. She worked hard and was able to fix the tree. Now the boy could climb it again. He was happy and went back to the tree. He carefully climbed it and was able to reach the top. He had a lot of fun and thanked his mommy for fixing the tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the bright sun. One day, Timmy found a screw on the ground. He picked it up and looked at it closely. Suddenly, a big dog came running towards Timmy. The dog opened his mouth wide and tried to bite Timmy. But Timmy was quick and he threw the screw at the dog. The screw hit the dog's nose and the dog ran away. Timmy felt very proud of himself for being brave. From that day on, Timmy always carried a screw with him, just in case he needed to scare away any more dogs.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very brave and one day she decided to go for an adventure in the dark woods. But it was getting late and the sky went black. 

The brave little girl was afraid and started to stumble as she walked. Soon enough, she noticed a strange yellow light. She knew she had to explore it no matter how scared she felt.

She kept walking towards the light and suddenly she could smell something strange. It was a very bitter smell. The brave girl was brave and decided to keep exploring.

When she got closer, she realized that the yellow light was coming from a house in the middle of the dark woods. But before she could knock on the door, the door opened and out came a huge, ugly monster! 

The brave girl was terrified, but she remembered how brave she was and decided she had to take on the monster. She bravely ran around the monster, making it stumble and fall on the ground.

Afterwards, she quickly ran away from the dark woods and back home to safety. The brave little girl never forgot how brave she was and lived happily ever after!

Once there was a little boy named Ben. He was three years old and loved to explore his backyard. One day he saw a big dog in the yard next door. He was so excited that he asked the dog if he wanted to play.

The dog said nothing but smiled in a friendly way. Ben thought that was a yes so he began to play. As he was playing he noticed the dog's owners peeking out from behind their fence. He could tell they were embarrassed, but he didn't know why.

So Ben asked them why they looked so embarrassed. They laughed and said that it was because the dog hadn't barked. He was too excited playing with Ben to make any noise. Ben laughed too, relieved that he wasn't in trouble. 

Then the owners invited Ben over to their yard to play with the dog some more. It was so much fun that Ben wanted to come back every day. He became best friends with the dog, and they played together in the yard every day.

Once upon a time, there was a small dog named Max. Max liked to play and run in the park. One day, Max found something new on the ground. It was shiny and pretty. Max did not know what it was, but he knew it had value. 

Max wanted to show his friends the shiny thing. He picked it up with his mouth and ran to find his friends. Max found his friend, a big dog named Sam. Max showed Sam the shiny thing. Sam liked it too. They played with it together.

Later, Max and Sam got hungry. They went to eat their food. Max thought about the shiny thing with value. He did not want to lose it. So, Max put it in his food bowl. Max and Sam ate their food and were happy. They knew they had found something special.

Once there were two friends. They were very curious. They wanted to explore the world! So one day, they decided to go outside and play.

They saw a big pile of soil. It was full of bugs, plants, and rocks. It looked like lots of fun. So they decided to introduce themselves to the soil!

First, they scooped a handful of soil and put it in their hands. Then, they said hello! The soil was so soft and fuzzy. They laughed and laughed, it felt funny!

They talked to the soil and played for a long time. Eventually, it was time for them to go, but they promised to come back soon and said goodbye. 

The two friends were so happy and excited about their adventure! They had a lot of fun, and would never forget their new friend - the soil!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Millie. Millie was curious and liked to explore. One day, her dad gave her a special saw and told her to be careful. Millie was so excited, she couldn't wait to try it out. 

Millie went deep into the woods. As she walked, she saw an old tree with strange markings on it. She knew she had to take a closer look. Millie went over and used her saw to open up the tree and what she found was amazing. Inside were glowing rocks and it was so beautiful. 

Millie was so delighted, but also a bit fearful. She put the rocks back and hurriedly ran home. Now, whenever Millie feels a bit afraid, she takes out her saw and remembers the glowing rocks she found that day.

Once upon a time there was a tall tree. It was very old and was loved by all the animals in the forest. Every night, the tree would glow and tell a story.

The animals would gather around and listen as the tree glowed and spoke. The stories were always magical and exciting, and the animals were always excited to hear them.

One night a small bunny hopped up to the tree and asked if it could tell a story. The tree agreed and soon the bunny's story was glowing in the starlight.

The other animals listened in amazement as the bunny told its story. When the story was over, everyone clapped and cheered for the bunny's story.

The tree glowed brightly that night, and the animals knew the tree was proud of their story-telling. From that day forward, they always remembered the story of the tall tree that glowed each night, and the bunny's magical story.

One day, Ginger was walking with her dad in the park. She was so excited and wanted to play. Suddenly, she saw a distant mint. She pointed it out to her dad and said, "Look daddy! A mint!" Her dad smiled and said, "Yes, it sure is a mint, sweetie." He then threw a rock in that direction to see if he could get the mint.

Just then, a small bird flew above them and swooped down to pick up the mint. He then threw it up in the air and caught it again.

Ginger laughed and clapped her hands. She said to her dad, "Daddy, look! The little bird is playing with the mint!"

Her dad nodded and laughed with her, "Yes, he sure is! He seems to be having a lot of fun." They watched the bird for a while, until eventually it flew away with the mint in its beak and they continued their walk in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty tank. It travelled around the land, helping everybody in need. Everyone cheered and praised it, reminding it of its amazing deeds.

One day, the tank faced a difficult problem. A storm had arrived and the village it needed to protect was badly hit. With a heavy heart, the tank tried to do its best by saving as many people as possible. 

But as the storm increased, the people started to doubt the power of the tank.

"Why isn't the tank doing more to protect us?!" one villager shouted.

The tank tried to stay strong, but it couldn't ignore their words.

As the storm worsened, people began to lose their faith in the tank. In the end, the tank was left standing, destroyed and broken, unable to save anyone from the wrath of the mighty storm.

Mum and Dad brought Polly an exciting letter. It was for the big birthday party next week. Polly was so excited that she shouted, â€˜Yay!â€™

Mum said, â€˜Thatâ€™s great, Polly! Weâ€™re all very excited that you are having a party.â€™

Dad said, â€˜We will make it the best party ever.â€™

Mum and Dad smiled and said, â€˜We canâ€™t wait either. Itâ€™s going to be so much fun!â€™

Anna and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to dig in the dirt and look for bugs. They had a jar with some ants and worms inside.

"Look, Ben, I found a big beetle!" Anna said, holding up a shiny black bug.

"Wow, let me see!" Ben said, reaching for the beetle.

But as he touched it, the beetle opened its wings and flew away. Anna and Ben screamed and ran away from the beetle.

They bumped into a rock and fell down. They looked up and saw something on the rock. It was a lizard. It had green scales and a long tail. It stared at them with its small black eyes.

"Ah, a lizard!" Anna said, panicking. She did not like lizards. She thought they were disgusting and scary.

"Shh, don't move. Maybe it will go away," Ben said, trying to be brave.

But the lizard did not go away. It opened its mouth and showed its sharp teeth. It hissed and flicked its tongue.

"Help, help!" Anna and Ben shouted, crying. They wanted their mom and dad to come and save them from the lizard.

They heard footsteps and saw their mom and dad running towards them. They picked them up and hugged them.

"What's wrong, sweeties? What scared you?" their mom asked, worried.

"The lizard, the lizard!" Anna and Ben said, pointing at the rock.

Their mom and dad looked at the rock and laughed. They saw the lizard, but it was not a real lizard. It was a toy lizard. Someone had left it on the rock as a joke.

"It's okay, it's not a real lizard. It's just a toy. See?" their dad said, picking up the toy lizard and showing it to them.

Anna and Ben looked at the toy lizard and felt silly. They realized they had been afraid of nothing. They laughed too and hugged their mom and dad.

"Sorry, we were silly. We thought it was a real lizard," Anna said.

"It's okay, we all get scared sometimes. But you don't have to be afraid of lizards. They are not disgusting. They are just animals. They won't hurt you if you leave them alone," their mom said.

"Really? Can we see a real lizard?" Ben asked, curious.

"Sure, maybe we can find one in the garden. But don't touch them, just look at them. They are very interesting and beautiful," their dad said.

"Okay, let's go find a real lizard!" Anna and Ben said, excited.

They put the toy lizard back on the rock and went with their mom and dad to look for a real lizard in the garden. They learned that lizards were not so bad after all. They had fun and forgot about the beetle.

Once there were two friends, a tall giraffe and a small mouse. The giraffe liked eating corn, but the mouse did not know what it was. So the tall giraffe showed the mouse a big yellow corn. The mouse thought the corn looked strange and was scared to touch it.

But the giraffe told the mouse not to be scared and said they should unite to try the corn together. So the mouse agreed. They both broke off a piece of the corn, and tasted it. It was sweet and juicy, and they both liked it very much.

The mouse was so excited, that it ran all around the tall giraffe and hugged it! The tall giraffe was so happy it had taught the mouse about corn and united them, and from that day on the two became the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a baby bunny who liked to be awake at night. She liked to hop around her crib and nibble on things.

One night, she was jumping around so fast that she jumped right over the crib and into the hallway. She started running down the hallway at full speed and didn't notice the big furry dog sitting nearby.

The dog saw the bunny and decided to take a bite. He opened his big mouth and grabbed onto the bunny with his strong teeth. The bunny tried to squirm away, but the dog had grabbed too tightly. 

The bunny was so scared that she didn't move for a long time. But then, the dog started to move, ever so slowly. He gently released the bunny from his bite, and the bunny hopped off down the hallway and back into her crib. 

The bunny was very lucky that night. She felt safe and snuggled up into her crib and fell asleep. The big furry dog watched over her until morning.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Susie. They were so silly that they liked to make funny faces at each other and laugh.

One day, Susie said, "Let's play a game!" Jack thought it was a good idea and said, "Yes, let's start!"

So they ran and hopped and jumped and made silly things. Then, Susie saw a hole in the ground. "I'm scared," she said. "Let's save you," said Jack.

He stretched out his hands and Susie jumped out. They both laughed and hugged each other tight. "That was fun!" said Susie. Jack smiled and said, "Yes, that was very silly!"

Once upon a time there was a wise rubber duck. His name was Quackie. Quackie was very happy and loved to swim around in his pond. One day, Quackie noticed a frog sitting on a rock. The frog's name was Froggy. Quackie swam over and said, "Hi Froggy! I'm Quackie the rubber duck."

Froggy smiled and asked, "Do you want to marry me?"

"Yes!" said Quackie. So Quackie and Froggy were joined together as one.

The two frogs became the best of friends and loved each other very much. They spent all their days swimming, playing, and exploring the pond.

Soon, it was time for them to part. But before they did, they promised they'd always be friends and never forget each other.

So, off they went, Quackie and Froggy, the wise rubber duck and the frog.

Once upon a time there were two friends, a bear and a cow. They loved to hang out together, but they always argued over who was better.

The bear was very fierce, while the cow was sleepy. One day they decided to race each other through the forest. The bear was sure he was going to win!

But halfway through the race they both saw something in the trees. Hanging up high was a bowl of spaghetti! The two friends stopped running, and looked at each other. Neither of them could reach the spaghetti, so the cow had a bright idea.

The cow asked the bear for a boost, and the bear agreed. The bear held the cow tightly and gave her a boost. The cow was now close enough to the spaghetti. She reached up and grabbed it, then hung it down for the bear. They both shared the bowl of spaghetti, and were happy to be friends again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very naughty and liked to play tricks on her mom. One day her mom asked her to do something, but the little girl did not listen.

Her mom was cross and said "I must punish you". The little girl started to cry.

Then a strange thing happened. A big jellyfish appeared and spoke to the girl. It said "I know you want to be naughty, but being sweet and obeying is better". The little girl was surprised, but she nodded her head.

The jellyfish said "I will punish you in a special way. I'm going to give you a big hug, and when you get a hug from me it will be like a hug from your mom. That will make you feel better".

The little girl was so happy. She hugged the jellyfish, and it was so sweet. She learned that it's nice to obey and be kind.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby little bunny named Benny. He loved to hop around and eat carrots all day long. One day, Benny heard about a meeting in the forest. He wanted to go and see what it was all about.

Benny hopped through the forest, following a path that led him to the meeting. When he got there, he saw lots of animals gathered around. They were all talking and laughing, having a good time. But then, Benny noticed something strange. One of the animals was leading the meeting, but he looked mean and scary.

Benny started to feel scared too. He wanted to run away, but it was too late. The scary animal saw Benny and chased after him. Benny tried to hop away, but the scary animal was too fast. In the end, Benny was caught and never seen again.

Lila was a little girl who liked to play with her toys. She had a big teddy bear, a yellow ball, and a red car. She also had a night light that made her room glow when it was dark.

One night, Lila heard a loud noise outside her window. She was scared and wanted to see what it was. She got out of her bed and walked to the window. She saw a big dog barking at a cat. The dog was angry and the cat was scared. Lila felt sorry for the cat and wanted to help.

She opened the window and called out to the cat. "Come here, kitty, I will save you!" she said. The cat heard her and ran towards the window. But the dog saw the cat and ran faster. Lila reached out her hand to grab the cat, but the dog was too quick. He jumped and bit the cat's tail. The cat cried out and Lila screamed.

Lila's mom and dad heard the noise and ran to her room. They saw the dog, the cat, and Lila at the window. They were shocked and worried. They shooed away the dog and brought the cat inside. They hugged Lila and checked if she was hurt. She was not hurt, but she was scared and sad.

They took the cat to the bathroom and cleaned his wound. They wrapped a bandage around his tail and gave him some milk. They told Lila that the cat was brave and strong and that he would be okay. They thanked Lila for trying to help the cat and told her that she was brave and kind too.

They took Lila and the cat back to her room and tucked them in her bed. They turned on her night light and kissed them goodnight. They told them that they loved them and that they were safe. Lila cuddled with the cat and felt his warm fur. The cat purred and licked her cheek. Lila smiled and closed her eyes. She felt peaceful and happy. She fell asleep with the cat in her arms and the light in her room.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Daisy. Daisy was walking in the park when she saw something in a tree. It was twinkling in the sun. When she got closer, she saw that it was a magnet! She was so excited and grabbed it from the tree. 

Suddenly, the ground started to tremble. Daisy was scared and looked around. When she looked up, she saw a fierce lion! Her heart was beating very fast and Daisy was scared. 

But then the lion started purring. Daisy was surprised and realised that the lion was friendly. The lion took the magnet from Daisy and set it back in the tree. Then the lion walked away. 

Daisy was so happy that the lion was nice. She learned a lesson that day - to not be afraid of fierce animals.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, but one day he accidentally broke his favorite toy truck. Timmy was very sad and didn't know what to do. 

But then, his dad came in and said he could fix the truck. Timmy was very happy and watched as his dad fixed the truck in the garage. The garage was a special room called a chamber where his dad fixed things. 

After the truck was fixed, Timmy felt a little ashamed for breaking it in the first place. But his dad told him it was okay and that accidents happen. Timmy learned that it's important to be careful with his toys, but if something does break, it can be fixed.

Tim and Mia are friends. They like to play in the park. They have a ball and a kite. They jog with the ball and fly the kite. They have fun.

One day, a new boy comes to the park. His name is Ben. He has a big bike. He rides his bike very fast. He has a label on his bike. It says "Ben's bike". He shows his bike to Tim and Mia.

"Look at my bike. It is new and shiny. It is better than your ball and kite. Do you want to ride my bike?" Ben says.

Tim and Mia look at the bike. It is new and shiny. They want to ride the bike. But they also like their ball and kite. They do not know what to say.

Ben sees that Tim and Mia are quiet. He thinks they are jealous. He smiles and says, "You are jealous of my bike. You wish you had a bike like mine. But you don't. You only have a ball and kite. They are old and boring. You are not my friends. Go away."

Tim and Mia feel sad and angry. They do not like Ben. He is mean and rude. They do not want to be his friends. They pick up their ball and kite. They jog away from Ben. They find another place to play. They have fun. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a wild mitten. It was brown and furry, and it knew how to move around. Every day it would sneak behind closed doors and explore the house.

One night, the wild mitten was really brave and went outside. It skipped through the grass, but it didn't know that it was getting closer to the road. Suddenly, something zoomed by really fast!

The wild mitten was scared and ran back inside. It tried to close the door, but it was too slow. The fast thing came closer and closer until it was right on top of the mitten.

The bad thing that happened was that the wild mitten got run over. It was very sad. The mitten couldn't move anymore, so it stayed where it was until the morning.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty nail. It was the strongest and toughest nail of them all. Everyone loved the mighty nail and wanted to have it, but no one could get it.

One day, a little boy came along. He was only three years old, but he was strong and brave. He wanted to have the mighty nail, too. The little boy walked up to the nail and looked it up and down.

He thought and thought until he knew exactly what would make him have the mighty nail. The little boy smiled and started to push the nail. He pushed and he pushed until the mighty nail was in his hands.

The little boy was so happy and excited! He held the mighty nail close and declared it was his forever. The mighty nail has stayed with the little boy since then and will never leave him.

Once there was a dog. It was called Tom. Tom was happy because he had a leash. 
The leash was for walking. Tom was so excited to go on a walk he jumped up and down.

Tom and his owner went for a slow walk. Tom liked to sniff all the smells around him. He had to keep close to his owner because of the leash. But Tom was so happy, he just kept walking and walking. 

Suddenly they heard a noise. It was a noise like a cat. It scared Tom and he pulled on the leash. He wanted to run but the leash was too slow. He had to stay close to his owner. 

Tom was so brave and he soon calmed down. After that the two of them carried on walking slow. Tom had a great day on his walk and he was so happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lila. She was 3 years old and very brave. One day, Lila was walking around with her mom and they saw a very big building. It looked scary!

Lila was curious, so she asked her mom, "What is that?" Her mom said, "It's a hospital. That's where sick people go to get better."

Lila's eyes widened. She said, "I don't want to go in there!" But her mom said, "Don't worry, you don't have to go inside. We only need to see the doctor."

Lila calmed down a little and they walked into the hospital. The doctor said, "Lila, I need to take a little needle and poke you. It will only take a second, and then you'll be done!"

Lila blinked. She was scared of needles, but the doctor looked very calm. She said "Okay, I'm ready."

The doctor gave her the needle, and it didn't hurt too much. The doctor said, "See? That wasn't so bad."

Lila smiled. She was glad she could be brave and get the needle. From then on, she wasn't scared of needles anymore!

Once there was a little girl named Emmy. She was only three years old, and one day she decided to make something special. She wanted to make cheese!
So Emmy started making the cheese, but it ended up looking really silly. It was a smushed, lumpy mess. Emmy's mom saw it and laughed, which made Emmy feel really embarrassed. 

The next day, Emmy decided to try again. She made a more rounded cheese this time, and it looked better. It was still lumpy, though. Emmy's mom saw it again and this time she said something very harsh. 

Emmy was so embarrassed, she felt like she wanted to hide. But she was brave and held her head up high, even though her mom's words felt very mean.

Finally, after a few more tries, Emmy got the cheese just right. She proudly showed it to her mom and waited for her reaction. Her mom said it was perfect and gave her a big hug. Emmy was so happy that all the embarrassment had gone away!

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. The lion lived in the jungle with his friends, the monkeys and the birds. One day, the lion found an axe in the jungle. The lion thought the axe was charming and decided to keep it.

The next day, the lion heard a loud roar. It was coming from the other side of the jungle. The lion and his friends went to see what was happening. They found a big bear who was very angry. The bear was roaring because he had lost his axe.

The lion remembered he had found an axe and showed it to the bear. The bear was very happy and thanked the lion. The bear stopped roaring and became friendly with the lion and his friends. From that day on, they all played together in the jungle.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside on the lawn. His lawn was very smooth and green. One day, Tim's friend came over to play. His friend had a toy gun and wanted to shoot it.

Tim's mom saw them playing and said, "Boys, we don't shoot guns at each other. That's not safe."

Tim's friend said, "But it's just a toy gun. It won't hurt anyone."

Tim's mom replied, "It's not about the toy gun. It's about being safe and kind to each other. We don't want anyone to get hurt."

Tim and his friend understood and decided to play a different game. They played catch with a ball instead. They had fun and no one got hurt. The moral of the story is that it's important to be safe and kind to each other, even when playing games.

Chloe was a very nice girl. She liked to play with her friends and help her Papa. One day, Papa had a project he wanted to do. He said he needed a cable. But Chloe couldn't find it. She looked and looked but she still couldn't find it. She was frustrated.

Once upon a time, there was a race. It was a hard race, because the ground was very wet. All of the racers wanted to win.

Some of them slipped and fell. They got their clothes very wet and muddy. But no one stopped. They wanted to win the race.

At the end, the ground was very wet. Everyone's clothes were soaked. But it didn't matter. They all were very happy because they had finished the race.

Once there was a little girl named Lilly. She was three years old and loved to take baths. Every time she went to the bathroom she looked forward to playing in the water.

Today was a special day because Lilly was getting a new sweater. She had wanted one for a long time. It was orange with white stripes and felt really rough.

After she was done, Lilly grabbed the towel and dried off. Then she wore her new sweater and went off to explore the world.

Tommy was a little boy. He loved playing with his toys. One of his favourite toys was a golf set. It had a golf ball and a golf club.

One day Mommy said to Tommy, "Let's go buy a new toy!" Tommy was so excited.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. The first friend was very nervous. The other was very brave.

The two friends were fillin up their pencil case with new pencils. The brave friend said: "Let's get lots of pencils and fill our case up!"

The nervous friend said: "I'm nervous. I don't want to get too many pencils." But the brave friend was very encouraging.
