She puts all the red toys in one pile, all the blue toys in another pile, and so on.

"Look, Ben, I sorted my toys by color. Do you like it?" Lily asks.

"Yes, Lily, your toys look very pretty. But I like to sort my toys by shape. It is more fun," Ben says.

They look at each other's piles and wonder who is right.

"Let's ask Mom. She knows everything," Lily says.

They run to the kitchen where Mom is making cookies. They show her their toys and ask her who sorted them better.

Mom smiles and hugs them. She says, "You both did a great job. There is no right or wrong way to sort your toys. You can sort them by shape, by color, or by any other way you like. The important thing is that you have fun and learn new things."

She gives them each a cookie and says, "Do you want to hear a story?"

"Yes, please!" Ben and Lily say.

Mom takes them to the living room and sits on the couch. She opens a big book and shows them a picture of a wild animal. It has a long neck, brown spots, and horns.

"This is a giraffe. It lives in a place called Africa, where it is very hot and dry. It eats leaves from tall trees and drinks water from rivers. It is a very cool animal, don't you think?" Mom says.

"Wow, it is so big and tall. I want to see a giraffe," Ben says.

"Me too. It is so cute and funny. I want to hug a giraffe," Lily says.

Mom laughs and says, "Maybe one day we can go to the zoo and see a giraffe. But for now, let's read more stories about wild and cool animals. Are you ready?"

"Yes, Mom, we are ready. We love stories," Ben and Lily say.

They cuddle with Mom and listen to her stories. They learn about lions, elephants, monkeys, and more. They have a lot of fun and feel happy. They love their Mom, their toys, and their stories.

Once there was a very fine rabbit. He was always looking for food in the garden. One day, he asked the other animals to borrow some smoke, because he was feeling very hungry.

The cow said, "Yes, I can give you some smoke, but you must promise to return it".

The rabbit agreed to this and borrowed smoke from the cow. He quickly ate the smoke and thanked the cow.

The next day, the rabbit wanted to borrow some more smoke. But the cow said, "No, you must return what you borrowed first".

So the rabbit said sorry to the cow and returned the smoke. The cow was happy that the rabbit kept his promise and he let the rabbit borrow more smoke.

The rabbit was very thankful to the cow for being so kind. From then on, the cow and the rabbit became very good friends.

One day, Jack was feeling anxious. He was standing at the top of a tall hill and still felt scared. Even though it was spring, he didn't want to move.

Suddenly, Jack heard a voice from behind him. It was his friend Maggie. She asked why he was standing there and not coming down to play. Jack said nothing. 

Maggie smiled and said, "I can show you a new way to get down the hill." Jack nodded slowly and followed her. 

Maggie showed Jack how to stand on his tiptoes and jump down the hill like a kangaroo. She said it was called 'springing'. 

Jack was nervous but he tried it. He jumped gently down the hill and it was fun! Jack couldn't stop smiling as he continued to spring down the hill with Maggie.

Once upon a time, there was a wild cat named Tim. Tim had soft skin and loved to play in the grass. He had a friend named Sam, who was a little dog.

One sunny day, Tim and Sam were playing together. They found a big ball to play with. Tim wanted to roll the ball, but Sam wanted to bounce it. They both disagreed on what to do with the ball.

Tim and Sam decided to take turns. First, Tim rolled the ball and then Sam bounced it. They played all day long and had lots of fun. In the end, they both agreed that sharing and taking turns was the best way to play.

Once there was a little boy who owned a brown safe. The safe was filled with many treasures that he loved to play with. Every day he would take out something different and enjoy it until dinnertime. 

One day, the boy was being naughty. His mom scolded him and told him to tie up the safe. So he went to his room and tried to tie the safe with a piece of string. But he couldn't do it. 

"Mom, I can't tie up the safe," he called out to her.

"Go and ask your father for help," she said. 

So the boy went in search of his dad, but he had gone out. He looked everywhere, but he was nowhere to be seen. 

Finally, it was getting late and dark so the little boy had to go to bed. In the morning, he searched again, but his dad was still gone and the safe was still untied.

The little boy was so sad. He never saw his dad again and his treasures were gone forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim did not like to eat his meals. He only wanted to eat candy and cake. This made his mom and dad very sad. They wanted Tim to become healthy and strong.

One day, a wise bird came to visit Tim. The bird said, "If you do not eat your meals, you will become weak and small." Tim did not want to be weak and small. He wanted to be big and strong like his dad. So, Tim tried to eat his meal. He found out that he liked it!

From that day on, Tim ate all his meals. He became healthy and strong. Tim learned that eating his meals was important to be big and strong. His mom and dad were very happy. The wise bird was happy too. And they all lived happily ever after.

The moral of the story is to always eat your meals to become healthy and strong.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to sail. He built a boat out of wood and found some sails. It was sunny, so he decided to go sailing. 

He put his boat in the water and hopped in. He raised the sails and felt the breeze push his boat away. He waved goodbye to his mom and dad as he floated away. 

He sailed for a while until he heard a loud barking. It was a big, angry dog. The dog was in the water and it did not look happy. 

The little boy was scared, but he remembered what his parents said: 'be brave and don't be afraid'. He quickly grabbed the oars and started paddling the boat away from the angry dog. 

The boy paddled and paddled until the angry dog was far away. Finally, he was in the clear and he could continue to sail. He was so happy that he stayed out at sea until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had long pink hair and was only three years old. One day, it started to rain outside. Amy loved the rain, but it made her sad because she could not go outside and play.

Amy said, "I wish I could find something to do inside on a rainy day like this."

Her mother said, "Don't worry, Amy. I have an idea. Let's go search for something fun we can do together!"

So, Amy and her mother searched around the house for something fun. They looked in the living room, the kitchen, and Amy's bedroom. Finally, Amy found something pink under her bed. It was an old game she had forgotten about!

Amy was so excited, she jumped up and down. She and her mother played the game together for the rest of the day, and Amy forgot all about the rain outside.
 
The end!

Once there was a lovely old lady who had a beautiful steel bird cage. Every day she would feed her birds pieces of fruit and seeds. The birds were so happy as she talked to them and sang to them as she fed them.

One day, a sweet little sparrow flew into the old lady's yard. He was so hungry that the old lady decided to feed him too. She got a little extra food from her pantry and put it all in a bowl.

The sparrow chirped and sang with joy as he ate and he was so happy to be respected by the old lady. Each day he would sit outside the cage and look longingly at the other birds, wishing he could join them inside.

Then one day the old lady opened the door on the side of the bird cage. She motioned for the sparrow to enter. The sparrow flew in and chirped with joy as he looked around the lovely steel cage. The old lady smiled, so happy to have a new friend in the cage.

From then on, the old lady fed the sparrow alongside her other friends. They all enjoyed their meals together, chirping happily while they ate.

The old lady felt so much love for all of her beautiful birds. It was a lovely sight to behold.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was sad, because there was nothing to do. She looked around at the gloomy sky and felt a strong urge.

The girl closed her eyes and wished for something new to create. Suddenly, she heard a sound. It was a soft voice saying, "believe in yourself". 

The girl opened her eyes and smiled. With her newfound courage, she began to create something special. She worked and worked until nightfall. 

When she was finished, she saw a beautiful world full of happiness. She smiled and thanked the voice for giving her the urge to create. 

The girl was never gloomy again.

Once there was an ancient man. He lived in a small house in the forest. Every day he would take long walks and look for mushrooms. One day he spotted a mushroom at noon that looked very special. He wanted to pick the mushroom but it was very hard. He pushed and pulled for a long time, but it wouldn't yield. The ancient man started to worry, but he didn't give up. He worked and worked, and finally after a lot of effort the mushroom yielded. The man was very happy. He brought the mushroom home and then cooked it. It was the best mushroom he had ever tasted!

Lily and Max love to dance. They dance to the music on the radio. They move their feet and arms to the rhythm. The rhythm is the beat of the music. It makes them happy.

One day, they go to the park with their mom. They see a big band playing music. There are drums, guitars, and horns. The music is loud and cool. Lily and Max run to the band. They want to dance.

They find a spot near the band. They start to dance. They spin, jump, and clap. They smile and laugh. The band sees them. They like their dancing. They play a special song for them.

The song is slow and sweet. Lily and Max hold hands. They sway to the music. They look into each other's eyes. They feel warm and fuzzy. They lean closer. They kiss.

They hear a loud cheer. They turn around. They see their mom and the band. They are clapping and smiling. They are happy for them. Lily and Max blush. They hug each other. They say, "We love you." They love to dance. They love to kiss.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. One day, he found a big hole in his yard. He thought it was a mine. He was very excited.

Tim called his friend, Sam. "Sam, I found a mine in my yard! Come play with me!" Sam ran to Tim's house. They both looked at the hole. They wanted to raise something from the mine.

They took a rope and tied it to a toy car. They put the car in the hole and pulled it up. They played like this all day. They raised many toy cars from the mine. They were very happy.

At the end of the day, they found a toy car that looked old and dirty. It was a dead car. They tried to raise it, but it was too heavy. They asked Tim's dad for help. He raised the dead car from the mine. Tim and Sam were very happy to have a new toy car to play with.

Once upon a time there was a farmer. He was very important. Every morning he woke up early and did his work on the farm. He worked hard all day long.

One special day, a bell rang on the farm. The farmer was so happy! He called out to his animals. He said, "Who is ringing the bell? Please tell me!"

The animals talked to each other and then replied, "It is the farmer's friend. She is coming to visit."

The farmer was so pleased. He quickly said goodbye to his animals and ran to greet his friend. He waved and said, "Welcome! I'm so glad you came to visit me today. It's important!"

His friend smiled and nodded. She said, "Yes, it is important that we see each other. Let's have some fun!"

They laughed and talked all day long. They played together, ran around and even sang songs. The farmer even made a special lunch to share with his friend. It was a very special day and they enjoyed themselves very much.

Once upon a time there was a small girl named Polly. She loved to explore the world around her. One day she went for a walk in the park and discovered something amazing!

As she walked by the pond, she was amazed by all the beautiful colors in the water. She sat down and started to watch. Suddenly, she noticed a very special pattern of colors, like a rainbow in the water!

Polly was very excited, and she quickly ran to find her mom. When Polly told her mom about what she had discovered, her mom said it was a rainbow fish. "They're a very rare kind of fish!" she said.

Polly and her mom sat together and watched the fish swim in its rainbow pattern around the pond. The colors were rich and beautiful. 

Polly was so happy. She learned that day that when she looked closely, amazing discoveries could be made!

Mia was very happy. She saw a big, brown owl in her garden and smiled. She wanted to take the owl home with her, but Mama said no. Mama said that it was too messy to keep an owl inside.

Mia pouted and said, "But Mama, it's so cute!" But Mama said no again. Mia sighed and asked, "Can I just give it a hug?" 

Mama smiled and said, "Ok! Just for a few minutes." Mia was so excited, she ran over to give the owl a big hug. She said, "You make me happy. I love you, little owl!" 

Suddenly, the owl flew away! Mia shouted, "Come back!" But the owl was already gone. Mia was sad and began to cry. 

Mama saw how upset Mia was, so she said, "Don't worry, Mia. Let's go get ice cream and smile!" Mia smiled and said, "Yes, let's go!" Then the two of them left to get ice cream together.

Once upon a time there were two cubes. One cube was very boring, and it stayed in one place all day. The other cube was much more adventurous and loved to split up into smaller pieces.

One day the two cubes met up for a chat. The boring cube was very jealous of the adventurous cube and wished it could do what the other cube could do. So the adventurous cube split up into small pieces and offered to show the boring cube how to do it too. 

After a lot of practice, the boring cube was finally able to split up into small cubes like the adventurous cube. They were both so proud! 

The moral of the story is that if you're brave enough to try new things, good things can happen. You never know what you can do until you try!

Once upon a time, there was a lazy rat. This rat did not like to run or play. He liked to eat and sleep all day.

One day, the rat wanted to travel to find more food. He walked and walked until he found a big house. Inside the house, there was a lot of food.

The lazy rat ate and ate. He was so happy. Then, he went back home to sleep. The rat had a good day traveling and eating.

Once there was a lonely father who wanted to improve his life. He had a daughter who he loved more than anything. One day he decided to leave home and search for a better job. He wanted to make money for his daughter and make her happy. 

But the father never returned home. He was gone many days and his daughter was so sad and lonely. 

One day a letter arrived for the daughter. She opened it and inside was a letter from her father. He had written a story to explain why he could not come home. He had found a new job, but it was not the kind he expected. He had to live far away and could not afford to return. 

The daughter wept as she read the letter. She was sad to lose her father and now live a lonely life without him. The father had tried to improve his life, but it only made it worse.

Once upon a time, there was a very gifted dinosaur named Dippy. Dippy was such a clever dinosaur and could measure things like an adult.

One day, he was measuring the biggest tree in the forest. Suddenly, he heard a loud and scary roar. He quickly looked behind him, and saw a giant T-Rex!

Dippy was scared but he bravely said to T-Rex, "What do you want?"

T-Rex replied, â€œI want all of your measurements!â€

Dippy refused. He did not want the T-Rex to threaten other dinosaurs. However, T-Rex refused to leave until he had all of the measurements.

So, Dippy had to give up all of his measurements to T-Rex. Unfortunately, T-Rex used Dippy's measurements to cause trouble in the forest.

The end.

Ernie was a little pigeon. He was sleepy from a long day of flying around. He wanted to find a nice place to rest.
So Ernie flew off to the mailbox. It was big and red. Ernie thought it looked like the perfect spot to take a nap.

Ernie curled up and closed his eyes, soon he was fast asleep. He had the best nap ever. 

When he awoke, he could hear voices coming from inside the mailbox. Ernie poked his head in and saw that the mailbox was full of letters. People had written them and were mailing them off to their friends and family. 

Ernie was amazed! He realized that mail was important and felt proud that he had found such a special place to rest. From that day on, Ernie knew that the mailbox was a great place for all the sleepy pigeons to find a place to rest.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl called Lucy. She had an important job to do. She needed to turn on her room's light. But, there was a big problem - her room had no switch.

The only way for Lucy to get light in her room was to go and get help from her Mom and Dad. So, she bravely set off to track them down.

She found her Mom and Dad in the kitchen. Kindly, they showed her the light switch. She was thrilled - she knew how to turn her room's light on now.

Back in her own room, Lucy bravely reached up and flipped the switch. At last, her room was bright and light! She smiled - now she could get ready for bed.

Lucy had done a great job. She had done what she needed to do and switched on her room's light. She was very proud of herself!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved castles and so one day she shut her eyes tight and wished for one.

Suddenly, Lucy opened her eyes and there before her was a pale castle. It was so glittery and shiny! Lucy couldn't believe it was real.

She took a few steps closer and blinked. When Lucy opened her eyes again the castle was still there! She gasped with joy and ran to the door. 

Inside the castle there were many exciting things to explore. Lucy jumped and skipped around, discovering different rooms and treasures.

After a long day, Lucy said goodbye to the castle and blinked one last time. When she opened her eyes, the pale castle had gone! Lucy smiled and thanked the castle for its magical day.

Timmy was excited. He had a special surprise waiting for him at school today. His mom had told him he was going to see something "very fun" in his classroom.

When he arrived, Timmy saw that someone was in the room. He saw a big, gray box in the corner.

"Mom, who is that?" asked Timmy.

"That is a surprise for you, sweetheart," said his mom. "See what he is selling?"

Timmy looked closer at the box and saw that inside was a toy. He was so excited. The toy was gray, too!

"Can I buy it, mommy?" asked Timmy.

His mom smiled and said, "Yes, of course you can."

Timmy knew right away that his new gray toy was the best surprise ever. He couldn't wait to show it off to his friends in the classroom.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely driver named Tom. He drove a big yellow bus that took children to school every day. One morning, a little girl named Lily got on the bus and started to misbehave. She was jumping on the seats and shouting loudly.

Tom turned around and said, "Lily, you need to behave on the bus. We want everyone to be safe and happy."

Lily felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Tom. I will behave now."

Tom smiled and said, "That's great, Lily. Thank you for listening. Now let's have a fun ride to school!" And with that, they drove off, happy and safe.

Once there was a little boy who loved grapes. Every day he would pick one from the bush in his garden, and eat it with a smile on his face. One day, as he was picking a grape, he had a big sneeze. He sneezed so hard that he almost fell over! The sneeze was so loud that it scared the birds away. 

After he finished sneezing, he went back to his task of picking grapes. He grabbed a grape and it felt bad. He shook it, but it was still bad. He put it back on the bush and grabbed another grape. Yay, this one was juicy and sweet! He happily munched on it and forgot about the bad grape. 

The little boy had a great time picking and tasting grapes. Every time he found a good one, he cheered with delight. He was so happy eating the sweet grapes that he forgot all about his big sneeze.

Once there was an old man who wanted to teach the children to play. He decided to teach them to play a pipe. Every day he would visit the children and show them how to make music by blowing into the pipe. Popular tunes would fill the air.

The children loved playing the pipe. They would practice everyday until they could make music just like the old man. With time, they even began making up their own tunes. Everyone in town started to enjoy the sweet songs coming from the children's pipes.

Soon, the old man became very popular. Everywhere he went, people would say hello and thank him for teaching the children to play the pipe. The old man was so proud of the children and the music that they had made.

The old man and the children continued to make music and play their pipes. It was a happy time for all of them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who liked to explore. One day, she decided to take a walk to the shore. As she walked, she came across a modest little pond. She saw something in the water, but it was too far away for her to see. She walked a bit closer. Suddenly, the object moved and the little girl jumped back. She soon realized it was a duck that was just swimming around. The duck had lost its way and the little girl wanted to help it find its way back to the shore. 

So, the little girl picked up some pebbles and started to throw them across the pond. The duck followed the stones, so she kept throwing them until the duck safely reached the shore. The little girl was very happy that the duck was back home and they both went their separate ways.

Once there was a boy named Bob, and he was very lucky. Bob had lots of cool toys, but he liked one toy in particular. It was a wooden car with a special knob on the side.

Bob loved to play with the knob. He would spin it around and around, and then turn the car upside down to see the knob fall out. It was a lot of fun. 

One day, Bob and his mom went shopping. When they got home, Bob ran to his room to see if his toy was still there. But the knob was missing!

Bob was sad until his mom showed him the plastic bag she was carrying. Inside was the knob, separate from the toy car. Mom had bought the knob all by itself.

"You're so lucky, Bob," Mom said. "Now we can buy you a brand new car for your special knob." 

Bob smiled, happy he was so lucky.

Once upon a time, in a land of ice and snow, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim had a big dream. He wanted to build an igloo, a house made of ice. But his mom said, "No, Tim. It is too cold outside."

One day, Tim saw a bad wolf. The wolf was hungry and wanted to eat Tim. Tim was scared and ran to his mom. He said, "Mom, there is a bad wolf outside. Can I build an igloo to hide from the wolf?"

His mom thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, Tim. I will allow you to build an igloo. But I will help you, so you don't get too cold." Tim was happy and hugged his mom.

Together, they built a strong igloo. When the bad wolf came back, he could not find Tim. The igloo kept Tim and his mom safe. From that day on, Tim and his mom lived happily in their icy home.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Emma. She loved playing with dolls, but she was given a problem - she didn't have enough money to buy the one she wanted.

So she went to visit her uncle and he said to her, "Emma, I'm sorry but the price is too high. I don't think it will fit your budget."

Emma was very sad. She wanted the doll, but she didn't want to hurt her uncle's feelings by asking him for more money.

But then her uncle had an idea. He said, "But wait, if you help me with a few chores around the house, then I can give you enough money to buy the doll."

Emma was overjoyed! She helped her uncle around the house, and in time she had enough money to buy the doll she wanted. She was so happy it almost made her hurt.

She said goodbye to her uncle, and went to the store to get the doll. At last, she was able to buy it. She thanked her uncle for his help, and went home with the precious gift. 

The end.

John and Lisa were very kind and good friends. One day, John had a new zip on his coat and he showed it to Lisa.

John said: "Look, I have a new zip!"

Lisa replied: "That's very cool. Can I try it?"

John said: "Yes sure!"

Lisa started to remove the zip. But, unfortunately, the zip got stuck and wouldn't come off. John tried to pull it, but he couldn't.

John said sadly: "I think the zip is broken."

John and Lisa tried their best to fix the zip, but it was impossible. In the end, they had to remove the coat altogether and John was very sad.

John said: "Now I don't have a new zip. That's not kind." 
Lisa tried her best to comfort him, but it was no use. They had to accept the bad result and went their separate ways.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat cherries, especially the soft ones. One day, her mom gave her a big bowl of cherries to eat. But when Lily started to eat them, she saw that one of the cherries was not soft, it was hard.

Lily didn't want to eat the hard cherry, but she also didn't want to waste it. She thought about what to do and then came up with an idea. She decided to give the hard cherry to her little brother who loved to eat anything.

When Lily gave the hard cherry to her brother, he was so happy and ate it right away. Lily felt happy too because she was able to solve the conflict and make her brother happy at the same time. From that day on, Lily always remembered to check if the cherries were soft before she ate them.

Once upon a time, there was a little painter named Luke. He loved to paint, he was very good at it too. 

One day, he was feeling very helpless because he had to paint a huge wall, but he only had a tiny brush. He tried as much as he could, but the walls weren't being painted quickly enough. He started to cry and then he heard a voice.

"I can help you, little painter", said the voice. Luke looked around but he couldn't see anyone. Then suddenly, he saw a small bird in the tree. 

"I know how to paint fast," said the bird. "I can help you, if you let me." Luke was so relieved, that he agreed.

The bird flew down and started to paint the wall with its sharp beak. In no time at all, the wall was painted and Luke was very happy. 

"Thank you!" said Luke. The bird smiled and flew away. Luke was very thankful for the bird's help and since that day, he always remembered to be grateful for the help of others.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to go to the park. He asked his mom, "Can we take a taxi to the park?" His mom said, "Yes, we can use a taxi today."

On the way to the park, the taxi got stuck in a big puddle. Tim and his mom were not glad. The taxi driver said, "I am sorry, we can't go to the park now. The taxi is stuck."

Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's use a rope to pull the taxi out of the puddle!" They all worked together to pull the taxi out. They were very glad when the taxi was free.

Finally, they reached the park. Tim played on the swings and had lots of fun. He was very glad that they used a taxi and that they were able to fix the problem.

Once there was a mom and a daughter. The daughter wanted to play with a laser toy. She asked her mom. Mom did not permit it.

"No," said Mom. "Laser toys are bad and I do not want you to play with them." 

The daughter looked sadly at her mom. "But I want to play," she said. 

"No," said Mom. "It is not safe. Lasers can be bad, and I do not want you to get hurt." 

The daughter did not understand. She started to cry. 

Mom hugged her daughter. "I know you want to play," said Mom, "but I cannot permit it. It is not safe." 

The daughter sniffed and wiped her tears away. "Ok," she said. 

Mom was relieved. She hugged her daughter again and kissed her forehead. 

"There are lots of other things you can do that are much safer," said Mom. 

The daughter smiled and hugged her mom. She decided to forget about the laser and play with something else.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy sun. The sun would be in the sky, but it did not like to shine bright. It would hide behind the clouds all day. The sun felt sad and did not want to play.

One day, the wind came from the east. The wind saw the grumpy sun and wanted to help. The wind blew the clouds away, so the sun could see the happy kids playing outside. The sun started to feel a little less grumpy.

The sun decided to be happy and shine bright for the kids. The kids laughed and played under the warm sun. The grumpy sun was now a happy sun, and it loved to light up the sky every day.

There was a kid who was very young. He was excited to rise early in the morning. He looked around and saw the sun rising in the sky. He wanted to get outside to play. He said goodbye to mom and dad and ran outside. He saw the birds rising high above the trees. He got on his bike and started pedaling fast. He was happy to feel the breeze on his face as he rose up and down the hills. Soon he was even higher than the birds! He laughed as he rose higher and higher, and felt proud of himself. He was getting so high, he thought he might never come down. But then, with a big smile, he felt gravity pull him back down and he gave the ground a big hug. He was so happy he had risen so high. He closed his eyes and felt the sun on his face, and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a young man named Tony. Tony wanted to find the right girl to marry. So, one day he went to a party and met a young lady named June. They started to talk and soon became friends.

At the end of the party Tony asked if June wanted to get married. She said yes, and they hugged.

Tony and June told their families. Everyone was so excited. On the day they got married, Tony and June were very happy.

Tony and June have been married for a long time now and they have a wife. Together they have a wonderful life.

Once upon a time, there was a little pig. He was worried because he had never finished anything. One day, he decided to try something new. He wanted to finish eating all the apples in the apple tree. He had never done that before! He was very excited and he started eating apples right away.

But soon, he was feeling very tired. He had eaten lots of apples, but he was just too tired to finish. So he lay down and fell asleep. When he woke up, he saw that all the apples had gone! He was so relieved and happy. He had finished eating all the apples!

He was so proud of himself for finishing the task. From that day on, he never worried about not finishing something. Instead, he focused on doing his best and enjoying what he was doing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Amy. She lived in a modern house and she loved to explore outside. One afternoon, she decided to go for a walk. As she strolled, she noticed a strange shadow moving quickly across the ground. She stopped to take a closer look and to her surprise, the shadow had a face! It was smiling at her.

Amy was so excited! She waved at the shadow and said "Hi! What's your name?" 

The shadow replied in a whispery voice. "My name is Shadow. I'd love to meet you!"

Amy eagerly reached out her hand to meet the friendly shadow. When she did, a strange thing happened. The shadow suddenly changed colour and became darker. Amy tried to take a step back, but it was too late. The shadow grabbed a hold of her and refused to let go.

Amy struggled to break free, but the dark shadow was too strong. She desperately screamed for help, but no one could save her.

Amy realised that this was not the friendly, care-free shadow she had met before. She soon realized, too late, that this was a bad shadow. It was a modern nightmare that she would never forget.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Anna who wanted to play. She saw a crystal in the corner of her yard. It was heavy and shiny! Anna ran to get it and held it in her hands. 

Anna's mom saw the crystal and said, "What is that?"

Anna said, "It's a heavy crystal. I want to keep it."

Anna's mom smiled and said, "We can pour some water into it and it will sparkle in the sun."

So Anna and her mom took a bucket and filled it with water. When the bucket was full, her mom poured the water into the crystal. The crystal glittered and sparkled in the sun.

Anna was so excited. She hugged the crystal and said, "Thank you, Auntie!"

Her mother smiled and said, "You're welcome, Anna. Now let's see what else we can do with this heavy crystal!" 

Anna and her mom had lots of fun playing with the crystal all day. Eventually, the sun went down and it was time for bed. Anna hugged the crystal and said goodnight, then put it in her room to look at when she wakes up the next morning.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Lola who loved to play. She had lots of toys and furniture in her room. Lola liked to keep everything organized so she could find all of her things. 

One day, Lola wanted to play a new game. She got an idea, so she closed her eyes and jumped on the furniture. She pretended she was a superhero and had to save the world. 

Lola flew all around the room and then stopped at the bed. She shouted "dive" and jumped so high, she nearly touched the ceiling. Afterwards, she was so tired, she fell fast asleep. 

The next morning when Lola woke up, she couldn't believe what she saw. The furniture was all neatly organized! Maybe her superhero powers worked!

Once upon a time there were two friends, Alex and Ben. They were both very jolly, and loved playing together. One day, they were pretending to be doctors, and Alex wanted to give Ben an x-ray. 

â€œI'm ready to get my x-ray!â€ said Ben, smiling.

Alex gave the x-ray and paused for a moment. â€œI can't see anything strange. You look very healthy!â€

â€œOh, good!â€ Ben replied. Suddenly, his face lit up and then he asked, â€œCan we take an x-ray of your tummy?â€

Alex laughed. â€œSure, why not?â€

Ben gave Alex an x-ray and after pausing to check it, he said, â€œLooks like your tummy is healthy too!â€

Alex and Ben both smiled. Now they knew they were both very healthy, so they ran outside and continued to play. The end!

Once, there was an girl named Jane. Jane liked to build things, like castles and forts. She liked to use different items, like blocks and books. 

One day, Jane was playing with some paper. She cut out different shapes and began building something. She used the paper to create a castle, with a page for the wall.

Jane wanted to make her castle friendly, so she began to draw. She decorated the page with happy faces and smiling flowers. 

When Jane was finished, the castle looked so wonderful! It made her so happy, and she showed it to her friends. They all loved her friendly creation!

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max had a flea on his back that he couldn't get rid of. The flea troubled Max a lot because it made him itchy. Max tried to scratch the flea off, but it wouldn't go away.

One day, Max's owner saw the flea and decided to help. She got a comb and started to brush Max's fur. The flea tried to keep hiding, but the comb caught it. Max's owner was happy to finally catch the flea.

Max was happy too because he didn't feel itchy anymore. He wagged his tail and licked his owner's face to say thank you. From that day on, Max's owner made sure to keep him flea-free.

Once upon a time there was a pink worm called Woolly. Woolly lived in a garden with lots of other worms. Every morning he came out and ate some juicy tomatoes. But one day he saw something very strange and he began to cry. It was a giant pink dragon flying up in the sky! Woolly was so scared that he quickly dove underground and hid. He was so scared his eyes were squeezed shut and he kept crying. 

Eventually Woolly decided it was safe to come out of his hole. He looked all around but there was no sign of the pink dragon. Instead, Woolly saw a beautiful rainbow and he smiled instead of crying. He realised that the pink dragon must have just been a dream. Woolly was so happy and he went back to eating his juicy tomatoes. And he lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a big, bouncy blue ball. His name was Bounce. Bounce was always excited to play with the kids in his class. He loved to bounce around and make them smile. 

One day, Bounce was feeling a bit scared. He was worried that the kids in his class would not like him. He was fearful of what they would think if he bounced around too much.

But his worries were gone when he saw all the kids in his class. They were smiling and clapping as Bounce bounced around. He felt happy and relieved. 

"We love you, Bounce!" the kids shouted.

And from that day on, Bounce was no longer fearful. He had made lots of new friends who loved to play with him. He knew he had nothing to worry about. The kids in his class loved Bounce and his bouncing!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom asked her to put the dishes in the dishwasher. Lily was very cheerful and happy to help her mom.

As she was putting the dishes away, Lily accidentally dropped a plate and it broke into many pieces. She started to cry because she was worried that her mom would be angry with her.

Lily's mom heard her crying and came into the kitchen. She saw the broken plate and asked Lily what happened. Lily told her what had happened and apologized for breaking the plate. Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, accidents happen. The most important thing is that you tried to help me." 

From that day on, Lily learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that it's important to always try your best. She also learned that it's important to ask for help when you need it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Melody. Melody had a friend called Sunshine. One day, they were playing at Sunshine's house. They wanted to paint pictures, so Sunshine went to get her paint box.

Melody looked in the paint box and saw some bright crayons. She mentioned to Sunshine how beautiful the colours were. Sunshine agreed and said that she liked to paint with them.

Melody decided to take one of the crayons and hid the other in her pocket. Soon Sunshine noticed and said it wasn't nice to take without asking first.

Melody felt bad and put the crayon back in the paint box. She realised it's not nice to take things without asking. Instead, she should have been quiet and asked permission to take the crayon.

The girls painted their pictures and had a lot of fun. They shared the paint box and were happy to have each other as friends. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to be polite, honest and quiet when you're with other people. Even if something looks interesting, always ask first!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved her uncle very much. He was a pretty man with a big smile. 

One day, Lily went to visit her uncle. But when she got there, she saw that he was very sad. She asked him what was wrong, but he didn't want to tell her. 

Lily didn't like seeing her uncle sad. She wanted him to be happy like he always was. So she decided to do something to make him feel better. She drew him a picture of a pretty flower and gave it to him. Her uncle's face lit up and he hugged her tight. 

From that day on, Lily knew that sometimes people can be sad, but she also knew that she could help make them feel better. And her uncle knew that he had a pretty little niece who loved him very much.

Once upon a time there was a brave penny. She wanted to try something new, so she decided to go on an adventure. She hopped on her bicycle and started to speed away.

She pedalled faster and faster, zooming down the street. The wind swooshed through her hair. She felt so happy, and excited to see what lay ahead. 

Soon she came across a giant hill. She was a little scared, but she was brave. She kept pedalling as fast as she could; faster and faster she went up the hill. 

At the top, she stopped and looked around. The view was amazing! She felt so free and alive.

The brave penny smiled, feeling proud of herself. She knew she had been brave, and had accomplished something great. She sped back home, knowing that she had had a wonderful adventure.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jonathan. He was playing in his garden on a sunny day. Suddenly he noticed something shine in the distance. He walked towards it, but it seemed so far away.

He eventually got to the shiny thing and noticed it was a strip of metal. He walked around it, and it seemed endless. He started to get frustrated, but he kept walking. 

He noticed someone coming towards him. It was a girl, she had been walking around the strip too. She was going slow and looked down. Jonathan walked up to her and asked,
"What are you doing?"

The girl looked up and said, "Trying to get out of this strip, but it never ends!" Jonathan thought for a while, then had an idea. He said, "Let's pretend the strip is like a game, and we have to beat it."

The girl smiled and the two of them started playing. Jonathan was really quick and managed to pass the strip. He turned around to the girl and found her a little bit behind.

Jonathan asked, "Are you okay? Why are you going so slow?" The girl said, "I am scared that I won't beat it. But with your help, I will try my best." 

They both linked hands and slowly but surely beat the strip. They cheered and hugged each other as they ran out of it!

Once there was a little girl called Abby. Abby was three years old and she loved warm days. 

One day it was very hot and Abby got tired, so she leaned against a fan to cool down. The soft breeze felt yummy on her skin and she closed her eyes for a moment. 

Abby was about to doze off when a fly flew close to her face. Abby didn't like flies so she quickly leaned away. She chased the fly away with her hands and then the fan blew her hair all around her face. Abby giggled and leaned back, feeling the cool air on her cheeks. 

Finally, it was time to go home. Abby leaned against her mum's legs and they all walked back to their house together.

One day, Sally was walking in the garden when she found a strawberry. It was such a delicate looking thing, and Sally wanted to take a closer look. She gently pushed the strawberry with her finger and it wobbled around. Then, Sally heard a voice. 

"Don't push it too much," the voice said. "It might break!"

Sally was surprised. She looked around and saw a big, friendly-looking rabbit at her feet. 

"I didn't know you could talk!" she said.

"Of course I can talk!" said the rabbit. "But careful not to push the strawberry too hard. It is delicate!"

Sally nodded her head and stepped away from the strawberry, deciding to leave it alone. But the rabbit had an idea. He leaned forward and pushed the strawberry to Sally with his nose.

The strawberry rolled slowly towards Sally, and then stopped. Sally was so happy! She picked up the strawberry and thanked the rabbit. He was right; it was so delicate and sweet! 

From then on, Sally and the rabbit were friends and went on many adventures together. But no matter where they went, Sally never forgot that the strawberry was delicate, and to be very careful when she held it in her hands.

Once there was a messy piece of cake sitting on a plate. Mommy and Daddy wanted to eat the cake, but their little 3 year old daughter did not want to share. She shouted, "No! Mine!"

Daddy tried to talk to her. He said, "Sweetheart, it's not nice to be so messy and greedy. Let's share the cake nicely, ok?"

But the 3 year old was not listening. She just wanted the piece of cake all to herself. Finally, Mommy got angry and said, "No, no! If you don't want to share, you don't get a piece of cake at all!"

"But I want a piece!" the little girl shouted.

So Daddy and Mommy talked about it and decided that the little girl could have a piece of cake if she promised to share it.

The 3 year old girl carefully picked up the messy piece of cake and smiled. Then she shared it with Mommy and Daddy. Everyone was happy, and the cake was gone.

Once upon a time there was a mommy bear and a baby bear. The baby bear was very adorable. One day they were out for a walk in the woods. The baby bear saw some honey dripping from a honeycomb in a tree. He wanted to try it, but the mommy bear said it was too high for him to reach.

The baby bear was sad and he didn't believe he could get the honey. But then, the mommy bear had an idea. She told the baby bear to climb onto her back and then she could reach the honeycomb. The baby bear was so excited!

So the mommy bear carefully climbed onto the tree and reached for the honeycomb. She was able to grab it! She gave some honey to the baby bear and he was so happy. He thought it was the best honey he had ever tasted.

The baby bear learned that day to always believe in himself and with the help of his mommy, he could do anything!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his colorful toys and run around outside. One day, he went to the park to play. There he met a little girl named Sarah. 

"Hi Timmy! Do you want to play with me?" Sarah asked, holding out her hand. 

Timmy took her hand and they played together. They played on the swings, the slide, and even had a picnic. They had so much fun together that they decided to meet again the next day. 

The moral of the story is that it's always nice to make new friends and play together. Even if someone looks different or has different toys, it's important to be kind and share.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pet hedgehog named Spike. Spike was very cute, but he had weird spikes on his back. 

One day, Lily decided to give Spike a bath. She put him in a tub of water and watched him soak. But then, something weird happened. Spike's spikes started to grow bigger and bigger until they were too big for his body. 

Lily didn't know what to do. She tried to help Spike, but it was too late. His spikes were so big that they hurt him and he couldn't move. Sadly, Spike passed away and Lily was very sad. She learned that sometimes, even when we try to help, things don't always turn out okay.

Once upon a time, there was a man who lived in a big house. He wanted something special. He wanted something that was luxury and reliable. So he went to the store to look for it.

When he got to the store, he saw a big red wagon. It had four wheels and a handle. It was perfect! He bought it and took it home.

When he got home, the man pushed the wagon around his big house. It felt so good to go for rides in the wagon. He was happy with his purchase.

Everywhere he went, the wagon was reliable. He could count on it to get him wherever he wanted to go. He never had to worry about it breaking down.

Time passed, and the man kept pushing the wagon around his big house. It was the most reliable luxury he had ever owned. He was so happy that he smiled every time he went for a ride.

Everyday, Timmy watched the sky to see the planes fly by. He was a restless boy, always wanting to do something. One day, he saw a plane flying high in the sky, but it seemed like something was wrong.

The plane started to shake and wobble in the air. Timmy knew something must be wrong, and he wanted to help. He asked his mom if he could try and rescue the plane. Even though it seemed impossible, she agreed.

Timmy raced outside and grabbed his bucket, which he filled with sand and rocks. He ran outside to the front lawn and threw the sand and rocks into the air. As he did this he yelled, "Help! Help!"

When the plane got closer to the ground, Timmy ran back inside with his mom. As he looked out the window, he saw the plane's wheels touch the ground. Timmy had saved the day! 

The next morning Timmy looked outside with a smile of satisfaction on his face. He was proud of himself! He had rescued the plane.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They sat down to eat lunch. Tim noticed his mom had a rare sauce on her sandwich. "Mom, what is that?" he asked.

His mom said, "This is a rare sauce that I found at the store. It is very tasty. Do you want to try some, Tim?" Tim said yes and his mom put some sauce on his sandwich.

Tim took a bite and smiled. "I like the sauce, Mom!" he said. They enjoyed their lunch at the park and played on the swings. They had a fun day and Tim was happy he got to try the rare sauce.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and a dad who were very happy together. They loved each other very much and wanted to be together forever. One day, they decided to raise their hands and say nice things to each other in front of all their family and friends. This special thing was called a marriage.

The mom and dad were so excited and had a big party to share the news with everyone they knew. But then one day, the mom got angry. She was mad and yelled at the dad, and they started to fight. 

The mom and dad loved each other, but their fighting was causing them a lot of sadness. They decided to talk to each other and try to understand why the mom was so angry. After talking, the mom and dad hugged and said sorry to each other. 

The mom and dad worked hard and showed each other how much they loved each other. Even though sometimes they still got angry, they kept trying to talk and understand and found peace in their marriage. 
The End.

One day, a girl named Mandy went outside. She saw a big box of chalk and knew exactly what she wanted to do. She took the chalk out of the box and started drawing on the sidewalk. She was so creative! She drew pictures of hearts, stars and circles and smiled from ear to ear.

Mandy asked her mom for lots of colours and drew even more! She made colourful, bright squiggles and lines all over the sidewalk. Mandy was having so much fun she never wanted it to end.

Mandy heard her mom calling her name, so she put the chalk down and ran back inside. Mandy was so happy she was still smiling. She was proud of her artwork and excited for the next time she could make something creative with chalk.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a cat named Mittens. Mittens was a very silly cat who liked to play with toys and chase butterflies.

One day, Lily accidentally knocked over Mittens' toy box and all the toys fell out. Mittens was upset and meowed loudly. "I'm sorry, Mittens," said Lily. "Let me help you pick up your toys." 

As they were picking up the toys, Mittens saw a ball and started to play with it. Suddenly, the ball started to roll backwards and Mittens tried to catch it. Lily laughed and said, "Mittens, you're trying to reverse the ball!" Mittens looked confused but kept playing with the ball. 

From that day on, Lily and Mittens played together and had lots of fun. Mittens was never upset again and Lily learned a new word - reverse!

Once upon a time, there was a bright corn field. It was filled with lots of yellow corn and the sun was shining brightly.

Suddenly, it started to rain. Little Amy felt scared and started to cry. Her mommy came to comfort her and gave her a big hug.

When the rain stopped, Amy saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. She was very happy and ran out to the corn field again.

With big bright eyes, she looked for the rainbow amongst the corn stalks. She found the end of the rainbow and stopped and smiled.

Once again, her mommy came to comfort her when she felt tired and scared. She hugged Amy and told her she was safe.

The sun was back to shine and Amy ran and laughed in the middle of the bright corn field.

Once upon a time there was a small boy named Tom. Tom saw a big jar and he wanted to touch it.

Mom said to Tom, "No, Tom. It is too heavy. You have to be careful. I have to protect you."

Tom was curious and asked, "Mom, why do you want to protect me from the jar?" 

Mom looked at Tom and smiled. "Because the jar is filled with tiny glass pieces. If you touch it, it might hurt you."

Tom shook his head. He said, "OK, I will be careful. I'll protect myself from this big heavy jar." 

He made sure not to touch the heavy jar and he was very safe. The end.

Once upon a time there was a stubborn bear who lived in the forest. He loved to eat honey and would yield to anything that had to do with honey. One day, he ventured out of the forest in search for more honey. 

He came across a huge house with a refrigerator inside. The bear saw the refrigerator and became excited. He thought there might be honey inside and so he opened the door. Unfortunately, there was no honey. The bear was so sad and he started to feel angry.

So the bear became very stubborn and started to push against the walls of the refrigerator. He kept pushing, until the refrigerator finally broke. All the food inside the refrigerator spilled out, and the bear ran away. He left the refrigerator behind and never yielded again. 

The end.

Once there was an honest man who lived in a small house with his two cats. Every day he would go for a walk as he loved to explore the woods around his house. But one day as he was walking he noticed something strange - there was a thief carrying something from the woods!

The honest man was so angry that a thief was carrying something from his woods that he decided to do something about it. He ran as fast as he could and yelled for help. Immediately a few villagers ran to help him and together they chased the thief.

The thief ran away as fast as he could and soon disappeared out of sight. But the honest man was glad that he had done his bit to stop the thief and make sure no one else was carrying anything they shouldn't be. From that day onwards, the honest man warned everyone in the village to be extra careful whenever they went into the woods.

There was a plane in the sky. It was high up in the air. The plane was white and shiny and it sparkled in the sun. Suddenly, the plane started to spray something. It sprayed and sprayed and sprayed. The plane sprayed a strange white stuff that was very high in the air. It was so high, you couldn't even see it! The plane spread its spray for a long time until finally it finished and flew away.

Once there was a little girl named Judy. She loved playing outside with her toys. One day Judy was playing with her favorite toy, a funny-shaped object which she called her monkey. 

Judy started making funny noises and dancing with the monkey. She was having lots of fun. Suddenly, out of the corner of her eye, she spotted something hot. 

It was a bright yellow ball, and when Judy held it in her hand it felt very hot. She quickly put the hot ball down and stepped back. 

Then she realized: the hot thing was a record! Judy thought this was the best discovery ever. She put the record on her record-player and started dancing. 

Suddenly her mom walked in the room and asked, "What are you doing?" 

Judy smiled and said, "I'm recording my fun dance moves with the monkey!" 

Her mom smiled back and said, "that sounds like a lot of fun!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, she found a beautiful butterfly. It was yellow and had black spots on its wings. Lily said, "Hello, little butterfly. You are so pretty!" The butterfly blinked its eyes and flew away.

Lily's mom came outside and said, "Lily, be careful. Make sure you stay safe." Lily replied, "I will, Mommy. I just saw a beautiful butterfly." Her mom smiled and said, "That's nice, Lily. Remember to always be safe."

Lily continued to play outside and she saw her friend, Timmy. Timmy asked, "What did you see, Lily?" Lily said, "I saw a beautiful butterfly. It blinked its eyes and flew away." Timmy said, "Wow, that sounds cool. I want to see it too!" They searched for the butterfly but couldn't find it. Lily said, "It's okay, Timmy. We can still have fun and be safe while we play."

Once upon a time, there was a long nut. It was very exciting for everyone. The little squirrels were particularly excited and began playing with the nut. They ran around it and rolled it near the tree. It was so much fun for them!

Next, a big bear came in the forest and saw the long nut. He was very excited too. He bent down and touched the nut. His fur was so soft and the long nut felt amazing in his paws.

The bear started to nibble the nut and very soon it became shorter and shorter. He was enjoying it so much that he ate the whole nut!

The squirrels saw the bear eating their nut and got sad. But they soon saw that the bear had brought a new long nut. This time they were even more excited than before and they ran around the new nut and played with it all day long. They had lots of fun and they both lived happily ever after!

One day, a 3 year old boy was exploring his home. He was looking for something important. He saw a cool print on the wall and knew that this was what he was looking for.

He wanted to keep the print safe and so he decided to put it in a box that he found in the attic. The boy was very careful not to damage the print.

But then something very sad happened. The boy forgot to close the box and the print started to rot. The boy started to cry, he knew he had been very careless and had lost something very important.

He ran to his parents and they helped him to look for a new print. They taught him an important lesson - never forget to take care of something important!

Once upon a time, there was a duck. He looked all around and he saw something special - a rare duck. He wondered if it was his friend. He flew close to the rare duck and he looked at her. He saw she was brighter than him, with feathers of many colors, red and blue and green.

He wondered if she would be his friend. He quacked and said "hello". The rare duck quacked back and said "hello". Together, they waddled and quacked and played together. They had so much fun!

The duck saw the rare duck everyday. He thought she was so special and he was so happy to have a friend like her. They spent days and days swimming, flying, and talking together. The duck was so happy with his rare friend.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Sam and Jenny. Sam had a whistle he wanted to share with Jenny. He gave it to her and said that it was good. 

Jenny was very happy with the whistle. She blew as hard as she could, but it didn't make a sound. 

Sam said, "It's not broken, you just need to use the right breath."

Jenny tried again, this time she blew with her lips puckered and it made a soft sound.

Sam and Jenny were happy. They both smiled and started to whistle together. It sounded so good that even the birds in the trees came to listen and sing along.

Sam and Jenny kept sharing the whistle as they laughed and played. They would take turns holding the whistle, and this made them both happy.

Once upon a time there was one weird caterpillar. It was fuzzy and loved to crawl around! He had no idea what he should do with his life.

One day the caterpillar decided he wanted to explore the world. And so he decided to leave his home. He crawled and crawled for days.

One night he saw a magical tree. It was shining in the night and looked so inviting! He went closer and saw a giant caterpillar at the base of the tree. The giant caterpillar was just as weird as he!

The caterpillar was so happy that he had found someone like him to share his adventures with. Together they rolled around in the leaves, talked and made plans to explore the world.

Finally, they decided it was time to leave. So they hugged goodbye and waved as they crawled away.

The caterpillar made a wish before he left. He wished that he and the weird caterpillar would one day meet again!

Timmy and his Mommy were playing in the park. As they walked down the path, they passed a mysterious structure. It was tall, delicate, and made of wood.

"What is this thing, Mommy?" Timmy asked curiously. 

"I'm not sure," Mommy said. "Maybe you can find out!"

Timmy tiptoed up to the structure. Suddenly, he felt an urge to lean against it. He obeyed, and squealed as the structure started to move!

Mommy rushed over. "Timmy!" she cried. "What are you doing?"

But Timmy knew what he was doing. He had leaned against the structure and, slowly, it had started to turn. As he kept leaning, the structure began to move faster and faster â€“ until it suddenly opened up. 

Inside was a small merry-go-round! Timmy and Mommy laughed in delight. They had found something special in the park, something delicate and magical. Timmy had leaned against the structure and given them a gift they would never forget!

Once upon a time, there was a wrap. It was orange and it was special.

Mommy went to the closet and put the wrap inside. Then she held the wrap up and told me to close my eyes.

When I opened them again, Mommy had put the wrap around me. It was so orange and warm and comfy. I smiled and laughed.

Mommy smiled too. She hugged me and said "You look just like a little present" Then she gave me a kiss.

I was so happy. I was wearing the orange wrap just like I wanted.

Once upon a time there was a clever dog. He was always making jokes and making everyone laugh.

One day, the clever dog wanted to show off his joke skills. So he went to the store and asked the storekeeper for a pay.

The storekeeper was very surprised. He laughed and asked the clever dog, "What do you want to pay for?"

The clever dog then said, "I want to pay for a joke!"

The storekeeper couldn't believe it! He laughed and said, "Sure! What kind of joke do you want?"

The clever dog thought for a moment and then said, "I'll take the funniest joke you have!"

The storekeeper was impressed! He gave the clever dog the best joke he had and the dog paid with a smile.

The clever dog thanked the storekeeper before running off to show his joke to everyone he knew! Everyone loved his joke and the clever dog was very proud!

A young girl jumped out of bed and stared at the cart in the corner of the room. She was restless with wonder, wanting to know what was inside the mysterious box.

"What is it?" she asked eagerly. 

"It's a surprise!" replied her mum.

The girl couldn't wait any longer and ran to the cart. She pulled off the lid and peeked inside. Her eyes widened as she discovered a big, purple teddy bear.

She smiled with delight and hugged the teddy bear close. 

"Thank you! It's so soft," she said happily. 

Her mum walked over to her and wrapped her in a big hug. "You're welcome," her mum said. 

The girl stared at her mum and smiled back. She was so glad she had received such a wonderful surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. One day, Timmy fell down and hurt his knee. He felt a lot of pain and started to cry.

His mom came running and asked, "What happened, Timmy?"

"I fell down and my knee hurts," Timmy said through tears.

His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry, I'll comfort you. Let's clean your knee and put a band-aid on it."

Timmy felt a little better after his mom took care of him. He looked up and saw the sky was blue. "Mommy, why is the sky blue?" he asked.

His mom smiled and said, "I think it's because the sun shines on the air and makes it look blue."

Timmy was happy again and forgot about his pain. He went back to playing with his toys, feeling comforted by his mom's love.

Billy was a loyal little boy. He loved to go outside and jog every morning. One day, he woke up early and jogged to the nearby park. When he got there, he saw a dog waiting patiently. He smiled at the dog as he jogged past it.

The dog started to follow Billy on his jog. Billy was happy and let the dog follow him. He jogged around the park for a little while, with the loyal dog running behind him. 

When Billy was ready to go home, he stopped to say goodbye to the dog. He started to jog away, but the dog still followed him. He jogged a little farther away from the park, but the dog followed him still. 

Billy stopped and waited for the loyal dog to catch up. He smiled and pet the dog one last time before saying goodbye and heading off on his jog.

Anna was shy. She did not like to talk to new people. She liked to play with her dolls and books at home. But today, she had to go to a new school. She felt scared and sad.

She held her mom's hand and carried her bag. Her bag had her lunch and her favorite doll. She hoped no one would take her doll or laugh at her. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Anna. You will make new friends. They will be nice to you. Just be yourself and smile."

They walked to the school gate. Anna saw many kids running and shouting. They looked happy and loud. Anna felt more shy. She wanted to go back home. She clung to her mom's leg and said, "Mom, I don't want to go. Please, can we go back?"

Her mom bent down and hugged her. She said, "I know you are shy, Anna. But you are also brave and smart. You can do this. I will be back soon to pick you up. I love you." She kissed her cheek and gave her bag to her. She said, "Now, go and find your teacher. She will help you settle in. And don't forget your doll. She will keep you company."

Anna nodded and wiped her eyes. She took her bag and her doll and walked slowly to the door. She saw a lady with a big smile and a name tag. She said, "Hello, I'm Miss Lee. You must be Anna. Welcome to our class. Come, I'll show you your seat and your new friends." She took Anna's hand and led her inside.

Anna felt a little better. She saw some kids with bags and dolls like hers. They smiled and waved at her. She smiled and waved back. She thought, maybe this school is not so bad. Maybe she will make new friends. Maybe she will have fun. She settled in her seat and hugged her doll. She said, "Thank you, Miss Lee. Thank you, Mom. I will try to be brave and smart."

Molly was a very curious three-year-old. She wanted to know what was in her family's big blue bin. Every time she asked, her mom would just mention that it was a surprise and Molly would have to be patient.

One day, Molly woke up early and went to take a peek inside the bin. She carefully opened the lid and peered inside. She saw lots of brightly colored shapes, mysterious objects and interesting books. She was so excited to explore the bin and find out all the secrets it held.

Molly picked up a book and a familiar voice mentioned her name. She looked up to see her mom smiling back at her. Molly's mom had set up a secret treasue hunt inside the bin. All of the shapes, objects and books were clues for Molly to find the true surprise in the bin- a new puppy! 

Molly was so thrilled her new puppy. She could barely contain her excitement. She hugged her mom in gratitude and went back to exploring the bin with her new puppy. From then on, Molly was extra curious whenever her mom mentioned that bin.

It was a hot summer day and Betty and Sally were ready for their big adventure. They were about to join the old jungle to explore new things.

Teddy was having a great day! He was playing with his toy cars, zooming them around the house, when suddenly something exciting happened. His mom said it was time for a change! Teddy was so excited he almost jumped out of his shoes.

Once there was a small girl called Lola. One day, she went to school with her mom and dad. When they got to school, they saw a big blackboard on the wall.

Lola was proud of her picture and was so happy she put it on the blackboard.

Lily and Ben were hungry. They wanted a snack. They went to the kitchen and opened the fridge. They saw many things inside. They saw milk, cheese, eggs, and fruit. They also saw a yellow cake.

Lily smiled. "Yes, cheese is good. And some grapes too. Come on, let's get a plate and a knife."

They waited for Mom to come back and explain more about the cake and Grandma's birthday. They hoped Grandma would like the cake. They wondered if they could have a slice too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to walk with her mom to the park every day. One day, they had to cross a big road with lots of cars. Lily's mom told her to hold her hand tightly and not to let go. They waited for the traffic to stop and then they crossed the road safely.

Lily's mom was very proud of her for listening and holding her hand. She told Lily that it's very important to always hold hands when crossing the road because it keeps us safe. Lily learned that holding hands is not only important for crossing the road, but also for staying close to the people we love.

From that day on, Lily always held her mom's hand when they crossed the road. She felt happy and safe knowing that she was doing the right thing. And her mom was always proud of her for remembering to hold hands. The moral of the story is that holding hands is important for staying safe and close to the people we love.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. The park is a big place with many things to see and do. Sara and Tom admire the flowers, the birds, the swings and the slide.

One day, they see a new thing in the park. It is a big red truck with a long ladder. There are people in yellow clothes and hats. They are firefighters. They are here to help a cat that is stuck in a tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her hoop in the park. One day, she went to the park but she forgot to bring her hoop. She was sad because she wanted to play with it.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was playing in her room when she heard a noise. She stopped and listened. The noise was coming from the next room.

Jim was a very curious three year old, who always asked lots of questions. His mum had alerted him to be careful not to touch the ashtray in the living room.

Once upon a time, there was a little penguin named Pete. Pete lived in a cold place with lots of snow and ice. One day, Pete's mom asked him to search for some fish to eat. So, Pete went out to look for some fish.

Once there was a bird who wanted to soar high in the sky. Its wings were small, but it had a big dream. It flew up and up until it was so high that it could look down on the clouds. It was so happy to be so high that it even let out a noisy chirp.

But then one day, a strong wind blew the bird far away from its home. It was so scared and didn't know how to get back. Suddenly it spotted a sock floating in the sky. It flapped its wings and flew over to the sock. The bird grabbed it in its beak and flew away.

The sock had been blown into the sky too. So the bird and the sock soared together. They flew side by side, and the bird protected the sock from the noisy wind. 

Finally, the bird and the sock were back where they belonged and the bird said goodbye to its new friend. The bird flew up high into the sky and soared home to its nest, happy and free.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful queen who ruled over a great kingdom. Everywhere she went, the people cheered for her and waved their flags. She was loved by everyone in the kingdom.

Once there was a witch who was dead. She lived in a dark and spooky forest, far away from people. One day, a little boy named Peter decided to explore the forest. As he ventured deep into the trees, he saw the witch.

Once upon a time, there was a clever cat named Mittens. Mittens loved to play with cones. One day, Mittens saw a big cone on the ground. Mittens wanted to play with the cone, but it was too heavy. Mittens tried to push the cone, but it didn't move. Mittens thought for a moment and then managed to roll the cone with her paw. Mittens was very happy and played with the cone all day.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely tree in a big park. All the other trees had many friends, but the lonely tree had none. The lonely tree was very sad.

Lucy thought for a moment and said, "I will be your friend!" The lonely tree was happy to gain a new friend. They played together in the park every day. The tree was not lonely anymore, and they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a bear and a rabbit. The two were best friends and were always together.
One day, they were walking through the woods when they came across a rough trap. The bear wanted to explore it, but the rabbit was scared and stayed back. The bear went closer to have a look and suddenly, he fell into the trap. 
The rabbit was so scared, he didn't know what to do. He felt so sad and he knew he couldn't help the bear by himself. He had to separate from the bear and find help. 
The rabbit was scared, but he ran and ran until he reached the house of an old wise owl. The wise owl thought for a bit and then said, "I have a way to help your friend".
He took the rabbit back to the trap and used a stick to lift the trap up. The two were soon reunited and were so happy to be together again.
They both thanked the wise old owl, and hugged each other tight before heading back home. They vowed to be more careful in the future, and always reminded each other to be extra careful around traps.

Once upon a time, there was a small girl. She was only three years old. Her name was Lucy.

Once upon a time, there was a humble ant. He didn't have much, but he was content. One day, he asked his friends if he could go exploring. His friends all said yes, but said he had to be careful.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was a happy boy and enjoyed a lot of fun things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was only three years old. Every day, her parents would take her to the park. They were her parents, because they were always with her and they looked after her.

On this day, they went to the park and stepped onto the grass. The grass was soft and green, and it felt nice beneath their feet. Then the little girl noticed something furry on the ground! It was a hairy caterpillar, crawling around.

One day, Sarah and her dad were in the park. Sarah was so excited to be out in the sunshine and wanted to have some fun. She saw a special circle in the grass and started to spin around it. Dad smiled as Sarah spun and spun and smiled.

Then Sarah asked, "Can we spin around the circle again, Daddy?"

And so they did, until bedtime.

Tim and Liz are friends. They like to play in the park. They run, jump, slide and swing. They have fun.

But after a while, they feel tired. They want to rest. They find a big tree with green leaves. They sit under the tree and look at the sky.

"Look, Tim, a bird!" Liz says. She points at a small, brown bird on a branch. The bird sings a pretty song.

"Wow, Liz, that is an interesting bird!" Tim says. He listens to the bird. He likes the sound.

They see something else on the tree. It is round and red. It is an apple. The apple looks yummy.

"Can we have the apple, Tim?" Liz asks. She is hungry.

"I don't know, Liz. The apple is too high. We can't reach it." Tim says. He is hungry too.

They think of a way to get the apple. They see a stick on the ground. They pick up the stick. They try to poke the apple with the stick. But the stick is too short. The apple does not fall.

They see a rock on the ground. They pick up the rock. They try to throw the rock at the apple. But the rock is too heavy. They miss the apple.

They see a ball on the ground. They pick up the ball. They try to kick the ball at the apple. But the ball is too bouncy. The ball hits the tree and comes back.

They are sad. They can't get the apple. They sit under the tree again and rest.

But then, something happens. The bird flies away. The branch shakes. The apple falls. It lands near Tim and Liz.

They are happy. They can have the apple. They thank the bird. They share the apple. They eat the apple. It is sweet and juicy.

They smile at each other. They are friends. They have fun. They rest.

Once there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his camera and take pictures of everything. One day Timmy noticed something strange while he was taking pictures. So, every time Timmy took pictures, the dog would stay close by and keep him safe. Timmy wasn't afraid anymore because he knew that he was being protected. Timmy and the dog became best friends and Timmy felt safe whenever he had his camera with him.

Once upon a time, there was an otter who was in a hurry. The otter wanted to get somewhere quickly, and so he began to run. As he ran, he soon passed a pond. By the pond stood a duck who noticed the otter running.

"Why are you in such a hurry?" asked the duck.

The duck smiled and said, "Of course. Before I can help, I need you to be very quiet. Can you do that?"

The otter nodded, and stayed nice and quiet. The duck then waved his wings, and the pond filled up with water. The otter hopped in and it quickly carried him to where he wanted to go.

The otter hopped out of the pond, safe and sound. â€œThank you!" he said to the duck. "You really helped me!"

The duck smiled and replied, "You're welcome. Remember to be quiet and hurry when you need to!"

One day, Tom and his mom went to the pool. It was a hot day, and Tom wanted to go swimming. Tom's mom put her red towel on a chair and told Tom to hang his green towel on the hook. Tom hung his towel up and ran to the pool. The water was cool and it felt nice to Tom. 

He swam around the pool with his float. He didn't want to get out. But soon, Tom got weak. He couldn't swim anymore and he started to feel tired. 

His mom called out to him, "Tom, it's time to go. I can see you are getting weak. Come out of the pool and hang up your towel."

Tom got out of the pool and hung his towel back up. He was glad he was able to hang his towel back up by himself. Tom picked up his mom's towel, and together, they walked home.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy bear and a baby bear. The mommy bear wanted to give her baby bear a big hug, but she couldn't. The fuel to power her car had ran out.
