Then, a funny little mouse appeared out of nowhere. He reminded the baby bear of the funny stories mommy always told him. The mouse said he could help the mommy bear fix her car. Like magic, he filled the fuel tank with new fuel.

The baby bear was happy. He knew he wouldn't have to wait much longer for a big hug from his mommy. Sure enough, as soon as the car started, mommy was able to give her baby a big hug. The baby bear had never felt such love before. He hugged his mom back and smiled from ear to ear.

Tom and Anna liked to help Mom in the kitchen. They wanted to join her when she cooked and cleaned. They liked to smell the food and watch the bubbles.

One day, Mom asked them to put the plates and cups in the dishwasher. She said it was a machine that washed them with water and soap. Tom and Anna were curious. They opened the dishwasher and saw the racks and the holes.

They started to put the plates and cups in the dishwasher, but they did not know how to do it right. They put them upside down, sideways, or on top of each other. They also put some spoons and forks in the wrong place. The dishwasher was full of things that did not fit.

Mom came back and saw the mess. She was not happy. She told Tom and Anna that they had to learn how to use the dishwasher properly. She said they could break the plates and cups or make the dishwasher stop working. She showed them how to arrange the things in the right way.

Tom and Anna felt sorry. They said they were sorry and they wanted to help. Mom smiled and hugged them. She said they were good helpers and she loved them. She also said they had to be alert and careful when they used the dishwasher. She said they could join her again next time, but they had to listen and follow her instructions. Tom and Anna nodded and said they would. They were happy to help Mom in the kitchen.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to travel. She had a special book called a passport that let her go to different places. One day, Lily was packing her bags for a big trip. She put in her favorite toys, clothes, and even her passport. She made sure to pack everything hard so nothing would break.

Lily was so excited to go on her adventure. She went to the airport with her family and they got on the plane. As they were flying, Lily looked out the window and saw a big cloud. She wondered what was inside the cloud. She blinked and looked again, but she still couldn't see.

Finally, they landed in a new place and Lily was so happy. She got her passport out and showed it to the nice person at the airport. They stamped it and let her in. Lily knew she had to keep her passport safe because it was important. She smiled and thought about all the new adventures she would have on her trip.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her dolls and stuffed animals. One day, she lost her favorite teddy bear. She searched and searched but couldn't find him anywhere. She felt miserable without him.

Lily's mom saw her frown and asked her what was wrong. Lily told her about her lost teddy bear. Her mom said, "Let's search for him together!" They looked in every room and under every bed, but still couldn't find him.

Just when they were about to give up, Lily's little brother came running in with the teddy bear in his hands. "I found him!" he exclaimed. Lily was so happy and hugged her brother tightly. "Thank you for helping me search," she said with a big smile.

Once upon a time, there was an enthusiastic dancer who loved to perform. Whenever he danced, he felt happy and full of joy. Everywhere he went, the people around him stopped and watched in awe.

One day, the dancer went to a new place and saw someone who looked familiar. He couldn't place where he recognized the person from, so he went over to ask who she was. It turned out that she was also an enthusiastic dancer, who had grown up in the same town as the dancer.

The two of them spent the day tucked away in a corner of the town, talking about their shared love for dancing. They shared ideas and laughed, until finally the night had come to an end.

The dancer couldn't believe that he had gone all that time without recognizing the talented dancer he had just met. He was so glad he had gone over to ask her who she was, because now he had a new friend. They stayed in touch and continued to share their love of dancing together.

Once upon a time, there was an oasis in the desert. The oasis was filled with beautiful trees, plants, and animals. It was the perfect place to play and have fun. 

One day, young Jack and his mom went to the oasis to explore. When the two arrived, Jack was so excited and ran around trying to see everything. 
 
Jack wanted to stay for ever, and asked his mom if he could. But his mom said that the oasis was a very special place that needed to be kept safe for everyone. So when it got too dark to explore, they had to close the oasis so that everyone could enjoy it the next day. 

But every morning, when Jack and his mom returned, they found that the oasis was always available to explore. They had lots of fun playing, discovering animals, and making new friends. 

The oasis became an adventure each and every day, and Jack was so happy to know that it was always close and available for him to explore!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat spicy food and always asked her mom for more. One day, her mom made a yummy dish with lots of spices in it. Lily took a bite and said, "Mmm, this is so spicy and delicious!" 

After lunch, Lily and her mom went to the park. They brought a cooler filled with drinks and snacks. Lily saw a butterfly and ran after it. She ran and ran until she got tired. She sat down on the grass and said, "Mommy, I'm tired. Can we take a break?" 

"Sure, Lily," her mom said. "Let's stretch our legs and have a snack." They opened the cooler and had some fruit. Lily said, "I love spending time with you, Mommy." Her mom smiled and gave her a hug. "I love spending time with you too, Lily," she said.

The tiny mouse was feeling mighty brave. He decided to invite all his friends over for a party. Everyone was having so much fun dancing and singing, but it was time to play a game. The mouse suggested a game of x-ray. Everyone agreed, so the brave mouse hopped up on the chair and spread out his arms. His friends found it funny, so they laughed and took turns copying the mouse's pose. It was a fun game and everyone cheered when the mouse won. After the game, everyone moved back to the kitchen for delicious snack. The brave mouse thanked everyone for coming and it was a mighty fun day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play hide and seek with her friends. One day, Lily's mom gave her a quiz to solve. The quiz had pictures of different animals and Lily had to recognize them. She found it very fun and exciting. 

After finishing the quiz, Lily went back to playing hide and seek with her friends. She found a great hiding spot behind a big tree. Her friends looked for her for a long time, but they couldn't find her. Finally, Lily came out of her hidden spot and her friends were very surprised. They asked her how she found such a good hiding spot, and Lily just smiled and said, "It's my secret!"

Tom and Anna like to play with their toys. They have many toys, but their favorite is a big horse. The horse is brown and soft and has a long tail. They like to hug the horse and pretend to ride it.

One day, Tom and Anna have a fight. Tom wants to play with the horse, but Anna does not want to share. She says, "The horse is mine! You can play with something else!" Tom says, "No, the horse is ours! We can take turns!" They pull the horse from each other and make it sad.

Their mom hears them and comes to see what is wrong. She sees them fighting over the horse and says, "Stop! You are making the horse angry! Look, it has a frown on its face!" Tom and Anna look at the horse and see that it does look angry. They feel sorry for the horse and for each other.

They say, "Sorry, horse. Sorry, mom. Sorry, Tom. Sorry, Anna." They hug the horse and hug each other. They decide to play nicely and share the horse. They make the horse happy again. They say, "We love you, horse. You are our friend." The horse smiles and wags its tail. Mom smiles and says, "Good job, Tom and Anna. You know how to be kind and fair." They all have fun and play together.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Eileen. She was three years old and loved playing with her toys. One day Eileen was looking out of the window when she saw an old man selling something from his cart. Eileen was curious and ran outside to have a closer look.

The old man smiled at Eileen and said, "Would you like to buy a toy? It's really special and I'll only sell it to you!".

Eileen was very excited and asked, "What kind of toy is it?".

The old man replied, "It's a special clock. It ticks every normal minute and makes a lovely sound!".

Eileen looked at the clock and said, "I would love to buy it!". The old man smiled and they made a deal. Eileen gave him some money and received the clock. She ran home, put it on the shelf and admired it every day. 

The End

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Amy and Jack. They liked to play together in the old gym.

One day, Amy asked Jack, "Do you want to go play at the gym?"

Jack said, "Yes! Let's go!"

So they quickly grabbed their things and went to the old gym. Once they got there, they ran around and played many different games. They played tag, hide-and-seek, and even a game of catch. 

After a few hours of playing, Amy said, "Let's go home now, I'm getting tired."

Jack replied, "Okay, let's go home together."

So they said goodbye and went their separate ways. They had a great time playing together at the old gym and they knew they would be back soon to play again.

Henry was playing by the lake. He liked to look for rocks. Suddenly, he saw something strange. It was a gray raft! Henry couldn't believe it. He ran to the edge of the lake and shouted, "Raft!"

Henry wanted to keep the raft. He shouted, "I want to keep the raft!"

Henry's mom came running to the lake. She said, "Keep the raft? What do you want to do with it?"

Henry said, "I'm gonna play with it!"

Henry's mom smiled. She said, "OK, you can keep the raft, but you need to be careful."

Henry nodded and said, "I'll be careful. I promise!"

So Henry kept the raft and had lots of fun playing with it at the lake. Every day, he and his mom would go down to the lake together and have a picnic by the raft. It was so much fun!

There once was a little girl named Sarah. She had a rope and loved to work with it. She would tie it around her waist and spin around and around. She was happy and laughed as she twirled.

One day, Sarah's teacher asked her to use the rope for a special project. She was so excited! She worked very hard to make each knot just right. It was tricky but she kept going until the rope was finished.

When she was done, Sarah held up the rope and was so proud of all her work. Then she took it outside to show her friends. They admired Sarah's rope and wanted to try it too. She made a game and each of them took turns jumping around with the little rope. They laughed and played until it was time to go home.

Sarah was tired but she carried the rope with her as she headed home. She couldn't wait to show her mom and dad the work she had done. They were so proud of her, they even put it on the wall as a reminder of all her hard work.

One day, a small dog named Spot went for a walk. Spot saw something unusual on the ground. It was a big crack. Spot was curious and wanted to see what was inside the crack.

As Spot got closer to the crack, he felt a tickle in his nose. He tried to hold it back, but he couldn't. Spot let out a big sneeze! The sneeze was so strong that it made the crack even bigger. Spot was surprised and looked inside.

Inside the crack, Spot found a little bird. The bird said, "Thank you for helping me. I was stuck in the crack and could not get out. Your sneeze made the crack bigger and now I am free." Spot and the bird became friends and played together all day. From that day on, Spot and the bird always looked out for each other and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time there was a quiet attic. Inside the attic were two sisters. The older sister, named Emma, was always in charge. 

One day while they were in the attic, Emma said to her younger sister, Lily. "Let's paint the walls of the attic!" Lily grinned, she had never painted before. 

Emma gave Lily a pot of bright green paint and a brush. "Paint the wall! Go on! Be brave!"

Lily held the brush and took a deep breath. She dipped the brush into the pot of paint and started painting. She painted little circles, big circles and even triangles until the whole wall was covered in bright green. 

When she finished painting, Lily looked around the attic. It was so quiet and even more wonderful with the walls painted green.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass and flowers. One day, she saw a spider crawling on her arm. She was scared and wanted to squish it, but her mom told her that spiders are special and they help catch bugs.

Lily thought about it and realized that even though spiders might look scary, they are unique and important. She decided to let the spider crawl away and not hurt it. 

Later that day, Lily was playing with her toys and saw her little brother playing with one of her favorite toys. She felt angry and wanted to take it back, but then she remembered what her mom said about spiders. She realized that just like spiders are special, her brother is special too and he needs to play with toys too.

From that day on, Lily learned that everyone is unique and has their own needs. She didn't want to be mean to anyone and always tried to share her toys with her brother and friends.

Once upon a time, there was a family of four. The youngest of them was a little girl who was only three years old. Every day, she would play and do many fun things. 

One day, the family got a special delivery! It was a big package, and when the little girl opened it, there was a surprise. Inside was a hoop, and it was beautiful! The hoop was made of colorful plastic, and it was harmless.

The family was so happy and excited. The little girl immediately started playing with the hoop. She kept spinning it and rolling it around the house. Everyone in the family was so happy to see her having so much fun.

The little girl would play with the hoop every day and take it out in the garden. Delivery brought her a lot of joy, and it was something she always looked forward to. Even when she grew up, the harmless hoop stayed with her as a reminder of a happy time.

Baby Jenny was feeling quite fierce. She was not sure why, but she could not relax. She stomped her feet, pouted her little lips and cried for her mommy. 

When her mommy came, she scooped Jenny up in her arms and said, "Let's go get something pink to make you feel better."

Off they went and soon they were at the toy store. Jenny saw a big pink unicorn and her heart swelled with joy. She hugged it and she felt the fierce feeling go away.

Mommy took them home and tucked Jenny into a comfy bed. Then she gave Jenny the pink unicorn and said, "Relax and have sweet dreams."

Jenny hugged the pink unicorn close to her chest, closed her eyes and drifted off to a peaceful sleep. She was finally relaxed.

Once upon a time, there was a happy sun. The sun loved to shine and make everything warm. One day, the sun shone so bright that it started to burn the grass.

A little puddle saw the grass burn and felt sad. The puddle wanted to help the grass. So, the puddle splashed water on the grass to make it feel better.

The grass was very happy that the puddle helped it. The sun saw this and felt bad for burning the grass. The sun promised to be more careful and not burn the grass again. The grass, the puddle, and the sun all became friends and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who had a very special crown. Imagine how shiny and sparkly it was! But one day, the princess was very angry. She had lost her crown and was feeling sad. She looked high and low and everywhere she could, but she just couldn't find it.

Thankfully, the princess had some very special friends who stepped in to help. They all looked and looked until finally, one of the friends found the crown! It was tucked away in the grass and the princess was so happy to find it.

The princess was grateful for the help of her friends. She laughed and waved her little crown in the air, and all the princesses and knights were glad that the princess had her crown and was no longer angry. They all celebrated with a big party and the princess enjoyed wearing her crown every day.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a friendly sheep who lived in a big meadow. He had lots of wool which was white and fluffy. Every morning he counted the butterflies that flew over his meadow. He said "1,2,3,4" as he watched them flutter by, always looking for new friends.

One day, he saw a small bird fly by, and he thought it was the most beautiful thing he had ever seen. He smiled and waved, but the little bird just kept flying.

The friendly sheep said, "Come back! I want you to be my friend!" But the bird just kept flying away.

So the friendly sheep decided to use some of his wool to create a net and catch the beautiful little bird. He made it very quickly and proudly showed it to the other animals in the meadow. He said, "I'm going to catch this friendly little bird!"

And sure enough, the next day the friendly sheep had a new friend! From then on, every day he would count the butterflies, and play with his new feathered friend with his friendly wool net.

Once there was a small orange cat called Chalky. He loved puzzles and always enjoyed trying to figure them out. Every day, Chalky's mom would encourage him to find the right pieces.

One day, Chalky found a special orange puzzle with lots of pieces. He was so excited! Chalky got to work right away, trying hard to find the right pieces to make the puzzle whole. He put them together, one by one.

Chalky's Mom cheered and clapped each time Chalky found a new piece. She encouraged him to keep going until all the pieces were in the right place.

Finally, Chalky had finished the orange puzzle. He held it up proudly, showing it to his Mom. They both smiled, happy with the accomplishment. Chalky had used his mind and his paws to make the puzzle complete.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse. The mouse had a broken leg. It hurt a lot. The mouse wanted to make it better.

One day, the mouse saw a big cat. The cat was not nice. The mouse was scared. The cat wanted to catch the mouse.

The mouse tried to run away. But with a broken leg, it was hard. The cat was fast. The cat caught the mouse. The mouse was very sad. The end.

Lily and Tom were playing with blocks in their room. They liked to build towers and castles with the blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes.

"Look, I made a chamber for the king and queen!" Lily said, showing Tom her castle. She had used a big block with a hole in it as the chamber. "They can sleep and hide in there."

"That's nice, but my tower is taller!" Tom said, pointing to his stack of blocks. He had used many small blocks to make his tower. "It can reach the sky!"

Lily wanted to make her castle taller too. She looked for more blocks to add to her castle. She saw a fat block on the floor. It was red and round. She thought it would look good on top of her chamber.

She picked up the fat block and tried to put it on her castle. But the block was too big and heavy. It did not fit on the chamber. It made the chamber fall down. Then the whole castle fell down too. The blocks made a loud noise.

"Uh-oh!" Lily said. She felt sad. She had worked hard on her castle.

"Uh-oh!" Tom said. He saw Lily's castle fall down. He felt sorry for her. He had worked hard on his tower too.

"Are you okay, Lily?" Tom asked. He walked over to her.

"Yes, I'm okay, Tom," Lily said. She wiped her tears. "But my castle is broken."

"I'm sorry, Lily," Tom said. He hugged her. "Do you want to help me with my tower?"

Lily smiled. She nodded. She liked Tom. He was a good brother.

"Okay, let's play together," Tom said. He took her hand. "We can share the blocks and make a new castle and tower."

They went back to their blocks. They started to build again. They had fun playing with the blocks. They forgot about the fat block on the floor.

Once upon a time there was a boy who liked to stare at the rug. It was a big, colorful rug and he, like many other children, found it fascinating to look at.

One day, the rug was lying still and dead on the floor. The boy was very curious, so he stepped closer and put out his hand. He touched the rug and it felt cold and lifeless. 

He stood there, frozen and stared at the rug. He felt a weird sensation he had never felt before. Fear and confusion filled his little body. He just couldn't understand what had happened. 

He cautiously stepped away and ran to find his mom. Together, they took a closer look at the rug and his mom explained that sometimes things and animals just die. 
The boy looked sad and asked if the rug could come back to life. 

His mom hugged him and said, "No sweetie, once it's dead, it's dead". 

The boy was sad for a long time, but with help from his mom, he eventually came to terms with it and learned to appreciate the things he had.

One day, two friends, Zoe and Joey, were playing near a lake. They were looking for something to do when Zoe had an idea.

"Let's play hide and seek!" Zoe said, clapping her hands. Joey smiled and agreed.

They started to count and Zoe began to hide. She found a big tree and curled up underneath it. She felt safe.

Joey soon finished counting, but he couldn't find Zoe anywhere. He looked around, but there was no sign of her. 

"Where could she be?" Joey mumbled to himself.

Just then, Joey heard a strange noise. It sounded like a fight. He followed the noise and soon found Zoe. She was in a corner, looking very uncomfortable.

"Who are you fighting?" Joey said, his eyes widening in surprise. 

"Nobody," Zoe said, "I was just hiding from you!"

Joey laughed and the two hugged each other. They were happy to be reunited. From then on, both of them knew that no matter what, they would always be there for each other.

Once there was a sweet girl. She was walking through the forest on a bright day. Suddenly, she saw an ugly monster. It had big eyes and a long, scary tail. The girl was very scared.

But then, she spotted a box of chocolates. She knew the monster liked chocolate. So she reached into the box and gave it to the monster. The monster smiled and thanked her for being so kind.

The monster was so happy, it picked up the girl and started running away. The girl was scared again. But then she spotted a river. The monster was heading towards the river. The girl realized it was in danger!

Without thinking, she jumped into the river and saved the monster. The monster was so thankful and it promised to never scare the girl again. The girl was happy, she had saved the monster!

Once there was a little girl called Mia. She was very excited to explore outside. She found a special mine and ran inside. The mine was filled with amazing objects and materials. Mia couldnâ€™t believe her eyes.

She went further inside and saw a big machine. Its purpose was to supply the mine with new items. Mia watched as the machine magically made new things, like toys and tools. She felt so amazed by all the neat things.

Mia explored the mine for hours and it was time for her to leave. She said goodbye to the mine and the machine. She took a little bit of the supplies of the mine, like small toys and gems, with her to play with.

Mia was so happy to explore the amazing mine. She would return often to find new exciting supplies!

Once upon a time there was a kind little girl called Daisy. She loved to collect flowers as she walked in the woods near her home. 

One day, Daisy was walking in the woods, picking some daisies, when she suddenly stumbled upon a magnificent palace. Daisy gazed up in awe, the palace was made of marble and glistened in the sunshine.

Curious, Daisy wandered closer and knocked on the palace door. Suddenly, the door opened and Daisy was faced with a kind old man.

The old man smiled at Daisy. "Hello," he said kindly. "My name is Harry. What can I do for you?"

"I was wondering," Daisy said hesitantly, "if I could collect some flowers in your palace garden? I want to make a bouquet for my mummy."

The kind old man nodded and opened the palace gates. He let Daisy explore his garden and collect as many flowers as she wanted. Soon, Daisy had collected a beautiful bouquet of flowers and couldn't wait to give them to her mummy. 

For the rest of the summer, Daisy visited the palace often to collect flowers and chat with her friend Harry.

One sunny day, Jessi went for a walk in the forest. She saw a furry fox and asked it what it was doing. The fox didn't say anything, but it just shrugged. Jessi figured it was looking for food in the soil. 

Jessi wanted to help the fox, so she opened her backpack and took out an apple. She held it out to the fox and said, "Here you go!" 

The fox didn't move. Jessi wondered why, so she said, "It's okay. You can have it." 

The fox still didn't move. So Jessi shrugged and said, "Well, I guess you don't want it."

The fox quickly took the apple from Jessi's hand and ran away. Jessi smiled and waved goodbye. She had made a new furry friend in the forest!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and cuddle with her teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom told her they were going to visit her grandma's house. Lily was excited because she loved to visit her grandma's house.

When they arrived, Lily's grandma showed her the fireplace. Lily had never seen a fireplace before and thought it was very cool. But then, she accidentally knocked over a vase and it broke. Lily was scared and sad because she didn't mean to break it. Her grandma was upset, but then she showed Lily how to be careful and not break anything else.

Lily learned her lesson and was happy again. She played with her toys and cuddled with her teddy bear by the fireplace. She was excited to come back and visit her grandma again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who loved animals. He always wanted to go and find animals in the woods, but his mom said he was too small.

One day, he finally got to go to the woods. He looked around and saw something adorable â€“ it was a rabbit! The rabbit was hopping around and eating.

The little boy was so happy. He slowly crept up to the rabbit and held out his hand. The rabbit sniffed it, and then hopped into his arms!

The little boy was so excited. "Can I take the rabbit home with me, Mom?" he asked.

His mom thought for a moment and then said, "It's okay, but you must take care of it."

So the little boy said goodbye to the rabbit, and gently closed the door. From that day on, the rabbit stayed in his house and they became best friends!

Once upon a time, there was a mighty penguin named Pete. Pete loved to swim and play with his penguin friends. One day, he wanted to go on an adventure to explore the big, wide world outside of his home.

Pete's mom said, "I permit you to go, but be careful and come back before the sun sets."

Excitedly, Pete waddled away from his family and into the unknown. He met a friendly seal who asked, "Where are you going, little penguin?"

"I'm going on an adventure to see what's out there," replied Pete.

The seal smiled and said, "That sounds like fun! Can I come with you?"

Pete happily agreed and together they explored the vast ocean. They saw colorful fish, big whales, and even a sunken ship. As the sun began to set, Pete realized it was time to head back home.

Returning to his family, Pete exclaimed, "I had the best adventure ever! And I made a new friend too!"

His mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you had fun, my mighty little penguin."

Once upon a time there were two people named Mommy and Daddy. They had a garden with a lawn. Every day Daddy would go out to the lawn and do things. He would mow the lawn and water the grass. He would do lots of other things too. 

One day Mommy went out to the lawn to help Daddy. But the lawn was very uncomfortable. The grass was too long and there were a lot of bumps and stones. Daddy and Mommy decided that they had to do something.

So the next day Mommy and Daddy bought a big tractor. Daddy drove the tractor around the lawn and it cut all the grass. Now the lawn looked much better. Daddy and Mommy were happy.

The lawn was now comfortable and fun. Daddy and Mommy could play and have picnics on the lawn. They were very happy. They could enjoy the lawn every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and ride her bike. One day, she fell off her bike and hurt her knee. It was red and sore.

Lily's mom gave her an orange band-aid to put on her knee. Lily didn't want to accept the band-aid at first, but then she realized it would make her knee feel better. So, she put the band-aid on and felt much happier.

From that day on, Lily always accepted help when she needed it. And she loved the color orange because it reminded her of her special band-aid that helped her knee. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sally. She loved to play with her toy. One day, Sally was feeling terrible. She wanted to play with her toy, but it was too far away. She tried to reach it, but she wasn't tall enough. Sally felt so upset.

Then, something magical happened. Suddenly, the toy started to move! It hopped away from Sally and floated across the room. Sally was so excited! She chased after the toy and managed to catch it.

Sally was so happy to have her toy back. She hugged the toy tightly and felt so relieved. From that day on, Sally always made sure to keep her toy close. She never wanted to feel terrible again!

Johnny and his mom were in the park. Johnny skipped around the pathways, scanning for interesting things. He discovered a tiny bug, just a few centimeters long. He was very excited and picked it up carefully. As he watched it, the bug began to shrink! Johnny was amazed and asked his mom to explain. 

"The bug isn't really shrinking, Johnny," his mom said. "It's playing a trick on you. That's called camouflaging. It's shrinking its body to look like other things around it and protect itself." 

"It's kind of like when I have to hide behind the couch," Johnny said. 

His mom laughed. "Exactly," she replied. "Animals are so clever. You have to be careful around them. We have to show them value and respect." 

Johnny looked at the bug intently. He was full of admiration and respect. "Okay," he said. "I promise to be careful."

Once upon a time there was a cute little girl named Lia. She loved to spin around and around in circles. Her mom saw her spinning one day and said, "Lia, why don't we go out and get a special treat?"

Lia smiled and said, "Yes!" So her mom and her went to the store and got a yummy cake. 

When Lia and her mom got home, Lia grabbed the cake from the bag and started spinning around, while singing and laughing. 

Just then Lia's mom said, "That looks like so much fun! Join me and let's spin together!"

So Lia and her mom both spun around with the cake held between them. They spun and laughed until they both got dizzy. 

They laughed and hugged each other, and Lia said, "That was the most fun I've ever had!" 

That night, Lia and her mom shared the cake and talked about their sweet spinning adventure.

Once upon a time there was a pond. Every day a little bunny would run to the edge of the pond. But he was scared to go any closer. The waters were so harsh and cold. He wanted to play in the pond but he was too scared.

One day the bunny made a brave decision. He ran into the pond as fast as he could. The water splashed around his little feet. It was so cold! He ran back to the edge of the pond and shivered.

Next day the bunny ran to the pond but this time he was more confident. He ran right into the pond, up to his waist. He felt the harsh coldness all over his body. But he was brave and he stayed in the pond for a long time.

Finally the bunny ran out of the pond feeling happy and excited. He had conquered the harsh pond and he would now return to it every day to play.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved eating cherries, but her mom always told her not to eat too many. One day, Lily went to the park and saw a big cherry tree. She climbed up and ate all the cherries she could reach.

When Lily came home, her mom saw her tummy was big and asked, "Did you eat too many cherries?" Lily nodded her head and said, "Yes, but they were so yummy!"

Her mom said, "I told you not to eat too many. Now you will be punished and have to go to bed early tonight." Lily felt sad and went to her room, but she knew she shouldn't have eaten so many cherries.

Later that night, Lily had a dream about an ugly monster who wanted to eat all the cherries in the world. She woke up and realized she didn't want to be like the monster, so she promised to listen to her mom from now on.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Ellie. Ellie wanted to go on an adventure. 

So she took her backpack and went out of her house. Ellie went to the forest. It was a very unusual place. The trees were big and the leaves were green. Everything seemed alive. 

Ellie stayed in the forest for a long time. She explored and played with the animals. She had so much fun and she didn't want to leave. 

But eventually it was time to go back home. Ellie took one last look at the forest before she left. She knew she would come back soon to explore more of this unusual place.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, while playing, she found a shiny jewel on the ground. She was so happy and excited to show it to her friends.

But then she heard a voice in her head that said, "You shouldn't have taken that jewel. It belongs to someone else." Lily felt guilty and knew she had to find the owner. She asked her friends to help her look for the person who might have lost the jewel.

After searching for a while, they saw a woman crying and looking around frantically. Lily approached her and asked if she had lost something. The woman reached into her pocket and pulled out a necklace with a missing jewel. She was so happy to have it back and thanked Lily and her friends.

From that day on, Lily learned that it's important to do the right thing, even if it's hard. She felt proud of herself for being honest and helping someone in need.

Once upon a time there was a tiny girl. She liked to shoot things with her bow and arrow. She loved shooting stars in the night sky and daydreaming.

Today she decided to go even further. She wanted to shoot something special.

So she found a powerful bow and arrow. Then she runs to the garden, points her bow and arrow to the sky and shouted: "I'm going to shoot the universe!"

The little girl shot the bow and arrow into the night sky. As it went up and up, it sparkled brightly in the starry night.

When the arrow reached the stars, the little girl hopped for joy. It made the night sky so mild and special. 

The little girl cheered, she could not believe it. She had shot the universe!

Johny was a boy. He was three years old. He liked to eat.
Johny was in his living room. He saw the screen. The screen was big and brown.
Johny asked his mum: "What can I eat?"
Mum said: "Let's go to the kitchen. We will eat something there."
Johny was happy. He ran to the kitchen. They ate a delicious dinner.
Johny was full and satisfied. He smiled. He looked at the screen again and said: "That brown screen is nice."

Oliver and his dad were walking to the train station. Oliver was so excited to take the train. He had never been on one before.

"Daddy, what is that big shiny thing?" He asked, pointing at the train at the station.

"That is the train, Oliver," Dad said.

Oliver's eyes opened wide in amazement. "Wow!" He said, "It's so impressive!"

His dad smiled. They got on the train and found their seats. Oliver looked out the window and watched as the world outside moved past. The train slowly chugged away.

After a few minutes, Oliver realized he was going on an adventure. He was so excited! He felt like he was going somewhere really special.

When they arrived at their destination, Oliver was very happy. He couldn't believe his first train ride was so amazing. He was so proud that he had been brave enough to take the train.

Oliver and his mum were cuddled up together on the sofa watching a film. He loved films. They were bright, colourful and lots of fun. But as soon as it started, his mum began to doze off.

"Mum! Mum wake up!" Oliver said, shaking her gently.

Mum opened her eyes and smiled. "Oh hello darling. I was just having a little sleep."

"Let's watch the film together," said Oliver.

Mum ruffled his hair and smiled. "Ok let's go. I just love films."

They watched the film together and Oliver found himself completely enamoured. He laughed at the funny parts and felt happy when the friendly characters hugged each other. Mum also seemed to be enjoying it, as they chatted and talked with each other throughout the film.

When the film finished, Oliver hugged his mum. "I love films. I love them so much!"

Mum smiled and hugged him back. "Me too darling. Films are a wonderful way to escape the world for a while and relax together."

And so Oliver and his mum finished watching the film together, content in the knowledge that they had shared a friendly, enjoyable experience.

Once upon a time there was a big, round thing called Earth. It was very interesting and included lots of things.

The Earth had green grass, bright blue sky, fluffy clouds, and naughty bugs. There were big birds that flew high in the sky and funny fish that swam in the oceans.

The Earth had people who lived on it too. Some people had beds to sleep in, and some people had sweaters to keep them warm. Some people ate ice cream, and some people ate pizza.

The Earth was a very special place with lots of things for people to see and do. From time to time people visited the Earth from other places and joined in the fun. 

The Earth was full of interesting things and everyone liked it very much.

Once upon a time, there were two friends that liked to play outside, in the sunshine. But one day, the friends started to fight. They were mad and upset with each other, and couldn't find a way to make friends again. 

One morning, the sunshine was so bright outside that it made the sky very happy. When the friends stepped outside, they could feel the sunshine's happy warmth. Although they were still mad at each other, they also felt the sunlight's cheerful glow. 

Suddenly, the sunshine started to make everything look different. The friends noticed that the sour anger they had been feeling was gone. All of a sudden, the sour anger had turned into a sweet friendship. 

The two friends hugged and laughed, and they promised never to fight again. From then on, they played together and said hello to the sunshine every day!

Once there was a poor family who had a little boy who was only three years old. On his third birthday, the little boy's parents wanted to deliver a present to him. The little boy woke up early in the morning and ran to the kitchen to see what was the present his parents had given him. 

When he arrived in the kitchen, he saw a big box with a bow on top of it. He was so excited! He opened the box and inside he found a toy truck. He was overjoyed! 

He then ran to his parents with the truck and asked, â€œWhat is this?â€ His parents replied with a smile, â€œIt is your birthday present. Now you can use it to carry and deliver things!â€

The little boy drove the truck around the house and he was so happy, feeling no pain. Suddenly, he heard loud knocking coming from the door. He raced to see who it was. 

When he opened the door, he saw a lady with a basket. She was a neighbor in need. She asked if the family could deliver some food to her family. Of course, the poor family said yes and the little boy was eager to grab his truck and deliver the food! 

The little boy was so happy to be able to help the lady and he was proud that he could use his truck to deliver something. He had learned a valuable lesson about helping others

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn pigeon. She liked to mark things in the park with her feet. She would stomp on the ground and make little marks everywhere.

One day, she decided to fly around the park. As she did, she marked more and more things with her feet. Suddenly, she spotted a little girl in the park. She had never seen a little girl before so she flew closer and closer. 

The little girl was three years old. She noticed the pigeon and reached out to try and touch it. But the pigeon was so stubborn, she wouldn't let the little girl touch her. Instead, she flew away and marked the little girl's dress with her feet.

The little girl was so surprised and the pigeon flew off into the sky. The little girl never forgot the stubborn pigeon and the marks it left on her dress.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around outside. One day, she went on a big adventure to a faraway country. It was very exciting! The country was so colorful, with bright flowers and pretty houses.

Lily had lots of questions about the new place she was in. She asked her parents about the food they ate and the animals they saw. Her parents were happy to answer all of her questions, and they all had a great time exploring the country together.

After their adventure was over, Lily was sad to leave the colorful country behind. But she was happy to have learned so much and to have had such a fun time with her family.

Once upon a time there were two friends called Ali and Ben. Ali was a 3-year-old boy and Ben was a lawyer. One day they were walking together in the hot sun.

Ali said to Ben, "I'm so hot. I wish I could go swimming."

Ben said, "We can't go swimming right now, Ali. It's against the law."

Ali felt disappointed and sat down in the middle of the road. Ben saw how sad Ali was and gave him a big hug.

"It's OK, Ali. You don't have to break the law to have fun. You can always find something else to do!"

After that, Ali and Ben went to the park to see the birds and to play on the swings.

Moral of the story: You can have fun without breaking the law.

Joey was playing in the park. He saw a big, yellow car parked near a tree. He thought it was cool and wanted to get closer to it. He walked over and asked, "What's this car?". Joey's mom told him that it was a yellow car. Joey wanted to know why the car was so heavy. His mom explained that cars are heavy because they have powerful engines inside. Joey thought it was so funny that the car was so heavy. He said, "That car is so cool!" and continued playing for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One night, she was outside looking at the stars when she saw a bright comet in the sky. She was so excited that she ran to tell her mom. 

"Mama, Mama! I saw a comet! It was so pretty!" said Lily.

"That's wonderful, Lily," said her mom. "But be careful, it's dark outside and you might stumble."

Lily nodded and went back outside to look at the comet. Suddenly, she stumbled and fell down. She scraped her knee and started to cry. 

Her mom came outside and said, "Oh no, are you okay? Let's get you inside and put a bandage on your knee. We need to keep you healthy."

Lily felt better after her mom put a bandage on her knee. She went back outside and saw the comet again. She smiled and said, "I'm glad I'm healthy now so I can see the pretty comet again."

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jack. He was 3 years old. He liked to play outside in the sun.

One day, Jack went outside to play. He saw a bird flying high in the sky. He wanted to catch it and make it his pet. He ran after the bird with his hands in the air, trying to catch it.

The bird flew away so fast that Jack couldn't catch it. He was very sad. Then he saw something sparkly in the dirt. Jack looked closely and saw that it was a glittery button. He wanted to pick it up, but it was too deep in the dirt. He found a stick and tried to catch the button with it. He tried again and again but he couldn't catch it. He was very sad. 

Then he heard someone say, "Do you need help, Jack?"

It was his Mom. She was holding a big bag of clothes. She said, "Let me help you catch that button." She put her clothes on the ground and put the stick in the dirt. Then she said, "I'm going to help you catch it!"

Jack and his Mom worked together to catch the button. Finally, they did it! Jack was so happy.

Mom gave Jack the button and said, "It's a bit bitter, but it's yours now."

Jack smiled and said, "Thank you, Mom!"

One day, Mummy was helping the little boy organize his toy basket. She said "Let's make the basket nice and tidy, so the toys are all available and easy to find." 

The boy said, "Alright, Mummy!" He and Mummy sorted through the toys and carefully put them away. The boy enjoyed being organized and helping Mummy. 

That night, when it was time for bed, Mummy said, "Why donâ€™t you pick a toy to play with in bed?" 

The boy was excited. "Where should I look first?" he asked. 

Mummy pointed to the basket. "Remember when we organized it today? All the toys should be available and easy to find now." 

The little boy smiled and went over to the basket. Once he found his favorite toy, he was ready for bed.

Mummy smiled back. She was proud that her little boy had helped organize the toy basket, and even more proud that he had remembered what to do when it was time to find his favorite toy.

One day a restless little girl entered the room. She saw a picture on the wall and wanted to take a closer look. She tiptoed to the picture and touched the frame with her small fingers. She saw beautiful colors and shapes coming together to make a nice picture. She looked at it for a while then decided to go explore. She ran around the room and found some old toys. She started playing and didn't want to stop. She smiled and had so much fun. Then she got tired and decided to leave the room. She left the room, feeling happy and content.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going to the grocery store with his mommy. They would always buy yummy snacks and treats. One day, Timmy saw a big candy bar that he really wanted, but his mommy said no. Timmy felt a strong urge to have the candy bar, but he knew he had to listen to his mommy.

As they walked through the store, Timmy saw a man and a woman racing to get to the checkout line first. They were being very competitive and almost knocked over some boxes. Timmy thought it was silly to be in such a hurry at the grocery store. 

Finally, they reached the checkout and paid for their groceries. Timmy and his mommy went home and had a snack together. Even though he didn't get the candy bar, Timmy was happy because he got to spend time with his mommy and have a yummy snack.

Once upon a time there was a bad wolf. He was very envious of his neighbours and their happy lives. One day he knocked on the neighbours' door and asked if he could come inside for tea. They were kind and said yes.

The wolf was full of nice words and promised to be good. He drank all their tea and ate all their food. He made the home a very messy place and the neighbours felt very sad. In the end, the wolf ran away with all their things.

The neighbours were sad and disappointed that the wolf had not kept his promise. They had been so kind and trusted him, but he had not been good.

Moral of the story: It is important to be careful when you trust people. Even if someone promises something, it may not be true.

Anna and Ben were friends who liked to sing and dance. They wanted to perform for their parents and show them their skills. They practiced every day in the garden, where there were many roses.

One day, they decided to pick some roses and give them to their parents after their performance. They were very careful not to touch the thorns, because they hurt. They put the roses in a basket and went to the living room, where their parents were waiting.

"Hello, Mommy and Daddy!" Anna said. "We have a surprise for you! We are going to perform a song and a dance that we made up!"

"That sounds wonderful, sweetie!" Mommy said. "We can't wait to see it!"

Anna and Ben smiled and started their performance. They sang a happy song about the sun and the sky, and then they danced with joy and grace. They were having so much fun, and their parents clapped and cheered.

When they finished, they bowed and ran to the basket. They took out the roses and gave them to their parents.

"Here, Mommy and Daddy, these are for you!" Ben said. "We picked them from the garden, because they are pretty and smell good!"

"Thank you, honey, they are beautiful!" Daddy said. He took a rose and smelled it. But then he made a face and spat. "Yuck! This rose is bitter! It tastes awful!"

Mommy also took a rose and smelled it. But then she also made a face and spat. "Ew! This rose is bitter too! It tastes horrible!"

Anna and Ben were confused and sad. They did not know why the roses were bitter. They had picked them with love and care. They wanted to make their parents happy, not unhappy.

They looked at the roses and saw that they had a strange color. They were not red or pink or yellow. They were black and purple and green. They realized that they had picked the wrong roses. They had picked the roses that grew near the fence, where the mean neighbor sprayed them with poison.

They felt very sorry and scared. They had given their parents poison roses. They had made a big mistake. They started to cry and hug each other.

"Mommy, Daddy, we are so sorry!" Anna said. "We did not know the roses were bad! We did not mean to hurt you!"

"Please, Mommy, Daddy, don't be mad at us!" Ben said. "We love you very much! Please, don't be sick!"

But it was too late. Mommy and Daddy were already sick. They felt dizzy and weak. They fell to the floor and did not move. They did not say anything. They did not breathe.

Anna and Ben were alone. They had no one to help them. They had no one to love them. They had lost their parents because of the bitter roses. They had performed their last song and dance. They had no more happiness. They had only sadness. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a raven named Raven. Raven liked to fly around and find shiny things. One day, Raven found a shiny rock and wanted to keep it. But, another raven also wanted the shiny rock. They started to quarrel and peck at each other. 

A little girl named Lily saw the raven quarrel and tried to stop them. "Stop! Stop!" she said, but the ravens didn't listen. Lily thought the ravens were crazy for fighting over a shiny rock.

Suddenly, a big gust of wind blew the shiny rock away. The ravens stopped quarrelling and looked at each other. "Oh no!" they said, and flew away to find the shiny rock. Lily smiled and said, "Silly ravens, it's just a shiny rock."

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl named Lily. She had a lot of energy and loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Lily was walking through the park and saw something very attractive. It was a shiny red car that was ready to zoom across the park. She had never seen a car like this before and wanted to ride in it.

Lily walked up to the car and said, "Hi! Can I have a ride?" 

The car driver looked at her and said, "Sure! Hop in and I'll take you around the park."

Lily was so excited. She strapped herself in, and the car zoomed around the park. The wind blew in her face and the sun shone on her skin. Lily had never felt so happy.

When it was time to go home, Lily thanked the car driver and said, "That was fun!" 

The car driver smiled and waved goodbye as the car zoomed away.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old bear. He wanted to go on an adventure, so he decided to search. He looked and looked, but he couldn't find what he was searching for.

Suddenly, he spotted something in the distance. He ran and ran, until he arrived at a village. It was full of people who were cheerful and kind. They welcomed the wise old bear and asked him why he was searching. He replied that he was looking for a home.

The happy people of the village showed him around, and he quickly decided that it was the perfect home for him. He thanked them for their kindness, and lived happily ever after in his new home.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going on picnics with his family. One day, they went on a picnic and Timmy's mom brought a cooler. Timmy wanted to help and tried to carry the cooler, but it was too heavy for him.

During the picnic, Timmy's mom asked him to fold the picnic blanket. Timmy didn't want to do it because he thought it was too hard. But then he remembered how he couldn't carry the cooler and realized that he needed to try his best. He folded the blanket and felt proud of himself.

When they got home, Timmy's mom told him that it's important to try your best and help out, even if things seem hard. Timmy felt happy that he could help and promised to always try his best. From that day on, Timmy always helped out on picnics and felt proud of himself for being a good helper.

Once upon a time there was a little cabin in the woods. Inside the cabin there was a boy of three years old. One day the boy was feeling bored so he went outside to explore. As he walked around, he found a small button on the ground. He picked up the button and held it tightly in his hand. 

Suddenly, the button began to glow. The boy jumped back and looked around in fright. Then he noticed a calm voice speaking: "Press the button, and your joy will increase". 

The boy was hesitant but eventually mustered up the courage and pressed the button. Suddenly the button made a loud noise, and the boy felt an increase of joy in his heart. He smiled and looked around. He saw birds flying in the sky and a calm river flowing nearby. The boy looked back down and saw a cabin full of toys and activities that he could enjoy. 

He then ran back inside the cabin, ready to explore the new world of joy that the button had opened up for him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to chew on bubble gum all the time. He would chew and chew until the flavor was gone.

One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy brought a toy weapon with him. Timmy thought it was cool and wanted to play with it too. But Billy said Timmy couldn't play with it because he might hurt himself.

Timmy felt sad and left out. He decided to go outside and play by himself. He found a stick and started to twirl it around like a weapon. But then, he got too dizzy and fell down. He realized that Billy was right and he shouldn't play with weapons. From then on, he stuck to chewing his bubble gum and having fun without any weapons.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy cow. She had big, wide eyes and she was always very curious. Every day she would go for a walk and look for something exciting to do.

One day, she stopped by a pond. She saw a frog over there and she decided to watch him. The frog was jumping around, but the nosy cow was getting very bored. After a while, she quit watching and went to find something else to do.

The cow then walked to a big field of grass. There were flowers, butterflies, and bugs all over the place. She hopped around and tried to catch them, but she quit after a few minutes.

Then the cow went to a nearby barn. She wanted to see what was inside, but the door was shut. She was trying to open it when she heard someone coming around the corner. She quickly quit trying and hid in the corner.

It was the farmer, and he was very nosy. He had noticed the cow trying to open the door and he wanted to figure out why. She quickly ran away, back to her home in the fields.

The nosy cow learned a valuable lesson that day. She was determined never to be nosy again and to always respect other people's privacy.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Emily. She was very happy and curious. She went outside and decided to explore the neighborhood. The first place she spotted was a restaurant. Emily already felt excited and decided to enter the restaurant.

Inside the restaurant it was very smooth. The walls were beige, the tables were round and the floor was white. Everyone in the restaurant smiled when they saw Emily entering.

Emily then whispered to herself, "This place looks really nice. I want to learn more!" At that point a waiter came up to her and asked her what she wanted to do.

Emily said, "I surrender! I want to know more about this place."

The waiter laughed and said, "No need to surrender to us, little one. We'll help you explore this place."

Emily was so happy that the waiter wanted to help her. She thanked the waiter and said, "Let's explore!" And so the two of them had a wonderful time exploring the restaurant. They tasted all the dishes, touched everything smooth and learned lots of new things.

At the end of the day they both said goodbye and Emily walked out of the restaurant with a content heart, having surrendered to the magical experience in the restaurant.

Once upon a time there was a mechanic. He had a long day because he had to fix a lot of cars. He was so tired, he decided to take a break. So he went outside and dug a hole in the ground. He put a blanket in the hole and he lay down inside it. He buried himself in the ground. He enjoyed the feeling of being buried because it was warm and cozy. 

The next day, the mechanic got up, brushed himself off and continued to work on the cars. He was so proud of himself for finding a way to relax after such a long day. He told all his mechanic friends what he had done and they thought it was a great idea. From then on, whenever they had a long day, they would bury themselves in the ground and relax. 

The End.

Once upon a time there was a herb garden. It was planted by a family named the O'Hara's. They planted many different kinds of herbs.

The herbs were used to make special teas, ointments and snacks. One day, the O'Hara's decided to bury some of the herbs in the garden to keep them safe until they needed them.

The O'Hara's were very kind people. Every morning and evening, they took turns visiting the herb garden and thanked the herbs for the lovely things they made.

The herbs were happy to be part of the O'Hara family. They were thankful to be buried in the garden and kept safe. 

The O'Hara's thanked the herbs for all the kind things they did. And from then on, the herbs stayed in the garden, safe and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a wet missile. The missile belonged to a boy. The boy wanted to attach the missile to his toy plane, so he could make it fly. But, the missile was too wet and it wouldn't attach to the plane.

The boy was very sad. He really wanted to attach the missile to his plane! He tried and tried to attach it, but it was just too wet.

The boy was almost ready to give up, when his mommy had a good idea. She told the boy to blow on the missile to make it dry. So, that's what the boy did. He blew on the missile until it was dry.

And finally, the missile was dry enough to attach to the plane. The boy was so excited! He quickly attached the missile and flew the plane back and forth around the house. He had a lot of fun!

The end.

Once upon a time there was a man who wanted to build a house out of blocks. He got out his box of blocks and started making his house. But then his wife came to help him. She said she would help, but she wanted to do it her way.

The man didn't like the idea and said he would do it his way. The wife said it was not fair and started to yell and shout. 

The man just stayed quiet and kept building his house. He wanted to show his wife he was honest and hardworking. He worked with the blocks hard and fast. After hours of hard work, he was very happy with the house.

His wife looked at the house and realized his efforts. She was very sorry and told him that she was wrong to make him angry. She said she was happy that he was so honest and hardworking. 

The man was very glad and he hugged her. They both continued to build the house together and it came out even better than he could have imagined. They were both very happy with the results. 

The End

Mommy was happy. She was pouring warm water into a building. She said it was for the people who lived there. She said they needed it to stay warm.

When they finished pouring, they went home and had dinner. Mommy said it was time for bed. Daddy said they'd done a good job.

The next morning Mommy was happy again. She took us back to the building and we saw the people. They were smiling and hugging her. They thanked her for the warm water. 

Everyone was happy. They said goodbye and we went home. Mommy and Daddy said they were proud of us. We had done a nice thing!

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very brave. Her name was Susie and she loved to explore and try new things. One day, Susie had an unusual idea and decided to dare herself to do something special. She wrote a note and put it under her pillow. 

The next morning, Susie took the note and headed to the park. She was so excited that she couldn't stop smiling! When she got to the park, Susie stood tall and proud and did the special thing. She was so brave that everyone around her clapped and cheered.

Susie was so proud of herself for daring to try something new. Every time she looked at her note, she remembered how brave she had been. She kept the note and kept daring herself to try new things.

From then on, Susie was known to be a very brave little girl and she was never afraid to try something unusual.

Once there was a boy named Bob and he was very obedient. He always did exactly what his mummy and daddy asked. One day his mummy said, "Bob, you need to start to learn how to write. I want you to go to your desk and write."

Bob went to his desk and looked at the paper. He picked up the pen but he hesitated. He did not know how to use it to write.

His mummy came to see what he was doing. She said, "That's ok Bob, let me help you." She showed Bob how to hold the pen and then write. 

Bob smiled and started to write. He felt a sense of pride as the words appeared on the paper. 

Bob was very obedient and he was pleased he had followed his mummy's instructions.

Tom and Lily were friends. They liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big man with a red shirt. The shirt had many words on it. Tom and Lily could not read the words.

"Hello, big man," Tom said. "We like your shirt. What does it say?"

The big man looked at Tom and Lily. He did not smile. He did not say hello. He was angry. He said, "My shirt says that I hate everyone. I hate you too. Go away!"

Tom and Lily were scared. They wanted to run away. But the big man did not let them. He grabbed their arms. He said, "You will come with me. You will march with me. We will show everyone how crazy we are."

Tom and Lily cried. They did not want to march with the big man. They did not want to be crazy. They wanted to go home. They wanted their mom and dad. But the big man did not care. He dragged them along the street. He shouted and waved his arms. He scared many people.

No one helped Tom and Lily. No one stopped the big man. Tom and Lily marched with the big man. They did not know where they were going. They did not know what would happen. They were very sad. They wished they never saw the big man with the red shirt.

Once upon a time, there was a purple spider. He lived in a cozy corner of the house. Every day, he would crawl around and explore.

One day, the purple spider went outside. He saw a big, bright light, and it was very beautiful. He ran towards the light and couldn't wait to explore it.

But when the purple spider got closer, he disappeared! He was gone and no one could find him. Everyone in the house was very sad, but they kept looking for him.

After a few days, the purple spider reappeared! He had been hidden in the light and was safe. Everyone was so happy to see him again.

The purple spider never disappeared again. He stayed in his cozy corner, and everyone was very happy knowing he was safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She had a special present that she wanted to give to her best friend Jonny. To wrap the present, she found some colourful paper and cut it into a square shape. She asked her mummy to help her wrap the present. Mummy showed her how to wrap the present and taught her the special way to make it look pretty. 

Then Sarah and Mummy went to the shop to buy something special for Jonny. Sarah wanted to buy him some spaghetti, because it was very popular in their city. Sarah picked out the biggest box of spaghetti she could find and brought it home. 

Once home, Sarah and Mummy wrapped the spaghetti in the same colourful paper she had used for Jonny's present. She folded the paper carefully, using the same method Mummy had taught her. Finally, the present was wrapped. 

Sarah was very proud of how it looked. She knew Jonny was going to love his special present!

Once upon a time there was a young girl who lived in a tiny house with her parents. Every day she would play around her house, but what she liked the most was to go to the library. There was an amazing shelf that was so tall it almost touched the ceiling and it was filled with books!

One day the girl asked her mum if she could take one of the books home with her. Her mum said yes, but only if she picked the right one. The girl was so proud of herself when she found the perfect book for her. She carefully put it in her bag and went home with it.

Once the girl arrived home, her mum noticed the book in her bag. "What's this?" she said. The girl quickly told her mum all about the library and the shelf filled with books.  Joe was so excited! He asked her again and again, but she just laughed and said, "You'll have to find it yourself!" 
Joe became determined to find his secret. He looked and looked, and eventually, he found it - a secret hideout in the woods! Joe was so happy! He kept his secret safe, and would always spend time there when he wanted to feel special and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He had a notebook that he loved to draw in. One day, it started to rain and his notebook got wet. Timmy was sad because he thought he couldn't draw anymore. But then, he blinked and had an idea! He would use his crayons to draw a picture of the rain. Timmy was happy again and his notebook didn't feel so wet anymore. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a young dolphin. She was so sad and wanted to make a friend. She had been looking for days and days for someone to talk to.

Suddenly, she spotted a little girl. She was of the same age as the dolphin, just a young three year old. She swam closer and asked the little girl, "Happy to play together?".

The little girl smiled, "Yes, I would love to play together!", and they started having lots of fun, jumping and swimming around in the ocean.

But after a while, the little girl started to weep. The dolphin was very worried and asked her, "What is wrong, why are you crying?".

The little girl explained, "I'm so sad, I miss my mom". The dolphin nodded and softly said, "I understand, it can be hard when we feel alone. Do you want me to take you to your mom?". The little girl was so happy, she hugged the dolphin and said, "Yes, please take me to my mom".

And then, the dolphin and the little girl swam off together, heading towards the little girl's mom, who was waiting for her with open arms.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys. One day, they go to the toy store with their moms. They see many toys. Some are big, some are small, some are shiny, some are soft.

Lily sees a doll. She likes the doll. She says, "Mom, can I have the doll? It is pretty and has a dress."

Ben sees the same doll. He likes the doll too. He says, "Mom, can I have the doll? It is cool and has a hat."

Lily and Ben both want the doll. They run to the doll. They grab the doll. They pull the doll. They fight for the doll.

"Stop!" their moms say. "You can't fight for the doll. It is not nice. It is not fair. You have to share."

"But I saw it first!" Lily says.

"No, I saw it first!" Ben says.

Their moms shake their heads. They look at the price tag. The doll is cheap. It is not a good doll. It is not worth a fight.

"Look, kids," Lily's mom says. "This doll is cheap. It is not a good doll. It will break soon. It will make you sad. Why don't you choose another toy? There are many toys here. You can find a better toy."

Lily and Ben let go of the doll. They look around. They see other toys. They see toys that are better than the doll. They see toys that they like more. They smile.

"OK, mom," Lily says. "I want this teddy bear. It is soft and has a bow."

"OK, mom," Ben says. "I want this truck. It is big and has wheels."

Their moms are happy. They buy the toys for Lily and Ben. Lily and Ben are happy too. They hug their toys. They hug each other. They say, "Sorry for the fight. Let's play together."

They go home. They play with their toys. They are friends again. They have fun. The end.
