Once upon a time, there was a big gray elephant. He was very stubborn and never listened to anyone. One day, he was walking in the forest and saw a juicy apple. He tried to pick it up with his trunk but it was too high. Suddenly, a little monkey appeared and offered to help him get the apple. The elephant was hesitant at first but agreed.

The monkey climbed up the tree and picked the apple. As he was coming down, the elephant opened his mouth wide to eat the apple. But the monkey was too quick and bit the elephant's trunk. The elephant was surprised and started to cry. The monkey felt bad and apologized. From that day on, the elephant learned to listen and became friends with the monkey.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Brownie. Brownie loved to eat delicious fruits like apples, pears, and prunes. One day, he went to a big orchard to find some juicy prunes to eat. But when he got there, he saw a little rabbit named Thumper eating all the prunes!

"Hey, Thumper! Those prunes are mine! You can't eat them all!" Brownie said.

"I'm sorry, Brownie. I was so hungry and the prunes looked so yummy. Can we share them?" Thumper replied.

Brownie thought for a moment and said, "Okay, let's share them. But if you take more than half, we'll have to fight!"

Thumper agreed, and they both ate the prunes together. They were happy and full, and they became good friends. From that day on, Brownie and Thumper always shared their food and never fought again.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with their wagon. They used it to carry their toys, books and snacks around the yard. Sometimes they pretended it was a train, a boat or a spaceship.

One day, Lily had a new idea. She wanted to improve the wagon and make it look nicer. She found some paint, stickers and ribbons in the garage and brought them to the wagon.

"Let's decorate the wagon!" she said to Ben. "It will be so pretty and fun!"

Ben was not sure. He liked the wagon the way it was. He did not want to change it. But Lily was bossy and did not listen to him. She told him what to do and where to put the paint, stickers and ribbons.

"Put some blue paint here, and some yellow stickers there, and some pink ribbons here," she said. "Hurry up, Ben, we don't have much time!"

Ben did not like being bossy. He felt sad and angry. He did not think the wagon looked better. He thought it looked messy and silly. He wanted to stop and play something else.

"Lily, I don't want to do this anymore," he said. "Can we play something else? I don't like the wagon like this."

Lily was surprised. She thought Ben was having fun. She thought the wagon looked amazing. She did not understand why Ben was unhappy.

"What do you mean, Ben?" she said. "The wagon is improved! It is the best wagon ever! Don't you like it?"

Ben shook his head. He did not like it. He did not like Lily being bossy. He wanted to be friends, but he also wanted to have a choice.

"Lily, I like you, but you are too bossy," he said. "You don't let me have a say. You don't care what I think. You only care about what you want. That's not nice."

Lily felt sorry. She did not mean to be bossy. She did not mean to hurt Ben's feelings. She realized she was wrong. She wanted to make up with Ben.

"Ben, I'm sorry," she said. "You are right. I was too bossy. I should have asked you what you wanted. I should have listened to you. I don't want to lose you as a friend. Can we still be friends?"

Ben smiled. He was glad Lily said sorry. He was glad she understood. He wanted to be friends too.

"Of course we can still be friends, Lily," he said. "But can we please wash the wagon and make it normal again?"

Lily nodded. She agreed to wash the wagon and make it normal again. She learned to be less bossy and more respectful. Ben learned to speak up and share his feelings. They both learned to improve their friendship. They hugged and played with their wagon happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went to the park with her mom. She saw a bird's nest in a tree and asked her mom, "What is that?"

"That is a bird's nest," replied her mom. "The bird lays eggs in there."

Lily looked at the nest and saw a small rod inside. "Why is there a stick in there?" she asked.

"That's a regular part of the nest," explained her mom. "The bird uses it to make the nest stronger."

Lily thought it was amazing that birds could make their own homes. She said, "I wish I could build a nest like that."

"You can build a nest with your toys," said her mom. "But you can't lay eggs in it!" They both laughed and continued to enjoy their day at the park.

Once there was a skeleton. He liked to rock all the time. One day he was walking and he found something useful. It was a rock! He was very happy. He could now rock even more. He rocked and rocked and had lots of fun. He rocked so much that he got tired. He had a great time and found a new friend. The rock was so useful. He could rock and play with it forever. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Rebecca. Rebecca was scared, because she didn't know anyone in her new town. She was walking around when she saw a dog. She called out to the dog and asked its name. The puppy looked at her and said his name was Spot. 

Rebecca was so happy to make a new friend. She asked Spot to help her find her way home. Spot followed her and helped her find her house. When Rebecca arrived home, she was so thankful to Spot for helping her. 

Rebecca and Spot stayed friends for a long time. Whenever Rebecca was feeling scared, Spot was always there to help her. When Spot was scared, Rebecca was also there to help him. 

Rebecca and Spot were the best of friends. They always helped each other and never forgot each other's name.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to dig in the dirt and play with his trucks. One day, while he was digging, he found a secret hole in the ground. He crawled inside and found himself in an underground cave. 

In the cave, Timmy found a treasure chest. He opened the chest and inside was a famous toy that he had always wanted. He was so happy! He couldn't wait to show his friends. 

When Timmy got home, he couldn't keep the secret anymore. He revealed to his friends that he had found a treasure chest underground and inside was a famous toy. His friends were so excited and they all went back to the cave to see it. They couldn't believe their eyes! It was the best day ever.

Once there was a boy and his name was Tom. He had a staff that a very special staff. He knew it was special because it could fit anyplace. 
Tom went to the park to show off his special staff. While he was there he saw a fake staff. It looked just like his but it was made of plastic. Tom grabbed his staff and said, "That staff is not real! Mine is special and it fits the best!". 
Tom showed the other kids how his staff was the best. He could fit it around a tree, he could even fit it through the playground bars! Everyone was amazed by Tom's special staff and that's how he knew it was the best.

Jimmy was walking in the forest and it was getting dark. He was very scared but he put on his brave face. Dad said he had to be brave. Jimmy found a flashlight and he tied it to his belt. The beam of light shone really high and Jimmy began to feel better. He could see where he was going, like a brave explorer. Suddenly, he saw something in the distance, a high tree! He tied his belt around the tree and shined his flashlight. He felt happy and safe. Jimmy knew he would be okay now and his bravery was rewarded.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Casey. She was a brave and curious child. One day, Casey wanted to explore the woods beyond her house. Her mom made her a promise and said, "Stay close and come right back home, ok?". Casey nodded and said, "Yes mommy". As Casey explored deeper into the woods she felt both excited and scared. It was a weak feeling, like something was watching her. However, Casey didn't want to break her mom's promise, so she stayed close. After an hour she heard her mom calling her! Casey happily ran back home to the safety of her mother's embrace. Her mom was so happy to see her and hugged the little girl tightly. From then on, Casey remembered her mom's promise and stayed safe in the woods.

Once there was a girl who was very curious. Every day, she wanted to learn something new. One day, she heard a new word. She decided to find out what it meant. 

She asked her mom what the word meant. Her mom said the word was "bake". The girl was excited to learn the new word - she wanted to bake something!

So, she asked her mom if she could bake a cake. Her mom said yes and the girl ran to get the ingredients. She was so excited! She followed her mom's instructions carefully and soon the cake was baking in the oven.

The girl sat patiently as the smell of the cake filled the house. Her mom carefully took the cake out of the oven and put it on the table. They both agreed that it was the most delicious cake they had ever tasted. 

The girl was so proud. Every day she discovered something new - and this time it was how to bake a cake!

Tony was very excited - today he was going to organize a picnic with all of his friends! He went to the kitchen to get a knife and started to cut up some apples and other fruits. 

Suddenly, Tony heard his mother's voice. He had forgotten that he was supposed to be tidying his bedroom. Tony quickly ran to his room and started to organize his toys.

When his Mom came in to check, she gasped. Tony had left his toy knife next to his bed - it was very dangerous to leave it there. She was very stern with Tony and told him that next time he would be in big trouble. 

Tony felt very guilty. He had been very careless and now he was scared of what would happen. He finished tidying his room and learned an important lesson - to never leave anything sharp lying around.

Once, there was a little boy named Jimmy. He loved to travel. Every day he would walk around the village and explore new places. 

One day, Jimmy decided to travel farther than he had ever gone before. He packed an oat for the journey and was excited to see what he might find. 

At first, the scenery was the same ones he already knew. But the further he went, the more lively the landscape became. The trees were so tall that Jimmy had to tilt his head to look them up and the birds were singing in the most beautiful way. 

The sun was setting and soon it was dark. Jimmy was starting to get scared, but he decided to just keep walking and humming a little song. Along the way, he found a little cottage full of light. He knocked on the door, and an old woman opened it. She invited Jimmy in, served him some warm food, and told him about the magical place he had arrived at. 

Jimmy was amazed. He never thought that his little lunch of oat could take him all the way there.

Once upon a time, there lived a young boy named Jake. Jake had an incredible dream: he wanted to succeed at being the best bus driver in the world.

One day, Jake decided to make his dream come true. He got dressed, packed up his bag and hopped on the bus.

When Jake saw the bus, he became so excited! He had never seen a bus so big and shiny before. He smiled and said, "I'm going to do it! I'm going to be the best bus driver ever!"

He took the bus for a ride. It was incredible! He drove on roads and took curve with ease. He drove fast and slow. People around town started calling him the best bus driver in the world.

Finally, after a lot of hard work, Jake succeeded in being the best bus driver in the world! He was filled with joy and kept on driving the bus with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time there was a chubby olive. It was a very special olive. One day it started to move and it began to appear all over the place. 

First it appeared in a kitchen. There it met a big pot that was bubbling away with soup. It hopped in but suddenly it was too hot and the chubby olive quickly hopped back out. 

Then the chubby olive appeared in a garden. There it met a little dog who was chasing its tail round in circles. The chubby olive giggled then waved goodbye to the little dog. 

Finally the chubby olive appeared in a park where a group of little children were playing. They saw the olive and started to chase it around. The chubby olive ran round and round and round until it was too tired and it flopped onto the ground. The children laughed and the chubby olive laughed too. 

And that's how the chubby olive's day ended, with happy memories and a big smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the zoo with her family. She saw many animals, like lions, monkeys and elephants. But there was one animal that caught her eye. It was a cheetah. It was so fast! It could run faster than any other animal in the zoo.

Lily watched the cheetah for a while. She noticed that it would blink its eyes really fast before it ran. She thought it was funny. Later that day, Lily and her family went to a race. There were many people running, but Lily wanted to race the cheetah. She knew she couldn't win, but she wanted to try.

When the race started, the cheetah ran so fast that it was a blur. But Lily remembered the cheetah's blinking and closed her eyes really tight. When she opened them again, she saw the cheetah had stopped running. It was blinking really fast, just like before. Lily had won the race!

Once there was a pony called Sam. Sam was very smart and one day he went out for a walk.
Suddenly, a big scary noise came from behind Sam. It was loud and made Sam scared. He started to run away.
Sam ran and ran but the scary noise kept following him. He was so scared that he tripped on a rock and fell down.
When Sam stood up, he saw that the noise was coming from a big monster. The monster was so scary that Sam was sure he would never be able to get away.

The monster chased Sam until they reached a dark cave. The monster was blocking the way out and Sam knew he was trapped. He tried to run away one more time, but the monster was too fast and caught him.

In the end, Sam was never seen again. The pony was too scared and the monster was too smart. Poor Sam was gone forever.

One day, Alice went to the park with her mom. As she walked, Alice saw something very interesting. It was a pink squirrel! The squirrel was eating an interesting snack. It was a peanut. 

Alice was so excited! She pointed and said to her mom, "Look! A pink squirrel eating a peanut!" Her mom smiled and said, "Let's go say hello". 

Alice ran over to the squirrel and said, "Hi, pink squirrel!" The squirrel looked up and said, "Hello, Alice". It quickly finished the peanut and then ran away, zipping around the trees. 

Alice and her mom laughed and waved goodbye. They continued walking through the park, always keeping an eye out for more pink squirrels!

One day, Sid decided to bring his unique luggage to the park. He was so excited to show it off!

On the way there, he was skipping along and singing a song. Suddenly, he heard a loud crunch! Sid looked down to see that he had broken his luggage.

He was so sad and a few tears began to fall. But then he heard a voice.

"What's wrong, Sid?" asked his best friend Jenny.

"I broke my unique luggage," Sid said sadly.

Jenny smiled and put her arm around him. "That's ok," she said. "We can fix it together."

Sure enough, Jenny and Sid fixed the luggage and soon it looked even better than before. The next day, Sid proudly showed off his fixed, unique luggage and no one could believe he had broken it.

One day, Jack was walking along the river. He saw a heavy log blocking his way. He tried to push it but it was too heavy! He was so sad. Suddenly, he heard a voice whisper in his ear. It was the river! It said "I can help you!". Jack was so happy. He said that he could not move the log. The river said he could help by peppering the log. Jack did not know what that meant, but he was happy to try.

The river was so kind and he sprayed some water at the log. What happened next was amazing! The heavy log moved and Jack could walk past it. He thanked the river for helping him and the river smiled. It wanted to help Jack more, so it asked if he wanted to go on a boat ride. Jack was so excited! He said, "Yes!"

The river allowed Jack to come on its boat and they sailed downstream. The ride was so fun and Jack looked around at all the creatures living in the river. He even saw a snake and a turtle. He said hello to them, and they said hello back. Jack had the best day ever. He thanked the river for permitting him to go on the boat ride. 

The river smiled and waved goodbye. Jack thanked it again and said that he would never forget his day in the river.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy. His name was Patrick, and he had a very big problem. Patrick wanted to reach the iron on the top shelf, but it was too high for him to get. He couldn't ask his mom for help, because she was busy. Patrick thought about what to do, and he had an idea!

He grabbed a chair and wobbled over to the shelf. He stood on top of it, but it still wasn't high enough. Patrick got a bigger chair, but then it was too hard to reach. He looked around and saw something disgusting: a pile of dirty clothes. Patrick had a great idea! He pushed the clothes up to the shelf, and he was able to reach the iron!

Patrick was so happy. He grabbed the iron and held it up in the air. He felt like a hero, and he knew that he had solved his problem.

Once there was a cute little duck. He was so happy to spread his wings and soar through the air. But his joy did not last long. One day, he heard an angry voice shouting at him from afar.

The little duck had paid the ultimate price for not following the advice of the voice. The moral of the story is to always act responsibly and pay attention to those who are trying to help you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because it was almost time for her favorite holiday, Halloween. She wanted to dress up as a princess and go trick-or-treating with her friends.

One day, Lily's mom took her to the store to buy her princess costume. But when they got there, Lily saw so many costumes that she got confused and didn't know which one to pick. "Mommy, I don't know which one to choose!" Lily said.

"It's okay, sweetie," her mom said. "Let's cover our eyes and point to one." So they covered their eyes and pointed to a beautiful princess costume. Lily was so happy that she hugged her mom and said, "Thank you, mommy! I can't wait for Halloween!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Jemma. Jemma was a very adventurous 3 year old. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her.

One day she went for a walk and stumbled upon a bridge. She was so excited and ran over to take a closer look. As she got to the other side, she noticed something very strange. It was a huge frown!

Jemma was confused, so she asked the frown why it was there. The frown said "I'm here to make sure everyone smiles. I'm the bridge-keeper and I like making sure everyone stays happy."

Jemma smiled and said "That's a fine job to have." The frown smiled back and said "Come again soon! Bye bye."

Jemma waved goodbye and returned home with a skip in her step. She was now sure that the bridge was safe and happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She had a big, red basket. She was excited to show it to all her friends.

Her friends loved the basket, they said it was so flexible. She thought that was special, so she decided to show them what else she could do.

She bent the basket into funny shapes. Her friends laughed. She bent it into a heart, an apple and a snake. They laughed even louder! Then she showed them how she could make it stand upright, like a triangle. 

Her friends wanted to try too, so they all took turns. It was their own special game. When everyone was done, they all gave the basket a big hug. It had been so much fun!

Jimmy was 3 and he loved playing with his toys. He played with them all day. But one day, something strange happened. The police arrived in two big cars. They were all wearing uniforms. Jimmy was confused and questions why they were there. He asked his mom but she didn't know why they were there either.

The police began looking in the house and it quickly became messy. They were looking inside drawers and cupboards. Jimmy was so confused and asked the police why they were there.

The police explained that the neighbors heard a really loud crash from inside the house. They had come to check to make sure everyone was ok. Jimmy was relieved and so was his mom. The police even helped clean up the mess! 

Jimmy and his family thanked the police before they left and Jimmy finally got to continue playing with his toys.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old. She asked her Mama, "What is marry?"

The man was so happy, he thanked Lucy and gave her a big hug. Lucy smiled and said: "That was easy!"

One day, Tom and his mom were walking in the park. Tom felt the rain falling on his head, and he smiled. His mom was so cheerful too! 

"Mom, why is it raining?" asked Tom. 

"It's raining so that the flowers can grow," his mom smiled. 

Tom and his mom kept walking. Soon they saw a big purple shop. "Mom, can we buy some ice cream?" asked Tom. 

"Yes, Tom. We can buy some ice cream," his mom said cheerfully.

So Tom and his mom went into the shop and bought two big scoops of ice cream. They were both happy and cheerful. 

When they left the shop, the rain had stopped. Now the sun was out, and the flowers had grown even bigger. 

Tom and his mom smiled at each other. They had had a wonderful day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and draw pictures with her crayons. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, it's time to start your math homework."

Lily didn't like math very much. She thought it was hard and boring. But she knew she had to do it, so she sat down at her desk and got out her notebook. As she was working on her math problems, she accidentally knocked over her cup of black paint.

"Oh no!" Lily cried. "My paint spilled all over my desk!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to play. She would play in the garden, with her friends and even with her toys. One day she decided to play with something special - poison. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a big green swing and wanted to try it out. She asked her mommy if she could swing on it.

It was a beautiful summer day. Annie and Joe were walking in the park. 

Joe asked Annie, "What do you want to do?"

Joe thought about it for a moment, and then he said, "You're right. From now on, I will think before I decide to do something."

Annie smiled and said, "At least you learned something from falling down."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to paint and spent all her free time creating beautiful pictures. One day Sarah went outside to paint, taking a bottle of paint and a brush with her.

Once upon a time there was a rich butterfly. It lived in a big field with lots of flowers. It flew all around, enjoying the sun and the warm air.

Once upon a time, there was a little octopus named Ollie. Ollie lived in the ocean and loved to play all day. He was a messy octopus, always making a big mess with his toys and food.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to run and play in the park. One day, Max saw a colorful butterfly flying in the sky. He wanted to catch it, so he ran after it. The butterfly flew higher and higher until it disappeared into the landscape.

Once there was a brave girl named Jasmine. She was very competitive and loved to explore. One day she went for a walk in the woods. There she saw a very special mushroom. She had never seen an orange mushroom before.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful wolf. He lived in a forest near a village. The villagers were afraid of the wolf, hoping he would stay away from them.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play together. One day, they decide to play sell. They find some toys and books and put them on a table. They make a sign that says "Sell. One coin for each thing."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Clara. She was just three years old but already so brave.

Harry was a little boy who lived in a big city. He loved to go to the park to swing. 

One day, Harry was swinging in the park when he saw a turkey hopping around helplessly. It had gotten lost and didn't know how to get back home.

Once there was a little fish who lived in the sea. He was having a very nice day and was swimming around looking for food, when suddenly he saw a hook! He was so scared, he quickly hid behind a rock.

One day, Bob was sitting on the floor playing with his toy truck. He saw a small cop outside his window. He went to the window and waved. The cop waved back and then knocked on the door.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy old bear. All the other animals in the forest were always happy and peaceful. The bear never seemed to have any fun.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Stella was walking down a mysterious path in the woods. The trees were tall and she could hear strange creatures rustling nearby. As she walked, she came to a big hill with a log at the top.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia was very curious. She always asked her mom and dad about the world around her. One day, Mia saw a little spirit in her room. The spirit was friendly and liked to play with her toys.
