Tom said, "We should leave this cloth here, itâ€™s too disgusting to touch." So they decided to go back home, never to return to the cloth again.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lilly decided to go to the office. She was curious to see what it looked like. When she got there, she felt very confused. She didn't know what to do.

So Lilly asked the office man, "What do you do here?"

The office man said, "I write a lot of things. I write about important things."

"What are important things?" asked Lilly.

The office man said, "Important things like business, the news and stories."

Lilly was still confused, but she thanked the office man anyway. Then she waved goodbye and went on her way.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Bella. She was very adventurous and loved to try new things. One day, Bella decided she wanted to bury her suit in the ground. Her mom said no, but Bella had a bright idea. 

Bella gathered all the tools she could find and started digging a big hole. She was determined to bury her suit and have an adventure. But when Bella put the suit in the hole, something else came out - a giant bird! 

The bird had a loud voice and said, "What are you doing? That is my home!" Bella was so scared that she ran away. She didnâ€™t know what to do. 

The bird chased Bella all the way home. When they arrived, the bird said, "I want my home back!" Bella was scared. But then she had a bright idea. She said, "I will exchange my suit for your home!"

The bird thought about it, and decided to agree. Bella was happy, and the bird was happy. Everybody was happy and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Alex. He loved to drive around in his toy car. He would drive it all around the house, across the kitchen floor and up along the stairs. 

One day, Alex had to go to the store with his mom. He was very excited to drive in the real car. As they drove down the road, Alex saw an old woman with a bag. He asked his mom why she was carrying a bag and his mom told him that the woman was worried because she couldn't find her way home. 

Feeling sad for the woman, Alex offered to help her. So, mom and Alex drove the old woman home. When they arrived, the woman gave Alex a big hug to thank him for helping her. 

This story teaches us that we should always help people who are in need. It also teaches us that even small acts of kindness can make a big difference in someone's life. Generosity is always worth it.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy named Bob. Bob lived happily with his family in a cozy home far away. On one special day, Bob asked his mom, "Where does the sun go at night?" His mom smiled and shrugged.

Bob had never seen the sun go away, and he wanted to find out. He put on his shoes and began to walk out of the house. His mom asked, "Where are you going, Bob?"

Bob smiled and said, "To find the sun!" His mom smiled sadly and said, "Be careful, it may be a long way away."

Bob kept walking until he reached a heavy oak door. He opened the door and stepped inside. But what he saw made him very confused. Instead of the sun, the room was just filled with more doors. There were so many doors that Bob started to feel frustrated. He started to feel sad and he wanted to go back home.

But then after he had thought it over, he decided to shrug his shoulders and take a chance. He chose one of the doors and walked through. He was amazed as he stepped outside and saw the sun just starting to dip below the horizon. He laughed as the realization hit him that he had found the answer to his question.

He waved goodbye to the sun and walked back home with a smile on his face. Bob was happy that he had taken a chance and now knew the answer to

Once upon a time, there was an old man. He lived in a small house near a river.

One day, the old man had an urge. He wanted to explore the river. So, he took a walking stick and headed towards the river.

As he got closer to the water he noticed something strange. He saw that the river was flowing in a different direction to usual.
He decided to follow the river to see where it went.

The old man followed the river until it lead him to a large lake. He was amazed. He had never seen such a big lake before. He looked around and noticed a point in the middle of the lake. From there he could see the whole lake. The old man was amazed.

He then had an urge to explore even further. So, he decided to take a boat out and explore the lake. He ended up having a wonderful adventure and he was never the same after that.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy that was very difficult to play with. He wanted to let his friends play with the toy, but he could not find a way to make it work yet.

One sunny day, Tim and his friends went to the park. Tim brought his difficult toy with him. He thought that maybe his friends could help him figure out how to play with it. Tim let his friends try, but they could not make it work yet.

As they played in the park, a big wind came and blew the difficult toy away. Tim and his friends tried to catch it, but it was too fast. The toy was lost and they could not find it. Tim was sad that he could not play with his toy, and his friends were sad too.

Once upon a time there was a butterfly. He was so pretty and perfect that everyone loved him.

The butterfly wanted to find a new home, so he started to look. He saw lots of places, but none seemed quite right.

Then, he saw a perfect spot underneath a microscope. "Yes!" he said. "This is it!"

He flew underneath the microscope and started to settle down. But then, he relalized that he was stuck! No matter how much he fluttered and tried to move, he could not yield.

The butterfly was so sad. He stayed underneath the microscope forever, trapped and alone.

Mia likes to look at the stars at night. She has a big book with pictures of stars and planets. She learns their names and shapes. One night, she sees a bright light in the sky. It is a comet. A comet is a star with a long tail. Mia is very happy. She runs to tell her mom and dad.

Mom and dad are in the kitchen. They are making a cake. It is Mia's birthday tomorrow. They want to surprise her with a special cake. They have candles, sprinkles, and frosting. They are making an original cake. An original cake is a cake that no one else has. Mia loves original things. She likes to draw, sing, and make stories.

Mia tells mom and dad about the comet. They are happy too. They say the comet is a special gift for Mia. They say the comet is delivering a wish for her. Delivering means bringing something to someone. Mia thinks hard. What does she wish for? She wishes for a happy birthday with her family and friends. She wishes for a fun party with games and balloons. She wishes for a slice of the original cake.

Mom and dad hug Mia. They say they love her very much. They say they are proud of her. They say she is original too. Mia smiles. She feels warm and cozy. She thanks the comet for delivering her wish. She hopes the comet will come back again. She says good night to the comet and the stars. She goes to bed and dreams of her birthday.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Lisa who was very tired. She had been playing all day and her parents thought it was time to rest. 

It was Sunday and her family went to church. Lisa loved going to church and seeing all the things that were happening there. 

When they arrived, they saw an old man who invited them to come to his house for dinner. Lisa was so excited and couldn't wait to go. 

When they arrived at the man's house, they had a wonderful dinner together. After dinner, they all sang together and it was the best time ever. 

At the end of the evening, Lisa was so tired but she was so happy. She thanked the old man for inviting them and went home dreaming of her wonderful day.

Ben and Lily liked to go to the park with their mom. They saw many things in the park: trees, flowers, birds, dogs, and people. Sometimes they saw a vendor who sold ice cream. The vendor had a big cart with many colors and flavors of ice cream.

One day, Ben and Lily wanted to buy ice cream from the vendor. They ran to the cart and looked at the choices. Ben wanted chocolate ice cream and Lily wanted strawberry ice cream. They asked their mom for money and gave it to the vendor. The vendor smiled and scooped some ice cream for them.

But then, something bad happened. The vendor's scoop was too big and he put too much ice cream on the cones. The ice cream was enormous and heavy. It was bigger than Ben and Lily's heads. The vendor tried to give the cones to Ben and Lily, but they could not hold them. The ice cream fell off the cones and splashed on the ground.

Ben and Lily were sad and surprised. They wanted to eat their ice cream, but it was gone. The vendor was sorry and embarrassed. He said he was sorry and he would give them new ice cream. He said he would separate the ice cream into smaller scoops. He said he would be more careful.

Ben and Lily nodded and smiled. They were not angry at the vendor. They knew it was an accident. They waited for their new ice cream. The vendor gave them smaller scoops of chocolate and strawberry ice cream. They thanked the vendor and licked their ice cream. It was delicious and cold. They were happy and enjoyed their ice cream in the park.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous poppy. The poppy was so big that it went into the sky. Every day, it changed colours. Sometimes it was red, and sometimes it was yellow.

One day, a very special bird flew down to the poppy. It was a big, green parrot. It wanted to make the poppy even more special. It said, "Let's change the poppy together!"

The bird started flapping its wings. And the poppy started flying around in a circle. It was the most beautiful thing ever. Suddenly the poppy went higher and higher and went off into the sky.

The bird and the poppy were never seen again. But the people in the town still talk about the wonderful poppy and the brave parrot who flew so very high.

Once upon a time, there was a family with a long history. The family had many members, including a mom, a dad, a grandma, and a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily asked her mom, "What does it mean to marry?" Her mom explained that it's when two people love each other very much and decide to be together forever.

Lily thought about this and said, "I want to marry my best friend Tommy when we grow up." Her mom smiled and said, "That's very sweet, Lily. But remember, family is important too. When you marry someone, you become a part of their family too."

Years went by and Lily grew up to be a beautiful woman. She fell in love with Tommy and they decided to get married. On their wedding day, Lily's mom gave her a special necklace that had been passed down in the family for generations. She said, "This necklace represents the love and commitment of our family. Wear it always and remember that family comes first."

Lily and Tommy lived happily ever after, but they never forgot the importance of family. They started their own family and passed down the necklace to their children, telling them the story of how it symbolized the long history and love of their family. The moral of the story is that love is important, but family is forever.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play in the park. Today, they have a new game. They want to disappear.

"Look, I have a cap," Tom says. He shows Mia a big red cap. "If I put it on, you can't see me."

"Really?" Mia asks. She wants to try.

Tom puts the cap on his head. He bends down and hides behind a bush. "Can you see me?" he calls.

Mia looks around. She can't see Tom. She only sees the bush and the cap. "No, I can't see you," she says. "You disappeared!"

Tom laughs. He jumps out of the bush. "I'm here!" he says. He takes off the cap. "Now you try."

Mia puts the cap on her head. She runs to a tree and hides behind it. "Can you see me?" she calls.

Tom looks around. He can't see Mia. He only sees the tree and the cap. "No, I can't see you," he says. "You disappeared!"

Mia giggles. She comes out of the tree. "I'm here!" she says. She takes off the cap. "This is a fun game."

Tom and Mia are happy. They are ready to play more. They take turns to disappear with the cap. They have a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was frightened. She had never been inside a palace before, and she was scared! 

On a bright Saturday morning, the little girl's mom brought her to the palace. When she arrived, she was amazed! Everything looked so beautiful and sparkly. 

The little girl went inside the palace and saw a big bowl. Inside the bowl, were two different kinds of yummy treats. The little girl decided to mix the treats together. She was so excited! 

Once she had mixed the treats together, the little girl took a big bite and it was delicious! 

The little girl was no longer frightened. She had a great time at the palace and learned that trying new things can be fun!

Once upon a time, there was a thin pumpkin. It was so thin that it could barely stand.

One day, a little girl saw the pumpkin and said to it, "Hello, thin pumpkin!"
The pumpkin didn't reply, so the little girl decided to look inside.

When she looked inside the pumpkin, she gasped with surprise. Inside the pumpkin was a tiny little bird!

The little girl said to the bird, "Hello, tiny bird. What are you doing inside this pumpkin?"

The little bird replied, "I got stuck in here! Please help me get out!"

So the little girl carefully lifted the bird out of the pumpkin. Then she said, " farewell tiny bird!"

The little bird thanked the girl and then flew away. The little girl watched it go, feeling very proud of herself.

Once upon a time there was a group of chubby puppies. They were playing in the garden when one of them noticed something strange.

The puppy said "Wow! This flower is shrinking!"

The rest of the group came over to see and sure enough, the flower was getting smaller and smaller.

The puppies started to get scared. What could be causing the flower to shrink? 

Suddenly, a wizard came out of the bushes and said "I'm using my shrinking potion. When I splash it on things, they shrink!"

The puppies were relieved and they started to laugh. They all thought the wizard was funny.

The wizard said "I'm glad you find it funny. Now, if you promise not to touch my potion again, I'll give you each a treat!"

The puppies cheered and promised. The wizard splashed his potion on the flower and it was back to its original size. Everyone was happy and the wizard gave each puppy a chubby treat for looking after the flower.

Once there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They liked to play with chalk every day, drawing on the sidewalk. But one day they got too close to each other and started to fight! They argued and shouted until their voices filled the air.

Jack and Jill both wanted the silliest chalk. They started to push and shove each other and then suddenly each grabbed a piece of chalk and started running. They ran and ran until finally they stopped, out of breath and out of chalk.

At that moment, a reliable old man walked by and said, "It's not nice to fight, friends." He wanted to help them, so he gave them both a piece of chalk and said, "Let's all draw something beautiful together!"

And that's what they did. Jack and Jill drew a happy rainbow with their new chalk and were very proud of their creation. They hugged each other and happily said goodbye, knowing that they could always count on each other for fun, laughter, and chalk.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was only three years old and very curious about the world. One day, she decided to take a walk in the nearby park.

As she was walking, she saw something mysterious. It was a scarf in the shape of a circle, but colored all sorts of bright colors. She walked closer to it and picked it up.

"Mommy, look what I found!" Lucy shouted.

Mommy smiled and said, "That looks very nice! What number do you want to put on it so you can remember it?"

Lucy thought for a moment before proudly saying, "Seven! I want to remember this scarf forever."

And so Lucy took the mysterious number seven scarf with her everywhere she went.

One day, a pale bunny named Bob hopped in the grass. He saw a big carrot stuck in the ground. Bob wanted to eat the carrot, but he could not pull it out by himself. He looked around and saw a friendly bird named Lily.

"Hi, Lily! Can you help me pull this carrot?" asked Bob.

"Sure, Bob! Let's pull it together," said Lily.

They both pulled the carrot. With a little help, the carrot came out of the ground. Bob and Lily were very happy. They shared the big carrot and ate it together. From that day on, they became best friends who helped each other.

John was outside playing in the garden when he heard something. He looked around and saw a pick! It was red and shiny and looked very fun. He walked over and picked it up.

John held the pick in his hand and started running around the garden. He was so happy with his new toy! Everywhere he went he made lots of noise with the pick.

John ran and ran, but then he heard something else. He stopped and looked around but he didn't see anything. He started walking, listening carefully. He heard it again and peered behind a bush. He saw a little cat there!

John smiled and said hello. The cat got up and started rubbing against John's legs. He was so happy to finally have a friend to play with! 

John and the cat played in the garden all afternoon. He made the pick noisy by clapping it against the leaves, while the little cat purred and jumped around. They were having so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a brave soldier named Jack. He wore a shiny hat and a big coat. He looked very attractive to all the people who saw him. One day, Jack's friend dared him to climb a tall tree. Jack was scared, but he didn't want to look like a chicken, so he climbed the tree. When he got to the top, he saw a beautiful bird. He was so happy he dared to catch it. But the bird flew away and Jack fell down!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly plane. It was flying high in the sky, almost to the clouds. The plane was looking for something, but it wasn't quite sure what.

But then it saw something down below. It flew lower to get a better look. Suddenly, it spotted something that it wanted to reach. It was so exciting! 

The plane swooped down and soon it was close enough to touch. The plane reached out with its wings and grabbed the shiny thing. It was a ball that sparkled in the sun. 

The friendly plane and the ball had so much fun together. They flew around and around, laughing and playing. The plane twirled and the ball glittered in the light. 

Their fun lasted until the plane had to go back up to the clouds. The plane waved goodbye to the ball, and together they wished each other a nice day.

Once upon a time there was a very old man. He was so old he needed a cane to walk. Every day he went to the same spot and offered his cane to anyone who needed it. 

One day, a young boy asked him if he could use the cane. The old man happily offered it to the boy and he started to walk away. But suddenly, a terrible sound filled the air. It was so loud that everyone was scared. 

The old man was very sad. He rushed over to the boy and saw that he had stepped on something terrible. He couldn't understand why the boy had stepped on it and tears filled his eyes. He realized that his cane would never be the same again. 

The old man sadly told the boy to give him back the cane. The boy looked sad too and gave it back. After that, the old man put his cane away and never offered it to anyone else.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree in a forest. It was the biggest tree in all the land. In its branches lived a bird.

One day, the bird was singing an especially beautiful song. All of the animals in the forest came to listen. When the bird finished its song, a rabbit hopped up to it.

"That was an amazing poem!" said the rabbit. "Please can I hang it up so that everyone can see it?"

The bird smiled. "Of course!" it said.

So the bird quickly wrote down the words on a big piece of paper. The rabbit then hung it up for everyone to see.

The animals all admired the poem and the bird was very proud. The bird always sang its beautiful song, but now everyone could see its poem too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Linda. Linda was 3 years old and loved to explore the world. One day, Linda walked into the forest and found a smelly skull. She was very excited. She tried to twist the skull with her hands, but she couldn't move it.

Suddenly, Linda heard a voice on the other side of the skull. It said, "Can you help me, little girl? I'm stuck inside the skull. Can you twist it open?"

Linda was so surprised. She was a brave girl and so she decided to try and twist the skull open. With all her might, she wiggled her hands and the skull twisted open.

On the other side, Linda found a small fox. It had been stuck inside the skull for a very long time. "Thank you, little girl," said the fox. "You saved my life." Linda smiled and watched the fox run back into the woods.

She had done something amazing! She had used her strength to twist open a smelly skull and save a fox's life.

One day, a little yellow fish named Finn swam in the sea. The sun was warm and the water was cool. Finn liked to play in the tide with his friends.

Finn saw his friend, Sally the seahorse, and said, "Hi Sally! Do you want to play in the tide with me?" Sally smiled and said, "Yes, Finn! Let's play!"

As they played, the water started to get very cold. Finn and Sally felt the water freeze around them. They were scared and didn't know what to do. But then, the warm sun came out and the water became warm again.

Finn and Sally were happy and continued to play in the tide. They had a fun day and promised to play together again soon.

Bunny was a famous hopper. He could hop very high and very far. He liked to hop all over the forest and show off his skills. He made many friends with the other animals, who cheered for him and gave him carrots.

One day, Bunny saw a hut in a clearing. He had never seen a hut before. He was curious and wanted to hop inside. He hopped closer and closer, until he reached the door. He knocked with his paw, but no one answered. He pushed the door and it opened.

Bunny hopped inside the hut. It was dark and dusty. He saw a big bed, a table, a chair, and a cupboard. He also saw a basket full of food. He smelled honey and bread and cheese. He was hungry and wanted to taste them.

He hopped to the basket and took a bite of the cheese. It was yummy. He took another bite, and another. He did not hear the footsteps outside. He did not see the shadow on the wall. He did not notice the big bad wolf who lived in the hut.

The wolf came in and saw Bunny eating his cheese. He was angry and hungry. He roared and showed his teeth. He wanted to eat Bunny for his lunch. Bunny was scared and sorry. He dropped the cheese and tried to hop away. But the wolf was faster and blocked the door.

Bunny was trapped. He wished he had not hopped inside the hut. He wished he had stayed with his friends in the forest. He wished he had listened to his mother, who told him not to go near the hut. He closed his eyes and waited for the end.

But then, he heard a loud noise. He opened his eyes and saw a big axe. It smashed the door and made a hole. He saw a man with a beard and a hat. He was a woodcutter, who worked in the forest. He saw the wolf and the bunny. He was brave and strong. He swung his axe and hit the wolf. The wolf howled and ran away.

Bunny was saved. He was happy and grateful. He thanked the woodcutter, who smiled and patted his head. He gave him some honey and bread and told him to go back to his friends. He warned him not to hop inside strange huts again. He said goodbye and left.

Bunny hopped out of the hut. He felt lucky and learned a lesson. He decided to be more careful and not to be too curious. He hopped back to the forest and found his friends. He told them what happened and they hugged him and gave him carrots. He was still a famous hopper, but he was also a wiser bunny.

One day, there was a wet pilot. He had an important job. He had to write something. So he grabbed his paper and pencil and started to write. He wrote for hours and hours until morning came. In the morning, he was so happy because he had finished writing. He had written an important message for everyone. From then on, people everywhere called him "The Writin' Pilot".

Once upon a time there were two friends, Sam and Lucy. Sam had an ugly oven. One day Sam asked Lucy if she knew how to make the oven look better. 

"No I don't," Lucy answered. 

Sam thought for a while, and then he had an idea. He went to get some colourful paints and decorated the oven. Lucy thought it looked lovely. 

Sam then asked Lucy if it worked. 

"Yes," she answered, "but you can't put your hand in the oven to find out - it's still too hot!" 

Both of them laughed and went off to play a game. The ugly oven was forgotten.

Once there was a little boy who was very excited. Today he was going on a special trip. He asked his mom if he could bring his favorite toy. She said yes and gave him a ticket to get on the train. 

The train ride was long and smelly, but the little boy was so excited. As they approached the end, he kept asking when they were going to arrive. 

Eventually the train stopped and the little boy was the first to jump off. He was so excited to be there that he jumped up and down, waving his ticket in the air. 

They spent the day having fun, but the little boy didn't want to leave. He asked his mom if they could stay a bit longer, but she said it was time to go home. 

The little boy was sad, but he couldn't wait to share his adventure with his friends. He picked up his toy and got on the train again, this time with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very happy. She loved to play and talk with her friends.

One day, her mom and dad told her they were going to the playground. The girl was so excited. She put on her shoes and ran outside.

At the playground, she saw a big slide. She ran to it and slid down. Then she ran back up the slide. She laughed and shouted as she slid again.

Suddenly, she saw something shiny. It was very expensive. Her mom said it was for her. She was so excited that she could not stop talking about it. She told all of her friends about it. 

Everyone was so happy for the little girl. They all agreed that the expensive present was the best present ever.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a huge door. One day, a little girl came to the house and knocked on the door. The door slowly opened and the little girl went inside. She saw a big fireplace with an enormous flame. The little girl was scared, but then she saw a nice lady who told her not to be afraid. The lady gave the little girl a cookie and they sat by the fire and talked. The little girl was happy and no longer scared of the enormous flame.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a good boy who liked to run and play with his friends. One day, Tim and his friends were in a race. The winner of the race would get a medal.

Tim ran very fast and won the race. He was so happy to get the medal. He wore it all day and showed it to everyone. But the sun was very hot, and it made the medal hot too. Tim did not know the medal could burn him.

When Tim felt the hot medal on his neck, he was uncomfortable. He took off the medal and showed his mom. His mom put a cool cloth on his neck and told him to be careful. Tim learned a lesson and now he knows to be careful with hot things.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved trains and wanted to ride on one. His mommy said she would provide him with a train ride on his birthday.

On the day of his birthday, Timmy was so excited to ride the train. But when he saw the big train, he got scared. He said, "Mommy, the train is too scary. I don't want to ride it anymore."

His mommy hugged him and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. The train is not scary. It will take us on a fun adventure and we will see lots of things." Timmy trusted his mommy and got on the train.

As the train started to move, Timmy's fear turned into excitement. He saw trees, animals, and even a big mountain. He said, "Mommy, this train ride is so much fun! Thank you for providing it for me."

Once upon a time there were two friends, Larry and Sue. They went to the park together one day. When they got there, they saw a big band playing some music. It was very loud and they could see the people dancing. Larry and Sue stopped to observe. The music sounded like jazz and it made Larry and Sue laugh. The dancers looked silly and Larry and Sue couldn't believe their eyes! They hopped around the park, enjoying the music and watching the silly people. Later on when they left, Larry and Sue said that it was the most fun they ever had.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was curious and wanted to explore the world around him. Every day he would look for something new to discover.

One day he went on a walk and found something strange. He discovered a large pile of waste! He was sad to see so much stuff thrown away.

The little boy decided to do something. He had an idea; maybe he could help clean up the waste.

He asked his friends if they wanted to help and they said yes! Together they worked and cleaned up the waste. They took turns carrying the stupid things away until it was all gone.

The little boy was proud of himself. He felt good knowing that he had made a difference. He had discovered a way to help the world and make it a better place.

Once there was a girl called Jenny. She was always bored, so one day she started looking for something to do. She was walking in the park when she saw some news on the ground. It was gray and old, but it looked very interesting.

Jenny picked up the news and started to look around. Suddenly she saw a big tree with a big door in it. Jenny was excited, so she opened the door and saw a magic world. She could see lots of colorful animals, funny people, and wonderful things to explore.

Jenny started to explore the magical world. She made new friends and saw amazing things. She was so happy to be in the new world!

Jenny stayed in the magical world for a few weeks, until one day the news she had found in the park had disappeared. Jenny felt sad and went back home, but she never forgot what had happened in the magical world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was very hungry and she didn't know what to do. She asked her mom if she could borrow some food from the kitchen. 

Mom said yes, so Sally went to the kitchen to get the food. When she got there, she saw a big mouse! It scared her and she almost ran away. But then the mouse smiled and said, "Hi Sally! Would you like some food?"

Sally was still a little scared but she said yes. The mouse called a few of its friends and they gave Sally food to eat. She thanked them and said goodbye, before running back to her mom. 

Sally was very happy she got to borrow the food. She ran to her room, ate the food, and fell asleep with a big smile on her face. 

The End.

Once there was a little man who wanted to make something special. He found a brown box with a model in it. He wanted to try and make it look even better. So he grabbed some crayons and paper and tried to draw a better model. He worked and worked, and after lots of trying, he made a new model that was even more detailed and special. He was very proud of what he had made. He showed it to his friends who were amazed at how much better it was than the original model. Everyone was impressed with how he managed to try and make something so great!

Once upon a time, there was a sad little girl named Jane. She had no one to play with and she was very lonely.

One day, Jane found a small shelf on the floor. She picked it up and looked inside. To her amazement, she saw a small talking teddy bear.

The bear said, "Hi! My name is Henry. Do you want to be friends?" Jane was so excited! She quietly answered "Yes!" 

Henry asked, "Do you want to go on an adventure?" Jane smiled and answered "Yes, let's go".

Together, they went on the most amazing adventures. Jane was never so happy and never felt so sad again.

Once there were two little girls, one named Elle and one was named Amy. Elle was older and helped Amy learn new things. On this day, Elle was studying for her test. She studied hard, looking at her books and notes. 

Amy watched Elle, wanting to help. She ran to the kitchen and found some pasta. She came back and put it on the table near Elle. 

"What's this?" asked Elle, confused.

Amy smiled and said, "it's pasta, to help you study".

"Oh!" said Elle, surprised. "Well, thank you very much!"

She grabbed the pasta and ate it. It was so tight and delicious. Elle kept studying and between bites, she remembered what she had to learn. Amy was happy that she could help.

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Jin and Ken. They were playing together in the field. Suddenly, Jin saw a pool. He pointed to it and shouted, "Look, Ken! A pool!"

Ken ran to the pool and looked inside. He said, "It's empty. What shall we do with it?"

Jin thought and then he said, "I know! Let's show our friends the empty pool!"

So the two friends ran to their friends' house. They showed them the empty pool. The friends were not impressed.

At this, Jin and Ken had a conflict. Jin said, "Let's fill the pool!"
Ken said, "Nope, I think it will be too much trouble."

In the end, Jin and Ken decided to forget about the empty pool and play in the field again. They had lots of fun together and eventually forgot all about the empty pool.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Danny. He loved to explore outside and was always curious about the world around him. 

One day when Danny was playing in the garden, he heard a strange noise coming from behind the bushes. He walked over and peeked through the leaves. He saw a hanger on the ground, with a strange blue light shining from it. It made Danny feel very curious and he decided to take a closer look. 

The hanger felt very cold in Danny's little hands, but he didn't let go. Suddenly the hanger began to shake, and the blue light grew brighter and brighter. "Oh, this is so interesting!" Danny said excitedly.

Just then, a voice came from the hanger. "Danny, don't be afraid. Freeze!" it said. Danny froze in place. He watched with wide eyes as the hanger rose up into the air and flew away in a big blue circle. Danny never saw the hanger again, but he always remembered it as the most interesting thing he had ever seen!

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big dog. The dog has brown fur and a long tail. The dog runs to them and wags his tail.

"Hello, dog!" Lily says. "You are nice. Can I pet you?"

The dog licks Lily's face. He likes her. Lily feels his fur. His fur is soft and warm.

"Me too, me too!" Tom says. He wants to pet the dog too. He reaches his hand to the dog.

But the dog barks at Tom. He does not like him. Tom feels scared. He pulls his hand back.

"Why does he bark at me?" Tom asks. "I am nice too."

Lily shrugs. She does not know. She keeps petting the dog.

"Maybe he does not know you," she says. "Maybe you have to be gentle and slow."

Tom nods. He tries again. He speaks softly to the dog. He moves his hand slowly to the dog. The dog sniffs his hand. He does not bark. He lets Tom pet him.

Tom feels his fur. His fur is soft and warm too.

"See, he likes you now," Lily says. "He is a nice dog."

The dog wags his tail. He likes them both. He is a happy dog.

Lily and Tom smile. They are happy too. They have a new friend. They play with the dog in the park. They have fun.

Once upon a time there was a perfect little girl called Lucy. She was so clever, she could name all the colours of a rainbow. One day while she was playing in her backyard, a sneaky thief came along. Lucy saw him and shouted "Hey thief! Don't take my toys".

The thief replied "Dear little girl, I need to wash my hands. So I need some water". Poor Lucy felt sorry for the thief and said "Ok, let me help you wash your hands".

Lucy ran to the kitchen, filled a bowl with warm water, and brought it to the thief. She carefully put in a nice soap and said "Here, now you can wash your hands". The thief smiled and said "Thank you little one! That was perfect". He washed his hands and quickly ran away. 

Lucy was very happy that she had been so helpful, and she knew she had done the perfect thing.

One day, a little girl named Red went to visit her grandma in the woods. She wore a red cape that her grandma made for her. She loved her grandma very much and wanted to give her a basket of cookies and milk.

On the way, she met a big, bad wolf. The wolf was hungry and wanted to eat Red. He said, "Hello, little girl. Where are you going?"

Red said, "I'm going to see my grandma. She lives in a house over there."

The wolf thought, "I can trick her and eat her and her grandma. What a delicious meal!" He said, "Why don't you pick some flowers for your grandma? She will like them very much. I'll go ahead and see if she needs any help."

Red thought, "That's very nice of him. Maybe he's not so bad after all." She said, "OK, thank you, Mr. Wolf. I'll be there soon."

The wolf ran to the grandma's house and knocked on the door. Grandma opened it and saw the wolf. She was scared and screamed, "Help! Help! A wolf!"

The wolf pushed her inside and locked the door. He put on her clothes and glasses and got into her bed. He waited for Red to come.

Red picked some flowers and walked to the house. She knocked on the door and said, "Grandma, it's me, Red. I brought you some cookies and milk."

The wolf said, "Come in, my dear. I'm in the bedroom."

Red opened the door and went to the bedroom. She saw the wolf in the bed and said, "Grandma, what big ears you have!"

The wolf said, "The better to hear you with, my dear."

Red said, "Grandma, what big eyes you have!"

The wolf said, "The better to see you with, my dear."

Red said, "Grandma, what big teeth you have!"

The wolf said, "The better to eat you with, my dear!" And he jumped out of the bed and tried to catch Red.

Red was scared and ran away. She screamed, "Help! Help! A wolf!"

A hunter heard her and came to the house. He saw the wolf and shot him with his gun. The wolf fell down and died.

Red hugged the hunter and said, "Thank you, thank you, you saved me and my grandma!"

The hunter said, "You're welcome, little girl. But you should be careful in the woods. There are many bad wolves out there."

Red said, "I know, I know. I was silly to trust him. He was disgusting and mean. I'll never talk to strangers again."

The hunter helped Red and her grandma out of the house. They ate the cookies and milk and thanked the hunter again. Red gave her grandma the flowers and said, "I love you, grandma."

Grandma said, "I love you too, Red. And I love your red cape. It's very pretty."

They hugged and kissed and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was just 3 years old. One day she was playing in the garden when she scraped her knee. It hurt so much that she started to cry.

Mummy rushed outside and saw her. She put a dry bandage on Lucy's knee and it made it feel better. But then Mummy said to Lucy, "Now you must hide the bandage so that the doctor can't see it and make you wear a new one!" 

So, Lucy went and hid the bandage in her toy box. But she couldn't remember exactly where she had put it. After a few days of searching, Lucy finally found the dry bandage! Lucy and Mummy laughed, and Lucy put the bandage in a special safe place so she wouldn't forget it again.

Emma was a 3 year old with a bright imagination. She loved to design things and one day she thought of something new. She decided she would design a bucket.

She went out to the garden in search of materials. She found some colourful stones, delicate twigs and some leaves. After she had gathered them, she went back to her room to see what she could do.

Lily and Max were bored. They had nothing to do. Mom was busy with the laundry. She said they could not go outside until she was done.

Once upon a time there lived a little rabbit called Buffy. He was not like other bunnies - he was very brave and helpful. He loved to explore the world around him.

Suddenly, he heard a comforting voice.

"It's ok, Buffy," the voice said. "The missile will not hurt you. It is only a harmless toy."

That's when Buffy noticed an old rabbit standing next to him. The old rabbit kindly explained that the missile was actually a toy and that it was meant to bring joy and laughter.

Buffy learned an important lesson from his experience: being helpful and brave can help you find happiness.

Mia liked to make cards for her friends. She used paper, glue, scissors and stickers. She made a card for Lily, her best friend. The card was attractive. It had a big heart, a rainbow and a star. Mia wrote "I love you, Lily" inside.

Lily and Emma did not understand why Mia did that. They looked at the pieces of the card and saw the heart, the rainbow and the star. They saw the words "I love you, Lily". They felt sorry for Mia, but they did not know how to make her feel better. They went back to playing with their dolls. Mia was alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to look at the stars in the sky every night. One day, she asked her mom, "Can we bring a star down from the sky?"

Once upon a time, there was a big boat called a yacht. It was very pretty and had lots of colors. One day, the boat went out to sea and the wind started to blow. Once upon a time there was a white bird who loved peaches. Every day it would fly high in the sky and soar. One day, it was looking for its favorite snack when it saw something strange in a tree. It flew closer to take a look and saw a huge white peach! The bird couldn't believe its eyes.

The bird kept the peach safe in its nest and shared some with its friends. Everyone said it was the best peach they had ever tasted! Every day from then on, the bird kept searching for more white peaches. It soared through the sky looking for the perfect snack.

Once upon a time there was a lake that everyone enjoyed visiting because it had such a beautiful view. Every day the lake attracted more visitors, until one day a boy named Jack came to visit. He brought a can of paint with him and he started spraying it along the lake's edge, creating a big circle. Everyone who saw it was very impressed!

The next day Jack came back and he sprayed a much bigger circle using up all of his paint. Eventually the whole lake was surrounded by a colorful pattern of circles. 

The people who had been visiting the lake every day started to argue and they were mad at Jack. They were mad because they thought the circles were spoiling the view and taking away from the beauty of the lake.

Jack realized that they were right and he felt bad. He apologized to the people and told them he had learned his lesson: sometimes it's better to think before you act. 

The people accepted his apology, but they made sure he could never do it again and they made a rule: whenever someone visits the lake, they must not spray paint near the lake. From that day forward, everyone respected the rule and the lake was able to stay as impressive as ever.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old and she loved going to the park.

Once upon a time, there was a proud wolf. Every day he ran in the woods, searching for something interesting. One day, he suddenly arrived at a clearing. Once upon a time, there was a girl and a boy who were best friends. Every day they would play together and have lots of fun.

Lily wanted to mail a picture to her grandma. She drew a big heart and wrote "I love you" with her crayons. She asked her mom for an envelope and a stamp. Her mom helped her put the picture inside and write the address.

"Can we go to the mailbox now?" Lily asked.

"Yes, let's go," her mom said. They put on their coats and shoes and walked to the mailbox. Lily was very happy.

But on the way, Lily saw a juice stand. She loved juice. She wanted to buy some. She asked her mom for some money.

"Sorry, honey, I don't have any money with me. We can have some juice when we get home," her mom said.

Lily was very sad. She wanted juice now. She saw a coin on the ground. She picked it up. She thought maybe she could use it to buy juice. She ran to the juice stand and gave the coin to the man.

"Thank you," the man said. He gave her a cup of juice.

Lily drank the juice. It was very good. She felt better.

But then she remembered her picture. She looked at her hand. She had dropped the envelope. She didn't have it anymore. She felt very bad. She had lost her picture for grandma.

She ran back to her mom. She was crying.

"Mom, I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I lost the picture, I lost the envelope, I found a coin and I bought juice and I dropped it and I'm sorry, I'm sorry," she sobbed.

Her mom hugged her. She was not angry. She was sad too.

"It's okay, Lily, it's okay. I know you didn't mean to. You made a mistake. You were tempted by the juice. But you shouldn't have taken the coin. That was not yours. You should have asked the man if he lost it. You should have been honest. Do you understand?" her mom said.

Lily nodded. She understood. She felt ashamed. She had done something wrong.

"I'm sorry, mom. I'm sorry, grandma. I love you. Can I make another picture?" she asked.

"Of course, you can, Lily. And we can mail it tomorrow. And we can also return the coin to the man. And we can say sorry to him too. And we can learn from this. And we can still have some juice at home. Okay?" her mom said.

"Okay, mom. Thank you, mom. You are the best mom," Lily said.

They hugged again. They walked home. They made another picture. They returned the coin. They said sorry. They had some juice. They mailed the picture. They felt better. They loved each other. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a fearful leather. It was scared of the dark and the loud noises outside. Every night it would lie down alone in its dark corner, waiting for morning to arrive.
