One day, Lily and Tom went to the park with their mom. They saw many flowers, birds and bugs. Lily liked to gather flowers and make a crown. Tom liked to gather bugs and put them in a jar.

"Look, mom, I found a beetle!" Tom said, showing his jar. "It is big and shiny and has spots."

Mom smiled and said, "That is a nice beetle, Tom. But do you think the beetle is happy in the jar?"

Tom thought for a moment. He looked at the beetle, who was crawling and tapping on the glass. He said, "No, I think the beetle is sad. He wants to be free and play with his friends."

Mom nodded and said, "That is right, Tom. Bugs are living things, just like us. They have feelings and needs. They like to explore and have fun. How would you feel if someone put you in a jar?"

Tom said, "I would feel scared and lonely and bored. I would not like that at all."

Mom said, "Then you should let the beetle go, Tom. He will be happier in his home, and you can still watch him from a distance. Maybe you can find another way to enjoy bugs, like drawing them or reading about them."

Tom agreed and opened the jar. He gently placed the beetle on a leaf and said, "Bye, beetle. I am sorry I made you sad. You are adorable and I hope you have a good day."

The beetle waved his antennae and scurried away. Tom felt happy and proud. He learned to respect and care for bugs. He gathered his crayons and paper and started to draw the beetle and his friends. Lily joined him and they had fun together. Mom hugged them and said, "I am proud of you, Tom and Lily. You are kind and curious and creative. You make the world a better place."

Lucy was very competitive. She wanted to be the best at everything she did. So when the bell rang to start the race, she was determined to win.

Lucy ran as fast as she could. She had her head down the whole way and she didn't see anything around her. But when she got to the end, she was surprised!

There was something very strange on the finish line. It was a hanger! All the other racers had stopped and were looking at it.

Lucy was confused. She had never seen a hanger at the end of a race before. She was so curious, she walked over to it.

As she got closer, she saw that the hanger was very special. It had a golden ring on it. The ring sparkled in the sun and it looked very shiny and beautiful. 

Lucy knew that she had won the race! She had never won anything before, and it felt great! She was so excited that she couldn't help but smile. From that day on, she was even more competitive and determined to be the best at everything she did.

Once upon a time, two friends named Mia and Tom went outside to play in their very own clubhouse. It was a big, warm and cozy building with lots of pieces of furniture to share. 

"Wow Mia! Look at our clubhouse," Tom said in amazement. "It looks amazing!"

Mia smiled and nodded, feeling so lucky and spoiled. She had been dreaming of having a clubhouse like that for so long. Then she said, "Let's go inside and share all the fun stuff we have here!"

Tom was so excited and they both ran inside. They decided to share the couch and the toys they found inside the clubhouse. They laughed and had so much fun together. They even shared an ice cream cone!

At the end of the day, the two friends said goodbye and promised to come back to their clubhouse soon for more sharing and fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little birdie named Tweety. Tweety was very curious and loved to explore. One day, Tweety flew far away from home and found herself lost in a big desert. She was very thirsty and tired, but then she saw a beautiful oasis in the distance. 

When Tweety arrived at the oasis, she saw that there were many other animals there too. They were all different from each other, but they were all happy together. Tweety felt very welcomed and happy too. 

After resting and drinking some water, Tweety realized that she had learned an important lesson. She learned that even though everyone is different, they can still be friends and get along. She also learned that it's important to always set out on new adventures, but to never forget where home is. 

From that day on, Tweety always remembered the oasis and the special friends she made there. She also remembered the lesson she learned about being different and getting along. And she lived happily ever after. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing in her yard with her toys. One day, she was running around and accidentally bumped into a rock. It hurt her foot and she started crying.

Her mom came outside and asked, "What happened, Lily? Why are you crying?"

"I bumped into a rock and it hurt my foot," Lily said.

"Let me see," her mom said. She looked at Lily's foot and saw a little red mark. "It's just a little bump. I'll give you a kiss to make it feel better."

Lily smiled and her mom gave her a kiss on her foot. "Thank you, Mommy," Lily said. "You always make me feel better when I get hurt."

"That's what mommies are for," her mom said. "Now, let's go inside and have some cookies."

Willie was walking near the park when he saw a pastel. It was so pretty that he took it and put it in his pocket. He felt a little guilty, but he loved the pretty pastel. As he walked away he heard a voice calling, 

"Willie! Did you steal that pastel?"

Willie didn't know what to do so he kept walking. His heart felt heavy and he felt like he had done something wrong. He knew he should tell the truth, but he didn't want to get in trouble. 

When Willie made it home, he felt a bit better, but he still couldn't shake the guilty feeling. His mom found the pastel in his pocket and knew the answer right away. 

She smiled and told him, "Willie, this pastel belongs to your neighbor, Mrs. Green. We should return it to her and apologize." 

Willie wanted to do the right thing, so he said yes and went to Mrs. Green's house to return the pastel. Mrs. Green welcomed him with a hug and thanked him for bringing it back. 

Willie felt so relieved and grateful that he had learned his lesson. He knew no matter how tempted he was, it was never okay to steal.

The sun was out, and Little Star was so enthusiastic to go outside and play. She had been cooped up in the house all of yesterday. Little Star ran as hard as she could outside and then suddenly she saw it! A great big purple butterfly! It was fluttering around, so beautiful in the sun's warm light. 

"Butterfly!" yelled Little Star. "I'm gonna catch you!" She ran as fast as she could, but the butterfly had a mind of its own, and it flew up high, out of Little Star's reach.

"Please don't go!" yelled Little Star. "Come back!"

But it was too late. The butterfly had vanished. Little Star wanted to cry, but she reminded herself that she would have to find another one.

She jumped up and down with excitement. "Next time I'll do better," she said. She smiled, and started to look around for another butterfly she could catch.

Once there was a brown comet in the sky. It was very big and it sparkled in the night. Everyone said it was so beautiful and they couldn't believe their eyes.

One night, a little girl saw the comet and wanted to learn more about it. She asked her mom and dad to explain the comet to her.

"That's a special kind of star," her mom said. "It's like a shooting star, but it stays in the sky and it's much bigger."

The little girl was fascinated and couldn't wait to see it again. So every night, she'd look up in the sky and see the brown comet. She'd think about the stories her mom had told her and wonder what other stars were like.

It became the little girl's favorite thing to do and it was a way for her to connect with the night sky. Whenever she saw the comet, it made her feel special and she knew that it was a sign that she was being watched over.

Jim had a new friend named Molly. He wanted to play with her every Wednesday. One day, he asked Molly to come over for a play date. She said yes.

When Molly came over, she brought a basket of sour apples. She leaned over to show Jim what she brought. Jim smiled and said, "Yum!" He took one of the sour apples and nibbled on it. Molly looked happy and leaned against the wall.

Jim and Molly spent their Wednesday playing. They even made their own castles out of blocks. Later they ate the sour apples together and eventually, it was time for Molly to go home.

Jim waved goodbye to Molly as she left. He was so happy they had spent their Wednesday together playing with the sour apples. He couldn't wait until the next Wednesday to see her again!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run and play with his friends. One day, he and his friends went to the park to play. They ran around and laughed a lot.

Timmy's mommy told him that he needed to eat healthy food to make his muscles grow big and strong. So, Timmy ate lots of fruits and vegetables.

But sometimes, Timmy could be a little naughty. He would run away from his mommy when she tried to catch him. But when she finally caught him, they would both laugh together.

Once upon a time, there was a yarn who was very anxious. It was the end of the winter and the yarn was looking forward to spring. One winter day the yarn was so anxious that he jumped up to feel the sun on his back. The sun felt warm and the yarn was so happy. He began to bounce around and spring into the sky. The yarn flew all around, smiling with joy as he felt the sun's rays. He could feel that spring was coming soon. Finally, the yarn flew back down to the ground, ready to wait for spring to arrive. 

Suddenly the ground shook and the yarn heard the birds singing. Spring had finally come! The yarn was so excited and he began to spring around in joy. The sky was blue and the fields were full of colorful flowers. The yarn was filled with happiness and the warmth of spring.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey named Max. Max loved to eat bananas. One day, Max found a big banana but it was too big for him to eat. 

Max asked his friend, a rabbit named Rosie, "Can you help me split this banana?" 

Rosie tried to split the banana but it was too persistent. They both tried and tried but the banana wouldn't split. 

Suddenly, Max had an idea. He climbed up a tree and dropped the banana from high up. The banana split into two pieces! Max and Rosie were so happy they could finally eat the banana together.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived an old man and a little boy. The old man was always restless. He liked to walk around the house and laugh. The little boy loved to hear the old man laugh. It made him happy.

One day, the little boy asked the old man, "Why do you laugh so much?" The old man smiled and said, "I laugh because it makes me feel good. When I was a little boy like you, my dad would laugh too. It made me happy, just like it makes you happy now."

The little boy thought about what the old man said. He wanted to make other people happy too. So, he started to laugh just like the old man. They would walk around the house together, laughing and making each other happy. And they lived happily ever after.

It was a warm day, and Tom was walking up the hill. He wanted to get to the top so he could look over the valley. He looked up and saw a big dark cloud in the sky. Tom was worried it was going to rain.

He kept walking and soon he reached the top of the hill. Tom could see the whole valley now. He was so excited!

Suddenly, big drops began to fall from the sky. Tom's Grandma had warned him it might rain. He quickly ran home, but it was already too late. The sky opened up and let out a deluge of rain.

Tom was sad and he felt like his day had been ruined. But then he heard a voice coming from inside the house. It was his Grandma, and she said: "Tom, don't be sad. A warm rain can be wonderful too!" 

Tom smiled, and he knew his Grandma was right. He opened the window and felt the warm rain on his face. It was beautiful!

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong man named Jack. Jack loved to lift heavy things like rocks and logs. One day, Jack found a shiny weapon in the forest. He picked it up and felt very proud.

But Jack's friend, Tom, was jealous of the weapon. Tom wanted it for himself. So, he came up with a plan. He pretended to be Jack's friend and asked to see the weapon. When Jack handed it to him, Tom ran away with it.

Later that day, Jack went to Tom's house to ask for his weapon back. But Tom refused to give it back. Jack was sad and angry. He wished he had never found the weapon. But then, he remembered his strength. He lifted Tom up and shook him until the weapon fell out of his pocket. Jack was happy to have his weapon back and Tom learned that it's not nice to be jealous and take things that don't belong to you.

Once upon a time there was a dog called Spot. Spot was a very fast dog. Every day Spot would run, and run, and run. But when Spot stopped running, he always felt something was missing. He knew he needed something but he just couldn't put his paw on it. 

One morning, Spot was running around his owner's garden. Spot saw a squirrel in the garden and started to chase it. Spot ran so fast that he quickly caught up with the squirrel and the squirrel was too scared to move.

Spot smiled and said,"What do I need?". The squirrel just looked confused.

Just then Spot's owner appeared and laughed. "My clever Spot!" he said. "You need a toy to play with! That's why you sometimes feel like something is missing." He picked up a ball and handed it to Spot. Now Spot was a very happy dog. Every day he would run around with his ball and never feel like something was missing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily went outside to play with her toys. She was having fun until she saw a big dog running towards her. Lily got scared and ran away, leaving her toys behind.

Later that day, Lily's mommy went outside to get the toys. She saw the big dog and got scared too. But then, a man came and rescued her. He scared the dog away and picked up the toys. He gave them back to Lily's mommy and said, "Be careful, that dog is smelly and mean."

Lily's mommy was grateful for the man's help. She thanked him and shook his hand. From that day on, Lily's mommy always made sure to keep an eye out for that smelly dog. She knew that if it ever came back, she could count on the man to rescue her again.

John and his dad were walking down the street. John was only 3 years old, so he was very small. As they were walking they passed a park, which had a big slide. 

John asked his dad: "Can we go to the park, dad?" 

His dad replied: "Maybe, but first I have to turn this corner and make sure everything is OK".

John's dad remained at the corner for quite a while, but then he came back and said with a big smile: "Let's go to the park, John!" John was very happy and ran towards the park very quickly.

Once they got to the park, John climbed up the small slide and said: "This is so much fun, Dad". His dad answered: "Enjoy it, you can go down as many times as you want".

John went down the slide again and again, laughing and having a great time. It was definitely his best day in a while.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, his mom came into his room and said, "Timmy, it's time to clean up your toys. Daddy is coming home soon from his job."

Timmy asked, "What is a job?"

"A job is what Daddy goes to every day to work. He has a job as a dependable mailman. He delivers letters and packages to people's houses," his mom explained.

Timmy said, "I want to have a job too when I grow up."

His mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea. You can be anything you want to be when you grow up. Just remember to work hard and be dependable like Daddy."

Once upon a Wednesday, there was a little girl called Sarah. She was very confused. She was walking in the park when she saw something shiny on the ground. She held it close and thought it was very pretty.

Sarah was very happy and held the shiny thing tight. But then she heard a voice calling her name. It was her mummy! She was very confused as to why her mummy was there. She held out the shiny thing and showed it to mummy.

Mummy was very surprised and explained to Sarah that the shiny thing was a coin. She asked what Sarah was going to do with it. Sarah smiled and told her she was going to hold it until Wednesday.

Mummy smiled and told Sarah it was a good idea. Then she gave Sarah a hug, and they went home together. From then on, Sarah held on to the coin every Wednesday in case she ever got lost or confused again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to hug her teddy bear, but one day she got very sick. Her mommy and daddy took her to the hospital to see the doctor.

The doctor gave her some medicine to prevent her from getting sicker. Lily was very brave and took her medicine like a big girl. After a few days, she started feeling better and asked her mommy and daddy for a hug.

Her mommy gave her a big hug and said, "I'm so glad you're feeling better!" Lily smiled and said, "Me too! I love hugs!" Her daddy said, "We have something special for you, Lily. It's a modern teddy bear that can sing and dance!"

Lily was so happy and hugged her new teddy bear tightly. She said, "Thank you, mommy and daddy. I love my new modern teddy bear!"

Joe gazed around his room. Everywhere he looked he could see his favourite things. He found all sorts of cool things to look at, like his model rocket, his toys, and his collection of books. But there was something extra special that caught Joe's eye. There, right besides the window was a big, pretty, shiny video!

Joe was so excited to see the video that he ran over to it and touched it. He pushed the buttons, trying to figure out how it worked. Suddenly, the video came to life with pictures and music. He giggled with delight and was mesmerised by the beautiful colours.

Joe continued to gaze at the video, captivated by the strange, yet wonderful moving images. He watched as animals danced, cars chased each other, and people sang. Joe was in awe of the pretty video. He stayed in front of it for hours, watching, listening and smiling.

Once upon a time, there was a dog. It was white, had big brown eyes and a long, wagging tail. Every day, the dog would run around the yard and chase its tail until it was tired.

One day, its owners loaded the dog into their car and drove to the store. The store was filled with interesting things, and the dog was curious to explore. But the dog was modest and stayed by the door.

The owners loaded the car with treats, toys, and other things they needed. The dog watched eagerly, hoping they would get something good too.

Finally, they loaded the dog back into the car and drove home. When they opened the door, the dog jumped out and ran around the yard. It was so happy! Then it stopped and wagged its tail. It was the happiest dog around!

Once upon a time, there were two little bears, named Bob and Jack. They were best friends who liked to play together all the time. 

One day, Bob and Jack grabbed a rag that was lying on the ground. They both wanted to play with it, and soon began to quarrel over it.

"Let me have it," said Jack.
"No, I want it," said Bob.

Jack and Bob quarreled with each other, but neither of them would give up the rag. Then, Jack got an idea.

"Let's race!" he exclaimed. "Whoever gets to the top of the hill first, can keep the rag!" Bob was very excited.

So, the two little bears started to race up the hill. They ran quickly, faster and faster. In the end, Jack won the race!

Jack was excited and he jumped up and down. He proudly held the rag up in the air. Bob smiled and gave Jack a high-five. 
Their quarrel was forgotten, and the two little bears played happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a hairy dancer. He was always dancing around and singing. Everywhere he went, he was so happy and everyone smiled when they saw him. 

One day the dancer went to a big party and everyone was having so much fun. The dancer loved the party and started to dance even more. The other people at the party loved watching him and they all started to join in.

Suddenly, the dancer started to get pulled by someone. He looked up and saw a big, furry monster. The monster smiled and said it wanted the dancer to come with him to an even bigger party. 

The dancer was really scared, but he decided to go with the monster. The monster said they were going to have the best time ever. The dancer hopped on the monster's back and they took off. 

The dancer had the best time ever. He danced with everyone there and made many new, hairy friends. After the party, the dancer promised the monster that he would come back soon. 

The dancer said goodbye and started to make his way home. He was so happy and excited about all the fun he had. He knew he would never forget his hairy dancing friends!

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to a show with her mom. At the show, there were people doing tricks. Lucy liked the tricks and clapped her hands. "Applaud, Lucy, applaud!" her mom said. Lucy was happy and clapped more.

After the show, Lucy and her mom walked by a jail. In the jail, there was a sad man. Lucy wanted to make the man happy. She said, "Mom, can we do something for the sad man?"

Her mom thought for a moment and said, "We can give him some food and a nice note." So, they went home and made a meal for the sad man. They also wrote a note that said, "We hope you feel better."

The next day, they gave the meal and the note to the sad man. The sad man was grateful and smiled. Lucy felt happy that she could help someone. And from that day on, Lucy always tried to make others happy.

Anna loved her pet bunny, Fluffy. Fluffy was pink and soft and liked to hop and play. Anna liked to feed Fluffy carrots and lettuce and give her hugs and kisses. Fluffy was Anna's best friend.

One day, Anna and Fluffy went outside to play in the garden. They saw many flowers and bugs and birds. Anna picked some flowers and made a crown for Fluffy. Fluffy looked very pretty with the crown. Anna said, "You are the queen of the garden, Fluffy!"

But then, Anna heard a loud noise. It was a big dog. The dog saw Fluffy and ran towards her. He wanted to catch Fluffy and play with her. But Fluffy was scared. She did not want to play with the dog. She wanted to run away. Anna saw the dog and was scared too. She did not want the dog to hurt Fluffy. She said, "No, dog! Go away! Leave Fluffy alone!"

Anna ran to Fluffy and picked her up. She held her tight and tried to run back to the house. But the dog was faster. He chased Anna and Fluffy and barked loudly. He jumped and tried to grab Fluffy from Anna's arms. Anna was very brave. She said, "Stop, dog! Fluffy is my pet! She is not your toy!"

Then, Anna heard another voice. It was her mom. Mom saw the dog and Anna and Fluffy. She said, "Anna, are you okay? What is happening?" She ran to Anna and helped her. She took Fluffy from Anna and put her in a safe place. She said, "Shoo, dog! Go back to your owner! You are not welcome here!"

The dog heard mom and was scared. He stopped barking and jumping. He ran away from the garden. He did not want to make mom angry. He did not want to bother Anna and Fluffy anymore.

Anna and Fluffy were safe. They hugged each other and thanked mom. Mom said, "You are very brave, Anna. You helped Fluffy and protected her. You are a good friend to your pet. I am proud of you." She gave Anna and Fluffy a kiss and a cookie. Anna and Fluffy were happy. They ate the cookie and smiled. They were the best friends in the world.

Once there was a big animal. It was cold. The animal wanted to go the other way. But it could not. Then it had a good idea! It reversed! It backed up until it was facing the other way. Then it started walking. It was so happy! Now it could go to a warm place. The animal was so glad that it knew how to reverse. It never forgot. And it always made sure to reverse when it needed to go the other way.

Lily was a little girl who liked to play dress-up. She had many clothes and hats and shoes in her big box. One day, she found a blue uniform with a shiny badge. It was her daddy's uniform. He was a police officer who helped people.

Lily put on the uniform and the badge. She felt very proud and happy. She wanted to show her mommy and her brother. She ran to the living room, where they were watching TV. But she did not see the toy car on the floor. She stumbled and fell down. She hurt her knee and started to cry.

Mommy and brother heard her cry and came to help her. They saw her in the blue uniform and the shiny badge. They smiled and hugged her. They said, "Oh, Lily, you look adorable in daddy's uniform. But you have to be careful not to stumble on the toys. Are you OK?"

Lily nodded and wiped her tears. She said, "I'm OK. I wanted to be like daddy and help people. But I stumbled and fell down."

Mommy and brother kissed her knee and said, "You are very brave and kind, Lily. Daddy will be very happy to see you in his uniform. But you have to ask him first before you borrow his clothes. OK?"

Lily said, "OK. I'm sorry, mommy. I love daddy's uniform. It's so blue and shiny."

Mommy said, "I love you, Lily. You are my adorable little police officer."

One day, Jack wanted to go for a jog. He put on his shoes and stepped outside. He stretched his body and started running. 

He wanted to get to the park to play with his friends. As he ran, he noticed a pale meal on a bench. He stopped to have a look. It looked delicious! He began to eat the meal. 

He felt so much stronger, so he continued jogging to the park. Finally, he arrived. 

His friends were so excited to see him! They all ran around together, playing and having fun. Jack was so glad he had that tasty pale meal before he arrived. Now he had enough energy to play all day!

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Jack and Jill. They were playing in the park when Jack saw a plant. 

Jack said to Jill, "Look, that's an incredible plant. We should take it home."

Jill replied, "That's a great idea. Where should we put it?"

Jack suggested, "We should put it in the yard. We can take care of it together!"

Jill was very excited. They gathered the supplies they needed and took the incredible plant home. They each grabbed a gardening tool and dug a hole to put the plant in.

Jill said, "Let's water it every day. We can watch it grow and see how incredible it looks soon."

Jack agreed and they watered it together. Before long, the incredible plant was growing bigger and bigger with beautiful flowers. The friends would often sit near it and admire its beauty. 

Jack and Jill's friendship was incredible too. They enjoyed taking care of their special plant together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite jacket with a heavy zipper. One day, Lily was playing outside with her friends when she accidentally broke the zipper on her jacket. She tried to fix it herself, but it was too hard.

Lily's friend, Timmy, saw her struggling and asked, "What's wrong, Lily?"

"My zipper is broken and it won't close," Lily said sadly.

Timmy said, "Don't worry, I'll call my mom. She's really good at fixing things."

Soon enough, Timmy's mom arrived and fixed the zipper on Lily's jacket. Lily was so happy and thanked Timmy and his mom. From that day on, Lily knew that if something was too hard to fix, she could always call for help.

Once upon a time there was a lively pirate. He was looking for adventure on the open seas. Suddenly, he could see a big island in the distance, so he stopped his ship and started to cover the island.

But just when he was about to get close, something terrible happened. Suddenly, an enormous ship appeared from behind the island. It was a pirate ship!

The lively pirate and the other pirate ship began to yell across the ocean. The lively pirate shouted: "What do you want?!" The other pirate yelled back: "We want your ship!"

The lively pirate didn't give up. He wanted to keep his ship. He thought for a moment and then shouted back: "No! I will never give away my ship!"

The other pirates were angry, but they had no choice. They sailed away, and the lively pirate sailed away too, still having his ship.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore new things. One day, she went to the beach with her mom and dad. They saw a big island in the distance and decided to go explore it.

When they got to the island, they found a group of kids playing. One of the kids started to tease Lily and said she wasn't fit to play with them. Lily felt sad and didn't know what to do. Her mom and dad told her to ignore the teasing and to just have fun playing.

Lily decided to join in and started playing with the other kids. Soon, they were all having a great time together. They built sandcastles and played tag. Lily was happy she didn't let the teasing get to her and had a fun day on the island with her new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a family. It was made up of a mom, dad, and three year old child.

One day, the family went to the store. The child walked around and looked at the items. He saw bags of rice, and he asked his dad what they were.

"This is rice," his dad replied. "People use it to make food."

The dad added some bags of rice to their cart. They went to the checkout line and the cashier asked, "Do you need anything else?"

The dad nodded. "Yes, the rice is for a friend who needs it. Can you please supply him with some?"

The cashier smiled. "Of course. We are always happy to help out an honest friend in need."

The family thanked the cashier. They paid for the rice, and then took it to the friend in need. The child smiled to himself knowing he had helped out a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a lady with a purse. She loved her purse very much. It was tough and she took it everywhere she went. One day, a bad person came and wanted to take the purse. The lady said no, but the bad person didn't listen. He tried to take the purse and destroy it. The lady tried to stop him, but he was too strong. In the end, the bad person took the purse and ran away. The lady was very sad and cried a lot.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Mary. Mary wanted to join a team that was very competitive and wore a special uniform. Mary was a bit worried when she tried on the uniform that she wasn't sure if she was going to be accepted. She anxiously waited to get the answer. Then one day she found out that she had been chosen to join the team!

Mary was so excited. She had worked very hard to make her dream come true. She put on the uniform with pride and found that it was a really great fit. All of her hard work had paid off.

Mary was so proud to be on the team. She was learning quickly, and soon enough she was very competitive. She had learned to never give up and to keep trying even when she got discouraged.

This story is about Mary and how she worked hard to achieve her dream. Mary has taught us that if we never give up and stay determined, we can achieve anything we set our minds to! Accepting a challenge and putting in hard work can make our dreams come true too!

Once upon a Sunday, a little boy was sitting on a seat. He was looking out of the window and watched the clouds rolling by. It was a very peaceful and quiet day. He could hear the birds singing in the trees, and the bees buzzing around the flowers.

Suddenly, he saw a big, white balloon flying in the sky. He watched it float and twirl until it disappeared in the distance. The boy leaned back and noticed a big tree in the garden. The leaves on the tree were dancing in the wind and the sun was shining through them. It was so peaceful.

The little boy closed his eyes and imagined he was flying through the sky like the balloon. Then he opened them again, smiled and got up from the seat. Sunday was a wonderful day!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and get dirty. His mom always told him to change his clothes when he came inside. But Timmy didn't like changing his clothes. He thought it was boring.

One day, Timmy went to play in the mud. He forgot to change his clothes when he came inside. His mom saw him and got mad. She told him to change his clothes right away. Timmy didn't understand why his mom was so upset.

Later that day, Timmy went to visit his friend Billy. Billy's mom said, "Wow, Timmy, your clothes are so dirty! Don't you feel ashamed?" Timmy didn't know what ashamed meant, but he could tell from Billy's mom's face that it wasn't good.

From that day on, Timmy made sure to change his clothes when he came inside. He didn't want anyone to think he was ashamed of being dirty. And he understood that it was important to listen to his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play outside. One day, he found an unusual piece of wood on the ground. It was very smooth and had a funny shape. Timmy picked it up and shook it. Suddenly, a genie appeared!

The genie said to Timmy, "I will grant you one wish, but be careful what you wish for." Timmy thought for a moment and said, "I wish for a big bag of candy!" The genie granted his wish and Timmy was very happy.

But as he ate all the candy, he soon realized that he had made a mistake. He should have wished for something more important, like happiness or love. Timmy learned that sometimes the things we think we want are not always the best for us. He promised to be more careful with his wishes in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went on a trip with her family to a big hotel. When they arrived, they met a friendly lady at the front desk who gave them their room key.

Lily was so excited to explore the hotel. She ran around and saw a big pool. She waved to her mom and dad to come join her. They all went swimming together.

Later, they went to the hotel restaurant to eat dinner. Lily saw another little girl sitting at a table. She wanted to be friends with her. So, she walked over and said, "Hi, my name is Lily. Do you want to play with me?" The other little girl smiled and said, "Yes, I would love to play with you!" 

Lily was happy that she made a new friend at the hotel. She waved goodbye to her new friend and went to bed with a smile on her face.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. It was an icy cold day, so they wore big coats to stay warm. They played on the swings and had a lot of fun.

As they walked home, Tim saw a big couch on the side of the road. "Mom, can we take that couch home?" Tim asked. His mom looked at the couch and thought about it for a moment.

"I recommend we keep looking for a better couch," his mom said. "This one is old and dirty." Tim agreed, and they continued walking home. They talked about the fun they had at the park and how they would find a nice couch someday.

There was a bird. It was a beautiful bird with wings, and it wanted to fly. So, it spread out its wings and stretched them wide. Then, it started to soar, high up in the sky. It flew and flew, faster and faster. It was so happy in the sky, free and perfect.

The bird was so high that it could see the whole world from up there. Down below it saw a lake, with boats on it. It started to fly towards the lake. When it got there it saw something amazing - a row of ducks swimming in the lake! The bird swooped down and began to row with the ducks. It felt so happy that it would never forget the perfect moment.

Once upon a time, there was a curious squirrel named John. He was always looking for new things to explore and one day, he found a big nut from a nearby tree. He was so excited and quickly requested the nut from his friend the owl. The owl kindly agreed and gave John the nut. 

John raced back to his home and carefully placed the nut in the middle of the room. He was determined to crack it open and see what was inside. 

John got a large hammer and started banging the nut. After a few tries, he finally cracked it open. Suddenly, a brilliant yellow light shone through the nut. 

â€œWhat is this?â€ he quietly requested aloud. He reached in and pulled out a shiny golden coin. John was so surprised he could barely believe what he was seeing. He hopped and cheered with joy. 

John had made a surprising and wonderful discovery from the little nut he requested!

Once upon a time, in a small, noisy town, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to watch the sparks from the fire at night. She thought they were like tiny stars falling from the sky.

One day, Lily met a new friend named Sam. Sam was a squirrel who lived in a tree near her house. They liked to play together in the park. Sam said, "Promise me we'll be friends forever, Lily." Lily smiled and said, "I promise, Sam."

One night, Lily and Sam sat by the fire together. They watched the sparks fly up into the sky. They laughed and talked about their fun day. As they watched the sparks, they knew they would be friends forever, just like they promised.

Once upon a time, there was a big orange tree. The tree had lots of oranges on it. The oranges were so yummy and juicy. 

One day, a little girl came by the tree. She saw the oranges and wanted to eat them. She waved at the tree and said "Hi tree, can I have an orange please?" 

The tree was very kind and rich with oranges. It gave the little girl an orange to eat. The little girl was very happy and said "Thank you, tree. This orange is so yummy!" She ate the orange and then went on her way. 

From that day on, the little girl would come back to the orange tree and wave hello. The tree was always happy to see her and would give her more oranges to eat. The little girl loved the orange tree and the yummy oranges it gave her.

Once upon a time there was a man who was very brave and powerful. One day he was walking through the forest and he heard a voice coming from above. The voice said: "I have a special task for you - can you deliver something to me?"

The man said yes, he could do it. Then the voice said: "I will give you a magical spirit - it is very powerful and it will help you on your journey. You must deliver this spirit to me. Can you do it?"

The man thought it would be a brave thing to do, but he wasn't sure he could do it. Finally he said yes, he would try his best.

The man set off on his journey and he faced many dangers along the way. But he was brave and he never gave up. Eventually he reached the end of his journey and he faced the greatest challenge of all - a giant monster.

The man had to fight the monster and there was a long and difficult battle. But the man was powerful and fierce and he eventually defeated the monster. He grabbed the spirit and delivered it to the voice from above.

The voice was pleased and thanked the man for his bravery. And the man was glad that he had done something so brave and he knew he had been very powerful.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Sam. He was a gifted boy who loved to tell stories. One day, Sam saw a rod on the ground. He picked it up, curious to see what it was for.

Sam asked his mom, "What is this rod, Mommy?" His mom replied, "That is a fishing rod, Sam. It's used to fish in the lake."

Sam was excited. He told his mom, "Can I use it, Mommy?" His mom smiled and said, "Of course you can! Let's go to the lake right now."

They got ready and went to the lake. Sam was so excited. He put the rod in the lake and tried to catch some fish. He waited and waited, but nothing happened. Then, all of a sudden, he felt something tugging at the rod.

Sam shouted, "Mommy, I got a fish!" His mom smiled and said, "That's great, Sam. You did it! Now you can put it in the bucket and take it home."

Sam was so excited that he had caught a fish. He put the fish in the bucket and took it home. From then on, he always went fishing with his rod whenever he wanted to catch fish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear fancy dresses and play with her dolls. One day, Lily's mom asked her what her favorite color was. Lily thought for a moment and said, "Pink is my favorite color!"

Her mom smiled and said, "That's a good opinion, Lily. What number do you like the most?" Lily thought again and said, "I like the number three because I am three years old!"

Lily's mom hugged her and said, "You are so smart! I love your fancy dress too!" Lily smiled and hugged her mom back. They continued to talk and play together for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daddy. One day, they went to a cafÃ©. When they opened the door, a yummy smell of coffee filled their noses.

Mommy said, â€œLetâ€™s go sit down!â€ They found a table with two chairs and sat down. Daddy said, â€œI want some coffee.â€ He ordered a cup of coffee that was thin and hot.

Mommy asked, â€œWould you like some?â€ Daddy shook his head and said, â€œNo, Iâ€™m good.â€ He took a deep sip and paused. He smiled and said, â€œMm, this coffee is so good!â€

Then, he took another sip and gave Mommy a big hug. They both smiled and enjoyed drinking their coffee. They had a nice day out together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a sweet cat named Mittens. One day, Lily and Mittens went to the park to play. While they were playing, a big dog came up to them. The dog barked loudly and scared Lily.

"Don't worry, Lily. I will protect you," said Mittens bravely.

Mittens stood in front of Lily and growled at the dog. Suddenly, the dog ran away. Lily hugged Mittens and said, "Thank you for protecting me, Mittens. You are my hero."

Later that day, Lily's dad needed to fix a loose screw on the front door. Mittens watched as Lily's dad used a screwdriver to tighten the screw. "That's a screw, Mittens," said Lily.

Mittens looked at the screw and meowed curiously. "It's a small, metal thing that holds things together," explained Lily. Mittens nodded and licked his paw.

From that day on, Lily knew that Mittens was not only sweet, but also brave and protective. They played together every day and Mittens always kept Lily safe.

Paul screamed as loud as he could. He was playing in the garden and he had seen something dark. It was a huge tomato! Paul had never seen such a big tomato before.

He was so scared and he kept screaming. Suddenly, his mom came running. She saw the tomato and she started laughing.

"It's okay Paul! It's just a tomato. It can't hurt you," she said.

Paul took a deep breath and stopped screaming. He reached out and touched the tomato. It was cold and squishy. He smiled.

Now Paul knew that tomatoes weren't scary. They were fun and delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and stuffed animals. One day, she was playing with her dollhouse when she noticed a big pile of ash on the floor. 

"Mommy, what is this?" Lily asked her mom. 

"That's ash, sweetie. It's what's left over after something burns," her mom explained. 

Lily was curious and decided to investigate. She found a match and lit it, watching as it turned into ash. 

Her mom saw what she was doing and became very worried. "Lily, you should never play with matches. You could get hurt!" she said, feeling ashamed that she hadn't been watching her daughter more closely. 

Lily promised to never play with matches again and her mom hugged her tightly. From that day on, they made sure to keep all matches and lighters out of reach from little hands.

Mama and Sara were playing together one day in the sunshine. Mama said to Sara, "Sara, let's go for a walk." Sara was excited, she loved going for walks!

Mama and Sara went outside and saw two big tires. Mama said, "Sara, I think we can peek into the tires and see what's inside." Sara loved exploring, so she and Mama peeked into the tires.

Inside the tires were two dependable, glowing rocks. Sara gasped, "Mama, these rocks are pretty!" Mama agreed, "They are dependable. They won't change or go away like the clouds do."

Sara liked the dependable rocks, so she asked Mama if she could hug them. Mama said, "Yes, you can hug the rocks, but remember to take care of them and always put them back inside the tires." Sara was so happy! She hugged the rocks and said, "Thank you, Mama!"

Lily had long hair. She liked to play with her hair and make braids and buns. But sometimes her hair got in her eyes and made her cry. Her mom said she needed to go to the barber.

The barber was a nice man with a big smile. He had scissors and a comb and a cape. He put the cape on Lily and said, "Don't be scared, Lily. I will make your hair look pretty and neat. Do you want a short cut or a long cut?"

Lily thought for a moment. She liked her long hair, but she did not like it when it hurt her eyes. She said, "Can you make my hair like yours, barber?"

The barber laughed. He had very short hair, almost no hair at all. He said, "Are you sure, Lily? My hair is very short. You might get cold or look funny."

Lily nodded. She said, "I want to try something new. You are a wise barber. You know how to make hair look good."

The barber smiled. He said, "Okay, Lily. If you are sure, I will give you a short cut. But you have to sit still and be brave."

Lily agreed. She sat still and watched the barber cut her hair. She saw her long hair fall on the floor. She felt the scissors tickle her ears and neck. She felt the air touch her head. She felt different.

When the barber was done, he showed Lily a mirror. Lily looked at herself. She had very short hair, like the barber. She looked different, but she liked it. She said, "Thank you, barber. I like my new hair. It does not hurt my eyes anymore. And I look cool."

The barber said, "You're welcome, Lily. You are a brave and smart girl. You look very cool indeed. And you can always grow your hair back if you want to."

Lily hugged the barber. She said, "You are a nice and wise barber. I will come back to see you again."

The end.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Ann. Ann had a pocket full of candy. She loved snack time and would always share her candy with her friends. One day, Ann went to market with her mom. She saw a toy she really liked, but there was no money in her pocket. She felt hurt. Suddenly, Ann had an idea! She decided to sell her candy and use the money to buy the toy. So she sold the candy and bought the toy. She felt really happy when she got to take her new toy home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was very proud of herself, so she decided to get a razor to look even better. Lucy looked in the mirror, and saw that she still wasn't proud of how she looked, so she humbly crawled away from the mirror.

Lucy's mom came into her room and spotted Lucy crawling away. She said, "Why are you crawling away, Lucy? Where did the razor go?"

Lucy replied, "I was trying to make myself look prettier, but I don't need the razor any more. I think I look wonderful now without it. I'm so happy and humble. That's why I'm crawling away."

Lucy's mom smiled and said, "I'm so proud of you, Lucy. It is much better to be humble and like yourself, rather than trying to change who you are." 

Lucy nodded and crawled away happily. She knew that she was the perfect person just the way she was.

Once upon a time there was a clever girl called Lily. She was so clever that she wanted to learn new things. Every day she would find new things to learn. One day she decided to learn about prices.

She started asking around and soon she learned that prices can be different for different things. She was so excited when she learned this. She kept learning and soon she knew that some things have a really great price and others can be really expensive.

Lily was so clever that she knew exactly when to buy things and when to save her money. She learned so much about prices and soon she was telling everyone about it. Everybody was very impressed by her knowledge.

The end.

Molly was excited! She had a new skirt. It was incredible. She put it on and spun around and around. Twirling and twirling.

Molly's brother, Lucas, came in and saw her with her skirt.

"You look so nice!" He said.

Molly smiled.

Then Lucas said, "I need a skirt too. Do you think yours is big enough to share?"

Molly giggled and said, "Let's try".

They both put on the skirt. It was a little snug but it worked. Molly and Lucas were both happy. They laughed and danced around showing off their new incredible skirt.

Once, there was a lively crocodile. She was always full of energy, and loved to play in the pond. One day, while playing she spotted something in the water. She touched it and was delightfully surprised to see a shiny toy! 

The crocodile was so excited that she shouted to her friends. "Come quick! I found a toy!" 

Her friends arrived quickly, and all of them were fascinated by the toy. One of her friends asked, "How did you find it?" The crocodile smiled and said, "I just touched it and it was there!" Everyone agreed they wanted to try touching and see if they could find some more toys in the pond.

So, they all tried to touch the water and low and behold, there were more toys! Everyone was delighted. The lively crocodile and her friends spent the day playing with the toys, and having lots of fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden. One day, she found a beautiful lily flower. It was pale and delicate.

Lily picked up the flower and showed it to her mother. "Look, Mommy! I found a pretty lily!" she said.

Her mother smiled and said, "It's beautiful, Lily. But it's very cold outside. You should come inside and warm up."

Lily started to shiver and realized her hands were very cold. She hugged the lily close to her chest and went inside with her mother. They sat by the fire and drank hot cocoa. Lily felt warm and cozy. She looked at the lily and smiled. It was still pale, but now it was even more beautiful in her eyes.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sally went to the park to play. She saw a lady wearing a big hat. Sally asked the lady: "Hey! What are you wearing on your lip?" The lady smiled and said: "I'm wearing a lipstick. It makes me look pretty."

Sally thought it looked very pretty and wanted to wear lipstick too. The lady said: "Yes, of course, you can wear lipstick too. But it's very fragile, so you need to be careful." 

Sally put on the lipstick, but it was soft and slippery, so it was difficult to put on. She asked the lady: "How do I make sure it stays on?" The lady held up a compact mirror and showed Sally how to put on lipstick properly.

The lady said: "There you go! Now you look even prettier."

Sally was thrilled and ran off to show her parents her new look. From then on, no matter where she went Sally always wore her new lipstick with care because she knew it was very fragile.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot was very dirty and had terrible dirt on his skin. His mom told him that he needed to bathe soon. Spot did not like to bathe, but he knew his mom was right.

One day, Spot went to play with his friends. They played in the mud and got even dirtier. Spot's mom saw him and said, "Spot, you must bathe now or you will not be able to play with your friends tomorrow." Spot was sad, but he knew he had to listen to his mom.

Spot went home and took a bath. He scrubbed and scrubbed until all the terrible dirt was gone from his skin. The next day, Spot was so clean and shiny that all his friends wanted to know how he got so clean. Spot told them, "I listened to my mom and took a bath." From that day on, Spot always listened to his mom and took a bath when she told him to.

One day there was a jet flying in the sky. It was an unknown vehicle that no one had seen before. Rachel saw the jet and wondered what it was. She asked her Mom, "What is that?"

Her Mom said, "It's a jet. It goes very high and fast." Rachel was excited to hear the explanation.

Rachel asked another question, "Can I ride in a jet?" Her Mom said, "No, not right now. That is something for when you get a little older." Rachel wanted to ride in the jet, but she knew she had to wait.

The jet kept flying in the sky. Rachel watched it until it went so far she could no longer see it. The unknown jet was gone and Rachel sat wondering where it had gone.

Once upon a time, there was a thick board on the beach. Sally was a 3 year old girl who wanted to play in the water. She looked around and noticed the board and decided to use it as a stepping stone to get in. She stepped onto the board and it wobbled. As she stepped further out the board quickly filled up with water, and Sally started to soak!

Sally was scared and shouted for help, but no one was around. She tried to paddle back to the shore in vain. Suddenly, a brave and strong dolphin came to save her. It grabbed the board with its mouth and pulled it back to the beach.

Sally was so glad and thanked the dolphin for saving her. She enjoyed the rest of the day playing in the water and being careful to not step on the board any more. She learned an important lesson about being safe by the beach.

Once upon a time there was a chewy style. It was ready to be eaten. Mommy cut it into little pieces so it was easy for the little boy to chew. He chewed it up and it tasted so yummy! After he finished chewing, he asked if he could have more. Mommy said yes and gave him a bigger piece. He was so excited to chew it up. He chewed it quickly and it was gone in no time. The little boy was so pleased with his chewy style that he asked for more. Mommy smiled and kept giving him the yummy snack until he was all full and ready for bed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emily. She was three years old, and she liked finding new things.

One day, Emily went on a walk with her mom. They were in the garden, and Mom said, "Look, Emily! What do you see?"

"I see a zipper!" said Emily excitedly. Emily was very curious about the zipper, so she decided to be polite and ask.

"Mommy, what is that?"

"It's a zipper," replied Mom.

Emily then discovered she could open the zipper. She carefully opened it and found a box inside. She was so excited to open the box!

The box was full of fun toys! Emily had a great time playing with them. She and Mom played hide and seek with the toys for the rest of the day.

At the end, Emily was happy and tired. She had a wonderful day discovering new things.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play together. Today, they are at Lily's house. Lily has a new puzzle. It is a modern puzzle. It has many colors and shapes.

"Do you want to play with my puzzle?" Lily asks Ben.

"Yes, please. It looks fun," Ben says.

They sit on the floor and open the puzzle box. They try to find the pieces that fit together. They make a big picture of a city. The city has tall buildings, cars, and people.

"Wow, this is a cool puzzle. I like the city," Ben says.

"Me too. It is a modern city. Maybe we can go there someday," Lily says.

They finish the puzzle and smile. They are proud of their work.

"Let's show it to my mom," Lily says.

They get up and run to the kitchen. Lily's mom is there. She is making a cake.

"Mom, look at our puzzle. We made a modern city," Lily says.

"That's wonderful, Lily and Ben. You did a great job. I'm very proud of you," Lily's mom says.

She hugs them and gives them a slice of cake.

"Thank you, mom. The cake is yummy," Lily says.

"Thank you, Lily's mom. The cake is yummy," Ben says.

They eat their cake and talk about their puzzle. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time there was a stubborn girl called Sarah. Everywhere Sarah went she was always looking for things to collect.

One day when Sarah was in the park, she found a pretty butterfly. Sarah wanted to collect it, but it flew away. No matter how hard she tried, she could not catch it.

Suddenly Sarah spotted a pretty flower. She was determined to collect it, so she ran as fast as she could to try and catch it. But the flower kept flying away.

Sarah was very frustrated. She stomped her feet and shouted, "I am stubborn and I WILL collect a thing!"

Just then, an ant crawled onto Sarah's hand. She smiled and said, "I will take this thing instead!"

So Sarah carefully cupped the ant in her hands and brought it home. From that day onwards, Sarah was known as the one who always collects stubborn things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved birds, especially the pretty ones that flew in the sky. One day, her mom took her to the park to see the birds. Lily saw a beautiful blue bird and wanted to take it home, but her mom said no because it needed to be free.

The next day, Lily went to the store with her dad and saw an adorable birdcage. She asked her dad to buy it for her, but he said no because they didn't have a bird to put in it. Lily was sad and missed the blue bird from the park.

A few days later, Lily and her mom went back to the park. They saw the blue bird again, but this time it was hurt. Lily's mom knew what to do and took the bird home to care for it. They put the blue bird in the adorable birdcage and took care of it until it was better. Lily was so happy and didn't miss the bird anymore because it was right there in her own home.

Once there was an itch. It was so big the itch weighed a ton! It was so big the itch was scared. It looked around and saw a normal person.

The itch asked the person, "Please help me get rid of this weight!"

The person sympathised with the itch and tried to help it. The person gathered everyone in the area and they all pushed together on the itch. But nothing happened.

The person said, "I am so sorry itchy. It looks like the weight is here to stay."

The itch was really sad. It weighed so much the itch could not move. The person went on their way, leaving the itch alone with its weight.

The end.

Once there was a nosy little cat. His name was Sam. One day he was walking through the park when he saw an envelope on the ground. It looked very strange. Sam wanted to know what was inside. He scurried over to take a closer look.

Suddenly Sam heard a voice. "That's mine! I forgot it!" It was an old man who had been walking in the park too. Sam quickly put the envelope back on the ground. He apologised to the old man for being so nosy.

The old man chuckled. "Thatâ€™s ok, Sam. I should have kept a closer eye on it. I was very forgetful today." He thanked Sam for returning it to him and then walked off.

Sam watched the old man go, feeling proud of himself for being so helpful. And thatâ€™s how Sam and the old man had a forgetful yet valuable encounter.

Jack was so excited! His family was finally getting a pet. He wanted a puppy, and when they went to the pet store, he saw one he really liked. 

When they brought the puppy home, Jack loved it right away. The puppy was so obedient and he followed Jack everywhere. 

Jack called the puppy Squeaky. He always played with it, but sometimes he was too rough. Jack's mom yelled at him to be gentler with the puppy. 

One day, Squeaky ate something in the yard, she started to act sick. Jack's family took Squeaky to the veterinarian. 

At the vet, Squeaky was so scared, he barked and yelped a lot. But the vet was kind and gentle, and he soon examined Squeaky. 

The vet said Squeaky was healthy, but needed to stay away from eating things in the yard. Jack and his family made sure they were more obedient, and kept Squeaky away from all the things she shouldn't have.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to eat limes. He thought limes were the perfect fruit. They were green and round, and they tasted so good. Tim's mom always told him to behave when he ate his limes.

One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He brought a lime with him. While he was playing, he met a girl named Sue. Sue saw the lime and asked, "What is that?"

"This is a lime," Tim said. "It's the perfect fruit. Do you want to try some?"

Sue tried the lime and liked it too. They both behaved and shared the lime. They became good friends and always played together at the park. And from that day on, they both loved limes and always behaved when they ate them.

Lila and Tom were playing with paper. They liked to fold it and make shapes. Lila made a paper horse. She was proud of it. She showed it to Tom.

"Look, I made a horse!" she said.

Tom looked at the paper horse. He did not like it. He wanted to make a better horse. He took Lila's paper horse and tore it.

"That's not a horse, that's a mess!" he said.

Lila was sad and angry. She cried. She wanted her paper horse back.

"Why did you do that?" she asked Tom.

Tom was not sorry. He was mean. He laughed at Lila.

"Because I can make a better horse than you!" he said.

He folded another paper and made a horse. He showed it to Lila.

"See, this is a horse!" he said.

Lila looked at Tom's paper horse. It was not a better horse. It was a big and ugly horse. It had too many legs and a long nose. It looked like a monster.

"That's not a horse, that's a monster!" she said.

Tom was surprised. He did not like Lila's words. He felt ashamed. He realized he was wrong.

"Maybe you're right, maybe it's a monster," he said.

He looked at Lila's paper horse. It was a modest horse. It had four legs and a short nose. It looked like a real horse.

"Maybe your horse was better than mine," he said.

He felt sorry. He wanted to be nice. He gave Lila his paper horse.

"Here, you can have my horse. I'm sorry I tore your horse," he said.

Lila was happy. She liked Tom's paper horse. She forgave Tom.

"Thank you, Tom. I like your horse. It's a funny horse," she said.

She gave Tom a hug. They became friends. They played with paper horses. They had fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He lived in a small house with his family and his pet dog, Marley. One day, Jack wanted to do something new, so he decided to go on an adventure! He packed a bag with some clothes and a peanut for Marley to snack on.

Jack walked for a long time. He crossed rivers, and climbed hills, and before long he had arrived at a new area. He noticed something in the sky that caught his attention. It was a bright rainbow, and it was special because it had seven colors! Jack was amazed, and he decided that he wanted to complete his mission by getting to the end of the rainbow.

Soon the sky started to turn dark, and Jack heard a loud rumble of thunder. He started to worry because he did not know how he was going to complete his mission, now that the rain had started. But he was determined, and he kept on walking.

Rain started pouring all around him, but Jack was determined to finish his mission. Eventually the sky cleared, and he saw a beautiful sight in the distance. At the end of the rainbow was a brand new toy store! Jack was so happy that he had completed his mission and he raced back home to share his new discovery with his family.

Once upon a time, there was a march. It was long and tiring, but exciting, too. Everyone brought things with them. The children had balloons and flags. The adults had food and drinks.

Their march was amazing. As they went farther, more people joined in. Everyone was having fun. Many people were singing and dancing. They were so happy to be marching together.

At the end of the march, everyone was tired but happy. They had made it all the way! Everyone celebrated the amazing march. They had brought so much fun and joy along the way.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to go on adventures and explore the world around him. One day, Timmy went outside to find something fun to do. He walked and walked until he found a big field. In the field, he saw something shiny. He ran over to it and found a shiny rock! Timmy was so happy to find it.

As Timmy continued to explore, he saw something scary. It was lightning! Lightning is a big, bright light that comes from the sky during a storm. Timmy was scared and ran back home to be safe. He told his mom about the lightning and she hugged him and said it was okay.

Even though Timmy was scared of the lightning, he still wanted to be independent and brave. He knew that he could go on more adventures and find more cool things, but he also knew that he needed to be careful and stay safe. Timmy was excited to go on more adventures and find more treasures!

Sara and Ben were twins. They liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big umbrella in the closet. It was red and yellow and had flowers on it. It was very pretty.

"Let's play with the umbrella!" Sara said. "We can pretend it is a tent or a boat or a parachute!"

"Okay!" Ben said. "But we have to polish it first. It is dusty and dirty. I have a cloth and some water. I can make it shiny and clean."

Sara and Ben took the umbrella and the cloth and the water to the backyard. They opened the umbrella and put it on the grass. Ben started to polish the umbrella with the cloth and the water. He rubbed and rubbed and rubbed.

"Stop!" Sara said. "You are polishing too much! You are making the umbrella wet and wrinkled. You are ruining it!"

"No, I'm not!" Ben said. "I'm making it better! You are not helping at all. You are just watching and complaining. You are being mean!"

Sara and Ben started to argue. They shouted and pushed and pulled. They both wanted the umbrella. They both thought they were right.

"Hey, hey, hey!" Mom said. She came out of the house and saw Sara and Ben fighting. She was not happy. "What are you doing? Why are you fighting over the umbrella? You are supposed to share and play nicely!"

Sara and Ben stopped fighting. They looked at Mom. They looked at the umbrella. It was wet and wrinkled and not pretty anymore. They felt bad.

"We're sorry, Mom," Sara and Ben said. "We wanted to play with the umbrella, but we couldn't agree on how to polish it. We got angry and we fought."

Mom sighed. She picked up the umbrella and the cloth and the water. She took them inside. She said, "The umbrella is not a toy. It is for rainy days. You can't polish it with water. You can only wipe it with a dry cloth. You have to be gentle and careful with it. And you have to be gentle and careful with each other. Fighting is not nice. Apologize to each other and hug."

Sara and Ben looked at each other. They said, "We're sorry, Sara. We're sorry, Ben. We love you." They hugged. They felt better.

Mom smiled. She said, "That's better. Now, go and find something else to play with. Something that is a toy. And remember to share and play nicely."

Sara and Ben nodded. They said, "Okay, Mom. Thank you, Mom." They went to find something else to play with. Something that was a toy. And they shared and played nicely. The end.

Once upon a time there was a fat cat named Fluffy. Fluffy lived in a nice, warm house. One day, she wanted to go outside and explore.

Fluffy ran to the door but it was shut. She meowed and meowed but nobody came to open it. Fluffy tried to push it open but it was too strong for her little body. She was trying her best to resist.

Suddenly, she heard a voice say, "What are you doing here, little kitty?" It was her owner, who had opened the door. He asked her, "Do you want to go outside and explore?"

Fluffy nodded her head and purred in excitement. Her owner smiled and said, "Let's go! It's a beautiful day outside and I'm sure you'll have lots of fun."

Fluffy and her owner went out the door, and she explored like she'd never done before. She chased butterflies and jumped in piles of leaves. She even found a little pond where she could take a swim. Fluffy enjoyed her day so much that she ended up taking a long nap when she got home. 

Fluffy will never forget the day she resisted the door and went outside to explore!

Little Jamie was feeling very lucky today. He had been told he was going to get a new bedroom. He almost didnâ€™t believe it when he heard it, so he asked his mother â€œIs it true?â€

She smiled and nodded.

Jamie was so excited that he couldnâ€™t wait to see the new room. He skipped all the way to the bedroom and when his mother opened the door, he saw colorful walls and a big bed. Jamie smiled and said, â€œIâ€™m the luckiest boy alive!â€

He couldnâ€™t wait to explore his new room, so as soon as his mother left, he started to jump around the room. Eventually he got tired, so he sat on the bed and looked around the room. He saw that there was a window with a huge tree outside, and he knew he would be able to sit at the window and watch the birds every day.

Jamie thought that he was the luckiest boy in the world. Little did he know that this was only the beginning of his luck.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Jack. He loved dragons and wanted to keep one for himself.

One day, Jack found a dragon egg in the woods. He picked it up and brought it home. 

When Jack showed his parents the egg, they told him he could keep it.

Jack was so excited! He kept the egg safe in his room and waited patiently.

A few days later, the egg hatched and a gentle baby dragon appeared. Jack was so happy; he could finally keep his very own dragon!

They were the best of friends, and spent all day long playing together. Jack loved his dragon very much. 

Sadly, one day Jack was playing too roughly and his dragon was scared away. It flew off over the trees and out of sight.

Jack never saw his dragon again. He was heartbroken and could only keep the memories of their happy times together.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who loved to soar high in the sky. One day, the bird met a little boy who played a drum. The bird asked the boy if he could play the drum too. The boy said, "Sure, but be careful, the drum is not flexible."

The bird started to play the drum, but he played too hard and the drum broke. The boy got angry and said, "Why did you break my drum? Now I can't play anymore." The bird felt sad and flew away.

Later that day, the bird saw a little girl crying because she broke her toy. The bird remembered how he felt when he broke the drum and decided to help the girl. He flew to the toy store and brought her a new toy. The girl was happy and thanked the bird.

The moral of the story is that we should be careful with other people's things and try to help when we can. The foreshadowing was when the boy warned the bird that the drum was not flexible, and the payoff was when the bird remembered the lesson and helped the little girl.

Once upon a time, a happy boy opened his eyes in the morning. He yawned and smiled. 

Outside, a beautiful day had begun. The sun was shining and birds were singing. 

The boy couldn't wait to explore his day. He caught his mum's eye and she winked at him. 

Together, they walked outside. The boy gasped. His garden was full of animals!

Squirrels, bunnies and hedgehogs gathered together to welcome the boy. He laughed and reached out to stroke a bunny's soft fur. He felt so happy! 

The animals stayed as the boy ran around, exploring and playing. 

At the end of the day, he said goodbye to all his furry friends. Until tomorrow!

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Lily. She wanted to go to the park with her mom but her mom said they needed to go to the store first. So they went to the store and got a cart to put their things in. 

Lily saw a toy she wanted but her mom said they didn't have enough money to buy it. Lily was sad and started to cry. 

A kind man who worked at the store saw Lily crying and asked her what was wrong. Lily told him about the toy she wanted but couldn't have. The man raised his eyebrows and said, "I have an idea." 

He took Lily and her mom to the toy aisle and showed them a small toy that was on sale. Lily was happy and her mom thanked the man. They put the toy in the cart and went to the park.

Jane saw a long piece of tape lying on the ground. She wanted to follow it because she was curious to see where it was going. As she followed the tape, she noticed that it had many twists and turns.

Suddenly, Jane heard a voice.

"What do you think you're doing?"

It was an old man who had been watching her. "This important tape is for honest people only. You should not be following it," he said.

Jane was surprised and discouraged. She had wanted to be honest, but she wasn't sure what to do.

"Why don't you help me out? If you help me with my work, I promise I will let you follow the tape," the old man said.

Jane thought about it for a moment and then agreed. She worked with the old man, and after she finished, he said, "You have been very honest. You may follow the tape now."

So, Jane followed the tape and at the end she saw a glorious treasure! She had never been so excited! 

The old man was right - honesty had rewarded Jane with an amazing surprise!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to visit her grandma's house. Her grandma was very bossy and always told her what to do. One day, Lily went to visit her grandma and something strange happened. The sky turned dark and it started to rain. Lily was scared, but her grandma told her not to worry. They sat inside and played games until the rain stopped. After the rain, they went outside to see a beautiful rainbow. Lily was so happy that she visited her grandma even though it was raining.

Lenora was a small girl, barely three years old, who was always wearing pink. She was so little and so loved, with eyes so bright they glowed like stars. All around her, the world seemed to stop and look. 

One day, her grandma brought her to the store. Lenora looked around the store, in awe of the colors and shapes around her. She stopped in front of a rack of pink dolls, she couldn't help it - they were so beautiful! She started to demand one of the dolls. Eventually her grandma agreed and bought her the doll. 

Lenora ran home, clutching the doll to her chest. She was so excited to show everyone - the doll was the best thing she ever owned! She hugged it tightly and it made her feel loved. 

Lenora knew she would never get tired of her new pink toy, but as she hugged it, she thought she might also want a real pet. She thought of the love that a pet could bring and started to demand a pet, too. Grandma said 'not yet' but Lenora was sure if she asked really nicely, it would happen someday soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little spider named Spidey. Spidey lived in a big tree where he spun his cobweb every day. He loved to play and catch flies in his cobweb. One day, a big storm came and destroyed Spidey's cobweb. 

Spidey was sad and didn't know what to do. He tried to make a new cobweb, but it was too hard for him. He felt like he wanted to surrender and give up. 

But then, Spidey remembered what his mom always told him: "Never give up, even when things are hard." So, Spidey tried again and again until he made the most beautiful cobweb he had ever made. He was so proud of himself that he forgot all about surrendering. From that day on, Spidey knew that even when things are hard, he could do it if he tried his best.

Billy was playing in the park with his friends. He was running around and having a great time. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and he was surprised. He stopped and looked around.

He saw a package lying on the ground. He was curious and walked closer to it. He bent down to take a closer look and he saw that the package had a big smiley face on it.

Billy was so excited. He wanted to open it! He grabbed it and started running to take it home. When he reached his house, his mother looked at him and said, 

"Billy, what do you have there?"

Billy smiled and said, "It's a package for me! Can I open it please?"

His mother nodded and said, "Of course you can."

Billy felt so enthusiastic! He carefully opened the package and pulled out a big red ball. He was so excited! He held it in his hands and started running around the house as he laughed.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Sue who loved to read. She read big books, small books, and all kinds of books. Sue read every day and night. Reading made her very happy.

One day, Sue found a secret door in her house. She took a step inside and saw a big room full of books. The room was rich with colors, and the books were shiny and new. Sue was so excited to read them all.

Sue spent her days reading the books in the secret room. She read about animals, stars, and faraway places. The more Sue read, the more she learned. She became the smartest girl in her town, and everyone loved her stories.

Once, there was a brave boy who could write. He had a special pen, and he wrote about war. Everyday he wrote stories about the brave and successful people who took part in the war.

One day, the brave boy went to visit his grandpa.

"Grandpa, why do people go to war?" asked the boy.

"I'm not sure, my boy," said Grandpa. "But sometimes grownups don't know how to talk and they make fight instead."
 
The brave boy thought and thought, and then he said with a smile, "I will write stories about how to make peace and be successful."

And so the brave boy kept on writing. He wrote and wrote stories about how to be strong, brave, and successful without having to fight. He sent his stories out into the world, and they started to make a difference. 

The boy was proud of his stories and was happy to have helped others. The war was over and people had learned to talk instead of fight.

Mum and Dad smiled on Wednesday. Mum had a new dress on - it was graceful. Graceful is a nice word. When Mum twirled it was so funny. They all laughed.

Mum said they were going to do something special. She said it was a surprise. They all got in the car because they wanted to do it.

When they got to the park they had a picnic. Then they did something else. They went and played on the swings. Dad did the highest. He was graceful too.

When they had done that, they went back home. Mum gave them all a hug. Wednesday was a special day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and cuddle with her soft rug. But one day, her rug got old and dirty. Lily's mommy decided to buy her a new rug. Lily was excited and couldn't wait to see her new rug.

When the new rug arrived, Lily's mommy told her to be careful not to spill anything on it. Lily promised to take good care of it. She loved her new rug so much that she even slept on it. 

The next day, Lily's mommy spilled some juice on the rug by accident. Lily was sad and worried that her new rug was ruined. But her mommy knew how to clean it and the rug looked good as new again. Lily was happy and relieved that her new rug was okay. She knew that her mommy would always take care of her things.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, but he was sad because he didn't have a jet to play with. 

One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy had a jet toy that he brought with him. Timmy was very happy to see the jet and asked Billy if they could play with it together. 

But Billy was selfish and didn't want to share his jet with Timmy. Timmy felt sad and didn't know what to do. 

Then, Timmy had an idea. He asked Billy if they could build a jet together using their toy blocks. Billy thought it was a great idea and they started building. Soon, they had built the best jet ever! They both played with it and had so much fun together. 

From that day on, Timmy learned that sometimes when we work together and build something, it can be even better than if we had it all to ourselves.
