Once upon a time there was a mop. It was sad and lonely. It wanted to escape from its gloomy life.

One day, the mop decided to try running away. It had never tried running before, but it was determined to try.

The mop ran as fast as it could. But it was too slow and clumsy. Whenever the mop tried to escape, it would bump into things.

Finally, it stumbled through a door and found itself outside. The mop had finally escaped! The mop felt happy and free.

The mop could now explore the world and make new friends. The mop was never lonely or sad again!

Once upon a time, there was a boy. He was a very humble boy, who always tried his best. He wanted to improve so he went to school and studied every day. He learned about law, and how to follow the rules. He worked hard and stopped and listened when the teacher spoke. Every day, he was trying to improve.

Then one day, something amazing happened! He passed his law test with flying colors. Everyone was so proud of him. He was the top in the class.

The humble boy was so excited. He had improved so much and was really proud. He thanked his teacher, who said he was a very good student.

The boy kept trying to do his best, and he kept improving. He did a lot of good things, and he was always humble. He was a shining example of someone who had improved and followed the law. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, while playing hide-and-seek, Lily couldn't find her friend, Timmy. She looked all around the park, but he was nowhere to be found.

Just then, Lily's mom called her for lunch. She sat down and took a bite of her sandwich, but it tasted bland. She realized she forgot to add salt. She asked her mom if she could go inside and find the salt. Her mom said yes, and Lily ran inside.

As she looked for the salt, she heard a lively sound coming from the living room. She followed the sound and found Timmy hiding behind the couch. He had been playing a prank on her by hiding and making noise. Lily was happy to find her friend and they both laughed about the prank. From that day on, they made sure to always play together and never hide from each other again.

Once upon a time, there was a bad zoom. The zoom was so bad that it rotted. No-one wanted to play with the rotten zoom anymore. 

But one day, a nice little girl named Sally found the rotten zoom. She decided to keep it and make it better. She cleaned it and painted it. She worked on it all day long. 

Once she finished, it was beautiful! The zoom was so happy that it started to zoom all around the house! Sally was so glad that it was no longer rotten. 

The zoom was so happy, it never stopped zooming. From that day, Sally and the zoom were best friends. They had lots of fun zooming around the house together.

The end.

One day, Carl was walking around outside. It was a sunny day and Carl was happy. He saw a tall tree in the distance and ran over to it.

When he got to the tree Carl saw something funny. A big alligator was standing there, looking around. Carl smiled and said, "hello alligator!"

The alligator didn't answer. He was quiet and still. Carl was worried, so he stepped closer to the alligator and saw why he wasn't moving. The alligator was stuck in the tree! He must have been clumsy and fallen into it.

Carl knew he had to help. He searched around the tree for something to help him get the alligator out, but he could not find anything. Just then Carl noticed a stick leaning against the tree. He picked it up and stuck it between the alligator's tail and the tree. He wiggled the stick around until the alligator finally moved.

Carl had done it! The alligator thanked Carl for his help and said goodbye. Carl felt happy that he had been able to help. He watched the alligator walk away and smiled.

Once upon a time there was a bear named Bob. Bob loved the woods and enjoyed spending his days there. One day he was walking through the woods when he smelt something spicy. He followed the aroma until he came to a clearing where he found a small fire with a pot of something cooking on top.

Bob went over to have a closer look and said, "What's that?"
Bob heard a voice coming from the pot, "I'm stew! Come and enjoy some, it's very yummy!"

Bob was surprised and said, "Wow, stew!" He couldn't believe it was talking. So he decided to give it a try. Bob tasted the stew and it was so spicy and delicious that he could not help but enjoy it.

He thanked the stew for the delicious meal and said goodbye as he walked away, happy and full from his spicy adventure.

Bob was a stubborn little boy. He had a big red tractor. He was playing happily in his garden one day. Suddenly, his mum called him over. 
"Bob, can you reverse the tractor around the corner, please?" She asked. But Bob just shook his head.
"No way! I don't know how to reverse it," he said.
His mum smiled. "It's easy. All you need to do is make a turn. Like this!" 
She demonstrated and showed Bob how to reverse the tractor. Bob watched carefully. He got a few wrong turns, but finally he managed to reverse the tractor all the way around the corner.
His mum praised him. "Well done, Bob!"
Bob was proud that he had been so stubborn and managed to reverse the tractor. He beamed with pride and jumped into his tractor.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was called Bill and the other was called Bob. Bill had a job, but Bob didn't have one.

Bill wanted to help Bob find a job, so he went to talk to him. Bill asked Bob what he wanted to do and Bob thought for a while. Then Bob said he wanted to be a doctor.

Bill was happy and said he would talk to someone to help Bob get a job as a doctor.

But days went by and nobody gave Bob a job. Bob started to feel very sad.

Then one day someone called Bob and said they would give him a job as a doctor!

Bob was so happy and thanked Bill for helping him.

Since then they've been best friends, and they still talk together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little girl named Lily. She liked to play with her toys and watch the stars shine at night. One day, her mommy took her to the gym. The gym was a big room with lots of toys to play with. Lily was scared at first, but she soon saw other kids playing and she wanted to join in. She played and ran around until she was tired. When they left the gym, Lily saw the sun shine bright outside. She smiled and felt happy. From then on, she was not so shy anymore and wanted to go to the gym every day.

One day, a small boy was walking in the park with his mom. He heard a loud noise and looked around to see what had happened. All of a sudden, a flame suddenly burst from the ground. The boy was so scared he started to cry.

His mom quickly ran to him and tried to calm him down. She said, â€œItâ€™s ok, everything is going to be alright.â€ She then reached down and released a big red balloon into the sky. The balloon floated away, taking the flame with it.

The boy was so happy to see the flame disappear that he jumped up and down and laughed. His mom smiled and said, â€œSee? Everything is ok.â€ The boy grinned and hugged his mom tightly.

The flame had been released, but the loud noise had been replaced by laughter and joy.

Once upon a time there was a jungle. It was full of different animals. Every day they wanted to go for a swim. But the water was dirty.

They decided to ask the elephant to help. He was very big and strong. He took the animals to a lake.

The animals started to play in the lake. They splashed and had lots of fun. The elephant looked for a big stone. He used it to wash the animals. He scrubbed them with the stone.

After the animals were washed, the jungle was happy again. The animals went back to the jungle and played all day. They were so happy that the elephant had helped to wash them.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and loved to have yogurt. Every day her mum would give her a big cup of yogurt for breakfast.

Lucy really loved the yogurt. Every morning she would get so excited to eat it and she would always tell her mum she thought it was "great".

One day, something very unexpected happened. Lucy got to the table, but there was no yogurt! She looked at her mum, very surprised and asked "Where's the yogurt?". Her mum explained that they had run out.

Lucy was a bit sad, but then she remembered something. She asked her mum, "Can I make yogurt?". She said it was a great idea, so they got all the things they needed to make a yummy yogurt.

When they finally finished, Lucy was so happy. She had made her own yogurt. Every morning from then on she would make the yogurt and feel very proud of herself. 

She will always remember the day she made yogurt with her mum.

John and Mary were playing in the park. Mary was very excited about all of the different colors of the flowers.

"Look, John! This flower is purple and this one is red," said Mary.

"Wow, those look so different," said John.

John and Mary went inside and Mary saw a big curtain hung on the wall. She went up to it and touched it.

"What is this, John?" said Mary.

"That is a curtain," said John. "We can pull it to make our room dark so we can rest in the evening."

Mary smiled. She liked how different the curtain looked and was excited to rest beneath it. 

John, Mary and their parents pulled the curtain shut every night. They all felt warm and cozy, and were able to rest peacefully until morning.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty dress that fit her just right. One day, while playing outside, she fell and got a scrape on her knee. Her mommy came to her and wiped the blood away with a soft cloth. Then she gave her a kiss on the boo-boo to make it feel better. Lily was so happy to have such a loving mommy. From that day on, she made sure to be careful when playing outside.

Little Jimmy was feeling lucky. He had on his favorite pants - his blue corduroys. They always made him feel special and excited.

He wanted to show off his pants to his friend, Sally. So, he ran over to her house and knocked on the door. 

"Come in, Jimmy! Let me see your lucky pants!" Sally said.

Jimmy turned around to show her and was excited when Sally gave him a big thumbs up.

"Let's play number games together!" Sally said.

Jimmy smiled and the two friends grabbed two chairs, lined them up, and started counting.

They shouted out the numbers together and when they got to 10, they jumped up in excitement!

"That was so much fun, Sally!" Jimmy shouted. 

Jimmy hugged Sally goodbye and gave her one last look at his lucky pants. "See you tomorrow!" he said as he ran off to play.

Once upon a time there was a dependable man named Mr. Smith. He had a very important job. Everyday, Mr. Smith would get up early and go to work. His job was to mail cereal every day. 

One day, Mr. Smith was getting ready for work and he noticed that his cereal was running low. "Oh no! I need to get more cereal for work today!" he exclaimed. 

Mr. Smith put on his shoes and coat and grabbed his mail bag. He walked to the grocery store and asked the cashier for a box of cereal. The cashier said, "Of course! Here you go Mr. Smith." 

Mr. Smith happily thanked the cashier and walked back to work. He was glad he could be dependable to his job. He filled up his mail bag with the cereal and set off mailing it to all its special destinations. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat grapes, they were her favorite fruit. One day, she went to the store with her mommy to buy some grapes. Her mommy asked her how many grapes she wanted, and Lily said, "I want a big number of grapes!" 

When they got home, Lily noticed that her little brother, Max, was struggling with his puzzle. Lily knew that Max was very intelligent, so she decided to help him. She showed him how to put the puzzle pieces together and Max was so happy that he gave Lily a grape as a thank you. 

Lily was so happy that she helped her brother and got a grape as a reward. She ate the grape and felt very satisfied. From that day on, Lily always wanted to help others and share her grapes with them.

One day, Lily and Tom went to the park with their mom. They saw many flowers and trees and birds. They liked to run and play and laugh.

They found a big fountain that sprayed water high in the air. It made a rainbow in the sun. Lily and Tom wanted to touch the water. They ran to the fountain and put their hands in the spray. It was cold and wet and fun.

But then, a bee came near the fountain. It was black and yellow and had a rough body. It buzzed and flew around the water. Lily and Tom did not like the bee. They were scared of the bee. They thought the bee would sting them.

"Mom, mom, help!" they cried. "There is a bee! It is scary!"

Mom heard them and came to the fountain. She saw the bee and smiled. She was not scared of the bee. She knew the bee was not bad. She knew the bee liked the flowers and the water.

"Don't worry, Lily and Tom," she said. "The bee is not scary. The bee is just thirsty. The bee wants to drink some water. The bee will not hurt you. The bee is your friend."

She took a bottle of water from her bag and sprayed some water on the flowers near the fountain. The bee saw the water and flew to the flowers. It drank some water and then flew away.

"See?" Mom said. "The bee is happy. The bee says thank you. The bee is gone. You can play with the water again."

Lily and Tom looked at the flowers and the water and the bee. They understood what Mom said. They were not scared of the bee anymore. They were happy too.

They said thank you to Mom and to the bee. They played with the water again. They had a good day at the park.

Mommy had a problem with her brush. It was broken! She needed it to fix her hair. Mommy was sad, but then Grandma said she could help. Grandma had a special tool to fix the brush. She worked very hard and soon the brush was fixed! 
Mommy was so happy now. She wanted to do something special for Grandma, so she made her favorite food. It was tasty! They both ate until their bellies were full and giggled together. 
Mommy hugged Grandma and thanked her for fixing the brush. Together, they went outside and enjoyed the beautiful day. 

The end.

Once there was an oak tree standing by itself in the middle of a field. It had been there for a long time and it was very proud.

One day, a stupid boy came running up to the oak tree. He wanted to climb the tree, but the tree said no. The boy refused to listen and he started to climb up the tree. 

The boy didn't realize how slippery the bark was and he started to slip. He slipped all the way down to the ground and he felt so embarrassed. He started to cry, and the oak tree felt bad.

The boy looked up at the oak tree and started to regret what he had done. He apologized to the tree and promised never to climb it again. 

The oak tree forgave him and the boy walked away, feeling much happier than before. The oak tree was proud that he had remembered his promise and never regretted it.

Sam was in the living room with his mom. He saw a big frame hanging on the wall. He asked his mom, "What's in the frame?" She smiled and said, "It's a picture of your little brother when he was a baby!" Sam loved his little brother and he wanted to see the picture up close. 

So his mom carefully took down the frame and set it on the floor. Sam thought his brother looked so sweet and he said, "He's so cute!" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, he sure is!"

But then Sam noticed something in the corner of the picture. It was an old sour lemon! He giggled and said, "What's that doing there?" His mom laughed and said, "That's just a silly joke your grandma put in there to surprise us!" Sam couldn't believe it. 

He thought it was so funny! He hopped up and down and said, "Let's put the frame back so I can show my little brother what grandma did!" His mom smiled and said, "Okay, let's hang it back up on the wall and show him together!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and cuddle with her velvet blanket. One day, Lily's mom baked some sweet cookies and offered her one.

Lily took a bite and said, "Mmm, this is so sweet!" Her mom replied, "Yes, it is. But remember, too many sweets are not good for you."

Lily nodded and continued to play with her toys. Suddenly, her little brother came and started to poke her. Lily got angry and wanted to poke him back, but then she remembered what her mom said about being kind to others.

So, Lily took a deep breath and said, "Please don't poke me. Let's play nicely together." Her brother smiled and they played together happily ever after. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a big red ball that she liked to play with every day. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't want to, but she knew it was important to listen to her mommy. So, she picked up her ball and put it in the toy box. 

Later that day, Lily's daddy came home from work. He was very happy because he had a success at his job. Lily didn't know what that meant, but she could tell her daddy was happy. He picked her up and gave her a big hug. 

Before bed, Lily's mommy and daddy read her a story. As they were reading, the phone started to ring. It was someone calling for Lily's daddy. He answered the phone and talked for a little while. When he hung up, he said it was just a regular phone call. 

Lily fell asleep with her favorite stuffed animal, feeling happy and loved.

Once there were two twins, Jack and Jill. Jack was very rude, always pushing Jill and grabbing the toys from her. Today, the two were playing in their playroom and Jill was getting very frustrated. She asked Jack, "Why are you so rude?"

Jack answered, "Because I want to win!"

Jill replied, "But why? Winning doesn't mean you have to be rude!"

Jack thought for a minute and then said, "I'm sorry. I won't be rude anymore."

Jill smiled and hugged her twin, happy that he had given her an answer. They went back to playing together and had a great time!

Once there was a small boy who really wanted a cow. He asked his mom and dad, but they said no. So, he decided to search for one by himself. He looked in the farm fields and in the village, but there were no cows anywhere. Feeling sad, he started to walk home.

Suddenly, he heard something rustling in the tall grass. He crept carefully over and peered around the corner to see what it was. He couldn't believe his eyes! There was a small cow, nibbling away on some grass.

He was so excited! He quickly took the cow back to his home and told his mom and dad the exciting news. His parents were so surprised that he had found a cow all by himself! From now on, the little boy and his cow were good friends, and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time a little boat was floating in the middle of the sea. It had a happy family onboard who were singing and playing together. Suddenly, the family noticed that the wind was blowing strongly and the waves around them were becoming bigger and bigger. 

The father knew he must act quickly and he shouted to the family to take action. He told them to take out the anchor, a heavy object they used to keep the boat in one spot, and to tie it tight. 

He urged everyone to work together to get the anchor ready. After a few minutes, they had the anchor ready. It worked and the boat was no longer moving around as the happy family looked up at the dark clouds in the sky. 

The moral of this story is that it is important to work together if you want to solve a problem and stay safe. Working together is the best way to use everyone's strength and make sure everyone is safe.

Once upon a time there was a fat cat who wanted to get inside the chimney. The cat had never been inside and was very excited. She scratched at the door, but it wouldn't open.

The cat looked around and saw a friendly bird flying by. The bird was happy to help the cat. He asked the cat why she wanted to go inside the chimney. The cat said she wanted to explore.

So the bird provided a feather for the cat. The feather was thick and long. The cat took the feather and poked it into the chimney. The feather made a big hole and the cat was able to get inside.

The cat was so excited. She explored the chimney, running around and climbing up the walls. After a while, she realized it was getting dark outside, so she went back outside. 

The cat thanked the bird for providing the feather that allowed her to explore the chimney. The bird was happy to help and they both went on their way.

One day, Andy was playing in the park. The day was sunny and it was a perfect day for playing. Andy heard a loud engine. It sounded like it belonged to a car. Andy was curious and he looked around. He saw a wide car. It was blue and shiny.

Andy wanted to go explore the car. He took a step closer, but he couldn't figure out how to open the doors. He heard someone getting out of the car. It was a strange man. The man looked angry and he was coming closer.

Andy was scared and he ran away. He had to be quick. He didn't want the man to catch him. Andy ran faster and faster. Suddenly, he could see his house. He heard the engine start up again and he knew the man was chasing him.

Andy jumped the gate and ran into his house. The man was gone and Andy was safe. He was happy to hear the sound of his mom and dad in the house. Andy was glad he was able to escape the wide car and strange man.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog. He liked to run and play with his friends. One day, he got tired and needed to rest. He found a cozy spot under a big tree and lay down. While he was resting, he noticed a mark on his paw. It was a little scratch, but it didn't hurt. 

After resting for a while, the friendly dog got up and went to find his friends again. They were happy to see him and asked why he had been gone for so long. The friendly dog told them about his scratch and how he needed to rest. His friends were glad he was feeling better and they all played together again. The end.

Once there was a cat named Puss who was very troubled. His owner wanted to help but didn't know what to do. So he decided to take Puss to see the veterinarian. 

The veterinarian said to the owner, "Puss is not feeling well. I think you should borrow some medicine from me so he can start feeling better."

The owner was overjoyed and said, "Thank you, veterinarian! I will borrow some of your medicine right away." He then took the medicine back home and gave it to Puss.

In no time at all, Puss started to feel better. He thanked the owner and the veterinarian for helping him. From then on, Puss was his cheerful, happy self again.

Once upon a time, a quiet farmer lived in a small house. He loved the outdoors, so he worked hard in his garden. Every day he would tie his plants carefully to the fence to help them grow.

One warm summer day, the farmer was in his garden tying some new plants when he heard a voice asking for help. "Hello, can you help me?" asked the voice. The farmer looked down and saw a small bug who couldn't reach the top of a plant.

The farmer smiled and said, "Yes, I can help." He bent down, grabbed some string and gently tied it around the plant. Then he helped the bug climb inside the loop so it could reach the top.

The bug thanked the farmer and said, "Thank you so much! You are very kind." The farmer said, "You're welcome," and continued on with his work.

The next day, the farmer found the little bug at the same spot, this time with some of its bug friends. The farmer smiled and waved before getting back to work. He knew the little bug was in good hands!

Once upon a time, there was a happy doll. She was made of soft yarn, with bright blue eyes, and a bright red nose. Her best friend was a little boy named Tommy.

Every day Tommy and his doll would play together. Tommy would hold her in his hand and listen to her stories. Sometimes they would go for a walk, or play pretend.

Today Tommy decided that he would take his doll for a special treat. He grabbed a bag full of tasty treats, like apple slices and honey sticks.

The two friends took the treats to the park, and Tommy lay the bag down on the grass. Then the doll watched as Tommy started to chew on his treat. She wanted to try too! So Tommy gave the doll a honey stick and she was so delighted.

She happily started to chew it, and soon she had finished the whole thing. With a smile on her face, she thanked Tommy for the treat. The two friends laughed and played until it was time to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, especially in the forest near her house. One day, her friend Jack came to visit her. 

"Let's go play in the forest!" said Lily.

"Okay!" said Jack, excitedly.

They ran through the forest, picking flowers and chasing butterflies. Suddenly, they saw a big pile of garbage on the ground. 

"Oh no, someone spoiled the forest!" said Lily, looking sad.

"We should clean it up," said Jack.

So, they picked up all the garbage and threw it away. They felt happy that they helped the forest. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to take care of the environment and not litter. Also, it's good to have friends who help you do good things.

Once upon a time, there was a brave hero who had an important mission to deliver. He was given a big box, and the box was zero. He had to make sure it got to its destination perfectly.

So the brave hero set off on his journey. He walked, he hopped, he skipped a lot too. But soon he got very tired and felt like he had a long way left to go.

But then a magical thing happened. Just as he started to get really tired, something landed in front of him. It was a giant bird! The giant bird said "Hop on my back and I will deliver the zero box to your destination."

The brave hero was so happy that he hopped straight onto the giant bird's back. He held the box tightly and the giant bird flew off. Soon they arrived at their destination and delivered the box perfectly. 

The brave hero was very impressed with the perfect job the giant bird did, and thanked him for his help. They both flew off in different directions and the brave hero went back home feeling very proud of himself. The end.

Billy and Jane were walking in the park. Jane looked at the wind blowing around them. "It's so cold!" she complained. "And it's making me so cold!"

Billy nodded and said, "It can be really chilly when the wind blows. Let's go over there and sit by the pond." They walked over and saw the ducks swimming around in the pond.

Jane noticed the water bubbling. She liked the bubbles. "Look at the bubbles, Billy!" she said. But Billy was too busy complaining about the wind. "It's so cold! I wish the wind would stop," he said.

Jane smiled and wrapped her coat tightly around her shoulders. "Let's go home, Billy. We can play inside," she said. Billy stopped complaining and they walked home together.

Once upon a time there were two friends walking through the forest. Their names were Bob and Jane. 

Bob and Jane were very brave, but they felt helpless when they heard a strange noise coming from the bushes. It was noon, and they wanted to see what was making the noise. 

Slowly, Bob and Jane approached the bush. Suddenly, they saw a small, scared animal. It was a baby fox. 

Bob said, "I'm going to hold the fox; it's probably scared and needs help." He lifted it up gently and said, "Don't worry, I'll take you home." 

Jane smiled and said they could take the fox to Bob's house. When they got there, Bob and Jane put the fox in a safe place and gave it food and water. 

Bob and Jane were glad they found the helpless fox and were able to help it. From then on, Bob and Jane were the fox's best friends.

The chubby boy was playing in his room. He saw a light high up on the wall. He wanted to reach it, so he started to climb.

The boy's mom came in and said,"What are you doing?"

The boy replied, "I'm trying to reach the light!"

His mom smiled and said, "That's a great idea, but it's too high up. Let me help you."

She picked up the boy and moved him closer to the light. The boy smiled as he reached out and touched it. He was so happy to have reached the light.

The mom asked, "What are you going to do now?"

The boy replied, "I'm going to climb down now!" His mom laughed and helped him down. 

The boy was so proud of himself for reaching the light. It was a very special moment for him.

The ocean was calm and beautiful. There were lots of fish in the water and they were swimming around and having a great time. Suddenly, an octopus started to splash in the water. It was so happy! The octopus was loyal to its friends, and they all wanted to hang out together. 

The octopus started to play a game with the other fish. It would splash near them, and the fish would swim away really fast. It was so funny! The fish loved the game, and the octopus was very proud of being loyal.

The fish kept swimming away from the octopus each time it splashed, but they eventually realized that the octopus was only playing. They all swam back to the octopus and surrounded it in a big circle. They started to splish and splash together and have lots of fun.

The octopus was so happy and loyal to its new friends. All the fish learned that having a loyal friend can be the best thing in the world!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mimi. She was very excited because her mom told her it was time to eat. Her mom had made her favorite food - rice! With a big smile, Mimi opened her lunch box and began to eat.

But suddenly, Mimi stopped. She remembered that she had to go to school now. She was very upset and started to cry.

Mimi's mom smiled and said: "Don't worry sweetie, you can finish it later. Let me remind you when you come home. Ok?"

Mimi nodded and wiped away her tears. With a smile, she hugged her mom goodbye and left for school.

When Mimi came home, her mom reminded her: "Hey Mimi, don't forget to eat your rice!"

Mimi gave her mom a big hug and thanked her. She was no longer upset and finished her rice with a happy smile.

Sam was a 3 year old who loved to explore. One day he decided to take a walk in the woods by himself. As he walked, he saw something weird at the side of a tree. He went closer and saw it was a brush. He asked his mom if he could take it and she said yes.

But when he took it in his hands, he noticed it was a magical brush! Sam was so excited he started jumping and laughing. He couldn't believe he had found such an amazing thing.

He asked, "Mom, what is this thing?"

Mom smiled and said, "That, my child, is a magical brush! It makes anything you wish come true!"

Sam couldn't believe his ears. He said with a smile, "Let's try it then!" and started waving the brush around.

And from that day on, strange and wonderful things started happening around Sam. It was all because of his magical brush!

Once upon a time there was a mama and a baby. Mama and baby needed to get something very important for dinner. So, Mama put on her coat and took the baby out for a walk. They went to the store and Mama bought some soup. 

When they got home, Mama started to cook the soup. It smelled yummy! The baby was getting very hungry and wanted to eat the soup right away! 

But Mama said no. She said they needed to wait. After a while, the soup was ready to eat! Mama put the soup on the table, and the baby came closer to have a taste. 

The baby thought the soup was delicious! Mama said the soup was very important for the baby's health. The baby thanked Mama for making the soup. 

And she knew that Mama always looks after her. Mama and baby ate the soup together, and it was the best supper ever!

Once upon a time there was a family of five. Mom and dad, and three little kids, who were all very happy.

One day, dad took the kids out to the park. They played so hard that dad was so sleepy he fell asleep on the grass! But the kids were so excited, they didn't want to leave yet.

The sun started to go down, and the sky began to glow. It was so beautiful! The kids danced and laughed. Then, suddenly, it got dark and the kids remembered that it was time to go home.

They were so sorry to leave, but mom and dad were waiting for them. They all hugged and laughed, and walked home together as the stars glowed. Mom and dad were so proud of their family.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Shawn. Shawn wanted to play outside, but it was raining. She asked her mummy, "Can I go play in the rain?" Mummy said, "No, Shawn, it's bad out there. You need to stay inside or you'll get very wet."

Shawn was disappointed but she stayed inside. She looked out the window and watched the rain. She watched it for a long time and then asked her mummy, "When will the rain stop?"
Mummy smiled and said, "When the clouds remain no more, it will stop raining." Shawn waited and waited, but the clouds remained. The bad rain kept coming down.

Shawn asked again and again, until finally, the rain stopped falling and the clouds went away. Now the sun came out and the sky was blue. Shawn was so happy â€“ she ran outside to enjoy the nice weather. And they lived happily ever after!

Once there was a lady who had a high face. Every day she would tell the sun good morning and the stars goodnight. One day she saw a big white bird flying over her. She told it hello and it sang back. She laughed and smiled. 

Then she felt something tickling her face. She saw some high clouds in the sky and smiled. Suddenly she heard a voice telling her to look down. It was a tiny mouse who wanted to tell her something. The mouse said, "I love your face and I want to be your friend".

The lady was so happy, she gave the mouse a big hug and thanked him. They played together until the sun started to set. The lady waved goodbye to the mouse and told him to come back soon.

The lady smiled. She was so happy to have a new friend. From then on, she always had a high face.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to go camping with his family. One day, Timmy and his family went to a campsite near the woods. They set up a tent and made a fire to cook their dinner. 

Timmy's dad said, "Timmy, be careful around the fire. It can burn you." Timmy nodded his head and said, "I will be careful, Dad." 

After dinner, Timmy and his family went for a walk in the woods. They saw a big, clear lake and decided to go for a swim. Timmy splashed around in the water and had so much fun. 

Later that night, they went back to their tent and sat around the fire. Timmy's mom said, "It's getting late, we should go to bed." Timmy said, "I don't want to go to bed, I want to stay up and watch the fire burn." His dad replied, "Okay, but only for a little while." Timmy watched the fire burn until he fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a bear. He was walking through the forest, looking for some honey to eat.But then, he started to sneeze. He sneezed and sneezed, until he was so tired. 

The bear looked around and saw some bushes. He went over to them, hoping he could rest there. But the bushes had some harsh thorns on them, so the bear started to sneeze again. 

He sneezed and sneezed until he quickly left the forest. The bear was so happy to be out of that harsh forest. He kept walking until he found a big, beautiful field with lots of sweet wildflowers. 

The bear was so happy that he found the field. He sat down and ate some of the sweet-smelling wildflowers. He felt so much better and decided that this was where he would live from now on.

Tummy the Cat was always very eager to explore and discover new things, so one day he decided to take a journey to outer space. He hopped into a rocket and kept going higher and higher until he eventually arrived on the moon. He stepped onto the moon and was amazed at what he saw, so he decided he needed to explore it even more.

Suddenly, he spotted a small oxygen tank lying on the ground. He wanted to pick it up and bring it back to Earth with him, so he lifted it up and tucked it under his arm. He couldn't believe how light it was - he thought it was going to be much heavier. 

But just as he was about to take off in his rocket, he heard someone shout, â€œWait!â€

He looked around and saw a small astronaut floating towards him. The astronaut thanked Tummy for finding their Oxygen tank and introduced themselves as Helio. Helio explained that their oxygen was running very low and they were in need of a top up.

Tummy was very kind and offered Helio some of the oxygen from the tank. Helio was thankful and thanked Tummy before they each continued on their own journey. 

Tummy went back home with a smile. He was proud of himself for helping the small astronaut.

Anna and Ben are young twins who like to play in the forest. They have a big dog named Max who follows them everywhere. One day, they see a wolf hiding behind a tree. The wolf is hungry and wants to eat them.

"Look, Ben, a wolf!" Anna says, pointing at the tree.

"Let's run away, Anna!" Ben says, feeling scared.

But Max is brave and strong. He barks loudly and runs towards the wolf. He wants to prevent the wolf from hurting Anna and Ben. The wolf sees Max and feels afraid. He runs away too, looking for easier food.

"Good boy, Max!" Anna and Ben say, hugging their dog. "You saved us from the wolf!"

They go back home and tell their mom and dad what happened. Their mom and dad are proud of Max and give him a big bone. Anna and Ben give him lots of cuddles. They are happy to have Max as their friend.

One day, a small boy called Jack and his dad were walking along the beach. Suddenly, Jack spotted something in the sand. It was a toy pirate! He felt very happy and proud. He asked his dad, "Can I keep it?" His dad smiled and replied, "Yes, of course!"

Jack held the pirate close to his chest, as he was so proud to be the owner of such a cool toy. He hugged it and smiled.

He and his dad decided to go and explore the beach. Jack carried his pirate wherever he went, feeling proud and happy with his new toy.

Near the end of the day, they heard a loud noise. It was the sound of a real pirate ship! The ship was sailing along the sea and was full of pirates, who were singing a pirate song.

Jack felt so excited and proud. He excitedly held his toy pirate up to the real pirates and shouted, "Look at my pirate!" The real pirates waved and shouted back, "Ahoy matey!"

Jack was so excited that he felt like dancing. He happily held his toy pirate up high and started twirling around the beach. His dad laughed and said, "You look so proud, Jack!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a thin body and loved to hug her mom. One day, Lily's mom bought her a red apple. The apple looked good, but it started to rot. Lily's mom said, "Don't eat the apple, it's bad." But Lily didn't listen and took a big bite. She said, "Yum, it's delicious!" 

Later that night, Lily started to feel sick. Her tummy hurt and she didn't feel good. Her mom asked her, "Did you eat the bad apple?" Lily said, "Yes, but it tasted good." Her mom hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, sweetie. We should have thrown it away." 

Lily felt worse and worse. Her mom called the doctor, but it was too late. Lily had eaten too much of the bad apple and her tummy couldn't handle it. She had to go to the hospital and stay there for a long time. Lily learned that she should listen to her mom and not eat bad things.

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy called Jack. He liked to play in the garden, and laugh with his friends.

One day, Jack was in the garden, looking for a flower when he saw a butterfly. It was quick, and it flew around in circles. Jack wanted to catch it, but he couldn't reach it. He tried and tried, but he only made it more scared. 

Suddenly, out of nowhere, a frog hopped up to Jack and spoke. "Why don't you strike the butterfly?" Jack was amazed and asked, "Why?" The frog said, "It's harmless, so you won't hurt it." 

Jack thought that this was a good idea so he tried it out. He reached in with his hands, and struck the butterfly softly. Suddenly, the butterfly landed in his hands. Jack was happy, and couldn't believe it! He had caught the butterfly!

Once upon a time there was a boy who was very tired. Every night he was very sleepy, but his dreams seemed so far away.

One night he decided to try and get to them faster. He closed his eyes and counted to three. He felt like he was flying through the air.

It was very quick, and he soon saw his dreams. They were so far away, but he could almost touch them. He began to reach out.

But then, just as he was about to touch his dreams, he heard a loud noise. He opened his eyes and his dreams were gone. He was back in his bed, fast asleep. He would never reach them.

Once upon a time, there was a car with four wheels. It was a red car and it loved to go fast. One day, the car was driving on a bumpy road when suddenly one of its wheels fell off! The car was sad because it couldn't move anymore.

Luckily, a kind man saw the car and wanted to help. He was very careful as he put the wheel back on the car. The car was happy again and started to drive away. But then, it saw a friend who needed help too. The friend's car was stuck in the mud and couldn't move.

The red car knew it had to serve its friend and help it get out of the mud. So, it drove up to the friend's car and pushed it from behind. Together, the two cars were able to get out of the mud and continue on their journey. The end.

Gabby was very excited to go to school. She put on her new uniform, and her mom told her how wonderful she looked. The uniform was very nice - it was red and had a nice, shiny badge on it.

At school, everyone was wearing uniforms just like Gabby. She smiled, because she felt so good in her new clothes. Her teacher was very kind and encouraged her to learn new things. She especially liked learning new songs.

At lunch, Gabby noticed some of the other kids had their own snacks. Their snacks looked so good, so Gabby asked her teacher if she could have some. Her teacher said "Yes", and her classmates announced, "Gabby has rich snacks today".

Soon, Gabby gained more confidence in learning. Her teacher was very encouraging, and she was learning lots of new things. Everyone was impressed with how well she was doing. 

She was happy that her uniform made her feel special, and that her teacher encouraged her to do her best. At the end of the day, Gabby was proud of all the things she had learned.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very hungry and wanted to eat her lunch. Her mommy made her a yummy sandwich and packed it in a brown bag. Lily was so happy!

After eating her lunch, Lily wanted to draw a picture. She asked her mommy for some paper and crayons. Her mommy gave her some paper and told her to print her name at the top of the page. Lily tried her best to print her name, but it was a little messy.

Suddenly, Lily heard a loud noise outside. She looked out the window and saw a big truck driving by. The noise was so loud that it made her ears feel deaf. Lily covered her ears and waited for the truck to pass. After it was gone, she went back to drawing her picture. The end.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. But sometimes they fight over who gets what. One day, they both want the same blanket. It is a big, soft blanket with stars and moons on it.

Anna says, "I want the blanket! It is mine!" Ben says, "No, I want the blanket! It is mine!" They pull and tug on the blanket. They yell and cry. Mom hears them and comes to see what is wrong.

Mom says, "Stop fighting, Anna and Ben. You can share the blanket. It is big enough for both of you. Why don't you take turns or use it together?" Anna and Ben ignore Mom. They keep pulling and tugging on the blanket. They do not listen to Mom.

Mom says, "Fine. If you do not want to share, then no one gets the blanket. I will take it away." She takes the blanket from Anna and Ben and puts it in the closet. Anna and Ben are sad and angry. They do not have the blanket anymore.

They sit on the floor and pout. They do not talk to each other. They do not play with their toys or books. They are bored and lonely. They wish they had the blanket. It is hot in the room. They feel sweaty and sticky. They miss the blanket. It is cool and cozy.

They look at each other. They feel sorry. They say, "I am sorry, Anna." "I am sorry, Ben." They hug and make up. They go to Mom and say, "We are sorry, Mom. We want to share the blanket. Can we have it back, please?" Mom smiles and says, "Of course. I am glad you learned your lesson. Sharing is caring." She gives them the blanket. They say, "Thank you, Mom." They take the blanket and go to their room. They spread the blanket on the bed. They lie down on the blanket. They snuggle and giggle. They are happy and sleepy. They fall asleep on the blanket. The end.

Sam and Mia liked to play with water in the garden. They had a big hose that could spray water everywhere. They also had a bucket, some cups and a towel.

One day, they decided to make a water show for their mom. They took turns to spray water in the air and catch it with the cups. They made funny noises and faces as they did it.

"Look, mom, look!" Sam shouted. "I can spray water very high!"

"That's impressive, Sam!" mom said. "But be careful not to spray Mia!"

But Sam was too excited and he sprayed Mia by mistake. Mia got wet and cold. She was not happy.

"Hey, that's not fair!" Mia cried. "You sprayed me!"

"I'm sorry, Mia, I'm sorry!" Sam said. "Here, take the towel and dry yourself."

Mia took the towel and wrapped it around her. She was still a bit angry, but she forgave Sam. They hugged and said sorry to each other.

Mom smiled and clapped her hands. She was proud of her children. She said they did a great water show. She gave them a big hug and a cookie. They were happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play pretend. She would pretend to be a fairy, a princess, or a superhero. One day, Lily found a message in a bottle. It said, "Be kind to others and always tell the truth."

Lily didn't understand the message at first. She thought it was normal to sometimes tell little lies. But then she remembered how she felt when someone told her a lie. It made her sad and confused. So, Lily decided to always tell the truth and be kind to others.

As she grew up, Lily never forgot the message in the bottle. She realized that being kind and truthful was not only important, but it also made her feel happy inside. And that's how Lily learned that sometimes the most important lessons can come from pretending.

Little Jane was looking out the window. She saw a pink sail on the horizon. Jane thought it was so pretty. She wanted to examine it closer, so she opened the door and ran outside.

When she got closer, Jane saw the sail was not just pink, but also really big. She tried to climb up to it, but it was too tall. Jane ran back inside to get help.

Just as Jane was about to return, she slipped and fell into the sea! Jane yelled for help but no one heard her. She tried to swim to the sail, but it was too far away and she was too tired.

Little Jane was never seen again. The only thing that was found was a pink sail in the sea.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One was a very elderly man, and the other was a little girl. They were walking together through the park. Suddenly, the girl said, "Look! There's a laser! I want to go catch it!" She started running.

The elderly man said, "Wait! You have to hurry!" So the girl ran even faster. She was so excited to catch the laser!

When the girl got close to the laser, it was spinning around in a circle. She reached out and caught it. She was so happy!

The elderly man smiled and said, "Good job! Now we have to hurry back home." So they both ran back home and the girl took her new laser with her. She hugged the elderly man goodbye and thanked him for helping her catch the laser. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a very adorable purse that she loved to carry around everywhere she went. One day, Lily's mom told her they were going on a trip to visit her grandma. 

Lily was so excited! She ran to her room to pack her favorite toys and clothes in her purse. "Mommy, can I pack my teddy bear in my purse too?" Lily asked. "Of course, sweetie," her mom replied. 

Lily carefully packed her teddy bear and all her other things in her purse. "I'm ready to go now!" Lily said, holding her purse tightly. "Okay, let's go," her mom said with a smile. 

Lily and her mom went on their trip and had a wonderful time. Lily was so happy she brought her adorable purse and teddy bear with her. When they got back home, Lily couldn't wait to show her friends all the fun things she packed in her purse.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful family who lived in a big house. They enjoyed playing together and often talked about their history. The family was very kind, and helped one another whenever they could.

One day, the family wanted to play a game. They found some matching cards and arranged them on the floor to play. Everyone worked together to find the right matches and the family laughed a lot.

The mother said to her daughter, "Look how cheerful we are! This has been a day to remember in our history!" Everyone smiled at the mother, and the girl smiled the biggest of all.

The family continued to play the matching game together until the sun went down. They all agreed it was the best way to spend the day and vowed to play the same game again soon.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play together. One day, they see a big house. The house is busy. Many cars and people go in and out. Lily and Ben want to see the house.

"Let's go inside the house," Lily says.

"No, we can't. The house is not for us. It is for grown-ups. They have work to do," Ben says.

But Lily does not listen. She runs to the house. Ben follows her. He is scared. He does not want to get in trouble.

They sneak into the house. They see many rooms and things. They touch and play with the things. They make a lot of noise. They do not see the grown-ups.

But the grown-ups see them. They are angry. They yell at Lily and Ben. They call their parents. They say Lily and Ben are bad. They say they have to pay for the things they broke.

Lily and Ben are very sorry. They cry. They wish they did not go inside the house. They wish they listened to Ben. They are in big trouble. They have no more fun. The end.

Once there was a girl named Ali. She was three years old. One day she wanted to take a bath. She filled up the tub with water and jumped in. It felt so good! She used lots of bubbles and played with her toys until she got tired.

After her bath, Ali went to her room. There, she opened up her treasure box. Inside was a shiny trophy. She had won it for being the best dancer at the talent show. It was very expensive and she was very proud of it.

The next day, Ali went to the park to play with her friends. She was so happy that she had her trophy to show them. That night, after a long day, Ali got ready for bed. She took another bath and washed her trophy until it was sparkly clean.

Ali was proud of her trophy and she knew she had worked hard to get it. She was excited to show it off to her friends and show them how special it was.

Once upon a time, there was a vine. The vine was very friendly and liked to make friends with all the animals in the forest. Every day, the vine would bloom and show its beautiful flowers to all its friends. 

One day, a rabbit came to the vine and said, "I don't have any friends. Can I be your friend?" The vine smiled and said, "Of course, you can be my friend!" The rabbit was very happy and they became good friends.

But one day, the rabbit got scared by a loud noise and ran away from the vine. The vine was sad and didn't understand why the rabbit left. Then, the vine realized that sometimes, even the best of friends can get scared and run away. So, the vine decided to be patient and wait for the rabbit to come back. 

Finally, the rabbit came back and apologized for running away. The vine forgave the rabbit and they became friends again. The moral of the story is that even if a friend runs away, you should be patient and forgive them because true friends always come back.

Ben and Sam were brothers who liked to play with boats. They had a big toy boat that they could sail in the pond. They took turns to steer the boat and make it go fast or slow.

One day, they found a shiny coin in the grass. It was money! They both wanted to keep it. Ben said, "It is mine! I saw it first!" Sam said, "No, it is mine! I picked it up!" They started to fight and pull the coin.

They were so busy fighting that they did not see the boat drift away. The wind blew it to the other side of the pond, where a big dog was waiting. The dog saw the boat and thought it was a toy. He jumped into the water and grabbed the boat with his teeth. He shook it and tore it apart.

Ben and Sam heard the dog bark and looked up. They saw their boat in pieces. They cried and ran to the pond. But it was too late. The boat was gone. The dog ran away with the coin in his mouth.

Ben and Sam learned a lesson. They were selfish and lost their boat and their money. They wished they had shared the coin and played nicely with the boat. But they could not undo what they had done. They had a bad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a big well. It was deep and wide and heavy. Each day, a little girl named Kayla played at the edge of the big well. She thought it was the most magical place in the world.

One day, Kayla had an idea. She thought it would be fun to explore the depths of the well. Without telling anyone, she grabbed a rope and tied it around her waist. She shouted down into the top of the well, expecting to hear an answer back. But all she heard was silence.

Still, Kayla was determined. She took a deep breath and jumped down. But when she reached for the rope, it was too late. The rope had become so heavy that it was impossible to pull herself back up.

Kayla was scared. She shouted and screamed, but no one came to help.

In the end, Kayla stayed stuck in the big well, never to be seen again. She had not thought about the danger of her plan.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Margaret. Margaret wanted to go to the park to play, but her mother said she had to stay home. Margaret was sad, so she looked for something to do.

Suddenly, Margaret saw a trap on the ground. It looked like a box with a hole in the top. Margaret didn't know what the trap was.

"Mommy," she asked. "What is this?"

"It's a harmless animal trap," explained her mom. "It's a way to introduce animals we can study and learn about."

That sounded exciting! Margaret decided to try her own animal trap. She got a box and placed it outside, putting some food inside.

Sure enough, an animal came to the trap looking for food. Margaret was so excited! She looked closely and saw that it was a cute little mouse.

Margaret felt happy. She had introduced something new to the world â€“ and it was harmless!

Jim went for a walk in the hall. It was dull and empty. Suddenly, he saw something shiny. It was a pretty glittery rock. He was so excited he had to pick it up.

â€œWhat have you found?â€ asked a friendly old man.

â€œI found a shiny rock!â€ Jim said excitedly.

The old man smiled. â€œThatâ€™s a very special rock. Would you like to keep it?â€

â€œYes!â€ Jim said. He thanked the old man and went on his way, holding the rock tight in his hand.

From then on, whenever Jim went for a walk in the hall, he always looked for more pretty rocks. He would pick them up and put them in his pocket. Soon, Jim had a pocket full of rocks of all shapes and sizes. 

Seeing Jim so excited made the hall a lot less dull. Every time he found a rock, his eyes sparkled with joy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She loved to bake with her mommy and daddy. Everyday, she loved to help with the dinners and desserts that her mommy and daddy were making. 

Today, the little girl and her mommy decided to bake some photos. They prepared all the ingredients and began mixing them together. The little girl was having so much fun. 

Once the photos were mixed, they put them in the oven.The little girl waited with her mommy for the photos to bake. It took a while, but soon they were ready! The photos were a beautiful golden brown colour. 

The little girl was so proud of the photos that she and her mommy had baked. They looked so crispy and yummy. The little girl couldn't wait to show the photos to her daddy. 

Finally, the little girl and her mommy took out the photos from the oven. They looked so dry and delicious! The little girl was so excited to share the photos with her daddy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Abbie. She always played alone in her room. Today, Abbie had something special. She was holding something soft and yummy. It was butter! Abbie was so happy that she started to rock the butter across the room. 

"Rock, rock, rock!" she said, giggling.

Just then, Abbie's mom came into her room.

"What are you doing, Abbie?" her mom asked.

"I'm rocking the butter," Abbie answered.

Her mom chuckled and said, "That's the quietest way to rock something, Abbie."

And so Abbie continued to rock the butter, slowly and quietly, until it was time for bed. 

The End.

Lily was a curious cat. She liked to explore the house and find new things to play with. Sometimes she got into trouble, like when she knocked over a vase or scratched the sofa. But she was also very sweet and loved to cuddle with her family.

One day, Lily found a new thing in the house. It was a small, round, and soft thing that made a funny noise. Lily thought it was a toy, so she pounced on it and tried to bite it. But the thing did not like that. It squeaked and wiggled and scratched Lily's nose. Lily was surprised and ran away.

The thing was a baby hamster. It belonged to Lily's brother, who had brought it home from school. He had a project to take care of it and learn about it. He put it in a cage with some food and water and a wheel. He named it Nibbles.

Lily was still curious about Nibbles. She watched him from a distance, as he ate, drank, and ran on his wheel. She wondered what he tasted like and how he felt. She wanted to play with him, but she was also afraid of him.

One night, Lily heard a loud noise from the cage. She saw a big, black, and furry thing trying to get to Nibbles. It was a rat, and it looked hungry and mean. Lily felt a strange feeling in her chest. She did not want the rat to hurt Nibbles. She wanted to protect him.

Lily ran to the cage and hissed and spat at the rat. She used her claws and teeth to scare it away. She was brave and strong, even though the rat was bigger and heavier than her. The rat ran away, and Lily stayed by the cage, guarding Nibbles.

The next morning, Lily's brother found her and Nibbles. He was happy and proud of Lily. He thanked her for saving Nibbles and gave her a hug and a treat. He said she was a good cat and a good friend. Lily felt happy and proud too. She licked Nibbles and purred. She still wanted to play with him, but she also wanted to protect him. She decided that Nibbles was not a toy, but a friend.

Once upon a time there was a bright bird named Bob. Bob was always very curious. One day, Bob wanted to escape his cage. He saw a telephone on the table and he decided to use it. He crawled into the phone and dialed the number. Suddenly, he found himself in a wonderful garden. It was full of bright flowers and colourful birds. Bob was so happy to have escaped his cage! He flew around the garden, singing a happy song. Bob was free!

Once upon a time there was a naughty bus. He was always getting into mischief, and never wished to follow any of the rules. One day, the bus decided to sneak away from the other buses and go for a joy ride. 

The bus was excited and started to speed around all the streets and lanes, honking his horn, and making loud noises. 

Suddenly, the bus saw a car-cleaner, who was polishing all the cars. He watched how the car-cleaner worked and how her cloth moved across the cars, making them shine. The car-cleaner was doing a good job. 

The naughty bus thought for a moment, and then he went up to the car cleaner. He said, "Miss, could you polish me too? I wish to be polished." 

The car-cleaner smiled and said, "Yes of course!" 

The naughty bus was filled with joy and the car-cleaner carefully polished him. When she finished, the bus was shining brighter than all the other buses! 

From that day onwards, the naughty bus had learnt his lesson. He realised that being naughty will not get him anywhere, but by following rules and listening to elders, he would be respected and looked after.

Once there was a girl called Anna. She loved her house very much. Her house had a high roof and a big garden. She wanted to play in the garden all the time.

One day, Anna asked her mom to turn the switch on in the garden. Her mom said yes and promised to turn the switch on later that day.

When her mom was not looking, Anna went outside and turned the switch on. The garden was filled with bright light and Anna was so excited. She could play in the garden for a long time. 

Anna thanked her mom for keeping her promise and for turning the switch on. She was so happy to be able to play in the garden under the high roof. Anna and her mom laughed and smiled, and went to play outside.

Once upon a time, there was a black helicopter. It was so big and so loud, it filled the sky.

One day, two little boys were in the park below, watching the helicopter fly. One of the boys looked up and declared, "Gosh, I wish I could fly in that helicopter!" 

The other one replied, "Me too. But it's too high and we're too small!"

Just then, a magical wind started blowing. Suddenly, both boys felt themselves lifting up in the air. They were heading right for the helicopter! 

Once they were inside, the boys looked down and saw the park below. They were so excited! Then, the magical wind blew them back to the ground.

When the boys landed, they looked at each other and said, "Wow, that was the best ride ever!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Mia. She was very smart.
Mia had an idea to build a pipe. She worked very hard and soon it was ready.
But the pipe didn't work. Mia tried again and again but it just wouldn't work. She was very sad.
Then one day, Mia got another idea. She thought and she thought and soon she had a plan.
Her plan worked and the pipe suddenly worked! Mia cheered and danced in joy. She had succeeded!

Once upon a time, there was a small rabbit named Benny. He loved to hop around in circles, round and round. One day, he met a little bird named Lily. 

"Hi, Lily! Do you want to hop with me?" asked Benny. 

"I can't hop, Benny. I have wings, not legs," replied Lily. 

Benny felt sad that Lily couldn't join him. Suddenly, he had an idea. "I could mark a small circle with my paw and we can play a game. You can fly around the circle and I can hop around it. Whoever finishes first, wins!" 

Lily loved the idea and they started playing. It was so much fun that they forgot about the time. But when they looked up, the sun was setting and it was time to go home. 

"I had so much fun playing with you, Benny," said Lily. 

"Me too, Lily. Let's play again tomorrow!" replied Benny. 

And so, they became the best of friends and played every day in their small round circle.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and very curious. She liked to ask lots of questions about the world.

Once there was a little boy who loved to pick. He was always looking for something to pick. One day he decided to go on a hike in the woods.

The little figure had a secret. She was very organized and liked to keep things neat. One day she was exploring her room and she noticed something on the floor. It was a shiny object that looked like a tiny round ball. She bent down to take a closer look. 

Suddenly, the round ball bit her finger. She pulled her hand back quickly and saw that it was a bright red spider. She was so scared that she started to cry.

Her mom came running in and saw the spider. She scooped it up in a cup and placed it outside in the garden. The little figure felt much better after that. She liked being organized and safe. 

The little figure never forgot this experience. She learned that not all round balls bite but she was still careful when looking at new things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the festival with her family. They would eat yummy food and play games. One day, Lily saw a thick balloon that she really wanted.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sarah. She was very polite, but she liked to play lots. One day she thought of a good game â€“ she would hide something and then go and look for it with a flashlight. She hid her toy in the garden and went inside to get her flashlight.

Once there was a little boy called Timmy. He was only three years old. He had a problem - he was weak.

Once upon a time there was a lucky little girl. Every day she went outside and clapped her hands. She saw many things but what she loved the most was the rainbow. Sara and Tom are best friends. They like to play together every day. They have a lot of toys, but their favorite is a big teddy bear. They call him Mr. Fluffy.

Lily and Max were twins who liked to play together. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big vase that their mom gave them. The vase was blue and shiny, and it had flowers on it. Lily and Max liked to pretend that the vase was a castle, a spaceship, or a hat.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was deaf, which means he couldn't hear. But Timmy was happy because he had a big family who loved him very much.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who really wanted to buy a drum. But he had no money to buy it. He asked his mom for some money but she said no.

The little boy and his mom had so much fun playing the drum and making music together.

Once upon a time, a young girl named Stella was unhappy. She was always complaining and never seemed to find anything that would make her happy.

Her mommy and daddy tried lots of things to get Stella to stop complaining. They bought her lots of new purple shoes, purple clothes and lots of yummy snacks. Stella was still not happy.

One day, Stella and her family went on a trip. When they arrived to their hotel, Stella was so excited! She couldn't wait to stay in her own purple princess room. But something was missing in the room - a toilet! She started to complain because she didn't have a toilet. 

Luckily, her mommy and daddy knew exactly what to do. They went to the store and bought a new purple toilet. When they came home, they all went to Stella's room and they saw it - a brand new purple toilet.

Once upon a time, there was a smart robot named Rob. Rob belonged to a family who lived near a big metal factory. One day, Rob saw flames coming from the factory and he knew that it could be dangerous.

Once upon a time, there was a happy octopus who loved swimming in the deep sea. Every day he swam around, looking for new places to explore. The two octopuses explored the ocean together, swimming around and stirring up any adventures they could find. They became the best of friends and had many wonderful underwater adventures!

Once upon a time there was a strong, brave bear called Tango. Tango loved to dance, eat and explore the outdoors. Ben was a boy who liked to play with his toys. He had cars, trains, blocks and dolls. He liked to make them move and talk. He did not like to nap. He wanted to play all day.

One day, his mom said, "Ben, it is time to nap. You are tired and cranky. You need to rest your eyes and body." Ben said, "No, mom, I do not want to nap. I want to play. I am strong and happy." His mom said, "Ben, you have to nap. It is good for you. I will read you a story and then you can sleep." Ben said, "No, mom, no story, no nap. I want to play."

His mom was sad and angry. She said, "Ben, you are being naughty. You have to listen to me. You have to nap. If you do not nap, you will not get any dessert after dinner. You will also have to go to bed early." Ben said, "I do not care, mom. I do not want dessert. I do not want to go to bed. I want to play."

His mom left him in his room. She said, "Ben, you have to nap. I will be back soon. Do not get out of your bed. Do not touch anything." Ben said, "Okay, mom, I will nap." But he did not nap. He got out of his bed. He looked around his room. He saw something shiny. It was his mom's iron. She used it to make clothes smooth. Ben wanted to play with it. He thought it was a toy.

He took the iron and plugged it in the wall. He did not know it was hot. He did not know it was dangerous. He put it on his bed. He said, "This is my car. It is fast and strong. It can go anywhere." He pushed the iron on his bed. He made noises. He had fun.

But then, something bad happened. The iron was too hot. It burned his bed. It made a hole. It made smoke. It made fire. Ben was scared. He screamed. He dropped the iron. He ran to the door. He tried to open it. But it was locked. His mom had locked it. She did not want him to get out. She did not know he was in trouble.

Ben cried. He yelled. He said, "Mom, mom, help me. There is fire. There is smoke. I am sorry. I did not nap. I played with the iron. Please, mom, help me." But his mom did not hear him. She was in the kitchen. She was making dinner. She was listening to music. She did not know Ben was in danger.

The fire grew bigger. The smoke filled the room. Ben could not breathe. He could not see. He could not escape. He was trapped. He was hurt. He was alone.

He wished he had napped. He wished he had listened to his mom. He wished he had not played with the iron. He wished he had been a good boy. But it was too late. He was not strong. He was not happy. He was not alive.

One day, Jack was playing at the park. He was feeling restless and decided to climb up the big slide. When he reached the top, he accidentally slipped and fell down. He landed on his lip and started to cry.

There was a puppy called Max. He had a very helpful owner, Tim. Every day, Tim wanted to take Max for a walk and he used a leash to attach to Max so he could stay close. But sometimes Max didn't want to stay close and he ran away.

Once upon a time there was a good boy. He was very curious. One day he wanted to discover what was outside, beyond his home.

Once upon a time there was a bear, who loved to hug everyone he met. One day when he was out walking in the forest, he saw an amazing view from a tall hill. He went up to see it better and when he got to the top he saw a thin tree.

Johnny was playing in the park when his mom said it was time to go home. Johnny was a little troubled because he didn't want the fun to end. He trudged home, looking around the maze of streets and alleys. He was so tired from all the running around that he started to yawn.

So they went up to Johnny's room and he climbed into bed. He turned off the light, snuggled under his blanket and yawned one more time. He said goodnight to his mom and closed his eyes. 

Sleep soon came and Johnny had dreams of running around the park and playing in the maze again. His little heart was full of joy and he was no longer troubled. With a happy smile in his sleep, he yawned yet again.

Once upon a time, there was a child named Michael who wanted to be proud. He asked his Mom what he should do to make her proud. His Mom said, "You can make me proud if you clap like this." She clapped her hands to show him. 

So he started to clap. He clapped every day, and soon it made his house sound full of joy. Everyone heard the clapping, and people started to smile. 

One day, Michael saw two children outside his house. They were sad, so he asked them why. The children said, "We wish we could make our parents proud like you are doing." 

Michael smiled and said, "Don't worry! If you clap like this, your house will get full of happiness just like mine." 

And so, Michael helped the children to clap and make their parents proud. All three of them were very happy.

The moral of the story is that everyone can be proud if they do something nice to make someone else happy.

Once upon a time, there was a hairy dog. He was wandering by a creek on a sunny day. He stopped to take a drink from the water, when suddenly he could smell something strange.
