Once upon a time there lived a wild image. Her name was Emily. Emily was like no other image. She loved exploring and being outside in nature. One day a big gust of wind blew and Emily flew away! Emily flew high in the sky with the birds and butterflies. She fell down into a secret meadow with flowers and trees. The meadow was so lovely and wild! Emily made new friends there. They went on adventures, played games, and told stories. Emily had so much fun in this amazing place! Eventually she said goodbye to her new friends and flew up in the sky. But she still visits the meadow every now and then. Emily is still wild and free!

Max was a small boy. He had a big smile and was always on the move. One day, Max was feeling adventurous and decided to go for a slide. He grabbed his blue slide and ran outside.

Max's mum watched from the doorstep. She noticed that Max was preparing to slide down a hill. She shouted out, "Be careful Max!"

Max smiled and replied, "I will, Mum!" He was feeling excited, but a little uncomfortable. He took a deep breath and slowly started to slide.

Max was sliding down the hill at top speed. He shouted with joy as he flew towards the bottom. When he reached the bottom, Max decided to have a go at a new sport. He grabbed a large stick and roller skates and tried roller skating on the grass.

Max's mum watched as he slowly got the hang of it. He eventually got it and was sliding around with ease. His mum was very proud and called out, "Great job Max!"

Max smiled happily and said, "Thanks Mum!" He had a fantastic day and was always glad that Mum was there to watch.

Tom and Lily are playing with blocks. They are making a big tower. Tom likes to poke the blocks and make them fall. Lily does not like that. She wants to make the tower tall and strong.

"Stop poking, Tom!" Lily says. "You are ruining our tower!"

"No, I'm not!" Tom says. "I'm having fun!"

He pokes another block and the tower wobbles. Lily is angry. She grabs Tom's hand and says, "No more poking! Or I will tell Mom!"

Tom does not want to stop. He thinks poking is funny. He winks at Lily and says, "Okay, okay, I will stop. I promise."

But he does not mean it. He waits for Lily to look away and then he pokes the tower again. The tower falls down with a loud crash. Lily is very sad. She cries and says, "Tom, you are a bad brother! You lied to me!"

Tom feels sorry. He sees that he hurt Lily's feelings. He says, "I'm sorry, Lily. I was just joking. I didn't mean to make you cry."

He hugs Lily and says, "Let's make another tower. And this time, I will not poke. I will help you. I will be a useful brother."

Lily stops crying and smiles. She says, "Okay, Tom. Let's try again. And this time, no poking and no winking."

They hug and start to build a new tower. They work together and make it bigger and better than before. They are happy and proud of their tower. They do not poke or wink anymore. They are good siblings.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He was a glad boy who loved to play with his toys. One day, Tim saw a big calendar on the wall. He wanted to put a sticker on the calendar for his birthday.

But, his mom said, "No, Tim. You can't put a sticker there. We need to keep the calendar clean." Tim was sad. He wanted to put the sticker on the calendar so bad.

The next day, Tim had an idea. He asked his mom, "Can I put the sticker on my toy box?" His mom thought about it and said, "Yes, you can put the sticker on your toy box." Tim was so glad! He put the sticker on his toy box and was happy that his mom allowed him to do it. Now, every time he played with his toys, he could see his birthday sticker and remember that special day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to ride his bike, but he always forgot to wear his helmet. His mom told him that he needed to wear his helmet to be safe. 

One day, Timmy went for a ride without his helmet again. He was having so much fun that he didn't notice how hot it was outside. Suddenly, he fell off his bike and hit his head on the ground. 

Timmy's mom heard the noise and came running outside. She saw that Timmy wasn't wearing his helmet and was hurt. She put his helmet on him and helped him up. Timmy learned that it was important to wear his helmet to be safe, even when it was hot outside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Rose. Rose had a toy she loved very much; a doll made of cloth called Daisy.

One day, Rose was playing hide and seek with Daisy. Rose decided to hide Daisy behind a big rock in her garden. But when she went to look for Daisy, she could not find her.

"Where is Daisy?" asked Rose. A bird came down from the sky and said, "I saw a fox with Daisy in its mouth!"

Rose was so sad that she started to cry. She wanted Daisy back.

Suddenly, Rose had an idea. She grabbed a teddy bear and put it behind the rock. Then she quickly ran away and hid behind a tree.

As expected, the fox came back, expecting to find Daisy to play with. But instead, he found the teddy bear. Furious, the fox threw the bear away.

Rose was so happy when she saw her toy safe and sound that she hugged Daisy tightly. From then on, Rose never hid Daisy in such silly places.

This story teaches us that real things have much more value than fake things. We should never hide our precious things away.

Once upon a time, there was a furry teddy bear named Teddy. Teddy loved to play with his friends in the forest. One day, Teddy met an ostrich who was lost. The ostrich asked Teddy for help.

Teddy said, "I can help you find your way back home. Where do you live?"

The ostrich said, "I live in a big field with lots of grass and trees."

Teddy said, "I know that place! Let's go there together."

As they were walking, they saw a big sack on the ground. The ostrich asked, "What is that?"

Teddy said, "It's a sack. People use it to carry things."

The ostrich said, "Oh! I have a sack too. I use it to carry my eggs."

Teddy and the ostrich became good friends and helped each other whenever they needed it.

John was a three-year-old boy who loved to imagine crazy adventures. He used to close his eyes and dream about flying through the sky, swimming in the deepest of oceans and saving the world.

One day, he was sitting in his kindergarten class and his teacher was talking about amazing things. She said, "Imagine having a comfortable bed to sleep in every night and never getting tired."

John was so amazed by the thought of this. He asked his teacher, "What is a pupil?"

The teacher smiled and replied, "A pupil is someone who is learning something new every day!"

John was so excited, he couldn't believe it. He imagined all the cool things he could learn and do with his new knowledge. He was determined to make the most of his life.

He decided that he was going to be the best pupil ever. From then on, he made sure to pay attention and ask lots of questions. He was learning so much and he felt so comfortable with it all.

John had found his dream. He was learning something new every day and he knew he was on the way to becoming the best pupil ever.

Once there was a cop who was hard. He worked every day, and he didn't spend much time at home.

One day he decided to take a break and spend time with his kids. He took his kids for a walk in the park and they had so much fun.

The cop played all sorts of games with the kids, from hide-and-seek to tag. He even bought them ice cream during the playtime, and he laughed and smiled the whole time.

The cop enjoyed his time with the kids and started to do this every day. He soon realized that together time with family is the most important thing that you can spend.

Once there was a dog called Jack. He lived in the west, where the sun shone bright and the grass was soft. Jack liked to run around and explore. 

One day, he saw something very ugly across a river. He barked and barked, trying to understand it. Suddenly he heard a voice saying, "Hi Jack, why are you barking so?" Jack was surprised. It was a very small mouse. 

"I'm trying to understand what's across the river," Jack said. The mouse smiled. "It's an ugly creature called a hippopotamus," it said. "It lives in the water and loves to eat leaves".

Jack thanked the mouse for helping him understand. He watched the hippo for a while, before running off in search of more adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a little fishy named Nemo. Nemo lived in a stream that was very deep. Nemo loved to swim around and explore his home, but he was always alone.

One day, Nemo saw something change in the stream. The water started to get clearer and he could see more fishies swimming around. Nemo was so happy to have new friends to play with.

The new fishies were very nice and they showed Nemo all the fun things they liked to do in the deep stream. They played hide and seek and swam through the plants together.

Nemo was so happy that things had changed in the stream. He had new friends and he was never alone again. From that day on, Nemo knew that change could be a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a prince who lived in a castle. He was very hungry and went out looking for a snack. He soon saw a big ice-cream truck and wanted to buy one.

The man in the truck said, "I'm sorry son, I don't have enough money to save you an ice-cream".

The prince was sad, until he remembered that he had some coins hidden in his pocket. He quickly showed them to the man and said, "Please, can you save me an ice-cream?".

The man smiled and said, "Of course! What flavour do you want?".

The prince was so happy and said, "Strawberry please!".

The man quickly gave him a warm and delicious strawberry ice-cream. The prince thanked the man gratefully and took his tasty treat back to the castle.

The prince had a wonderful afternoon eating his delicious ice-cream!

Once there was a chubby little boy. His name was Sam.
Every morning, Sam liked to go for a jog with his mom. His mom always liked to exercise and Sam followed along.

One day, Sam said to his mom, "Mommy, why do we jog?" His mom smiled, and said, "Well, it's so our bodies stay strong and healthy. Plus, it's lots of fun!"

Sam thought about this, and smiled. He started to jog and soon he was running. He laughed and said, "Jogging is fun! I like jogging with Mommy!"

They jogged together, around the block. Every morning, Sam really enjoyed feeling his body jogging and getting healthier. After a few weeks, Sam was even less chubby than before. 

"See, Sam," said his mom. "Jogging is good for you."

Sam smiled and nodded. He knew that jogging was one of the best things you can do for your body.

Once upon a time, there was a big gorilla in the jungle. He was very beautiful with shiny black fur. One day, a little girl was walking in the jungle and saw the gorilla. She said, "Hello Mr. Gorilla, you are very beautiful." The gorilla smiled and said, "Thank you little girl, you are very kind."

The little girl wanted to talk to the gorilla more, so she asked, "What do you like to do?" The gorilla replied, "I like to swing on vines and eat bananas." The little girl said, "I like bananas too!" They both laughed and talked for a while.

Suddenly, the little girl's mom called out for her. She said goodbye to the gorilla and ran back home. The gorilla waved goodbye and said, "It was nice talking to you little girl, come visit me again sometime!" From that day on, the little girl visited the gorilla every day and they became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. One day, she decided to take a walk in the park. As she explored, she came across a club. She was curious and decided to pick it up. 

When she held the club, something magical happened! Suddenly, Jane was in reverse! She began walking backwards and couldn't figure out how to stop. 

Jane wandered around in reverse, feeling hungry and confused. As she passed an old man, he laughed and said, "What are you doing walking in reverse? You must turn it around if you want to find food."

Jane thanked the old man and did as he said. She reversed the club and all of a sudden, she was walking forwards again. She soon found a cafe and was able to eat a delicious meal.

To this day, Jane still remembers her magical journey in reverse. She will always keep her club close by in case she needs to reverse something!

The boy was so excited to take his first ride in a vehicle. He called out to his mom about all the places he wanted to go. She told him that his dad had a surprise for him. 

The boy was so eager to find out what it was that he lay down in anticipation. Suddenly, he saw a vehicle driving up the driveway. It was huge, and it made a terrible noise. 

The boy was so scared that he started to cry. But then he heard cheering and saw his dad getting out of the vehicle. His dad had bought a brand new car! The boy was so happy that he jumped up, ran outside and gave his dad a big hug. He was finally old enough to go on a special ride in a vehicle. The experience was so exciting that the thought of it being terrible had completely gone away.

Ben is a hero. He likes to help people and animals. He has a big red truck that he drives around the town. He takes his truck to the park, to the school, to the farm and to the fire station.

One day, he sees a cat on a tree. The cat is scared and meows. Ben stops his truck and gets out. He takes a ladder from his truck and puts it on the tree. He climbs up the ladder and reaches the cat. He says, "Don't worry, cat. I will take you down. You are safe with me."

But then, a crazy man comes. He is angry and mean. He wants to take Ben's truck. He runs to the truck and gets in. He starts the engine and drives away. He laughs and says, "Ha ha ha! This is my truck now. Bye bye, hero!"

Ben hears the crazy man and looks down. He sees his truck going away. He is sad and mad. He says, "Hey, stop! That is my truck! Give it back, you crazy man!"

The cat sees Ben's face and feels sorry for him. The cat says, "Meow, meow. Don't be sad, Ben. You are still a hero. You saved me from the tree. I will help you get your truck back. Come on, let's go!"

Ben smiles and says, "Thank you, cat. You are a good friend. Let's go!" He takes the cat in his arms and goes down the ladder. He runs after his truck and the crazy man. He hopes he can catch them and get his truck back. He and the cat are brave and smart. They are heroes.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with dolls and cars and books. They also liked to pretend they were married. They would wear their parents' clothes and rings and say "I do" to each other.

One day, they found a big box in the attic. It had a lock on it, but no key. They wondered what was inside. Maybe it was a treasure, or a toy, or a cake. They wanted to unlock it and see.

They looked everywhere for the key. They searched in the drawers, under the bed, in the closet. They asked their parents, but they said they didn't know. They asked their older brother, but he said he wouldn't tell. He was mean and nasty and liked to tease them.

They were about to give up, when they saw something shiny on the floor. It was a key! It looked like the one for the box. They ran to the attic and tried it. It worked! They unlocked the box and opened it.

They were so excited, until they saw what was inside. It was disgusting! It was a bunch of old clothes and shoes and hats and bags. They smelled bad and had holes and stains and bugs. They screamed and dropped the key and ran away.

Their older brother heard them and laughed. He had tricked them. He had put the key on the floor and the disgusting things in the box. He thought it was funny, but they didn't. They were sad and angry and hurt.

They decided they didn't want to play with him anymore. They also decided they didn't want to pretend they were married anymore. They said "I don't" to each other and took off their rings and clothes. They put them in the box and locked it. They hoped their brother would never find the key. They hoped he would never unlock their marriage.

Honey and her mom were going to the store. They were going to buy bread and butter for Honey's lunch. When they got to the store, mom saw a fierce dog near the entrance. She was a bit scared but she still decided to go in.

But the dog had another idea. It blocked the entrance, growling fiercely. Mom had to delay going in, until the dog finally moved away.

Inside the store, they found the bread and butter they needed. Mom was so relieved! Honey was happy too. They bought the butter and quickly went to the checkout. The fierce dog was still outside and mom wanted to avoid it. 

At home, Honey made her lunch quickly. She spread the butter on her bread, and the sandwich tasted yummy! 

Mom was happy that they had found the butter despite the delay caused by the fierce dog.

James was walking down the street with mommy. It was a sunny day, the sun was shining and the birds were singing.

"Mommy, why is there a sign up ahead?" asked James. 

"That's a stop sign," said mommy.

Suddenly, it started to rain. Mommy frowned and grabbed James's hand. She raced to a nearby store.

When they got inside, James was embarrassed. Everyone was staring at him and mommy.

"It's ok James," said mommy, giving James a hug. "The rain will stop soon, and the sun will be back out."

Sure enough, the rain stopped and soon rays of sunlight were streaming through the window. 

James smiled up at mommy. "I'm glad the sun is back out," he said.

Mommy smiled and agreed, happy they didn't have to be embarrassed any longer.

Once there was a tiger who lived in the jungle. He was very happy in the jungle, but he wanted to see what the world outside was like. So one day he decided to leave the jungle and go explore.

The tiger said goodbye to his animal friends and set off. He walked through the tall grass and crossed over rivers and hills. Finally, after many days, he came to the edge of the jungle.

The tiger looked out and saw a strange new world. Everything seemed so big and strange. He thought the new world looked funny.

But he was brave and he set off to explore. He saw new things and learned lots of new things. He stayed away from the jungle for many days. 

But then he missed the animals and the trees and the jungle sounds. He decided to go back. When he got back, his friends were so happy to see him. They celebrated with a big party. It was so fun that the tiger decided to stay in the jungle forever.

Once upon a time, there was a tall man named Tom. Tom liked to keep onions in his big garden. He took care of his onions every day. One day, he found a very big onion. It was bigger than all the other onions. Tom was very happy and took the big onion to his home.

Tom put the big onion on his table. He looked at the onion and thought, "This onion is special. I will keep it safe." Tom had a small box. He put the big onion in the box and closed the lid. Tom went to bed and had a big smile on his face.

The next day, Tom opened the box to look at his big onion. But the onion was not there! Instead, there was a small note. The note said, "Thank you for the big onion. It was very tasty. Love, Mouse." Tom was sad, but he knew he still had many onions in his garden. He would keep growing more onions and maybe find another big onion one day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One morning, she woke up early and decided to go on an adventure. She put on her red boots and wandered outside. 

As she walked, she saw a big, dangerous dog. Lily was scared, but she remembered what her mom told her about staying calm. She slowly backed away and continued her adventure. 

Lily wandered through the woods and saw many animals, like birds, rabbits, and squirrels. She even found a pretty flower to bring back home. When she got back, her mom was happy to see her and asked about her adventure. Lily smiled and said, "I saw lots of animals and flowers, but I also saw a dangerous dog. But I wasn't afraid, I just walked away." Her mom was proud of her bravery.

Once upon a time there was an elephant and she had a very special finish. The elephant was not real - it was fake and made out of plastic.

One sunny day the elephant went for a walk in the park. As she was walking she saw lots of other animals and said hello to them all. Suddenly, she saw another elephant. It was also fake and it had the same special finish as her. 

The two elephants were very happy to see one another. They waved their trunks, danced and had so much fun. They talked about all the things they liked to do and the other animals in the park.

"Let's finish off with a special game," said one of the elephants. And so they decided to have a race. The elephants raced around the park, trying to see who would be the fastest. In the end, the first elephant crossed the finish line and they both had a wonderful time.

Once upon a time, there was a sister and brother. They were very excited to visit their grandma and grandpa. They went to their grandpa's house. When they got there, each grandchild had to clean the garden. The sister and brother started to work together. They laughed and joked as they worked.

At the end of the day, they had a beautiful garden. The sister and brother were so proud of their work and they knew they had done a good job. Grandpa was very proud of them, too.

The sister and brother learnt a valuable lesson that day. They learnt that when we work together, good things can happen. We can all help to make things better when we work together.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big dog. The dog is black and brown. It has sharp teeth and loud bark.

"Wow, look at that dog!" Tom says. "It is scary. I do not like it."

Sara says, "It is not scary. It is just a dog. Maybe it is friendly. Maybe it wants to play."

Tom says, "No, no, no. It might bite us. It might hurt us. Let us go away."

Sara says, "Do not be afraid. Be brave. I have a dictionary. I can look up the word 'dog'. Maybe it will tell us something about the dog."

Tom says, "A dictionary? What is that?"

Sara says, "A dictionary is a book. It has many words. It tells you what the words mean. See, here is the word 'dog'. It says, 'a four-legged animal that barks and wags its tail'. It does not say anything about biting or hurting."

Tom says, "Oh, I see. Maybe you are right. Maybe the dog is not so bad. Maybe we can say hello to it."

Sara says, "Yes, let us try. Come on, Tom. Be brave. Follow me."

Sara and Tom walk slowly to the dog. They hold the dictionary in front of them. They smile and say, "Hello, dog. We are Sara and Tom. We want to be your friends."

The dog looks at them. It wags its tail. It licks their faces. It is friendly. It wants to play.

Sara and Tom are happy. They pet the dog. They throw a ball for it. They have fun.

They learn a new word from the dictionary. They learn that the word for the dog is 'Labrador'. They name the dog 'Lola'.

Sara and Tom are brave. They make a new friend. They love Lola. Lola loves them. They are happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Max and Olive. Olive was very patient. Every day, Olive waited for Max to come to the big house. 

One day, when Max arrived, Olive smiled. She asked Max to follow her. Max followed Olive, who took him to a secret spot behind the house. 

Max was very curious, but he waited patiently. Then, Olive said, "Max, look!" Max was excited to see a big surprise, a big treehouse with a slide and a tire swing! 

Max was so happy, he gave Olive a big hug and smiled. Olive was so happy, too. She had been patient and her surprise worked out!

Mum was carrying Tim to the zoo. He was so excited, he yelled, "Zoo! Zoo!" Tim thought it would be very fun.

There were lots of animals at the zoo. Tim loved watching the lions, tigers and elephants. He wanted to get right up close, but Mum said he had to stay quiet.

They were walking to the monkeys, when they saw a big lorry. Tim asked what it was doing there. Mum said it was carrying something he wouldn't like to see.

When the lorry drove away, Tim saw lots of cages in the grass. Inside were the monkeys from the zoo. He asked why they were in the cages. Mum said sadly, the zoo was closing down.

Tim was so sad. He had been looking forward to the zoo for weeks. He started to cry. Mum hugged him and said that the zoo was now too quiet.

One day, Sara was playing with her friend in the park. They laughed and ran around together and it was lots of fun. Sara trusted her friend and felt safe with him. 

Suddenly, her friend picked up a stick and started hitting Sara with it. Sara felt hurt and started to cry. She didn't understand why her friend would do this. 

Sara's mum saw what happened and went over to comfort her. She was angry but also sad that her daughter's friend had acted in this way. 

Mum and Sara spent the rest of the day together, talking about how important it is to trust friends but also to be careful and not get hurt. Sara was reassured that if she ever felt unsafe again, her mum would be there to help her.

Tim and Jen were playing in the yard. They found a big pot and some sticks. They pretended to make soup.

"I will stir the soup," said Tim. He used a stick to move the water in the pot.

"I will add some things to the soup," said Jen. She picked up some leaves, rocks, and dirt. She threw them in the pot.

The soup became thick and brown. It looked yucky. Tim and Jen laughed.

A raven flew over the yard. It saw the pot. It thought the soup was food. It landed on the edge of the pot. It pecked at the soup.

"Hey, go away!" shouted Tim. "That is our soup!"

The raven did not listen. It kept pecking. It made a loud noise.

Tim and Jen were scared. They ran to the house. They left the pot and the sticks.

The raven was happy. It ate the soup. It did not care that it was yucky. It liked the leaves, rocks, and dirt. It flew away with a full belly.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play games. One day, they play a game with a big ball. The ball is heavy. They have to crawl with the ball to the other side of the yard.

"Ready, set, go!" Lily says. She crawls fast with the ball. Tom crawls too, but he is slower. The ball is too heavy for him.

"Come on, Tom, you can do it!" Lily says. She is nice. She waits for Tom at the end of the yard.

Tom tries hard. He crawls and crawls. He is tired. He wants to win. He sees Lily and the end of the yard. He crawls faster.

"Yay, Tom, you made it!" Lily says. She claps her hands. She gives Tom a hug. "You are a good crawler. You win too!"

Tom smiles. He is happy. He hugs Lily back. "Thank you, Lily. You are a good friend. You win too!"

They share the ball. They play some more. They have fun. They are happy.

Sara and Ben liked to play with their toys. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big truck. The truck was red and shiny, and it made loud noises when they pushed it. Sara and Ben pretended to drive the truck around the house, and sometimes they took it outside.

One day, they decided to take the truck to the park. They put on their coats and hats, and asked their mom if they could go. Their mom said yes, but she told them to be careful with the truck. She said the truck was not very strong, and it could break if they were rough with it. Sara and Ben nodded, and said they would be gentle.

They walked to the park, holding the truck between them. They saw other kids playing on the swings, the slide, and the sandbox. They wanted to join them, but they also wanted to play with their truck. They looked for a good spot to park their truck, and they saw a big hill. They thought it would be fun to roll the truck down the hill, and see how fast it could go.

They climbed up the hill, and put the truck on the edge. They counted to three, and pushed the truck. The truck started to roll down the hill, faster and faster. Sara and Ben cheered, and ran after it. They wanted to catch it at the bottom.

But the truck was too fast. It hit a rock, and flew into the air. It landed with a loud crash, and broke into pieces. Sara and Ben gasped, and ran to the truck. They saw the wheels, the lights, and the engine scattered on the ground. They felt sad, and started to cry.

A lady who was sitting on a bench saw what happened. She came over to Sara and Ben, and asked them if they were okay. She said she was a doctor, and she could help them. She picked up the pieces of the truck, and put them in a bag. She said she could fix the truck, and make it look like new. She said she had a special glue, and a special tool, that could mend anything. She said she would take the truck to her office, and bring it back the next day.

Sara and Ben stopped crying, and looked at the lady. They asked her if she was sure she could fix the truck. The lady smiled, and nodded. She said she was not an ordinary doctor, she was a toy doctor. She said she loved toys, and she knew how to make them happy. She said she would take good care of the truck, and she would be back soon.

Sara and Ben thanked the lady, and gave her a hug. They said they were sorry for breaking the truck, and they would be more careful next time. The lady said it was okay, and she understood. She said accidents happen, and sometimes toys need a doctor. She said she would see them tomorrow, and she walked away with the bag.

Sara and Ben waved goodbye to the lady, and went back to their mom. They told her what happened, and how the lady was a toy doctor. Their mom said they were lucky, and they should be grateful. She said they should go home, and wait for the lady to come back. She said she hoped the truck would be okay, and she hugged them.

Sara and Ben nodded, and held their mom's hand. They walked home, and wondered how the lady would fix the truck. They hoped the truck would be happy, and they missed it. They said they loved the truck, and they wanted to see it again. They said they would never break it again, and they would be gentle. They said they learned a lesson, and they were sorry. They said they were glad the lady was a toy doctor, and not an ordinary doctor. They said she was very nice, and very smart. They said they couldn't wait for tomorrow, and they smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved animals so much. One day, she got a gift. She was so happy to receive a birdcage. Lucy wanted to find a bird friend to live in the birdcage.

Lucy went outside to look for a bird. She saw a tired bird sitting on the ground. The bird was very small and could not fly. Lucy felt sad for the tired bird. She picked up the bird and took it home.

Lucy put the tired bird in the birdcage. She gave it food and water. The bird soon felt better. Lucy and the bird became best friends. They played together every day. The bird was happy to have a home, and Lucy was happy to have a new friend.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. There is a big tree in the park. Anna and Ben want to climb the tree.

"Can we climb the tree?" Anna asks Ben.

"Yes, we can. But we have to be careful. The tree is very high." Ben says.

They hold hands and walk to the tree. They find a low branch and pull themselves up. They climb higher and higher. They see birds and squirrels and leaves. They feel happy and brave.

"Look, Ben, I have a bow!" Anna says. She shows Ben a bow made of grass and flowers. She found it on the tree.

"Wow, Anna, your bow is very pretty. You are good at making bows." Ben says. He smiles at Anna.

"Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend. Do you want to wear my bow?" Anna says. She puts the bow on Ben's head.

"Yes, thank you, Anna. I like your bow. You are a good friend, too." Ben says. He laughs.

They hug and look at the sky. They see clouds and sun and rainbows. They feel happy and loved. They are good friends. They like to climb the tree.

One day, Jim was playing a game. He wanted to win! He used his machine. It was big and looked very dull. He worked really hard to get the machine to do what he wanted. Then he heard something amazing! He had won! Everyone cheered for Jim for winning with his machine. Jim was so happy he wanted to do it again. He raced to the machine and started playing the game. He wanted to win again! After much trying, he was able to win again! Now, Jim was the happiest he had been in a long time. The machine was the best!

Sammy wanted to play outside. He wanted to feel the bright sunshine on his face. He saw a slide in the park and wanted to go on it. He ran to the slide and climbed up the ladder. Once at the top, he looked down, and it seemed so high! But Sammy did not hesitate, he pushed off and down he went! He had so much fun going up and down, up and down on the slide. Every time he went down, the slide was so bright and pretty in the sunshine. Sammy wanted to play on the slide forever. When his mom called, he reluctantly got off the slide and went home. Sammy said goodbye to the slide, dreaming that he would play on it again someday.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lily. She always wanted to help her mom in the kitchen. So one day, Mommy gave her an apron to put on before they started cooking. Lily put on the apron and she was so excited. 

Mommy said, "Lily, can you help me by stirring the beans?" 

Lily said, "Yes Mommy! I can do it!"

So Lily started stirring the beans with a big spoon and she did a good job. Mommy smiled at Lily and said, "You did a very good job, Lily."

Lily was so happy that she ran over to Mommy and hugged her. "Thank you Mommy for letting me help," said Lily. 

Mommy said, "Anytime, my sweet little girl! It's always nice to help."

The moral of the story is that helping people can make you feel good, and be nice to show appreciation to those that help you.

Once there was a little girl who loved to explore. She opened her bedroom door and saw a yellow carpet. It was so soft and squishy and she wanted to know where it came from. She followed it around the house and eventually she found it. It was in the living room and it was perfect. She wanted to keep it forever.

The little girl stepped onto the yellow carpet and immediately felt so warm and comfortable. She discovered that it was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen. She stopped and plopped down right in the middle of the cozy yellow carpet.

The girl spent hours playing on the carpet. She found all sorts of fun things to do like pretending she was a princess, rolling around, and making funny shapes. She even took her dolls there, and they had a great time, too!

The little girl's mom was so happy that she had found the yellow carpet. She said it was the perfect place for her daughter to play, relax and have fun. The girl loved it so much and she found that it was the best spot for her to explore her imagination.

One day, there was a pet. The pet was a bird. His name was Flappy. Flappy was very happy. He liked to fly around all day. One day, Flappy decided to fly higher than ever before. He flew up into the sky. But he couldnâ€™t find his way back home. Flappy was confused. He kept flying around, wondering where he was.

Suddenly, he noticed a girl below him. She was calling his name. It was his owner. She had come to find him. Flappy was so happy. He flew down right to her. She was so glad to see him. She put him on her shoulder and they headed home. 

Flappy was happy to be home. He never wanted to get lost again. He made sure to keep close by, since his owner was so happy to have him. He always loved flying. But, he knew he should be careful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the rain. One day, she saw a big puddle and jumped in it. Her mom saw her and said, "Lily, you're all wet! Let's go inside and dry off."

Lily said, "But Mommy, I want to play in the puddle some more."

Her mom said, "I know, but you'll get sick if you stay wet for too long. Let's pack up and go inside."

Lily was sad because she wanted to play more, but she didn't want to get sick. She said, "Okay, Mommy. I don't want to be poor-ly." So, they went inside and Lily got into her cozy pajamas. She looked out the window and saw the rain still falling. She said, "I can't wait to play in the puddles again tomorrow!"

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old. She loved to explore and dreamed of far off places. 

One day, she found an interesting symbol in the grass. She touched it and it glowed a bright yellow. Suddenly, all of Lucyâ€™s dreams felt possible. 

Lucy asked her mom, â€œWhat is this?â€ But mom just ignored her and walked away. Lucy felt confused and sad. 

So she decided to explore some more. She found a delicious-looking fruit tree. She begged her mom to let her pick one of the tasty fruits. Again, mom ignored her. 

That night, Lucy was so sad and lonely. She was also very disappointed that her mom kept on ignoring her and wouldn't let her have the tasty fruit. 

The next day, Lucy never mentioned the symbol or the fruit tree again. She learned that no matter how much she wanted something, sometimes her wishes would be ignored.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very curious and liked to explore. One day she was walking near a river and saw a big stone laying beside the water. She got up close to the stone and noticed it was very interesting. It was shaped like a star and had many bright colors. The girl thought it was so special that she decided to pick it up and carry it back home.

When she got home she showed the interesting stone to her mom and dad. They both got so excited that the little girl was able to find such a special stone. They told her to keep it in a special place so she wouldn't forget about it.

So every day the little girl would take out her special stone and look at it for a few minute. She would remember the day when she first noticed it and feel excited all over again. The little girl was very happy to have found such a special stone.

Once upon a time there was a fly named Priscilla. She was an adventurous fly and loved to explore the world. One day, she decided to take a special journey.

She flew high up in the sky, through the clouds and over the mountains. As she flew further and further away, the scenery beneath her started to look unfamiliar. Priscilla soon found herself in a strange new land.
