Sadie looked up with a big smile on her face. She was so happy that her mom wasn't mad at her. Her mom hugged her and said, "It's important to follow the rules, Sadie. Otherwise, we'll both feel guilty."

Sadie nodded her head and said, "Okay, Mom. I won't hold the van anymore." From then on, Sadie followed the rules and never touched anyone else's things without permission.

Once upon a time there was a blueberry. The blueberry was very bossy. It rolled around the house slipping and sliding. It wanted to have fun but no one knew.

One day it decided to visit the park. It rolled down the hill and into the water. When it came out of the water, it was shiny and slippery. It loved the feeling of being wet and slippery.

The blueberry then went over to the playground and met a new friend. It was a caterpillar. The caterpillar wanted to play tag. But the blueberry was too bossy and wanted to just slip and slide around.

But then the blueberry saw something that changed everything. It saw a bird. The bird was playing with a marble, and it looked like lots of fun.

The blueberry asked the bird if it could join the game. The bird said yes, and soon all three friends were slipping and sliding around the playground.

The blueberry had so much fun sliding and slipping around with its new friends. The bossy blueberry had a great time and couldn't wait to come back and play again.

Once upon a time, there was a pig who wanted to escape his pen. He tried pushing the gate open, but it was too hard. He asked the farmer, "Can you fix it?" The farmer said, "No, that gate is too strong. You cannot escape." The pig was sad. He felt so dirty in his pen, and he wanted to be free. Suddenly, the pig had an idea. He went to find some tools and started to work on the gate. After a while, he managed to fix the gate, and set himself free! The pig was so happy he could escape his dirty pen. He raced off through the grass and the flowers and never looked back. From then on, he lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, Bella and Lucy. They were playing in the garden, when suddenly, something magical appeared in front of them! It was a bright and colorful bottle of lotion, shimmering in the sunshine!

"Wow!" exclaimed Bella. Lucy was still too surprised to speak. 

After they both got over the surprise, Lucy thought of something thoughtful. She dreamed that the lotion must be sent from the sky by some special fairy. "Maybe the fairy wants us to share the lotion!" said Lucy.

Bella was overjoyed by this thought and they quickly opened the bottle of lotion. They both rubbed it on their hands, feeling so special and thankful. 

The lotion did more than just make their hands soft, it made their friendship even stronger that day. It was a magical moment for them both. 

THE

Once upon a time, there was a nice, compassionate puppy. He liked to go on walks and explore the world. One day, while walking, the puppy found a bear. The bear wanted to be his friend, so the puppy followed the bear into the woods.

The puppy soon realized that the bear was up to no good. But the puppy felt sorry for the bear and was still very compassionate. The bear wanted the puppy to stay and be his friend, but the puppy refused. The bear got mad and chased the puppy out of the woods.

The puppy ran as hard as he could, but the bear was too fast. Eventually, the bear caught up and bit the puppy. The puppy was sad and scared. The bear ran away soon after. 

The puppy was lucky to be alive, but he was very hurt. Thankfully, a nice lady came by and helped the puppy. But the puppy would never be the same again. Despite his injuries, he still showed compassion and loved to go on walks. He just wasn't as free and happy as before. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a very modest train. On its way to the big city, it stopped at a station to unpack all of its cargo. Inside the cars were a variety of items, and each one had to be taken out carefully. There was a wagon full of books and chairs and packages of food. 

At the very back, something else caught the eye. It was a beautiful whip, too pretty to be forgotten. So the man who was unpacking stopped and carefully took the whip out, laying it carefully on the ground. 

As soon as he did, the whip suddenly came alive! It stretched and stretched until it was as tall as a tower. Everyone was amazed and clapped as the whip bowed and bowed. The whip weaved around, leaving trails and colors everywhere. 

The whip thanked the modest train for letting it out of its box and flew away. From that day on, the people at the station remembered the magical whip and the modest train that allowed it to be free.

Once upon a time, there was a wise giraffe. He had a special way of talking and he pretended a lot. He would pretend to cook in the kitchen, climb mountains and he even pretended that his faucet was a rocket ship.

He went on pretend adventures around the house and saw many wonderful things. One day, he even pretended to go to the moon! He pretended to land in a crater and explore the alien terrain.

The wise giraffe even pretended to talk to the stars in the night sky. Slowly, he began to feel like a real astronaut.

Finally, the wise giraffe made it back to his home. He had the best pretend adventure ever!

Once there was a girl who loved pastries. She was very attractive and the pastries were too. One day, she wanted to hide one of her pastries so no one else would find it. She went to her secret spot and looked around carefully. Once she was sure nobody was watching, she placed the pastry in a safe place.

The girl felt happy and excited that she had hidden the pastry. She went back later to get it, but it was gone! Someone else had found her secret spot and taken the pastry away. She was very sad and disappointed.

The girl decided to never hide anything at her special spot again. She still enjoyed eating pastries and looking at them, but she decided to never hide one ever again.

Marie looked out across the field. The sun was setting and she blinked in amazement. It was really beautiful. Suddenly, something in the corner moved. Marie blinked again, this time in fear. What was it?

In the corner of the field sat an ugly monster. Its eyes were wide and its mouth open. Marie was scared and wanted to run away, but her feet refused to move.

The monster moved closer, but it wasn't so ugly anymore. It smiled and waved! Marie waved back and smiled, too. She blinked, realizing the monster was no longer scary.

Marie thanked the monster for not being scary and waved goodbye as it turned and walked away. She blinked one last time and smiled as the sun set behind her. She had made a new friend!

Lily is a daughter who likes to wear dresses. She has many dresses in her closet. She is very organized. She puts her dresses in order by color and size.

One day, Lily wants to wear a pink dress with flowers. She looks in her closet and finds it. She takes it out and puts it on. She feels happy and pretty.

She goes to the kitchen to show her mom. Her mom is making breakfast. She sees Lily and smiles.

"Wow, Lily, you look so lovely in your pink dress!" her mom says. "Did you pick it yourself?"

"Yes, mom, I did!" Lily says. "I know where all my dresses are. I am very organized!"

"I am very proud of you, Lily!" her mom says. "You are a smart and neat daughter. Now, come and have some pancakes. They are your favorite!"

Lily hugs her mom and sits at the table. She eats her pancakes and enjoys her dress. She is a happy daughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, red ball that she loved to play with. One day, while she was playing, her ball rolled away and got stuck in a tree. Lily was sad and didn't know how to get her ball back.

Then, Lily saw her friend Tom, who was reading a book called a novel. Tom was very smart and always had useful ideas. Lily asked Tom to help her rescue the ball from the tree. Tom thought for a moment and then had a great idea.

Tom found a long stick and used it to reach the ball in the tree. He pushed the ball with the stick, and it fell down from the tree. Lily was so happy to have her ball back. She thanked Tom for his useful help and they played together for the rest of the day.

One day, a fast rabbit and a slow turtle had a race. They wanted to see who could speed to the finish line first. The prize was a big, yummy carrot. The rabbit said, "I am fast. I will win the prize." The turtle said, "I will try my best."

The race started. The rabbit went very fast. The turtle went very slow. The rabbit saw a dangerous cliff. He stopped and said, "Oh no, I can't go this way. It's too dangerous. I must find another way."

The turtle kept going slow and safe. He saw the dangerous cliff too. But he found a safe way to go around it. The rabbit was still looking for a new way. The turtle went past the cliff and got to the finish line first. The turtle won the prize! The rabbit said, "Wow, you were slow but safe. I should have been more careful." They both shared the yummy carrot prize and became good friends.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toys in the garden. They had a lot of fun making mud pies, building forts and digging holes. They got very dirty and their clothes were brown and wet.

"Time to come in, kids!" their mom called from the door. "You need to wash up before dinner."

Lily and Ben ran to the door, but they saw something that made them stop. There was a big blue dog sitting on the porch. It had long fur, sharp teeth and a loud bark. Lily and Ben were frightened and did not want to go near it.

"Who are you?" Lily asked the dog, trying to sound brave.

"I'm Bluey," the dog said. "I'm your new neighbor. I came to say hello and make friends."

Lily and Ben looked at each other. They did not know what to do. They liked dogs, but this one was too big and too blue.

"Mom, there's a blue dog on the porch!" Ben shouted.

Their mom came out and saw Bluey. She smiled and petted him.

"Don't be afraid, kids. He's a friendly dog. He just needs a bath. He's blue because he rolled in some paint at his old house. He's not happy about it either."

She took a hose and sprayed some water on Bluey. The paint washed off and revealed his true color. He was a golden dog with a wagging tail.

"See? He's not so scary now. He's just a normal dog who likes to play. Why don't you give him a hug and invite him to join your game?"

Lily and Ben did as their mom said. They hugged Bluey and apologized for being scared. They took him to the garden and showed him their toys. Bluey was happy and licked their faces.

Lily and Ben learned a lesson that day. They learned not to judge someone by their appearance. They learned to be kind and friendly to everyone. They learned that blue is not a bad color, but a beautiful one. And they made a new friend.

Once there was a bear called Sammy. He loved to crawl around in the pitch. He liked to feel the crunchy logs under his paws. 

Sometimes he would find healthy food like berries to eat. He also liked to find shiny stones and colourful leaves to collect. 

One day Sammy decided to crawl to a new place. He found a lake and he could feel the soft sand under his paws. He liked the lake, it was very quiet and peaceful.

Sammy stayed there for a long time. He ate healthy food, swam in the lake and met new animals. He felt very happy and healthy. 

At the end of the day, Sammy crawled back home feeling content and happy. He had had a wonderful day full of exploration!

Once upon a time, there was a spoiled little girl. She had a special vest that she liked to ride in. Every day, she asked her mommy to take her for a ride in her special vest. 

One day, her mommy said yes. She put on her special vest and took her for a ride in the car. They drove around the city, and the little girl loved it. She smiled and waved at everyone they passed. 

They drove all over the city, and the little girl was so excited. She even got to have an ice cream after the ride! As they drove back home, the little girl said, "Mommy, can we go for a ride in my vest again tomorrow? Please!" 

And her mommy said yes.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in his backyard. One day, he found a big net and he thought it was so cool. He decided to play catch with his dad using the net. They had so much fun!

After they finished playing, Timmy's mom called them for dinner. She served Timmy his favorite food - spaghetti! Timmy loved it so much that he asked for seconds. His mom was happy that Timmy enjoyed his meal.

Later that night, Timmy had an adventurous dream where he caught a big fish using his net. He was so happy and proud of himself. When he woke up, he couldn't wait to go outside and try to catch a real fish with his net.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Sam. He loved to play in the park. One day, he wanted to help his Mommy do the laundry. So he took the laundry basket to the park and he put all the clothes in the basket.

When he was done, Sam picked up the laundry basket and went home. But when he got home, the laundry basket was missing! Sam was scared so he ran all around looking for it.

Then, he saw it! The laundry basket was at the edge of the park. It was open and on the ground next to it were all the clothes. Sam was relieved. He quickly picked up all the clothes and put them back into the basket.

He went home, put away all the things and did his mommy a big favor by folding all the clothes. The next day, it was a mild and sunny day, so Sam went back to the park with the laundry basket again. He had a great day playing with his friends and when he was done he returned home.

One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the woods. She saw a small, scared bird sitting on a tree branch. The bird was sad because its nest had fallen into a pile of ash. Lily felt bad for the bird and wanted to help.

Lily said, "Don't worry, little bird, I will help you make a new nest." The bird was happy and thanked Lily. They worked together to find sticks and leaves to make a new nest. Lily was careful not to touch the ash because she knew she would hate how dirty it would make her hands.

When they finished the new nest, the bird was no longer scared. It was very happy and grateful to Lily for her help. The bird sang a beautiful song to thank her. Lily felt happy that she could help her new friend and they played together in the woods for the rest of the day.

One day, a little boy was running across the yard. Suddenly the sky filled with angry clouds and the wind began to blow. The boy struggled to keep his balance, but he couldn't do it. Water started to fall from the sky. The boy was scared!

He looked around and saw that the ground was quickly filling up with water. It was a giant flood! He was stuck! The boy struggled to keep his head above the water. The flood was getting bigger and bigger and he was really scared.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was a man from a boat. He offered to help the boy. The boy quickly climbed into the boat and the man started paddling away. The man paddled with an impatient energy. The boy watched and hoped that they would both reach safety soon.

Fortunately, the man was able to out-paddle the flood and the boy was saved. From then on, the boy was very thankful whenever he saw the rain and the clouds. The flood showed him how powerful nature can be.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named John. He was three years old and loved exploring. One day, he found a big open door. He wanted to step inside but he was scared. The door looked sour and he didn't know if it would be safe.

But then he heard a voice say, "Come in! I am your friend." The voice sounded nice and he felt safe. 

John stood inside the door. It was dark and he couldn't see very well. He heard some noises and started to get scared. He was about to turn and run away when suddenly a light came on and he saw a room full of toys!

John smiled and had lots of fun playing with the toys. He forgot all about the sour door. 

Before he left, he heard the voice again: "Hope you come and play again soon!"

John was a cool kid who liked to explore. One day he was with his mom in the big building and saw an elevator. It looked like a metal box and he wondered what it was. Mom explained that it was an elevator and it could take people to different floors of the building. John was excited and wanted to try it out. 

John and his mom got in the elevator. He felt the floor move under his feet and it made him giggle. He was amazed at how the elevator could take them so high up so quickly. When they got to their floor, John was so proud that he knew how to ride the elevator. He told his mom that he was cool!

John was really glad he knew how to use the elevator. He was proud that he could show his mom that he knew how to use it too. Whenever they go to the big building now, John likes to ride the elevator all by himself. His mom is still there to make sure he is safe, but he knows how to use it just by himself.

Once upon a time, there was a family who loved each other very much. One day, Grandma wanted to take the family on a camping trip, and everyone was excited. Grandma always knows when someone is feeling scared or unsure, so she reminded them, "Remember, if you're scared, all you have to do is smile and believe in yourself." 

On the day of the camping trip, everyone was a little bit scared. But when they arrived, they found a beautiful campsite with lots of fun things to do. They smiled and began to explore. They built a campfire and roasted marshmallows. They swam in the river and caught fish. As the day went on, everyone began to feel less scared and had lots of fun. 

At night, they all sat around the campfire. As they warmed themselves by the fire, Grandma smiled and said, "Don't forget, if you ever feel scared again, all you have to do is remember to smile and believe in yourself." Everyone was reminded of what Grandma had said that day and smiled in agreement. They were all thankful that Grandma had given them such great advice and were happy that they were no longer scared. 

The family shared lots of laughs and stories around the campfire that night and had a wonderful time. They all thanked Grandma and promised to remember her advice in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved the color purple. She had a purple dress that she loved to wear all the time. One day, she went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, I have an idea! Can we paint my room purple so it matches my dress?"

Her mommy thought it was a great idea and they went to the store to buy purple paint. They painted Lily's room together and it looked beautiful. Lily was so happy and said, "Now my room matches my dress! I can wear my purple dress in my purple room!"

Lily's mommy smiled and said, "You're right, Lily. You look so pretty in your purple dress and your room looks so nice in purple. I'm glad we had your idea." Lily hugged her mommy and said, "I love you, mommy." And they both felt very happy. The end.

Once there was a very famous cube. It was called the Magic Cube and everyone wanted it.

One day, the Magic Cube decided to go for a walk. He wanted to find new friends and show off how famous he was.

On his walk, he met a dog, a butterfly, and a duck. They all wanted to be friends with the Magic Cube and so they played together.

The Magic Cube showed them how he could fit and roll in different shapes. The dog, butterfly, and duck all loved the Magic Cube and wanted to keep playing with him.

So, the Magic Cube and his new friends went off together on many adventures. They explored the world and had lots of fun together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a cozy blanket that she loved very much. It was thick and kept her warm at night. One day, Lily saw a tiny plant in her garden. She wanted it to grow big and strong like her blanket. So, she watered it every day and gave it lots of sunshine. 

As time passed, the plant grew taller and taller. Lily was so happy to see it grow. She realized that just like her blanket, the plant needed love and care to become big and strong. 

The moral of the story is that if you want something to grow, you need to take good care of it. Just like how Lily took care of her blanket and the plant, we should take care of the things we love.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey named Bongo who lived in a jungle. Bongo loved to climb trees and play with his friends, but one day he got lost. He didn't know which way to go and he felt scared.

Suddenly, he saw a kind elephant named Ellie. Ellie was very compassionate and asked Bongo what was wrong. Bongo told her that he was lost and didn't know how to get back to his home in the jungle.

Ellie used her big memory to remember the way to Bongo's home. She led him through the jungle, and Bongo felt happy again. He was so grateful to Ellie for helping him and they became best friends. From that day on, Bongo always knew the way home and he never got lost again.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play together. Today they want to ride their bikes to the park. But they have a problem. The park is far from their houses. They have to cross a big road. The big road is difficult and scary.

"Can we ride our bikes to the park?" Lily asks her mom.

"No, it is too difficult and dangerous. The big road has many cars and trucks. They go fast and loud. You have to wait for the green light and look both ways. You are too small to ride your bikes there. Maybe when you are older." Mom says.

Lily is sad. She wants to go to the park. She likes the swings and the slide. She likes to feed the ducks and the squirrels. She likes to play with Tom.

"Can we go to the park with you?" Lily asks her mom.

"Maybe later. I have to do some work in the house. Why don't you play in the backyard? You can ride your bikes there. It is safe and fun." Mom says.

Lily and Tom go to the backyard. They ride their bikes in circles. They pretend they are going to the park. They make sounds of cars and trucks. They stop at the red light and go at the green light. They have fun. But they still want to go to the park.

"Maybe we can sneak out and ride our bikes to the park." Tom says.

"No, that is a bad idea. Mom said it is difficult and dangerous. We have to listen to mom. She knows what is best for us. Maybe she will take us to the park later. Or maybe we can ask dad. He is at work now. But he will come home soon." Lily says.

Tom agrees. He does not want to get in trouble. He does not want to get hurt. He likes to play with Lily. They ride their bikes some more. They hope they can go to the park soon. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to wear pretty skirts that twirled when she spun around. One day, her mommy said she couldn't wear her favorite skirt to the park because it might get dirty. Lily was worried she wouldn't have fun without her special skirt. 

But then, her mommy allowed her to wear the skirt as long as she promised to be careful. Lily was so happy she twirled around and around until she got dizzy. At the park, she played on the swings and the slide, careful not to get any dirt on her skirt. 

When it was time to go home, Lily thanked her mommy for allowing her to wear her favorite skirt. She felt happy and special all day long. From then on, she knew that sometimes her mommy would allow her to wear her special skirt, and it made her feel like a princess.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch TV all day long. But one day, her mom said, "Lily, you need to stop watching TV all day. You need to go outside and play." Lily didn't like this. She wanted to watch TV all day. So, she started to cry.

But then, Lily's mom had an idea. She said, "Let's go to the park!" Lily was happy and stopped crying. They went to the park and played on the swings and slide. But it was getting cold outside and Lily started to shiver. Her mom said, "Let's go home and have some hot chocolate." Lily smiled and they went home.

When they got home, Lily's mom turned on the TV for a little while. But Lily didn't want to watch it anymore. She said, "Mom, let's play a game together." They played a game and had fun. Lily realized that playing outside and spending time with her mom was much better than watching TV all day. She felt modest about her behavior before and was happy to have a new way to spend her time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat oatmeal for breakfast every day. Her mommy would make it for her with milk and a little bit of sugar.

One day, Lily wanted to make her own oatmeal. She asked her mommy for help and they got out the oatmeal and the milk. Lily poured the oatmeal into the bowl and her mommy helped her pour the milk. They mixed it together and put it in the microwave to cook.

When it was done, Lily took a big bite and smiled. "Yummy!" she said. Her mommy was so proud of her for making her own breakfast. Lily felt happy and fit because she made her own oatmeal.

Once upon a time, there was a happy musician named Max. Max loved playing his guitar and singing cheerful songs. One day, Max got a special job to deliver his music to the children at the park.

Max packed his guitar and went to the park. When he arrived, he saw lots of children playing and having fun. Max started to play his guitar and sing his cheerful songs. The children stopped playing and gathered around Max to listen to his music.

One little girl said, "I love your music, Mr. Musician! Can you play more songs?" Max smiled and said, "Of course! I have more songs to deliver to you all." The children clapped and danced to Max's music. They had so much fun that they didn't want Max to leave.

At the end of the day, Max said goodbye to the children and left the park. He felt happy that he could deliver his music to the children and make them smile. From that day on, Max visited the park every week to deliver his cheerful music to the children.

Once there was a farmer who loved to give. He gave to everyone that he saw. One day, he wanted to do something extra special. He decided to give an incredible gift. 

He built a huge barn. It was so big that it could fit many animals. The farmer gave the barn to his neighbour. She was so happy with the barn. She could now keep all of her animals safe.

The farmer was happy that he was able to give something incredible. Giving was the best thing ever and the farmer always wanted to do it. Everyone was so happy with the barn and the farmer's incredible gift!

Once upon a time, there was a hidden farm. On this farm, there were many animals. There was a big red barn where the animals lived. The farm grew lots of corn.

One sunny day, a small mouse and a big cow were talking. The mouse said, "I want to enter the corn field." The cow said, "Okay, let's go!" So, the mouse and the cow went to the corn field.

When they entered the corn field, they saw many tall corn plants. They walked and talked, and had lots of fun. The mouse and the cow were very happy. They played together in the corn field all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a big gate in the park. The gate was always open for kids to play. One day, a little boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went to play in the park. They saw the gate and ran through it. Tim felt happy.

Tim saw a ball and wanted to hold it. But another boy, named Sam, also wanted to hold the ball. Tim and Sam both felt guilty because they both wanted the ball. They didn't know what to do.

Then, Tim had an idea. He said, "Let's both hold the ball and play together!" Sam liked the idea, and they both held the ball. They played all day and became good friends. From that day on, the gate in the park was a place where everyone learned to share and play together.

Once there was a little cat who was always losing things around the house. He would misplace his toys, his food, and even his scales. One day, the cat's master decided to help him by putting some scales in different places around the house so the little cat wouldn't lose them anymore. He made sure that the scales were available for the cat to use when needed. 

One day the cat saw the scales around the house and was very happy. He was so excited he jumped in the air and screamed, "Found!" Then he realized that he was mistaken and felt bad. He remembered that the scales were not lost, they were available so he gave some thought to the lesson he had learned.

The little cat then understood that it is better to be patient and look for lost items before jumping to conclusions. That way an available item won't be mistakenly declared as lost. 

From then on, the little cat made sure to be patient and look in all places before concluding something was lost. This showed him that it is important to think things through and not jump to conclusions.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw pictures of flowers and animals. One day, her mom gave her a special folder to keep all her drawings safe. Lily was so excited to have her own folder!

She ran to her room and carefully placed all her drawings inside. She felt happy knowing that her drawings were safe in her special folder. Every day, Lily would draw more pictures and add them to her folder.

One day, Lily's friend came over to play. She saw the folder and asked what it was for. Lily told her it was her special folder where she keeps all her drawings. Her friend was excited too and asked if she could draw a picture to put in the folder. Lily happily agreed and they spent the afternoon drawing together. From that day on, Lily and her friend kept adding more pictures to the special folder, making it even more special.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, John and Alex. They were playing in the park together. 

Suddenly, they heard a loud leak coming from the playground. They both looked around to see where it was coming from.

Alex said, "What's that noise?"

John answered, "I think it's a leak!"

They both went over to take a closer look. Sure enough, there was water pouring out of the slide. It was a funny sight! 

John and Alex decided to try and fix the leak. After a few minutes of brainstorming, they had the perfect solution. They took some sand from the sandbox and put it in the hole where the leak was coming from. 

The leak was fixed and John and Alex were both very proud of their work. The park was much better now, and it was finally time for them to go home. 

They had had so much fun, that they promised each other that they would come back to the park as soon as possible.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a cat named Mittens. One day, Mittens got lost in the big forest. Lily was very sad and cried a lot. She looked for Mittens everywhere but couldn't find him.

One day, Lily's friends came to her house and asked why she was so sad. Lily told them about Mittens. Her friends decided to help her find Mittens. They searched the forest and finally found Mittens. Lily was very happy and celebrated with her friends.

When they got back to Lily's house, they saw her mom was very angry. She said they were making too much noise and needed to be quiet. They all sat down in silence and played with Mittens. Lily's friends felt bad for her because they knew she was poor and couldn't afford to buy new toys. They decided to give her some of their toys as a gift. Lily was so happy and thanked her friends. They all hugged and celebrated together.

One morning, the sun began to rise. It was a beautiful sunrise with the sky filled with big, fluffy clouds. Martha was so eager to start the day. She took one last stretch and jumped out of bed.

Martha went outside to her garden, looking for something new to test out. She saw a big tree, with a swing hanging from it. Martha was so excited, and without a second thought, she ran over and jumped onto the swing.

She held onto the ropes and pushed off the ground. She was soaring through the air! She was so eager to do it again and she went higher and higher each time. Martha was having the time of her life!

Eventually, Martha was so tired from all the swinging, she had to take a break. She sat in the warm morning sunshine and just enjoyed the moment. Martha had had a great morning already and the day had only just begun.

Once there was a little dragon named Bob. He lived with his family in a cozy cave at the edge of a forest.

One day, Bob decided to go outside and explore. He flew through the trees and soon noticed a brilliant flame burning in the middle of a clearing. He flew around it in awe of its beauty, but he was careful not to get too close.

Bob wanted to show his family who he found and so he flew back to his cave. When he arrived, he could see that his family was very excited.

"What is it, Bob?" asked his mom.

"I found a brilliant flame," he said.

"That's amazing! Now act quickly and fly back to it before it goes away!" said his dad.

Bob was so excited to go back, he flew as fast as his little wings could carry him and soon he was back at the clearing. The flame was still burning and he was so proud to have found it. He flew around it in delight, feeling the warmth and strength of the flame.

When it was time to leave, Bob was sad to say goodbye. But he knew that although the flame may not always be there, he would always remember the brilliant sight it had been.

Once upon a time there was a brave little fish. The fish loved to explore the big lake. One day, the fish decided to dive the deepest it ever had. As the little fish dove, it noticed something shiny and interesting. The fish swam closer and it saw a modern scale! The fish swam around the scale, admiring its beauty. The fish was so excited and happy. It wanted to get a closer look, so it dove right into the scale! As the fish swam closer, it saw bright colors inside the scale. It thought it was the most amazing thing ever! The brave little fish spent the rest of the day exploring the modern scale. It was the best adventure ever!

Tom and Jen are friends. They like to play in the snow. They make a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They give him a carrot nose and two rocks for eyes.

"Look, our snowman is so nice!" Jen says.

"Yes, he is. But he is also cold. Do you think he is happy?" Tom asks.

"I don't know. Maybe he likes the snow. Maybe he likes to freeze." Jen says.

They hear a loud noise. It is a big truck. It comes to their street. It has a big shovel. It pushes the snow away.

"Oh no! The truck is coming! It will take our snowman!" Tom says.

They run to their snowman. They hug him. They try to save him.

"Stop! Stop! Don't take our snowman!" Jen shouts.

But the truck does not stop. It does not see them. It is too dark. It is too crazy. It shovels the snow and the snowman. It throws them away.

Tom and Jen are sad. They cry. They lose their snowman.

"Bye, snowman. We love you." Tom says.

"Bye, snowman. We will miss you." Jen says.

They go home. They are cold. They are wet. They are sad. They hope their snowman is happy somewhere. They hope he likes to freeze.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Luke. Luke was only 3. 

One day, Luke wanted to help the farmers. He wanted to protect their corn. 

So, Luke went to the farm and took a big bucket. He was very brave. He filled the bucket with corn and ran very fast. 

The corn was hot in the afternoon sun, but Luke didn't mind. He kept running and soon he was back in the safety of his own home. 

Luke was happy because he had protected the corn from the hot sun. 

The end.

Harry the bear was very excited. It was his birthday and he was going to have a party in his house. Harry wanted to make his house look special so he asked his mum if they could decorate it. His mum agreed, so they got some white streamers and balloons. They put the white streamers on the walls and the ceiling. They made the house look magical. 

Next, Harry's mum said it was time for a treat. She brought out a big white cake with his name on it. He was so excited and he couldnâ€™t wait to eat it. Everyone had a lot of fun at the party eating the cake and playing games. 

When the party was over, they cleaned up all the decorations and treats. Harry was so happy that he had such a wonderful birthday. He thanked his mum for making it so special and he said he wouldn't forget his special day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going on adventures with her dog, Max. One day, they went for a walk in the park and saw a butterfly resting on a flower. 

Lily said, "Look Max! The butterfly is resting. It must be tired." 

Max barked happily and wagged his tail. Suddenly, they saw an ugly bug crawling on the ground. 

Lily said, "That bug is not pretty, but it is still important. It is a part of life." 

Max barked again, and Lily giggled. They continued their walk, enjoying the sunshine and the fresh air. When they got home, they both rested and took a nap. It had been a fun day!

Once upon a time, there was a happy infant. Everyday, her parents would spoil her with love and affection. Every hug made her feel warm and cozy inside!

One day, the infant's parents decided to take her to the park. She was so excited that she squealed with delight! She ran around the large, wide fields, and explored the playground.

As the sun began to set, the parents gathered the infant back together. They took her to the nearby ice cream shop, telling her they had a special treat in store. When they arrived, they gave the infant a large, delicious ice cream cone! She was so happy that she could hardly contain her joy.

But before the infant could finish the treat, it started to rainâ€”hard! Laughing, the parents ran with her back home, safe and snug under their umbrellas. Once inside, the infant was spoilt once more, with warm blankets and a hot cup of milk. She was delighted, and so glad she didn't have to give up her special treat!

Once upon a time, there was a frog. It was pale and seemed sad. One day, it made a wish on a star. Suddenly, something magical happened! The frog began to glow! It glowed brighter and brighter until it was almost too much to look at. The frog stopped glowing and hopped away happily. It had learned a very important lesson - that wishes can come true as long as you believe.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear named Bubba. He was strong, brave, and had a loud, deep roar.

One day, Bubba went to the park to meet all of his friends. He saw his friend, elephant Abby. Abby said to him, "Hello Bubba, what's wrong?" Bubba said, "I need an operation today. I am worried."

Abby said to him, "Don't worry, Bubba, you'll be fine. I have something yummy for you! Here's a honey sandwich."

Bubba took the yummy sandwich and started munching. Then he gave a big roar of thanks to his friend. Bubba felt better, and was ready for his operation.

The next day, Bubba was feeling much better. He went back to the park to thank Abby, and to roar happily with all his friends.

Once upon a time there was an oak tree which stood very high. A little girl loved playing around the tree. Every night she would go to the oak tree and talk to it. One night, the little girl said to the oak tree, "I wish I could climb you!"

The oak tree replied, "I'm sorry, I'm too high to let you climb me. You'll fall."

The little girl felt disappointed but she refused to give up. She told the oak tree, "I'm sure if I try, I can make it to the top!"

The oak tree said nothing and the little girl went away. Every night she kept returning to the oak tree and each time she told it, "I still think I can make it to the top of you."

One night, the oak tree replied, "I believe you can, if you try very hard."

The little girl was so excited and she started to climb the oak tree. She worked very hard and with a lot of effort, she finally reached the top. The little girl was so proud of herself and shouted with joy.

It turns out the oak tree was just waiting for her to finally refuse to give up. After that, it became the little girl's favourite spot. 

From that day on, the little girl and the oak tree were the best of friends.

Once there was a little girl named Joy who loved to learn. One day, she decided to learn about whales. She asked her mom, "Mommy, what is a whale?â€ Her mom said, â€œItâ€™s a big, messy animal that lives in the ocean.â€

Joy was very excited to find out more about whales, so she asked her mom, â€œCan I see a whale?â€ Her mom said, â€œNo, Joy, you canâ€™t. Whales live far away in the ocean and itâ€™s not safe to go there.â€

Joy was sad not to be able to see a whale, so she asked her mom, â€œMommy, how can I learn more about whales?â€ Her mom said, â€œYou can read books and watch movies about whales. That way, you can learn all about them without ever going to the ocean.â€

Joy thought about her mom's words, and she realized that even if she couldnâ€™t go to the ocean to see a whale, she still could learn a lot by reading and watching movies. She understood that learning can be fun and safe at the same time.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Minnie. She lived in a house with her Mommy and Daddy. 

One day, Minnie and her Mommy were in the kitchen and Minnie noticed something new. On the counter was a big ugly stove!

Minnie asked her Mommy, â€œWhat is that?â€

Her Mommy smiled and said, â€œThat is a stove. With it we can cook up all kinds of delicious food and enjoy it together.â€

Minnie was excited and asked if she could help. Her Mommy said, â€œOf course you can help me. Letâ€™s make you a yummy snack.â€ 

Minnie and her Mommy enjoyed cooking together and Minnie was so happy when the snack was ready for her to eat. 

They all had fun that day and Minnie loved using the ugly stove.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck who lived by a stream. The stream was her home and she loved to swim in it every day. One day, she met a kind frog who became her friend. They would play together and have fun all day long.

The little duck always remembered to visit her friend by the stream. She knew she could depend on him to make her happy. But one day, when she went to see him, she found out that he was gone. She searched and searched but he was nowhere to be found.

The little duck was very sad and missed her dependable friend. She swam in the stream alone, feeling lonely and lost. She wished her friend was with her again. Sadly, she realized that she would never see him again. The end.

Once there was a small boy called Tony. He was only three years old. His mum and dad said to him one day, "You can choose your own food for dinner tonight, Tony!"

Tony was so excited. He chose a small apple, a banana and some chips. He thought this was the very best food ever. 

However, when Tony ate the food, he started to feel unwell. He felt funny in his tummy and he had to rush to the toilet. His mum and dad said, "Oh, Tony - it was a bad choice for dinner!"

Tony was so sad. His tummy hurt and he had to sit on the toilet for a long time. He realised that sometimes it isn't so fun to choose your own food!

One day, Timmy and his mommy were walking in the woods. It was a very gloomy day, but Timmy still wanted to explore. Mommy warned him to be careful, but he was too curious to listen. He ran ahead, climbing up and down the hills. 

Suddenly, a creek appeared in front of him. But he noticed a hot, fast-moving steam floating on the surface. It was very hot, but Timmy had to cross the creek. He was scared, but he put his brave face on and did it. He carefully followed the stream of hot air, and he found his way to the other side. 

When Timmy made it to safety, his mommy was there. She hugged him tightly and said, "You have been so brave today." She was so proud of him.

From then on, Timmy never stopped exploring the woods. Whenever he would come across a hot, gloomy day, he would always remember his brave journey and smile.

Once upon a time, there was a brown tiger who lived in the jungle. One day, the tiger went walking through the jungle, looking for something. Suddenly, he met a little monkey. The monkey was very friendly and wanted to be the tiger's friend.

The tiger was happy to meet the monkey and he wanted to introduce himself. He said, "Hello, my name is Tiger. What's your name?" The little monkey was very excited and said his name right away. He said, "My name is Monkey, nice to meet you!"

The tiger and the monkey became best friends and they decided to explore the jungle together. They ran, jumped and laughed as they explored the jungle. They even found a tree with a swing and played all day long.

The tiger and the monkey became the best of friends and they had many more fun adventures together in the brown, beautiful jungle.

One day, a brave cat named Tom went outside to play. He liked to watch the birds in the sky and the fish in the pond. Tom was very brave and always ready for an adventure.

Tom saw a big tuna fish in the pond. The tuna was swimming fast and splashing water. Tom wanted to catch the tuna, so he jumped into the pond. The water was cold, but Tom did not mind.

Tom swam and swam, trying to catch the tuna. The tuna was very fast, but Tom was brave and did not give up. In the end, Tom caught the tuna and brought it back to his house. Tom was very happy and proud of his brave adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a long mark on the ground. It was a nice sunny day and Mark decided to take a nap there. He laid down and closed his eyes, and he was soon fast asleep.

As Mark was napping, a bird flew down from the sky and perched on a nearby branch. It chirped and sang a sweet little song, and Mark even smiled in his sleep.

After a long nap, Mark finally opened his tired eyes. He stretched out his arms and legs, and rubbed his eyes with his fists. He knelt down and touched the long mark with his fingers. He smiled and remembered the nice nap he had taken there.

Once upon a time, there was a happy bunny named Benny. Benny loved to hop and play in the green grass. One day, Benny heard a loud noise. It sounded like a big truck! Benny was scared and wanted to run away. But then he saw his friend, a wise owl named Ollie. Ollie winked at Benny and said, "Don't be afraid, it's just a thunderstorm." Benny felt better and wasn't scared anymore.

Later that day, Benny saw his little sister, Bonnie, eating all the carrots in the garden. Benny knew he shouldn't have eaten them all, but Bonnie looked so guilty. Benny said, "It's okay, Bonnie. We can share." And they both ate the carrots together, happy and content.

Davey was in his garden with his dad. His dad was digging up a big pile of clay. "What are you doing?" Davey asked.

"I am making a great big pot!" said his dad.

Davey laughed. He picked up a piece of clay, and rolled it around his hands. His dad looked over at him.

"Do you want to help me?" he said.

Davey smiled, and nodded. Together they made their way to the hole and started to put some clay in.

Davey watched as his dad patted the clay down. Then he grabbed a stick and started making designs on top.

Davey liked them a lot.

When they were finished, they put all the clay they had gathered into the hole. They began to bury it.

When they were done, they put their hands together and smiled.

"Great job, Davey!" said his dad.

Davey beamed with pride. He had helped make a great pot!

Sara and Ben are playing in the yard. They like to run and jump and laugh. The sky is blue and the sun is bright. They are happy.

But then they hear a loud sound. Boom! Boom! Boom! It is a storm. The sky is dark and the wind is strong. They see flashes of light and hear more booms. They are scared.

They run to the house and knock on the door. "Mom! Mom! Let us in!" they cry. But no one answers. They knock again and again. But still no answer. Where is Mom?

They look around and see a red car in the driveway. It is Mom's car. They run to the car and open the door. They see Mom sitting in the front seat. She has a phone in her hand. She is talking to someone.

"Mom! Mom! There is a storm! We are scared!" they shout. Mom looks at them and smiles. She puts down the phone and hugs them.

"I'm sorry, my loves. I didn't hear you. I was on the phone with Grandma. She is okay. She is in a safe place. The storm will pass soon. Don't worry. Come inside with me. We can have some cookies and milk and read a story. How does that sound?"

Sara and Ben nod and smile. They are happy. They love Mom. They love Grandma. They love cookies and milk and stories. They are not scared anymore. They follow Mom into the house. The storm is still loud, but they don't mind. They are safe and warm and cozy. They are happy.

Mum took Lilly out of the house and into the park. Lilly saw a lot of people and she felt excited. She ran to the swings and jumped on them.

Mum said, "I am going to bring you a cake! Would you like that?" 
Lilly smiled and said, "Yes, please!"

So Mum went off and came back with a big, white, tidy cake. Lilly was delighted and hugged Mum. 
Mum said, "Let's take the cake to the picnic spot and eat it together". 

They went to the spot and sat down. Mum cut the cake into slices and gave one to Lilly.

Lilly held the cake in her hand and said, "Yummy! I love this cake, mum!"

Mum smiled and said, "I am glad you like it, my darling".

Once there was a boy named Mark. He was eager to get a special pass. It was a pass to enter the secret garden.

Every morning Mark would wipe off the fog on the window to try and look for the secret garden. One day, he saw a bright light in the sky. He knew it was a sign that the pass was near.

He quickly jumped out of bed and ran outside. There it was, the pass! He wiped off the dew and held it tight in his hands.

He was so excited! He wanted to show the pass to his friends. He ran to the secret garden and was finally able to go inside. He was the happiest he had ever been.

Once upon a time, there was a big red flower. It lived in a garden with many other flowers. One day, a little girl came to visit the garden. She saw the big red flower and said, "Wow! That flower is so pretty!"

The flower heard the little girl and said, "Thank you! I just bloomed today. My name is Rosie."

The little girl smiled and said, "Hi Rosie! My name is Lily. Do you have a mustache?"

Rosie was confused. "A mustache? No, I don't have a mustache. Why do you ask?"

Lily giggled and pointed to the center of the flower. "That part in the middle looks like a mustache to me!"

Rosie laughed and said, "Oh, that's just my stamen. It helps me make seeds so I can grow more flowers like me."

Lily was amazed and said, "You're so cool, Rosie! I hope I can come back to see you bloom again someday." And with that, she waved goodbye and skipped away from the garden.

One day, Jack and his mommy were in the store shopping when they came across a big box of shiny wraps. Jack's mommy paused and asked him, "Do you want to buy this wrap and spend some of your piggy bank money?" Jack thought it over and then agreed.

He and his mommy took the wrap home, but mommy warned him not to open it 'till his birthday. Jack was very excited, but he was also very lazy and he couldn't wait.

So the next day, Jack tried to think about how he could get the wrap open without his mommy noticing. He decided to sneak into the living room and peek inside, but as soon as he opened it, his mommy was standing there looking very unhappy.

She said, "Jack, I thought I told you to wait till your birthday to unwrap your present? Now we have to re-wrap it."

Jack felt a bit guilty, but he was still very excited to finally see what was inside! On his birthday, he eagerly opened the wrap to find the toy he had been wanting for so long. His mommy was glad to see that, despite being a bit lazy, Jack had learned his lesson and would be more patient next time.

Lily and Ben are playing with their toys. They have many things to play with: cars, dolls, blocks, and puzzles. Lily likes puzzles. She likes to match the pieces that have the same shape and color. Ben likes cars. He likes to make them go fast and make noises.

"Look, Lily, I have a red car and a blue car. They are very fast and loud. Vroom, vroom!" Ben says.

"Look, Ben, I have a puzzle with animals. They are very cute and quiet. See, this is a cat and this is a dog. They match!" Lily says.

They show each other their toys and smile. They are happy to play together.

But then, the wind blows and the door opens. A cold air comes in. Lily and Ben shiver. They feel cold.

"Brrr, it is cold. I don't like cold. Do you, Lily?" Ben asks.

"No, I don't like cold either. Let's close the door and get a blanket. Then we can play more." Lily says.

They run to the door and close it. They find a big blanket and wrap it around them. They feel warm and cozy. They go back to their toys and play more. They match their puzzles and race their cars. They have fun. They are happy.

Once there was a rhinoceros. He had lots of friends but he was always anxious about something bad happening to them. He never knew what the bad thing was, but he was always worried. One day, he was talking to his friends. Suddenly, something bad did happen.

The rhinoceros felt really scared and he ran away. His friends were worried - they wanted to help but they didn't know how. After a while, the rhinoceros came back. He was very happy to see his friends. They hugged and were all very relieved that nothing bad had happened.

From then on, the rhinoceros wasn't so anxious anymore. He was happy to be with his friends and knew that if something bad did happen, they would be there to help.

Jazz loved the wise owl. Every day she flew around the forest to say hello to the owl. The owl was always happy to see her and they'd have long talks.

One day, Jazz decided to give the owl something special. She gathered some nuts and seeds and put them inside a shiny glass jar. She brought it to the owl and he was so pleased! He thanked her with a big hug.

Jazz was so happy. Every day she would come with something special for the owl. The sparkle in their eyes said it all; they truly loved each other.

From that day on, Jazz visited the wise owl every day. Together, they'd listen to the pretty jazz music that filled the trees and watch the sun setting in the sky. No matter what happened, their love would live forever.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. Sarah was three years old, and always wanted to catch something.

One cold day Sarah was outside wearing her warm jacket and mittens. She saw a little squirrel and she loves animals, so she decided to try to catch it.

She quietly came up behind the squirrel, but it was so fast that she couldn't catch it. She was so sad, but then she had an idea. She put her mitten on the ground and the squirrel came over to it. She quickly scooped it up and was glad that she finally caught something.

Her dad saw what she had done and said, "I'm glad that you caught something, but sometimes it's best to just appreciate animals in nature and not try to catch them".

Sarah felt so happy that she had caught the squirrel, but she was also glad to have learned a valuable lesson that day. She would never try to catch animals ever again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was a very happy child and her favorite thing to do was play in the garden.

One day, while she was playing in the garden, she saw something very brown on the ground. It was a big stick and when she picked it up it made a funny noise, like it was about to snap!

Jane thought it was very exciting and decided to run around with it. But then, suddenly, SNAP! The stick broke right in two.

Jane started to cry, realizing what trouble she had caused. Her mom came out and scolded her until finally, she was sent to her room where she was very sad.

The end.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was an ordinary bus. The bus was big and yellow. Every day, the bus took kids to school and back home. The bus driver was a nice man named Tom.

One day, the bus was on its way to school. The kids were happy and talking. Suddenly, a little cat ran in front of the bus. Tom saw the cat and said, "Oh no! I must save the cat!" He stopped the bus very fast. The kids were scared, but they knew Tom was trying to help.

Tom got off the bus and picked up the cat. He said, "Don't worry, little cat. You are safe now." The kids on the bus cheered. They were happy that Tom saved the cat. From that day on, the kids knew that their ordinary bus was also a hero bus.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who lived in a village. He was very confused one day when he saw many people running around. Suddenly, he heard a loud sound, and he knew something was happening. He asked his father, "What's wrong?" 

His father replied, "We must release the animals!" 

The little boy was even more confused now, so his father explained. "The village has been surrounded by wild animals. We must let them out so they don't attack us or hurt anyone in the village. So, the villagers have to release them from their cages." 

The little boy nodded his head in understanding. He was no longer confused, and he helped the people release the animals. After the animals had been released, the village was safe again.

Once upon a time there was a little fish who wanted to come and see the world. But the world was a big and difficult place and he was scared to come. Every night he would look at the stars, dreaming of what it could be like outside the pond.

Then one day his best friend the bee came over and told him the news. He said that if the little fish came with him, he could show him the beautiful world outside their pond.

The little fish was so excited that he swam as fast as he could to come with the bee. When he came to the top of the water, he saw a world that was so much bigger than his pond! There were trees, and clouds and even other fish!

Little Fish was so happy that he wanted to stay forever. He thanked his best friend the bee and promised to come back and visit often.

The little fish still comes back to visit his pond, but now he knows that the world is a special and beautiful place. And he will never forget how difficult it was to make the journey out of the pond.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to slide. She slid down the hill with her blanket, it felt so nice and warm. She ran and ran, back and forth, until she was tired. 

But when the little girl got to the bottom of the hill, she noticed something strange. Her blanket was wet. She realized it had rained while she had been playing. 

The little girl was sad. How was she going to slide without her dry blanket? She asked her mom for help. 

"Mom, the blanket is wet. What can I do?"

"That's no problem," said her mom. "We can hang the blanket over the clothesline and let the sun dry it. Then you can keep sliding."

The little girl smiled and ran outside with her blanket. After a few minutes in the sunshine, her blanket was dry and she kept sliding until she was tired. 

The little girl was happy that she had found a way to enjoy her slides with her warm and dry blanket.

Once upon a time there was a parrot called Pete. He was a happy parrot and flew around from tree to tree in the sunshine. Every evening he would fly to the same tree and say hello to his animal friends.

One day, Pete saw something different. It was a big yellow thing that flew in the sky. Pete was excited and tried to follow it. He flew after it for a long time until the big yellow thing could no longer be seen.

Pete was sad but he tried to remember the big yellow thing. He wanted to tell his friends all about it. When he got back home, his friends were glad to see him. Pete told them all about the big yellow thing and everyone was excited.

From then on, Pete always remembered the big yellow thing. He made sure to look up at the sky every day in case it came back. Although it never did, Pete was glad that he could still remember it.

Once upon a time, there was a rough jungle. It was full of tall trees and bright flowers. Animals all around made it come alive.

One day, a little girl named Julia went deep into the jungle. She was very brave. She wanted to explore.

As she went she had to watch out for thorns. She had to mind where she stepped. It was often very muddy.

As she went further and further the jungle was getting thicker. The trees were closer together and there were more bushes. It began to get really dark. Julia was starting to feel a bit scared.

Then, all of a sudden, she heard an animal sound. She looked up and saw a beautiful parrot. The parrot said, "Don't be afraid, mind your way and you'll be out soon."

Julia followed the parrot's advice. Sure enough, after some time, she found herself out of the rough jungle. She felt so happy and relieved. She had made it!

Once upon a time there lived a happy little boy named Jack. He loved to play outside and make new friends. 

One day, Jack was playing in the park when he stumbled upon an old, rusty trap. It was a scary sight. He froze as he tried to remember where he had seen something like it before. 

Jack called out to his friend, "Hey, do you know what this is?"

His friend replied, "I think it's an animal trap. People use it to trap animals but it looks dead now."

Jack remembered hearing a story about animal traps that his grandma had told him. He shivered. He was glad he was safe from the trap's danger. 

Jack and his friend decided it was best to leave the trap and never come back. They ran away as fast as they could and never looked back. 

The End.

John walked in the park. He saw something shining on the ground. He went to take a look. It was a thin skull. He was very surprised.

John shook the skull and heard a musical sound. He decided to join the music. He started to sing and dance with the skull.

Suddenly, a little girl appeared. She asked John what he was doing. He smiled and said "I'm joining the music with this thin skull!"

The little girl smiled. She joined him and they danced together in the park for a long time.

When John and the little girl finished their song, the sun was setting. They said goodbye and went home. John kept the thin skull in his pocket. Every time he wanted to join the music, he knew what to do.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with clay. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. They all had different colors of clay. Lily had green clay.

Lily wanted to make a big castle with her green clay. But it was hard to manage. She tried and tried, but it kept falling apart. Her friends tried to help her, but it was still hard. 

Finally, Lily managed to make a small castle. It wasn't as big as she wanted, but it was still fun to play with. Her friends liked it too. They all played with their clay together and had a great time. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to go outside. It was winter and the sun was shining brightly. She opened the door and stepped outside. She was so excited! The winter air was chilly and the trees were full of snow. Everything looked so charming. 

The little girl ran and twirled and laughed. She loved the winter! 

As she ran, she saw a group of kids sledding down a big hill. She wanted to play with them, so she asked her mom if she could go sledding too. 

"Of course," her mom said. "Just be careful and take your coat."

The little girl smiled as she put on her coat. She was so happy that she could play with the other children. She ran over to the hill and they all had so much fun sledding down the hill together. 

"This is the best winter ever!" she said to her mom as she ran back inside.

One day Jake saw a black nose in the park. He ran to touch it and saw it was a black cat! Jake was so excited and he started to give the cat a big squeeze. The cat meowed but then it purred and Jake knew he liked being squeezed. 

"Don't squeeze me too hard Jake," said the cat. Jake calmed down and started to pet the cat instead. He rubbed the black nose and it felt so soft. The cat purred again and Jake smiled. 

Jake and the cat played together for the rest of the day. The cat enjoyed getting his nose rubbed and the sun was bright and warm. The day was perfect! When the day was over, Jake and the cat said goodbye and Jake walked home. He was already looking forward to the next time he and the cat could play together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved lions. Lions were her favorite animal and she made it her job to learn all there was to know about them. She was fascinated by the big, modern cats and loved to dream about cuddling them.

One day, the girl saw a beautiful lion walking in the park. He was big, with a stunning modern mane, and his eyes sparkled like gems. The girl was so excited and couldn't wait to introduce herself.

So, she stepped right up to the lion and said, "Hi, my name is Jane. I love lions. What's your name?"

The lion smiled and said, "My name is King. I'm so happy to meet you, Jane. And I love you too!"

The girl couldn't believe it. She had made a new friend! From that day on, Jane and King would always meet at the park, and they were always absolutely happy to see each other. For Jane, it was the best feeling in the world.

Once there was a family who wanted to find a house. It took a long time, but finally they found just the right house. It was peaceful and comfortable.

Once upon a time, in a big gray house, there lived a kind girl named Amy. Amy loved to help her mom and dad. She also loved to teach her little brother, Tim, new things. They would play and learn together every day.

Anna and Ben were playing with paper. They liked to fold the paper and make different shapes. Anna made a hat, and Ben made a boat. They put their shapes on the table and smiled.

Mommy had to go to the kitchen and cook dinner. She told Anna and Ben to stay in the living room and play nicely.

"OK, Mommy, we will be good," Anna and Ben said.

But when Mommy left, Ben had a naughty idea. He saw Mommy's phone on the sofa. He wanted to play with it. He took the phone and ran to the corner.

"Ben, don't touch Mommy's phone. It is not a toy. You will break it," Anna said.

But Ben did not listen. He pressed the buttons and made noises. He thought it was fun.

Mommy forgave Ben and hugged him back. She said she loved him too. She also praised Anna for being good and careful. She gave her a kiss and said she could wear the hat.

Sara and Ben are eager to play in the park. They run to the swings, the slide and the seesaw. They have a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a clear candle. The candle was very shiny and sparkly in the sun.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Millie who loved going to the beach. One day, Millie went to the beach with her mama and when she saw the waves, she really wanted to go in. Mama said no, so Millie pouted and ran away.

Millie saw a big metal track and wanted to play on it. It was cheap so she thought it would be a fun way to spend the day. Millie started running on the track but quickly realized it was wet. She had stepped in a big puddle and got all soaked.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Rocky who loved nothing more than playing in all the sunshine and bright colors. One day, he went to the big corn field to pick up some tasty snacks. But when he got there, Rocky noticed that all the corn was drooping down and helpless. Rocky knew that something must be wrong and he wanted to help, so he started to glow brightly. Rocky hopped back home, feeling happy and contented. He knew that he'll never forget the invaluable lesson of learning to help his friends.

Lily likes to ride her bike. She has a pink bike with a basket and a bell. She puts on her helmet and gloves and goes outside. She sees her friend Ben on his blue bike.

"Hi, Lily!" Ben says. "Do you want to race with me?"

Lily nods. She likes to race with Ben. They pedal fast and go around the park. Lily feels happy and excited. She rings her bell and smiles.

But then, Lily feels something wrong. Her bike makes a funny noise. She looks down and sees her tire is flat. She stops and gets off her bike. She feels sad and scared.

"Are you okay, Lily?" Ben asks. He stops and gets off his bike too. He sees Lily's flat tire. He feels sorry for her.

"My tire is flat," Lily says. "I can't ride my bike anymore. I don't know what to do."

Ben thinks for a moment. He has an idea. He says, "Don't worry, Lily. I can help you. You can ride on my bike with me. We can share. I have a big seat and a big pedal. You can sit behind me and hold on to me. It will be fun."

Lily looks at Ben's bike. She feels unsure and uncomfortable. She has never ridden on someone else's bike before. She says, "But what if I fall? What if I hurt you? What if your bike breaks too?"

Ben smiles. He helps Lily get on his bike. He says, "Hold on tight, Lily. Ready, set, go!"

They pedal together and go around the park. Lily feels nervous at first, but then she feels safe and happy. She rings her bell and laughs. Ben feels proud and happy too. He says, "You are doing great, Lily. You are brave and smart. We are a good team."

One day, a young boy and his mother were walking in the park. They noticed a strange station with a sign that said "Come and study!". The boy was curious, so he asked his mother what it was. She explained that people went to the station to learn things.

Josh was feeling brave and wanted to win a prize. He walked up to the wheel and asked his mom if he could give it a throw.

Once upon a time, there was a playful kitten. The kitten loved to play with her friends, but mostly by herself. She liked to chase lumber and snap it into pieces.

One day, a little girl named Lily was playing in her room. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bear. Suddenly, her mom called her for lunch. Lily was hungry and went to the kitchen. She saw her mom cooking yummy food and she was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bubbly little girl, who was always getting up to something silly. She was always eager to explore and try new things.

Once upon a time there was a farm. On the farm, the animals were stirring everywhere. The chickens were looking for food, the cows were munching on hay and the cats were dashing around.

Tim and Mia were friends who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big tree with many peaches on it. The peaches looked juicy and sweet, and they wanted to try one.

"Let's get a peach from the tree," Tim said.

Tim had an idea. He saw a big rock near the tree. He said, "We can use the rock to climb on. Then we can reach the peaches."

Mia agreed. They pushed the rock to the tree and climbed on it. They stretched their arms and tried to grab a peach. But the peaches were still too far.

They saw an old man walking by. He had a long stick in his hand. He saw the children and smiled.

"Hello, little ones. What are you doing?" he asked.

"We want a peach from the tree, but we can't reach them," Tim said.

The old man nodded. He said, "I can help you. I have a stick that can knock down a peach for you. But first, you have to answer a question. Do you know what makes a person wise?"

Tim and Mia thought hard. They remembered what their parents and teachers had told them.

Tim said, "A person is wise if they listen and learn."

Mia said, "A person is wise if they are kind and fair."

The old man smiled again. He said, "You are both right. You are smart and good children. Here, let me get you a peach."

He used his stick to hit a peach from the tree. It fell on the ground and rolled to Tim and Mia. They thanked the old man and picked up the peach. They shared it and ate it. It was delicious.

They were happy. They had succeeded in getting a peach from the tree. They had also learned something from the old man. They decided to be wise like him.

Mum was in the kitchen, measuring sugar. She was getting ready to make toast. 

Mum looked down at her daughter and said, "Would you like orange toast or brown?"

The three-year-old looked down at her plate and smiled as she started to eat. She savoured every mouthful and said, "Mum, I love orange toast!"

Once upon a time two friends, Sam and Amy, went on a march. It was a bright sunny day, and they had lots of fun.

Once upon a time there was a brilliant car. It was so shiny and new. One day, the car drove off on an adventure! Along the way, it drove through a forest.

Suddenly, Bob noticed a very shiny rock at the edge of the cliff. It was so sparkly and pretty. He decided to grab it and keep it as a souvenir. Bob felt really happy with his new rock and smiled.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his toys, but he always wanted more. One day, he saw a shiny toy in the store. Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys. His favorite toy was a big red ball. He liked to kick the ball around the yard.

Tim and Mia were playing in the park. They liked to dig in the sand and look for treasures. One day, they found something shiny and hard in the sand. It was gold!

One day, he met a small girl. She was very young, only three years old, and she was alone. The dog smiled at her friendly, but the girl looked scared. "What's your name?" He asked her softly.

The girl shivered, but answered bravely. "My name is Alice," she said.

The dog felt a warmth in his chest, realizing that he had a new friend. Every morning, Alice would come and the two would run around and play together.

But one morning, Alice did not rise. The dog waited and waited but she still did not come so he started to look for her. After a long search, he finally found her. She was standing in the back of a big truck, and she looked very scared and frustrated.

The dog barked and barked, trying to get her attention, but she did not hear him. The truck started to move and the dog watched sadly as his best friend drove away. He felt so alone and frustrated that he laid down and did not rise again.

The hunter was packing. He had made a plan that he was sure would make him very happy. He put everything he needed in his bag and set off on his adventure. As he walked, he noticed something weird in the distance. He couldn't make it out, but it seemed to be calling to him. He decided to look a bit closer.

The hunter approached cautiously and saw a strange creature. The creature was very weird looking and it started to laugh. The hunter was amused, he wasn't scared and he enjoyed the strange creature's company. After some time, he asked if he could take the creature with him. 

The creature happily agreed and the hunter decided to pack it up in his bag. He knew this creature was something special, something weird yet amazing. He knew that this creature was going to be important to him. The hunter continued on his journey, excited to explore the mysteries he would discover. Sure enough, his weird little friend was the key to unlocking an adventure that he could never have imagined.

Ben and Lily were playing with their toy cars in the garden. They liked to make them go fast and make loud noises. But they also liked to make them shiny and clean. They had a cloth and some water to polish their cars.

"Look at my car, Lily. It is so shiny and red. It is the best car ever," Ben said.

"No, my car is better, Ben. It is shiny and blue. And it has a big horn that goes beep beep," Lily said.

They started to argue about whose car was better. They did not want to share their cloth and water. They pulled and pushed each other.

"Stop it, Ben. You are making my car dirty. Give me the cloth," Lily said.

"No, Lily. You are making my car wet. Give me the water," Ben said.

They were so busy fighting that they did not notice the sun. It was very hot and bright. It made their cars hot too. Soon, their cars were too hot to touch. They burned their fingers when they tried to pick them up.

"Ow, ow, ow. My car is hot. It hurts," Ben said.

"Ow, ow, ow. My car is hot too. It hurts more," Lily said.

They dropped their cars and ran to their mom. She was sitting under a tree with a book. She saw their tears and heard their cries.

"What happened, Ben and Lily? Why are you sad?" she asked.

"Our cars are hot. They burned us. We were fighting over the cloth and the water. We wanted to polish them. But now they are too hot to play with," Ben and Lily said.

Mom hugged them and kissed their fingers. She said, "I'm sorry, Ben and Lily. You should not fight over your toys. You should share and be nice to each other. And you should not leave your toys in the sun. They can get hot and hurt you. Next time, you should play in the shade or inside when it is hot. Do you understand?"

Ben and Lily nodded. They said, "We understand, Mom. We are sorry. We will share and be nice. And we will not leave our toys in the sun. Can we have some ice cream, please?"

Mom smiled. She said, "Yes, you can have some ice cream. But first, let's go and get your cars. Maybe we can polish them together later, when they are cool. How does that sound?"

Ben and Lily smiled too. They said, "That sounds good, Mom. Thank you. We love you."

They held Mom's hand and went to get their cars. They learned their lesson. They decided to play nicely and safely. And they enjoyed their ice cream. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to perform a special task. She had to put all the dirty dishes in the dishwasher. Lily was very happy to help, but she found it hard to reach the top shelf. 

"Mommy, it's too hard," Lily said. 

"Don't worry, sweetie. I'll help you," her mommy replied. 

Together, they put all the dishes in the dishwasher. Lily was so proud of herself for helping. But then, something bad happened. When they turned on the dishwasher, it made a loud noise and started to shake. Suddenly, the dishwasher exploded and water went everywhere. 

Lily and her mommy were very scared and wet. They hugged each other and cried. "I'm sorry, Mommy. I didn't mean to do it," Lily said. 

"It's okay, sweetie. We're just glad we're safe," her mommy replied. 

From that day on, they never used the dishwasher again. They washed their dishes by hand and Lily always helped.

Once upon a time, there was a ranch. On the ranch was a mommy, a daddy, and two baby chickens. The mommy and daddy were very kind and loving and the two baby chickens were always happy. 

But one day, the mommy and daddy began to worry. It was very hot, and they worried that the baby chickens were too warm. They knew they had to protect their babies, and they wanted to keep them safe and cool.

So the mommy and daddy built a tall fence around the ranch. They made sure to keep the baby chickens away from the warm sunshine. The mommy and daddy worked very hard, and soon the tall fence was finished.

The baby chickens were now safe and cool. But the mommy and daddy still worried for other things, like if the baby chickens had enough to eat and if they had enough space to run around and play. 

But the babies felt safe and content, and soon the mommy and daddy stopped worrying and went back to enjoying their beautiful ranch.
