Once upon a time there were two brothers, one was called Bob and the other was called Mike. Bob asked Mike: "What would you like best in the whole world?". Mike replied "An incredible gift". Bob said " You must be very patient and wait a minute".

Mike was so curious and waited, not knowing what the gift was. After a minute, Bob presented him with a large box filled with wonderful toys.

Mike was so excited and asked "What is this? Is it for me?". Bob said "Yes, these toys are for you. But remember, patience is very important in life. With patience, incredible things can happen!". 

Mike understood the message and was more excited about the toys. He enjoyed playing with the toys for a long time and never forgot Bob's wise words.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Tina and George. They lived near each other and enjoyed playing together in the park.

One day, they decided to pretend they were rock climbers. They gathered lots of rocks and made a big pile. Then they took turns pretending to be rock climbers and scaling the rocks. 

Tina was very polite when it was her turn. Whenever George needed help, she said,"Please let me help you" in a very kind voice.

They had a wonderful time pretending to be rock climbers, and when the day was done, they both said goodbye, agreed to come back the next day, and went home happy.

Once upon a time, in a land far away, there was a big volcano. The volcano was very grumpy and would sometimes make a loud "boom" sound. People who lived near the volcano were scared and did not like the noise.

One day, a brave girl named Lily decided to help the people. She thought the volcano was grumpy because it was hungry. She knew that the volcano liked to eat sour fruits. So, Lily went to the market to buy some sour fruits. She did not have much money, but she wanted to help. She gave her money to the man at the market and said, "I want to pay for the sour fruits, please."

Lily took the sour fruits and climbed the big volcano. When she reached the top, she said, "Mr. Volcano, I brought you some sour fruits to eat. Please don't be grumpy anymore." The volcano ate the sour fruits and stopped making the loud "boom" sound. The people were very happy and thanked Lily for her help. From that day on, the volcano was not grumpy anymore, and everyone lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a man who had a plan. He was very clever and his plan was special. He wanted to make a fast pistol. He got out a big toolbox. Then he got out some things from the toolbox. He took out some nuts and screws and other tools. He put them on the table and worked hard. After a while he had made a fast pistol. He smiled and was very happy.

Maggie was out shopping with her mommy. She saw a pretty blouse in the window. The blouse was pink and had a sparkly design on it.

Maggie asked her mommy if she could have it. Her mommy said, "No, it's too expensive."

Maggie was sad but she understood. She knew that her mommy valued the family's money and only bought things when they were really important. 

Maggie asked her mommy if they could look at some of the other shops. They went to the market and Maggie found a blouse with a spicy pattern on it. She liked it even more than the one in the window!

To Maggie's surprise, the blouse was much cheaper than the one in the window. Her mommy said yes and Maggie was so happy. She ran back to her mommy with the new blouse and hugged her tight. 

Maggie had learned a valuable lesson that day. To value family time and money, but still have fun shopping for nice things!

Mommy and baby wanted to go to the park. It was a nice day and they wanted to have fun. They saw a lizard in the park. It was green and small. It was really fast.

"I want to catch the lizard," said baby. But the lizard moved too fast. The lizard scurried around the park.

Mommy tried to help but it was too hard. "Sometimes things are too hard for us," said Mommy.

Baby got mad. She stomped her foot and said, "That lizard is so stupid!" Mommy laughed and said, "Maybe you can catch the lizard one day." 

They kept playing and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time there lived a wise old woman named Grandma. Grandma had a dishwasher that she used to wash all her dishes. She would work it diligently every day to keep her kitchen clean.

One day, she decided to take her dishwasher apart to try and fix it and make it even more efficient. As she was taking it apart, all of a sudden the dishwasher started to make a funny noise. Grandma looked perplexed and did not know what to do.

Just then, her three year old grandchild, Emily, came in and saw what was happening. She offered to help Grandma fix the dishwasher. Grandma smiled and nodded, and before long the dishwasher was back together and running smoothly. 

Grandma thanked Emily for her help and hugged her. Emily proudly went off to play, feeling very wise for helping her Grandma.

Once upon a time, a nosy bear named Benny lived in a tall tree. He loved to climb up and down, but he could never get to the top. His lumber pile was too small.

Then one day, Benny had an idea. He went to all the animals in the forest and asked for help. He wanted some help to solve his problem.

All the animals worked together and built a super big lumber pile. Now Benny was able to climb to the very top of the tall tree.

When Benny got to the top, he was so happy! He could now see the entire forest. He couldn't believe all the nosy animals had helped him solve his problem.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Jim. Jim loved playing with his toys, but one day he was told he was going to a special party. He was so excited!

He put on his best clothes and ran to the party. When he arrived everyone clapped for him.

At the party Jim saw lots of games, sweet treats, and lots of fun. He couldn't believe how lucky he was! Jim ran around playing, eating snacks and feeling very happy.

Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and he became scared. He quickly ran away and didn't look back. When Jim returned home he looked sad.

His mom asked him what was wrong. He replied, "I regret running away from the party".

His mom smiled and said, "I am so grateful that you are safe. We can have our own special party, just for us".

Jim smiled and said, "Yes, that would be nice!"

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom loved to play with his toy rocket. He would carry the rocket in his mouth and run around the house.

One day, Tom saw a big box in the living room. He decided to put his rocket inside the box. He carried the rocket in his mouth and dropped it in the box. Tom was very happy.

Later, Tom's friend, a little dog named Max, came to play. Max saw the rocket in the box and wanted to play with it too. Tom and Max took turns carrying the rocket and running around. They had so much fun playing with the rocket all day long.

Once upon a time there was a small mouse who loved to zip around. She loved to explore the world and find new things. While she was out exploring one day, she noticed something very unusual. It was the strangest question she had ever seen. It made her pause and stand very still. She held her breath and looked around for the answer. Everywhere she looked, she couldn't find it.

Suddenly, something small zipped past her. It was a tiny bee. She giggled at the fast bee and followed him. He zipped around all different places and before she knew it, he had stopped right in front of the question! He had the answer. She smiled and thanked the bee as he flew away, and then she answered the strange question.

It was the best day ever! The small mouse had solved the mystery. She was so happy and proud of herself. She knew that the answer would make all her friends happy. As she zipped away, she was already excited to tell them what she had learned.

Tommy and his mother were walking in the park one sunny day. Suddenly they saw a radish on the ground. It was shiny and round.

"Mommy, can I pick up the radish?" asked Tommy.

"Yes, Tommy, you can pick it up," replied his mother.

So Tommy bent down and picked up the radish. He looked at it carefully. He pinched it and felt how juicy it was. 

"What should I do with it, Mommy?" asked Tommy uncertainly.

His mother smiled at him. "That's a good question. What do you think we can do with the radish?"

Tommy thought for a moment. Then he said, "I know! I can make a radish necklace!"

Tommy's mom was very impressed with his creative idea.

"That's great, Tommy! Let's do it!" she said. 

So Tommy and his mom made a necklace out of the radish. Tommy was so proud of his work that he wore it all day. At night he even put it in his bed so he could look at it while he slept.

Lily and Max were playing hide and seek in the big house. Lily was the seeker and Max was the hider. Lily counted to ten and then looked for Max. She checked the kitchen, the living room, and the bathroom, but she could not find him.

"Where are you, Max?" she called out. "I give up!"

She heard a giggle from behind a door. She ran to the door and opened it. It was the basement. She saw Max hiding behind a box. He had a playful smile on his face.

"Gotcha!" she said and ran towards him.

But then she saw something else in the basement. It was a big, black spider. It had eight legs and many eyes. It was crawling on the wall. Lily was very scared of spiders. She screamed and ran back to the door.

"Help! Help! Spider!" she cried.

Max heard her scream and saw the spider. He was not scared of spiders. He thought they were cool. He picked up a broom and tried to shoo the spider away.

"Don't worry, Lily, I'll save you!" he said.

But the spider was fast and angry. It jumped from the wall and landed on the broom. Max dropped the broom and backed away. He and Lily both trembled with fear. They wanted to get out of the basement.

"Where is the exit?" Lily asked.

Max looked around and saw a small window. It was high up, but he had an idea. He pushed the box he was hiding behind to the wall. He climbed on the box and reached for the window. He opened it and saw the garden outside.

"Come on, Lily, we can escape through here!" he said.

He helped Lily climb on the box and then through the window. They jumped down and ran to the house. They hugged each other and breathed a sigh of relief.

"That was scary!" Lily said.

"Yeah, but we made it!" Max said.

They decided to play something else. They did not want to go back to the basement. They hoped the spider would not follow them. They were glad they had each other. They were brave and playful friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had to choose what to wear for the day. She looked in her closet and saw her favorite dress. It was pink and had flowers on it. Lily picked the dress and put it on. 

After breakfast, Lily's mom asked her to help with the laundry. Lily was a little naughty and didn't want to help. But her mom said it was important to help each other. So, Lily helped her mom put the dirty clothes in the washing machine. 

When the laundry was done, Lily's mom praised her for being a good helper. Lily felt happy and proud for making her mom happy. From that day on, Lily tried to always choose to be helpful and not naughty. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her colorful dolls. One day, she was playing with her dolls when her little brother came in and disturbed her playtime. 

"Stop disturbing me, please!" said Lily to her brother. 

But her brother didn't listen and kept bothering her. Suddenly, Lily's dad came in and asked what was going on. 

"Lily, why are you upset?" asked her dad. 

"My brother disturbed me while I was playing with my dolls," replied Lily. 

Her dad talked to her brother and told him to be more careful and not disturb Lily's playtime. He also explained to them about war and how we should all be kind to each other. From that day on, Lily and her brother played together without disturbing each other and enjoyed their colorful toys.

Once upon a time, there was a huge lab. Inside the lab were a girl and her teacher. The teacher was there to teach the girl new things.

The teacher showed the girl around the lab. There was a lot to explore! There were beakers, computers, and shelves full of books. So many things to learn!

The teacher then showed the girl the coolest part of the lab. It was a huge telescope that the girl had never seen before. The teacher explained that it was used to look into the night sky and help them learn more about stars and planets.

The teacher helped the girl look through the telescope. The girl was amazed! She could see stars that seemed so close she could reach out and touch them.

The teacher said that it was important to learn about the stars, so that the girl could explore the world and reach for her dreams. 

The girl thanked her teacher for teaching her something new. She was so excited to keep learning new things!

Once upon a time, there was a big, tall giraffe named Jerry. Jerry was very excited because it was his birthday. All of his animal friends came to celebrate with him. They played games and ate cake. But when it was time to open presents, Jerry got sad. His presents were all mixed up and he couldn't separate them.

Jerry's best friend, a little monkey named Timmy, saw how sad Jerry was and came up with an idea. He told all the animals to help Jerry separate his presents. They all worked together and soon, Jerry had all his presents sorted out.

Jerry was so happy and grateful to his friends. He thanked them all and hugged Timmy extra tight. It was the best birthday ever!

Once there was a little boy who was very hungry. He looked all around, but there was nothing to eat. He started to complain.

"Mommy, I'm so hungry," he said.

His mommy said, "Look up at the ceiling, honey. You might see something that will help you."

The little boy looked up and saw a giant basket hanging from the ceiling. Inside were all the delicious treats any little boy could ever want! 

The little boy smiled, no longer hungry. 

"Mommy, thank you for showing me the ceiling," he said. 

"You're welcome, honey," his mommy said. "That's why I'm here."

Once upon a time, there was a rich man. He had lots of nice things. 

One day, he wanted a new hedge in his garden. He asked for everyone to come and help build it. 

But the day was sunny, and everyone was enjoying the weather. They all delayed helping the rich man.

So the man decided to do it on his own. He worked very hard, and he managed to build a big and beautiful hedge.

The rich man was very happy with his hedge. All his friends admired it, and they were sorry they had delayed helping him. 

The end.

Once upon a time, in a distant land, there were two groups who did not like each other. They had a big war. They fought and fought for a long time.

One day, a kind girl from one group met a nice boy from the other group. They talked by the big tree. The girl said, "I don't like this war." The boy said, "Me too. We should be friends, not fight."

The girl and boy went to their own groups and told them to stop the war. They said, "We can be friends and share the land." The groups listened and stopped fighting.

In the end, the two groups became friends and lived happily together. The girl and boy were happy too. They played by the big tree every day.

Sara and Tom were twins who liked to play together. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big iron train. The train had a red engine and many cars that could separate and join. Sara and Tom liked to make the train go around the room and make noises.

One day, their mom said they had to share the train with their cousin Ben, who came to visit. Ben was older and bigger than Sara and Tom, and he did not play nice. He took the train from Sara and Tom and said it was his. He made the train go very fast and did not let Sara and Tom touch it.

Sara and Tom were sad and angry. They asked Ben to share the train, but he said no. He said he was the boss and they had to do what he said. He laughed at Sara and Tom and called them babies.

Sara and Tom had an idea. They waited until Ben was not looking and grabbed the train. They ran to the other side of the room and tried to separate the train. They wanted to each have some cars and play together. But the train was too strong and they pulled too hard. The train broke in half and made a loud noise.

Ben heard the noise and saw the broken train. He was very mad and screamed at Sara and Tom. He said they were stupid and mean and he hated them. He pushed Sara and Tom and made them fall. He took the broken train and ran to his mom. He told her that Sara and Tom broke his train and hurt him.

Sara and Tom cried and hugged each other. They were sorry for breaking the train, but they did not like Ben. They wished he would go away and leave them alone. They did not want to play with him anymore. They wanted their mom to come and make them feel better. But their mom was busy talking to Ben's mom and did not hear them. Sara and Tom felt very alone and sad. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside with her hose. She would water the flowers and make mud pies. One day, Lily's mom gave her a new hose. It was very fragile and she had to be careful not to break it.

Lily was very happy with her new hose. She played with it all day long. But then, something bad happened. Lily accidentally stepped on the hose and it broke! She was so sad and started to cry.

Lily's mom saw her suffering and came to help. She told Lily not to worry and that they could fix the hose together. They went to the store and bought some tape. They fixed the hose and it was good as new. Lily was so happy again and promised to be more careful with her fragile hose from now on.

Once upon a time, there was a bright little girl named Molly. She was always playing with her toy blocks and her stuffed animals. One day, Molly was playing with her toy blocks and suddenly spotted a needle on the ground. She was very curious and wanted to get it, so she clapped her hands in excitement.

â€œOh no. That needle is dangerous,â€ her mom said.

Molly's mother smiled back, because she was proud of her daughter's decision. Molly's mum wanted her daughter to know that danger could be avoided if you just make the right choice.

Moral of the story: Always make the smart choice and avoid danger.

Sam and Ben are friends. They like to play with cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. They like to race their cars on the floor.

One day, they have a quiz at school. The quiz is about animals. Sam and Ben know many animals. They are good at the quiz. They finish the quiz fast.

After the quiz, they want to play with their cars. They take out their cars from their backpacks. But Sam sees that his car is broken. The wheel is off. He is sad.

"Look, Ben, my car is broken. I can't race with you," Sam says.

Ben looks at Sam's car. He feels sorry for Sam. He has an idea.

"Don't be sad, Sam. I have a glue. We can fix your car. Then we can race together," Ben says.

He takes out his glue from his backpack. He puts some glue on the wheel and the car. He sticks them together. He waits for a minute.

"Try your car now, Sam. I think it is fixed," Ben says.

Sam tries his car. He sees that the wheel is on. He is happy.

"Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend. You fixed my car. Now we can race together," Sam says.

They smile at each other. They put their cars on the floor. They say "Ready, set, go!" They race their cars. They have fun.

One morning, Benny woke up feeling brave and ready for adventure. He put on his favorite shoes that were a bright blue and started marching through the house. His parents watched him curiously and questioned where he was going. Benny replied, "I'm marching to get a novel!" His parents laughed and explained that he would have to take a car to the store if he wanted to buy a novel.

Undeterred, Benny marched out of the front door and into the driveway. He marched around the car until he finally spotted a gray novel resting on the street. Benny excitedly picked up the novel, dusted it off and marched back home. 

When his parents saw him marching back to the house with the gray novel, they cheered and clapped. His parents were proud that Benny was so brave! Benny smiled and kept on marching around the house.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse. The mouse was very healthy. He loved to run and play all day.

One day, the mouse found a big box. The box was full of toys. The mouse wanted to sort the toys. He took out all the toys and put them into groups.

The mouse sorted the toys by color. Red toys were in one group, blue toys in another group, and yellow toys in the last group. The mouse was happy. He had sorted all the toys. Now, he could play with them and have fun.

Jack was playing in his garden with his favourite toy - a big red brick. It always made him happy to look at it because it was the most unique brick that he had ever seen. 

Suddenly, a neighbour popped by and said, "Hey, Jack! What are you building with that brick?"
Jack felt very annoyed that the neighbour had interrupted him. He wasn't building anything, he just liked looking at it. He shook his head and said, "I'm not building anything".

The neighbour didn't believe Jack. He said, "Come on, Jack, why don't you build something cool with your brick? You can create something very unique if you try!" 

Jack wasn't sure what to do. He liked his brick how it was - why should he have to build something with it? He thought for a minute, then he smiled and said, "I know - I'll build something completely unique! I'll build a tower that no one has ever seen before!"

The neighbour smiled and said, "That sounds like a great idea, Jack. I can't wait to see your unique tower!" 

So Jack set to work, carefully constructing his unique tower with the big red brick. As he worked, he realised that there really was something special about it - and that his unique brick was the perfect tool for creating something truly unique.

He couldn't wait to show the neighbour his amazing creation -

Once upon a time, there were two people who were married. They were very happy together and they wanted to have a daughter. One day, their wish came true! They had a baby girl.

The baby girl grew and grew and she became a big girl. Everyday she grew smarter and smarter. But one day she did something very stupid. Her parents were mad. They thought their daughter had become too silly.

But no matter what, her parents still loved her. They hugged her and told her that she was still their beautiful daughter. 

With time, the little girl became smarter and smarter. Eventually she became the smartest daughter in the whole world! The parents were very proud of her, and their love for her only grew.

Once upon a time there was a bunny who liked to read. He liked to sit in the garden and read all kinds of books. One day he decided he wanted to be successful, so he set off to find out how he could do that.

He asked a rabbit who he passed by and the rabbit said, "If you want to be successful, you need to eat carrots!" So the bunny gathered lots of carrots, went back to his garden and began to read.

The bunny read and read and ate carrots until finally he became successful!

He was so happy, he wanted to share the good news. He ran up to the rabbit and said, "Thank you for your advice! I read and ate carrots and I am now successful!" 

The rabbit was so delighted to hear it, she said, "That's wonderful! Congratulations!"

One day, Little Joe was playing in his room when he found a tool. He was so glad! He picked it up and looked around the room. He saw a box of blocks and put the tool in it. Then he grabbed a block to play with. 

He looked over at the window and saw a bird. He wanted to go outside and look at it. He grabbed his tool and ran outside. The bird was singing a happy song. 

Little Joe was glad he could look at the bird and play with his tool. He looked for sticks and rocks so he could make something with his tool. He was so happy that he jumped up and down with joy. 

Little Joe was glad he found the tool. He had a lot of fun with it that day. He was very excited to come back the next day and look for more items to use it for.

Once upon a time there was a little green frog. He was happy and funny and he hopped around the meadow all day. Until one day he noticed something strange: a big, green symbol in the sky. He hopped up to get a closer look and shouted out "What's that green thing in the sky?" 

Just then, a big, friendly eagle flew down from the clouds. "That's a symbol of power" he said. "It means that you can gain strength if you try hard enough." 

The frog cheered excitedly. He wanted to gain strength, so he hopped around the meadow even faster than before. He practiced and practiced, and soon he felt stronger. 

The green frog was so proud of himself. He hopped up high into the sky and proudly saw the green symbol still shining brilliantly. He knew he had gained strength!

Jen and Tom were playing with their toys in the living room. Jen had a shiny polish that she used to make her dolls look pretty. Tom had a laser that he used to make noises and lights. He liked to pretend he was a space hero.

"Can I polish your laser?" Jen asked Tom. "It looks dirty."

"No, you can't!" Tom said. "It's mine and it's not dirty. It's cool. Go away!"

Lily learned that it's important to be kind and not to judge others. She felt happy that she made a new friend. And they both played together happily ever after. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy called Tommy. Tommy was only 3 years old but he was a very brave boy.

One night, Tommy woke up feeling scared. He wasnâ€™t sure what made him scared, but he knew he needed help. So, he cried and looked around for someone to help him.

And that's why Tommy always kept the rag close by!

Once upon a time there was a loyal little tap. He was very brave and kind and wanted to help others. Every day he would tap away until he heard a call for help.

One day the tap heard a loud cry coming from a nearby sack. He quickly rushed over and saw a little puppy was inside the sack and was very scared. The loyal little tap knew he had to help.

He worked together with the puppy to push open the sack. Finally they were free! They hugged each other and the puppy thanked the tap for his help.

The little loyal tap was very proud and happy. He knew he had done the right thing and that made him even happier. He was a true friend and was always ready to help.

Once upon a time, there was a furry cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to take pictures with her camera. She would take pictures of her friends, the trees, and the sky.

One day, Kitty met a new friend named Doggy. Doggy was very happy and liked to play with Kitty. "I want to take your picture," Kitty said to Doggy. "You need to smile big for the camera."

Doggy smiled big and Kitty took his picture. They looked at the picture and laughed. They were so happy to be friends. From that day on, Kitty and Doggy played together and took many more pictures with the camera.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play games with his friends. One day, they decided to play a game of hide and seek. Timmy was so excited to play. He found a really good hiding spot behind a big tree. He waited and waited until he heard his friends shouting, "Ready or not, here we come!"

Timmy stayed very still and quiet, but he was getting scared because he could hear his friends getting closer. He peeked out from behind the tree and saw one of his friends walking right past him. He held his breath and waited until his friend was gone.

Finally, Timmy's friends gave up looking for him and he jumped out from behind the tree shouting, "Victory!" His friends cheered and they all went to get some ice cream. Later that day, they decided to test their bravery and went on a scary rollercoaster ride. Timmy was a little scared at first, but he loved it and couldn't wait to ride it again.

Once there was a little girl named Sophie. Sophie was three years old and very impatient. One day she noticed a stitch in her shirt. She became very excited and started to laugh.

She grabbed her mommyâ€™s sewing box and found a needle and some thread. She was determined to fix the stitch by herself! She tried very hard to do it, but she was only three and couldnâ€™t manage it.

Sophie got very impatient, so she called for help. Her mommy came and saw Sophie trying to sew the stitch. She smiled at her and said â€œSophie, let me help youâ€.

Sophie smiled, thankful that her mommy was there to help. She watched as her mommy skillfully stitched the hole. When she was finished, Sophie laughed and hugged her mommy, happy that her shirt was fixed.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. One day, Tom says to Sam, "Let's visit the park. There are fireworks there."

Sam says, "Yes, let's go. Fireworks are pretty. They make loud noises and bright colors."

They take their bikes and ride to the park. They see many people and tents. They smell popcorn and candy. They hear music and laughter.

They park their bikes and run to the field. They see a big stage and a man with a microphone. He says, "Welcome to the firework show. Please stay back and be safe. The show will start soon."

Tom and Sam are excited. They sit on the grass and wait. They see the sky get dark. They see the first firework go up. It makes a boom and a sparkle. They clap and cheer.

They see more fireworks. They see red, blue, green, yellow, and purple. They see stars, flowers, hearts, and circles. They ooh and aah.

But then, they see a firework go wrong. It does not go up. It goes sideways. It hits a tent. The tent catches fire. People scream and run.

Tom and Sam are scared. They see smoke and flames. They see the man with the microphone. He says, "Sorry, sorry, this is a mistake. Please stay calm and follow the signs. We will put out the fire."

Tom says to Sam, "This is bad. This is stupid. Why did the firework do that?"

Sam says to Tom, "I don't know. Maybe it was broken. Maybe it was naughty. Let's go back to our bikes. Let's go home."

They get up and run to their bikes. They ride away from the park. They see the fire trucks and the police cars. They hear the sirens and the horns.

They are glad they are safe. They are sad the firework show is ruined. They say to each other, "Fireworks are pretty, but they are also dangerous. We have to be careful."

Once there was an infant who loved to dive into the swimming pool. One day, the infant wanted to dive in the swimming pool, but it was too heavy for him. The infant was so sad. He wanted to dive, but he didn't have the strength to lift the cover of the pool. He asked someone for help, but no one was around. 

Just then, the infant's mom came into the garden. She saw her infant wanted to dive, so she quickly ran and helped him. She lifted the heavy cover and the infant happily went inside the pool. He dived in and felt so glad that he was able to go swimming with his mom's help. The infant and his mom had a blast swimming together. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Lucy. She was out walking one day and she had an urge to go searching for something. She walked for miles and miles until she came across a deep and dark cave. She wanted to explore it so she stepped inside.

The cave was something terrible. It was full of strange noises and Lucy couldn't see anything. Suddenly, a voice called out from the darkness: "Who are you?"

Lucy was scared but she bravely shouted out: "I'm Lucy. Who are you?"

The voice replied: "I am the King of the Cave, and you have come to search my kingdom. What do you seek?" 

Lucy thought for a moment and said: "I'm looking for adventure!"

The King was pleased and he said: "Then come with me and I shall show you the way!"

So with the King leading the way, Lucy began her exciting search.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Jasmine. She was 3 years old and very curious. One day, she found a velvet box in a corner of her room. She opened the box and there was something magical inside. It was a golden necklace. Jasmine was very excited so she showed it to her mom.

Mom said she could keep the necklace, if she was careful with it. Jasmine was so happy that she put it on right away. But when she looked in the mirror, she was embarrassed. The velvet box was very special, but the necklace didn't fit her.

So, Jasmine's mom took her to a store that sold jewels. There were so many pretty necklaces to choose from! Jasmine was so excited that she forgot why they were there. But mom knew, and she helped Jasmine find a new necklace that fit her perfectly.

Jasmine was so happy that she hugged her mom and thanked her. She wore the necklace every day and hoped it would make her look even more beautiful. She became very proud of it and never wanted to take it off!

Once upon a time there was best friends. One was named Zoey and the other was named Jack. Zoey was the youngest.

One day Zoey said to Jack "Let's go on an adventure!" Jack said "OK".

So the two best friends went on a fun adventure. They explored and had a wonderful time.

Then it was snack time. Zoey said "This snack is so yummy and easy". Jack agreed. Then Jack said he was feeling sad. 

Zoey knew just what to do. She gave Jack a big hug and said "I'm here for you, Buddy". Jack said "Thank you!" and smiled.

Zoey and Jack hugged and laughed and enjoyed their easy snack. They had lots and lots of fun. What a great adventure they had!

Tommy loved his big sister Anna. She was nice to him and played with him a lot. But sometimes Tommy was naughty and did things that made Anna angry. Like when he took her crayons and drew on the wall, or when he hid her doll under the bed.

One day, Tommy saw a shiny necklace on Anna's dresser. It was a gift from their grandma, and Anna loved it very much. Tommy wanted to play with it, so he took it and ran to his room. He put the necklace around his neck and pretended he was a king. He felt very happy.

But then he heard Anna's voice. She was looking for her necklace and could not find it. She sounded very sad and worried. Tommy felt bad. He knew he did something wrong. He wanted to say sorry, but he was afraid Anna would be mad at him. He hid under his blanket and hoped Anna would not find him.

But Anna was smart. She knew Tommy liked shiny things. She knocked on his door and asked, "Tommy, do you have something that belongs to me?"

Tommy did not answer. He wrapped the necklace around his neck and hoped Anna would not see it.

Anna opened the door and saw Tommy under the blanket. She lifted the blanket and saw the necklace. She was angry and hurt. She said, "Tommy, how could you? That was my special necklace from grandma. You know you should not take things that are not yours. That is very naughty and mean. Give it back to me right now!"

Tommy felt very guilty. He took off the necklace and gave it to Anna. He said, "I'm sorry, Anna. I just wanted to play with it. I did not mean to make you sad. Please don't be mad at me. I love you, Anna."

Anna looked at Tommy. She saw his tears and his sorry face. She felt sorry for him too. She said, "I love you too, Tommy. But you have to learn to ask before you take things. And you have to be careful with things that are important to others. Promise me you will not do it again."

Tommy nodded and said, "I promise, Anna. I will not do it again. Can we still play together?"

Anna smiled and hugged Tommy. She said, "Yes, we can still play together. But first, let's go and say sorry to grandma. She will be happy to see you and your necklace."

Once there was a little girl who had a pet cat. Every day she liked to pass an orange to the cat. She would throw the orange and the cat would catch it. 

One day the girl wanted to play a game. She took a little orange and put it in a bowl. Then she put the bowl on the floor and asked the cat to pass the orange. 

The cat was a bit confused at first, so the girl showed it what to do. She passed the orange to the cat and then the cat passed it back to the girl. 

The two kept playing this game over and over again until the little girl was too tired to play any more. It was a lot of fun and the cat seemed to like it too.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little duck. She lived in a pond with her friends. One day, the duck went for a swim and found a surprise! It was a shiny rock. The duck was so happy and showed her friends. They all quacked with joy! From that day on, the duck wasn't shy anymore. She was brave and curious. She loved to explore and find surprises. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ellie. Ellie loved to walk through the hot and dry desert, searching for water. One day, Ellie saw a small oasis in the distance. She felt happy and excited because she knew she could gain some water there.

Ellie walked towards the oasis and met a little bird named Betsy. Betsy was also looking for water. Ellie asked Betsy, "Do you want to come with me to the oasis?" Betsy replied, "Yes, please! I am so thirsty."

When they arrived at the oasis, they saw a big pool of water. Ellie and Betsy drank water until they were full. They felt happy and refreshed. Ellie said to Betsy, "I am glad we came to this oasis. We gained water and made a new friend." Betsy replied, "Yes, Ellie. This oasis is big and beautiful." From that day on, Ellie and Betsy walked through the desert together, always looking for the next oasis.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars and trucks. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to fill up his toy truck with some blocks. Timmy was happy to help his mom and he filled up his truck with the blocks.

As Timmy was playing with his truck, he saw a missile flying in the sky. He was scared and ran to his mom. His mom told him not to worry and that everything was going to be okay. She explained to him that it was just an airplane flying high in the sky.

Timmy felt calm and safe with his mom. He went back to playing with his truck, filling it up with more blocks and driving it around. He was happy to help his mom and glad that he was safe with her. The end.

Timmy was a nosy boy. He always wanted to finish what he started. One day, he spotted a big, black TV in the living room. He wanted to finish it! He toddled over and pressed a big button. The TV lit up and he smiled. He finished it! He watched some cartoons and decided to have a nap afterwards.

Timmy was feeling nosy again the next day, so he put on his shoes and started looking around the house. He found an old book and wanted to finish it, too. He started to read the first few pages, but quickly got tired and decided to take a nap.

Timmy was so nosy, he finished everything he touched. He finished books, games, and toys. He finished so many things that he often got tired. But he never stopped being nosy. Timmy finished everything he set his mind on and made sure to never give up!

Once there was a tall boy. He was so tall that he could shoot high into the sky. One day, the tall boy was feeling very tired. So he decided to go to a restaurant.

When he got to the restaurant, he was so happy. There were lots of delicious food and exciting games. The tall boy ate lots of food and then he played the games. He had lots of fun shooting the targets and running around.

When it was time to go home, the tall boy was so happy. He was so full and had such a fun time! He went to bed that night feeling relaxed. The tall boy had found a new restaurant to go to and he couldn't wait to go again.

Once upon a time, there were two friends: a tiger and a bear. The tiger was always very jealous of the bear. The bear could climb up a tall ladder to reach the banana tree, but the tiger couldn't because he was too big and too clumsy.

One day, the bear came to the tiger's cave and said: "Friend, I'm tired from climbing the ladder and getting the bananas. Could you please come and help me?"

The tiger felt a little jealous but he said: "OK, I will come." Then he followed the bear to the banana tree. When they got there, the bear asked the tiger to hold the ladder while he climbed up. The tiger felt so jealous, watching the bear climb the ladder, but he held the ladder steady and soon enough, the bear got all the bananas.

The moral of this story is that it's important to help your friends and be unselfish. Even if we feel jealous sometimes, we should not let it stop us from being kind and generous to the ones we love.

Tom and Mia like to go to the pond with Dad. They see many fish in the water. Some fish are big and some are small. Some fish are red and some are blue. Tom and Mia want to catch a fish.

They have a rod and a hook and a worm. Dad helps them put the worm on the hook. He says, "Be quiet and patient. The fish will come soon."

Tom and Mia wait and wait. They see a fish swim near the hook. Tom says, "Look, Mia, a fish! It is big and red. It seems hungry. Maybe it will bite the worm."

Mia says, "Yes, Tom, it is a good fish. I hope we can catch it. It will be fun to show Mom."

But the fish does not bite the worm. It swims away. Tom and Mia are sad. They try again and again. But no fish bites the worm.

Dad says, "It is okay, Tom and Mia. Sometimes the fish are not hungry. Or they are smart and know the worm is not real. We can try another day. Let's go home and have some cookies. They are good too."

Tom and Mia smile. They say, "Okay, Dad. We like cookies. And we like the pond. And we like the fish. Maybe next time we will catch one." They pack their rod and their hook and their worm. They say bye to the pond and the fish. They go home with Dad. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl called Sarah who wanted a pony. She asked her parents if she could have a pony and they said yes. So they went to the farm to find the perfect pony.

When they arrived, they saw a lot of ponies. One was very impressive. Sarah's parents thought that it was the right one for her and told her to go and take a look.

Sarah went to see the pony. She was very impressed. She wanted to polish the pony so that it would be shiny. She grabbed the brush and started brushing the pony.

The pony looked nice and shiny. After she finished polishing the pony, Sarah said to her parents, "I like this pony! Can I keep it?"

Her parents said yes and Sarah was so happy. She had an impressive pony and she was so proud.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play near the lake. One day, they saw a kayak on the shore. It was red and shiny and had two paddles.

"Can we try it?" Tom asked Lily.

"I don't know. It's not ours. Maybe someone will be angry if we touch it," Lily said.

"But it looks so fun. Please, Lily, let's go for a ride. I promise I will be careful," Tom said.

Lily thought for a moment. She wanted to have fun too, but she was afraid of getting in trouble. She looked around and saw no one. She nodded to Tom.

"Okay, but only for a little while. And you have to listen to me," she said.

They put on the life jackets that were in the kayak and climbed in. Tom took one paddle and Lily took the other. They pushed the kayak into the water and started to row.

They felt the breeze on their faces and the waves under their feet. They laughed and sang and pretended they were pirates. They forgot about everything else.

They did not notice that they were drifting away from the shore. They did not hear the voice that called their names. They did not see the big rock that was in their way.

They were too careless.

The kayak hit the rock with a loud bang. It tipped over and threw Tom and Lily into the water. They screamed and splashed and tried to hold on to the kayak.

They were scared.

They heard the voice again. It was their dad. He had seen them from the dock and came to rescue them. He swam to them and grabbed them. He pulled them to the kayak and helped them get back in.

He was angry.

"Tom, Lily, what were you thinking? You could have drowned! You took someone else's kayak without permission! You broke your promise to be careful! You are in big trouble!" he said.

Tom and Lily felt ashamed. They knew they had done something wrong. They looked at their dad and said sorry.

They were sorry.

Once upon a time there were two friends, a cat and a dog. The cat and the dog lived together but were always very far apart. They never spent time together, until one day a magical crane appeared.

The cat and the dog were very surprised. The crane said, "I am here to unite you and take you for an adventure!"

The cat and the dog felt excited about their adventure, but a little scared. The crane said, "Don't worry. I will take care of you and make sure you both have a good time." 

So with a thoughtful smile the crane spread its wings wide, and flew away with the cat and the dog. As they soared above the clouds, they saw the most beautiful sights ever. 

The cat and the dog had a blast during their adventure and when it was over, they were sad to say goodbye. But they were proud of their new friendship and they vowed to stay together forever. The magical crane had united them, and flies away happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden. One day, she saw a big pumpkin. It was so big that she couldn't carry it. She thought it was very useful because she could sit on it and jump off it. 

Lily's friends came to play with her. They saw the big pumpkin and asked if they could jump on it too. Lily said yes and they all took turns jumping off the pumpkin. They had so much fun! 

When it was time for Lily's friends to go home, she said goodbye and thanked them for playing with her. She looked at the big pumpkin and thought about how much fun it was to jump off it. She decided to keep it in her garden so she could play with it every day. From that day on, Lily and her pumpkin were the best of friends.

One day, Sam's mommy had a special job for him. She wanted him to reverse the broken file. Sam didn't understand what she meant.

"Reverse the file?" He asked.

"Yes, it's easy," she said. "You just have to turn the file over and it will be fixed. Don't forget to be careful so it won't be broken again."

Sam nodded. He carefully took the file and he reversed it. The file was whole again and he was happy.

"Good job Sam!" His mommy said.

Sam smiled and gave her a hug. He was glad he could help his mommy.

Once upon a time, there was a busy bee named Buzzy. Buzzy loved to fly around and play with his friends. One sunny day, Buzzy and his friends decided to build a big sandcastle. They needed to find the right equipment to make the best sandcastle ever.

Buzzy's friend, Sally the snail, had a small shovel. But Buzzy insisted that they needed something bigger. They searched and searched until they found a big bucket. Buzzy knew that this was the perfect equipment for their sandcastle.

They worked together, using the big bucket to make the tallest sandcastle in the whole park. All the other bugs came to see what they had made. Buzzy and his friends felt so proud of their hard work. And from that day on, everyone knew that when Buzzy insisted on something, it was always for the best.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy boy. His name was Josh. He always was very sleepy, no matter what he did. One day, Josh was walking in the forest near his house when he saw something shiny behind a tree. He went to check it out and saw it was a mustache! Josh was so excited that he tried to rescue the mustache. 

Just as he grabbed it, he heard a voice. It was a funny old man. The man said, "What are you doing? That's my mustache!"

Josh asked, "Why do you want it?" 

The old man replied, "Because this is my lucky mustache! I always wear it and I'd like it back. Will you help me rescue it?"

Josh smiled and said, "Of course I will!" So Josh and the old man worked together to rescue the mustache. 

After they rescued it, the old man was very happy. He thanked Josh and said, "You're a brave young man. I thank you for rescuing my mustache!" 

Josh waved goodbye and went back home, feeling very proud of himself. Josh was glad that he was able to rescue the old man's lucky mustache!

The family was going on a trip and so everyone set to work packing the things they would need. The little girl was so excited and she was already imagining all the fun things she would do.

"What should I pack?" she asked her mom. 
"Let's see," said mom. "You should bring your favorite toy and a change of clothes."

The little girl went to her room and started picking up her things to pack. Soon all her favorite things were neatly packed in her bright pink luggage.

When she was done, the family went to the airport. Everyone was busy loading their luggage into the car. Everybody's luggage was different colors, but the little girl's was the most popular one - it stood out from all the others. 

"Wow!" said the little girl. "My luggage looks so cool!" 
"It sure does," said mom. "Let's go have an adventure!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was a very troubled boy, and he often felt sad. One day he decided to take a walk. 

As he was walking, he heard a voice. It was asking for help. The voice sounded far away, but the boy could tell that it was a person in trouble. 

The little boy decided to take action. He followed the voice until he came to a pond. There was a big, mean monster! 

The boy was scared, but he was brave. He took a stick from the ground and started to fight the monster. After a lot of fighting, the monster ran away! 

The boy had saved the day! Everyone thanked him, and the little boy was no longer troubled. He was happy, and his friends cheered for him. He had taken a brave action, and it made him very proud.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat grapes, but her mommy said they were too expensive to buy all the time. 

One day, Lily and her mommy went to the store. Lily saw a big bunch of grapes that looked so yummy. She asked her mommy if they could buy them, but her mommy said they were too cheap and not good quality. 

Lily was sad and didn't understand why her mommy wouldn't buy the grapes. But then, as they were leaving the store, they heard a man rush past them. He had stolen some grapes and was trying to get away. 

Lily's mommy explained that sometimes people do bad things to get what they want, but it's important to be patient and wait for the right things to come. Lily understood and was happy to go home and eat some apples instead.

Tom is a smart boy. He likes to play with his toys and books. He has a cane that he uses to walk. He was born with a bad leg, but he does not let that stop him.

One day, Tom sees a big ball on the roof of his house. He wants to play with it. He asks his mom if he can get it. She says no, it is too high and dangerous. Tom is sad, but he does not give up.

He waits until his mom is busy in the kitchen. He takes his cane and crawls to the back of the house. He sees a ladder leaning on the wall. He thinks he can use it to climb to the roof. He is very brave.

He puts his cane on the ladder and holds it with one hand. He uses his other hand and his good leg to go up the ladder. He is careful not to fall. He reaches the roof and sees the ball. He is happy.

He grabs the ball with his free hand and puts it under his arm. He turns around to go down the ladder. But he sees his mom looking at him from the window. She is angry and scared. She yells at him to come down right now.

Tom is sorry. He knows he did a bad thing. He crawls to the ladder and tries to go down. But he drops his cane. It falls to the ground and breaks. Tom is stuck on the roof. He is scared and sad.

He cries and calls for his mom. She runs to the back of the house and sees him. She is worried. She tells him to stay calm and wait. She calls for help. Soon, a fire truck comes. The firemen use a big ladder to get Tom and the ball. They bring him down safely. They are nice and gentle.

Tom hugs his mom and says he is sorry. She hugs him back and says she is glad he is okay. She tells him he is smart, but he should not do that again. He could get hurt. He nods and says he understands. He thanks the firemen and gives them the ball. They smile and say he is welcome. They leave.

Tom and his mom go inside. She gives him a new cane and a kiss. He gives her a hug and a smile. They are happy. They love each other. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She loved to play hide and seek with her family. One day, Lucy decided she would be the one to hide. She hid behind an old photo frame in the lounge. Her family went looking for her. They searched for a long time but soon gave up and decided to sit down on the sofa. But Lucy had been very so still, so they hadn't seen her hiding behind the frame.

Suddenly Lucy piped up, "Boo!" Her family jumped up in surprise. They all laughed, and then Lucy said, "I was hiding very fast!" Everyone smiled, and they decided to play one more round. This time, it would be Lucy who was looking for the others. She ran around the house, peeking under tables and behind the curtains. At last, she found everyone hiding behind the photo frame. She'd done it! Lucy shouted "I found you!" Everyone cheered and then they decided to keep playing the game.

One day, a little girl was playing outside in the garden. She was feeling really happy and wanted to explore more. Suddenly, she saw a witch peeking from nearby. The little girl was quite scared and started to cry. 

The witch was very selfish and wanted to play too. She decided to poke the little girl with her wand. The little girl was very scared and did not know what to do. She tried to run away but the witch kept on following her and poking her with her wand.

Finally, the little girl found a safe place and hid there. She stayed there until the witch went away. After a while, she emerged from her hiding spot and was quite happy that the witch was gone. She learned a lesson that day that she should be careful and never trust a selfish witch.

Lila was a gifted girl. She could sing, dance, draw and read very well. She loved to learn new things and share them with her friends. But sometimes, she felt tired and bored. She wanted to do something different and exciting.

One night, she had a dream. She saw a big bird with many colors. The bird had soft skin and shiny feathers. It spoke to her in a sweet voice.

"Hello, Lila. I am a rainbow bird. I can fly very high and see many places. Do you want to come with me?"

Lila was curious and happy. She nodded and said, "Yes, please. I want to see the world with you."

The bird smiled and lifted her up. They flew over the mountains, the rivers, the forests and the cities. Lila saw many things she had never seen before. She felt amazed and grateful.

"Thank you, rainbow bird. You are very kind and generous. You have shown me a wonderful gift."

The bird hugged her and said, "You are welcome, Lila. You are a gifted girl. You have a bright and beautiful mind. You can do anything you want. But remember, you also need to sleep and rest. Sleep is a gift too. It helps you grow and heal and dream."

Lila understood and agreed. She closed her eyes and said, "Good night, rainbow bird. I hope to see you again."

The bird kissed her and said, "Good night, Lila. I will always be with you in your heart."

Lila slept peacefully and woke up with a smile. She had a new story to tell her friends. She had a new friend to love. She had a new gift to cherish.

Once upon a time there was a mommy and a baby. The mommy was so excited because it was time to eat. On the table there was a big bowl of rice. It looked yummy!

The baby said, "Rice! Rice!" She was so excited.

Suddenly a fairy appeared! The fairy was wearing a lovely dress and was very sparkly. The baby couldn't believe it. 

The fairy waved her magic wand and suddenly the rice started to dance! It was so much fun to watch.

The baby said goodbye to the fairy and the fairy flew away. But the baby had a happy memory of the dancing rice.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who liked to bounce. She could bounce higher than anyone else! 

One day, she saw a yellow pond. She wanted to bounce on the pond so she did. She bounced once, twice, three times and then she heard a splash! 

The little girl had bounced so hard that she fell into the pond! She was scared at first, but she started to laugh. She swam around, splashed and had lots of fun in the yellow pond. 

It was so much fun that she started to bounce in the pond. She bounced once, twice, three times. She was so happy and she even taught the frogs how to bounce!

Once upon a time, there was a volcano. It was purple and tall. It was very powerful. 

One day, a small girl wanted to try to climb the volcano. She was brave and determined. She started walking up the volcano's rocky side. 

The girl worked very hard, but it wasn't easy. She took lots of breaks. She kept trying until she finally made it to the top. 

When she was at the top, she felt so proud! She had succeeded in climbing the volcano. 

She had worked really hard to get there and she was so happy. She felt so proud of herself for succeeding. 

The End.

Roofus was a small dog. He was very worried. He was stuck outside on one side of a big wall. He wanted to get in. He walked up and down the wall, but it was too high. He couldn't see over it. He knew his family was inside, but he couldn't get to them. 

He started to bark and howl, hoping they would hear him. Finally, he heard a noise on the other side of the wall. He stopped barking. He heard his family calling his name. His family had left food for him. They pushed the food under the wall so Roofus could eat. 

Roofus was so happy. He ate his food. His family promised to never leave him alone again. Roofus never wanted to worry about being left outside the wall like that again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big bag of candy, and she loved to chew them all day long. One day, Lily's mommy told her that candy didn't have any power to make her strong and healthy. Lily felt ashamed because she didn't know that before. 

Lily's mommy told her that fruits and veggies had the power to make her strong and healthy. Lily decided to try some fruits and veggies, and she found out that they were really yummy too! She didn't feel ashamed anymore because she knew that she was making a good choice for her body. From that day on, Lily ate lots of fruits and veggies, and she only had candy as a special treat.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a big bin. The bin was green and had a funny face on it. Tim thought it was a very silly bin. He wanted to show his friend, Sue.

Tim marched to Sue's house with the silly bin. He was so excited to show her. When he got to Sue's house, he knocked on the door. Sue came out and saw the bin.

"Look, Sue!" Tim said. "I found this silly bin! It has a funny face on it."

Sue laughed and said, "That is a very silly bin, Tim! Let's play with it!"

They played with the silly bin all day. They marched around the yard, pretending the bin was a big, funny monster. They had so much fun with their new silly friend, the bin.

Billy and his mommy were in the park. He wanted to ride. His mommy said yes. 

He saw a big slide. He wanted to ride it. He went up and slid down. It was fun. 
 
Then he saw a swing. He wanted to ride it. He sat down and his mommy pushed him. He laughed and smiled. 

Then he saw the best ride. It had lots of colors and lights. His mommy said it was a brilliant ride. He wanted to ride it too. 

So he got into the ride and went around and around. It was hot, but he laughed and shouted. 

Billy and his mommy had a brilliant time riding in the park.

Tom and Anna are going to church with Mom and Dad. They put on their best clothes and shoes. Mom says they look perfect. Tom and Anna are happy.

They go to the car and help Mom and Dad load the bags. They have some books, some snacks, and some toys. Tom and Anna each pick one toy to bring. Tom chooses a truck and Anna chooses a doll.

They drive to the church and park. They see many people and cars. They hear music and bells. They walk to the door and say hello to the man. He gives them a paper and a smile.

They go inside and find a seat. They see a big cross and some candles. They see a man in a robe and a woman with a guitar. They start to sing and pray. Tom and Anna listen and try to join.

They like the church. They feel calm and happy. They thank God for their family and their toys. They hope to come back next week.

John was walking in the park. He heard a loud whistle coming from behind him. He stopped and saw a little boy. The boy said, "Hi, do you know how to do that whistle?" John nodded and he said "Of course! Watch this."

He made a loud whistle. The little boy's eyes grew wide in amazement. Then, the boy asked "Can you teach me how to do that whistle too?" John smiled and said, "Sure, I can teach you. Here, take this thing."

John handed the boy a small whistle. The boy smiled, thanked him and took the whistle. But when the boy blew the whistle, it only made a broken sound. The boy was upset and said, "It's not working! Please help me make this thing work."

John thought for a while and then he said, "This thing is broken. But I have another whistle at home, I will bring it tomorrow. Then you can whistle whenever you want." The little boy was very happy and thanked John. The next day, John brought the new whistle and the little boy was able to whistle just like John!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One night, Lily had a bad dream, also known as a nightmare. She woke up feeling scared and sad.

Her mommy came to her room and asked her what happened. Lily told her about the scary dream. Her mommy hugged her and said, "It's okay, everything is fine now." She then rubbed Lily's back until she fell asleep again.

The next morning, Lily woke up feeling much better. She told her mommy that she had a good night's sleep after mommy rubbed her back. From that night on, whenever Lily had a nightmare, her mommy would come and rub her back until she felt better.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer who was very anxious. The farmer had a lot of work to do and was always in a hurry. One day, the farmer needed to raise a big truck of vegetables to the market. The farmer was very anxious because he was running late. He worked hard all day, loading and unloading his truck.

Finally, the farmer was done and he raised the truck to the market. Everyone was so happy to see the full truck at the market. Now the farmer was not so anxious anymore. He was proud of himself for working hard and raising his truck to the market. Everyone was glad to see the farmer. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play at the park. One day, she saw her friend Max crying on the swing. She went to him and asked, "What happened Max? Why are you crying?" Max wiped his tears and said, "I fell off the slide and hurt my arm. Now I can't take my turn on the swing."

Lily felt sad for Max and wanted to help him. She said, "Don't worry Max, I will push you on the swing. But first, I have a question for you. Do you want to go high or low?" Max smiled and said, "I want to go high!" So, Lily pushed Max on the swing and he went higher and higher. Max felt happy and forgot about his weak arm.

After a while, Max said, "Thank you, Lily. You are a good friend." Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome, Max. I'm glad I could help you." Then they both laughed and played together at the park until it was time to go home.

One day, Mark was playing outside in his yard. He heard a noise. He stopped and listened. It sounded like a farm animal. He quietly walked to the fence and peeked through. It was a dependable sheep. He heard the sheep start to baa. He thought it sounded so funny! He laughed and giggled. 

Mark wanted to see the sheep up close, so he decided to go inside and tell his mom. He said, "Mom, can I go and see the dependable sheep?" His mom said, "Yes, but I want you to listen to me. Don't go too far away, okay?" Mark nodded and ran off to the fence. 

He saw the sheep and was very excited. He watched the sheep for a few minutes and listened to it baa. Then he started to count the sheep's fluffy fur. He was having so much fun! He waved to the dependable sheep and ran back to his house. 

Mark had a great time. He learned that when you listen carefully, you can have a really fun adventure!

Every day, Momma would take little Sammy to the park. They would play very happily in the sunshine until it was time to go home.

One day, Momma told Sammy that today, they would be making a very special visit. She told him he must be patient and keep a nosy eye out for what she was looking for. 

They searched and searched, but Sammy couldn't figure out what it was. Finally, Momma stopped and told Sammy to look down. There in the middle of the grass was a little wooden box with a lock.

Momma explained that inside this box was a secret. She showed Sammy how to twist the key in the lock and then opened the box. 

Inside, Sammy was amazed to find a little blue stone. He asked what it was and Momma explained it was a special rock from the Earth. She said it helped her feel close to her family from far away. 

Sammy smiled - he now understood why they came here today. He hugged the little box close and went home with his momma.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Henry. He was three years old and he loved to shout! One day, Henry was in his garden playing and he shouted, "Look!" He saw a funny vegetable. It was green and round, like a melon.

Henry laughed and said, "What is this?" He ran to pick it up and yell, "It's a veggie!" 

Henry was so excited he couldn't help shouting. He ran to show the funny vegetable to his mom. She said, "That's a cucumber!"

Henry decided to take it inside to share with his family. He shouted, "We can eat it!" 

 Everyone laughed when they saw the funny vegetable. They had a great time.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very stubborn. He never wanted to do what his mommy and daddy told him to do. One day, Timmy got very sick and his mommy took him to see the doctor. The doctor was very nice and gave Timmy some medicine to make him feel better. After a few days, Timmy started to feel better and his mommy told him it was time to settle down and rest. Timmy listened to his mommy and went to bed early. The next day, Timmy felt much better and he knew it was because he listened to his mommy and the doctor.

Once there was a jolly old man who loved his pipe. Every day he would take a long stroll through the park and smoke it. He loved the smell and the feeling of peace that it brought him.

But one day, something changed. Another man came along with a pipe of his own and he started puffing and blowing smoke everywhere. The old man got angry and started shouting at the other man to leave but he wouldn't go. The old man was so angry that he hated the other man's pipe.

The old man went back home and the next day he brought his pipe to the park again. But this time, he was careful to avoid the man with the other pipe. Whenever he saw the other pipe, he would quickly turn away so he didn't have to look at it. His pipe was much nicer.

He would still take his long strolls through the park and smoke his pipe, but now he was careful to keep away from the other man. He loved his pipe and he could never truly hate it.

One day, Tommy and Mommy were packing for a trip. Tommy was excited and asked "Where are we going, Mommy?" 

Mommy replied, "We're taking a nice port to explore a new place. We will be so happy when we get there!"

Then they started packing. Tommy looked up and smiling he said, "I like packing Mommy." 

Mommy smiled back and said, "We need to bring a lot of things on our nice port, and it will be a lot of fun!" 

Tommy and Mommy packed their bags and filled the port with all the things they would need for their exciting journey. They were both so happy for the adventure ahead.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She was so excited one sunny day to go to the harbor. As she walked down to the harbor, Lucy blinked. Everything was so interesting to her!

When she arrived to the harbor, Lucy saw all kinds of boats. Some were big and some were small. She blinked again, seeing the beautiful colors of the boats. There were even a few people swimming in the water.

Lucy was so excited. She wanted to explore more, but she was too scared. Then, out of the corner of her eye, she saw a friendly seal. She blinked and the seal swam to her.

The seal and Lucy soon became friends. They had so much fun swimming and playing together.

After awhile, Lucy waved goodbye to her new friend. She left the harbor with a smile on her face and a jump in her step. She knew she would never forget her interesting trip to the harbor!

Once upon a time, there was a shy cat named Kitty. Kitty was scared to play with the other cats. One day, Kitty saw a ball and wanted to play with it. But, Kitty was too shy to ask the other cats to play with her.

Kitty's friend, Timmy the dog, saw that Kitty was sad. Timmy asked Kitty, "Why are you sad?" Kitty said, "I want to play with the ball, but I'm too shy to ask the other cats." Timmy had an idea. He said, "I will bring the ball to you, and we can play together."

Timmy brought the ball to Kitty, and they started to play. The other cats saw them playing and joined in. Kitty was not shy anymore. She made many new friends and had a lot of fun playing with them.

The moral of the story is: Don't be afraid to ask for help. Friends can help you when you are shy or scared.

There were two best friends, Sally and Ted. Sally was very tall and Ted was very small. They were standing close to the lake, hoping to catch some fish.

Ted looked out to the lake and said excitedly, "Look Sally! There is a hook in the lake!"

Sally smiled and said, "Letâ€™s go get it! Do you think you can reach it?"

Ted nodded and said, "Yes, I think so."

So, Sally and Ted headed out by the lake and Ted reached out to grab the hook. He was so small that he could barely reach it.

Suddenly, Sally had a bright idea. She said, "Wait, I have a better plan. Iâ€™m taller, so I can try and grab the hook. Can I help?"

With a grin, Ted said, "Sure! I hope we can catch a fish!"

Sally smiled and stretched out her arm. She was able to reach the hook and pull it out of the lake.

Ted cheered and said, "We did it!"

Sally laughed and said, "Letâ€™s try and catch some fish!"

And so, the two friends went on their fishing adventure, hoping to make a big catch.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Bounce. Bounce loved to hop and jump around all day long. One day, Bounce saw a big, fancy car driving by. It was so shiny and nice, Bounce thought it must be a luxury car. 

Bounce wanted to see the car up close, so he hopped over to it. Suddenly, a fierce dog appeared and started barking at Bounce! Bounce was very scared and hopped away as fast as he could. 

After that scary experience, Bounce decided to stick to hopping in the fields where it was safe. Even though he never got to see the luxury car again, he was happy just bouncing around with his bunny friends. The end.

Once there was a little boy named Tom who loved to play outside. One day he was running around in the garden when he noticed something shiny. As he got closer he realized it was a razor that someone had lost. Tom was very excited because it was the first time he had ever seen one. 

He picked it up and held it in his hand. Suddenly, his older brother noticed and scolded him for being so ignorant. He said that something so sharp could be dangerous and told Tom to put it down. Tom put the razor back on the ground and ran away to go play. 

Tom had learned a valuable lesson about being careful and more aware of his surroundings. He was no longer ignorant of the dangers that sharp objects can pose.

Once upon a time, in a sunny meadow, there lived a fast little kitten. Each day, the kitten would run around the meadow, chasing after butterflies.

One day, she heard something strange coming from the trees. She stopped to listen and heard a strange sound repeating over and over again. It sounded like, "meow, meow". So, the kitten slowly walked closer, and saw a tiny, little kitten meowing. It was so little and scared, so the fast kitten went up to it and said, "meow".

The little kitten stopped meowing and looked up happily at her new friend. It then said, "meow" again and jumped up to give the fast kitten a big hug. The fast kitten was so happy that she said, "meow" back and started to cuddle and play with the little one.

They both continued to play and repeat, "meow". They could not stop and became the best of friends for life.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run and play outside. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy and they saw a big hill. The hill was very green and had lots of trees on it. 

Lily wondered what it would be like to climb to the top of the hill. She asked her mommy if they could try. So, they started to walk up the hill. It was very steep and hard to climb, but they kept going. 

Finally, they made it to the top! Lily felt so happy and proud of herself. She looked out at the beautiful green trees and felt so lucky to be outside on such a nice day. From then on, Lily loved to go on walks and wonder about all the things she could do.

Once upon a time there was a patient sailor. He sailed around the world on a boat and saw all kinds of exciting things and animals. 
One day, the sailor decided to bake some cookies and he got the ingredients ready. He mixed the dough and put it in the oven to bake.
The sailor waited patiently and when the cookies were done, he took them out of the oven and put them on a plate. The delicious smell made him smile and he took a bite of one of the cookies. It was so yummy that the sailor wanted to share them with his friends. 
So he took them on his boat and went around the world to all of his friends. He shared the cookies with everyone and everyone was so happy. 
The happy sailor was glad that he decided to bake!

Once there was a boy called Bob. He was three years old and very happy. One day, Bob was playing in the garden. The sun was shining brightly in the sky and he could hear birds singing. Suddenly, there was a loud noise.

Bob looked around. He saw a dog who had bitten his ball and taken it away. Bob shouted, "No, come back!" but the dog did not listen.

Bob's mum came running out of the house when she heard the noise. She said, "Don't worry, Bob. We will get a new ball."

So Bob and his mum went to the shop and bought a new ball. Bob was very happy when she gave it to him.

The sun was still shining and the birds were still singing. Bob quickly forgot the noise and played happily with his new ball in the sunshine.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and watch cartoons. One day, she found a roll of tape and got very excited. She loved to stick things together with it.

Lily decided to peek outside her window to see what she could tape. She saw a beautiful butterfly and wanted to catch it. She ran outside with the tape and tried to catch the butterfly, but she accidentally got stuck to the tape instead.

Lily was very scared and tried to get the tape off, but it was too strong. She cried for help, but no one heard her. Eventually, she fell asleep and never woke up. The tape had suffocated her. From that day on, her parents always reminded her to be careful with tape and to never play with it alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bake with her mommy. One day, they decided to make cupcakes. They got all the ingredients out and Lily's mommy used a mixer to mix them all together.

Lily asked, "Mommy, can I help mix too?"

Her mommy replied, "Of course, you can help me mix. But be careful, the mixer is very fast."

Lily was happy to help and she mixed the batter with the mixer. When they finished, they put the cupcakes in the oven to bake. After they were done, Lily's mommy said, "These cupcakes are so yummy! And they were cheap to make too."

Lily smiled and said, "I love baking with you, mommy. Can we do it again soon?"

"Of course, we can bake anytime you want," her mommy replied.

Once upon a time, there was a vendor who was very independent. He wanted to make all of his own decisions and do his own things. One day, he saw a person trying to steal things from another person. The vendor did not like this and knew he had to do something. 

The vendor asked the person to stop what he was doing. The person didn't listen and kept trying to steal the things. Then, the vendor got very angry and shouted at the person to stop. 

Finally, the person stopped trying to steal. The vendor was proud of himself for standing up for what was right. He felt good that he was independent and could make choices all on his own. The end.

Once upon a time there was a grumpy man. He loved playing the guitar, so he got it out of the closet. The guitar was big and shiny. He tried to strum it but it did not sound right. The strings were tangled. He tried to untangle them but he kept stumbling. He got so angry that he was grumbling. 

He needed help! He called to his daughter and she came running over. She was excited to see the big guitar. She took the guitar and looked at the strings. She started to untangle them. She worked slowly, but eventually all the strings were untangled. 

The man stared in amazement. His daughter smiled and played him a song on the guitar. It was beautiful! The man smiled and was no longer grumpy. He hugged his daughter and thanked her for helping. From that day on, they always played music together.

John was feeling very sad. He didn't know how he would learn how to do all the things he wanted to do. Then he remembered he had a helpful bookcase! It had lots of books that could teach him how to do stuff. He spun over to it and saw some books with pictures he liked, so he decided to pick one up. He opened up the book and started to read. He started to learn so many new things! He was so excited that he spun around and around, to show everyone how much he was learning. He kept spinning and spinning until he was too tired to spin anymore. John was glad he had the helpful bookcase. It was teaching him all kinds of things!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Mandy. She was three years old and loved playing in the park. Her mommy had a phone that she would always talk on.

One day at the park, Mandy said, "Mommy, when I'm bigger, I'm going to marry someone!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Okay, Mandy."

A few years passed and one day, Mandy came home from school very upset. She said, "Mommy, I asked Jimmy to marry me at school but he said 'no' and it made me feel bad!" Her mommy hugged her and said, "Honey, don't worry. It's okay to marry someone when you're grown up. But not now."

Mandy thought about that for a minute and then smiled. She said, "Well, I think Jimmy is a bad idea anyway!"

Mandy and her mommy laughed and hugged. Then Mandy went back outside to play, while her mommy went back to talking on the phone.
