The owl smiled and said "Try not to worry. Just stay brave and be careful. I'm sure you will have great adventures out there!"

The fox thanked the owl and continued on his way. Soon, the fox was so far out of the forest that he had forgotten all about his worries. He was off having amazing adventures and finding success.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help tie his shoes. Timmy tried his best, but his fingers were too small to tie the knot.

Later that day, Timmy and his friends were playing when they got thirsty. Timmy's friend said, "I want to drink some water." Timmy said, "Me too!" They ran to Timmy's house to get a drink. Timmy's mom gave them some water in small cups.

Timmy's friend said, "This cup is too small. I want a bigger one." Timmy said, "It's okay, small cups are good too. We can drink more times!" They all laughed and enjoyed their small cups of water.

Once upon a time, there was a brave boy. His name was Sam and he wanted an adventure. So he grabbed his spear and set off.

He walked for a long time and eventually he came to an old wood. He saw a small animal darting between the trees. Sam wanted to catch it, so he decided to throw his spear.

He threw his spear and it flew through the air. He was so lucky! The spear hit the animal and it flew into his arms. Sam had caught it!

He grinned a big grin and the animal hopped off. Sam was sad, but he was happy too. He had been so lucky!

Sam decided to head back home. He felt brave after his adventure. So he clutched his lucky spear and made his way back.

He had a wonderful day and he was ready to go on more adventures soon.

One day, a little boy went outside and saw a lot of mud. He wanted to examine it. He stepped onto the mud and felt its squishyness. He enjoyed pressing his feet into it. Then he looked around and saw an empty cup. So he started scooping the mud into the cup. He examined the mud up close. He noticed its dark color and the way it felt between his fingers. He had so much fun playing with the mud that the empty cup soon became full! He was so happy that he laughed and jumped around in the mud. It was such a fun day!

One day, a boy named Jimmy went on an adventure with his family. They drove to a valley where they saw lots of animals and plants. 

Jimmy was so excited! Everything was so busy and different than what he was used to.

All the animals were running around and exploring the valley. Then, Jimmy noticed something strange - there was a big door that was locked. 
Jimmy's family tried to open the door but it wouldn't work.

Jimmy wanted to help, so he searched and searched until he found the key. As soon as he found the key, he unlocked the door and found a beautiful garden inside! Everyone was so happy!

Jimmy's family then ate some tasty snacks in the garden and thanked Jimmy for his hard work. 

Jimmy had the best time ever in the busy valley.

Once there was a big bear who wanted to find an igloo. He looked around, but he couldn't find any igloos anywhere. Then, he saw something white and long in the snow. It was an igloo!

The bear walked over to the igloo, poking at its walls. Suddenly, the igloo door opened and a little snowman popped out. The snowman said to the bear, "What are you doing?"

The bear replied, "I'm looking for an igloo. Can I come in?"

The snowman smiled and said, "Of course you can." So the bear crawled inside the igloo and the snowman closed the door behind him. It was cozy and warm inside the igloo.

The bear and the snowman talked and laughed for a long time. Finally, they said goodbye and the bear left the igloo. He waved goodbye to the snowman, feeling very happy and content.

Tom and Lily liked to play near the river. There was a big bridge that crossed the river. Sometimes they would go under the bridge and look for stones and fish. But they had to be careful, because the bridge was old and could fall down.

One day, they saw a man on the bridge. He was angry and shouted at them. "Go away, you little rats! This is my bridge, and I don't want you here!" He threw a stick at them and hit Tom on the head. Tom cried and Lily got scared.

"Who are you?" Lily asked the man. "Why are you so mean?"

The man laughed and said, "I am the troll of the bridge, and I don't like anyone who crosses my bridge. If you don't leave, I will eat you up!"

Tom and Lily ran away from the bridge, but the man followed them. He was faster and stronger than them, and he caught them by their hair. He dragged them back to the bridge and said, "Now you will pay for your trespassing. I will shut your mouths and make you my dinner!"

He opened his big mouth and bit Tom and Lily. They screamed and tried to get away, but it was too late. The man ate them up and licked his lips. He was happy and said, "That was a good meal. I wonder who will come next to my bridge?" He lay down on the bridge and waited for more children to come. He was a bad and greedy man, and he never felt sorry for what he did.

Once there was a kid named Pete who was always good. He never caused any trouble and listened to all his teachers. One day his teacher, Mrs. Johnson, wanted to teach Pete something new. She told him to go outside and learn how to fly. 

Pete was excited, but he had a bad feeling. He thought that it was impossible to teach someone how to fly. But he was still curious, so he went out and tried anyway.

He jumped and flapped his arms, but he just couldn't get off the ground. He tried over and over again, but each time he stayed firmly on the ground. 

Mrs. Johnson watched him from the window and shook her head sadly. She knew that the lesson would be too difficult for Pete. Even though he was good, he couldnâ€™t learn to fly.

One day, Sam found a new mint. It was shiny and looked delicious. He couldn't wait to taste it. He ran to his mother and showed it to her. 

"Look, Mommy! I found a new mint!" he exclaimed. 

"Oh no," said his Mommy. "You can't eat that mint. It's too new." 

Sam was very sad. He wanted that mint so badly. He had to find a way to get it. 

He went to his Daddy and asked if he could have the mint. But his Daddy said no. 

Sam was very mad. He thought he could get away with it, but obviously not. He threw the mint to the ground, and it shattered into tiny pieces. 

Sam's Mommy and Daddy were very upset. They had to teach Sam a lesson not to be so greedy. And that was the end of the new mint.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and sing to the rhythm of her favorite music. One day, Lily went to her friend's house to play. They started to dance and jump around, having so much fun. Suddenly, Lily accidentally stepped on her friend's toy and it broke. Her friend started to cry, but Lily apologized and promised to buy her a new one. Then, they continued to dance to the rhythm of the music, even though the room smelled a little smelly because they had been jumping around so much. They laughed and had a great time together. The end.

Tom is a dog who likes to dig. He digs in the yard, in the park, and in the woods. He digs for fun, for food, and for bones. Bones are his favorite thing to find. He likes to chew them, bury them, and show them to his friends.

One day, Tom is digging in the woods. He smells something good. He digs faster and faster. He sees something white and hard. He thinks it is a bone. He is very happy. He pulls it out of the ground and runs to his friend Max.

"Look, Max, I found a bone!" Tom says. "It is big and tasty. Do you want to share it with me?"

Max is a cat who likes to nap. He naps on the couch, on the bed, and on the sun. He naps for fun, for rest, and for warmth. Naps are his favorite thing to do. He does not like to be disturbed, especially by Tom.

"Tom, that is not a bone," Max says. "That is a stick. A stick is not good to eat. A stick is good to play with. You can throw it, catch it, and break it. But you cannot chew it, bury it, or show it to your friends."

Tom is confused. He looks at the stick. He looks at Max. He looks at the stick again. He realizes that Max is right. It is not a bone. It is a stick. He feels silly. He feels sad. He feels hungry.

"Max, I am sorry," Tom says. "I made a mistake. I thought it was a bone. I wanted to share it with you. Can we still be friends?"

Max is kind. He is also bored. He wants to play. He sees that Tom is sorry. He sees that Tom is sad. He sees that Tom is hungry.

"Tom, it is okay," Max says. "You did not mean to be wrong. You were just excited. We can still be friends. And we can still play. Do you want to play with the stick? I can throw it and you can catch it. And then we can find a real bone. A real bone is good to eat. A real bone is good to share."

Tom is happy. He likes to play. He likes to eat. He likes to share. He likes Max. He barks and wags his tail. He takes the stick and runs to the field. He waits for Max to throw it. He does not care that it is dark. He does not care that it is not a bone. He cares that he has a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures in her backyard. One day, she went on a walk and found a pretty stamp on the ground. It was a picture of a flower. Lily was so happy to find it!

She picked up the stamp and held it gently in her hand. She decided to show her mommy and daddy. They were so proud of her for finding something so special. They put the stamp in a special book to keep it safe.

From that day on, Lily loved to go on walks and find new things. She always remembered to be gentle with her treasures. And she was always on the lookout for more stamps to add to her collection.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there lived a helpful worm. The worm liked to twist and turn in the dirt. He made the dirt soft for the plants to grow. The worm had many friends, like the birds and the bugs.

One day, a big bird came to the garden. The big bird was not nice. He wanted to eat the helpful worm. The worm was scared. He didn't want to be eaten. The worm twisted and turned to hide from the big bird.

The worm's friends, the little birds and bugs, saw the big bird. They wanted to help the worm. They all worked together to chase the big bird away. The big bird flew away, and the helpful worm was safe. The worm was happy to have such good friends. They all played in the garden, and the worm kept twisting and turning to help the plants grow.

Once there was a boy named Tom. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, the wind was blowing so loud the kids started to race. Tom set out to be the best. He was competitive and wanted to be the first one to cross the finish line. But the wind was blowing so hard it was hard to keep going. In the end, no one was able to beat the wind that day. All the kids laughed and decided it was more fun to just play together and have fun. Tom learned that sometimes it's more fun to have a good time playing with his friends than being competitive.

Once there was an old pink car. It belonged to a family who lived in a big house. One morning, the little girl wanted to take a ride in the old car.

Mum said, "Where do you want to go?"

The little girl said, "Can we spend some time at the beach?"

Mum said, "Yes, of course."

The family had a wonderful time at the beach. They built sand castles, splashed in the waves, and ate ice cream.

When it was time to go home, the little girl asked, "Can we spend some more time in the old pink car?"

Mum said, "Yes, let's go for a drive!"

The family spent the rest of the afternoon driving around, enjoying the sunshine and looking at the pretty view. It was a very special day. They will never forget their time spent in the old pink car.

Once upon a time, there was a big, green lawn. On the lawn, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a dependable boy who always helped his mom and dad. One day, Tim saw a small ant on the lawn. The ant looked lost and needed help.

Tim urged the ant to follow him. He wanted to help the ant find its way back home. The ant was happy that Tim was dependable and would help. They walked and walked until they found the ant's family.

The ant's family was so happy to see their lost ant again. They thanked Tim for being so kind and dependable. Tim learned that it is good to help others when they need it. The moral of the story is to always be kind and helpful to others.

Once, there was a gray cat who lived in a village. The cat was very adventurous, and often explored the village. One day, the cat was exploring near a large hill. 
Suddenly, the cat saw something appear near the hill. It was a small pill. The pill was round and gray, and the cat was curious.
The cat walked closer and closer to the pill, until it was right next to it. It sniffed the pill, and decided it looked interesting. So, it decided to take the pill with it. 
The cat took the pill back to its home and decided it would keep it as a special treat. From that day forward, the cat kept the pill safe, and it was the most treasured item in the village.

Once upon a time there was a happy pony. He lived at the edge of a great icy forest. Every day he would go to play in the woods. One day the pony started to feel something strange, something that was changing him. He soon noticed that he was starting to grow a cold, icy coat.

The pony became very afraid. He soon realized that the curse of the icy forest was changing him. He ran back home desperately, but the icy chill had taken over and he was now a frozen figure, standing in his barn, unable to move.

The poor pony was never able to enjoy the forest again. The icy curse had taken hold and changed him forever.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Jack. Sam was very brave, and Jack was very shy.

One day, Sam had an idea. He wanted to play golf. Sam urged Jack to come with him, but Jack was scared.

"Come on, Jack! It'll be so fun," said Sam. "It won't be too tough. I know you can do it!"

Finally, Jack agreed to go. He followed Sam out to the golf course.

The course was very tough, with lots of hills and trees. But, Sam and Jack persevered. With Sam's help, Jack was able to hit the golf ball further and further.

At the end of the day, Jack was beaming with pride. He had played golf with the help of his brave friend Sam. 

"Thanks, Sam!" said Jack. "That was fun!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Bella. Every day she would wake up and be so excited to start the day.

One day, Bella woke up a bit grumpy. She rubbed her eyes and got out of bed. She looked around and saw something strange. There was a big mark on her wall!

Bella asked her mom, "What is that mark?" Her mom smiled and answered, "That's a special mark that was made by a very special guest."

Bella was so curious. She went to look at it up close. "It looks like a butterfly!" Bella said, her face lighting up.

But then she noticed something else. The mark was fading. "Why is it fading?" she asked.

Her mom replied, "That means our special guest is about to leave. Soon he'll be waking up and flying away."

Bella was so sad to say goodbye, but she knew that her grumpy morning was turning into a magical day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was very tired so she lay down in her bed. Suddenly she saw a sparkly jewel under her bed. She was so excited she couldn't stop trembling. She quickly grabbed the jewel and put it in her pocket.

She ran outside to show her mom and dad. When they saw the jewel they were very happy. They all hugged each other and the little girl couldn't stop smiling. They decided to keep the jewel as a secret between the three of them.

The little girl kept her special jewel in a safe place. Every time she looked at it she felt very special and happy. She thanked the jewel for making her so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, Timmy found a little hole in the ground. He looked inside and saw a mole. The mole looked sad and gloomy.

Timmy wanted to help the mole feel better. He tried to talk to the mole, but the mole didn't understand him. So, Timmy decided to open up the hole and let the mole come out. The mole was so happy to be out of the hole and in the sunshine.

Timmy and the mole became friends and played together every day. Timmy was happy to have a new friend and the mole was happy to have someone to play with. From that day on, Timmy always made sure to check on the mole and make sure he was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and always made a big mess in her room. One day, her mom came in and noticed how messy her room was. She asked Lily to clean up her toys and make her room tidy. 

Lily didn't want to clean up because she wanted to play more. But her mom told her that it was important to keep her room tidy so she wouldn't lose her toys and could find them easily. 

Lily realized that her mom was telling the True and decided to clean up her room. She put all her toys away and made her bed. When she was finished, she noticed how much better her room looked and how happy it made her feel. From that day on, Lily made sure to keep her room tidy so she could always find her toys and feel happy.

Once upon a time, there was an infant who wanted to see the world. He was very adventurous and full of spirit. One day he set out on an impressive journey. He was determined to explore all the wonders this world had to offer, and he did!

He trekked through forests and deserts, seeing all the different sights. Everywhere he went he was welcomed warmly. Eventually the infant came to a beach. He had never seen such an impressive sight before; the sea sparkled, and the sun beamed down on him!

But then a storm set in. The wind began to gust and the rain poured down. The infant was feeling scared, and all he wanted to do was to go back home. He started walking, but the storm worsened and it was too late; he was lost and couldn't find his way home.

The infant was never seen again. He had set out on a grand adventure and hoped to experience all that life had to offer, but this journey ended in tragedy. It was a sad ending for the adventurous infant.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and teddy bears. One day, she found an old lamp in her attic. When she rubbed it, a genie appeared!

The genie said, "I will give you a wish, but be careful what you wish for."

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I wish I had the power to make everything clean and shiny!"

The genie granted her wish and suddenly, everything in her room was polished and sparkly. But then, Lily noticed that her favorite teddy bear was missing.

She asked the genie, "Where is my teddy bear?"

The genie replied, "He was disgusting and dirty, so I got rid of him when I cleaned your room."

Lily was very upset and realized that sometimes, things that seem bad can actually be good. From that day on, she made sure to appreciate all of her toys, no matter how dirty they may seem.

Jim was a lonely boy, who often felt alone. But one day, he heard a very special noise. It was the operation of a tractor! He was so excited that he said to the farmer, "Can you teach me to drive a tractor?"

The farmer was glad to teach Jim how to drive a tractor. First, the farmer showed Jim how to operate the controls. He explained that Jim needed to steer the steering wheel and use the pedals to make the tractor move.

Jim was so excited to learn how to drive the tractor. The farmer showed him how to press the pedals in the right order to make the tractor move. Jim was amazed! He said to the farmer, "thank you for teaching me how to drive a tractor!"

Jim was very proud of himself. With the help of the farmer, he had learned to operate the tractor. From that day on, Jim wasn't so lonely anymore. He would take the tractor for joy rides, out in the sunny fields, and explore places he had never been before. He was so proud of himself and his tractor!

Once upon a time there was a small orange caterpillar. He was very wide and even wider when he stretched his body out. Everyday he would explore around his garden, looking for something new. 

One day he came across a very strange plant. He had never seen anything like it before.

The caterpillar crawled up to it and asked, "What do you do?" 

The plant replied, "I can help you to understand the world around you." 

The caterpillar was surprised. He asked, "How can you do that?" 

The plant said, "By showing you what is wide and what is narrow." 

The caterpillar thought for a moment and then understood what the plant meant. From then on, the caterpillar used the plant's advice to explore the world around him.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play knights and dragons. Tom has a sword made of wood. Sam has a shield made of cardboard. They run around the yard and pretend to fight.

"Roar! I am a dragon and I will eat you!" Sam says.

"No, you won't! I am a knight and I will save the princess!" Tom says.

They chase each other and laugh. They have fun.

But soon they get tired. They lie down on the grass and look at the sky. They see clouds and birds.

"Can we nap here?" Sam asks.

"Okay, but only for a little bit. We have to be alert. Maybe a real dragon will come!" Tom says.

They close their eyes and nap. They dream of adventures.

But they are not alone. A cat is watching them from a tree. She is curious. She jumps down and walks towards them. She sees the sword and the shield. She wants to play too.

She pokes the sword with her paw. It makes a noise. Tom wakes up. He sees the cat.

"Hey, that's my sword!" he says.

He grabs the sword and swings it at the cat. The cat is scared. She runs away.

"Sam, wake up! There was a cat!" Tom says.

Sam opens his eyes. He sees Tom holding the sword.

"Wow, you are brave! You chased away the cat!" Sam says.

They hug each other. They are happy.

They decide to play some more. They pick up their sword and shield. They run around the yard and pretend to fight.

They are knights and dragons. They are brothers. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very creative boy. He liked to play in the sand and make fun things.

One day, Tim found a big pit in his backyard. He thought it would be fun to put things in the pit. He put rocks, sticks, and leaves in the pit. He also put some of his toys in the pit. Tim liked to watch the things fall into the pit.

Tim's mom saw him playing in the pit. She told him to be careful and not fall in. Tim listened to his mom and played safely. He was happy to have a fun pit to play in. And that is how Tim found a new way to be creative with the pit in his backyard.

Jill had a microphone. It belonged to her, and she could use it whenever she wanted. She liked talking into it and singing into it. She asked her mom if they could go somewhere special to use the microphone.

Mom said yes, and took her to a regular cafe. At the cafe, there was a band playing. A regular band. They had drums, guitars, and a microphone. Jill's eyes lit up. She pointed to the microphone and said she wanted to use it.

The band said 'yes'. Jill said she wanted to sing a song. Mom counted to three and Jill sang her favorite song. Everyone at the cafe clapped and cheered. Jill felt so proud and happy. She held the microphone and knew it belonged to her. It made her feel special.

Once upon a time, there was a cute whale who lived near the beach. This whale loved to play in the water, and all the other creatures in the sea would applaud the whale's games. Everyone was so happy!

One day, the whale was enjoying a swim when it noticed a tiny boat floating nearby. A small girl was inside the boat, waving her hands and smiling. The whale felt so happy that it started to jump and splash around in the water.

The little girl clapped her hands and cheered for the whale. This made the whale so very happy; it shot out of the water, creating a big splash. Everyone near the beach was so amazed that they started applauding too!

The whale and the little girl spent the day having lots of fun. They played tag and blew bubbles. The whale showed off its tricks and the little girl laughed in delight. It was the best day ever. At the end of the day, they said goodbye and the whale waved as the little girl sailed away.

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toy kayak in the river. One day, he saw his friend Johnny crying near the river. Tim asked, "What happened Johnny?" Johnny replied, "I lost my toy boat in the river." 

Tim thought for a moment and said, "Don't worry, I'll help you find it." They both started to search for Johnny's toy boat. After a few minutes, Tim found it and gave it back to Johnny. Johnny was very happy and said, "Thank you Tim, you are very generous." 

Tim replied, "It's okay, Johnny. I know how it feels to lose something you love. I just wanted to help you." Johnny learned that it's always good to have kind friends like Tim. The two boys continued to play with their toy boats in the river and had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very eager to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, her mommy asked her to set the table for dinner. Lily was so excited and ran to get the plates.

As she was setting the plates, Lily noticed that one of them was chipped. She didn't want her mommy to be upset, so she decided to hide it. "Mommy, look at how pretty these plates are!" Lily said, trying to show her the other plates.

During dinner, Lily's mommy picked up the chipped plate and it broke in her hand. "Oh no, Lily," her mommy said. "This plate is broken. Did you know about this?" Lily felt so bad and started to cry. "I'm sorry, mommy," she said. "I wanted to help, but I didn't want you to be mad."

Her mommy hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. You can always show me when something is broken. We can fix it together." From that day on, Lily always showed her mommy when something was broken and they fixed it together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to read books about animals. One day, Timmy found a book with a crocodile on the cover. He was excited to read it.

As Timmy read the book, he learned that crocodiles are very scary animals. He felt scared, but he kept reading. Suddenly, Timmy heard a noise outside his window. He looked outside and saw a big crocodile in his backyard!

Timmy was very scared. He didn't know what to do. But then he remembered something he read in his book. He knew that crocodiles don't like loud noises. So, he started to make loud noises by clapping his hands and shouting. The crocodile got scared and ran away. Timmy was safe and happy that he read about crocodiles in his book.

Mom brought a book. It was big and green. She opened it and put it on the table.

Dad brought a safe. It was heavy and strong. He put it next to the book.

Mom and dad put the book inside the safe. Then they closed it and locked it with a key.

Mom said the book was safe now. She gave the key to Dad and said, "We must keep this safe, okay?"

Dad nodded and smiled. He said, "Yes, our book is safe now."

One day, there was a fine bear in the park. He wanted to go for a walk, so he decided to twist and turn his way through the park. He jumped over rocks, twirled around trees and raced past the squirrels! He was having so much fun, twisting and turning. He even went down a little hill and jumped over a few puddles! He made some new bear friends, who joined him for the fun twisty adventure. When the sun started setting, the fine bear said goodbye and twisted his way back home. He was so happy, his heart was twisting with joy. It was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a poor boy named Tom. Tom had no toys, but he loved to play with ash from the fire. He would make little ash people and have fun all day.

One day, Tom met a girl named Sue. Sue saw Tom playing with his ash people and asked, "Can I play too?" Tom was happy to have a friend and said, "Yes, come play with me!"

As they played, Tom accidentally pinched Sue's finger. Sue cried, "Ouch, that hurt!" Tom felt sad and said, "I'm sorry, Sue. I didn't mean to pinch you." Sue forgave Tom, and they continued to play with the ash people.

Together, they made a big ash village with many ash people. They played and laughed all day long. Even though they were poor, Tom and Sue were happy because they had each other and their ash people.

From that day on, Tom and Sue became best friends. They always played together and shared their ash people with other children in the village. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a frog called Jerry. He opened his eyes and jumped in the lake. The lake was blue and glittery. Jerry saw some strips in the water and he hopped over them. He hopped and splashed in the water.

Suddenly he saw a fish. Jerry said to him, "Hi Fish. What are those strips?"

The fish said, "Those are ribbons. Aren't they pretty?"

Jerry smiled and said, "Yes, they are! I want to splash in them."

The fish smiled and said, "Go ahead! Have fun!"

So Jerry splashed in the ribbons. They were very messy but he liked it. He had so much fun jumping and splashing in the ribbons. He had a great time!

Once upon a time, there lived a tiny seed. It was soft and yellow, and it was in the ground.

The seed grew bigger and bigger everyday. Its weight got heavier and it started to feel strong.

The seed grew strong and tall, like a yellow apple tree. It had lots of leaves and strong branches.

The tree grew apples, and the apples were yellow. Each apple was big and heavy, full of sweet juice. All the animals and birds liked them, and it was fun to watch them eating.

The tree grew bigger and bigger, and it was very happy. It spread its branches wide and tall, and its yellow apples grew heavier and bigger each day.

Peter was a 3 year old boy who lived in a small house. One day he wanted to go on an adventure. He looked around his house for something interesting.

He noticed a bookshelf in the corner of his room. He walked over and tried to move it, but it was too heavy. He squatted down and started to whistle. Suddenly, a small, magical door opened in the bookshelf!

Peter was very excited. He peeped through the door and saw large trees and bright flowers. He wanted to explore, but he was nervous because it looked a bit difficult.

At that moment, his mum walked in the room. "Peter, what are you doing?" asked his mum.

Peter explained what he'd found and asked if he could go on an adventure. After some thought, his mum said yes. She even agreed to come with him.

Peter smiled and was so happy. Together, he and his mum ventured through the small door and enjoyed a wonderful adventure.

Susie was so happy because the sun was out. She opened the door and rushed outside. She started to skip in the sunshine, feeling so free and happy. Suddenly, something hurt her ankle. She looked down and saw a sharp stone. It had made her ankle hurt. 

She was so sad but then she remembered that she was in the sunshine. She thought it was too nice outside to stay sad. So, she put on a big smile and started to skip again. She skipped and jumped around, feeling so much better in the sunshine. Nothing else could hurt her. 

Susie kept skipping and feeling happy until it was time to go back inside. She was so excited to come back and play in the sunshine the next day.

Once upon a time there was an ancient tunnel. It was a very dark tunnel, but deep inside it was a secret. Suddenly, a big rainbow light shone through the darkness. A little boy smiled when he saw it. He started to move closer to the light.

As he got closer, he heard sweet music. There were many different animals playing the music. And there was someone else too; an old man! The old man saw the little boy and smiled. He invited the boy to join the animals and dance.

The little boy was so happy. He danced and laughed in the tunnel with all his new friends. They all danced in a big circle. Even the old man joined in. 

When the dancing was over, the old man gifted the little boy with a special toy. It was a wooden car with rainbow wheels. The boy smiled and thanked the old man before running away with his special toy. 

He never forgot the ancient tunnel, and his special friends and the toy - it always made him smile.

Lily was very excited, because today she was going for a drive. She had never been in a car before and she couldn't wait to see what it was like.

Lily's mom helped her into the car. She fastened the seatbelt around Lily and then she got in the driver's seat. Lily watched out the window as they drove. She saw lots of nice things.

They drove past a park, with lots of flowers and trees. They drove over a bridge and saw boats floating in the river. Lily waved hi to all the people.

Finally, Lily's mom pulled up in front of a big house. Lily smiled when she saw it; it was so nice! Lily's mom helped her out of the car and they went inside together.

Lily had had the best time on her drive. She couldn't wait to go on another one soon!

One day, a woman was walking in the park. Her eyes sparkled as she saw a brown bird in the tree. She smiled and laughed. Then, she went to the playground to laugh again. She saw a little boy laughing on the swings. She laughed too. Soon they were both laughing and having a good time.

The woman then saw a brown snake on the ground. She stepped back and gasped, but then she started laughing again. It was just a stick! She laughed and picked it up. The little boy laughed too. They both laughed until their bellies hurt. 

The woman and the little boy went home together. Wherever the woman went, she found something to laugh about. She was so happy and all the day she was heard laughing.

Once upon a time, there was a penny. The penny was shiny and new. One day, it had a loud noise. It was so loud! Something was happening.

The penny started to move! It hopped around the room. It jumped over the curtains and onto the floor. It moved so fast!

The penny went around the room and bumped into things. Then it stopped by the window. It was really quiet. Nothing seemed to be happening. 

But then, the penny started to hop again. It hopped out of the window and into the garden. It jumped around the flowers and over the fence. What was the penny doing?

Suddenly, the penny hopped up to a bird. The bird had a penny in its mouth! The two pennies hugged and started to fly away together.

The two pennies were happy. They were never apart again. They flew away, never to be seen again. That was the end of their loud adventure!

Once upon a time there was a little bird. He wanted to fly so he started to flutter his wings. He felt so excited as he started to feel the wind under his wings. He flew higher and higher until he reached the clouds. 

The bird was so happy as he flew. He felt so free. Suddenly he saw another bird and he wanted to fly with it. He started to fly closer and closer but the other bird flew away. The little bird was so sad he started to cry. 

His wings felt so dead. He tried and tried to fly but could only go down. He landed on the ground. He started to sleep and when he woke up he saw a lot of other birds. He was excited, he started to flutter his wings and he found that he could fly again! 

The little bird flew around with his new friends. They were so happy. They stayed together for a long time and the little bird was never sad again. The end.

Tom and Mia like to count. They count everything they see. They count cars, birds, flowers, and stars. They are very competitive. They want to count more than the other.

One day, they go to the shop with Mom. Mom says they can each choose one thing to buy. Tom and Mia run to the toy aisle. They see many toys. They want to count them all.

"I see five cars," Tom says. "I see six dolls," Mia says. "I see seven balls," Tom says. "I see eight books," Mia says. They keep counting and counting. They do not look at what they are counting. They only want to count more.

Mom comes to the toy aisle. She sees Tom and Mia counting. She smiles. She says, "Time to choose, Tom and Mia. What do you want to buy?"

Tom and Mia stop counting. They look around. They do not see anything they like. They only see numbers. They feel sad.

Mom says, "Counting is fun, but choosing is fun too. Why don't you look at the toys and see what you like? You can count them later."

Tom and Mia nod. They look at the toys. They see many things they like. They choose one thing each. They are happy.

They go to the cashier. They pay for their toys. They say thank you. They leave the shop.

They go home. They play with their toys. They also count them. They are not competitive anymore. They are friends. They share and help each other. They have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little rocket. The rocket was very poor. It did not have many friends. One day, the rocket met a big bird. The bird was friendly and said, "Hello, little rocket! Do you want to play?"

The little rocket was happy to make a friend. They played together all day. They laughed and had fun. But then, a big wind came. It started to scare the little rocket. The rocket said, "Oh no, I am scared! What can we do?"

The big bird hugged the little rocket. The bird said, "Do not worry, my friend. I will help you." The big bird flew up high and pushed the wind away. The little rocket felt safe again. They continued to play and became best friends.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Frank. Frank was three years old. One day, he decided to go on a walk.

As he walked, he heard the sound of a distant violin. Frank saw a man playing the violin and it made him very happy. He wanted to make music too, so he asked the man if he could try.

The man said yes, so Frank grabbed the violin. He held it in his hands and tried to make some music. But instead of making beautiful music, Frank started to slap the violin.

The man laughed and said he should try playing the strings. So Frank tried! He moved his fingers over the strings and made the most wonderful sound. Frank was so proud of himself and he clapped his hands.

The man thanked him and said goodbye. Frank waved goodbye and watched him walk away until he was nothing but a distant memory. Frank then smiled, happy to have made music that made the man smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine and pick flowers. One day, she found a jar on the ground. It was empty, but she decided to keep it anyway. 

As she walked home, she saw a butterfly flying around. It was so pretty and colorful. Lily wanted to catch it, but it was too fast. She tried and tried, but the butterfly always flew away. 

Later that day, Lily's mom gave her a present. It was a toy bow and arrow. Lily was so excited to try it out. She went outside and practiced shooting arrows at a target. 

The next day, Lily saw the butterfly again. This time, she was ready. She aimed her bow and arrow and shot it right at the butterfly. She was so lucky that she caught it in the jar. Now, she could keep it forever and always remember the day she became a great archer.

Once upon a time, there was a spoiled dog. All the people in the house gave the dog food and love. The dog was so happy!

One day, the dog was in the yard. A stray cat came running by. The dog got excited and wanted to play. The dog wanted to bite the cat, but the cat jumped away.

The people in the house were so mad at the dog. They told the dog that it was not nice to bite. The dog was sad.

Finally, the people in the house made a rule for the dog - no more biting. The dog did not want to get in trouble, so it obeyed the rule.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a lucky scooter. He loved to ride it up and down the street.

One day, Tim saw a big hill. He wanted to go down the hill on his scooter. He thought it would be fun. So, he went up the hill and got ready to ride down.

As Tim went down the hill, he went very fast. He could not stop. Tim fell off his scooter and started to weep. His lucky scooter was broken, and he was sad. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She woke up in the morning and looked outside. It was a pretty day with the sun shining and the birds singing. Lily got out of bed and went to her mommy. She asked her mommy if they could wrap a present for her friend's birthday. Her mommy said yes, so they got some paper and tape and wrapped the present. Lily was very happy to give her friend a pretty present. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved potatoes very much. But she didn't know how to make potatoes, so she asked her mom. Her mom said, "you need to learn how to cook potatoes". So the little girl tried. First, she washed the potato. Then she cut it. Lastly, she put it in the oven.

She watched the potato in the oven and waited. After a while, it was done! She took it out to eat. But the potato was too hot and it burnt her mouth. She was so sorry.

So she tried again and this time she was careful. She learned that you have to be very careful when cooking a potato. She was careful not to burn the potato and it turned out perfect. She was so happy!

The little girl enjoyed her potatoes and was proud that she had learned how to cook them. From then on, she knew how to make potatoes and enjoyed them even more.

Once upon a time there was a mommy, daddy and a little girl. They all wanted to go out for dinner. They went to a restaurant and saw a menu on the wall. The little girl was so excited! She wanted to order an orange drink. The mommy and daddy let her choose from the menu. The little girl chose an orange soda and it was so yummy! She drank it all up and enjoyed every sip.

After dinner, the mommy and daddy got the little girl an orange ice cream for dessert. It was so cold and delicious. The little girl couldn't stop eating it. The colors were orange and white and it was so yummy. She enjoyed every bite.

When they were done, the mommy and daddy gave the little girl a big hug and a kiss. They were so proud of her and they enjoyed watching her enjoy her dinner.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the woods with his friends. One day, they decided to make a spear out of sticks they found on the ground. Timmy's spear was weak, but he was still proud of it.

As they were playing, they saw a big, scary bear coming towards them. Timmy and his friends got scared and tried to run away, but the bear was too fast. Timmy tried to use his weak spear to defend himself, but it didn't work. The bear attacked him and he got hurt badly.

Timmy's friends were very sad and scared. They ran back to their village to get help, but it was too late. Timmy didn't make it. From that day on, they never played in the woods again. They always remembered Timmy and his weak spear.

Tim and Sue are friends. They like to play in the field near their home. The field has many flowers and bugs and birds. Tim and Sue run and laugh and have fun.

One day, a big dog comes to the field. The dog is not healthy. He has dirt and cuts and fleas on his fur. He is hungry and angry. He sees Tim and Sue and barks loud.

"Go away, dog!" Tim says. "This is our field. You cannot play here."

But the dog does not listen. He runs fast to Tim and Sue. He bites Tim on his leg. Tim cries and falls down. Sue is scared. She tries to help Tim.

"Help, help!" Sue shouts. "Someone come and help us!"

But no one hears Sue. The field is far from the houses. The dog bites Sue on her arm. Sue cries and falls down too. The dog eats their food and toys. He leaves Tim and Sue alone. They are hurt and sad.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy family who had lots of money. The family felt safe and happy, because the law was there to protect them. Every day, the family would go out and have lots of fun, always knowing that they were safe. 

But one day, something bad was going to happen. A thief came to the family's home, looking to steal all their money. Thankfully, the law was there to help. It sent police officers to the family's home who chased away the thief.

The family felt very relieved and safe again. They thanked the law for protecting them and making sure the thief didn't get their money. The family was wealthy again and the law had done it's job!

Once upon a time there were two friends Mo and Bob. Mo was very independent and Bob was very dependent. One day, Mo asked Bob if he could help him make dinner. Bob said no because he wanted to do things on his own. 

Mo got angry and decided to make dinner without Bob. He boiled some potatoes and put them on the table. When Bob went to the kitchen, he saw the potatoes and asked Mo why he hadn't served them. 

Mo replied â€œYou don't need help. You're independent. You can serve yourself.â€ Bob felt sad and started crying. 

Mo realized that independence isn't always something to brag about. Everyone needs help sometimes. The moral of this story is that it's ok to ask for help when you need it.

One day, a girl named Sue had a big urge to ride her horse. Her horse was very interesting because it had many colors. Sue loved her horse very much. She told her mom that she wanted to ride her horse in the big park today. Her mom said, "Okay, but be careful and have fun!"

Sue and her horse went to the big park. They saw many trees and flowers. They also saw a big hill. Sue thought it would be fun to ride her horse up the hill. They started to go up the hill, but her horse stopped. Sue did not know why her horse stopped.

Then, Sue saw a big hole in the ground. Her horse had seen the hole too. That is why her horse stopped. Sue was happy that her horse was so interesting and smart. They went around the hole and continued to have a fun day at the big park. Sue knew that her horse would always keep her safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He liked to play with his toy box. One day, Tom saw that his toy box was empty. He felt sad.

Tom's mom saw him and said, "Let's add more toys to your box!" She took Tom to the toy store. They looked at all the toys. Tom saw a big, soft ball. He gave it a touch. It was very nice.

Tom and his mom added the big, soft ball to his toy box. Now, the box was not empty anymore. Tom was happy. He played with his new ball all day.

Once upon a time, there were two cats named Misty and Snowy. Misty and Snowy lived in the same house, but their owners were never home so they were often bored. One day the cats decided to explore the garage of the house. 

The cats slowly opened the door of the garage and peered inside. They saw lots of yummy food and it made them meow with excitement. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise that scared them so much they ran away as fast as they could. 

The next day, the cats were not so brave and decided to explore the garage again. This time they were ready for the scary noise. As they stepped inside, the loud noise echoed again, and scared Misty and Snowy. The cats realized it was only the sound of the garage door closing. But the cats had already seen something much worse which was enough to scare them for life. 

Inside the garage the cats had seen a giant rat that was eating the yummy food. They were so shocked and scared that they ran away and never went back.

Mum and Dad were talking to each other. They were discussing something. Suddenly, Dad took an envelope from his pocket. It was mum's birthday present. Mum opened the envelope, and inside there was a tasty cake!

Mum was so excited. She took the cake, and she smiled. She hugged Dad and thanked him. She said the cake was very tasty. Everyone was very happy.

Mum and Dad then sat down and ate the cake together. They were talking and laughing. They were very happy. They discussed how tasty the cake was, and how much they enjoyed it.

The cake made everyone happy and it was a wonderful birthday present. Everyone agreed that cake was really tasty and they were glad they discussed it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved playing outside with her friends. One day, while playing, Lily's friend fell and hurt her leg. She was crying and suffering from the pain.

Lily quickly ran to her house to call for an ambulance. The ambulance came quickly and took her friend to the hospital. The ambulance had flashing lights and made loud noises.

Lily's friend was okay though, she only had a harmless bruise. When Lily visited her friend at the hospital, she asked, "Are you feeling better now?" Her friend smiled and said, "Yes, thanks to you and the ambulance." Lily felt happy that her friend was okay.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Amy. She picked up a pen and paper and went outside to play in the field.

It was a big, soft field, full of green grass and trees. Suddenly she saw something in the grass - it was a shiny pen!

Amy was so excited, she took it and started to write in the dirt with it. She wrote her name, and then she quickly wrote a few more words. She was getting so good at writing, it made her feel really happy.

Soon it was time to go home, so Amy carefully put the pen and paper into her pocket and ran home. She had a lot of fun in the soft field and she was so proud of all the writing she did.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy went on a long vacation with his family. They went to the beach and played in the sand. They also went swimming in the ocean.

One day, Timmy's mom bought him a big ice cream cone. Timmy was so excited to eat it, but he accidentally dropped it on the ground. His ice cream was spoiled and he couldn't eat it anymore. Timmy was sad, but his mom told him they could get another one later.

The rest of their vacation was fun and Timmy had a great time. When they got home, Timmy told all his friends about his long vacation at the beach. He didn't even remember the spoiled ice cream anymore because he had so much fun.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey who was always very dirty. His fur was messy and he had mud all over him. One day, the monkey went to a pond to clean himself. He started to splash the water all over himself. He got so clean that his fur was even more shiny and soft than ever before!

The monkey was so excited that he decided to go on a new adventure. He had heard of a spicy forest that he wanted to explore. He started running and jumping through the forest, until he reached a lake. The lake was so spicy that it burned the monkey's nose a bit. But he kept exploring anyway. 

The monkey had so much fun in the spicy forest that he decided to stay there for a while. He would find an extra-spicy leaf every day and eat it. He even found a whole tree full of spicy fruits!

Every morning, the monkey cleaned himself in the lake, so that he was always looking and smelling his very best. That way, he was always ready for new adventures. 

The End.

One day, Mikey the monkey was in the jungle looking for something fun to do. All of a sudden, he found an incredible tap! He was so excited that he started to crawl towards it. 

Mikey's friends were nearby watching him. One of them asked, "What are you doing, Mikey?" Mikey replied, "I'm going to get that tap! It looks so incredible!"

Mikey finally crawled up to the tap and started to play with the water and enjoyed the incredible sensation. He was so happy!

Mikey and his friends had a great time playing with the tap and playing in the water. It was an amazing day!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a map. He wanted to find a big tree in the park. The map would help him get there. Tim was very serious about finding the tree.

One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. It was a hot and dry day. They walked and walked, following the map. Tim knew they were getting closer to the big tree.

Finally, they found the big tree. Tim was so happy! He knew his map would help him. Tim and his mom sat under the tree. They ate their lunch and had a fun day at the park.

Tom and Lily liked to play on the beach. They made sand castles and dug holes. They also liked to pretend they were pirates and mermaids. They had a big stick for a sword and a shiny shell for a crown.

One day, they saw a big boat on the water. They wanted to go closer and see it. They asked their mom if they could go. She said, "No, it is too far and the tide is coming in. The water will be deep and dangerous. You have to stay here where I can see you."

But Tom and Lily did not listen. They waited until their mom was busy with the baby and ran to the water. They thought they could swim to the boat and find treasure. They did not see the tide was getting higher and higher. They did not hear their mom calling them.

Soon, they were in deep water and could not touch the bottom. They were scared and cold. They tried to swim back, but the waves were too strong. They cried for help, but no one heard them.

Then, they saw a big dolphin. It came to them and let them hold on to its fin. It swam with them to the shore, where their mom was waiting. She was very angry and very worried. She hugged them and said, "You were very naughty and very foolish. You could have drowned. You have to listen to me and obey me. I love you and I want you to be safe."

Tom and Lily said they were sorry and thanked the dolphin. They learned their lesson and never went too far into the water again. They still liked to pretend they were pirates and mermaids, but only on the sand. They also learned to respect the tide and the animals that live in the sea.

Poppy is a colorful bird who likes to cook. She has many friends who come to her nest to eat her yummy food. One day, she wants to make a big cake for her friends. She flies to the market and buys eggs, flour, sugar, and fruit.

But when she comes back, she sees a big cat in her nest. The cat is hungry and wants to eat Poppy's food. Poppy is scared and angry. She says to the cat, "Go away! This is my nest and my food! You are not my friend!"

The cat does not listen. He says, "I am bigger and stronger than you. I can do what I want. Your food looks tasty and I will eat it all!"

Poppy thinks fast. She has an idea. She says to the cat, "Okay, you can eat my food. But first, you have to help me cook it. It will be more fun and more delicious."

The cat is curious and agrees. He follows Poppy to the kitchen. Poppy tells him to crack the eggs, mix the flour, and add the sugar. The cat does what Poppy says, but he is clumsy and messy. He breaks the eggs on the floor, spills the flour on the table, and throws the sugar in the air.

Poppy pretends to be happy. She says, "Good job, cat! Now, we need to add the fruit. Can you cut the fruit for me?"

The cat nods and takes a knife. He tries to cut the fruit, but he does not know how. He cuts his paw and cries out in pain. He drops the knife and the fruit and runs away.

Poppy is relieved and happy. She says, "Bye, cat! Thank you for helping me cook! You are the best!"

She cleans up the mess and finishes the cake. She invites her friends to her nest and they enjoy the cake together. They say, "Poppy, you are a great cook and a great friend! We love your colorful cake!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy. They sat on a bench and listened to the birds singing. Lily loved to listen to the birds.

After a while, Lily's mommy put some perfume on her. Lily loved the smell of the perfume. She said, "Mommy, I smell pretty!" Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, you do!"

Then, Lily and her mommy went to get some ice cream. Lily got a cone with chocolate ice cream. She ate it quickly and her mouth became dry. She said, "Mommy, I need some water. My mouth is dry." Her mommy gave her a bottle of water and Lily drank it all up.

Once upon a time, there were two little ducks, Jack and Jill.
They were best friends and were always together. 
One day, they went for a walk in the forest. 
Jack said to Jill, "Let's look for some blueberries!"

So they went looking for blueberries. 
They came across a beautiful field of blueberries and their eyes lit up. 
The field was bursting with plump, juicy blueberries, some white, some red, and many gray.

Jack said, "Let's pick some of the gray ones - they look yummy!" 
But Jill said, "No, no, it's better not to take things that don't belong to us."

Jack didn't listen, he just picked many of the gray blueberries and ate them. 
Jill said, "We better go now - or someone might meet us!"

But it was too late. 
A big, mean man came running towards them. 
He shouted, "What are you doing?! You're stealing my blueberries!"

Jill tried to explain, but the man wouldn't listen. 
He punished them for stealing, and they never saw each other again.

Moral of the story: Don't take things that don't belong to you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch cute movies with her mommy and daddy. One day, they decided to watch a movie about a cute little puppy. The puppy liked to lay in the sun and play with his toys. 

Lily thought the puppy was so cute and wanted one just like him. She asked her mommy and daddy if they could get her a puppy too. They said they would think about it. After the movie was over, Lily went to lay down for a nap. She dreamed about playing with her own cute little puppy in the sun. 

When she woke up, she went to her mommy and daddy and asked if they had thought about getting her a puppy. They said they had and that they would surprise her with one soon. Lily was so excited and couldn't wait to have her own cute little puppy to play with and lay in the sun with.

Once upon a time, there was a big pink elephant who had a bright yellow spot on his back. He liked to have fun and play all day. 
One day, he heard a ring coming from the nearby jungle. He turned his head to look and saw a little dictionary dancing in the air. He became so excited because it was so playful. 
The elephant asked the dictionary, "What are you doing?". The dictionary responded in a sweet voice, "I'm ringing around and having fun!" 
The elephant smiled and said, "That sounds like fun! Let me join you!" 
The little dictionary and the pink elephant then began to ring around the jungle and had a great time. All their friends stopped to watch the playful pair. 

When they were tired, they stopped to take a rest. The elephant thanked the dictionary for such a fun day. The dictionary said, "Thank you! That was so much fun! We should do it again soon!" 
The elephant and dictionary then said their goodbyes and went their separate ways. From that day onward, they were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a folder for school that he carried every day. One day, Timmy's folder became weak and started to fall apart. Timmy was sad because he didn't want to lose his papers. 

Timmy's friend, Bobby, saw that Timmy was sad and asked him what was wrong. Timmy showed Bobby his weak folder and Bobby knew just what to do. Bobby said, "Let's throw the folder away and get you a new one!" Timmy was happy and they threw the weak folder in the trash. 

The next day, Timmy had a new folder and he was so happy. He told Bobby, "Thank you for helping me. You are a good friend." Bobby smiled and they went to class together. From that day on, Timmy knew that if anything was weak, he could always count on Bobby to help him throw it away and get something new.

Lia and Ben love to swim in the sea. They like to see the fish and the shells and the coral. The coral is a reef. It is hard and colorful and has many holes.

They swim and swim and swim. They see many fish. Some are big and some are small. Some are yellow and some are blue. Some are striped and some are spotted. They say hello to the fish.

"Look, Ben, there is the reef!" Lia says. She points to the coral. It is bright and beautiful. It has many shapes and sizes.

"Be careful, Ben, some of them can hurt you!" Lia says. She remembers what their mom told them. They have to be gentle and respectful with the reef.

They swim around the reef. They explore the holes and the cracks. They find a treasure. It is a shiny shell. They share it and put it in their pocket.

They are happy and proud. They plan to come back to the reef. They swim back to the shore. They hug and smile. They show their mom their treasure. She hugs and smiles too. She is happy and proud of them.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily was playing in the park. She loved to play on the swings and slide. One day, she saw a boy with an unusual hat. It was very big and had feathers on it. She went up to him and said, "What's your name?"

The boy replied, "My name is Max. What's your name?"

"I'm Lily," she said. "That's a very unusual hat. Where did you get it?"

Max smiled and said, "My grandpa gave it to me. He said it's a special hat for Wednesdays."

Lily was curious and asked, "What's so special about Wednesdays?"

Max laughed and said, "I can't tell you now. You have to come back on Wednesday and find out!" Lily was excited and couldn't wait for Wednesday to come. Finally, Wednesday arrived and Lily went back to the park to see Max. He was wearing the same unusual hat and had a surprise for her. He brought out a big bag of candy and shared it with her. Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Kayla who loved to play. One day, while playing with some toy bunnies, her mother came into the room. Her mother asked Kayla to kneel in front of her, so Kayla obeyed. 

Kayla's mother told her that she had not been obedient lately and so she was giving her an uncomfortable punishment. Her mother took a cloth from her pocket and wrapped it around Kayla's eyes, telling her not to move until the cloth was taken away. 

Kayla listened to her mother and stayed very still for a long time. But eventually, it became too hot and scratchy to stay still, so Kayla started moving around the room. Suddenly, her mother came back into the room and was very angry with Kayla for not obeying her instructions. 

Kayla was scolded and punished. She was made to kneel in the corner for a long time. This time, Kayla remembered to keep still and obedient, but it was too late. Her mother had already been very mad and the punishment had already been decided. 

And that was the end of Kayla's story. A clever lesson indeed: always be obedient and listen to your parents!

Jack flew to distant lands, searching for something that would make him smile. He crossed planets, galaxies and universes, until he came upon a beautiful blue planet. He stopped and smiled, fascinated by the sight of nature and the clear night sky. 

Jack gazed up at the stars, spotting many new ones he'd never seen before. But he couldn't help but feel sad again. He knew he wasn't alone, but he couldn't help wondering why he was so special that he was the only one of his kind. 

Just then, a beautiful twinkling star appeared and flew towards him. She smiled at him with a gentle light and said: â€œWe are all special stars, Jack. Don't be sad, you can find happiness in the many different places in this vast sky!â€ Jack smiled back, no longer feeling so alone. 

From that day on, Jack and the other star travelled around the sky together, exploring new lands and discovering all the wonderful things it had to offer. Eventually, Jack felt happy and grateful for the star that had helped him. He was no longer sad, and he never stopped

Sam and Ben are brothers. They like to play with cars and trucks. They have many cars and trucks of different colors and sizes. They make sounds like "vroom" and "beep" when they move them.

One day, they have to go to the doctor for an exam. They do not like exams. They are scared of the needles and the machines. They do not want to leave their cars and trucks at home.

"Can we take our cars and trucks to the doctor?" Sam asks Mom.

"No, you can't. You have to leave them here. The doctor will be quick and gentle. He just wants to check if you are healthy and strong." Mom says.

"But we want our cars and trucks. They make us happy and brave." Ben says.

Mom thinks for a moment. She knows her boys love their cars and trucks. She has an idea.

"OK, you can take one car and one truck each. But you have to hold them in your hands and not make any noise. The doctor's office is a peaceful place. You have to be quiet and polite." Mom says.

Sam and Ben are happy. They choose their favorite car and truck each. Sam picks a red car and a yellow truck. Ben picks a blue car and a green truck. They put them in their pockets and get ready to go.

They go to the doctor's office. They wait in the waiting room. They see other kids and parents. They take out their cars and trucks and play with them on the floor. They make soft sounds like "zoom" and "honk". They do not bother anyone.

The nurse calls their names. They follow Mom and the nurse to the exam room. They see the doctor. He is nice and friendly. He smiles and says hello.

"Hi, Sam and Ben. I'm Dr. Lee. I'm going to check your ears, eyes, nose, mouth, heart, and lungs. It won't hurt at all. You can hold your cars and trucks while I do it. They are very cool. What are their names?" Dr. Lee says.

Sam and Ben tell him their cars and trucks' names. They are not scared anymore. They let Dr. Lee do the exam. He is quick and gentle. He gives them stickers and lollipops when he is done.

"Good job, Sam and Ben. You are very healthy and strong. And you are very quiet and polite. You can go back to the waiting room and play with your cars and trucks until Mom is ready to go." Dr. Lee says.

Sam and Ben say thank you and goodbye. They go back to the waiting room. They play with their cars and trucks some more. They make happy sounds like "zoom" and "yay". They are proud of themselves. They did not cry or fuss. They had a good exam. They love their cars and trucks.

Once upon a time there was a poor little girl called Rachel. Everywhere she looked she could see peanuts lying around. She loved to eat peanuts, so she quickly removed them from the ground and pocketed them. 

One day, Rachel was looking for her peanuts when she noticed something unusual. A peanut tree! Before Rachel could take the peanuts from the tree, an old man appeared from nowhere. He said, "If you remove the peanuts from this tree, you will regret it!"

Rachel was not sure what to do. She wanted the peanuts, but she was scared of the old man's warning. In the end, she decided to listen to the old man and left the peanuts on the tree.

The next morning, Rachel was astounded! When she woke up, the tree had turned into a peanut mountain! Rachel was beaming. She quickly removed all the peanuts she could carry and thanked the old man. From that day forward, Rachel never went hungry again - the poor little girl was happy, thanks to the mysterious peanut tree.

One day, a little girl named Lucy found a jar of jam. It was her favorite, red and sweet. She wanted to eat it all. But the jar was tough to open. She tried and tried, but it just would not open.

Lucy asked her big brother Tom for help. "Tom, can you open this tough jar for me?" Tom was strong and opened the jar easily. But as he opened it, he accidentally cut his finger on the jar's lid. It hurt a lot.

Lucy felt bad and wanted to help Tom. She knew that hugs could heal. So, she hugged Tom tight and said, "I'm sorry, Tom. I hope your finger heals fast." Tom smiled and thanked Lucy for her hug. They both enjoyed the sweet jam together, and soon, Tom's finger healed.

The fox was angry. He wanted to scare the lumberman. He sneaked through the dark woods and followed the man. The lumberman was carrying a big axe and a saw. The fox had never seen anything like this before. He was scared.

He stopped in the clearing and started to chop down a big tree. The sound made the fox very nervous. He wanted to scare the lumberman away. He started to huff and puff loudly.

The lumberman looked up and saw the fox. He was surprised. The fox's loud huffing scared the lumberman and he ran away fast.

The fox was relieved. He had scared away the lumberman. But deep down he knew he was still scared.

Once upon a time, Lucy and her mom were discussing something. Lucy was very curious, so she asked her mom, â€œWhat are you discussing?â€ 

Her mom replied, â€œWe are discussing fashion style.â€ 

â€œWhat does that mean?â€ asked Lucy.

â€œIt means wearing clothes in a certain way,â€ said her mother.

â€œOh,â€ said Lucy. She thought for a minute and then said, â€œIâ€™m tired. Can I go to bed now?â€ 

â€œYes, of course,â€ her mother said. She kissed Lucy goodnight and tucked her in.
