Once upon a time, there was a kind lady named Mary. She had a lot of rags that she didn't need anymore. Mary decided to sell them to help others. She went to the market and set up a little table. People came to buy her rags and Mary was very happy. 

One day, a little boy came to her table. He didn't have any money to buy the rags, but he looked very sad. Mary felt compassionate for the boy and decided to give him some rags for free. The boy smiled and thanked her. 

From that day on, Mary decided to sell her rags and give some away to those who needed them. She felt happy knowing that she could help others in a small way. And the little boy always remembered Mary's compassionate heart.

Once upon a time there was a puppy that lived very far away. He was a small and furry pup and he really wanted to be friends with everyone.

One day he heard voices in the distance. They were coming from over the hill, so he started hopping up the hill. When he reached the top, he saw two small children playing.

The puppy walked up to them, wagging his tail. The children noticed him and squealed with delight. They asked him what his name was and he answered with a bark.

The older one, who was 3, asked him if he wanted to be their friend. "Yes!" said the puppy with a happy yip. The 3 year old said, "Come on, I'll explain how to play."

The puppy followed her and she showed him how to play catch and tag. Soon, the puppy and the two children had become the best of friends. The 3 year old smiled as she watched them run, play and bark with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a kind little girl called Sally. She was a brave girl and liked to help other people. One cold winter's day, she spotted a small puppy in a ditch. She knew he was stuck.

"Help!" Sally shouted.

A kind old lady heard Sally's cry and ran over.

"What is it, my dear?" she asked.

"This puppy needs saving," Sally said.

The kind old lady smiled and took off her warm scarf. She wrapped the puppy up and carried him out of the ditch.

"My goodness! You are so kind," the old lady said as she handed the puppy back to Sally. "You have saved this little one today!"

Sally smiled, feeling very proud of herself. She thanked the kind old lady and went on her way with the warm fluffy scarf wrapped around the puppy.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Bob. Bob was sad because he did not have any friends. He wanted someone to love and play with.

One day he decided to go out and try to find some friends. He hopped down the path, looking everywhere.

Soon, he saw three other bunnies in a field. He ran over and asked if he could join them. The bunnies said yes and they all ran around, hopping and playing all day. They had so much fun, and Bob was so happy to have some friends.

At the end of the day, they all decided to gather together in a big group hug. They shared lots of love and felt so happy that they found each other. From that day on, they were best friends forever.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Anna. Every morning, Anna woke up and had a good breakfast. After that, she would do yoga in her bedroom. She loved to do yoga because it made her feel good.

One morning, Anna asked her mum, "Can I go and wash my hands outside? I want to feel the fresh air and see the sunshine." Her mum said, "Yes, but don't forget to wear your sun hat."

Anna ran outside and found a hosepipe. She sprayed the water on her hands and had lots of fun. Then she dried her hands with a big blue towel. 

As she felt the sun on her skin, Anna was filled with happiness. She felt so good and it was the best day ever!

Lila and Ben like to play in the park. They have a big box of rocks that they find and keep. They look for rocks that are shiny, smooth, or have different colors. Sometimes they break the rocks to see what is inside.

One day, they find a big gray rock that is very hard. They try to break it with their hands, but it does not work. They look for a smaller rock that they can use to hit the big rock. They find one that is sharp and heavy. They call it a hammer rock.

Lila holds the big gray rock and Ben holds the hammer rock. He strikes the big gray rock with the hammer rock. He strikes it again and again. He strikes it so hard that the hammer rock breaks in half. But the big gray rock does not break.

Lila and Ben are surprised and curious. They look at the hammer rock and see that it has shiny bits inside. They touch the shiny bits and feel that they are smooth and cold. They realize that the hammer rock is not just a rock, but a mineral. They wonder what other minerals are in their box of rocks.

They decide to keep the hammer rock and the big gray rock. They put them in their box and carry it home. They show their mom and dad their new minerals. They ask them to help them learn more about rocks and minerals. They are happy and proud of their discovery.

Sara and Ben went to the zoo with their mom. They saw many animals, like lions, monkeys, and elephants. They liked the animals, but they wanted to see the seals. Mom said they could go to the seal pool after lunch.

They ate their sandwiches and drank their juice. Then they ran to the seal pool. They saw many seals swimming and splashing in the water. Some seals were lying on the rocks and sunning themselves. Sara and Ben clapped and laughed. They wanted to touch the seals.

One seal was very friendly. It came close to the edge of the pool and looked at Sara and Ben. It made a loud noise, like "Arf, arf, arf!" Sara and Ben thought it was saying hello. They reached out their hands to pet the seal.

But the seal did not like that. It was frightened of the children. It thought they wanted to hurt it. It opened its mouth and showed its teeth. It made a louder noise, like "Rrrr, rrrr, rrrr!" Sara and Ben were frightened too. They pulled back their hands and screamed.

Mom heard them and came quickly. She hugged them and said, "Don't worry, the seal was just scared. It didn't mean to scare you. You have to be careful with wild animals. They are not like pets. You can look at them, but you can't touch them. Do you understand?"

Sara and Ben nodded. They said they were sorry. They said they still liked the seals, but they would not try to pet them again. Mom said that was good. She said they could watch the seals for a while, and then go see some other animals. Sara and Ben smiled. They were not frightened anymore. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy who loved exploring. One day he was walking through a magical forest when he saw a very old, big tree. He ran up to it and noticed an old perfume bottle with the stopper tightly on. He shook it, and to his surprise, he heard a sound coming from inside!

He carefully opened the bottle and a puff of magical, ancient perfume filled the air. Suddenly, a little fairy flew out! She was very old, with a tiny wrinkled face. She thanked the little boy for letting her out.

The boy was so happy and asked her what kind of magic she could do. She said, "I can make things rot!" The boy thought this was amazing and started to shout and dance in the forest.

The fairy then said it was time for her to go and waved her tiny little wand, flying away. But before she left, she said to the little boy, "Take care of the bottle, because there's only one of kind, and it's very special!" The boy smiled and carefully put the bottle back in its place.

Once there was a little bird who wanted to find something to sell. He found three special eggs in the nest. 

The bird looked at them with amazementhe had never seen anything so pale before. He decided to take them and sell them at the wake the next morning. 

Early the next morning the bird flew to the wake. He showed the eggs to everyone and everyone said they were the most beautiful eggs they had ever seen. 

The bird sold all three eggs quickly. He made lots of money and was very proud of himself. 

The bird was so pleased that he sang all the way home, telling everyone about his success.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved his new pants, they were blue and soft. One day, Timmy was playing outside when he saw a sharp rock on the ground. Timmy picked up the rock and started playing with it. Suddenly, the rock slipped from his hand and hit his foot. Timmy started crying and his mom took him to the hospital.

At the hospital, the doctor said that Timmy's foot was badly hurt and he had to stay in bed for a long time. Timmy was sad because he couldn't play with his friends anymore. But his mom was compassionate and stayed by his side, reading him stories and bringing him snacks.

One day, Timmy's foot started feeling better and he wanted to go outside and play again. But when he went outside, he saw that his friends had found a new game to play without him. Timmy felt left out and started crying. His mom tried to comfort him, but Timmy was too sad.

From that day on, Timmy didn't want to play with his friends anymore. He stayed inside and played alone. Timmy's mom was sad too, because she wanted Timmy to be happy. But Timmy couldn't forget the time he had missed with his friends. And so, Timmy's story ended sadly, with him alone in his room, wearing his blue pants.

Lily and Ben are playing with their toys. They have many toys of different colors and shapes. Lily likes to sort her toys by color. She puts all the red toys in one pile, all the blue toys in another pile, and so on. Ben likes to sort his toys by shape. He puts all the round toys in one pile, all the square toys in another pile, and so on.

"Look, Lily, I sorted my toys by shape. Do you like it?" Ben asks, showing his piles of toys.

"Yes, Ben, it looks nice. But I sorted my toys by color. Do you like it?" Lily replies, showing her piles of toys.

"Yes, Lily, it looks nice too. But I have a question. Why do you have a brown nose?" Ben asks, pointing at Lily's face.

Lily touches her nose and feels something sticky. She looks at her hand and sees some chocolate. She remembers that she ate a chocolate cookie before playing with her toys. She forgot to wipe her mouth.

"Oh, Ben, it is not my nose. It is chocolate. I ate a cookie and it was yummy. Do you want some?" Lily says, smiling.

"Yes, please. I love chocolate. Can we share?" Ben says, licking his lips.

"Of course. We can share. Sharing is good. And then we can play more with our toys. Maybe we can sort them by both color and shape. What do you think?" Lily says, breaking the cookie in half and giving one piece to Ben.

"I think that is a great idea. You are a good friend, Lily. And you have a funny nose." Ben says, taking the cookie and laughing.

"Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend too. And you have a funny nose too." Lily says, laughing too.

They eat the cookie and then play more with their toys. They sort them by both color and shape. They have fun and learn new things. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, Lily found a shiny staff lying on the ground. She picked it up and showed it to her friends. They were all jealous because it was so pretty.

Lily decided to keep the staff safe and took it home with her. She showed it to her mom and dad, and they were very proud of her for finding it. Lily kept the staff in her room and looked at it every day. She loved how it sparkled in the sunlight.

One day, Lily's friend came over and saw the staff in her room. She was still jealous and asked if she could have it. But Lily knew it was special and said no. Her friend was sad at first, but then they played with other toys and had fun together. Lily was happy she found the staff and even happier to have such a good friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch aeroplanes fly in the sky. One day, she saw a big aeroplane struggling to fly. It looked like it was having a hard time. The pilot was trying his best to make it go up in the air, but it was too heavy.

Lily felt sad for the pilot and the aeroplane. She thought it was stupid that the aeroplane couldn't fly properly. But then, she remembered that sometimes people and things struggle, and that's okay. She decided to cheer up the pilot by waving at him and giving him a big smile.

The pilot saw Lily waving at him and it made him feel better. He knew that even though the aeroplane was struggling, he could still make it to his destination with the help of his co-pilot and the air traffic controllers. Lily learned that even when things are hard, we can still be kind and help others feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived on a ranch. Every morning, she would go outside and see the wild horses. She loved them, especially the pink one! She wished she could become a horse, so she could run in the fields with them. 

One day, while playing in the fields, the little girl found a magical necklace. It was beautiful, with a single pink gem in the center. She wore it around her neck and suddenly she became a horse! She was so excited that she ran with the wild horses, as fast as she could! 

The little girl and the wild horses explored their ranch together, prancing through the meadows and playing in the streams. They even galloped beneath the stars at night! 

The next morning, the little girl found the necklace again. She put it on, and she became a little girl once more. But she never forgot her adventure on the ranch with the wild horses - especially the pink one!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her dolls. One day, her mom asked her to help load the dishes into the dishwasher. Lily was happy to help and carefully placed the dishes inside.

Later that day, Lily's big brother came home from school and showed her some math problems he had learned. Lily didn't understand them yet, but she was excited to learn when she was older.

Before bed, Lily's mom read her a story about a delicate princess who needed help from her friends. Lily loved the story and fell asleep dreaming of being a brave princess herself one day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jake. Jake had a special zoom which he loved to play with. One day, Jake wanted to show off his zoom to his friend, Bob. But when they got to the park, they saw something that made them both gasp.

"Oh no!" cried Bob. "A big bird!"

The bird was really big and it was making a lot of noise. Jake was too scared to move.

"It's alright," said Bob. "It's only harmless."

But Jake was still too scared. He buried his face in Bob's shoulder and started to weep.

"Shh, don't worry," said Bob. "It's just a silly bird. See, it's flying away now."

And sure enough, the bird flew away. Jake finally stopped crying and smiled at Bob.

"Let's go play with your zoom now," said Bob.

And so Jake and Bob ran off to the playground. They had lots of fun playing with Jake's zoom and soon forgot all about the big bird.

Once there was a little girl who was very adventurous. She wanted to learn something new every day!

One day, the little girl saw a big, colourful rug lying on the ground. She wanted to know what the rug was. She ran over to it and touched it with her fingers. It felt soft and nice.

The little girl asked an adventure friend nearby, "What is this?" Her adventure friend said, "This is a rug. You can use it to keep your feet warm and make a room look nice".

The little girl was excited to learn something new. She decided that she wanted to keep the rug as a reminder of what she learnt. She put it in her house and told her mom and dad all about it.

She was so proud of herself for being so adventurous and learning something new!

One day, a little duck named Tim went on an adventurous walk. He loved to splash in the water and play with his friends. The sun was shining and the sky was blue. Tim was very happy.

Tim splashed in a big puddle and laughed. His friends came to play too. They all splashed and had fun. After a while, they were tired and wanted to take a nap.

Tim and his friends found a nice, soft spot under a tree. They took a cozy nap together. When they woke up, they felt refreshed and ready for more splashing fun.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny who loved to have fun. One day, the bunny wanted to play with his friends, so he hopped along the forest path to find them. But it was very foggy and the bunny couldn't see. He started to worry, but then he remembered that he had something with him that he could use. He looked at his backpack and smiled, because he remembered that he had a mist in there. He opened the bag and pulled out the mist. He used it to make it so that he could see his way.

The bunny was so happy! He was able to find his friends, and soon they were all having a great time playing together. The mist was very useful, and the bunny was glad he remembered to bring it along. He made sure to keep the mist in his bag, so he could use it whenever he needed to find his way in the fog. He was very thankful for his mist!

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Sally. She was three and very curious. She always wanted to go fast. One day, Sally asked her mom if she could try something new. Her mom said yes, so Sally was very excited.

Sally put on her roller skates and headed down the street. She moved as fast as she could. She zipped past all the other kids. They were so surprised to see Sally go by so quickly! 

One man, watching from the side, noticed Sally's speed. He said, "What a smelly youth! She's moving so fast!" Sally was pleased with the man's compliment. She smiled and kept skating. She kept skating and skating, until the sun went down. 

Sally was tired from her speed skating, but she had had a wonderful time. She said thank you to the man and went home. From then on, Sally always thought about that smelly youth and how fun it was to speed down the street.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her dolls and singing songs. One day, Lily's mommy and daddy were talking about marriage. "What is marriage?" Lily asked. "Marriage is when two people love each other very much and decide to live together forever," mommy explained.

"Oh, that sounds hard," said Lily. "It can be, but it's also very special," said daddy. "I recommend waiting until you find someone who makes you really happy," mommy added. "Okay, I will," said Lily.

Later that day, Lily was playing with her friend Timmy. "Do you know what marriage is?" she asked. "No, what is it?" Timmy asked. "It's when two people love each other and decide to live together forever," Lily explained. "Wow, that sounds nice," said Timmy. "Yeah, but it's also hard," said Lily. "My mommy said so." "I recommend waiting until we're older," said Timmy. "Me too," said Lily.

Once there was a dependable boy named Mike. Everyday, Mike would pass his house and go see his best friend, Joe. Joe lived just across the street. One day, Mike was walking to Joe's house, but he forgot to wear a sweater! It was very cold outside, and he was freezing. He decided to turn around and pass his house to go get a sweater. 

Mike ran into his house and found a bright blue one. It was his favorite sweater and it was the perfect one for a cold day like this. He put it on, and it kept him very warm. He passed out of the door and was ready to go see Joe.

He was happy to know that he could trust his sweater to keep him safe and warm. So, Mike and Joe had lots of fun together, and Mike was thankful that he had found a dependable sweater to get him there.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Amy. She was very excited because it was a sunny day and she could play outside. She wanted to go and explore the park so she asked her mom if she could borrow her wagon. Her mom said yes and gave her the wagon. 

Amy happily grabbed the wagon and filled it with the things she wanted to take with her. She smiled when she looked at the wagon and couldn't wait to get started. 

As she was walking to the park, she saw another little girl with her mom. The girl had a big basket full of apples. She asked her mom if she could try one and the mom said yes. 

The little girl took a bite from the apple and yum! It was so tasty. Amy was excited and asked the little girl if she could try a bite too. The girl smiled and said sure. 

Amy took a bite of the apple - but it wasn't sweet like she expected. It was sour! She made a face and said "Yuck, your apples tasted funny!" The little girl laughed and said, "You've just been tricked! Those apples are for my wagon, they are apple sauce, not apples to eat." 

Amy smiled and thanked the girl, then continued on her way to the park. Now she knew that the sour apples weren't to eat - they were to make her wagon even more exciting!

Once upon a time, there was a gray elephant. He had a goal in life. His goal was to have lots of friends. But, no matter how friendly he was, the other animals kept ignoring him.

The gray elephant was sad. He tried to be even nicer, but the animals still ignored him. He even painted pretty flowers on the rocks. But the animals still ignored him.

One day, a blue butterfly flew in front of him. She didn't ignore him! In fact, she said hello. The gray elephant was so happy. He waved back to the butterfly and smiled!

From that day on, the gray elephant wasn't sad anymore. The butterfly had shown him that there was still a chance for him to make friends. With the butterfly's help, the gray elephant was able to find lots of new friends. He was so happy that he painted a rainbow over the rocks!

One day there was a yellow bird. He was always watching the mechanic working. Every morning he would fly down and sit next to the mechanic's shop. 

The mechanic spoke to him and told him to stay away from the workshop. He said, â€œI won't have any trouble if you stay away from here.â€

But the bird didn't listen. He kept coming back again and again, no matter how many times the mechanic warned him. 

One day, the mechanic was tired of warning the bird. He had enough and decided to do something about it. He grabbed a stick and hit the bird, sending it flying across the sky. The poor yellow bird never came back again. 

It was a sad ending for the bird and a lesson to us all. Everyone needs to listen to warnings or else they might end up in a bad situation.

Once upon a time there was a yellow box. It was an unusual box because it had no lid. Every day the same thing happened; the box would open on its own. One day, a little boy stopped to look at the box. He was curious as to why it always opened by itself. He got closer to the box and stuck out his hand to see if it would open again. Sure enough, the box opened and the little boy was so surprised! Inside the box was a bright yellow present with his name on it! He opened the present to find that it was full of delicious candy! The little boy was so happy that the box had opened and he was overjoyed that he had found the special present inside. He thanked the box for its unusual behavior, took his gift and went on his way, with a very big smile on his face.

Once, there was a little soft cell. It was very happy in its cozy home. One day, someone put it inside a box. It was very scared in the box and didn't know what was happening.

Suddenly, someone picked up the box and put it outside the door. The cell wondered what it was going to do. Then, the door opened and a nice person said "It's time to go outside".

The cell was so excited! It came out of the box and looked around. It was a sunny day and all the other cells were out playing in the playground. Together, they ran and jumped around, having so much fun.

At the end of the day, the nice person put the cell back in the box and took it home. Inside, the cell felt warm and cozy and it was so happy that it had gone outside for the day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Max. He loved to ride. He had a bright bike with yellow and blue wheels, and whenever he got a chance, he would jump on it and ride around his neighbourhood.

One day, he wanted to go to the baker's to buy a muffin. He put on his helmet, hopped on his bright bike and zoomed off. After a while of riding he made it to the baker's and bought a muffin. It was pink and covered with colourful sprinkles.

As he was licking the sprinkles off the muffin, he heard the birds singing in the trees. He looked up and smiled as he saw how bright the sky was. Max hopped on his bike, took a big bite of his muffin, and rode home.

Once upon a time, two friends went for a walk in the woods. They were walking along a path when something bright happened. In the midst of the trees, a long forgotten history emerged from the hidden depths of the Earth.

The friends were astounded and stopped in their tracks. "What is this, what happened?" asked the first friend. His companion replied excitedly, "It looks like a piece of history, a bright one!"

The first friend was amazed but then he noticed something peculiar. He moved closer to the relic and noticed that it was cracked. He said worriedly, "Oh no, it looks broken. Weâ€™ll need to fix it, otherwise we wonâ€™t learn its history."

The friends decided to work together to repair the relic. With much effort, they fixed the crack. They were both relieved when the relic shined bright again, just as it had done before.

The friends celebrated their successful repair and continued their journey, happy that they were able to uncover this forgotten history.

Tom and Lily were friends who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big parade with many people and flags and drums. They wanted to join the parade and march with them.

"Let's go, Lily!" Tom said. "We can march like the big people and have fun!"

"But Tom, we don't know where they are going or why they are marching. Maybe they are serious and don't want us to play with them." Lily said. She was scared and did not want to leave the park.

"Don't be silly, Lily. They are just having a party and we can have a party too. Come on, follow me!" Tom said. He grabbed Lily's hand and ran to the parade.

They tried to march with the big people, but they were too small and slow. The big people did not see them or hear them. They pushed them and stepped on them and made them fall. Tom and Lily got hurt and lost and cried.

The parade was not a party. It was a protest. The big people were angry and serious and wanted to change something. They did not care about Tom and Lily or their fun.

Tom and Lily learned a lesson. They should not join things they do not understand or belong to. They should listen to their friends and stay safe. They should march to their own beat and play in their own way.

Once upon a time, there was a lucky dish. It was made out of special sparkly metal and it was big and round and shiny. Everyone wanted the dish, but the dish refused to go to just anyone! It wanted to pick one special person who was very lucky.

Then one day, a little girl came along. She saw the dish sitting there and she wanted it. She asked the dish to come home with her and she promised to look after it forever. The dish looked at the little girl and decided she would be the one.

So the dish agreed to come to the girl's house. Together they went and the girl was so excited and happy! She carried the dish all the way home and never refused to give it away. The dish was now lucky to have such a special home with the girl.

Once there was a boy named Joe. He liked to play all the time. But one day his mom said that it was time for bed. Joe groaned and said no. He wanted to keep playing, but his mom was very quiet.

Joe's mom said, "Joe, it's time to be quiet. You need to go to bed now." Joe was unhappy, but he stopped playing and went to the bedroom. His mom gave him one last hug and said, "Goodnight, Joe."

Joe picked up his special number blocks and started counting them. One, two, three, four... he loved the numbers. He was getting sleepy, so he put the blocks away and closed his eyes.

Suddenly, amazing things started happening! Joe opened his eyes to see a magical world with amazing colors and shapes, where he could play forever! Joe was so excited and he totally forgot it was bedtime!

But, the magical world didn't last long. As soon as the last number was said, it all vanished. Joe was so sad and he cried and cried. His mom came in to see what was wrong and he explained what had happened.

She told him that it wasn't real and it was time for bed. Joe was so sad, but he knew his mom was right. He went to bed and never saw the amazing world again.

Today, Sally wanted to read her favourite book. But her mom said they had to delay because they were going to the playground. Sally was unhappy and protested, so her mom told her they could be flexible and read the book at the playground. She was so excited and quickly packed her bag and ran out the door.

At the playground, Sally found a nice spot under a tree to read. She opened the book and started to read. It was full of interesting pictures and stories. She read for hours until it started to get dark. Eventually, her mom told her it was time to go home.

Sally was very happy that she was flexible and could read her book at the playground. She was so proud of herself for not giving up and being able to read her favourite book in a special place!

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Pete who loved to dance. Every night Pete would stand up, clap his hands and move his feet to the rhythm of the music. One day Pete and his friends decided to have a dance-off to see who could dance the best.

At first, Pete was very scared because he thought that he wasn't going to win. He told his friends, "I can't win, I'm not very good at dancing!" But his friends said, "Just try your best and have fun."

Pete tried his best and eventually started to really enjoy himself. He just kept moving to the rhythm of the music and before he knew it he had won the dance-off!

Pete's friends were so impressed and said, "You won because you kept a good rhythm and kept believing in yourself."

The moral of this story is that if you believe in yourself and keep trying your best then you can accomplish great things!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sophie. She was very cheerful. One day, she went for a walk in the park.

While she was walking, she discovered something red and long. She picked it up and it felt hard. She knew it was a carrot. She was so excited! She said to her friend, "I found a carrot!" 

Her friend was quiet and then said, "Let's have a race to see who can get to the bench first." 

Sophie was very happy and agreed. 

They raced and Sophie won. She was so cheerful, and as a reward she got to eat the carrot!

Once upon a time a little girl named Michelle was playing in the park, looking for an adventure. Suddenly, she saw something strange in the corner. It was an octopus! Michelle was ready to touch it, but it was very cold.

Michelle went to get help from her mother and said, â€œMommy, look! There's an octopus in the park and it is cold. Can you fix it?â€ 

Her mom thought for a moment and then said, â€œNo, I'm sorry sweetheart. I can't fix it. We should leave it and go home.â€ 

So the two of them left, but when Michelle looked back she saw the octopus still lying there, cold and alone. She knew it needed help, but there was nothing she or her mom could do.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a perfect toy car that he loved to play with every day. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play with him. Billy saw Timmy's toy car and wanted to play with it too. Timmy didn't want to share his toy car with Billy and they started to argue.

Suddenly, Timmy had an idea. He told Billy that they could separate the toy car into two parts so that they could both play with it. Timmy took out a screwdriver from his pocket and carefully separated the toy car into two pieces. Billy was happy and they both played with the toy car together.

In the end, Timmy realized that sharing was better than fighting over toys. He put the toy car back together and they both had fun playing with it. From that day on, Timmy and Billy learned to share their toys and became best friends forever. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Henry. He lived in a big, bright meadow and jumped around every day. One day, Henry found a ticket lying in the grass. He hopped up and down when he saw it! Henry knew it was a special ticket.

Henry decided to find his friends to show them his new ticket. He quickly hopped over to the forest and he could see his friends in the distance. When he got close, he called out, "Hey friends! Look what I have!"
Henry's friends gathered around and they all stared at Henry's ticket. They were so excited! They had never seen one before.

One of Henry's friends, Mia, had a great idea. She said, "Let's use the ticket to play a game! We can be as playful as we want!" Everyone cheered and Henry was so happy to share his ticket with his friends.

So, that's what they did. They took turns using the ticket, hopping around and playing together. Henry and his friends had the most fun they ever had!

That's the story of how Henry and his friends found a special ticket and had a very playful time together.

Lily liked to write. She had a big book and a red pen. She wrote her name, her mom's name, and her cat's name. She wrote some letters and some shapes. She was happy.

One day, she wanted to write more. She looked for her book and her pen, but she could not find them. She asked her mom, but her mom did not know. She asked her cat, but her cat did not care. She was sad.

She looked everywhere. She looked under her bed, in her closet, and in her toy box. She did not see her book and her pen. She saw a spider, a sock, and a ball. She was scared.

She ran to the kitchen. She saw her dad. He was drinking milk. She hugged him and told him what happened. He smiled and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I have a surprise for you."

He took her to his office. He showed her a new book and a new pen. They were bigger and brighter than her old ones. He said, "I saw how much you like to write, so I got these for you. You can write anything you want."

Lily was happy. She thanked her dad and kissed him. She took her new book and her new pen. She wrote, "I love my dad. He is the best." She was not sad or scared anymore. She was proud.

Once upon a time, there was a mouse. He was tiny and grey, and he was very brave. One day, he decided to go on a big adventure. He started walking, and walking and walking.

Soon, the mouse came to a deep hole. He looked down, and it was very dark and deep. He wondered what was down there.

The mouse decided to go down the hole. He spread his furry arms wide, closed his eyes, and jumped. As he was falling, he felt something lift him up. It was Big Bear!

Big Bear had seen the mouse falling, and wanted to help. He used his big arms to lift the mouse up and set him down on the ground safely. The mouse thanked Big Bear and began his adventure again.

Bobie was having a hard time. He wanted to go shopping for groceries, but he was really ignorant. He didn't know where to go, and he didn't know what to buy.

Bobie's Dad had an idea. He suggested that Bobie and him go to the grocery store. Bobie was so excited! He grabbed his Dad's hand and they went outside.

When they arrived at the grocery store, Bobie's eyes grew wide. He had never seen so much food before. He started pointing out all the different things he wanted to buy. His Dad said he could have one special treat.

Bobie chose a cookie and then his Dad went to get the groceries. Bobie explored the store, but he was careful to stay close to his Dad. When his Dad was done, they went home with their new groceries.

Bobie couldn't wait to have something to eat. He had learned a lot from his trip to the grocery store, and he would never be as ignorant again!

Harry was 3 years old, and he loved adventures. Today was his lucky day!

He looked out the window, and saw an animal. It was running very fast. He wanted to get a closer look. 

He opened the door and took a step outside. He wanted to get closer, but the animal was scared, so it ran away. But then it stopped and looked at Harry.

Harry was very excited. He got his toy gun and shouted: "I'm gonna shoot it!"

Mamma came running. "Harry, no!", she said. "We don't shoot animals, they are our friends."

Harry thought for a moment, then he smiled and put down his gun. He waved at the animal and said: "Bye, my friend!" The animal waved back and ran off into the forest. 

Harry couldn't believe it. He had made a new friend!

Once there was a boy who loved to whistle. He had a special key that he would always whistle while holding it.

One day he went on a walk and he heard a voice. "Hey! Give me your key," said the voice. He quickly put the key in his pocket so that the voice couldn't get it.

The voice said, "I know you have the key. Give it to me". The boy said, "No! It's mine". Then the voice said, "Give it to me or I'll eat all of your tasty treats". 

The boy was scared and ran home. He didn't want to give away his cherished key. But, when he got home all his tasty treats were gone. Someone had taken them all!

He knew it must have been the voice from earlier. He looked all around but he couldn't find the voice. He was very sad and never played with his key again.

Lily and Max were having dinner with their mom and dad. They ate their soup, their bread, and their salad. They were very hungry, but they also wanted dessert. Mom had made a cake with chocolate and cream. It looked yummy.

"Can we have dessert now?" Lily asked.

"Not yet, sweetie. You have to finish your dinner first," Mom said.

"But I'm full!" Max said.

"You're not full, you're just eager. You have to eat a little more, or you'll be hungry later," Dad said.

Lily and Max sighed. They wanted the cake so much. They tried to be patient, but it was hard. They looked at the cake on the table. It smelled good.

"Please, Mom, please, Dad, can we have dessert now?" they asked together.

Mom and Dad smiled. They saw that Lily and Max had eaten most of their dinner. They were proud of them.

"Okay, okay, you can have dessert now. But only a small piece, okay?" Mom said.

"Yay! Thank you, Mom! Thank you, Dad!" Lily and Max said.

They ran to the table and grabbed their plates. Mom cut the cake and gave them each a slice. They filled their mouths with the cake. It was soft and sweet and delicious. They smiled and licked their lips.

"Mmm, this is the best dessert ever!" Lily said.

"I agree!" Max said.

They finished their cake and drank some milk. They felt happy and full. They thanked Mom and Dad for the dinner and the dessert. They hugged them and kissed them.

"Can we have cake again tomorrow?" Lily asked.

"Maybe, if you're good and patient," Mom said.

"We will, we promise!" Max said.

They went to brush their teeth and get ready for bed. They dreamed of chocolate and cream.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. She was very excited to go on an adventure. 

Anna put on her special dress and hopped into her car. Her dad drove her to the park. She could see the butterflies and the birds. She was so excited! 

They got out of the car and Anna ran all around the park. She found a big tree and some pretty flowers. Then, she spotted a jewel shining in the grass. 

Anna bent down and picked up the jewel. She showed it to her dad and he smiled. He put the jewel in a safe place so that it always stayed safe. 

Anna and her dad had a wonderful day. They laughed and played until the sun went down. Anna was very excited to take the jewel home in the car. 

Anna never forgot the day she found the jewel at the park.

Tim and Lily were playing with cards. They had to find two cards that were the same. That was matching. Tim was good at matching. He found many pairs of cards. Lily was not so good. She could not find many pairs.

"Look, Lily, I have more cards than you. I am better at matching," Tim said. He was proud of himself.

Lily felt sad. She wanted to be good at matching too. She asked Tim a question. "How do you find the cards that are the same? Can you help me?"

Tim did not want to help Lily. He wanted to win the game. He was ignorant. He did not care about Lily's feelings. He said, "No, I will not help you. You have to find them by yourself. It is easy. You are just slow."

Lily felt angry. She did not like Tim's words. She thought he was mean. She said, "You are not nice, Tim. You are not a good friend. I do not want to play with you anymore." She took her cards and left.

Tim was surprised. He did not understand why Lily was mad. He thought he was just playing. He did not know he hurt Lily's feelings. He was ignorant. He did not know how to be a good friend. He was alone with his cards. He felt sad too.

Once upon a time there was a thumb. It was so popular that everyone wanted to pay to see it. Every day, people would come from far and wide to take a peek. 

One day, a little 3 year old girl came along and decided to pay to see the thumb as well. She knew that it was going to be a special treat. 

When she got to the place where the thumb was, she was amazed! It was bigger than she had imagined and it looked so special. She touched it with her little finger and smiled to herself. 

The little girl was so excited that she decided to pay for a second visit. She went back again and again and soon the thumb was her most favorite thing in the world. 

The end.

There were two friends, Josh and Sarah. Josh was very competitive and wanted to win at everything. Whenever he did something Sarah would say, "Yay Josh!".

One day, Josh and Sarah had to go on a walk. Josh saw a lot of different things like trees and buildings. He also saw a lot of traffic. 

Josh said, "Wow, that's a lot of traffic". Sarah said, "Yeah, it sure is." They both looked carefully and Josh saw a blue truck. He said, "That truck is cool!"

Sarah said, "Yes, it sure is. We should be thankful that the drivers in the traffic are being safe." Josh said, "Thank you drivers!" Sarah smiled and said, "You're welcome."

They both crossed the street safely, grateful to all the drivers. Josh said, "I'm still competitive, but I'm also thankful too!" Sarah said, "Me too!"

Micky was a funny little mouse. He liked to do things differently. One day, he had an idea for a new game.

Micky went over to his friend Daisy's house. "Let's play a game!", he said. Daisy smiled.

Micky asked Daisy to stand on one foot and balance a juice bottle on her neck. They both had a lot of fun. Micky was very creative with his ideas.

Daisy said, "Wow, this is fun!" Micky grinned and said, "I like to do things differently."

They played the game for hours. Daisy got better and better at balancing the juice bottle.

At the end of the day, they hugged and said goodbye. Both of them had had a fun and creative day playing the balancing game.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to walk to the park with his mom. One day, they saw a group of kids playing with a football. Timmy wanted to play too but his mom said they didn't have one. 

Suddenly, a boy walked up to Timmy and his mom and said, "Do you want to play with our football?" Timmy was so happy and said "Yes please!" The boy gave Timmy the football and Timmy played with the other kids. 

After a while, Timmy's mom said it was time to go home. Timmy didn't want to leave the football behind. His mom asked him how much it cost and Timmy said, "It was expensive!" His mom smiled and said they would have to save up to buy one for Timmy to keep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a white cat named Snowy. Lily loved Snowy very much and she always took good care of her. One day, Snowy got sick and Lily knew she needed to take her to the vet. 

Lily asked her mom, "Mommy, can we go to the place where Snowy can get better?" 

Her mom replied, "Yes, we need to take Snowy to the vet. They will help her feel better." 

Lily and her mom went to the vet's place. The vet was very nice and told Lily that Snowy just needed some medicine. After a few days, Snowy was feeling much better and Lily was so happy. She hugged her white cat and said, "I'm so glad you're better now, Snowy."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play and have fun, but he didn't like to exercise. His mom would always tell him that exercise was important to stay healthy and strong, but Timmy just wanted to play with his toys.

One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy brought his favorite toy, a big red ball. Timmy wanted to play with it, but Billy said they had to exercise first. Timmy didn't want to exercise, so he got mad and said, "I don't want to exercise, I just want to play!"

Billy was generous and said, "Okay, we can play with the ball first and then exercise later." Timmy was happy and they played with the ball for a while. But then, the ball accidentally hit Timmy's mom's vase and it broke into many pieces.

Timmy was scared and said, "Mom is going to be mad! I wish the vase could disappear!" Billy said, "Don't worry, we can tell the truth and say it was an accident. It's better to be honest than to make things disappear." Timmy felt better and learned that being honest is always the best thing to do.

Bob liked to jog. He liked to jog in the park every day. He jogged around the big trees and around the lake. He liked to jog so much that he even jogged in his house.

One day, when he was jogging in his house, he saw a new TV. He ran over to look at it. It was a very good TV. It had lots of colors. He wanted it!

So Bob kept jogging. After a few days, he had jogged enough to earn the TV. He was so excited. 

He ran to his mom and showed her the TV. She said he could keep it because he had jogged so much. Bob was very happy. 

He went back to his house, put in the new TV and watched it. He was very happy with his good TV.

Once upon a time, there was a naughty little monkey who liked to play tricks. One day, he decided to play a trick on his friends. He told them he could reverse the direction of time! His friends waited and watched as he tried to do this trick. But nothing ever happened. In the end, they all laughed and the naughty monkey felt embarrassed.

Once upon a time, there was a musician. He liked to play music all day. One day, he played music near a big tree. The tree had a fruit that was rot. The smell was very bad.

The musician said, "Yuck! What is that smell?" A little girl came by and said, "It's the rot fruit from the tree. Don't go near it!" But the musician did not listen. He went close to the tree, and the smell made him dizzy.

The little girl helped the musician sit down. She said, "Next time, listen to me." The musician said, "Thank you. I will." From that day on, they played music together far away from the rot fruit tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, he found a match on the floor and picked it up. He asked his mom what it was and she told him it was a match. 

Timmy wanted to play with the match, but his mom told him it was not a toy and it was very dangerous. She said if he pushed too hard on it, it could start a fire. 

Timmy listened to his mom and promised not to play with the match anymore. He thanked his mom for keeping him safe and went back to playing with his toys. From that day on, Timmy knew that matches were not toys and he should never push too hard on them.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Dave. One day, Dave was at the park with his mom. He was playing with his toys, when suddenly, he saw a huge green trophy. He was so curious and he wanted to touch it. But his mom said no and told him to stay still. Dave was so excited and wanted the trophy so badly.

So he got up and ran towards the green trophy and grabbed it! His mom panicked and quickly ran towards Dave, while calling out his name. She was worried that he was hurt and was afraid of what might happen. She was relieved when she saw that Dave was ok.

But then, she remembered the trophy. She looked and Dave was holding the green trophy proudly. Dave had a huge smile on his face, and his mom couldn't help but smile too. She was so proud of Dave for being so brave. They took the trophy home and Dave kept it in his room. Every morning he would wake up and see the trophy. He was so happy to have it.

Once there was a distant pirate. He sailed across the sea and stopped when he saw an island. He wanted to explore it to see what was there. He got out of his boat and walked around for a while. 

He stopped at a tall tree and saw a shiny chest on the ground. He had found buried treasure! He opened the chest and saw a lot of coins and jewels inside. He was so excited and started to pick up the coins and jewels and put them in his pockets. 

Suddenly he heard a loud noise. He stopped and looked around, and saw a big pirate ship coming closer to the island. The big pirate ship was carrying a lot of other pirates. The distant pirate was scared and hid behind a bush. 

The pirates got off the ship and started to explore the island. They searched everywhere, but they could not find the distant pirate. After a while they got back on the ship and sailed away. 

The distant pirate was relieved and came out from behind the bush. He quickly grabbed the chest and the jewels and coins, got back on his boat and sailed away. He was very happy that the pirates had not found him.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was very eager to go outside and play. But a big lock was keeping her from going. She tried to open it but she wasn't strong enough.

Bravely, she knelt on the floor. She closed her eyes and made a wish. Suddenly, the lock opened! She was so excited that she jumped up in a joy.

The little girl ran outside. She said Hooray!

Then, a big lion came out of the bushes. The lion said, "What are you doing here?" 

The little brave girl knelt on the ground before the lion. She said, "Please let me play here. I just want to have some fun!"

The lion smiled. He said, "Yes, of course. You can stay and play."

So the little girl played and had a lot of fun. She was so thankful to the lion.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very miserable. She was unhappy all the time and her friends would try to make her laugh, but the little girl just would not laugh.

One day, the little girl's mom decided to give her a pill. She said "Take this pill and it will make you feel better". The little girl was scared, so she asked her mom "What will it do?". Her mom just smiled and replied "Just try it and you'll see".

The little girl reluctantly took the pill. After a few minutes, she started to feel different. Suddenly, she burst into laughter and couldn't stop! Her friends were so happy to see her finally happy.

"That pill really worked!", they said. The little girl was so glad that her mom had given her the pill - it had made her feel so wonderful and had taken her out of her miserable state!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sara. She loved to play with her mom's makeup. One day, she found her mom's original red lipstick. Sara wanted to look pretty like her mom, so she put the red lipstick on her lips.

Sara's mom saw her and said, "Sara, you look so pretty, but you are too young to wear makeup. Let's stay inside and play with your toys instead." Sara agreed and they went to play with her dolls.

As they played, Sara's mom told her that she was already beautiful without makeup. Sara learned that it was more important to be herself and have fun. She promised to stay away from the makeup until she was older.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, she found a shiny box that could open and close. It was very attractive, with lots of colors and sparkles.

Lily showed the box to her mom and said, "Look, Mommy! This box is so pretty. Can I keep it?"

Her mom replied, "Sure, Lily. But be careful with it. It's a special box that can record your voice."

Lily was excited and asked, "What does record mean?"

"It means the box can remember what you say and play it back to you later," her mom explained.

Lily spent the whole day playing with her new box, recording her songs and stories. She was so happy to have found something so special.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toy cars all day long. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to clean his room. Timmy didn't want to clean his room because he was having so much fun playing with his cars.

Timmy's mom said, "If you clean your room, you will have success and be happy." Timmy didn't understand what success meant, but he knew he wanted to be happy. So, he started cleaning his room. While he was cleaning, he accidentally knocked over his toy castle and destroyed it. Timmy felt sad because he loved his castle, but his mom said, "Don't worry, Timmy. You can always build a new one."

Timmy felt better and continued cleaning his room. When he was finished, he felt proud of himself and showed his mom. She said, "You did a great job, Timmy! You are so brave for cleaning your room even though you didn't want to." Timmy smiled and felt happy knowing he had success and made his mom proud.

Once upon a time there was a little bear called Bob. Bob lived in a little town with lots of other animals.

One day, Bob wanted to borrow an apple from his friend Rabbit. He went to Rabbit's house and knocked on the door.

"Hello, Bob!" Rabbit said. "What can I do for you?"

"Can I borrow an apple, please?" Bob asked.

Rabbit smiled. "Of course you can. Come inside, and you can pick one from the tree in my garden." 

So Bob went in and picked a nice, shiny apple from Rabbit's apple tree. Then he thanked his friend, said goodbye and ran back home. 

He was so excited to show his apple to his mom. When she saw it, she said, "Thank you, Bob. Now let's make a yummy apple pie!"

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a little girl named Lily. She had a big, fake toy elephant named Mr. Trunks. Lily loved to play with Mr. Trunks and spend time with him every day.

One sunny day, Lily and Mr. Trunks went to the park. They played on the swings, and they laughed a lot. Then, Lily found a peanut on the ground. She picked it up and showed it to Mr. Trunks.

Lily and Mr. Trunks decided to plant the peanut in the ground. They dug a small hole, put the peanut inside, and covered it with dirt. Every day, they would visit the peanut and give it water. Soon, a tiny plant grew from the ground. Lily and Mr. Trunks were very happy to see the plant grow. They spent lots of time taking care of it, and they became the best of friends.

Once there was a brave cat called Mimi. She liked to bounce around and have a lot of fun!

One day, Mimi was walking along a reef and she decided to bounce across it. She was so excited to see what was on the other side. She leapt and jumped and bounced until she reached the end of the reef.

Mimi was so brave and she was so proud of herself. But, when she looked around she realised she was still on the same reef!

Mimi bounced back and forth trying to figure out how to get off the reef. Eventually, she realised she could bounce high up and fly off the reef!

So that is exactly what she did. She bounced so high and she flew off the reef. Mimi was so proud of herself and she continued to bounce around and explore the world.

Oliver loved going outside to play. His favorite thing to do was to climb a hill behind his house. Today, he wanted to run really fast, so he asked his mom if he could go.

"Oliver, I'm sorry, I can't let you go," said his mom. 
"But why?" Oliver asked.

"Because it's too dangerous," said his mom. "You might slip and fall." 

Oliver wanted to go so much, that he started to cry. His mom hugged him and said, "I know you want to go, and I don't want to prevent you from having fun, but it's not safe. Maybe we can find a safer way to have fun outside."

So, Oliver and his mom went outside together and found a grassy hill. It was just big enough to climb up and down, and it was perfect for running fast. Oliver and his mom ran up and down it together, and they even built a slide down the hill so they could go faster. 

Oliver had so much fun, and his mom was happy she could prevent him from getting hurt while still letting him have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a frog named Fred. Fred lived in a pond with his friends. One day, Fred saw a butterfly and he hopped after it. He hopped and hopped until he found himself far away from the pond.

Fred was having so much fun chasing the butterfly that he didn't notice the sun was setting. Suddenly, he realized he was lost. He tried to hop back to the pond, but he didn't know which way to go.

Just then, he heard a voice. "Hello, little frog. Are you lost?" It was a wise old owl. "Yes," said Fred, "I can't find my way back to the pond." The owl looked serious and said, "Let's pause for a moment and think. Which way did you come from?" Together, they figured out the way back to the pond and Fred was so happy to be back with his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to unpack. One day, she was given a special box from her will. When she opened it, she was so excited. Inside was a dull toy. She quickly unpacked it and flung it around the room. She liked it so much, she decided to keep it forever. The little girl was happy to have a new toy to play with every day. This is why she loves to unpack!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a desk in his room where he liked to draw and color. One day, Timmy's mommy took him to the store to buy some new crayons. Timmy wanted the big box of crayons, but they were too expensive. So, Timmy's mommy bought him a cheap box of crayons instead.

When they got home, Timmy sat at his desk and started to color with his new crayons. Suddenly, he felt very cold. He looked outside and saw that it had started to snow. Timmy got up from his desk and went outside to play in the snow. He ran and jumped and played until he started to freeze. Then, Timmy went back inside and sat at his desk to warm up and continue coloring.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to dance. Every day she would print up a new dance to practice. Her dad told her that she was the greatest dancer around!

One day, the little girl went to eat lunch at school. She was served a bowl of bitter soup. She didn't like the bitter taste but she was a brave girl and still ate it. After she finished, she stood up and started to print around the room. All of her friends clapped and cheered for her.

That night, the little girl asked her dad for a special treat for being so brave. Her dad printed a bright and shiny new tutu for her. She was so happy and couldn't wait to wear it and go dancing. Every day from then on, she would put it on and print around the house.

The little girl became a great dancer and even taught her friends to dance too. Her dad would always tell her that she was the best dancer around!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Alice. She was three years old and she loved to play outside.

One day, when Alice was playing in the garden, she saw something unusual. It was a symbol that was getting bigger and bigger!

Alice ran to show her mum. Her mum was very surprised.

"What do you think it is, Alice?".

Alice said "I don't know. It just keeps increasing!"

Alice's mum smiled. "That's very unusual. Let's see what this symbol is all about!".

Alice and her mum walked closer to the symbol. As they got closer they could see numbers written on it.

Alice's mum explained that this was a special symbol called a multiplication sign.

Alice was so excited and she laughed. "Look Mum, the number keeps increasing!"

Alice's mum smiled and said, "Yes, that's right! This symbol helps us work out how to multiply numbers!"

Alice hugged her mum and said, "This is so cool!". From that day onwards, Alice kept increasing her knowledge of maths!

Once upon a time there was a large family. Each day they had to organize their lives. They worked together to make sure everyone was happy.

One day, the family decided to organize a picnic. They found a nice spot in the park, spread out a large blanket and everyone helped to bring food and drinks. 

When it was lunch time, the mom put the hot food on the blanket and everyone sat to eat. The food was delicious and the family ate until their bellies were full.

After lunch, everyone organized some games. They played tag and hide-and-seek and laughed a lot. At the end of the day, everyone was happy and it was the best day ever!

Once upon a time, there was an ugly guitar. It was not shiny and new like a regular guitar. Instead, it was old and worn.

The old guitar had been around for a long time. It lay in a corner of the house, forgotten. No one wanted to pick it up.

One day, a man came to visit. He saw the guitar and thought it was very sad. He picked it up, wiped it off and started to tune it.

Soon, he was strumming it. It made a beautiful sound! The man started to play a song, and it sounded wonderful.

Then, the man lay down the guitar and said he wanted to come back soon to play it again. The old, ugly guitar was happy to be loved and played with.

Jimmy was ready to go on his first aeroplane ride. His mum and dad filled his backpack with all the things he might need during the trip, and the aeroplane was waiting in the airport with the door open. 
Jimmy was so excited he couldn't help but jump up and down. Then he heard a noise and saw that someone was pouring coffee from a pot into small cups. It smelled so good!
When he got on the aeroplane, his eyes grew wide with excitement. He sat in his seat and looked out the window as the aeroplane started to move. Soon, they were in the air and Jimmy felt like he was flying away. 
He waved to his mum and dad as the aeroplane flew high above the clouds, and he knew that this was going to be a really fantastic adventure!

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three-years-old and her name was Polly. One day, Polly's Mom said it was time to bathe.

First, they filled the tub with warm water. Polly got in and had a lot of fun playing with her rubber duck.

While she was splashing around, her Mom put a potato in the roasting pan. When it was time for Polly to get out of the tub, her Mom took the delicious potato out of the oven.

Polly dried off, put on her pajamas, and then sat down with her Mom to enjoy her yummy dinner. She loved it! She thought the potato was even more delicious than a slice of cake!

Molly was a cheerful three-year-old who loved to make snow angels in the winter. One day, she asked her mom if she could go outside and make a snow angel.

Her mom said, "Yes, but you must prepare. Put on your mittens, your boots and your hat."

Molly was so excited that she started to put on all of the things that her mom had suggested. She put on her blue mittens, her warm boots and her pink hat.

Once she was prepared, she ran outside. She found the perfect spot in the snow and began to spread her arms and legs to make a snow angel. After she finished, she was so proud of her masterpiece.

She saw her mom watching her and smiled. Her mom said, "How cheerful you are, Molly."

Molly beamed with pride and went back inside to warm up.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved ice cream cones and would always ask her mom for one whenever they went out. One day, they went to the park to play and Lily's mom bought her an ice cream cone. It was so delicious and peaceful to eat.

Suddenly, a boy came up to Lily and asked for a bite of her ice cream cone. Lily didn't want to share because she only had one, but her mom told her that it's always good to supply others with what we have. So, Lily gave the boy a bite and he smiled and thanked her.

Later that day, Lily and her mom went to the store and saw the boy from the park. He was crying because he lost his toy truck. Lily remembered what her mom said and decided to supply the boy with her favorite toy, a teddy bear. The boy hugged the teddy bear and stopped crying.

Lily's mom was proud of her for being kind and sharing with others. The moral of the story is that it's always good to supply others with what we have, even if it's just a little bit.

Once upon a time there was a crab who was very thoughtful. She wanted to record her thoughts, so she started planning. She was determined to make the perfect recording.

The crab gathered some materials to make her own recording device. She found a shell, some paper and some string to use. She put it all together and made her own machine.

She pressed the big red button and started to record. She spoke into the shell and told all her thoughts. She spoke about being kind and thoughtful to all the animals in the sea.

When she was done, she stopped the recording and smiled. She was so proud of her work. Then she put her recording device on the beach and shared her ideas with everyone. 

The crab was delighted that she was able to record her thoughts. She was very pleased with her results. That night she went to sleep with a happy heart, happy that she was able to share her thoughtful ideas with the world.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy staff. Its name was Clumsy. Tom and Jill had never seen a staff like Clumsy before. They fed Clumsy some nice treats and wanted to play with it.

Jill wanted to hold Clumsy, so Tom gave it to her. But Clumsy was so clumsy that it slipped out of Jill's hands and fell on the ground.

Tom and Jill were sad when the clumsy staff was broken. So the two friends decided to make a new staff for Clumsy.

They took some sticks and tied them together. Tom and Jill painted it beautiful colors and called it "New Clumsy". Then they gave it back to the clumsy staff.

From that day forward, Clumsy was never clumsy anymore. Tom and Jill were happy and enjoyed playing with New Clumsy!

Tom and Lily were playing in the yard. They had a big box of tools and toys. Tom liked to use the hammer and nails. Lily liked to use the paint and brushes. They wanted to make something perfect.

They found some wood and started to work. Tom hammered the wood together. Lily painted it with bright colors. They made a birdhouse. They were very happy.

"Look, we made a birdhouse!" Tom said. "It is perfect for the birds!"

"Yes, it is!" Lily said. "Let's hang it on the tree!"

They ran to the tree and hung the birdhouse on a branch. They waited for the birds to come.

But then they saw smoke. There was a fire in the yard. It was coming from the trash can. Someone had thrown a match in it. The fire was big and hot. It started to burn the grass and the flowers.

"Fire! Fire!" Tom and Lily shouted. "Help! Help!"

They ran to the house and told their mom. She called the firemen. They came with a big red truck and a loud siren. They sprayed water on the fire. They put it out.

"Are you okay, kids?" the fireman asked.

"Yes, we are okay," Tom and Lily said. "But our birdhouse!"

They looked at the tree. The fire had burned the branch. The birdhouse had fallen to the ground. It was broken and black.

"Oh, no!" Tom and Lily cried. "Our birdhouse is ruined!"

They were very sad.

"I'm sorry, kids," the fireman said. "But you did a good thing. You told your mom and you stayed away from the fire. You are brave and smart."

He gave them a hug and a sticker. He said they could come to the fire station and see the truck and the tools.

"Really?" Tom and Lily asked.

"Really," the fireman said. "And maybe you can make another birdhouse. A new and perfect one."

Tom and Lily smiled. They thanked the fireman. They still loved their hammer and paint. They still wanted to make something perfect. They decided to try again.

Once there was a poor little mouse. He was so small that no one could see him unless they looked very carefully. One day, the mouse decided to go and search for food. He ran and ran until he spotted a tall chimney. After a few jumps, he was at the top of the chimney. But alas! when the mouse got to the top of the chimney he was very surprised. The chimney was empty. The mouse was so disappointed that he started to cry. As he was crying he felt something soft and round. He looked down and, with joy, he saw that it was a big delicious cheese. As he went to grab the cheese, he dropped it! The cheese fell from the chimney and far away from the mouse. He was very sad, but he knew he would find something else to eat.

Ben likes to paint. He has many colors and brushes. He paints cars and trees and houses on paper. He is happy when he paints.

One day, Ben sees a wire on the floor. It is long and thin and shiny. He thinks it is a snake. He wants to paint the snake. He picks up the wire and puts it on his paper.

But the wire is not a snake. It is a wire from the lamp. It is hot and has electricity. When Ben touches the wire, he feels a shock. He screams and drops the wire. He is hurt and scared.

Mom hears Ben scream. She runs to him and sees the wire and the paint. She is angry and worried. She says, "Ben, what did you do? You are not supposed to play with wires. They are dangerous. You could have been killed. You are a bad boy."

Ben cries and says, "I'm sorry, Mom. I wanted to paint the snake. I didn't know it was a wire. Please don't be mad at me."

Mom hugs Ben and says, "I'm not mad at you, Ben. I'm glad you are alive. But you have to be careful. You have to listen to me. You have to learn from your mistake. Do you understand?"

Ben nods and says, "Yes, Mom. I understand. I won't play with wires again. I will only paint with brushes."

Mom takes Ben to the doctor. The doctor says Ben has a burn on his hand. He gives Ben a bandage and a medicine. He says Ben will be fine. But Ben is sad and frustrated. He can't paint with his hand. He can't paint the snake. He can't paint anything. He hates the wire. He hates the lamp. He hates the paint. He hates himself. He wishes he never saw the wire. He wishes he never tried to paint the snake. He wishes he could go back in time and do something else. But he can't. He has to live with his mistake. He has to live with his pain. He has to live with his mom's anger. He has to live with his own guilt. He has no happy ending.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little girl. She wanted to explore the world, but she was too scared to go very far. One day, she asked her neighbour if she could lend her something to help her. The neighbour had an idea and gave her a bulb. The little girl took the bulb and lit it. The bulb was so bright and cheery, it made the little girl brave. She took the bulb and went outside to explore. With the bulb's help, the little girl was able to go on all sorts of adventures. She explored the world with the bulb and she was no longer scared. The little girl was eternally grateful to her neighbour for lending her the bulb. The End.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to do many things together, but they are also different. Anna likes to play with dolls and draw pictures. Ben likes to play with cars and build blocks. Sometimes they share, and sometimes they fight.

One day, their mom takes them to the market. The market is a big place with many people and things. Mom wants to buy some food and clothes. Anna and Ben want to see the toys and books.

"Mom, can we go to the toy stall?" Anna asks.

"Mom, can we go to the book stall?" Ben asks.

Mom says, "Not now, we have to get the things we need first. Then we can look at the toys and books."

Anna and Ben are not happy. They complain and whine. They say, "Mom, this is boring. We want to see the toys and books. Why do we have to wait?"

Mom says, "Please be patient and quiet. We will go to the toy and book stalls soon. But first we have to get the food and clothes. They are important for us."

Anna and Ben do not listen. They keep complaining and whining. They make a lot of noise. Mom is angry and tired. She says, "That's enough. If you don't stop complaining and whining, we will not go to the toy and book stalls at all. We will go home right now."

Anna and Ben are scared. They do not want to go home without seeing the toys and books. They say, "Sorry, Mom. We will be good. We will stop complaining and whining. We will wait for you."

Mom says, "Thank you. I'm glad you understand. Now let's finish our shopping and then we can go to the toy and book stalls."

Anna and Ben nod and smile. They hold Mom's hand and follow her. They are quiet and polite. They hope to see some toys and books that they like. They also hope that Mom will buy them something. They think that maybe being different is not so bad, as long as they can share and have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. It was her birthday and she was very excited. Her mommy baked a cake and they decorated the house with balloons and streamers. 

Lily's friends came over and they played games and sang "Happy Birthday". But then, something terrible happened. One of the balloons popped and scared Lily's cat. The cat ran away and Lily was very sad. 

Her mommy tried to comfort her and said, "Don't worry, we'll find your cat." But Lily didn't want to act happy anymore. She wanted her cat back. They searched everywhere but couldn't find the cat. Lily's birthday ended terribly and she cried herself to sleep.

Once upon a time there was a flower. It was very old and dead. One day, a small boy walked by and saw the flower. He wanted to make it come alive again. He felt sorry for the flower and bent down in front of it. He opened his hand and held it out to the flower. In his hand was a tiny seed. He said, "I will make you better." The flower opened its petals and the tiny seed landed inside. Suddenly, the flower started to grow and become alive again. The boy was so happy. He jumped for joy and hugged the flower. The dead flower was now growing and happy. The end.

Once there was a little girl named Anna. She was curious and always wanted to explore. One day, Anna wanted to go on an adventure and find a mystery. She stopped at the edge of a forest and said, "Today I'm going to find a mystery!"

So Anna took a few steps into the forest. It was very dark and she couldn't see anything. But as she kept walking, she saw something. There were lots of leaves all over the ground. It was very messy!

Then Anna heard a noise. It was loud and made her stop. What could it be? Anna kept walking and soon she saw something. It was a big, old tree with a door on it. Anna opened the door and saw a very big secret inside. It was amazing!

Anna was so excited that she couldn't stop exploring. She found a lot of neat things. But eventually, she knew it was time to go home. 

So Anna left the forest with lots of new stories and adventures. She had found a mystery and it was even messier than she ever expected!

Once upon a time, three friends, named Mike, Sarah, and Nina, went on an adventure to the shore. Mike was strong and brave and Nina was nervous, but Sarah was excited to see what was there.

The friends arrived at the shore and it was beautiful. The sand was soft and the water was blue. The friends started to explore the beach and Mike found a giant shell.
 "Look at this! What should I do with it?" Mike said.

Sarah had an idea. "Let's store it in my backpack so we can show everyone how pretty it is!" Mike and Nina thought that sounded like a great idea so they stored the shell in Sarah's backpack.

The three friends played at the shore all day. They ran and laughed and had lots of fun in the sun. Later on, Mike caught a fish and the friends all cheered. That night, they went home with lots of good memories of their adventure to the shore.

Once there was a girl called Sam. She was very busy and loved to play. One day, she went to a hotel with her family. 

The hotel was busy. There were lots of people. Sam liked to throw things and she wanted to throw something fun. 

Sam found a softball and she wanted to throw it. She asked her mum if she could throw it outside. Mum said yes, so Sam ran outside to the garden and threw the ball as far as she could. She laughed as it flew through the air.

Sam threw the ball again and again. She had so much fun playing outside. Finally, it was time to go home and Sam said goodbye to the hotel. 

Sam was very tired after such a busy day. It had been so much fun throwing the softball!

Once upon a time there was a beetle who was ashamed. He had never seen anything like the other beetles and he felt really lonely.

One day he decided to explore a bit. He saw a flower in the garden and he wanted to examine it. As he looked closer, he saw there were lots of creatures living inside the flower!

He was so excited and he said 'hello' to them all. They all said hello back and were very friendly. The beetle was so happy he had made some friends.

He wanted to thank the flower so he gave it a big hug. He was so glad he decided to examine it! From then on he was never ashamed again.

Once there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They were both very excited to go to the station. Jack wanted to buy something popular, so he had his pocket money ready.

When Jack and Jill stepped onto the station, they quickly heard a loud snap. The station was crowded and everyone was looking around to see what had happened. Then they saw it, a big sign had snapped and was now broken on the ground.

Jack and Jill looked at each other, they both knew the sign was popular. People used the sign to find their way around so there was a lot of confusion now. Jack and Jill decided to help the station and quickly picked up the sign.

Jack and Jill were happy to have helped the station and soon the sign was back in place, ready for people to use. Jack and Jill smiled at each other, they had done a good job.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went outside to play in the park. She had a pocket in her dress to keep her toys in. She loved to play with her toys in the park.

Suddenly, a big dog appeared out of nowhere. The dog barked really loudly and scared Lily. She quickly put her toys in her pocket and ran away. She was so scared that she hid behind a tree.

After a while, Lily's mom came looking for her. Lily told her mom about the big dog that scared her. Her mom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I'm here to protect you." They went home together, and Lily was happy to be safe with her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his toys. One day, the wind blew so hard that his favorite toy plane flew away. Timmy cried and cried because he loved that plane so much. 

His mom came outside and saw him crying. She hugged him and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. We'll find your plane." She was a reliable mom who always kept her promises. 

The next day, they went outside to look for the plane. The wind was blowing again, but this time it was helping them. It blew the plane back to Timmy's backyard. He was so happy that he cried tears of joy. He hugged his mom and said, "Thank you for being reliable and finding my plane!"

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. Mia wants to go on the slide. Tom is scared.

"Come on, Tom. It is fun. You can do it." Mia urges Tom.

Tom shakes his head. He does not want to go on the slide. He thinks it is too high and too fast.
